author: Anthony Nieves
review_text: Whoever thought of this place is a genius, a moderately small space but lots of choice, friendly staff, fast service, and an app that lets you order seamlessly and has Google pay as an option. 10/10 would recommend and the food is just the icing on the cake, amazing tender and seasoned boneless chicken with tasty, crispy fries, this is just an absolute unicorn of a place and you should try it! If the owner is looking at this, I would love to be a part of any advertising/ promotion because I enjoy this place so much!

author: Joan Ng
review_text: We had an ocean-view table facing the sea and it was really relaxing! Loved the breeze and the whole vibe – very chill and great for sunset. Food was not bad too. Because we were seated near the rock side, there were quite a lot of ants and flies around the table, so just take note if you’re sensitive to that. Service during dinner was okay, but after we finished, it suddenly started to rain heavily. The staff did come out with umbrellas, but it didn’t feel very helpful or friendly when trying to guide customers out or get to the car. The umbrella is for themselves to use 🥲 Overall, still a beautiful spot with a lovely sea view and wind – but a little room to improve on the service especially during rain. ✨

author: Rodney Montgomery
review_text: We waited in line for over 30 minutes to get our breakfast today, and throughout that time, no one communicated with us about our order. When I asked if our order had been called, an employee simply said, “I’m not sure,” and walked away instead of trying to find out what happened. It actually took my mother asking for a refund before our order was finally given to us. I’m really confused about why the wait time was so long—especially since there’s no drive-thru. From what we saw, there seemed to be enough staff to handle the morning rush. Unfortunately, no one was communicating or assisting customers, and the experience felt robotic and unorganized. I won’t be returning after this experience.

author: Journey4Peace
review_text: Joloff is not good to me, they give u sooo much rice w very little meat, then what I thought was a trky wing I purchased on the side an it was just the tip, which was hard...very hard an chewy, tiny piece of cow foot just the bone, happened twice, i decided to gv another chance but im good now, we need zoodoo African spot back, the customer service is rushed but the tip jar is rte there , oh also over priced

author: Gatsuka L
review_text: No wait on a weekday morning just after 8am so we could choose our table. Prices are very affordable and the fried fish in bean sauce was fresh & tasty. Rice with fried pork and vegetable was good as wok's breath (wok hei) was present in the vegetables & good marinade in the pork. But the crab meat on the curry and scrambled egg with rice was not as substantial as pics by others. There was also hardly curry taste. Soup with bamboo pith was chockful of bamboo pith, sliced shitake mushrooms and button mushrooms but it clearly tasted of artificial seasoning. Drinks tasted alright. Maybe will visit again if I'm in the vicinity and need a quick bite as the rice dishes come out fast but will not queue for it.

author: Coco Choi
review_text: It was really nice food and it’s my first time to enjoy our barbecue cooling that was like pulled pork it’s very soft and very tasty.

author: Belle K
review_text: It's a cute spot. You're surrounded by greenery, and it's very chilled, no unnecessary frills. We had a salted caramel cream white coffee and a peanut butter cream white coffee which were very nice. Unfortunately, the croissants were terrible, but in their defence, we haven't found anywhere in Da Nang or Hanoi that do croissants well, so maybe the dry texture might be the preference here. Would definitely come again for the coffee.

author: thivan2000
review_text: Updated 2024: They provide clean spoons. Service is now better. But let's be patient with them on peak hours. 2022: Dirty spoons. Not the first time.

author: Bernabe rramirez
review_text: Very good the servicio Rosario help us to get our sandwiches . We recommend

author: oscarwong78
review_text: Great cuisine and great live music. Whenever you are feeling nostalgic and crave delicious Chinese dishes with harmonious flavors

author: Ken Tan
review_text: Exquisite Cafe - best lemon tea. This brings out the nuances and flavour of the lemon 🍋 in the tea

author: Danni G
review_text: Such a great experience for my entire family — all 17 of us! While in Miami awaiting our cruise, we stopped by Miam for brunch, and it did not disappoint! The food was absolutely DELICIOUS and the portions were huge. 🍳🥞 Our server, Karè, took such good care of us and made the experience even better. From the Eggs Benedict to the French Toast, Nutella Pancakes, and Breakfast Burrito, you really can’t go wrong here. Highly recommend if you’re ever in the area!

author: Chimere oronzi
review_text: The food hall has a variety of foods to offer. It's cute and surprisingly very clean. We went to Mike and Patty's because we saw they had vegan options. My husband got the vegan Burrito, and I ordered the vegan classic. Firstly, the girl working gave me a regular egg and cheese, so I took it back to explain that I requested to make it vegan. I didn't like her response and tone when I tried to have my order corrected. Telling me that I didn't order a vegan sandwich. When I sure wouldn't have ordered a regular one because I don't eat regular eggs. That is why I rated the service with 3 stars. The rating does not apply to the entire food hall and other vendors. Just my encounter with the employee from Mike and Patty's.

author: Eason Neoh
review_text: Taste: 4.5 stars , quite tasty and delicious. Ambience: it’s a 1-2stars environment, air is not well ventilated and warm, table top is acceptable but I won’t touch it, the floor is of course expected to be yer… 😅

author: CE.C Foo
review_text: I think easily the best restaurant in Canggu! If you don’t come here, you are missing out. Every dish was so yummy, we would love to order more but we are trying to control ourselves. I love love love the strawberry guava tart!!

author: Orn Lucky
review_text: The restaurant is decorated cutely and warmly. The staff provides excellent service. The taste of the food is not very spicy. It might be adjusted to accommodate foreign customers.

author: Edmond McClure
review_text: Great place right on the beach!!! The food and service were amazing. It was a perfect spot for our last night in FL before heading home.

author: Aussie Abroad
review_text: Love this spot, really casual, laid back vibe with easy eats and screens for anyone who wants to watch sports… personally I prefer to watch the comings and going’s from the water from here 🛥️!

author: Abismael Diaz Melendez
review_text: Outstanding service and absolutely great food. ¡Fenomenal!

author: BR AL
review_text: I went to this buffet last night with my girlfriend, and the place was completely packed. The first thing we noticed at the entrance was the strong smell of detergent and the amount of cleaning chemicals sitting out in the open, which already felt unusual. When we sat down and went to get food, most of the plates and serving areas looked messy and not properly cleaned. The utensils used to grab the food weren’t actually dirty, but it looked like leftover food from previous customers was still stuck on them. It didn’t seem like they were being replaced or wiped down regularly. I went back to the table and saw that my girlfriend had filled her plate but looked extremely uncomfortable because of the place not being clean. At that point, I told the waitress that we wanted to leave. She noticed we had only been there for about five minutes and asked if we didn’t like the food, and I confirmed. Despite leaving immediately and not eating anything, they still charged us the full amount. She even pointed to the tip line on the receipt to make sure I didn’t forget to add a tip, which felt inappropriate given the circumstances.

author: Celeste Kerina
review_text: LOVED EVERYTHING! The gracious services, attention from management and the attention to detail for our food allergies. The food was DELICIOUS. This will be our new go to spot!

author: Ilana Ash
review_text: This place is awesome!! Our server Calista was so sweet, very prompt, and made excellent recommendations! This was our first visit and certainly not our last. The cafe itself was so cute, very clean, and offered a lovely outdoor dining patio as well. My only negative, was it seemed like the AC wasn’t working, in which it was very uncomfortably warm, and the tables were very very close together (which is understandable as they made the most of the beautiful space they have). Overall, would absolutely recommend this spot, and will be back!

author: Amy B
review_text: Wow! Easily the best meal I had in Miami! The location is great, in the marina, but the food is what stood out. The pulled pork (lechon asado) and tamal (not pictured) were fantastic! The mashed potatoes, steamed vegetables and plantains were also fantastic. We actually ate here twice during our vacation because it was that good. The staff was very friendly and attentive. Cannot recommend this place enough!

author: Ann Ng
review_text: Bánh mì Bà Huỳnh (Madam Win) is quite a famous bánh mì shop in Saigon, always busy with both delivery drivers and walk-in customers. 🥖 The baguette is crispy on the outside and soft inside, with generous fillings — rich and flavorful meat, fresh cucumber, herbs, and pickled vegetables. It’s very filling, and the portion is so big that one person might not even be able to finish it! 🥬 My only small drawback is that the pickled vegetables are on the sweet side. Personally, I prefer them more sour as it helps cut through the richness. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 After dining in, we also ordered a couple more to take away for the family, and everyone was satisfied. 📦 I was pleasantly surprised by the takeaway packaging. Instead of just paper bags, they use proper boxes, and even separate the herbs and pickled vegetables individually — very neat, clean, and thoughtful. 💰 Small size is 50,000 VND, big size is 75,000 VND. Considering the District 1 location, portion, and packaging, I think the price is reasonable. Overall, it’s a very good bánh mì experience. Definitely worth trying if you’re nearby! 🍞🌿🥒

author: Stan Kuleshov
review_text: Great spot with amazing seafood. The oysters were super fresh, the hazy beer was perfect, and the lobster roll really hit the spot. Service was awesome too — very attentive and detail-oriented without feeling over the top. Everything came out just right. Would definitely come back.

author: Alexander Herrschfeld
review_text: If you are looking for a spot in Uluwatu to enjoy a drink while watching the sun dip below the horizon, Malini Uluwatu is a solid choice. The absolute highlight of this location is the view. Perched on the cliffs, it offers a breathtaking, unobstructed panorama of the Ocean that is hard to beat, especially during the golden hour. Regarding the food, it was okay but nothing particularly special. The food didn't quite stand out compared to other dining options in the area. It’s perfectly fine for a casual meal, but don't expect a high end culinary experience. The service, however, was a bright spot. The staff members are incredibly friendly, welcoming, and always ready to help with a smile, which adds a nice touch to the atmosphere. One thing to note is that the facilities feel a bit dated. The venue is showing its age and could definitely benefit from some maintenance.

author: Viale M
review_text: Our experience at this dumpling house was a mix of practical positives and some notable drawbacks. On the plus side, the dumplings are decent, and the prices are fair. The steady stream of delivery drivers in motorcycle helmets suggests its main business is takeout. For walk-in customers like us, this meant there was no wait and plenty of available seating, which was a convenience. However, the physical space could use some attention; it felt a bit shabby and worn. A more significant issue for us was the menu's lack of vegetarian main courses. Aside from a few appetizers, there were very limited options for anyone in our party who was vegetarian, making it a difficult choice for a group with mixed dietary needs. In summary, this is a functional spot for a quick, affordable meal of decent dumplings, especially if you're dining in and want to avoid a wait. However, the shabby interior and the near-total lack of vegetarian entrees make it difficult to recommend for group dining or for those seeking a more polished experience. As ordinary consumers, we are not paid or compensated in any way for this review. We offer this feedback to help other diners make an informed choice.

author: Isabeau Terlouw
review_text: The food was very tasty and the staff was super friendly! While we stayed in San Francisco we have had breakfast at Kate”s Kitchen twice. The coffee and food was great. They also gave us blueberry pancakes and Hush puppies to try. Definitely would recommend, it made our stay even more great! Greetings from the Netherlands :)

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Taka H
review_text: Small grab and good spot Orangetheory fitness and semi close to Marriott A decent amount of outdoor seating and friendly service. They actually brought the food out and consistently checked in Donnie’s breakfast burrito was Phil. I love how it’s loaded with tons of mushrooms and well-balanced. The OG breakfast burrito was also amazing if you like your baking crispy or your potatoes crispy, I will let them know Avocado toast looks like a popular item since I saw a lot of people get it along with her açaí bowls Had the blue crush smoothie which is really good the blue spirulina, blueberries, and coconut whip cream definitely blended well Love this spot and nothing but positive vibes definitely will be coming back

author: Oscar N
review_text: I have to say I didn't expect this place to be as good as it was, food was excellent and our server Elena was very polite and attentive she made the experience even better and I will definitely be returning to this place, I need to try the rest of the menu ☺️

author: Fah Lunla And Luna
review_text: Duck leg noodles are good. For those who like a mild ginger soup, the ginger smell is not too strong. This shop is good. The duck meat is well-made, tender, not tough, no fishy smell. When cut, it falls off the bone. The innards are clean and well-made, no smell. - Steamed dumplings are very delicious. Dip them with the shop's dipping sauce. There is sweet and sour sauce. * But the shop doesn't steam them fresh in the microwave, so some parts are a bit hard, but only a little.

author: Heidi Liou
review_text: If you’re going to order directly and physically come here (vs using Uber eats for example), make sure you order ahead. Highly recommend Brady’s Bakery for delicious cookies! We just got the cookies to go rather than the “made to order” cookies since we didn’t want to wait longer.

author: Neelam Larm
review_text: Excellent customer service, food was delicious flavored, rustic retro atmosphere. Overall I would like to give 4.5 but don't know how. Lamb chops was excellent flavor and mint jelly to to top it off. Only thing I didn't care for was, it was little tough. Everything else we had ordered on the side was excellent.

author: E L
review_text: We went in late on a quiet weekday evening. The restaurant is very cozy and clean, with good music playing. The food itself was also really good and the portion sizes were balanced -- most of us had just enough leftovers to bring home for a second meal. The owner and the server were both amiable and attentive. No complaints! It was lovely.

author: Riccardo
review_text: Buzzy/noisey atmosphere at the entrance, good host and reception with drinks at the bar before table was ready. Waiters not really alert, they messed up with my order, still smiley at least. The pizza is very good/authentic Italian, average price 20 dollars each, but the service is very slow(and I mean it). Can’t say I loved the dessert as I left most of the pancake. Will still be definitely back as the it’s probably best pizza in Brooklyn.

author: Elisha Peterson S. K. Teo
review_text: Very good Babi Guling. This outlet number 3 is my favorite. It’s a little hard to find but is actually the home of Ibu Oka. Nestled in a very green area.

author: ahmad sadiq
review_text: I have been there just recently. The place is under new management. And they have changed their menu. They have amazing burgers and indian desserts. 👌 Must try

author: Abri
review_text: 5/5 Food 5/5 Customer Service 5/5 Ambiance 4/5 Drinks (pricey downtown prices) Amazing experience!!! It is fun, the music and live music is great!! The food is so delicious. I have been at least 4 times and everytime has been a blast. The servers are kind, friendly, and helpful. This time we got corn and garlic parmesean wings and it's was busssinn (so damn good) the time before we have gotten lemon pepper wings and shrimp ceasar salad which is also very food. The catfish stripes are also very delicious. The cornbread appetizer is to die for, my absolutely favorite. The drinks are kinda of pricey but are very good. When crowded the food takes a long time but the servers sometimes bless you with a free drink if the food takes too long. Highly recommend. If you don't like loud music and loud talking don't go here.

author: Fauzan Nazar
review_text: This is my first time visiting this restaurant during my holiday with my family here in Penang. They served us delicious food for dinner, and we absolutely loved it! It was a wonderful dining experience with my family. I highly recommend this place to everyone. From the bottom of my heart, I wish Wooden Wagon all the best—keep serving great food and excellent service!

author: Cheryl Jackson
review_text: What a great little find! Authentic Indian food that’s absolutely delicious at a very reasonable price. This is a no frills place, so if you’re looking for atmosphere, this is not your jam. But the food is the real star here. Most dishes are offered in mild, medium or hot. Friendly wait staff, too! I’ll definitely will be returning soon, if only for take out.

author: Phillip Smith
review_text: The food was amazing. Coconut cheesecake was really delicious. When we left it was pouring rain with no end in sight. Our hotel was just a short walk and one of the workers walked us home with his umbrella. That was really kind and very good customer service

author: Gissel Avila
review_text: We were a big party and they were able to accommodate us with no issues. The staff was friendly, the service was fast, and the place was clean.

author: Michelle Pham
review_text: The best banh mi place I had while exploring Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City! Its pricier than most banh mi in the city but its worth is. The bread amazing,meat cuts thick, pate delicious. The banh mi is huge. I ate half for lunch and ate the other half for dinner.

author: Liz S
review_text: No my first time in Vegas, but my first time at Broken Yolk and it did not disappoint! The food, the drinks, the service 10/10! My husband order the sopes, my son order the Diablo omelet and I ordered the ranchero skillet. We shared lemon custard pancakes and frozen drink flight. We were stuffed and there was food left over! Nice portions, good flavors and overall amazing service. Totally recommend!

author: George Cendejas
review_text: I ordered Large fries and received fries in a box still flat, not opened all the way. Theyre stingy on the fries. The cashier told me it doesnt make a difference.

author: Victoria Figueroa
review_text: Biggins was our server today, and I must say that his attention to our preferences and his ability to anticipate everything we needed made him an outstanding asset to this location. Since it was Mother’s Day, he remained composed, detail-oriented, and truly enhanced our experience. I was out with my mom, uncle, and grandmother, and while we don't go out often (mostly just on holidays or special occasions) we felt welcomed and never rushed. Overall, it was a wonderful experience. Bravo! A genuine personality goes a long way in service, and Biggins exemplified this. Thank you all once again. We will definitely come back on our next outing!

author: Luis Torres
review_text: This is a solid 3.5. View is amazingHe hadn't fears.Great, but the food leaves a lot to be desired. But this review is just my opinion. The fried snapper had good flavor but was extremely dry. The ceviche portion was generous but it looked like it was just thrown lazily thrown together (precooked shrimp no fish or octopus) and lacked flavor. If you love resort drinks you’ll love the frozen stuff here. They just taste off.

author: Pedro Rico Jr
review_text: Great service and tacos. I love lengua tacos and theirs remind me of home. 100% recommend trying this place at least once.

author: Berta Gonzalez-Eloy
review_text: We had an amazing experience at Mykonos Kitchen and Bar! The service, especially from Matias, was excellent — he was incredibly attentive and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our meal. The quality of the food was absolutely incredible, every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. The view was very nice, and the atmosphere was warm and inviting. The live music was definitely a plus and made the evening even more enjoyable. Highly recommend!

author: niki kaur
review_text: We ordered our baby shower 2 tier cake from Argentina bakery, this has been our go-to bakery for all big and small occasions given their exceptionally delicious cakes! I showed them a reference picture of what I wanted, something simple with a few cake toppers (ordered by me and dropped off for them to decorate). To say that the cake was LOVED would be an understatement, the cake was devoured within minutes. The flavors were fantastic especially their famous Dulce De Leche. Our Tier 1 was Dulce De Leche, Chocolate with fresh strawberries and Tier 2 base was Dulce de Leche with chocolate, both were phenomenal! Everyone at the bakery is so warm and friendly and they listen to you to deliver exactly what you need.

author: Joel Headley
review_text: Update: another visit to Vegas with another great visit to Ono. There are plenty of other all you can eat places, but I'd be worried we would have said, Oh no, had we visited there. White the rules are still listed in the menu, the waiter seems eager to make us happy rather than stick to the letter of the law. I had the deep fried rice which had spicy tuna and is sauced to finish my meal. Great easy to end it. _________________ Great sushi in Vegas? Ono Sushi has shown it's possible. If you eat like I do, the lunch all-you-can-eat sushi is a great deal. All sushi and food is still prepared each order and comes out looking, and ultimately tasting great. There's a 90 minute limit on the meal, and you get charged for leftovers if you can't eat what is ordered, but loosen the belt and get as much as you can.

author: lynn koh
review_text: I din a lot as I was full. I ordered the grilled pork and fried spring roll. Overall the food was good! Especially the grilled pork. The service was above averaged, we was serve by a young guy, he recommended their must try food n beverages. He was very friendly.. Thumb up to him! Please keep it up.

author: Wolf Raven
review_text: The place looked great — clean, stocked, plenty of choices, everything warm and fresh on the surface. But the taste? That’s where the wheels came off. Most of the food was either bland or just… off. I grabbed a deviled egg, and whatever that flavor was, it sure wasn’t “egg.” Tried a hotdog next — it acted like it wanted to be all-beef, but it missed the mark and limped in with a weird, almost-there flavor. Good presentation, zero payoff.

author: Bella
review_text: I’ve always like eating here, because the food is delicious, the ambience is great, but sometimes it takes too long to be seated. So i always choose best time that not too crowded and i enjoyed it. I ordered pork eschalot pasta, and it was delicious! They were very generous with the pork! The oolong is okay and lemon cake is okay.😊

author: Sharon
review_text: 3.5 ⭐ for this landmark Ipoh Hor Fun. Hor fun is silky smooth with slightly sweet soup. However, chicken was slightly tough and a tad dry. Beans sprouts crunchy and juicy. Overall, a very salty meal.

author: jerena teo
review_text: What an amazing experience dining within the rice field! Perfect place to have lunch before kanto lampo waterfall (close distance). Food was good paired with their cold coconut. Place is also kids friendly- highchair available, non Chili food for kids are also available. Will be back!

author: Irwin Harith
review_text: Had an amazing time for dinner last night. First time at the High Tide Bistro and Bar. Was recommended the butter chicken pizza and it was delicious! We all had a beef quesadilla which was also yummy. Will definitely come back again :)

author: Maria Fernanda Ghiggeri
review_text: The food is very good and the table service is good as well. The problem was the girl at the entrance. She didn’t want to seat us at a table for four, saying everything was reserved, even though I insisted that wasn’t true. In the end, I was right—the restaurant remained empty the entire time, with comfortable, large tables available, while we had to eat squeezed into a small table, that’s the reason of my 2 stars..

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: Chan Veronica
review_text: The broth really surprised me. I went in with normal expectations, but the moment I took the first sip, I could taste how naturally rich it was. The sweetness doesn’t feel artificial, It’s the kind that comes from real prawn flavour, slowly cooked until the depth really comes through. It has that comforting warmth that makes you pause for a second and go, “Wah… this is good.” What I like most is that it’s not overly salty or heavy. Even after finishing the whole bowl, it doesn’t leave that jelak feeling. Instead, the broth is clean yet full-bodied, with enough richness to feel satisfying. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!!

author: Vedangi Patel
review_text: I don't remember the server name, but she was very polite and well behaved. We ordered classic butcher's burger and the best egg sandwich. Sandwich was little in blend taste but burger was the highlight. Also we ordered cold pressed juices - red and passion . Which were truly amazing. The place's vibe was so so good. Love this place.

author: Hannah Marymarie
review_text: This is the cutest little breakfast place we have been to on vacation so far! The inside is instagram worthy vibes with plenty of photo opportunities! My only complaint thus far is we couldn't sit inside to eat because it was so hot! It could be tolerable but not comfortable.

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: Zelrick Kun
review_text: One of the best LeiCha I had in Singapore. Although LeiCha isn't for everyone, their LeiCha isn't overpowered by the "grassy green" smell. Worth trying if you are sick of having greasy food and looking for healthier option.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Bach
review_text: One of the best bun bo hue i’ve ever had! The beef and pork is super tender and soft. Broth is very flavourful and the owners are both so nice ;’)

author: Richca Davine
review_text: Dinner at Osteria Gia Orange Groves was so good! Service was on point, and Kak Suci was really great. For sure coming back to try more stuff!

author: Hamza Juman
review_text: The food was excellent. Very tasty! Our waitress was super nice, very attentive. Excellent mimosa's and did not have to wait long at all for the food. Definitely one of my new favorite chill spots at Hollywood Beach.

author: Agustin Tirado
review_text: I went at 8:44 pm today and they didn’t have any meat to make any sandwich? I mean

author: GT
review_text: High quality drinks and food, but service is incredibly slow. I waited 20 minutes for a latte. I appreciate a chill atmosphere, but the staff loves to chat more than get orders out efficiently - I think there can be a better balance. Not the spot to run in and get a quick drink at the moment, which is unfortunate because they’re the only spot with hojicha!

author: Jami R.
review_text: Cold delis were great! The French dip was mediocre. Could have seasoned the meat while cooking. Service was wonderful.

author: Mek Nani
review_text: I aimed for pasembur and my hubby and kids really craved for nasi kandar ..and we were very lucky that this restaurant really served to our craving. The beautiful interior design, the cleanliness and the friendly staff really impressed us.

author: Ify Akpone
review_text: I love coming to this place every time I visit Newark, New Jersey. The food reminds me of the motherland Nigeria. I love the fact they have special soups for everyday of the week…Mon-Fri and they all taste amazing. I do recommend their Efo-Riro you can never go wrong with that meal. And their Jollof Rice is practically the best Jollof in Newark. Don’t argue with me argue with your mother oooo. But sincerely if you want a good naija meal and you are in the Newark, NJ area stop by you won’t regret. 😁😍

author: Jim J
review_text: Pig trotters are really good. Bak Kut Teh is the white peppery type and was ok.

author: Cricketer Sayful
review_text: I recently visited this pizza shop and had a fantastic experience. The pizza was fresh, hot, and full of flavor—the crust was perfectly crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. The toppings were generous and high quality, especially the pepperoni and fresh veggies. The staff was friendly and welcoming, and service was fast and efficient. Whether you're dining in or taking out, everything runs smoothly. The place was clean and had a cozy, casual atmosphere that made it a great spot to relax and enjoy a meal.

author: Frontier Cookers
review_text: Their staple food items are great! Service is good wish they would tell you there is a surge charge on bill. Atmosphere is small and cozy parking is is a task.

author: JF Bruns
review_text: 9/25 - Staying at the Sheraton and this was a close walk. There was still a 45 minute wait on a Sunday @ 7pm. Our group was lucky enough to score two high tops in the bar to cut that in half. Our server was great, efficient & easy to deal with even when it came to dividing our ticket up 5 ways. I enjoyed the Jamaican shrimp but the shrimp were a little overdone. The wife had the crab cake bites, perfect size for her and she loved them. Very limited beer menu but did have a full bar. Enjoyed our visit!

author: Beth Harper
review_text: Great Husker bar!!!! Food average but fine! Thanks for having a Husker bar in Las Vegas! GO BIIIIGGGGG RREEEEDDDD❤️

author: Joanne Bowie Alvarez
review_text: It was a great spot – we arrived right at opening, so it wasn’t crowded, and the food was fantastic. They have live music on Fridays and Saturdays, plus valet parking or a nearby parking lot. The outdoor area is absolutely breathtaking, and the chef’s ceviche was delicious and very flavorful! Overall, an amazing experience! Margarita welcomed us warmly as we walked in, and our bartender, Sebastian, was very nice.

author: Andrew J
review_text: Food was mediocre at best. We were served almost immediately after sitting down, which made it clear the meat wasn’t freshly grilled — especially surprising when you can see the chef grilling right behind the seating area. Some people might prefer the quick service, but I personally would have preferred freshly grilled meat. Overall an okay meal, and the prices were good, so no complaints there.

author: J B
review_text: Always ask for the waitress Claudia from Columbia… The wagyu beef appetizer was great. The clam chowder was good. I have had better but I would order it again. The drinks were superb! I wish we had more time to order a few more drinks. Claudia was so attentive as well as the rest of the wait staff. They made our trip to Boston lovely. Claudia was so nice and personable. My wife is vegetarian and I wish there was more options but the sides she ordered were very tasty.

author: Sweta Baniya
review_text: I had delicious vegan food here and both dishes were made with care! The owner also asked about Oyster sauce which I don’t eat! He was very attentive to my request and was very kind and careful. The tofu was DELICIOUS! Cauliflower was okay!

author: Mayra Volquez
review_text: If you are looking for a nice breakfast/ Brunch place in Downtown Miami, this is your place. I will definitely come again and bring my sister.

author: Weston Corbin
review_text: The steak is phenomenal in every sense. The dry age is perfect and the seasoning is just right. It truly is a quality steak. The portions on the salads, appetizers, and sides are large enough to share. The German hash browns were particularly delightful. The atmosphere is somewhat stale and the service is good, not great. Overall, one of my favorite New York steakhouses.

author: Jill
review_text: This was my favorite visit of our whole vacation!!! The atmosphere was nothing but perfect. The service was so friendly and welcoming. Now about the food! We ordered like half of the menu and not one dish disappointed. Everything was 5 star 🌟 Amazing drink selections to accompany the menu. Thank you for such an incredible dining experience 💖

author: Stacy
review_text: I was at the Hingham Wahlburgers last Thursday. Jill was our server and she was AMAZING!! Very friendly and patient. I was there with my 80 yr old mom - who can be pretty picky about what she eats. She loved the ‘Our Burger’ in a bowl - absolutely perfect choice for her and easy to eat. Everything was delicious!! 💚

author: saif khan
review_text: Average food at average price. There are items on the menu that priced on the lower end. But also some that's not. Like $13 plus tax and tip of course for a chocolate dessert isnt worth it. But there 3 for me for $11-$13 is.

author: Jonathan Dorf
review_text: We had a great early dinner before a show at the Prudential Center. Easy to walk from to the venue. Awesome staff. Super attentive to my wife who has celiac disease - so many GF options even very good GF bread - seriously!

author: Rafael Sa
review_text: Average japanese food; nothing outstanding in particular Service is ok; fast but not offering a lot of assistance or suggestions. Basic mistakes as forgetting drink orders, and offering shoyu and wasabi. Beware of pricing scheme: the menu prices does not include taxes, 20% service charge and 7% tip charge; so whatever you see in the menu, add 36% Atmosphere feels crowded and lowed; not what you would expect in a traditional Japanese restaurant There are definitely better options to dine in Lincoln street

author: Keith
review_text: Nestled on the bustling Banthat Thong Road, Pungdet is a charming café that has garnered a loyal following for its meticulously prepared charcoal-toasted bread. Banthat Thong Road itself has a rich history—originally known as "Phra That Thong" and once a hub for car repair shops, it has since transformed into one of Bangkok's premier culinary destinations. Today, the street is lined with a vibrant array of eateries, attracting food enthusiasts from near and far. At Pungdet, the focus is clear: delivering perfectly toasted bread with fillings that delight both the sweet and savory palate. Each piece is toasted to order over a charcoal flame, a process that takes just enough time to create a crisp, golden exterior while warming the fillings within. The result? A fragrant and irresistibly soft bite that lingers on the palate. The Offerings With an impressive selection of 22 fillings, diners are spoiled for choice. Among the highlights are: Ham and Cheese – A timeless pairing of melted cheese and smoky ham. Butter Sugar – A sweet classic with buttery richness and a delicate sprinkle of sugar. Hokkaido Milk – Smooth, creamy, and delicately sweet, inspired by Japan's famed dairy. Tuna – A savory favorite for seafood lovers. Smoked Salmon – A luxurious option with bold, smoky notes. Prices are refreshingly affordable, ranging from 20 THB for a simple butter sugar toast to 60 THB for premium fillings like smoked salmon. A Culinary Experience During my visit, I opted for the Hokkaido Milk and Thai Tea fillings. The bread, served fresh from the grill, boasted a wonderfully crisp crust and a pillowy-soft interior. The Hokkaido Milk filling was divine—creamy, light, and delicately sweet, a perfect complement to the toasted bread. The Thai Tea filling, though flavorful, leaned on the sweeter side and might be an acquired taste for some. For those seeking a savory indulgence, the Ham and Cheese filling appears to be a crowd favorite, and it’s certainly on my list for my next visit. Ambiance The café features a cozy, air-conditioned space next door, complete with tables and chairs for diners who prefer to savor their toast on-site. Fresh water and tissues are thoughtfully provided, making for a comfortable dining experience. While the buns are delightful at any time, they’re best enjoyed fresh off the grill when the textures and aromas are at their peak. Verdict Pungdet is a must-visit for anyone exploring Banthat Thong Road. Its combination of expertly toasted bread, a wide variety of fillings, and unbeatable value makes it a standout destination in Bangkok's thriving food scene. Whether you're looking for a quick snack or a leisurely treat, Pungdet delivers with charm and consistency.

author: Globe Walker
review_text: Signature Pork ribs are soft n tender, easy to chew for the elderlies. The ribs are well marinated and the sweet spicy sauce placed at the table is delish! Bacon bits on volcano potato are hard and dried, not complimenting the dish as should. The baked potato was only slightly warmed up , making the volcano experience less exciting. Flavour wise, it is alright. Fried rice with ribs (iga) is a good option for pple who cant finish a portion of signature pork ribs. Butterfly tea is yummy n refreshing. It's butterfly (pea flower) juice + mango juice + black tea. Place has no aircon.

author: Keila suarez
review_text: Special all day $16.99 delicious bacon cheese burger with fríes and soda/beer Nice place at bayside right in front of the chicago view ,excelent service,tips already included in the bill.

author: Alberto Miami
review_text: I’ve visited the Sushi Sake chain before at other locations around Miami, and this was my first time at the Biscayne location. I came to the restaurant on a Wednesday around 4 p.m.; it was pretty much empty. The hostess told me I could pick any table I wanted, inside or outside. The weather was nice that day, and the veranda looked very pretty, so I chose a table outside. Also I had a quick look inside, and the restaurant looked modern, nice, and clean. My waiter came over pretty fast and was nice. BUT he only brought me the regular menu and didn’t mention anything about the Happy Hour menu, which actually starts at 4 p.m. at Sushi Sake restaurants on weekdays. I had to bring it up myself, and he acted like he had forgotten about it. When I asked for the Happy Hour menu, he told me they didn’t have physical menus available at the moment, which seemed strange. Then he just started listing a few of the dishes from the Happy Hour menu, and of course, he missed a lot. Luckily, I had done a review of another Sushi Sake location a few months earlier and had ordered from their Happy Hour menu. So I pulled up that review on my phone to remind myself what I wanted. I ended up ordering the JB Roll and the Miami Heat Roll again. My food came out fast - about 10 minutes after I ordered. Everything looked and tasted as expected: nice and delicious! The portions at this restaurant are big and filling. Personally, I’m always fully satisfied after eating two sushi rolls. I absolutely love the JB Roll + Miami Heat Roll combo - they go really well together! As for the regular menu, it offers a lot of variety, which is great. I’ve never had bad food at this sushi chain. For drinks, I always order an iced tea. It’s very tasty here, plus they offer free refills. I also love that they have agave syrup and simple syrup, which I always ask for instead of sugar. Price-wise, I find this restaurant generally reasonable; just a few items on the regular menu seem a bit overpriced to me. But the Happy Hour menu is an excellent deal! My final bill after ordering two items from the Happy Hour menu plus a drink is around $22, which is fantastic! I absolutely recommend the Sushi Sake chain if you’re looking for good, tasty sushi and rolls. And the Biscayne location is a great option - it’s in a tourist-friendly area of Miami and not far from the Port of Miami, which makes it a perfect spot if you’re arriving by cruise ship and want to grab some Japanese food!

author: Frankie Bradley
review_text: So I called in to order the new knotted pizza 🍕 and the lady told me 21.50 then after taxes 23.99. I went to order it offline and it came up to 17.11 now this lady is rude and I always have issues with her and her attitude towards me. So I hear her ask someone and they told her 19 I told her that it was 17.11 online then she asked someone again I believe in Spanish and told me they give it to me for 17. Im afraid to eat the pizza cause they special her are very petty. If I get sick 🤢🤒 y'all know who did it. I'm so hungry 😭 should I trust it? To be continued 😆

author: oriana rojas
review_text: my fiance, cousin, and I came on a whim after a billie concert and WOWWW SO GLAD WE DID!! Danny and Gladys were absolutely amazing! they were kind and made the best recommendations. Ten cuidado con los dos por que son como familia después de 10 minutos

author: Ying Ying Eeow
review_text: Great place for Western food! The portions are generous, the flavors are spot on, and the staff are super friendly. Definitely coming back again!

author: Priya Chandran
review_text: i went to this place because the reviews were extremely good, but honestly, it was a huge disappointment. Booked a table for a birthday celebration and chose a package that was supposed to include free table decoration. Please don’t be misled, the decoration was about 7 fake flower petals on the table. Lol . Worse, they forgot to even put it out when we arrived. Fyi: if you want balloons its rm100 extra. The food was another letdown. We paid around RM300 and were served mushroom soup and chicken that weren’t even warm. At the very least, it could have been reheated. Paying that amount for cold food is unacceptable. The staff were clearly more focused on entertaining their corporate event tables, But we are also paying. Thats not fair. If you want to focus then please dont book usual tables. I came with very high expectations, especially since it was a birthday dinner. Unfortunately, the experience completely spoiled the night. I won’t be returning.

author: Heizhudaddy
review_text: Great food and service overall. Walked in early without a reservation and got a seat as long as we finish before 8pm. Glad we made it as the dishes were mostly superb. Ordered the snails (5/5), hand roll platter(3.5/5), banh xeo (4/5), prawn sashimi (5/5) and pig’s stomach (4/5). Will definitely be back again when I’m in HCMC in future.

author: N Liang
review_text: Booked for vvip last week and found that their private room really needs renovation where we can see the furniture is old. Dining table was too low, AC was too old although there were more than 1 unit, we were still sweating. Soft shell crab and squid were awesome, noodle was tasty but a little spicy, tiger prawn was fresh and tasty. Overall, tasty and generous portion. Maybe the restaurant can add more toilets coz currently they only have 1 toilet for ladies and 1 for men at the dining area. And the other toilets were at the basement which makes it not convenient for vvip to go down.

author: Shirley Lim
review_text: Delicious beef hamburger, but the puree is a little salty. Yummy soft-shell crab spaghetti, more sauce will be better :)

author: Jason Millahn
review_text: We saw the amazing reviews for this restaurant and knew we had to give it a try — and we’re so glad we did! As people who aren’t too familiar with Peruvian cuisine, we didn’t quite know where to start, but luckily our waiter, Franco, did. Franco guided us through the menu with confidence and enthusiasm, offering recommendations that we happily followed — in fact, we let him curate our entire dining experience. It was an incredible decision. The food was absolutely outstanding, and Franco made the evening truly unforgettable. I travel the world for work and have dined in some of the best restaurants across major cities, and I can honestly say Franco was the best waiter I’ve ever had. The food alone would have made this a fantastic meal, but Franco’s service elevated it to something special. The restaurant’s décor and overall vibe were also excellent — warm, stylish, and perfectly suited to the experience. Highly recommend!!!

author: Crimsonpig101
review_text: A busy foodcourt which is pretty hidden away, 25+ food stalls. No air-conditioning just wall fans. Tried the Michelin guide stir fry noodles for medium size $8 which were good but was it worth the queue time?

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: dq
review_text: Came by upon landing, first impressions - wow very grand & definitely gonna be an above average meal in terms of cost. They have a holding area for luggage bags too so I believe theyre used to taking in tourists. We were greeted at the door and led to a table where they started piling dishes upon dishes all cling wrapped. You can pick out what you want and return what you don't want. Once you open then you will be charged for it. Dishes I would go back for: ayam pop, rendang dating & ayam penyet. There was also a minced beef (?) with chilli on top which was good. Overall I enjoyed the meal!

author: meta meidia
review_text: Came here on a Sunday night with a reservation and paid a deposit. The place is very nice and aesthetic. The service from the staff was amazing, starting from giving us a welcome drink, taking us to our table, and offering to help us take photos at good spots. The food is delicious but I think the menu choices should be expanded The last thing I like the most is the live music. Overall I am satisfied and happy to come here 🩶

author: Wayne Anthony
review_text: Discovered this little 😍 gem 💎 of a place buy chatting to someone at the beach ⛱️ very impressed with the food and the service, the price is also great for the amount of food you receive, full of flavor and very pleasing to the eye ! Would highly recommend that you give a place a try as you will definitely appreciate that you did 👍 😊 so many bars 🍸 and restaurants to choose from and this one ticks all the boxes, and not like a lot some of the restaurants in bali that try and use the locals to intimidate you to come in 🤕they have built up a good reputation from the word on the street 📦 😍 .

author: Debora Chong
review_text: Upon walking into Miam I thought, "Wow, this place is really nice!" The staff are so friendly, place is so organized and clean and as I looked into the kitchen the cooks were so busy and diligent at work. They looked so efficient. The star of the show was he food! Everything we ate was so delicious! We had the buttermilk pancakes, match latte and the breakfast burrito. Everything just melts in your mouth. You can't go wrong ordering anything from the menu. Amanda was super friendly and nice. Always there whenever we needed anything extra. We will definitely come back here again.

author: Braksigmog C
review_text: Just came in today for some chilaquiles and man I can't come out the bathroom. They also tasted funky like the oil was way past due. Unlucky me that was so hungry ate them and man I so regret that decision. Most likely will have to go somewhere else to eat as im sick while I'm typing this.

author: Frédéric Hachnel
review_text: Get a line number on QueQ app before. We waited 2 hoyrs 30mn and it was worth all the wait. Salmon salad and tom yum mama were amazing. Just go and give 5 stars rhey deserve way more than 4.1 avg. Only negative point was they ran out of crispy pork and shrimps but it didn t matter much at the end

author: Bee Sun Ng
review_text: The signature white pepper crab was wholesomely good; meaty and filled with crab roe! This came as a surprise as we ordered the smaller crab for 2 pax. The other dishes were also delicious, flavourful! The staff were very helpful and friendly, ready to meet our needs so that we can enjoy our dinner.

author: Kat Jane Thirsty
review_text: I've been here once before so I suggested to my friends for us to come here for lunch. They almost suggested somewhere else because the reviews were all over the place. I insisted that the last time I was here, I really enjoyed the food. So they took my word for it and ended up loving it! Everything was fresh and tasty. The servers/ staff were so friendly and attentive. My friends are coming back with their kids. I'm glad I introduced them to a new spot for them to enjoy.

author: Kevin M
review_text: Meaty frog logs and delicious spicy sauce. Enjoyed our meal here. A little on the expensive side...but worth it. Definitely try the spicy one. The tables are outdoor with fans. Service was fine. Will be back again.

author: Alex Soares
review_text: We had a wonderful time at the Qatar lounge, from the reception to the food to the great facilities. The whole team was outstanding, specially Hazel, Pinky, Stary and Montra, they looked after us and we're very attentive during dinner time, they really went the extra mile. There are different areas to dine, work, relax, including some lovely private pods. The washrooms were always spotless. This is probably the best airline lounge I've ever visited, it's a joy spending time here before a flight.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Claire
review_text: Great place to enter into exploring the taste of bak kut teh. This particular place does not seem to have an overwhelming aroma of herbal infusion, so it is good to try as a first bak kut teh. Meat is so tender and soft, and the soup is peppery and clean.

author: Sacha Martinez
review_text: Delicious and fresh food! Challenging that they only serve walk-in. We showed up just before 12P and were seated in 30 mins even though predicted wait time was 53-73 mins. I felt for people waiting with kids. It was worth the wait! If you value fresh and wholesome food - you will not be disappointed here. I had the veggie scramble - it was great!

author: Do Thao
review_text: Compared to many other restaurants, my taste at this restaurant is the best, the price is cheap. I went with the hot pot program for 1, 2 people for only 99k + grilled combo for 139k, but 3 people were full, there was a lot of meat, I ate a lot. The male waiters were quick. The only thing is that the restaurant was crowded so it was a bit hot.

author: Rohee Lee
review_text: The dim sum are really tasty! Their portion is small and you can try variety of choices. Ordered Bak kut Teh and the meat is tender, soup is really good. Very satisfying with their food, will go and eat again for next trip

author: Em Pzhi
review_text: I order maggie goreng！ only vege and egg - 6 packs！ But didn't put vegetables for me！

author: Neva Rosse
review_text: The service is good, the food is implacable, and the Server name Suci is humble and friendly ✨

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Alex Ford
review_text: I met a friend here for breakfast. It’s a cute little spot! The menu has hot breakfasts, salads, açaí bowls, and smoothies. I had the breakfast bowl which isn’t marked as gluten free but is indeed gluten free. It was great!! Next time I’d ask for my eggs scrambled just because it’s hard to sop up all that yolk-y goodness without bread. But overall, very happy with my breakfast. I also got the Jasmine green tea and they gave me a FAT wad of tea which is awesome.

author: Arty
review_text: I liked everything besides being rushed by the hostess by being asked to follow her multiple times, when i already was. Food is great. The hostess was nice too, it just doesn’t have to be a rush during a meal, praying, sex or bathroom time. Everything and everyone was awesome. Free refills. Paid $21 per myself😂Gladly tipped. Everyone was full and happy. P. S. Please consider mixing up your music playlist. Thank you, FG & B.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Jerry Granillo
review_text: Mauro is an amazing server! My family and I have been coming here for some time, and Mauro is always so friendly and attentive to us. One of the best servers here! The price is good and the food is amazing! Great place to come relax and have a great family experience

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: Yaw Zhe Syuen
review_text: I order leicha and yong taufu. The amount is pretty decent and the yong taufu is really tasty! Gotta thanks the boss for recommending it to me. Definitely will go back when I’m craving for leicha.

author: Anzac Chew
review_text: Nice Chicken Rice. I had the roast version & it taste great. But they are also very popular with it's humfull lasagne.

author: Von Dominguez
review_text: Best Thai spot in Las Vegas! I live on the other side of town and still make the trip to come here when I can, it’s that good! If you’re undecided on what to eat and Boun Thai came up on your radar, just go ahead and dine-in or order that takeout - you won’t be disappointed!

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: Adam Schmitt
review_text: Now this is the real deal. With a plethora of options, I stumbled upon fantastic selections at incredibly reasonable prices. Situated in a bustling location, it exudes a wealth of character that makes the visit absolutely worthwhile.

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: Whisky Dev
review_text: Excellent wantan noodles (Bamee) place that has been open for ages (since the 50s). A solid 8/10 for me. Paid a return visit to try their crab fried rice. The standard plate cost just THB100 so don’t expect too much crab meat. There is a THB250 option that has lots more chunks of crab meat. My thoughts… good “wok hei” and delicious to the taste. Perhaps they can charge a little more and increase the amount of crab meat a little. Satisfying plate of fried rice. I’d say a 7.5/10

author: Sai
review_text: Consider as street food. Sell barbecued bread with various filling. The owner tried to put in all his favourite food as the bread filling, that's how the idea come to mind. You can sit beside the shop with air conditional. But the area is bad with air ventilation where the smell of burned charcoal in the room. Table is not clean after guest left. The price is acceptable and worth to try.

author: Yohanes Gunawan
review_text: Their signature appetizers and main courses were outstanding. Paired with a sweet red wine, the dinner atmosphere was even more special. And to our guest assistant, Mr. Diaz, thank you for your assistance.

author: Andrij Barytskyi
review_text: Michelin noodles with beef were good, the spicy sauce made it different. But the scallops were outstanding, the first time i tried such a combination with minced pork, onion, garlic and butter + chilli sauce on the side. Recommended!

author: Polevy Ezekiel
review_text: One of the most recommended specialty coffee shop in Ho Chi Minh called @theworkshopcoffee, established since 2014 and located in the bustling Bến Nghé area. Located on the second floor of an old 1912 building, the classic vintage ambience feels very strong because many architectural elements are very well maintained. High ceilings with many window openings from various directions create good natural lighting, causing a warm, comfy and welcoming space. Various coffee menus are served here and the ones I recommend most are classic coffee and manual brew with various of the best coffee beans from various origins.

author: Cao Nguyen
review_text: Food is nice, unique and very tasty, especially their signature "white pepper crab" dish. I personally think it is a bit over price but it is fine, we paid for what we wanted 😀😃. Our group is 9pax, eat and drink beer, total bill S$588, happy ending, haha.

author: Lily Fong
review_text: Nice atmosphere, great staff services and meats are fresh and tender. Will come back again!

author: Xiao Xuan
review_text: Michelin rated food! But it’s more of a local delicacy, simple yet comforting food. Most importantly the pork does not have any weird porky taste, all the innards is prepared well. The pork blood jelly is very nice, given four large pieces! The meat pork ball is yummy too! The yam rice is surprisingly very tasty! Fluffy fragrant rice, paired with yam so yummyyy The chili sauce given and the soup is very good. The soup is very light yet flavourful. The hygiene can be questionable but well no one had any diarrhoea. Service is quick, pay when food arrive. Would come back again!

author: Emily Moenning
review_text: I got shrimp tacos from the Mexican brand. Flavors good, shrimp cooked nicely. Cold and stiff corn tortilla led to cracking and breaking. But it’s nice and thick. I feel like if they warmed up the tortilla I would be giving them a 5/5 stars. It’s nice in a pinch because you can choose different cuisine options and it’s right by the Trader Joe’s which is good for errands. I would come here if you’re starving and need something convenient but if you want tacos because you’re trying to have like a cute Mexican lunch you should just go to an actual taco place.

author: Rick C
review_text: I lived by Argentina Bakery in the mid 90s and now l live in CT. I still travel to NJ for their awesome and delicious empanadas!!!! Great job!!!! See you soon!!!!

author: Elihu Salas
review_text: The portion sizes here are generous. I had the Beach Club sandwich and the BBQ combo. I only made it through two of the three club sandwiches, and my son ate most of his meal, only leaving a few ribs. He mentioned they could’ve used more sauce. The atmosphere is great, and if you sit outside, you can enjoy some beautiful water views depending on your spot. One thing to note is that an 18% gratuity was included in the bill, which is good to be aware of. Overall, a solid place to enjoy a filling meal with a nice vibe.

author: Mitchell Lim
review_text: Old school bakery been around for eons. Their bread/buns have quite a bite (not eating air). Prices have gone up a fair bit in recent years. Taste, nostalgia..

author: Krishna Wiharsa
review_text: Great ribs, vibrant atmosphere and good service! Nothing beats them for a perfect dine-in around Bali. The premium ribs are so tender and juicy. We were served by Eka, very helpful and friendly, making sure everything served well for us 👍🏼 Definitely a must-go place if you're in Bali.

author: Oyin Ayo
review_text: My review is about catering. We do not know the owner or anyone working from this establishment. Although, I gave a 5 star for the atmosphere, I can not actually rate the dining space since we have never eaten there. We are a family that simply loves good food. I have used 9jabuka to cater very important milestones in my family order the past year. It is the only jollof vendor my partner will accept. Depending on the number of guests, they have only provided the best of the best! We have ordered pans of jollof, ayamase w/ white rice, nigerian salad, pepper soup, and most recently a cooler of jollof rice. I believe they are reasonably priced for catering. They are always on time for the pick-up and the food is always fresh, tasty, and hot (if applicable). There is a $50 deposit if you need to borrow a cooler like we did. We will continue to be a customer.

author: Matt Mitchell
review_text: Very friendly staff and amazing food. The Seoul Sista Kimchi Fried Rice was amazing! Got it with the jerk chicken added and do NOT regret it! New fave place in Newark. I wish I had a bigger stomach or more reasons to be in Newark because I want to try so many of the menu items.

author: Michael Robert
review_text: Food was very good and not overpriced. The place was very busy during Sunday foorball. The server who was handling our table was overwhelmed. Luis, who has working another area, noticed she was behind and got our food and drink order in. Good group of people there.

author: Anh Nguyen
review_text: I’ve been a regular at the original Nguyen Thi Minh Khai location for a long time; the only real drawback was the limited space. This newly opened branch fixes that problem completely. It’s spacious, has five floors, and the decoration is really cute. I ordered the Bún Thang and salted coffee, and both were excellent. The soup is aromatic yet light, the ingredients are fresh, and the coffee is spot-on. I’d say the Bún Thang is true to Northern cuisine and so far the best I’ve tasted. Definitely worth the visit.

author: 5880 Partners Peoria, AZ
review_text: Wow. A new wall for a nice room. Try the chicken caesar salad. We'll be back for the steaks!

author: Gabbie Kim
review_text: It was okay overall. I’ve had better steak, but it definitely wasn’t the worst. The seasoning seemed uneven, so the first half of the steak tasted pretty bland. The place was packed on a Wednesday night, and while our server was clearly busy, they only checked in at the very end, and our water sat empty most of the time.

author: Faith
review_text: Maybe we are lucky to come at a good time with a good chef because this was really one of the good fried rice I’ve had in a while (and in town) The rice is super fragrant and the spiciness is damn good with it! The portion is actually good for two to share and try it! The price is also reasonable as it was on a discount during the September period offer

author: Kenkeh Hi
review_text: The sar hor fun noodle 🍜 here is tasty . Visited Thursday morning 9am . I don’t have to wait very long on weekdays . They give less soup , but you can ask to add more soup . Broth is intense .

author: Briana Villanueva
review_text: Food was great, server was kind, and the chocolate cake was to die for. The parking situation was rough, very small lot and they charge $5 for valet, which isn’t a big deal but they don’t actually give you an option to park your own car?

author: Jessica W
review_text: Had the ox tail burger with a side salad. My fiance had wings. It was fye!🔥 Great service. Good music. Cool spot. BYOB. Will definitely come again. 💖

author: Eduarda
review_text: Good Banh mi in the city center. They have many options but to my taste the pate is one of the best I’ve had. The place is small and often packed with tourists, so I recommend getting your food to go and enjoying it in the square across the street.

author: Ksu Ou
review_text: I really like these servers!They are so nice and they make delicious food!!) 😋 But the chicken is a little bit dry but if u take the souse (that I don't really like) this will be perfect!)

author: hector cordero
review_text: Saturday 3 22 2025 I ordered tatter tots with extra cheddar and when I smelled and tasted the food it was rancid. The powder being used smelled like it has been in a plastic container for a very long time and expired. I ended trashing the food as I was already far from the location. We were looking forward to the tater. Tots, unfortunately the expectation, what's i'm not there. Please have your staff trained on your product and even taste the product and have knowledge of what is old, What is rancid and what should be served. Thank you Hector Cordero F&B Assist Director CSUN

author: OB1
review_text: Kok Sen lives up to its Michelin reputation, drawing a noticeable crowd of tourists, but the wait time was manageable—we were seated within 20-30minutes ( we arrived at 6:50pm). They offer both indoor (air-conditioned) and outdoor seating, which is a nice option. ( If you come after 8 p.m., there is most probably no more queue.). For our group, we ordered the Prawn Hor Fun (small $20), Beef Hor Fun (medium $14), Cereal Prawns, a fried vegetable dish, and Sliced Fish with Bittergourd, plus 5 barley waters, totaling around $109. The Hor Fun dishes were the definite stars—incredibly smooth and executed perfectly. The Cereal Prawns were also excellent. However, a couple of items were disappointing: The fried vegetable portion we ordered was quite small, almost comically so ("pathetic," as you said), and is definitely something we'd skip next time. The Sliced Fish with Bittergourd also didn't quite hit the mark; the flavors felt separate, as if the two main ingredients were cooked individually and tossed together, lacking that essential zichar harmony. Despite these minor misses, the overall meal was satisfying, driven by the quality of their signature noodle dishes. I would certainly return for the Hor Fun.

author: Angelica Beth Sia
review_text: Food serving is huge, and food is just divine! Best bun cha ever. The service is also excellent. From how they received us (despite no reservations) and server us with all smiles, we enjoyed the experience all the way. Special mention to the best crew teka, sam, and alexander! Thank you so much

author: BNL BYN
review_text: Popped in for lunch. Food was alright. Got the beef pho. Broth was watery and felt too “healthy”. Prob what the neighborhood folks want but not me. The service was amazing! Server was very personable

author: Ray K
review_text: Good tasting shawarma with amazing hummus! It’s a tiny rundown spot with just a few tables for dine-in, but the place was packed with students and locals on a weekday. The meal came with a nice portion size and packed with great flavors. Perfect spot for a quick bite too.

author: Nisha Upadya
review_text: Food was good, but service was so awful it didn’t make up for it. First, the server disappeared for an extended period of time and another server had to go and find him. Once we had ordered, the dish I got was not what I was expecting. I had ordered the Rasta pasta vegan which I assumed had vegan protein with it. My pasta that came only had vegetables. I’m sorry but what vegetable is worth an extra $8????? Then, my friend ordered the chicken and was charged for the vegan which is more expensive. When we pointed it out to the waiter, he fought with us until I just paid for the food anyways to get out of there fast. Once I left, I realized that the vegan provably did entail vegan protein and they had just left it off when they gave me my meal. It’s extremely frustrating paying extra for something that you don’t receive and having a server who doesn’t take the time to explain the menu or clarify what you are hoping for… or at least that the food actually comes. I would probably not come back again. Disappointing and overpriced restaurant. What a rip off.

author: Neha Rege
review_text: Bunna Cafe was my first Ethiopian food experience, and it instantly made me fall in love with the cuisine. The food was rich and flavorful, the ambience felt warm and authentic, and the service was friendly and attentive. A great spot for anyone trying Ethiopian food for the first time or looking for an authentic Ethiopian experience in Brooklyn.

author: Neftali Marrero
review_text: LA FUSTA was a bustaa. Sorry to say, but this was my first time going to this establishment, which I saw many good reviews, so I believe that because of the special day being sunday(MOTHER'S DAY).they were not well prepared for so much confusion,so I'm rating my bad experience on one day,but I will be back to try and give a better review on a slower day.For one was a small place and parking was challenging on tonelle Avenue, in new jersey.for this particular day.It started off with 2 waiters coming for our orders ,we told the second waiter that we put our order of drinks and appetizers with the first waiter. Never served the bread,butter, or the famous chimi churi sauce.i believe you have to pay for bottle water because they never brought regular water out,so we continued to ask for more bottled water 💧 cause it goes fast in our party.lol..the appetizers were not bad but as you look at the picture of the fried calamari plate it was more lettuce than calamari ( a rabbit would've enjoyed that dish) they must've been running short on calamari. Another suggestion if when ordering grilled Argentinian meat plate and you don't eat intestines, ask for no intestines cause it brings the most,and one of other meats which have to say were very good. Plus, the chimi churi sauce was delicious. As well as the salad was plenty with all you can imagine and very healthy and delicious. Oh yes,and the shrimp soup was not bad. My Personal recommendation is this place to book on holidays or special occasions not recommended maybe on a regular day they might be better 🤔.we paid over $200, not worth it .Sorry to say very expensive, but it was a special day, and they also had another limited menu, not their regular menu.

author: Ruslan Panahov
review_text: Real authentic local food at crazy very good prices!!! Try not to fall for fake tourist traps guys compare any restaurant prices with this place and you can understand what must be near real price!

author: Hannah Madaus
review_text: Solid 3 out of 5. Props to them for staying open late for all the drunk gamblers out there in Fremont, definitely saved us when we were hungry - however we waited in a very long line for alright tasting pizza that ended up being over 30$ for three slices including tax and tip.

author: James
review_text: I would like to say this is an amazing establishment. They have amazing food. Amazing customer service the owner keeps this place looking amazing. You can go here to have dinner or have a good time. Live music.

author: Jamie Spranger
review_text: This was a great spot for a pre-wedding breakfast. Our server was fun and attentive. She even brought us mimosas to celebrate! The plates were plentiful and tasty. My onion bacon and mushroom omelet really hit the spot and I was fueled for the the big day being a brides maid. It was a cute place with an old school style inside. If we are in the area we would come back.

author: felicity edmondson
review_text: I returned here several times during my trip. The service was quick and the staff were really friendly. The coffee was good, most of the food I had was good too, but I found the chicken salad under-seasoned and lacking in most of the ingredients listed. The atmosphere was generally good, but I found the music quite loud at times.

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Umami Ngon
review_text: Pleasantly pleased with our pho - broth was flavorful and noodles were smooth. Guava juice was refreshing. The staff were very friendly and attentive. A small puppy entertained us while waiting for our meals. Will definitely come back to try their spring rolls and bun cha.

author: Eklil Oriakhil
review_text: We were visiting Las Vegas for vacation, and this restaurant was one of the highlights of our trip! Everything was absolutely perfect — the food, the atmosphere, and especially the service. Our waiter, Rob, was incredible! He was so friendly, attentive, and really took great care of us from start to finish. You could tell he genuinely cared about making sure we had a great experience. Everything was 10/10, and we left completely happy and satisfied. We’ll definitely be coming back next time we’re in Vegas — highly recommend!

author: Shane Kelly
review_text: If you’re flying a OneWorld airline this is Singapore airport’s best lounge to go! The quality of food and wines is a step above BA or QF lounges. (Even the First lounges). The shower rooms are nice and cool and all accessories are provided. Amazing service delivered by Hazel, Alvin, Elsy, Ben, Harvin, Anu and Eva! A lovely experience for 3 hours while in transit. Thank you ❤️ See you again sometime soon

author: Life Of A Nomad
review_text: Authentic flavors and colorful presentation! Bangkok Street Thai Street Kitchen brings true Thai street vibes to Las Vegas. The papaya salad was super fresh, crunchy, and bursting with lime and chili just the right kick! The chicken satay was tender and grilled perfectly, served with creamy peanut sauce and sticky rice on the side. Everything came out beautifully plated, full of color and flavor. The place has that cozy local feel with great service and a chill atmosphere. Perfect for anyone who loves real Thai food. Highly recommend if you want a little Bangkok experience right here in Vegas!

author: Eric Merten
review_text: Boun Thai had some really good food. I love Thai food and I trybto eat it wherever I go. This meal was exceptional. So good. And the nice cook lady came out at the end of the meal and we had a nice chat about the spices n such. Lovely time.

author: Mirian Hernandez
review_text: Manager is so rude they never wanna help I made a complain an they never got to me food quantity was an acceptable

author: Lisa Sierra
review_text: This place is an experience that is worth every dollar. This is a long review but hopefully gives you information you might look for. Dress code island casual to dressy, you wouldn’t feel out of place in either. We loved the dishes and the experience, the discussion and anticipation was half the experience! This was our second dinner in four days because the first was so good. Both times we all looked at our chef’s tasting menus 1 the first time and two the second and chose what we each thought would be our top three of the evening and in almost all cases we were wrong! CucaBali expanded our palates and the experience with your pairings on the plate and suggestions from your staff. Some made us curious, two we all had definite reactions to, others surprised and many just delighted. We tried each others drinks, and endlessly discussed the food, the order which things were served and what order we would have eaten them in, we tried to eat slowly to not get too full, but ended up very full and satisfied. We had menu two this time - and I will tell you that I was going to try the Fish tartare, but had told my dining friends they could have my portion when we first reviewed the menu as I don’t usually eat sushi but love ceviche and didn’t think I would like it. That ended up being my favourite dish of the night! I ate more than my share!! We loved the Bbq Octopus, roasted pork buns, pumpkin salad from our first visit and it was hard to watch them get prepped and leave the kitchen! We had intended to do Al a carte but couldn’t narrow down our choices so went tasting menu 2 Diner 2 tried to order a Tea-irmisu (sp?) but Veri kindly explained it wouldn’t survive our long warm journey back to Seminyak. That’s how much she loved it ❤️ Diner 3 said his favourites were the Hawaiian Cracker, Lobster roll, crab and fish tartare, and chocolate cake. Diner 2said her favourites were Fish Tartare, Moroccan Meatballs, Lobster roll, both desserts then crab and broccoli Caesar Mine were Fish Tartare, morroccan meatballs, Hawaiian Cracker, Crab, the frozen yogurt dessert Unfortunately, it was unanimous hands down for savoury cotton candy. Not aligned with our taste buds but tried it both visits. The peppers with chicken inside - were a definite hit and we all loved those as well! Drinks were again favourites of our trip! Thanks to your incredible staff - here are some shout outs Lala -Server from our first dinner kept things paced perfectly, not too fast not too slow, great explanations, perfect amount of chat She was so knowledgeable about the food Veri- Server last night, attentive, anticipatory, there to explain, kept us hydrated since it was warmer at the bar, reminded us to take our pictures before we ate ( my parents wanted photos :)) because we kept eating before we remembered to get a photo. Yuli- hostess last night enjoyed chatting with her and discussing weather, travel, and food Heri and Casper who explained our dishes and oversaw our food Everyone else was professional and warm and lovely almost as if they had invited you to their home.

author: Yu Sec
review_text: This is one of the most chaotic and complicated hawker center with strong local atmosphere. If you want to see real singapore life, I recommend this rather than Lao Pasa or Maxell, that are walking distance from here.

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Siang Leng Tan
review_text: Yuta has been very attentive and helpful. She speaks English, very well. Helped to manage our food order, otherwise we might have over ordered.

author: Nuhn ya Biz
review_text: I recently visited Cacique Restaurant with my coworkers, and we had a delightful experience. The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, making it an ideal spot for both casual and fine dining. We started our meal with the Philly sandwich, accompanied by fresh French fries. The sandwich was flavorful, with tender meat and melted cheese, while the fries were crispy and well-seasoned. Additionally, we tried the protein shake, which was both refreshing and satisfying. The highlight of our visit was the exceptional service. The servers were incredibly friendly and attentive, ensuring that our dining experience was enjoyable from start to finish. Overall, Cacique Restaurant offers delicious food, a pleasant ambiance, and top-notch service. I highly recommend it for anyone looking to enjoy a memorable meal

author: Raymond Ng
review_text: Thus pizza hut skimps on everything. My orders always have underwhelming toppings. That's really the only thing I can say that gets my fired up. If I order a pizza I just want to see a nice amount of toppings. Always under the bar. I once got the wrong order and wanted to get a refund and they always Pass you off to a manager who is never there. Tried calling the customer line and they tell you to call the store. Pizza hut just isn't for the customer anymore, and have resulted turning the one beloved restaurant to all pizza hut express that you'd find at a target.

author: Imran Haziq Bin Khairul Anuar
review_text: The ambience of the restaurant feels very Indonesian with plenty of mirrors and trees that create a maze-like atmosphere. There are also some steps inside so please be a little careful when moving around. One of the highlights is the seating arrangement as every table offers a good sense of privacy which makes dining here even more enjoyable. The food is absolutely delicious with bold flavors that truly capture the essence of Indonesian cuisine. I especially loved the sambal tempe. The only drawback was the service which was a bit slow.

author: Chloe Hill
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Amazing burgers, great vibes, and even better service! The food was absolutely delicious and full of flavour, and the music created such a fun, relaxed atmosphere. What really stood out was how attentive the staff were — they made sure to check for allergies and took it seriously, which made us feel really comfortable and well looked after. Highly recommend if you’re after amazing food, good music, and excellent service! 🍔🎶

author: Sangavi Eswaran
review_text: The Cheesecake Factory is an ideal spot for a dinner date, offering a diverse range of cuisines all in one place. It's a perfect haven for food lovers.
