The must-try item is their cheesecake, though the portions are ample for one person, the pricing is a bit on the higher side. Nevertheless, it's a fantastic place to indulge in a variety of flavors..

author: Lori Villani
review_text: Nice and clean! Katie was AMAZING! Fun, spunky, beautiful inside and out. Go to Oceans 13 on Hollywood boardwalk for sure. Great atmosphere, great food & drinks and the servers are excellent!

author: Krystal Simmons
review_text: Couldn’t even snap a picture before digging in. Food smells amazing, and tastes even better! Worth the price, about $20 for a meal with two sides. If I’m being honest, I normally don’t like cornbread but it complemented the meal perfectly, not too sweet but not bland either. Everything tastes very authentic and made with love and care. The restaurant was clean and I enjoyed the R&B/Afrobeats music. I will be returning!

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: Mai
review_text: We visited Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn while traveling through Vietnam and happened to be in Ho Chi Minh City for a friend’s birthday. The reservation process was really smooth and friendly — we even received a nice confirmation by email, which we appreciated. The food was delicious, and the atmosphere felt warm and inviting. The restaurant itself is beautifully designed, and we also liked the little shop on the ground floor. After dinner, we had a short and very nice chat with the General Manager Phuong Vu, which made the evening feel even more personal. Definitely a lovely spot for great food in the heart of the city.

author: Amory Emlon
review_text: We have been fans of Tikki for several years now. We've never been disappointed! The menu is diverse and delicious, and the kitchen always gets the spice level just right for us. The service is attentive, and the atmosphere is calm and friendly. Recently we tried the Tikki Masala app for take-out, and it was great, too. Thanks to Mr Sharma and his lovely staff!

author: DESMONT
review_text: Wonder Williamsburg is a fantastic spot with a unique concept! I especially want to highlight the salmon bowl—fresh, delicious, and perfectly balanced. Every detail of the dish reflects the high quality of the ingredients and great care for the customers. The atmosphere is cozy and modern, creating a welcoming vibe. It's definitely a place I want to return to and explore more of their exciting menu!

author: Joshua Rivera
review_text: Food was good but portion sizes too big and overpriced. Won't be going back there again

author: Dor Nahum
review_text: A classic roasted pig experience here in Bali, place was neat and organized. Very clean, half indoors, half outdoors sitting while everything is covered to protect from the rain. The food was absolutely delicious. I ordered the large portion special which kind of gives you a mix of everything that you should have. I also ordered pork belly, which was very good I tried to order some extra skin, but I think they were saving it for the specials aside from that. I had a great experience and would come back again. Paid 110,000 rupiah

author: 유지원
review_text: Communication with the staff was difficult due to language barriers, but we proactively used a translator to resolve the issue. I'm not familiar with the country's cuisine, so I can't comment on the taste, but it might be a matter of personal preference. Nevertheless, I thoroughly enjoyed every bit of the meal.

author: say.w
review_text: The decor was beautifully adorned in the timeless Nyonya style, with its intricate details and vibrant touches. I savored the delicate flavors of white tom yum, a perfect balance of spice, and the stir-fried bitter gourd with shrimp, which offered a delightful contrast of textures. Simply exquisite and unforgettable!👍👍👍

author: Tiffany
review_text: Great customer service (thanks Jasmin) and I look forward to having another meal here! I was surprised and glad that they only grill their meats. That’s good! There is ample seating and all the good jams playing as you enter the door. We are looking forward to our visit at the Phoenix location. Update: Jerk chicken over rice, red beans & rice, greens and yams - I am quite impressed with this plate and I’ll tell you why. First of all, the food is seasoned and well balanced. Often times soul food is too salty or too sweet. This right here, is called balance! I enjoyed everything. The greens were perfectly tender just how I like them, however, my only critique is that more seasoning (not salt) be added and wish the jerk chicken came through a bit more. But, so glad it didn’t hit me hard like some places I’ve had! The banana pudding was a surprise, because I thought there’d be more cookies, but instead there was fluffy pudding that seemed to have cookie blended inside? I could be wrong. However it was made, it was flavored well and I could taste the vanilla, banana and everything. We definitely will be back to try more!

author: Matthias Gobert
review_text: You step into another world when coming here. The setting is so peaceful and authentic Vietnamese. And the staff welcomes you with a smile! Would definitely recommend!

author: Patrice Martin
review_text: Our server Zay was fantastic. He was friendly and knowledgeable. I had the Dallas filet and it was cooked perfectly and delicious. Zay suggested mushrooms and onions and that was a great addition. The mashed potatoes are perfect. The broccoli was cooked perfectly and buttery. The bread is sweet and yeasty. The kitchen was slower than expected: on that day, we probably waited 30 minutes for the salad to come out and the food came out 10 minutes after that. It was busy, and I was visiting with friends, so I didn't mind it so much. Overall, this visit changed my perspective on Texas Roadhouse. I will consider visiting the one closer to my home in the near future.

author: Elizabeth Wang
review_text: Peter Luger in Brooklyn is definitely worth visiting — the steak was delicious, cooked perfectly, and you can really feel the sense of tradition and history in the place. The old-school vibe adds to the charm and makes the experience memorable. That said, it’s pretty inconvenient that they only accept cash or debit cards. In 2025, that feels a bit outdated. Still, the food and atmosphere make it an iconic spot that’s worth trying at least once

author: Liliana M
review_text: Food is good, they have only out door sitting... minimal sitting available but it nice We alway order takeout.

author: Life Of Glo
review_text: I love coming here especially when Nehry is working! She’s such a sweet, caring server. She’s persistent always make sure the orders are done correctly, that we’re okay, & enjoying our food & drinks. I haven’t been seeing her much but i hope that she’s still there & to keep hiring great employees like her. Beautiful young lady!

author: Gillian Bertram
review_text: A disappointing dinner after the end of a shopping day. Kept things simple and ordered the shrimp Pad Thai, morning glory and clams with chili. Hardly any noodles in the pad Thai and after finally finding them they were very thin gluey noodles clumped together they saturated in too much sauce with way too much fried pork skin all over it. The clams were not fresh, smelt fishy and were overcooked or reheated from frozen , stringy, and basically not worth eating. Such a shame! Waitress also a bit clueless. Nice decor inside. Again, such a shame as reviews looked good at 4.9!

author: batutour -
review_text: BM Yam Rice is a 40-year-old traditional kopitiam in Bukit Mertajam that truly deserves its Michelin Guide recognition. Run by three sisters who took over from their father, this establishment serves exceptional yam rice cooked with shrimp paste, paired perfectly with their signature pork soup featuring pickled mustard greens. . While the non-air-conditioned environment might get warm during peak hours, the authentic flavors, especially after 12PM when the soup reaches its peak taste, make it well worth the visit. Their braised dishes, including pork leg, tofu, eggs, and sausages, are prepared fresh daily, maintaining consistently high quality that keeps both locals and international visitors coming back.

author: Jack Nedell
review_text: One of the best places to eat in this area. Their shawarma is fantastic, and their falafel too. Make sure you get a side of their homemade hot sauce if you like it spicy.

author: Jason Por How Tan
review_text: Lots of decent food options here. Special shout out to the 肉骨茶 stall at the last (outer) row of the hawker centre. Top quality and cheap price, definitely worth a shot.

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: ani jensen
review_text: This place is magical! I stumbled upon it before I went to the war museum, and it was definitely a high end restaurant! I spent about 40 AUD which is a lot more than a street meal, but the experience was so fun and good to treat yourself. They greeted me so nice and took care of everything for me. Hand towel, clearing my table and getting food to me so beautifully. The food was delicious!! Try the pork skewers, my fav. An amazing vibe and atmosphere while visiting sai gon.

author: Angel Hsu
review_text: Cute place in ironbound for tapas and drinks. Love the bar seating area and bartenders are friendly. They have a solid selection of draft beers as well. Just wish they’d update their tapas menu every now and then. Also pricier compared to other places in the area. The tres leches cake though, best I’ve ever had.

author: Paul Vetrano
review_text: Sat at the bar on two separate occasions. Sean and Steve were awesome and so was the entire staff. Delicious Sashimi and Oysters Rockefeller! Very cool vibe - and wonder sake selection! I would definitely return!

author: Erick Carrillo
review_text: We where here for my wife's birthday 🎉 excellent food and ambience. I like the steak and seafood. I would love to comeback another great spot in Ironbound

author: Grogu
review_text: Food was good. Serve attentive. Bathrooms clean. There was lots of free parking but the noise level im the restaurant was extremely loud. It is impossible to hold any sort of conversation. I would not recommend it for a date night or a place to go if you want to talk to each other.

author: BT L
review_text: My friend from mainland China wanted to try the Ipoh famous bean sprout chicken. Everything was good and my friends enjoyed it so much. Bean sprout is good and fresh but I think it’s little too much chicken fat. The ho fun in Ipoh is always good.

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: Jeng Shi Lee
review_text: The taste is blend and ordinary but when you add chilli powder to the noodle it changes the whole taste perspective. Chilli powder is spicy for people who couldn't eat spicy food advice not to take at all. The soya sauce on the table is good as well

author: SINCLAIR SINCLAIR -
review_text: They burnt my wings I tried them before Too much obay seasoning i had throw some away . Today my wings are burnt . Great service But the food i had i could've went to wendys . Good day 🥴

author: Kathryn B
review_text: Do not visit Las Vegas and miss out on experiencing Ameribrunch Cafe! Even though we visited at a PEAK time we were brought to our table quickly yet not rushed once we were seated. Every interaction with staff was lovely. Our server, Jonathan, was charming, funny & knowledgeable. The chorizo biscut is placed as one of my favorite brunch meals anywhere!!!! Chill music was at a level that allowed for conversation. Both the Bloody Mary and cappuccino were DELICIOUS. My only regret is that I couldn't finish everything because the portions are HUGE!!!! One of my favorite dining experiences in my 54 years of a travel filled life.

author: SKIP.ej1
review_text: Food was excellent 👌 loved it. Live band. Was so awesome.. order the ONION RiNGS.. there the best. Should have came back the next day when the Eagles played DeM B☆YS though. Otherwise this place is great. And will most def be coming back again.

author: Aft_and_About
review_text: I stopped by this restaurant last night (a Thursday) for a solo happy hour, and I’m so glad I did. Happy hour runs from 4–7 PM, which is perfect for easing into the evening. The atmosphere was perfectly chill with a DJ playing good music, and the marina views made the whole experience even better. I sat at the back bar where Monika and Mario were providing top-tier service. They were friendly, attentive, and had great menu recommendations. I really enjoyed chatting with both of them—they helped make the night feel relaxed and welcoming. For food, I ordered the mahi and wahoo fish dip as an appetizer, which was delicious. My first drink was the Pain Remover made with rum, and wow… that drink was sooo good. I ordered a #2, which comes with two shots, and it was perfectly balanced. During happy hour, there’s also a boat serving oysters, shrimp, and a few other items. I tried the oysters from Chesapeake, VA at $2 each and loved the self-serve condiment setup. I also tried a piña colada, mai tai, and a watermelon mojito. All were great, but the piña colada is an absolute must-try. Overall, I had a fantastic time and will definitely be going back. Highly recommend this spot for solo outings, happy hour, or just a chill evening by the marina! 🌅🍹🦪

author: CHARLES BOTTE
review_text: Seribu Rasa = thousand flavors, is one of our favorite restaurants to eat Indonesian foods with friends, we like this restaurants because they can customize their menu into the vegetarian foods, because very often we have an overseas guests that's required a vegetarian foods.

author: Ryan Adams
review_text: Overall, an excellent lunch. Service was a bit slow, but very friendly, and the fried oxtail was too chewy, but everything else was excellent. The BBH with bone marrow was quite good - good enough we ordered another bone marrow. The hen (baby clams) was very good, although perhaps just a touch sweet. The loco moco was excellent - better than any in the States that I have had. The Jasmine IPA from PSB on draft was fantastic. And they were nice enough to bring out crayons for the kids.

author: Laine
review_text: Always busy especially at peak hours like Friday night when we last had dinner here. We’ve been here numerous times and it never disappoints! Get the Pad See Ew, Papaya Salad, Crispy Egg Salad, Morning Glory, Pad Thai. Big family-size portions. Quick service. Just be prepared to wait! Parking is valet, cash only. Or you can try to find street parking.

author: Malena Mendez
review_text: I had such a great experience tonight! The place was full of life with a fun and welcoming atmosphere. The food was absolutely amazing everything was fresh, flavorful, and cooked perfectly. Our server, Maddi, truly made the experience even better. She was friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed. Thank you, Maddi, for the wonderful service! I will definitely be coming back.

author: Michael Arthur
review_text: WOW. What an incredible dining experience. The flavors here are STELLAR. Yes, it’s heavy and it’s oily, but you will love it. I did!! One of the best meals I had in Malaysia.

author: Vanessa Cheung
review_text: Excellent food with fast service. Granted we were the only party since we arrived before they closed. There was a kiosk to order but you can also use the QR code. Pho broth was ok, Bun Bo Hue broth could've been better. Portions were huge though. The dumplings and spring rolls were surprisingly delicious.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: truong nguyen
review_text: The service is bad, the staff is understaffed, I keep ordering more noodles but they still don't come out.

author: Michelle Rowlands
review_text: I absolutely loved it! The food was amazing. Service was good. Not too over the top & not lacking either. I went for Sunday brunch. Prices were pretty good especially for the amount of food. Would highly recommend. My husband actually went back that same evening to meet some colleagues. If I lived closer, I would definitely be dining at least once a week.

author: Lee Eric
review_text: Very disappointing with the maintenance of food market; the big fan has not been in service for more than half a year, and the recent closure for blending the good market during Christmas period also did not repair or put the fan as n in service! What is the main purpose for closure gif service and was the big ceiling fan was included for the maintenances? Food for thought 🐷🐷🐷

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: Victoria Ho
review_text: Had a really good meal at Zhup Zhup — no wonder they’re a Michelin Bib Gourmand awardee! The flavours were bold yet comforting, and you can really taste the effort that goes into their rich, umami-packed broth. Here’s what we tried: 🍜 Dry Five Fortune Jumbo Prawn Mee / Kway Teow Mix – packed with wok hei and generous tiger prawns 🍲 Jumbo Prawn Paofan – warm, comforting, and full of seafood flavour 🍗 Har Cheong Gai – super crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside 🥤 Calamansi Sour Plum Soda – bright and refreshing 🥤 Sour Plum Prune Soda – a great balance of sweet, salty, and tangy Service was quick and friendly, and the food came out piping hot. Highly recommend Zhup Zhup if you love prawn noodles, hearty broths, and comforting local flavours done right! 🦐✨

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: Mike Ang
review_text: They are good for the pig mix soup, but maybe can consider give up selling this pork leg ? It will bring up the review instead.

author: Victor Hernandez
review_text: I’ve visited this restaurant several times and always enjoyed it, but on this occasion I noticed the quality has gone down a bit. Food quality: The Caesar salad had no dressing and the garlic shrimp lacked seasoning also. The sides of tostones were old, they just heated up a little. I truly hope they bring back the great flavor and freshness that used to set them apart because I’ve always liked this place, but they definitely need to fix something with the kitchen staff. On the other side… They have a very good customer service, what always makes us return there. The beautiful host Camila was very kind and find us a comfortable table. And our server Richard was attentive and kind. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Prices 💰: For such a fancy place, the prices are very suitable to your pocket, we had 2 main course, 2 no alcoholic drinks, one appetizer and a salad for $53 excluding the tip. Which is not bad at all.

author: Armen B
review_text: My kids love this place. For adults it is little greasy but kids love French fries.

author: Sumaiya Miah
review_text: racist and homophobic. joe told my friends from mexico "welcome to america" before they kicked us out. wish i could give negative stars. i will not be visiting again

author: rossana urugutia
review_text: We enjoy this food halls when we want a bit of different food, a change for our tastebuds. More of a mature food halls than others in the area. Always stop by when we are in Boston

author: Vũ Thị Kim Chi
review_text: A bit pricey, but totally worth it. The bún Huế and bún riêu were absolutely delicious, while the spring rolls were just okay. The atmosphere like a working space, good place to work then have a food later

author: Belles Marcial
review_text: The food at Chang Yang Ji was absolutely delicious! The staff (Apple) was incredibly friendly and attentive, and it was a great value for the quality of the food. The prices were reasonable too. It’s a perfect spot for families and circle of friends…

author: Grace Kusen
review_text: this place has been our go-to place in bali for years and it never disappoints. we ordered the pork knuckle, caesar salad, and truffle fries. everything was amazing and fulfilling! satya, one of the staff members, was very helpful and friendly, which made the experience even better. a true must-go in bali. as always, we’ll definitely be back!🫶

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: Dia Worakittikul
review_text: Basic, standard taste for local, perhaps good for foreigner not for local. Price is a bit expensive comparing to portion 5 main dishes, 1,8xx THB. taste is rich, spicy but not flavourful, especially Kang-kua-hoi-kom, spicy, coconut milk but not well balanced. Service is on par, when asking what is mixed in this curry, they can’t tell, need to go back and ask in the kitchen. nothing convince me to comeback again.

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: Vidya Andarikha
review_text: One of the best thunder tea rice I've tried. Their portion is huge, my jaw felt a bit sore after munching all those veggies, but it's worth it!

author: Jade Jimenez
review_text: GREAT FOOD! GREAT SERVICE! The drinks were so tasty. Reasonably priced. It was raining and the employee at the door held an umbrella for us to walk to our grab. Waiter was very helpful in guiding us to order. Overall had a great experience here

author: Ivett Vics
review_text: Ate here twice during my stay in Canggu, both times fantastic! Tried their pulled jackfruit burger, and the cauli rice bowl. Lovely variety or dishes both vegan, and vegetarian and delicious drinks, ice teas, kombucha, juices, smoothies etc. The atmosphere is lovely, all tables outside in the garden under the trees - hence the name - with natural furnishings and lamps, take mosquito spray in the evening though! Serive is very fast and friendly with a smile.

author: ST
review_text: We had such an amazing server, Brittney like Britney Spears! She was so attentive and I swear her energy alone made my Las Vegas trip much better. The food was pretty damn good. And the wait was nonexistent. it was so weird that IHOP was the best place we went to in Las Vegas, but it was really great!

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: CK Cheong
review_text: Many good food options like mutton soup, fried carrot cake, duck rice, wanton noodles and Nana curry. The hawker centre us a little run down and could definitely do with some upgrades. It is also not easy to find parking especially during peak hours and weekends

author: Kavin Chan
review_text: A mom-and-pop Thai restaurant, with a TV outside looping a video of their menu items. The owner explained that they immigrated to the US and couldn’t find any authentic Thai restaurants, so they decided to open their own. I found this a bit amusing, as many Thai and exotic restaurants are founded, and I doubt all of them are not authentic. On my first night, I ordered the raw shrimp salad, which was good, but I think my stomach wasn’t reacting well to it. The next day, I tried something more popular and ordered the morning glory. It was good, but I wish they had added more chili to it. The pad thai was great. It was served separately with bean sprouts and peanut crumbs. The dish wasn’t as sweet as other Thai restaurants, which I prefer. My order came with tofu, and it was generous. I highly recommend it.

author: Armand Urb
review_text: I read reviews from Italian restaurants in the Forest Hill area and found the most consistent positive here. I showed up asked Manuel my server his favorites and I must say I agree with the taste from each one of these dishes. Step out your comfort zone and trust works at these restaurants, I will be back for more dishes another day

author: Kelvin Cheung
review_text: Food taste: Their fried rice, fried noodles, bee hoon, hor fun taste have all deteriorated, blend and doesn't taste nice anymore. Food price: Don't ever order medium size ones. Charged double the price, give a bigger box without much quantity increase. Just order 2 small packets for better value. Service: They are always rushing and usually very grouchy.

author: Aaron Brown
review_text: The burgers are on par with Whataburger. There, i said it and I'm sticking to it. The service was great, very friendly and helpful to a first timer, and they guys cooking are fast and efficient. Don't get me started on the chicken strips. One word: Huge. That milkshake, omg! I'm officially designating R Burgers best burger Las Vegas 2025. That's official, write it down, make a plaque, go ahead and give it to them

author: Yager
review_text: I recently visited Blueprint Café, and although I arrived close to closing time, Ivan still provided excellent service with a welcoming and positive attitude. His professionalism and warm demeanor made such a strong impression on me that I’ve decided this will be my go-to spot for work on a daily basis, if possible. I’m so happy to have discovered this hidden gem in Newark. Having lived here all my life, I never knew this place existed, but you can be sure I’ll be telling all my friends about both Blueprint and Ivan’s incredible service!

author: Ines 063
review_text: A fantastic find in Ho Chi Minh City! The food was incredibly delicious and the portions were a great size for the price. I love that they have plenty of vegetarian options available. I highly recommend the Vietnamese-style curry with vermicelli—it was packed with fresh vegetables and several types of mushrooms that had a unique and interesting flavor profile. Compliments to the chef! The restaurant itself is beautifully decorated, creating a lovely local atmosphere, and the staff were exceptionally kind and welcoming. It's also in a perfect location: right near a park and within easy walking distance of Ben Thanh Market. Definitely worth a visit!

author: Yerai P
review_text: We really enjoyed having dinner at Wahahas! Pork ribs were amazing. Also the service was really great. Our waitress Desi was the best! I fully recommend eating here.

author: Sam Tan
review_text: Food may be good, I'll explain why. We were asked to leave at 1 pm on the 1st floor cause they are closing the section without a good explanation. And we just managed to take our seat around 12.45pm. I do not understand why they do that. We have to finish up our lunch in a hurry and dun even have chances to taste the food well. Overall, very bad service cause the restaurant is not respected their customer.

author: Tam N
review_text: If I could give the service here six stars out of five, I absolutely would. We were lucky enough to have a waiter named FRANCO, and he completely elevated the entire experience. From the moment he started sharing stories about the dishes to the way he guided us through the menu, it felt like we were getting a fine dining experience in a casual setting. He made sure we had just the right amount of food—never too much or too little—and every recommendation felt genuinely thoughtful. You could tell he took real pride in his work, and it made a huge difference. As for the food, it was top-notch. I’d give it a solid five out of five. Honestly, I walked in a bit skeptical because they had so many good reviews, and I thought they might be overhyped. But nope—everything was delicious, fresh, and exactly what we hoped for from a great Peruvian spot. Finally, the atmosphere had a really nice vibe—no complaints at all. So if you’re in Miami and you want an amazing Peruvian meal with outstanding service, CVI.CHE 105 is absolutely worth it!

author: simone food.channel
review_text: [can try le] 1) Overall - Chinese hawker store, long wait for chicken hor fun, do go in the morning, ok service and cleanliness, food and drink selection are chicken hor fun, curry mee, dry curry mee, chee cheong fun, chicken rice noodle, kuey teow soup and more from Restoran Moon De Moon 2) chicken hor fun with fish ball - soft and smooth noodle, sweet prawn and chicken broth. tasted good. fish ball was ok.

author: Estela Cordeiro
review_text: Took a ride from Boston (Massachusetts) to Newark (New Jersey) to drop off some boxes at a transport company to ship to Portugal and stumbled upon this Coimbra Bar & Restaurant and what a treat it was. Our server Pedro was amazing!!! The piglet was the best I’ve ever had, with its crispy skin, and the service was 5 stars even with the Saturday lunch rush. This is definitely a site we will be visiting again. See you soon!

author: Jowen Goh
review_text: I came around 5:30pm and luckily there wasn’t a very long queue. The buns are toasted with butter and then filled with whatever fillings we choose. I ordered their Pandan and thai milk tea, both were divine. Fillings were generous and the servers were also very friendly.

author: Marvin Fuentes
review_text: The four horsemen has to be one of the best dining experiences I’ve been to this year. Everything was exquisite from the presentation to the music. But all the credit has to go to our Bartender Will; his knowledge of wine and bitters and amaro is renowned with some of the best in the game. Sit at the bar and thank me later

author: Wade Marshall
review_text: I just want to thank you to Ichabobs for a wonderful Thanksgiving dinner. The atmosphere was outstanding. The customer service was even better. My experience there was 100% delightful Thank you Ichabobs .

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Jonathan
review_text: Bun Cha set with extra meatballs and spring roll ordered on grab. Food came quickly, packed in individual boxes to ensure freshness. Grilled pork and meatballs were well seasoned, spring roll crispy and delicious. Wrapped with lettuce almost felt like a Korean meat wrap

author: Andre Krause
review_text: Ordered lunch from 3 “kitchens” vendors. Wasn’t really a place to sit and eat. It’s really for pick-up only, but food options were solid and varied. My group of 3, got a Banh Mi sandwich, a BLT with waffle fries, and a “chicken and waffles” plate, from three separate vendors. We ordered ahead via online and grabbed food as soon as we arrived. Very quick.

author: Edward Phipps
review_text: I ordered a churrasco for 1 person, with medium rare steak, collard greens & black beans. The waitress took my order made me pay before I got my order, and never got back to me until she brought my order more than 30mins later. Never acknowledged or apologized they had me waiting forever for a take out order. When I got home & looked my food, my steak was well done & I got red beans. The food was great but…. Common courtesy & good customer service.

author: X D
review_text: This hawker centre has one of the best Porridge stall in Singapore Mei Xiang Porridge 01-34

author: M Morraz
review_text: First off, the name is quite misleading. We went looking for fresh food and were met with plastic looking eggs and potatoes. The waitress was nice, but then didn’t circle back to check on us.

author: Dipti Modi
review_text: Ummm may one of the bad days but right from food to drinks everything went bad that day including waiting of 50 minutes for Food. I understand the wait time but yet every restaurant accounts for more people on weekend. Not my choice to repeat except for Ambience. I ordered Paneer and hummus platter. hummus was good and Falafel There is a jaljeera drink with vodka. Badly made with over chilli and not a drink I would recommend. I asked to replace, but they totally forgot. Overall quite sad as I was quite excited 😊 to visit this place

author: Le Summer
review_text: Happening was there today. Relax and chill with nice food, nice view and awesome service by Wendy. Glad to have her today, make my trip in Singapore with good mood

author: Joshua C Bonifas
review_text: I recently dined at [Restaurant Name], and I have to say, the service was truly exceptional. The staff was attentive and always made sure we had everything we needed, checking in frequently without being intrusive. It really enhanced the dining experience. As for the food, it was decent but didn’t quite meet my expectations. While the flavors were good, some dishes felt a bit underwhelming compared to the high standard set by the service. Overall, I would recommend this place for its outstanding service, but I hope they can elevate their menu to match the quality of their hospitality. I look forward to seeing how they improve in the future!

author: Ronnie Chew
review_text: This bakery sells delicious breads. All types of breads. I've tried quite a variety and it's pretty good. My favourite is dates and walnuts. The apricot bread however is quite rough and dry. I don't like it that much. Walnuts and dates to be should be the best. My personal opinion 🤗 Don't go during opening time at 10am. There's so many people waiting to go in, it's quite ridiculous. I saw that crowd last week thinking I'll buy my favourite bread but I kept going. I'm not crowding with them. Go around 10.30. It may not be as crowded. Your favourite breads would not be ready if you go too early though so be warned. Call first to check availablity.

author: Christina W.
review_text: Really love having access to a vegetarian spot. The food was great, especially the mushroom calamari and Pad Thai. It’s not vegan but they’ll ask if you’re ok with eggs, etc. Very friendly wait staff and super helpful. We did have a bit of an issue regarding our seating but happy with everything else.

author: michael aldryan
review_text: Just amazing. One of the best pork dishes in Bali (babi guling). Price is very cheap with the high quality taste. There is big queue but Waiting time is short due to the speedy staff action. While you wait there is also many traditional food outside. I recommend the jumbo size of nasi campur. Dont forget to try the sate babi. Drinks also nice such as coffe bal, es buah, es daluman. The view is also nice, you can see rice fields while eat that delicious foods! Recommend!

author: Ali Major
review_text: Everything was delicious 😋 The best Vietnamese crispy pancake ever, and it is huge! The book choy with shitake mushrooms was so good and the Hanoi rolls juicy and left over for breakfast! Hats off to Fish for excellent service, he is an asset to the restaurant.

author: World Traveler
review_text: This place 3 years ago was wonderful Great service, amazing food and good times This time 11/624 the bartender kept complaining about the customers asking questions etc, the food is just ok now. It's not the fun atmosphere it used to have. I will probably not return. Sad for me ***I should add that if you are a local, it's a different experience. They will take care of you better if you are a regular customer.

author: Raquel Hokett
review_text: My sister and I were in town for a concert and were staying at the Port of Miami Holiday Inn. This little café/bakery was right behind the building! I could not stop stating how damn cute and fabulous this place was, the instant I walked in. They have a little gift shop where you can get shirts, cups, and little knick knacks. Too pricey for me (coffee mug in the $25-$30 range) but I understand it’s a small business thing. The items were seemingly well crafted and adorable! The atmosphere was very cutesy and welcoming and I just wish there was a place like this where I live. I would literally WALK there every day! We had a chocolate muffin and a hazelnut filled croissant which were out of this world. I had asked if I could get an iced vanilla latte with oat milk (was not on the menu) and the barista told me he could make me anything I wanted. Those three items cost $20. I was delighted to see that they actually serve lunch/dinner items and regret not going back. I heavily contemplated only eating from this place for our entire weekend stay! It really is that good. Reminded me of the bakeries in Italy. I actually thought all of the food on display was fake. Like when you go into Starbucks or something. But it is REAL! My croissant and my sister’s muffin was plucked right from the display window! Highly recommend! You will NOT be disappointed. We got our food to go and I was just praising my coffee the entire time I took a sip. Best coffee I have EVER had made. So creamy and flavorful and not bitter or too sweet. Just perfect.

author: YEW KEEN LIM
review_text: A comfortable shop with several food supply, got noodle, got rice, got some simple Dim Sum. Tea and juice is very good experience here and staff are friendly, shop owner also very well taking care Food is good taste and meet the Asia style. Price is reasonable and is worth. The shop is expanding, next time will have more seat. Hehe

author: Jamie Schnaitter
review_text: The classic tonkotsu ramen was fantastic. The broth is rich and slightly smoky. The shaved ice (kaki-goori) was ok, it’s a very large portion but would be better a little less fancy and closer to the real thing. Besides the bit of cream and anko, it was a bit bland. It would have been better soaked with condensed milk as is usual in Japan.

author: Cindy W
review_text: Our meal was delicious, and the service overall was pleasant, but the hostess was not well trained and thus ruined the overall experience for us. The cocktails were decent, but nothing out of the ordinary. Some must-get food items are “whipped eggplant”, “octopus salad” (even though I have been avoiding eating octopus given the Netflix show), and the various pasta dishes (gemelli and ragu). Reservation is a must here. We were here to catch up with friends, so it didn’t bother us that we were seated in the garden section (no exterior view) of the restaurant rather than the lounge area that gets packed with patrons there for the sunset views. The restaurant is in partnership with GreenPlaces to reduce carbon footprints by charging a 0.5% fee per check. It was a relatively small amount but goes a long way to make the guests feel good that we get to participate in something positive.

author: Being Fancy Entertainment
review_text: This was me and my cousins first time. The food was good and the servings were big while the prices was cheap. The service was amazing and I will definitely be returning. The stuff mushrooms was so good.

author: C Ware
review_text: The service was very slow and we had to keep asking for things (silverware, our food, napkins). The food was average, decent burger.

author: Iustin Raducanu
review_text: Delicious local food in a traditional setting. Service is more than excellent and prices are very reasonable for the area. Heard that this place can get very busy throughout the summer, however we got a table with minimal wait (in December). Note that their last order is at 9.15pm.

author: Tamara Hemphill
review_text: I tried the pastrami again yesterday and it was really good. I can tell they did something different. The roll was really soft and the pastrami was flavorful. I really enjoyed it. I like the size of the fries..in between skinny and thick

author: Songren Lim
review_text: Decided to check this place out due to the close proximity to my accommodation. It was a delightful experience. The Ladyboss was friendly and ushered me to the air conditioned dining area which was a nice surprise. Felt their Bak Kut teh was decent but would definitely return for their unique dim sum dishes and variety.

author: Mark ปาริน
review_text: Pleasant fine dining with air conditioning restaurant, thai foods, drinks and of course mango and glutinous rice with coconut milk...

author: JasJ
review_text: First time here, I would say this is like more of a experience, beef was good vege there is brocoli and carrot unli refill. Price a lil high I can undersrand that coz they use high quality mean, good rice. The good thing is you can adjust the meat raw to welldone to urself. The most important thing the service ziyu provided was professional and attentive, carving and make sure that we enjoy it. Soup she also ask if we need tofu or mushroom. Overall good service good food!

author: Nguyen Thanh Tam
review_text: This restaurant offers a beautiful and peaceful atmosphere, with seating options indoors, in the garden, and by the river. The menu features a variety of Vietnamese dishes, not only from Hội An but also from across Vietnam. The flavors are thoughtfully adjusted to suit different guests, ensuring that the food isn’t overly sweet or greasy while still staying true to its authentic essence. The staff are nice and caring for our needs

author: Jonathan Alker
review_text: They do an amazing cheeseburger here and the wife loved her vegetarian burger. Fries are delicious and staff are friendly and funny. The prices are a little high but the quality of the ingredients mostly justifies it. If you've had a few beers and can't be bothered to wait for a sit-down meal, this will hit the spot.

author: Ana Sassin
review_text: Still blown away by the idea of 17 restaurants in 1 drive thru open til 1am. The college students always get the good eateries LOL it is in a bit of a weird place that almost seems like GPS is leading you into a nightmare if you're going late at night. But then all of a sudden, you'll see the skinny, well-lit opening between two warehouses that is the Grand Food Depot. Tried Sundays Korean Fried chicken wings. Very tasty however the wings aren't large. And they give a ton of waffle fries. Almost too many. Definitely going back to try some of the other spots.

author: Tameka Osborne
review_text: Great place for a high end sports bar and food experience! Great drinks and food at a reasonable price.

author: Li0neL Ng
review_text: I'm a foreigner trying to taste local food as my friend suggested me (small stainless steel chair, small restaurant in a small valley, local foods). I didn't want to ruin other people money making restaurant, but for me almost all vietnamese food kinda plain (I ordered beef chowfun) But my friends like it (they ordered macaroni fried beef & pork chop with rice)... It's cheap, smells good & fast And the ahma/grandma is still welcoming us even its already 21.30ish

author: Agustina Rastelli Gatti
review_text: I got my wedding cake from here, and it was the best one I’ve ever tried ❤️ I will get my facturas today!

author: Melissa Sepulveda
review_text: I had a great experience at Landshark Bayside . From the hostess to the waitress. I loved my entire experience.The hostess Alexandra immediately welcomed us and sat us at the table we requested.The waitress Piper was friendly and funny making sure our food came out on time. Piper approached our table several times making sure we had everything that we needed at our reach. The manager Raul was very attentive to our services making sure our experience was great and that our food was up to standards. Our view was great as we watched the boats come into dock.

author: Ana Butler
review_text: Breaking from my routine introduced me to this gem. Employees understand the menu while staying approachable. You get genuine service and delicious meals. The servings here are generous and taste exceptional. Another trip here is guaranteed.

author: Yelloboi Jaysen TJ
review_text: I was recommended by my Indian friend. So I purposely came over to try. But it's not up to our expectation. The curry is not flavorful enough. The price is quite reasonable, staff is friendly. There are more nasi kandar with better taste. Sorry, no second visit.

author: Wayne Tota
review_text: Im not a nightout person but was buffled at what i saw😂.. noisy stuff, free adverts of everything ..they sell anything..check out all videos on my youtube @drwaynetota. I uploaded them all will upload some here. I only managed to eat Mcdonalds, afraid to be pulled into some bar😂

author: Michal Berkovich
review_text: Great spot next to Bayside Marketplace! Excellent coffee and desserts, with friendly and attentive service. Perfect place to grab something to eat before or after a boat tour at Bayside in Miami. Highly recommended!

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: joe conners
review_text: The atmosphere felt really homey and warm like eating home cooked meals but ready in 5 mins. Very simple food with lots of condiments to choose from so you can customize the noodles to your liking. The base itself is already flavourful so the condiments are only there to enhance it. The egg noodles are extra springy but if you put even one tablespoon of soup, it’ be less springy. So if you want to retain the bounce don’t add soup to loosen it. Very affordable too!

author: Tan
review_text: ✅️ Halal ✅️ QR Code payment ✅️ Delicious ✅️ Easy to order ✅️ Friendly staff ✅️ Not oily ❌️ No pork lard Do note that as this is a halal-certified store, they do not have pork lard. Surprisingly good though! I love how it doesn't feel oily and still has the char kway teow taste. It's very nicely done! Be patient with the stallholder as he is doing everything by himself. It is worth the wait, can afford to get the medium sized if you have an appetite.

author: Đorđe Jovanović
review_text: Everything was absolutely delicious! The pasta portion could have been a bit larger, but the taste was simply delicious. Our waiter, Ode, was incredibly polite and friendly. Not only did he recommend some fantastic cocktails, but they were also well-made.

author: Rachel Avila
review_text: Kind of scary because we went to use the restroom and one of the workers were in there using the restroom and they walked out without washing their hands so we never end up getting anything except for I got a flawn that wasn't that great I've had better and that was pre-wrapped already that's the only reason why I bought it just because we went to use the restroom but other than that we would never go back

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Banana Gus
review_text: Awesome Padang restaurant. They are located in numerous locations and I went to the one in PIK. It was a Sunday for lunch, place was packed. Had to wait for 10-15 minutes for our table. Food were fresh and tasted so good. Service was excellent. One of my go-to place for nasi Padang.

author: Marcus Nah
review_text: Plenty of nice food.. if you see long queue just go for it.. But the hawker is rather quite noisy...

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Duangsamorn Songmuang
review_text: Delicious A la carte .slow cooking.service is ok.chill atmosphere .

author: Evelyn Puentes
review_text: I'm not sure how it is on all locations. But contacted the store and expressed how upsetting it is to buy 4 sandwiches, 16 dollars and not get enough sauce on my breakfast sandwiches. Person on phone states that is the procedure, half an ounce of sauce. It's not worth at all paying so much and thats all your gonna get. Even the muffin is missing pieces, is that standard procedure too.

author: Hello Dude
review_text: The food was phenomenal! Your manager there, what's her name? Jennifer is a wonder to be around. If I had anything to complain about I just wish you would add strawberry/grape jelly to the menu. The biscuit can be a little dry. 11/10 otherwise. Please think about the jelly.

author: Takahiro Koyama
review_text: Geylang Lor 9 Frog Porridge (芽笼九巷活田鸡) has been serving up its famous frog dishes since 1995, and it’s won tons of awards like The GreenBook Best Food Awards and Singapore Brands Awards. Open daily from 11:00 AM to 4:00 AM, it’s super convenient—just a heads up, it gets really busy at night and into the late hours. The menu has all kinds of frog dishes like frog porridge, claypot frog, and fried frog, plus seafood, chicken, and veggie options too. You can choose portions for 1, 2, or 3 people for the porridge and claypot frog, so it’s fun to order different spice levels and share with friends. Dry Chili Frog (宮保田鸡) This one’s spicy! It’s frog cooked in a sweet soy-based sauce packed with dried chilies. If you’re not big on heat, go for the Ginger Spring Onion version instead. The frog meat includes legs, shoulders, and more—tastes kind of like a cross between cod and chicken. The thighs are especially juicy and flavorful! Ginger Fried Frog (蒜片炸田鸡) This dish has chopped frog pieces lightly battered and fried until crispy. Each bite is crunchy on the outside and tender inside, with a simple salt seasoning. Don’t forget to dip it in chili sauce—so good! Plain Porridge (白粥・小) Lime Juice with Sour Plum Ice Jelly (愛玉冰)

author: Khanh Doan Ngoc Mai
review_text: As a Vietnamese I am proud to say this restaurant got the flavor and the presentation of the dishes 1000/100. Everything was so extraordinary that I wanted to come back. For all of you who are checking for what to eat: dare to explore anything new besides pho cause they are all amazing. Taste some wraps, rolls and the dessert as well☺️

author: Kevin Hubbard
review_text: The food and smoothie were both excellent but this place shines because of their service. Calista was one of the best servers I've ever seen. Not only did she handle my table with care, there was a difficult person at the table next to me who had some pretty odd requests. Not only did she not question them, the chef came out to confirm exactly how the person wanted his food, showing that this attitude is part of the culture of the cafe. Kudos to the management who are fostering such a great environment. If my business was in Miami I definitely would have tried to offer Calista a job working for me.

author: Ruki Dole
review_text: We first ate here when we visited Miami in 2017. It was so good we had to come back! Today Romina was our server and helped us figure out the right mix of dishes to make a late lunch an amazing experience! Highly recommend this place!

author: Alireza Habibzadeh
review_text: Delicious and smoky. The restrooms are paid though! Even for customers. It’s just a quarter but who has coins these days.

author: Chris Ianiri
review_text: This restaurant offers nice water views and outdoor seating. The staff is very friendly and accommodating. The food was phenomenal! I highly recommend the blue crab ravioli meal… One of the best seafood dishes I’ve had in a long time! Definitely check this place out!

author: Charles Lowman
review_text: This place is phenomenal! The best lunch I have had in a really long time! The spices on the jerk chicken blew my mind. It was pure heaven. The plantains were perfect in every way…. Slightly caramelized on the outside, a bit sweet, with warm spices to complement. The environment was also exceptional. The well trained staff and the beautiful decor made me feel so welcome. It was a pleasure to dine here. I hope you will go check them out very soon!

author: Dara Behjat
review_text: Definitely worth the hype. The food is exceptional. Pizza Bianca with the tomato relish is delicious bite and the bread is so perfect, the pepperoni pizza with hot honey is probably the only thing we ate that you can skip but it's still really good, clams and guanciale is cooked to perfection and the sauce is addicting, the bucatini with chilli anchovy butter is one of my favorite dishes I've had, perfect chew and flavor. The sausage cavatelli was a delicious change of pace again a perfect cook on the pasta, finally the taleggio signature dish, absolutely delicious, if you're going with a group I'd probably get it as a shared plate because it is so so rich. Service was also stellar

author: Ehsan Asadi
review_text: The food was generally okay. The portion was smaller than I expected. The chicken wasn't cooked well though. The kobideh was better than the chicken. The service was not professional. They had difficulty managing 5 tables.

author: T. Sanichara
review_text: Our experience has always been amazing! From the owner to Valentino to Raphael, the bartender, Gonzalo and the rest of the crew have always been great! Great service and great food!

author: Irene Curbelo
review_text: The place is beautiful. It has options to sit inside our outside by the marina. The music inside is good enough to enjoy a meal with a beautiful conversation. It is clean, staff is friendly. Very good customer service and attention. Food is AMAZING. Servings easily serve 2 people, the dessert comes with a cute presentation. It is fresh and tasty. The drinks selection is so good. So many tequilas .. they can even make your cocktail with the tequila of choice. Our waiter was Malena, truly recommend her , she knows her menu and her recommendation were 10/10

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: Jacob Yap
review_text: Authentic Thai Flavors & Great Vibes We had lunch here on New Year’s Day 2026, and it was the perfect start to the year! Ekachan definitely did not disappoint. • The Food: The cuisine is incredibly authentic. We highly recommend the Tom Yum Goong, Fried Fish, and the Pomelo Salad. Don't miss out on the Mixed Rice — it was too a highlight of our meal! • The Venue: The space is beautiful and spacious, but it gets very crowded because it’s so popular among tourist. • Pro Tip: Strongly suggest making a reservation in advance to avoid a long wait. Overall, a fantastic spot for ethnic Thai cuisine in Chiang Mai. Highly recommended!

author: Jo S
review_text: Ehh. It’s a try hard scene-y spot that only cares who you are. I have been there numerous times and tried to give them the benefit of the doubt, but the last time I was there it became abundantly clear. Friends from out of town always want to go here, and I have been happy to oblige as I enjoy the sunset views and their famous eggplant dip. But every time I’ve been here, I’ve been treated like an imposition for simply being there, shoved at a table with barely enough space, crammed between 4 other parties and a server trying to rush to get their next cover. The last time I was there, they were “setting up for a private party” which literally included tables being carried OVER my party. It was stressful and chaotic. When asking our server, she was immediately rude about the situation. There were at least 10 open tables in the front (near the railing) but I was told those were all booked. Then some influencers in sweatpants came in, were given those tables and I watched the staff members discuss their needs and serve them right away; while I’ve been waiting 10 minutes for a drink and am having tables carried over me. I follow another Bachelor contestant on Instagram that is always perched in the front. This is a see and be scene spot more than anything, and if you’re an everyday person trying to enjoy the sunset with your mom, you’re better off elsewhere.

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: Rajen Arasu
review_text: Iconic market in the East... has 2 levels comprising the market and sundry stalls on the Ground level offering a myriad of grocery and market items, and Hawker dining and retail stalls offering apparel and household items on the Second level. Very crowded especially on weekends. Time for a major renovation to the market area and hawker dining area as it's very congested. A few hawker stalls on the 2nd level are "Legacy Hawkers" having existed in the old Geylang Serai Market 50 years ago or more.

author: YC Teh
review_text: A relatively new restaurant in 2023 serving western food with creative twist. Food is okay, sevice is decent, price is reasonable (around Rm20 for a main). A summary - Hawthorn Cheesy Chicken - 4/5 Kerabu Fish and Chips - 2.5/5 Mushroom Soup - 3/5 On to the deets: Their Hawthorn Cheesy Chicken is savoury and juicy. The chicken cutlet is thick as well. Overall not bad. The plating, fries, sides and taste reminds me of Empat Sekawan’s chicken chops for those of you who have tried it. The Kerabu Fish and Chips pales in comparison. The fish fillet feels like one of those dory from the supermarket frozen foods section. It lacks the flakiness and creaminess of a good fillet. Nothing special about the mushroom soup. There are mushroom chunks but could be better with fewer fillers and more mushroom-y. Would I return again? Maybe, but only for their chicken.

author: J. Thomas
review_text: Huge recommendation for Pho and Bun Cha (probably everything else as well)! Lovely owners/staff, explanations how to eat and cook included :) all the best!

author: CarolineN (PJbabe)
review_text: Had waited an hour to get my food. First time tasting their kai si hor fun and dry curry mee. The food was tasty. But to wait 1 hr? I would give it a miss if there is a next time in Ipoh. Can find almost equivalent in kl with shorter waiting time

author: Bugwagen
review_text: Lots of good food here. 👍🏻 We like the satay, hokkien mee, carrot cake. Very popular hawker so parking can be a challenge. Also when it rains, it is not fully sheltered

author: hung nguyen
review_text: I recently had the pleasure of dining at Làng Nướng Nam Bộ and I must say, it was an exceptional experience. From the moment I stepped foot into the restaurant, I was greeted with warm hospitality and a cozy ambiance that set the stage for a memorable evening. The highlight of my visit was undoubtedly the delectable array of grilled dishes. Làng Nướng Nam Bộ truly knows how to bring out the flavors in their dishes, as each bite was bursting with succulent and perfectly cooked meats. Whether it was the tender grilled beef, the flavorful marinated chicken, or the fresh seafood, every dish was a delightful combination of textures and tastes. What impressed me even more was the attention to detail in their presentation. Each dish was beautifully arranged, showcasing the culinary artistry that goes into their creations. The vibrant colors and enticing aromas added to the overall sensory experience, making the meal even more enjoyable. Not only was the food exceptional, but the service was top-notch as well. The staff at Làng Nướng Nam Bộ were attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable. They took the time to explain the menu options and offer recommendations, ensuring that every guest had a personalized dining experience. The restaurant itself boasts a charming and cozy atmosphere, making it the perfect place to enjoy a meal with friends, family, or that special someone. The spacious seating arrangements and tasteful decor create a welcoming ambiance that enhances the dining experience.

author: V A (Tom)
review_text: Pros: love the vibe. Very comfortable, very relaxed while also having a refined edge. The whole fish snapper was cooked to perfection. The chimichuri steak was 10/10 , tender and flavorful. Calamari is one of the best in town. Nice and crispy. The cesar salad was fresh, and the dressing was perfect. Our waiter Tyrone was absolutely fantastic , friendly, warm, and polite. Cons: what in gods name are we doing with the key lime pie? That radioactive green "kiwi lime syrup" that was drizzled on it was an abomination. The pie was 6/10 to begin with but that syrup added a nice little nursing home food touch to it. In fact, don't put that gross syrup on any of the other desserts please. Also, it's supposed to come with vanilla ice cream, but our came with melted caramel instead. What a flavor nightmare.

author: Adeline Rebekah Peh
review_text: The service at the Changi Airport Qatar lounge is amazing. They have lockers for travellers to store their bags. I was served by Hazel, Else, Jessy, Pinky, and Anu this evening. The staff are so attentive right from when you enter. They kept coming to check that I had everything I needed and that all was in order. There is a small cold buffet station and ala carte menu. I ordered the burrata as an appetizer, lamb rack, and chocolate fondant. So good. The lamb was juicy, even though I left it sitting for awhile (busy attacking the burrata). I heard that the grilled beef tenderloin is really good too but sadly, I was too full.

author: Anil Soekhoe
review_text: We had an amazing experience at the omakase table. The chef and his whole team are so much focussed on delivering a good time with the best quality sushi and sashimi that we have ever tasted! We even tried food that we never ate before and the chef made us try all these new fish. This place is a must go when you are in Penang. We visited 2 times in 4 days we spent in Penang. Next to the fact that they have amazing fresh food, the talks with the chef and his team made us feel so welcome. Once again, I’m from Europe and dine on a regular basis in high quality restaurants, but this place is a hidden gem when it comes to quality, hospitality and honesty. Worth every cent spent. Thanks Ron and your team and hope to see you again. Chocolate regards from Lucia and Anil (the pastry and chocolate guy)

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Michael Phạm
review_text: We had such a great experience dining at Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ! The food was delicious—fresh, full of flavour, and beautifully presented. We were lucky enough to visit during a special event, so we got to try some new creations that were absolutely amazing. It felt like a real treat. The atmosphere was calm, elegant, and welcoming—perfect for relaxing and enjoying good food with great company. The only small downside was that the table was a bit tight for our group of 10, but honestly, everything else made up for it. The food and experience were more than worth it.

author: Nelly Torres
review_text: i never do reviews because I never do food delivery but I was sick yesterday so thought it was the easier thing to do. I was very upset yesterday with our food order and feel like they should at least hear the good and bad. I spent $50 for two breakfast meals first off the meal on the menu said 2 sausages or bacon. We picked sausage and only got one sausage on each order. Our food arrived extremely cold and who ever prepped our order put all the condiments napkins and utensils at bottom of the bag and the boxes of food on top so of course the boxes flipped to the side. Due to not a flat surface of bottom of the bag. The French toasts were little, cold and not fluffy at all. The whole thing was a whole disappointment having to wait an hour, spending $50 and then having cold food and missing food. We ate it because well I mean if you spend $50 you better eat it at that point but very dissatisfied. The dasher was very nice she was trying to hold the bag a certain way and once I grabbed it I noticed it was bagged incorrectly.

author: Danny Woodson
review_text: Walking by on our way back to the hotel and saw bubba gump shrimp (a restaurant I’ve ALWAYS wanted to eat at). I must admit my fiancé and I wasn’t to thrilled to stop by and was ready to go home after a long day of exploring the city on a hot September day. But as we walked by we saw a bartender with an amazing vibe! His energy was pulsing and we couldn’t pass it by! His name is Juan P!!! He was SUPER friendly and had such an amazing and outgoing personality that we just had to stop for a drink and conversation. All we can say is WOW! The vibe, the atmosphere and his awesome personality really made such a huge impact on us! We highly recommend this restaurant AND a drink especially if it’s from Juan P! Do yourself a favor and stop in and say hi! Oh and a shoutout to the manager who doesn’t want to take credit for her hospitality but OMG we thank you both SO much!

author: Will Noble
review_text: A super full and meaty Banh Mi! The butter ratio that is used is quite frankly ludicrous! In a good way. The filling is so good and really makes for a delicious sarnie. I went twice after a local friend took me here and then I came back again because it was such a good first experience. Both times I sat in the air conditioned seating area and I liked how they gave you plenty of wipes. Great spot!

author: Liz Gallibult
review_text: Ordered a roasted pork banh mi with pickles, chillies, and no cilantro for VND 45.000 and it’s quite worth the hype. Pork tasted amazing with crispy skin and slightly salted pungent roasted flavor. However, due to the 50:50 proportion of meat and veggies, the banh mi eventually turned out a little bit bland for me. Big portion, gotta take the other half away home.

author: Franco Migliorati
review_text: Great variety of food stalls, plenty of choice and cousines. Most places only accept cash and there is a specific place for drinks. It is quite hard to find a table as the airport workers also go there for lunch, watch out! A strange thing is that nobody provides napkins, you have to buy it somewhere. An unusual place to find inside an airport. Prices very affordable

author: Sandy
review_text: Visited here a couple times when we are on holiday in the states. Always busy which is good for business. The food choices are great and always well stocked up. I always go with the intentions of having a feast but never get close. I wish we had decent places like this in the UK

author: Christabella
review_text: This was such a pleasant surprise! We were going to the HistoryMiami museum and stumbled upon it and decided to stop in. I think they have their usual crowd and we were unexpected so their initial reaction to us was sort of caustic but that changed quickly and we were seated and served with no issues. Service was great and so was the food. It was more home cooked meals vibes than “restaurant-grade”. Very generous portions and fairly priced as well.

author: May P
review_text: Totally unexpected happy surprise of a Restaurant sharing the lot with a Gas Station. At first glance stepping in it looks like a shop, but then you walk inside it becomes this adorable Restaurant reminiscent to places in the Spanish countryside. The selection of wines was impressive and the foods we had ordered were delicious. No Happy Hour menu but of course provided you have a quiet well mannered dog it was also dog friendly with great service personnel.

author: Prabha Iyer
review_text: This was a good experience.. We had vegetarian options and this was a budget friendly compared to the other restaurants.. The staff were courteous and answered yo our queries humbly and respectfully.. You may try here as this is much recommended..

author: Chia Hau Lee
review_text: Tried Ipoh Tuck Kee and the food definitely lived up to its reputation. The Moonlight Hor Fun was full of wok hei — fragrant, tasty, and truly addictive. We also ordered the fried bee hoon mixed with hor fun, which had a unique combination of crispy and wet textures. Every bite had a satisfying crackling sound in the mouth, which made it really enjoyable. The baby squid came with a delicious and addictive chilli sauce, while the chicken feet, although nicely marinated, were a little too small.

author: Sharix Ng
review_text: Best yam rice in Penang Mainland! Sometimes might need to take longer time for the food served due to peak hour, but good food worth the wait

author: A C
review_text: I was deceived by the raving reviews, so I’m updating this to help others avoid the same experience. While the service was good, the staff repeatedly asked if I had reviewed the restaurant, as they were offering a free dish fried salmon head, which turned out to be overly oily and starchy. I specifically searched for “authentic Thai food” and ended up here, only to realize it’s more of a Chinese-Thai fusion, which wasn’t what I was looking for. I ordered individual dishes with rice separately, and to my surprise, the portions were quite small, especially considering the high price range. Even the rice was served in a small plate, not a full bowl. After spending 300-400 baht per person, I walked out feeling unsatisfied, knowing I could have gotten better quality food elsewhere. Unless you're just looking for an air-conditioned place to eat, I wouldn’t recommend this restaurant.

author: Nathan King
review_text: Too tier! My dad and I enjoyed a meat lovers pizza and a Philly. The crust on the pizza was out of this world! The bread on the Philly was so soft and the cheese steak was massive. Our eyes were bigger than our stomachs but we managed to make it thought all the food because it was DELICIOUS!!!! Definitely a must try place! Great staff, clean restaurant and tasty food!

author: Brenda Alvarez
review_text: This is our 3rd time coming and we have no complaints. Well just one thing to keep in mind Sunday’s they tend to run out of some items which is not a biggie for us. The food is great the ribs are full of flavor and fall off the bone. Best sides in my opinion and my parents is the potato salad and the corn. Definitely worth a try.

author: Tamara K
review_text: Great place for a clean light meal! Love the salad bowls!! The ambience is also lovely, and apart from the street noise, it's also quiet.. If they had power outlets closer to the tables, would be a great place to work from… :)

author: Steven Wong
review_text: A nice place for a good lunch with friends. Love their prawn horfan and fried frog legs. Should come with a bigger group to be able to try more dishes.

author: matt matt
review_text: Visited Restaurant Tuck Kee in Ipoh. Ordered the Yue Guang Ho (moonlight hor fun) and Wat Dan Ho (slippery egg hor fun) — the taste was just okay. The fried chicken wings were nice. Overall, the food was alright and served quickly. The place was overcrowded, mostly with tourists, but the staff were friendly.

author: Dave
review_text: Walked by this place all the time and never thought to try Indian food in general. However, I came here soon after I tried Indian food for the first time a few months ago. I was sort of thrown aback by how small the dining room is compared to other restaurants up and down that same street, which tend to go way deeper into the restaurant. Regardless of space, I was ready to enjoy the food! I had to start off with a mango lassi, as is customary anytime I eat at an Indian establishment. It was really tasty, refreshing, and worth the price. I say this in appreciation of how the restaurant doesn't stuff the drink full of ice so you're getting a fraction of your actual beverage, it was ALL lassi. I went with a classic, butter chicken. It was juicy and flavorful. The sauce was lovely to pour all over my rice. My wife ordered the goat curry and she was enamored. The goat was the least bit gamey and extremely tender. I was excited that this place was so delicious however, I am kicking myself knowing I could have walked in plenty of times. I will continue to visit whenever I am craving lassi, naan, and hopefully a new favorite from their menu!

author: Guillaume Bourcy
review_text: Not ideal for vegetarian, although they can accommodate a few dishes on demand. However their seafood and fishes preparation are excellent on top of being well presented and beautiful. The location and space make it also a great spot both for professional and casual or family diner. A great address in Jakarta should you want to experiment local upscale seafood and fishes.

author: Anya Lindsey
review_text: Passing thru town we went drive thru. I requested 2 cups of mayonnaise on the side. The girl acted like the four ranches was being generous.Even though the food we ordered was supposed to come with that many dipping sauces. She handed me 1 mayo so I asked her for a second. Her words were "we're too busy. We can't do it. We don't have the time," so I told her, Get me a manager & my second cup of mayonnaise. Manager never came to window & the 2 cup was 1/3 filled. $30 for super dry over heated horrible food plus an attitude.... corporate needs to fix this!!

author: Hernalisa Phang
review_text: Really enjoy the food with my family, we order 9 dishes and we like 8 of those. The best is pork fried. The drink, white coffee is also nice. The service is fast and friendly. Recommended to come and try everything that must try. You must reserve before come because it is always full.

author: Tracy C
review_text: We tried the crab fried rice — although it was amazing and the main reason why we wanted to go to the original store, the wait for one dish was absurdly insane (1+ hour and also needed to get a food voucher which is another story). I do understand the hype causing these long queues, but I’d recommend for people to try the original location for a better experience with even better food (although again as mentioned above, it was already great to begin with)

author: WY N
review_text: Restaurant Titi Papan in Bukit Mertajam is hands down one of the best spots to enjoy a rich, flavorful curry meal. What makes this place stand out is their commitment to serving everything hot—whether it's the curry, rice, crispy fried chicken, or beef. The dishes are always served warm and fresh, and if by chance it’s not hot enough, you can just request them to reheat it on the spot. In the mornings, their roti canai and chapati are top picks for breakfast—soft, fluffy, and perfect with their thick dhal or curry. Come afternoon, the star is their curry rice loaded with beef, chicken, fried oily egg, and a good mix of vegetables. It’s a hearty, satisfying plate that keeps you coming back. Their curry—whether beef, chicken, or mutton—is always full of flavor, slightly spicy, and incredibly addictive. By evening and especially on weekends, it can be hard to find a seat because it’s often packed. That’s no surprise—the combination of affordable prices and consistently delicious food makes Titi Papan a local favorite. If you're a fan of good Malaysian-style curry meals, this place is a must-try. Just come early if you want to beat the crowd!

author: Zenobia Loh
review_text: Can remember the individual stalls but the food here generally quite yummy one. Will come back again to try the other stuff. Best is if you can come in a group so can try more items. Lots of parking spaces and a lot of seats. But most of the seats quite dirty so i guess thats the only bad thing. Also if you walk pass the toilet its DAMN SMELLY so i suggest you empty your bladder first before coming.

author: Serdar N
review_text: Top 5 all my life steaks. The Boston branch is very nicely located. You look at the historical ship and water front. Food is unbelievable. Is it affordable? Not necessarily. I had to cut off dining out for a few weeks in order to eat here. But it’s worth it

author: Dee Kwok
review_text: Loads of good hawker stalls at the round market - prawn noodles, fried carrot cake, those, fish ball, kolo noodles, youtiao, lotong/mee siam (this stall has super chip wings too!), and lots more to try!

author: ZX Chin
review_text: Really authentic and yummy southern Thai food located at the edge of Hatyai town which makes it easy to find street parking. Food can be quite spicy but I'm sure you can ask them to reduce that. English menu is available, staff have limited English communication but they were happy to serve with a smile. Will be back to visit again soon with my friends.

author: Christine Rumi
review_text: A dish that combines white rice and suckling pig, flavored with spices. The price of the “paket hemat” is only Rp. 40.000,- Btw, the staff doesn't smile enough, which makes the atmosphere feel unwelcoming.

author: Samuel Kaplan Art com
review_text: Best view of key Biscayne a land yacht club. Descent food nothing above average but okay. White table cloths denote price point for upscale service and lots of eye candy.

author: Irwin Harith
review_text: Gorgeous cafe with yummy food. Had a great experience during brunch yesterday. Been to the branch in Canggu but this is definitely more spacious and new. Our waiter, Dicky was super friendly and sweet too!

author: Meecheer
review_text: Love this place so much! Authentic food and our favorite is the Shrimp cake. Sharing photos of take out meal from one of many times of our visits. Also sharing the parking rate sign at the parking lot.

author: Peter Tan
review_text: Don't be fooled by the small shop front, the narrow corridor retry leads to a rather sizable dining hall. The pho taste nice and the wagyu beef is tender, one of the best pho that I have ever eaten. The soursop drink is basically blended soursop, that's why it taste so rich and yummy.

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: Watachiwa Aungaung
review_text: I went there for dinner with friends the staff were so nice and the food was delicious.

author: Hussaim
review_text: I just had the best experience at Taco John’s in Boston! From the second I walked in, the vibe was super chill and welcoming. The staff were friendly, which always makes a big difference, and the place itself was clean and comfy. Let’s talk about the food—honestly, it was amazing. I got the tacos, and they were so good! The seasoned beef was perfect, and the crunchy shell with all the fresh toppings made every bite satisfying. I also tried the Potato Olés (because why not?), and I have to say, they’re a game changer—crispy, loaded with flavor, and just the right amount of seasoning. The menu has a great variety, so you’ll definitely find something that hits the spot no matter what you’re craving. And their salsa bar? Big fan. It’s perfect for adding that extra flavor kick. Plus, the service was fast and friendly—always a plus when you’re hungry. I’ll definitely be back next time I’m in the area! Highly recommend this spot if you’re looking for a quick, tasty meal.

author: Dimas Wijaya
review_text: First time visit as we craving for Balinese babi guling, unfortunately the taste failed me! All combination is too dry and taste less, when I took the picture we were already excited but a dissapointment came later. I think it's just more to the hype rather than quality to maintain its originality. If I compared with Babi Guling bu Oka branch No.2 (only this branch), bu Oka still much much better to maintain their recipe and quality. So, to conclude my recent visit to Pande Egi one-time is just enough, nothing special, tasteless, just over-rated.

author: David Flacks
review_text: If I could give this restaurant twelve stars, I would—Oranuch Thai Dining is hands down my favorite restaurant in all of Thailand. From the very first visit, it completely won me over, and I’ll keep coming back again and again, even if it’s just for their unforgettable Penang curry. The moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warmth and grace, often by the owner herself, which sets the tone for an experience that feels both personal and elevated. The atmosphere is inviting and intimate—elegant without being pretentious, and filled with the kind of charm that makes you feel at home while still knowing you’re in for something truly special. Every dish is prepared with exceptional care and attention to detail. The flavors are deep, refined, and masterfully balanced. Nothing is rushed or ordinary—everything is made to perfection, and it shows. The Penang curry is a standout, rich and aromatic, with the kind of complexity that makes you pause between bites just to savor it. The cocktails are just as impressive—crafted with precision and creativity, each one feels like a piece of art in both taste and presentation. Service is another highlight. The staff are attentive, gracious, and genuinely passionate about the food and the experience they deliver. It’s rare to find such consistency in both hospitality and cuisine. Yes, it’s on the higher end, and you’ll spend a bit more—but every baht is well spent. You’re not just paying for a meal; you’re paying for a dining experience that lingers in your memory. Oranuch Thai Dining is a true gem, and I’ll never get tired of returning to it.

author: Juliana Ong
review_text: WhatsApp them to make a reservation way before my trip as we went on Christmas Day. They were fully booked, for walk in only avail 7pm and after. Very small restaurant so seating is limited but the restaurant is cosy and clean. Ambience is there, food is delicious and staff fine albeit attitude a bit cold. Take note they only accept cash.

author: Mia Tucker
review_text: I can’t say enough good things about the Bayshore Club in Miami! The atmosphere is stunning—right on the water with the perfect mix of laid-back and upscale. The food and drinks were amazing, but what truly made our experience unforgettable was our server, Alex. From the second we sat down, Alex was warm, attentive, and genuinely friendly.
