She knew the menu inside and out, gave us excellent recommendations (the calamari and the asparagus were both incredible!), and somehow managed to anticipate what we needed before we even had to ask. Even though she was clearly busy, she made us feel like we were her only table. That level of service is rare, and it truly elevated the whole evening. If you’re coming to Bayshore Club, you’re already guaranteed a beautiful view and delicious food—but if you’re lucky enough to have Alex as your server, your night will be next-level. Can’t wait to come back!!

author: Joey Tan
review_text: We had a really great dinner here! The food was wonderful and we enjoyed everything we had. Our favourites were the lasagne and pizza. Kiru was our server and they were really friendly and attentive. Thank you for a great time!

author: Shawn Sheng
review_text: Every single time I walk by this place there seems to always be a line, especially on Saturday mornings. Even 15 minutes before they open, a queue already starts to form. For good reason too, the chocolate croissants here are super famous and perhaps the best in the area. Every pastry they have is absolutely fantastic and perfectly made. The staff are very friendly, and they have both indoor and outdoor seating.

author: Leanna Saavedra
review_text: Marissa makes the BEST shots in Vegas!!! Every employee treats you like family and you really become family in there! Trivia night on Sunday at 10:30pm with Marissa is THE BEST and the most fun I've had in a long time and is hilarious! Also, Michelle, Shane, Zo, Renée, and Sharon are awesome as well, but no one is better than Marissa because she will give me wake up calls for work in the morning😁 I LOVE THIS BAR

author: vicki buchwald
review_text: Wonderful service with Paolo and very delicious food! We shared a traditional Seafood Paella and had Pulpo a la Gallega and Boquerones as appetizers. We finished this lovely meal with a shared Crema Catalana. The amazing lunch here was a highlight on our visit to Miami.

author: Pokeo Ninja
review_text: A true gem hidden in a rather industrial neighborhood! This is why I love using GoogleMaps to find places to eat when we travel: a wide selection of original salads, burgers, sandwiches, smoothies and crafted coffees and teas in a very hip setting, minutes from 95. I am writing the review so we can find this place again next time we travel this way.

author: Melody Liang
review_text: The pros: The food is 100% DELICIOUS. I got the spicy salmon salad and the pork tom yum mama noodles and they are both so good 😩😩if you love sour flavours this is the place for you I would say that the spicy salmon salad is VERY spicy (at least for me) so either bring water or buy a cold drink The tom yum on the other hand has that classic flavour but isn’t spicy, and hey, there’s free wifi! Portion size is great as well The cons: I came on a Monday night at around 6:45pm, there were I think 92 in front of me and I waited a total of 2 hours (I was told it’d be 90 minutes) They put me (a single person) on a table that could easily fit four people if not five people, I think this is the reason for the long queue and low table turnover rate — should consider putting guests together! Service is also subpar — staff looks like they’d rather be anywhere else I also had to go to another table to get tissue since there wasn’t any on mine

author: Someone who adore Nature
review_text: Tomyam soup is just nice Many options of frozen food Chicken and other fresh stuff like seafoods not really fresh They had the roti bakar , nugget , Maggie Goreng was quite nice too. You can spend 2 hours which cost you rm29.90 each. Worth to try . Quite crowded

author: Sammy Soong
review_text: Ubi Claypot Lala – Generous Portions, but Hygiene Needs Improvement - At Ubi Claypot Lala serves their dishes over a charcoal stove with a generous portion of lala (clams), giving it a nice, smoky aroma. However, food hygiene seems to need better attention — the fridge doesn’t feel sufficiently cold, and the vegetables weren’t very fresh during my visit. While the concept and portion are good, proper food storage and freshness should be improved to match the quality of the dish.

author: T Sher
review_text: Very Pretty Location amidst of the Rice Fields! A lot of local ppl come and enjoy meals there but need private transport to come. Near to Titi Waterfall. We ordered Porsi Special, Nasi Ayam, Rujak, fried spring rolls! All very very delicious especially the tender meat!

author: Yi Wang
review_text: There are two levels where you can select your seating. I opted for a cinnamon chocolate beverage, which was incredibly creamy and bursting with a decadent taste. During the early hours of Monday, between 9-10am, the place is not very crowded. The ambiance is enhanced by the soothing sounds of old-time jazz music, making it a perfect setting to enjoy a meal and unwind.

author: Jennifer
review_text: I visited this place with a friend on a Friday morning around 10am for breakfast. We didn't have a reservation and were told there would be at least a 20-minute wait, but could sit in the waiting area. That area is unfortunately right next to a construction site in the back, which wasn't very comfortable. After about 10 minutes we were seated and asked if we were okay sharing a table with other guests. While I generally don't mind shared tables, we ended up at a large table shared by several different parties. Combined with how busy, loud, and crowded the space already was, it felt quite overwhelming and had a bit of an assembly-line atmosphere. The café itself is nicely designed in a rustic, wooden style, but due to how packed it was, the overall vibe felt stressful rather than cozy. Conversation was difficult because of the noise level. Service felt rather slow. The coffee was genuinely good, and the banana bread was fine, but nothing particularly memorable. I've had noticeably better breakfast and coffee in Canggu, Pererenan, and the surrounding area over the last years. While I appreciate that the staff asked before seating us at a shared table, and it ultimately was our choice, the combination of crowding, noise, and hype took away from the experience. For me, this isn't a place I'd return to for a relaxed breakfast.

author: K M
review_text: What's great? Came here as Chokdee was closed. A different style of dim sum here. The music is most apt. Fried Gu Cai Kueh is the best. What's to improve? Found a dead housefly on one of the lettuce! Skip the salmon, it is overcooked. Visit again? Yes, but skip the lettuce.

author: Helen Chen
review_text: We had a great time at the Bayshore! Our server Peter was excellent. The dishes we tried conch fritters, calamari and frutti de mart were great. The smash burger though was killer good. It was our favorite! The live music was unrivaled. Can’t wait to drop by again

author: Tanesha Peralta
review_text: AMAZING, we held an office party here and it was fabulous. The food tasted delicious and the space is beautiful. The manager, Larry, answered all our questions and offered great menu options (Including options for vegetarians).

author: Shawn Ng
review_text: Roast continues to deliver a consistently good experience. This visit was a light one — I had the French fries, a piccolo coffee, and a watermelon smoothie, and everything was good as usual. The fries were nicely done, the coffee was well-prepared, and the smoothie was refreshing and not overly sweet — simple items, but executed properly. I’ve also visited other Roast outlets previously, including the CentralWorld branch, for brunch, and the consistency across outlets is commendable. You know what to expect, and the quality holds up, which is always a good sign. A reliable spot whether you’re stopping by for brunch or just a casual coffee and snack. Comfortable environment, steady standards, and easy to return to anytime.

author: Unikicon
review_text: If you’re looking for a club vibe and get a delicious meal this is the place to go. My husband took me here for our anniversary. The waiters themselves were respectful and joyful. We had Franco, he was humorous and extremely informative with the menu. I had a churrasco with rice and a mocktail. The rice itself was a bit too salty for my liking but the overall meal tasted natural. I highly recommend when celebrating a birthday (they sang happy birthday to like 7 people 😂).

author: Lana Bryant
review_text: First time here and I will for sure be back. Everything is grilled no pork, I got the catfish mac n cheese and red beans and rice, everything was fire!! My daughter and her dad got the oxtails, literally fall off the bone deliciousness.

author: Martina Mattar
review_text: Surely a highlight of my 3-week trip to Asia. I really wish I could eat the steamed fish every week... The scallops were also bomb. God bless Elvis Suki and Seafood + all their staff.

author: Hary Luo
review_text: Had an amazing feast at Naughty Nuri’s! We ordered the 2kg BBQ pork ribs, fried pork, corn, and the signature volcano potato, and everything hit the spot. The ribs were the star of the meal—tender, smoky, and packed with flavour, easily one of the best I’ve had. The fried pork was crispy on the outside and juicy inside, a perfect companion to the hearty mains. The corn was sweet and buttery, balancing out all the rich dishes, while the volcano potato was fun, indulgent, and full of cheesy goodness. Overall, it was a satisfying and memorable dining experience, perfect for sharing and definitely worth coming back for!

author: Su YH
review_text: The food were great. Nice atmosphere when you come in the evening. Ordered butter chicken, it was nice n not spicy, kids can eat. Kids friendly too as they have kids meal and pizza which the kids will like. For adult, we can indulge on the various Indian food. The lady boss was very hosting n friendly. Very rare in Spore to find good service standard, yet I found it here. Food price is reasonable with service charge but no GST.

author: Alicia Linder
review_text: Delicious brunch spot with a super cute and pretty atmosphere! We got the strawberry fizzy soda, the Harmonie, and the Scamby. Everything was absolutely delicious. Their menu is varied with plenty of great options. Highly recommend!

author: Chris Chee
review_text: Many good choices.. Weekends expect crowd.. Weekdays moderate crowd.. The pork trotter stall, sell out by, the evening.. This one can target..

author: Trav23 Angel
review_text: Nice spot as a new Yorker of course katz is #1 but on the west coast I'd pick this spot Mariano delicious 😋

author: SM
review_text: I didn’t see what’s the hype on this place. The food tasted average to me. You can get it anywhere else that serve the similar food. If there’s no wait in line, you can try it. But if you need to wait for hour, save your time and eat elsewhere. Service is slow. Payment needs to pay twice (drinks and food, separately and different location). It’s a hassle with the right space.

author: means mini
review_text: The view is spectacular, but the experience was a letdown. • Drinks and food were just average. • Poor seating—I was placed near the smelly restrooms. • No non-smoking area; the air was thick with smoke even with children present. For a bar with a "world's best" reputation, I expected much more.

author: Firdaus Mapasisi
review_text: Came in with modest expectations, simply wanting to give the famous Uncle Roger Nasi Goreng a try. I ordered the spicy version, which arrived with sambal and a perfectly cooked sunny-side-up egg with a rich, melted yolk. The very first bite caught me by surprise,the nasi goreng was full of flavour and carried that unmistakable Malaysian authenticity. It genuinely felt like home. The sambal deserves special mention too. The heat was just right, beautifully balanced with salty and umami notes; a perfect complement to the dish. Kudos to the team for delivering such a satisfying plate. One last word: Fuyooo!

author: Teresa M
review_text: Il Poeta is an extraordinary dining experience. Superior Italian cuisine and a newly redecorated, romantic dining room make Il Poeta extra special.

author: DR. ALVIN TUNG
review_text: The classic Ipoh dinner! Bean Sprout chicken, Tauge Ayam, 芽菜雞! Always the Comfort food! Our meal was perfect in every way. The bean sprouts were plump and crisp the chicken was flavorful and silky and the noodles were smooth as silk. Accompanying the main characters were fish balls, fresh and al dente and flavorful fresh pork meatballs. Even the humble soya sauce for the chicken and the bean sprouts is flavorful and Rich a light and satisfying dinner always! The staff here are very friendly and attentive. This was a perfect dining experience!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Colin Scholl
review_text: Love the indoor outdoor vibe with the roof overhead. Even in a rain storm vibes were good with music and they got a nice tiki bar. Very colorful place with some of the best steak fajitas I’ve had anywhere. I came back and got the Tuesday taco deal and those were great also! Soft corn tortilla is the way to go. Zero complaints. Nancy was also friendly!

author: Roonie W
review_text: This place is awesome. Selling alot of veriety of bread. The only problem is that space of parking. You have to find a place to park. Unless there are persons in the car to wait. Very limited car park. The bread is very nice soft and fresh. If you are a bread lover

author: Polina Mashkova
review_text: Cuca is a refined and well thought out dining experience that feels relaxed and welcoming, which suits Bali perfectly. It was especially pleasant to see that they offer a kids menu with food that children actually enjoy and are happy to eat. There is also a small playground on site, which makes dining here much easier and more enjoyable for families. The menu for adults is designed around sharing, which is a great concept and works beautifully for a social dinner. Dishes are easy to divide and try together, making the experience feel more connected and relaxed. The food itself felt quite simple. It may be that we chose similar dishes, or perhaps several items rely on frying, which made the flavours feel less complex than expected. Still, everything was well prepared and nicely presented. Overall, it is a lovely place for a calm and elevated evening, especially if you are visiting with family and want good food in a comfortable, thoughtful setting.

author: Michael Tarachand
review_text: I rarely feel the need to leave a negative review, but the service here was genuinely offensive. To be clear: I wasn't upset that the food was late. Delays happen. What was unacceptable was how the hostess handled it. I arrived at 5:00 PM for a 4:30 PM pickup. When I checked in, the hostess was completely unapproachable and inconsiderate. She made no effort to check on the order or offer a timeline. When I asked for a simple estimate (5 minutes vs. 30 minutes) so I could manage my restless young children, she snapped at me with a terrible attitude. Being treated like an inconvenience for asking a basic question is where I draw the line. It’s a shame because the food is usually good, but the blatant lack of customer service and the rude energy from the front desk makes it not worth the visit.

author: Tonya C
review_text: It was a beautiful place with a good atmosphere. Made a reservation here for my birthday with a party of 5. We first got a table seating but requested a booth. The host was nice and accommodating and was able to move us. This place is great for social media photos. They had arts everywhere and that made it photo worthy. The food and drinks was good. We got the Patron tower and let me tell you. The MANGO patron slushie was the BEST! PARKING was easy at the garage near by. As for food portion my opinion was not fulfilling for us 5. That's the only thing that was negative for us. Overall the place is great! Recommend!

author: Jessica Hensley
review_text: This place is unbelievable! The service was just the beginning of this fantastic experience. Alfredo was our server very friendly and cheerful. The food was off the charts. This is unassuming from the outside but don’t let that fool you. It’s a must try.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Andrija Milinkovic
review_text: This place is amazing I loved the food and the staff were so friendly and welcoming. I am amazed by the quality of the meats whole Miami should eat at this place!!🦾🍀

author: Vik Su
review_text: Humless bowl of laksa it was despite the name of the brand. Guess it's better to be harmless to those allergic to cockles. Taste was alright, lacking some laksa leaves and real hum.

author: Farah Samy
review_text: Amazing amazing amazing. Everything is top notch. Whether its the staff, especially Indra who was very welcoming and kind, the food! The tenderloin steak and the baked pasta with smoked beef as well as the chilli fries were exceptional. The strawberry lemonade shaker was insane as well. Only thing that wasnt up to that goodness was the bread and butter basket, the bread felt very oily and the portion of the dips was so little. But it honestly did not matter that much because of the quality of the rest of the experience. I would recommend you make a reservation but it wasnt crowded since its a big space.

author: MIKE EMMERSON
review_text: Found this place by accident but knew what to look for when I saw it as a friend who lives down there mentioned it. We love the local food atmosphere and experience, this one did not disappoint. Great service. Great food. Great time!

author: Sam kassis
review_text: The food was perfect we were party of four every we was happy with there food nothing to complain about, the day was raining and we sat inside but they do have nice deck i am sure the deck is beautiful on a nice sunny day

author: Lincoln Martinez II
review_text: We got the full plate no soup with a side of fried pork. It was fantastic. The pork skin are fried pork were the pest parts.

author: Vivian “Vivventure” Wayfarer
review_text: Authentic Malaysian/Singaporean breakfast spot with great combo prices (12-15 bucks for a set with an entree, a drink - all kinds of kopi, and complementary pastry of choice — ranging from Kaya toast, pandan cake, to pineapple buns). We ordered three sets, giving us a chance to try instant noodles with curry pork skin, nasi lemak with curry fish balls and Malaysian sticky rice with chicken. All the dishes hit the spot and are reminiscent of what you would get in the region locally. Definitely need to come back to try the lunch, which seems to be popular!

author: S ZS
review_text: Came on Tuesday 8.40pm, waited about 15mins to be seated. Very disappointed cause only when we were seated, only were we informed that crab is out of stock. Rice dishes were served fairly quickly but it was barely warm, almost cold. Tasty.. But can't comprehend when is it not served freshly cooked kinda hot? Egg, rice and pork neck not even warm. No options available just to order omelette, it is only served with rice. Prawns were plump and fresh on the dish with basil garlic. Prawns were cut into small pieces in the other omelette rice. I don't think I'll return. Not worth the travel time unless your near by. Free herbal drink for every five star google review.

author: Joe B.
review_text: Message to the Chef: All your food taste the same. I couldn't find the difference among Beef Broccoli, Compaw chicken or orange chicken, salty and overcooked vegetables. Too sweet and missing special ingredients such as ginger, green onions and or fish sauce. The amount of food doesn't compensate flavor. I gave your place 3 chances try different plates. Work on you seasoning.

author: dedi berlian
review_text: I visited the restaurant during lunch time. I was quite packed with people queuing up. The wait was not long. I love seeing a crowd in the restaurant. Nasi lemak was delicious and the fried chicken was juicy and tender. The sambal is sweet and spicy. Nice.

author: Orang Gina
review_text: Our first visit here. Truly a gem in the "beautiful" ironbound section of Newark. We had goat and cod dishes. Clams and sausage appetizers were great, in fact it was the best sausage I've ever had. The food was beyond excellent. The bar and restaurant are in the same room so you can eat and watch soccer or Portuguese CNN from anywhere. There also appears to be an event dining room in a separate section.

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: WY N
review_text: This bak kut teh establishment consistently operates at full capacity, requiring patrons to endure long queues. The allure lies in the delectably hot and tasty food, accompanied by an enticing aroma that lingers. The experience is incomplete without pairing it with rice, creating a taste that leaves a lasting impression in your memory. Situated in a location boasting ample parking space, which is free at night, adds to its appeal. This convenience makes it an ideal spot to bring together friends and family. The welcoming atmosphere, coupled with the savory dishes, transforms this bak kut teh place into more than just a dining spot; it becomes a preferred destination for shared moments and enjoyable meals.

author: Judy Nie
review_text: Amazing Malaysian/Singaporean food! Came here for the breakfast sets. Price is so reasonable! A set comes with entree + hot drink + side. Tried the curry noodles, kaya butter toast, and hot milk tea. Everything was on point and authentic! Also impeccable service, they offered us refills for the milk tea. You have to come here for breakfast!

author: 金Ck
review_text: We've been here for more than 20yrs! We have seen them go thru many transformations. My family simply loves it. Its basically white rice with pork. The taste is quite unique and it can 'get' on to you, just like how it did to my family. But for me, I'm ok with it. The taste is not too bad, the soup is simple but nice, the meat is pleasant with crackling pork skin. The restaurant is by the main road so it's not diff to locate. Price wise, I'd say it has gone dearer with little improvement with quality or quantity. Service was not the greatest but this is a rural joint, so I'm not complaining. In any case, if you're in Ubud, give it a try.

author: Prateek Goyal
review_text: Boun Thai Kitchen is amazing! The portion size is great and the taste is fantastic. I would definitely recommend the place if you're visiting Vegas. Items ordered : - Pad Thai - Orange Chicken (good portion size, comes with sticky rice, not overly sweet) - Green Curry - Chicken Satay (perfectly cooked and peanut sauce was yummy) - Veggie Spring Rolls - Raspberry Iced Tea (lightly sweet and very refreshing)

author: Lakita Robinson
review_text: Wait time way too long. Waited almost an hour for food. Mac and cheese was good, Oxtails and alfredo was entirely too salty. For the taste and wait, I’ll try another location, if it’s not good. I’m just be good on Tastebudz. OH YEAH THEN AFTER 1 HOUR WAIT FOR YOUR FOOD and your food still is not Ready. They OFFER NO REFUNDS!! They have signs stating no Refunds… Spare Yourself!! Your Money your Time.

author: Amos Lau 立辉
review_text: Food was really yummy 😋 worth the time and waiting for food 👍🏻 A bit warm despite the night meal out with friend group, one of more senior lady didn't seem as trained, she had trouble taking our landscape, vertical photos and brought us a wrong dish....the seating was cramp especially if you sit at the edge of the round table, hence I recommend 3-4ppl or else, get 2 tables. Besides that, I had a good time with my friend group

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Alex Broad
review_text: While the weather was hot out side, it's was nice to walk in to a cool video with a good tunes playing in the background. Grabbed a booth seat, so comfy, then Peter (awesome waiter) took my order, he was super friendly and talking about everything local, so many insights. When the food was brought out, so delicious, and I may have ordered to much for one person, but still so good.

author: Rain
review_text: The place is a little hard to find but the food was great! Probably one of our favorite food in Ubud

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Casey Kopp
review_text: The people working here are so friendly!! Coconut cold brew is a must get. Great place to work or hang for a bit because of their nice patio seating area!! Inside has some seating as well with a couple outlets. Breakfast sandwich was 10/10 too!!! Coming back next chance I get 😍

author: Marisol Sanz
review_text: First, we ate at the restaurant and the food and drinks were delicious. Then we headed down to the party, and it was one of the best in Bali. Nice venue, great music, plenty of security, and a lot of fun.

author: Kaytie Owens-Liston
review_text: We came for breakfast for the first time and were SO happy. The food combines the diner feel with a modern presentation. Highly recommend the combos so you can enjoy their pancakes (or waffles!) and all of the egg/bacon/potatoes. Mimosas are phenomenal - actually taste like there is sparkling wine and not just orange juice. Prices are absolutely reasonable given the quality of the food, drinks, atmosphere, and service. Highly recommend and this will become a regular spot for us!

author: Wm R
review_text: Met up with a friend for lunch. I had this place on my list and she had been here and confirmed it was good. Located in a commercial plaza so parking was easy to find. We were quickly seated. She knew what she wanted and I took a few moments to look at the menu. I ended up going w to meats and one side. Requested the brisket and burnt ends along with the street corn. Wow the meat was delicious and juicy. The sauce was on point. We sat in a booth. There was plenty of art around and that added to the atmosphere. We sat there and talked for quite awhile.

author: Tammi Calarco
review_text: The service was absolutely fabulous. The hostess Junise was the mostess with her upbeat attitude and her willingness to accommodate my needs. Our waitress Sheyla C. was super with making sure we had cold drinks and our food at the right times. She also was accommodating when it rained. Between Junise and Sheyla, they made sure the big umbrella was positioned to avoid us getting wet from the rain. The food tasted excellent and was very delicious. The scenic views while eating outdoors were delightful. Overall, I highly recommend Bayshore Club and look forward to returning.

author: Glori Acosta
review_text: I had high hopes for Petralunga and their Cacio e Pepe tableside cheese wheel , but unfortunately, the food didn’t live up to the expectations. From the meatballs to the pasta, everything was just average at best. The wait for our food was unusually long, and when it finally arrived, the pasta was cold. It honestly felt like something I could’ve made at home. That said, the tableside tiramisu was actually pretty good — it’s the main reason I gave them three stars. In addition, the setting is undeniably beautiful. The waterfront location creates a stunning atmosphere and is perfect for photos. I really wish I had come during their 2-for-1promotion — because at full price, the dishes simply don’t justify the cost.

author: Camila Isabel
review_text: Ordered the rainbow roll and hot truffle nigiri and it was sooo good! More than anything our server, Ana was so sweet and attentive. She knew the menu like the back of her hand and made sure we had everything we needed. Hope to be back to be served by her.

author: Steve Capen
review_text: One ofy favorite meals in all of SE Asia! The flavors were incredible and the staff were absolutely outstanding, highly recommend 😋😋

author: D M
review_text: Honestly I had the Mariscos and nothing close to Sinaloa. Great service but Marsiscos lacked flavor. I dont recommend this spot for Mariscos. Im sorry will not return.

author: Fredis Maravilla Saravia
review_text: Great customer services and the food always excellent. I love the beans 🫘

author: Perica Milicev
review_text: Very small place, just 4/5 tables inside available, but the location is good. No free parking around, so you gotta park on the spot which is $5 per hour. The service was quick and no much hassle. We liked fresh squeezed juices which were delicious but the food was just mediocre, not too much taste and flavour, just a basic experience which i think wasn’t worth for the price we paid for it. If you want a nice coffee or fresh squeezed juice while walking around downtown, this is a good place for it.

author: Karina Adianto
review_text: This bakery looked like it was an old establishment which survived and stayed strong for a long time. For our surprise, they had many varieties of breads with unusual flavors. We were intrigued to try everything but unfortunately, we were in Penang for a short time, so we didn't get the chance to come back to try their other freshly made breads. We bought: Graham cheese bun - whomemeal flour soft bread with generous cream cheese filling. Custard choux - thick yellow custard (consists lots of eggs), slight salty crusty choux. Complemented each other well. Kiwi muffin - with poppy seeds, slight tanginess, not too sweet, moist. Definitely will be back to try their sweet corn cheese twist & lemon tart. Eyeing on those when we visited last time 😆🤭

author: Tue Minh Nguyen Hoang
review_text: walked in on a saturday evening, got seated pretty quickly after ~10 mins. classic tonkotsu was worth it though meat cuts felt too thin for me. service was nice and ambiance was top notch! get a res if ur going in larger groups though because space can feel small

author: مواقف مضحكه تيك توك اضحك من قلبك
review_text: Expensive and exaggerated in prices and the service is very bad and the workers do not smile at the customer, but rather treat the customer very badly, but the food is okay

author: Carter Schlenz
review_text: Awesome restaurant. Very good food. Our waitress came to our table 3-4 times to check up on us. She was very friendly. My meal was 16.99 with then we added the fries so it was 2.50 more. On the pricier side. Otherwise it was great!

author: Gregory Varshavskiy
review_text: HIDDEN GEM! My wife and I came in for lunch on Sunday and Deepa welcomed us and made us feel like family. Every dish we ordered was exquisite and made fresh for us. You can really tell that Deepa and her family are artists and the kitchen is their studio 😋

author: Dolce PicolaJO
review_text: The atmosphere is beautiful and cozy, and the staff is absolutely wonderful — friendly servers and professional hookah masters who really know what they’re doing. I highly recommend this place for birthdays, events, corporate parties, or just to come, relax, smoke hookah, and enjoy the vibe. Truly the best of the best. We are thankful to our friends who invite us for a New Year 2026 dinner. I highly recommend this place.

author: Leanne Kwek
review_text: We went there around 3pm so there is not much queue, we order and got seated in around 10minutes. i order a rice w/ minced pork basil but it does not taste any spicy at all, just pure salty. My friend order a rice w/creamy omelette & crab, dont know why but the omelette has a very fishy smell. And we order a stir fried crab curry to share, it taste just normal. Not worth it if need to queue.

author: Chau Chau
review_text: In my opinion, the restaurant is affordable, we ate a lot of food for 6 people for only 900k. The service is also enthusiastic. But the dishes take a while to come out. I don't know if it's because the restaurant is still empty so the kitchen is not open or what. In my opinion, the dishes are delicious, only the grilled breast with fermented bean curd is a bit salty, if possible, they should be grilled separately, dipping fermented bean curd according to the customer's preference. The restaurant is very spacious, suitable for large parties. One suggestion is that the restaurant should review the toilet a bit. Add 10 points to the restaurant owner for being very enthusiastic.

author: Tazio Lai
review_text: Some of the best Thai cuisine in Bangkok, all in a wonderfully warm welcoming set up! Have never had any bad dishes over the past 8+ or so visits, and their standard remains equally high and memorable each time! Service is prompt/fast and attentive, food is of course delicious and served quickly and the flower/plant green house vibe make for a beautiful environment to dine in! On top of all that, the prices are very fair, especially for the area and quality! 10/10 would recommend!

author: Meera Yalangovan
review_text: The take away mamak mee goreng I bought just now totally disappointed me. Usually pelita auto city food is delicious compared to other branches but today it was not my day. It gave a crab curry smell and feel puke after eating. There is no mamak mee goreng smell and taste. I am not sure on how to attach picture here. Please improve on food tasting. This is totally disappointing.

author: Ellie Cameron
review_text: We came across ‘The hungry pig’ on google recommendations as it is so close to our accommodation. We are SO glad that we did! The staff are so brilliant and friendly - super welcoming. Thank you Hannah and Helen. The food was absolutely delicious! We are going back for breakfast tomorrow! We also tried our first Vietnamese Iced coffee which is delicious if you like sweet coffee 11/10.

author: Bob Pham
review_text: If it weren’t hyped up I’d give it a 3.5/5 star rating. The age of social media does not help. Hoi An has so much more better banh mi vendors, and the social media hype does not play fair. TBH the bread is nice but the ingredients were quite average quality and silly enough felt like it was tweaked for tourists, thus a trap for tourists. We can certainly say that people will fall for this one time only lol. Personally if you want bragging rights then find your way there and eat the hyped banh mi and take a selfie at the front of the store. Otherwise Hoi An has so much to offer and people need to be held to their words when recommending such places. Perhaps people who recommend these places need to share responsibility for misleading others to such vendors.

author: Nick Hensman
review_text: Top quality Suki as expected at a Michelin rated establishment. The scallops are a must here, cooked to perfection with a nub of sausage and lots of butter.

author: KWRER
review_text: Went to Segar chinatown outlet for lunch, around 12 noon on 7 October, an older waitress serve my dish (kway tiao cockles) to wrong table 2 times + 1 time wrong dish with chilli (belonged to the table next to me) *Total 3 times error in a row. I had to repeatedly ask where's my dish because i waited 30 minutes for my dish. At last , my dish came. Quality was so-so because it was rushed out by the cook. All because the waitress messed up. Server had a black face with no apologies given. We overheard the aunty waitress replying to the manager ' serve wrong so what..' in chinese when confronted on the mistake. Not sure whether the older aunty waitress has dementia or simply lack of EQ and training. I need to feedback this because it can affect the reputation of the company if this kind of attitude is continued without consequences.

author: Christine Eastvold
review_text: Absolutely amazing staff! Fabulous food! Don’t miss out on this hidden gem! I will be back soon! Thank you for an amazing afternoon!

author: Matt H
review_text: We’ve been here a bunch of times as they have great vegan sandwich options. The ‘steak bomb’ sandwich is one of the best vegan sandwiches you can get around Boston. The rest are hit or miss. Some of the baked good are underwhelming which is why I’m only giving a 4

author: Stijn V
review_text: Very good meat. I had the NY strip loin. Also the tuna tartar was excellent. Béarnaise could use some improvement though, more sour would have been nice. Wines were great as well as was the bread. Good service.

author: Connie Chan
review_text: The boat noodles come with various options, beef, pork or chicken. We went with the beef with original noodles. We chose spice level 2 which was super spicy. Spice level 1 would have been sufficient. The wagyu beef was tender, but even the “normal” beef was good. The side dishes were great. We had fried wanton, spicy dumpling and beef balls. We repeat the orders as they were so good!!

author: leong tatt lee
review_text: The Nasi kandar curry taste is ok. Price ABOVE average. Satay taste normal.

author: Markesha Smith
review_text: My aunt had a truly distressing experience at Domino’s that I feel compelled to share. During her visit, she unexpectedly felt faint and ended up passing out. It was a scary situation, and she had to call 911 for assistance. In that moment, she asked for a simple cup of water to help her recover while waiting for help. Shockingly, the employee on duty refused to give her water unless she paid $2. Given her state—disoriented, shaken, and unable to think clearly—she wasn’t in a position to pay. It was deeply upsetting that, even in an emergency, a basic act of kindness like providing water wasn’t extended. While I understand that businesses have policies, this was a clear situation where human decency should have prevailed. My aunt was left feeling disappointed and hurt, not just because of her health scare, but because of the lack of compassion she experienced. I hope Domino’s management takes this feedback seriously and trains their staff to handle emergencies with more empathy. --- Not to mentioned she purchased food from them.

author: Willy Soon
review_text: Good service, good food Tomyum, grilled chicken, somtum, sausage must try

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: kimberly
review_text: Such a spacious and fun atmosphere! The waitresses were super friendly. The robots are pretty cool too. The meats were fresh and came out immediately after ordering them. I recommend the green apple soju.. it tastes like juice! I had such a fun and delicious time dining with my husband

author: Lee meyers
review_text: Food turned out very good but was shocked at paying 21.00 for one sandwhich

author: Sapna Rajpoot
review_text: Fresh, flavorful, and perfectly baked! The crispy crust, juicy toppings, and bright tomato bites made this pizza an instant favorite. 🍕✨ Paired it with a refreshing sangria — perfection! 🍷👌

author: hazman z
review_text: Nasi Kandar Original. Their reputation speaks for itself.

author: Macxchange Inc.
review_text: If you're looking for a good street side breakfast meal in Saigon, this is the place to be. Their baguette bread is to die for and perfect for Banh mi chao. The best!!!

author: Apinya Chamchoi
review_text: Came here with my parents for dinner and we love all the menu we ordered. The portions are perfect and the staffs are amazingly sweet. Best part of today’s dinning is the แจ่วโซดา drink! Highly recommended

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Zeeb M.
review_text: A sensational experience in every way, lots of variety and 100% vegan, an unforgettable bistro.

author: Jo Atfo
review_text: First off, the staff is amazing!!! Every time I go..amazing! I've been going here for years but this is the first time I dined in because I was with a friend. I love the food especially the patatas, my go to. Drinks amazing, and I love that there are options for the plant based community. Dining in is way better than taking out, which is what I'm used to doing. I highly recommend if you're in this area.

author: Alec Silva
review_text: got a seasonal specialty burger that was amazing and a salad that was really really good. Excellent portions can’t believe how awesome this food is!

author: Chimene H. James
review_text: First time having dinner at Crazy About You. We had an amazing server Andrea, who explained the menu to us and gave his recommendations. The food was rich and well prepared. The service was top notch and Andrea made sure we were okay while we were there. Would definitely visit again next time I’m in Miami! We had the tortellini served with shrimp and the branzino with potatoes. FYI- Photos are done for you at an extra charge.

author: Larry Morton
review_text: First time here loved it. Food was great. I had a chance to set up the way back bar before my girlfriend and family came. Then we moved up to the front for dinner. There’s multiple places you can enjoy a good meal or drinks with friends. I highly recommend it during the Woburn area or anywhere close to it to stop in. This was Christmas time which made an extra special. God bless all of you and come down to Sam Walker’s American tavern for a great night feel like to see the full video. Go to life with Larry on YouTube.

author: The Funk Child_662
review_text: I will start by saying that the Pastrami Sandwich is very, very good. I drive all the way across town to get it. However, a few complaints: some of the staff could use better customer service skills. I ordered a Pastrami Sandwich there, a couple of weeks ago, and the young Latino who took my order, failed to inform me that it the menu price doesn't include cheese. If I didn't check my order, before I left, I would have been quite upset when I got home. I don't know of anyplace which sells Pastramis, that doesn't automatically include cheese! Lastly, I don't like the fact that the cashier handles cash money, then touches the containers of food and hands you your order. I understand that the food is in containers. But, that's still unsanitary. I worked at Wendy's, Domino's, and (in Las Vegas) as a cashier at the Venetian and Capriotti's. That was NOT allowed. One had to scrub up to the elbows or put on gloves to touch ANYTHING after handling money! But, the young Latina is nice and they do give decent portions for the price. So, I'll continue to go.

author: yukeong kim
review_text: We really enjoyed our time here at the restaurant. It was our first experience with Peruvian food and it could not have been better. Our server Franco was absolutely amazing and he really took his time to enhance our experience. Definitely recommend this restaurant to everyone, especially when visiting Miami!

author: Poh Zhi Nan
review_text: Needed a quick dinner fix and chanced upon this nearby store on Google. It’s my first time trying babi guling, and I was not quite sure what to expect. The pork skin was crispy but tough, and it was a little spicy. Overall I think it’s flavourful but nothing spectacular about it. It’s worth a try but I am sure there are even better ones out there in Bali.

author: Leonis Minoris
review_text: I had a wonderful dining experience at Nara Thai. The staff were warm, attentive, and made us feel very welcome throughout the meal. The food was absolutely delicious – full of authentic Thai flavors, beautifully presented, and cooked to perfection. The restaurant’s environment was also lovely, with a cozy yet elegant atmosphere that made the meal even more enjoyable. Overall, it was an excellent experience, and I’ll definitely be coming back again.

author: Jaslyn Lau
review_text: I was with my family for dinner. The staff informed us that this place is halal. I was informed that there is 5% discount for self ordering through QR and joining as a member, hence I did. I initially preferred to order through the staff directly to save the hassle. One thing that upset me was that when I asked the staff for help us take a group photo, 2 of them rejected me as they said their hands are dirty. They didn't even come back to assist. A third staff came and help but grumbled when we informed that we prefer the photo to be taken from outside as it looks better. I feel most of the servers are not that service oriented. Food wise, it was ok but tastes different compared to non halal Chinese food so the elders didn't enjoy as much but still quite tasty.

author: Joaquin Urbonas Alvarez
review_text: Great food and drinks very reasonable prices and even better ambiance and view. Will definitely come back. Shame in you miami for not having nothing remotely close to this .

author: Kyle Olney
review_text: Delicious Thai street food / brunch spot. Went back multiple times on our trip to Bangkok it was so good. The egg + rice base is definitely the way to go. Gets *SUPER* busy at peak hours so go on a shoulder time if you want AC or be ready to sweat outside on the sidewalk.

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: Asyifa Rizki Aprilia Harahap
review_text: We came here for breakfast and we were surprised of how clean this place is. I heard they were recently renovated. They offer a lot of different cuisine also. The food area is available on the first storey & second storey.

author: Charles Cheese
review_text: If you’re looking for dry donuts that taste a day old, just come in after 7 AM. And don’t expect a true “Baker’s Dozen” anymore—apparently 12 is the new 13 here. Very sloppy. Staff also seem irritated if you don’t tip, which just adds to the negative experience. On top of that, it feels unprofessional when employees switch to Spanish to give certain customers extras. The combination of stale donuts, no extra piece, and poor service is disappointing. I’m not the only one who noticed—there were over 10 people with me upset about the change from 13 to 12. One customer lost, and probably more to follow.

author: John Donaldson
review_text: Had a great time when I was here during the day. In the night the “service” is rude and incompetent. Staff at far corner looking at phone. I walk over. He looks up impatiently. “Welcome sir! Have a seat!” Nope. “Are you open?” Yes. Disinterest. “Can I sit?” Yes. Look at menu. He is at far corner looking at phone. I get up to leave. He comes over. I sit. He tells me only then kitchen is closed. I leave. Too bad. Compared to last time when the server Wendy is awesome. Very friendly. Great service. Good food. Like that Long Island w blue berry

author: John Larson
review_text: Great AmeriMex comfort food. Great service and reasonable prices. Good bartenders and always sports on the TVs.

author: George Slavchev
review_text: A local friend recommended this spot and, although I’m not a big fan of tourist traps, I really enjoyed Naughty Nuri’s! The service was great and everything we ordered arrived very quickly! The Babi Guling was pretty good! The nachos were very different to what I’ve had — very light and crispy — we really enjoyed them. Note that the place gets very busy at night and there’s a reasonably long wait. Overall a great spot if you’re in Bali for the first time.

author: Andre Bastary
review_text: We were helped by the supervisor on the day of our visit. She was very helpful and understand the menu quite well. The restaurant provides a vibrant atmosphere that combines nostalgic Italian charm with contemporary design, creating a comfortable and relaxing dining environment. The interior is a magical vibe of classical mahogany piece. The food quality is consistently high, with generous portions for Italian cuisine . Diners can indulge in top-tier food and beverages, including authentic Italian dishes like their pizzas and pastas. Notable dishes include the Maialona pizza, Spaghetti Aglio Olio.

author: Coy Swint
review_text: This is a new and very clean store that has a nice downtown location, but customer service needs improvement. I've visited this store twice, and each time, the server failed to acknowledge the customer even though there was no line. She pretended to be busy and didn't even look towards the counter. This has happened before with me as well as other customers. Perhaps another training course on customer service can correct this behavior. My rotisserie chicken foot long sub was delicious. This store has a lot of potential, so hopefully, they can improve in this area.

author: geo “ragingbutcher”
review_text: I went there food for my family they want to rush you out gave me the wrong ordering had the girl read it back and still didn't give me everything on my order they want to keep saying (is that it) if I spend my money here I should get what I order

author: Farrel Arkananta
review_text: One of the best nasi lemak I had in KL. Fluffy and flavorful rice, the chicken tastes very rich, the sambal was perfectly balanced, just a really great experience. Definitely worth the hype. Cues may be long, could be 20-30 mins of wait time.

author: Andrew Gummo
review_text: Legal Sea Foods in Boston was an excellent dining experience right on the water. The atmosphere was clean, relaxed, and well-managed, with efficient service from start to finish. We tried the lobster cone, buffalo shrimp cone, mussels in lemon garlic sauce, steak tips, and sole — everything was fresh, flavorful, and well-prepared. Prices were surprisingly reasonable for both the quality and the location. If you’re planning to dine in, definitely make a reservation — tables fill up fast. Highly recommend for seafood lovers visiting Boston!

author: Olive橄榄廖
review_text: Love the spacious tables and seats. Very detail design in the restaurant Food We had BBQ and steamboat. Love the mutton base soup. Love the mutton and chicken skewers. The rest of the food are normal. Service was good too, very attentive and friendly. And of the meal, they even offered dessert. We went there during lunch and ate from noon to 3pm. Great for gathering. Would go back again alone just to try their single pot..

author: Ed VanTil
review_text: The hanger steak I had was super tough, which has not been my experience that that cut. The atmosphere was quiet, but very big, and not a lot of people. My lady said it's not of a happy hour place, before and after baseball/basketball games. It was just ok.

author: Christopher Wu
review_text: For Vietnam, I only had a few pho spots while here, but this one was definitely the benchmark — easily the best one I had. I wasn’t a fan of the hot stone pho though; I felt like the broth became too diluted, and there was a bit of a weird colouration to it that threw me off. The flavour of the meat also didn’t hit the mark for me. The regular bowl, on the other hand, was packed with such a hearty broth. I ordered the beef pho — not a huge amount of meat inside, so if you’re someone who likes it loaded, I’d recommend adding extra beef. The noodles were as good as it gets, a bit on the thicker side but still held a nice bite. Service here was also really solid — they seat you quickly and the food comes out fast. Overall, a comforting bowl and easily my favourite pho experience in Vietnam.

author: Kimberly Smith
review_text: Beautiful detailed Restored building ,offers several areas of seating. we chose near the river. Delicious local food with a beautiful presentation. service is very welcome. I will return before leaving Hoi An !

author: Marti Deacon
review_text: Food was great. Spicy mayo def has a kick. Only problem is that when you order online, once you hit send, there is no way to contact the establishment if there is an issue, etc.

author: Omer Anis
review_text: Lunch at Peter Luger in Brooklyn was nothing short of phenomenal. I ordered the steak for one, accompanied by the creamed spinach and the legendary apple pie, and every bite was perfection. The steak was beautifully charred on the outside, tender and flavorful inside, truly the kind of cut that reminds you why this place has been an institution for over a century. The creamed spinach was rich and perfectly balanced, and the apple pie… simply unforgettable! comforting, crisp, and decadent all at once. A special mention must go to Denise, who made the experience exceptional. His warmth, attentiveness, and effortless professionalism elevated the entire meal. He struck that perfect balance between friendly and polished, making me feel genuinely welcomed and cared for.

author: Patty Alva
review_text: I stood for 15mins NOBODY greeted nobody said One word to me. They just kept staring a me. It was Online pickup order, the order wasn’t in the pickup area. A guy FINALLY gave me my order. Didnt say a Hello o have a nice Day, NOTHING. Place is DIRTY AND SMELLS HORRIBLE! Get it together TACO BELL.

author: Madam Wee
review_text: Had a lovely and romantic evening celebrating my birthday here, arranged by my husband. 💕 The ambience was beautiful, the food was above average, and the staff were super friendly — especially Nick, who helped us take many great photos. They even surprised us with a complimentary brownie cake and offered a 20% discount for birthdays! Parking can also be validated — just show your dining receipt. Perfect place for special occasions. We’ll definitely come again! ✨

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Jörg Baumeister
review_text: Lunch was fantastic. Highly recommended. Angus burger and chicken special with bacon. Very friendly service.

author: Juan Garcia
review_text: Another fantastic lunch in Coimbra restaurant, one of the best .

author: kaitilin moor
review_text: My husband and I came for lunch after a fabulous day snorkelling. He had a surprise birthday cake and flowers arranged for my 50th birthday !! The place is so beautiful. The views are spectacular. The food was fantastic and the staff were so professional and couldn’t do enough for us. Throughly recommend. ❤️👍🏼❤️👍🏼

author: Jaime
review_text: I liked the atmosphere at this restaurant. It is a little upscale but yet you can dress casually with no problem. I ordered the pizza and thought it was good. I didn't have a hard time finding parking. The waiters were friendly and attentive.

author: Karla Martinez
review_text: This is a Classic!! You can’t t leave Vegas without trying it at least once! This burgers were Fresh, Hot and Made to Order. It’s a Favorite among the Locals! We had some simple cheese burgers 🍔 for our picky eaters… That were more Out than In 😆 In the City that Never Sleeps… They had other plans… Definitely Check it out!

author: Jony
review_text: Since 1996, this beloved spot has been serving up mountains of delicious, affordable dim sum. The experience is part of the fun: just pick your favourites from the counter, and the staff steams them on the spot, delivering each one piping hot to your table. Don't let the crowds scare you away! Their efficient system means you'll be seated in no time, ready to dig into classic dim sum or their famous Bak Kut Teh. With three locations, it’s easier than ever to get a taste of this local legend.

author: T Henderson
review_text: The food and customer service were amazing. Tabitha, thanks for making my first time memorable.

author: Marcy Nordberg
review_text: Company event and the service was top knotch. We had the outdoor patio deck with beautiful bay views. Food was very good and our bar tender Noah took exceptional care of us. I highly recommend Mission resort- call Daniella ASAP to book your next event or just have a team happy hour. 🥂

author: Eduardo
review_text: The staff was really rude. We sat outside and waited for about 10 minutes for someone to come take our order. Then a woman “ Alexandra” came over and told us we couldn’t sit there because we weren’t buying anything. But how are we supposed to buy something if no one even came to serve us? Are we supposed to serve ourselves now? Come on — that’s just ridiculous.

author: 리ybbo비읍
review_text: One of my go to Hawker for breakfast, lunch probably not recommended for dinner. Prata, duck noodles, Chee Cheong Fun, Nasi Briayani, chicken rice, curry rice, bread and toast, soya beans, soft boiled eggs. What you name it, will definitely full-fill your 90% of your choice. Prices might not be as economical as you thoughts, but it won’t be rocket high. Saturday & Sunday are packed, avoid peak hours. Enjoy!

author: aqilah yahya
review_text: This café is aesthetically beautiful—cute and sleek. It has a nice ambiance, making it a great spot to hang out and take photos. The food is delicious, the service is excellent, and we didn’t have to wait for a table. My friends and I had a great time here.

author: Anh Le
review_text: Anh Le 1 review       4 months ago Meal type Dinner Price per person ₫200–300K Food: 1 Service: 4 Atmosphere: 5 Group size 2 people, 5-8 people, 9+ people Parking space Somewhat difficult to find parking Parking options Paid parking garage Wheelchair accessibility No accessibility  Like  Share

author: Leydiperez Makeup and hairstyle
review_text: A horrible experience. I ordered through Uber Eats. The first time I waited two hours and it never arrived. Today I ordered for my son's birthday and the pepperoni arrived burnt and smelled awful—disgusting.

author: Leonard Chong
review_text: Dinner dated 13 Dec 2025. Taste of hor fun was not the same, compared to what I had 2 years ago. Chill helped to elevate the taste slightly. It was my fault to order the miserable 2 x small fried spring rolls. Served hot but it was kids serving. No doubt hor fun was smooth, but it was another eaten and could be forgotten dish for me. Very sad.

author: Ross McMillan
review_text: The sandwiches here are amazing, so many good combinations and you can make your own. Staff are super cool too and speak great English.

author: Stefan Nicorescu
review_text: As soon as I land in Bali, there's one thing I know: I'm heading straight to BO$$MAN. This isn't just a burger joint — for me, it's a travel essential. I always get what I call my “Winner Winner” burger (or any beef/pork masterpiece they have sizzling at the moment), and it hits every time — thick, juicy patties (dry-aged or slow-cooked), bold smoky flavours, and that perfect balance of textures and sauces. On top of that, the loaded fries are next-level: crispy, flavor-packed, with pulled pork (or cheese, jalapeños, chipotle mayo...) — ideal if you want something more than a basic side. The vibe at BO$$MAN is epic: loud beats, street-cool decor, and an energy that feels like the pulse of Bali nights. The staff are always friendly and helpful — from service to a warm "welcome back," they make you feel right at home. And here's the thing I love: right next door is Sisterfields Cafe — so sometimes I'll grab a burger (or two) from BO$$MAN and a side or drink from Sisterfields, then chill with both in one spot. It's the kind of combo that only a seasoned Bali-traveller truly appreciates. For me, no Bali trip feels complete without that BO$$MAN burger fix. It's not just food — it's part of the experience, the ritual, the memories

author: Dallas D
review_text: Great food and coffee — I had an omelet and a perfectly brewed cup, a proper breakfast to start the day. But what truly surprised me was not only the food, but the artwork on the walls. Some of the drawings and paintings here are over 30–40 years old. For those who take the time to look closely, this place is not just about breakfast — it’s like a small hidden gallery. A café worth visiting not only for the food, but also for the meaning carried in these artworks. 🌿

author: Nechel Rodriguez
review_text: This was our first time coming to this place and will be our last. I don't know maybe we came in the wrong time with the wrong Cook. But if you guys like a weak margarita ( I felt like I was drinking a strawberry shake), a bland shrimp fajitas and if you like to pay $3 for a 2oz salsa then this is the best place for you . For a price over $20 or $25 IT IS NOT WORTH IT. We don't mind paying high price if food is good but this place is not for us. For the amount we paid, this place is no good.

author: Lisa C
review_text: I've randomly stopped a few times on way into the Keys. However, each time they've been out of something. This last time they charged me for drinks prior to informing me all they had was lemonade.and I could take that or 'Have a nice day' No offer for moneyback and when I asked I wa told they can't do that 🤔 Yea, I'm going with the 3 strikes your out on this lication

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Andrej Žižek
review_text: Good Vietnamese pork belly strips. The patties were just ok, less smoky than most places in Ha Noi. The soup is good especially by adding the calamansi lime + garlic + chopped 🌶 chili. We were pretty satisfied. Complete or special set 100K + meat only 60K + Spring Roll 20K = 180K nett. As expected because it is in touristic area (9 Aug 2025)

author: Jennifer De La Torre
review_text: First time coming here because King Taco was closed, but glad we gave it a try. I will say that if given the choice I would always pick King Taco but this was a nice alternative. We ordered; torta cubana, tacos, militas and champurrado. Meat was tasty but I was not a fan of the cheese they used. It was not stringy and I honestly don’t know what cheese they used but I was not a fan. Both salsa were spicy so if you are into really spicy salsas, then this is a good place. Champurrado was good too! I would come again if King Taco was closed again.

author: CooZooRoo
review_text: Overall taste is great. The restaurant is beautiful, but weekends are almost full and parking is limited. Number of servers are not compatible with the crowds so lacking of services for tables are happening.

author: Kaylee k
review_text: Can’t recommend this place enough!! The food is absolutely delicious, the bun cha takes me straight back to Hanoi! Yen and Carol are also very welcoming and loving. I will definitely be back!

author: Александра Качало
review_text: The place is really nice — cozy & comfortable, stylish. I ordered chicken, it was good, the portion is served with french fries and veg salad and it's really huge. The only one thing was a bitter taste of tomato sauce. I also liked the hospitality of the staff, especially our waiter Yumang. She was really friendly and helpful.

author: Ash Mowbray
review_text: For the price charged, this is not what a bacon sandwich should look like! A couple of scraps of bacon, mostly fat, served on T he cheapest bread they could find, soaked in butter. It tasted fine, but a total rip off. That said… if you want a “western” style breakfast, it’s one of the cheaper options in the terminal. And I must say the service from the lady working on the bar was fantastic!

author: Ummairah Mahmood
review_text: Yummyyyyyyyy! Had to queue for almost an hour to get my hands on Nasi kandar but it was all worth it..! A must try! My fave is the Ayam goreng bawang!

author: Kinda Jessop
review_text: Love the look, vibe and service here! We had the Four Lokos drink flight and a Watermelon Martini. Delish! However, food was okay. We had the elote and loaded fries. Not bad but definitely not on my foodie bucket list and I love Mexican food. Loved the selfie corners and decor. Music was pumping. Loved the staff birthday rollout!

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: Cheryl Lee
review_text: Aircon mookata, looks good and nice, many locals here instead of tourists, recommended to try, must come to this food street, it’s a amazing place with lots of variety!!

author: Edyta Drozdzal
review_text: Zum Stammtisch is a true gem that has earned its place as our top choice for family dinner. Every other week, we eagerly return to savor their delectable and fresh cuisine, soak up the warm atmosphere, and enjoy their impressive selection of beers. The kids menu is a thoughtful touch, offering a range of wholesome options reminiscent of European traditions. With its seamless service, this restaurant consistently exceeds our expectations, leaving us feeling inspired and already looking forward to our next visit.

author: Nadya Chandradewi (Nadya)
review_text: We did enjoy all the meals. Delicious Karedok, Tahu isi, Cumi, Nasi Bakoel & Dendeng Balado. Prices are affordable, too. Really worth the 5-star taste. Nothing compares to what Remboelan is cooking in their kitchen. Enak deh pokoknya. Highly recommended

author: Shaun Lomelin
review_text: I've eaten from this location multiple times, and the accuracy level is about 25%. I ordered a Double Western Bacon, and a California Classic. I received a basic double cheeseburger, and a single burger that is most definitely not a Double Western. I didn't even have time to return it since I had to make it to school on time. If this were the first or second time, I'd be a bit more forgiving, but this is well beyond that. What a waste of money.

author: Zeno Lee
review_text: Holbox definitely had some amazing dishes. Their fish tacos and their octopus were exceptional. The scallop aquachilles were a little too sour for us and the ceviche was good, but just as good as any other restaurant we been to. The presentation was amazing. And we generally really enjoyed the meal. The only thing that was challenging was waiting in line and then finding seats. We got there 30 minutes before open on Saturday and we waited just a little more than an hour. So 30 minutes after they opened. That wasn't bad considering the line got considerabl7 longer after we arrived. Then next challenge was finding a table. So many people were saving tables even though they weren't eating. Holbox definitely need to relocate to a new location. Would definitely go back for the fish tacos.

author: Hannah Katz
review_text: If I could give this restaurant 10 stars, I would. Everything is above and beyond - the food is delicious, the service is fast and kind, the ambiance is peaceful and inviting. There is also a coworking space which is a great environment. My only regret is not finding this place sooner!

author: Diego Cejas
review_text: Excellent! The food was delicious and the service was incredibly fast! Highly recommended. The menu is very varied!

author: Dr.Foodie
review_text: A solid place for good burgers and chicken sandwich. Haven't tried the shakes yet. It's outdoor dining on a patio area with a nice cool breeze. The steak and cheese fries were delicious and I do recommend. The only thing I can't wrap around is the price as it is more than 14 dollars for a chicken sandwich/burger.

author: Isabela Jazmín Santana Polanco
review_text: Amazing experience all around! Hubble Bubble truly exceeded my expectations. The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, the hookah was smooth, flavorful, and perfectly prepared, and the food was absolutely delicious. Everything we ordered was fresh and full of flavor, and the service made the experience even better. It’s the perfect spot to unwind, enjoy great food, and have an amazing hookah session. I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great vibe and quality all around!

author: Anthony Gangaram
review_text: Martin was amazing! Couch house has constantly adapted to the times and looks amazing these days! New menu is great and I recommend their angel envy's old fashion

author: Athena Roos
review_text: So many vegan options and vegan treats. I’ve eaten here 4 times this week just to keep trying different things. They also have such a gorgeous atmosphere…you can’t go wrong here

author: Andi ArcoStringsAsia
review_text: Nostalgic dim sum place.. The dim sum is good but I feel the savory offerings has too much msg & has a sugary taste.. Being premium priced, they should focus on refinements in their dim sum dishes.. Service is prompt but I still prefer the plates to be empty before collection. While I still prefer the old days of Foh San ( near the old association) , it is still a must visit place in Ipoh.

author: Sean Renner
review_text: I stopped by Fiore Caffe Miami for brunch and really liked the cozy, cheerful vibe. The avocado toast and pistachio pancakes were delicious and fresh, though the sweet dishes were a bit too sugary for my taste. The place has a nice open layout with a chill, welcoming atmosphere that makes it easy to relax and enjoy your meal. Overall, it’s a great spot for a casual breakfast or brunch in the city.

author: Sanchit Kamath
review_text: Have been seeing this place since 2021 and today finally made a move inside. The ambience over here gives you a typical Nepali vibe and a little space for the seating area. I was craving Momos for a long time and today I'm glad to have it. I had ordered chicken Momos. The dish came along 2 sauces( 1 spicy, 1 regular) and a rice kheer. The spicy sauce was enough to make my nose runny, the other sauce was fine whereas the kheer too was okay. Coming to the chicken Momos, the staff said that they make it fresh in the morning and deep freeze it.. honestly, I didn't get the logic behind it as it's officially frozen but once they steamed it.. it did feel a bit fresh compared to what a fully freshly made momo would feel like. Honestly, I was expecting a fresh product here in a Nepali restaurant and I would admit that I felt a bit down after seeing the frozen momo. Overall the taste was above average as of now since this is the first time I've had Momos in this country! Btw the staff is friendly over here. Looking to try out a few more dishes next time!

author: peter liew
review_text: Reach the restaurant about 1830, there is queue but you don't have to wait very long. You placed your order first and you will be given a queue number. You paid after you finish your meal. The price is very reasonable and you get big chunky crab meat. The food is tasty. Do take note that the last order is at 7pm. You can continue your meal and they will only closed when all guests have finished. I highly recommend giving a try.

author: PT Payton
review_text: Will not return. Lots of menu items to choose from but we were sadly disappointed. Food is overpriced and sandwiches were soggy. French fries tasted like old fryer and cookies were stale. Service counter workers are rude and stare at you while you are eating not a very comfortable situation.

author: A. M.
review_text: I went to this cafe based on my hotels recommendation and it is a very peaceful spot that I really liked. The banana bread was good and the potion size was big. The mango smoothie is rather heavy, I think it contained yogurt but still very tasty. They also gave me free ice tea.

author: Justin Snider
review_text: Great local bar. Came on a Saturday to watch football and it wasnt super busy. Only had a few things on the menu but they were all good. Would definitely come back.

author: Kathy Troxell
review_text: We are traveling from Oklahoma and staying at the BW Plus, directly behind the restaurant. We decided to walk to dinner and hadn't been to a Walkers. Hopefully it won't be our last! Jessie was a great waitress!! Highly recommend.

author: MikaelaRoze Starr
review_text: Stopped in for a quick bite and was very surprised that it wasn’t busier. The food was amazing and the service was even better from Somdat. Will definitely visit again soon! 🤍

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: Hoong Wai Wong
review_text: Crowded but can get a seat eventually. Friendly stall owners, plenty of great food choices here! Mutton Briyani, Nasi Ayam, various nasi or mee gorengs, kambing (mutton) soup, mee rebus with satay, nasi padang, Bubur porridge. Every time come here lost for choice what to eat sia! The Ching Teng dessert soup also nice and cooling contrast for the spicy dishes. Recommended!

author: Michel Cheung
review_text: Really good place to visit in Malaysia. Decent price that is no overpriced due the viral moment. Really recommend this place. Definitely will come again on my next vacation. Staffs are very friendly. To avoid line up come before 12pm or it will be cloudy and needed to wait in queue.

author: Jamieko Lane
review_text: What a great find. We only stayed a few nights in Miami and wanted to eat here every night. Our server Luisa was great. She was the only server for happy hour and even with a full restaurant we felt attended too. We had the shrimp shumai, nfl roll, spicy conch roll, veggie fried rice, and the combo tempura. We came during happy hour (which was pretty late) and scored some great deals! The old fashioned we had took a little while but was worth the wait. The food was great. The spicy conch roll had a hot sauce that was different but not bad. The veggie rice was definitely under cooked but it had a great flavor! They have an amazing outdoor seating area with fire pits. We chose to go inside bc we had our little with us. Highly suggest!

author: Cindy Juarez
review_text: This was honestly one of the worst places I’ve eaten at. The food was terrible, nothing tasted fresh and most of it seemed stale. We went during the week and the menu was super limited, barely any options. From the fajitas to the birria tacos, everything tasted off and not authentic at all. It felt super Americanized. I would’ve rather eaten at Chipotle or even Taco Bell. I also ordered a piña colada and it was disgusting. It tasted super fake, like they used some kind of powder mix instead of making it fresh. I couldn’t even finish it. I ordered a Coke too and got a tiny glass full of ice with barely any soda. They didn’t even give me the can, which was annoying because it felt like they kept the rest of my drink. On top of that, they automatically added an 18% gratuity for a party of four, which is crazy considering that’s not even a big table especially with how bad the food and service were. The prices were high, and I don’t mind spending money on good food, but this definitely wasn’t it. The place looks nice from the outside, but the food is not good at all. Huge disappointment.

author: Corey W.
review_text: Well my wife and I visit the Yard a few times a year and they have some great burgers and sauces that are pleasurable to the palette. I had thr oxtail burger and my wife had the Seoul sister fried rice! It's always a vibe with the music in Military Park in the city of Newark!

author: Aaliyah Reese
review_text: My friend and I had just hopped off our cruise looking for some Miami food to eat and stumbled across JRK. We got the Jerk Patties and coffee and EVERYTHING WAS DELICIOUS!!! Probably one of the best jerk patties I've ever had!! And the guy in the front is extremely nice and welcoming!! I will definitely be back at the establishment 🤩

author: Alisa M.
review_text: Lucky Fish in Dania has everything going for it—amazing views, great food, and drinks that hit the spot. It’s the kind of place you want to spend hours at, just soaking it all in. The only downside was the service; our server kept asking if we needed a box every 15 minutes, even though we clearly weren’t done and had plans for two more rounds of beer. We hadn’t even finished our drinks when the check arrived. It’s such a great place to enjoy yourself—if they let you! 😂 Unfortunately, we ended up leaving early.

author: Claire Bonnepart
review_text: This place is clean, staff are friendly and the food was tasty! Gluten free bread and vegan options available. I ordered the tofu scramble and added a side of chicken apple sausage ($7) a bit pricey .. but I’d definitely go back to hang out in the outdoor patio area for brunch again.

author: J “Joey” Jouk
review_text: I’ve been to Kampang ISAN Casual Dining (คำแพง) many times now, and each visit continues to impress me. It’s rare to find a place that maintains such a high level of consistency, but Kampang nails it — every single time. The food is truly authentic Isan, bursting with bold, spicy flavors and made with fresh, high-quality ingredients. Some of my favorites include the som tum (papaya salad), grilled chicken, and larb — all perfectly seasoned and packed with that signature northeastern kick. The sticky rice is always warm and soft, and their dipping sauces are addictive. Even the simple dishes are elevated with care and attention to detail. The atmosphere is casual and welcoming, making it great for anything from a quick lunch to a relaxed dinner with friends. The staff are always kind, attentive, and efficient, which adds to the overall great experience. You feel genuinely taken care of from the moment you arrive. And I can’t leave out the iced tea — it’s honestly one of the best I’ve ever had. Perfectly sweet, cold, and refreshing — it balances out the heat of the food beautifully. Kampang is a gem for anyone who loves Isan cuisine. Highly recommended and worth coming back to again and again!

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: Andy Lee
review_text: Food is great. Love the prawn, and those who love spicy will love the curry fish head. Only one complaint. We had an appointment, but was only seated after 30min delay. Add another 15min before we could place our order. By the time we eat, it was after a hour wait. Understaff, but the employees are friendly.

author: Paul Niehouse
review_text: Abolutely fabulous food! Had the pork belly appetizer, green curry Chicken and the Daisy, Eggplant with basil and a Lychee martini. Everything was absolutely fabulous. Finished every bite. Can't wait to go back again!

author: Jo De Leon
review_text: The food was delicious, and the service was on point. I highly recommend the cilantro steak. We originally went to try chilaquiles, but they were soggy and had no egg. Every other dish was excellent.

author: J P
review_text: Oceanside restaurant along the boardwalk very scenic. The food is good and you get plenty in your serving. I wish they had a single burger item on the menu but all they have for adults is double burgers which are too huge to finish. The kids menu has a single burger. Very good drinks coke, lemonade etc. Great location next to Margaritaville surfing machine. Friendly staff. Easy parking right next to the restaraunt in the parking garage. Prices are fair for the size of the items.

author: Savannah Broderick
review_text: The best part of the experience was our server Patrick. He made it personal and inviting. We were impressed by his speedy service and his patience and kindness. Would return again only for the service. I loved the waterfront experience and the fish tanks. There are several puffer fish and clown fish! Great food, came out timely and was flavorful. I got the french dip sandwich. It came with fries and oju, which I never had before but was pleasantly surprised!

author: Bowen Chau
review_text: Bếp Cuốn Sài Gòn is a delightful culinary gem nestled near the city center of Ho Chi Minh City, making it easily accessible via Grab. This Michelin-recommended restaurant offers a refreshing twist on traditional Vietnamese cuisine, setting it apart from the usual pho-focused menus. Upon entering, you’re greeted by a cozy yet stylish decor that reflects a modern take on Vietnamese aesthetics. The intimate size of the restaurant fosters a warm atmosphere, perfect for enjoying a meal with friends or a loved one. The staff at Bếp Cuốn are incredibly friendly and eager to guide you through their unique offerings. They are passionate about the menu and are happy to recommend dishes that showcase a fusion of flavors, blending classic ingredients with innovative techniques. Each dish is a testament to the chef’s creativity, bursting with fresh ingredients and vibrant tastes. The food is nothing short of delicious, with each bite inviting you to savor the harmonious blend of textures and flavors. Overall, Bếp Cuốn Sài Gòn is a must-visit for anyone looking to experience a modern twist on Vietnamese cuisine in a welcoming setting. Don’t miss out on this unforgettable dining experience!

author: Ppaulina Jjamroz
review_text: Very nice place and great service, helpful people very good and tasty food - We came here for breakfast - large menu a lot of choices- you can choose between sweet or not sweet breakfast, simply delicious. I can truly recommend this place and I will definitely come back here.

author: David Ryabov
