review_text: This place is amazing. You do not even notice how time flies by (manage your time accordingly lol). Food is amazing, especially tea - when you go you HAVE to try the tea and dumplings.

author: Norma Correa
review_text: For me it's a great treat I love pastrami sandwich no one has like them. especially when you had good results at another place this my treat for the day .

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Phúc Nguyễn
review_text: Delicious grilled pork vermicelli with golden brown grilled pork, well marinated, served with soft rice noodles, fresh vegetables and sweet and sour fish sauce. The attractive blend of flavors, rich in Vietnamese, makes anyone who eats it fall in love.

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: An Chee
review_text: The food were delicious and the service was excellent. Peter was especially friendly and patient, he even took the time to teach us the best way to enjoy the pancakes. Really appreciated his warm and attentive service. Highly recommended!

author: Max Sulla
review_text: Understaffed. Definitely not Brazilian. Nice hard working staff but so short staffed that they have no chance to be attentive even if they try. Two waiters and a bartender sharing all roles include a host post. Didn’t ask once if we need anything else once mains were served. Medium rare steak was medium well. Didn’t ask if we would like coffee or dessert after dinner. We had to ask for bread service. Brought main courses And left dirty appetizer plates on the table. We had to ask to clean the table. Don’t know how to make a decent dirty martini either. And then they added 20% gratuity for a party of 2 ! Convenient location for pre show dinner. Next table over burger looked good though. Hope to find a different pre show place to dine at near NJPAC.

author: Joe
review_text: Unfortunately I can’t recommend this place for its pastries. I’ve tried multiple times hoping maybe something will be different. Not sure what it is but the quality of the pastries is just not really up to par and the flavor of most of them is just dull. No butter flavor—just sort of salty/yeasty. Dulce de Leche on Jersey City is a much better option in my opinion. Maybe the cakes are better though—-I haven’t tried them.

author: Salina Allen-Sharpp
review_text: I spent my 65th birthday dining solo at Moo in the Seaport — something I do often and truly enjoy. This wasn’t about being alone; it was about indulging myself in an extraordinary meal while quietly celebrating where I’ve been and embracing where I’m headed next. ✨ The Beef Wellington was exceptional — beautifully prepared and perfectly tender. The Yukon potatoes were rich and fluffy, though I did happen to find a thin wire in them. To their credit, the staff handled it with grace and professionalism, immediately apologizing and making things right without hesitation. Their attentiveness turned what could have been an unfortunate moment into a testament to true hospitality. 🍷 I paired my entrée with broccolini and ended the evening with a freshly baked chocolate chip cookie — still warm, almost too hot to hold, and completely worth the wait. Moo offers an atmosphere that feels both refined and welcoming — the kind of place where a solo diner can feel perfectly at home while enjoying a bit of quiet luxury. It was a wonderful way to mark another year of life, gratitude, and growth. 🌿

author: Weng Hau Hoon
review_text: This is one of the restaurant with good food that the locals and tourist eat in Patong. The BBQ Chicken Wing is delicious but the stir fry pork with mint can be skipped if you can't eat spicy food as it's actually quite spicy. The Thai Iced tea and Rose Syrup with milk is tasty and cooling especially during hot weather. Overall damage is about 500 baht and would definitely revisit again to try their Grilled fish and seafood.

author: Victor Leung
review_text: I recently dined at this traditional Balinese restaurant, and I had a wonderful experience! The location is very convenient and easy to find, although I noticed there wasn’t a suitable place to park motorcycles, which could be a bit challenging. The quality of the food was outstanding; each dish was flavorful and authentic, showcasing the best of Balinese cuisine. The decor of the restaurant adds to its charm, with beautiful traditional elements that create a warm and inviting atmosphere. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking to enjoy delicious Balinese dishes in a lovely setting. I can't wait to return!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: A P
review_text: Whenever you see a new restaurant with low reviews, and especially a chain restaurant that has done this multiple times, one always wonders what happened, and mostly it’s about the leadership at the top - especially the restaurant management. In our case, we ended up on a Monday with the restaurant 80 percent empty. On this particular day, they had run out of the house red to go with the food. While there were five other wines that were available by the glass , we were not allowed to substitute. Finally, courtesy the bartender we were offered a low cost Malbec that was not on the wine list. Several questions here: why do you have a cheap wine in the bar but not on the menu unless you are feeding it to unsuspecting customers. How much money are you gonna lose by substituting one red wine glass with another from already open bottles? And most importantly, how well are you training your staff to create happy experiences for your customers? After all, 80 percent of the questions your servers face are tied to 20 percent of the issues. Just remind your staff about these issues in your afternoon staff meeting till it becomes like A, B, Cs for them. On the food side, we simply had the pizza and it has nothing special to it. One can totally avoid it if needed. But, not everything was bad. a shout out to Vlada for giving us a listening ear and understanding the issues. To the super senior management, you can invest millions of dollars, but without the right people, you are just another 4.1 rated restaurant in a busy Miami restaurant scene. Good luck!

author: Ashley Hung
review_text: We had coconut iced coffee, which is like liquid coconut coffee ice cream, very delicious! The cafe is located in the heart of old town Hoi An and right across from the Thu Bon River. p.s. Cong Caphe tote bags also make great souvenir gifts for friends!

author: Kshitij Bodhankar
review_text: Some delicious food and a great vibe. Def recommend going here for the classic weekend morning breakfast/brunch experience. The coffee tastes so good and their dishes are heavy. Super warm hosts and a great place for a weekend meetup.

author: Miranda Nghiem
review_text: Great experience. The restaurant was full but they were able to squeeze me in due to a cancellation, and if that wasn’t possible at least let me do takeout. I got the crab pasta and burrata which was delicious. The crab was fresh tasting and a healthy portion, especially for the cost. It was great reading the menu to see how everything was sourced locally. Would definitely come back!

author: Patrick No
review_text: Definitely worth doing a little drive to get to this elevated food court and trying Holbox. This is some of the city’s best fresh Mexican cuisine, with a focus on seafood. Do yourself a favor and order a bunch of stuff, it’s worth it. We got: Branzino, Scallop Aguachile, fresh Santa Barbara Uni, Kanpachi & Uni Tostada, Kanpachi Taco, and Baja Fish Taco. Overall, whatever you do, get the Scallop Aquachile and something with Sea Urchin. By far, probably the best Sea Urchin I’ve had in my life. The Smoked Kampachi Taco was quite good too, it had a peanut chili oil (Salsa Macha) which I’ve never seen before until here. Really cool. The Branzino was fresh and cooked perfectly, with insanely good blue corn tortillas to go alongside. The Baja Fish taco was pretty standard. All in all, I try to come here every time I come to LA now. You get FRESH FRESH FISH here and it shows. Recently, there’s been lines out the door. Worth the wait, I think, but maybe come at a weird time and you won’t have to worry. All of this order was like $100.

author: NL. C.E.
review_text: Amazing experience! Had wanted to go here since I saw Funke’s Amazon docu in 2020! Well it was worth the wait. Fast (we were dining during a long layover to AUS), friendly service and amaze balls food. We were able to eat apps, mains and dessert all in an hr. Thanks to our server (and kitchen staff) for taking into account our short time to dine! Perfect, perfect all around.

author: Lena Bennett
review_text: Love love love this place!! Really yummy burgers!! Had the lil smashin ,So tasty. The chicken strips are also great! They have a unique flavour. Ate here twice! Great service and eating area airconditioned inside and clean tables. Will be back when in Bali again.

author: JH
review_text: The food was delicious and reasonably priced! I went on a Saturday without a reservation and was told the wait would be 10–15 minutes, but I ended up waiting nearly 40 minutes.🫠🫠 Because I had another appointment, I had to eat in a rush and took the rest to go. That said, the staff were all very friendly and the food was absolutely worth it. Prices are fair, and I’d definitely recommend this place. On weekends, the wait can be quite long, so I recommend making a reservation in advance. Next time, I’ll try to visit during a less busy time!👍

author: Lemus Lemus
review_text: Very good place to bring family or friends. The food was good and had amazing service when I walked out without my sauce the lady came outside and gave it to me

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Tien T. Tram
review_text: good food, great service. The staff (Hien) was so helpful and friendly

author: RJ Ang El
review_text: First time trying and it's amazing! The crust is light and crispy, and the pork is flavourful and juicy. Portion is MASSIVE!! Rice is well cooked and curry sauce is nice. Generous owners provide unlimited servings of rice, curry and salad. Soup has many chunks of tender pork, carrots and some veg with deep flavour in every sip. Everything is cooked and served with ultimate sincerity. We arrived at 11.25am on a thursday and there was already a queue. Lovely and cozy environment, felt like immersing in a japanese tempura bar. Service is top notch and everyone is so friendly and patient. I must go back and try their seafood and black curry!

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: I Love Fried Hokkien Mee
review_text: This plate of FHM is the wetter kind, with lots of broth. Pork bones were used as the base, but probably not simmered long enough to bring out deep flavour. The noodles taste raw and there’s no wok-hey, so it’s missing that smoky kick which we usually find in a Cze Char stall. The prawns and sotong were overcooked and a little tough. No pork belly, though there is some crispy pork lard to enjoy. The chili and lime help lift the dish, but overall the ingredients don’t quite come together.

author: rae wu
review_text: The coffee was so unique, but the avocado one was a little bit thick for me…yogurt jar is really recommended! Nice place nice staff:)

author: A R
review_text: Great food, great place and exceptional service. The steak was tender and cooked perfectly. The flan was amazing. I spilled a part of my drink on the table, and the waiter cleaned it up and brought me a whole new drink.

author: Angel Tan
review_text: Dropped by Haig Road Market & Food Centre since I was on a journey to the east! Tried out dishes that I’ve never eaten before, eg. Sarawak laksa which came with big prawns & a strong taste of spices, & Mee rabus with thick & sweet gravy. The Fried carrot cake was sweet & crispy with its slightly burnt sides, & we ended off with desserts coz of the hot weather (I had the Ice jelly cocktail). Couldn’t leave without getting some of the famous Putu piring! IG @pingguo301

author: J. H.
review_text: Really lucky that this place was near my hotel but I’d have gladly made the journey here anyway. It’s a tightly run ship here, the boss & staff are attentive and quick. Everything from getting seated, ordering, getting my food and paying the bill went smoothly. Appreciate them for kindly offering an extra chair, when they saw I rested my bag on my lap. You don’t have to worry about not speaking any Vietnamese. As things are quite fast paced, it wouldn’t hurt to check if the change you received is correct. Clearly a favourite among foreigners and locals alike. A hearty way to start the day!

author: Esmond Chun
review_text: This is to review the stall name "Luck樂 Wanton mee. Ipoh hor fun". We ordered the hor fun $4 and wanton soup noodle $4 for a try. For hor fun I don't think is good as I can't even find it tasty, the hor fun that used is too thick comparing with traditional way, even they tried to get the grave to make it smooth. Ingredients provided is reasonable more than many other stalls. As for the wanton noodle, the BBQ pork used is nice, tasty and some fatty. As for wanton putting too much pork meat that find a bit too hard. Overall, this could be a new stall as can't find in the directory.

author: Kathy Yu
review_text: WOW! First time here and I love it so much. The slices are large and the crust is thin. The toppings have fresh ingredients, and there's so much variety in the slices you can buy. The margherita was amazing, with fresh basil and mozzarella. I also loved the veggie so much. The pizza is seasoned well.

author: Penny Young
review_text: Seated very quickly nice warm banana muffin brought to the table we had the chili relleno omelette. WOW fantastic.

author: Gabriella L
review_text: I came with my homegirls and we had a great time. Great vibes and our server Nehry was 10/10!!! Very attentive, funny, welcoming and beautiful. She made the experience more comfortable. The food and drinks were great. Would come again!!

author: David E
review_text: My favorite ever Mexican restaurant outside of Mexico and I am picky about Mexican food. Genuine Jalisco style food. Never had a bad meal here.

author: Ian Pomato
review_text: The best place to fix your tonkatsu craves. The pork is fatty and juicy with perfect crust. The tonkatsu doesn't need any fancy dressing or seasoning as it is already flavourful enough. This place is crowded all the time so best is to come on weekday lunch hour.

author: Tina Sargent
review_text: This place was amazing! So delicious and fresh! You won’t be disappointed!! Give it a try! Ask for Stephanie, made dinner ever more enjoyable! full of joy and a beautiful smile. Very helpful! The jalapeño mahachi is the best!!

author: Elmer Castillo
review_text: If I could give Delicias Colombianas six stars, I would. This place is a true gem and the perfect spot for any occasion. Carolina is an absolute star. She is always so friendly and attentive, and she remembers my favorite order even when it's been a while since I've visited. She makes every dining experience feel special and personal.

author: Mario Flores
review_text: We traveled into Miami for a convention and arrived early, so we stopped at Nicky Jam’s La Industria Bakery & Café for breakfast. It definitely has an interesting vibe, but it felt like it was missing a few atmosphere elements that would have elevated it into a high-end spot. The food was excellent — I ordered La Combi Completa with the Strawberry Cheesecake topping, and it even came with a slice of cheesecake, which was a great surprise. The coffee was strong and just what I needed for a morning pick-me-up. Overall, good food and good start to the day — with a little more attention to the ambiance, this place could really stand out even more. Worth a visit if you’re in the area early and hungry!

author: Shang Yih Leong
review_text: Best local Thai restaurant I had experienced so far in Hatyai. The food is delicious and free of MSG. The friendly boss can also speak fluent English. Must come early to get into a shorter queue (very unlikely that you won't get into a queue because of its popularity, so you can only wish for a shorter one).

author: YouToobr
review_text: We had Chow Mein and chilly momo. Chow mein and chilly momos were good. Unlike Chinese lo mein the chow Mein isn't sweet and that's fine because they have the flavor of garlic, onions, and peppers to compliment. Would visit again when In the area.

author: Mark VanPatton
review_text: Had time to kill waiting on our flight. Party of 3 with luggage and the waitress was nice and told us we could have our bags by us. And we could hang out for a few hours no problem! Very good food and great service! Liked the location and the atmosphere. Ubered over and quick seating outside. Honestly didn't look around. 2 burgers and the fish tacos. Chips and salsa. Overall experience very good! Highly Recommended-MVP

author: Josemari O. Calip (Joma)
review_text: This was my first time visiting through my buddy Jeremy. He reckoned me and I actually like it if it is actually a family friend orientated a little better than your average pizza, but they are from Philadelphia so definitely go through that. I am an ECW Philadelphia fan so I'm sure the owner will know a lot of them. But overall definitely give that a shot if you're around town. Definitely a crown jewel Susie was actually one of the servers that helped me so definitely worth it out

author: TDC
review_text: This is an unassuming old school Vegas spot. There's a smoke-fee restaurant section and a bar/lounge section with live music. The clientele is older. This is not the Instagram crowd, and I say that in a good way. They have the best prime rib in town. Tender, juicy, well seasoned and perfectly prepared. My picture doesn't do it justice. The other items on the menu are generally ok. The customer service is hit or miss. The owner doesn't have the best reputation for different reasons.

author: Sh Cheng
review_text: Super crowded during peak hour. Select your dishes, walkover to another shop for seating, the restaurant will serve your food there. Good experience at their HQ. Be ready to pay.

author: Kuanyi (Chloe)
review_text: One of the most comfortable business-class lounges I’ve visited in Singapore. The service here is truly outstanding ☺️warm, attentive, and proactive without being overbearing. A heartfelt thank you to Hazel, Elsy, Alvin, Stary, Pinky, and Divan for their genuine hospitality and thoughtful service throughout my visit. The dining experience feels closer to fine dining than a typical airport lounge. Most dishes are made to order, which means fewer buffet options, but everything is refined, beautifully presented, and genuinely delicious. The shower rooms are spacious, spotless, and fully equipped. The lounge itself is calm, quiet, and incredibly relaxing. It’s really perfect for enjoying a proper meal and unwinding before a flight.

author: A T
review_text: ทอสมิทธ์ is undeniably a gem among the many noodle shops in Bangkok. Known for its widespread popularity, this place consistently delivers exceptional food that reflects the chef's meticulous attention to detail, right down to the carefully crafted condiments that accompany each dish. As a Thai person, I can confidently say this is how a boat noodle shop should be. I highly recommend trying the beef ball with spicy sauce—it's truly delightful. While the overall experience is wonderful, I'd love to see the noodles served a bit hotter and with more soup. The pricing reflects a more upper-class noodle experience, but I find it well worth it for the quality and authenticity offered. Overall, ทองสมิทธ์ captures the essence of Thai boat noodles with finesse and flair.

author: Kimberly Iwamoto
review_text: Waiting time: 40 mins at Sunday morning The menu has so many choices , I ordered Country fried steak and eggs $22 . It was very good, like the hash browns were crispy on the outside and buttery which was great, but it made me so full that I didn't have to eat dinner. The portion is huge, I guess that's why it's so popular. Service is fast and friendly !

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: Tini Seng
review_text: I takeaway regularly from this shop and I really enjoyed the thunder tea. However, recently I find that the thunder tea is salty. I usually will put the whole thing and mix with the ingredients. But yesterday, I added one scoop only and gave up the rest as it's too salty. The caipo is also more salty and the ingredients more oily. Standard seems to have drop :(. Hope they will restore the standard otherwise will find other leicha store to try.

author: Chairil Junin Riza
review_text: Such a beautiful café with amazing vibes ✨ The atmosphere is elegant yet cozy, making it perfect for catching up, working, or just enjoying some quiet time. The space is spacious and thoughtfully designed, so it never feels crowded. Their bakery is next level — fresh, delicious, and beautifully made. Pair that with their specialty coffee blends, and it’s honestly a perfect combo. Every sip and bite feels well crafted. Definitely a spot I’ll keep coming back to. Highly recommended for anyone who appreciates good coffee, great pastries, and a lovely ambiance 🤍☕🥐

author: Megha Sheth
review_text: Probably the only Indian food place that I'd rate at zero. The food was bland, it was apparent that no effort was made to look at the taste and spice level. The Dal Tadka had no Tadka and dal tasted uncooked. The rice that is served along looked re-heated than fresh made. I'd recommend this place to No One.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Bryan Nha Hoang
review_text: 100,000vnd ~ 4,5usd for a special bowl. Freaking high price in such a small restaurant like this. Bun bo was ok but really not worth the price.

author: Rosie Espinosa C FH
review_text: We had another great experience at 4P’s. The staff are always friendly, especially Uyen — she was very attentive to our table, always smiling, polite, and so cute! The food was excellent as usual. It’s not our first time here, and every visit the dishes are consistently delicious. Thank you to the 4P’s team for the warm service and great food!

author: KL Cheong
review_text: Very disappointed with this chicken rice shop. The staff were rude and unfriendly, which made the whole experience unpleasant. The chicken had a strange smell and didn’t taste fresh at all. On top of that, they only accept cash, which is very inconvenient. The soup and portion size were really not worth the price I paid. Definitely not coming back. Would not recommend!

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Antoni Carrascal
review_text: A perfect restaurant to take photos and post on social media. In terms of quality, honestly, nothing that makes me say ‘wow, I have to save this place in my agenda.’ Service… to be honest, they make you feel like an alien. You speak to them in English and they give you a look of denial. You speak Vietnamese and their face is the same, so it’s better not to talk about the service. So, in summary… if your goal is to take photos, it’s a good place; if, on the other hand, it’s to eat… that’s up to you.

author: Rachael Richardson
review_text: How quaint and beautiful is this place?! The atmosphere is so inviting. This is not your average coffee shop. This coffee shop is definitely anointed. I came here for coffee and ended up staying two and a half hours and didn't even realize how much time it went past because the atmosphere is so electric you literally get out of time and you travel into space upon entering this place.

author: Irzam Sarfraz
review_text: We had the philly cheesesteak, wings, chicken fingers and nachos here. Owners were very welcoming. Food was decent too. Overall, a good experience.

author: william gross
review_text: In the beginning it started out shakey the hostess didnt seat us and the bar tender was yelling across the room to her she turns around and says why cant you seat them the food and drinks were great and the waiter was attentive. Kinda pricey for the drinks but food was very reasonable. Overall would go again.

author: Amanda Ang
review_text: Ordered our food and waited for 2 hours via foodpanda. Called them but food wasn’t prepared at all & they mentioned that it’s on the way, but it was not. They forgotten to prepare our food. We asked what time the food will be ready but the lady who answered the call kept giving us generic replies “I asked them to cook already”. We told them we will complain, and the lady just told us to complain. Very disappointed with the poor customer service & for such dishonesty.

author: L.G. Wee
review_text: Jan2026. This was probably one of the best bak chor mee i had for a long time. In my opinion, it was even better than Taihwa bak chor mee. I ordered a dry version, the minced pork and dumplings were served in a separate soup bowl from the noodle. The soup absorbed the pork fragrance and the minced meat was fluffily easy on chewing. Even the dumplings had a unique taste which i liked. The only thing to complain was it was oily albeit already ordered with no lard oil.

author: Shaun Lin
review_text: My partner and I visited on 5th November 2025. We ordered a special fried rice, and a special fried noodle (chow mien). The food was delicious. The eggs were perfectly fried. Nice crusty base, soft body, with a perfect runny yolk. Fried rice had the right amount of heat, flavour, and a nice touch of umami, aroma, depth, and texture that's added from the finely diced ginger flower. Most importantly, it had wok hei! The sambal belacan sauce was a great pairing with the fried rice. It had some sweetness, but it leaned towards the savoury side. I topped every spoon of fried rice with just a touch it and it brought a whole new level of depth to range of flavours that the fried rice already had. The chow mien was amazing. Noodles were well cooked. It had a wonderful aroma, and rich in flavour. She ordered with a side of fried belachan chicken. Perfectly fried. Crispy on the outside, juicy, and tender on the inside with a nice amount of belacan used to season it. Is it on the pricier side? Yes, but you get what you pay for; quality. As for the ambience, it's an American retro diner style fitting, with a little twist of uncle Roger's essence, ranging from ceiling and wall lamps, neon signs, and the choice of style in the seats and tables. Music choices enhanced this effect with the old school songs playing in the background too! Such attention to detail! Well done to the cook, and the team for the food and service too! Amazing first time experience. I'm glad I came by, and I will definitely be back with other family members too! What a treat!

author: WeiPeng
review_text: Hidden gem! Love this place. Many choices, Healthy Rasa Bowls, Pasta using premium ingredients, even the olive oil. The portion is big and you can't find this price in KL. Highly recomended!

author: Kwei Wong
review_text: Ambience is good. I like the fried duck a lot with the chilli dip and crispy skin! The acidic and refreshing salad on the side also cut through the greasiness of the meal. The matcha cloud is nice too! Next time will visit the outlet at Ubud!

author: Carlos Mennea
review_text: My wife and I recently visited La Fusta for the Copa America final, and it was our first time dining there. Despite the hectic night, the staff was incredibly friendly and attentive. We ordered a mix of empanadas (carne/beef, spinach, and jamon y queso/ham and cheese), a mixed salad, and milanesa completas. The prices were more than fair and actually cheaper than some other Argentine steakhouses in NJ. The quality and taste of the food were superb—everything tasted fresh and was seasoned to perfection. Although we didn’t get a chance to try their parillada, which they are known for, we will definitely be returning soon!

author: Rebecca Schiappa
review_text: Boosting the stars on this place — they deserve more! Service was quick and friendly. Super cute ambiance, great vibes on a Saturday morning. :) I had the spinach feta pastry (simple and delicious) and my partner had the GF rose pistachio cake… yum! Such a uniquely flavored treat for breakfast. The baristas clearly know what they’re doing; my cappuccino was perfectly crafted and the Gesha pour over was *muah* chefs kiss!

author: Viaan Dodhia
review_text: Queen was amazing and helped me with my first time hotpot which I had at this beautiful restaurant. The staff is super friendly and excellent ambience and service. Must come for great food and awesome view.

author: Antwon Waters
review_text: The food was absolutely delicious and the service was impeccable. I will definitely be coming back soon.

author: FS M
review_text: We went here for dinner. The queue at Zhu Wei Xian big prawn noodle was short so we took the chance to order it. The broth is very tasty, the pork practically falls off the ribs, the prawns are generous and chunky. Very economical for $8 per bowl. Add some chili padi with soya sauce for more flavour. Highly recommended.

author: Zunairah Janis
review_text: Honest Indonesian flavours, well executed. Comforting dishes with rich spices that taste authentic and satisfying. A great spot for a relaxed local meal. Please come early if you do want to be disappointed by the long queue.

author: Andy
review_text: I think this was the BEST sandwich of my life! they only have two options, which means they’re the best at it. It was sooo good, I had to order another 3 for my flight home. I wish they had a spot in every country. Unfortunately I don’t have photos of the actual meal, because I was busy eating them 1000/10

author: Adrian Y
review_text: Food was good. Bathrooms not available for me to wash my greasy hands before closing time. Also, they started cleaning the floor when we're still eating our food and the smell was filled with chlorine. I also have my infant with me so that's not cool.

author: Ian Hartley
review_text: Maybe not the fastest. But probably the best The atmosphere is beyond 5 stars. Definitely worth trying out if you are in the downtown area The food here is amazing as well. Great breakfast stop

author: Robert Czarneski
review_text: Excellent establishment... If you want a great meal before a event on Newark, you must check this place out !!!

author: ingrid robles
review_text: the hostess in the front was so kind!! she greeted us with the warmest smile and made incredible conversation. vivana was the cutest server ever, created a great atmosphere. I had the 3 amigos smash burger and it was genuinely delicious. i had an issue with my drink and she immediately took it off our bill and got me a new drink. she was genuinely so sweet and had a ton of recommendations it seemed like she was very familiar with the menu and definitely contributed to my experience, very attentive and kind. lots of seating available and the view from any table in the restaurant is beautiful.

author: Sharon Goh
review_text: Just tasted the best authentic food during our holiday stay here. The tom yam is superb & traditional. It is a small eatery shop, nothing fancy but really rustic. But one needs to catch the opening hours. We tried 3 times & finally, the 4th time, we managed to savour these good dishes. If you missed it by 5min, you will not be able to enter. The boss is a friendly, humble man & he could speak English. Thank you for keeping up the good local food with standard! 🥰😁😆😉😋 We will return! 🤣😂😊😉

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Zachary Weisenthal
review_text: I would give The Hive 6 stars if I could. It’s such a cute, clean spot right on the water. The entire menu is delicious and has truly nourishing options with healthy ingredients. The portions are good sizes. This is my teams’ go-to healthy spot for breakfast, lunch, and dinner whenever we are in the area! Staff is friendly!

author: Frank Wan
review_text: The is a well known chicken rice cafe in Ipoh. The cafe has no air conditioning and most of the tables are placed on the street (actually at the side of the road). So, if you are looking for a nice place to dine, this cafe may not suit you. Because of its name, it is quite busy even on weekdays. The dinner session starts at 6:00 pm and close when the foods are sold out. The staff are extremely efficient. Foods are normally sold out at 7:30 to 8:00 pm. Please be there at 6:00 pm if you want to try most of their signature dishes. The foods are not bad but I found it a bit salty. I also that the chickens are not free range chickens and hence the “taste of chicken” is rather light! The bean sprouts are good though!

author: Melissa LovesIceCream
review_text: Well ventilated place, clean toilets and delicious local Thai food especially prawns with glass noodles and scallops with a tinge of minced pork - Awesome and worth returning!

author: Stephanie Brookes
review_text: Best ever Babi (also chicken avail) experience . The vibe is great and it’s totally 100% excellent service . Highly recommend . Delicious Babi - you can see the kitchen operation right there. Beautiful at sunset . Around 50 k for dinner. Total bargain.

author: Zhi Chiaw Lim
review_text: SCAMMER ALERT! Told me the BKT was $7 when I ordered, then collected $10 from me when served.

author: David M
review_text: Very nice and hearty burger. The price for burger was 100,000 IDR and was melty and well worth it. The staff was professional and the setting appeared very clean as customers can see the cooking area. Highly recommended!

author: Zen Yong
review_text: If you’re visiting Hatyai, Chokdee Dim Sum is definitely one of those breakfast spots that locals and tourists alike recommend, so I decided to give it a try. It was a good experience overall, and I can see why it’s so popular. The staff here are friendly and attentive, even though the place was quite busy during breakfast hours. Service was quick, and they patiently guided me through the dim sum selection process, which is a nice touch if it’s your first time there. There are two dining areas – the main store and a newer, more spacious dining area just opposite. I chose to sit in the main store, as it is closer to the dim sum counter and has a more authentic, bustling atmosphere. The main store feels a bit more “classic,” while the newer section seems to cater to larger groups and tourists. The price is reasonable and in line with what you would expect for a well-known dim sum place. The portions are small, but they match the price, which makes it easy to order and try a variety of dishes without wasting food. Taste-wise, the dim sum itself was decent – I would say it was just ordinary compared to other places I have tried, but still enjoyable. I also ordered their Bah Kut Teh, which was slightly salty for my liking, though taste can be very subjective and others might find it just right. Overall, Chokdee Dim Sum is a nice breakfast experience if you are in Hatyai. The variety of dishes, reasonable pricing, and lively atmosphere make it worth a visit. Just be sure to go early, as the place can get really crowded during peak hours.

author: Umut O.
review_text: Maui Poke was one of the best poke bowls i’ve ever had in my life. Super fresh fish, really good sauces. The coconut cheesecake was also amazing. Love it.

author: Kelly V
review_text: I went here late at nine really great atmosphere. The first thing I saw was Sapporo beer on draft so I had to get a pint or two! Then went to fried buns and had the chilli oil dumplings with noodles. The noodles were absolutely delicious just the right amount of chewiness. The chilli probably could’ve been a bit spicy. For dessert, brownie cheesecake, also could’ve eaten two slices so good. Overall experience would recommend !

author: Traci Bidwell
review_text: I got a cream puff and tres Leche pie. So yummy. Everything was homemade and fresh.

author: Joseph Marino
review_text: The food here is incredible, especially the patatas — my absolute favorite! The drinks are fantastic, and I really appreciate that they have great choices for those who prefer plant-based options. Eating in made the whole experience even better than takeout. I’d definitely recommend this spot to anyone nearby!

author: T Keane
review_text: Nancy and Mary are sweethearts. Never had a bad meal. I always go there any chance I can get.

author: Regina Gray
review_text: Good food and service. Our waiter was really helpful with describing the food options on the menu. The portions were suitable and the food was good! I was with a group and we shared get a an idea of how the menu items tasted. One notable dish was the Lobster Mac-N-Cheese. Judging the crowd and atmosphere, I think it’s a great place to go out on a date. The restaurant also has a DJ which brings a great vibe to the restaurant.

author: Tan Junyu
review_text: This food centre is known for vegeterian food and quite quiet but when you walk over to 79A food centre, you can spot this long snaking queuing for Yong Lai Fa Ji Shu Shi fish soup. Queue move quite fast. Batang Fish is silky soft, fish skin is removed. Fried fish is tasty, deep fried using batang fish and not the usual dory fish. Broth is clear and light flavour. Chilli with douchi is complement with the fish soup well. Pig organ soup from heng heng was equally good as well. Liver, pig stomach, sliced pork were tender. Broth is slight peppery with some salted veg. 😋😋😋

author: xin
review_text: The deco and ambiance were nice, but it was very noisy inside. The food was average (as ive had better broken rice roadside stalls) and the cleanliness wasn’t great, I even found hair in my food. The staff also need more training, as the service was quite poor. Overall, not the best experience.

author: Aleksandr L.
review_text: Good enough to eat there twice. The oysters were fresh, steak was ordered was blue rare, Mahi Mahi filled was slightly over cooked(i like mine undercooked and forgor to mention that to the server) and the kids had hamburger that was cooked to medium rare. Was satisfied 😌 and service was great.

author: Gourmet Deli
review_text: Al Hadi Satay Really good, meat tender n juicy Smokiness of the meat makes u drool 🤤 80cts a stick where to find in Singapore 🥢🥢🥢even better than the infamous stall in AMK big market.

author: Nikireview
review_text: This is hands down one of the best meals we had during our trip. Our favorite dish was the fried noodles with fried pork. We were so lucky, we arrived at 6:15 PM and only waited around 15 minutes before getting a seat. I will definitely come back to this place and recommend it to friends who are planning to visit Thailand. The location is also very convenient, as it is close to many other famous food spots in the area.

author: Muhammad Asyraf
review_text: One of the worst Pelita.. Roti Canai not well cooked, half boiled eggs, either over or under cooked. Many staffs but none show interest with customers.

author: Renee Lam-Whiteman
review_text: Omgggg if you are looking for delicious seafood and paella. This is the place. When you walk in, it’s like you went back in time, almost like you’re on a movie set. The staff is polite and willing to serve. I highly recommend the garlic giant prawns, the paella and the sangria. It’s in Newark but luckily they have a parking lot. Great food!!

author: Lindsay Harris
review_text: We got an assortment from the menu and some drinks (fish tacos, burgers, and shrimp). Everyone loved their food, and I had the coconut castaway, which I could have drank 10 of since it was so delicious. Very big and fun restaurant, I like that they take photos and give you a free postcard with the option to buy a bigger one. Service was great, and we liked the music they played. Overall, the only complaint is that inside doesn't have air conditioning, but they do have ceiling fans. Lastly, I love the little fins they put in their burgers and the view of the water if you sit outside.🦈 ❤️

author: Michele Redman
review_text: Really great onion rings, wonderful people serving delish food in neighborhood diner.

author: Chetha Thirathinarut
review_text: Enjoy a variety of creative fusion-style som tam dishes (I tried the mangosteen & strawberry version!) along with authentic Northeastern Thai (Isaan) favorites that are packed with bold, spicy flavors. Every dish was absolutely delicious! 😋

author: Shantal Gonzalo
review_text: Visited the first time in a while and picked up my favorite empanadas, the Pabellon ones. Did not disappoint. Venezuelan approved !!

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: Desislava Filipova
review_text: Great streetfood market with good diversity of chinese, indian, indonesian, vietnamese cuisine. More than 50 booths with main courses, desserts, drinks. If you are a streetfood lover, it is a must visit. Prices are very low for Singapore. Great value for money!

author: YouMakeIt I'LL REVIEW IT
review_text: AVOID THIS LOCATION. Service is slow if you order inside. Drive thru is normal speed but beware you will be missing items or you will be given bad quality food. I was given a "whole chicken" unfortunately this chicken was missing both chicken breast and a thigh. And too make matters worse, they serve you plantains that are burned pass the point of no return. I recommend asking for your receipt, they tend to purposefully not give it to you at the window. I guess you can't complain if you don't have proof of purchase. Do yourself a favor and avoid this location.

author: Grace Zhang
review_text: came here on a weekend morning and ordered the mascarpone toast, cold brew, and latte. everything was a little pricey but delicious, and the gallery space and outdoor seating were both lovely as well. was wonderful to stop by after driving down skyline.

author: Eddie Aguilar
review_text: Took 1 hour and half for delivery when I got it ..it was cold. And I got food poison 🤢🤮 I was in bed for like 2 days and had to take 1 day off from work. Safe yourself food poison and go some where else.

author: Happy Belly Chef
review_text: If you’re chasing the ultimate plate of fried kway teow in Singapore, this legendary stall at Hong Lim Market & Food Centre is my top pick. Every visit feels like a reunion with comfort food done right. The “wok hei” here is unmistakable—smoky, intense, and deeply satisfying. And that signature pork lard smile? It’s not just a garnish, it’s a promise. Crispy, golden bits that elevate every bite with rich, indulgent flavor. The uncle behind the wok is a master of his craft. He’s meticulous with every plate—balancing sauces, controlling heat, and portioning ingredients with care. You can see the seriousness in his movements, and taste it in the results. Occasionally, a younger assistant takes over when the uncle’s on break. While the finesse may vary slightly, the taste still holds up well and is worth trying. Be prepared to wait, especially during lunch rush. But honestly? The queue is part of the experience. It builds the anticipation—and the reward is always worth it. This stall consistently satisfies my cravings. It’s a stall that respects tradition, delivers bold flavors, and never compromises on quality. Whether you’re a local or just visiting, this is one plate you shouldn’t miss.

author: Cody Flowers (Cody Flowers)
review_text: Stopped by here on a whim. Fun, smaller hole in a wall type atmosphere. Food was great and fair prices. The Saturday night prime rib special was better than a high dollar steak house we ate at while here. Will definitely come back when in Vegas next.

author: Blue Zulu
review_text: One of most iconic venue in Seminyak, maybe in all Bali…Different stages and parts, many bars and lovely corners to spend time. We had light dinner and after continued party. Party place quiet small but you not need to stuck there to hear music and enjoy dancing. Location is in the heart of Seminyak and very easy to reach. Give a chance a night for this fun. Enjoy.

author: Hatsune Miku
review_text: Hot, stuffy, expensive and long queues is what best describes Hong Lim Food Centre. Most of the stalls here serve average and above fare, so this place is a relatively safe bet. If not for the fact that this place is stuffy and packed, I would have given it 5 stars. Several famous stalls can be found in Hong Lim, the most notable being the fried kway teow, wanton noodles and curry noodles. This food centre has 2 storeys, so please dont forget to visit the second level. This food centre has both quality and quantity, but is in serious need of better ventilation. Based in Chinatown, you can also expect to pay a little more for your food. Overall a pretty good food centre if not for the poor ventilation.

author: Miami Judge
review_text: If you only have one night to dine in Miami, this is the spot! Chefs Lomas and Cabrera put their hearts into every dish, and the team makes you feel like family. Great wine selection and top-tier music. ¡Gracias!

author: Ko Sing Chin
review_text: The cozy, warm atmosphere and vintage decor made for a truly authentic and peaceful dining experience. Suitable for anyone looking for a relaxed, traditional Vietnamese vibe. Highly recommend to try the braised snakehead fish dish. The fish was tender and flaky, absorbing the rich flavors of the sauce completely. The pork belly pieces added a nice textural contrast and richness to the dish.

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: 茉莉Jasmine
review_text: Get a try because of the Michelin rated. Personally feel the char koay teow is overrated.... The taste is so so and didn't meet my normal char koay teow expectation. Maybe for others the taste is suit them but not for me....

author: Mel JH Tan
review_text: Man this is a great place. Firstly, the crab with fried egg; chunks of fresh crunchy garlic really added to the kick, with the Basil, fish sauce and chili padi really brining the dish together. Sunny side fired egg adds a creamy depth to the bite. Second, the pad thai was sweet and chewy with good wok hey. Good amount of chunky peanuts. River prawn was seasoned with lesser salt than usual, which paired perfectly with the sweet and salty pad thai.

author: Dr. Egheosa Igbinoba
review_text: The food was delicious. The DJ was spinning throwback R&B. Great atmosphere. We had to wait for about 15 mins since we didn't have a reservation but that wasn't bad at all. There were outdoor seats so we didn't have to stand while waiting.

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Anie Koltsova
review_text: Everything we tried here was delicious! Excellent hospitable service. Friendly atmosphere. Ate here almost every day during our vacation, occasionally twice a day haha. That’s how tasty it is. Cards, qr code, cash payments — all options are available.

author: Joyful Explorer
review_text: Comfort food. Chose some of our favourite to share. Always busy during lunch crowd on weekdays and hard to find a table. No wait for us on a weekend brunch.

author: Alejandra Cervantez
review_text: Wings were awesome! I had the hot buffalo and the lemon pepper also had hot buffalo sauce which was super delicious. The pizza tasted really fresh the crust was superb. I would highly recommend this place for really amazing wings. But be prepared, the wings are on the pricey side. We got 3 drinks, a pizza, and a 24 count of wings, and the total was close to $79. But the wings were worth it.

author: Rosemary Rodriguez
review_text: My boyfriend and I stopped by CVI.CHE while visiting Miami and it was absolutely amazing. The food was incredible, the ambiance and music were perfect, and the service was top-notch. A special thank you to our waitress Dora — she was wonderful and made the experience even better. We couldn’t be happier and will definitely be back!

author: Michael Wedd
review_text: One of the great NY slices. Get in line with 20+ minutes to spare at peak times. Get the burrata, NY slice, sausage and pesto, or anything else. Order to eat in (standing) for the real experience. The crust is crispy, the mid crust gooey, and the toppings like burrata being deluxe without over the top add ons. The service is friendly and smiley despite the chaos. Legit!

author: Arno Harutyunyan
review_text: This Place Is A Very Good Place To Eat.The Food Is Good.The Service Is Good.And The Workers Are Very Nice.Keep Up The Great Work!

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: Apple Mae Dionaldo
review_text: I recently had the pleasure of dining at 71 Mookata, and it was an experience I won’t forget. The restaurant specializes in mookata, a Thai-style BBQ where you grill your own meat and vegetables on a hot plate, creating a fun and interactive dining experience. The food grill set offered a wide variety of options, from juicy cuts of beef and pork to fresh seafood and a selection of vegetables. Everything was well-marinated, which really enhanced the flavors as it cooked. I especially enjoyed the dipping sauces that complemented the grilled items perfectly. The location of 71 Mookata is very convenient, situated in a vibrant area with plenty of parking nearby. The atmosphere inside was casual and inviting, with a warm, cozy vibe that made it a great spot for both casual meals and gatherings with friends or family. One of the standout aspects of my visit was the staff. They were incredibly friendly and attentive, always ready to assist with any questions we had and ensuring our grill was at the right temperature throughout the meal. Their service was both efficient and personable, which added to the overall enjoyment of the experience. The food, location, and service all combined to make my visit to 71 Mookata a memorable one. Whether you're new to mookata or a seasoned fan, I highly recommend giving this place a try – it’s the perfect spot for a delicious, interactive meal with great company.

author: Audrey Bennett (She’s a Little Local)
review_text: Small but well designed restaurant with a nice ambience. The service was wonderful - we really enjoyed all the staff. The boquerones with the tomate were delicious, we ordered it with a side of their toasted bread which was the perfect crispy exterior & soft fluffy interior. The steak tartare was fantastic - had ours topped with a soft fried egg to add that luscious yolk. Paella for main course - was a special with rabbit & escargot. Finished with the creme Catalan - delicious.

author: Jenelle Leane Velsa
review_text: A long drive thru with a bunch of restaurants to choose from. Such a cool concept and service was fast and orderly! HIGHLYYY recommend the chicken karaage bowl from Shin Sen Gumi Express

author: Cristina Da Costa
review_text: Impressive doesn't even begin to describe this hidden gem. I've heard of it so I wanted to try it and from the outside you'd want to turn away but once you go in and go into the restaurant you're transported somewhere else. Amazing wines and sangria and we had 2 different paellas and they were amazing! We'll be back!

author: Ar Monsanto
review_text: The food is extremely delicious and not overpriced. The space is cozy and perfect for a date night or hanging out with friends. There’s a variety of ways you can experience oxtails. Say yes to the shrimp and grits!

author: Adinda Ellena
review_text: Always coming back whenever I’m craving pastries because this café is truly the place to go. The almond croissant is perfectly sized for the price and tastes amazing, and their coffee is also really good. All the staff are helpful and friendly, even their HR Manager (if I’m not mistaken) kindly helped pass my order to the team.

author: Gabriela Contreras
review_text: I spent $18 with a soda included. The portion served is very generous which is always an extra ⭐ since it was my first time, I had to ask for my options, the person who was serving took the time to explained me and everything was nice and easy.

author: Livelovetravel
review_text: 🌴 La Brisa Beach Club – Bali Vibes! 🌅 We visited this beach club last week — 2 adults and 2 kids — and honestly, our first impression was just wow! The place is absolutely beautiful, with amazing lights, cozy vibes, and great music. When we arrived, we were offered a table with a minimum spending requirement (starting from around 1,800,000 IDR+), but we decided to sit at a free table by the pool downstairs since we knew we wouldn’t spend that much. The drinks were tasty (though, as expected, prices are a bit higher — it’s a beach club after all). We didn’t order food as the menu wasn’t really our style — not very Balinese — but the atmosphere totally made up for it. Great vibe, nice tunes, and perfect spot to chill by the sea and watch surfers. Such a cool, Instagram-worthy place — highly recommend stopping by if you’re in Canggu! 🌊✨

author: Chloe Lim
review_text: Zi Yu the server is providing very good service and attention to details. Fast response in refilling the side dishes and friendly. Really like her enthusiasm and will definitely come back for the kimchi. Kimchi is really good!

author: Joshua Gonzalez
review_text: I'd like to give 5 stars based on food and service, but the fact that there are no restrooms for customers is unacceptable. When it comes to the food, I had the club sandwich and fries. The fries were fresh and lightly seasoned perfectly. The club sandwich was also amazing, with fresh lettuce, tomatoes, buttery, and saft but crisp bread. Somehow, they pulled it off. My only complaint is that the amount of meat could have an extra portion. I 100% recommend this place but insist that restrooms should be available for paying customers. Also FYI $1.50 credit or debut charge on all orders.

author: d7usah
review_text: The burgers here are seriously delicious. I liked it so much that I came two days in a row. The ‘MC LOVIN’ burger was amazing. The truffle fries were also incredible, with that mushroom and cheese kick that makes them so addictive. If you love burgers, coming to Bali and not visiting this place feels like missing out on something big.

author: Sharayna Christmas
review_text: I visited Blueprint Café for the first time today for brunch and unfortunately had a very disappointing experience. I ordered the chicken and waffles, but the chicken was undercooked and the waffle looked nothing like what was shown on their website—it was thick, tough, and difficult to chew. When I shared these concerns with the staff, they didn’t offer to remake the dish or even ask how I wanted to proceed. Instead, they simply took the same plate and put it in the oven to re-cook it, despite it being a fried chicken dish that should be prepared fresh. I was honestly shocked by this approach. There was no apology, no offer of a replacement, and not even a gesture like offering a drink while I waited. In the end, we left the food as it was, paid for the meal, and walked out. Given the undercooked chicken and the lack of basic customer service, I would not return to this establishment.

author: Natchapon Nomnunthasab
review_text: This might seem like a strange comment, but I really like the macaroni at the Suki crab fried rice restaurant. It's like my mom's homemade macaroni with lots of ketchup. If anyone recommends the macaroni and suki menu to me, it's delicious. I don't really like the crab fried rice, but I'm more indifferent.

author: Timothy HL
review_text: I've been to Venezuela, and this is the best Venezuelan food I've had outside the country. The cachapas but everything is good here. It's natural, always freshly made, and of excellent quality. Highly recommend.

author: Christa Dunn
review_text: We enjoyed our food- enormous serving sizes and very reasonable prices!

author: F@ye yuen
review_text: Overall the food are delicious and really pretty . The photos came out really pretty so if you’re looking for a place to take pictures of the food I recommend here. The pancakes are kinda blend but maybe because its a strawberry jam instead of fresh ones.

author: Becky Gonzalez
review_text: One of the best Mexican sushi i ever had will definitely refer and Employees very polite

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Eddy Lin
review_text: Good food with cute puppy. Lady boss was very nice, speaks English well, and honest. I almost paid 10 times the amount with cash and she corrected me. Price was very reasonable too.

author: Angel Lee
review_text: An excellent omakase experience. The sashimi was exceptionally fresh, showcasing the chef’s refined knife skills and deep understanding of ingredients. Each course was thoughtfully prepared and beautifully presented. The ambiance was calm, elegant, and comfortable, making the entire dining experience truly enjoyable. Highly recommended for anyone who appreciates authentic Japanese omakase.

author: Ann Koppuzha
review_text: One of my favorite hidden gem cafes. Love the space. The drinks are great. I also loved the pastries. The avocado toast and ham sandwich are a little overpriced but tasty.

author: April S
review_text: You can’t come to Ubud and not visit their notorious Ibu Oka chain! I had their roast pork special that came with extra crackling, rice and a vegetable broth soup on the side. This place is very clean!

author: Apex Imagery
review_text: Crazy Good Kitchen lives up to its name! Their bacon double cheeseburgers are packed with flavor, the Parmesan truffle fries are absolutely incredible, and their milkshakes are the perfect sweet treat to top it all off. Highly recommend for an unforgettable meal!

author: Nael Din
review_text: Food was so good it's almost illegal. The change was placed in a duck basket which was a cute little touch. Overall experience puts you in a great mood the whole day.

author: Chia Hau Lee
review_text: Visited the iconic Restaurant Tauge Ayam Lou Wong — a place I felt I had to experience at least once, even though its rating has dropped to 3.6 stars from over 6.5k reviews. It’s clearly a tourist spot, but also a good benchmark to taste the “standard” version of Ipoh tauge ayam, knowing many reviews say there are better options elsewhere. I found the prices reasonable: a 2-person portion of chicken was RM25, tauge for 2 was RM7, and the 5-meatball soup was RM5. Service was fast, and they accept e-payment, which is convenient. Taste-wise, nothing particularly special for us, especially since we’ve had better chicken rice back in Singapore. But as mentioned, it’s worth coming once just to experience this iconic spot and see what the hype is about.

author: bo seo
review_text: Today, my mother and I were strolling around Siam Paragon and wanted to find something to eat. We wanted Thai food, and we thought of Nara Thai Cuisine cuz it's a really good Thai restaurant. The staff were welcoming, polite, and very courteous to us, their customers. The interior and dining tables were excellent, making for a comfortable meal without feeling like the meal was over. However, the food might take a little while to prepare. But that's okay, because the food came out one dish at a time, so I could eat continuously without getting too full. The food has a rich, authentic Thai flavor, but not overly spicy. The seasoning is balanced, making it suitable for both Thais and foreigners. And of course, if I crave delicious Thai food again, my family and I will definitely think of Nara Thai Cuisine.

author: Mela M
review_text: I never mind a long line when it comes to waiting for food here because my food is usually hot. But that did not apply at this location. This was my first time here and definitely my last. I waited in the drive thru for 28 minutes and when got my order and bit into my burger it was absolutely cold!! I did not wait until I was home to eat. I started digging into my food immediately upon pulling out of the parking lot. This was super disappointing!! My pictures clearly show the melted cheese was nearly solid because the burger was now cooled. There is no reason for that. If the shopping center here wasn’t so chaotic I would have drove back, went inside, and asked for a refund. Eat at different location if you’re expecting hot food.

author: JR FF
review_text: Spacious hawker center, somewhat built for tourists. More airflow than the typical hawker center, and therefore provides a more comfortable experience. Really enjoyed the blurb about the hill (mount erskine) that used to be in the area, and how it was used to reclaim what now comprises the Central Business District. Showing Singaporeans the mighty works of our forefathers, and how we stand in an unbroken line of admirable people with significant and consequential deeds. Home to a host of well known names, including the famous visit by the beloved Anthony Bourdian to Tian Tian Chicken Rice.

author: Asli Akal
review_text: Really fresh food! Holbox has been on my list for a long time, and for seafood, I think it's very reasonably priced. It's located in Mercado la Paloma and has free parking. We arrived around 6:30 p.m. on a Saturday, and the line was about 20 minutes long. The mercado was pretty busy, so it was slightly hard to find a good place to sit. However, the service was very fast. The ambiance is casual and lively. We got ceviche mixto, smoked kanpachi tostada, Baja fish taco, taco de pulpo en su tinta, and churros! The ceviche mixto is a must, it was incredibly fresh! I would skip the smoked kanpachi tostada and taco de pulpo on my next visit; I thought they were just okay. The Baja fish taco was amazing, definitely try it! The star of the night was definitely the churros! They were crunchy on the outside and moist on the inside, and the chocolate sauce was delicious. Overall, it totally deserves the hype.

author: Sandra Elizondo
review_text: We are in town visiting from Texas staying at the Aria and my husband found this place on Tik Tok and I must say we will be back 10/10 Carolina was Great and answered all our questions we had about menu. Everything was delicious.

author: Julie Spathos
review_text: Went for a quick bite but ended up trying more off menu and I didn’t regret it!! What a great restaurant If you’re in this part of town and you gotta try their chicken and salsa and onion rings! Loved everything we tried but those were my favs. They also have orange bang which is a blast from my past! Can’t wait to stop by this gem of a place again soon! Gotta mention their staff also all so fast and friendly! Go try this place out if you’re around.

author: Terrence Reed
review_text: A very hectic, yet efficient experience. You walk in, get in line if it’s busy. You can order by the slice or order a whole pie. The restaurant itself, I hate to say, is disgusting. I don’t think 2 full time housekeepers could keep the place clean, sit to the sheer volume of people coming in and out. It was very packed at 8pm on a Monday night. The pizza was the best part of the experience. You get a wide variety of slices to choose from so that you can get a mix instead of committing to one whole pizza like a traditional restaurant. The pizza gets a 6/10 in my opinion. Many spirits to choose from top of course. Worth checking the box.

author: Shouvik Maazumder
review_text: I opted for a catering from this place for a small gathering at my place yesterday and I couldn't be happier with the experience! The lady who assisted me was incredibly sweet and accommodating, making the entire process seamless. The food, both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options, was absolutely delicious and a huge hit with all of my guests. Everyone loved the authentic Nepali cuisine, with the flavors being truly outstanding. I highly recommend Namaste Momo Cottage for anyone looking to enjoy great food with excellent service. Lastly, chicken chilli momos is highly recommended.

author: Jorge Narvaez
review_text: Bob may be gone, but his legacy is alive and delicious. Bob’s East Side Deli is still boomin’—same classic sandwiches, same flavor-packed punch. You can taste the pride in every bite. It’s clear the team kept his standards alive: generous portions, fresh ingredients, and no messing around when it comes to quality. RIP to the legend, but his name still stands strong—one bite at a time. If you haven’t been, you’re missing out.

author: Dena Scoullos
review_text: Delicious tapas. Many gluten free options. The tapas are great to share and taste all different flavors. For two people we ordered 6 small tapas and it was perfect. Great drinks too!

author: Josh Smith
review_text: This place was outstanding! Best Babi Guling we tried and very authentic setting. We were the only westerners eating there in the morning all though I know alot of tourists go also. Great service and even better food! Highly recommend trying whilst in Bali. Go early not long after they open and enjoy the suckling pig with the kind hearted locals 🙏❤️🙌🐖🐖🐖

author: Cha Gomez
review_text: Kai (Staff) kindly granted my request for a smaller portion of Bep Cuon! The original platter for was supposed to be for sharing but I dined solo here, they modified the order and gave me 2pcs of each. Just right for me finish 🇻🇳❤️ and I did finish everything! They very much deserve the michelin recognition.

author: Yulia Christina
review_text: Very cheap hotel with strategis location , room clean & nice place...the breakfast delicious & service also very good. Recommend this hotel & will come back to this hotel if come to Bali 😍

author: pianized
review_text: Here is the original outlet where it started. Building used to be tin roofed and it has since been transformed into a modern shop house. Place was clean and service was fast. We visited late at around 5pm and they had only lean pork meat left. Taste was okay and unremarkable, my experience was similar to 12 yrs ago when I tried this - never a fan and not worth the exorbitant price. There is cubed vegetable soup and sambal (which is really stir fry green chillies) is spicy for a strong chilli eater.

author: Pelaiah Auset
review_text: This is my favorite (go-to) Indian food restaurant in Boston! I have a very delicate palate & prefer authentic & real food- and the food gives authentic Indian! I love that they have fish options , mainly why we chose this this spot -I had the Fish(haddock) Masala, my partner had the Fish( haddock) mango, both were equally delicious 😋. In a world of fast & fake food, this spot is👌🏽! The food is delicious, the service was lovely, the atmosphere is positive and there's on street parking ! I highly recommend - esp for vegan /vegetarians 🤍

author: Kimberly
review_text: The service overall was amazing. Evando made sure we were good the whole time we were a party of 12 and he was patient, efficient and very professional. Made sure we were taken care of immediately we highly recommend him. The food was 100/10 enjoyed everything overall!!

author: K.H.
review_text: Visited at night, ayam goreng bawang sold out. Fried chicken is also nice. Kuah campur with rice is delicious.

author: Марта Пляцок
review_text: at first glance a nice clean new facility. but it was a deep disappointment. the food is not tasty, very salty. the pizza was not pizza but pita bread and cheese and leftover chicken. the chicken was heavily seasoned with vinegar and salt. everything was terrible, except for the cashier who served me. it was my first and last visit. all the food had to be thrown into the trash. the food does not match the photos on the poster. as terrible as possible, and not cheap. the food stinks of fat and vinegar. I spent $56 on it and threw it in the trash. Thank you.

author: Kaman Kwok
review_text: A variety of pandan, coconut and rice cake. 8 pieces for 50 baht. They are all very sweet and not particularly special. The rave reviews seem to be overrated. If you are in the neighborhood it’s worth a try. However really not worth a special visit.

author: Thinh Nguyen Thi
review_text: Our fav place for thai food in bangkok , even their vegetarian options were wonderful. We had crab meat omlette, stired fried morning glory, vegetarian curry and more

author: Hana Karina Arraya
review_text: Nestled in the back of a gas station is a restaurant with an extensive wine selection and your classic Spanish tapas. Honestly, your Spanish friends might not be impressed by the food, but anyone else will be satisfied and entertained by the unique location of this local hidden gem. The bacon wrapped dates and gambas al ajillo are my favorite!

author: ARYAN SINGH PUNDIR
review_text: WORST Chole Bhature experience of my life! No flavor, no effort, no quantity — just a sad excuse for a dish. If this is their idea of North Indian cuisine, it’s an insult to street vendors who actually know how to cook. Avoid this place like the plague unless you’re into culinary disappointment. 👎🤮

author: Anthony I
review_text: Good duck and chicken soup n noodles nice flavour with ginger and other spices,love the green noodles

author: Tammy Tan
review_text: Cafeteria style dining. Bright, clean spacious. Drinks & dessert is places in a fridge where customer can grab what they want. Some food in small portion some big. 2 of us ordered 4 dishes plus a botel of mineral water & 1 dessert cost 400+ thai baht. Food taste good 👍 Most of the staff speaks Chinese. Go there before peak hours then you don't need to queue. Went there again, this time ordered Fried Squid & Braised Pork. Both ok but I prefer Braised pork more

author: Stephany Rivas
review_text: Great food, loved my salad, lobster bisque and my drink. 10 out of 10, Coachhouse has gotten an upgrade and I’m here for it

author: Eric Beckley
review_text: Excellent food and prices fair for the quality. The seafood pilaf was AMAZING!

author: Aliee Delvalle
review_text: I got the chicken wings, they were good saucy but tasted dry. I forgot the name of the burger but it looked as amazing as it tasted! First food place we tried in Newark NJ! The service was spectacular and that’s what would bring us back.

author: Jessica Teoh
review_text: Their coffees’ prices are on the higher end, but justified by the “kao-ness” of the coffees. Their toasts are paired well with coffee. Overall, a decent place to get light breakfast or afternoon tea. If you plan to come, it’s better to come by bike. Parking is very very VERY limited.

author: E M
review_text: The service was amazing, the ladies in there were so nice and welcoming! This place is really clean at a nice location 👌 . I enjoyed my experience .

author: Meditate Zen
review_text: High Tide Resto & Bar For a weekend outing, I decided to visit a bar by the sea to enjoy the breeze and catch up with my friend over some heart-to-heart talk. We chose this spot as our meeting point and ordered a variety of dishes: Margherita Pizza, Aglio Olio, 12 sticks of chicken satay, Lychee Melon, and a Singapore Sling. The food was satisfying, but the highlight was definitely the satay—big, juicy, and perfectly paired with the sauce. The staff were friendly and attentive, adding to the positive experience. Time slipped by quickly as we chatted, enjoyed the view, and watched the evening sky turn dark without even realizing it. I’d definitely recommend this place for a chill night out, whether with your bestie or a loved one. My ratings: Food Quality: ⭐ 4.5/5 Food Portion: ⭐ 3.5/5 Environment: ⭐ 5/5

author: John lcf
review_text: Very disappointed with both the food and service. The food portions were shockingly small, especially considering the high prices. The owner seemed more interested in simply calculating the bill rather than providing an honest and pleasant dining experience. Overall, I will not recommend "Ama dim sum" There are many other restaurants in hatyai that offer better food, fairer prices, and more honest service... Sorry for given the poor fedback, but this is really my honest experience..

author: Daniel Sgroi
review_text: La Brisa Bali, is remarkable venue that has quickly become a favorite destination. As soon as you enter, the ambiance captivates you with rustic decor, including canoes adorning the walls, hanging lights, and numerous ocean-themed elements. The lush atmosphere is complemented by two expansive pools and swaying coconut trees, making it a picturesque spot to unwind. During my visit, I had the pleasure of enjoying the slow-cooked lamb shoulder, which was absolutely delicious. The lively energy of the place attracts a diverse crowd of young people from around the world who gather to relax and watch the sunset. I highly encourage making a reservation in advance, as the popularity of La Brisa Bali often results in long waiting times based on seating preference.

author: Victoria D
review_text: I had 4 plates. Great value ! The food is fresh and the variety . I had two servings of Bourbon Chicken it was so flavorful and cooked to perfection. , fresh roasted ham,all vegetables I don't get at home.

author: Serina Cardona
review_text: This place is 10 out of 10!!! Hands down the best in VEGAS! Cause if you aren’t from here… most of you know it’s hard to find real food! Love eating here & I’m always bragging to my friends and family to come here every time they visit Las Vegas!!

author: James Prince
review_text: The best Banh Mi in town! Only two selections and everything’s is made in advance so no wait! The bun is soft and crispy. The filling is so moorish and delicious - and they slather a good chunk of ghee in the centre to bind it all together. We ate right there in front of the kitchen in the rain amongst all the traffic chaos - great experience. Most seem to order on grab because of the location on a busy road.

author: Doug Hall
review_text: We strolled the markets and decided to give this place a try. Three of us got the cheeseburger deal and we all thought the burgers were excellent. Best burger I have had in a long time. The draft Landshark was great also. Service was just meh - had to track down our check to pay and leave.

author: Richard
review_text: Great breakfast restaurant with fast and corteous service! Camila was very nice! Definitely a recommendation!

author: Mo Da Prophet
review_text: First time trying Ethiopian food? Go here! Food: Authentic and delicious food. Feast for 2 was perfect amount for 2 people. Each dish had its own distinct flavor and you can explore different flavor combos. Food came super fast as well. Service: Staff is friendly. They more less leave you alone. Perfect, if you’re looking to eat alone and not be bothered.

author: Risk
review_text: Went for dinner and everything was great, the food was fresh and delicious. We ordered the poke bowl, cheeseburger 🍔, and sticky date pudding. We were starving, so no photos… except for the dessert duhh 😄 Dicky was super helpful and friendly, and the whole team was warm and welcoming 🫶 As always, we love Milk & Madu, and having this new branch just a short walk away (no more trips to Canggu!) makes it even better.

author: Irina M
review_text: Extremely cozy place with trees and lots of greenery around! 😻 My husband and I liked the second floor, it’s just the best place. Nice and friendly staff. Great coffee and pastries.

author: Jim Haynie
review_text: Cold day today on New Years Eve! The wind was blowing through the windows!! Someone needs to send them a case or two of caulking to caulk inside and out. Freezing near any windows.

author: Jasmin Ahmed
review_text: The dough was perfect. It was airy and non-greasy. The toppings were great and we loved the selection! Best pizza of NYC, I ordered 3 different slices (Cheese pizza, Margharita pizza & Pepperoni pizza), couldn’t decide which one was better. The pizza tasted fresh and most importantly, the kids were happy. Great combination.

author: anais siba
review_text: The place is beautiful and quiet. A lots of space so you don’t feel to much pressure. Also the view on the river is lovely. The waitresses are professional and nice. The food was tasty and well proportioned 🫶🏼

author: Kee Kelven
review_text: This was one of the most popular food court in Bukit Mertajam as they had one of the best Yam Rice and Jawa Mee in the town. The yam rice was yummy as it had a big chunk of yam and dried shrimp in it. And the pork intestines soup was really as the meat and intestines were clean and fresh. The sticky soup of Jawa Mee was really good and tasty. But the foods were mostly higher in price in general compared to other food court in the town. Especially the cheapest beverage is RM2 and required us to order and pick up ourselves. I guess it was why the food court was not as crowded as it was back in a few years ago. The food was still good but the place was packed with too many tables and food was higher in price.

author: Adrian Yong
review_text: Food Court offering a large variety of Singaporean local favourites. All self service. Parking can be a challenge in the evening.

author: M M
review_text: One of the best pizza in NYC!!!! Dough are freshly made. Doughnuts are also made in house. You can see they mix the dough and the dough that are proving to rise. Pizza itself was really aromatic. Crust was perfect. Highly recommended

author: carolina Bolanos
review_text: Every time I go to the beach, I have to come eat at this delicious Tiki Tiki restaurant, as I love all the food!!! It feels super fresh, the atmosphere and the service are spectacular, in addition to the beautiful view, if you are near Hollywood or Davie you cannot miss this spectacular restaurant, my husband loves the oysters and I of course the shrimp! Dishes that I highly recommend in addition to their wonderful cocktails, I also have to highlight the espresso Martini, you have to try it.

author: Miley Cyrus
review_text: It wasn’t very easy for me to find the entrance, I at first thought I’m at a wrong place, but look at the entrance in my pictures if u got confused like me😹 I paid 175.000vnd for this omelette 🍳 prices are about 45-100 for the drinks and 130-200 for the food. it’s a bit expensive for me but it was delicious and cooked very fast. I recommend this place to visit 👍🏻 u can bring ur computer and work here but today around 6pm it was a bit crowdy. It’s not quiet but also not noisy.

author: Yeen Yeen
review_text: Went to Ban Khun Bhu for lunch, it was raining heavily during lunch hour, but luckily there was no crowd and no need to queue. The restaurant owner was very friendly and even recommended some must-try dishes. We ordered tomyum soup with pork, grilled chicken, grilled pork neck, sweet and sour glass noodle with seafood, fried rice, and more. We absolutely loved the tomyum soup with pork! We chose spicy level 7 & just nice! Definitely worth a visit. 🌶️🍲

author: Carlos Curramba
review_text: Classy set up in the dining room. The host was courteous. The staff wasn't as attentive or friendly. Had to be on top to request service. Multiple servers serviced with different styles philosophies of serving. As appetizers ordered a manchego cheese platter which was creamy, and portuguese chorizo (sausage) which had a grilled taste to it rather than sautéed in garlic, delicious accompanied with bread which i removed the dough from the middle and ate the crust. Had a Napa bottle of wine soft to the palate, and no after taste. As the main course i tried the seafood paella which was a bit dried, and T-bone steak accompanied with boiled potatoes, rice, and vegetables. The steak was tender easy to cut into with a succulent taste to it. I'll order the steak again. I am not sure that I'd come back soon based on the staff customer service. Rating of 3.9.

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: Jayon See
