review_text: One of the better Lei Cha in Singapore. Ingredients are all fresh and fragrant, the soup is aromatic and less salty, definitely on the healthier side. Fried Pork in Fermented Tofu is a must try too, it is crispy and flavourful. Price wise it is quite cheap in my opinion, and the portion given is almost huge. The place is also clean and tidy, feels comfortable to dine in the shop.

author: Siew Ching Tan
review_text: Came here during the Oktoberfest and was blessed with such a good atmosphere!! There were discounted alcohol, nice music, and even games! The lady boss and daughter were such great hosts to the restaurant, that it made us felt so comfortable dining here! We love the place so much, and were so pleased to chance upon this rare restaurant! Really a good place to recommend for groups! The food were also flavourful and unique! Special mention to their fish tikka and corn fritters!!

author: Celeste Zanabria
review_text: Good joint just off of miracle mile, if you walk down where the boat is and past the Brazilian steakhouse. We ordered a few plates: chicken quesadilla, wings, rice and beans, 2 carnitas tacos, chicken nachos and chips and salsa. I loved the tacos, great amount of meat for the price (2 for $7). Nachos were also good. I asked for only the avocado, chicken, cheese, and pickled onions. The chicken quesadilla and wings were for my bf. He liked the seasoning on the wings and the chicken quesadilla was as should be. It wasn't until dinner time, at another place, I realized that my beans and rice was never brought out :( we were charged for it, and now I'll never know if the place was a 10/10 (I base my "Mexican food" review off of their rice and beans, a staple and must). If staying near, I'd probably be back. The awesome early 2000s punk/pop music is a keeper!!

author: Engkarat Techapanurak
review_text: Super cheap food provided here for staff and public as well. A bit difficult to realize the place. Need to go a bit outside of the airport terminal to get to this place. Google map's location is correct.

author: Santiago Garcia
review_text: This is my go-to spot for spanish seafood dishes. Can’t go wrong with the rice and the charcosl oysters. There is always great wine options.

author: Diana Mendelson
review_text: Food was really good but hot food was served before cold food/salads which is very weird. I wish service was better, our server wasn’t that good - seemed new. Food took some time to come out even though it was relatively empty for Father’s Day… idk probably not coming back unless someone else makes the rezzo.

author: Fred Becker
review_text: Just went in for a quick lunch and super impressed. The steak sandwich was wonderful: tender meat and wonderful blend of flavors. I ordered it medium and it came out perfectly - not easy to do on thin pieces of steak! Well done!!!

author: Jeremy Guzman
review_text: We decided to try this place for breakfast since we were in the area running errands. The food was very good. And despite it being very busy at the time we went, since we sat at the bar the service was really good. The prices where about the same to other common breakfast places. Even though ever since the pandemic breakfast can be around the same price as dinner these days. But that doesn't mean the food wasn't good. I had the Santa Fe skillet made with chorizo... As pictured. My wife had the classic eggs over easy.. Made very well. And yes I will be back and I do recommend. 👍😃

author: Kaixuan Soh
review_text: the food is not fresh especially the meat and the seafood which have a stinky smell. the pork is generally fatty with very little of meat, and doesnt taste good. it doesnt worth a try at all.

author: Abraham Daruich
review_text: Yiri was amazingg! The food was Great and tasty ❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️ Absolutely loved MIAM MIAMI! The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Every bite felt thoughtful and well-balanced. The atmosphere is super chill but stylish, perfect for brunch or a relaxed meal. The staff was friendly and attentive without being overbearing. Definitely one of those places you keep coming back to. Highly recommend!

author: Tom Bosschaert
review_text: The Joi Factory is something else. Yes it's a great place to have a coffee, eat, and meet friends. There's regular events as well, and the atmosphere is unique in saigon. But beyond that, the organization invests in social and environmental causes more than most places. It's also a meeting place for likeminded folks. Can't recommend it enough.

author: Seemantini Bose
review_text: My go-to place in Phuket. Excellent food, absolutely reasonable. Heaven for seafood lovers like me. Their grills are to die for! Try out the grilled prawns, green pepper crabs, grilled white snapper. Strategically located in Patong, you can either choose to walk from patong beach/ bangla road or take a tuktuk that will charge you 200 TBH. It’s adjacent to the hotel ‘Natural Resort’. They have two seating areas, one open and the other one AC. Service is great and the waiting time for food is quite fast. Don’t miss it if you enjoy seafood!

author: Richard Romero
review_text: Bob's Eastside Deli is outstanding! We used their catering service for two events—one in October and again last month—and both experiences were exceptional. The food was incredibly fresh and delicious. What really stood out was their attention to detail: each meal was individually labeled with our attendees’ names, ensuring everything got to the right person. I've never seen that level of organization before. Thank you, Bob's Deli, for helping make our RC Boating events so memorable with your fantastic service and amazing food!

author: Tita CNesa
review_text: I finally revisited Milk & Madu Ubud, and their burger was absolutely amazing. A juicy patty, a perfectly toasted bun, and rich, delicious flavors that hit all the right notes. Paired with an ice-cold Kura Kura Beer, it was the perfect combo for a laid-back afternoon in Ubud. The atmosphere is warm, lively, and carries that cozy Ubud charm that makes you want to stay a little longer.

author: Zak Poole
review_text: Friendly staff and convenient drive thru. Excellent variety of tastes and flavors from different kitchens, all worth a try!

author: Karen C
review_text: I found this restaurant on Google, looking for a place to spend a relaxing time with my family. We love Peruvian food (I have been to Peru), so At Peru caught my attention. Everything was delicious! We tried the jalea, pesto with chicken and steak (both tender), fish ceviche, yuca a la huancaina, lomo saltado, and pisco sour. Hector, our waiter, was the best! He was very patient, friendly, and had a great sense of humor. Definitely coming back.

author: Phaik Sia Lee
review_text: They are not service food by sequence even you are coming earlier and order first. The food still serve for the table came after you.

author: mamacelho mamacelho
review_text: Nice & cozy place to eat. Everything is good, except for the sofa. I have difficulty sitting in a comfortable position on the sofa at table F1. Always makes me slide down while eating. The rest is perfectly nice. There is a sink inside the restaurant and clean.

author: Angel Carta Blanca
review_text: Well to start this off on the right note. I dont think yall wanna eat from here. Some if not all of these meats sit for days on display.

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: Jim J
review_text: A very small eatery, just 10 mins walk from paya lebar mrt. Healthy vegetarian alternative. Very crunchy & with free slow peanuts. You can order fermented pork if you want some meat. I quite like their lei cha but the tea., it may not be to everyone's liking.

author: MC Teh
review_text: This is an old hawker center. There is a lot of hidden gems of good and cheap foods. However not all foods store are open every days.

author: Myly Tran
review_text: The restaurant space is airy, the dishes are diverse, suitable for the taste, especially there are delicious dipping sauces that go well with the dishes.

author: My Faith
review_text: Combo fried rice is a complete winner. Everything is fresh, great customer service and affordable!

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Areej Bishara
review_text: Amazing Vietnamese food! Everything was super delicious and the menu is really diverse, with great vegetarian options too. We wish we had discovered this place from the first day we arrived! We didn’t even have a reservation, and even though the restaurant was completely full upstairs and downstairs, they seated us within seconds. Sky, the girl who served us, was incredibly polite and kind, and the service was unbelievably fast. One of our best experiences in Vietnam! 💛🇻🇳

author: YUUKI SUGIYAMA
review_text: My group of five stumbled upon this delightful Vietnamese restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City, and what a find it was. The decor immediately catches your eye, with its rich, traditional Vietnamese touches that make you feel truly immersed in the local culture. Given that we didn't have any specific recommendations from social media, we decided to be adventurous and simply order whatever caught our eye from the picture menu. To our absolute delight, every single dish was a winner not a single bad choice in the lot! A standout was the grilled pork belly. It was perfectly cooked, with a wonderfully crisp exterior that gave way to tender, juicy meat. Paired with a spicy dipping sauce, it was incredibly moreish and surprisingly light. We also thoroughly enjoyed the grilled pork with rice noodles. I’ve had this dish before in Laos, and the flavours here were just as authentic and delicious a testament to the shared culinary heritage of the region. What makes this place even better is the price. For a group of five, we were able to enjoy a fantastic, satisfying meal without breaking the bank. A brilliant spot for anyone looking for a genuine and affordable taste of Vietnam. Highly recommended!

author: Steven Briggs
review_text: I loved the location and the service was great given how busy it was. They seem very responsive to food allergies which was helpful. The food was good but what kept this from a 5 star experience was that the food was rather flavorless. Even the salt/vinegar cod needed salt and has zero vinegar flavor. It all looked great on the plate but I didn’t feel like I really got what I paid for. Maybe it was an off night but I felt at $200 (plus tip) for 4 people, that I overpaid a bit. I hadn’t been to a legal sea food in maybe 12 years as my travel to the Boston area didn’t happen after moving to a different role at work. I made a point of getting reservations months in advance and looked forward to the night. It wasn’t like I remembered so perhaps that tarnishes the experience some.

author: Brittany Baart
review_text: To say wow would be an understatement for how amazing Sun Sun Warung was. This was our first time trying Indonesian food being Australians, and first time at a Warang, It exceeded all expectations. We were met by someone that greeted us warmly and we waited in line to be seated (It was very popular and loved, hence the line). We then had the wonderful Lily help us pick items off the menu to eat as we had no idea where to start. We end up getting a tasting platter and some other dishes on the side. The food was INCREDIBLE! So full of flavour and fresh. We loved it so much we are going again for the second night in a row. Do yourself a favour and go have a great meal at Sun Sun Warung!

author: David Lagro
review_text: This is the first Chick-fil-A that I have ever walked into, so I can’t give a comparison to other franchise. The line was long when I entered as several people walked in just ahead of me. The staff were fantastic and methodically whittled down the line. The food was ready quickly and I was out the door. My sandwich and fries were fresh and hot, and my shake was cold and creamy. Job done!

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: Suzanne Lim
review_text: By far the best BKT in Penang. Very similar taste to Klang BKT. Very organize even with big crowd. Service is fast, good, responsive and friendly.

author: J
review_text: An absolute delight, honestly feels and runs more like a restaurant more than a airport lounge Private , zen, peaceful Friendly and approachable staff especially hazel , Elsy, Alvin , Jessy Personalised service Food was of restaurant quality and its Ala carte , cook fresh on order not a buffet style. Tempura was a miss because it’s so blend even with the sauce The lamb was cooked beautiful with a good wine parring recommendation No doubt the best business class lounge in Changi. Honestly , I have no idea how they could have further improved, it’s first class lounge standard right here

author: Kirtan Shah
review_text: Had a great meal at The Cheesecake Factory in Boston! The pasta was delicious, mac n cheese balls were super cheesy and crispy, and the s’mores cheesecake was the perfect sweet ending. Big portions and solid comfort food — definitely hits the spot!

author: Han Sin Chia
review_text: The bakuteh is not bad. The meat very tender n tasty. The soup is thick n peppery, the peppe is a little strong, but still OK. Song Fa is better by a bit but double the price. For this price... Unbeatable 😂

author: Matthew Thomas
review_text: Most everything here is ok. One concern is this.. at the drive through window, the metal frame at the window is covered in LAYERS of dust. Looks awful!

author: Shawn Shirley
review_text: Very good full service restaurant right on the harbor. The food was delicious all around. I tasted a lot from the party I was with and cant say I had anything I didnt like. I personally ordered the lobster roll. The roll was perfect with a healthy dose of lobster, yum!

author: Simon Choe
review_text: Came for date night and had the set menu. Overall highly recommend. Loved almost everything we got. Ceviche was perfect! The lamb and thousand layer potato were well cooked but taste-wise felt out of place on the menu, as the flavor profile was much narrower than the other dishes. Perhaps it would have been better to swap for a seafood main and the corn cake.

author: Lily Zhang
review_text: Horrible experience. Everything was bad, especially the service and the food. First, we asked for iced lattes and they gave us all hot lattes. When we pointed this out they dumped the hot lattes into another glass with 3 ice cubes; the lattes were still warm and now, watered down. Our waiter was SUPER un-attentive. It took us forever to order our main dishes. To give the restaurant credit, the food came out fast and looked tasty. However, looks can be deceiving...the food was horrible too. The ocean view was nice, but it was hard to even look at it because the pasta tasted like it had been dunked in the salty ocean water. Our cacio e pepe and ragu tasted so salty we thought the whole salt canister was dumped onto the dishes. Since the waiter was no where to be seen, we only had one measly cup of water that was finished and our whole table was extremely parched. The waiter didn't check up on us once and was sitting at the bar chatting with her co-workers. We had to waive the waiter over to ask about alternative options with the food, she was dismissive and spoke so quietly we could not hear her over the chatter in the restaurant. The best part of this experience was leaving the establishment.... unless you are handicapped then good luck leaving because the exit points down to three flights of stairs.

author: Aleix Donnachie
review_text: Came for dinner and such a shame as staff here are really lovely, I really wanted to enjoy it. We ordered the seafood platter and we received 3 dehydrated prawns, and what seemed like the last bit of fish they had for the day served with old rice. We unfortunately did not enjoy our meal and would not recommend :(

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Tín Nguyễn Phúc
review_text: The restaurant is a bit crowded so it feels a bit stuffy and not very comfortable. The restaurant has a parking lot, so if you want to eat, go into the alley The food here costs from 28k, I ordered a portion of meat and spring rolls for 32k. I got an extra portion of vegetables and noodles for free. Iced tea here is charged at 3k. In general, the food is okay

author: KB
review_text: Very cool spot on the water with a unique ocean vibe and tons of decorative pieces to show it (including tubs and toilets). The burger is large at 13 oz and was delicious, cooked perfectly.

author: Jon D. Visionary
review_text: Goodness gracious this place is bomb! Their chicken is the best charbroiled chicken in LA. Seasoned amazingly, and very juicy. The sauce compliments everything and cuts through the greasiness with the tanginess of the vinegar. Now people talk about the chicken with the fries, but the rice plate is what you should be getting. Very well seasoned rice. It just mixes with the beans so well, and makes me drool just thinking about it again 🤤 Their DUI fries are also bomb! Carne asada with pastramiis a dangerous combination. It would leave any big back with their back blown 🤤 The only fries I can put on par would be the pastrami fries from The Hat, but this might have it beat! The worst thing about this place is how far it is, and the parking. I luckily went on a Monday, and got a spot in the lot, but I’d imagine it would be more difficult on the weekends. Service was quick. Definitely visiting again after going to get my film developed at Gold Photo. Hopefully that will be soon 🤤 Update: Don’t dine in. No restrooms. The staff is pretty rude. I didn’t notice because I took my food to go last time. Their burgers are delicious too, but take your food to go! Grow your big back from the comfort of your car 😌 To go: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Dine in: ⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: A Holn
review_text: Pittsburgh if you're hungry and you want Togo's I suggest you go to Costco and buy a hot dog. Food was lacking hardly any meat on their sandwiches anymore.

author: Roxana A
review_text: We started this adventure not knowing what we were going to encounter… we arrived a little after 5:30pm on a Friday but because it’s the middle of December it’s like midnight outside, so looking for parking was a nightmare here. Be ready to park a bit far and walk through puddles of piss or you might get lucky and find one close enough 😏 Avalon Blvd is busy that hour too! On to the food. I ordered something called a Vampiro, which was essentially protein sandwiched between two really toasted tortillas. Which wasn’t too bad I had the carne asada, the meat was really well seasoned and tender. Ordered a carne asada quesadilla, this was much better, love that they are making the tortillas right there in your face, super delicious this way! Also ordered an al pastor burrito, it was huge and lots of meat that was also very good and tasty. Kinda wish they added pineapple to this!! The mulita was also good and got two large agua frescas, which always hits the spot. Service was okay, a little intimidating (to me) when ordering because they do have different stations and people just standing around and I was trying figure that out but got going. Lol Prices were okay, we paid about $60 for all this and they take cash only. They have a lot of seating available as around the time we got there people are really prob getting off work and picking up to go’s. Music plays and pretty nice little spot to eat and enjoy good food. 💫

author: Julie Carter
review_text: My daughter & I stopped in for breakfast while on vacation. Food was delicious. We had the pesto chicken sandwich and an açaí bowl. Everything was fresh. The coffee and latte were perfectly crafted. And the service and atmosphere were both wonderful.

author: Ekim Mike
review_text: Authentic and Flavorful Pad Thai at Mae Thong Bai, Siam Square Pad Thai Mae Thong Bai at Siam Square truly lives up to its Michelin Guide recognition. Their pad Thai is incredibly flavorful, with fresh, juicy prawns and perfectly stir-fried noodles that hit all the right notes — sweet, savory, and just a hint of smokiness. Pair it with their sour vegetable minced pork soup, and you’ve got a beautiful balance of rich and tangy flavors. The eatery itself is small and cozy, with a casual setup that gives off an authentic Bangkok street-food vibe. During lunch hours, it’s buzzing with both locals and tourists, though you’ll likely spot more tourists eager to try this well-known spot. While the food and ambiance are top-notch, be prepared to pay a premium. Prices here are nearly double what you’d usually pay for a similar meal elsewhere in Bangkok. Still, for the quality and taste, it’s a worthwhile splurge if you’re in the area and craving a solid pad Thai experience.

author: minios no
review_text: Tasty Vietnamese food! Pho Sai Gon, Pho Hoi An, Cha Gio, Mango Kefir & Bee Perfect —> all good!

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: Yan Peng Lim
review_text: This local boat noodle joint was a real gem! The broth was the star of the show - thick, flavorful, and just the right amount of savory. The meat was incredibly tender, melting in my mouth. The ice milk tea was a perfect complement, creamy and refreshingly unsweet. Every bite and sip felt like a celebration of local flavors, and I'd definitely go back for more!

author: Erika Graham
review_text: Love the atmosphere here on Fremont Street . The food was ok but , love the fact they offer vegan options. James our server was fantastic polite and very pleasant. When I make it back to Vegas I’ll hit it up!

author: JM
review_text: BEST MEAL I HAD DURING A WEEK IN VEGAS! We were able to snag a seat at the bar around 7PM. We ordered drinks and the crispy spring rolls, which were AMAZING! I had the short rib fried rice and my husband had the green curry with pork. Everything was amazing. If I come back to Las Vegas, I will have to visit Le Thai again!

author: Veronica P
review_text: way too much dressing mixed into my salad. the salmon that came in the salad was cooked well, and great flavor, but it was ~3.7 ounces in size. i also ordered the cinnamon bun pancakes, which came highly recommended by the waiter and others nearby, but it they were pretty underwhelming. they tasted like regular pancakes with a light glaze drizzled on top. considering they had a nice variety of coffee-based items on their menu, i expected the coffee to be good quality, but the black drip coffee tasted slightly burnt. overall, it was a meh experience for me.

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Lê Bảo Trân Trần
review_text: Yesterday was my first experience at The Chill's Tay Thanh branch, but it was really terrible! I won't comment on the food because everyone has different tastes, so I won't give a detailed review. But the important thing is, the staff seem to lack proper training. I arrived at 6 PM and stayed until 8 PM. From the moment I bought my ticket until I started eating, I had a very unpleasant experience with the staff. The service was incredibly poor. The staff were all standing around, in clumps, and when I needed a grill change, no one came to help. There was absolutely no quick response, even though my table was burning and smoke was billowing everywhere. They just crowded around chatting and were very impolite. I really disliked the staff's attitude. Many of them were even staring intently at our table. Overall, I was extremely disappointed.

author: Arestides Andre
review_text: Everything was just right, plenty of food, staff was great, the place is very clean, yes I will be returning and I will recommend the restaurant to friends and family.

author: Mohamed Uzain
review_text: Really impressed. The food was delicious and the part I love the most is that the fact that everything is served so fast right after the order. The environment is spacious and tidy and the staffs are VERY attentive. I had to revisit here just because how good it was. Highly recommended for a meal here.

author: DANIEL LAWSON
review_text: Had to try a philly after another local said they had the best. And it was great! had a joeys philly, love the fresh texture of the imported rolls. What a difference. Had a slice of tomato pizza which really good as well. East Coast pizzaria vibe as well.

author: Daniela Bárbara Martínez Ramos
review_text: I love the food at this place — one of the best breakfasts I’ve had in Downtown Miami.

author: Emi
review_text: The food was so nice and the atmosphere was very calming and enjoyable. Had to revisits the next day. Can highly recommend the banh mi.

author: Lynley Niu
review_text: Delicious and worth it! 🦀 Crab meat comes ready to eat, no shells. The curry powder flavor is rich, creamy, and so tasty. Perfect with rice. Great value and a must try! 💯

author: Walid Alam
review_text: Stopped by Napoli Pizza on a busy afternoon and was blown away by the quality! Got a classic cheese slice – the crust was perfectly crisp yet foldable, the sauce had that tangy-sweet balance you crave, and the cheese was generously layered and deliciously gooey – absolutely stellar! 🍕 *Flavor:10/10 – Authentic, fresh, and satisfying. *Value: Huge slices at very fair prices for NYC. Great bang for your buck! * Service: Quick and no-nonsense – perfect for a grab-and-go slice. Staff was friendly despite the lunch rush. * Vibe:Exactly what you want: a bustling, no-frills, quintessential New York slice joint. Clean and efficient. Whether you're a local needing a reliable fix or a visitor craving a real NYC slice experience, Napoli delivers. This place holds its own against the big names. Highly recommend! Will definitely be back soon.

author: Yuley Gonzalez
review_text: Went during the week to treat myself to enjoy a beautiful view and dinner. Le Tub did not dissapoint. I was seated immediately even though I know the wait list is usually 30 minutes+ Cristina & Brianna quickly came over to say hello and help me decide on drinks & eats. Friendly & amazing service. They aim to please and make this a place you'd want to be a regular in. Must try the Steamed Shrimp & Le Burger. Cant wait to go back.

author: Alex Loai
review_text: Portions was big and sufficient; the 滑蛋炒粉 is definitely one of the best (even compare to Penang)!

author: JC M
review_text: Mixed feelings on this one. I was expecting it to easily be a top ten best Banh Mi I’ve ever had (having never been to Vietnam prior to this trip). It was a good sandwich, but I’ve had much better Banh Mi’s in the US - not even in cities known for Vietnamese food. This is a high volume, large portion thing. If that is what you are going for you will be very happy. Pros: - Pate was maybe the best I’ve had on a Banh Mi - Meats were plentiful, thick cut and tasty - Amazing value and speed - Thoughtful to go packing with vegetables separated to ensure the baguette didn’t get soggy Cons: - not balanced at all as most Vietnamese food is - bread had beyond the crunch you want, maybe I just got a bad baguette but it was crunchy to the point it could shred the top of your mouth - vegetables did not add the texture and balance I desire in a Banh Mi - peppers were terribly cut with a huge variety in thickness, resulting in some bites with a lot of heat and some bites with none

author: Uachit Petchkong
review_text: Food is huge portion if come only 1-2 ppl. If 4-5 ppl it will be great portion. Found many rare or special menu here. Food taste Hot n Spicy like authentic southern part of thailand style. Stuff is really nice service mind. Price is reasonable for food portion. Recommend to do have seperate small size portion too then we can try more dishes.

author: ILoveFood
review_text: It's like a fast food place, food is prepared pretty quickly. There's a small outdoor place with tables and chairs.

author: Ervin Lau
review_text: Delicious shrimp wan ton. Love the crabmeat ball, very juicy. Nice place for brunch. Be ready to have some patient here.

author: moises diaz
review_text: That’s the best experience I’ve ever had in a venezuelan restaurant prices,taste,and food quality are amazing in this place if you’re one hour away.. trust me it will worth every single minute you spent driving to come and try this food don’t think it just come. Ask for lady 5stars for all

author: Sunny Patel
review_text: Place is gorgeous! Food was alright. Service was alright as well. Don’t get the spicy chicken kebabs - subpar at best! The chicken sumac dish was good - very mild taste thou. I’d go back to try other dishes. Didn’t love what I had. The pita and hummus was great thou!

author: Jania Consuegra
review_text: I love this place. No wonder why it’s busy all the time. Amazing prices, amazing food, amazing service. Definitely one of the restaurants to always go to in Coconut Grove. Pastas are a go to! Great drinks! Everything is good about this spot. Will always come back here

author: TANIA RODRIGUEZ
review_text: The food hall atmosphere and the food options are super good! If you are a group, everyone can order exactly what they want! Experience worldwide food in just one place! Sushi, Pasta, Sandwiches, Tacos, Hamburger, Hand made Juices, Salads, Pizza, MOET champagne, Coffee, Cocktails… Saturday afternoon DJ is fantastic for enjoying a beer! I love this place for the options and vibe!😉

author: Farouq AlMutawaah
review_text: Had the crab fried rice at Hai Paragon branch. The wait was about 15 minutes, which was fine, but the dish itself felt pretty average. Nothing special in terms of taste—not bad, just not memorable. Worth trying once if you’re curious, but I wouldn’t order it again.

author: Madison
review_text: I was super excited to get some good wings. So I ordered a 10 piece, honey barbecue wings, a 5 piece, lemon pepper, and a pineapple mango smoothie. I opened my wings, and they looked delicious.But then I realized a wing was missing in my 10 piece honey barbecue. I was very heartbroken since they were pretty pricey, but they were still delicious. I also had to wait 25 minutes for my order.

author: Justin H
review_text: Loved this place. The wait was a bit long due to how busy it was (Saturday morning so im not too upset about it). We sat at the bar top which was cool cause we got to watch everyone buzzing around. They were well orchestrated, communicative and really pumping out the food and drinks. When it came to customer service, Antonio was really nice and friendly. The food was good as well! I got the breakfast sandwich and my wife got the spicy chicken sandwich. My sandwich was good, not great but I wasnt disappointed at all. Her sandwich was really good. The French Toast that I saw coming from the kitchen looked incredible. This will for sure be on the list to visit when we come back!

author: Aung Aung Oo (Ezra)
review_text: The food is great and the portions are huge (one bowl easily feeds two!). Service is fast once you’re seated, but honestly, waiting through hundreds of tables is a "do it once" kind of experience. Next time, I’d probably just hit a regular street food spot. 🤷🏻‍♂️ Pro Tip: Use the QueQ app to queue up early so you can wander around while you wait. Overall: 7/10 — worth trying once for the hype!

author: Albert Khor
review_text: We ordered the crab omelette with white rice (395 Baht) and the crab meat fried rice (395 Baht) at Siam Paragon Mall. Given the location, the higher price is expected, but the dishes were delicious, especially when paired with the chili sauce. Aside from the steep price and the 45-minute waiting time, I have no complaints—it was a satisfying meal overall.

author: Sherrelle Golden
review_text: Bobo's food is very delicious you get your Money's worth believe me I know

author: Halimi Abdullah
review_text: Quite a popular restaurant and justifiable since the food is reasonably priced, taste good and prepared fast, even though there were quite a number of customers when we arrived. The “Dua Negara” siakap (sea bass) fish is recommended, and for RM47 for a good sized fish (can easily feed 2-3 people), quite a good value for our money. We also saw a lot of people ordering the “Daging salai berapi”, well, that’s for our next visit.

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: Adam Koh
review_text: Anyone who went there, pls try the wantan noodle. The stall is locate at near the carpark. The portion they give is really worth the money as compare with other stall. 23August2021, Dinner 3, packs of curry rices - $10.50 #Supportlocalfood #curryrice #dinnereatwhat #decentprice #extraportionfood #food #huaweip20pro #huawei 25August 2021 Dinner, pork chop x1 10 February 2023 Lunch - roast pork with char siew rice (Having here) I believe many place are selling food at reasonable price. This is one my favourite stall. Recommended $5 portion. Owner is quite old already. Do patronise this stall if you are at this place. #Charlie #roastpork #bukitmerahview #hawkercentre #hawkerfood #cheap&reasonableprice #ilovehawkerfood #samsung #samsunggalaxyM32 #followme #10feb2023 #10022023

author: Vanessa L.
review_text: What a lovely and unique dinning experience, I love the waterfront view, delicious food, great service and unique decor! We always come here when we are in Hollywood because its such a fun spot for dinner and drinks. Cant wait to be back again! Also management went above and beyond to a fix a little issue we had. I thoroughly appreciated that.

author: Taka H
review_text: AFFORDABLE and DELISH! Parking is on the streets or scan the QR when you park to pay. Others park in the DMV parking lot too. There's normally a line but the staff is VERY efficient in ensure it gets pushed through smoothly including no one trying to cut the line FOOD 5/5 Is always consistent coming here back to back times. - Baja Fish Taco - Baja Shrimp Taco = I COULD EAT ENDLESS AMOUNTS OF THIS - Filete Al Carbon - Pulpo a Las Brasas = TOP CHOICE just like the taco they have! - Shrimp Aguachile = Super fresh - Tostada de Jurel + ceviche are amazing! - Sopa De Mariscos - Mascarpone Pumpkin Spice Cheesecake = perfect amount to compliment the courses CLEAN AMBIENCE 4/5 Since it shares with our restaurants is busy but you're able to find seats every time you come. SERVICE 4/5 Quick and attentive staff from ordering, bringing out the food, and cleaning up the tables PARKING 4/5 It can get difficult on the time you come

author: Ricky Chin
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Had an amazing dining experience here! The staff were super friendly and attentive, making us feel very welcome. The food was absolutely delicious and full of flavor 😋 Everything was perfect — I’ll definitely come back again! Highly recommended!

author: Arif Syazwan
review_text: Came all the way from Malaysia to try this viral restaurant. Turns out it was good overall. Worth to try their delicious foods and desserts. Their service was superb as well.

author: Special K
review_text: Ordered through food delivery. Food is ok. Rice is fragrant enough. Portions could be a little more generous though.

author: Deval Shah
review_text: Amazing food . Everything we tried ( and we tried many vegetarian items) was very high quality ingredient wise and also well cooked. This place is now my #1 for Mediterranean style food. great addition to the community. Thank you for your effort! The pita, fried halloumi, muhamarra, kanafe, eggplant, labneh, vegan platter were all amazing.

author: alex cheong
review_text: Ah Wang Cafe is a nostalgic kopitiam-style coffee shop that claims to have been in business for over 40 years. Stepping into the cafe brings back memories of simpler times, with its retro ambiance and old-school setup. The place offers the classic kopitiam fare — kaya butter toasts, soft-boiled eggs, and traditional nasi lemak. It’s the kind of place that takes you back to childhood breakfasts with family or slow mornings with a newspaper and coffee. As expected, the menu is simple and straightforward. The toast is crisp with generous kaya and butter, and the soft-boiled eggs are served in the traditional style — perfect for dipping or stirring with a dash of soy sauce and white pepper. The nasi lemak comes with the essentials: sambal, peanuts, anchovies, egg, and a choice of protein, making it a decent and filling option. However, for someone who enjoys bold and robust coffee, the brew at Ah Wang Cafe might come off as underwhelming. Kopitiam coffee usually has a reputation for being thick, aromatic, and strong, but here it leans towards the milder side. While that may appeal to some, it may not satisfy those looking for a deep caffeine kick. That said, Ah Wang Cafe still earns its stripes as a legit, no-frills coffee shop. It’s a chill spot to enjoy a slow morning or an afternoon break, especially if you appreciate traditional Malaysian breakfast staples and a relaxed, old-school vibe. Nothing fancy — just simple comfort.

author: Mercedes Landeta
review_text: Service is kind and food is exquisite! The cow feet soup remind me of the one my Mom does it was delicious👌🏼😋 we will always get back when we crave for “parrillada Argentina 🇦🇷!!! Sangria was also the perfect match 🥳

author: Winnie Quek
review_text: Not a nasi lemak person but I thoroughly enjoyed the food! Tried both kambing and ayam. Ayam wins hands down! The chicken is tender and flavourful, combined with the soft and fluffy rice makes it really good indeed. Would recommend changing the hard boiled egg to sunny side up.

author: Yeung Au
review_text: Santanera is my favorite dining spot in Bali! The food was fantastic, but what truly made our experience exceptional was the service provided by Gung Vera and Ade. They were incredibly friendly and always greeted us with warm smiles. When I mentioned that we were celebrating a friend's birthday, they went above and beyond to create a wonderful atmosphere for our celebration. Their thoughtful touches made our day truly special. We will definitely return on our next trip to Bali! I highly recommend Santanera for anyone looking for great food and outstanding service!

author: Nicholas Lai
review_text: Try their duck soup noodle, is yummy. You would not get it in Malaysia.

author: Ayodele Abiodun
review_text: The service here is 110/100. Girls are versatile in their doing🥰🥰🥰

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: Pattaratorn Karnchanapaisal
review_text: Best thai-style grills in town. Reasonable price and good taste. The queue might be long during meal time, but should try at least once.

author: Luke He
review_text: 3 (good quality but not my taste), freshly cooked kway teow but just not to my taste. I came around 6pm at Sunday, and owner told me get food 20 mins later. It’s freshly cooked and ingredients are good quality like oyster with no bad taste. But I do not like the overall seasoning of it. You may find it good tho.

author: Man Phan
review_text: The claypot rice here is delicious. I think this is the best place in District 1. Office workers eat a lot. Parking is convenient.

author: Jessica Schneider
review_text: Raisin cane chicken fingers are so juicy and delicious. They melt off bone good. The service wasnt clear what i ordered. While waiting, it was a bit hectic. I was disappointed that $9 didnt get meal. It was only the chicken. It goes in the splurge fast food section. It's def worth it.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Tokki
review_text: I came here because I wanted to eat Bun Bo after dinner. I ordered what the menu said was "Thap Cam Bun Bo Tai Mixed Beef Soup." First of all, the portion wasn't huge, it's Vietnamese-style, lol. You might think, "It's a little small for Koreans." Because I was like that... ... ;ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ I wish they had both regular and large portions. The meat had no gamey smell and the broth was clean. The broth was so clean, I thought it would be okay for Koreans to eat, too. 🙂 I saw a review on YouTube.

author: Alvar Marin
review_text: The food was exquisite. I’m Peruvian, I’ve been in the US for more than 8 years and this is by far the best Peruvian place I’ve been to in the US. Really glad I ran into this place. The waiter was very attentive and kind too!

author: Lena Völlger
review_text: Really nice hidden coffee place in Da Nang. For me the best coffee I had in Vietnam 😍 The Bananabread was also very delicous! You shouldn't miss out this place!

author: Mink Marks
review_text: I got lucky and got mine in 3 minutes waiting in line. Im a big eater , 210 pound guy :), and i was completely stuffed after 1. Might even be a bit of a meat overdose.. but it was good. Pricer than on the street but as a tourist its still nothing for such a filling. Takeaway only, veggies etc on the side. Loads of plastics come with that ofcourse…

author: Mike Chia
review_text: Great food and we’re returning customers 👍 Love the selection of beef and pork — a good go-to place for meat lovers. My son especially loves their Jjajangmyeon. Overall, the menu items are pretty solid. Only downside is parking, which is common for this area. Will still come back! 😊

author: Ying-Kuan “Rick” Tsai
review_text: The food was absolutely delicious. Every dish was flavorful and beautifully prepared. You can really tell the care and creativity that goes into the menu. Special thanks to Luciano, who made our experience even better. He explained the dishes in great detail, answered all of our questions with patience, and gave excellent recommendations. His service was attentive, friendly, and genuinely thoughtful. Highly recommend this place for both the food and the outstanding service. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Amy B
review_text: The yellowtail and the sole fish were wonderful. The oyster delicious- the freshness was just perfection. The clam chowder is not bad, but not the best there is. Definitely worth a visit for sure. Staff was helpful and gave good suggestions. Atmosphere was nice, not so loud you can't hear the party you're with, but not super quiet. I love how is within walking distance to a variety of places.

author: Stella Han
review_text: If you are craving poke, this is a really great spot. They have premade menus for bowls or if you want to customize your own you can do so I usually get the large bowl and it is pretty filling. They have free water. They have outside seating and it’s pretty quick to receive your food. You will sometimes be able to find street parking depends on what time of day it is, but if you need time to kill time, there are plenty of shops around and there’s also a salt and straw if you want ice cream 🍦

author: Craving Calories Foodie
review_text: Pricey but Halal. The atmosphere is pretty clean and calm. Service is good. Chicken is pretty-made and heated before serving. The Nashville sandwich is average. The waffles and chicken do not go as a sanwich/burger style. It’s practically too big to be eating as a sandwich/burger. It looks really good aesthetically in pictures/display.

author: Tan Leddin
review_text: Very nice place! Food is great and the waiters are very friendly and helpful. Yap was especially helpful and always serving with a smile. Great place to celebrate a friend’s birthday. Ventilation is great so there is no smoky smell. Toilet is really clean as well. Awesome place to spend a Friday night with friends!!

author: Martin Haberstich
review_text: I was there tonight Jan 10th. The food was great. There was a large party outside with the most beautiful girls in Vietnam.

author: Kung Chien Pin
review_text: Worth Trying -Kaeng Som and Fried Pork Knuckle Prices are quite affordable, and the food portions are generous! If you're dining with someone who doesn’t typically eat a lot, it's a good idea to keep that in mind and avoid over-ordering. Every item on the menu is definitely worth trying, though I must admit, I felt a bit overwhelmed by the wonderful variety of dishes available! It genuinely took me some time to decide on my order from the menu. The atmosphere was filled with lovely music from a band until 10PM, but unfortunately, the live performance wrapped up just as I stepped into the restaurant.

author: Althea Elaine Jaug
review_text: I go to this location a lot and usually do mobile order here. The customer service is always nice/helpful and the food is always fresh. This location is also very clean.

author: Jill C
review_text: Really good food! Went during happy hour and got 2 margaritas each at $15. T-bone steak was really good and juicy.

author: Nicholas Hugh Sam
review_text: i understand the other raving reviews, but i prefer my banh mis less full. the price to food ratio is unmatched, super cheap, very flavourful and big banh mi, but it's really too much for me. too much butter, too much meat. you can't really taste the individual ingredients anymore. i understand, but not for me. their juices are FANTASTIC though.

author: Bernard
review_text: Woke up early one sunday morning just to make a trip to this famous restaurant, for a plate of their signature Nasi Lemak and its worth our effort. Plate of fragrant rice arrived fluffy with each grain clearly separated yet still moist - not sticky or soggy, and lightly infused with coconut milk and pandan. The star was the Fried Chicken - A whole golden-brown leg, its skin shatteringly crisp with flecks of spiced crumbs, while the lightly seasoned meat inside stays tender and juicy. The sambal glossy and rich, tying the rice and chicken together beautifully. On the side, crunchy ikan bilis and peanuts provide that addictive bite, while the egg balances the richness. It’s a plate that feels generous, comforting, and bold all at once for us. We ordered their Fried Noodles and Bee Hoon as well, and although they were not signature dishes, both were well fried and balance in flavours. We didnt like their Bagadil and Potato Curry Puff (Pastry was ok, but fillings had an overwhelming turmeric flavour) though. Overall, we will return just their Nasi Lemak and Ayam Goreng, next time round when in KL again. Good to reach before 8am on Sunday, as we did not encounter any queue and found seats immediately by ourselves as no service staffs attended to us, due to full capacity. However, its better to approach their service staffs for seats, as ordering procedures are rather confusing after that.

author: V M
review_text: Hole in the wall place close to JSQ . No frills , but amazing momos . Had the steamed chicken and veg jhol momos , both made freshly by the woman who runs the place . Very authentic feel - almost like eating in your own home kitchen! They also recently started chaat . They gave us samples to taste - pani puri and dahi puri . Also pretty good!

author: SingWei Wong
review_text: Quits an upmarket experience at a Thai restaurant, food are made freshly n delicious. The serving size is quite substantial, so do not over order in the first round.

author: Hana
review_text: We ordered the famous san lou mee hon, deep fried pork belly, and of course, white pepper crab. All for 2 people T_T lol our total bill was 111sgd but every penny was worth it. Thanks to Gordon Ramsay for such a fine recommendation. We went here around 6pm, there are still a few tables available outside. You can call them to reserve a table inside. Staff are friendly. They have clean restroom, too. Restaurant's very accessible. There's bus stop nearby. Can't wait to go back here and order their pork belly and bee hon again (crab's expensive lol)

author: Ss Kk
review_text: We celebrated our friend’s birthday here and had such an amazing time! The food was delicious, the drinks were on point, and the place has such a great vibe. Definitely recommend checking it out. Special shoutout to our waitress Suzan she was the sweetest and made the night even better. Thank you for the great service!

author: Dani Calvo
review_text: this food was incredible. favorite dish was definitely the bep cuon combo 2. the pork and shrimp pancake rolled into the spring roll provided was an incredible array of flavor. we also ordered the tom su sot bo toi an kem banh bao chien, which was good as well, a little less savory than expected, but delicious. finally we ordered the Ba Chi Gion Da Mam Tac. the sauce it came with was incredible and the crispy edges of the pork were delicious. definitely recommend to stop by for a bite.

author: Elyn Chew (Lyn)
review_text: Can’t believe that Jalan Alor not only has grilled chicken wings, but also nasi lemak seafood platter and Thai-style grilled fish! During dinner time, it’s really crowded! Luckily, the restaurant is very spacious, and you can choose to dine outdoors, indoors (with air-conditioning), or even upstairs in private rooms (with karaoke). We ordered their special National Day menu – the nasi lemak seafood platter. The portion was generous, and the seafood was really fresh! The sambal was super fragrant and spicy – a love-hate relationship for me 😂. The four of us ate to our hearts’ content and left very satisfied! The grilled fish came in a Thai-style clear tomyam flavor – sour, spicy, and really appetizing! Everyone agreed it was delicious, especially since the fish meat was lightly pan-fried before being added to the soup, making it fresh and flavorful. While waiting for food, you can also check out their snack corner – there are all sorts of titbits, candies, and ice cream to nibble on! Since it gets really crowded on weekends, taking the MRT is a good option – it’s just a 3-minute walk away!

author: Cristina Major
review_text: I had a little trip to Newark and it was a bit chaotic but choosing Casa Nova Grill was the best choice for the whole trip. Evando waited on us and he was the nicest. He showed us our options, detailed about the all you can eat options. Just for his service I would rate the 5 stars and the food was amazing as well. I will definitely come back when traveling up north again. I absolutely love my experience today. Going back to Louisiana and hope to be able to go back to Casa Nova Grill again.

author: N.I.I
review_text: Everything we ordered is superb! Come and try on your own! Just the place is very hot and drinks kinda limited. Will definitely visit again!

author: Daniel Wong
review_text: It's the stall with the longest queue. After ordering they will pass you a buzzer. Our dishes were ready after 15 minutes although we were told it's a 30 minutes wait. Loved the fried rice, full of flavour with wok hei and generous amount of crab. The mantis shrimp was delicious too, lots of garlic, only complain is that the dish was not warm when it was served. Will definitely be back whenever we are in Bangkok.

author: Edward Scott
review_text: The atmosphere was full of great vibes the food was Great. Ordered chilled shrimp cocktail and gator bites. Was fresh the gator was fresh well seasoned fried to perfection

author: 송지현
review_text: The food, the service, and the atmosphere were all so good. Order anything! Everything is delicious. And the meticulous service of the staff makes for a very happy time. I was able to have a happy and enjoyable time thanks to the aweni staff especially who served our table. I hope the company rewards her well. I always want to see her smile. Thanks to her, I want to visit again.

author: Satoru Gojō
review_text: Always have had good experience at this Burger joint. Their portions are always TOP TIER. Worth your money. FLAVOR IS THERE!!!! I recommend you Dinning IN! I remember ordering a lot of food and the cashier told me that the portions are big.. he wasn’t lying hahah! I’m going to be moving back to Culver City but this spot will be brining me back to South Central

author: Yong Hee Chan
review_text: A place that offers food of my liking, be it laksa, prawn mee, carrot cake, roti prata. I mostly patronised the carrot cake and prawn mee, the carrot cake, at $3.50/packet is not only cheap but very well cooked. Prawn mee, a very popular stall where ingredients vanished is one goes after 9.30am, is another generous stall, with the food very much in my favour. There are many other stalls, making choices difficult. Highly recommended place, cheap and delicious food!!!!

author: Sudarshan Lodha
review_text: Absolutely loved our lunch at Milk and Madhu! The service was top-notch – we’re super picky vegetarians (no egg, no fish oil) and Captain Puspa and Novi were amazing, guiding us through the menu without batting an eye. She suggested the Summer Slice Pizza and OH MY GOD – best pizza EVER. I seriously still can’t get over how good it was. Big shoutout to the team for making a Milo Shake for us, even though it’s supposed to be just for kids. That was such a nice touch! We had an awesome lunch and can’t wait to come back soon. Highly recommend this place!

author: Cheong Loong
review_text: A great hawker style food centre with mix of Chinese, Malay n Indian traditional food under one roof . One can surely find something that suits one taste bud on that day. Be pampered to some popular items like wantan noodles, prawn noodles, chicken rice, claypot rice ,curry, chinese deserts , mee goreng, satay, rojak , longtong, mee rebus, nasi brani, mee goreng n goreng pisang and putu piring. There is more variety but just follow the long queues and one will not be disappointed by the food . Have a heavy meal but leave some room for dessert.

author: Almighty LO
review_text: I not only lost my appetite but I became nauseous within minutes and then I took a uber to the hospital. Nothing was fresh, food was reheated and lukewarm. I honestly don’t understand how this place is still in business. I didn’t finish my food I paid but then I was harassed to leave a tip

author: Virginia Cabrera
review_text: Food is good but the waiting time is long and prices are fair we love this food

author: Shaolin Leong
review_text: A relatively small food center. 2km from where we stay & we always jogged here have dinner & walk back . The famous CKT is "so so" to us , with terrible long waiting time.Not worth the wait ! The wanton noodles is not bad surprisingly! BKT is ok too ! Prawn noodle at the corner has loyal supporters too ! Yet to try the rest ! Parking I heard is a headache !

author: Rmsadeq
review_text: It was great 😍🤩Iranian authentic food with the best koobideh kebab and excellent rice. Definitely give it a try. The staff were also wonderful and very kind.

author: barbara Mosley
review_text: First time there service was great, drinks were good. I ordered the Hennessey barbecue honey wings and the spicy calamari. Well the chicken was over cooked and didn't taste like Hennessey barbecue honey. Calamari was cold. Didn't even wanna take the left overs. Beautiful establishment in need of a dance floor or at least have karaoke night. They have a DJ but no dance floor. Big screen TV's that are awesome for watching the games!!!

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: joseph ng
review_text: Finally we get to try this Michelin star Bak kut teh!. totally satisfied and happy!! Ordered the premium loin soup, its is good as advertised! The soup is thick & flovourful and not salty. the chicken feet is surprisingly good!! It's so good, nothing left!

author: Christopher Gorrie
review_text: I didn’t know what to expect when coming here, but I’m sure glad that I did! I ordered a half chicken with rice and beans, which also came with complimentary coleslaw and corn tortillas. The rice and beans were absolutely incredible! They were obviously slow-cooked and have been perfecting the recipe for years. The chicken was great, too, and I’m impressed it was juicy and tender when being cooked in such huge batches. Even the coleslaw was great! Dino’s might not look like that much from the outside, and they only have basic hard-back booths and bar seats, but the food is so good I’d eat it sitting on the sidewalk. It was also only about $15 for a massive portion of food. I definitely want to come back here to try other items in the future.

author: Maysaya Bass
review_text: This restaurant is another popular choice when it comes to sukiyaki. They don't have a huge menu, focusing on simple, yet delicious a la carte dishes. I recommend: - Mixed Dry Suki: The sukiyaki sauce is excellent, stir-fried with a fragrant wok aroma. The toppings are packed with pork, squid, and shrimp, making it a great value. - Chicken Stir-fried Noodles: Soft, wide noodles stir-fried with a fragrant wok-fried sauce, served with a generous serving of crispy squid. This restaurant offers a delicious, balanced meal, with portions appropriate for the price.

author: nessa i
review_text: From the atmosphere to the service to the food, it was overall pleasant The price is very reasonable and the food is well seasoned. Renan our Brazilian slwaiyer was very nice.

author: A Grandusky
review_text: A BEST place EVER ☆ Our first time & everyone n everything was just too wonderful ♡☆ We took ssssoooo long in line picking out what we wanted aaaand nobody cared ♡☆ not one single person ♡☆ The selection is enormous ☆ Every clean ☆ Well lit ☆ Very open ☆ Great seating: inside & outside in the awesome shade ☆ They have a very nice water dispenser ☆ Fantastic music ☆ Some may say it's expensive. ... THESE Donuts ARENOT your "store packaged" ones & for us, worth every penny ☆ Glad we came from across town!

author: Frida Tan
review_text: Came here around 1pm and not so crowded. The owner (i assumed, the person who took order and payment) can speak English well, no worry for ordering. All good served in reasonable speed and overall really delicious. You can customise the spicy level for tomyam too.

author: Jack Michalski
review_text: Went for a birthday dinner. Service was accommodating and friendly. It was BYOB and we brought a bottle of wine and there was no corking fee. Food was good across the board. Lots of vegetarian/vegan options. We got: baba ghanoush (smokey), fried halloumi, vegan platter (too many good things to list but especially liked the zahir and wara dawali), and the grilled salmon salad. Reasonable prices. Will definitely come back again

author: Rui Ern Low
review_text: We visited on a Sunday morning hence we are required to queue up and wait for approximately 30 minutes. But i really think that it’s surely worth the wait!! I’ve visited the place previously on a weekday afternoon and there is no wait needed, so it would be rather decent and recommended to pay a visit on weekdays. For the bagels, it’s toasted till perfection, not too crunchy yet remaining the unique chewiness that bagels have. My favourite would be matcha yuzu where the yuzu cream cheese pairs nicely with the layer of matcha filling. As their matcha are sourced from a local coffee shop— forest cloud, the quality is promised ! A perfect option to opt for if you’re craving for something sweet and flavourful. The staff are very attentive, overall it was a splendid and fulfilling dining experience.

author: Chow Stephen
review_text: Nasi Kandar Chicken cooked in red sweet sauce, taste normal, Teh Tarik is ok, nice. Indian Mamak Plenty of parking Environment Indoor and outdoor seating. Price for Nasi Kandar+Tarik RM 10.40

author: Sabina Shorey
review_text: Amazing restaurant experience! Everything I've had has been great and left wanting to come back. The waitress went above and beyond helping us with wine and aperitif picks. Small restaurant, can be hard to get a reservation but definitely worth it.

author: Tuy Chanmonypech
review_text: The experience can be described as opulent, given the cost and the elegant decor. The cost of the food could be considered somewhat greater. Their menu features a variety of Thai cuisine. The service was decent, although the food can take a while to arrive, and it tends to be busy regularly. The food was acceptable, but I really enjoy their stir-fried crab with yellow curry, papaya salad, and deep-fried seabass. The serving size is quite small. Their mango sticky rice is likely the standout dessert on the menu. All in all, this spot is a great choice for top-notch Thai cuisine.

author: Sierra Phillips
review_text: Was so excited we found this place it was everything we wanted and more! Dennis was amazing and had the best customer service we have had our whole visit here in Vegas! The food was delicious and great prices! We also tried their tik tok coffee, it was the best and bigger than our heads! The vibe over all was exactly what we needed!

author: W T
review_text: Portions are big, and the desserts taste alright—my companion enjoyed them. We had the Thai tea bingsu and panda coconut toast with a lemon tea. The total came to about 580 baht.

author: Jade Reviews
review_text: My family and I had an excellent time here. My oldest even found some vegetarian options to our surprise.

author: mike professionaal
review_text: This was my first time at this spot and it was great! Definitely going back, the food was amazing with something for everyone! Carnivore? Vegan? Pescatarian? They got you! Rustic decore is brilliant! It's the Blueprint to good eating! Forgive the pics we was so hungry and the food was so good I almost forgot to take pics.

author: Dabbie Yap
review_text: Amazing seafood spot right in the heart of KL! Boleh Seafood Pot serves a super satisfying seafood hotpot packed with prawns, squid, clams, mussels, and even deep-fried Siakap — all in a spicy, tangy broth that hits the spot. RM250 gets you the full set plus a free crab! Great sides too (Salted Egg Sotong, dry butter Chicken, etc.), free snacks & ice cream, and even karaoke rooms for groups. Just 2 mins from Bukit Bintang MRT. Highly recommended!

author: maria wong
review_text: Nothing to shout about. The Wagyu or Angus beef patty tastes same to me, in fact Angus is more rough. Smell is the same. I order original and the truffle sauce is like mayo / tartar add truffle oil. The patty is frozen & cooked on high heat then served on the small burner in front and you continue to cook until the center is warm ! if want raw its cold. The side sauce is thousand island, soya, spicy kichimi pepper, garlic bits. The original beef tastes plain. To add up the taste please add soya, kichimi pepper to the grill tray to add flavour The Extra skewers are not 1 piece of meat but thin slice of beef stacked up together

author: K. O.
review_text: Great food. Great service!! The portions were huge!! My wife and I saw this place pop up on a TikTok and decided to make the trip from Anthem to the Eastside. Let me tell you, the trip is definitely worth it.

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: Ty lee
review_text: The restaurant serves two types of Bak Kut Teh. I preferred the fragrant herbal tea soup type .The other is the dry spicy version. Ordered the iceberg lettuce as another side dish. The restaurant is quite popular and usually packed with customers for dinner. Service is fast. Price has gone up slightly and the portion has reduced too.

author: FlavorFool-N-Spain
review_text: My brother told me they had great breakfast sandwiches...and he was correct!!!! I had the bacon and 😋

author: Mei
review_text: The food was fine, but the service could be improved—we had to wait over 10 minutes for our drinks, and even when our food arrived, the drinks still hadn’t been served.

author: Mike Be
review_text: Tastes pretty good and the portions were decent. Typical Chinese food options. Kinda small on the inside so seating was limited. But over all the food was good.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Minh Bui
review_text: Food was better before. While I was eating, a mouse ran next to the table and started to grow whiskers.

author: Peter Lo
review_text: We ordered the calamari, octopus and clams casino for apps. All were very good. Calamari crispy and that marinara sauce had a little kick which made it better. octopus was tender and not rubbery. The clams were satisfactory. My daughter ordered chicken and rice and me and my wife order paella Valencia for 2. Entrees were good. My only disappointment was they pushed the "still" water on me which cost $10. All patrons beware as it's a up sell tactic. I hated it cause I was targeted and no other table got screwed.

author: A V
review_text: I had a hard time making my purchase plus the food ain't even good. Never again.

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: choco cake
review_text: Food was very delicious. This is probably one of the best meals we'e had throughout our whole stay in Vietnam. Menu was also easy to understand. Staff were very accommodating and welcoming. Place is very beautiful and almost every spot is picture perfect, even tbe bathroom and elevator. Atmosphere is very warm and relaxing.

author: Patrick K
review_text: Michelin star wine bar? Yes pls! But people come here for the food. Impossible to snag a resy but worth waiting for a walk in spot at lunch or before dinner service. Vibe cozy and cute. Food was amazing! Small menu but basically every dish was a hit. Also the wine selection was well curated. Verdict: recommend and will return!!

author: Andrea Montgomery
review_text: Vanessa from Argentina was our server and she was so attentive and provided great service. Our party was a bigger party and some girls came late however she still handled everything in order and precisely. I had the turkey croissant which came with potatoes. I also tried the beignets and the caramel latte with my photo on it was amazing! Mica came and suggested that we take a photo in front of the flower Arc and she even accommodated Us by closing the doors and taking a photo of the entire group because there were 10 of us or more. I would recommend it and thank you ladies for your service.

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: OANH PHAM
review_text: I passed by this restaurent on my way to the Michellin Guide JeOh Chula. Why nobody talking about this mookata dish as a Thai food must try? The food is good, fresh and delicious. Though it’s quite noisy because of people talking and music but the service is 5/5. The staff stopped me from order another drink cuz I can get it refill lol. Btw, if you want to try Thai traditional dishes and want to try hot pot and drilled meat as the same time, give this a try.

author: Melise Nguyen
review_text: I’ve been here a few times, and I must say..never disappointed. Food was staff amazing. Amanda was our waitress and she was friendly and pleasant and always checking to see if we need anything but giving us enough time and space to have our meal. Host was very friendly and informative. Highly recommended.

author: bladimir hernandez
review_text: lovely place, delicious food, really transit as there it is a corner between 2 large avenues but the food and service gets a 10 of 10

author: Asnida Amri
review_text: Nice place to dine in with beautiful sunset. Place is huge and have a lot of table. Menu is based on Thai cuisine. So tasty and affordable. Waiting time is just nice. No need to wait that long eventough got many people. Also got products from Thai available here. Will repeat again...

author: Vicky Kuo
review_text: I ate here twice and loved both times! Really delicious food, quick service and decently friendly staff. Pricier than local street food, obviously, but still cheap and worth it in my opinion. Get the beef skewers - best meal I’ve had in HCMC.

author: Omar Lopez (Marejo)
review_text: I found this place on TikTok, and it was called the Mexican Narnia. It did NOT disappoint. It was beautiful inside. The best atmosphere I've ever been in for a Mexican restaurant. The only disappointment was I ordered Menudo, and they didn't have any. I settled for the Chilaquiles, and they were fire🔥 with asada on them. Big portion. My prima had a shrimp cocktail and my mom and had some ceviche, and it was all very good. It's definitely a must try. We showed up once they opened, and within 20 minutes of sitting down, that place was packed. Make sure you are hungry if you visit cause they hook it up.

author: Tony Solano
review_text: I loved the service. Sat at the bar and gentleman was pretty attentive and friendly. The octopus was AMAZING. The Steak even better. I was asked if I needed any condiment on the Steak. Just cook it with salt please.

author: L A
review_text: The food is fairly priced. Usual place for a lot of beach goers. Good Food. Good Price

author: Anthony Ladd
review_text: Decided on Panera bread wanted to try to Bread bowl. Meal was nice. Service was great. The associate Make sure that out ingredients was fresh nice.

author: Aaron Feld
review_text: As of today, my favorite & by far the best New York Style Pizza in Las Vegas! We decided last minute to try Lucinos’s, a place I tried years ago that was always good. I don’t remember them being this great. Crust was perfectly cooked, sauce was so tasty, & they had a great Vegan cheese option. The Margherita pizza was perfectly cooked too. We tried their poppers which were delicious & the homemade vegan ranch was incredible. They had mozzarella sticks that were huge & the kids enjoyed them. Everything is priced well & the service is impeccable! Erika, our server was exceptional. The place is super clean & has a lot of space. I’m not into sports but if you are they have a handful of tvs to watch games. Team Luciano’s! Thanks For everything. See you soon!

author: Alphonse Eelric
review_text: personally recommend kao-pad-poo (crab meat fried rice) & glass noodle hot pot at this shop. price are reasonable, plenty of parking, just beware of traffic rules at this area. also beware they have afternoon closing hours from 2pm to 4pm.

author: M&L
review_text: Absolute Foodie Must-Visit! This HCMC Gem Blew Me Away. Honestly, finding O Tinh House was the highlight of our trip to Saigon! It’s tucked away just enough to feel like a genuine local secret, and the food here is on another level entirely—not just your average Vietnamese place. The menu is so creative. It's Vietnamese fusion, but they nail the flavors perfectly. You absolutely have to try the Bone Marrow Beef Noodle Soup (Bún Xáo Tủy Bò). The broth is slow-cooked for hours and has this incredible depth and richness. We also loved their Loco Moco twist, which sounds random for HCMC, but trust me, it’s amazing! Everything we ordered was fresh, flavorful, and seriously impressive. Beyond the food, the vibe is cozy and clean (major plus for the air conditioning!). The staff are genuinely friendly, and the owner is super welcoming and speaks great English, giving you that perfect hospitality experience. If you’re bored of the typical tourist spots and want a truly exceptional meal that balances tradition with new ideas, just go here. Excellent value for money, too. We’re already planning our next visit!!

author: Ming Bin Lee
review_text: Super damn poor services especially the lady boss not friendly at all Food just so so If you order not much, she will show face not welcoming you Won’t be visiting next time!

author: Kia Kalantari
review_text: Cuca Restaurant in Bali is a fantastic dining spot with both indoor and outdoor seating that creates a relaxed yet elegant vibe. The service is outstanding, with attentive and friendly staff who make you feel welcome. The menu offers a wide variety of delicious foods and creative drinks, making it perfect for any occasion. Highly recommended!

author: Ernest Baca
review_text: The staff here are fun and love to keep you happy w food and drinks. Our waiter Victor was not only funny but fast and never let our drinks get empty. This is a spot for great Mexican food and drinks in town. So come in hungry and leave wobbly and happy

author: Jason Ng
review_text: It's my first time at Haig Road Food Centre, and I can tell you it's definitely not my last time! Had loads of good food there and here is my review for each of them Signature Kolo Mee ($5.50) from Lin Yu Mei - now this is probably the best Kolo Mee I've had. The noodles were perfectly springy, well tossed in shallot and lard oil while not being too oily and the chilli was amazing. It was very fiery, and yet it had a beautiful aroma which made this dish even better. Never mind the minced meat and char siu, just give me their noodles and chilli and I will be a happy man. Pork and Chicken Satay ($0.80 each) from Mei Mei Satay - the satay meat was pretty sizeable! I loved the marinade used; it was well charred and it made the meat quite tender, even for the pork version. The satay sauce unfortunately isn't peanut-y enough, but it was fine for me as the pineapple juice helped cut the meatiness of satay! Putu Piring ($2.50 for 4) from Haig Road Putu Piring - now this is a famous one, and I couldn't leave the food centre without having it! Indeed this was probably the best Putu Piring I've had. The flour and gula melaka used was somehow different, it was much more aromatic than others that I've had before. A sweet treat to end the meal! Definitely coming back for these 3 items again 😍

author: Elaine Aviles
review_text: We had a fantastic experience here! We enjoyed a Philly cheesesteak with jalapeños on the side and fresh fruit, plus a delicious breakfast burrito loaded with chorizo, egg, bacon, and potatoes — served with their famous crispy potatoes. Everything was full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The cappuccinos were amazing too! Alfredo, our server, was friendly and attentive, and Nick, the owner, made us feel genuinely welcome. Great food, great service, and great vibes — we’ll definitely be back!

author: Dwight Kenneth
review_text: Let’s start off with the good! Food was fresh and came out SUPER FAST! Portion sizes were great too! We were greeted and seated promptly as we already had reservations. Another great thing is the variety that they offer , they have a plethora of authentic Vietnamese dishes. Lots of the dishes tasted amazing ! The not so good, some of the dishes weren’t the tastiest. The Bahn Xeo in my personal opinion is pretty over hyped here. We also tried the summer rolls, and they weren’t that good either (the sauce they came with was amazing though) The prices were a LOT higher than that of what you would normally paid. Overall, it’s a pretty decent experience. But for the fact that they offer so much variety maybe it compromises on the quality of certain dishes. I also think that it has a lot of height, even though there’s locals and tourist here. The price of value ratio for me just wasn’t there.

author: PATHY MURDOCK
review_text: I loved the location of this restaurant with its beautiful ocean view, the music was incredible, the service was good, the sea bass was delicious, and the cocktails were amazing. I recommend it 100% The Sunset was Phenomenal!!❤️

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Heidi
review_text: Super yummy and comforting meal! The pork rib soup was rich, bold, and perfectly peppery – the pork was super tender and fell right off the bone. Loved that they refill the soup too! The braised large intestines were flavorful and well-prepared, and the iced lemon tea was a great refreshing balance to the heat. Definitely a must-try for anyone craving a classic Singaporean bak kut teh experience. Do prepare for a queue – I waited around 10–15 minutes, but they were so sweet to offer a fan and a drink while waiting, which made the experience really pleasant.

author: Treasure Pot
review_text: Good variety of food. Sunday brunch , carpark was full but the wait was quite fast.tried the spicy fried black carrot cake at stall #01-17, good taste cost $3.50. the iced kop at $1.70. the food centre is spacious and windy seated outer seats facing shoplots. The pork and prawn noodle soup is a must try cost $4.5 with generous ingredients and tasty soup.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Thomas Allison
review_text: What a place!!! Only three things on the menu but god, they are so good! The soup was excellent with the meatballs so tender and tasty. The spring rolls are the best I have ever had.

author: Ls Lin
review_text: You can find number of tipical local food stalls here. I tried traditional porridge with additional egg this morning, worth for value

author: Như Quỳnh
review_text: Delicious food, student-friendly prices, and lovely staff 😻😻😻

author: Andrew costa
review_text: If you’re looking for the best coffee shop in Jamaica Plain, Massachusetts, this bakery is the place to be. The breakfast here is absolutely fantastic—fresh, flavorful, and the perfect way to start your day. Their pastries are hands down the best in Jamaica Plain, with every bite tasting homemade and baked to perfection. What really sets this spot apart is the people. The owner, Charlie, is truly a diamond in the rough—down-to-earth, welcoming, and passionate about what he does. The staff reflects the same warmth and friendliness, making every visit feel special. One of my favorite parts about this Jamaica Plain bakery and café is the cozy spot in the back where you can sit down with your coffee, relax, and enjoy the atmosphere. It’s a wonderful hidden gem in the neighborhood, perfect for breakfast, coffee dates, or just a quiet moment with a pastry and a latte. I highly recommend this bakery to anyone in or around Jamaica Plain. Whether you’re local or just visiting, make sure to stop in—you’ll be glad you did!

author: Jake Poteat
review_text: Beautiful restaurant and terrific food. We had the grouper special, the fried herbal pork, the panang beef curry, the crispy pork papaya salad, the cabbage and chicken, and the and the egg stew with tofu and pork. We also tried a couple desserts. Everything was phenomenal. The staff and owner are so friendly and attentive. We will be back ASAP!

author: Ashley C
review_text: We finally got to try Humo barbecue and it did not disappoint. Their concept is a fusion of Mexican and American barbecue. If you’re a meat lover, this is your place! We ordered the half rack, mouthwatering ribs, Barbacoa tacos, sliced brisket, half roasted chicken, and an order of fries. Our favorite were the ribs and tacos. The prices were great, the service was fabulous!

author: Novita Wu
review_text: Great Indonesian Food, few options for vegetarians. Great for big groups as they offer many tables and chairs. Food quality is good too. Service for prepping the food takes sometimes as they are serving large groups of people. Atmosphere is pretty noisy as many people gathered around. The restaurant is pretty aesthetics. I went on Sunday, so that’s when family gatherings are held.

author: Peter Gruber
review_text: Great German food. With an old world atmosphere. The workers are wonderful and explain anything on the menu including what type of beer they serve. The food is excellent. Try the Jaeger schnitzel. And for desert the apple strudel is a good choice.

author: Wing you Tsang
review_text: The owner is so friendly and they have such a great service and the food is so delicious.

author: Jenny Shin
review_text: We visited as a group of three — two women (Two women who usually have small appetites) and one man — and ordered the steak for two, baked potato, tomato and onion, and spinach. The portions were generous, and we left feeling very full and satisfied. Our reservation was for 5:45 PM on a Tuesday evening. Although getting to the restaurant during rush hour from Manhattan was a bit challenging and the location was somewhat unusual, it was absolutely worth it. It was the best steak I’ve ever had, and the high price felt completely justified. Everything we ordered was delicious, and the place was quite busy. I would definitely visit again.

author: Vicki L
review_text: I have tried Cane’s at Las Vegas. The decorations are completely different from this Boston Cane’s. Both are about LOVE. The chicken tenders are for sure very tender and fresh.
