Their Cane’s sauce is the best. Check if they give it to you. It’s a must-have. The crinkle fries are average. The cole slaw is very smooth. The bread is very soft. Next time I’ll try their chicken sandwich. Staff are efficient. It’s extremely crowded but you get your food very fast. 5 stars.

author: Jaie Mo
review_text: The food is awesome here I actually met the new owner and I also met the former owners wife they were real nice. Customer service was awesome and on top of that the food was great. I ordered a pastrami sandwich which was very delicious, if you haven’t been there, what are you waiting for? It’s great.

author: Leon Yip
review_text: We had a truly delightful dining experience at your establishment. The food was exceptionally well-prepared and delicious. Furthermore, the staff members were remarkably friendly and attentive throughout our visit. We especially appreciated the thoughtful touch of providing a candle for our cake. Thank you for making our celebration so special.

author: Sohail Mohammed
review_text: Wonderful start to my day. One of the more elegant and relaxing cafes in the bay. Cappuccino hit the spot. First time tasting a charcoal latte. It was surprisingly tasty and gorgeous looking. Will be sure to visit again.

author: Serene Gan
review_text: Being their customer for years, service drop. 5pax then expect 1 of us to sit at the stool and share the table. Their Michelin stars is just for show, especially they just to earn more $ at lunch crowd. 4 dishes took 40min to serve, one by one. Food are yummy but the service already spoil the business. Noisy at lunch hours. Another restaurant down the road is much better and even have 10% discount when spend more than $80.

author: Juaquin Gerton-Henderson
review_text: Went here two nights ago and have to say it’s one of the best places we’ve found. All the flights of stairs were most definitely worth it. We arrived and got seated in a waiting area as we didn’t have a reservation. It was no more than 2 minutes that we had to wait to be seated at a table. Ordered and the food was fantastic. Me and my friend who went were trying to eat on a budget and we found the cheaper items to be on the leg pages. Less fancy but still very good. Great portion great taste, great flavours. The atmosphere was the best part in my opinion, perched on a roof top overlooking the tops of some of the Saigon buildings. We went on a Friday night and it was bustling…but not overpoweringly loud. Overall great experience, would highly recommend if your around the area.

author: Mr Yeo
review_text: We came on a rainy Sunday. We ordered the lamb soup. This place is famous for their lamb and soup. Special thanks to Wei yang yang for the awesome service. PS: previously they didn’t have the ice cream machine and now they have it. Nice desert after the meal.

author: KG
review_text: This review has been a long time coming and it’s totally well deserved. I’ve been a loyal fan of Ruen Pair for over a decade now, ever since my Laotian friends from San Diego first introduced me to this gem of an authentic Thai spot. I don’t get to come here as often as I’d like since it’s kind of a trek from where I live, but best believe I make a stop every time I’m in LA. The food here is always on point, super consistent and packed with legit flavors that you just don’t get from your typical Americanized Thai restaurants. One quick way to tell it’s the real deal? Just look around at the crowd it says a lot about the kind of market this place caters to. This visit, we kept it classic. We started with the plain papaya salad you can’t go wrong with this dish. It’s super popular for a reason with generous portions and that perfect sweet-tangy-salty combo that sends me straight to Cloud 9. Next up was the Morning Glory, which is a must-have for me. It’s a simple vegetarian dish, but so flavorful and fresh. And to round it out, we got the Pad Woon Sen with shrimp balanced, tasty, and not heavy at all. It hits just right. If you’re in LA and find yourself near Thai Town, definitely make the stop. And trust me on this just pay for valet. Save yourself the parking stress. It’s worth it.

author: ena nieto
review_text: This guys did not send me my orders right they send me leftovers I was missing chicken wigs and the fries were nasty and cold also the wings I want my money back but they won’t answer me back

author: Melissa Sheehan
review_text: Vegan-friendly! The menu had multiple vegan options available. Portions are massive. I had the tofu scramble which was just OK - wish it had more developed flavor. I could taste the spices, but something was missing. My partner had the sausage omelet and enjoyed it. The interior is very cute and well-decorated. There is seating outdoors as well. The parking lot is right before the building and can be easily missed.

author: Miguel Diaz
review_text: Was feeling like a burrito never had a burrito from Bobos and let me tell you the are super pack with meat and flavor they don't hold back 5 out 5 try their burritos I believe they only carry asada and chicken but asada was delicious

author: Jackie Vanegas
review_text: Incredible meal with incredible services. My partner and I went here to celebrate some of our professional successes that’s happened within the last couple of weeks. Upon finding out, our waiter and the rest of the team presented us with a lovely chocolate cake on the house. The Tomahawk for 2 was incredible and he brought home plenty of leftovers with us. The flavor of the steak and the temperature was perfect and each bite had such an amazing flavor. We thoroughly enjoyed the service in where they explained to us each part of the tomahawk and cut it by the table. We enjoyed it so much and cannot wait to come back.

author: IamGloria Louis
review_text: I absolutely love coming here . I’ve been coming here for about 3 years and the service here is amazing . Carolina de Hyde park is such an amazing server ! Very welcoming and kind . You will not regret coming here .

author: ANA BEL V
review_text: The waiter has an awesome attitude and always smiling. The margaritas had NO alcohol taste whatsoever (not worth the price). A 500ml bottle water was $4.79???? DON'T get the bottles water.

author: Venus Chiam
review_text: Lots of classic Malaysian dishes, plus some limited-edition snacks. I really love the newly launched Purple Sweet Potato Taro Pineapple Bun 💜. The egg tarts, coffee, and nasi lemak are also must-tries. Crowded with tourists, so expect a queue. Souvenirs available too.

author: enrique mendoza
review_text: Great small family-owned burger place with friendly staff. Food is delicious

author: Sharryn Gedeon
review_text: Great ambiance and staff is lovely. The owner Caroline definitely invests in their property and staff. Place is always clean and inviting. Food beautifully presented and love the music! I definitely will be back!

author: alex kelly
review_text: Food was absolutely delicious and the staff were amazing. Specifically Hera! She went above and beyond helped show us how to eat roll the Banh Xeo! Would highly recommend if you're traveling to Ho Chi Minh.

author: Zaza Md Taat
review_text: Decided to give this plate of char kway teow goodness a try. It's pretty ok-nice, but not in a way tat one shd travel all the way to B.Merah just to try this out (leave that to me heh). Their plate of CKT uses dark sauce which i dont normally like, coz im used to mum's versh which is a brown-pedas2 sauce. I rarely buy CKT outside & if i do, it'll be beef CKT. Their cockles are not big, pretty small really & i alrdy asked for extra but it's not really visible unless u start eating into it. Fast service, clean stall, overall clean hawker ctr.

author: Eric Cruz
review_text: Legend. That’s the best word to describe this place. I’ve been coming here since 1996 when they first opened and this place has become an LA institution for Thai food. Been to Thailand over 25x and this place is bonafide legit. Love how humble they remained even with the lines. They recently opened one of the best ice cream shops in the USA. This and Sanamluang down the street are my go to’s in Thai Town.

author: Yuhng Yeap
review_text: Amazing dimsum place, definitely not overhyped. There's still quite a queue even at 10am. You order by taking a table number and a tray from the stuff, and pick any dimsum you want from their wide range of selection. They will steam it and sent it to your table. They have multiple stores with seating area around the block, some seatings stores are opposite the road. They also have a bakkutteh store which I highly recommend to give it a try. The soup is a bit different from what we usually have in Malaysia, but still very delicious. Best part is definitely their pork cuts inside, super tender and soft, literally melts in your mouth. Highly recommend getting more of their Thai specialty dimsum instead of classic ones you usually see in Malaysia for a more unique experience. Some highlights includes the steam cob and meat dimsum, various types of siewmai, and glutinous rice chicken. Their har gao is a flop tho, dry and tasteless, can skip it. Recommended.

author: Brian Bush
review_text: Beautiful view. Food was good. Good menu. Bartenders/servers were great. Very small inside. There is outdoor seating as well.

author: Solomon Clarke
review_text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Great experience at Delicias Colombianas! The food was delicious and Carolina gave excellent service — friendly, attentive, and fun to chat with. Looking forward to coming back!

author: Jimmy Wah
review_text: The best in Penang. Crispy, fresh pork fillet which is excellent. Soup is flavorful. Rice is on point. Staff is friendly too. Sometimes queue can be intimidating but it’s worth the wait. Been here many times and food is consistently good.

author: Heather Pontius
review_text: Amazing food. Little bit of a weird seating area but its meant for take out. Excellent burger.

author: Carlos Morales
review_text: so i tried these before and my order was sent via ubereats wrong when they just opened. today i went in person the guy at the register was nice, great service and they got my order right(still wasnt too familar with the menu might i add) but out of all places ive ordered lemon pepper wings this seemed to be the worst. usually in other spots the u can taste the lemon pepper in each bite. it just tasted bland and i threw out half my order. the fries were good tho but for a wing spot i would expect better wings. kinda regret giving this place a second chance. i did however love the drink. tasted different in a good way and not too sugary. but unfortunately im not returning for wings ever again.

author: Manon Bruynel
review_text: Food and drink here are very average compared to the rest of the resort. Personally I felt Rock Bar overall was overrated. It was chaotic where we were with lots of people trying to get photos with the view and others smoking at tables nearby which we couldn’t get away from. None of the food or drink we ordered lived up to our expectations and was all very so so, the dinner menu food looked like it probably tasted better. Glad we tried it as we were staying at Ayana but feel I would have been disappointed if I had come from further away.

author: Henry Tran
review_text: Food: Southern-ish style pho. It's good food if you're looking for some casual eats, but it doesn't taste like pho! However, the Chinese food is GOOD. 3 stars for Pho, 5 stars for Chinese food. Service: Caters to introverts. You order from a QR code. Atmosphere: It's clean, but it's giving 2010's chipotle. Feels dead and sterile.

author: Emily Tan
review_text: KIRV is an amazing server. Welcoming, polite, friendly, comfortable. We came here for a birthday celebration. They prepared a candle and played the birthday song. The handmade pasta was fresh. Pizza bread was fluffy and nicely burnt. We sat in the air conditioned area so it was nice and cooling. The outdoor seating looks nice too. Great vibes. Quality food. Strong cocktails. 1 for 1 daily 4-7pm. Worth it.

author: WILLIE MONTOYA
review_text: I’ve come here a few times. The first time was amazing. An asian lady helped us and went above and beyond. The last 2 times there’s been some 2 Hispanic ladies, vey bad service. Feels like they don’t care for customers. They a while to get us menus and I don’t like the way they talk to us. There tone is very aggressive. They are loud with their comments. Today they were taking about a customer not leaving tip. How they shouldn’t dine if they have no $ for tip. I’m sure it was their bad service that got them $0 tip. Food is always good. Environment can be better. Customer service needs to improve. Where’s the Asian lady and Asian cook, we miss them. I don’t think I will tip some arrogant ladies.

author: Joanne J
review_text: Balinese and tourist alike says they're amazing. I personally thinks it's okay/normal. I don't understand what'l the hype is about 😅 maybe I expect too much. I liked the pork crackling (usually there's this so I'm guessing it was that) and soup compared to another one I tried though. Its pricey at 104k for one person with drink. Another babi gulung local I tried was only like 25/30k per person. But that was outside of town so... The location was strategic right beside the palace. Can sit down while people watching.

author: Cameron Weeks
review_text: Good Persian spot in East Williamsburg with tough to get reservations. The bread and dips/sauces were probably our favorite items but everything was delicious. The kebab plate was also more plentiful than we were expecting and tasty.

author: Shareen Fatima
review_text: Chanced upon this place coincidentally while out and about. It’s a deli that also sells Nepalese food. Confirmed with the cashier that the chicken is halal. Tried their combo 4 box which included 5 pieces of chicken momos and a side of vege chow mein. The momos were fresh with the right amount of spicy. They give a side of sauce and spicy chutney to go with it for extra kick. Price is good for the amount of food you get. Do visit if you enjoy momos, I know I’m definitely going back for more :)

author: Paola Nevarez
review_text: My family and I have been coming here for years & it has really gone down hill. The service is terrible. The lady cooking the steaks today 9/16/25, has a serious attitude and turns out to be the manager. Our server was nice but didn't even come around to refill our drinks or take our plates until we asked. The restrooms are beyond disgusting! They are covered in dust & and just filthy. You can tell they haven't been cleaned in weeks. The Henderson location is definitely better.

author: liping cheng
review_text: Located at an inconspicuous corner of Changi Airport Terminal 1, this food court / canteen hosts a wide variety of food. Mala here is 1 of the hot favourites among the airport staff. A special mention goes to the last stall at the far L-corner that sells kuehs. There, sells a heavenly peanut pancake that has crunchy peanuts and fluffy chewy pancake!

author: Ilaria Mariani
review_text: Amazing variety of food and such a lively atmosphere! We went multiple times during our stay and always had a great experience—tried grilled seafood, Korean dishes, Chinese classics, and more. Every time, the food was delicious. The setting is very cozy and comfortable, with a traditional market-style vibe where you simply grab what you want from a stall and enjoy it anywhere in the hall. Outside, the street transforms into an open-air dining area in the evening, which is super nice with a great view of the city’s skyline—it’s really something special. Very much suggested if you want to enjoy authentic flavors in a unique and vibrant environment. A must-visit food destination in Singapore!

author: Pat P
review_text: We came to this new location for a late Monday lunch. Inside was very spacious and new looking, with nice heavy marble looking tables. This location has a great weekday all day special that was a better deal compared to our usual Matador order (which has gotten exponentially pricier over the years). Chicken was flavorful, and the accompanied sides were well made. Added avocado to our salads for an extra $1 which wasn’t really worth it for the small slices we got. Music at this location was better than the Jackson Heights location - more pop music and at a lower volume that still let you hear the conversations at the table. This is a great addition to the Pio Pio chain.

author: Jackee Santiago
review_text: This is a small but wonderful bakery I have to stop here every time I come to the state of New Jersey thank you

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: derek neo
review_text: A Huge hawker center with many stalls some a few with Michelin Bib. Nice airy and clean environment with ample parking around the hawker.

author: Sukha Lee
review_text: The pho soup here is very clean and rich in flavor, not greasy at all but still deeply satisfying. You can really taste how well the broth is prepared, and it feels light while still being hearty. The coconut drink was sweet and refreshing, which paired really nicely with the meal. I ordered the soup with a variety of meats, and everything was cooked perfectly. The ox tail stood out the most, it was tender, flavorful, and added a lot of depth to the broth. Overall, the restaurant is clean, the food tastes amazing, and you can tell a lot of care goes into each dish. I would definitely come back if I’m craving a comforting bowl of pho.

author: Amanda Warnars
review_text: Great place to enjoy company with friends and family! Private party in the corner was amazing! The food they provided on the buffet was delicious!!

author: Chris Parent
review_text: None of the Wahlberg brothers were there this time either... Lol! I have to ask each time I go. The food is amazing every time and staff is very patient with everyone that has the same kind of questions. Hahaha! They also sell many different kinds of franchise stuff, including shirts, hats and accessories. They have now opened different ones up all over in and out of the Country, so check em out and see what You 🤔.

author: binho Motorcycle Club
review_text: The place is very bad, terrible service. They forced us to give a tip, which was already included in the bill. I will never go back to this place again. Everything is very bad. I do not recommend it. Food: 1/5 | Service: 1/5 | Atmosphere: 1/5

author: Filip Mizerski
review_text: First time on the west coast and all I can say is I loved the food. Although just a burger and fries, it was amazing. The service was great and really fast. The restaurant is clean and there was no issues with my order. Loved it

author: E Philip F
review_text: Night cook is excellent but beware of the day cook. Last visit I ordered the House Scramble and emphasized “extra easy, almost runny” and got a plateful of rubbery extra well. Today truly the worst Eggs Benedict ever. Soggy muffin, broken sauce, and two failed attempts to produce crispy hash browns.

author: karla linares
review_text: They said there restrooms was not working and I see a worker coming out of the restrooms

author: Mrs Pittman
review_text: 1/26/24 between 630pm to 730pm and sat at the bar. The waitress was excellent and made our 1st to this location very welcoming. We would dine in again just because of the excellent service we received. I know prices are inflated but please don’t short us on the portions of our food. What was most upsetting was the lobster dip we ordered to go and it was $16.99 but what we received I believe we should’ve only paid $6.99!!!! We received more chips than dip 🤦‍♀️ The food was good but the portions didn’t weigh out for what we were charged. If you look at the menu for the lobster dip and compare to what we received, you’d be as upset as we are for how much we spent last night. Red Lobster do better please!!!!

author: Joe Murrin
review_text: Best ever taco 🌮 in Vegas Menudo is great Good price. Fast friendly service Clean establishment Staff is very nice

author: Sarah Liddell
review_text: The person who worked at the order stand on midnight on 10/25 was very patient and kind.

author: faisal alsalem
review_text: Honestly, I had high expectations after hearing so much about this place from my wife, but it turned out to be pretty underwhelming and overpriced. • Tempura was fine, nothing special. • Edamame was plain and forgettable. • Noodles were bland. • The mushroom beef bowl with truffle sounded promising but was just okay. I was really hoping for that wow factor, but it just wasn’t there. I might give it another shot to see if things improve, but as of now, it’s definitely not my first—or even second—choice.

author: Yuliia Biliak
review_text: Absolutely delicious! We had an amazing experience at this Mexican restaurant. The food was full of bold, authentic flavors and perfectly seasoned. The tacos were juicy, the sauces rich, seafood was super tasty. You can really taste the freshness of the ingredients and the care put into every dish. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, and the service was friendly and attentive. We will definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to anyone who loves great Mexican sea food! Sea scallops are hit!

author: Adam Zdeb
review_text: We love this place for the reason we were able to bring our dog 🐶 with us to eat. Verry solid food with great views on the water. The Best item we had was the Key lime pie in a jar, it was a great spin on the classic and we enjoyed it a lot. For the food it was all solid but nothing was mind-blowing. The tiki tiki chicken was juicy but the rice under needed a bit more flavor. Fish tacos were well cooked had good flavor. The fish and chips had great flavor in the batter bit just too much batter. And my fish sandwich was blackened but it was missing that blackened spice. We really liked the tuna nachos because the flavors were on point and the chips super light and crunchy.

author: Sohail Gidwani
review_text: If you are looking for an Indian restaurant near USC, this is the place you can eat from. I liked the chicken biryani, it was quite good. Don't try the indo-chinese options, it doesn't even come anywhere near to what you are expecting, at least I didn't like it personally.

author: Pilai W
review_text: From the moment we walked through the doors, the ambiance of the steakhouse set the tone for a memorable evening. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with dim lighting, rustic wood accents, and the subtle aroma of grilled meat in the air — it felt both elegant and comfortable. Our server was attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely enthusiastic about the menu. He walked us through the different cuts of steak, cooking styles, and mocktails with patience and professionalism. We started with a salad and bread— both fresh and full of flavor. But the real highlight of the evening was the steak. I ordered the ribeye, cooked medium rare, and it was absolute perfection. The crust on the outside was seared just right, locking in the juicy tenderness within. Every bite melted in my mouth. My partner had the filet mignon , and it was equally impressive — tender, rich, and perfectly seasoned. The sides — especially the garlic mashed potatoes and grilled pork chop — were the ideal complement to our meal. What stood out most was the attention to detail. Everything from the bread service to the dinner was thoughtfully prepared and beautifully presented. Even the mocktails list was extensive, with great recommendations that matched our meals perfectly. The prices were fair for the quality and portion sizes. We left feeling full, satisfied, and already planning our next visit. If you’re a steak lover or simply someone who appreciates a great dining experience, this steakhouse is a must-visit. From exceptional food and service to an inviting atmosphere, it’s truly a five-star experience from start to

author: C.J. Kendall (She Her)
review_text: This is my absolute favourite place to eat near Bui Vien / District 1. So authentic, some of the most lovely owners. Such amazing value. I never buy food in Bui Vien - go into the lanes, be adventurous- best thing I did in Vietnam. This is where the life energy of the area is.

author: LeanGuan Seow
review_text: This bustling coffee shop is a lively spot filled with a wide variety of hawker stalls, making it a great place for casual dining. Nearly half of the stalls serve Chinese cuisine, offering everything from northern to southern flavors. Among the top picks are the wantan mee with its springy noodles and savory sauce, the tender and flavorful chicken rice, and the Sarawak kolok mee—light, fragrant, and satisfying. With so many choices under one roof, it’s perfect for group dining. Affordable prices and quick service make it a favorite neighborhood go-to.

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: Ks T
review_text: Attracted to there by recommendation from internet source. Saw they won many prizes and having recognition by Michelin star. Have been told to wait for half an hour when I ordered. Perhaps initially set the expectation too high, sorry to say that the food for me was indeed, so so only... Don't really feel the difference of duck egg or difference by charcoal... Or maybe my tastebuds "degraded"?...

author: Marcus CHUA
review_text: I tried the daluok mee and fried rice noodles, both were good. I had to wait for 15-20 minutes and I had to get it myself. There were a lot of people at the stall and some of them cut in line. I don't know how the boss remembered the order of so many people. To be fair, I suggest distributing numbers, which is easiest

author: Uyển Nhi Hồ
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Great local spot with plenty of options! The food was really good — I tried the babi guling, fried banana, and sweet soup, and all were delicious. The place is beautiful, spacious, and has lots of seating. Many locals eat here, which makes it feel authentic. A must-try restaurant if you want to experience real local food in Bali! 🍽️🐷🌿

author: Kiran Hegde
review_text: The food was amazing. Fish was the person who served us. He was very kind and helpful and recommend a lot of dishes which was absolutely fabulous and delicious. Atmosphere was amazing. The staff were very polite. Would definitely recommend this place to all!!

author: B FPV (Jay)
review_text: I love this Denny's. On my global travel I ended up at the hotel next door. The breakfast here was super nice, the wifi was fast and free, and the staff were really friendly. I highly recommend this place.

author: Punto Dewa
review_text: Maxwell Hawker Centre is absolutely one of the best places to enjoy local food in Singapore. The atmosphere is lively, busy, and full of great smells from every corner. We loved it so much that we ended up coming here twice during our Singapore trip. We tried a bit of everything: Hainanese chicken rice, chili crab, chicken noodles, and a few other local dishes. Every stall had its own flavor and style, and the food was fresh, delicious, and very affordable. It’s also a great place to sit, relax, and soak in the local vibe while enjoying good food. Lots of choices, fast service, and the energy of the crowd just adds to the experience. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Singapore. We’ll definitely come back next time!

author: Wong Yeanling
review_text: The private room service is fine, it is equipped with karaoke system and a private toilet. However, they do not provide change plate service after the dish, and there is no place to put the bones after eating. The food is nice and creative presentation.

author: BePreston Nexwxw
review_text: The food was amazing – full of flavor and beautifully presented.

author: randall
review_text: Honestly quite good for kbbq! Didn't have much expectstions coming and we got the pork set. 73 bucks for 450g of meat with egg and soup. Quite worth for 2 big eaters of 3 small eaters. The meat is obviously the star here. The kimchi tina soup was so so. Steamed egg is normal as usual. Got the upgraded double cheese but honestly not that worth. Hence 4 stars for food, so stick to the meats! Service is damn good imo. Super friendly staff, even brought me for a mini tour to look see. Overall quite happy

author: Tlangelani Mkhombo
review_text: I went last week saturday around 20h00. It was quite busy but you could move around. It has a lot of markets selling Thai food from proper meals like pad thai and stir fried rice, to finger food like spring rolls and pork on a stick. They also sell fruits, some prepared and ready to eat (no fruit salads though). They also had some clothes and bags. The interesting ones were the guys with scorpions where you could take a picture for 10 baht if not buying. Vendors keep stopping you to buy from them, which is to be expected but can get annoying, but just refuse politely. Prices for food was reasonable and written, so no negotiations needed. They were playing some music but you could talk. There was a bar for drinks where you could sit down and rest and eat your food from other stalls as long as you buy something from them, too. I went for food stalls and the vibe.

author: Ngoc Anh Nguyen
review_text: The grilled food was a bit oily and felt a bit greasy. The hot pot was sweet and easy to eat, with a huge chunk of beef. The chicken feet were given as a gift. The price was not expensive and the road was easy to get to.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Pam Leonido
review_text: Amazing staff, meat selection and amount of time you can stay for this all you can eat Korean BBQ! Everything is top quality and the staff are the most respectful and kind people we met and we had a party of 12!

author: Jason Cheong
review_text: We started eating the porridge here since early 2000. Over the years the quality is still maintained and not far away. Recent years this shop is getting more and more famous. If you come at the peak time you will need to wait for 20-30mins.

author: Handy Perdana
review_text: Food is okay, cleanliness needs to improve just a tad bit. Service is top notch. My favorites are the Gurame Parape Ujung Pandang and the Es Kopi Cengkeh

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: lee on miin
review_text: My first Padang dining experience in Jakarta and it didn’t go as expected. Many wrapped dishes were placed on the table even without ordering, and while you only pay for what you open, the food we tried was too salty and completely cold. There were no price displays, so we only found out the cost at the counter, and the bill felt expensive for the small portions. We also learned only at payment that rice is free refill. Overall, it felt more like a tourist-oriented place with high pricing that didn’t match the quality.

author: Rawlins Amar
review_text: We took our friend for her 70 th birthday our experience was not very good. The server was rude rude his mannerisms not of the caliber to be a server. We had to leave the premises before something unpleasant happened. I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone neither would I return. I feel though the food has some quality and the chefs knows what they are about however the front line people need some attention. We came because we saw an add on the Google chat about the restaurant and what they do for brunch this was totally misrepresented. Nothing on the add came to past. The restaurant had nobody.

author: Jagen Manogran
review_text: Delicious food with generous portions! Service was good and the place has a nice cozy vibe. Highly recommend Rich Asian Western Food for both Asian and Western food lovers.

author: Lusman Yunarto
review_text: Never not happy when dining at Piston Ubud. Amazing service with crew always attentive and smiling. Food & drinks prepared quickly too and freshly arrived at our table. My cream brulee iced americano was salty and great fix, the yuzu cold brew was good too since I asked for the syrup separate (otherwise it'd be too sweet). Thai pork belly kailan over rice was fragrant and saucy. Loved the coriander cilantro taste and its perfect portion size. Only issue? I think price could be a bit less if I'm being honest, like 10-15% less. But with the location, setting and service I'm happy to keep coming back to Pison Ubud.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Stephen CK Kwok
review_text: Very clean place. Stock/soup is very good. Pork is tender. Vermicelli is well cooked. Condiments (shallot, onion, lemon, green chilli are all fresh). Service by boss himself is excellent 👍. I come from Singapore 🇸🇬. Do come and taste and enjoy.

author: Tiffany Roldan-Howell
review_text: My friend and I came to do a sunrise meditation for her bday and after stopped by here for breakfast. The views are amazing for sure, but what really stands out is the service. It was 8:30 am and both the servers were so nice and welcoming. The food and drinks were really good and the executive chef Vinny even came out to say hello and happy birthday to my friend. You can tell this place is has a family dynamic and that’s a lost art now and days in the restaurant industry. Would recommend this to anyone & Will definitely be coming back!

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Todd Moon
review_text: I just moved to this area and found this nice Bun Cha shop. It is a nice quiet area and has plenty of on street parking. The Bun Cha was very good and we ordered a side of egg rolls. They had a couple cats that wanted to be friends in the indoor seating area.

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: Justin Tan
review_text: December 2025: I am a Level 8 contributor (>450 reviews) on Google and regularly review eateries and experiences both in Asia and Melbourne. I saw this eatery on Instagram and decided to check it out. I ordered the signature noodle dish for 120 Baht. The outstanding items are the crispy pork, roast duck, Chinese sausage and the mushrooms. The char siew is very bland, unlike the Hong Kong/Singapore version. The pork and prawn wontans are acceptable, but I would have liked to bite into pieces of prawns. It is accessible by walking along the bridge, past exit 3, then descending to street level. Overall, it is acceptable and you can consider visiting if you are in that area.

author: Renee Salcido
review_text: We sat outside & had Juliana has our server. We loved all of our dishes & the service was great!

author: Derek H
review_text: The Qatar Airways Lounge at Singapore Changi is an exceptional pre-flight retreat that perfectly balances comfort and excellent service. The seating areas are spacious and beautifully styled, offering both quiet corners and social spaces. The food selection is great, as are the premium champagnes. Staff are warm, attentive, and a great asset to the lounge making the visit more personal and enjoyable. Special mention for Hazel and her colleagues Stary, Pinky and Montra. All exceptional and welcoming. Overall, the Qatar Airways Lounge in Singapore delivers a world-class lounge - a perfect start to your journey 👍🏼

author: Andrew Bennett
review_text: This a classic old school diner, with eggs and French toast exactly the way I love them. Thank you!

author: Harriet Cooper
review_text: Went to try this as it’s supposed to be one of the best places for Banh Mi in Hoi An. It really didn’t live up to the hype. Because it was so busy we got the barbecue pork one to take away and it was ready in a minute. The bread and filling was nice but the whole thing was cold and it wasn’t the tastiest one I’ve had since being in Vietnam.

author: Bob Smith
review_text: It’s pretty good for a Taco Bell. I’ve been here a hundred times or so and I’ve almost never or never had bad experiences. One time there was a guy eating with a cat on his shoulders. That was cool 👍

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: Zheng Yan Tan
review_text: The new branding Zhup Zhup is very apt. The soup literally tastes as good as a rich prawn zhup! So full of flavour and umami. The dry prawn mee is tossed in a fragrant chilli paste with just the right kick. The prawns are fresh and plump, the noodles have a nice springy bite, and the portion is generous. From the noodles and pork slices to the lard bits, everything comes together so well. I also ordered a sharing ngo hiang plate for fun, and it really surprised me. The tofu, prawn cracker all done nicely, tasty and super crispy as if they are specialise in ngo hiangs!

author: Ajeng AP
review_text: I ordered the plain butter croissant and the berry smoothie, both were excellent! I loved the croissant, especially. It was incredibly buttery and flavorful, with a soft inside and a perfectly crisp outside. Highly recommended!

author: Kia Sen Tan
review_text: Best Tonkatsu in town ; Be prepared to wait even on weekdays if going there during meal time. Their business are always very good since opening until now for few years already. They have so many regular, including local and foreigner alike. The food is five stars and service is very attentive ; the only drawback of the shop is probably their stuffy environment due to the reason that that protein are prepared inside the bar counter before its being serve.

author: Hope Pettengill
review_text: My sister originally had sent me a video of her trying a burger from this restaurant (I was so jealous it looked legit insane ) and then she brought us back with our family for Father’s Day. We were sat down with great service, it was rlly peaceful in there (we went during the day). Perfect place to grab lunch with family, friends or even a date. Half of us got the joint burger which speaks for itself. Just a rlly great burger. Regular burger with caramelized onions and joint sauce. I mean you can’t go wrong at all. We also got the chicken avocado club. Rlly filling and something where you just feel content after eating. Rlly good as well. Each item comes with fries that are some of the best fries I’ve had, rlly hot which is the most important for my fam and I. Great crisp as well. The owner, came up to my family and checked in with us and everyone who was sitting down at the establishment. He is a class act. Rlly down to earth, personal and great guy/ owner. Came back after a couple of minutes and gave us this fried ice cream dish, with fresh fruit, cinnamon and powdered sugar. Legit insane. Was gone in 3 min. I love this place so much. Pls go if you are considering you will not regret. I know we will be back soon that’s for sure 🔥🔥

author: S.
review_text: So this is the best buffet on this side of town. Everything is pretty tasty well the dishes I choose 😋. They have these little shrimps made with a bomb garlic sauce and they aren't over cooked not gummy but soft melts in your mouth. Rice both yellow and the brown one is my favorite with mushrooms in it not alot of them just enough for the flavor. When I ask to have something filled they don't give you no attitude they tell you how long the wait will be and bring it out in that time. Very pleasant ☺️. I do the take out plates so for 2 it cost like $30. Don't know how much buffet is but I think it's around the same price. Good eats to make the belly happy 😊

author: Steve Tham
review_text: Place is cozy and nicest decorated for Christmas. Chose the spicy crab omelette and it was tasty. The fried pork neck was a surprise as it was chewy and fragrant. Unfortunately it was served lukewarm which could be improved.

author: Jo V.
review_text: Winnie & Ethel's proved to be an excellent place to meet up for brunch with wonderful foodie friends, which makes Winnie & Ethel's even more iconic 👏🏽 One of their best features is their venue. Feeling like an expanded living and dining area in someone's home, we were seated at a good-sized long table with enough elbow room, and table space for all our plates. Check out their drink specialties! Their drink and food menus are ones to really browse through and make calculated decisions, because their selections are all appetizing 😋 Service with a smile and attentiveness from Katherine (I believe) was what any customer would love. Many thanks for making our ordering and dining experience easy. We know how stressful large groups and extremely busy weekends can be. If you haven't eaten at Winnie & Ethel's yet, make your reservation in advance. They book up for a reason. Come enjoy and experience it for yourself, and learn about its special history.

author: Jea Kim
review_text: South Asian/Middle Eastern-inspired cafe that brings a refreshing concept to JP, but its execution feels like a work in progress. Came here for breakfast and lunch this past week. On my first visit for breakfast, I opted for the pistachio butter toast and Breakfast Sammy. The toast had a promising start — the nutty richness of pistachio butter paired beautifully with fragrant rose petals. Yet, the tartness tipped the balance and made it difficult to finish without the grounding comfort of their turmeric latte. As for the Breakfast Sammy, it was a solid option. The focaccia was fine, though not my personal favorite for a sandwich base, and I found myself wishing for a more generous slather of Calabrian chili butter to elevate the flavors. I then returned with a friend for lunch and tried the Turkish-style eggs and Chicken & Rice. The Turkish eggs was essentially a deconstructed breakfast pita — jammy eggs, garlic labneh, and Aleppo pepper oil delivered on comfort but lacked a distinctive twist. Meanwhile, the Chicken & Rice offered a satisfying salad-rice bowl hybrid. The peanut ginger marinade added a nice twist, yet the dish was oddly similar to something I tasted from DIG. Overall, the cafe undoubtedly has potential, with thoughtful touches and a welcoming vibe. Not sure if I would return just for the food, but definitely a great spot to casually hang out with friends.

author: Terence Z W Lim
review_text: Wth...even jz a bowl of soup not asking for free...paying for it...also cannot...if not because I want to use cdc....I won't eat it...

author: Anonymous
review_text: This restaurant is PHENOMENAL! After reading other reviews, I decided to go here for Thanksgiving! I live in Queens, NY and went to Newark to see the movie "Sara's Oil" wanted a spot for dinner and they did not disappoint! I highly recommend and will stop by again when I'm in the neighborhood!

author: Paty
review_text: Food here is very good! First time I ordered a side of tortilla chips and a small side of guacamole. The chips were freshly made and hot and properly salty and delicious! A very huge portion too for just being a side order of chips! The guacamole was delicious and creamy. Tonight I ordered a bacon cheeseburger and it's juicy, flavorful, and a good portion size. Highly recommended and will be a repeat customer for sure !!!😊😁

author: orion sanchez
review_text: All good, except it is no 24hrs this is the third time i pass by around 4am, and im greeted with "unfortunately we are not serving any orders right now, please publish the right hours for this venue, thanks.

author: Jennifer Rios
review_text: Really enjoyed the ambiance like walking into an authentic Mexican place with beautiful decor. My mom loved the background music of her favorite singer Javier Solis. When you walk in everyone is very nice and welcoming, the waitress was nice and attentive and I over heard another young waiter taking care of a table with all ladies and one in particular was being picky and he had great customer service and allot of patience. I felt bad for him but I have to say he did a great job. Me and my mom had a good dinner, we ordered the fajitas with chicken and shrimp and it was delicious the shrimp were big and the chicken was cooked just right, it had allot of bell peppers of all 3 kinds and onions and all was very fresh. The beans and rice also very good. It was a big portion and we took leftovers home. I recommend this place and prices are good.

author: Julia Trinidad
review_text: Me and my husband saw this nice restaurant and decided to dine in. There were so many options so we ended up both getting the 3 tacos with rice and beans plate and a drink. The food came out very delicious. There are a lot of tables and very nice atmosphere. There’s plenty of parking and you can choose drive through if you need food to go. Definitely recommend trying their food.

author: Rob Gregg
review_text: Placed an order in drive thru after checking bag items were not in bag Ordered 2 apple pies & only received 1 as the other was a strawberry & creme pie Went inside to get missing items I had to stand in lobby with other customers while staff was in kitchen area having personal conversations

author: Dzaki Adzkiya
review_text: Tried the Oat Caramel Latte at GigiSusu and it was really good. The oat milk was creamy and well-balanced with the caramel—sweet but not overpowering. The coffee was smooth, not bitter, with a pleasant aftertaste. The atmosphere is cozy and aesthetic, perfect for relaxing or hanging out. Service was friendly and quick. Overall, GigiSusu is definitely a recommended spot for oat milk coffee lovers. ☕✨

author: Bill Sheehan
review_text: They don't have wait staff. You order when you come in. I am handicapped they brought me my food. They don't have a restroom. Food is great, large portions for the price and very good value. They are closed on Sunday

author: joshwin clervoix
review_text: Great food! Very comfortable and cozy intimate setting. Food comes out very fast and fresh for Rodizio and the salad bar was very good it’s like you can get an entire entree in the salad bar alone. Me and my wife had a great time only negative is the parking but I soon figured out you can park at the bank across the street.

author: Steve Sharp
review_text: Had a great breakfast sandwich with potatoes, salad and tasty coffee. Staff were very friendly and helpful Great deal for tasty food.

author: Pauline Ng
review_text: Ordered fried black carrot cake, chicken curry prata, Michelle curry puff, satay, Hock Lian Huat Prawn Cracker & Ngoh Hiang. The famous hokkien prawn bee was closed when we arrived at 5:30 pm; ate from another stall.

author: Ruth Alba
review_text: Felix Trattoria does not miss. The burrata with persimmons was unreal, fresh, creamy, and the persimmons made it feel special. And the pizza? I’m not even a pizza person, but I was obsessed. Spicy pepperoni with the perfect heat. 10/10 dinner.

author: Aneesh Dalvi
review_text: Great place to get some work done especially when it is quiet during the day or early in the morning. The iced latte and matcha latte are very good. Wifi is weak, but everything else is great.

author: justin chang
review_text: Love the ambiance of this joint. Was greeted by the doorman and they have the loveliest staff that is attentive and conscientious of your needs. I personally didn’t get a cocktail but they looked lovely as ever and was shocked to see that they had a Jasmine IPA🤤 to quench my thirst. Although, the real showstopper was the bone marrow soup that I ordered and I absolutely couldn’t get enough of the bone marrow😩 The location of this place is amazing because it is centralized and walking distance to all the iconic spots within the vicinity.

author: Johnny
review_text: Omg ! So delicious ! Everyone must come ! I am from Taiwan ! I love Vietnam food here !

author: Elyse
review_text: Small space only and full of tourists when peak dining hours. Good value for the money, but you have to queue patiently for a while. There are coffee shops nearby in case you wanna buy drinks and wait up. Dine-in order process: Get menu from a staff to write down your order>>Hand over your order to a staff and get your queue number badge>>Waiting. You will see an electrical board on wall showing the latest queue number for dine-in.

author: Cami Tussie
review_text: Had an incredible experience here - lived up to the hype based off the cappelletti alone. It is a MUST, I’ve never had a pasta experience like it before. The pizza Bianca is not a pizza, beware, it’s hot delicious bread. The ricotta and eggplant caponata we ordered with the pizza Bianca highly recommend. The tomato salad and mushroom pasta (lumache) were good, but not standouts. The tagliolini aglio olio pomodoro we wouldn’t get again (still delicious, but there’s better on the menu). Tiramisu is a MUST. Best I’ve ever had. Incredible and kind service!! Worth the stress to get a reservation

author: Camila Olivo
review_text: just went here and we tried to order 2 large pizzas for 8 people. the cashier convinced us to order 2 XL (which was not on the menu btw) since there was 8 of us and claimed it was bigger. so we also ordered 7 soda cans. my dad ordered it and paid $100 he tapped his card and was confused about tho when he came back to the table and showed us the receipt we were confused cause one L is 14.99 all cheese and 19.99 for L pepperoni. so how did an 2 XL come out to $100?? when we asked they told us that ONE XL PIE IS $40 and that all the drinks were $21. then on top of that they got it wrong and gave us 2 pepperonis instead of one cheese one pepperoni… just unclear prices and when we tried to tell them about the error they tried to tell us that the XL 2 inches bigger so for two inches the price goes from $20 to $40 DOUBLE THE PRICE. another customer sitting there showed us his L pizza and it looked like the same size as our “XL” btw and XL has 8 slices just like a large. very unprofessional and unclear prices. and the pizza wasnt even that good when you picked up the slices they were not crispy and were floppy

author: hazem ght
review_text: Idk , the price doest match the quantity, the said the meal cost 128 for 5 to 6 person , the rice is bearly enough for 1 person , highly not recommended to come

author: Lim Lim
review_text: The pandan snack tasted good, but the other item with coconut filling was too sweet. I visited on Saturday morning around 11am, and unfortunately, the young lady serving showed a poor attitude, seemed unhappy to answer questions, and even got my order wrong.

author: Azaria Primo
review_text: I’ve been wanting to eat these meals ever since I was kid watching master chef and they did NOT disappoint!!!! Every single dish was a 10/10. I had the caeser salad, lobster risotto, petite beef Wellington and sticky toffee pudding. They have a very affordable lunch option where you can get two courses for $25 and 3 for $34 I think which has the dessert in it. That sticky toffee pudding was AMAZING. This place is really good !! And my waiter Alex Morel was so attentive and very knowledgeable about the menu. Alex gets a 10/10 as well. Great service and great food!

author: William Tan
review_text: This noodle place has been known for many years for the long Queues and waiting time. I waited for 45mins with at least 15ppl in front on a PH afternoon. So be prepared to wait. When the noodle is prepared, I must say it smells wonderful with the right amount of chilli and vinegar to complement the flavour. Springy and well seasoned and well greased! Yes…! It is filled with pork oil and lards (not for the faint hearted) Eat mouthful is pack with flavour in my dried version. The soup filled with mince pork, garlic and meat dumpling is equally wonderful. Had a bowl of fish ball soup and it tasted okay. Guess that is not their forte. A wonderful bowl of “old school” (100yrs plus) heritage noodle as claimed. Will just hope the wait is shorter or at least used a numbering system to let us seat and wait….. Parking is available but limited, so do have to wait for a while. Near the train station so that’s a plus. Spacious seating area and well ventilated! Wheelchairs are accessible with slight ramp but mostly flat grounds. Compare to the famous Bedok competitor… hands down a winner here! P/s: maybe it’s just me but don’t down all the delicious soup as I had to flush down a lot of water after which. Hint hint…

author: Alex
review_text: We came here for the CNY set reunion dinner. Food is average only. The steam fish has a foul smell and in the end it was only replaced by fried chicken wings which is not worth the money we paid for the set dinner. I would rather they refund us the money for the steam fish rather than replacing it with some cheap dish. Will not come back here again for their set dinner. There are cheaper and better tasting options elsewhere.

author: Elvi Thio
review_text: THE SNACKS ARE 10s ACROSS THE BOARD!! Must-order Snacks (1 a person): Woodfired baby squid Foie gras parfait Tokusen wagyu beef tartare PLUS Order the Mixto Ceviche!! Creamy. Snacks also Yummy but not necessary: Duck empanada Chicken skewer Mains were just okay, good but not the same caliber as the snacks. 1 Yellowfin Tuna 1 Char-grilled Octopus 1 Woodfired chicken I also loved the Potato Mille Feuille, but I love potato so maybe a bit biased.

author: Mike G
review_text: Incredible ceviche, probably the best I’ve had in the US, and with very generous portions. Make sure to ask for spicy sauce — really brings the food to the next level. This place is a rare find of delicious authentic cooking, large portions, and very reasonable prices. Will definitely be coming back soon to try the rest of the menu.

author: Manaschanok Buanark
review_text: We absolutely love Pho Viet Nam!!! This particular meal marked my very first time experiencing the authentic dish right here in Vietnam, and it was unforgettable. I was especially impressed by the soup, as I had ordered the hot pot style. The beautiful thing about the hot pot is that the broth remained consistently piping hot throughout, allowing me to cook the meat precisely to my preferred doneness—a perfect, personalized experience.

author: Yeoh Ts
review_text: The sauce in the “Dai Luk Mee” hides the boss’s secret recipe, featuring crispy pork lard that adds amazing depth. Served steaming hot, it’s truly unforgettable. The fried crispy noodles are delicious, and the “Da Ban” comes in both dry and wet versions. Even though it’s crowded, the service is surprisingly fast, and the boss is very friendly.

author: Emma Betts
review_text: Our tour guide recommended this spot, and my husband was not disappointed. As you can see, the bánh mì was so good it was lifted into the air like Simba on Pride Rock. 10/10 moment, 10/10 sandwich.

author: isey cherr
review_text: Deens Maju definitely serves one of the best nasi kandar I’ve had so far (both me and my wife agree!). The taste is perfectly balanced – not too spicy, not too sweet, just right. Came on a weekday and didn’t have to wait long. Parking is convenient too, just across the street at the private car park. If you’re a fried chicken lover, my advice is to take extra – it’s really tasty! The sotong is also top notch. Service is fast and efficient, and cleanliness is well maintained. Overall, a must-visit nasi kandar spot in Penang! 😄

author: YAGIZ “CollageUSA Drive”
review_text: waitress was rude, chicken wasn't cooked enough (its risky for health), only good thing about restaurant was atmosphere but I pay for eaiting not atmosphere so 1 star only

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Amie Yg
review_text: The food is delicious and the prices are reasonable. The menu has Thai and English options and there are many choices. I was pleasantly surprised by this restaurant.

author: Mika'ele Keni'
review_text: Great place to hang out and enjoy a variety of different cuisines, desserts and drinks. Can't forget about the live music as well

author: Chng Philip
review_text: The worst minced pork noodles in town. The cook at 0520am not interested in cooking. Wanted A but given otherwise!! Buy from this stall at your own risk. In the end, I throw away the entire bowl of noodles away which was so soft!! Thank u for making breakfast a wonderful one.

author: Agnes “ManKiller” Sem
review_text: First time here to try out this lala pot. I would prefer if their fried garlic is freshly made instead, that will level up the soup though. If they fried the lapa on the spot will be great but i heard from one coffeeshop lala pot boss told me in sg not allow to stir fry on the spot in public, i am unsure abt the rules .

author: allison thornton
review_text: Got the chili momo. So good! Clean flavors, perfectly fried momo; the tomato chili based sauce balanced with diced sweet onions and red and green peppers, not over sauced, not oily. Packaged tight so nothing spilled into the paper takeout bag. Included in my bag was a cup of a lighter tomato-based sauce and another of a chili paste at the spice level of fresh wasabi. I’m new to this food/dish, and this restaurant, and now after one dish I’m a fan. I thought it may of been pricy, but there’s maybe 8-10 momo in the serving. One of the women told me about the 3-5pm ‘happy hour’ with lower prices. The menu on the wall is a lil different from the website, is different from Google. Meh. It was a lil frustrating til I arrived then I got it. It’s a neighborhood spot; you instantly feel the warmth when u enter. It feels like a family dining room inside an abandoned bodega, and I would totally invite some friends and eat there. There’s a great Mom Energy coming from the ladies in there, and that energy is also in the food. I’m going back. At whatever time of day. I ate it all. Maybe next time I’ll share.

author: Vu Tran
review_text: A place worth visiting and enjoying exotic Asian food. The exotic food is delicious, the service is attentive, the atmosphere is moderate and not too noisy. Will come back next time, and recommend this place to friends.

author: B
review_text: I miss the sweet guy who used to work the window. The guy there now is so serious lol. But anyway the food is great as always. Very consistent taste. It’s nice to see the upgrades and outside seating that has been installed. The prices are slowly creeping up like everything else. Last time I came it was $15 a box now it’s about $18 out the door =| but it’s worth it for the craving. I always get the half chicken over fries extra wet. The burgers and other menu items are good too but I come for that ! Very unique flavor that you can’t really get any where else! Very friendly service. Very fast service. Even when there’s a line. Would recommend !

author: Sheue Lin Ng
review_text: I love the soya sauce based hor fun (order dry instead of soup). The texture of the noodles were soft and it absorbed the taste very well. Next, the pork ball was delicious too. The bean sprouts were crunchy and tasted sweet. The chicken was delicious but I think the person did not know how to chop the chicken nicely. The angle and the shape doesn't confirm to the normal on how chicken should be chopped! The chicken feet cold dish was ok only. Will skip this for sure!!

author: Henry Tan
review_text: Very reasonably priced and delicious dim sum in Hat Yai, definitely a must-go location 🫖🥢

author: Nina Brooks
review_text: Scott and Andres were absolutely amazing my husband brought me here for my birthday and the food was delicious! We ordered the whole fried snapper it was very impressive in presentation! The spicy margarita was perfection! We had white chocolate raspberry cheesecake for dessert. The ambience a music and history of the restaurant is wonderful. We will definitely be back!

author: Edonore
review_text: Loved the vibe at Bobe Kitchen & Bakery. The black coffee hit just right — smooth and strong, without being too bitter. Tried the “Dubai Style” croissant and some Danish pastries and everything tasted incredibly fresh and flavorful. Sandra, who was working that day, was the sweetest. Super kind and attentive. Definitely one of those little spots you remember. 🥰

author: Elmer Hernandez
review_text: The young cashier gets mad for any little thing, and I asked for a ln order of toast she wanted to charge me $10 . And she told me go to sleep

author: Kok Hoong Lee
review_text: 6th January 2024 Visit Hatyai after 9 long months. Decided to have breakfast at Cook Chai Dim Sum together with my Thailand friend. The dim sum isn't too bad but slightly salty for the chicken leg and pork rib. Surprisingly, the Bak Kut Teh improved a lot compared to my previous visit. 8th March 2023 Once again, I went back to try other varieties and Bak Kut Teh. Overall, all the items that I ordered were acceptable, and the price is reasonable. 5th February 2023 My first visit to this Dim Sum restaurant in Hat Yai. All the items that I ordered were acceptable but not fantastic. However, I think the price is very reasonable for the amount of food that I ordered. (7 items, 1 coffee, and 1 pot of Chinese tea for 186 bahts).

author: Tuân Nguyễn
review_text: The space is airy and comfortable, the food suits my taste, and the owner is friendly and enthusiastic.

author: T.
review_text: Authentic Nigeria food absolutely delicious. Lagos is right here.

author: Grace Chizawsky
review_text: The best açaí bowl I’ve ever had! Everything about this bowl was perfection. The açaí base was thick, smooth, and packed with flavour — not watery like some places. The fruit was unbelievably fresh, the granola perfectly crunchy, and the toppings beautifully arranged (just look at that presentation 😍). Every bite tasted like pure tropical bliss! Service was also amazing — super friendly staff who made sure everything came out quickly and with a smile. This bowl was honestly to die for!

author: Nothing Impossible
review_text: We went to the Oon Kee without air-cond. There were two shops with the same name. Smooth steamed chicken, with enough flavour. But lacking sesame oil taste. And they didn't provide ginger sauce as condiment. The chili sauce was spicy and love the taste. The plump, short taugeh was crunchy and flavoured with sesame oil, soy sauce and black pepper. Love it. The flavour of the rice was tasty., just too soft.

author: Sing Lim
review_text: I used to come to this hawker when it was in the other location until I found it again recently. So, I decided to come and try it out. I came early as it was reported that the queue can be very long. I was here at around 11 a.m., and there's already about 6 people in front of me. But the queue moved fast so I didn't have to wait for too long. I ordered the mee pok dry and a bowl of fish balls soup. The noodles come with a bowl of dumpling soup and minced pork. The noodles were cooked very well, and it went well with the soup. The fish balls were fresh and bouncy. Overall, I would have to say that i enjoyed it very much and I would probably come back again. But it is still not at the top of my favorite BCM.

author: eee che
review_text: Touristy spot for its iconic Bean Sprout and Chicken Rice. My Ipoh friend recommended here instead of the opposite side Old Wong chicken rice for it’s chicken rice. Trust the locals taste buds. Chicken: these are local breed chicken instead of industrial chicken. Industrial chicken are meaty but lack firmness and tender. The chicken here are silky and smooth 👍 even the breast meat are tender. Bean Sprouts: Fat bean sprouts give the crunchy bite and you don’t feel the raw bean sprout taste. Fish ball soup: the fish ball are freshly hand made mackerel pike fish. No fishy taste 👅 Rice is cooked with chicken broth plus pandan leaves. Without the garlic taste as eating in Singapore. Rather go with the hor fun. Chilli sauce for the chicken rice is sweet and little spicy. You noticed there are chilli padi provided on the side. A bit pricey for locals but quality wise is worth it. 😊

author: Scarlet Newman
review_text: It was a sunny Saturday and we decided to seek out a spot for an afternoon lunch with a water view. We decided on Mission Rock and were happy to find parking pretty easily and got seated upstairs. So far so good. My friend tried a mimosa made with grapefruit juice while I stuck with water. We ordered the ceviche to share. I had the mussels and fries and my friend had a burger with fries. The mimosa was only average as it was difficult to discern the flavors of the grapefruit juice or the bubbly, which I believe was Prosecco. The ceviche was sadly served with either fried flour tortillas or wonton strips. They were so stale it was hard to tell. The ceviche itself lacked citrus and could’ve used a bit more salt. Unfortunately, it was very difficult to get the attention of the server to ask for more lime. Inexplicably, they serve the mussels and fries in the same dish. So my request for crispy fries was overwritten by the fact that they were soaking in the mussel cooking sauce. The mussels themselves were OK although I had to discard three or four. The burger looked really delicious, but my eating partner was underwhelmed with the flavor of the overcooked beef and the size of the patty. The fries were served in a cone shaped dish and were nestled in a sheet of paper. We both laughed when we realized that the paper was an old menu that had been cut up. Not very appetizing to think that the food you are eating has been sitting on an old menu that who knows how many people have touched.

author: Dee Jay
review_text: First time visiting and one thing to know! Join the waitlist before you actually get here!! We didn’t know and waited two hours 🥲But the food didn’t disappoint me. We tried their laksa noodle, chicken curry, Kaya butter toast and roti! Everything was on point and delicious! I love their Kaya and Butter toast. It’s so simple but so flavorful ❤️

author: Monica Nieto
review_text: Delicious Spanish food and great selection of tapas! Make sure you order the grilled oysters.

author: Ai Nuraidah
review_text: I ordered nasi goreng pedas, tofu, kailan stir fry, all the food are nice The service was ok, we didn’t wait for so long to get our food .

author: T Sp
review_text: Must came earlier to this restaurant, or else u had to wait in queue! Always loved their cuisine, the taste was delicious & authentic. Southern style braised pork was so flavorful. The gravy was incredible nice. Every dishes were thumb up! Superb

author: Red Eve
review_text: Had their famous signature 'Kai See Hor Fun' and was certainly worth the wait. The noodles were soft and silky while the broth was rich with flavour. One of the best that I've tried in Ipoh. The curry noodles were average while the Chee Cheong Fun was below standard. Next round I'll just order the 'Kai See Hor Fun'. Do note that they are closed on Mondays and Tuesdays and waiting is definitely a must.

author: Ebony Anderson
review_text: Walked in to an open environment with great music. She was already busy with customers but instantly greeted us. We ordered the baby boil, veggie loaded potato, and strawberry shortcake grapes. Words can’t describe how delicious everything was. If we take her back to Ohio, we would!

author: Dave
review_text: We selected this lovely looking restaurant from Google maps: it was just a short walk from our hotel (The Hilton Grande Asoke) and had very good reviews. Oranuch is run by Aunty Ying (she greeted us as we arrived at the restaurant) and their website states "… at Oranuch, we don't serve Thai cuisine, we serve her cuisine." It's a lovely looking restaurant and beautifully decorated inside. We loved the menu and it took us a while to choose our dishes. We started with a couple of cocktails, one of which arrived wonderfully fuming with dry ice: - Siam Passion: Grand Cabaret Hendrick's Gin, Passionfruit Puree, Honey, Basil Leave, Elderflower We then shared a plate of: - Hokkaido Scallop Sashimi with Spicy Sauce Followed by: - Ribeye Beef with Basil - Stir-fried Eggplant with Minced Pork & Salted Fish - Pad Thai with Shrimp The cocktails were beautifully presented and tasted so good. The sashimi was wonderfully fresh and delicious. The beef, aubergine and pad Thai were also well presented and full of flavour. What a delicious meal! We'll definitely be back! (Also posted to my food blog on Instagram @AbbeyKing16)

author: Zul Shinoda
review_text: About Deens Maju Nasi Kandar is a must-visit destination for anyone looking to experience authentic Penang cuisine. Located on Jalan Gurdwara in George Town, this popular eatery is known for serving some of the best nasi kandar on the island. Situated just a short distance from the bustling Komtar area, Deens Maju is conveniently accessible for both locals and tourists exploring the vibrant streets of Penang. Nasi kandar, a dish rooted in Penang's culinary heritage, is a flavorful rice meal served with a variety of curries and side dishes. Deens Maju has earned a stellar reputation for its perfectly spiced curries, tender meats, and generous portions. The restaurant is particularly famous for its fried chicken, which is crispy on the outside and succulent on the inside, as well as its rich, aromatic curry sauces that complement the rice and sides beautifully.

author: Chun Wong
review_text: Best pho in Vietnam! Friendly staff too, would definitely come back next time I'm back.

author: Randa Gozum
review_text: We've been here a few times and always have had wonderful experiences. Our server, Francisco was excellent! Fun vibes by the water, great food, lots of photo ops. Definitely need to check it out!

author: John Mclaughlin
review_text: Amazing group of people at this restraunt. We had a big group event and the staff blew away our expectations.

author: Lori Shubert
review_text: Brush up on your Spanish. I could not communicate my order. It was missing black beans, avocado and plantains. No one was helpful. One girl tossed an unsliced avocado in a cup and placed it on the counter. No eye contact or conversation. Too much work to get back in line for missing items in my meal. I usually stop here when back and forth from kw. Last stop for me. Customer experience should always come first 👋

author: Kaewjai Nacaskul
review_text: Menu looks appetizing. Only a few metres walk from my gym. I'm here for lunch but looks like a lot of actions at night.

author: Boo Cooper
review_text: Came here three times during our trip to HCMC and it was some of the best western food we’ve had! Staff are so lovely and kind too!

author: SavyLA
review_text: Best experience here at this location. Awesome service. Awesome employees. Will be “my spot” when I’m around this area.

author: christinya ware
review_text: Super disappointed definitely with spending almost $100 on 2meals. Oxtails were hard and burnt. Mac n cheese was good , greens had no taste. If you get a “baked potato” please be advised that it’s not an actual baked potato. It’s a potato cut into chunks that is not all the way cooked I was so sad in this whole experience because y'all hyped this place up way too much for it to taste like what I received.

author: Roberto C. Michue
review_text: As peruvian you are expected to eat delicious, but unfortunately this Pio Pio location is serving americanized food, it means no salt, no pepper, no tartara (for the jalea) and even the chili has no flavor at all. I am really disappointed, i have been fan of Pio Pio locations around NYC and this one is not recommendable at all. The only good thing about this location are the drinks, the bartender was very kind and helpful. God bless you my friend from Uruguay! NOT EVEN THE WAITERS WERE HELPFUL. If you really want to try real peruvian food, DO NOT COME HERE, YOU ARE WARNED! you will thank me later.

author: Diana Ramirez
review_text: I love this place with all my heart idk what I would do without. I'm pregnant and Everytime I get a strong craving for plain white jasmine rice and I buy from this place everyday so convenient now I don't have to cook lol I also love their fried chicken it's the absolute BEST and my fave side is their vegetable rolls they're sooooo yummy I could eat 10! Also, the servers/cashiers are so nice make me feel comfortable and they don't judge or look at me funny. If I could give this place 1,000 stars I would 🤩

author: Ernest Energy
review_text: Very rude and slow service. The drive-thru is advertised as 24/7, but I was told they close at 4am even though I ordered before that. I had a card issue and the employee told me to drive around. When I came back, I was told the drawer was closed and they couldn’t take my order. Extremely poor customer service and a huge waste of time.

author: Mohammad Naimur Rahman
review_text: Went to this place for try the pizza as I heard is very popular. Sometime you have to wait in line to order. I tried two of their popular pizzas. The food was ready with in 20 mins. The pizza taste was really good. Also after finishing the pizza tired the ice cream too. The food was really good. Highly recommended 👍.

author: James Smith
review_text: Boston Shawarma is one of the best spots in town! The food is always fresh, flavorful, and perfectly seasoned. The chicken shawarma wrap is my favorite — juicy, tender, and full of authentic Middle Eastern flavor. The staff are super friendly and welcoming too!

author: karthi m
review_text: biriyani is good becz it was different taste like nizam biriyani … goat curry was awesome .. mild spicy … feel little hot inside the shop…. staff are humble …. u have kulfi, sprite over there …. atmosphere is good

author: Sashwin Govintesamy
review_text: Very disappointing experience. The tomyam was a letdown — only 2 prawns served for 6 people, which is unacceptable. The Kam Heong chicken was extremely dry and lacked flavor. On top of that, portion sizes were very small and definitely not worth the price. Would not recommend if you're looking for value or quality.

author: Mary Hoang
review_text: The place is quite suitable for small gatherings. Enthusiastic service, good sound and lighting.

author: Jenny Sin
review_text: The hawker is at the 2nd floor, thanks that no flying birds inside and it is clean. It is a morning open hawker, start at 5am+, one of the stall laksa end at 10am so early. Surprisingly still can find $2.50 food at this hawker, happy. The food is nice, handmade and cheap, worth to try :) I first time bought so big chau siew bao x2, and price is cheap!

author: Jack Carello
review_text: I love Le Tub! The staff were friendly! The food was delicious! Very beautiful and detailed nautical and costal scenery in the interior! Plus you get a great view of the harbor! Without doubt worth going to! Have a great day!❤️🌊⚓️🔱⛵️😃🛟

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: Yu Gen
review_text: Already craved for Penang/Bm Ckt for a long time. Cooked by the shop owner daughter, the taste and colour are much heavier and darker than other ckt in Penang. It also more greasy and wet compared to Penang's style. The portion for big and small has no difference, so better order normal size is enough. The wokhei taste good, only have lapcheong, beansprouts, jiucai, no siham in the ckt.

author: Công Minh Vũ
review_text: Food: - The food is decent, the broth has a good flavor. - Many beef dishes for hot pot are good. Service: - Fast service. - Affordable prices. Atmosphere: - The restaurant is clean and has some decor. - Located on a main road, convenient transportation. - Not too noisy. - It's a narrow building, a bit cramped. The restaurant is small, not very spacious.

author: Maria Yastika
review_text: Really good restaurant with super friendly, fast service, and a very comfortable atmosphere. I came around 1 PM, and thanks to the AC, the place was still cool and pleasant to dine in. The food and smoothies were top-notch—really yummy. On top of that, the place is so pretty. Definitely worth visiting!

author: Ivan Ramirez
review_text: The service I received today in this subway is unacceptable. Salad was nothing near what I wanted. Portions are not good. The lady that attended me was rude and with a lack of courtesy. I'm not coming back to this place. Period.

author: Yi Jing
review_text: Loved the meal — there are many vegetarian options (see photo), service was wonderful, and ambience was great. Suitable for casual meals or more formal gatherings, note that it’s very lively even during a weekday lunch.

author: andréa
review_text: i live in europe and i heard a lot about how good raising cane’s was.. and they did not lie !! this is honestly the best fast food ever =D everything was good and i went there multiple times during my trip. please open a raising cane’s in France !!!!

author: Joanna Galo
review_text: It's ok. Food is too expensive, not worth the price. The food was ok. Service was not ok, cooks kept staring as if they wanted to say something or were surprised that we were there. It's dirty, needs to be cleaned and washed down. I wouldn't recommend it. Just not worth it.

author: Alyssa Jane
review_text: We got the coconut cold brew, latte, poke bowl and ceasar salad. Everything was wonderful. Some live music playing and a variety of sweet treats available! Will be back while we are here for their happy hour from 4-7 (BOGO). Movi was our server- she was attentive and very kind!

author: Alia S
review_text: Great food. Great service. Great atmosphere. A bit pricey but worth it. Would definitely recommend for anyone who wants authentic Indonesian food in a safe, clean, and secure place.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Jay Nam
review_text: Not as good as the D1 location but still 5 stars for the food and nice parking attendant

author: José Alfredo Maldonado
review_text: Probablybthe best burguer I have tasted in Las Vegas. Great fast, and friendly service, clean establishment.

author: Todd Steven Burroughs
review_text: This is to make up for my "4" review on GrubHub last night. I made a mistake: my order *was* right and I'd like to thank everyone involved; Friday night shift, THANK YOU!!!

author: Putri Maharani
review_text: the place is pretty cool, lots of alcohol choices and the vibe is kinda fun. i’m not even sure how to review it properly, but overall it was a nice experience.

author: joe jacob
review_text: Great location as well as good food selection, only remarks some waiter seems comes out high-school, no clue whatsoever what they representating, management should not put them to take order like burger king, other than great food

author: Yiyi Zhang
review_text: A Glorious Journey to Old-World Germany!!! Walking into Zum Stammtisch in Brooklyn feels like stepping through a time portal straight into a warm, wood-paneled tavern nestled deep in Bavaria or something. The ambiance is MAGICAL!!! Every detail, from the carved dark wood to the vintage beer steins lining the shelves, feels designed to transport you far from modern-day NYC and into a cozier, more charming world. It’s not themed, it’s immersive and authentic, like a love letter to another place and time. The wait staff are great: attentive and genuinely friendly. Foodwise, every dish we tried was satisfying and hearty. The standout was, suprisingly, the potato salad. I never thought I’d write the words “life-changing potato salad,” and yet here we are. It was tangy, creamy, perfectly textured...I'm still thinking about it days later. It also feels old world in pricing! Definitely a great deal for all the food, and ambiance. It’s the kind of place you tell your friends about and bring out-of-towners to to flex on them a little bit. Can’t wait to go back!

author: Katie Manzo
review_text: Food is absolutely delicious. The Cubano sandwich, Pollo lunch plate (with the yellow rice & beans), and mofongo were incredible. The empanadas were very good (small but cheap). The tostones were thicker than I expected, but were still good. Staff was very patient (I speak little to no Spanish) - highly recommend this place.

author: Ramsey Wee
