review_text: Every time I walk past this stall always long queue , decided to try their mee Soto , kinda disappointed that the begedil ( Malay style potato patties ) is those factory made , not hand made 😑 . Shredded chicken meat no taste at all 🙄. Only the broth and chilli is good . Behind the food center , there's a aquarium shop , price are all super reasonable . Friendly environment in the wet market .

author: Julie J.
review_text: Ordered a family pack all 4 the same lettuce and tomato they made two with lettuce, one with tomato and one plain Food was not good, chicken tacos either 👎🏽 When I called and told them it wasn’t how I ordered they laughed.

author: Wander in Wisconsin
review_text: I had the Thai Green chicken curry which was fantastic. The eggplant was a nice addition. The owner was very friendly and the restaurant is very clean. They offer Thailand beverages and lemon diffused ice water. I highly recommend esp if you’re look for Authentic Thai food.

author: Melody Timothee
review_text: Today was my 2nd visit at Jrk and man was it great I had to leave a honest review. I got a curry chicken and my partner got the oxtail. We both loved our meals. Greg at behind the register was extremely kind and greeted me once I walked in. The portion I received was crazy, closing my lid was difficult. Just a 10/10 experience. Thanks to this team for amazing food, service and overall experience!

author: Edmund Tan
review_text: One of our favorite hawker centers to enjoy Singaporean hawker fare with friends when they visit me and my wife in Singapore. Lots of good food like chicken rice, banh mi, fried carrot cake, rojak and popiah.

author: AC Chan
review_text: Shi Le Yuan Teochew Porridge 实叻圆潮洲粥 Simple and comforting, homely fare that reminded us of the typical Teochew dishes that my late-grandmother used to cook, back in the Eighties. My personal favourite is the flavourful minced pork with fermented black bean. It’s so delicious, I ended up consuming two bowls of rice.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Adrian Nguyen
review_text: Stepped into the store and nearly threw up because of the smell. Ordered Nam Vang and serving size was tiny compared to Nhan Quan competitor down the street. Prawns were definitely not fresh. Would not recommend here m. If you want hu tieu nam vang you need to go a store that specialises in it and not a place that sells alternate dishes as well.

author: Moshe
review_text: Very nice place. Location is amazing, right on the calm waters of the canal. Romantic if you are looking for a date night. We had lamb shank and scallops. Wine selections were good. The interesting thing was, even though this is a Greek spot, they also have sushi.

author: Israel Ortet
review_text: First time here. We came for the burger and it didn’t disappoint. It is big and delicious. The place has a unique feeling. Definitely coming back.

author: Doug Nguyen
review_text: Good Indonesian comfort food at a great value. The babi guling was very flavorful, along with the crispy skin. The fried pork dish was surprisingly nice as well. Good stop on the way back to Seminyak from Ubud.

author: Eden Dayuha
review_text: Acacia Coffee - A Unique, Green Oasis for Nature Lovers Acacia Coffee is an absolute paradise for those who appreciate nature-inspired spaces. From the moment I walked in, I felt like I’d stepped into a hidden forest retreat. The cafe’s design is earthy and inviting, with wooden furniture, gravel floors, and lush green plants hanging from every corner. It’s a refreshing break from the usual cafe interiors, and the abundance of greenery adds a serene and calming vibe that’s perfect for unwinding. The layout is spacious, with plenty of seating options, both for groups and individuals. The atmosphere is relaxed, and the decor has a rustic charm that makes you want to stay for hours. You can work, read, or enjoy a quiet conversation without feeling crowded. Overall, Acacia Coffee is a delightful escape for anyone looking to enjoy a unique ambiance and delicious coffee. It’s an ideal spot for nature lovers, remote workers, or anyone who wants a peaceful place to recharge. Downside: There are many mosquitoes inside and the room smells like molds. The lady staff was grumpy and didn't even bother to smile.

author: Melissa Santos
review_text: Shout out to Ben! He was our server & we absolutely loved him! He was so sweet. Took our order fast & kept making sure we were good.

author: Eline Valoaga
review_text: Food was Delicious! I love coming to this location. Atmosphere was Wonderful as always. Service was good. The greeting when we walked through the door and being seated, Awesome! I was trying to be understanding that we were getting forgotten on certain things. I chopped it up to she said she was kinda new and I just told my daughter she was busy. To let’s leave it at that. We tipped her well and I talked to her and gave words of encouragement. If you get a server and she says she’s only been there for a few months, well, I’ll pray for her. I would definitely keep going back.

author: Emma Reading
review_text: This was such a fun dining experience! It's a very eclectic array of foods with so many flavors to try. Our server, Josh, said the best way to describe the food they serve was "saucy" and that honestly is true. So many good sauces, with flavors from all over the world! We did The Ride, a fixed menu with 8 plates plus dessert. They were flexible with some dietary needs and our server was fun, knowledgeable, and had fantastic service. We loved trying so many different things and enjoyed some lovely cocktails alongside it all. Such a great spot to try new flavors and have a special date night!

author: C T
review_text: Nana the waitress was so nice and attentive. Bernice the cook, kudos to her the food was immaculate my first time here and I ate all my food!! It was amazing and fresh. Kim the manager was also so nice and made sure we were taken care of. Definitely would recommend this place and definitely coming back.

author: J C
review_text: This is the gem of East Coast Park, forget about the usual fast food and crowded places along the east coast park. This place is so cozy and relax, the atmosphere and music they played will make you like to come back again. The foods were fantastic, most importantly the service was excellent. Kudos to Hannah, she was so attentive and friendly. Will come back again!

author: Polina Shevchenko
review_text: A variety of potato options, and you can customize it just the way you like. Delicious. Thank you!

author: Millie Eu
review_text: I have never tasted such nice coffee. The PEANUT BUTTER CREAM COFFEE was out of this world. I would highly recommend coffee lovers or non coffee lovers to try everything on their coffee menu and also the banana chocolate cake.

author: George Mulang Chen
review_text: Very multi storey vietnamese restaurant tucked away in a backstreet. The shop front is lush with an inviting vibe. Inside the shop is thoughtfully decorated with intricate lighting and display objects. The food was quite nice. We ordered a hot pot style soup, a local alcoholic beverage, amongst other things. It was delicious.

author: Osama Malik
review_text: This place has excellent Thai food. I visited with a group of three and there was a bit of a line but it moved quickly. I had some morning glory and pad see ew with shrimps. The morning glory was pretty tasty and a good appetizer. The pad see ew was a bit too spicy, which was my fault, since that’s what I ordered - but it made it hard to discern the taste. I also had a Longan juice, which was my first time. It was very refreshing and something I’d get again.

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: Karthick Sonaimuthu
review_text: A hidden gem with lots of great food. There are a good number of Michelin star hawker stalls. My favourite are, Carrot cake, NaNa Curry and the western food shop. The ambience is not great, But foe good food its ok to compromise on the ambiance.

author: Tracy Andrews
review_text: If you're in Miami. Please make this your place for Lunch, Dinner or snack!! Had no idea that I was walking into Paradise! I will be back with more people!! Thank you for showing love to me on my Birthday 🎂! Food and Drinks (2for1)💕 are out of this world! So, was I when I finished!! LOL

author: Liam
review_text: Giving this place extra stars because it truly deserves them. The service was fast and genuinely friendly, and the space itself is adorable with great Saturday-morning vibes. I ordered the spinach feta pastry—simple, warm, and really tasty—while my partner tried the gluten-free rose pistachio cake, which was such a unique and delicious breakfast treat. You can tell the baristas are skilled pros: my cappuccino was perfectly balanced, and the Gesha pour-over was flawless. Total chef’s kiss. ☕✨

author: Pramuaji Pramono
review_text: Written on Jan 22, 2024. First time dining here, I thought it was one of those over-fancied and price-y restaurants with so-so savor. Turned out I was wrong. The price is relatively affordable, compared to other similar establishments, and the food tasted pretty great! They place a button system on every table to call the waiters for ordering or requesting the check. They don't provide condiments and napkins on the tables, and the menu books (yes, plural, one for the main dish, and another for desserts and beverages) are ridiculously large! I ordered the Bubur Candil for appetizer, Tahu Tek Telor Gunung Ijen for the main dish, and the usual sweet iced tea for beverage. All of them tasted great, and the serving time was satisfactory. Got all of my orders in less than 12 mins.

author: Robert Hill
review_text: Overall the food was very good and flavorful! I had the turkey wings that were very tasty and tender. It was a big portion(3 wings). I had the cornbread that tasted almost like a cake. I personally prefer it not that sweet, but it was good. The cabbage and mac and cheese were good as well. My wife had the fried fish which she felt was a disappointment with it being dry and salty. My cousins had the fried chicken and collard greens which they felt were a hit! Overall, I would say it was a good experience!

author: Alexey Subach
review_text: Overall the pizza is nice and probably one of the best spots to try New York style pizza. To me the flavours were not as prominent and the price/quality ratio was a bit low. This place often has a large queue and the staff is not able to cope with the demand even they all work hard. Sausage pesto pizza didn’t have as much sausage but it surely had the spots of cream cheese that they put on most of their pizzas. I wish the baked cheese had a more prominent flavour. The dough structure and crunch was really great though. The New Yorker pizza was nice but the flavour was very straightforward of course. Overall if you want to try the New York style pizza then I do recommend this place. Not sure I want to be back and try it second time though

author: jeremy cho
review_text: Pig intestine soup very well done. Comes with pork slices, pork belly, pork blood, stomach etc. The pig trotter and the braised soya intestines also very good.

author: Emily Litman
review_text: A friend took me here to celebrate my birthday. The ambience is understated elegance with a touch of whimsy with the presentation of the cocktails and food. I really enjoyed the shrimp arepa bowl and steak with onions. We had 2 cocktails, one appetizer and the two entrees for about $90. Everything tasted great and the service was friendly and professional. I hope to return soon!

author: Bui Nga (Kelly Bui)
review_text: 🌟 **O Ty Beef Hotpot - Rich Flavor, Dedicated Service** 🌟 O Ty Beef Hotpot is truly an ideal destination for those who love delicious and rich beef hotpot. The hotpot broth is clear but the flavor is extremely well-rounded, making me remember it every time I enjoy it. The grilled dishes dipped in fermented bean curd are also very delicious, creating a special and unforgettable flavor. The staff here are very friendly and dedicated, always ready to serve customers with a smile on their faces. However, the restaurant needs to pay more attention to keeping the space clean to create the best experience for diners. Overall, O Ty beef hotpot deserves to be a great choice for gatherings with friends and family. Come and enjoy, you will not be disappointed!

author: A P
review_text: I had grown up grilled cheese and it was so incredibly awful that it makes sense to review it, so that others can think twice before ordering this epic failure and wasting 14 dollars. It is basically two slices of toast, drowned in awful ketchup, with some meat (nothing to write home about), some cheese (likewise) and something that was supposed to be caramelised onion. It was sautéed onion, nowhere near caramelised onion. The sandwich looked bloody terrible, but I was hungry and I do not like wasting food, so I decided to eat it. It turned out to be a grave mistake, because it not only looked unappetising, but it also tasted truly terrible: just oily toast with loads of ketchup (literally drowned in it) with overpowering vinegary taste plus sautéed onions and some meat and some cheese. Given that it was drowned in this awful sauce, it could have been cardboard. After eating this, I felt like I ate a ton of bricks, plus it left a truly terrible taste in my mouth for a long time. Awful experience. I would never order this again. It is surprising, because it was recommended by staff as one of their most popular items on the menu

author: Uncle Hong 1
review_text: After renovated was comfortable of chair with soft leather seat, inside have a air-conditioning dining area with no have any charge fee that was great. The food tasted good and delicious but for me this times wait around 20 minutes at 10pm that's decent. Order method just seat and waiting for waiters come for order except Curry Mix Rice. Overall, the environment, vibe, food and price not bad at all, that desrve to rate 5 stars.

author: Cher Ong
review_text: Latest visit : Visited again after half a year. Ordered 3 different dishes to try. This time around, their taste is not as good as i expect. Their signature black pomfret 🐟 is very normal but very expensive. 1st visit : Quite an interesting Thai restaurant. They don't accommodate too many customers so better make reservation before visiting. Service is not very friendly. Ordered some basic dishes but tasted delicious. The keng som is super duper spicy. For the weak heart, better don't test your limit. The price is a bit on the higher side.

author: Jason Tan
review_text: The noodles are lack of "wok-hei", really missed the old style cooking. Quite disappointed with the food quality. Having said that, the squid 🐙 is tender and delicious 😋

author: Meg
review_text: Fantastic atmosphere and service. They have indoor and outdoor seating. The chai latte was divine.

author: William Chu
review_text: The oldest Nasi Kandar spot in Penang operating since 1907. Meats are very tender. Portions are big, lots of meat, variety of dishes to choose, and different curries. Ordered and paid the dish at one shop, and the waiter helped carry the plate of food to the shop next door to sit and dine. Very clean food and very clean tables.

author: June Thorfun
review_text: Cong Caphe has a really cool vibe with its vintage military-style decor and cozy atmosphere. The mix of antique wooden furniture, Chinese cotton print cushions, and soft lighting makes it a great spot to take a break while exploring Hanoi. There’s a nice mix of seating, from lounge chairs to wooden tables, and the whole place has a nostalgic, slightly retro feel. The drinks were just okay—not bad, but nothing too special. Still, the unique ambiance makes it worth a visit, especially if you like cafes with character.

author: Maggie Li
review_text: Delicious food, good service, comfortable, and modern atmosphere with seating spaced out and high ceiling. Fresh salad. Music a bit too loud. The combo special deal during the weekday is a great value. And they are accommodating, switching our fries to yuca fries for our stir fry filet mignon dish.

author: Brian Tamase
review_text: We ordered the pad Thai and the crab egg roll. The pad Thai was good like most pad Thai places. Very classic approach. The crab egg roll was a welcome surprise because the rolls were big and was literally filled with crab meat.

author: Ann W
review_text: Beef stew aroi mak mak. Truffle mash potatoes was very flavourful and the beef was very tender. Would definitely come back another time!

author: Tezeta “Tez” Roro
review_text: By far one of the worst restaurant experiences I have had. As a business owner myself, I am not quick to give a negative review yet this place lost every opportunity to make things right. We called ahead after an event an NJPAC for an early dinner. We were quickly sat which was a good start. We ordered calamari as an appetizer. I can tell from the first bite that it wasn’t quality food or preparation. The crispy coating came off flaking and I had a hard time grabbing the rubbery calamari underneath with a fork. I ordered a ceasar chicken salad as it felt like a fairly safe option-I was wrong. Before the plate even hit my table I can see how hard the chicken pieces were. Clearly NOT freshly made and looks like it has been warmed up several times. We couldn’t get a waiter to even look our way for a long time much less ask us how the food was. We had to flag someone down and tell them. She told who I believe was the supervisor. No acknowledgement again for a good amount of time. One of our party ordered medium burger and it came overcooked and saturated in whatever sauce was in it. We felt hostage to the place as we wanted nothing more than to leave yet couldn’t get acknowledgement, resolution, a bill or ownership of this experience. The waitress ultimately came with our check. And guess what? It had “suggested gratuity” INCLUDED on our bill and credit card charge which we had to cancel out. It is unfortunate as this is a venue that is well positioned being close to NJPAC yet that days experience has puzzled all of us about the ratings and reviews thus far which is what we based our decision to go there on. I understand that an establishment has an off day or maybe a different chef. Total and complete disregard for the quality of food that comes out or the experience tells me a lot about management. It is often when things don’t go well that businesses have an opportunity to win over customers and create loyalty. There was ZERO ownership, effort or acknowledgment here hence my 1 star review.

author: Ben Park
review_text: Had the spicy cabbage, frog, and shrimp fried rice. The fried rice was just ok, but the other two dishes were great. The frog had a great texture and didn't taste fishy with a good numbing spice profile. The cabbage was actually my favorite. The staff was nice. Order a Beijing yogurt. It's just a sweet yogurt, but can offset the spice. EDIT: order the items with thumbs up. The spicy wontons and the garlic eggplant weren’t good but the items with thumbs up were good.

author: Sukay Thwe
review_text: The taste is great. I would admit that this is the best Babi Guling around Bali. Crispy pork and curry paste are super delicious. But I don’t like the atmosphere that much. Location is hard to find.

author: MJW Editions
review_text: We ended our East Coast walk here after doing so a few months back and just grabbing a drink. This time we came for the food and we were not disappointed. Great quality, Indian & western fusion going on too. Started with a mezze platter, then a spread of dishes, Fish Tikka, Sriracha Cauliflower, Tandoori Stuffed Jalapeno, Chilli beef, Butter Chicken and Kathi Rolls. A real feast and all tasty, washed down with a couple of ice-cold beers and cider. We'll be back as this makes a wholesome stop after a wholesome walk!

author: Honey Jackson
review_text: Never coming back. Gave me like 1 small scoop of pasta that’s was burnt and took forever with the restaurant being empty.

author: Trenice Lyn Keyes
review_text: Dirty grounds Drive thru was slow and unwelcoming Customer service was rude to the Uber driver and me Have window for Uber P\U would not open and sat in drive thru for 33 mins.... 😡 Food was Cold and drinks were watered down 👎

author: Sarah Jane
review_text: After leaving the midwest, this was the chain I missed most, the absolute joy I have that this food is close by again. The location is great if you use South Station, the employees were all incredibly nice, the place was clean and bright. The food? Just as good as I remembered, everything was made in incredible time, it was hot and wonderful. They even had some gluten free options for my sister! This was the PERFECT place to catch up with old friends and reminisce. I will absolutely be back!

author: Parthipan Somasundaramm
review_text: No Respect for Customers – Extremely Poor Service I spent $56 at this restaurant and was appalled by the service. The waiting time was around 30 minutes, which was frustrating enough. After finishing my meal, I asked to pack the leftovers. The staff gave me a flimsy plastic sheet—free, but entirely unsuitable and unpleasant for takeaway. Will this owner of the restaurant accept this plastic cover? When I asked for a proper container, they told me it would cost 20 cents. I paid because I had no choice, but charging for something so basic after such a large bill is a clear sign of disrespect. The staff member (wearing glasses) was dismissive and lacked any form of professionalism or courtesy. This experience wasn’t just about the 20 cents—it was about a complete lack of respect for customers. No transparency, no hospitality, and no effort to make customers feel valued. I will never return, and I strongly advise others to think twice before dining here.

author: mikel simmons
review_text: I went with my cousin, when we arrived the music was a little loud so we asked them to turn it down. We ordered our food and it arrived quick. I tasted the Mac and cheese, I didn’t like it but my cousin gave it a strong 9. I tasted the potato salad, didn’t like it but I was told that it’s ordered a lot. They didn’t have baked beans. The ribs were a solid 10 the burnt ends were a solid 10 and they give you enough. Would I go back YES… The service was great.

author: S.Y
review_text: 𝐑𝐨𝐣𝐚𝐤 so shiok! I love it when they give a lot of sauce that is also not watery and it is thick, the taste of the prawn paste, sugar, chili whatever they added in so yummy! Their You Tiao also not soggy and crispy. Inside got red apple, green apple. pineapple, radish, cucumber, taupok. 𝐏𝐨𝐩𝐢𝐚𝐡 is also not bad, spicy enough to make me wish I had gotten 2 roll instead. Also had 𝐅𝐫𝐢𝐞𝐝 𝐎𝐲𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐫 𝐎𝐦𝐞𝐥𝐞𝐭𝐭𝐞 - taste is not bad but find it too starchy, should have ordered the one with egg instead and if it's crispy more good also loh. 𝐌𝐢𝐱𝐞𝐝 𝐑𝐢𝐜𝐞 with Broccoli, Cabbage, Fried Egg & Fried Prawn - If you don't know what to get just go picked whatever you want. Ended our meal with a dessert of 𝐂𝐡𝐞𝐧𝐝𝐨𝐥 however it didn't taste very good and it came in a takeaway container which I find it hard to dig the ingredients that are at the bottom. ✨Rojak $5 ✨Popiah $2.50 ✨Katong Fried Oyster Omelette $5 ✨Mixed Rice $6 ✨Chendol $2.80

author: C.S
review_text: Most stalls are not open even during lunch time. Variety is limited too. Avg small hawker.

author: J Y K
review_text: Perfect spot for Breakfast & brunch. Quality & portions are great for the price. Staff could be a bit more welcoming but overall dining experience was beyond expectations. Recommended to come early to avoid the rush hour.

author: Mariya Doncheva - Real Estate Agent
review_text: During our vacation, our visit to Sushi Sake Biscayne was a delight, marked by friendly staff and amazing food that truly stood out. My husband was particularly impressed with their sushi, praising its freshness and flavor, while I found myself enamored with their chicken fried rice and chicken hibachi—both dishes were cooked to perfection. We also indulged in their desserts, which were a wonderful end to our meal. The ambiance is welcoming, making for a memorable dining experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking for top-notch sushi and more.

author: Jenny Ramos
review_text: Tuesdays are the day to go. They have 31.95 Rodizio. Great price. All the meat you can eat and they will come back again. What they didn’t have was the grilled pineapple. They said it usually goes to waste to so they didn’t set it up. They all have a Rodizio special for lunch. The sea bass was not great according to my companion. It was a frozen fillet. Didn’t taste fresh. The Rodizio on Tuesday is their best offer. It wasn’t packed so you could hold a conversation.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: ngan vo
review_text: Buy fish sauce to take home and use it yourself? First time but the staff like qq didn't give any instructions, the food isn't special and it's expensive, first time is like last time

author: Yuelin Li
review_text: Hidden inside Mercado La Paloma, Holbox is a Michelin-starred seafood counter that completely lives up to the hype. We tried the uni & scallop tostada — freshly opened sea urchin topped with scallop and green salsa, unbelievably sweet and creamy. The Filete al Carbon (grilled sea bass with cilantro rice) was perfectly cooked — crispy skin, tender meat, and full of flavor. Both octopus and fried fish tacos were light, crunchy, and fresh, especially with their house-made hot sauces. The Kanpachi ceviche was bright and balanced, a perfect mix of acid and spice. Everything tasted so clean and ocean-fresh. It’s a casual spot, not fancy at all, but the quality easily rivals high-end restaurants.

author: Tatsiana Tsiushkevich
review_text: I think the rating is overstated. The place is very busy, so be ready to wait. The coffee was just average, and the avocado toast had a very modest amount of avocado. There are definitely much better breakfast spots in this area.

author: Chong Wee
review_text: Very authentic Thai foods... Somtum is tasty,for the baked fish was awesome,the Thai curry fried crab really good

author: Madeline Burns
review_text: Best Venezuelan food outside of Venezuela. Incredibly kind people, excellent green sauce, cachapas are to die for!

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Vy Thuý
review_text: The restaurant offers free extra noodles and vegetables, but for my appetite, one bowl like the one in the picture was enough to fill me up. The taste was pretty good.

author: Ryan Falconer
review_text: The food was overall great. We had appetizers, drinks & mains. The ribeye was excellent. The appetizer sampler was delicious. Drinks were all very well made & tasty. I would not order the lemon potatoes as a side again. 3 stars for service because of how the rain was handled. We wanted to sit outside for the ambiance, but it rained. The servers/employees worked diligently to get the water screens down for every table except ours- even after we asked them to, it took a while. Wet rib eye was not as enjoyable as when it was dry. We'll still go back & hope for better service next time.

author: c c
review_text: This restourant is famous within Chinese tourists which makes it difficult to wait for a table. After 15 minutes waiting, you will find out waiting is not the hardest part to bear. Table for two at the end of the corridor is too narrow and cramped. Speaking of the dishes, we ordered curry crab with rice and deep fried prawn mantis. The flavour of crab is heavy sweet which make me dizzy. And the mantis is as common as any restourant can offer. Remember price is the only reason you come to this restourant and dont expect too much. Every coin matters.

author: Jet Vargas
review_text: Crema Downtown Miami is a great spot with a clean and cozy environment that feels very inviting. The music creates a relaxing vibe, and the food was absolutely on point—everything I tried was fresh and delicious. However, parking in the area is definitely a challenge, which is something to keep in mind if you're driving. Overall, it’s a wonderful place to unwind or grab a bite if you’re in the area. Highly recommended for the atmosphere and quality!

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: Tan Lai Heng
review_text: The soup was savoury and nice. But a little on the salty side. Best to drink when it is on its hottest. The meat is a bit hard. Seating is aplenty here but if you are driving here, parking space is limited and you sometimes have to eait for spaces.

author: Wojciech Kałużny
review_text: Ok! I have to admit. That was best dessert I ate in whole thailand. Its soft, kind of cripsy and sauce inside its just sooooo tasty! You must try it when you will be in Bangkok!

author: Brandon Martinson
review_text: I ordered lunch online through the app for delivery. Everything was easy, worked perfectly and my lunch arrived on time. Everything was as I ordered and fresh. Highly recommend the spicy tuna poke bowl.

author: J C
review_text: Service is terribly bad here. You make an order and it takes almost 15mins for them to get the order out. If you ordered through mobile, they set it on another window to the side that is completely hidden from your view. They don't call your order number for mobile orders. This location also runs out of stock for specials like the Frozen drinks. I went on 2 different days and it is still out of stock The only plus side is the location and convenience since it is in downtown

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Chris Wong
review_text: It's been a long time since I've been to this restaurant. The Nam Vang noodles are still delicious. Today I took my mom and aunts to eat, and when the adults praised them, everyone knew it was a delicious restaurant. But there are 3 super picky mothers here. The noodles are rich, not salty and not chewy, suitable for the elderly. The meatballs are also ok, but the beef noodles are not something my family has had a chance to try yet. The restaurant is right at the front but the spice tray is very clean, not dusty. The 10k iced tea is huge, strong tea. Will come back!!!

author: Nique
review_text: We typically go here for breakfast after work and it's so good. The steak and eggs are always great and I love that after a long night at work we can get a good drink and talk.

author: Evelyn Sanchez
review_text: Good food and friendly service. Polite manager, Juan checked in on us and made sure everything was going well. Nice experience in general, little pricey though.

author: Jessica Diaz
review_text: We had a wonderful breakfast, avo toast, side of bacon and a bacon/egg/cheese croissant. Get the hot sauce on the side. Everything was hot, fresh and savory. I also had a hoy lavender latte and it was just right. Next time I will definitely get the pancake stack. Everyone had them around us and were raving about them!

author: Barney Simon
review_text: The house special cake and the pastries are amazing. Owner is friendly and super helpful

author: Jann Elaine Eleodinmuo
review_text: I've tried this place a few times but sadly the coffee usually tastes burnt. The prices are reasonable. The atmosphere is cute; I love the plants. The guy who works there most of the time always seems like he doesn't need to be friendly and he's way too cool to serve anyone anyway, that it's annoying and inconvenient for him to have to do so. The bakery options- so many of them are vegan or gluten-free but if you're looking for normal stuff there aren't as many options, which is weird because traditionally a "bakery" sells things that INCLUDE flour and butter. But mostly the coffee having a bad aftertaste bothers me.

author: Pk C
review_text: A local tim sum restaurant serving bak kut teh too. Their speciality, fish head with fried flat noodle was nothing to shout about. The fish used was seabass but the flesh has some muddy taste in it.

author: Zalikha Ishak
review_text: Yusuf Restaurant Vervea is a true gem in Penang, easily earning its spot as one of the best places for nasi kandar and nasi briyani in Batu Kawan. Their nasi briyani, in particular, is a standout – incredibly flavourful and fragrant, a delightful aromatic experience with every bite. When you visit, I highly recommend trying their signature nasi kandar and, of course, the nasi briyani. Don't miss out on their excellent side dishes, especially the ayam masak bawang and ayam masak rose. Be sure to add some of their crispy bawang goreng and a generous pour of kuah campur to complete your meal. Beyond the fantastic food, the restaurant itself is a pleasant surprise. It's noticeably clean and boasts a nice decoration, creating a comfortable dining atmosphere. There are plenty of tables on the ground floor, and if it gets busy, you can head up to the upper level where even more tables are available. Convenience is key here, as they also provide surau facilities and clean toilets for patrons. Parking is a breeze, with plenty of parking spaces available around the restaurant. Be aware that the queue for lunch can be quite long, a testament to its popularity, but it's definitely worth the wait. All in all, I absolutely love Yusuf Restaurant Vervea and will always make it a point to come back whenever I'm in Penang.

author: Lizett Canari
review_text: Service and most importantly food was right on point! Though a steak house, their seafood selection was also just as great. I can't wait to go back!

author: Danielle Riehl
review_text: We were greeted by Carlene, whom I believe is one of the owners or at least the manager. She was so kind and funny! You feel like family right away! It’s old diner feel, which was a nice nostalgic vibe. We ordered the gator bites and a chefs salad. Food was served promptly and the seasoning in the gator breading was chefs kiss! Mom and pop style dining, comfort food, clean and would definitely stop by here again!

author: ELLA ESHAGHIAN
review_text: This place was like a fever dream….no actually a nightmare. Rather than being welcomed upon entering we were immediately scolded for having bottles of water and told they’d have to be kept behind the bar even though we expressed our intention to all order drinks. The menu is confusing and doesn’t describe the items or ingredients properly at all. When I asked whether the frappe had cream I was told no. I asked to add cream and pay for it and I was told no again. The drink then arrived with cream on top. The drinks are all for show and taste horrible. Some drinks are comically large whilst others are comically small but of course none of it is stated on the menu. The frappe is comically large but mostly ice. It arrived served on a plate which half of it had spilled onto which the waiter unapologetically ignored. The food is also all for show but lacks any flavour. My friend ordered the “bacon burrito” which was 99% egg filling wrapped in an egg tortilla with one tiny piece of bacon. He also ordered a side of hash brown which somehow also resembled egg and was inedible. The whole experience felt like a ridiculous prank.

author: Lori Batronis
review_text: One of the best places I have ever eaten in Vegas!! We had the Pork Belly, Chicken Skins, Deviled Eggs, and Oysters. Also enjoyed the Tequila flight and bourbon flight. EVERYTHING was wonderful. Staff was very personable and helpful. We will be going back each time we are staying on Fremont street.

author: Victor Koh
review_text: Nice atmosphere and good for catchup over unlimited food and time. Should come again.

author: Viva M
review_text: Excellent Vietnamese Food & Great Hospitality! The food here was absolutely delicious — full of authentic Vietnamese flavours and generous in quantity. Every dish was fresh, aromatic, and perfectly balanced. Fish (nick name:)) was incredibly hospitable and made the whole experience even better with his warm and attentive service. Highly recommend this place if you want to enjoy the best of Vietnamese cuisine with great portions and friendly vibes!

author: John Acosta
review_text: The food was delicious and the service was super fast. Our waiter Julius was very nice and super helpful. He was very attentive and made us feel welcome. The new look and atmosphere of this diner is so beautiful and chic. I’ll definitely be back!

author: Efi Love Light
review_text: One of the best places in Bali! Fantastic food, exceptional service and super friendly staff! We come here at least once a day to have a drink or something to eat, and every time it's a real treat! The atmosphere is also very nice and the restaurant is lovingly decorated with a touch of Hawaiian culture, which we find very appealing and special! Well done, guys, and thank you very much for your hospitality! ❤️🫶🏼

author: Now.Loading.Carlos
review_text: Holbox completely lived up to and honestly exceeded its Michelin-star reputation. We ordered the scallop ceviche, kampachi, lobster, and the fresh uni… and every dish was an absolute standout. The scallop ceviche was bright and silky, bursting with clean citrus flavors. The kampachi had that perfect buttery texture, so fresh it practically melted. The lobster was rich, sweet, and cooked to perfection. But the uni wow. Creamy, briny, and unbelievably fresh… now I fully understand why Holbox earned its Michelin star. Every plate was thoughtful, balanced, and executed with precision. This is seafood at its highest level innovative, respectful of the ingredients, and genuinely unforgettable. Holbox remains one of LA’s true culinary gems. If you love world-class seafood, this place is non-negotiable.

author: Brooklyn Rose
review_text: THE SERVICE: Unremarkable customer service experience in alignment with an old school pub. Come as you are, take a seat, and we’ll get to you kind of establishment. The weathered decor is charming, and the atmosphere is nostalgic- I felt comfortable. THE FOOD: The fried seafood platter was very good. The seafood tasted fresh, and the batter perfectly adhered giving the ideal non-greasy coating. I particularly liked the fact that the seasoning accentuated the natural flavors of the seafood. The clam bellies and scallops were my standout bites. The side green beans tasted invisible because the only adornment was steam. The onion rings were cooked to perfection-light and crunchy batter encasing a succulent onion. THE VALUE: Budget friendly price point for fresh well prepared seafood.

author: Nima Azizpour
review_text: Eyval is by far the best Persian restaurant I have ever been to. The food is absolutely fantastic—each dish feels like a true work of art. Chef Ali is not only an incredibly talented chef but also a wonderful human being and a true artist when it comes to creating unforgettable flavors. The vibe of the restaurant is unmatched. Everyone who works there is so warm and kind—it feels like being welcomed into one big family where their only goal is to make every guest happy. The energy and atmosphere are just perfect. This place deserves a Michelin star without question. Everything is made fresh the same day, and you can truly taste that freshness in every single bite. If you’re looking for an unforgettable dining experience, Eyval is it.

author: Rini Raharjanti
review_text: Pison serves delicious coffee and food. My favorites are their famous nasi goreng, fried calamari, and pretzel with red bean and butter. Every night, a live band performs, and the fun crowd makes it even more enjoyable! Make sure to reserve your table in advance 😊

author: Conception Ordunez
review_text: I just drove thru. My food was good. The workers were very nice . The lemonade with the popping balls sucked, but i don't blame noone for that ..lol. Besides that my food was good n the customer service was good.

author: Sandra Gonzalez
review_text: Clean and modern looking cafe. Loved the wood accents around the store. I ordered a flat white and a s'mores pop tart. And my husband ordered an Americano and a caramel apple pop tart. Pastries and food were good. The atmosphere was very chill and quiet. People were there doing work on their computers and then saw other people using it as a hang out spot. My husband and I went there for a quick coffee date. Didn't disappoint. I'm glad we came upon this place, we would come here again. 😊

author: Abhinav Sridharan
review_text: Truly one of a kind fast casual Indian dining. The Nashville sandwich was the right amount of seasoning and crisp with some desi flavors. The mac and cheese and tikka bites hit the spot also.

author: John Bevis
review_text: Have been here several times and you are lucky if the order is right. Don’t even bother asking for a sauce or napkins. Just got a medium fries and the container is maybe 1/3 full. Been here multiple times and lucky if my order is right, let alone anything else.

author: Julius Tan
review_text: Old Airport Road Food Centre, established in 1973, is a highly popular hawker food centre in Singapore. It boasts a wide array of stalls, each specializing in traditional local dishes, offering a diverse culinary experience that caters to all tastes. While the food centre may show signs of age and the environment is not the most hygienic, the quality of the food remains exceptional. Notable stalls include Nam Sing Fried Hokkien Mee, Hua Kee and Cho Kee Wanton Mee, Whitley Road and Albert Street Prawn Noodle, Dong Ji and Lao Fu Zi Fried Kway Teow, and the renowned Lor Mee, among many other famous hawkers.

author: Krysta Chan
review_text: Quite good value for money. Decent food though I personally don’t feel that it’s outstanding. When we arrived, there were people queueing even before they opened. Typical SG foodies! 😂 thankfully Boss made reservations. Noise level is a bit too much for me but you get used to it after a while when focus shifts to the food 😆

author: Traveling Kupo
review_text: Great great AYCE. I got 3 of the specials which two of them were the ones that offer a cloister, jumbo shrimp, & oysters. The other was the cajun style which was really really good & not that spicy at all. Sushi was also great sushi over rice ratio is an 8 out of 10. Which is really good. This is kot your typical AYCE where the sushi is sitting out. You order it and then they make it as you keep ordering. Well worth it, service is great. Large parking, wheelchair access. Great price cheaper on weekday, but is a bit far from the strip. So worth the drive. I will be returning again & again when I am in that side of town.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Cyndi
review_text: Place was really clean, the owner was very sweet and friendly. Ordered mixed oxtail, came with all sorts of beef parts, everything was tasty, only wish that the broth was hotter, it was warm ish

author: Min Khant Zaw
review_text: Not quite located near city centre but it is definitely worth a travel to this restaurant. Old school vibes with delicious hot steaming dimsum at great price! To order: get a table and paper with that table number. Bring the paper to dimsum counter and choose whichever dimsum that looks good to you. Pass the chosen dimsums together with that paper with your table number. The freshly steamed dimsums will be delivered to you table a few minutes later. Place is clean and staffs are attentive too.

author: Chuck Paone
review_text: Nice place for a quick meal, drink or a long hang with friends and family. Easy to locate right off of Rte 93 with wonderful rustic atmosphere. Attended as part of a large holiday party. The food was great, appetizers were a big hit with the Italian egg rolls the stars. Large party orders can be a challenge for one server, but ours was professional, patient and perfect with the delivery. The only reason there is not a 5 star review for the restaurant and service is the head of house at the door was maybe having a bad day, but wow not exactly a warm greeting or helpful when we arrived and asked about our reservation. Hopefully she has a better day next time.

author: Antonio Grelicha
review_text: Undercooked suckling pig, mixed up order, wrong food on Christmas Day. Very disappointed. Having Hoped for better turnout. Alex did not offer any remedy. Frequented place.

author: Cat T
review_text: Tried the Chinese style mutton soup and fell in love, especially the tendons. Although not cheap... Mei Mei Satay - The medium size plate of carrot cake at $4 was good value and delicious.

author: ri fieschi
review_text: love capturing the atmosphere and environment 85 redhill food centre. brings back alot of memories, 80s/90s. will miss this area once i moved out from this neighbourhood. love the sugar cane, the indian food stall there, everything there is affordable and cheap cheap good food! will always come back here! <3

author: Lj
review_text: This is a family friendly Mexican restaurant. They serve the best authentic Mexican-inspired breakfast. The atmosphere is lively with friendly service. Our waiter Lorenzo was very attentive & made sure our food arrived quickly. They are famous for their pancake & mimosa flights. Best of all you have to have their cafe de olla, served with a concha. Their portions are large & the prices are reasonable. Definitely have to come back & try the other amazing dishes!

author: YippieYaYa
review_text: If you’re looking for a place that serves fresh seafood with bold flavors, Som Som Seafood is a must-visit! The highlight for me was their curry crab—rich, aromatic, and perfectly spiced. The crab was fresh and meaty, and the curry sauce had just the right balance of heat and creaminess, making it irresistible with steamed rice or mantou. The atmosphere is casual and welcoming, and the staff were attentive and friendly. Prices are reasonable for the quality you get. Highly recommended for seafood lovers—don’t miss the curry crab!

author: Carley Lemay
review_text: UNREAL. Every time I go to Tonino it’s a 10/10 experience. The food is absolutely incredible...easily the best Italian in Boston, and their specials never miss. The entire staff is warm, professional, and so attentive. Special shoutout to the lovely Taylor, who always makes the experience even better. I recently had my birthday dinner there, and the staff went above and beyond to accommodate multiple dietary restrictions and food allergies. Every single one of my friends left raving about the meal and is already trying to book a reservation to go back. I seriously can’t recommend them enough!

author: A. Ace.
review_text: Great variety of different cakes, sandwiches, and pastries made well and tasty. The place is always clean. The workers are helpful provide a friendly service, and are ready to serve you. Highly recommend this place.

author: M P
review_text: We came here our first day in Vegas, and bc of the service, the food and the total experience was awesome, we came back everyday for breakfast. All the servers were awesome , but Rob was very memorable..he remembered us and always stopped by to chat even if he was not our server. Everyone who works here was so courteous and friendly, the management team needs to appreciate the great staff they have here.

author: Asia Edwards
review_text: The food is great. I love their lemon pepper wings. If you like Wing Stop, then please give them a try. Their cheese sticks are so delicious. 😋

author: Aaron Brown
review_text: This is my go to place for friendly people, great food, at a really good price. Your sweet tea mug will never be empty, your food will always be cooked the way you order, and the servers are some of the nicest people in Vegas. 03-16-25 I still stand by my original review. My boys, daughter-in-law, and grandson flew in from Texas, so I reserved the Belaire for them. The service, food, and atmosphere made it a great first breakfast in Vegas. 06-11-2025 Kick ass Club sandwich 10-2-25 Hours are now till 10pm. yes!

author: Kalle Granada Starholt
review_text: Five stars! The Tuna Toast was incredibly fresh and delicious. Crema Gourmet has such a great vibe and the service was excellent. Perfect spot for a quick bite or a chill hangout. Highly recommend!

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: Scott Bender
review_text: Real local place,food atmosphere. The staff understand your English-speaking better than you think. Point to pictures. You share dishes among the group.

author: Tom Bouwhuis
review_text: L’Industrie is an absolute bucket list spot and more than worth the hype. We arrived just as it opened and it was already starting to get busy right away. By far, these were the best slices we had during our time in NYC. We tried three different slices— the burrata, the L’Industrie slice, and the spicy salami — and each one was absolutely awesome. Perfectly crisp, flavorful, and unforgettable. A must-visit for any pizza lover. We shared 3 slices with the two of us and were super full after.

author: Sebastian Santana
review_text: Service was good, the workers had a language barrier but that didn't stop them. My sandwich was prepared beautiful.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Steve Ludwig
review_text: I come to Serafina often as a regular usually sitting up at the bar area. Kat is awesome and a great bartender! The food is great and atmosphere is perfect. There is a good balance of happy hour food specials + regular menu items. Also they sponsored an event with my apartment complex. It was very nice and great environment for meeting other people. The best items are the Alfredo with chicken, the meatballs and the chocolate cake. It's great Italian food matching the quality of other restaurants in the area. Recently my last two visits were really great. I could not travel for Christmas because of nose surgery. Serafina had a Christmas brunch which was so great and made my holiday. Also for New Year's eve they had a nice menu with really good cake. Serafina is fitting into the neighborhood very nicely and caters both to tourists and the regulars like myself very well.

author: Keat Chiew
review_text: Pretty average fare. Ordered the bee hoon set 3 with wing. Chicken curry puff and a teh C kosong. Bee hoon is ok but the wing is tasteless. Sambal is overly sweet. The curry puff is a disappointment. Unfortunately, the food did not live up to its namesake, Tip Top. Sadly, will not be coming back any time soon.

author: Erick Sanchez
review_text: Amazing vegetarian option my favorite is the Biryani, definitely is a great place to spend with your friends and family!

author: Kim Ling Lim
review_text: Nice place, nice environment but service is super sucks. Served tea no cup, make food order the waiter keep asking to hold, make drinks order but was not delivered. More training and better service if want to make big business to get good and excellent service rating by clients. All staff to be well trained to give your excellent service to clients so that you will be in the heart of others for good good comments. Can see locals don't care much bout the service and requirements by clients but one words your foreigners do even better jobs to served clients.

author: Melvin Phil
review_text: Whenever i buy food over here, they always don’t follow my order. I always ask for chicken curry but the workers are lazy to walk and giving me fish curry EVERY SINGLE TIME. Always disappointing me 👎🏻

author: Elizabeth Wong
review_text: we had an enjoyable dinner at High Tide on 3 Nov, it was 2 of us + our furry gal. there were only 2 tables at 5.30pm, so the service and food were very prompt. the lady owner was very friendly, served a bowl of ice water to our gal without being asked, and chit chatted with us about her own dog and the restaurant background. we ordered 3 dishes, the cauli pop, tikka platter and palek paneer. they were all delicious, the tikka came on a sizzling platter and looked so mouth watering that the other table also looked over and exclaimed. the portions are pretty generous, we were stuffed and yet still packed some leftovers home. the pricing is not cheap, but also not overly pricy, and with the bigger portions and no GST charged is still quite good value. the bonus is the seaside view, with the seabreeze blowing over us and the sunset starting in the distance, a very relaxing and chill place. Will definitely be back again.

author: John John
review_text: First, I will say this is not a WHITE TABLE CLOTH Resteraunt, but the tablecloths are white, The Resteraunt name really says a lot because they WHIP your food up. I've been to many. This food was terrible. I will never go to this restaurant again or anything close to it. The chicken empanada was terrible poor qualiy. I couldn't even pick it up because it was soggy. So I needed a fork to eat my empanadas????? Never had an Empanada like that, and I've eaten all over the world. Beef empanada was fried more appropriate, but the beef used was poor quality. The spinach empanada was clearly the one that you see coming out the shell it wasn't good either. Next , the shrimps in garlic sauce a total of 6 for 22.50, which was also horrible, and a side order of spinach was not edible. I couldn't eat it. I literally couldn't swallow the food. And a bottle of pellegrino cost 8.25? That cost 4 times the amount as one bottle in a 12 pack. Then they rush you to leave. The waiter didn't have an understanding of the menu. For example, if you dont have something available on the menu what is the most popular dish or anything you suggest is the job of the waiter. The waiters and staff did not speak english enough to suggest anything in the menu. White Table Cloth Restaurants don't have 5 to 8 men waiters and busboys standing by the bar talking. Nobody greets you at the door. They greet you at Applebee's. For those who have eaten at AUTHENTIC WHITE TABLE CLOTH RESTAURANTS knows this is a 2.5 star restaurant at best. There's an OUTBACK STEAKHOUSE not too far from this place that's probably better. Oh yeah, I forgot the bread was good.

author: Alivey Maldonado
review_text: The food is so good and so many options!! I love the mexican music playing the whole time. Really represents our culture. Lots of authentic mexican food options as well as american. George was our server and he was super friendly. They provided fast service. 10/10 recommend. Will come back next time i am in vegas!

author: Nat Han
review_text: The man who took our order and served us our food could take some course in mannerism. He was rude. Didn't welcome or even greet us upon entering. This was our second choice because the other Thai Restaurant that we wanted to try had a line out the door. So we came here. The food was mediocre and way over priced. The portion was not worth the price but had the employee pretend to be friendly then I would have been fine with it. We thanked him multiple times but he didnt care to respond. This place should learn better customer service. No wonder this place was empty.

author: Hiroshi Kazuhiro
review_text: The toast bread is delicious and the coffee as well. But not the nasi lemak. I don't recommend you to take the nasi lemak. The kopitiam is at the old flat neighbourhood. So it's a bit rundown. Don't expect good environment and ambient.

author: Jason Liaw
review_text: First Visit, Impressive Experience! Tried the lamb hotpot and collagen soup - absolutely delightful! The lamb meat and bone were tender and flavorful. Staff were exceptionally helpful and polite, making our dining experience even more enjoyable. Definitely recommend this place! 5/5 stars

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: Rbw dinata
review_text: Pick any noodle stall in Bangkok, they were never failed. This is one of them. Busy staffs, full customers inside and many online order drivers queueing outside. Ordered their egg noodle with prawn and pork wontons and crispy pork belly. I amazed that chewy thin egg noodle could be so delicious seasoned by savory fragrant oil. Their generous big chunks of crunchy pork belly, chubby wontons and some green vegies, satisfying. Affordable price and good service too, fast, clean and orderly. Recommended.

author: Iuliia Litsevych
review_text: Delicious pandan desserts, was my first time trying, and I can say it’s better to eat them hot or warm for sure 👍🏼 it’s a place with a lot of different sweet snack near Siam square!

author: J
review_text: Comfortable and quaint little coffee shop with old school decor and outdoor style theme. The drink quality is very consistent, and the staff here are quick to remember what you usually order or like. The Brown Saigon style iced coffee was my favorite item to get here, strong coffee with the right amount of sweetness. The drink quality and flavors are top tier, and is better than some of the more popular chains found in Danang. Would highly recommend giving this place a shot if you have never been. They also have two cats which are well taken care of that will also socialize with patrons. :D

author: Amber Burns
review_text: Small hometown feel! Great atmosphere. Service is hopping and ready at your beck & call. Food came fast. Plum sauce and spring rolls were to perfection. Steak salad was excellent. Glad we found a local healthy place to eat!

author: Lorine Fyrd
review_text: It might not be the most refined restaurant in Bali, but it’s become my go-to spot — the food is super tasty and the portions are generous! In terms of value for money, I haven’t found anything better in Canggu. They’re pretty quick too, so I don’t get the negative reviews… The best!

author: Xinchen Tang
review_text: Very cheap price and good quality food, the owner can speak English, I didn’t order any drink and he served me a cup of tea for free, this fried rice is only 35000 and it’s very delicious, they have other different meals as well. I recommend this place. The tables are also very clean.

author: Angelique Milillo
review_text: Wow! Amazing service from Kelly and a dining experience that was nothing short of perfect. Every dish, from the appetizers to the dessert, was beautifully presented and absolutely delicious. Authentic Italian flavors, fresh ingredients, and handmade pasta that melts in your mouth—what more could you ask for? A true culinary delight! thank you!

author: Keri Carrillo
review_text: A literal nightmare. We’ve come here 3 times now and each time it’s been a disaster. Long wait times, wrong food, terrible food quality, etc. Last time we were here was over a year ago so we decided to give it another chance. We went through the drive thru and waited in line behind another car for about 5 minutes. The car in front of us gave up and left. We then waited to order at the speaker for another 3-4 minutes without anybody talking to us. We finally decided to pull up to the window, thinking maybe the speaker was broken. When we got to the window the girl looked at us and literally said “huh?” We told her we’d been waiting for quite a while and weren’t sure if the speaker was broken so decided to pull up to the window. She again so eloquently said “huh?” Another guy (the manager?) came up and asked what was going on and we again explained we’d been waiting for quite a while behind another car that had eventually left then waited some more and thought the speaker was broken so had pulled up to the window. He told us that they’d just (coincidentally?!) started taking the car behinds ours order and we’d need to go back around and get back in line. By now, we’d been waiting over 10 minutes to order 2 blasts, so didn’t want to pull back around and wait in the long line of cars that had piled up. We asked if there was any way we could just place our order at the window since it was small & fast. We had to ask them maybe twice to take our order but we were kind and respectful and not at all argumentative. The manager said it wasn’t a problem and he took our order and we paid for 2 blasts with extra mix-ins. The total for the two items was around $15. We waited about 3 min, got our 2 blasts and were on our way. Parted on good terms, thanked them for helping us out and drove off. As we started to dig in, we realized that the 2 medium cups that we’d just paid $15 for were filled with plain ice cream with some toppings on top. They hadn’t put any toppings in the ice cream or blended anything. I called the store and let the manager know and while he did offer to give me a gift card for new blasts, I wasn’t at all comfortable going back there. This location is ALWAYS short staffed, the staff that is there is not at all trained, and they’re unbelievably rude. Not once has the food been right and a couple items have been inedible. It’s always taken an inordinate amount of time to take the order and then an ever longer time to get the food. Everybody at this location (including the manager) needs to be fired, an entire new staff hired and they all need to actually be trained properly. In a time when everything in incredibly expensive and treats are few & far between, it’s not right that these children ruined a the little thing we’d decided to treat ourselves with. I will absolutely NEVER visit this location again.

author: Lisa Spenneberg
review_text: The atmosphere was like totally awesome! I did not get a picture of the oysters, we had four different types of oysters, yes it was the first time I've ever eaten an oyster and it was most awesome

author: Paul Ginnane
review_text: Old school “Roadhouse” feel place (without the fights!) that has great music, views and atmosphere! Great bar staff that will keep your drinks topped off and tons of stuff on the walls to keep your eyes wondering. Watched an awesome sunset from the deck seating area and enjoyed their classic burger and fries. Menu had some seafood that looked good too. Well worth the visit if in the area, I’ll be returning next time I’m in town.

author: Sandra Shinn
review_text: Came here on Sat around lunchtime and was fortunate to find no queue. We ordered three dishes for two people, and the portion sizes were generous. Everything tasted excellent, and the service was quick. However, the fried rice wasn’t very hot, and I couldn’t tell if it had been pre-fried. Regardless, it still tasted great. Overall, a pleasant dining experience!

author: Mark Blackham
review_text: Food the family for $38 and had some left overs. The sides are very simple and well made. The meats are great. The sauces are the highlight. My favs are the pineapple rum and guava BBQ. This is the restaurant I look forward to when traveling to Florida. My 4 yr old granddaughter asked what a review was. I told her I was sharing my opinion that the restaurant was good. She said she she also liked it and would say that it was DELICIOUS!!!

author: K
review_text: The pork katsu is thick and juicy. Even if it's fried, it's doesn't taste oily at all. What i find interesting is that you can choose the types of pork and cuts. However, there are limited seats so queueing are common.

author: Goh Su Teng
review_text: Perfect environment for a gathering or dine-in, cozy. Food arrangement look appetising. Service crew is nice

author: Kevin Stevano
review_text: Had a great experience at Milk & Madu Seminyak. The food was delicious with good portion sizes and consistent quality. The atmosphere is cozy and relaxed, perfect for breakfast, brunch, or hanging out with friends and family. The service was friendly, attentive, and efficient. Overall, a highly recommended place in Seminyak!

author: Shikhar Das
review_text: The Best Hookah Master in Miami! If you’re in Miami and want a flawless hookah experience, look no further than Amir at Hubble Bubble. I’ve been to lounges all over the city—and honestly, no one comes close to the level of skill, care, and hospitality Amir delivers every single time. From the moment you sit down, Amir makes sure everything is perfect. He knows exactly how to craft the smoothest, cleanest, and most flavorful hookah mixes, and he pays attention to every detail—heat management, airflow, bowl preparation, the works. You can tell immediately that he’s a true master of his craft. What really sets Amir apart is his attitude. He’s friendly, attentive, and genuinely wants guests to have an amazing experience. He checks on you without hovering, remembers your preferences, and always brings positive energy to the lounge. Hubble Bubble is great on its own, but with Amir there, it becomes a must-visit spot. Whether you’re a hookah expert or just enjoy a relaxing night out, ask for Amir—you’ll instantly understand why he’s the best in Miami. Highly recommend!

author: WTFYD DYFTW
review_text: Well what can i say about this place, it was an experience, please do not compare this place to panda express, its a moms and pops style, mixed with traditional asian style food, even though it has many similarities with panda express, but panda can never COMPETE WITH THE NOODLES IN THE CHOW MEIN. The place was not pack when we arrived but im sure we arrived at the right time because as we entered the line the place began to look we had found a neighborhood jewel with the amount of people that showed up. The staff were focused on taking care of the rush and everyone seemed to know how to do there jobs. This place was busy and not one customer was complaining about the wait. We drove 15 miles to get there because of recent publicity on tik tok, my wife finds these places all the time for us to experience different things as a family. The food portions were comparable to the price, if not more of a value than what we paid, we had left overs for two days. The selection was what you would expect in a franchise Chinese restaurant. I chose not to use the sauces they had to get a taste of the food they made, it was not bland at all. I can see me going back if i was on that side of town without a doubt.

author: Stephie C
review_text: They got 3 shops here, waiting time around 10 mins only. Bak kut teh tastes quite good. Overall dim sum not bad. Worth for a try.

author: Arthurlyn Cee
review_text: Service here is terrible! Unfortunately, the server who assisted us had a very negative attitude, which made the service unpleasant.

author: Scott Alan Blanchard
review_text: Oh wow! Great, FRESH YUMMY-LICIOUS-NESS! The smells alone could make you gain 10 pounds! I'm certain of it! I'm sure Heaven will have Carl's Donuts!

author: KK
review_text: Hot n stuffy inside the restaurant. No air con inside: Poor service. Famous for their tall roti tissue. Full of China chinese. Always got queue. Prepare for long wait for food

author: Euthymios Logothetis
review_text: Great food, good staff but badly understaffed most of the time. Orders taking fully a half hour after scheduled pickup times, god forbid you walk in. It’s a shame that it makes it unreliable when all the fundamentals are so good. Just trying to squeeze out an extra dollar.

author: Mikey Boy
review_text: The braised beef soup was a spicy delight that had just enough peppers to keep you on your toes and yet could be easily handled by a novice. Highly recommend a visit if you're staying in Chinatown.

author: 林谦颐Karen Lynne
review_text: Friendly & kind staffs helped me, 1st time customer, got free membership & saved well. The lambs are fresh & tender & juicy & very well cooked! Can’t make it at home that kinda pro quality! Really worth the price! 口水鸡 & 夫妻肺片 both are authentic & delicious, I ordered one more 夫妻肺片 as takeout! Will definitely come again & try hot pot & noodles. Highly recommend.

author: Nhi Le
review_text: Hands down THE BEST CARNE ASADA I’ve had in LA! You must get these, the freshly made tortillas really make all the difference! Still drooling thinking about that smoky meat and soft, fresh, chewy corn tortillas. Cabeza was really good too, chorizo was ok. But carne asada is a must! We preferred the soft tortillas (tacos, mulitas) over the crunchy ones (vampiros - they were a bit hard and messy to eat. Horchata was a bit too sweet for my liking. $9 for mulitas, $2.5 for taco, and $4 for vampiros if I remember correctly. There were some chairs and tables for sit down. We had to find street parking in the nearby blocks though. Ordering can be confusing if you don’t know what the Mexican dish names mean.

author: frances stangroom
review_text: Very glad we found this hidden gem. From the moment we arrived we felt like we were being treated like family. Ole was our server and he was so enthusiastic and attentive I had a smile on my face the entire visit. The food came out rather quickly and was seasoned perfectly. We had the fresh spring rolls to start, then we had Thai Fried Rice, Drunken Noodles, Mixed Vegetables and Basil Eggplant. We always get more so we can enjoy leftovers for next two days. It was definitely tasty the next day. Boun Thai is definitely worth the trip.

author: Alice Ang (艾利斯)
review_text: Good taste🤭 Is VERY Big portion of the pineapple fried rice😅 i think 6pax also dont even can finish 🤭

author: Michelle Arlene
review_text: vibey and cozy place, came around 10.30ish so we got a place to sit (if u come later, it’ll be full asap). food came out decently quick, and pretty filling for portion wise. food ordered (stars out of 3) : • salmon quiche (⭐️⭐️⭐️) — picky eater cous approved • egg’s benedict (⭐️⭐️.5) — like usual benny but its p guds • big breakfast (⭐️⭐️.5) — v filling, the hasbrown issa win • caramelised banana toast(?) (⭐️⭐️) — its okay, nothing cray. imo needa be more moist for the bread drink : • latte (⭐️⭐️) — p gudss, was a bit strong at first n taste a bit on the acid side when its colder.

author: Madeleine Tan
review_text: We tried the mixed selection of pastries and it was a good taste of local flavors. The pandan cake didn’t have a strong pandan flavor but it made up for it with its soft, chewy texture, great for a light snack on the go. The coconut pastries were better as it’s sweeter with distinct layers of flavor. You could really taste the corn and purple rice well.

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: Velika Mustika
review_text: Seng Kee is one of my go-to spots when I’m craving something satisfying and comforting especially at night or supper. Their chili crab is an absolute highlight—packed with flavour and just the right level of spice. It’s messy in the best way and perfect for sharing! Another must-try is the Herbal Pork Mee Sua with Intestine. The soup is rich and nourishing, with deep herbal notes, and the mix of tender pork and intestine adds great texture and taste. It’s comfort food at its finest. I also love their Sesame Black Chicken—fragrant, juicy, and full of goodness. And don’t miss out on the Crispy Bee Hoon! It’s crispy on the outside yet soft inside, and goes so well with the rest of the dishes. Basically, I love all the foods here. 😛 I’ll definitely be back for more!

author: Ayleen Trindade
review_text: I’ve been here twice in one week and it’s just so good. You get the great service, tasty food, good coffee, and the pink aesthetics. Thank you Valentina & Annabelle! You ladies are so hospitable! 10/10 recommend

author: Jarot Wahyu Ardhi
review_text: Halal muslim owned restaurant.. nice and delicate flavour with acceptable prices..

author: Steph Tan
review_text: The pancake flavour quite special and nice. I like the green colour one - pandan flavour. ✌️❤️

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: Brenda Yeo
review_text: The food was so delicious. Ingredients were generous, and the portions were just right for the four of us. The staff who took our order was very courteous and made appropriate recommendations so we don’t over order. Thank you for a great meal!

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: Joanna Tags
review_text: We tried the crab omelette, wagyu pad kra pao, yellow curry with vermicelli, and pad thai. Everything was so delicious! It was such a nice dinner on our first night in Bangkok. They accidentally billed us twice for my drink, but when we went back a few minutes later, the staff were very accommodating and quickly gave us a refund. Great food and great service, highly recommend!

author: Benjamin L
review_text: Overall great experience. Food was delicious. The highlights would be the traditional paella which flowed with tons of flavor. My only thing is I wish there was more rice with the paella, but tons of seafood and meats was nice. The meat platter was also tasty, just sad there was only one lamb chop. The negra paella was also worth a try. Definitely go with a group of 3 or more people to try more tapas and enjoy all they have to offer. My only concerns was we went on a weekend night and were seated by the open window, where cars kept zooming past loudly. Ask to be seated further back in the restaurant and away from the street.

author: BOON LEONG TAN
review_text: On 13th July 2025, me and family members come to visit this famous restaurant in Hatyai. Since the crowds are big and the waiting time to be around 20 to 30 mins. The ordering was easy as the restaurant owner well speak English. All the dishes we ordered are recommended. We ordered the roasted chicken, clear tomyam, sausage and fried rice. Although with a many customers the timing to serving was great and didn't take much time. Well done.

author: nial nasa
review_text: everything about this place is top notch. the food is bussing. they SERVED. the place is quiet comfy and cozy. DEFINITELY GOING TO COME AGAIN. thanks to one of the server, ROSE for guiding us. thanks donkai.

author: Polina Antipova
review_text: Ok, first to the atmosphere. It’s cool at the lobby with that screen showing Gordon Ramsay, pretty basic inside the dining room on the second floor. Second, the service, it was good and I loved that the chef came out to our kid to greet him with a souvenir. (it was actually my 11 y.o. idea to come here) Now, to the food. There are 2 dishes I really liked: Beef Wellington and Sticky Toffee Pudding dessert. We also tried sea scallops (they were too salty) and steak tartar (lacking of taste) but didn’t like it. My kid liked his filet mignon steak and wagyu meatballs. My husband really liked roasted brussels sprouts Anyway, I would visit it again for brunch experience.

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: genalyn Gocon
review_text: Can be less crowded if you come early on weekends all the seafoods are cheaper compared to our neighborhood market but if you buy a fish they won't clean for you The food court upstairs 2nd level are awesome specially the kambing soup and the mee rebus

author: Syidah Fitri
review_text: Recommend you to try this halal japanese restaurant if you come to TRX! I really live the vibe, feeling² like real japanese restaurant. They got Wagyu/Angus beef/chicken for the patty, and I would recommend you guys to choose Truffle as the sauce! It was so delicious 9/10. If you small eater like me, better choose 1 patty only, well serving portion. Btw beware with ur wallet, it's a bit pricey but worth the money! (Got tips from the worker, mix white rice with pasteurised egg + Furikake + soy sause + truffle sauce = mix² together. Best rice mix eat with the patty! 9/10) 💯✨️

author: Ch'ng Ewe Theng (Thomas Ch'ng)
review_text: A special thank-you to the Boss and his wife for the amazing meal they served us for free on the night we escaped from the city centre. They turned their restaurant into a soup kitchen, offering free food to everyone — customers and locals alike. We thought we could go home the next morning, but the second wave came and destroyed their restaurant overnight. We truly believe the Boss will receive good karma, and his business will come back even stronger when he reopens. 🙏❤️ From the B2 Premier Hotel 7th floor 11 Gang with Love ❤️❤️❤️

author: Sleepy Snoopy
review_text: Value for money, the best was the pork trotter , deeply braised soak well in the sauce dark enough , peppery soup and tender pork ribs, peanuts was well cooked $10 pork ribs , $9 trotter , free refill soup

author: Genta
review_text: The go to restaurant brand for amazing Pan-Indonesian food!! Always love Remboelan and this branch specifically don’t get too crowded like the other brances (GI, Lotte) which usually has queues! We got in at 6PM with no wait!!! Service was nice, we had bakulan asap, bakwan jagung with good roa, sate sapi matah (was a bit hard tho sadd), cumi wonosobo, and es pisang hijau makassar. Really good! All came out around 450K IDR

author: Jordan Cotton
review_text: Just opened and just….wow! It’s like stepping back in time to Vietnam in the ancient times. Amazing food, better ambience, perfect setting. For westerners/foreigners wanting a traditional Vietnamese, ancient countryside experience in the city - then this hidden gem will be for you. It will not be hidden much longer. Trust me.

author: I Made Judistira
review_text: I usually eat at this restaurant in Plaza Senayan or Gandaria City, and this is my first time at Senayan City. Don't know why.. I think the food here tastes better. No wonder this place is always full. Highly recommended for those of you who want to eat Indonesian food.. 👍

author: erin
review_text: Yasniel was excellent! Every item we ordered was recommended by him and excellent! Tha Vaca Frita was incredible and can never go wrong with maduros in Miami. Great service and great food!

author: Richard Sng
review_text: I paid $7.80 for this BKT with rice. First impression is nothing spectacular. However I got a wow effect when I start eating. The soup is peppery with a hint of herbs favour. The pork ribs are super tender, literally melt in your mouth. The unassuming dark sauce is one of the main actor. It is spicy enough to kick off the overall Shiokness. I must say this is one of the best BKT around. Totally worth it.

author: Hayley T
review_text: Beautiful fresh salad. Team were so friendly and food delicious. Even got a takeaway milkshake for dessert

author: Prettyme Yu
review_text: The pig organ soup was nice. Braised pig trotter and braised intestine was delicious. My son especially loved the braised intestine. Ordering very systematic. You just need find a table, then go to front to order. They will give you a number. Serving quote fast despite a lot of ppl. Place a bit rundown tho.

author: Chris K
review_text: They've fallen off in the past few years. Vibe and visual still great, but the meat lacked flavor. Needs salt, marinade, or a pre-roll. Very 1 dimensional. Must be retirement phase

author: Rachel Kissinger
review_text: WHOAH. This place is a 5min walk from Freemont Street and absolutely amazing. Even with the paving work outside, which added to the low-key vibe, we looooooooved this place. We had Devil's Eggs, Beet salad and each had a smashburger. Everything was delicious. Great staff, great food and great ambience. Do it - you won't regret it.

author: Jan Exar Aspiras
review_text: Food is good. but the Quantity is really plenty. We ordered #5, and it should be sufficient for 2-3 person.

author: E Ang
review_text: An old fashioned eating outlet resemblance of a traditional coffee shop. The main food item served is chicken rice which is not bad and is different from the normal boils type of cooking for the chicken. The meat is not so fatty but yet is tender and chewy. Is nice and tasty. The veggie is cooked Hainanese style with lots of dried shrimp and its favors is too strong and not too my liking. Otherwise the chicken and rice is definitely good and is recommended .

author: Roy Prawira
review_text: The food is delicious, the service is fast and detailed, especially by Rara and Agung, who are very helpful.

author: Thanh Lam
