review_text: Delicious claypot rice, variety of dishes, delicious shrimp paste dish worth trying, parking on both sides, will come back

author: Ashish Upreti
review_text: Had the Chill momo and steam Momo. The Best Nepali Momo in all of new Jersey. Authentic Nepali taste !! One of few places in US, where I really enjoyed the momo.

author: Kay
review_text: After the renovation, the restaurant’s atmosphere became much more upscale and bright, which I really liked. The food was excellent, and the service was also satisfying. I would definitely visit again!

author: Marce J
review_text: Amazing experience! The service was excellent. We had dinner at the bar and loved it, the bartender were shaking cocktails right in front of us and sharing the stories behind them, which really made the evening feel special. The live Latin American music in the background added so much atmosphere, and the food was truly great. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Natalee Guerra
review_text: Came in for lunch because we saw they had gluten-free fish and chips and were excited! We had an extremely uncomfortable experience here and will likely never return when visiting Boston. Overall, the food was ok for the price, but the service was not good at all. We were sat instantly, however, it seemed to take about 10 minutes for us to even be acknowledged by our waitress. The restaurant was not very busy for a Sunday afternoon and they seemed to be perfectly staffed. Initally, she just handed us waters with no introduction. She then came back around 10 minutes later and asked if we were ready to order to which we ordered the fish and chips. We then proceeded to be given gluten-free rolls which was awesome. The Guy who ran our food out, gave us more conversation than our waitress did the entire time. I started to put my coat back on to show we were ready to leave. The waitress came over and asked if we wanted dessert, we declined and said we were ready for the check. To which she pulled out the machine for us to pay. We were planning on leaving a cash tip, however when my sister selected no tip the waitress immediately asked is there a reason why you selected no tip? It threw us off. I looked at her and said we were planning on leaving a cash tip to which her demeanor changed and her response was I take cash as well. I was extremely thrown off and just grabbed the loose dollars that I had in my purse which I gave to her. She counted in front of me and scoffed. She did not give us a receipt so I am unable to leave a name that explains how much service she even gave to us in the first place. In my opinion, this is extremely inappropriate behavior from a waitress. We were hardly attended to in the first place yet to be asked this kind of question? I have never been asked why I wasn’t leaving a tip or watched while selecting the tip option. It was extremely uncomfortable. For the price of the food, the service should match and this restaurant did not meet those expectations.

author: Jennifer Ruff
review_text: I was looking up late night spots in LA after getting some tattoos and this spot seemed pretty enticing! Although, in typical LA fashion the plaza is a mess for parking. There was a pretty sizable wait-list but the wait wasn't too bad. The food though? Delish!! Authentic, good portions and don't forget to order a side of rice and their locally brewed Ruen Pair beer.

author: Chris Ferreira
review_text: I honestly feel like this place is better for drinks then for food I felt like it was extremely overpriced for what we actually got. I did think they went above and beyond with the menu. It was a nice personal touch. I was there for an anniversary and a birthday and they gave her a personalized menu but other than that when you spend 400+ on a dinner 389 to be exact you would think you would get more. I will say that I went there prior just for drinks in the atmosphere. It was pretty amazing. But just be aware that you are going to spend quite a bit when you go here it’s up to you if you think it’s worth it or not I believe this place is more hype than what it’s worth. I would be willing to try it again some other time. The milk and cookies was amazing! Also had to add that in there

author: Otoko Otoko
review_text: Long queue for this chicken rice stall. Just $3 for a decent sized plate of Hainanese Chicken Rice

author: Iris Chang
review_text: Celebrated my birthday here - great ambience, really tasty food and impeccable service. The server Anom gave food recommendations that were spot on - potato Mille feuille, empanadas, grilled octopus and wood-fired chicken finished off with Frozen Cheesecake. Anom surprised us with a complimentary guava pie and took great photos of us. The only regret I have was not eating here in all my earlier trips to Bali.

author: Dirty Souf Yankee
review_text: Excellent and quick service, but the food fell short. The plate was not worth $20. Fries were lukewarm, some were cold. They had clearly been sitting out for awhile and we're not fresh. The pita was thin and tough/chewy. It felt stale as well. The hummus was ok, good creamy texture but strong tahini flavor (not a fan). I wish it had a little bit of different flavor to it. Salad was ok, basic. Did not care for the garlic sauce, but their house spicy sauce was bomb! Falafel was pretty yummy. Rice was soft & tender. The chicken & lamb shawarma was tender, tasty and seasoned well. That was the best part of the plate. I expected more given the high ratings and reviews here. But it also appears they offer incentives for good reviews. *sigh* Id say the dinner plates are average, at best. The cashier was sweet and lovely, though.

author: Berge Wassilian
review_text: For a quick fill of your stomach: French fries - Fast and delicious.

author: Kenn Mullen
review_text: Comfort breakfast food, the classics at its best and a wonderful in-the-neighbourhood vibe. The kayaking and butter on toast can be a challenge for some, but these people have perfected it! The half boiled eggs were super consistent and not over or undercooked. Nothing short of perfection. The one that took me by surprise was their KIAM KOPI (salted coffee) cant say that it was any more salty than salted caramel, and its malty texture made it taste alot like mocha and i LOVE mocha! The nasi lemak was nothing to write home about, but still scratches the itch if you craving for some. Overall score: AWESOME! Cant wait to come back here

author: Michael Fisher
review_text: I adore this place for its all day breakfast. The atmosphere feels warm and welcoming, and Melody made my visit even nicer with her wonderful service. My meal was amazing. I ordered the veggie scramble and it was so filling that I could not try the cornmeal pancakes, even though they looked fantastic. I already know that on my next visit I am definitely going to try them.

author: Cordero Emile
review_text: I went here last week and I had the time of my life over here. The interior of this place is beautiful combined with the food and service makes this one of the Best Black Restaurants and Restaurants period in Boston. The complimentary muffins they give you is so addictive, while the drink I ordered was a Red sangria tasted so right and the Rasta Pasta with chicken I ordered is one of the best I’ve eaten. I would definitely come here again. In addition to what I previously said, here are more photos of Park 54 and it’s food I ate at later visits and also when you stop by at Park 54 I want you to give praise to the Chef Khadijah who works there. She is the best Chef I ever met and that woman works too hard to not get the respect she deserves.

author: Katy Hernández
review_text: The place is located in a spot I never would’ve imagined — literally at a gas station — but to me, it’s a true hidden gem. You can choose your favorite wine and they’ll open it for you. The paella is delicious, the octopus is very good, and the people who work there are warm and welcoming. I also noticed that the owner is truly attentive to making sure everything runs smoothly. I’ve been there about three times, every time I visit Miami, and I always leave happy. If you’re someone who appreciates complete silence, this isn’t the place, but you can still have a perfectly good conversation and enjoy a delicious meal. If you live in Miami or are visiting, I highly recommend stopping by — it’s an interesting and unique spot!

author: WD SonjaInc
review_text: Used to be 5 stars, taste of the food and the chicken texture was great. Their homemade luncheon meat also good flavor.... But recently the portion has been getting smaller and smaller. The last time I ordered the 4ppl portion chicken for 3 ppl we still had to eat them sparingly cause there was so little meat nia It's been nice knowing you guys, bye 👋🏻👋🏻

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Anastasiia
review_text: Great place, deserves its michelen stars. There was the queue to enter, but it was not so long, around 30 minutes, not over. While I was waiting, I was offered the small fan (on the back side, you can see all chain restaurants in Singapore. Than they gave the small paper with queue number, you can pre-order food while waiting, it was very convenient. I have ordered pork rib soup and pork tenderloin. It was super delicious, only they offered to refill the soup if you have finished it. Perfect and highly recommended!

author: mojojoedwards
review_text: A good break from Indonesian food. Taste like proper Vietnamese food - although the pho could do with a little less MSG flavour. Restaurant is packed with East/SouthEast Asians which is testament to how good/authentic the food is.

author: Ali Raza
review_text: Firstly, the service was incredible. The staff was super attentive and helpful in explaining allergens etc. The staff also dealt another table of entitled customers very professionally so kudos to them. The food tasted great. There were alot of raving reviews about this spot and it didn't disappoint one bit. A special shout out to their carrot cake. scrumptious!!!

author: Vanessa A.
review_text: We ordered pork noodle soup, Thai boat noodles (beef), dry pork noodles, and pork balls and they did not disappoint! The broth was super thick and flavorful and the springy noodles and toppings complemented the broth well. Portion-wise, a bowl is enough for one person, or even two people if you don't eat much.

author: Tukang
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 — Absolutely Superb Experience La Brisa Canggu is easily one of the most beautiful and atmospheric spots in Bali. The vibe is absolutely superb — a perfect mix of tropical charm, bohemian detail, and relaxed seaside energy. Every corner of the venue feels carefully curated with unique rustic design and warm lighting that makes it feel both magical and cozy. The food was delicious and beautifully presented — fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with care. The cocktails were outstanding as well, perfectly balanced and full of character. The service team was friendly and attentive without ever feeling intrusive. Whether you come for sunset drinks, a laid-back dinner, or just to enjoy the view, La Brisa Canggu truly captures the soul of Bali’s coastal lifestyle. Highly recommended — an unforgettable experience from start to finish.

author: 金正一
review_text: I visited this restaurant after seeing a YouTuber’s recommendation. There are many food options to choose from. This time, I tried the crab fried rice. It had a generous amount of crab meat, and the eggs were cooked very smoothly and tenderly. The flavor was quite mild, perfect for those who prefer less strong tastes. I believe it would be even better if paired with some tomato sauce. The portion size was large, and I was already quite full after eating it alone, so I couldn’t try anything else. I feel a bit regretful for not trying the Pad Thai, which I’m sure would be even more satisfying. The restaurant is conveniently located near Siam Square, making it easy to go shopping or get a massage afterward. Highly recommended!

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Cassandra Bell
review_text: My favorite health food spot on the Westside! I’m actually attached to the Blue Crush smoothie…. Service is always warm, wide selection of health conscious options, vibe is lovely with books and games on the shelves. I make sure to come here whenever I’m in the area <3

author: Francois Cournil
review_text: Good breakfast with friendly and efficient service. I had the cheese roti option A and it was delicious. Recommended.

author: Jeff Cannon
review_text: We have eagerly awaited Koro’s opening! They’re a welcome addition to the neighborhood of East Boston. The restaurant is clean and bright, the tables are intimate, and the menu is easy to read on the wall. You order at the counter and grab a table. There are 5-6 tables and an outward-facing bar seating for 5 people. The single-use bathroom was clean and accessible. My wife and I had chicken karaage (app), a spicy tuna roll, and a crazy caterpillar roll. I felt it was good for the price! The app came out within 5 minutes; the rolls came out about 10 minutes later. They were busy and I still felt this was a reasonable time to wait for freshly made, counter-ordered food. Give them a try! Welcome, Koro!

author: Wenter S.
review_text: Super tiny so limited seating! I came here by myself and waited about 5 minutes for a seat outside. Such good breakfast and coconuts milk latte, yum. Can’t wait to come back

author: Minh Ngo
review_text: This place is surprisingly cozy and fancy. It’s like a combination of a gallery and also a coffee shop at the same time. I would definitely recommend this place for dating. The drink is good too. The hojicha latte has a distinctive taste.

author: PraSan
review_text: Love this place. Everyone is so nice and our waiter was really nice and awesome! I am coming again with friends. Love this place so much. It is authentic nacho and it is really good.

author: Alberto Guzman
review_text: I recently had the pleasure of dining at a this charming restaurant situated right in front of a marina, offering a mostly enjoyable experience, though there were some areas that could be improved. The first thing that captured my attention was the stunning view of the marina—a picturesque backdrop that made it an ideal spot for a relaxing dinner. However, the environment was a bit noisier than I prefer, with lively conversations and the sounds of nearby boats creating a bustling atmosphere that occasionally distracted from the meal. The food, on the other hand, was a true delight. The menu featured a variety of delicious options, and each dish we ordered was well-prepared, flavorful, and made with fresh ingredients that perfectly complemented the waterfront setting. I also appreciated the surprisingly quick meal prep time, which allowed us to enjoy the evening without long waits between courses. The service was friendly and attentive, with our server ensuring our drinks were filled and checking in on us regularly. However, during peak times, it seemed they were stretched a bit thin, resulting in slight delays. Even so, I was impressed with their efficiency in delivering our meals promptly. Unfortunately, one downside to our visit was the occasional presence of individuals approaching our table to ask for money. While I understand this can occur in busy areas, it was disruptive and detracted from an otherwise pleasant experience. It would be helpful for the restaurant to implement measures to better manage such interruptions, enhancing the overall ambiance and comfort for diners.

author: lisa murphy
review_text: Came here every day for a week it was so good. Great omelets. Awesome value for money. Cute diner.

author: Jinghorjiak
review_text: This is not my first time coming here. This food centre is a place to find many good local food. Standard of food here is quite high. Noodles, rices, xiaolongbao….etc. most all are above average. Will back again to try the food from other stalls.

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: megan
review_text: The place is more comfortable than others. It’s a standalone shop, near the temple and there’s a sheltered walkway from paya lebar square and the MRT. I arrived at around 11.30 and there were people queuing for takeaways and eating there. It’s also 50cents cheaper for the brown rice as compared to other leichas. THEY ACCEPT CDC VOUCHERS! THE TEA IS GOOD. Finally. It’s herby and you can see the seeds. It’s a little bit salty but not overly salty. Everything else is cooked well too. They include haebi as well.

author: Rachelle Hodges
review_text: Arrived just before 11:00 pm, after a long day of flying and starving. Waited in a stall for a bit until a voice came on saying drive thru only. Okay moved to drive thru. Waited 30 minutes to order behind 1 car. The person taking our order was rude. Took another 5 or so minutes to receive our food. I ordered a BBQ burger with no bun (I'm gluten free) and this was what I was given. I've ordered this many times from other Sonic stores and it's put in a container with a fork and knife. This didn't have the grilled onions or other vegetables either. Very disappointed.

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: Mustafa Yehia
review_text: Most people can’t even decide on a tie, and here they are handing you two menus and expecting you to behave. It’s an embarrassment of riches, really—Mặn Mòi and Hum Lounge playing house in a garden that’s far more tranquil than my last three massages. Here is how you handle a table for three without looking like an amateur: The Nem Vuông Nấm: These mushroom squares are a miracle of engineering. Usually, "plant-based" is just a polite way of saying "we ran out of ideas," but these are crispy, golden little boxes of secrets. They have more personality than most people I've worked with. The "Wrapped Meat" Ritual: Whether it’s the Gà nướng lá dứa (Pandan Chicken) or the Bò nướng ống tre (Beef in Bamboo), it’s dinner as a DIY project. You wrap the meat, you commit to the flavor, and you pretend you’ve done something productive with your hands. It’s smoky, tender, and—since we’re skipping the pork—tactically brilliant. The Cơm Chiên Gà Đồng, Lá É: Fried rice with lemon basil. It smells better than a French perfume and actually delivers on the promise. It’s the kind of starch that doesn't just sit there; it performs. The Dừa Nướng: They grill the coconut because, apparently, just being a fruit wasn’t dramatic enough. It’s chilled, it’s sweet, and it’s the only thing in this humidity that actually works as advertised. The Verdict: We skipped the pork and I didn't feel a hint of deprivation. Sit in the garden, order with the confidence of a man with a gold card, and let everyone think you’re a genius. It’s much easier than actually being one.

author: Ji Young Yoon
review_text: Really nice brunch and drinks with great service. Had an iced latte with coffee cubes which was so nice and the hojicha latte was delicious. Crispy calamaris were good, smoked salmon egg’s Benedict comes with gouda cheese which was fantastic. Their oven baked eggs was creamy tangy and little spicy, so nicely balanced.

author: Callin Mullaney
review_text: One of the best pizza places I've been too and a top contender in NYC. The staff was ridiculously friendly, the slices were huge and amazing, and the wait time (despite the long line) was not a big deal. This is a must stop for any traveler visiting Brooklyn or a local looking for the best place. Can't say enough great things about this place.

author: Agnes Hermann
review_text: By far the best restaurant in Miami. Every time we went to Niu Kitchen, the food was AMAZING. We love the simplicity of the place, very quick service, every single dish prepared with professionalism and love. We appreciate to have a place like this. Can’t wait to be back again.

author: Emily Ky
review_text: Sevice is good and staff well trained. However food serving not hot enough and getting cold in 15 minutes. River prawn not the fresh catch indeed it’s frozen. Overall,foods just average with not in economic range. A lot of China Tourist and most probably they saw some tourist videos.

author: Liliya Fisher
review_text: I had seabass and it was cold and small. Half of it was just thick skin. I was very disseminate. Tuna tartar was small as well. Half the size of what im used to getting at other restaurants and the sesame cracker was soggy. Last time I was there it wasn't like this. Maybe bad chef night?

author: Brian McCaffrey
review_text: Good pub food, a friendly and relaxed vibe, nice staff. Cozy neighborhood spot with live music, karaoke, and comedy nights.

author: tracey napoleon
review_text: Made reservations for 4 on Saturday at 4:45. When we got there it wasn’t crowded, so we were seated right away. The staff was professional and attentive. The restaurant has an old rustic vibe which was ok for me. We ordered some apps the..scallops stuffed with crab meat and scallops with calamari in a spicy sauce. It was just ok. I wasn’t able to eat the calamari, because they were rubbery. The lentil soup they served was good. My dinner was Salmon with crab meat on top. It wasn’t good. The salmon was flavorless and was on top of a red sauce that wasn’t good at all. My husband enjoyed his meal which was the steak ham and egg special. I should have just gotten the Paella Valenciana which my friend said was good. Over all the experience was good. If i do come back I will get the Paella Valenciana.

author: Murugan Namasivayam
review_text: We enjoyed the quality of the food and service. Veggie platter was very well made and crisp. My personal favorite was Veggie wrap that had chickpeas and tofu with the right amount and blend of spices.We also had biriyani, tandoori chicken and mango lassi which we enjoyed it.

author: Carrick F
review_text: Incredible place! The staff are so lovely, the food is some of the best around - and completely vegetarian/vegan. The atmosphere is laid back and accommodating for everyone. You will often see many locals enjoying the space throughout the day. We loved coming in on a Sunday to see the staff preparing meals together for the less-fortunate in the local community. The staff always greet you with a smile and you can see that they genuinely love what they do. Highly recommend!

author: Lupita Luna
review_text: The meat was delicious tender and very flavorful. We had the Chico platter it had half slab of ribs and half chicken for me and my husband and some brisket all the choices were magnificent! The meat smelled delicious and tasted you could tell how well they brined it. Anyhow we had left overs and that’s what had for next day lunch. The spot was picked by my husband 🙌

author: FoodLover Benson
review_text: Beef steak rice was not bad Adding the fried onion gives a marvellous crunchiness for the whole dish, but a little bit lack of sauce. Beef tongue is something you could die for! Love the charcoal smell and every pieces are perfectly cooked. Gonna order two for myself for the next time!

author: Khánh Tâm
review_text: The claypot rice and food here are delicious 😍, I rarely eat claypot rice, my friend is abroad so I want to let her experience Vietnamese cuisine. I opened the map and saw this restaurant, the picture was also very interesting so I took my friend to eat and the ending was very surprising, it was delicious, very delicious 🤤 ! We ordered: - normal claypot rice - burnt edge claypot rice (quite painful to the teeth, don't recommend eating 🥲) - stir-fried morning glory with garlic (crazy delicious!) - bitter melon fish cake soup (delicious, but the fish cake is not too fragrant 😢) - lemongrass chicken (delicious, my friend loves this dish) My friend paid so I don't remember how much the damage was 🤣🤣🤣, remember it was delicious haha

author: Joey Barrett
review_text: This is the best catfish I have had in a long time and some of the best I have ever had. The baked macaroni and cheese is made almost identical to how my family in South Carolina made it growing up same with the potato salad. On top of all that the cornbread is amazing, sweet and moist. I will definitely return! In addition to the wonderful, authentic food every one is very friendly. Wonderful service, clean restaurant, no issues at all!!!

author: TenTen 1010 (TenTen1010)
review_text: The food were ok ish but the service kind of not responsive. The decorations were nice, but the sink are quite far.

author: Tony R
review_text: Zero stars. Worst service. Do not go. They will forget your pieces of your order and then say it was in the bag. Save your money.

author: Tee Elle See
review_text: This restaurant is the nicest I've been to, and also extremely clean. The food was delicious, our server, Emily, was wonderful. The posters on the wall, were fun to see. We can't wait to visit again, when we are in town!!

author: Victor Price
review_text: Great place. Pleasant atmosphere. Excellent customer service. Food well cooked with acceptable portions and presentation.

author: wei chong lim
review_text: Best place for a seafood lover! This restaurant is so famous that they own 2 shops in the same alley. The new shop was much bigger and nicer compared to old restaurant. All the seafoods served was fresh and in good quality. The curry crab is suitable for those who can’t take spicy, haha. It was rich and creamy with slight spicy. River prawn has 2 sizes with different prices. It was not overly grilled which can bring out the best flavour and texture of the prawn. Crab meat fried rice was another dish that I like. Foods were presentable and served fast. Service from staffs was good as well.

author: Henry
review_text: Friendly bakery / coffee shop. Enjoyed a lovely Salmon bagel breakfast as well as coffee and some of their pasties. Good to see stuff being baked in front of your eyes.

author: Cindy W
review_text: We ended up at this restaurant after our flight was canceled. It was a delightful surprise! We arrived about 30 minutes before the restaurant was due to close, but the servers and live music welcomed us warmly. Kevin was very friendly and recommended some dishes for us. The two of us shared some empanadas and a smaller portion of the mixed grill. The mixed grill was enormous, with a portion large enough for at least four people! The steaks were perfectly cooked to medium rare, and the sweet bread was delicious (even though I am usually not a fan). It was the perfect dish to share and taste a bit of everything! If you love steak, this is the place to be!

author: Brian Hinkle
review_text: Good food. Huge portions. Great staff. First stop from landing at the airport. Hidden gem

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: Adam Do
review_text: We randomly came across this restaurant while walking around Saigon, and it ended up being one of the best meals we had during our trip. It’s clearly very popular and well known, there was a wait when we arrived. The architecture and design of the restaurant are incredible and truly one of a kind. It reminded us of a Studio Ghibli–style aesthetic, with beautiful details throughout. The interior features Portuguese-style tiles on the floors, and as you move up each level, the space opens into different Studio Ghibli–inspired scenes. It’s an amazing place for photos as well as dining. We ordered an entrée featuring dried mushrooms, broccolini, and lotus, which was incredible. We also had the sautéed garlic chive flowers with Sapa wild mushrooms, light, fresh, and full of flavour, the perfect refreshing dish. For the main, we shared the salt-baked Man Hill pork platter, served with wild herbs and rice paper. It was outstanding. Wrapping the pork with herbs in rice paper made for the perfect bite, simple, balanced, and absolutely delicious. The restaurant is busy, and we had to wait about 30 minutes, but it was well worth it. We just walked around the area and came back. Definitely recommend booking ahead if you can, this place is a must-visit in Saigon.

author: Terence Wong
review_text: Came to try this after watching a lot of tiktok videos that recommended this stall. But was totally disappointed. Only taste I got is very sweet. The other stall Kanom Siam we tried at one of the mall is so much better than this.

author: Fay M
review_text: All you can eat sushi for 90 minutes for $31 ($18 for kids 5-9). They have a lot of items on their menu including ramen, salads, skewers and desserts. We got there late so I chose to just à la carte a couple of items but next time I'll definitely do the all you can eat option.

author: Natulya S.
review_text: It was an excellent choice. We arrived without a reservation but were seated on the patio. The food arrived promptly despite the restaurant being full. The food was delicious. The Greek salad is excellent and made by Greek standards: big chunks of feta and vegetables with a very tasty dressing. We got lamb kebab which was slightly burnt but still good and stuffed peppers-excellent. We also took a plate of fried smelts. In Greece it is called small fish. It was excellent as well. The portions are big, we could not finish them and they packed the leftovers for us. I would highly recommend this place.

author: TwoSomeVoyage
review_text: Visited Maxwell Food Centre looking for the famous chili crab at Stall 41, but it was closed until Christmas. Chili crab in Singapore is well known, but the popular places are pricey, so I was happy to explore hawker options instead. Ended up eating at a chicken rice stall that usually has a long line—worth it. The chicken was tender, portions were just right, and the chili sauce is very spicy, so be careful. Cutlery comes one per bowl, and extras cost a small fee. Credit cards are accepted, which is convenient. Tried a Michelin-listed oyster dessert nearby—interesting to try once, though personally I prefer Korean-style oyster pancakes.

author: SP
review_text: Finally got a chance to try the kai si hor fun here. It was... underwhelming. The dry curry noodle was good though. Arrived at 7:30am and there were throngs of customers seated, waiting for the hor fun and curry noodle stall to start cooking. We waited 45 minutes for our noodles as there were about 50+ other customers waiting. The kai si hor fun looked great when it arrived but something's amiss - soup was only half bowl, barely enough to cover its noodles. A flip of the hor fun to mix, there was hardly 5cm of broth. Really stingy and the soup was warm - must be due to mass cooking before serving. The soup tasted rich with a strong taste of prawn. Hor fun as default in Ipoh, is smooth as silk. We ordered extra sides of pork and fish ball and they were great - bouncy texture and rich flavours. But if I were to rate the kai si hor fun - it is 3 of 5 stars only. Because it was served warm, and wasn't enough soup. Their dry curry chicken noodle was good though - right level of gravy thickness and kick of spiciness. Add lime, and its tanginess elevates the overall taste of the dish. I would rate it as 5 of 5. Would I come back for kai si hor fun? Nope. Dry curry noodles? Maybe if the wait is shorter.

author: KK IT
review_text: If you're on the hunt for a sukiyaki experience that's as authentic as it gets, Elvis Suki in Soi Yotse should be your next culinary destination. Nestled in a bustling alley of Yotse, this eatery offers a nostalgic trip back to traditional Thai suki, with a twist of modern flair. **Ambiance:** The first thing you notice when stepping into Elvis Suki is the casual and welcoming vibe. The décor is simple, reminiscent of a classic Thai diner, but with an undeniable charm. The bustling kitchen and the sound of sizzling meats create an energetic atmosphere that's both lively and comforting. **Menu Highlights:** The star of the show here is undoubtedly the sukiyaki. The broth is rich and flavorful, simmering to perfection with a harmonious blend of herbs and spices. Whether you prefer it with pork, chicken, or seafood, each option is cooked to tender perfection. The accompanying vegetables are always fresh, adding a delightful crunch to each bite. One must-try dish is their famous grilled pork, marinated in a savory sauce that strikes the perfect balance between sweet and savory. It's grilled to a delightful char, adding a smoky flavor that's simply irresistible. **Service:** Despite its modest setting, the service at Elvis Suki is top-notch. The staff are friendly and attentive, always ready to make recommendations or refill your broth. They go out of their way to make you feel at home, which only enhances the overall dining experience. **Price Point:** One of the best aspects of Elvis Suki is its affordability. The generous portions and reasonable prices make it a fantastic option for both lunch and dinner. You get excellent value for your money without compromising on quality. **Overall Experience:** Dining at Elvis Suki is like taking a journey through time, with flavors that evoke memories of home-cooked meals and family gatherings. It's a place where tradition meets taste, providing an unforgettable sukiyaki experience. Whether you're a local or a tourist, Elvis Suki in Soi Yotse is a must-visit spot that will leave you coming back for more.

author: Jocelyn Herrera
review_text: First time passing by after it being remodeled and honestly loved it. Place looked very cute! Music was definitely a vibe && Martin our server was amazing !!

author: мιѕѕувєlα2828
review_text: Another popular spot along Banthat Thong Road that consistently draws a long queue—this place is well-loved for its toasted buns with a variety of fillings. We tried the Thai milk tea and pandan custard versions, and they definitely exceeded our expectations. The buns were perfectly toasted—crispy on the outside while staying soft and fluffy inside. The chilled custard filling, which had an ice cream–like texture, complemented the warm bun beautifully. At just 50 THB for two buns, it’s an affordable and satisfying sweet treat worth queuing for!

author: Saravanan Baskaran
review_text: The place had gone through a renovation, looks clean and modern but the utensil are dirty and rusted. Tried sharing to the staff but they were too busy. The "new" chairs are so different level. Plastic chairs feel softer and cleaner. I used to visit here frequently before the reno, taste was good. Now I got no comments. From a comfortable environment, now it's tight and stuffy...

author: Mariana Raquel
review_text: This is a must try! I’m from Maracaibo, Venezuela🥹 This place is the best Venezuelan restaurant that I have tried in my 4 years living in New York. Went with my family to celebrate my brother’s birthday, drinks were amazing, had a Polar negra, had the Cara-Caracas and a cepillao (This one came with music, made me feel at home). We shared the Mcbo-sampler to start, my favs were the mini Cachapas and the tequeños. Then we had main course, I shared an arroz chinozuela (20/20), I tried the asado negro, patacón de pernil and we also shared the Parrillada Maracaibo. Everything was delicious, atmosphere and playlist were amazing, staff were super kind and attentive with me and my family, they even sang happy birthday with us, I truly appreciated it. If you are thinking about going here or somewhere else, just don’t think it twice and go to Maracaibo, you will not regret it. Thank you guys for making my brother’s birthday dinner very special. ❤️‍🩹

author: Cynthia Streater
review_text: I really enjoyed everything here. Atmosphere, food, drinks, service, and music everything was spot on. I attended solo during a spontaneous trip to Miami and fortunately got Marybelle as my bartender. Her inviting demeanor, great conversation, service and DRINKSSS really stamped my visit. Service was phenomenal, kudos to Marybelle and the chef truly made my night. Highly recommend this spot ladies 💕

author: M Bon
review_text: What a find! We were casually strolling around Brickell and saw the cute entrance to Paperfish. Intrigued by it we decided to have lunch there and my I’m so glad we did. Service is top notch. Food is delicious. Everything we ordered was fantastic. My Bento box was full of flavor and plentiful. The zucchini spiral salad was fenomenal as were the sushi and truffle infused fry rice. Dessert was also decadent to close a fabulous meal. We are coming back with our friends for sure.

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: Kit Lim
review_text: Been buying takeaway from them for few years. Noticed today the vegetables ingredient is so much lesser. Always tell my frens this place gives lot of ingredients.

author: Mahsa
review_text: Liked the place, food was delicious and the owner is nice and accepts requests if you want to add or change part of the order that is written in the menu. Small place but cozy.

author: Shanas Ishak
review_text: I recently had the pleasure of dining at Thong Ne Thae, and I must say it was an excellent experience from start to finish. The restaurant offers a warm and welcoming atmosphere, perfect for casual meals with friends or family. From the moment we walked in, the staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel right at home. Now onto the food — every single dish we tried was absolutely delicious! You can really taste the freshness of the ingredients and the love put into the cooking. Whether it was the soups, grilled items, or the side dishes, everything was well-seasoned, balanced, and full of flavor. The portion sizes were generous too, making it worth every cent. One of the things that stood out was the consistency in quality. Sometimes you get one or two standout dishes at a restaurant — here, every dish we ordered was a hit. It's clear that the team behind Thong Ne Thae takes pride in maintaining high standards. Overall, I highly recommend Thong Ne Thae to anyone who appreciates authentic, tasty food served in a friendly setting. Definitely a place I’ll be returning to again soon. Five stars from me!

author: stevanie yuliana
review_text: Located in a busy dining hub, this restaurant is a favorite among tourists. I suggest visiting when you are hungry because the dishes are meant for sharing. At first, I was a bit confused by the long line. You have to download an app to get a queue number and wait for your turn to be called. The service is very fast, but I suggest improving the restrooms because so many people visit this place. Overall, the food tastes great, and it even has a Michelin star. It is located near Central World, an area full of other great restaurants.

author: Doni Digiovanni
review_text: I’ll fully admit—I’ve written a review for Niu Kitchen before, but it deserves another. I’ve been in this industry for 16 years, worked alongside some of the top chefs in the game, and grew up with my grandmother, who was a chef at the Waldorf. I’d like to think I know what I’m talking about. And I can say with absolute confidence: Niu Kitchen isn’t just one of my favorite restaurants in the U.S.—it is my favorite restaurant in the United States. This little slice of Spain in downtown Miami is understated at first glance. But once you sit down, you’ll feel it: the warmth, the soul, the authenticity. What sets Niu apart—beyond its incendiary food—is its people. While so many restaurants around them are turning and burning through staff, Niu has kept the same loyal faces for nearly a decade. That kind of consistency and heart is rare in this industry, and it shows. I’m grateful this gem survived the pandemic, because they deserve every bit of praise. The food is transportive. I lose myself every time I dine here—each bite better than the last. The Bronzino tartar is a must, the legendary ous (only on Tuesdays, so book ahead!) is a revelation, and the squid ink arroz will stop you in your tracks. Don’t miss Chef Deme’s new clam dish, a family recipe from his mother—it’s soulful, heartfelt cooking at its best. For me, no trip to Miami is complete without a visit to Niu Kitchen. It will forever hold the most special place in my heart and truly feels like home.

author: Kian Hong Lim
review_text: One of the best Hor fun I ever eaten. Must try! Small portion for the big prawn noodle soup is huge, enough for 3 pax. Price is well worth as portion is big and ingredients used is quality and fresh. Gem in this area!

author: Stephen Fallon
review_text: I stopped in for take out after a long day of work on Saturday 3/22/25. I wanted to try something different from my normal order, the young woman working the tables suggested the Korma. Best thing I did today was take her recommendation, it was exactly what I was craving! Thank you for making my Saturday night! I am sorry I did not get her name, but she was absolutely phenomenal!

author: Sandi Perry
review_text: They made me and 2 cars in front of me pull to the front after we ordered and paid. I waited for 15 minutes before I gave up and walked into the place and asked where my food was.It still wasn't ready. I finally got it and left. The 2 cars in front of me were still waiting. I only ordered 2 tacos and French fries. How long should that take!!!

author: Catherine Mechael
review_text: Coming from an Egyptian, this is the BEST middle Eastern food I’ve had in a while. Try the chicken Shawarma wrap and the garlic sauce as well as tea to finish up the meal. very welcoming owner and very good customer service.

author: Mohd Ilyas
review_text: A strategically located eatery in the city center. Tasty dishes with plenty of variety. Limited parking — expect a short walk. Queues can be a bit long but manageable. Elderly and pregnant women can wait inside and find a seat first.

author: Christina Eagar [Detwiler ES]
review_text: Slow service. RUDE employees. No smiles anywhere. This place cannot survive for long with the crappy attitudes. We asked what time the half price shakes happy hour was and the girl just shrugged. We had to say, “can you ask someone?” She came back and mumbled 2. Then hastily handed the first shake, knocking the lid off and making a mess. She just stared at us. No offer of napkins or another lid. Handed us the second shake and closed the window. We had to sit there and get her attention to get the straws. Reading through all the other reviews I don’t understand why corporate is allowing this place to ruin Sonic’s reputation. Get a good manager in there and fix the employee’s attitudes. The quality of everything will go up.

author: Y Teo
review_text: Food market reopen on dec 22 after 3 mths renovation with a number of new stalls. New hello steam fish is good - small half seabass steam fish with one veg and rice for $7.80. Second new stall fei mao fish soup is good too - grouper fish head soup with rice $6 - business is good for dinner and my fish was a bit undercook - staff lady is not friendly. The original teochew fish soup is excellent with long lunch queue but overprice - rice is $1. New fishball/minced pork noodles is good too compared to the old stall. Yet to try is new 3rd chicken rice stall, curry puff, Sarawak noodles… These new stalls have injected some vibrancy to the hawker centre and a wakeup call to some of the lethargic older stalls.

author: Andrew Wong
review_text: Ordered the grilled chicken and steamed vegetables platter with braised fish sauce. Enjoyed the meal, place was cosy with fast service, price was reasonable considering it’s a restaurant with AC.

author: Craig Villamor
review_text: This is a great spot right near Chase Center. Service was quick and friendly. I had fish and chips and they say that the fish is local rock fish. I will say it was VERY fresh and tasted great. My wife had a Caesar with chicken that was tender and well seasoned. Great atmosphere for lunch or brunch. View of the very industrial waterfront is pretty cool if you’re into that sort of thing. A little on the pricey side would be my main complaint but not outrageous for SF. Street parking was ample at the time we visited (Saturday afternoon with no big events going on).

author: Aneisha Huggins
review_text: The ambiance was fantastic, and the food portions and taste were truly impressive. The drinks were decent, although they could offer more options.The frozen drink was a bit disappointing, but anything on the rocks seemed to be quite good. The staff was friendly, and the music was amazing. Overall, this place is a great choice for a great dining experience.

author: DiAnne G
review_text: Tonchin absolutely delivered. The cucumber with the miso glaze? Ridiculously good — the kind of dish you think about later like, “Damn, I should’ve ordered two.” We hit happy hour and the whiskey highballs were spot-on, crisp and easy. The chicken noodle dish was amazing, full of flavor and super satisfying. Service was great the whole time — attentive without hovering. Highly recommend this spot for anyone who wants legit comfort food done right.

author: JT Ysseldyke
review_text: Great food, and a fun atmosphere. I just fell like I was hung out to dry when it came to the bill. The server when I was ordering my drink asked if I wanted a small cup or medium. I said medium but unbeknownst to me the medium is a $40 drink (compared to the $16 "small"). To say when I got the bill I wasnt a Happy Camper is an understatement. Plus they add a mandatory 20% tip. I wish that was disclosed somewhere on the website, because a $40 drink (2x more than my food) lead to a massive mandatory tip I wasnt aware of until the server was breathing down my back. Just be aware of these tactics and switcheroos.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Michael Paul
review_text: I found the food to have a vast variety of choices, and absolutely fabulous. Most of the prices are reasonable. However I find the service itself to be poor and lacking as your suppose to tip a non waiter/waitress server that does not serve nor collect. No Bueno! Further more if your going to work with customers in the United States, speaking and understanding english clearly and fluidly is highly recommended if you like repeat business and recommendations. I am going to change to a five star, as my boyfriend and I went back for a second chance and it was better, as tips were earned this time by interacting at our seat with service to receive our food! Thank you! I don't mind putting my dishes away on the way out, it should be marked better to do so. I love the make your own bowl.

author: Adam Shivers
review_text: We were in Downtown Las Vegas for vacation recently and we always heard amazing things about Carson Kitchen and we decided to stop in for dinner during our recent trip. We made a reservation in advance- the restaurant is pretty small, so definitely try to make a reservation if you can. We arrived a few minutes before our reservation and were seated promptly at a table near the front. Our server came by a few minutes later and offered to answer any questions we had on the menu. We ordered a bottle of wine to start, all at reasonable prices, they had a few options to pick from. We ordered the Pepp on Pepp flatbread to start ($18), and the Brussell Sprout Caesar Salad ($13) and two of the Pot Roast Dips ($19). All of the food was truly amazing and all very fresh and tasty! The service was also really good throughout the meal and efficient. We look forward to returning and highly recommend trying Carson Kitchen if you're in the Downtown Las Vegas area!

author: Houston Loh
review_text: I bought the multigrain sourdough walnut & cranberry bread and the apple pies. The prices are a bit on the high side, but the bread is tasty, healthy and generously filled with walnuts and cranberries. The apple pies are my personal favorite, the filling isn’t too sweet, which I really like and you can taste the delicious diced apples. The only disappointment was that the pie wasn’t served hot enough. Overall, I enjoyed everything and will definitely try other breads and pies in the future.

author: Tyler Huson
review_text: It’s a relaxing, clean diner with kind staff and good food! Easy access to and from the interstate!

author: Airynn M
review_text: We have been having problems with them for the last 3 times that we've ordered due to rude employees, but today took the cake. Not only did they not give us our whole order, but they also put tomatoes in my southern-western sandwich after I specifically asked for no tomatoes due to allergy. The manager lady took the sides of her cooks when my brother told her we were missing one of our fries, instead of reviewing the camera. I will never support them ever again.

author: Bé Nữ Nguyễn Thị
review_text: The food was delicious and perfectly seasoned, the staff changed the grill plates constantly and were very enthusiastic 🥰

author: Cee Cee T
review_text: Alex was our waiter she was by far the best waitress very professional well groomed & polite! The only complaint I have is the food temperature being cold to the taste the cook/cooks need to do better customers should not have to take their food home to heat it up Alex this was not your fault you are simply amazing love thanks for all of the greatness you brought to our table

author: 오리새
review_text: A gem in the heart of Asok! 🌟 Just a short walk from the BTS station, with its own parking lot—a rare find in Bangkok. The vibe is warm and family-friendly, with baby chairs available. We had Tom Yum Goong, fried rice, lamb chops, and mango sticky rice—honestly, some of the best Thai dishes I’ve ever had. Perfect seasoning, spot-on cooking, and served at just the right temperature. If I lived here, this is where I’d bring special guests. Prices lean slightly on the higher side, but worth every baht. And that beautiful mango basket at the front? Absolutely unforgettable—those were the sweetest mangos I’ve ever tasted. 🥭✨ * Reservation seems to be required

author: Jasmine Nguyen
review_text: This place is my go to for mozzarella sticks!! Most of the time, if u order the mozzarella sticks, they are crispy to perfection alongside of a perfect opportunity for a long cheese pull!! I love their mozzarella sticks that it’s become an addition to just order takeout for 6 pieces of them . Birthdays are welcome!! The waiter will sing you happy birthday and the overall experience is chill . Once you sit down , you get bread, and if you’re lucky enough ,they will give u very delicious garlic bread!! (I even asked if they could give me some more to take home one time cus I loved it so much😅😅) The calamari comes with a very crispy crust also, it comes with marinara sauce if I recall, but it’s not that very flavorful, the crunch is all (no shade) . I suppose they don’t have their own pink lemonade, I asked, and they gave me a bottle of Snapple pink lemonade (and a cup w/ice to pour in) which is fine because it still tasted like pink lemonade!! I ordered many since I arrived in a big party, we ordered pizza and it came it a large portion! Eat it fast because it taste very good when the pizza is hot . I personally love the mozzarella sticks but everything else is great, the service is average and not too bad, I haven’t had any issues.

author: Cyndi Scott
review_text: If you’re looking for a top-tier brunch experience, AmeriBrunch Cafe is the spot — and be sure to ask for Big Rob! His service is unmatched — friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience even better. We kicked things off with a Sunrise Mimosa — the perfect refreshing start. The food? Absolutely flawless. The Philly omelette was savory and loaded with flavor, and the smoked salmon toast was fresh and beautifully presented. We also shared the French toast with fruit, which was sweet and satisfying without being too heavy, and the breakfast potatoes were crispy and seasoned just right. Everything from the drinks to the dishes to the hospitality was on point. We’ll definitely be back.

author: Andy
review_text: This place is famous for its Dalu noodles, Moonlight River noodles, fried noodles, and fried rice noodles during the KL Food Festival. Every time I go, I always order the fried noodles (RM8) or Dalu noodles (KL Hokkien noodles) (RM8). The owner uses a generous amount of ingredients and the wok is very powerful. The chef stir-fries everything in one large wok, so the food comes out quickly.

author: VelvetDaDog
review_text: Last time I came here the service/ food was horrible. That was May 2017. Now it's October 2025 still the worst ever!. We asked for 2 happy hour Margaritas. They told us Happy hour was over at 6 p.m. I looked at my phone it was 5:55 p.m. The Margaritas were bland. We ordered guacamole. We received fake guacamole. I would say it's the green pea base type guacamole. It tasted like Gerber baby food. No spice no flavor. Now let's talk about the watered down salsa. It's like they added water and vinegar to diced up tomatoes and cilantro. The tamales were served dry and about 1 teaspoon of meat inside. We were charged 3 dollars for a side of red sauce (Tasted like canned tomato soup) and 3 dollars for a green sauce. We could walked over to Robertos and got better sauces for less. Check came to 70 dollars. Never going here again! Need a great restaurant drive to Juan's Flaming Fajitas!

author: Doraemon
review_text: Kitty and I were on a road trip tfrom thialand hrough Malaysia, and we were excited to finally make it to Bukit Mertajam. We had planned our lunch stop at BM Yam Rice Kopitiam, a place known for its authentic Penang cuisine. We later learned that it had even earned a Michelin "Selected" recognition, and it was famous for its yam rice. Walking into BM Yam Rice Kopitiam, we were greeted by a lively and bustling atmosphere. The air was filled with the delicious aroma of yam rice, and a flurry of chatter and laughter from the locals filled the space. It was clear that this was a beloved institution in Bukit Mertajam. The atmosphere was welcoming and friendly, and even though it was a bit noisy, the fans kept the place cool enough for a comfortable dining experience. We couldn't resist trying their signature dish, the yam rice. It was a revelation. The yam rice was cooked to perfection, boasting a strong shrimp flavor and a satisfyingly chewy texture. The accompanying pork broth was a delightful blend of briny and sweet, enhanced by the tangy depth of pickled cabbage. We also ordered the pork trotter, which was tender and flavorful, the braised tofu in soy sauce, which was a comforting classic, and the mixed organ pork soup. The service was efficient and friendly, and the staff made sure we had a pleasant dining experience. We were surprised by how affordable the prices were, especially considering the Michelin "Selected" recognition. Overall, we enjoyed our experience at BM Yam Rice Kopitiam. It's a great choice for anyone in Bukit Mertajam seeking a taste of authentic Penang cuisine. The yam rice is a must try, and the other dishes we had were equally delicious. The atmosphere is a vibrant reflection of the local culture, and the service is friendly and efficient. However, the noise level could be a bit overwhelming for some. We highly recommend this kopitiam for a delicious and authentic Penang food adventure.

author: Jessica Diett
review_text: I was here back in November 2025. This is a nice and cozy restaurant. Although the vibe is more “romantic couple dinner”, I felt super comfortable going there alone (solo traveler) and my server was so nice! First, I got a rack to hang my purse and every table has a box to put your phone in, so you can have actual conversations with the one you’re with and enjoy the atmosphere. It’s not mandatory, and it felt weird at first given I was alone, but I enjoyed not being on my phone (except taking pictures), enjoying my food & drink, watching other people and taking in the precious view of the bay. Food, drink, and service was fantastic! I’ll definitely be back. Special shoutout to my server Keyla who constantly checked on me made sure everything was good.

author: Graham Barry
review_text: A premium choice: you get a creative and delicious menu served in an atmospheric riverside restaurant. The team was warm and attentive but had limited English to answer a question about allergens. As most diners were on the way to the Memories Land show, service was prompt. The short walk to escape the intensely touristy core of Hoi An is rewarded with dining which is higher quality and costs less. This is a very popular place - we were lucky to get a table spontaneously - so a reservation is always a good idea.

author: Philip
review_text: Can't miss with the chicken and fries. Although the chicken was drier than we prefer the sauce (savory with a slight vinegar finish) the coleslaw and skinny fries made up for it. I'm surethere's better chicken in LA but this will do when hungry.

author: Rob Lewis
review_text: Worst place, I ordered online 20 mins, another 15 waiting in the store, even when fully staffed still slow

author: Sean D
review_text: An unforgettable gem in Bali. From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere was perfect. Elegant, quiet, and deeply private. It felt like we had stepped into our own little world. The service was exceptional, with staff who were attentive, kind, and incredibly polite without ever being intrusive. We chose the romantic package and were welcomed with a breathtaking flower arrangement that immediately set the tone. Each course of the chef’s tasting menu impressed us more than the last. The flavors were bold and inventive, blending local culture with modern twists that elevated every bite. It was easily one of the best tasting menus we experienced during our entire time in Bali. They adapted the entire menu on the spot for my wife’s seafood allergy without hesitation, and the alternative dishes were just as delicious. The attention to detail and care they showed were beyond impressive. At the end of the night, we were given a thoughtful gift that we’ll genuinely treasure. The entire experience felt curated, luxurious, and heartfelt. The pricing was more than fair for the quality and care provided. This place offers a Michelin-like experience that we cannot recommend highly enough. Add it to your Bali itinerary. You won’t regret it.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: EL
review_text: Popped by sorta by chance as I had a sudden craving for something spicy — the food was SO good, owners extremely welcoming, and the place so neat I feel I now should make a daily visit!! Had a beef soup and a pork soup with two glasses of sugar cane juice and it only cost us 160K. Best value for money, and by far the best restaurant I’ve been here in Da Nang. Would give 100 stars if I could.

author: Thanatpong Rujirawan
review_text: Despite a 30-minute wait for a table, this Thai papaya salad restaurant proved to be worth the patience. The compact, bustling space creates an intimate atmosphere, though it can feel somewhat crowded during peak hours. The standout dish was undoubtedly their grilled chicken – beautifully marinated and grilled to perfection, it's an absolute must-try for any visitor. Their salads showcase authentic Thai flavors with well-balanced seasoning that stays true to traditional preparations. The portion sizes justify the pricing, offering good value for the quality received. The service had some hiccups, with a noticeable 20-minute gap between our initial dishes and the final two orders, which appeared to have been overlooked. However, the staff handled the situation professionally, offering sincere apologies and expediting the remaining dishes. Overall, while the restaurant may have room for improvement in service efficiency and space management, the exceptional food quality, particularly the grilled chicken, makes it a worthwhile dining destination.

author: RUSSELL YAP
review_text: Ate here on National Day; made a reservation earlier to make sure we had a seat. Food was pretty good, tastes good. Personally felt the pizza was a bit salty (but my partner said it was ok) - presumably it’s a personal preference. Service was fantastic, servers were attentive and quick to respond. Special shout out to Pat for amazing service! Appreciate the attention and detail to us!

author: Michelli Ikawa
review_text: The food is good, but pay attention when paying the bill. We were 4 adults and 2 children and they charged us $160. Since it was the 4th of July, each adult should have paid $19.90 and each child $9.90. The total is almost $100, each person drank a soda, it doesn't make sense that they charged $10 per soda... I didn't like that

author: Mike
review_text: I really like the presentation, staff were polite, and courteous. Ordered the special, and salted cream coffee. Overall not a bad banh mi, and you get what you pay for. These bad boys come stuffed, but my gripe is that all the meat and pâté lacked seasoning, and too much butter muted the flavors of the different cuts for my taste. My favorite is the salted cream coffee, so delicious.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Melissa Jeffries
review_text: The Hive is THE spot in Manhattan Beach! Organic coffee? Fire 🔥 Build-your-own bowls? Straight-up fuel for the soul. They’ve got so many macronutrient-packed options that even my 🦩 flamingo spirit animal stays balanced—one leg up, vibing with the ocean views. The staff? A1 👌🏽 Friendly, welcoming, and they make you feel like a regular even if it’s your first time. Whether you’re pulling up for a post-surf espresso or a power bowl to keep you thriving, The Hive gets it right every time. 🍯 Hive, let’s heal 💛 Stay healthy, stay happy, and keep those good vibes buzzing! 🦩☕🔥 For more organic coffee reviews and music follow me IG: @TheBaristaBae

author: CHRIS PERRY
review_text: Great spot for a classic South Florida experience! The burger lives up to the hype — juicy, flame-grilled, and packed with flavor. The quirky, laid-back vibe with waterfront views makes it a perfect casual hangout. Service is friendly, and the atmosphere is pure local charm. Don’t expect fancy — just great food and a cool spot to kick back.

author: Rulita & Nikola
review_text: Lau Pa Sat is a fantastic place to experience Singapore’s food scene in one spot. There’s a huge variety of food options, so everyone can find something they like, and the quality is consistently good. The atmosphere is lively, especially in the evening, and sitting outside adds to the experience. It’s a great place to try different dishes without having to move around the city. Perfect for food lovers and a must-visit if you want to taste many flavors of Singapore in one go.

author: Joshua Moses
review_text: I first visited this location at the grand opening back in December of 2013, the line was outside the door lol. I've visited this restaurant a few times lately. The food is good especially their omelettes. The service is good, and the ambiance is always busy.

author: Melody Quiros
review_text: Great service and excellent breakfast and lunch items. Everything looked delicious from what we saw and we both loved our food, we just couldn’t eat it all of course. Brandon was a great server and knows the menu well. We both had their specialty elderberry and pistachio coffee and we loved them

author: James Douthit
review_text: Our group of 4 vegetarians went here and were utterly blown away by the taste. We got biscuits-and-tofu, veg sausage big mac, brunch fried rice, and tamale. Every piece of tofu had an impressively delicate but flavorful breading and the tofu inside was also brined and tasty by itself. This is some of the best food I’ve ever had in Boston out of over 50 restaurants I’ve been to, and it was all vegetarian. The gravy on the biscuits was a special highlight, it might be gross but we literally licked the plate clean.

author: Chris Tang
review_text: Food here is pricey but the quality reflects. The true stars of the place are the pasta dishes. We ordered the peach with Burrata cheese and Polpette Della Maestra Alessandra (prosciutto meatball) as appetizers. Both were good but didn’t particularly stand out. The prosciutto meatballs was the better of the two dishes in my opinion. We tried the Margherita pizza and it was very good. The pizza dough had a good chewy texture. For the pasta dishes we got the Trofie (pesto sauce), Rigatoni All’Amatriciana and Orecchiette. All three were outstanding and cooked Al Dente. They were all delicious and had nice firm chewy feel in the mouth. Sauces were solid also. My wife liked the Trofie the best. My daughter voted for the Rigatoni, and I personally rate the Orechiette the best (on the slim margin the sauce has a spicy kick to it). It’s a good sign that there were no clear winners here - gives a good indication they were all good. We also ordered the grilled Branzino - preparation was great (they had debone most of the fish bone), the taste was good but didn’t blow us away (albeit we were all really full by that time and only took few bites of the fish - maybe if we had less food before we would have rate it higher. Service attentive and efficient and decor was good also. Overall the food were very good with special mention to the pasta. We plan to return

author: YunYi
review_text: An unplanned late dinner at this restaurant, and it is absolutely astounding! Thus far, this is the only cafe/restaurant I find serving gnocchi (I probably have not been visiting Penang cafe/restaurant quite a while). Ordered mushroom soup, fried mushroom, gnocchi. You know the food is finger licking good when you continuously taking bites after bites. Definitely worth to revisit for rest of the menu, and of course the wine.

author: Mayra Deleon
review_text: This place was recommended by a coworker and since we were in town we decided to give it a try. I am glad we decided to give it a try because it did not disappoint. The workers were amazing and welcoming. The restaurant was clean and the decor was nice. Parking was a bit difficult to find, but we expected this from San Francisco. The bread and sauce given at the beginning were delicious. I could not get enough and wanted more. The Lomo saltado needed a bit more seasoning, but it was still good. The pescado sudado was very good that I finished it all. The portions were great and I would be definitely be coming back when in the area.

author: Karyn Wong
review_text: food was tasty and affordable. 6 of us spent $165 in total and we had salted egg sotong, koh loh yoke, drunken prawn, egg, veg and the lala that they recommend. lala was huge by the way. comfortable dining space, not too noisy. pleasant for good conversations. easy to find parking lot.

author: steve ong
review_text: FIRST & LAST ‼️ Arrived at 5pm for a 7:30pm reservation. The staff were welcoming at first and seated us at a hot walk-in area with umbrellas. Ordered some beers while waiting, then asked about our dinner table, turns out it was just right beside our current counter top seat, with a poor view, while walk-in guests at 5pm got the top deck seats with the best views. Decided to try some bites before dinner-ordered nachos, and they were honestly the worst I’ve ever had: bland, tasteless, nowhere 5-star hotel standard. We lost our appetite and canceled dinner. By 7pm we decided to leave. Shockingly, the exit process was terrible-no guidance, no staff escort like when we arrived, just vague directions. The way out was dark, with endless stairs, and even other guests were complaining. In the end, 4 beers and awful nachos cost nearly 900k IDR. The view is the only thing worth it, but overall a disappointing, overpriced experience. Definitely won’t return.

author: Meko W
review_text: My problem with this jack in the box: 1. Charging 50 cent for extra sauce. Gave me a hard time for some extra sauce. I pay almost 40$ for my food in the hood and people here are stingy with SAUCE? Ridiculous. If I pay a lot for my food I should be able to get as much sauce as I need with my food. 2. Bought a size L fries and gave me Medium scoop of fries…. I had already left the driveway when I saw the amount of fires they gave me…. I’m probably NEVER coming back to a Jack in the box and will be sticking to restaurants burgers instead. Thanks.

author: Kathy B.
review_text: Best breakfast sandwich in JP. Generous and delicious scrambled eggs, cheese, and sausage or bacon with tomato on your choice of bagel. Accompanying home fries are perfect along with lightly dressed greens.

author: 傅絲斐
review_text: Fresh seafood, tasty dishes, spacious seating, and a free snack bar. Only 2 mins from Bukit Bintang MRT!

author: Christopher Vargas
review_text: 4-Star Review for Alex’s Chimis Alex’s Chimis serves up some seriously delicious Spanish food, and the flavors never disappoint! Every dish is well-seasoned, cooked to perfection, and definitely hits the spot. If you’re craving authentic and tasty Spanish cuisine, this is a solid choice. That being said, I do feel like the portions could be more generous, especially for the price. I’ve been to other Spanish restaurants where you get enough food to easily feed two to three people for the same price, whereas here, the portions are more single-serving. While the food is amazing, a little more value for the price would make it even better. Overall, if you’re looking for great-tasting Spanish food, Alex’s Chimis is still worth checking out. Just keep in mind that the portions aren’t as big as some other spots. Definitely recommend for the flavor, though!

author: Helpful Tany
review_text: Came across this restaurant unexpectedly while searching for a breakfast spot, as many were crowded with full parking lots. Opted to try this one due to its decent and clean appearance. The food offered great value for money, with flavors surpassing expectations. The only downside was the absence of coffee. I'll definitely revisit if I find myself in the area again.

author: 奚琦
review_text: very good experience here with my friends, the sea view is very beautiful and the singer can sing and interact with us.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Ossi
review_text: One of the best food experiences in Ho Chi Min. Absolutely delicious food with quick and friendly service. Atmosphere is like eating at a Vietnamese home.

author: Ryan Kim
review_text: HW Phoenix Bar PIK offers an exceptional interior and atmosphere, standing out as one of the most impressive cocktail bars I've visited. The sophisticated design and ambiance truly elevate the experience. However, the cocktails didn’t quite live up to the same standard. While the drinks were enjoyable, they lacked the finesse and depth one might expect from such an upscale venue. It’s still worth visiting for the atmosphere, but there’s room for improvement in the drink quality.

author: Wittaya Wongvatanyu
review_text: Location: the place is only 10 minutes walk from MRT Asoke and BTS Sukhumvit. While driving there is possible, the parking area is quite small so walking or taxi are better options. Also, prior reservation is strongly encouraged. We visited the place on Tuesday's night and the place was almost full. Don't go there on Friday night or weekend without calling them first. Front door had a step or two but wheelchairs should be able to get in with some help. Atmosphere: the place was cozy and decorated discreetly. It may be noisy though. Service: waiter was very polite and can handle orders in English. He has his supervisor to help explaining how-tos when the food was served too. They even offered to pack the leftover when they saw we left chicken mostly unbeaten. There were some mixed up when they brought us the wrong boxes a few times though. Food: it was tuned for inner city people. Not too spicy, not too salty. Me and my friend ordered chicken masman, somtam (papaya salad), stir-fried morning glory with eggs, and grilled chicken with herbs. We had hot green tea and a cocktail as beverage. All of them were very good, except papaya salad which was not sour enough. Hygiene: the place was clean. There was not undesired odour nor anything that looked dirty. We didn't visit the restrooms so no comments on that Price: we spent a little under 2000 THB for two. They accepted credit cards without extra charge.

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: Wen Chien Cheang
review_text: Boat noodles were perfect. Surprisingly, the rice and pork combo tastes well. Plenty of parking spaces available.

author: Hammerhead
review_text: One of the best ho fan you can find in mainland Penang. Delicious, tender chicken and clean environment. Personally, this is as good as those famous ho fan you could find in Ipoh. Maybe the bean sprouts is not as fat and juicy but good enough for my level 😏.

author: Andrew Schneider
review_text: Amazing pizza joint, perhaps the best I've had in Brooklyn. Dive atmosphere. Great wine list. Service from Lauren was amazing.

author: BigP
review_text: Came here with family for a quick dinner, food was great Michelle was even better! Thank you guys for the fast and friendly service. Love the halloween vibe, will definitely be back!

author: Nubia Zazzini
review_text: I been for years with my dad so i was due .i am from argentina closet your going from Argentina its fab .i brought everything that why i went

author: MD ASIF HOSSAIN
review_text: We went as a family our first night in NY They have a very wide variety of knowledge The pizzas are exquisite the attention is very friendly, the place is near Bryant Park and opposite of residence inn by Marriott , very easy to get to. Very good pizza, with the speedy service as we know it in NYC. Good value for money Fully and Absolutely Recommended.

author: Keith Patch (Patches)
review_text: It's a quaint little place to get fries and chicken tenders. It's not amazing, but it's a good amount of food for the price.

author: Daniel Farrow
review_text: Rough experience. The staff seems lazy and unhelpful. They were nice I suppose but just seemed to not care. We had a small order online. They said it didn't process and had to cancel and reorder it. But then we had to wait almost 30min for a big mac, small burger, fries and a soda. Not sure what they were doing but the place stunk like weed inside and I didn't see any customer smoking nearby. 🤔 Either way, I definitely will never be back to this location. Food wasn't great either, cold and sloppy. They also didn't put lettuce on my Big Mac 😬 F-

author: Sam Wong
review_text: Our first stop in the Ancient Town, and we had a great lunch! The restaurant has a beautiful interior, and some tables offer a stunning view of the river. The staff was attentive and patient while introducing the dishes, and the food was delicious. Overall, it was a wonderful experience with great food in an elegant, chill atmosphere.

author: A T
review_text: Rodizio was amazing. The ribs were delicious! And to top it off, the cappuccino was excellent. The place was beautiful. I would have given all 5 stars for atmosphere but the music playing was very distracting and ruined the ambiance. It was playing the radio with ads. But I would definitely come back again. Staff, can you please change the music to fine dining music or nice cafe jazz background music? 🙏🏻 I asked the waiter but he said they couldn't change it.

author: Ahmed Alzahrani
review_text: Great place to watch the sunset, but you need to make a reservation. Once you book, you can arrive early and they’ll find you a table—don’t worry, the place is huge with over 500 tables. The earlier you come, the better. There’s a minimum charge of 350k IDR per person (around $20). The food wasn’t the best, but the atmosphere and the sunset view were absolutely stunning, plus there’s a live DJ. Definitely recommend adding this to your Bali list.

author: Faray Almazrouei
review_text: Winnie and Ethel’s is the kind of diner that makes you feel instantly at home the moment you walk in. Nestled in downtown Las Vegas, it blends that old-school diner charm with a touch of modern flair. The staff are genuinely friendly, greeting you like a regular even on your first visit, which sets the tone for a relaxed and welcoming experience. The menu is full of comforting classics done right—fluffy pancakes, perfectly crispy hash browns, and hearty sandwiches that hit the spot any time of day. The portions are generous without feeling over the top, and everything tastes fresh and thoughtfully prepared. What really stands out, though, is the atmosphere. It has that nostalgic, retro-diner vibe but feels clean and updated, making it a cozy place to enjoy breakfast with friends or a late-night bite. Whether you’re a local or just exploring downtown, Winnie and Ethel’s is the kind of spot that leaves you planning your next visit before you’ve even finished your coffee.

author: Treturus Savantur
review_text: Oh Canes… where do I began. I love Canes so much. The chicken is always crispy, the fries are well salted. The bread is warm and buttery. The sauce is immaculate. Wow! Don’t get me started on their SWEET Tea. Yum yummy yum

author: johnnykuochung
review_text: 🍔 PS Burger at East Coast Park 🏖️ One of my top 5 burgers in Singapore, hands down! 🤤 The PS Burger is a bit of a splurge, but totally worth it. The beef patty is juicy and cooked to perfection (I go for medium 😋), and the fries? Piled high, golden, and crispy can’t get enough of them! 🍟 I love pairing it with their lychee & lime drink sweet, tangy, and refreshing. The perfect balance to the richness of the burger. 🍹 Why I love it: After a long day, I cycle to PS Café by the beach to unwind. The vibe, the ocean breeze, and the great food make it my go-to spot for a little indulgence. 🏖️✨ It’s a bit on the pricier side, but trust me, the whole experience is worth it. 🥰

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: Ilyah AA
review_text: The chicken rice balls were good and fulfilling. The roasted chicken was tasty, including the steamed fish. An order of the chicken liver was good also. The soup with fishball was ni e and warm. Great chilli sauce and soya sauce to compliment the chicken rice balls.

author: S T
review_text: Tried the Sauerkraut beef noodles - the broth is tasty and not too salty/overpowering. Light yet acidic but the ramen noodles were a little bland and floury. Ordered the lunch set $9.50 with drink - still quite value for money. Also order the fry roasted mutton bun - it was amazing. Crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. Mutton was not gamey at all. Would go back for this!

author: Axel's reviews
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ The five-cheese pizza is absolutely insane 🤯 Super creamy, perfectly balanced (not too heavy), with a great mix of cheeses and a perfectly cooked crust. You can really taste the authentic Italian flavors — simple, high-quality ingredients and spot-on cooking. If you love cheesy pizzas with a true Italian vibe, this place is a must. 🇮🇹🍕

author: Hislight Studios
review_text: Great place with a mad chill atmospheric vibe. As a vegan, I make an effort to find places that accommodate the plant based lifestyle with more than salads, lol. Their vegan menu was very extensive. I felt a little cheat in me, so I ordered the vegan blueprint Phillychesse steak wrap. Which was phenomenal. My only issue was the portion size. I do feel that the wrap could've been bigger, but the taste of the ingredients made me overlook that. Well seasoned mock meat, with fresh veg inside. The fries were coo, no issues there. Lightly seasoned for an overall tasty vibe. I treated myself to the maple and also the blueberry vegan donuts. The blueberry was one point!! The maple could've been better.
