They should've been heated up a little more to truly let the donut melt in your mouth. They didn't hold well and became less enjoyable as time went on. But the blueberry was definitely more of the hit for me. I would definitely recommend this place, and I do plan to visit again.

author: Michelle
review_text: I came here for my birthday breakfast and arrived right when they opened, so there was no line at all. I ordered the beef boat noodles with egg noodles and spicy soup (menu with end number of 3). Honestly, I was surprised by how much meat they gave, very generous. The broth was rich and flavorful, and the spice level was just right. It’s spicy but not the kind that hurts your stomach later. I also ordered the Teddy Palm Juice, which was really good. The sweetness was perfectly balanced. The service was great too. I didn’t catch the waitress’s name, I think her name tag said either “Ye” or “Yo.” When my noodles arrived, she noticed I hadn’t started eating yet and checked to see if everything had been served. I told her I was still waiting for my drink, and she quickly followed up with the kitchen. A few minutes later, my drink arrived. Overall, great food, great service, and a nice atmosphere. Definitely worth the price!

author: Kurt Whittemore
review_text: I came here with my wife and had great Indian food and good service.

author: Charlotte Thomas
review_text: We ate here and the food was so good! The portions are very big so it’s good value for money! Staff were friendly and service was quick! Perfect place for brunch/lunch!

author: Troy Henriques
review_text: An outstanding lunch with my family at a lovely restaurant. The Polynesian theme and atmosphere was calming and captured the vibe really well. The food was beautifully cooked, mild spices with perfectly cooked fish. A memorable lunch!

author: Janie Martin
review_text: Very friendly staff. Service was great! Food wise, it was okay only. I would rate it a 7/10. We enjoyed the salad and wrap. Pizza was so-so. They have kids meals that comes with fruits and cookies. They have a kids play area too.

author: KK
review_text: As a Singaporean, I would definitely come here for the oyster omelette — it’s fresher than most places, with more oysters and plenty of egg, at $7/plate How to get there: take the train to Siglap Station and exit via Exit 1 (cross the road opposite the station exit) > Walk straight and you’ll see an underground passage > Go down the stairs > walk through > and come up the other side > Continue walking straight and in about 8 minutes > you’ll see the park and lagoon on your left, with Lagoon Hawker just beside it. Eat while enjoying the sea breeze. Remember to return the tray after food and no smoking is allowed at the park, hawker and beach.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: araceli angel
review_text: rvice was great and attentive. Everything we ordered was brought to our table within minutes. The food was good and spicy pork belly was delicious! The music was good throughout our visit. Very good place to have a good meal, drinks, and have a chill time

author: Syakirah AJ
review_text: A restaurant serving local Indonesian foods with variety of options. Quite popular among Malaysian tourists. This place can get crowded and a long queue during peak period. When I went there (around 5:30pm), I didn't have to wait too long. They gave us maximum 2 hours per entry. The employees were very nice and polite. Price wise, a bit pricey but so worth it with quality of foods they are serving. My mum's favourite dessert is Es Cendol Tapai. We ordered Cumi Sambal Matah Uluwatu and it was delicious. We ended up coming to Remboelan twice during our 4-day Jakarta trip at 2 different locations: Grand Indonesia and Kota Kasablanka.

author: Angela Wright Baumsteiger
review_text: Absolutely delicious veggie breakfast scramble. Fresh squeezed OJ in the mimosas. Many veggie and gluten free options. Excellent service. No wait on a Saturday. Great mimosas prices.

author: Winston Chuah
review_text: The food at Onn Kee Restaurant is quite good, especially the bean sprout chicken, which is flavorful and tender. The bean sprouts are fresh and crunchy, making for a great combination. However, the place can get really crowded, and service tends to be a bit slow during peak hours. The prices are slightly on the higher side for the portion sizes. Overall, it’s a decent spot for authentic Ipoh chicken rice, but there’s room for improvement in service and efficiency.

author: Full time Fun
review_text: The Farmer's Market Restaurant offers a delightful farm-to-table dining experience with a focus on fresh, local ingredients. The menu is seasonal, with creative dishes that highlight the best of what’s available. Service is friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere is cozy yet vibrant. Whether you're enjoying brunch or dinner, it’s a perfect spot for those seeking quality, sustainable food in a welcoming setting. Highly recommended!

author: Shelly Ja
review_text: My first time trying Taco Johns. I had a great experience here. Clean place first of all, kind and attentive employees. Ease of ordering, order came out quickly and I was on my way. The taco salad is actually pretty good! Soft chicken taco was yummy with good flavor, love the diced chicken pieces inside.

author: Chua Yixun
review_text: Warning this place is a no go, hdl prices for lesser portions. Base price of 21.8, with coloured plate pricing, some stuff are priced at ridiculous price, like in the picture, green plates at 6.9 is crazy

author: Jo Gu
review_text: The experience was great, it was really a piece of Venezuela in New Jersey. We had the example as an appetizer, then we had soup, pabellon and patacon everything tasty and delicious; for dessert cabello de Angel tres leches cake wow definitely recommended.

author: Melanie Pliskin
review_text: Bon Bouquet was an absolute treat! The food was incredible. My son had the pancakes and my husband and I split the avocado toast and French toast. Everything was delicious but the French toast was really special. Our waitress, Calista, did a superb job as well! I would highly recommend this restaurant.

author: YMC
review_text: Stopped in at Nhà Tư for dinner and everything felt like true home-style Vietnamese cooking. We had the sour fish soup with pineapple and tomatoes — bright, comforting, and perfectly balanced. The stir-fried vegetables were simple but really well done, still crisp with just the right amount of garlic. The clay-pot dish came out bubbling hot and packed with flavor, the kind of dish that makes you want to eat every last bite of rice with the sauce. I also tried their house drink topped with an edible flower — refreshing, light, and a great match for the food. Cozy space, relaxed pace, and dishes that feel like they came straight from someone’s family kitchen. I’d definitely come back.

author: Sachiko Y
review_text: The best shrimp noodle ever for me. i always love tender chicken, bean sprouts, pickled vegetable😍 and pumpkin barley drink😍 On top of that, I had a flat tire with my car and the shop person kindly called to arrange for the repair shop🥹. It was REALLY REALLY helping me a lot and she is so kind. I sincerely appreciate🙏 Thank you very much🙏

author: Lis Conde
review_text: Highly recommended. Best food we had in Bali at really affordable prices. The ambience is the place is exactly what you would imagine Bali to be. I had the Nasi campur and loved the fact that it had a little bite of everything! My husband had the duck with bbq sauce and he literally wanted to lick the plate. This place is awesome.

author: Danielle Cusnir
review_text: This is an amazing hidden gem! Keep going up the stairs and yoh will find this cute secret garden. Food wise I order a salad which I was never told it was super spicy! When I complained the waiter told me he had never eaten the salad so he did not know it was spicy, but he would not be able to refund or change. I mean, waiters must know the menu even ifthey haven’t tried all food. As I could not eat it I order a sticky rice toasg with pork on top. The portions are really small and quite pricy for Ho Chi Minh city! There are more options with bigger better food and prices. The place is amazing for a drink, but service and food wise is not worth it.

author: Teodor Morava
review_text: I loved everything about this spot — from the food to the presentation to the overall vibe of the restaurant. The staff was on point, attentive without being overbearing, and the food was absolutely delicious. Every dish looked just as good as it tasted. Take a look at these pics and you’ll fall in love. I’ll definitely be planning a return visit.

author: june netikosol
review_text: The best boat noodle ever!!! Rich flavor. They give a lot of meat verses noodle portion

author: Jaykay Teoh
review_text: Used to be the landmark of Jitra, my favorite restaurant for the past 30 years until recent when the kid(2nd gen) took over, revamped the place to high class restaurant look but the food level has dropped! Kensom, aka sour tomyam - has no more the basic essence, the chicken feet kerabu - somehow the taste and feel are totally gone, pra kra pao - for my son's favourite, left 50% untouched. Very sad to say, this is the last time I ever step to this stall!

author: Natsuki Chen (AsiaDream)
review_text: This is a popular restaurant with long queues, so you'll likely have to wait a while. The seating area is crowded and noisy, giving it a distinctly old Singaporean feel. The food is typical of many restaurants; the flavors are average, tasty but nothing particularly amazing.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Bredgy L.
review_text: Follow @bredgyeats for more food posts! Mindblowing. That’s how I would describe my elevated dining experience at this beautiful vegetarian restaurant, reserved for the finale. The star of the show and the source of my wet dreams: Durian Curry. My newfound love that borders on yandere obsession, where creamy coconut milk meets durian in a swirl of sweetness, funk and richness that lingers on your tongue. Thai basil lifts it with an herbaceous perfume, cauliflower and dense mushrooms give chew and bounce, while slices of crusty yet fluffy baguette beg to be dragged through every last drop. Backtracking, the mushroom salad brings a riot of textures all in one: bouncy oyster mushrooms and meaty lion's mane play against the crunch of peanuts and carrots, while starfruit and Thai basil cut in with brightness. The fried mushrooms add a nutty depth, and the whole thing feels alive once dressed with the tangy-sweet umami-filled fish sauce. How they achieve such delicious meatballs without meat is beyond me, when such convincing golden-crumbed spheres deliver a fragrant crunch, giving way to a moist legume filling that mimics ground meat. The fermented soybean sauce layers on a funky depth, and the mango salads bring a fruity spark. Finally, it's decorated with a glint of edible gold leaf and a fog of dry ice to drive the spectacle.

author: Kyle VonDeBur
review_text: Traveled to Italy last year, and this is still up there with the best pasta I have ever eaten! The bolognese and amatriciana were both phenomenal, and the prawns were also great! And the kids enjoyed the Margherita pizza too!

author: Vincent Yuen
review_text: From the moment we walked in, the service was warm, attentive, and full of great recommendations. The ambiance is a beautiful blend of classic elegance and traditional Balinese culture—truly a feast for the senses. Ketut provided excellent service—his thoughtful recommendations made the experience both joyful and impressively professional. The highlight of the meal was the dry-aged duck—perfectly cooked and bursting with flavor. Every dish we tried reflected high-quality ingredients and thoughtful preparation. Prices are very fair considering the exceptional food and atmosphere. Highly recommend for anyone looking to enjoy refined cuisine in a culturally rich setting. Will definitely be coming back!

author: Maria Guerrero
review_text: This place is amazing!!! The Staff and owners are always so sweet and super attentive. Great customer service. Their food is extremely good! Always fresh and great flavors. Their empanadas are always so tasty and filled so much with meat. Definitely worth every penny! Highly recommend this restaurant!

author: Dahee Sohn
review_text: We ordered the acai bowl and fruit platter, and both were absolutely delicious and incredibly fresh. From the first bite, you could really taste the quality of the ingredients. The acai bowl was perfectly balanced—not too sweet, smooth and refreshing—with generous toppings of fresh fruit that added great texture and flavour. It felt nourishing and light, yet still filling. The fruit platter was equally impressive, featuring a colourful selection of ripe, juicy fruits that were clearly prepared fresh to order. Everything tasted vibrant and natural, making it a perfect choice for a healthy meal or snack, especially in Bali’s warm climate. Beyond the food, the vibe of this place really stood out. The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, with a positive energy that made it easy to sit back and enjoy the moment. The people were friendly and warm, adding to the overall experience and making us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. This spot feels like more than just a place to eat—it’s somewhere you can slow down, enjoy fresh food, and soak in a great atmosphere. If you’re looking for a place with healthy, well-prepared dishes, a great vibe, and genuinely nice people, this is definitely worth visiting. We really enjoyed our time here and would happily come back again.

author: Fikria Nur Abidah
review_text: Had a wonderful time at SKYE Bar & Lounge. The sunset view was absolutely stunning, and the ambience felt warm and homy, making it easy to relax and enjoy the moment. The drinks were great, the food was delicious, and the service was attentive and friendly. A perfect place to unwind, enjoy sunset drinks, and spend quality time!

author: Siew Kiat Tai
review_text: My son is Uncle Roger's fan so giving one of fuiyoh! Restaurants a visit is a must. We went to the Pavillion store in the evening. Unfortunately most of the menu items were unavailable. Only egg fried rice was available. Anyway, we ordered one spicy one and one non spicy. The fried rice was done well. The rice was not too oily and ful of flavours. We also ordered uncle rogers favourite and one berry lychee drink. The drinks were ok. So overall, the experience was ok. The atmosphere was great. I wish there was more dinner options.

author: Juliette
review_text: Amazing experience at Milk & Madu in Bali! From the moment we arrived, the service was absolutely top-notch: the team is incredibly reactive, attentive, and genuinely kind. You immediately feel welcomed. The atmosphere is super warm and cozy it’s the kind of place where you can actually have a conversation without having to shout, which is rare and so appreciated. The crowd is great, the vibe is relaxed yet lively, and honestly, everything just feels right. Now, the food… wow. Every single dish was delicious. My plate was simply incredible: perfectly creamy, with a flawlessly poached egg and amazing flavors pure comfort food done to perfection. The food bowls are outstanding, the fritters are delicious, the carrot cake is rich and moist, the banoffee pie is to die for, and the homemade juices are fresh and perfectly balanced. Milk & Madu truly excels at everything: exceptional food, a beautiful atmosphere, and outstanding service. A must-visit spot in Bali i can’t recommend it enough!

author: PIRM
review_text: I purchase a pionono it had no flavor what so ever and they only add a tiny bit of meat very stingy the pasteles as well no meat no flavors and expensive.

author: Tamera Foster
review_text: My go to stop when I am heading back to middle keys. They often have someone outside now taking your order. A little nicer than before talking to the box to order. The food is alway Very good. Love the yucca bites with or without cheese Better than fries to me anyway. The tropical chop bowls are always good too. They do offer a great family value with good chicken and sides for less the KFC and it taste good.

author: Serene
review_text: Really loved this café! The nachos were super tasty, seriously one of the best I’ve had. The vibe is really calm and aesthetic—great place to chill or catch up with friends. Tried the pasta too, and it was cooked just right. Oh, and the coffee? So good! Will definitely be back!

author: Fernanda Permenter
review_text: My Father and I enjoyed eating here all the time together. He's in heaven now, I miss coming here, so I've decided it's time to come back, enjoy a meal, and remember my Father by eating a delicious Ceviche. Muchas Gracias, I love you Papi.🌻🐝

author: YC L
review_text: Roast at EmQuartier offers a broad all-day menu with coffee, desserts, and breakfast plates in a mall setting near the garden-facing side. During this visit, the tiramisu was the most notable item, with balanced layers and a clear coffee-cocoa profile that matched the classic presentation. Pancakes are available with selectable add-ons, allowing diners to choose fruit, syrup, or spreads to adjust sweetness and texture. Coffee service includes standard espresso-based drinks and milk options consistent with modern cafe expectations. Seating ranges from counter spots to tables suitable for small groups, with steady foot traffic typical of a shopping mall environment. Overall, this branch provides reliable dessert and brunch choices, with tiramisu as a dependable pick and customizable pancakes adding flexibility for different preferences.

author: Ah 2
review_text: Not a bad spot for gathering, but their serving speed for both food and drinks are just a bit too slow even for a patient person.

author: Mauricio
review_text: Love this night food market located right in the middle of Bangla Rd Awesome local street food including a huge variety of seafood amongst other great dishes It gets pretty busy which adds to the atmosphere and is a great place to eat before a night out on the town

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: Jayven Phang Jun Wei
review_text: See Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup shop is located within waking distance from Kembagan MRT or if you drive there is parking along the nearby street. Ate here multiple time with different groups and I highly recommend the beehoon, prawn balls and pork cutlet fried rice. Price point is decent and portions are generous for any group size! Highly recommend for anyone looking for good food in the east, especially near an MRT station. To my understanding they only accept cash/paynow and no paywave so something to take note.

author: Regan Donecker
review_text: Nice breakfast/brunch spot. Attentive service and plenty of coffee refills. Delicious omelette of the day and American breakfast. Feels like a typical cozy east coast cafe with classic American dishes!

author: JYH
review_text: We were mentally prepared for a long queue, but to our surprise, we got a table in less than 20 minutes! Perhaps the restaurant has expanded — there are definitely more seats now. Despite the crowd, both the ordering and serving were impressively efficient — definitely worth a thumbs-up! 👍 Every dish we ordered was delicious, and the drinks were great too. Very satisfying overall, and the prices are reasonable. The only downside is that they don’t accept e-wallet payments.

author: guy nolan
review_text: Kay and Richard were great ! I popped in mid afternoon for a few drinks and a light snack and I wasn't disappointed. Is refreshing change from the craziness of the main part of Fremont street further up the road. I highly recommend this place.

author: Cole Tor
review_text: The best! All the food is delicious, especially the curry sauce. Ordered fried maggie, nasi kandar with their fried chicken, roti kosong, all delicious!

author: Hoong Wai Wong
review_text: Had the $9 pig's trotter, added $2 said veggie and rice. Pigs trotter not bad, the gravy is thick and sticky with the dissolved collagen, goes will with the rice. Meat portion is quite abit maybe cos I ordered the larger portion. Salted veggie is expensive, small plate for $2 not worth it. Can skip. Overall not that fantastic, can eat lah...

author: Jose Mendieta
review_text: From the moment we arrived, Novikov Miami impressed with its seamless valet service and prime location, making the experience effortless from the start. The ambiance is nothing short of spectacular—an artful blend of chic decor, perfectly curated lighting, and a lively yet sophisticated soundtrack that elevates the dining experience. Our server, Jean, provided impeccable service with an attentive yet unobtrusive approach, enhancing the evening with expert recommendations and warm hospitality. Without a doubt, we will be requesting his section on our next visit. As for the cuisine—every dish was a masterpiece. Flawlessly balanced flavors, exquisite presentation, and an unmistakable attention to detail made each bite a delight. For those seeking an elevated culinary journey, Novikov delivers in every aspect. Check out the review photos for a glimpse into this unforgettable feast. A true gem in Miami’s fine dining scene—highly recommended, and we will undoubtedly return.

author: Grace Chen
review_text: Out of expectation in every aspect! Amazing food with great creativity, amazing staffs and atmosphere, such an honor to have dined in this amazing restaurant! If i have the chance to come back to Bali again in my life, i would definitely fly over to dine, no matter where i am. Highly recommend chili satay, the beef bone; for dessert, if you enjoy tropical fruit, PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE get the Bali breakfast. SOOO GOOD OMG.

author: Joshua Chia
review_text: First time trying nasi kandar in Malaysia and totally impressed. The dishes are all deep in flavour and and very rich. So good we ate here twice during our short trip in Penang. Be sure to order the Ayam Bawang. Staff were very friendly too

author: Marina
review_text: My husband and I have been here twice now and we will be back again. The food is to die for!!! We were the only ones who were eating when we arrived but we did go at an odd lunch time so we had the whole place to ourselves. I think the husband-wife owner team served us and they were very kind and also accommodating. I ordered a tea, shish kabob and then we ordered the saffron pistachio ice cream. The food is so fresh and flavored perfectly. The meat was tender and the veggies were grilled to perfection. My tea was delicious and fresh and the best part was the ice cream. I’ve never had saffron ice cream before but it’s now my favorite. We love the ambiance here. There is a stage where I imagine is live music but while we were there, Arabic music was playing and I loved listening to it. Can’t wait to come back. Oh yeah, the booths were very spacious and comfortable and the serving size for the price is worth it.

author: Renee W
review_text: Great range of Hawker market stalls. Highly recommend Tian Tian chicken rice worth the queue although it does move quickly. Chicken was flavoursome, tender recommended getting the rice added and poached mixed plate. Chendol dessert stall - do not recommend plate was $2.5 owner took $10 and did not give change. Ignored me when I questioned it added to which the desserts were not great. Lovely older couple running the oyster omelette stall also recommend checking them out.

author: Margo Conley
review_text: Best Puerto Rican food in Boston. Been coming for years. Sometimes a bit salty but tastes like grandma made it with lots of love. Authentic flavor. Literally all dishes are flavorful and delicious. I love the soups, beans, arroz con candules, alcapurrias, pollo guisado, Pollo frito, tres leches etc.

author: Danny Hill
review_text: It stinks in here literally!!😭 the food is not what it used to be and im only talking about from a year ago! The guy at the register was weird acting and the food itself was kinda nasty. The people around this way don't care what they eat so they'll probably tell you it's good but to me nah you're better off heading to the one downtown on broad.

author: E. Y
review_text: 🍜 Really love the noodles here — they’re firmer and chewier than most ramen places, which is exactly the texture I’m into. The broth? So rich and flavorful, every sip feels like a warm hug. And whether it’s their regular ramen or the dipping noodles, they all hit the spot. don’t miss their signature fried chicken. Crispy, juicy, addictive. Trust me on this one.

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: Michael Nguyen
review_text: My wife and I found this jewel of a place in our trip to Chiang Mai. The service was great. They were packed and had a number of tables that have big groups so it was a little bit busy and service was a little slower but not so bad. I use to work in the food industry so I know how it can be when you have a packed house. I had their grill steak with mushroom and a small side of beetroot salad with mustered and the steak melted in your mouth with the garlic basil chimichurri sauce. We also had their chicken curry also that did not disappoint. The chicken was soft and tender and moist. The cabbage stir-fry with garlic tasted great not too oily or salty the cabbage was still crunchy. Then we also had a salad tomato with fruit and dried shrimp with shells on. It tasted so refreshing. You will need a reservation for this restaurant. We ate there at 7:06 on a Friday night. I forgot to get our servers name but he was excellent always stopping in to check if we needed anything, he was also very professional when there was a rude customer service at one of the tables next to use.

author: ms __
review_text: Cozy café with charming outdoor camping vibes. Drinks and bakes were decent, and there’s a deck dining area on the second floor along with an air-conditioned indoor space. Cat lovers will be pleased to know there are resident cats around; the grey one we met was especially friendly! Just a heads-up if you’re not a fan of cats. Card payment accepted with a 3% processing fee

author: Carol ODell
review_text: Excellent food cooked exactly as requested! The meal was awesome and Yoshi was more than helpful with his service. On our table was, a medium burger, full rack of ribs and a rib/shrimp plate. The sides were delicious as well with no room for dessert! Overall was a great place, great dinner, great experience. Do yourself a favor and go!!

author: kelvin sim
review_text: First time going there, price quite cheap but problem the meat and seafood quite terrible. Meat not fresh and look like few week meat where not fresh produce then seafood like not fresh at all where prawn look dark and head come out and lembik. Meat mostly some terrible smell.

author: Bunny Sammm
review_text: Having dinner here at Chinatown outlet. Been here for few times. The food is average sometimes salty. Usually the staff are quite friendly. However, today one of the staff is kinda rude when asking for cutlery she give my an annoyed expression. After a meal I was request a refill hot water for my tea. As I came here before I know can refill once. She sounds so much rude and confrontational said only can refill once. Just wanna to ask are u ok seriously??? If you’re not happy can take leave or rest at home please don’t ruin customer mood like this. We are paying money not to suffer by ur attitude tho.

author: Agil A. Fahrezy
review_text: The serving time is relatively quick, while maintaining the iconic taste of Indonesian cuisine. All of the food that we order are amazing, perfect combination of taste. The workers are humble and handle questions quite well. The atmosphere is also nice, calm and soothing, with no loud music or whatsoever.

author: Joe Lau
review_text: The food center is beside the river with very good vibe. We have the Michelin kuai zha but found it abit salty.

author: Wilbert Villanueva
review_text: My wife and I went there before, we tried the menudo, and we liked it. Today we decided to go back to have breakfast, and this time the food was terrible. We didn't like it at all, we are not going back again

author: Kathy Rodriguez
review_text: This Taco Bell saved my life. I do Uber eats and I work late at night and I was craving Taco Bell and they came through because they’re open 24 hours. Also the worker was super nice

author: Dylan Warnock
review_text: This is the worst pho I’ve had in San Francisco. The food was bland, and the veggies were visibly wilted, as if they weren’t fresh. The Thai tea was watery with very little flavor—definitely disappointing. The staff didn’t make much of an effort to be welcoming. While they weren’t outright rude, they seemed a bit disinterested, and the service felt rushed and impersonal. It would have been nice to feel more warmth or engagement, especially in a dining experience that already left a lot to be desired.

author: Gastronomic Nomad
review_text: Food quality is rock solid, the old school traditional taste sustained All the Malaysian classic old school dishes are here Regardless how great the food is, it is way too much to que for it, wait half an hour for it since you certainly can find equivalent alternative easily nearby This myth is consistently turn into reality by the eaters who may have been mislead by the social media As for the pop up restaurant, it is not only crowded but cramping into a tiny space with inadequate space between the customers Seriously not ideally for hygiene noise and comfort reasons

author: Tom
review_text: Our first time at Casa Don Juan. We stopped in for lunch and were immediately greeted as if we were old friends. We were seated and Victor introduced himself as our waiter. He was prompt, efficient, and entertaining. We will definitely ask for Victor next time we dine here. I had the shrimp ranchero and it was very good and filling. I am anxious to come back and try their many other dishes on the menu. My only regret is that I have not tried Casa Don Juan before today.

author: Marc
review_text: So, they don't have any draft beer (they said they were broken... lots of lost sales there). They were also out of the chicken appetizers. Cod rolls are basically fish sticks, according to server. "Free" chips were super stale, gross. The only thing good about the main dish, was the mushrooms. Walls were pealing paint ans floor tiles were cracking. Presentation was poor. Not impressed.

author: Vanessa Esqueda
review_text: I've always gotten good service at this location & the drive thru runs pretty fast to be in a busy intersection. The 🍟 are always fresh. Just make sure you ask for your sauce because they won't put it in the bag.

author: T Parker
review_text: My grilled chicken salad was delicious and huge! Everything on the salad was crispy fresh, and the chicken was grilled and seasoned to perfection! The french fries and steak my mother ordered were also delicious and well seasoned. Prices are reasonable for the amount of food you get. The service was excellent, and the staff was friendly and engaging. I would definitely visit again whenever I'm in the area.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Kianna Nguyen
review_text: Food and service were amazing. The broth was delicious and rich with a mild kick- best Bun Bo Hue I’ve ever had!

author: CruzeFamily Blessed
review_text: We love it here. The customer service is immaculate. Everyone’s so nice and kind makes the food taste even better today I want to give a special thanks to Stephany for putting a smile on my one year-old son face it’s just the small things in life that can really touch a heart and make a big difference. Keep up the good work Chick-fil-A of USC.

author: David R Pearse
review_text: Good food. It seemed a little pricey, but it's my first barbacoa in Nevada.

author: Lee
review_text: Came here with friends during lunch for Omakase without reservation. The staff was graciously welcoming us in. Luckily it wasn't fully occupied, hence we were given the bar seat. Since it was my first Omakase experience, hence I have no comparison to draw with unlike my other 2 friends. They were certainly impressed and wowed away by the food prepared by the chef. As for me, as I was recovering from COVID and in midst of regaining my sense of smell and taste, I guess I do enjoy some of the stronger tasting dishes, and especially the texture of the food. I liked the attention paid to the details on the combination of the food, the sequences of having them in order to fully savour the textures and flavours of each ingredients the chef has prepared. Even their cutleries are fascinating and cute. Again, I would say I'm giving 4 🌟 even though I couldn't taste all food but because of the atmosphere, customer service, food presentation and the chef's skills while preparing our Omakase. I underestimated their food portion, thinking I would still be hungry after the course meal, which was NOT true. We were full and satiated(so much for our back-up plan to head to Edo-Ichi/Daorae across the street thereafter). Well worth the meal indeed. Will definitely return again to fully enjoy the taste the next time I get my taste and smell back. Side note: Better to make reservations for bar counter to watch all the action. Their selection of sake is delightful, also they allow you to choose a sake cup design you like.

author: JOE THOMAS
review_text: Nice quiet place to meet friends and have a coffee. They have a Clean shop and friendly staff working here. I think the owner was here today, she was sitting down and then got up to help the staff make some coffees!!

author: Phyllis Lowe
review_text: Hailing from the south, I make it a point to find African American Soul Food restaurants when visiting other states. This one was impressive. The fried chicken was outstanding. Newark, you have my appreciation.

author: Juliet Clark
review_text: I’ve given this place several chances, especially after winning a $100 gift card during their opening promotion. I really want to like it since it’s just around the corner, but I’ve left disappointed every time. The tempura in the rolls is always cold, which makes me wonder if the shrimp and sweet potato are pre-fried and just sitting around before being added. The rolls themselves often fall apart, and the rice has that hard, slightly stale texture you’d expect from grocery store sushi, not what I’d hope for from a made-to-order restaurant. I’ve only ever ordered takeout, so maybe the dine-in experience is better, but what I’ve had hasn’t left a good impression. I also tried the vegetarian ramen once, and it upset my stomach, and left me questioning if the broth was truly vegetarian. Overall, despite its convenience and my initial excitement, this spot just isn’t for me.

author: elsie johnson
review_text: Sunday, we came had a good meal , server was not the friendliest, i said maybe because she's fairly new, I had to ask her name, got food ate food, wanrto order soup to go, but no server, if you're not they're table, they aint helping you, she finally came back, we ask for box and bill, I paid with card, and gave a 15% tip, then I see them in the corner discussing, and pointing, and looking at me, was I suppose to tip more?, for really very subpar service?, to the most all the ladies are very nice, and attentive, please help new workers present that same energy, you wont have to question your TIP.

author: Fredy Lim
review_text: At last, I have the opportunity to taste one of the finest Nasi Lemak in KL. The nasi lemak featuring the deep-fried drumstick was incredibly tender and tasty. The sambal chili had perfect flavor and spiciness. I was informed that sambal cuttlefish is also good and comes in large servings, but it was unavailable when I got there. The morning was already busy with numerous food delivery drivers waiting to pick up their orders. The orders clearly show me its popularity. One should anticipate waiting at least an hour in line during lunchtime... The hours of operation are daily from 6:30 am to 5:30 pm.

author: li橙子
review_text: I had such a great experience here! The restaurant is very clean and has a warm, inviting atmosphere. The food was absolutely delicious — everything was fresh and full of flavor. Our server, Franco, was amazing — very attentive, friendly, and professional. He made sure we had everything we needed and made the whole dining experience even better. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for authentic Peruvian food and great service!

author: Yoon Yit Sam
review_text: Service and environment are okay, clean, friendly staffs. Food is kopitiam level western food. Pasta noodles were fresh, however, the sauce is too sweet for my taste. We ordered 2 pastas and both tasted too sweet. They use the same mushroom for the two pastas, lacking variations (eg french beans, nuts, fresh basils etc.). The frozen seafood used is a RED FLAG to me. The frozen clams tasted very bad. Its a shame to see them using frozen materials everywhere eventhough the wet market was just within walking distance. Another RED FLAG is the cheap sausage that they used to sell for 50cents in school canteen. Maybe they display that on the menu as a deterent from people who has high expectation. Overall not worth the time and stomach if you are looking for some legit western food.

author: Sparkly Freeze
review_text: ✨ A Five-Star Indonesian Dining Experience! Beautiful, elegant, and full of authentic Indonesian flavors — this restaurant delivers a top-notch culinary journey through the archipelago. No wonder it’s a favorite among expats and locals alike who are looking for refined, delicious Indonesian cuisine in a stylish setting. 📍The location is strategic and easily accessible from many parts of Jakarta. 🚗 Note: Parking is limited, so it’s best to come early or use ride-hailing apps. A must-visit spot for entertaining guests or enjoying a special night out. Definitely one of the top Indonesian restaurants in town! 🍽️✨

author: Spacecake420
review_text: Me and my wife drove 3-1/2 hrs for the billie eilish concert and understanding the overwhelming amount of fans pouring into the restaurant ordering food after the event ended we expected to wait a little on ordering the food our order not only took almost an hour to get but the staff was extremely rude, looking very unprepared for the night, and serving the homeless free waters before serving paying customers their own drinks and being told they would be right with everyone about their orders then walking off. Me and my wife both work in the fast food industry and this is definitely unsatisfactory and unprofessional they need to not only have enough staff ready for big events like this (considering being located right by a concert arena) but also staff needs to be more patient and respectful to customers.

author: Mr. Boss
review_text: The food is ok only, but preferred to eat the Maggie Qatar, the other food soso only. Price is reasonable. Service abit poor, the food wait very long and if u ask them, their reaction was like "oh okok, sudah sudah."

author: Anna
review_text: There is so much work space here, it is almost unbelievable. Charcoal latte was unique but gritty, although I should’ve completely expected it. I got it with a shot of espresso that didn’t really taste super strongly, but it does come free of charge with this drink if you want it. Their offerings lean a little more expensive and it is a bit diabolical to charge for whole milk… The other drinks and food both look delicious and there is plenty of street parking nearby, as well as a couple of lots.

author: lucy gillings
review_text: Cannot recommend enough. The owner has adapted Hawaii'n with Vietnamese cuisine (his mum's) recipes. Absolutely perfect 👌🏾

author: Abner Bonilla
review_text: It is what it is. If you’re looking for cheap food and lots of it this is your place if you’re thinking you’re going to get filet mignon and lobster tails for the price your gravely mistaken based on that that’s what I judge it on the service is great and when you walk in, they usually are friendly, they clean up the tables right away. It is handicap accessible, and there is plenty of parking out front. For what the price of the food is the food is fine. It’s a really big area. Have fun and enjoy.

author: Ben Attack
review_text: Exceptional service from all the staff. Especially from Novi! Really enjoyed the live music with breakfast on a Sunday morning. Burrito was delicious, especially with the sauces. Madu breakfast was very tasty, the only comment about that would be to chop the coriander a bit smaller. Unfortunately the coffee here isn’t very good, taste too much like dirty water.

author: Brendan
review_text: Came here for lunch and I thought that while the food was not bad, it was not especially special. The ribs were soft and meaty but flavour wise it was a normal bbq pork rib. Food also came out lukewarm. Overall an okay experience.

author: Nicole Quek
review_text: Gigantic portion - can be shared between two or even three pax. Based on what I see, at least four different types of ham was used. The pate is pretty good, though the floss was not evenly spread. Fresh vegetables served in separate sealed plastic bags. The service was fast and there’s a small unit between their two kitchens with seats for customers.

author: Sarah Devereaux
review_text: Such a relaxing space to share breakfast on our last day in Miami! Food was truly exceptional, from the maple bacon French toast all the way down to a simple, plain arepa. Coffee was awesome, and service was also fantastic. This will be a new tradition during our annual Miami trip! Thanks to the staff and chef!

author: Theresa
review_text: Excellent ramen! Thick, chewy noodles, flavourful broth, tender pork in the tonkotsu and lots of clams in the dashi bowls. The highlight of the meal was the sweet and savoury Tebasaki wings. So much so, I wish they sold the seasoning to go.

author: Chuck Lee
review_text: In the last day of my trip in Ho chi min city, I enjoyed breakfast in Banh Mi Hong Hoa restaurant with my wife. The food is so gooooooooooood. I wish I tried earlier. Price is affordable, and staff is super friendly with a big smile on face. Highly recommended to you guys.

author: Emily Etman
review_text: We had Family dinner there. A cozy and beautiful Mediterranean restaurant with a stunning water view. The atmosphere is warm and inviting—perfect for a relaxed quiet dinner. The food is absolutely delicious: all appetizers where top of the line, especially the grilled octopus, which was tender, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. Every detail, from the presentation to the taste, reflects authentic Greek cuisine. lamb shank, souvlaki, lamp chops 👍 A must try lava cake for desert ! A wonderful spot to enjoy great food and wine while watching the water.

author: Barbara West
review_text: I love their delicious food, friendly service and atmosphere. I'm located in Central jersey and it's always a treat when I travel North to have lunch or dinner there.

author: Vincent Ku
review_text: The Hainan chicken is very nice. Other dishes so so. Only accept cash so see local people have to go out to find ATM. Don't expect much service. It's a very local neighborhood restaurant only.

author: Lilith Purpura'Regina
review_text: We go here literally every week! It's the best buffet in the area! And the people are super friendly! Shout out to my boy at the front desk! The dude with the cool hair is always super nice! And the food is usually really good! Like any buffets, they have off times. But I've never left regretting eating there! I definitely recommend to everyone! P.s. gotta try their crab Rangoon! It's one of the best I ever had! They fill them so much! And you gotta get the Hibachi rice and put the drippings from the beef roast on it and a little soy sauce.... literally to die for!

author: April Butler
review_text: Literally probably the best breakfast I've ever had. Visiting for for hubby's bday and our 10 year anniversary. The service was phenomenal and the food was even better. These 2 employees made our whole experience that much better at this restaurant and we're a highlight of our day. Not to mention the bloody Mary was SO GOOD and I'm a bloody Mary connoisseur. GO EAT HERE AND SUPPORT THIS RESTAURANT

author: Vanessa
review_text: I love the fish ceviche, it’s my favorite. I’ve been coming here since they opened. Best authentic Peruvian food in SF!

author: Adam Herlambang
review_text: Visited in August 2022 and I still can’t get over how stunning the sunset was. This place isn’t just a bar—it’s an experience. Perched on the edge of a cliff with the ocean crashing below, every golden hour turns into a movie scene. Drinks were solid, vibes were unmatched, and the staff was super friendly. Pro tip: come early to grab the best seat before it gets packed.

author: Jackovan
review_text: Food: The food expecially the Inspirasi or whatever stall it's called absolutely terrible. Taste felt off and what made my whole day went terrible wasn't the terrible and off taste. I found a PLASTIC in my food! That wasn't the worse part. Went for a drink at Kopi Meow and holy the people were so dirty I can't even describe. I don't want to even review any further as it's making me more frustrated. Service: The service was okay, nothing special except a sense of unfriendlyness. Atmosphere: I came here on a weekend and alot of the tables are dirty and crowded. It gives the local hawker vibes though! Never go here. Never.

author: Benjamin
review_text: Stopped by for a late night dinner , Roger was my waiter. He was friendly and polite. It’s inside the casino 🎰.

author: Sky
review_text: I had huge expectation for Michelle 1 star. Long story short, it is not worth to wait 1 hour to get the food. I might try again if no line. The octopus was good but not exceptional, the sauce was not aligned with octopus and not tasty. The Aguachille was too sour and couldn't enjoy it well. Octopus taco was good. Smoked kanpachi taco was hmmmm. I don't smell any smoke and just plain taco. Urchin was good and I might come back for it. Lemonade was fresh good, but not super excellent. Dish setting is good for the price but not Michelle star up scale. I think there are lots of people due to relatively reasonable price for Michelle star, but taste is not balanced well, and not tasty for the star value.

author: Fenny Gosal
review_text: I went here last December 2025. We ordered fried rice and the 1 kg US Premium Ribs. It was my first time trying their US Premium ribs. The taste was good, but I didn’t really like the texture, a bit hard to chew and not as soft compared to their signature ribs. As for the fried rice, I think it needs some improvement, as it tasted quite plain. Overall, I’d still come back, but I’d definitely stick to ordering their signature ribs next time.

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Shaun Nel
review_text: The food here is very good and the staff are very cool and super friendly. We came here for Christmas eve dinner and we thoroughly enjoyed all the food and service. Absolutely amazing value for money.

author: Marek Michalak
review_text: One of the best hidden gems on the Greater Boston culinary map! Food: Small tasting plates are the love language in this place and boy, they are wonderful! Most of them being Asian-fusion influenced. From the wonderful gochujang mackerel through one of the best brussell sprouts I've ever eaten to my absolute fave - the chive cakes with two types of curry sauce. WOW WOW WOW! One of the best dished I've had all year. Their cocktails are also fun and inventive. Service & Ambiance: Our waiter was absolutely wonderful - warm, friendly and made us feel right at home. I loved the interactions (though I usually find them awkward and forced) and it did feel like I was being welcomed into a spot owned by inclusive and quirky friends. It feels like a bar, a cafe and an upscale restaurant mixed together and I loved this low key vibe from the get-go. If you don't go there, you are really missing out!

author: Claire
review_text: The food was very good and full of flavor! Lots of options on the menu. We waited about 45 minutes for a table on a Sunday afternoon, which is pretty expected for this place. Unfortunately, the service did not match the quality of the food. Our server wasn’t very attentive and came across as rude. Because of this, we left a lower tip. Afterward, the server confronted us not once, but twice!! Once at the table and again as we were leaving, with a coworker. They asked us why we didn’t tip more. This felt intimidating and unwelcoming. It’s disappointing, because the food itself was great, but the service really took away from the overall experience.

author: May C
review_text: For the price of rm29.90 perpax ,there is nothing to feel dissatisfied. U got crab n prawn, other sode dishes, all the frozen foods and drinks.u canot find thos price elsewhere..tomyam soup base a bit salty whole clear soup almost tasteless...try to put a scoop or 2 of chocolate ice cream into thai milk tea..terrific

author: Katarzyna Jaworska
review_text: Nice place with good food. The ribs were a bit on the lean side – I personally prefer them fattier – but the crispy bacon was absolutely delicious and definitely a must-try! The presentation of the dishes was just okay. we didnt have to wait for the table- coz they have upstairs which was all empty

author: Giulia Morf
review_text: amazing hidden gem in Nusa Penida. great food, awesome staff and incredible life music. they even sing for my birthday and made candles for birthday on the dessert. :) thank you ☺️🙏🏼

author: Kylie Camarda
review_text: Beautiful restaurant, food was amazing, and our server Valentina and the whole staff made our experience absolutely perfect! Highly recommend

author: Nasira Aziz
review_text: Malini Uluwatu is all about the view — and yes, the view is absolutely stunning. The restaurant sits right on the cliff, and the seaside scenery is truly beautiful and dramatic. Unfortunately, that’s where the positives mostly end. We reserved a table in advance, which is the only reason we got a direct seaside view. If you don’t reserve, you’ll most likely be seated in the back with no real view at all. Even after mentioning that we were celebrating a special occasion, we were still seated at a regular counter-style table, right next to other guests, instead of a private or special spot. The food was very disappointing. The portion sizes are a joke. I received a tiny portion of pasta that didn’t taste good at all. My husband ordered the aglio e olio seafood pasta, and there were exactly three shrimp on the entire plate. For a seafood restaurant at this price point, that’s unacceptable. On top of that, there are very few vegetarian options — basically none. If you don’t eat seafood or meat, your choices are extremely limited. The seating is uncomfortable: • Hard, uncomfortable chairs • Very little space — your knees are literally against the wall • Not a place to sit and enjoy a relaxed meal Overall, Malini is only worth visiting for the view. The food is bland and uninspired, the portions are far too small, and the comfort level is low. If you’re looking for a special table (anniversary, engagement, birthday, etc.), you need to very clearly and repeatedly communicate this in advance — and even then, there’s no guarantee you’ll get it. Personally, I would not recommend this restaurant unless you’re only coming for the scenery and photos. For good food, comfort, and value, there are much better options in Uluwatu.

author: Victoria Howard
review_text: The food was absolutely amazing! We got the strawberry cheesecake pancakes (not on the menu but just ask!), the fried chicken sandwich, the french toast, and the steak eggs. Mafe was our server, a sweetheart! The area is so cute, and there’s a little parking garage right next to it, and parking is validated! I have no complaints, I can’t wait to come back again!

author: Tâm Như Trần Nhật
review_text: I came here to try the famous giant roti tissue with sweet condensed milk sauce, and it was pretty good. However, I recommend coming with at least one other person because the portion is huge and can get a bit boring if you eat it alone. Since I was by myself, it felt like too much. The food came out super fast. The price isn’t exactly cheap, but it’s still reasonable for the experience. I also tried the “masala tea,” but for me it wasn’t that impressive. Overall, I’d give this place a solid 4 out of 5.

author: Ken Ny
review_text: Order pineapple fries rice, fries shrimp cake, mango salad and hot pot seafood egg. Pineapple fries rice portion is very big. Overall the food is good and atmosphere is super nice. Services for us is average only. The price for the food, a bottle of beer, coconut and plain water cost 1300bath for 6 persons.

author: Rick Lu
review_text: Open early on Sunday morning...enjoyed blueberry scones and the raspberry filled crispy turnover.

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Devon Scott Dempsey
review_text: Great place with lots of food and variety Staff was super nice and accommodating Price I was charged was more than what's on the sign !

author: Kai Pierce
review_text: It's a little dinner with dinner food. You can't go too wrong. I'm not expecting Michelin star level service just a big plate of eggs and bacon and this place delivered.

author: Frank Fazzalari
review_text: The Galway House in Boston sure takes you back — this place started in 1960, and that’s exactly what it feels like walking in. We were greeted by a few servers almost immediately — it felt good to know you were recognized. We grabbed ourselves a booth, ordered a few pints and some wine, and then put in our food order. We had the seafood platter — broiled (key, not fried). Wow — it had about 8 scallops, shrimp, and a nice piece of fish — all tasty. We also ordered the steak tips — they were great. I think they use the same marinade I make. Steamed broccoli, summer squash, mashed potatoes, mac and cheese, and fries rounded out the sides. Oh, get this — for an extra $2, you can add the clam chowder when you order a main, so we definitely opted for that. All in all, it was a good experience, and I would definitely go back. Saluti

author: Kelly Stout (DizzyedUpGirl)
review_text: My car was broken down in the parking lot and Mauricio really took care of me while I waited for a tow. The cheesecake was delicious and the bathroom was clean.

author: Ayman Siddiqui
review_text: Staff was extremely friendly and accommodating! Definitely the best service I have ever received from a small business like this one. The seekh kabob and raita were delicious. I would highly recommend to anyone seeking authentic Pakistani food and excellent service!

author: Jonathan Diaz
review_text: They take too long for the order to be ready bad customer services, don't come here unless your willing to spend an extra 40min wait go to another pizza hut please

author: Hoàng Khánh Linh Nguyễn
review_text: This is truly the claypot rice restaurant that I feel most satisfied with in District 1. The claypot rice restaurant has delicious Northern flavor, suitable for the taste, the golden crispy rice layer, fragrant served with rich traditional dishes. Lunch here is delicious, the menu is diverse with many dishes, 2 people ate until full and still did not run out of rice. The restaurant space is clean, has convenient parking, very suitable for office workers or families, the price is reasonable, I will definitely come back here many more times.

author: NORSHAM SUHAINA BINTI YAAKOB (FRIM)
review_text: Great meal at Restoran 5 Utara!Loved the Siakap Goreng Khengsom (crispy, flavorful) and Udang Padphet (spicy, aromatic)—will reorder! Kangkung Garlic and Ayam Goreng Garlic were solid. Decent price for 3 pax. Only downside: tea too sweet. Highly recommended!

author: Jorge Chiman
review_text: I always see this spot and never got around to going, and now I realize I've missed out this whole time! The atmosphere is giving tex mex, the food is full of flavor and the sides are very diverse. Not one overpowers the other. I got the BBQ chicken and pulled pork and it had a good mix of sweet and spicy with the Mac and cheese and chorizo beans. Overall solid experience would definitely come again. Make sure you save room for dessert the portions are bigger than they seem.

author: Layla Mansour
review_text: I had my doubts about their zucchini chips but they were fire 🔥 also had a chicken gyro (not pictured). It was pretty good and generous but I didn't care for the garlic skordalia.

author: David Zhang
review_text: We showed up late after they ran out of pork skin, but despite that the food was still pretty good I really enjoyed the fried green chili. They have if you want to add some spice to your food.

author: Patricia G.
review_text: I wasn’t sure about trying this restaurant at first, given its 4.4 rating and my past disappointments with some of the higher-rated (4.7) places in town. But we wanted something different from the usual Chinese or Indian options, so we decided to give it a try. What a great surprise! Their hamburgers were not only huge and tasty, but the service was also very friendly. In my opinion, this restaurant deserves a much higher rating than many of the other places I visited.

author: Võ Băng Nhạn
review_text: Delicious, cheap, lots of promotions, enthusiastic staff, good care. Everyone follow the tiktok and facebook channels.

author: Jud Sa
review_text: Here the menu , because when I search and see the prices online was not correct I a little expensive. The food was good but not excellent for the price that we paid.

author: Autumn
review_text: Very chill vibe. Asked the barista for a rec and she made me literally one of the best lattes I've ever had. Everyone was very nice and helpful, place is super clean and comfortable. Also got a smores pop tart and it was delicious. Normal prices, nothing crazy. Definitely recommend giving it a try, also I didn't realize at first but it's a pretty Christian place so if that's ur thing you'll like it even more.

author: Jack Du
review_text: Escape!!! This place is a joke. Sure, the food might be ‘authentic,’ but the service is absolute garbage. One rushed, incompetent server for the whole restaurant, unable to follow simple order instructions, let alone refill water or provide napkins. Worse, the server—a fellow Asian—was straight-up racist. Friendly and chatty with English speakers, but cold and monotone when I spoke Chinese. Unbelievable. And the best part? When I rightfully chose not to tip for this disaster of a service, the server told me not to come back. Instead of whining about a missing tip, maybe ask yourself why you didn’t earn it in the first place. Pathetic service, disrespectful staff—save your money and go somewhere that actually values customers.

author: The Samoan Light
review_text: I'm a critic when it comes to burgers, these burgers are good but i still prefer Johnny Rockets for the overall experience. They dont offer beef bacon as a replacement to pork, which i dont like. The shop seems very empty and bland compared to the theme layout in Johnny Rockets. This place is definitely worth trying out if you like burgers.

author: E-FACTOR
review_text: Had the urge, had to go! Thanks again, Anthony👍 Made my order perfect!

author: Rob Verheyen
review_text: Sorry to be negative again after a bad experience in Jalan Alor a few days back. We had a good meal here a couple of years ago so we came back on this trip. This time, it was no good, not as disastrous as on Jalan Alor, but still no good. The curries were just bland, underseasoned, tasteless. They had a slimy consistency because of the thickener added. The naan was poor, too. It all had little to do with Indian food except the names of the dishes. Is there a new owner or just a new concept? Serve cheap food to ignorant foreigners on a budget who don't appreciate real food anyway? The place obviously tries to reduce costs where ever it can, even going so far as to not place condiments or even a box of tissues on the table - if you ask for some, the waiter comes and hands you one or two tissues. Service was indifferent. An okay place to sit though, relatively quiet. And owner: please don't react to this. I'm sure no-one is waiting to read your arrogant comments to negative reviews.

author: Czar Esterak
review_text: We had a truly great evening at this restaurant. The food was delicious, fresh, and perfectly prepared. The service was friendly, efficient, and professional, which made us feel well taken care of. The atmosphere was welcoming and pleasant, creating a comfortable place to relax and enjoy our meal. It was a wonderful overall experience.

author: Elle Barnes
review_text: I went in to purchase a salmon plate with rice and peas and cabbage. I asked for jerk gravy on my salmon while placing my order. I notice while the server was closing my plate she did not add the jerk gravy, so I asked her could she pls add it. She responded with a nasty attitude “ I’m not opening the tray again it will be hard to close” so I said ok that’s fine, do you mind putting some in a small container. She does, when she comes back I said thank you. She rolled her eyes and sucked her teeth as she was walking away. And I left that plate on the counter . There is NO way I was paying for her attitude. It sucks even trying to support this business. You have to mentally prepare yourself to be miss treated . I’m all set ! They really need learn customer service ! You can’t buy everything online - I will never support this business again 🤷🏽‍♀️

author: Isamari Burgos
review_text: I love Chilis and I always go to them but this one is always pretty packed & loud. The service was good, server took our orders quick & got everything out in a timely fashion. The only thing is they sat us in a really noisy area with kids and it was really loud. Though in this chilis it’s to be expected since it’s the only one in the “city”. That being said I’ve gone here a few times before because I love chilis and it’s the closest to me.

author: Cesar agusto Urrutia
review_text: The places are clean and the food is fine .but the only thing is when they give food there no smile 😒 and when u odder it worth please, owner, look at the camaras, please .....today is Sunday 05/4/25 odder again and there no smile and we said thank u they don't answer back owner u need to send someone and see the services she give

author: Alan Ritchie
review_text: We had an excellent meal at Elephante. The ambiance is next level and will be extremely hard to beat given its proximity to the water in Santa Monica. During our meal, we had a nice view of the water yet enjoyed the dark and moody atmosphere of the restaurant. The service was very kind and attentive despite being busy. We got the whipped egg plant dip which was solid (the bread is next level). We then got the vodka pasta and sopressata pizza. I really enjoyed the combination of the honey and hot soppressata on the pizza and felt that the vodka pasta was extremely well balanced. This was a great meal and I am glad we were able to make it in. Note- I would definitely recommend making a reservation multiple weeks in advance as it was quite busy.

author: Conner Nevel
review_text: Fresh and tasty ingredients. However, do yourself a favor and get the bowl They’re not great at wrapping your burrito

author: GG K
review_text: Finally tried this highly raved about dessert cafe in Bangkok and I did think it was not bad, but not worth a queue. We got the mango sticky rice kakigori and the salted egg yolk cold buns. The flavours of both were pretty good, but were still a bit too sweet for me. I enjoyed how finely the ice was shaved for the kakigori, and the chunks of mango and sticky rice inside it, which helped in making the overall dessert less icy. I do think it could be improved by changing out the cream they drizzled on top and provided on the side into unsweetened coconut cream. The buns were pretty nice as well, though again the salted egg yolk filling was a tad too sweet. Additionally, it would be good if the portion could be smaller as 6 rather big buns per pack is quite a lot. Overall, not a bad place for dessert, but definitely not worth the long queue that is nearly forever present at this place. We came at around 6pm and still had to wait for a while before getting a seat, so do try to avoid peak hours or the wait might take quite a while.

author: Sequoia Wright
review_text: Hello, so 1st time back here at this Decatur location bc I had my Mouth watered & set on their Oaxtail mac but once Receiving it, Driving all the way Home from work (not to Mention), Tasting it to see wassup, I instantly became Upset smh Mac & cheese a little dry, 1 oaxtail was cooked Perfectly & well the 2nd one, Not so much, meat not Tender enough & here's a Pic to Prove it as well. Last time I checked, this Meal use to be Bigger portioned & you had 3 tails instead of 2 as well; Probably won't be Coming back here for any Good eats😩 I just want my Money back, Refund me please & thank you!

author: Sibu Pitse
review_text: We had our 1st meal in Vietnam at this Michelin selected restaurant. Kai masterfully showed us how to eat the rice cakes with garden salad. Everything was fresh and absolutely delicious. Thank you Kai for the great service.

author: Harry Lee
review_text: Can order in Chinese. My dad say the current proprietress is second generation. Soup is used to be thicker. Still quite nice now.

author: Jeremy LeBlanc (Jeremy)
review_text: I haven't had Pizza Hut in a long time it's got to be better than Little Caesars because that was so horrible the final results was a really big let down , especially because of the tremendously delicious advertising, ughh absolute falsely faked by the ads and it upsets me tremendously, trash that was a robbery at 7:11 211 which is robbery in progress and is no better than a 7-Eleven Pizza you can't get with food stamp!! SMH

author: Update
review_text: When I see good things I don't hesitate to support and give commemts. I went for a party 2 blocks away from this restaurant, saw cars parked outside tge restaurant, so we decided to check the place out. The environment was classic, the food is well cooked and delicious. i have been back there with friends and family from Trenton, which is over 56miles to enjoy the food again and again. I feel much as if am in Lagos each time am there. Pure Nigerian food, you need to try it.

author: Raul Bussot
review_text: I’m a big fan of Rollo’s so it’s no surprise that Hellbender is just as impressive. I would return to enjoy all of the dishes I had and there were several we didn’t get to try. The smashed cucumbers, fish tacos and crispy lamb were outstanding. I look forward to retuning and trying the rest of the menu!

author: Cindy Woon Lee Loo
review_text: Food is better than expected.. ribs , pork and vegs are delicious... with broken roce of course...

author: JB Jose
review_text: My brother took me this Michelin-starred seafood place. Though it’s in a food hall, it’s not food hall prices. The quality of the dishes were still outstanding and worthy of the cost. The highlight for me was the sopa de mariscos. The flavors reminded me of how we used to have it as a youth, if not the texture. The seafood was abundant and fresh. Other highlights include the delicious tostadas and the fresh uni and scallop. Try all the dishes with their home made hot sauces. Though the wait was about 25 minutes to be sat at prime dinner time, it’s still definitely worth it. We’ll be back.

author: 孤獨的美食家
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Rock Bar is truly one of Bali’s most iconic sunset destinations — perched dramatically on the cliffs of Jimbaran, it offers breathtaking ocean views that are simply unforgettable. Watching the sun dip below the horizon with waves crashing beneath you feels magical, and the overall ambience is unmatched. It’s definitely a must-visit spot for anyone who loves scenic views, good vibes, and great music. The atmosphere is vibrant yet relaxed, especially as the sky changes colours. The live DJ adds a nice energy to the evening without being too loud. It’s the kind of place where you can enjoy a cocktail, take in the sea breeze, and just unwind. The drinks are well-crafted and beautifully presented, though the prices are definitely on the higher side — expected for a venue with such a view. The food is decent but not particularly memorable; it serves more as a complement to the drinks and sunset rather than the highlight itself. The service was generally friendly, though it can be a bit slow during peak hours due to the large crowd. Staff members were polite but seemed slightly overwhelmed at times. Overall, Rock Bar delivers a spectacular visual and sensory experience. It’s perfect for sunsets, celebrations, or just soaking in the best of Bali’s coastal charm. While it’s not ideal for foodies seeking fine dining, it’s absolutely worth visiting for the view and atmosphere alone.

author: Adilene Llanes
review_text: The food was decent, but overall the experience was disappointing because of all the extra fees added to the bill. In addition to the menu prices, there was a non-cash adjustment fee of $6.72, an automatic 18% gratuity, and a $25 parking fee. None of this was made very clear upfront, and it significantly increased the total cost. The food itself was just okay—not bad, but not good enough to justify all the added charges. I would recommend paying cash when eating here.

author: Nicolai
review_text: What can I say except what has already been said? The food is divine. This is a no fuss, no muss dining experience where you’re in-and-out in 15 minutes: fuller, happier, and living a better life. The staff in the narrow street will wave a welcoming hand towards their small collection of tables and stools, knowing that you’re already captive to the smell of sizzling eggs. Take a seat and stab your finger at the top of the page: banh mi chao special. Add a drink of choice and await the best little plate of breakfast in Vietnam. Served piping hot, there’s a medley in the pan: eggs, lovely pork in various forms, pate, onions, laughing cow cheese (yes, that one), and fresh bread. There’s absolutely no wrong way to eat it! Haphazard chunks of bread with a sloppy spoonful of meats, the distant honking of passing cars, and the cool bittersweet taste of bac xiu coffee is the recipe for a great day. Come once, come again, and eat your heart out.

author: Joshua Gonzalez
review_text: I hope McDonalds corporate sees this, but I doubt it. I came in with my fiancé for a quick bite and started doing the usual pictures for my review without intrusion on customers or employees and went out to take a street shot of the building. As I'm coming back in 4 employees, one a security guard cane aggressively at me asking what am I doing? Again, they were very aggressive, but I simply told them I do google reviews and was taking a couple of shots. They said I couldn't, and I respected their wishes as they are a private company, and I was on private property, so I told them I wouldn't but I CAN still take photos from the PUBLIC sidewalk as per the UNITED STATES FIRST AMMENDMENT freedom of press gives me the right to. (Eyes can not be trespassing from public property). The manager said I could not, and the security guard was getting an aggressive look along with the other employees, so to de escalate, the situation I left without further confrontation, only to find out my order was also all messed up. MCDONALDS should make sure their employees and security guards aren't infringing on our constitutional rights!

author: Jamie Keno
review_text: Barely anyone in there the night we went. And the bartender couldn't even shake a margarita. For a $200 bill- just order wine here, because the bartender can't be bothered to make a decent drink. LAZY

author: Joseph BROWN (Mr. Brown)
review_text: Me and my family was there tonight and yooooooo the customer service was stop on. I did not have tip money on me and i fault bad but since my son goes to school i will send the tip money with him. Thanking the crew

author: Bali Nelson
review_text: I had a lovely brunch with a former colleague today and really enjoyed the veggie scramble. We talked at length with the charming long-time owner and had a great experience at this quaint place.

author: Юрий Соловьев
review_text: The tuna poke bowl is good. But was better poke and for less money.

author: Tonja Howard Jenkins
review_text: Food was good. Well seasoned and fresh. Our server was kind and accommodating. There was a slight language barrier for us (no one in my party spoke Portuguese), but it all worked out. The music was the only thing off about the ambiance. The decor was steakhouse, but the music was diner/cafeteria. All in all, a great time.

author: Peter Vogelsanger
review_text: Brilliant food. Be aware that you have to walk up 8 sets of stairs, no elevator. But you'll be ready for a cold drink and it's definitely worth it 😉👍

author: Y SW
review_text: Succulent chicken that cooked to perfection and paired with nice soy based sauce to give it a rich umami saltiness. The rice is fragrant and fluffy albeit of the drier style instead of the oilier types common with chicken rice. Both the dry and soup based hor fun(rice noodles) are nicely done. Order based on your preference, the dry version is heavier in taste. The soy bean sprouts are plump and crunchy and is slightly undercooked giving it a taste similar to salad. This might be a bit of an acquired taste for those not used to it. Take note there is actually a queue system and it is not free seating. This is slightly confusing as there are minimal signage to highlight this.

author: Frank Wan
review_text: This is certainly the best Japanese restaurant that I went to in Penang. We had the set lunch this time as we have not booked the seats for Omakase in advance. The Omakase counter was full. The services and food quality are excellent. The taste of the food is the same as that we experienced in Japan. The price for the lunch sets are very reasonable. We will come back to try the Omakase next time. Updated on 13 January 2025: We came back after a few months later, and found that the restaurant has already changed management. The restaurant had no guest when we walked in and had only two tables during our lunch. They cut down a number of staff and only one assistant chef was retained. We are shocked that for the same menu, the price has gone up for more than 50%. For example, the Sashimi set was RM50 per set but now RM88 😱. Although the quality of the food maintained similar standard, it was a big shock as the returning customers who knew the previous prices. There are some other choices for Japanese food with similar price!

author: Tasheena S
review_text: My coworkers and I stopped here for a bite to eat. It was a Friday afternoon around 2pm. We were seated immediately. Our waitress was super friendly. The restaurant was super quiet and relaxing. The ocean views and breeze really did add to the ambiance. I had the grilled mahi mahi. It was pretty good. I would definitely return especially after a long day at work.

author: maria jose
review_text: Great food and vibes! Recommend Bruskhlyn Pizza and cacio e pepe pasta! Linguine Al frutti Di mare was okay, I had better ones. Servers need to be more open with what you’re being charged for example bread: it was given like it comes with the service. FYI, the tips are included at 20%, and they are charged even when it's just a 2-person date.

author: Z Z
review_text: Third time purchasing from them! Never disappoints! The portion size is always just right for me with deliciously tender chicken! My only suggestion would be to offer plain cucumber as an alternative to the pickled ones, as not everyone might be a fan. It would be great to have the option for customers to choose their preference!

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Pao M
review_text: Bad service in the afternoon..not sure if the morning staff is better. I updated my rating due to another bad experience, purchasing food at 6:30 pm, and not being allowed to eat inside because they were closing at 7. We were not told our food was going to be to-go only, we, and two other couples, were literally kicked out. ....I’ve been here many times and the food is usually very good. Service is generally OK too. However, I want to share a recent issue. I placed a to-go order two days ago for two chicken pesto bowls, and both were missing the chicken. Since it was takeout, I didn’t realize until I got home—and by then, the store was closed. I called the next day and was told I could come back to pick up the chicken, which didn’t make much sense and honestly took me by surprise. I let them know I wouldn’t be returning just for that, but wanted to make them aware so they can look into it and improve. I was disappointed with how it was handled. If interested in looking into it, the order was to go at around 6:50 PM on 07/02/2025 (I added a video of the bowl)

author: Chin Yan
review_text: Away from the city breakfast spot. No queue, good coffee, Bengali roti is good. Parking is limited at the housing area. Do try out their white and black coffee. Salted coffee is just okay for me.

author: Abbey
review_text: I enjoyed the customizable aspect of GRECO's pita roll, with its various protein and sauce options. While flavorful, I found both the fries and the meat to be a little dry and not as tender as I would have preferred. It's also convenient that they have seating available in the store.

author: Bri D
review_text: Absolutely disgusting, a disgrace to Peruvian food. Ceviche was just lemon water on fish, Conchas a la Chalaca were absolutely horrible. Not flavor at all. If you are looking for a real peruvian restaurant this isn't it! Customer service is great but food is horrible

author: Liz Miniel
review_text: The food was fine, but they charged me for the wrong sandwich, even after I clarified I wanted a different one.

author: Ben S
review_text: The worst bánh mì I’ve had so far in Vietnam. Seriously terrible. I don’t know why it’s so popular. I tried two sandwiches: the grilled pork and the special bánh mì. The grilled pork wasn’t real grilled pork chop—it was more like hot dog meat. Nasty. I wanted actual grilled pork, not filler. The special bánh mì was full of cured meats that just tasted like preservatives. No good flavor—just salty, fake, and unhealthy. The bread was way too toasted, so hard it cut the roof of my mouth. It also didn’t seem freshly toasted—the sandwich was room temperature and the meat inside was cold. The mayo spread tasted weird and looked too yellow, which made me think it wasn’t fresh. The price was also very high. Almost 100,000 VND for the special bánh mì. Also the staff didn't care at all when I told them I didn't realize the grilled pork banh mi was not real meat. They basically said too bad, you paid for it.

author: Interstellar Productions
review_text: Food was low quality and bland with no flavor, whoever the chef is has got no creativity on his food, it was dishes one expects at a fast food truck.
