Plato Navideño ; Waiter was rude instead of helpful and made a rude comment telling me he didn’t care. This is when I told him the salad was too small of a portion for the price of almost $30. It was the chicken salad. The hallaca had no flavor on it’s stew and corn flour. I would give it 1 out of 10. And the Ham bread it was the smallest two slices i ever received in any restaurant. Listen you are not Gourmet , it’s street food value food and by putting it in a fancy carousel Does not make it fancy . Small portions don’t help either unless you’re running out of business and are portioning your budget. Maracaibo Parrilla , it was small boring and nothing fancy but it’s decor. The Sopa de Lenteja; was bit watery and miss the flavor it was meant to have. It did have pork for smokiness. Nothing good or fancy about it. Almost bland. Try some flavor meat stock instead of water to get that intended flavor. Or let it cook little longer to get the lentils to become thicker and flavors to come throughout. Desserts were the typical boring what you expect from a food truck , I didn’t bother to waste my time with another flan or tres leches. Be original and invent this old recipes and turn them into fusion beauties. Overall food was bland and missed the mark, and the poor portions in pretending to be a fancy Michelin restaurant its failed missionary. They spend more money on the look which attract young audiences of a tick tock and Instagram flair. And finally just another Venezuelan restaurant playing with the nostalgia of those who seek an authentic flavor.

author: claudia sandoval
review_text: Thank you for making my mother soooo happy on her 76 birthday. The food was delicious and Hilda, our waitress was very kind and helpful with all the needs of our group.

author: Adam Donaldson
review_text: After hearing a lot of hype around this chain and especially people highly rating their "Cane Sauce" I was very excited to try it. But I left disappointed as it wasn't that great and I personally think Chick-Fil-A is a better fast good fried chicken chain. Service was reasonable but the restaurant was generally loud and messy. We had a quick bite and got out. Food wasn't great but also wasn't terrible.

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: Farah Amine
review_text: Came here twice for a reason. The first bite I took here I cried and sang. Absolutely worth the wait, staff are so kind and it brings all flavors from different regions. We live for their pamelo salad with the leaves. Their dessert was ok, but loved their tea and it was served hot. Overall, food was so fresh, hot and flavorful.

author: Ong Ting Yong
review_text: I tried Pungdet’s Bread with Nutella, and it was a simple yet indulgent treat! The bread itself was incredibly soft and fluffy, with a light texture that made every bite enjoyable. It had the perfect balance of chewiness and airiness, making it an ideal base for the rich filling. The Nutella filling was generous and oozed out beautifully with every bite, giving that signature chocolate-hazelnut flavor that we all love. It was smooth, creamy, and not overly sweet, complementing the softness of the bread perfectly. The slight warmth of the bread made the Nutella even more melty and satisfying. While it’s a straightforward snack, the quality of the bread and the richness of the filling set it apart. It’s the perfect comfort food—simple, nostalgic, and delicious. Whether you’re grabbing a quick bite or satisfying a sweet craving, Pungdet’s Bread with Nutella is definitely worth trying. Highly recommended for chocolate lovers!

author: Currie Pok
review_text: Lovely find in the area. Best food on a rainy day. Owner was attentive and filled up soup for us. He said he selected the lala himself daily. We didn’t opt to add any steamboat sides into the soup as we wanted the original taste.

author: Faye Zheng
review_text: If you wanna some microwaved food, feel free to order here. Or you can just buy from trader joes and save you 80%

author: Evan Lee
review_text: This beef hotpot is surprisingly good! The cold weather in December made us want something warm and comforting and Googling around, we decided to try this spot out. The place was absolutely packed and we waited about 5 minutes to get a table. Everything on the menu looked great and we tried the pickled chicken feet and pork ears. It was really good and not overpowering like most places. Next we tried the self-grill goat boobs (yes, goat boobs) and it was also really good. It's pre-marinated so you don't need to dip anything else. And last but not least is their signature Mongolian beef hotpot. Packed with meat and about $12USD for two, the hotpot was amazingly good. The broth and dipping sauces were on point. Everything was really good and service was fast and friendly. I would definitely come back and recommend this place! Update: Fourth time visiting and it's still as good as day one. They're even more busy than before as we went on a Sunday evening and the restaurant is packed. Quality has not suffered one bit. Definitely one of the best beef hotpots in Da Nang and our favorite for sure.

author: Anna Danielian
review_text: I don t understand how this place does not have 5 star rating all across the board. Yes, there are lines even at 10:30 am on Friday and the place is cramped but because it’s fast paced there is always a good chance of landing a table. You don’t come here to hang out. You come here to taste their AMAZING pastries!!! I am a big connoisseur of French pastries and have a handful of my favorite bakeries but this one is the best. I wish they opened a location in Hollywood or Silverlake.

author: Ali Alyammahi
review_text: If you’re in Bangkok and love desserts, this place is a must visit. The menu offers both local and Korean inspired favorites like kakigori. The atmosphere is clean, perfect for cooling off after a long day of shopping. You can find branches in all the main malls in central bangkok. Mango Sticky Rice Bingsu 8.7/10 ❤‍🔥 Original Milk Bun 8.5/10 ❤‍🔥 Nutella Bun 8.5/10 ❤‍🔥 Strawberry Bingsu 6/10 Honey Toast 7/10

author: A. S. T.
review_text: Excellent menu, great prices, live music on Friday nights. The Cabernet Sauvignon that was served was exquisite. The only things that bothered me was that the wild mushrooms croquettes (pictured) were actually just mashed potatoes, and the tacky violinist playing tacky music for an hour between the live jazz sets. Luckily the friends I invited for the jazz act had a good attitude.

author: 林千尋
review_text: Tasty babi guling, me personally feels tourists friendly spiciness. Soup is very mild with many vegetables. This location is easier to access to avoid traffic jam compared as other branches. Beer is not super cold and price setting is for tourists are reasons I didn't put 5stars.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Yushaz farahani
review_text: Touchdown Indonesia and straight away feeling the hype lah! First meal had to be Pagi Sore — and it did not disappoint. The food was genuinely good and super sedap. The ayam pop was really enak, and the tunjang totally satisfied my craving. Udang Tofu must tried for spicy lover. Even tried my first air jeruk — refreshing gila! Overall, a solid spot for that authentic Indonesian comfort food fix. Will definitely come again!

author: beni
review_text: I recently visited the Raising Cane's in Downtown Crossing, Boston, and overall, the experience was great! The chicken fingers were perfectly crispy, juicy, and packed with flavor—exactly what you'd expect from Cane's. The signature sauce paired with the Texas toast and crinkle-cut fries made for a very satisfying meal. What really stood out was the decor. The restaurant was decked out in gold accents, which gave it a fun, upscale vibe—definitely not what I expected from a fast-food spot. However, the one downside was that I had a hard time finding seating. The place was packed, and the seating area seemed pretty limited for the size of the crowd. It would have been nice to enjoy the meal in a bit more comfort. Overall, still a great spot for some delicious chicken, just be prepared for a possible wait if you want to sit and eat inside!

author: John Chong
review_text: Old School Bakery. I found this place on google map and the reviews looked good. So I went down to pick up a few buns and a loaf of bread. The bread and pastries were surprisingly fresh and good and very reasonable. I loved the curry puff, chicken pie and Egg Tarts. I bought a loaf of Sliced Multi-Grain Bread. It was fresh and soft even after 3 days. My only regret was not buy more stuff !!!

author: Marie Gail Stratford
review_text: Perfect place to unwind at the end of a long day! I've recently moved into the neighborhood and was taking a walk after a long afternoon of virtual meetings. Stopped for a glass of wine and a nibble. The bartenders were both attentive and wonderful, making sure I had what I needed and felt welcome in the space. The food was good--especially the sweet potato fries. I will definitely be back!

author: Carolina Aguilar
review_text: On Tuesday at aroud 12:20am past by the drive thru and got a combo 13 a home style ranch and two tacos when I stared eat the sandwich was hard then I notice the the chicken sandwich was raw I went back to telling them and the lady on the drive thru didn't even apologized . She asked my if I wanted more food and i said not she gave me a refund for the sandwich .not great service at all

author: Arline Wijaya
review_text: Recommended All variant of friend rice 8,5/10 Red wine cockburns 9/10 Shrimp fried 8/10 Sweet and sour pork 8/10

author: M planetmike
review_text: This is a Szechwan Zone. If you enjoy Spicy Chinese, this is the place. Like so many good restaurants in California, it is Innocuously located in a strip mall. We had excellent food and service. The restaurant furnishings have been updated. Prices were very reasonable. Our bill for 4 people came to $100. I encourage those who had negative experiences years ago to give this another chance.

author: Siah Hx
review_text: Some stalls in this food center only accepts cash, i suggest bring along cash when visiting. And quite many stalls do not provide extra cutleries when requested. Service is below average at most stalls too. The food center is warm and stuffy on a hot day. Crowded during meal hours too. Washroom and hand wash area available nearby.

author: Pat Lisi
review_text: Well I’ll start with saying I’ve never been so sure I was about to be robbed as I was when our cab driver took us into this industrial area which was pitch black as it was night time. When the car stopped and there was nothing around I was sure it was my time to go !! However the cab driver pointed to a red light over a small vestibule and said “that’s it” was beyond relieved to know we were still gonna make it !! As we had no reso we had to wait two and a half hours for a table as the place was packed. The pizzaiolos were very friendly and talked to us about everything pizza and more. I asked some questions about the oven as it didn’t look like any I ever saw live or when I shop for my own and then they explained it was basically home made on the spot and that’s just amazing and very cool .. especially because they’re churning out NYC’s best pizza. Very vibey atmosphere , very friendly staff … incredible pizza. 🍕 10/10

author: Damian Koh
review_text: I can imagine this to be amazing if it was a cool rainy evening. It's pretty much self service here. First you notify the staff of your table number, then pick out the ingredients you want in the fridge and pay for it at the counter. Then you wait for them to bring the claypot to you. Soup was rich with a reasonable amount of garlic, which I love. It does get quite heavy after boiling for some time so you can get free soup refills. Ingredients are fresh and go well with the soup.

author: Steve
review_text: I always here for the Ban mee and nice cup of coffee, btw this hawker have many Arab servant stalls suitable for halal people.

author: Joel Keane
review_text: We went for dinner while waiting for our laundry to dry. The food was absolutely delicious and very well priced! Some of the most friendly customer service we have experienced in the USA. The 50's theme was very well done also. Would most definitely return.

author: Fillipe Candido-Fraga
review_text: I love this place. It was one of my go-to spots when I visited North Jersey. It's a Brazilian place and they mainly speak Portuguese. They have nightly live music, both Brazilian and American songs. Great atmosphere. It's becoming a regular spot for me when visiting Northern NJ.

author: zzubsg
review_text: WARNING DO NOT BUY FROM THIS MIX RICE STALL BEING CHARGE $9.50 for this sad looking rice , they mention $7 for the braised intestine. TOTALLY A SCAM FOR SUCH STALL. Taste really average. GO AT YOUR RISK 😡😡🤬😡

author: lordminder
review_text: Absolute waste of time and waste of money. Went with viet friends , everyone found the meal inedible. Ox tails were tiny. It's impossible to chew and had little to no meat. Young was not cooked correctly. Chewy and impossible to eat. Brisket was chewy full of inedible veins and fat. Tendons were undercooked and in edible. Had to throw the entire meal away. Avoid this place. Many other local places that are far superior. *pictures attached.

author: Charmaine
review_text: Eat here if you want to experience the worst bak kut teh! Soup was meh, just peppery and savoury without much depth of flavour The worst crime was the you tiao which tastes like it has been kept for one year, it’s almost like a bun/bread texture instead of the crispy treat you expect. Apparently this used to be good but I was SO disappointed

author: Indrasis Chakraborty
review_text: Me and my wife went there for a Sunday brunch during our visit to Miami. The place is exceptional , both in terms of food and ambience. Our host was nice and kind and brought every single dish with a smiling face. We got their calamari , which was crunchy and fresh, well seasoned and came with a homemade marinara sauce. I got their grouper for main dish, which tasted fresh and flaky, came with a house potato and a salad. My wife got the impossible taco, which she said is really good and fresh. For desert, our host recommended us their brownie, which came hot and served with a scoop of vanilla ice cream. Altogether, excellent choice for a brunch with your loved ones and family. P.S. they are also dog friendly, and if you like birds, you can see tons of them sitting next to your table.

author: Jessie Lan Pham
review_text: I’ve ordered from Cơm Tấm Ba Ghiền twice and tried both the grilled pork chop and the grilled chicken. The toppings are genuinely good, and as someone who really loves com tam and has tried many places, I can see why Ba Ghiền is so well known. That said, I think the experience is best when you customize it a bit to suit your own taste. Personally, I find the grilled chicken juicier and less dry than the pork chop. The rice is on the drier side and clearly meant to be eaten with soup. Since I usually skip the soup, I add a little water and microwave the rice when eating at home, to make it softer. One small tip is to order outside peak hours, either before or after lunch or dinner, as the food tends to be prepared more carefully. For example, when I ordered around 9 am and asked for extra chili, they were very generous.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Than Pawannanwanitch
review_text: Hong Kong style pork rice - The best! Excellent medium roast Americano 10 out of 10

author: Aries Lai
review_text: Soooo disappointed! This ice coffee keeps melting. And this look terrible. How they can think the drinks keeps melting gonna be look good? So terrible aesthetics! The customer just needs drinks and food tastes good and provides good service! That all we need! Sooo bad! Pls don’t order this ice coffee frappe. Tastes like water. I can’t finished. I rated it -15 out of 10(minus 15)

author: Roy Rodriguez
review_text: Service staff was RUDE!!! Got our order wrong. Management argued with us about their personnel. Parking suck. Food was pretty good thou.

author: Richard Ondreicka
review_text: My wife Shirley and I have come to Il Poeta for years, before heading into the city to go to theatre. It's a romantic, intimate place to eat where the food is always made to the highest Northern Italian standards with homemade pasta and gnocchi. Chef Mario hails from both Cipriani Restaurant in Venice Italy as well as NYC where he worked alongside his Papa Luigi who taught him everything. We've had their calamari, mussels and clams, Caprese, croquette di eggplant, and Linguini with clam sauce with zucchini. Chicken breast parmesan crust white wine and lemon sauce, veal scallopine with mushroom and bacon (to die for) and Salmon in a mustard pistachio crust and spinach. I do want to try the pork tenderloins with wild mushrooms next. Put it this way, after reviewing and eating at multiple restaurants up and down Metropolitan ave we chose to celebrate our 17th wedding anniversary here with a party of 25 people. Everybody loved the food, and the service was excellent. Mario provided me a choice party menu at a price we were happy with. I wouldn't change a thing. The family raved about the menu and we all plan to come back again. Thanks Il Poeta

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Cynthia Gutierrez
review_text: Ok, so I don’t like to give this kind of review, but unfortunately this place just... I don’t even have the words to express my disappointment. I chose this place for my partner’s birthday and was excited because it was a new spot and we love Italian food. When we arrived, we had to wait a few minutes until someone was available to attend to us. When we saw the host, we asked her if that was where we were supposed to wait, and she said yes—just wait for me, I’ll be right back—which never happened. A lovely woman showed us a few minutes later where to sit and was kind, especially since the table was for four and we were just two. They offered us prosecco on the house, and we appreciated the gesture. We waited more than 15 minutes until someone took our order. The waiter was really kind and did his best with the resources available to him. As for the food, it wasn’t anything extraordinary. Honestly, I’ve been in better places. My boyfriend ordered a truffled beef carpaccio and bruschetta, which weren’t good. I ordered a pepperoni pizza, and I have to say that was the best dish of the bunch. I also ordered truffle fettuccine, and my boyfriend had spaghetti al pacino. According to him, it wasn’t bad, but unfortunately, the chef didn’t want to accommodate our requests, so we moved on. I honestly didn’t have a good time there. Maybe it was just that day, or I don’t know, but for a barely new place, it was pretty empty. And can we talk about the bill? Too expensive for that quality. The worst money I have ever spent P.S.: Please also pay attention to the restrooms. They were pretty disgusting.

author: Randy Abulon
review_text: there's no seating or amenities for eating at the location. so the atmosphere was 'ok'. there are several vendors at this location, as it's more geared towards the food delivery services than the walk up customers. i ordered a pastrami philly cheesesteak sandwich, and the pastrami was very tasty. the sliced steak seemed a little over seasoned but was still good. would recommend trying one of the cheeses versus their cheese whiz, just as a balance for their version. both meats were very juicy and tender though, as the bread was soaking it up. the size was good, so portion wise was excellent. I'll add this to my list to try the other sandwiches here. i just need to try the other menus at this location first.

author: Chlotus
review_text: This is a lovely little cafe where we can take a break from our walking tour! It's tucked away in a building, giving it a cozy feel. The coffee here is delicious and has a nice strong flavor. It's a popular spot for people working or studying, but it's a bit too quiet, almost like a library.

author: Tim Ou
review_text: Food was good and serviced is excellent. Not the typical ones you get from Miami. Lobster was worth a tried. And service charge 20% is already included in the bill and waitress make sure you know about it. Worth it .

author: Johan Jaramillo
review_text: Wanted rodizio for my birthday and after checking out a few places, we decided to come back here — I had been once a while ago and remembered it being good. The service was beyond great! The rodizio was amazing, with tons of different cuts of steak, all super tasty. I definitely got full fast but still tried to sample as many as I could — the picanha was especially delicious! The sangria was also a hit. Overall, a great experience and I’ll definitely be back!

author: Han Lee
review_text: Many choices and quite cheap there. The place is also airy and huge. A good neighborhood food center. Enjoyed the soya bean grass jelly drink. So many other food I wanna try!

author: Melnea Cass (IYADONNA)
review_text: I love this place! Seriously, they can have all my money because I had an amazing time here. The food was amazing. I had the Rasta pasta, I also tried the Mac & cheese (I kept stealing my mother’s catfish strips tho. Those were truly top tier. Staff was very polite and inviting. I can’t wait to return!

author: Stephen Kagawa
review_text: Food is amazing and delicious! The tomyam and crab meat with yellow curry is must try! Strongly recommended when you in hat yai. Price is affordable. We spent around 500baht for 3 person. We were there around 5.30pm and it was almost full house.

author: Winniebear
review_text: Wouldn’t come back here for dessert, but that’s only my preference. Ice shaven is bingsu quality but lacked flavor. Rating this a 3 since I only tried one. Serving time took long also, 15 minutes but they did communicate this while ordering.

author: micah Gillette
review_text: Cristina is absolutely amazing!!! She was so helpful with helping us find the best thing on the menu. The coffee is amazing!!! Will definitely be back here next time i’m back in miami.

author: Lee Yien
review_text: It's their 1 yr anniversary and there's no Q at the restaurant during lunch. Ordered their egg fried rice and i really like it. The flavour is just right, not too salty and rice is cooked perfectly, not too dry nor mushy. The service staff who serves us were all good. Overall i had a good meal and glad that i came to give it a try.

author: Wee Guan Kho
review_text: The food here is really good. The moonlight hor fun is so smooth it literally slit down my throat effortlessly ! Had the cuttlefish ball soup too, which was comforting and they are huge ! Suggest to come before 6pm as the crowd starts coming in.

author: Kiariladyboss
review_text: First time trying Ethiopian food 🇪🇹 and i went with a friend for my b.day. Enjoyed the experience to eat on the same plate. We ordered the feast for 2 (even though that’s food for at least 3 people😂) for $49 + a couple of appetizer and mango juice (freshly squeezed) that is served with pomegranade syrup (if i am not mistaken). On a mission to try all the vegan spots in NYC

author: Crystal Morris
review_text: I've been going there for a while and I have no complaints about anything the service is excellent the staff is very respectful and very nice and the food is fresh and they welcome anyone to come eat and enjoy yourself and I give them 10 or more star's 💯❤️

author: Wayne Wayne
review_text: Very popular seafood restaurant in Chulalongkorn Street. The staff are very efficient, the waiting time for table is around 10mins. For the dish that I ordered which is glass noodles with prawn, crabmeat with curry, seafood Tom yum gong and vegetables. Taste good and very authentic Thai food. The total bill is THB 1250 plus drinks.

author: Alicia MH
review_text: Milk and Madu Seminyak is a very good breakfast spot. My partner had the croissant croque monsieur and I had the eggs benedict. The food was delicious, we were served very quickly. Dita served us , she is sweet and very attentive. Highly recommend this place!

author: Verdinand Tampubolon
review_text: I had a wonderful dining experience at Oriental Kopi, Pavilion Mall. Here’s what I tried: Egg Tart 🥧 The egg tart was absolutely delightful—crispy, flaky pastry on the outside with a smooth, custardy filling. The egg flavor was rich but not at all “eggy” or unpleasant, making it very enjoyable and well-balanced in sweetness. White Coffee ☕ The white coffee was aromatic and comforting, with a smooth body and just the right balance of bitterness and sweetness. A perfect pairing with the egg tart. Hainanese Chicken Rice 🍗🍚 The Hainanese chicken rice was fragrant, with tender chicken served alongside flavorful rice cooked in chicken broth. The dipping sauces complemented it well, making it authentic and satisfying. Fried Chicken Rice 🍖🍚 The fried chicken rice was another highlight—the chicken was crispy on the outside yet juicy inside. It came with the same fragrant rice, which elevated the dish beyond just a simple fried chicken meal. Overall, Oriental Kopi serves quality food with a good mix of local favorites and kopitiam classics. Highly recommended if you’re visiting Pavilion Mall and looking for a hearty yet comforting meal. Even though I queued for a long time standing

author: PHANG WAI HUN
review_text: Delicious chicken chop with cheese! The meat was well-cooked and the cheesy topping made it extra satisfying. Great portion and value for money.

author: Katharina Brandau
review_text: Awesome coffee place in HCMC, if you are into speciality coffee. Staff take their coffee seriously. They give great recommendations and show their different brewing methods and utensils. The place itself is on the 3rd floor, industrial design and nice decor. Loved it so much that we took a 20min walk just to come back here for a nice V60. Got beans, too.

author: Peter Tudor
review_text: I was recommended to go here from someone at mu hostel and so glad they did. Garlic naan was greating the chicken and rice was OK. Staff were friendly and helped me out ordering. Would go again if I was in KL.

author: James Wiryo
review_text: Great Chinese foods and friendly staff! Good for family gatherings!

author: Saiful Yusoff
review_text: Buy chicken soup with 2 slice of bread... what was pack 1 slice of.bread cut into 2 piece & the chicken soup only contain very little portion of chicken. Very poor food serving for take away customer. Not worth it to pay rm5.95 for.chicken soup & rm 1.40 for the bread.

author: Warren Teh
review_text: If you like authentic Indonesia food with flavourful spices, must have it here. Nice and atmospheric ambience. Try the mango sambal, crunchy mango adds a sour punch to the sambal.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: maddy acosta
review_text: Okay look Korean bbqs are my things. I've been to many bbqs and look the food is ight . The meets are great. The side dishes are alright like the rice and cucumbers. Everything was ight till I started to notice the hygiene of the restaurant. The bathrooms are extremely dirty. It smells like black mold . The seats at the tabels are greasy and sticky. How can it be both I have no clue but for sure my pants where peeling off the seats. Walking to bathroom 8 months pregnant was almost a safety hazard from the slippery floors. I really think they should have some professional cleaning done. The robot service it's pretty cool till ur trying to get everything off and it says bye and your still trying to chase it to get your food. The mango lemonade was so watered down I had to ask for a coke after trying 2 cups. Over all it wasn't that bad just i think they need to invest in cleaning the restaurant

author: rafflesia sh
review_text: Food is ok only Service is slow; not enought staff The tables is not cleaned that fast after a customer finish eating I had to order my own drink Service slow Roti canai is not smooth

author: Faith Rhodes
review_text: A Must-Visit Gem! 🌸 We had an amazing time at Bon Bouquet Café! Even though the place was fully booked, our food came out incredibly fast and everything was delicious. Our server was attentive, efficient, and made us feel so welcome throughout the meal. The atmosphere was lively but cozy, and you could tell the staff really had their rhythm down. We’re already planning to come back to try more of the menu—it all looked so good! If you're thinking of visiting, I highly recommend booking your reservation in advance—they fill up quickly, and it’s easy to see why. Can’t wait for round two!

author: Zachary Chan
review_text: The service and atmosphere are quite good, and there's a traditional dance performance with audience interaction. Unfortunately, the food isn't very tasty. The beef short ribs weren't tender enough, and the beef was too dry (it should have been prepared using a slow-cooking method / sous-vide).

author: Miriah Cruz
review_text: I absolutely love this place! The food is so good. I would personally recommend the black cod bites and the chocolate cake (to die for). The manager Danny is very friendly and does a great job checking on the tables to make sure everyone is happy. We usually have Diego as our server and he is amazing. But even the entire staff as a whole is attentive and happy to help, seems like they work as a team really well together. Would definitely recommend this spot if you enjoy sushi and a good atmosphere!

author: Akin Ulusoy
review_text: This is hands down Boston’s best seafood spot. The lobster sandwich I had here? Best I’ve ever tasted! Loved it so much we came twice-if we’d stayed any longer, honestly, I’d have dragged you back every single day. Staff were proper friendly, kitchen smashed it, every dish was spot-on. Big thanks to the whole team-see you next time we’re in town!

author: Mark Gor
review_text: I recently dined at Hoang’s Kitchen in Ho Chi Minh City, and it was an absolute delight! The food was incredibly delicious – from the fresh spring rolls bursting with flavors to the tender grilled beef with rice, every bite was a perfect blend of authentic Vietnamese spices and freshness. What made the experience even better was our server, Anna. Her service attitude was impeccable; she was attentive, friendly, and went above and beyond to recommend dishes that suited our tastes. Plus, Anna is absolutely stunning, adding a warm and welcoming vibe to the cozy atmosphere. Highly recommend this gem for anyone craving top-notch Vietnamese cuisine!

author: Hungry Two Travel
review_text: We were recommended this spot from a local we got chatting to. We’re really glad we ended up checking them out! Their banh mi is absolutely massive, packed with meat, pate and butter. Seriously one of the biggest banh mi in Saigon and definitely worth checking out. 75K VND for one. Check out our channel for a full review of our experience: Hungry Two Travel.

author: Nick Richards
review_text: This spot is always a 10/10. Informed and educated waiters and staff, delicious food with huge portions, and it’s BYOB! They also have different atmospheres, outside, inside, and downstairs - each with their own vibe.

author: Sabrina C. (Bri)
review_text: We were a party of four with no reservation on a Saturday night and waited about 20 minutes at the bar for a table to open up. The restaurant is small and every table was taken, but they still managed to accommodate us. Service was good, though a bit on the slow side. The food, however, was excellent! We ordered jerk wings, jerk skewers, fries, plantains, and curry oxtails. The jerk was perfectly spicy and did not disappoint. A live DJ played a great mix of Caribbean music, Afrobeats, and R&B. The dim lighting created an intimate atmosphere, while the music added a fun, lively vibe. It’s definitely a great spot for date night or an evening out with friends. Highly recommend and I’ll definitely be back!

author: Chika Brown
review_text: Not crowded at the time of our visit. Food was subpar. Fried pork chops were good… lemon pepper wings were way too salty, loaded fries were mediocre, corn muffins and candy yams were good. .*Updated review… revisited with a friend and the hospitality provided by the owners was top notch! Thank you for the friendly convo and welcome you provided.

author: Usha Devi
review_text: Had an incredible dining experience! The food was absolutely amazing – every dish was packed with flavor and beautifully presented. The view added an extra charm to the meal, making it even more memorable. But what truly stood out was the service – attentive, warm, and beyond excellent. Not to forget they are pet-friendly too!! Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for great food with a view and top-notch hospitality! 🌟

author: Jordan Lloyd Si
review_text: When I first stepped onto this place I was greeted by waiters who efficiently brought us to our seats. I was quite amazed by the atmosphere, mixing a contemporary with industrial style making the place a vibe. Upon ordering our food, the food came out pretty quickly and after taking a bite of the food I was blown away by the quality and freshness of the dishes. A waiter even offered to make my drink for me so that I did not have to have the hassle of making it myself. Overall, the immaculate service, atmosphere and dish quality makes me understand the hype of this place and I recommend visiting this place when you visit Danang. 🔥🔥

author: Cristian Patru
review_text: Great food and drinks, stopped by spontaneously after visiting the Independence Palace, as it's in walking distance and was totally worth it. Big portions, we had some fried pork as a starter and as main a Cha Ca La Vong (fried snakehead fish fillets) and a Banh Mi. I have to admit, it was too much, we couldn't finish. Food tastes amazing and the Pineapple juice was great. Highly recommend this place!

author: aimiaiko roselinne
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 10/10 Experience at LandShark Bar & Grill! From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere was exactly what you’d want for a perfect getaway meal — fun, beachy, and full of good vibes. The view by the water was absolutely beautiful, especially at sunset. The staff was super friendly and attentive, making sure everything came out just right. Our food was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked — from the juicy burgers to the seafood dishes, everything tasted amazing. The drinks were also on point — refreshing, strong, and well-presented. You can tell this place was designed for people to relax and enjoy themselves. Whether you’re stopping by for lunch, dinner, or just cocktails by the water, it’s the perfect spot to unwind. I’d definitely recommend LandShark to anyone looking for great food, great views, and great service. Can’t wait to come back again soon! 🌴🍹

author: Karmen
review_text: Have been here many times. Every time I’m in Ipoh. It’s a spacious, clean and efficient place. I would recommend this place for dim sum for tourists. The quality of the food is above average and service is efficient. Range is pretty good for food but very limited for drinks.

author: Jhung Lim
review_text: When I think about mookata, I always think of Khao Khun Mookata! They have so many dishes to choose from, including ready-to-eat items which is a big plus. The variety is amazing, fresh meats, seafood and side dishes, all at a good price. Staff are ready to refill the soup either u choose for Tomyam or the normal one. Drinks and ice cream are all free!

author: Dan Barker
review_text: horrible portions for the price I was paying I would have at expected then to be at least full. The tiniest little bowl with 3 pieces of tuna. Looked like they just threw it in there as quickly as possible: What a rip off!! 15 bucks a bowl for this??!! Never ordering from them again and I’m pissed I didn’t look at the reviews before I ordered.

author: Neko Chan
review_text: Very colorful and tasty breakfast. Good presentation of food. There are both air conditioning indoor seats and outdoor garden seats. Crowded with tourists. I recommend the Ryan French toast. A must try item.

author: adam haber
review_text: This is a must do when travelling to Bali. The food is some of the best I've ever had! The cocktails 🍸 were superb. At night this place transforms in to a night club and definitely doesn't disappoint. The interior is visually stunning.

author: Dawn Tan
review_text: It's a food centre, so no, no impeccable service but definitely friendly. Atmosphere here in the morning is great thou. Very friendly neighbourhood. Lotsa great food to choose from. Fried fritters, desserts, noodles/rice/porridge, chwee kuey, char kuey (only $2.50! And is on the 2025 makansutra guide), drinks...

author: Kelvin Teo
review_text: Great food located within Redhill hawker centre…… limited space for parking but worth going there every time for the greatness of food variety

author: Paul-Elie Nauleau
review_text: Pretty darn good I must say! Lobster truffle risotto was excellent, although a small tail. House burger was good, slightly smashed Petite Wellington with whipped truffle butter was the best part The eggs Benedict were very mid…

author: Magdalene Ong
review_text: Chose this place because of the high reviews but was very disappointed. Got a beef and pork set but the meat was so bland and tasteless. Had to cook ourselves which I did not expect given the prices, as more upmarket kbbqs usually cook for you. Kimchi soup was like diluted kimchi water with shreds of pork. Overall it was $130++ which is reasonable for the amount of meat but not worth it for the taste and a very expensive unenjoyable meal overall.

author: Luz Rodríguez
review_text: I had an amazing experience at Liu. The food was absolutely delicious, every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented. But what truly made the visit unforgettable was our server. She went above and beyond to make us feel welcome, offering attentive, friendly, and personalized service that turned a great meal into a unique and memorable experience. Highly recommended!

author: Linda Chevalier
review_text: If you are into suckling pig, this is the place to eat it. A stand out meal for a good price.

author: Mischa Ngan
review_text: 4.5 Casual setting, yet great food. Amazing crab ball wrap, fried egg, and very good padthai.

author: max rampage
review_text: Came here for the RM32 set lunch (main + 2 sides + drink). It's available every day including weekends and public holidays! We basically ordered everything off the menu and It's so worth it. The hae bee hiam carbonara is a unique one and we loved it, as well as the cream spinach.

author: Sheraz Choudhary
review_text: Upon entering the restaurant I could barely breathe and a few others patrons were also having a hard time. There was something in the air that irritated the throat. I put on an N95 but did not leave. The meal I ordered was $16 so not cheap but the ingredient quality was extremely poor! My stomach was upset for a few hours after consuming the food. The chicken disgusting and full of fat. From other recent reviews it seems like this restaurant has gone downhill recently (definitely not deserving a 4.6 in its current state). I rarely write negative reviews but GRECO has to improve its quality because for $16 there are much better places to eat at.

author: Jasmine
review_text: I had the pleasure of trying banh mi chao for the first time, and it was absolutely divine! Even now that I'm back in my home country, I still find myself craving it. What made the experience even more special was the exceptional service from the gentleman serving us. He was kind, attentive, and ensured that we were enjoying our meal to the fullest. I'm looking forward to returning to Ho Chi Minh City and visiting this place again. Highly recommended!

author: Dana Rodriguez
review_text: I’ve been a customer for about 4 years, and I feel I need to be honest with my review. Since I come here often, I’ve noticed the changes, and honestly, I preferred the atmosphere when the previous manager was in charge. She was young, but her charisma, work ethic, and the way she supported her team were what I admired most about this place: everything was always organized and up to date. In my recent visits, I bought some empanadas that were so unpleasant they couldn’t be eaten — they seemed like they had been sitting there for hours. The same thing happened with the croquettes. Other times, there’s no bread or other basic items, showing a lack of consistency in this bakery. I’ve also had to wait over 30 minutes in line because there was only one person working. When I asked who the manager was, I was told she was at the gas station on the phone. I’m the kind of person who really values a team’s effort because it says a lot about the business, and it’s truly a shame that everything has changed. Nowadays, I feel like I waste my money here because the products are not fresh, and on top of that, I have to wait too long to be served. Really disappointing, especially since a year ago my experience was completely different.

author: MP Fashion
review_text: Disappointing experience We came here for my birthday dinner, and while our server was kind and professional, the experience was disappointing. My seafood dish arrived with something in it, so I couldn’t eat it. The management only removed the dish from the bill, which felt like the bare minimum. For a birthday dinner, I expected better care and responsibility from the restaurant.

author: Cindy Francis
review_text: My husband and I celebrated our anniversary at Peter Luger Steak House in Williamsburg, and it was incredible! The rustic old-time charm adds such a warm touch. Eric, our server, was amazing, attentive, kind, and even surprised us with an anniversary treat. We had the Steak for Two with baked potato and fries, perfect portions and absolutely delicious. Finished with the chocolate mousse cake and homemade whipped cream, which was the perfect ending. A true New York classic worth every bite! 10/10 recommend and can’t wait to return!

author: Sam Shee
review_text: Long wait in a large warehouse of a coffee shop with the most amazing yam rice! Pretty affordable with plenty of large round tables and plastic seats, with relatively quick service for a full house. Staff are curt and the place is warm, but it's a eat-and-go type place so don't expect to get too comfy.

author: Aisha Damian
review_text: The location is a bit inconspicuous. Honestly I had higher expectations for the atmosphere as we went for NYE but it was just ok. The music was okay and they had some videos playing on a projector. The food was good but nothing to rave about. I enjoyed the nigiri the most. The himachi jalapeño roll was a disappointment. Drinks were good and decently priced. I really liked the passionfruit drink on their specialty cocktails.

author: Helen Abera-Taggay
review_text: Goodness! I have given this place chance after chance and they disappoint. The portions here are a joke and you give four slivers of cucumber with a sprinkle of tuna. My goodness, at this point, just rob at in front of our eyes so we can see it coming at least. DO NOT ORDER FROM THIS LOCATION!

author: YH
review_text: A nice place to have soup noodle. The shop also famous with their pumpkin milk drink too. Overall, the place is comfortable and suitable to bring your baby here

author: N M
review_text: My family and I had dinner at Brassica last Sat. Would highly highly recommend this place for several reasons. (a) Eclectic, global menu (b) every dish, be it the rigatoni with chanterelle or the clams in a spicy sauce, the dishes were made to perfection and highly palate pleasing (c) warm and friendly service staff and finally (d) reasonably priced and no service charge. All charges and taxes are built into the prices on the menu. I so wish other restaurants would follow this practice.

author: donny ho boon tiong
review_text: On 01Nov25, Saturday, I brought my family and my daughter mother/grandmother in law to our 1st outing to Penang. Also our 1st time at Hameediyah Restaurant. The food was great especially rendang beef, fried bitter gourd, captain chicken and malay rojah. The serving staffs were friendly and attentive. We have a enjoyable time there.

author: Vernice Pai
review_text: Celebrated my birthday here and it was the best decision ever. We heard from friends that this is the best cafe in canggu and must try. We were so excited we came at lunch, and we got to enjoy the sunlight and big blue sky in the fancy decor. The place is stunning and the food was amazing. Two of us, but we ordered 5 dishes + 1 dessert on the house!!!!!! It was so good we wanted to try everything. Thank you again to Vera And Ketut who made special arrangements to celebrate this big day for me ❤️ I really felt the hospitality. They were really professional and well spoken in English too. Would love to visit again :)

author: Rahim Barnes
review_text: Great service! Went over and beyond to provide a pleasurable experience!!! It was my birthday and this happened without them even being aware!!! I feel so special and this stop has just been another memorable stop on a wonderful Miami Birthday trip!!!

author: Giovanni
review_text: Fantastic experience, the staff is so incredibly helpful and smiling, always present and never invasive. The lamb hotpot is to die for, not so spicy, just perfect balance. The meat is tender and flavorful, the quantity is big. Also the pork and the beef slices were nice, together with the vegetables. We also tasted lamb skewers (with cumin), chicken wings filled with shrimps (but we could not feel the shrimps), and the lamb pancake, amazingly crispy even if the lamb patty was too firm, probably not much fatty, and definitely the broth is the king of dinner, don't miss it.

author: Rendra Budi Hutama
review_text: Recommended to celebrate special moment of your family or colleagues here. One of upper end Indonesian restaurant. The food was tasty, the service was really good. Can't complain.

author: Justin Stein
review_text: Situated on the borders of Coconut Grove, this was one of our favorite places when we lived in Miami. Coming back, we remembered why we loved it, and enjoyed it again. The eggs scrambled were excellent, with mine coming with a generous helping of onions and nova. The potatoes were excellent, and our server’s attentiveness was perfect. Can’t wait to come back.

author: Aminul Rouf
review_text: Overall 8/10 Food is a 7/10 As a halal joint of course i give this a 10/10. But to just give it a 10/10 because it’s halal and not be completely honest is so biased and not fair. I had the diva egg wrap (egg white, grilled chicken, lettuce and tomato), chicken tender wrap with fries, home fries with grilled onions and peppers, and i forgot the name of the last one (drenched?) gravy turkey chops which was the recommendation of the waitress. With a side of coleslaw corn bread (corn muffin lol) and mac and cheese. Diva wrap was 8.5/10 Fries 7/10 (a little too salty) Tender wrap 8/10 Turkey 5/10 Corn bread (corn muffin) 5/10 Mac and cheese 7/10 Cole slaw 5.5/10 (too many large onion pieces) Service and our waitress was absolutely wonderful. So pleasant, friendly and caring. Would definitely say to come by and try their food. I would totally come by again

author: Robert Cruz
review_text: The food, service and atmosphere was everything we could have hoped for in experiencing Bali and Balinesian cuisine. Sun Sun Warung is a hidden gem. Unassuming from the exterior but the setting was a quiet haven. Our server, Lili, couldn’t be more helpful, made us feel welcomed and at home here. This is my wife’s and my favorite dinner spot in Ubud. Thank you, Lili, and Sun Sun Warung for making our first, and repeated, dining experience the best in Ubud!!!

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: Hamzah Alsagoff
review_text: Each year during Ramadan I make it a tradition to first bring the family and then my non-Muslim extended family of kakis to the festive bazaars. Bazaar...for Ramadan. Not a repurposed pasar malam. Where I grew up anticipating and looking forward to festive traditional offerings — especially soulfood that will break my resistance or restrain....for health reasons.....that I'll be damned over — and not the proliferation of supposedly creative fusion which often are the hipster young fascination with Western cuisines which they sadly not only butcher at times but rehash for localised taste. At times using cheaper pseudo ingredients and slathering with overly hot toppings to mask the mediocre passable copies. Anyway I hardly fancy those. What I want to lament is the glaring absence — if any it is scattered and few — of traditional Ramadan or Raya soulfood favourites that I don't see many talk or raise about. It can't just be me. If I am blunt I'll say what used to be a great festive family affair at a beautiful bazaar, where we visit to soak in the vibe and sample the offerings, has been robbed and hijacked by 'vendors' who can afford the high rent who in turn sell high and expensive. Terrible. Where we no longer or hardly see committed makciks or pakciks lovingly peddle what they offer just for Ramadan and for some to do so to sadaqah. What a sad state. The worst is this year's supposedly largest — not .....with plenty of empty spaces obviously untaken — Geylang Ramadan Bazaar. It is a pathetic disguised tourist-bait glorified pasar malam. If you want classic traditional food that won't cost an arm and leg then for Geylang area head over to the food centre above the market. No hipster gimmick in sight. Just good ole familiar mouth-baiting classic Malay or nusantara food. And festive drinks that are traditional and not charged at inflated cafe prices. One wonders if the ones who planned all these factor in consideration for heart and soul. For respect and love for our culture. Yes, I'm naive and hopeful. Profit is sadly evident in play.

author: Maria
review_text: Tiny spot known for his extensive wine list and ever-changing (short) menu. We started with the bread and clams which pairs perfectly together - thanks to the suggestion of our waitress. Next we had the green tomatoes dish which was our favorite by far as it was packed with so much flavor and seasoned to perfection. We finished with the Golden Rice topped with Uni which was delicious as well. Highly recommend this Michelin star spot for a date night! *Resys are a must unless you get there right at 5pm and get a bar or window seat

author: Daniel Ling
review_text: Food was great! Price was very reasonable. Steamed fish for $10 and sotong for $12. Will come again for more.

author: Blaker Giron
review_text: I'll start off by saying this is a local sports bar. It leans towards the divey side in the best way possible. The best thing about this bar is the surprisingly well cooked food. They have a great selection that is reasonably priced. You can't go wrong with any other burgers and if you want a steak dinner the prime rib is amazing. I thoroughly enjoyed the chili bowl with beans. Whether you go to watch a game or play billiards with some friends, you won't break the bank with the pricing of the drinks. During the week they have different events, such as scavenger hunts, bingo and karaoke, to name a few. This is a great place to have a relaxing evening with friends. I will definitely be back.

author: Raymund Gerard
review_text: This was recommended to us by a local. The food was very good and there was so much of it! It's not cheap but you also get a lot of food. We went in the evening and the line was much shorter than during the day. The staff were friendly and quite helpful as this was our first time experiencing Nasi Kandar. For people going there for the first time, you select what you want and pay in one shop, and then they bring the food to you in the dining area a few doors down.

author: sweethartzoya
review_text: Had a great meal at The Cheesecake Factory. The avocado egg rolls were a standout, crispy on the outside, creamy inside, and the tamarind chutney that comes with them takes it to another level, so flavorful. The brown bread with butter is always a favourite, soft and paired perfectly with the salty butter, the perfect start before the mains. Ordered pasta and, true to Cheesecake Factory style, the portion was huge and very tasty. Overall, a really satisfying experience and definitely recommend.

author: A Viz
review_text: The food is out of this world. The service is amazing. The atmosphere is way beyond what we expected. Can't believe that we have not visited this place before. Will definitely come here again. You can't go wrong with anything on the menu. Camila was our waitress and she was AMAZING.

author: Yerslan Aimakov
review_text: Very nice fast food joint with affordable prices and decent portions. Taste is ok, burgers taste kinda like Burger King, fries are extremely salty though. 1/2 pound cheeseburger combo was $14.52 which is pretty good in today’s economy. Free parking is available.

author: Cole Young
review_text: Every time I swing through Vegas I make it a goal to stop here for an espresso and a pour over. This is easily the best coffee I’ve found in the state of Nevada. If you’ve not stopped here for a pour over, you’re missing out!

author: Jennifer Lee
review_text: Finally getting around to writing this, but The Four Horsemen really lived up to the hype. The place is super cozy and welcoming. Our server was awesome and gave us great wine recs that perfectly complemented the food. Everything we ate was seriously delicious—you can tell they put a lot of thought into every dish.

author: Kary Sartan
review_text: Oh my God, what can I say about this place??? too many things.. from the Agua Chile to the tacos to the lamb shank to the mole I am speechless. ALSO THOSE DAMN PANCAKES ::: JEEEEEEEEZ. Food heaven! This place has an epic menu with epic flavors. It’s a great space. I love it for our neighborhood.

author: Derek Liu
review_text: The restaurant is extremely dirty and the food is not well prepared. My chicken tenders were far too salty, I could not finish them. Additionally, the employees here are off-putting and rude.

author: Thanachit M
review_text: They provide excellent offerings during their happy hour, including cocktails and oysters. The staff members were courteous and friendly. The view from the establishment is truly remarkable. It is a suitable location for romantic dates, group gatherings, or even solo dining experiences.

author: AnunA Gankhuu
review_text: Incredibly top-of-the-food-chain grade wings from Banh Mi Cafe. Lemon pepper and Thai Chilli flavored ones were Chef’s kiss. Truly a blissful experience. The Garlic Soy Sauce Spring Rolls were not deep fried, more Summer Roll. That one was a sad emoji face. But the Wings overpowered the disappointment of the spring rolls.

author: Алиса Шульц
review_text: I finally got to eat on this island!! The food was fresh and delicious, the drinks were made with real fruit. I recommend the octopus dish!! 🙏

author: Emiliano Guerra Juarez
review_text: The food and customer service was excellent and exceptional and delightful. The shift leader Kyle was really amazing at his job I had a question about the food and he gave me the most amazing feedback and honest recommendation about his favorite burger the western bacon cheeseburger such an amazing experience here today. I love kyle great food and great service.

author: Mack Jackson
review_text: It was extremely busy and the employees focused more on putting the homeless out rather than take my order.When I did order a received my burger was basically thrown together with poor quality.I was on my lunch break and very disappointed with the quality of my burger only things that were good were my overload cake and the curly fries

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: The_leader
review_text: It's delicious~ The price is low. The portions are generous!

author: Amirah Randolph
review_text: I absolutely loved dining here. The cuisine was delectable. The staff were lovely, especially Suzan. The live music tied everything together. This was the perfect birthday experience. I would definitely recommend everyone come and visit.

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: Joel Chan
review_text: Fragrant thunderbolt tea / soup which didn't taste too green-fy. The vegetables were fresh and crunchy. Overall, I really loved the meal and will definitely be back again. $5 for the brown rice thunderbolt tea set and add-on fried pork for $2

author: Banuaji P
review_text: Nice place to hangout and enjoy some dim sum. The dimsum is good and they have many choice of them. Its not cheap but you can tell with the building. Its big.

author: Ty Anderson
review_text: I heavily debated between 3 star and 4 star. Ended up downgrading to 3 star because of a "surcharge" on the bill. I'm visiting Cali and was shocked to see this is a hot debate topic. Freakin' put it in the price of the food. A little hard to find parking outside. A decent atmosphere on the water. The service was slow - maybe because there was a large party downstairs? Food was hit and miss. We got sourdough bread. Crust was a little hard but the guts of the bread was very good. New England claim chowder was OK (you are not in New England). Oysters pretty good. Fish/chips was good. Drinks not bad. We shared the fish and chips (1 dinner plate), had 3 mixed drinks, the oysters (6), chowder, and bread -> total bill including the surcharge and tip came to $149 even.

author: Melanie Ponichtera
review_text: We had the best experience at this Legal Seafood location than any other we’ve visited before! The entire wait staff was kind, accommodating and incredibly fast. Our server was lovely and gave great recommendations. She was calm and patient with our questions and requests even though she had many tables and patrons. The food was outstanding and the portions were fantastic. We started with the shrimp cocktail and it was so tasty for our first bite. Served with fresh lemon and a superb cocktail sauce, the colossal shrimp were cooked perfectly and were quite tender. Definitely a favorite for everyone! I didn’t get to take a photo, we got to them pretty fast! Our kiddo had freshly sliced watermelon and a grilled cheeseburger and steak cut French fries. I had the Thai Peanut Salad with grilled chicken and it was such a delight. A generous portion, perfectly seasoned and grilled chicken and the flavor was everything I wanted it to be and more! My husband had the baked stuffed lobster and it was better than he had hoped it would be. Plenty of food in the smaller portion which is about a 1.5 lb lobster, filled with bay scallops, shrimp crumbs and buttery goodness!! We will absolutely be coming back the next time we are in Boston. Thank you to the staff of Legal Seafood for the lovely experience this afternoon.

author: Ruben Castaneda
review_text: Excellent service, host made our birthday girl feel great with all the attention n surprise dessert.

author: Goh Siauleng
review_text: The staff said this is “cooked” 🥱 Who dare to eat 😥 Blk 742 , very bad service..

author: Grigorii Rybakov
review_text: Yo, this spot is straight-up FIRE 🔥 Hands down the best hookah/tea lounge in the whole MIA area! Chill vibes, clouds on clouds, flavors hittin’ different every time. The teas? Insane selection, bro. But real talk — shoutout to Olga, our server, she’s an absolute QUEEN 👑 Super friendly, on point with everything, knows the menu like the back of her hand, and legit the prettiest smile in South Florida, no cap. Made the whole night 10x better. If you’re in the area, pull up ASAP. You won’t leave disappointed, fam. 5 stars easy ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Already planning the next sesh!

author: Bavdun Umar
review_text: I love this place! That’s so hard to find good Halal food in United States and I am so happy that in 5 min from me I have this beautiful place. The fries are so starry and crispy ! Chicken delicious 🤤 thank you so much for good service and asking How Is my day today! I live Muslim Culture and Ethics that’s how people on Earth should treat each other! Mash Allah Halal Tamaq yehmen dégenler razi bolidu. I made a Combo for $ 13 and get so good substantial food. They work late. Deliver is also available.

author: Ly Chou
review_text: definitely recommend this place, if you want to try Vietnamese food, they have a variety of foods n their staff are so nice, some can even speak a little bit of Khmer. The atmosphere is so cozy, not crowded too, WOULD COME HERE AGAINN⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: Candice Springer
review_text: Brassica has one of the best brunches in town. The cocktails are wonderful and the food is top-notch. I love their commitment to changing up the flavors just enough to keep you wanting more, but also keeping their tried and true gems on the menu (shout out to the chicken and waffles)! And, I always look forward to taking home one of their homeade doughnuts for later. They never miss!

author: Nicole A
review_text: Made by people that clearly have never tasted real potato corner bc what is up with the seasoning?? Yall just dump a whole bag in there or something? The ingredients are all there you just have to make it right. Also prices are outrageous patatas lang naman toh pero lahat di marunong.

author: J Hill
review_text: 5/5 no question. The moment you walk in, you can tell the staff works hard—just spending a minute in the lobby shows how much hustle goes into this place. I was greeted right away, and my food came out surprisingly fast. The coffee selection was solid, the prices were fair, and the food looked just as good as it tasted. Overall, a great experience from start to finish and they even matched my partners sweater with the latte!

author: Jason Masong
review_text: Missed the views of Jakarta's skyline when they renovated early in 2025, so was thrilled to see what was done to the space when reopened! One word to describe it all: cozy!!! The new space seems to provide something for everyone, not only those who seek the Skyline View whilst bobbing their head to some beats. For wine afficionados, there is the new Wine Cellar wirh an expansive range of Bubbles For foodies and families, one of the many indoor dining spaces, one of which is blessed by the backdrop of a open faced kitchen For cocktail cats, revel in the new open bar inside the restaurant or revamped semi outdoor lounge area to soak in the sunset with a martini in hand etc... Skye has also significantly stepped up its food offerings with a well curated menu anchored around contemporary, western-leaning grilled fare. Favorites are: - Tomato salad with garlic panacotta - Any cut of steak and a side of trippled cooked fries - Brown Butter fish: this is seasonal so ask what the catch of the day is The new Cocktail menu is fun and flavor forward with different cocktails for the indoor restaurant and lounge areas, to ensure that there is always something new to try!

author: Janet
review_text: Delicious. mozzarella sticks taste so cheesy and good. Loved the lemon pepper chicken, it was juicy and loved every bite. The staff is friendly and the place is super clean. Definitely coming back and will try the roasted turkey with cornbread stuffing. Oh! 😍❤ Oh the chicken country fried sandwich is absolutely amazing! 🤤 Today had the country breakfast. Yum Another update went for breakfast with Fam and once again delicious 😋 Back again. Got the grilled chicken sandwich with fries and coleslaw. So good. Tried the meatball sub and it was so delicious. Fam order liver and onion and steak sub. Great food and service! Omelette 🥚🙌🫶🤍🔥🔥

author: Luis Diaz
review_text: Good dining experience in Newark. Sangria was flavorful, the salad bar was fresh and the meats were all delicious. The service was good as well. Parking was not easy and I had to find a spot on the street.

author: LaTrice Davis
review_text: Listen!! I watch alllll of his tv competition shows so I had very high standards and when I say they did NOT disappoint!! My GOD!!! The food melting in your mouth is no exaggeration!! I had the lobster risotto, bone-in ribeye, and roasted brussel sprouts. My wife has the pan seared scallops and the beef short rib. And off the drink menu we both had the Notes from Gordon. 10 out of 10!! We also had an awesome table right at the front of the kitchen.

author: Thallyta Cracco
review_text: Don’t be scared by the look of the restaurant, THE FOOD IS EXCEPTIONAL! I am a chef and the food is really delicious. No doubt, it was one of the best fried fish I had in a restaurant. While I was there, 2 couples came following maps, but when they saw the place, they turned away and left. It’s really a pity for them and for the ladies who cook. My advice is here, leave your preconceptions outside, and try it. It’s cheap btw. Just take a seat and go, you won’t regret, they know what they are doing.

author: Michael Ooi
review_text: Decent sized food court with quite a variety of food. What I liked about this food court is that it has some less common food - i.e. not limited to the regular stuff like Koay Teow soup, Wantan mee, Curry mee... Instead, you get stuff like Japanese rice set, gourmet fried rice, Thai food, Sarawak kolo mee, special dumplings, cuisines from China, et al. I've tried the Mala noodles, which was ok. Chongqing dried noodle wasn't bad either. The Tai Lok Mee was good. Mutton satay was awesome. Everything was reasonably priced.

author: Mohanasundaram Sinniah
review_text: Food portion is small (raw foods are expensive) fried chicken piece is too small, and doesn't feel worth it. Asked for mee goreng mamak, but came mee goreng basah. Teh tarik too much milk. We used to go a few times, but this time around nothing great.

author: Staci Crouch
review_text: The best Persian food in Vegas! The food is so good and the owner is the sweetest. It's worth going off the strip for. Just a 15 min cab and you'll get one of the best meals! My favorite is the Barg with rice. So tasty!

author: Kenny Yau
review_text: Great food and atmosphere. We ordered four dishes and none disappointed. Everything arrived promptly, packed with smoky wok hei, and tasted fantastic. Highlights included the pork and basil omelette, shrimp noodles, stir-fried chicken with rice, and the crispy pork neck. The only downside was that they were out of crab and salmon that day. Otherwise, I’d absolutely return - especially to try the crab omelette, since the eggs were incredibly creamy.

author: Scumdog 1980
review_text: Food was really good. Taco Nachos were amazing. Fish and chips were a win for me and im not a seafood person. The chicken sandwich with Chipotle pineapple aioli was also amazing. The dragonfruit spritzer was great, the strawberry one not as good. Our waitress Shanda did an amazing job taking care of us. Never once felt rushed and over burdened.

author: Tang Zhao Zhen
review_text: Restaurant serving local Thai Dishes. Food taste suite my taste Order both or their Thai Sausage. 1)Darker one is more chewy. Taste like otak otak, but less sweet, more spicy 2)Red one mixed with sticky rice. It is softer and taste more on sour(fermentationside with a little sweet.

author: alex cheong
review_text: 4 big stars for nasi kandar rafei ali because i would say one of the best nasi kandar in tanjung tokong. Roti canai and maggie goreng also damn good. Only downside is the air ventilation and fumes in the restaurant.

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Thalia Gonzalez
review_text: 5 stars all around!! I had my first Bun Cha and my lovely service Mari helped me in showing me how to eat it. A bit on the expensive side for Vietnam, however, the food and service make up for it! Another thing to note, you’re able to pay with a credit card without an additional fee. Great place overall!

author: Aamer Mahmood
review_text: Boston Shawarma is an option for Halal food. We were a family of three and got the shawarma dinners which were about $18 each with free water. Portions were generous. Fries were cold. Salad was ok and the meat seemed hard. Seating was limited.

author: Ronald Marshall
review_text: Pass word on 💯// Antonio Sherman.... Calvin Payton Walter Payton brother and Dawayne Wade and Derrick Rose 🌹 Ronald Marshalls.... // Athletic coaches inspired us....// Artist 🎨 3chevys on carlot s and streets we all designed networking all 50states and all community s.... the new chevy impala double pipes and new Camaro z71 double pipes and new heavy chevy ss double pipes....// Bitcoin investment s platform extra income for economy crisis pass word on 💯 because government ain't gonna give u shit....

author: YEK YEE LING
review_text: Halal food available here. There’s a wide variety of seafood to choose from. I really like the seafood hotpot and salted egg sotong. I accidentally came across a free crab promotion for spending RM250 — I chose the chili crab and it was really delicious! Don’t forget about the unlimited ice cream and snacks. I’ll definitely come back again. It’s also an easy place to get to after shopping in KL city, just a short walk away.

author: David Borel
review_text: Frozen dumplings and dried noodles prepared well, but served without the right sauces. The banh mi and iced coffee was very good, though. There were a lot of different stereotypes in the decor, but it was a pleasant space overall. Most concerningly, we heard productive coughing and unmasked sniffling coming from the kitchen.

author: Kathryn Johnson
review_text: Great food, service and view! Only complaint was the nearby smokers. The fish tacos were awesome! Park in lot 72 and get your parking validated by the restaurant.

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: Patrick Lee
review_text: 17Jan 2024 - This is a large food centre with many stalls. You'll find 2 to 3 stalls offering the same food, giving you more options to choose from. To sample as many food stalls as possible, it's recommended to go early, preferably between 10 am and 2 pm, as some stalls close after 2 pm. There's also a spacious area for cyclists to park their bikes, making it a good gathering place for cycling enthusiasts. Keep in mind that competition among stalls brings out the best, making it a rewarding experience for food and cycling enthusiasts alike.

author: Krissy M
review_text: Great spot, wish I knew about it sooner! The food was delicious and reasonably priced. Atmosphere can’t be beat on a nice day.

author: Michael Keller
review_text: Best service in the history of food service! Food tasted like it was crafted in high heaven, and our waiter said his name was "Bryce" but we shall forever refer to him as, "JOHN WAITER" If you're ever in Boston, it should be an obligation to place this on your to-do list

author: ice bear
review_text: A fried rice shop specializing in fried rice. I walked past and smelled the aroma. I saw a few customers, so I decided to give it a try. The crab fried rice was perfectly cooked, with the rice grains separated and fragrant. The shrimp sukiyaki was fresh and crispy, and the squid was bouncy. It was tasty, but a bit too sweet. Overall, it was a good experience. It's cute, and there's a sink for customers to wash their hands. The food is reasonably priced, and the service is relatively quick.

author: Choco Zee
review_text: Love the vibes of Acacia. The banana chocolate is so delicious and great coffee. The service is tiptop!

author: Seeker Star
review_text: The dim sum taste compared to Malaysia, I still prefer Malaysia. There is no juicy and normal taste. The space is big and will be available for you. The foods to steam but consider fast service.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Thanh Ngan Nguyen Tran
review_text: I had a wonderful experience at this place with my friend! Every dish was fresh, flavorful and beautifully presented. The staff were so kind and welcoming, which made the whole atmosphere even more enjoyable. Highly recommend!!!

author: Noa
review_text: A Miami staple! I love this place cause it’s so unpretentious, unlike most places in Miami, the food is always so good here. They are consistent with their delicious food and with great customer service. The atmosphere is also really nice; lively, but not loud enough that you cannot hear each other (great place to catch up with friends or go on a date) I also love that they have a fabulous extensive selection of wines. I always get the octopus here cause they cook it perfectly. Must try!

author: Christian Madonna
review_text: The place was absolutely charming and inviting — clean, cozy, and beautifully decorated. I especially loved the huge flower display; it added such a lovely touch to the atmosphere. The food was excellent — well presented and delicious. I had the smoked salmon and eggs, which were perfectly cooked and beautifully plated. Service was efficient, and I didn’t have to wait long for my meal. The coffee was spot-on, and the Prosecco was perfectly chilled — a great combination for a relaxing brunch. The service really stood out. The staff were warm, friendly, and attentive, happily accommodating my request to change seats. Every meal was served with a smile, and the team made a genuine effort to engage with us each time they passed by. A special shout-out to Nicolas, who went above and beyond to check on us throughout our visit — his hospitality made the experience even more enjoyable. Overall, a delightful spot with great food, lovely ambiance, and outstanding service. Highly recommended!

author: ashley munn
review_text: Tastebudz never disappoints! The food is slapping every single time — full of flavor, fresh, and worth every dollar. The atmosphere is super chill, perfect for eating in or grabbing food on the go. And honestly, every cashier I’ve come in contact with has been so nice and friendly. Great vibes, great service, great food. Definitely one of my favorite spots!

author: V P
review_text: I love coming here karaoke nights on Saturday, the Dj is good, drinks are good. Got Jell-O shots and drinks, yummy bar food. Cheaper than most places and a good time

author: El
review_text: It has been awhile since I was at RL again. This time I took my son and surprising they offer “ Shrimp” choices for Kids meal. Overall Food was great and most part was our waitress Ms Paola had enhanced our dining experience to escalates to its maximum. We had an enjoyable dining experience by her attentiveness and enthusiasm service. She is among the BEST in service industry we experienced. One of our most comfortable meal here and look forward to going back again. Thank you

author: Andrew Minarik
review_text: This is a Wonderful coffee shop. Great minimalist clean asthetic, Great drinks, good WiFi. A great place to relax and escape the craziness.

author: Eugene Zheng
review_text: The best bowl of pho at D1 in my opinion. Known more to the locals than to tourists. Be warned that Menu is in native vietnamese language. This place is best enjoyed if you have a local friend to show you how to have the full experience with the sauce and vegetables usage. Would also recommend that you get the fried dough sticks to try too. Very interesting.

author: T F
review_text: I ordered an overpriced whole chicken for 27 dollars plus tax around 30 dollars for take out . This place is mad expensive.

author: 로리
review_text: Enjoy Southern Thai-style suki in a cool and comfortable indoor setting! The stir-fried suki features meat infused with smoky flavor, bringing out the crisp texture of the vegetables. The seafood suki was initially thought to be a sweet broth, but the chili sauce and chili powder were added, and it was addictive. Above all, you absolutely must order the authentic Thai omelet here. It's crispy, moist, and perfectly smoky, with a savory egg flavor. They prepare your order fresh to order in their open kitchen, and everything is delicious and refreshing. If you're in Hat Yai, be sure to stop by!

author: Fatima & Juan Carlos Benitez
review_text: What a gem of a find!! We had our eye on it for a while and today was the day to check it out and it sure did not disappoint! From the atmosphere, the delicious food, and the friendly staff, our experience was the best we’ve had in a while. We had never tried Venezuelan food and it’s so nice to find out we have one so close to home! Posted a few of the things we ordered. Give it shot, you won’t be disappointed! Shout out to Harold Guevara and his amazing team for taking care of us as if we were in their home ❤️ thank you, we’ll be back again!

author: Lift_Run_Eat_
review_text: The better of the two in area (Huynh being the other). The filling is what stands out here, I went for the bbq pork and it was excellent (nice bits of crackling in there and mixed cuts). I also had the pork balls one and that was also excellent. I’d happily try any of the others on the menu with confidence. The extras (bao & wrapped leave bao) were very average, far too much bun and not enough filling. Stick to the Banh Mi and you can’t go wrong!

author: Maria Sweeney
review_text: This place is an amazing find. We were in the area to see a show at NJPAC and we happened upon this incredible gem of a restaurant! As other reviewers have said, the service is fantastic, so attentive. The food was delicious and beautifully presented. We are definitely coming back here with family and friends!

author: Frank Palombi
review_text: HANDS DOWN best donuts around ! Folks are friendly and the place is clean. More importantly the donuts are AMAZING. Light and fluffy and some really cool items you don’t see anywhere else. Worth the trip from the strip ! 6/8/25

author: Apple Ong
review_text: Chance upon this restaurant when we were searching for dinner near our hotel. We got lucky and had air condition seats for family of 5. By 6:30pm on a Sunday, the shop was filled with local customers. Food was very yummy, with lotsa wok hey for stir fried option and less oily as shared by other patrons too. The shop staffs were very local, so we communicated through Google translate for customised dish and they charged us an affordable price overall including customised dish. As one of my sisters is a vegan, they attempted to customised the dish accordingly, but may not have plant based seasoning. So do proceed with caution if you have very strict vegan diet. No outside food and drinks were allowed, we ordered their drinks and the blue pea lemon drink is unique and refreshing. Will recommend to others who are around the area to try this restaurant. When we left about 7pm the customers were still coming in as showed in the video.

author: Ms Jackson
review_text: The bar sotsvon the beach.They had Karoke night, the DJ made it very fun. The food came ot pretty fast. The waitress service was good despite the bar being busy.

author: Andrew Yeoh
review_text: They have the usual selection of curries - chicken, beef and mutton. They have fried chicken and vegetables as well. The nasi kandar is actually quite delicious. Apart from the rice and curries, they also sell roti canai and mi goreng as well. The restaurant is reasonably clean. Parking may be a problem during peak hours.

author: Hung Vo
review_text: Not sure why this place got bad reviews but if you like eating grilled/bbq pork then this is a good choice. Also the price is very affordable

author: Derrick Liang
