review_text: what an insanely large portion and so much variety in food in one plate. solid flavors too, I wouldn’t say the meat was incredible but it wasn’t distractingly dry or anything. It’s solid. it’s like a time machine to when things were 5$, i think 20$ is worth it when you get a bit of everything and they aren’t trying to pinch pennies on the size of a falafel or meat like cava

author: Jia-Fu Yu (Rex)
review_text: It’s great for your first time to try the Pho in here, but if you did have experience with “PHO”. They are just ok. It just pretty normal, non gonna surprise you.

author: CC
review_text: Always such a great experience at CHUNN! The food is incredible — from perfectly grilled skewers to flavorful rice bowls topped with that rich egg yolk. Atmosphere is welcoming, and the service is consistently excellent. Definitely a spot I’ll keep coming back to

author: John Vaisa
review_text: I’ve been coming here since this AYCE first opened. Sadly, I have to say, with a heavy heart, that the restaurant has gone downhill in customer service. You’re given 90 minutes to eat, but when you wait over 45 minutes just for a server to come by and take your order, that time is wasted. On top of that, when the food finally arrived, it wasn’t even the correct order. This was during dinner on a Saturday, which made the experience even more disappointing.

author: J Seng
review_text: This hawker center offers an array of Singapore's local delights. From the comforting warmth of Claypot Rice to the vibrant variety of Zi Char dishes, each bite promises a burst of flavor. Savor the smoky char of Satays and BBQ Chicken Wings, or indulge in the rich, spicy Curry Rice. The Steamed Fish and Fish Soup are a testament to the freshness of local seafood, while Briyani and Thai Beef Noodle provide a hearty, aromatic experience. Not to be missed are the Pig Organs Soup and Char Kway Teow, each offering a unique taste of tradition. For those with a sweet tooth, the Traditional Desserts will surely satisfy. Every dish is a celebration of Singapore's culinary heritage.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Julie M
review_text: Lovely place. beautifully presented food and great choices for vegetarians. Loved the little donuts, they were soft and delicious

author: Hencredible
review_text: One of my favorite Thai food restaurants in the area. Compared to southern Thai-style restaurants, this place has more natural flavor instead of using strong spices. Curries are more liquid, and fresh meat (dark meat) is used instead of more chewy breast meat. Expect some wait even at 5 p.m. on a Sunday, but the taste is worth it.

author: Andrew Chan (www.roadtrippers.asia)
review_text: Nice comfortable aircond seating, spacious and clean .. food is good, but I wanted roasted duck, and they were out of it. Shrimp wanton is very nice. Portion is quite generous, and the price is fair. My meal was 155b. Their longan drink is nice too.

author: Shawn Chua
review_text: Bếp Mẹ In offers a warm and homely taste of authentic Vietnamese cuisine, with dishes that feel like they came straight from a family kitchen. The flavours are comforting, well-balanced, and not overly commercialized, exactly what you’d hope for from a place that prides itself on tradition. The menu has a good variety of favourites, from hearty soups to classic rice dishes, and everything is presented beautifully without losing its rustic charm. Portion sizes are generous, and the ingredients taste fresh. Service is friendly and welcoming, though the wait can be a little longer during peak hours. Prices are reasonable for the quality and atmosphere, making it a solid choice for anyone wanting a reliable Vietnamese meal in a cozy setting. As it is hidden at the back alley along rows of hair salons, you might missed it easily if you did not navigate via Google Maps. A satisfying and authentic dining experience, definitely worth returning for more.

author: {Michie-Bea}
review_text: One of my absolute favorite places to go nearly everyday! Highly recommend. Very pretty place with the best hot chocolate for blocks. Amazing orange juice and amazing eggs. Absolutely try the French toast as well!

author: Muhd
review_text: Too slow waited 30mins just for 1 packet takeaway. Please improve your manpower at this outlet. Still want take orders from walk in when others are still waiting for their food? Keep my $7 change.

author: Jimmy Si
review_text: Decent place. They tell you to order at the front if you're ready, but they also take your order at your table. The waiter was very nice and attentive. It was nice they they offered hot water long with regular water. I ordered the khao soi with the large chicken. My family ordered the green curry and pad Thai. I also ordered the papaya salad. The papaya salad was very refreshing and good and had that nice tangy flavor. The khao soi had a good broth and the noodles were very good and the chicken was very tender and huge. The green curry with chicken was decent. The pad Thai was ok. This place is also a bar/cocktail place and it has a decent selection to choose from. I had the pfriem Japanese lager that was very smooth. The place is very much like a late night bar eats which gives it a cool vibe.

author: john chan
review_text: Worth the price, food also not bad expecially the prawn and crab, very fresh Drink also quite tasty. For me, I will go second times. If the owner can improve a bit on the ventilation will be better. The environment quite hot there.

author: Sean Wang
review_text: This place has countless options for food so there will be something for everyone; from barbeque chicken wings, desserts such as egg tarts, western food (mostly Hainanese), Chinese food (fried rice, soup dumplings, etc.), to Muslim food varieties. The portion size can vary according to which store you order from, as there are multiple stores that sell similar food items, and some with slightly different recipes which can change the texture and the taste profile. As with all hawker centres, you will have to clear your tables and place the trays in the designated tray return area. It will definitely be noisy around the center area but there are seats where it's a little quieter in the edge spots if you want to have a quieter experience. Expect the place to be crowded during lunch and dinner so finding a table can be difficult during these peak periods. You may have to share a table with others, so be polite and ask if they can share their table if you cannot find one. Otherwise, you can take your time to look for a seat while you wait for your food or come by during less crowded periods after 8pm or before 6pm. I went to this place around 7-8pm but I still managed to find a seat. Most of the stalls will give you a buzzer when you order so you can keep track of when your food is ready.

author: Phat Nguyen
review_text: A very popular place for frog porridge, noticed this place is highly recommended on all the websites and with all the awards shown on the store front. We ordered frog porridge, which is ordered based on how any frogs you would like, and a clay of porridge. The spicy level can be adjusted. It was quite good, the frog was tender and the sauce was well flavoured. We also ordered fried oysters but the dish was just okay, nothing special. The stir fried veggies was the same as well, overall this was an okay meal, nothing too special.

author: Francis Ho
review_text: Came her for early dinner before the crowd. Surprisingly many stalls were closed for vacation or rest. Chanced upon this Malay food stall but run by a Chinese couple. The stall is called Alipapa briyani and Alimama. I ordered the recommended Green chilli chicken rice ($7.50). The chicken thigh was over deep fried till the skin is almost black. Luckily the meat was still ok. Overall it was a nice plate of chicken rice but the green chilli wasn't outstanding. Couldn't taste the spiciness of the chilli. 23.11.25

author: Travel Coffee Andy
review_text: This local Thai food restaurant, nestled just a stone’s throw away from Samyan Mitrtown, offers a delightful dining experience despite its modest amenities. While there’s no air conditioning, the shared bathroom within the complex, and limited seating, the food is simply fantastic. They boast a wide array of freshly prepared dishes featuring a delightful combination of crab meat, shrimp, pork, chicken, and an assortment of vegetables. The staff, though limited in their English proficiency, are incredibly helpful and attentive. However, it’s essential to note that they only accept cash or QR codes, so ensure you have sufficient cash for your visit.

author: Bob Job
review_text: Cafe Papillon has great food, but unfortunately the service really fell short. After paying, we asked for milk in one of the coffees and never received it. The Turkish coffee also wasn’t prepared properly. When we were seated, the table hadn’t been cleaned, there was still a bit of a mess on it and we had to call the server back to wipe it down. The space itself is very small and tightly packed, with chairs and tables extremely close together, which made it uncomfortable. On top of that, some of the staff came off with an attitude. I understand early mornings can be rough, but it still affects the experience. Overall, while the food was good, the poor service and lack of attention made it disappointing. Wouldn’t recommend.

author: Lanxin Shen (Ada)
review_text: Food is good and they got many interesting items. A lot of non-rice options :) And $30 for AYCE

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Samuel Godbout
review_text: The tacos at Taco Beach Shack were absolutely delicious, packed with bold flavors and fresh ingredients. The service was friendly and attentive, making us feel welcome from the moment we sat down. Despite how busy it was, the waiting time was impressively short, both for seating and for the food to arrive. Overall, it was a great spot for quality tacos and fast service.

author: Kelvie Malia
review_text: Ono Sushi was… semi-licious. Let’s just say the food was decent—not bad, but certainly not the highest quality or freshest grade sushi I’ve ever had. The flavors were okay, but nothing stood out as exceptional or memorable. If you’re looking for sushi that wows you, this might not be the place. What really tipped the experience downhill, though, was the bathroom situation. Imagine this: no toilet paper, no paper towels, and not even a sign of an attempt to fix it quickly. I flagged this issue to the servers, but nothing was done until another customer also complained after going to the bathroom. Mind you, the restaurant wasn’t even a third full, so they had more than enough time to address the issue promptly. It’s disappointing when basic things like cleanliness and customer care are overlooked, especially when the restaurant wasn’t busy. While the food was passable, the lack of attention to something as essential as stocking the restroom left a bad taste in my mouth.

author: Nickin Sitaram
review_text: Wow wow wow... What a street and atmosphere. It was fantastic to be there and absorb the great vibes. The famous satay street lived up to it's expectations, it was just lovely. It's really important to add how clean it was. Considering the number of people and satay sticks they must go through.. the place was again immaculately clean with no rubbish on the floor and the tables constantly clearer. The culture is to clean after yourself. One that should be adopted here back in England. The satay was fantastic. The stalls say it's all the same but there is a clear winner with massive queues for it. Definitely visit this. We had chicken, pork, lamb and prawns. Beautifully cooked and full of flavour. More importantly, no stomach issues experienced by any of the family. Win win.

author: Anna Hudack
review_text: European Sea-bass is die for! Ribeye and lobster special was excellent! Shrimp & garlic and chorizo is always done perfect! By the way we just here for Sangria! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: J J
review_text: Loved it ! Thank you ! Very much recommended and will continue to come appreciate the hospitality !!

author: 00Y
review_text: This spot serves arguably the best wanton noodles in town—springy noodles, tender duck, and crispy siew yuk (no greasy mess!). Their Thai tea is divine, and the mango sticky rice next door (Ken Phu Phang) is the perfect finale. Just two caveats: Parking is tricky, and service can be hit-or-miss.

author: Nadia Williams
review_text: Food was cooked very well, spices on point, good texture. My picky daughter loved it. Good Caribbean food. Options to eat in on glass plates is a plus

author: Karen K.
review_text: Amazing first experience at the yard. Came here with some coworkers for lunch and was pleasantly surprised by this hidden gem. Staff were super friendly and helpful when placing our orders. Also, they would always come check on us and made sure our drinks were always filled. Superb service! I ordered the seoul sista fried rice. Beautifully plated with a flower in the bowl. The fried rice was made with kimchi that wasn't overly spicy and a large fried egg on top. The Yaya sauce was creamy and paired well with everything. Overall, loved the dish! My coworkers ordered the oxtail sandwich, the walla chicken and the chopped thigh wrap. Everyone loved their dishes and want to come back to try the other dishes. Lastly, we ordered the grilled coconut cake. This is definately a MUST try! First time having a grilled cake and I can say I've been missing out!

author: Ivan Ang
review_text: We waited 2 months to get a reservation at this legendary Italian spot in the middle of Jamaica Plain. It wasn't worth the 2 month wait. I must add that our server was FANTASTIC. She was kind, attentive and immensely knowledgeable about the wines and menu. We just needed the food to be ½ as brilliant as she was. The bread sticks (Pizza Bianca) were good and the cheesy dip was worth the wait. The pizzas and pastas however, were painfully mid at best. We ordered the Cacio e Pepe, which is a Secret item available only upon request. When it came, the sauce was breaking apart and the dish was a little dull and lack a cheesy punch. We loved the Cheesecake but the Pina Colada and Tiramisu was boring. I feel the 2 month wait probably worked against the restaurant — after such a long wait, I think we expected way too much and it certainly did not meet expectations.

author: IBETH Molina
review_text: Loved it food was delicious, they where fast with are food and very polite 🙂I will definitely come back when I come back to Las Vegas

author: Joy James
review_text: Taco John’s just opened this past Thursday in Downtown Crossing, and I’m really impressed. Opening a taco spot right across from Taco Bell is a bold move, but they absolutely deliver. The food is incredibly fresh, hot, and full of flavor. Everything I tried was delicious, and it came out really quickly. The staff was kind and helpful, and the bathrooms were very clean — always a good sign. I’ll definitely be back. It’s a great new addition to the area, and totally worth checking out.

author: Jonathan Khoo
review_text: Soy Sauce Octopus was yummy! Excellent side dish. Fried Spring Roll was good as well (No pics, sorry). Deep fried Chicken Wing was pretty normal. Yu Kong Hor is great! But the most unique was the 滑蛋鱼面. Noodles made from fishball material, looks like Udon, but so springy and coated with savoury sauce. Go early to avoid the queue. Food is served relatively fast. One of the more special Ipoh eateries we stopped by.

author: Claudia Sanchez
review_text: Wha Da Pho?? Super delicious steak sandwich! Tender and juicy meat, soft bread, and sweet dressing! I really enjoyed it, great service, clean, and nothing beats the prices! Thank you!

author: Dan Barman
review_text: Beware, I’ve had real Di Fara’s many times, and this is not it. Food is fast and convenient but not good. My wife and I tried 4 different places through Wonder (including Di Fara’s), we had high hopes, but everything was subpar. The people working the counter are very nice

author: Chico
review_text: I’m really sad they moved away from their old location in West Roxbury because it was so close to my house. Now I have to drive all the way to Jamaica Plains for this awesome food. I walked in for the first time today and I’m happy to see that they have more customers at this location. I’m happy for them. Good food, good prices. Nice, clean, and spacious restaurant. Eat in or take out.

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: David Ha
review_text: My first dinner on my 6th trip to Vietnam, and Man Moi was an absolute standout. Food was amazing—great portions, fair prices, and top-quality dishes. The nighttime ambiance is beautiful, and the service was excellent from start to finish. Loved the chilled tea to start, and every dish impressed: roasted baby shrimp, beef jerky papaya salad, grilled frog sausage with veggies and rice paper, and the incredible two-way duck on a hot stone plate. One of my best dining experiences in Ho Chi Minh City. Definitely a place I’ll revisit and my top recommendation for friends visiting

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Magdalena Velichkova
review_text: The food was soooooo delicious we ate until we couldn’t. The meat was professionally cooked and the sides with it were perfect. For these food we would have paid at least 200 dollars if we were on the bay side. AMAZING

author: Leona Palevac
review_text: I went by myself sunday 10pm to have their roasted chicken tijuana chicken entree, which was advertised $18 on the site. When I arrived the entrance was interesting and the place wasn't the "barra" on google maps but Little Tijuana and had same pictures of this barra place. When you enter there is a big empty ballroom and a staircase to your right, as well as a staircase down before that to the kitchen I think. You have to go towards the brightly colored stairs and take a right to enter the bar area. I don't know what else is in the building but the bar, bathroom are beautiful and interesting, albeit terribly noisy. My bartender gave me an ipad with the menu, and I was informed by it there's an automatic gratuity of 18%. I did NOT like that. Then I learned the dish I wanted was $24, not $18, and the bartender didn't know but returned a few minutes later to inform me they didn't have roasted chicken. I then asked for tacos and they said they didn't have the steak, but they did have pulled pork so I got tacos al pastor for $19, chips and salsa for $5, and two modelo's $6 a piece. The food was good, but I did feel sick from eating the tacos and worried as to whether the meat was really food safe. I would go again in a heartbeat, especially if they changed the audio surroundings in the bar to not be deafening... especially if they fixed the televisions. You can put closed captions on the television if there's no sound for them. Overall it was ok, but really, REALLY not worth the price I paid whatsoever. I would not recommend you eat here until Little Tijuana gets an actual manager in their kitchen. I will update this review and do a whole new one if the business offers me, as I don't like leaving businesses with poor reviews but this place needs improvements. I will say there was some decent flavor in the tacos, so they definitely have some staff in the kitchen performing. IT's certainly their management that is lacking with inventory control. My tacos had I believe canned pineapples too, dull in color but with good flavor.

author: J W
review_text: Very cute minimalist trendy decor. Very bright! There’s designated laptop and non-laptop seating too. I only came for lunch but the Maggi Deluxe was delicious!!!

author: Shelby Vandewalle
review_text: Love the everything gold aesthetic. The staff is really friendly and helpful. My order came out fast. Although I did come here on a weekday. Ordered a three finger combo. Came out just as I wanted. Worth checking out.

author: KH Koay
review_text: Turmeric rice is nice. Coffee is OK. A good place to visit especially when it rains, because the parking is covered. Not recommending its QQ noodle, portion is very small, and roti canai is hard.

author: Angielou Timbang
review_text: Had a wonderful dining experience! Every dish we ordered was delicious, and the ambiance made it even more enjoyable. The staff were warm and attentive—especially our server, Fish. Highly recommended!

author: Chuck Roast
review_text: I have been here multiple times the pizza and the vibe is awesome! There is a nice outdoor seating in the back, as well as a few spots up front outside.

author: A S
review_text: worth trying. Price are reasonable. taste of the food is good but only spicy sauce so be aware of that.

author: Oopszahdaisy Crayola
review_text: Retraction: I have never done this before. I am retracted my statement for now. I decided to come back for some soup. And the next visit, I came back for a 2 combo plate. I must say I was very impressed. My food did not spoil. The food was fresh. It was nice. I've only been back twice, but if my third visit is a winner then I will delete the bottom of my post. I don't know what happened, but I thank you for the drastic change. I appreciate this. I never go back and retract my statements. I may edit them or just delete them. But I feel this restaurant did a total change, and they need to know the customers are looking and watching and tasting. And I thank you for listening. It takes three chances to win my vote. We will see what happens next. December 22nd 2024 First of all I "used to love coming here". I can deal with a lot of things. But what I CAN NOT deal with is how my food SPOILS within a few hours. On MULTIPLE occasions, I would come in for a plate after my shift at 4:30. By 8, I could not eat my food because of the sour smell. My food had STUNK up my whole house. I mean it smelled like kimchi, dead rats, and skunks. If it will spoil within three hours, imagine what it will do in your stomach. I am SO Sick of Chinese food places in South LA serving us reheated food that sours within hours. If you do get something, get white rice. The spices is KILLING the food under the heat. I know I'm not the only person experiencing this. This happens EVERY single time. It's HORRIBLE. We deserve FRESH food. I decided to give this place a few chances because I really liked it, but hell no, not again. Don't say I didn't warn you. If you knew better you would do better by us. I will NOT be coming here EVER again. Food poisoning isn't CUTE or healthy. I have permanently giving up Chinese food because of it, unless it's 🐼. I would love to see the owner eat his own food after leaving it sitting for 4 hours. I guarantee if he did, he would have the same reaction as I did 🎯

author: Alexander Ly
review_text: Several food options. We are at Mike and Patty's where I ordered the MBB burrito. It's made fresh, though tastes like it looks. Tortilla, avocado, and eggs. My wife and son ordered the Crack sandwich 🥪. Good and cheesy, but must eat while hot; otherwise, the cheese cools down.

author: P M
review_text: A true 5 star review. I could ramble all day about how great this place is but if you’re reading this just go. You won’t be disappointed.

author: The DDP
review_text: Was in Bryant park and took the short block walk to grab a snack around 3 pm. The restaurant has a small eat in area but the surfaces were still dirty from the lunch rush. Service was friendly and efficient. Ordered a slice of pepperoni which they tossed in the oven and came out piping hot a minute or two later. $3.50 for a slice with a topping which is a good price for Manhattan, but this wasn’t a very big slice. Problem with this is that the pizza itself wasn’t particularly good. Light on the sauce and cheese with no great flavor. Tasted kinda like a large slice of a Red Baron frozen pizza. Went here based on the reviews but they were not indicative of the pizza I tasted. No reason to revisit.

author: Sandy Heidloff
review_text: Excellent breakfast spot just a short walk from Circa Resort. The staff were so inviting, felt like part of the extended family. Was the best breakfast we've had out in years. Highly recommend a visit you won't be disappointed.

author: Elaine Mari
review_text: This Dennys is a huge disappointment. Ordering food thru online application and they never have it ready on time. They always forget something, and when you ask for a refund, they don't give it to you because they say that they can't due to you ordering thru application. The girls at the counter all the time don't have manners and just stand their chewing their gum half the time. They don't answer the phone if you call. The manager is never around here, so what is the point of even complaining. Don't bother coming here service sucks when you eat in too.

author: Sovit
review_text: Indian Delight impresses with its delicious Indian cuisine and excellent service. The cozy atmosphere, coupled with traditional decor, creates a welcoming dining environment. Highlights include flavorful palak panner and fluffy cheese garlic naan. The attentive staff enhances the experience with their friendly and prompt service. Reasonably priced and generous portions make it a great value. Perfect for both casual meals and special occasions, Indian Delight is a top choice for Indian food lovers.

author: David Cruz-Flores
review_text: Our first time to this restaurant and the food was excellent and prepared fresh. Our waitress, Lorena was very nice and attentive! We will definitely go back!

author: Anique Lim
review_text: Nice buttery buns comes with different filling. Of course my favourites will be Thai Tea and Matcha. When we order then produce. Fresh buns and seating area just next to the shop. Air conditioning and provide free drinking water. Must try is you in the area. You won’t regret.

author: 狐鸣
review_text: I found this place on xiaohongshu. Short walk from Siam Square and there was no queue. The staff there were very friendly and helpful even though there was a slight language barrier. You can find all things crab here, and the deep fried pork belly is a must-try. Do try the mango sticky rice. One of the best I've had during my trip. They also have this unique lotus root juice which was very refreshing.

author: hector capilla
review_text: I was in line to order my food I was ignored like I wasn't even there went to another person

author: Rovik Robert
review_text: Very good pizza in a vibey Brooklyn space that has lots of character. Decent selections of beers and wine to pair as well.

author: Sonja Gomez
review_text: Food was amazing and the blueberry martini was the best I've ever had. That's also coming from 2 people who don't really drink we could barely finish one between the 2 of us. Atmosphere is great and it was very clean well kept restaurant 👍🏾

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: Norlaila Norddin
review_text: We eat at around 4.30 pm today. We got a front seat inside area. We order chicken rice ball, roasted chicken, hainan chicken (first time i like to eat hainan chicken, it's very good and i asking my husband to tapaw it makan kat hotel.. hahahaha..) Service also very good. Boss very friendly. Thank you boss for a free large bowl of fish ball. I give you 5 stars and mini love🫰🏻

author: Karen Berrien
review_text: I got the spicy tuna burritos last night for the family. First burrito here usually get the bowls. Fantastic experience, loved every bite and my family all felt exactly the same. Keep them coming and great new idea burritos. Thank you Tom for your great service. 5 star evening. Thanks karen

author: benjamin flores
review_text: If I could give them less than 1,000,000, I would because they played with my son's feelings, who for over a week had been asking me to take him to dinner at this damn place. I finally had the day off from work, and I'm taking my son and the rest of my family. It was a day like today, a Monday at 6:30 pm. My wife arrived, checked in, and was told that in about 20 minutes there would be a table for us. More than an hour passed and people kept arriving. The place was getting crowded, but it was full of older people, and obviously they were letting us wait. 2 hours passed. I got desperate and spoke to the person who checked me in and asked what was going on, and he clearly told me that there was still no table for me because the place was very busy with older people who did drink, or had consumed alcohol. Then I realized that the problem was that my party was less conducive to them because no one drank alcohol, and the older people who arrived for 5 to 10 people, or more, did drink, and obviously they were going to consume more than us at the end of the night. I understand that that's the business, liquor, but I hate it. They made me waste more than 2 hours sitting there watching how they served the others just because I was accompanied. From my children and my wife, I think that for those of us who are parents, they understand that it is not a family place, but rather another bar only for those who drink alcohol. A very, very, very bad experience. I spoke to the person in charge and he told me to wait for 10 more minutes, and I replied, "Are you sure?" And smiling, he said no, because if someone else who drinks alcohol eats, we'll give them the table because selling alcohol is our priority, and food is something extra. I feel very angry. Looking at my son, I said, "I think children aren't welcome here." I said, "He looks down and answers, 'Okay, Dad.'" Honestly, I'm frustrated with this place. I know very few people will understand the frustration you'll experience, but I advise you, if you're looking to get drunk, you're in the perfect place. But if you go with the family, you're not welcome. I would tell them more about my bad experience, but I'm at Chillies Chelsea, where they served me right away. Please don't go there. If you want to have a family afternoon, they only want drunks. People who only want to drink alcohol. Hurry up, do it yourself. Don't go. Don't go. Don't go.

author: Lena Kim
review_text: Even though I had a reservation, I still had to wait about 10 minutes after arriving. Among the dishes I ordered, the bacon burger was pretty good, but there were no vegetables in it — no lettuce, pickles, or onions, just the beef patty, cheese, and bacon. The staff were friendly though.

author: Nhan Nguyen
review_text: Delicious and affordable food for tourist who prefer to just dive in then continue their trips. Fast service and seating area is clean. Most shops close at 9.pm

author: pear arnont
review_text: Good food, good taste. Reasonable price. Worth it. Recommend

author: Tameika Rosario
review_text: 8/22/24 Order 2 pizzas & a pasta through the app. App said my food would be delivered by 5:57pm. By 6pm, I decided to call the store. A lady picked up, then put me on hold for over 5 minutes, & never returned. As me & my daughter sat outside waiting another 15 minutes, I decided to call the store again. That’s when XAVIER answered the phone. I stated my issue, & he told me he couldn’t understand me. I said okay, and proceeded to slow my speech & speak again, only to not be given the chance becuz HE HUNG UP THE PHONE ON ME! Now let me state that I am literally LESS THAN 5 minutes from this location, had my husband NOT calmed me down, Xavier & I would’ve met in person!! Horrible customer service, & Xavier better hope he doesn’t see me becuz I WILL REMEMBER THIS! I work in retail, & this is unacceptable to me

author: Christopher R.
review_text: Great food, well seasoned, adequately priced, and bigger than expected portions. Good beer selection, too. There was a live band that was a bit too close to the tables and a bit too loud, but it didn't take away from the experience too much. We'll be sitting inside next time.

author: Ellie Oh
review_text: 🥘✨ TG’s Bistro – the place where Indian food meets viral Instagram trends! Let’s be real—I came for the Roti Tissue, and yes, it was all drama and zero flavor 😅 Super photogenic, but definitely not the highlight taste-wise. BUT… the butter chicken? Absolutely soft and melt-in-your-mouth. So flavorful I almost forgave the portion size (yeah, it’s a bit small). 🧄🧀 Also obsessed with their cheese garlic naan—fluffy, fragrant, and the perfect sidekick to all the curries. If you're looking for viral-worthy dishes and solid Indian staples, this place knows the balance. 📸 Pro tip: Snap the Roti Tissue for the ‘Gram, then devour the butter chicken for your soul. #TGsBistro #RotiTissueTrend #ButterChickenGoals #KualaLumpurEats #ellies.taste

author: Honest Reviewer From DC
review_text: Hands down the most amazing Jamaican food I've had that wowed me. I wish they had a bigger seating area to go out for dates. Definitely recommend 5/5 I love the jerk mac N Chz. The pineapple plantains were to die for. My favorite thing about this place was that they had glass bottled water.

author: Super Fragrance
review_text: Ordered yam rice plus mixed pork soup for 13rm. This isn't preferred by locals clearly from the lack of customers. But i prefer this as their yam rice is definitely superior due to the salted fish. Soup was sour in a great way. Pork were generally okay some more porky than the other for example the meat ball but okay. But the show stealer is definitely the rice with salted fish it was pretty homogeneous meaning u don't get a bit of only super salted fish, instead the taste was consistent throughout.

author: Kilian Chasseriaud
review_text: Sandwiches are unreal and at an amazing price. Can’t recommend this place enough. The bacon and egg crumpet is so good and is only 50k. Will have to come back to try all the rest.

author: Brittney Casalina
review_text: Great experience! The drinks, food and atmosphere were incredible! Highly recommended! Our server, Roberto, was fantastic!!

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Manrit Leon
review_text: Had an amazing dining experience here! The food was absolutely delicious — especially Bun Cha which was full of flavour and perfectly cooked. Big thanks to our tour guide, Kevin from The Tour Bros, for recommending this place and giving such great explanations about the local food and culture. He really made the experience extra special! Highly recommended for anyone visiting Vietnam 🇻🇳 . - 🇲🇾

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: kk teoh
review_text: One of Bukit Mertajam's Michelin award eateries, this place has been drawing crowds locally and outstation. It is located along Jalan Betek in an unassuming location, which looks more like a car respray workshop. This also means that when the eatery opens at 6pm, there is some space for parking. We were fortunate to arrive when the crowd has not built yet on a Wednesday evening. Ordered two plates of regular char koay teow with duck eggs, which came to RM9 (at the time of writing). The dishes came relatively quickly. The char koay teow does not look much like the typical Penang char koay teow as it is darker and not as spicy (even though we mentioned that we are OK with chilli). Visually, it does not look appetising, but surprisingly it tasted really good. It had lots of wok hei, presumably from the use of charcoal fire, and the pork lard pieces were crispy and delicious. The eggs were perfectly cooked and the runny egg yolk added a different layer of umami compared to normal char koay teow. Portions were also adequate and we left feeling satisfied. You also have the option of adding side dishes, though we chose not to do so. A nice place to eat and will return as long as prices are maintained.

author: Heather Dawson
review_text: From the drinks to the food to the wonderful service from Ann, everything was amazing. Will definitely be coming back here when in town again

author: Kiran B
review_text: Lau Pa Sat is an absolute must-visit in Singapore,an iconic food haven that perfectly blends heritage charm with an unbeatable variety of flavours. The moment you step in, the vibrant atmosphere, sizzling satay stalls, and endless food options pull you right in. From perfectly grilled satay to delicious local specialties and international bites, every dish feels fresh, authentic, and full of character. With great seating, lively nightlife vibes, and food that never disappoints, Lau Pa Sat delivers an unforgettable dining experience every single time.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Razali
review_text: An OVERRATED place. Mediocre foods. A had a way better tunjang at a cheaper place. Rempah is not there. Almost all are overpowered by santan. Really disappointed with it. The a/c seems unavailable to cater large crowd. It is hot inside the restaurant. Crowded & noisy. Many staffs but most are not attentive. The only standout dish is sayur ubi tumbuk. A nice combination of ingredients.

author: jeremy cho
review_text: Legendary Ipoh Chicken Hor fun and chicken curry mee. The wait times varies from 30 -60 mins depending on dates and timings. They often sell out by 1030hrs. The horfun is silky smooth and just goes down like butter through your mouth. The broth is thick and flavourful. The curry is in my opinion one the best in South east Asia as a condiment to a bowl of noodles. If you are too full, you can just order curry chicken to go with your hor fun. They deserve 5 stars and more and naysayers about price etc sadly miss the bigger picture.

author: Jacob Fisher
review_text: Imagine Panda Express but good. Line out the door good. Portions overflowing the to-go box good. Imagine a wonton soup that isn't 2 wontons in water with three scallions but a hearty flavorful broth with massive leaks made fresh to order. I had genuinely forgotten what good wonton soup tasted like until I chanced in on this place. You know the place is good when it is always busy and I've never seen this place. Not busy but service is still fast and you are in and out the door. I love the idea that this place is doing everything that Panda Express wishes that it was and should aspire to be. For my money, this is my favorite local asian food restaurant. I hate to even compare them to Panda Express because they're not even in the same class. Dragon Express is so much better.

author: John Sutton
review_text: Let me start with the service, if there was a way to give them 4.9 Stars that's what I would give them. They were a little slow with service in the beginning. Because I think it was shift turnover. Otherwise the little gal that helped us was fantastic. I had two Lucky's Rum Punch, and they were pretty good. Had we more time, I'd have probably ordered a third or more. My wife ordered a watermelon Mojito and it was very good. Didn't detect very much watermelon but that is such a delicate flavor, the drink was still very good. I had the Traditional Fishing Village salad, which is a Greek salad and I added blackened Mahi Mahi. That fish was cooked perfectly, to my tastes, I know that your mileage may vary! The dressing was mild and the red onions were a little hotter than I'd like, but my experience lately is that all red onions have been hotter, which means that either my tastes are changing, or the onion crop this year was different. I regret that I did not get a picture of this, we just come off of a cruise and I was not in the taking pictures of my food mode. My wife ordered the blackened mahi mahi version of the Hooked Up Tacos, she said they were excellent, it's fair to mention we had a pretty good amount of seafood on our cruise and no Mexican cuisine. So she may have been a little bit hungry for the tacos, but that fish was very good! I like the atmosphere of this place, The View can't be beat and the Pagoda over the bar is massive and very cool. We sat at one of the covered high tops and that was additive to our lunch. We shared a piece of key lime pie, and since we had just come off of that cruise we had more than a little bit of experience with nicer desserts. I know that not everyone has the same requirement from Key Lime pie, but for us, this was amazing! We had key lime pie on probably three different meals, and this easily surpassed all of them. This place was a little pricey, but not expensive by any stretch. If I lived nearby, this place would be a regular stop.

author: pramoch r
review_text: This is the second location we went to. Same good food quality. The place offers a wide variety of food and drinks. Would suggest to visit with a group of friends so you can try several dishes. Were informed that the taste was very local and cater to a spectrum of customers. I love the fried rice topped with chicken. The drinks were also very refreshing. I say this is a go to place for Indonesian food!

author: Jeremy Lim
review_text: The roast chicken rice was trying to play it crispy and cool, but sadly, it flew too close to the sun. The chicken, though roasted to a decent hue, was dry enough to make you reach for a second glass of water. The rice, fragrant but forgettable, couldn’t save the dish from its lackluster performance. A meal that aimed to roast the competition but ended up just winging it—barely clucking along. That said, the service was impressively efficient, with a fast turnaround even during the bustling lunch peak, which deserves a nod.

author: Lee Leblanc
review_text: Snotty workers and people who care about nothing but there money they didn't want to make a medium stuffed crust they told me it was only large pizza nobody spoke English in America employee did not make me feel welcome and gave me the stiff upper lip face because I didn't want a large but at least the food was served hot if that counts for anything

author: Justin
review_text: Amazing place! Super cozy with that authentic hookah vibe, you relax from the very first inhale. The food is fantastic; I especially recommend the new rolls on the menu, they’re absolutely delicious. The service is quick and friendly, and a special thanks to Olya for her warm smile and attentive care. We’ll definitely be coming back again and again!

author: ʕ•̫͡•ʕ•̫͡•ʔ•̫͡•ʔ•̫͡•ʕ•̫͡•ʔひかり
review_text: Got here early so we didnt need to queue. But after around lunch time theres small crowds start queuing up. The Pad thai was ok, but abit sweet and the crispy pork abit hard to chew. Clear Tomyum soup is sour & spicy enough for me. For the crab rice its too spicy.. so please let the staff know if you cant handle spicy 🌶️

author: Ester R
review_text: Im sorry to say this, but the food served here really needs emergency improvement. Also, the menu on the book are not ready to order, I got cancel twice! So when you make reservation, make sure what menu is ready, even better book in advance also for the menu. They might change it. So unreliable menu. The drinks here pretty acceptable, their liqour (baileys) taste really good! We loved it! This place is very suitable for photo, the decoration is so beautiful🥰

author: Ella Spence
review_text: I had the mahi fish tacos and my husband had the grouper platter. We had coconut shrimp and a bowl of she crab soup. Everything we ate was delicious and full of flavor. The service was extremely slow and there was a $13 service charge that came on our ticket for using the dining room. This was a 19% charge that was hidden before we came in and is the only reason that we won't be back.

author: Timothy Teegarden
review_text: I liked this place, would go again. Lunch specials were served on a cute compartmentalized tray.

author: Amanda Hoffman
review_text: Mike the manager went above and beyond to come to our table offering to fill our personal water bottles so we stay safe and having a great time during the day after we leave the restaurant. The food was delicious and hearty and our server D was very attentive and sweet! Will come back!

author: Frank Fazzalari
review_text: This small in-and-out spot has a steady stream of regulars for a reason: it’s good, honest-to-goodness homemade food from the Dominican Republic. The tender and juicy rotisserie chicken is seasoned and cooked perfectly — they rest the whole birds and cut them to order, to go of course. Definitely recommend, as it’s a solid choice for takeaway! Saluti.

author: Rbw dinata
review_text: So many option of interesting crab-based menu, so I picked rice with a combination of creamy omelette with crab and stir-fried crab curry, on one plate. Tastewise, indeed their cream and curry just like two pole crashed in your mouth. Each of it gave a specific taste and sensation, so soft yet tasty, full of flavor. The crab meat itself is generous, fresh and no fishy aroma at all. All is perfect to me. And for all this satisfaction the price is no more than THB 100. Hands down! Despite of horrible crowded customer, they apply a good and orderly queu system, so no extreme long wait even on lunch hour. Highly recommended.

author: CS Chai
review_text: This dim sum restaurant is among the more popular ones in Hatyai. Big sitting area including the non air-cond section at the side. Diners choose the dishes and the waitresses send them to be steamed in the kitchen. Kon loh mee, fish, pork and prawn porridge, bak kut teh and pork leg stew are also available. Free Wifi. Accept cash only.

author: W M
review_text: Food was great. Prices were reasonable especially compared to the outrageous strip restaurants. We ended up here based on tik tok reviews of the place and glad we came. The atmosphere is cute, very authentic Mexican vibe. Sometimes places are social media picture worthy but the food doesn't match. This place was good. We are used to our LA Mexican spots so we can be picky 😂. Check this place out, definitely worth a visit. Staff was very friendly.

author: Lim CY
review_text: We visit the restaurant from time to time. The food is decent, though it tends to be on the oily, salty side with heavier flavours, quite typical of some Chinese dishes, I think. It’s the kind of indulgence that’s nice once in a while, hits the spot.

author: Hoe Gee
review_text: The auntie taking the order was trying to hard to be nice and talking too much Alr ordered Hainan pork rice and she has forgotten, and asked for further order. Then later she recalled i already mentioned it. 3 cups of kopi, 2x kopi O siew dai and 1x kopi C kosong all wrong. It served 2x Kosong O and 1x C siew dai. After the meal, 2x persons not happy with the drinks, just me OK with or without sugar. Auntie has written down the order which is good, but her mind processor just intended to talk instead. The food order accuracy is absolutely a priority, no 2x ways about it. If the food all messed up, then the service means nothing.

author: Brandon Martin
review_text: They stopped carrying Beyond burgers, so we don't go anymore. They have good burgers though. Like any of the fast food joints, if the food is fresh it's pretty good. I'd say it's probably 85% of the time at any Carl's Jr.

author: rae wu
review_text: Honestly, this is more than just a meal; it's a full sensory experience. We're seated right at the water's edge, with the gentle sea breeze brushing against our skin and the rhythmic sound of waves providing the most natural soundtrack. Every now and then, you can even taste the faint, salty mist in the air. As the sun begins to dip below the horizon, painting the sky in shades of orange, pink, and purple, you truly understand what it means to dine in paradise. It’s pure magic.

author: sn.niagamotors
review_text: We came to Sarastro to celebrate my wife’s birthday and had a great experience. The food was delicious and beautifully prepared, and the atmosphere was perfect for a special occasion. What truly stood out was the service from Nick and Lisa. They were professional, warm, and very attentive, and they made us feel genuinely welcome from the moment we arrived. Their care and attention really made the evening memorable. They are a real credit to Sarastro and absolutely deserve recognition from management. Highly recommended. 🤍

author: Breanna
review_text: Great place to eat on the boardwalk. Beautiful view of the ocean and tasty food! Our waiter was kind, quick, and attentive. Loved my Ocean Cobb salad!!! My only gripe is that I wish the drink menu had prices.

author: Nickin Sitaram
review_text: One of the best Hawkers in Singapore. We planned this around being starving and making sure we researched which places to eat at. The food was phenomenal. Everything comes out fresh and cooked to order. Nothing rewarmed. It's a great hustle bustling vibe full of locals and tourists. The atmosphere is fun, fast and hot. Great to see all the stalls to see what they do and specialise in. We ordered everything we researched and way too much for us. We had a lovely local lady sitting opposite us so we shared everything with her and she doggy bagged it all too. This is a must place visit and again, none of us had any tummy issues even after eating like the world was coming to an end.

author: David Tomsic
review_text: They should advertise prices that you actually pay. Charging 25% on top of menu prices is not acceptable. And when you complain, all of a sudden no one speaks English.

author: Dale Rowan
review_text: Absolutely loved it! Food is amazing. Staff really helpful as we didn't speak the language. Cash or QR code only no card. No alcohol but mango lasi was good. Strongly recommend lamb which had generous lamb shank, and honey chicken.

author: Roberto Robledo
review_text: Food was delicious all the way from the Burnt Ends (food item) to the sauce they used. The bread was also soft and buttery. Also the Jamaica was home made. And the dessert we went with the bread pudding w the ice cream also superb. Highly recommend and plan on returning for more food items. Wow!

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: Frankey
review_text: Today, we went there for Father’s Day dinner. Their yam paste with Gingko nuts is like our childhood taste. I will sure return for the yam paste! It’s so nice! The damage is only $176.00 for 5 pax.

author: Elizabeth Jung
review_text: The food was fresh, natural no artificial flavor, and delicately prepared. Dicky was so friendly and helped us choosing the perfect dishes for the brunch - breakfast set is very good deal! We had omelet and french toast. Thank you Dicky for making our morning wonderful.

author: Amanda E.
review_text: Awesome experience. Such a perfect, open air, al-fresco ambiance. The food has been outstanding each time, this is my third visit. I plan to continue going. It’s right on the water so I’d say they need to just improve the conditions of the outdoor seating from the mosquito overtaking. Aside from that, kind and attentive servants and bomb music. Chill vibes.

author: Kevin Stallings
review_text: i’ve ordered here multiple times , i’ve only been disappointed , because i didn’t order more food ! i love everything they sell, the food is absolutely delicious ,the portions are enormous, the bag of food for the $60 i spent was easily 25 pounds or more , no kidding , the chicken soup is excellent & my daughter absolutely loves it , the sweet & spicy chicken is incredible , the Oxtail is amazing , all the vegetables are done perfectly , all of their Rice is done perfectly , i have to buy 6 beef patties in order to get one , thats because my kids love them so much , Honestly I can’t say enough about the taste ,freshness & generous amount of food at the price you get, at Only one !

author: Daniel Rothamel
review_text: The food was amazing. The Kuba fried rice was delecious, and had a perfect balance of rice to ingredients. I have never in my life had a plantain that was that delicious! Yasniel was super friendly, and he made great recommendations, answering all of the questions of our large party. Eating here was a wonderful experience from beginning to end.

author: Teng K.H. [simone food.channel]
review_text: It is like a small food court but the attention would be at the shop selling hor fun and curry noodle. Usually pack during peak hour, shop already full at their opening hour at 7.30am. The hor fun texture is great, smooth and soft, the broth is slightly sweet, lack of other complex flavor. The fishball was ok. I think their top seller is their dry curry noodle which we would try next time.

author: David Karapetyan
review_text: The worker didn’t want to get my order because of the personal conflict with one of my friends. So I do not suggest to go there, the worker has some mental and personal problems. I would rate a negative number but I just put 1 star because I cant put less than that.

author: Esg
review_text: Today we came to Fusta restaurant for a family birthday. Such a great time. The service was great, Nazar was very attentive,friendly and kind,he gave such a great service. The food was super good. This place is a must come if you are in the area. The atmosphere was nice,calm. It's not so big inside but is worth it. Great for any type of event. We all order different dish and everything was super good..I order skirt steak,spinach and mashed potatoes. Super delicious. The calamari also very good..usually I order this on other places and the calamari is always extremely fried like rubber not here. Totally recomend this place and I would definitely visit again. You can get an idea of some of the dish below..ahh let's not mention for the coffee lovers like me,my expresso shot is a must, super good. Note: the calamari is serve with lettuce but we ask no lettuce just the calamari.

author: Laura Demarco (Laura & Irene)
review_text: Dining at Il Poeta is never just about the food — it’s an experience that feels like coming home. As a family with deep Venetian roots, we feel incredibly lucky to have this gem right here in Forest Hills. From the moment you step in, you’re welcomed not just with warmth, but with the familiar sounds of the Venetian dialect from Chef Mario and the unmistakable aroma of true Italian cooking. It’s the only restaurant that brings my husband & me right back to our parents’ and grandparents’ kitchens — where meals were made from scratch, with love, and always shared. Chef Mario, a friend and true Venetian, has created something really special. Every dish is rooted in tradition and executed with care. Our daughter Irene loves the baccalà mantecato and the fegato alla veneziana, something she wouldn’t be able to experience elsewhere. The entire menu celebrates the lesser-known treasures of Italian cuisine, always healthy, authentic, and handmade. The ingredients are fresh, the flavors are authentic, and there’s never any rush — just like if you were at home for Sunday dinner. Our Golden Retriever Red loves coming here for alfresco dining and to try some of Chef Mario’s specialties. We come back again and again, and every time it feels like a reunion — with the food, with the culture, and with great friends. If you're looking for real Italian food, Il Poeta is the place.

author: Sadaf K
review_text: Tasty food, huge portions, and great prices. The banana muffin was the highlight: fluffy, moist, and delicious.

author: Racheal Jm
review_text: This was my teenager daughter's dream to eat here. They did not disappoint. Parking is quite interesting in Miami but they do have valet parking right next to restaurant. We parked in a parking garage not to far for $10/hr not associated with Hells Kitchen. So plan on parking. The food was amazing! We ordered the 3 part meal for $125/person. This came with options from each category. Never had anything like it! Plan on a 20% gratuity / this is added on automatically. We had Alex ( I will have to get last name added) as waiter. He made the experience extra special. He kept our water full. Very attentive to anything we needed. I've never seen so much silverware changed. Fun experience we will treasure.

author: I l
review_text: About the worst that can happen: 3 out of 4 machines out of service, then full system failure in ordering. All.orders take-out. No tablets available. All souces missed in the order plastic straws and excessive plastic use for sauces as tiny size ketchup and mayonnaise, everybody gets handful of these ... Europe has pump your own ketchup for decades. Homeless coming into store, picking food out of the trashcan. Hard to watch.

author: YING PEI TAN
review_text: A well-known brand of coffee for a long time. Feeling amazed by this concept store which initially I thought was just a kopitiam. The food is good especially the whole grain bread with butter kaya. Sweet and wonderful taste as a breakfast for a bread lover like me. The noodles are OK, but the best is no doubt their coffee. Cold coffee without ice and full of flavour with very little sweetness. Amazing! Same went to that in hot. Looking forward to try their roti canai and other menu items. The price was more to cafe pricing, as we spent about RM20 per person. Seating will need to wait as it was quite crowded at the weekend. However, their service and management were really systematic and fast.

author: Wendy
review_text: Super good banh mi. The classic combo (No.1 on the menu) is my favorite. BBQ pork is a close second. The price between 45,000-55,000 is the size. If you don’t mention that you want small, the staff might just decide the big one for you. (That is what happened to us when we visited the first time.) *I think by big or small is the amount of meat, not bread size. Before we left Vietnam, we went there 6am and they are already opened. There was a lady who was packing the bread. She looks like the owner of the place, she is super friendly and helpful. I absolutely love this place, will come back for more next time.

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: D. Lim
review_text: Old hawker center with affordable food and good variety. Surprisingly, there are 4 western food stalls here.

author: Anna
review_text: I love this place. Right on campus and perfect when craving a chicken platter. Although sometimes my chicken comes a bit dry/stale but other than that can’t complain. Every time I get a platter it lasts me 2 meals…portion size is worth it.

author: Wailing Mok
review_text: We went to order tonight's dinner at 11.30 in the morning and when we arrived, they actually forgot our order, how come this will be happened? And they told us that a table can seat 15 people but they couldn't. The food was not delicious at all, serviced was very poor. Will not come again.

author: Ashley Romero
review_text: This is such a cute place. I would recommend the honey vanilla latte, palm latte and the flourless chocolate cake. It is great that they offer vegan and gluten free options such as the flourless chocolate cake.

author: 劉品辰
review_text: Food is ok, but there’s just so many strange people appearing in the evening.

author: yunchia
review_text: Discovered this Vietnamese restaurant in Bali through Xiaohongshu. They have multiple branches and the food is served quickly very convenient. The restaurant is open air with no AC, but it was comfortably cool in the evening. The pho is flavorful and delicious🥰 definitely a place I’d visit again!

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Trân Trịnh
review_text: The food is affordable for students, the space is spacious and comfortable. Overall, it's delicious and cool. I've come back many times.

author: Paul Ciprian
review_text: A more elegant, cleaner hawker center than most of the others in Singapore (personally, I have never seen a more beautiful and clean one). The tables and chairs are no longer so cheap and fixed to the floor. That cheap canteen atmosphere is missing here. The building, a historical monument, is very beautiful. In the evening, especially, the atmosphere is very nice. Inviting smells, a very varied offer, garlands with lights that remind of Christmas, but also crowded. A place you must try!

author: zhou poa
review_text: The food and rice came out quickly but cold. Every piece of meat had pig hair and bristles that were not cleaned up, it looked disgusting. All the hot dishes were cold, the prices are expensive for Bali, and the portions are small. It's hard to get here, don't come here. We also read other people's recommendations, but we couldn't stand the cold dishes and the meat covered with pig hair. The meat looked like it had been sitting for a long time. There is no air conditioning, and the fan is off by default unless you ask the waiter to turn it on. It's a terrible experience.

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: WanderWithWit
review_text: 🌟 Comfort Thai Food with Hits and Misses – A Realistic Take on Kub Kao’ Kub Pla (CentralWorld) We stopped by Kub Kao’ Kub Pla at CentralWorld for lunch, and while the experience had a few bumps, it still offered some memorable highlights. The star of the meal was definitely the Southern Thai Crab Curry with Butterfly Pea Vermicelli. The crab meat was tender and fresh, and the southern-style curry packed a rich, spicy punch. Pouring the curry over the vibrant butterfly pea vermicelli gave each bite a delightful blend of heat and floral aroma — beautifully balanced and visually striking. We also had the Stir-Fried Chinese Kai Lan with Crispy Pork, a classic dish we usually enjoy. The pork was nicely crisped, but we found the overall flavour a bit flat. It lacked the salty umami kick from the salted fish paste — the chef had added too little, which was disappointing given how much it could have elevated the dish. Lastly, we had the Deep-Fried Seabass with Fish Sauce, although it arrived late due to a forgotten order by the waitress. While the fish itself was fresh and well-cooked, it was heavily salted, which made it overly intense. It came with a separate side of shredded green mango, red onions, and fish sauce — very tangy and sharp, almost overwhelming. We wished we had gone with the grilled or steamed version instead. Service felt rushed due to the crowd, and though the staff were polite, we were slightly let down by the missed order and the lack of any gesture to smooth over the delay — even something small like a complimentary dessert or ice cream would’ve gone a long way. ⸻ ✨ Overall: A lively, stylish spot with good food and beautiful presentation, but our experience didn’t feel as polished as expected. Still, that crab curry vermicelli? Worth returning for.

author: Megan Varela
review_text: I came here with some friends and family visiting from out of state. They loved it. The ambiance was just what we were looking for. The food and coffee were amazing. We got the chicken and waffles, avocado toast, Oreo pancakes, and the pancake tacos with fruit. Every meal was delicious. The Nutella latte was also so good. Our waitress Christina was so kind and helped us with any questions we had. The manager was also very nice and validated our parking. There is a parking garage right next to the cafe so I recommend parking right there.

author: Cristina Martinez
review_text: Delicious arepas, quick service. The chicken is better than every other arepa place I’ve tried! Seasoned perfectly. The staff was attentive and the location was clean and had plenty available seating.

author: Yatin Pradhan
review_text: Great spot with old school vibes. We had the Rodizio and they do not skimp on portions. From chicken to lamb to steaks, everything was 💯. In case you do not like well done steaks, ask them for medium temps and they bring it right away. As someone on a carnivore diet, this was a perfect meal. For almost $70 pp, this is definitely a great deal.

author: Del Stokes
review_text: Facilities are nice and welcoming. That is only thing good I can say about the dining experience. Chose the location for my wife’s birthday dinner because it seemed upscale and had okay reviews. Wife is GF(celiac) and tried to order accordingly. Had two different wait staff confirm her order but neither seemed to know what was up with the food choices. They said the kitchen staff would handle the order of grilled chicken and mashed potatoes carefully. Food came out smothered in gravy. She had to send it back while server looked befuddled. Wife didn’t dare to trust anything else from the kitchen or staff. I hurriedly ate my meal and we left. Feel totally flustered and angry that a special dinner was ruined. Would definitely NEVER return or recommend location for another person.

author: Gloria Zho
review_text: We had a lovely lunch at Phoenix Restaurant and truly enjoyed every moment. The ambience is beautiful,elegant yet cozy and the food was absolutely savoury and satisfying. A special appreciation goes to Mr. Bagas, who was so kind, enthusiastic, and willing to help us take photographs. His cheerful attitude and excellent service made our dining experience even more memorable. All the staff are very polite, friendly, and welcoming, which made us feel right at home. We’re very satisfied with everything and would definitely love to visit again when we return to Jakarta. 💕

author: Lex K
review_text: The buffet has a great ambiance and the staff were friendly and said thank you. The food was ok but some items are better than others such as fried chicken but the salmon was cold so choose wisely also I did notice some unsanitary conditions like sneezing and stuff so I stayed away from the hibachi would I go back ? They would have to make some changes before that.

author: Andrea Hernandez
review_text: Best place for breakfast. Our waitress was very attentive. A nice vibe here. The smoked salmon with avocado and capers was delicious. Mom's omelet was very good too. We enjoyed the champagne flight and tropical flights.

author: lol its jj
review_text: Best restaurant everyone was so respectful, food was so well presented and well made to my liking, definitely recommend coming here.

author: Wong Kean siong
review_text: "Terrible experience at Kimly Zi Char! Ordered food and it was completely wrong. Tasted awful, like it was leftover from yesterday. Worst part was waiting 40 minutes for the food with no apology or update from staff. Definitely won't be back."

author: S S
review_text: Juan was great he was my waiter the food was decent .The steak was overcooked some what hard to chew wanted medium rare but it is what it is …

author: Hui Ying Tan
review_text: I have tried most stalls and these are my honest opinions on what to order Quite good Wan tan mee (morning till afternoon only) Mala Xiang Guo Chee Cheong Fun Japanese bento stall Ah zhen fried rice stall Soup stall China fish fillet stall (酸菜鱼） Okok Fish head bee hoon Sarawak kolo mee What to avoid (not good) Penang laksa Yong Tau Foo Pan mee Hokkien mee Going to try their other stalls and update my review here accordingly.

author: Rob Z.
review_text: Interesting concept, terrible execution. Much is lost in the transition from a restaurant to a central kitchen, with terrible food quality standards as well.

author: FARAH LIYANA
review_text: We had much fun having a good ice-shaved (bingsu, garlic bread, caramel pudding, & drinks at here! 100% satisfied cuz all hot selling menu are so mouthwatering and delish! We will definitely come here again! The ambience and deco are so cozy & warm. We were so lucky by the time we arrived, the cafe was not so crowded. We enjoyed the most!

author: Rafael Souchet
review_text: Amazing experience. Manny was our waiter. He was incredible. Short rib fried rice, chicken fried rice, and waterfall beef all incredible. Best food we’ve had in vegas. Must go especially if you go to Fremont st.

author: vu nguyen
review_text: Tourist spot that is always packed. Banh mi is a little on the pricier side at around 75k but these monstrosity of a Sammie is basically 3 meals. All though the lines are long, the service is quick as they only make 1 style of sandwich. Apparently this is one of the 2 most popular spots in Saigon and they were both ex lovers but who knows. They make a good Sammie though.

author: Stuart Gibbel
review_text: For peeps from the east coast In-N-Out is a rare treat. Same great taste and prices as a regular in n out but in Vegas. Very busy but fantastic service. If you stay at the Linq its only a few steps away. A great burger and fantastic prices await you.

author: ihopetheyhaveicees
review_text: If you’re in the area and need breakfast this is the place to go. Haven’t gone there for anything else, but diner breakfasts are hard to beat especially since it doesn’t break the bank.

author: Vicki L
review_text: I never have anything bad to say about this restaurant. Our favorites are herb crusted blackened salmon, Louisiana chicken with bow tie pasta and red velvet cheesecake. If you get lucky you will be served by students. They are smart and if you tell them how you like the salmon cooked the food always comes out exactly how you want it. The salmon we got this time is superb, the most delicious salmon I ever had. The sweet potato fries are really good too. We have a side order and we got a really big plate with 2 dipping sauces. Of course I’ll keep returning. 5 stars

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: Oscar wong
review_text: Very friendly staff, food is clean and super yummy! Very fresh vegetables, definitely one of my favourite now ;-)

author: Tharindu Mahakumara
review_text: I went to Élephante for a birthday dinner and had one of the best nights! Our server, Angelo, was amazing! He so attentive and full of great recommendations. It was my first time dining there, and definitely not my last. The view was stunning, the food was delicious, and the whole experience was unforgettable. I highly recommend checking it out if you haven’t already!

author: Breanna Wade
review_text: Very good Jamaican food! Love the ay you can customize your meal

author: omnipresent original
review_text: Chris was amazing! He was super cool 😎 and super nice and polite to my wife it was so pleasant waking up with him this morning he didn't mind the million photos for the review and he found us the best croissants and donuts in the house we really appreciate it 10/+0 service today from our server chris so if you're in the neighborhood come say hi he will treat you like family

author: Jason Ng
review_text: [MATTAR, SINGAPORE] Don't remember the Circuit Road Hawker Centre being so crowded at night, but there were so many dishes I wanted to try 😍 among all of them we had 3 that caught our eye: The Fried Prawn Mee from Tian Seng was like a roller coaster ride; I was shocked & disappointed at the start when I saw that the bigger $5 portion was so small... But once I tried it I fell in love 😍 the umami prawn & garlic flavour was so intense, and the noodles were cooked just right! Although the wok hei might be slightly lacking, but such intense prawn flavour is really hard to find. This might be one of my top 5! I've had oyster omelette ($5) from Ghim Guan quite a few times, and the standard remains high. This rendition is wetter than others, but rich in flavours. I love how eggy this whole dish tastes and that the oysters were plump and juicy! Lastly, the Claypot Chicken Rice ($7) from Nanxing was just decent, felt like there was nothing much to say about the rice. The chicken was very tender and fresh though! Such a nice place for dinner, with quite a huge variety of stalls to choose from! I think this is a lesser known hawker which you should try visiting 😍

author: pk a
review_text: I ordered the number one minced meat with bee hoon soup. For those who like minced meat and meat dumplings this is good. However I prefer the teochew style with liver, dried mushroom and sliced pork, so I was rather disappointed. The soup tasted a tad too sweet for my liking. I also ordered the $5 fish ball soup and it came generously with 9 fishballs, it was not bad, but not the best I have tasted.

author: Peter Lin
review_text: Kway Chap. Kway Chap stalls without a name always draws me to buy from them. This one near my hood is not super shiok compared to my previous hood but definitely passes well as a kway chap place.

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: Caroline Cheong
review_text: Popped by for dinner on a Saturday and there was a queue. Took a number and we got seated in about 20mins. Food came really quick and every dish was outstanding and full of flavour. The stir-fried bitter gourd dish was surprisingly good.

author: Amanda Landry
review_text: Absolutely gorgeous venue especially for a shower (we had 60 ppl) & great customer service. Flexible to fit your needs; pricey packages but understandable for a waterfront (harbor) view near Boston. Beautiful room, big windows & vaulted wooden ceilings. My o my complaint, however, was the function food (brunch) couldve been much much better for that price tag. Waitstaff and bartenders were exceptional! Very helpful, kind & great service. Plenty of parking. Thank you!

author: Frank Herrera
review_text: I don't want to give up this hidden gem but too good to keep it a secret! Nothing on the menu disappoints!! Cafe de olla a must try with a free piece of pan dulce! Now to the service.....my boy Frank handled business with top notch service. I always come here when in town not only for the food but amazing service! Pictured is the sopes of chorizo and papas and chilaquiles tricolor.

author: rick pentecost
review_text: I got a bowl of chicken noodle soup and a drink. It was 13.00 and it was not even half a bowl of soup. I would not eat here.

author: Bry H
review_text: Sukiyaki sauce is definitely memorable and delicious. Seafood vermicelli, various shelled seafood were good as well. Recommend! Cash only or some QR transfer... No visa/mastercard

author: Jacqueline Le Brane
review_text: The food is fantastic. The sangria they are fabulous!! A bit pricey but worth it. Great service and atmosphere.

author: Kacie Williams
review_text: I booked Novikov for my honey’s 45th bday dinner, with just the two of us. Our reservation was for 8:30, we arrived at 8:45 and waited 10-15 mins for our table. We were seated in the middle of the restaurant in Alain’s section and here’s where the magic happened. He took such great care of us, giving recommendations and great details of the menu items considered. To start, we requested our usual, two spicy mezcalitas. Next, we ordered the delicious hamachi, and the king crab maki - both 10/10. Then were the short rib bao buns and the undefeated Brussel Sprouts w/ crispy pork belly - so genius another 10/10. For the main we went with the wagyu ribeye and prawn fried rice - these were good, especially steak but the prawn fried rice was not a star of the night and that’s okay. Alain; such great personality and service. We will definitely be back to see you “Jersey”. Thanks for making an unforgettable birthday experience.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Quý Mai
review_text: Kieu Bao's grilled pork vermicelli restaurant seems to be packed with customers all the time. I went there to eat and saw orders constantly coming and going on the app. The full grilled pork vermicelli dish costs 33k VND as pictured, including grilled pork, grilled spring rolls, and fried spring rolls. The portion is decent for the price. A plus point is probably the fresh vegetables and pickles, which are refilled free once. A downside is that the restaurant space is quite small, with tables and chairs placed close together, so it can feel a bit cramped and noisy when it's crowded. Parking is available in the alleyway with assistance.

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: Phylicia Lim
review_text: One of my favourite place for 猪杂汤. Price maybe on the pricier side for hawker but lots of ingredients. Recommended to try the 猪脚饭 too, very flavourful and meat is tender. Overall very tasty food. Service needs to be better though, ordered takeaway and doesn’t want to give extra chilli, ask me go refill with that small container myself, cannot just give me one more packet?!

author: Jacklyn Lynch
review_text: Went this evening to order cheese empanadas, beef empanadas and tequeños. All was delicious, was having such a craving for that taste of my homeland, couldn't been more happier to treat my family with a touch of all we liked. Service and food was great.

author: Sabrina Freeman
review_text: Just popped into Cacique Restaurant on Flagler St, and wow! The vibe is super chill, perfect for grabbing a coffee or a quick bite. Staff was super friendly and totally made my day. Gonna be a regular here for sure! ☕🍴

author: Oscar Tan
review_text: Everything here tastes so good! The restaurant is air-conditioned with a nice vibe as they play a lot of early 2000s classics, and the staffs were mostly friendly. Only thing I can nitpick is that the Pandan Toast was kinda expensive as it costs 119฿. Definitely would return the next time.

author: Crystal Tan
review_text: The services and food quality are excellent, so far the best japanese restaurant in Penang. The price for all the dishes that we ordered is reasonable. Definitely will come back again!

author: Erica Matos
review_text: I had such a great experience at this breakfast spot! Everything came out fresh, hot, and beautifully plated. Our server, Dani, was fantastic — super friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed without ever feeling rushed. The pancakes were absolutely delicious — fluffy, buttery, and perfectly golden — but definitely huge! One order could easily feed two people, so I’d recommend sharing if you want to try other items too. The bacon, egg, and cheese croissant was another winner: buttery, flaky, and packed with flavor. The only miss for me was the matcha — not bad, just not something I’d order again next time. Still, with food this good and service this warm, I’ll absolutely be back. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a satisfying breakfast and great vibes!

author: hai au
review_text: Dear owner, are you sure this is called “sauce”? It was just enough to make your plastic bag wet. Disappointed I like the sauce, went there many time but buy back very dammmmm

author: Lorraine Bmor
review_text: The other more famous shop has more queues over Bánh Mì Hồng Hoa, and is generally the popular spot for tourists, but don’t let fool you. Bánh Mì Hồng Hoa is far superior (atleast for me) and here is why: 1. Size: Bigger isn’t always better. 🙈 The competitor offers just one massive size of banh mi while Hong Hoa gives you an option; one that is as big as the rival shop and one that is just the right size that’ll give you the perfect bite with everything in it (bread, veggies, and meat). Since the competitor’s is so big, it’s impossible to get that perfect bite, unless of course, you have an equally as massive mouth. Lol. 2. Variety: The other shop has only one Banh Mi option which is the traditional “put every Vietnamese charcuterie” in a baguette. It’s tasty and the most traditional but you’d get tired of it easily. More options would be better. Meanwhile, Hong Hoa has 6 varieties to choose from with their Bread with Roast Pork option being the best! 3. Price: The other shop’s pricing, as mentioned by many, is too expensive at 73K VND. Yes, it is big. But Hong Hoa offers the same size at just 55K VND. 🤷🏻‍♀️ 4. Taste: Not gonna lie, the rival’s is delicious as heck but there is a thing as over filling. It has too much meat, butter, and paté that it has become too overwhelming on the taste buds. They give you separate packs of fresh greens and pickled vegetables but even that isn’t enough to balance out the flavors. On the other hand, Hong Hoa’s is perfectly balanced.
