We tried both their Roast Pork and Mixed Meat one which is similar to Huynh Hoa’s to give it a fair comparison. For the Mixed Meat one, the slices of ham and paté taste better here although not as generous and the other shop. Again, Quality > Quantity. 😉 And for the Roast Pork one, it is hands down the best Banh Mi I’ve had in my life!!!!! The pork is nicely charred and its fattines goes really well with the pickled veggies. It meat is kinda reminiscent of Pork Sisig (a Filipino dish). It even has that spicy little kick from the chilies. It’s a sandwich worth the trip back to Saigon! 💯 Either way, both these Saigon banh mi shops made the most famous stall (for tourists) in Hanoi, Banh Mi 25, taste like utter crap. Lol. 🤣

author: Cynthia Kenina
review_text: It was our first time in Las Vegas and I am goodie and love sharing experience on my social media and this is how I found this place. We visited one near fremon street and wow menu was just amazing so much to choose from. I had bloody Marie at 8am don’t judge me I was on holiday. I had an omelette and my fiancé had something else, soon as we stepped in service was 10/10 nice new clean and most importantly so so delicious. I would defiantly fine broken yolk in different areas and visit again

author: Osaka Nov17
review_text: Traditional Vietnamese food, the dining experience is good. Only ordered 2 dishes and a shrimp congee. Congee is sweet. The dipping sauce for steamed broccoli is tasty. Overall environment is nice.

author: Kee Kelven
review_text: This restaurant has probably the most stunning decoration I've ever seen. The huge wall painting of mountains and the Great Wall of China is just amazing. We were also satisfied with their authentic Chinese food. We had breakfast here, so we ordered dim sum, which was freshly made to order. We also tried their noodles and porridge, which were fresh and flavorful. However, I wish they could speed up the service, as we waited quite a long time for our food, even though it wasn’t busy and there were only a few tables occupied on a Thursday morning.

author: Anshika Prasad
review_text: The Com Tâm was phenomenal. I’m back to my country and I’m still craving it! Someone said forget Michelin guide, this is the best pork ever, anywhere! And I agree. Amazing flavours, beautifully done meat! The sauce pairs well, we visited and had some. And within 3 hours we ended up ordering again via grab to have it again. We also had the strawberry smoothie and it was a lot, and very delicious! I’m tempted to come back to HCMC to have the ribs.

author: James Lim
review_text: Person taking the order was a bit perturbed that we asked what a certain roll was after being ignored for a while, she was talking to a co-worker. From there her attitude didn't turn positive, although she did take our order for a box of 8 rolls. The rolls were ok, as per prior comments by others its best to eat while still hot.

author: Robynne Jackson
review_text: I stopped there to get my grandson lunch. He had a cheeseburger special I know they have excellent breakfast I love their breakfast I Haven't had anything else from them but breakfast and it was delicious. The place is clean the service is quick and the atmosphere is cool

author: Eric Perez
review_text: This was my first time trying Raising Cane's and I really enjoyed it. I got a combo box with 4 tenders, fries and sauce, usually comes with coleslaw as well, but I'm not a big fan of 'slaw', so I got extra fries. The chicken was really delicate and flaky, almost like it was fresh. The fries were, just fries and the toast, didn't even pay attention to it, but it was fresh and crispy on one side, but not the other. The sauce was really good, I even dipped my fries in it and made them a little better. The place is all gold as well because it opened on the 28th of August, so Golden Birthday. Overall, the place was clean, it was busy, but I only waited about 5 minutes for my food and it was good. Overall 7/10, got Eric stamp of approval!

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: 吃喝玩乐
review_text: Hidden in a back alley, they told me only have pork. Very delicious and tasty but the soup is more on the sweet side. At 70 baht per bowl, slightly more expensive than other stall but the meat portion also more, big chunk of meat and very tender.

author: Steve.PM. “Spreadsheet Nerd” VBA
review_text: Tikki Masala was our first introduction to what proved to be a foodies paradise in the great city of Boston. With family from Fall River, I thought that my nostalgia for New England was the root of my affection for this place. However, the approval from the rest of our ten group party affirmed that my affection was justified. Cannot recommend Tikki Masala high enough. The food was authentic Indian, the service exceptional and the atmosphere pure “whole in the wall”, “side of the road”, “diamond in the rough” perfection. Will make a point to visit again when back in Boston.

author: Sanju santhosh shetty
review_text: Citrus and Salt is an absolute gem! From the moment you step inside, the aesthetic environment captivates you with its vibrant, yet relaxed vibe - perfect for any occasion. The decor is modern yet welcoming, with a mix of clean lines and cozy touches that create a warm, inviting atmosphere. The food is just as impressive. Each dish is thoughtfully crafted, bursting with bold flavors that hit the spot every time. Whether you’re there for a light bite or a full meal, everything is fresh and expertly prepared. Don’t skip the drinks - they offer a great selection, from creative cocktails to refreshing mocktails, all of which are a treat. A perfect place to enjoy fantastic food, great drinks, and an unforgettable ambiance! Highly recommend!

author: Soo Yeo
review_text: So miserable and deflating to see all the cockatoos chained and stressed. Won't support this kind of business. I left this place being stressed at the end. Also got bitten by one cockatoo while I was speaking to a resident next to the restaurant. When I reported this to a restaurant staff, he said "It is okay. I got bitten too." showing his thumb with a permanent scar. It was the resident who helped putting a bandaid for me. No antibacterial ointment prepared. Babi guling taste was average.

author: Alexis Heu
review_text: My husband and I stopped here after a long road trip. Hands down, the best Thai food we've had in a while! We ordered the Drunken Noodles, Cashew Nut Beef, Sticky Rice, and the Chicken Satay. All were phenomenal! If we're ever near Vegas again, we'll definitely be back. Our server was amazing! We loved everything about this Thai restaurant. 10/10!

author: Jose Cegarra
review_text: I love it the food of here, great flavors y very fresh and low price!

author: Hans Bae
review_text: A double espresso at Pison, a fusion restaurant and café in the heart of Ubud, was the perfect pick-me-up after a long day of traveling. The cool air-conditioning, spacious high-ceiling interior, and beautiful rice field views make it a very comfortable place to relax. The atmosphere is lively, with travelers happily enjoying great food and drinks. The staff are friendly, attentive, and truly welcoming. They even try their best to accommodate special requests, sometimes preparing items not listed on the menu. Excellent service and a wonderful experience overall.

author: Jennah do
review_text: My favourite local Italian food in Singapore is Rosso Vino, it is located at Robertson Quay, I love the delectable and scrumptious flavours of their Italian Cuisine and the tranquil and serene atmosphere while eating al fresco, overlooking the picturesque and beautiful view of the Singapore Clarke River. Or, I can choose the indoor seating that gives off an authentic and classy vibe. I always chill out at this place with my friends or family on the weekend. The food has an authentic Italian taste, and is much more tastier when paired with their refreshing Red wines. My daughter loves to eat Pizza Burrata, Fettuccine alla Bolognese and Tiramisu. For me, I love all of their food. Every time I come to Rosso Vino, I would try different types of food on their menu. Moreover, the staff are friendly, polite and professional. Carlo, the co-owner of this place, is fantastic. He is very friendly and makes us happy every time we visit this place. He also pays attention to details of the food and drinks. Keep it up Rosso Vino 👍

author: Elena Wilcox
review_text: Came before the concert at Chase Center. Had mussels, fish and chips, cocktails and wine. The food was average and atmosphere ok if you not sitting at water front seats. Thank you

author: Pauline Tan
review_text: Comfort food, nostalgia location in residential flat community area. Parking a bit challenging but still don’t stop me from coming here for a toast and authentic Malaysian kopi. Home made Kaya is divine

author: Debbie Voon
review_text: The food is good. The fried crab thingy is really good. Enjoyed the wantan noodles too. The drinks were a little strong in color but taste is fine.

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: Rachel Ng
review_text: This place is incredible! It's affordable, fuss-free, and the fried rice with sausage & crab meat was so comforting. I had the crispy pork & roasted duck, wiped it all up despite being a single diner. Thank you for the hearty meal!

author: Diamond Dae
review_text: It's LA so what can I say about the Atmosphere . I will say that OMG the food looked so delicious on the reviews and when I got there the smells were off the chain. However the chicken not so good. Which was disappointing. The smell and look makes you wanna hope there is a piece that tastes like something. Not even rotisserie. It's was so blah. Took leftover home and even my son was like this is so bad. Sadly it got tossed in the trash. It's smelled soooo good and wasn't. The staff w as friendly.

author: Jim Schaefer
review_text: First time here, the menu is limited, the kids had the chicken BLT, which is huge and looks delicious and I just had the best oysters I’ve had in a long time. Brooke, our server was excellent and everyone here is very friendly. I would definitely come back to this place.

author: Irvving Kairos
review_text: The rain helped us stumble upon this place. Before walking in, we did not hear about it nor saw any type of advertisement in Boston. But it was a pleasant surprise tucked in the middle of buildings. Offering a variety in different shops, food and drinks, this food hall did delivered. The lounge area was buzzing but sadly the food halls seemed ghostly. Don't know if the set up is to blame for, but it provided a nice space for a bite, some drinks and a chill place to hang out with friends and family.

author: Meaghan Kavanagh
review_text: We had a good time at Brassica. The staff were great and organized. The food was good but some things like the brussel sprouts were mid for the price and very small portions with rice underneath (seemed like they were just trying to cut costs). Also the pizza was alittle burnt, beyond what I would have served. But I loved the housemade vermouths and would recommend if you are looking for a fancy meal out in Boston that has a friendly/local vibe. Also definitely make a reso as it's a busy place.

author: John
review_text: Excellent food, grest service. But the perfume is very strong and smells synthetic. Eating places should not be so heavily perfumed.

author: Yancy Alfaro
review_text: Arrived at 7:58. Wouldn't take my order because they were closed. Aren't they supposed to close at 9pm? I asked at what time they closed. I was told 8pm. Only about a minute had passed since I arrived.

author: Hermosa
review_text: We really enjoyed our time here. The rooftop view is amazing! Being up on the rooftop gives such a nice feeling, especially in the evening. The atmosphere was relaxed and comfortable. The food was really good. The chicken piri piri brochette is definitely a favorite,very tasty, juicy, and well seasoned. Everything came out fresh and nicely done. The staff was great as well. Tivany, Julio, and Rio were friendly and attentive without overdoing it, which we really appreciated. Overall, a very nice place for a chill evening with good food and a beautiful view. Would definitely come back! Olla & Imane

author: Jessica Maloy
review_text: Great restaurant with yummy food & assertive staff. Shelly was friendly, and my tomato soup hit the spot on a cool day. The blueberry muffin & cookie were delish. I'm going to try broccoli- cheddar in a bread bowl next time. 😋 Definitely recommend this Panara location.

author: Ivy Wong
review_text: Worth a trip from Seminyak to Canggu just for this meal! We tried 3 different ceviches with the Alfonsin being the stand-out dish. The grouper was amazingly cooked with the skin so crispy and meat so flavourful. Service was excellent as per most Balinese restaurants, and they even served us a complimentary guava tart (must try!) when they found out it was our honeymoon. The place is beautifully decorated too. 10/10 would recommend!

author: Gerrard Teh
review_text: The place is quite spacious and cooling. Food serving is very fast. The soup hor fun is quite good with fresh clear shrimp broth, however the portion is a bit small to me even though i ordered a large size. The steam chicken is not impressive as the texture is not as smooth as you would like it to be. Ginger tea was ok not too spicy. 😅

author: Neneng Lestari
review_text: This place is really gwooddd! The food tastes amazing and everything is nicely prepared. The ambience is cozy and super comfortable—perfect for hanging out or having a relaxed meal. The staff are friendly and helpful, which makes the whole experience even better. Definitely a spot I’d recommend if you’re looking for good food and a good vibe👌🏼👌🏼

author: Annette Robinson-NeSmith
review_text: I’m so shocked that the potato salad was not the best. It was so sweet and loaded down with an over amount of mayo. The potatoes were not all cooked through. I couldn’t even eat it. The Salmon was good and the collards were ok. Hopefully they will review their potato salad.

author: Jesse Chin
review_text: Ordered chicken chop, the food portion looks great and big, but honestly it is just because of the fried skin and it looks big. The environment needs to be improved as we are sitting just in front of the toilet as in the picture and it smells like Dettol. Why 3 stars, if you ask for extra sauce, the lady at the counter will tell you sauce needs to pay extra! What?! I need more sauce just because your food is served with not enough sauce. Will I come again?🤔Maybe yes, when I have no other choices

author: Anshika Singla
review_text: Great place to visit while in singapore.. U will get every type of cuisine Indian, Chinese, French, Thai, continental, Mexican, Asian. Also there are good seafood options. Even desserts and drinks are amazing. So a must try place. Closes at nearly 9pm.

author: Chun Hou
review_text: Might be well known but food is below average. The chicken is unseasoned and tough, and the sauce is way too salty to make up for the bland chicken. Service is fast and efficient, food was served up within 5min.

author: SK C
review_text: I feel nothing special, just a normal bread filled with cream/jam

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Oi L W
review_text: We recently visited this restaurant near our apartment on two occasions within just three days, and it was a happy experience! 😸 The banh mi sandwiches are good and have a comforting, homey feel. However, we wish they had a bit more filling, as we prefer them thick like homemade versions. 😂 The spring rolls are deep-fried, so expect them to be a bit oily. We're not huge fans of deep-fried foods, so our comments are neutral. They aren't overly salty and have no strange flavors, making them a decent comfort food option, especially when paired with warm rice. The pho (noodle soup) is made with a clear broth that’s perfect for breakfast or dinner. It’s a versatile meal that’s easy to enjoy at any time. If you're planning to order, go for the large bowl—it offers great value without being overwhelming in size. ❤️ The salt coffee is decent as well. ☕ We haven't tried the bun cha yet, but we're excited to do so next time! The grilled meat looks incredibly flavorful, though we’re a bit intimidated by how to eat it. Overall, a lovely spot we look forward to returning to! 😘

author: George Bailey
review_text: When you're here ordering food and sitting down to eat it and ask if there's a restroom for the customers and they answer you with a rude crazy look I think it's time to call the health department. I think it's illegal not to have a bathroom at a restaurant where they serve food and drink drinks.

author: Myke Shorter
review_text: They were so busy, yet so clean and so personable. I salute the whole team

author: Davi Santos
review_text: I recently had the pleasure of visiting Wahlburgers and indulging in a selection of their mouthwatering burgers. From the first glance, it was clear that these burgers were crafted with care and an eye for delicious detail. Classic Cheeseburger The classic cheeseburger was a sight to behold, with its perfectly melted cheese draped over a juicy beef patty. The fresh lettuce and thick slice of onion added a crisp texture that complemented the richness of the beef. Each bite was a delightful blend of savory meat, creamy cheese, and refreshing vegetables. It's the kind of burger that reminds you why you love burgers in the first place. The Super Melt Next up was the grilled cheese burger, which took a creative twist on the traditional burger. Sandwiched between two slices of golden, buttery toast, the patty was packed with flavor and paired perfectly with the melted cheese and caramelized onions. This burger managed to capture the essence of comfort food, delivering a nostalgic yet innovative experience. Double Decker For those who crave a bit more, the double cheeseburger did not disappoint. Stacked with two beef patties and layers of gooey cheese, this burger was a feast for both the eyes and the stomach. The combination of the well-seasoned beef and the creamy cheese was simply irresistible, making it a top choice for anyone with a hearty appetite. Crispy Chicken Sandwich Lastly, the crispy chicken sandwich offered a delightful alternative for non-beef lovers. The chicken was fried to perfection, boasting a crunchy exterior that gave way to tender, juicy meat inside. Paired with fresh lettuce and a slice of tomato, this sandwich was both satisfying and refreshing. Overall, Wahlburgers delivered an exceptional burger experience. Each item was carefully crafted, balancing flavors and textures to create a truly memorable meal. Whether you're a fan of the classics or looking to try something new, Wahlburgers has something to offer for every burger enthusiast.

author: Yujing Wang
review_text: Got scammed by the Good Google reviews 😅 The chicken tenders were way below my expectations. Anyone who’ve tasted Dave’s Hot Chicken would understand my disappointment.

author: Leese Sheesh
review_text: I had one of my top 3 worst experiences as a customer at this location, and I do not saythag lightly. As soon as I walked in, I urgently needed to use the restroom, so I wanted to do that first, has people in front of me were still ordering anyways. The employees would literally not allow me to place my order after using the restroom; they refused to give me the code until I waited for my turn and then chose and paid for my order. I was already extremely unimpressed at how they were interacting with me, specifically as a customer. You would think it would end there, wouldn't you? WRONG. As I am in the process of using the songle person restroom, I had to deal with multiple knocks on the bathroom door. Finally I pick my head out, and told him I needed to still wash my hands, Ingrid rudely informed me that I had a strict 5 minute time limit for doing all my business in the bathroom!!! On top of being grossly unprofessional, I was so uncomfortable and perturbed are there multiple interruptions during this whole ordeal. The other employees then stated it was because of other customers need to use the restroom, but I sat in the restaurant for another 10 minutes after I got out and not a single person went in after me. Dishinesty can be added to the list of tbings I was forced to endure as a PAYING customer. Just overall gross, cheap, and unsophisticated behavior from all of the female workers behind the counter. If I go to rate this zero out of 5 stars, I would gladly do so, and it would be whole accurate. Honestly, just overall shame play treated me, from their tone to their explanations to their complete lack of sympathy and social/business etiquette. Do better, because honestly you couldn't do much worse. 👎👎👎

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Kong Wen Sheng
review_text: This is a famous Bun Cha store apparently as my queen brought me here for lunch, first proper meal of the day and trip. Very satisfying and delicious! This has set a high standard of food for the trip and nothing hardly beats it for the next few days. We ordered fried Spring rolls too! The tables on top could hardly fit both of us a we are both XXL in size 🤭

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: Eunice Ang
review_text: So far the best char kwy teow I had , someone brought me there and I would say the taste is so good and wok hey. I grab another pack after I reached hotel! Hehe

author: Anthony Contreras
review_text: PROS: * Amazing selection of food from different restaurants. * Live music often playing outside and inside. * Tap beer selection is vast! * Family friendly place. * Plenty of outdoor seating for nice weather. CONS: * Parking can be tough.

author: WY Lau
review_text: This duck noodles didn’t meet my expectations. The soup is clear soup, a lot of pepper powder added into it. Portion is small but the duck still ok and it is soft. The place is hidden and not easy to find. The surrounding is dark and got mosquito.

author: Sidney Kan
review_text: Lunch was within a walking distance from out hotel and yet so hidden within the town centre. Food at Ban Khun Bhu was just amazing, light and delicious. Shrimp omelette was just unbelievable delicious, fragrant, warm and addictive. Their bbq boneless chicken got us hooked, love the fine firm texture of the chicken and tasty marinated. White tom yam was just amazingly good, owner himself told us that the fresh herb used comes from his home garden without any peticide. Ours came with plenty of sizeable prawns. We also add on their specialty Northern and middle Thai homemade sausage, it was so good. We also tried the coconut drink too, nice. Love this eatery, no frills so delicious ♥️♥️♥️ Baan Khun Bhu 1 Prachathipat Road, Hat Yai District, Songkhla 90110

author: melany hernandez
review_text: My experience here at Luckys has always been good. The food was very yummy, although the area may not be the best never judge a book by its cover. My personal fav Chinese food spot.

author: Sandeep Kaur
review_text: This was my first time here and I absolutely loved it. The pancakes, the scramble, mimosas, and the orange juice were all 10/10. The service was great and the prices were more than reasonable.

author: Fatima Mendez
review_text: So awesome place to chill and vibe, the best part is getting to chose your vibe settings here. They have three different levels. The lounge , you dance and have drinks, the dinning room where the music is at its mid and the rooftop, super elegant and that’s where I was loved it! Had a great time🫶 the owner did such a great job and he made us feel so welcomed that’s really what made me want to stay cause I don’t like being in Newark. The only thing I did not like was the valet parking. I get the $25 to park but what threw me off is that the guy didn’t let me enter the restaurant from the parking lot and made me walk around to the front. But when I came back for my car I saw he let someone else go through the back. So idk if maybe she’s also the owner prob. Idk. But I’d hope if they could change that because I had heals on and it was super dark and a bit of walk to go to the front.

author: 펭돌
review_text: I went here today and bought two combos. The staff here were unfriendly and felt very bad because the coke didn't contain any carbonic acid. It was just sugar water. I don't want to go again. This restaurant needs to check the beverage machine. How can there be no soda coke?

author: Mendi Sim
review_text: The food is very fresh and nice… the kimchi is very delicious… we went for the buffet which is very worth it..

author: Geneva Williams
review_text: So me and my guy wanted some breakfast while in Miami we came across Cafe Papillon the pictures outside the door looked great and I glanced at some of the plates through the window they looked great so we decided to go in . We had to order at the register and pay before we ate ok didn't like that we found a table sooo presentation is everything to me and when she brought the breakfast out I looked at my eggs which supposed to be egg whites but the were gray the cook either burnt the butter or just didn't care what was going into my bowl the food wasn't good it seemed like they just threw it on the cutting board and served it to us . But I was really upset when I seen the gentleman on the side of us platter was perfect looked just the picture. They treat us tourists any kind of way and their own like a celebrity which I don't like.. Sorry I'm giving you guys a thumbs 👎 👎👎👎.

author: Pbpb Pbpb
review_text: I had a wonderful experience at this beach club. The place is extremely beautiful, with a stunning view of the sunset that makes the whole atmosphere unforgettable. The food was decent, but the cocktails were incredibly good — perfectly prepared and full of flavor. A special thanks to the manager, Mika, who guided me through the cocktail selection with excellent recommendations. His attention and hospitality truly made my day. I had an amazing time thanks to him. I’ll visit again very soon

author: Tan Yung Yung
review_text: 06 JANUARI 2026 J.B. San Lou Bee Hoon (S) Very yummy , smoky , flavourfull, never let us down Cod Steak (S) this time a little bit rough , not as soft as we ate before , but over all still yummy Longan Pineapple Sweet & Sour Pork yummy but to sour for me Rice, a bowl full that so satisfying Barley with ice , nice not too sweet

author: O TW
review_text: Another random spot we found that turned out to be quite famous in the area—probably among tourists too. We went for lunch and there was a long queue, but it moved fast. We waited around 20 minutes, though be prepared to stand under the hot sun. The curry crab meat omelette is a must-try—creamy but not undercooked, and the curry fragrance isn’t overpowering. The tomyam is spicy in a good way. Overall, it’s worth it and not pricey.

author: Roberts .J06
review_text: Sunday brunch for this spot, for a chill, great scenery, great vibes with all the right songs, tequila & tacos! I got to go during brunch times, the waitress checked off the vibe check! Was able to help me out exactly with what I wanted! I told her what I was feeling and she reassured that what I wanted was THE items in the menu! I could have ordered TWO orders of the pancakes! But probably would have had to be carried out! Do yourself a favor & grab the Cornbread Pancakes has is (if you like everything there) TRUST ME ! With the tater tots make sure to cut the egg over it before trying so it’s not as dry! Recently took family there cause I felt so highly about them, and it had been confirmed . THE brunch spot! We had 3 orders of the pancakes at the table! & the staff is truly amazing! Friendly, welcoming! Have my girl now that’s there, that is THE girl she’ll make sure everything comes out on point! Idk if I want to tell yall, cause then you’ll make it difficult for me!

author: Stephen Black
review_text: Luis was our server and he was awesome explained everything and took care of us. The food is awesome and is served fast! The ambiance is nice and they were playing best of the 80s music. Very clean and has there A rating posted clearly. And I have been to many AYCE sushi restaurants and this one is a step above the rest. And there are many options for someone who does not like fish. So weather you like fish or not it will be your fault if you leave hungry. Thanks Luis

author: kk teoh
review_text: A very typical nasi kandar place with a decent selection of options. There are not too many tables, so seating is limited. There is no air-conditioner, so it can be a bit warm there. Having said that, most patrons generally opt to take away their food. Parking is available along the street but is fairly limited. I did not have a chance to take photos this time as we had to rush. Having said that, since we enjoyed the food so much, I feel that it deserved a positive review. The food in general is fresh and delicious. Freshness and cleanliness are two factors which are important to us as we have had poor experiences at some nasi kandar outlets. While we were not privileged to see how clean the kitchen was, the food counter/station was quite clean and the food was fresh. I ordered a white rice with ayam masak merah, some shredded cabbage and deep fried bitter gourd. As with many other patrons, I asked for a mix of kuah/gravy and in the typical banjir style. The fried bitter gourd was crispy, even when taken half an hour later at home. The ayam masak merah delicious and tender, though a bit too sweet. The shredded cabbage was fresh, unlike those at some outlets that I have tried previously. Happy to recommend and return to try other dishes. Thumbs up.

author: Sam Shee
review_text: Best beef noodle broth bombardment, with a big boost of pungent raw meat and wet veggies as soon as you waltz in. Lots of seating and great for groups if you don't mind having no space to put all these big bowls of slurpy flat noodles. Broth flavour is top notch and the beef is chunky and chewy like it should be. There's two shops in close proximity so head on over to the overflow outlet. Staff speak workable English which is handy.

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Shaun Nel
review_text: We had an absolute blast here, the staff are extremely friendly and helpful. The food was all brilliant and didn't have to wait long at all. I will definitely be back and recommending to friends and family!!!

author: R C
review_text: ★★★★★ Taco John’s absolutely blows Taco Bell out of the water! This place is a fantastic addition to downtown Boston—finally, a fast-food taco spot that delivers on quality and flavor. The service is top-notch, with friendly and efficient staff who make sure your order is perfect every time. The food is fresh, fast, and absolutely delicious. The tacos are loaded with flavor, the Potato Olés are addictive, and everything tastes like it’s made with care. If you’re looking for a quick, satisfying meal that doesn’t sacrifice quality, Taco John’s is the place to go. Highly recommend!

author: Cheong YP
review_text: Loves their bagel. Tried 5 different bagels. My rating from the best: Super Mario > Matcha Yuzu > Pistachio Grandeur > Lox in a bagel > Caramelized onion & cheddar. Main cons: shop is too small to serve all customer, have to queue & wait about 30 mins no matter take away or dine in. Besides, very limited car park.

author: Marie Gail Stratford
review_text: Absolutely amazing local sandwich shop! We had the turkey and brie panini (seasonal) and a gluten-free Top-Shelf Italian. Both were amazing. I grabbed a carmel apple cookie for the road afterward as well. Fantastic place for families. Friendly neighborhood vibe.

author: TCH
review_text: This morning I came to try this stall after a strong recommendation from a friend. Very old school taste of fried Bee Hoon Mee. Added Chicken Wing and Taukua. The chicken wing was well marinated tasted awesomely delicious. Worth the queue and I am told usually by 9am they are done and close for the day!

author: Amber Tidwell
review_text: Stopped in here during my stay and the gentleman working the counter was so welcoming and helpful. We couldn’t decide on one thing and ended up getting quite a few things. From the empanadas to the fall, the pastries. Everything was absolutely delicious. My favorite were the cookies/cakes Dulce de leche. We wanted to get by before we left town but didn’t make it. I was sad.

author: Stasi Michailidis
review_text: Absolutely fantastic experience at Mykonos Greek Restaurant in Sunny Isles! We hosted a group of 25 people, and the evening could not have been more perfect. From the moment we walked in, the manager Natalia and her incredible staff went above and beyond to ensure our event was magical. Every detail was thoughtfully attended to, and we truly felt like we were in the best hands. The food was out of this world – authentic, fresh, and bursting with flavor! From the appetizers to the main courses, every dish was a hit, with the grilled octopus and lamb chops stealing the show. The ambiance was second to none – a perfect blend of warm Greek hospitality and a lively, beautiful setting that transported us straight to the islands. We couldn’t have asked for a better experience. Thank you, Natalia, and the entire team at Mykonos for making our evening unforgettable! Highly recommend for anyone looking for an exceptional dining experience.

author: Fiona
review_text: Incredible Vietnamese food. Best I’ve ever had. Comfortable, organic, vibrant, culturally relevant atmosphere. The server was extremely thoughtful, the best service I have ever received in a restaurant. I’m extremely impressed and Ill be back! 😍

author: Stephanie Abil Vicente Gonzalez
review_text: It’s my first time here and I absolutely love this place. The atmosphere is excellent, and the service is outstanding. The quality of the food is truly 5-star—fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. The coffee is delicious and simply incomparable to any of the nearby places. The service is impressively fast, and the music is at the perfect volume, creating a very pleasant and welcoming ambiance. Overall, it’s an exceptional experience from start to finish.

author: L VK
review_text: To celebrate Cinco de Mayo we chose a fun local spot we hadn’t been to. Located on Flamingo Rd in Las Vegas, Los Cedros is definitely a great find. As a family-owned establishment, their dedication to authentic Mexican cuisine shines through in every dish. The Mexican-inspired explosion decor, adorned with Virgin de Guadalupe statues, Mexican art, fountains, colorful flags and flowers through and even intricately decorated bathrooms, creates a visually stunning atmosphere. Our dining experience was nothing short of spectacular. We were warmly greeted with complimentary chips and salsa, setting the tone for a fantastic meal. The guacamole was a standout with its generous serving and amazing flavors. The shrimp tacos, chicken tacos, and bean burrito were a delightful explosion of flavors that left us wanting to lick the plates. To complement our meal, we indulged in their margaritas in mango, strawberry, and pomegranate flavors. These cocktails were not only excellent but also generously poured and delightfully strong. The service at Los Cedros was great, friendly, fun, and incredibly attentive. Overall Los Cedros is an excellent find for anyone craving authentic Mexican cuisine in Vegas. From the decor to the food to the service, every aspect of our visit was exceptional. Highly recommended for a flavorful and memorable dining experience!

author: Stacy Feinberg
review_text: We have been going here for years now, it is amazing! So so so delicious! One of my favorite foods. It’s hard to describe how amazing the taste and quality is. My favorite item on the menu is spicy wonton.please go here! It’s amazing

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Victoria
review_text: We tried the small-sized pho bo — and it was absolutely delicious! 😍 The broth was rich and flavorful, with thin slices of beef. We also had the banh mi with pork — there was plenty of meat, everything was juicy and tasty. And the sweetest dog welcomed us 🐶 — such a lovely touch! Thank you so much for the amazing food and warm atmosphere 😊

author: Jane Le
review_text: We had lunch at this restaurant last Tuesday with our colleagues. • Venue: Conveniently located in the Chinatown area, near Maxwell MRT. • Reservations: Recommended, especially during peak hours. The restaurant is medium-sized, and reservations help you avoid the long queue. Reserved guests are given priority entry. • Opening Hours: Opens at 12:00 PM. • Atmosphere: Local-style setting with air conditioning — comfortable for a casual group lunch. • Service: Quite fast and efficient. • Food: My favourite dishes were the shrimp hor fun, black hor fun, and fried egg — all very tasty and satisfying. Especially all the shrimps are fresh, not frozen shrimp. • Cost: Around $270 for 12 people, which is reasonable for the portion and quality. • Overall: A solid lunch spot with good value. Will definitely come back to try other dishes.

author: Arika Mikirin
review_text: Good foods and enthusiated employees. Also have music. Feel really good.

author: Elaine SYL
review_text: Absolutely love this place! 😍 Affordable and super tasty Thai food with generous portions. The boss is incredibly friendly and always checks in to make sure the spice level suits you. Great spot for a casual meal without breaking the bank. Highly recommended! 🌶️🇹🇭

author: 布鲁塞尔糯米糍
review_text: I ordered the C2 hot-stone beef pho, which comes with raw beef slices and cooked beef brisket. On the side you get beef broth, scallions, bean sprouts, lemongrass, Thai basil, and fresh chili. The taste is very close to the classic pho I’ve had before. The stone bowl arrives piping hot, so you can cook the raw beef yourself, almost like a mini hot pot. Don’t rush it the way I did—if you add all the beef at once, it clumps together. Take your time and swish the slices in the broth for the best texture. The fresh chili is seriously spicy, so add with care. The chili sauce on the table packs heat too. The broth here is noticeably fresher and a touch sweeter than what I’ve had in Europe, and it tastes far less like MSG. European pho really does cut corners on slow-simmered stock. Overall, this bowl beats any pho I’ve tried in Europe or Japan. I can’t compare it to local Vietnamese spots since this is the only one I’ve tried so far, but I’ll definitely explore more next time. The shop itself is small, clean, and welcoming, with plenty of foreign visitors. Both card and cash are accepted.

author: Ny Delancy
review_text: I stumbled upon grand food Depot, purely by accident rushing around Los Angeles on a Friday afternoon, desperate to salvage a dinner party after my original caterer canceled last minute. Within a minute, they created a spread of fresh produce, artisan cheeses, specialty sauces and a selection of important spices that made my kitchen feel like a five star restaurant. Great food great service

author: J P
review_text: This place is definitely not worth going out of your way for. The selection was not very good. There were only 10 Chinese-American options in the buffet, the rest were things like chicken nuggets, desserts, salad, pizza. The food we tried wasn't great... It was edible. It didn't taste like it had gone rotten or rancid. Most items were hot enough in the steam tables. Nothing to write home about. The dining room looked fairly clean and I didn't stick to the table, which surprised me. At the end of dinner, I looked up, and you can see from the picture that they don't clean their ceiling vents or filters, so all that crud is falling and blowing into the food and onto your plates. I walked into the bathroom. It was gross. This bathroom hasn't been cleaned for more than a day. It was filthy everywhere. I hardly ever say bad stuff about a restaurant. I will never go back to this one because it was gross and I can't imagine how it passed health inspection, and the food wasn't great. Great prices, but not worth it

author: jayden
review_text: Felt only the bee hoon was nice(a little salty was still had the traditional local bee hoon taste), the other small one stick finger food was not nice, quality isn't there, can taste it's of a lower quality frozen kind. Quite pricey though as compared to the other stalls around the area with portion and quality.

author: Tommy Tang
review_text: This place is wildly famous! Though the street-level sign is so small you'd easily miss it. Entering the first floor feels like walking into a condemned building. You'll need to navigate narrow, steep stairs up to the third floor. The coffee and cakes? Decent but forgettable. The staff are lovely though - which almost makes up for the completely uninspired food.

author: Dave
review_text: Visited High Tide Bistro and Bar on a Friday evening with a group of friends, and overall, it was a pleasant experience. The food was solid — not extraordinary, but definitely above average. One standout for me was the satay. While I’ve had great satay at hawker centres, this one felt like an elevated version you’d expect at a proper restaurant — juicy, well-seasoned, and grilled just right. The only slight letdown was the limited beer selection, which could’ve been better given the setting. The atmosphere was lovely. Although it wasn’t a wide, open sea view, we still enjoyed the breeze coming off the water and the calming seaside vibe. Visiting during sunset made the experience even more enjoyable — the golden hour light and cool breeze created a great backdrop for a relaxed dinner. As for the service, it was fine — nothing particularly memorable, but not lacking either. Some responses from the staff felt a bit slow, which was noticeable at times, but didn’t majorly impact our evening. One thing to note is the accessibility. We came by Grab, and the drop-off/pick-up area wasn’t very clearly marked, which might be confusing for first-timers. Not sure about parking options since we didn’t drive. Overall, a nice spot to unwind with friends by the sea, especially if you’re looking for a chill evening with good vibes and a few standout dishes

author: Anny Phan
review_text: so good! i ordered the #1 special and it was so filling, it's actually quite a large banh mi so if you don't eat that much i'd suggest sharing it with someone

author: Justin Lim
review_text: The best Nasi Lemak in town! Even though it’s a bit pricey, I’m still happy to pay more for such a delicious dish. The dine-in environment is also impressive, the floor and tables are cleaned frequently, and the whole place feels very clean and bright

author: Natalia Morgunova
review_text: I think this place needs to be visited by the department of sanitation. Barefoot belly dancers climb up on the tables (and encourage guests to do so too) and then food is served on these tables without so much as a wipe down. That’s just disgusting. The food was very good, however the atmosphere not so much. Seems like this place has an identity crisis and doesn’t know if it’s a restaurant or a club. Even at 6pm the music was so loud that you could not hear the waiter, nevermind trying to have a conversation with people you are dining with. Also everything is extremely cramped, so you barely have any room and you are constantly being bumped against by people trying to pass.

author: Pui Yee
review_text: Great food and service! The quality of the meat is good and even the other dishes were delicious (steamed egg and kimchi soup). Will come back again! :)

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: H FG
review_text: Excellent food and great customer service!!! Been coming here for years, I love their egg soup

author: Federico Pizzuto
review_text: What an amazing experience and place! We loved this place and the food. Also, service was over the top in its simplicity but attention. They took care of us and they were all nice with great recommendations and also, taking the time to answer to some of our curious questions. Especially, the Japanese server (I think Yu)… he was extraordinary and made us become passionate about ramen and Japanese food. Going to the food… the “Chashu” Rice ball was delicious; the “Tsukune” ban was yummy and I wished I got more; we love the “Gyoza”… among the best I have ever had in the city; the “Tonchin Classic Tokyo Tonkotsu” was very delicious and I couldn’t stop eating it… my wife got the “Dipping noodles - Original Tsukemen” and they were also amazing!!! Finally, the “Mango Kaki-gori” was a nice surprise. The place it is minimalistic, but very cozy. We had great time and we will definitely keep going there any time we are in NYC. Tonchin… well done and keep going!!!

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Amy Huynh
review_text: We walked into this restaurant it really knowing what to expect. To our surprise the food is really delicious. We ordered a few dishes to share and our waitress Nhung gave some excellent recommendations. Every dishes we had was very good. The restaurant was quiet and calm, really fit the theme. Definitely recommend trying. Nhung was our sever and she did a great job!

author: Katy Rodríguez
review_text: This was my first time here and from the moment I walked in I felt welcomed! They helped me understand the menu, let me take my time and were extremely helpful. Well, when I got to the dining area it was absolutely gorgeous!! I felt relaxed and at home even… then came the food!!! I have eaten jerk chicken in Jamaica and I think all over the Caribbean and the jerk chicken here has to be one of the best jerk chicken I’ve ever had in my life!! I was also lucky enough to have gotten the shrimp (at an extra cost, but completely worth it!!). This restaurant has got by far the best Jamaican food I have ever had in my life!!!! The service from everyone including the bartenders is superb I recommend this restaurant to anyone who is in Downtown Miami looking for a good time and AMAZING JAMAICAN FOOD!!!!!!!

author: Danika Rose
review_text: From a cultural standpoint, great - the locals definitely thrive off the tourism however they must know the word “no” as the pushing gets old, they pester & follow you making you feel obligated to say yes, they also charge Australian prices, if you’re not bartering you’re definitely getting ripped off. The locals less polite here, making you feel very rude for saying no. The toilets are 10baht & you’re rushed, cultural shock for us aussies. They physically drag you away/grab your arm/ follow you for the adult shows, we felt especially bad for the men as the women just wouldn’t stop no matter how many times they said no or try to walk away.. it’s a whole new level of persistent, we saw men physically have to pull the ladies hands off them even if they had girlfriends. Thai ladies would guilt men saying “you no think I’m beautiful” and act sad guilting men. There are also male adult shows however the men aren’t nearly as persistent as the women. We did it once because we’re in Thailand but we will probably never come back to this market

author: Abby Goldschmidt
review_text: The food here was awesome!! Our only complaints were that they were sold out of crab by 8 pm and that the amount of pork in the pork salad was too little. We loved it so much!!! Just wanted more pork but so worth it. We waited in line for 45 minutes which was a lot for a Monday night BUT we ate before which I highly recommend. I want to come back just to try the crab omelet because we got the shrimp one instead and it was amazing as well.

author: Marisol Peña
review_text: Tasty meals , HONEST and kind staff. We lost a bag with our passports and cash which was returned with everything inside!!!! We really want to thank all the staff and wish them the best luck!!😊

author: Wina Huang
review_text: Very spacious restaurant! Easily fit 100people. they have a private hall at 2nd floor too. food is okay with reasonable price.

author: Sankar Shaji
review_text: Tiptop is one of our go-to food stalls in the Changi airport terminal now during our long layovers. Some of the items maybe slightly priced higher than other stalls out there. But in comparison, the taste more than makes up for it. I loved the chicken curry puff so much. And the fried egg bee Hon here was better than the one we had earlier from one of the other stalls. Even the iced coffee was better overall.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Minh Vũ Quang
review_text: Delicious grilled spring rolls, free noodles and vegetables per person. Food comes out quickly.

author: arpita
review_text: Quaint place to eat in Boston. I'm from Texas and don't get opportunity to eat outside. This was perfect time to do people watching while eating good food. My son is picky and he finished his plate. Reasonably priced.

author: Mah Yan Mei
review_text: Delicious seafood in KL! The Boleh Seafood Pot is a must try! Super fresh and flavourful. We also had Black Pepper Crab, Fried Garlic Kangkung, Salted Egg Sotong, and Buttermilk Chicken, all cooked perfectly. Highly recommend!

author: Not A Lie
review_text: Ordered tacos and got burnt tacos with black char on the sides with the most basic ingredients in the tacos that they were flavorless. If the chef burns his food, just toss it and redo it!!! At least there were chips and salsa on the side to snack in. Sadly this was a togo order so I only noticed that it was bad when I was already at a beach and there was nothing I could do about it. At least the servers and hostess were nice and helpful in the restaurant.

author: Cherry
review_text: The café used to be amazing, but the quality has dropped recently. Croissants and bakes are still decent, and the vanilla almond latte is good, but it’s not quite the same. The second floor is a nice escape from the crowd, though the broken toilet and floating stairs make it less convenient and unsafe for kids.

author: Iqwan
review_text: Just landed in SG and came in for a late night meal. The food was great and hit the spot. We were served by Pat, who was an absolute superstar. She explained the recommendations expertly and served with a smile. 10/10 service - will return.

author: Leandro Alonso
review_text: We had a great time at Bubba Gump! The food was delicious, the service was excellent, and the atmosphere was very pleasant. The only downside was that the music was way too loud, it made it hard to have a conversation. Other than that, everything was really enjoyable. 🇺🇸

author: Hammerhead
review_text: Hidden in a nice secluded alley. Serving great western food. Top notch in term of food quality. Service is great as well and love the vibe and the environment.

author: Sean Mitchell
review_text: Fantastic food, great prices, lovely people. I go here all the time, I choose the special.

author: SeefoodEatfood
review_text: Honestly it was so damn flipping good. I enjoyed every bite of the Vietnamese loco moto. The owner is very friendly and nice. The environment is quiet and great to enjoy your meal. Deserves 10 stars!!

author: Tim Noonen
review_text: We were in Boston for a couple of days and looking for seafood. We made reservations through open table and we were immediately seated near the back windows. The view of the harbor is amazing. Our server was young and a little nervous, but super friendly and after a little conversation she relaxed and was really friendly and helpful. We ordered the seafood tower for two and it was outstanding ... 4 oysters, 4 clams, 1/2 lobster, 4 shrimp, and tuna tartar. All were outstanding quality. For the main course I selected the clams and my partner ordered the fettuccine with clams. My clams were good and cooked well, but i would probably order something else the next time. My partners dish was tasty, but a little heavy on the pancetta. Overall, we had a great experience at Legal Seafood

author: Krystal Quiles
review_text: Mike and Bernice were amazing, the cornbread was excellent and very fluffy and sweet. I’m eager to dive into this meal because it smells delightful. The whiting always fresh- It’s my favorite.

author: Xinyang Long
review_text: 好吃，推荐。Local friend took me here, good atmosphere, authentic and delicious food, nice location and attitudes, will visit again if comes to Jakarta again.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: RS San
review_text: The hostess is very friendly, and the noodle soup is delicious!

author: Raneesha Jackson
review_text: I love the atmosphere & aesthetic. I love how dark & moody the vibes were. I enjoyed the music and live DJ. Jimmy was very pleasant, he went above and beyond with exceptional customer service. I would highly recommend this restaurant to everyone. Also most importantly the food was finger licking good. Don’t forget to try the rum cake! You won’t regret it.

author: Jiahui Jiang
review_text: I mostly order their briskets which is a five star. Other things I tried there were mediocre. Ordering online then picking up later is super convenient

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: Anne Marie Kim
review_text: We got to taste the authentic boat noodle at this place. There is a parking further down. And it has a beautiful garden that is so well-maintained. The boat noodle has a flavourful thick soup, the best we’ve tried. My friends tried their basil rice and stew pork rice - both are good. We also tried the dessert, which is the Thai equivalent of “kuih talam”. This is definitely a place to return to!

author: Mel
review_text: The soup broth for our noodles was rather watered down, good if you’re looking for something light and flavours that are not overpowering. The pork balls are springy and has a good bite! Would go back again for the pork balls.

author: Andrew SP
review_text: Ribs dry and not as easily pulled as it used to be. Lacking taste as well. Was definitely expecting a lot better. Service was good, but we came for the food. Pork knuckle also tastes quite bland, although the skin was still quite crackly.

author: Vincent Li
review_text: Chicken sandwich and fries both came out cold. Also they charged us for an extra grilled cheese sandwich and when we brought it up they said it would get fixed before they charged it but it didn't. Food looked good, but 100% not worth

author: Min Min
review_text: Cool restaurant, delicious food, reasonable price, the owner is very cute and friendly. Will always support the restaurant.

author: Ava
review_text: I loved the cocktails here!🍹and my favorite dish was the baby back ribs. The place feels tight when it starts to get busy, but has great service. If I come back I’ll probably do it for dinner, I think the view and atmosphere are better at night.

author: fu ching
review_text: Thanks to Dekwi, I had an amazing experience at this Bali cafe! Really appreciated for your lovely service and help me to fill my bottle with iced water, such a life-saver. The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, perfect for a relaxing meal. I ordered the all-day breakfast, and it exceeded my expectations — the food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The staff was incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure I had everything I needed. Excellent service combined with delicious food makes this cafe a must-visit. Highly recommend for a satisfying and enjoyable dining experience in Bali! -By Michelle

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: Catherine Huynh
review_text: Such a dissopointment. Booked a table 2 days in advance and was excited for it as reviews were good. Architecture is immaculate but it doesnt compensate for the food. Spring rolls were decent but the veggies with it meh. Farm chicken hot pot was disastrous, we didnt enjoy it at all. Practically no chicken, only veggies and rice noodles. High prices so expected a lot more than this. Craft beers were the only good thing. Service couldve been more attentive at a place like this, got better service in pizza 4p.

author: Simmie Wong
review_text: I think i like the pickle most. Apart from banh mi, this is also their traditional breakfast. Good to give it a try. It is a roadside stall and i arrived 830am on weekday. Not much people and no waiting time

author: Damika
review_text: My first time eating here and the food along with the customer service was phenomenal!

author: Jairo Sanchez
review_text: We dined at this peruvian restaurant as a family with the hopes it would reflect the culinary excellence my country of origin provides for this wonderful city. Unfortunately, the experience left much to be desired. The so called food, lacked the authenticity and the flavors and freshness we were expecting as peruvian people with much background in this culinarily realm. Several dishes were bland and underwhelming. To make matters worse, we noticed discrepancies in our bill, a 25% CHARGE ON TAXES... unjustifiable, treachery at its finest, especially for the regulars that come around this establishment. We value supporting peruvian establishments, but this was a straightforward let down. I genuinely hope they take feedback from my comment here today, and improve their ethics, quality, and their integrity of their billing practices specifically.

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: Charles Chen
review_text: Tasty, cheap and popular with the locals. Springy egg noodles are the way to go. The crispy pork belly was super crisp. Clean ‘street food’ you can rely on in Bangkok.

author: Shelby Rice
review_text: My favorite place we ate in Las Vegas. Our waitress was so friendly and seemed passionate about the food and history of the place. I got the Pad Thai which was good, but I sampled the Pad Si Eew and it was on another level. Savory, a hint of sweetness. Would recommend that. They were out of the Mango Sticky rice which ended up being a pleasant surprise. The Ube Creme Brulee was SO DELICIOUS. The crisp, burnt sugar coating covered the whole dish. The ube custard below was thick and a perfect consistency. Highly recommend this restaurant.

author: Benya
review_text: DECENT The crunchy Ovaltine spread was divine but the toasted bread was so-so - it could use more toasting, making it more crispy on the outside. The menu toasted bread dip was awesome though - the texture was just right.

author: Kenny Thirza
review_text: They have lagre parking lot of car and motorcycle. Nice paddy field view. See the menu as attached, they have lot of items. Nice and friendly staff.

author: Robert Llc
review_text: PLS BE AWARE OF THIS TOGOS, THE WHOLE ORDER WAS WRONG AND MESSED UP, THE CASHIER OVERCHARGED US, $5.00 FOR CHIPS?? WOW, THE STAFF IS VERY RUDE AND ARGUMENTATIVE! NEVER GOING BACK TO THIS LOCATION. DISHONEST AND UNEDUCATED STAFF!!

author: Thao Le
review_text: Staffs are so nice and service is good. However, if you stop serving any course, please take it out of the menu.

author: Michael Mandle
review_text: If heaven had a food court, Piton Coffee & Catery would definitely be running the snack bar. Every dish was unreal — truffle fries addictive, wings spiritual, cordon bleu dangerously good. The coffee? Life-changing. I don’t usually review big spots, but I added this to my exception list My exceptions, I do not review a place with over 1,000 reviews unless: -The sever asks me to -The food is busting

author: Mark Lim
review_text: Where to start? It's a western cafe for sure. Simple deco and open kitchen. What's worth is the set lunch. A larte price is slight higher probably due to location. Thats my opinion. There are 3 choices to choose from for set lunch, 2 chicken and 1 fish. Sides selection have multiple. I would prefer an option of coffee or tea aside from only fruit punch. Overall food were nice. Note: pork free

author: Jheems (陳國敬)
review_text: Healthy food and good atmosphere in the restaurant to enjoy one meal with your love one

author: S Marie
review_text: Nice café with a good view and fine for a quick stop, but the drinks were disappointing. I asked for Vietnamese coffee for my latte, and they didn’t have it, which was surprising. The baristas also weren’t flexible with adjusting the sweetness or replacing the sweet milk with fresh milk. The service was okay, but the overall experience was average at best.

author: Anna Maro
review_text: I’m going to just say it: I had the best cup of black coffee here. The best cup of coffee I’ve ever had in the US. Do whatever you want with this info, but I know the ball, so it’s safe to trust me.

author: Thomas Saw
review_text: This neighborhood has good mix of old & new HDB estate and MRT entrance is nearby 10 min walking distance. The Mee Siam ($4)from Hup Hup stall is good as recommended & the soup not sour like muslin type but alittle sweetness toward Nonya. The mee hoon is well cooked with evenly mee siam powder color & the tao por is cut edible piece size, unlike other stalls cut small pieces. In the same roll stalls at corner has fried carrot cake stall 333. They sell white, black or mix ($4.5) carrots cake and may take awhile to cook. The white carrot cake taste like old school style and has little egg in it, but the black carrot cake taste better.

author: Online Support
review_text: Unbelievably delicious ceviche and snapper. Highly recommended. Staff is top notch as well!

author: Janice Chang
review_text: better make reservation during weekends, they open at 530pm. many varieties of raw and ready eat food, i especially like the moopin and the mushroom soup. Free flow of ice cream and drinks, my all time favourite is the lemongrass drink..

author: Bentrice Jusu
review_text: The cornbread is actually amazing! The fish, fried to perfection, you hear me?! Hassan and Mike were incredibly hospitable and treated my complicated order with ease and care. Every time I come in, There’s a diverse crowd (Asian, Black, Hispanic, white men and women, and the food ALWAYS looks so delicious. Definitely a staple on broad street, and with it being right across from city hall, well I think they are here to stay! Would recommend 10/10!!!

author: King Tohoku
review_text: Famous for its crab fried rice, which is surprisingly not too salty. Prices are very reasonable, and they even support cross-border QR payment, super convenient!

author: K M
review_text: It's open 24 hours! Kopi is very nice. Beehoon with chicken wing is a good homely meal before you leave the country.

author: Ellen B Cutler
review_text: Saw Brassica recommended in the Boston Globe--among other restaurants--for a visit from the Michelin people. A foodie cousin was all in for a visit. We both took the T, she a couple of stops in JP, me, a bit more of a trek from East Boston. So getting there without a car is easy-peasy. We had reservations although probably not required on a Wednesday at 5:30. Charming. Casual. A bit noisy. Our server was prompt with drinks and explained the recommended approach: plates are small, so share. Foodie cousin and I opted for 3 plates: sole, flatbread margarita, salad. Weren't sure how much food it would be and it was plenty. Server started us on the fish and brought pizza and salad together. Perfect! Not cheap but excellent value. A wonderful time was had all round. We'll be back.

author: Our_Discoveries5
review_text: My experience at TG’s Bistro was excellent, and it’s one of the best options in Bukit Bintang for tasty, quick, and affordable meals. The restaurant offers a wide variety of Indian and Malaysian dishes such as roti, biryani, and masala — all fresh, flavorful, and satisfying. I tried the cheesy roti, and it was delicious, especially with the accompanying sauces. The atmosphere is simple and casual, and despite being busy, the place is clean and well-organized. The service is fast, friendly, and the staff are very helpful. Being open 24/7 makes it a perfect spot for late-breakfast, dinner, or a quick meal anytime. A great experience overall, and I would absolutely come back again.

author: Mark Merren
review_text: Ordered Chana Masala. The chickpeas were completely mushy, almost like a gravy. Didn’t seem fresh. As if it was old and reheated in the pan. I watched them reheat the rice in the microwave. And the Aloo Naan lacked flavor. It was late and was looking for a vegan option. Completely disappointed. I wasted $20. I couldn’t eat any of it all. Upside is the staff was very polite. Never going there again though.

author: Olena Voloshchuk
review_text: I ordered one combo and a separate burger. They charged me for two combos instead and then said they couldn’t refund me because the manager was not in on weekends. I'm going to point out that I was asked multiple times if I wanted to make it a combo and I said no every time and they still gave me two combos instead of just one. I'm very disappointed. I’m sorry but 26$ is ridiculously expensive for processed food. I’m not coming here again.

author: Darrell Maule (Dagga)
review_text: Very nice and pleasant joint, workers are very friendly and food is pretty tasty. Only real downside is the long wait for food depending on the amount of customers. Overall would recommend....

author: Stephanie Hanshaw
review_text: My husband and I flew into Vegas to pick up a rental van in this area and had some time to kill. We stopped here for lunch and it was so good! They let us place our luggage in the booth with us, provided excellent customer service, and my shrimp tacos were SO GOOD! Fresh guac and fresh salsa as well. Highly recommend!

author: Jennifer Shannon
review_text: I loved this place! Will come back and go again if ever in town! Breakfast food was really good! Can tell it’s homemade and high quality ingredients. They have a nice selection. And good coffee options as well! It is on the pricier side but anything near the ports are expensive.

author: Josh Friedlander
review_text: Exceptional food. The oysters are a Religious experience. The paella is very good. The pan con tomate is worth the carbs. The chocolate ganache dessert will end you. For the quality of the food, the prices are reasonable. I recommend you eat here while you can get a table.

author: Ofi
review_text: The queue is long but fast service. The room was big, so you'll get table. Went there at 8.30 pm and still a lot of people to wait. The taste was good. My first time tried nasi kandar so i can't compare how good this nasi kandar is. Overall was good!

author: Khushi Nakum
review_text: My parents and I stopped by for dinner when I first moved in to USC housing. Now we go for lunch whenever they’re in town to visit. It’s super close to campus, so it’s convenient for students. There’s a large menu and the food is flavorful and well made. The staff are also friendly. Highly recommend!

author: Chaithawat Dongcharoaen
review_text: I recently visited CHUNN Restaurant in Ekkamai and had a really enjoyable experience. The atmosphere is modern and lively, yet it remains cozy enough for a relaxed dinner. The menu offers creative twists on classic dishes, and every plate I tried was full of fresh flavors and beautifully presented. Whether you’re planning a casual hangout with friends or a special night out, CHUNN in Ekkamai is definitely worth checking out. Highly recommended for beef lovers 🙃

author: Jo Atfo
review_text: Can't believe I never came here. The food was so good, except for the vegetarian paella...a hard pass never again. Had the mushrooms and salad, delish. And oh man, that dipping sauce they give with the bread was amazing! Sangria was ok.

author: Jose Vazquez
review_text: This place is awesome.its atmosphere great..server lady from Colombia taking care of us always with a great smile .you need more servers like her on your place ..sure we will be back for your food ..and your service great way to go Colombian lady keep going like that and very soon you will be the manager from the place ..

author: Erin Johnston
review_text: Probably my favorite slice in NYC so far. Had the burrata slice and a Pesto sausage special. Crust is very good. Crispy on the bottom and thin but with a nice chew. Flavorful. Ingredients and toppings were all high quality. Pricey for a slice of pizza but in this case, it’s worth it! Visited on a Thursday around 4:30pm and no line/no wait.

author: BRYY
review_text: Everything from customer service to food quality was great. The portioning of the family meal is definitely a great deal, i plan on getting it again soon. The chicken was not overcooked nor undercooked. It was juicy & hot. Made fresh, tasteful. Rice tasted fresh as well. Rolls were nice & soft. The only thing I did not understand was the employee standing outside in the scorching heat when there was no cars around at all. My wife & I felt for her. Should be inside if no customers are around. Other than that. Everything was great. Appreciate this location.

author: Yelo JC
review_text: Excellent experience at Cơm Niêu Chú Chen! 🌟 The Vietnamese food here is simply spectacular: authentic, flavorful, and perfectly balanced. The rice cooked in a clay pot is a delight, and watching it being served is a truly memorable experience. The dishes are beautifully presented, and the portions are generous. The atmosphere is cozy and charming, ideal for a quiet meal or a meal with friends. The staff is very friendly, always smiling, and willing to explain the dishes or offer recommendations. Without a doubt, one of the best Vietnamese restaurants in the heart of Quận 1. I will definitely be back! 🇻🇳✨ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: Lior Singer
review_text: This place deserves a Michelin star. Whoever created the dishes was extremely accurate and creative with the flavor combinations. I gave five stars before, but this place truly deserves it. The food deserves to win awards. Thank you so much for having us!

author: Rachel Butler
review_text: Loved this place overall - incredible food and $5 cocktails at happy hour. Great location on a corner in Coconut Grove too

author: P Hamilton
review_text: Closest location to work!! So it was busy, but served quickly. Food was great!!

author: Sabs A
review_text: These plates were well-worth the long line, outdoors, in the rain. The aguachile scallops were filled with flavor that left my tongue tingling on occasion. This was my first time having sea urchin, but the creaminess and freshness of all the seafood was memorable. I don’t think the urchin made the dish - the scallops and salsa would have been great on their own, but the urchin added some nice buttery texture that added to it. I can’t wait to return!

author: Parker Fitzgerald
review_text: Joey & Erica are the best! I went here the other night with a friend and I must say that I was very impressed. It is by far one of my new favorite pizza spots here in Las Vegas. I had two slices of pizza (pepperoni & cheese) and also the Philly Philly which was also very good. Cannot wait to be back soon. TRUE FACT: Their bread comes from Jersey and their steak comes from Philly! Makes the food very good high quality and top notch!

author: Poh Tuen
review_text: The prices at Hameediyah are approximately 20% higher than at most Nasi Kandar establishments in Penang. Personally, I found the flavors somewhat bland, despite my preference for food that is not overly salty or sweet. The spice level is mild, and the aromatic curry lacks the richness typically expected. I recommend adding salted egg to help balance the subtle flavors and enhance the overall taste. This reflects my personal experience. *** Dine In *** Qty Item Price (RM) 1 White Rice 2.00 1 Regular Onion Chicken 12.00 2 Mutton Curry @ 10.00 20.00 1 Lady’s Finger (1 plate) 2.50 1 Salted Egg 1.70 Subtotal (6 items): 38.20 Net Total: 38.20

author: Abby Y
review_text: Chanced upon this place which was fairly booked but had space for walk-in. Large indoor dining area comprising of 2 shop spaces, with air-conditioning and looks clean. Qr code given to make orders, which allowed customisation eg less salt, no msg etc. San lou beehoon was great! Well seasoned with slignt char and wok hey. Sambal kangkong- cant fault that. Deep fried pork belly was crunchy with good ratio of fat and meat.

author: Emily D
review_text: Definitely returning for the tacos whenever I'm in the area. Got the chorizo, chicken, and carne asada. All were an absolute hit. They did need more of a punch like some lime juice or vinegar-based hot sauce to elevate the flavors, but wow the tortilla, which they make right in front of you fresh, and the meats are awesome. Highly recommend all three meats. Ordering was easy and fast. They take card and cash. For three tacos, I paid $8.50 out the door. Covered seating right next to the prep area. Parking is street parking, so may be tricky to find, but I got a spot just around the corner in no time. Coming back to try more of their menu items!

author: Kenny Yap
review_text: Perfect date spot. Food was good but I wouldn’t say mindblowing. Didn’t have to reserve and manage to get seated immediately on a Wednesday evening. Favorite for me was the pork collar, followed by the crab, the egg, then the vermicelli. The salmon was a let down for me, the quality felt like it was frozen and recently thawed only so it was quite hard. I didn’t enjoy the sauce either it felt very bland.

author: J L
review_text: Okay, I didn't want to write but I was asked. We were not made aware of the holiday surcharge. The rice was a bit tasteless and we couldn't chew the pork. Atmosphere and views were good, however not worth 4 flights of stairs and this price.

author: Ong
review_text: It's been a long time since I visited a nice Thai Zichar style restaurant. The food here are amazing and the standout has got to be the curry crab and prawn woonsen. The glass noodle are super tasty and must try. Every dish are easily a 7/10 up.

author: Irving Jaramillo
review_text: The best chilaquiles in south central 🔥🔥🔥🤤 now these what u call some loaded chilaquiles with steak asada fire 10/10 shoutout to the cooks 🫡🙏🫶🏽 THIS PLACE SHI ON ALBERTS ON HP

author: Natalia Ciobanu
review_text: TIKI TIKI – Hollywood, FL We had a lovely dining experience at TIKI TIKI, a waterfront restaurant with a relaxed, tropical atmosphere. The décor is casual and inviting, and the setting by the water really adds to the charm. One of the highlights is that boats can dock directly next to the restaurant deck, which gives the place a unique marina vibe and makes it especially enjoyable. The food was mostly excellent. We had fresh raw oysters, a very flavorful seafood chowder, and the pasta with lobster was delicious, rich, and well prepared. The cocktails were also very good — refreshing and nicely balanced. The only downside was the stone crab, which unfortunately was a bit overcooked and didn’t quite meet expectations (as in my food experience in Keys 😉 )compared to the rest of the meal. Overall, it was a pleasant experience with quality ingredients, a beautiful waterfront setting, and a great atmosphere. With a bit more attention to cooking the seafood, this place could be outstanding.☺️

author: Danny Mcguiness
review_text: Newark is really cool, never been here, coming to see a hockey game and came for lunch and whatba great surprise, white table cloth and servers all over, great service, the bread was great, complimentary soup, very tasty, we had the roast pork quesdilla very nice and flavorful and I had bone in chicken in a sherry sauce, super good, desserts were tasty as well! Super old school classy feel, will fo again.

author: Minh Nguyễn Hoàng
review_text: The restaurant has a clean and comfortable atmosphere. The staff are friendly, polite, and provide quick service, especially the staff member Tan Si The food is served promptly and looks very appealing. The taste is well-balanced and delicious, matching my expectations. Prices are reasonable for the quality. A great place to enjoy a meal with friends or family. I will definitely come back again.

author: Tasheena S
review_text: I hidden gem! I came here for a solo brunch date on a Saturday. The service and views were perfect. This is the perfect hidden gem. Restaurants by the water is always so beautiful. The food was delicious! I decided to have the red snapper and eggs. It was so good. I can't wait to visit again to try something else off the menu.

author: Celeste Lee
review_text: We accidentally walked into the wrong Tuck Kee restaurant, but luckily realized it while ordering. The baby octopus dish was really fresh and tasty, but the rest of the dishes were just so-so. Overall, it was an okay experience."

author: Rose Wolner
review_text: Celebrated my birthday tonight at IL Poeta. I don't order calves liver often, but tonight's dish was cooked to my liking...tender and moist. Service and ambiance was terrific! Bravo Mario for making my birthday a memorable one!

author: boub bou
review_text: Great portion for the price, and the food came really fast. Really love the claypot golden chicken from here, one of the best chicken menu i ever had! Will come back for the curry fish head next time.

author: Cham Nizam
review_text: From the moment we stepped onto the 56th-floor terrace, we were greet with a jaw-dropping smile of Kia, Tasya charming personality and Glow brought us to visit the dining area before we heading to the lounge. Both area atmosphere struck the perfect balance between chic and relaxed. Great vibes! Ringgo comes in with his awesome asean hospitality. Riassa, Bunga, Ian and Catarina represent the team synergy. Tasirwan played role well too! Price is equal with it's offerings. Toilet well clean everytime. Moga sukses semuanya! Cheers from Malaysia!

author: Helen King-Searfoss
review_text: I was so excited to go to dinner at Hells Kitchen in Miami. However, for as popular as the tv show is, we were surprised how difficult it was to actually find the restaurant downtown. Once there, the food was good, but very expensive. I expected my scallops to mimic what I’ve seen on tv, but rec’d 3, not 5 (they were good though!) and the lobster risotto didn’t come with a chuck of lobster on top like what I’ve seen on tv either (again still very good!) It will most likely be a one and done on price alone, but the atmosphere was nice.

author: Amanda Antonino
review_text: This place is terrible. The service sucked. We all got our food at a different time. They sold one of our meals to someone else and told us it was gonna be 30 to 45 minute wait for them to make it again after we’ve already been here for an hour. Don’t waste your money go somewhere else.

author: Prima Shella
review_text: Went here twice during my stay in Da Nang. The cafe is well shaded and very cool even though it is scorching hot outside. Here's the menu I tried: - Peanut Butter Cream Coffee (original and white) - The balance between the peanut butter cream and coffee is very delicious, the cream is smooth and velvety, combined with strong coffee below - I prefer the original one, but the white coffee one is also good (creamier) - Brown Coffee Saigon style - I guess it's kind of like shaken espresso coffee. It has a very unique taste - creamy and the coffee is bold - Caramel flan - I think this is one of the best flan I have ever eaten, it's not overly sweet and it's very creamy They even sell coffee beans which is very affordable (140k VND) - available in whole beans / grinded Overall one of the best coffee I had in vietnam. Will definitely visit again when I came back to Da Nang !

author: Gvel Cmajor
review_text: If you haven't been, YOU NEED TO visit this gem in Hyde Park.
