Service is great, food is amazing and the patrons seem like friends from the neighborhood decided to go eat at the same time. Lol. My wife and I went around 1230 for brunch on a Sunday. I'll be honest, for two brunch meals at 35 a pop, 2 mimosas a piece and 2 desserts to go, the price was 200. 🤯 just don't get the mimosas. Lol but this is an absolute must! You'll thank me later. Oh, yeah, the DJ and music was so on point! I just wish the volume was a tad lower. But all in all no complaints!

author: Harrison K
review_text: Great BBQ! I love the Latino influence in the BBQ flavors! Meat was falling off the bone. Sorry, I hit the ribs before taking the pic 😁. You have to try the hatch chili Mac n cheese. Only downfall is there are a lot of hard surfaces in the dining area and sound echos a lot. For most folks that's fine but I have some hearing damage in one ear and it was hard to have a conversation. Even with that said, I'm still going back!

author: Connush B
review_text: The restaurant is nice, however the tables are too close to each other and it is loud so it is difficult to talk in private. Food is average but affordable. Service is friendly and attentive.

author: Han Nguyen
review_text: The owner is cute, the restaurant is cheap, the service is good, worth visiting

author: Fiona Tan
review_text: Crab meat is tasteless and mantis prawn only taste garlic taste. Totally wasted for such delicious and precious Ingredients. The only yummy part is the egg and the green chili 🥲 Cost THB 850 and worst than street food. Too bad! Too disappointed and overrated. I wonder how they got the Michelin For many years.

author: V Cat
review_text: If i could give 0 stars i would. I go in to the drive thru make my order. A few minutes later im told to park my car and go inside to pick up my food. I go inside there is a group of people waiting and showing the workers their receipts of what they ordered. I told the worker if i or anybody who used the drive thru wanted to park our cars come in to pick up the food we not have used the drive thru in the first place. Next thing I over hear the employees asking one another whose order is whose and whose order is next in front of the customers present. I regret not asking for my mobey back. My food arrives no apology given. This place needs better management. If you are overwhelmed or short staff. Put sign up to have customers not use the drive thru and just take orders one by one 1 line at the cashier so people will get there food, the person at the grill wont be overwhelmed and orders will not get mixed up.

author: Samuel1992 California
review_text: Everywhere the place are still in old fashioned and the toilet, locations and corridor have a small gap, MP in charge please wake up your idea. Got money and never closed down the coffeeshop for 1 month and replace the toilet from squat to seat toilet. What the heck and the people needs to have their mindset fixed. At least the carpark got the under shelter and other places like traffic light needs a high shelter. Please get LTA to investigate the location to replace the toilet

author: MR DL
review_text: Very hidden! After walking up a number of stairs, you're rewarded by a fabulous private terrace with wonderful locally made food, set against a fantastic skyline. The service is excellent and the food is superb. A great place to dine. Not noisy, calm and respectful. Give it a go... and keep it secret!

author: Yong Zhou
review_text: We usually come here when we're nearby shopping for groceries. It's usually not crowded before 2 p.m. on Sundays. There's a wide selection of crayfish, seafood, crab, duck, pork, chicken, sushi, hibachi, fruit, and more, so if you're hungry, you'll likely be able to fill up easily. The food is just okay. Don't expect the same quality and taste as you'd get at a specialty restaurant. However, considering the price we paid, I think it's well worth it.

author: Chris T
review_text: We went earlier before dinner crowd. First timw for parents eating here. Few times for me as usual the food is good. Portion and price is just right. The curry soup is nice 👍🏻

author: Loowee
review_text: Located in a regular shopping plaza, front entrance doesn't suggest that there is a restaurant there. Once inside, its small and very clean, purposely designed just like most east coast pizzarias. Service was very good and welcoming. I ordered a slice of Sicilian cheese. The sauce on the pizza was magical. You can tell the quality. The crust although was tick but was also airy which made it easy to eat. I definitely recommend and will be back soon.

author: Mike Mu
review_text: Handcrafted drinks in a nice setting with plenty of seats and tables. You also get to drink out of one-of-a-kind pieces of cups made by Sue. Internet is slow, but that's probably Comcast's fault. I enjoyed my charcoal ube. It was a bit warm inside (we sat at gallery side, as it was busy). Great place to do bit of reading, some work, or have a pastry. Sold out of croissants when we got here on the weekend.

author: Nolianto Ananda
review_text: Indonesian cuisine, tons of menus, mostly delicious. Nice and cozy place, helpful and friendly staff. Worth it.

author: Ashley Gomes
review_text: Everything is good but sometimes y'all employees be going to work with stank attitudes but other then that y'all good

author: Jasper Teo
review_text: First time trying this outlet and I can see why the reviews are high. Ordered their main item, the soup BCM and was pleasantly impressed by the flavour. Slightly herby taste in the soup, with lots of bak chor and also fried pork skin. The wantons are pretty big too! And there were at least 3 in every bowl. The size of their wantons puts some wanton noodle stalls to shame. Would come back for more visits.

author: EW
review_text: We had the mango sticky rice, crab fried rice and appetiser set here, all were good and can tell this is authentic. The price is also reasonable.

author: Justin Godbout
review_text: Bravo. I’ve determined that this would officially be my last meal. Everything was perfect. The restaurant itself is super cosy. The service was excellent, relaxed. The food was interesting and flavourful. We tried a number of fun wines that paired well our food. My only complaint is how hard it was to get a reservation 😆

author: Gia Ade
review_text: Would not recommend unless you’re only going for the aesthetic and photo ops, not the actual food or drinks. I ordered the Thai Tea with popping dish (their take on chicken and waffles). The chicken was good, and the waffle was decent but a bit soggy. The Thai tea, however, was terrible—basically milk with the faintest hint of Thai flavor. I asked both waitresses if I could swap the Thai tea for their special Choco drink since the tea was so bad. They both agreed, but when it was time to pay, they said they couldn’t remove the Thai tea because it had already been made. Had they mentioned that upfront, I never would’ve ordered another drink and would’ve just stuck with water. And speaking of water—it’s not automatically served; you have to ask for it, and I’m assuming you also have to pay for it. I noticed several guests brought their own water bottles, which makes sense. To make matters worse, the special chocolate drink was bitter, so I ended up wasting money twice. I didn’t even drink a quarter of it. Overall, a complete waste of 894 baht.

author: cohani tay
review_text: Social media famous. Normal food. Overrated visuals. Only for girls to take photos

author: Samantha Fitzgerald
review_text: I wish I caught our server’s name—he was excellent! From the time I called to check if seating was available to even after dropping the check, our server was prompt, attentive, and had our entire group laughing. The food was great with many vegan options. We enjoyed the atmosphere, and it was very clean. It has its own parking lot which made everything easy. Perfect place to go if you need to be close to Newark Penn Station.

author: Gulcan Cetin
review_text: This place is crazy great atmosphere with lovely smiling servers. Yoga and Kristen were amazing. They did their best to make us happy. hey, I have to mention the food. It was the best non-local food in Bali. I had basil pasta and creamy spinach chicken it was same as New York style so you gotta come here for Food for service for the view. It’s five star.

author: Thu Hương Phạm
review_text: Recently, my company held a party here. My first impression was that the VIP room was quite airy and had good lighting. However, I found the air conditioning position to be not very suitable. If the temperature was set low for people on the edge to be cool, people in the middle right under the air conditioner would be very cold. Regarding the food, there was a wide variety of dishes, the prices were a bit high. Regarding the taste of the food, I generally found it a bit salty. Almost all the dishes were like that. There was a cheese beef dish with a delicious sauce, but when I ate the beef, it was salty, so I felt a bit regretful. The restroom was clean and had air conditioning.

author: Ilya
review_text: Amazing spot! Crate is a gem for anyone who loves healthy and tasty food. I got the massive chicken salad (Chick Chik boom) - it was so fresh and satisfying that it was a challenge to finish, especially with my protein smoothie on the side. Great portions, fantastic flavors, and affordable prices. I can't recommend it enough and will definitely be back!

author: Laurent Bralé
review_text: Great spot for a delicious bánh mì. The food was fresh, flavourful, and well-balanced, and the service was friendly and efficient. Definitely worth a visit.

author: 곽우찬
review_text: Alex T Surya was incredibly kind and attentive during our visit. He responded to our requests quickly and made us feel genuinely cared for. Thanks to his warmth and hospitality, we were able to create a wonderful memory on our honeymoon. His exceptional service made such a difference — and because of him, we truly want to come back again.

author: JJ
review_text: Food is decent, but nothing special. I don’t think it’s worth the hype and the wait. Outside wait time for us was twice longer than the actual dining time. We were seated after 40 minutes. Waitress brought the check 15 mins after food is delivered. No water refill. $3 parking

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: ken goh
review_text: Liver in the soup had black spots . Meat was clumped like it was frozen. Kidney had a really strong smell. We are long time customers. Unfortunately standards seem to be dropping.

author: Joelle Fhima-Berdowski
review_text: After a long travel day, Mykonos was the perfect place to enjoy a delicious meal with a view. Our waitress Valentina was wonderful and so attentive. She recommended the Special Greek Salad and lamb chops. Both were delicious and did not disappoint. If you love an Old Fashioned, you must try their Greek Old Fashioned… it’s nothing like we’ve tasted before. We loved our experience, the service and food so much that we’re coming back with our family in a couple of weeks… can’t wait!!!

author: Dr. WH Tan
review_text: The food here was undeniably delicious, but if you want to try their signature dim sum, you will need to place your order from across the street. This unique setup might require a bit of extra effort, but it is well worth it for the opportunity to savor their specialty dumplings, buns, and other delicacies.

author: Leepin Won
review_text: Very delicious and authentic babi guling in Ubud. The meat is nicely marinated, the side vege is authentic Balinese taste, the blood sausage is also the traditional one. The crispy pork skin is a must to try. I specifically love the sitting area at the patio, the eating atmosphere is wonderful! If you look for authentic Balinese Babi guling, here is the best one. Will always come back here for nasi babi guling since many years!

author: Ismael Valverde Kardouchi
review_text: This place is awesome for hanging out with friends, especially in the evening. I came for lunch, and the food was delicious. The vibe is super chill, and it's also a great place to have drinks while enjoying some stunning views.

author: Jennifer Elenbaas
review_text: This place was recommended by a friend for the shrimp. We went just before the dinner crowd got there. Parking is free if you are dining and leave within 2 hours. It’s a crowded area but in a cute way with lots of memorabilia. The sunset is beautiful for dinner time. The shrimp need to be peeled but the sauce is great with them. The smoked fish dip is also recommended and the vegetables with it were perfect. I had the fresh squeezed margarita, being a margarita lover this one was good but nothing new or special and served in a plastic cup. Overall I am glad we stopped in for a bite, if we were hungrier we would have tried that burger! Ps- don’t forget to get a photo at the front by the tub!

author: Diana L.
review_text: What a gem! Can't believe I live here all the years and just visited them. It was a beautiful breeze night and we definitely enjoyed seating outside. Order Octopus capacio, house salad, papadelle with lamb meatballs, tagliatelle. All pretty good. Good service too. They are super busy on a Thursday evening. I can see why.

author: Wei Kang
review_text: The food is delicious and reasonably priced! Since I walked here from the hotel, I didn’t have to worry about parking. Also, I arrived before the busy hours, so there was no need to queue. Shortly after I sat down, I noticed more and more people arriving. So I suggest everyone who doesn’t want to wait too long should come a bit earlier!

author: Tracy Lee
review_text: The most delicious pork! It was so tasty in here, the food was cooked perfectly and the pork was so tender and juicy. I can see why Anthony Bourdain loved this dish! Highly recommend, the staff will help you order if you aren't sure too. Lovely smiley staff who just added to this brilliant find!

author: Sahra
review_text: Brassica is a truly unique restaurant and cafe. We went for brunch and were met with a warm quirky Brooklyn ambiance with high hopes for the food. We started with two donuts to share- a toasted maple donut and a Boston cream (can’t remember the specific names) but they were absolutely delicious and fresh. We also ordered the fried rice with fried chicken, which was packed with flavor Umami and spice-absolutely incredible. We also ordered the tamales which tasted truly authentic and the impossible burger. However, nothing compared to the hashbrowns, never have I tasted anything so deluxe and cheesy! We were all so satisfied and will come back again.🙏

author: Yunong Shi
review_text: This cafe buzzes with activity, creating a vibrant atmosphere. I like its open workstation, allowing you to watch the staff as they stir a big pot of strawberry syrup and craft croissants. I ordered a croissant and a cortado. The croissant was exceptional—perfectly crispy on the outside while maintaining a fluffy interior. It was a delight to have each bite. However, the cortado didn’t hit the mark for me; it was both sour and bitter, which might have been due to an off day with the espresso machine calibration.

author: Mikki B
review_text: Ps Café at East Coast Park has a very pleasant environment, surrounded by greenery and close to the sea, making it a relaxing spot to unwind. Parking is plentiful, which makes visiting convenient. However, the food was just so-so and didn’t particularly stand out. One downside is that there is no toilet within the restaurant itself, which can be inconvenient. Overall, it’s more about the setting than the food experience. Great place to catch up with friends.

author: Roger Beaujard
review_text: Very sad excuse for a steakhouse. I had the T-Bone which as you can see was more of a bone in strip steak with almost no fillet. No stand out flavor at all, very thin. Absolutely not worth it. Massive disappointment. I've literally had a better steak at Denny's and that's really sad.

author: Ron Vega
review_text: Their food was so fresh and delicious. Such a chill atmosphere.

author: Jayden Kusuma
review_text: Food is okay, great fried rice but not out of the ordinary amongst any south east asian fried rice dish. Staff does barely and dine in orders are done via a QR code on the table. Costs quite a bit and DOES NOT TAKE CASH. Came here when the hype died down on a weekend and place was empty. Mid at best, for the price, not recommended.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Kelly Wing
review_text: Food overall is quite good, nice decoration, privately. However, in my opinion, the staff was unprofessional because that was my birthday, me and my friend has come first then the staff just asked there would a birthday cake, would us like to use right away. I think this is a big mistake and I feel a bit bad. I hope the restaurant will look again about the first impression from your staff.

author: Renee Richter
review_text: This place is popular! The banh mi’s were so good and prepared fast. We had the tofu/avocado and the bbq pork. Very tasty. Juice took longer to make (we had lemonade and mango) but was fresh and really good. Reasonably priced. We spent about 150k vnd for 2 banh mis, 2 juices and 2 waters. I would avoid going her around lunch time— you won’t get a table. There were three tour groups that came in while we were waiting for our food and they gave them tables first. However, there is a park across the street and it is nice to sit and eat there.

author: Narcisa Szabo
review_text: If you’re looking for a great spot with delicious food, this restaurant is an absolute gem! From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with warmth and hospitality that made us feel right at home. The atmosphere is cozy, perfect for both families and couples. The menu offers a wide range of options that will please even the pickiest eaters. We tried several dishes, and everything was flavorful, fresh, and beautifully presented. The portion sizes were generous, ensuring no one left hungry. All dishes are bursting with flavor and cooked to perfection. Their desserts are the perfect ending to the meal, with rich, indulgent treats that the entire family will love. Service was prompt and friendly, and the staff made sure we had everything we needed throughout the meal. This restaurant truly understands what it means to create a welcoming, enjoyable experience. Highly recommend it for a delicious, memorable meal with loved ones!

author: Johnny Venom Blaze
review_text: 5 stars review cos they have the best Nasi lemak in Singapore! 786 nasi lemak is to die for!!!! Stall 01-34!!! Cheap value for money n your tummy!!!

author: TooGood
review_text: Very typical local hawker centre in Singapore with lots of stalls to choose from. The food is tasty. We tried the curry chicken noodles from Ah Heng Curry Chicken Bee Hoon Mee and several beverages from two stalls next to it. Another great dish is the bak kut teh from the stall right next to the curry chicken. Don't miss out the Curry puffs from Tanglin Crispy Curry Puff (Middle Stall). All in all, this centre is a foodie's delight. Last but not the least, a special shoutout to the cleaners who work tirelessly to keep the space clean and who also kept my sunglasses (which I had forgotten on a table) safely with them until I came back 17 hours later. :)

author: bh
review_text: The food center is located in an older part of the estate border some light industrial zone. There are some local favorites like Hokkien Mee, Porridge, etc. In all frankness, the cleanliness in this hawker center is not high, the whole dining environment is dark and gloomy in certain corners, the floor can be quite dirty at times too.

author: Phyllis Twilligear
review_text: BBQ ribs, and Bourbon chicken were really tasty, hit the spot. Had a tremendous spinach salad, onions mushrooms, chopped eggs, tomatoes, croutons, pickled beets, Ranch. Love the buttery fish, clam chowder, etc. Ice cream cone.carrot cake, bread pudding, banana pudding Yum, went to heaven! May God bless these hard working people! Love you guys, Carlos- great waiter thank you!

author: Jade Bacciarelli
review_text: Love this little nook! Moana has such a good variety of seafood dishes - if you’re looking for good quality fish and wanting to experience that tropical feel - Moana is the place 💕

author: Lilly G.
review_text: I normally am not a fan to do a bad reviews but I had one of the worst service experiences here. The lady who served me and my brother was not welcoming at all. I came for samplers, drinks and dessert to stall time. I love Denny’s so this was disappointing. This was also my second time coming to this location and I will not be coming back. The server did not ask us if we wanted refills or check on us at all after she gave us our food. I am a decent tipper and normally tip 20% and up, but this server I declined tipping due to her only tending to the customers in back of us the entire time. She came back to just hand me my check did not ask me if I wanted more. A refill and dessert offer would have been great. The only person who said thank you was me the entire time. Very disappointed and very unwelcoming experience. I hope the service improves. I don’t expect a 5 star treatment just wanted to be treated as the people in back of me with great service.

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: kenneth tong
review_text: Wantons were perfect. Roast pork kinda hard and not crispy. Char siew didn’t taste like much. Soup is a little blend. Everything else is nice.

author: Afiesha
review_text: I DONT KNOW WHAT HAPPEN TO THIS PLACE FOOD USE TO BE SOO GOOD flavorful I went there yesterday TRASH THREW UP IMMEDIATELY AND THE ROACH OUTSIDE THE RESTAURANT TOLD ME EVERYTHING I REGRETTED EATING THERE WILL NEVER GO AGAIN N STOP SELL OLD FOOD HEATING IT UP WONT MAKE IT TASTE BETTER THE NEXT DAY NOODLES WAS SO SOFT TAKE LIKE MASH POTATOES RICE SMELL SPOILED I JUST ATE PLATE OF FRUITS AND LEFT WORST EXPERI EVER I WISH TO NEVER GO BACK IMMA THROW UP AGAIN AFTER THIS REVIEW DIGUSTING

author: Megan Rose Jagger
review_text: Love this spot. The bagels were amazing, our group had the mushroom, pistachio and smoked salmon, everyone enjoyed them! No complaints at all. The coconut coffee was delicious also! Nice vibe, peaceful and no one is too loud. They have oat milk!

author: Brian Yung
review_text: Our very first meal in Vietnam was at Pizza 4P’s - was recommended by multiple friends and it did not disappoint! Fantastic pizzas, great service, lovely atmosphere. Get a seat at the pizza counter to watch the chefs work their magic if you can.

author: Yuta Sai
review_text: The owner of this place is a really nice and friendly person. We ordered the sukiyaki and scallops and there were absolutely delicious. They are on the spicy end so be prepared but it was really good and really cheap as well compared to more expensive places like Hong Kong . The classic spicy sauce of sweet spicy and sour really complement the dish . I look forward to coming here again to try some more things . Get the fried rice !

author: Ashley Dean
review_text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5-Star Review for Dino’s Chicken on Pico! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I had the pleasure of trying Dino’s Chicken on Pico, and it was an amazing experience! I ordered the Dino’s chicken plate with chicken fries, and let me tell you, it was absolutely delicious! The flavors were on point, and the chicken was cooked to perfection - juicy and tender with a mouthwatering crispy exterior. The chicken fries were a unique twist and added an extra level of deliciousness to the meal. The service was friendly, and the food was served quickly. The overall ambiance of the restaurant was welcoming and made the dining experience enjoyable. I highly recommend Dino’s Chicken on Pico to anyone looking for some seriously tasty chicken dishes. Whether you’re a fan of classic chicken plates or looking to try something different like the chicken fries, you won’t be disappointed! Definitely a must-visit spot for all chicken lovers out there. Can’t wait to come back for more! Keep up the fantastic work, Dino’s Chicken! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Andrea Payne
review_text: I waited ten minutes for two drinks and it was obvious by the layers in my caramel latte drink that it had been sitting. Carhop was friendly n did apologize, but sometimes the app isnt better.

author: Orchid S.
review_text: Had an amazing time with friends and family here. Our server India was so kind and sweet the whole time and checked in on us often. She was busy but did not hesitate to get us everything we needed! India deserves everything and more. The food was also really great!

author: Dj Gillespie
review_text: Sat there for over 2 hours and sushi didn't show up. The people without a clip board won't even talk to you. Waiter and manager did make an effort to make it right, but still. Waiting 2 hours for your main meal is a bit much even if you get a 10% discount. At $40 a person...was a bit disappointed. Food was great when they finally brought it out.

author: Harry Dang
review_text: Nostalgic at every turn. From the moment you entered the alley till you set foot into the courtyard and sit down it is like you are transported to countryside of a bygone era. Food is just like what you would expect grandma to cook at home.

author: N. T
review_text: It’s SO GOOD but I had food poisoning from this place (burrito bowl)

author: Martina Zoi
review_text: Amazing place. Great atmosphere there was live music. I loved the singer. The food was very good. Scallops were cooked excellent. Lobster roll was kind of blunt. Did not feel mayo or any marination. Definitely overpriced lobster roll. There is a wait of ~45 minutes on busy days for outdoor seating.

author: Muaz Azhari
review_text: Food: 5/5 Atmosphere: 4/5 Service: 5/5 The queue is long, as usual. It doesnt matter when did you come. I think it might be justified, i guess? The hamburger is good. They cook them right in front of you and then serve it on the mini pan at your place. That pan isn't really that hot so you don't need to worry much on whether your hamburger will be overcooked. If this is your first time here, I'd suggest not to order anything original. Because you'll be served with original hamburger and then you can pour the sauce onto the to meat to your liking. I had truffle sauce + japaneese wagyu and it was good. Probably not A5 level but it's still good nonetheless. Will I come here again? Probably not in near future because it's quite expensive tbh haha. But is it good? Yeah definitely

author: MrsJ Brice
review_text: My first time at Park 54 on a Date night with my husband and I give everything 10/10. The food was delicious, portion sizes were on point. The cleanliness , the look and atmosphere all around was top tier. The servers were very attentive and friendly. And I love to dance when I eat my food cause food is my happy place lol, and you can’t help but vibe to the dope mix of songs in the background. I think I danced through my whole meal. We will definitely be back again.

author: Pin Yeoh (Foodie life)
review_text: RM $29.9 per person charcoal hot pot and bbq grilled with pork butter all you can eat! There are lots of choices and the food quality is great! We really enjoyed crab and clam. The hot pot soup tasted delicious! I love their ice lemongrass drink. There is 2 hours time limit. It’s recommended to reserve a table beforehand because the place is popular. Be prepared to SWEAT! It is hot and humid when you first sit down, but it gets better once you get used to the temperature.

author: Frank P
review_text: 20251205 - night market near patong beach that is opened till late night. Sells variety of seafood, thai food, drinks and desserts. It is considered quite pricey compared to bangkok. Ordered iced thai tea, iced thai coffee and mango sticky rice. The drinks are ok but the mango sticky rice is disappointing, with dry rice that sticks together and mango that is not so sweet. I would consider going to nearby mall food court to eat instead. The roti banana nutella outside the market along the main road is nice though, with ripe and sweet banana.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Howie
review_text: I know this brand might be quite popular in Singapore, but for me, the actual experience this time was just average in terms of taste. Their bak kut teh soup is pretty decent and has some unique flavor, but if you try other dishes, the taste is really average—at least for me, it wasn’t anything impressive. Overall, I think it’s not as good as the lotus root and pork rib soup from Wuhan. There were a lot of customers, and I waited in line for about 10 minutes. The seating inside was quite cramped. At first, somehow, our table didn’t have the condiment rack like the other tables. I had to ask twice before the staff finally provided it. In addition, I saw a flie in the restaurant, and it landed on the plates or table multiple times—I had to wave it away several times. So annoying. 😳

author: Dan Brown
review_text: I have been out for breakfast literally thousands of times in my life, and this is by far the best place I've ever eaten! The portions are huge, service is prompt and they are very welcoming. I will never forget this place!

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: Dizi Concerto
review_text: Separate additional menu for egg, clams, sausage? Surprised and couldn’t believe. RM4 for only a few clams? Beyond ripoff. Only RM1 differences between small and large portion? Obviously you will feel better to get the large portion but what about people who just want to eat less? Now now, I wouldn’t complain at all if the foods are tasty. Which they AREN’T at all!!!! And not to mention the waiting time. We waited an hour or maybe more. Which is till acceptable if it is tasty! Problem is it is NOT tasty and very felt ripoff!!!

author: Tony Rosca
review_text: Mamacita’s Latin Bar & Grill in Hollywood, FL, delivers a lively beachfront dining experience. Located at 591 N Broadwalk, its ocean views and vibrant Latin atmosphere are undeniable draws. The menu features Mexican and Cuban dishes like shrimp ceviche, Cuban sandwiches, and their signature Red Snapper, praised for its freshness but sometimes criticized for lacking seasoning. Guacamole and chips are a hit, described as “on point” and fresh, though some find portions small for the price. A medium piña colada costs $20, reflecting medium-high prices that some reviewers on Tripadvisor and Yelp call overpriced, especially for drinks like margaritas, which can lack potency. Service is inconsistent—some praise the friendly staff and quick breakfast service (e.g., $6 eggs and pancakes), while others report slow, inattentive servers and issues like missing items or rude interactions. Food quality varies; tacos and seafood soups shine, but some dishes, like churrasco, disappoint due to overcooking. Street parking is challenging, often requiring patience to find a spot. Despite mixed reviews (3/5 on Tripadvisor, 2/5 on Yelp), the beachfront location and live Latin music make it a fun, if flawed, spot.

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: Super Fragrance
review_text: Ordered large ckt for 8rm. Wait time was 10min. Kway tiao was actually well fried and very tasty in a savory way. However it has one fatal flaw. Their pork lard. This is the first time i had pork lard totally ruin the dish. The oil they used to fry the lard must has been reused so many times that the lard just has a stanch of oiliness and after consumption it feels very greasy. Such a shame whole dish ruin. Other things to note is large plates only comes with daoge and a bit of lup cheong and small shrimp. There is no hum nor fried egg.

author: Supakij Khomvilai
review_text: I stop by to get famous snack, Caramel Almond Stick and Ar Lua from Chalom shop in front of the restaurant. It's really good taste. You have to try it. Not so sweet and good ingredients they choose for the snack. You will love it ! Recommended.

author: Jay
review_text: Went before 9pm, and was glad to be served the last available plate of chicken meat. Great taste, always crowded, food was served very quickly. Went on a chilly night, hence was not too bothered by outdoor/indoor seating, had to share a table as all tables were occupied during dinner time.

author: Pat L.
review_text: Excellent place. The entertainmen along with a small cozy dance floor is lots of fun. It'll probably become a regular.

author: Davide Bigoni
review_text: This IS the place for breakfast in San Francisco . Worth standing in the queue for such amazing delicious food

author: Jay Aquino
review_text: Not a very good place, people are not friendly. All the cashiers and workers look mad like they don't want to be there. They don't greet you at the intern simple order.

author: Zo TX
review_text: big portions but the food is just average at best. Go to westlake for best chinese food its right next to J N Bargain Market, i think its like 517 S Burlington Ave

author: Janchicsiken
review_text: I can see why my colleague recommended this spot - we got the pig trotters, pork ribs soup, salted veg and youtiao to share and the portions were perfect. The pork ribs were pretty generous, and of course the soup is free flow (for dine in). Very 老味道

author: The Laughing Lion
review_text: I thought this place was good, not spectacular or bad, but good. The flavors of the grilled pork chop were as expected. My only complaint was of the spring rolls. The rice paper they used was kind of tough. I am accustomed to soft spring rolls, so I was a bit surprised. The dining room was basic and clean. The tables and chairs were all made of wood. I went for lunch and it was not very busy, so the service was really quick. The staff was friendly. The prices are very reasonable here considering this is in a tourist zone. I would definitely come back here and have a meal again.

author: Linh Nguyen
review_text: I've only ordered for pick-up, and it's been good so far. Their spicy chicken sandos always hit the spot.

author: Stacey McKenzie
review_text: As every other cheesecake factory, this was good. Food as always tastes great. Cheesecake cake was delicious. Drinks was ok. The service was great. This cheesecake factory is really big and on great downtown location. Paid parking cross the street

author: Bree Reeves
review_text: 10/10 Exposed brick wall, beautiful high ceiling, warm wood. I might have to keep ordering so I can stay here longer 😍 The food. Delicious! (Ut khon) my server was helpful - service overall was friendly and well run.

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: Glen Ho
review_text: Woah.. "flavour bomb in a bowl" is how I'd describe the thunder tea rice here. Ordering is pretty straight forward and instructions on the board are pretty self explanatory. You get to pick between fragrant or brown rice, and also to add peanuts or not. Serving size is very value for money and every element of the dish just mixes together to create one bowl of awesomeness. Location is in a quiet corner of paya lebar, and is more convenient to access by car, with car parking lots in the blocks behind. I greatly appreciate how clean the location is overall too.

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: Pang WS
review_text: One of my favourite spots for duck egg char kuey teow in mainland BM. I do enjoy their kuey teow's wok hei. Pair those with the steamed octopus for a perfect combo. Table wait and queue would be subject to weekends/holidays season. Ample but limited parking available within the premises.

author: Hayashi Rina (YT : cocofunnyoversea)
review_text: I thought it would be difficult to get a seat, but it turned out their seating system is very smooth and fast. The broth is the soul of the pho — so rich and comforting. The hot stone is a brilliant idea to keep the pho hot and makes it easy to cook the raw beef perfectly. I ordered the beef ball + raw beef, and wow… those beef balls are so chewy and incredibly tasty! Definitely worth a visit, and it has become one of my comfort foods in Ho Chi Minh City.

author: Manuel Dresselmann
review_text: If you are looking for a great banh mi experience look no further. The incredibly long queue to the Shop speaks for itself. The Portion of banh mi that you get is so full of ingredients such as: ruoc, lots of butter, rich paté and its signature sausage that half a sandwhich is enough for most. If that as it is wouldnt be enough you also get different sides to create your perfect banh mi. 1 Pack of pickles, 1 Pack of cucumber and 1 Pack with a mix of spring Onion, coriander and Chili. This shop truely understands how to serve the national dish.

author: Schwarz T
review_text: There is no waiter or waitress in the cold room to order food, so you have to go out to order. It's very boring. At least send someone to stay in the cold room to order food instead of standing up and going out to order.

author: Carmen Pineda
review_text: Barbacoa didn't disappoint! The food was delicious, but what really makes ut special is our server maria. She's so kind, always checking in on us, and made my first time visit feel welcoming. We truly appreciate her! I'm from Santa Ana, CA this is worth the trip and ill definitely be coming back again!

author: Alexandra Honor Arrivillaga
review_text: “ The food here is ok , not great “ We went here today to try this place . We got the pernil , arroz , and plátano . The food was ok ( fills a hungry stomach ), but not great . The beef empanadas are good though. If we are ever in the area we will come back for those . They have a big parking lot so parking is not an issue. The staff is super friendly. The vibe is warm and welcoming.

author: Nhut Le Quang
review_text: Ideal place to organize meetings, including wedding parties because there are many halls with 5-10 tables. There are open spaces and private rooms, serving a variety of guests. The front gate of the restaurant is easy to recognize because it is the busiest on the street. There are many staff guiding parking to avoid traffic jams, and staff guiding to the banquet hall. There is an elevator but it is often overloaded if there are many parties on the weekend. I had to use the stairs because I didn't want to waste time waiting. The toilet on the ground floor had air conditioning when I went, but the 3rd floor did not. The food was also quite tasty. The party menu was quite diverse. Opening hours are until 22:30 but there is support for extra guests if the fun is not over yet. I am weak so I didn't stay until that time to check :D Come to have a party at the restaurant around the end of the year, there are Christmas decorations with many more virtual living corners

author: Lyn Long
review_text: Undoubtedly the best food in Saigon! Wish we had discovered it earlier. Not the standard Vietnamese dishes but items like bone marrow beef noodle and lemongrass oxtail. the desserts were phenomenal - the Chunky Monkey was delicious! A small restaurant (so best to book), but relaxed, lovely ambience. Very reasonably priced. Highly recommended.

author: Jillian Perez
review_text: I genuinely liked Coach House. In the beginning they were good and consistent. Lately food quality and quantity has been disappointing. Also I have had a few issues with take out orders. Today I placed an order for delivery. I ordered a cheeseburger deluxe (photo attached). $14 for this and look at the amount of fries given. That’s ridiculous. There were barely any fries. Also, you receive different fries every time. Sometimes it’s crinkle fries, then sometimes it’s regular fries. I used to order breakfast, and as part of breakfast you would get toast, 2 slices. Now you receive 1 slice of toast that is barely even toasted. Why only 1 slice of toast? That’s so odd. Another time I called to place a takeout order and was told that I wasn’t “allowed” to order a kids chicken fingers for takeout for my daughter. I then asked to speak to a manager because what kind of ridiculous policy is that. The manager I spoke with ended up accommodating but she also asked if it was for a child. I guess you’re not allowed to order kids chicken fingers because they think an adult is getting it for themselves. Regardless, if I want to get chicken fingers and I’m paying for it, what does it matter? The next situation I had was just last week, where I ordered grilled chicken and a side of home fries. When I went to pick it up, I was asked if I have ordered that before, which I have. Then I was told that I wasn’t “allowed” to order grilled chicken. At this point I’m annoyed because I’ve already had previous issues with Coach House. I then wait to speak with the manager and I was told that I needed to order a grilled chicken dinner and not a side of grilled chicken. Well put it on the menu then. My husband has stomach issues and can only eat a handful of things and he likes the grilled chicken. But yet I wasn’t allowed to order that? That’s absurd. My guess is because it was charged as a side and not a whole $20 meal. It’s disappointing because I genuinely liked Coach House. Lately though, all of these issues make me not want to order from them anymore or even go there. Coach House please do better. I have been a customer for years, this is not the level of service that one should be given.

author: hua
review_text: Zion Hawker Centre is my go-to spot for a delicious Char Kway Teoy, I highly recommend Stall 20, “River side good food”. It’s not the super famous stall with a endless long queue. Here is definitely one of the best I’ve had. I always order white, extra egg, and without beansprouts. There was wok hei, pork lard and the taste was just so tasty. If you’re a Ckt lover, you absolutely must try this one! The queue is shorter, and you won’t be disappointed. Highly recommended. The place is bright, clean, and in the eve it has a nice breeze, making it a great spot to enjoy the food.

author: Rocio A. Cruz (Rosy)
review_text: First time here and I like it, I hesitate a little bit about eating here because I knew it would be just tacos, Tortas, burritos, etc., and it was really early in the morning to have tacos. While I was looking at the menu and , I asked the cashier Maria, and she was kind enough to tell me everything they have for their breakfast menu. I ordered a chorizo and egg burrito 🌯 and it was huge and yummy 🤤 I added the red tomatillo sauce and it tasted just like homemade! I will definitely return. Just a suggestion for the owner or manager about posting that your place carries delicious breakfast and hot coffee ☕ BTW... plenty of parking 🅿️

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Sara B.R.
review_text: Great food and service! This was our first meal after arriving to Vietnam and it was delicious. Out waitress, Sky, was extremely nice and explained us how to eat the dishes we ordered - fab service

author: gev
review_text: love the elegant ambience at Osteria Gia PIK warm, chic, and cozy at the same time. interior nya classy dan inviting, pas banget buat casual dining maupun special moments. the pizza feels so authentic with a light crisp crust and flavorful toppings, dan tiramisu nya rich but perfectly balanced. definitely a must visit in PIK 2.

author: Yongxing Xu
review_text: I’m not sure if I got her name right but Sherine or Cherine took her time to explain the various food options to me. This helped me make the right food choices for my 4 year old which is very important to me. Thank you for your patience and advice! Much appreciated!

author: Juju Miano
review_text: Love the banh mi here so good and super affordable. I also tried their stir-fry noodles and loved them just as much. Simple, tasty, and great value for money. Definitely a spot I’d come back to again.

author: Elynn -
review_text: thick and rich coconut gravy topped with tau pok, slices of fish cake and cockles. comfort food.

author: Bảo Lâm Nguyễn Trần
review_text: Thank you for giving my family a delicious and cheap meal. The restaurant has a spacious, airy and clean space! Thank you!

author: Nicole Bell
review_text: Love it! This was our first time, and it definitely won’t be our last. We loved the atmosphere and truly appreciated how family-friendly it was. The food options were excellent, everything was delicious, and the service was outstanding - thank you - Ani. A wonderful experience all around.

author: Forest House
review_text: This is the best nasi lemak to my taste. Apart from the delicious food, the restaurant is always kept clean and bright.

author: Moses
review_text: Terrible food quality, terrible food presentation, everything looked dried and not taste. The native rice was just terrible. Hard. Not fresh. And red stew was flavor less.

author: Alexander Pasay
review_text: My wife and I had a wonderful time here. Great service. Amazing atmosphere. And the food was so delicious. Will definitely come again with the whole family. Came back the 2nd time and brought my daughter. She loves this place so much. Highly recommend if you like seafood and sushi.

author: Harvey
review_text: Coconut juice was refreshing. Seafood tom yum was spicy, creamy and rich. Crab omelette and crab fried rice was pretty average. Be prepared to wait in a long queue as this is a popular tourist spot and vloggers often come to try out the cuisine.

author: Hai Cheen Choong
review_text: We checked on Google for good food in Hatyai and found this place with thousands of reviews and a high rating – and it definitely lived up to the hype! There were people helping to take care of our car during parking, which was very convenient. The food was served very quickly, and everything we ordered was absolutely delicious at a reasonable price. The floor and tables were clean, and the staff were all very friendly. Highly recommended!

author: Lu Bu
review_text: Im removing my 5 star review for removing the fiesta veggie burrito. Change the price if needed- why remove it entirely.. need more vegetarian options - such as the fiesta veggie burrito… I’ll change it back to 5 stars if you bring it back, thank you

author: SF SIT
review_text: the food here was super good!!! the seafood was so fresh and flavourful, hope to come again sometime in the near future the next time i’m in bangkok. also pretty affordable for the size of the seafood.

author: Mesi Fransiska
review_text: The food was avarage, the staffs weren't that nice, they barely smile to us, the view was just bamboo tree.

author: Shalese Fuller
review_text: Unfortunately I only speak English that was a big problem!! Our waitress never understood anything we asked for (straw, ketchup, steak sauce & ingredients in our mixed drinks) I had the rodizeo & the meat tasted bland.. I work close & popped in with a coworker for a early Friday meal, guess this place wasn't for us.

author: Jacob L
review_text: Best Lomo Saltado in SF! Food is always fresh and the purple corn drink is so GOOD!

author: Vincent Ming
review_text: Came here for some local breakfast. The famous Char Kuey Teow stall and Pork Noodles stall had long lines queuing, but I noticed the Char Kuey Teow serving was quite fast despite the longer queue. Tai Wah pork noodles took some time before we got our noodles. Probably around 35minutes? Not much to say about the pork noodles. I ordered the dry meepok. It has its’ unique charm, with the touch of vinegar and tiny bit of spicy taste. The YuanYang from the beverage stall along the same row as the char kuey teow was amazing though! Right amount of kaw.

author: Jessica Campos TV
review_text: I'm on vacation in Boston and I loved this place. The food is great and the staff is very friendly. I'll be back soon!

author: Sabrina Cheng
review_text: Absolutely loved this place! The atmosphere is so chill and the service was excellent. The food portions are huge and incredibly tasty. It's also super Instagrammable – a perfect spot to enjoy a great meal and have a long chat with friends. Highly recommended!

author: Tim Chu
review_text: I am surprised with the four stars rating of this location. This definitely is one of the best place to enjoy a simple rice dish with nicely cooked, charred, and juicy meat to go with it. The location is relatively far away from all the tourist places, but that's exactly why we travel and explore the unknowns. Very easy menu here and the prices are extremely reasonable.

author: Monica Nicholson
review_text: Great service from Danny at the bar! Amazing decor and atmosphere. The cocktails were amazing, Fuji apple crisp and espresso martini were deeeeeelicous!!!

author: Pamela A
review_text: This place is awesome! My family and I had the best meal. The menu is made for sharing. Every dish we ordered was the best I’ve had. The service was great. The team worked together seamlessly. We were not rushed. The dishes were brought out in a timely fashion. Our table was never devoid of food. The drinks were unique and delicious. The vibe was great!

author: MAKI
review_text: I visited this lounge before catching a late-night JAL flight. It's not large, but it's not crowded and is a very nice lounge. The relaxed atmosphere and excellent service made for a very enjoyable stay. The staff were also very attentive. If I have the opportunity to visit Singapore again, I will definitely visit this lounge. Thank you to Hezel, Alvin, CS, Jessie, and Azfar for your wonderful service. The Singapore Sling was delicious.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Cho Dongwook
review_text: It was right next to my hotel, so I went there for breakfast. I've been to Vietnam many times, and I don't think I've ever seen a place as cleanly maintained as this one. The sauce containers are often dirty, but here, they were all cleaned, and they even provided saucers for each dish. I ordered the dish pictured first on the menu, adding garlic, vegetables, and a little sauce. It was delicious. I plan to return to this place on my next visit.

author: Yuchen L
review_text: Overall, great food. I'd recommend the grilled prawns, scallops, and fried noodles. The sukiyaki is well made but too sweet for my taste buds. The only issue was that one of the prawns was undercooked. Instead of giving us a new prawn, they re-grilles the prawn we already de-shelled.

author: Tyre Kenney
review_text: I’m from Baton Rouge, Louisiana and live in Atlanta now so I know a thing or two about soul food. This place is topping any soul food spot in ATL and will give Louisiana restaurants a run. Shoutout to Juceila our waiter and Mai the cook who did his thing on the snapper (that didn’t make the pic cause we were already smashing). 12/10 recommend. Will be back.

author: Ibob Pramadi
review_text: Food was good. High quality smoky fried rice and plenty of crab meat. The green sour chili sauce add more depth to the taste 👍🏽👍🏽 But the service is too long, 1+ hour until the food is ready to eat. Is it worth the wait? Simply no. They should've add more stove, wok and cook to anticipate the demand. Located in a foodcourt so cant expect much about the ambiance.

author: Summer C
review_text: while i do agree it’s a tourist trap, the spring rolls platter was fabulous. centrally located, and yes there’s that stair climb. we had lunch so we reckon it’s nicer at night but the spring rolls was such a great welcome to saigon

author: Tom Kang
review_text: Way over priced for the portion. Nearly cannot finish my rice as there are too little meat given. As per photo, $9.50, which is totally not worth it as it doesn't taste as good before. The meat seems to be cooked over and over for many times. Tasted very "old". Probably is the case since their standard dropped and customer traffic is lesser? Verdict : thanks but no thanks

author: Lacey Martell
review_text: Food was delicious and the atmosphere was wonderful. We were sat next to the kitchen and were unable to chat much due to the noise, but our server placed us at another table which was great. I order my food without an ingredient as I did not like the taste of it, and 1/2 of my meal was made properly and the other half had the ingredient I requested not be included. Overall the food and drinks were delicious and at a great price and the service was great, I would just recommend double checking your food if you have dietary restrictions. Additionally, this is a beautiful restaurant location with a pretty interior if you are looking for a pretty place to have a meal.

author: Desiree Chisolm
review_text: More than $50 worth of food and there's nothing for us to eat. Oxtail are mealy. Gravy is watery. Vegetables are bland and unseasoned. Meatloaf was just not good. SAD EXPERIENCE.

author: Jo Jan
review_text: Parking space is quite limited, have to park behind other ppl's cars so may need to shift cars during dining. Love the atmosphere. Mushroom soup was delicious, mashed potato and spinach was nice too. Ordered soy sauce salmon, the sauce was very nice and salmon wasnt too dry luckily.

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: Jorden Tan
review_text: Local wet market where you can find fresh fish and meat. Do note, it’s a Muslim market, so you won’t find pork related items there.

author: Cindy
review_text: Food was way better last time dunno what happened……. Service sucks! Auntie just starts cleaning in front of you and the soup spilled on to me!

author: Abby Merritt-Evans
review_text: It was mid. My brother got a bistro burger, loved it, but it was cooked a little under. The carnitas my mom ordered were pretty gross. The corn still had bits of cob on it, the meat was gross, and the whole dish was cold. She also didn't get her order of rice. I had to send my chopped salad back because it was nasty. Swimming in dressing, the tomatoes tasted rotten, and the chicken was tough and basically inedible. The wait was long but understandable, I think they were understaffed. Minnie or Winnie I think was our waitresses name, and she was so so sweet. Super accommodating and understanding, too! Shes the only thing saving this review, so make sure to thank her!

author: Paul Ciprian
review_text: A place where you can eat tasty and cheap Asian dishes. The offer is extremely varied, it's hard to decide what to choose. Very crowded, at certain times. The conditions are spartan, tables and chairs fixed to the floor, in some cases plastic cutlery, there are no napkins, the tables are not always clean. But it's worth a try.

author: Mike V
review_text: I had the best experience celebrating my mom’s birthday at Maracaibo Restaurant in Union City! From the moment we walked in, the service was warm, welcoming, and attentive — they truly made us feel like family. The food was absolutely delicious, full of flavor, and came out fresh and perfectly prepared. On top of that, the prices were very reasonable, which made the evening even better. The staff went above and beyond to make my mom’s special day memorable, and we couldn’t have asked for a more perfect celebration. If you’re looking for a place with amazing service, great prices, and outstanding food, I highly recommend Maracaibo. We’ll definitely be back! 🎉👏

author: Loh Kwai Yin
review_text: Pretty tasty food and drink. Interesting concept/ presentation for some of the dessert. It was a bit rush the counter as the cashier expected us to be familiar with the items on the menu, and therefore able to place order very quickly. The atmosphere would certainly be elevated if the servers served with a smile.

author: Ming Leow
review_text: Nice hawker centre. I went for Mee Rebus. Super and Kopicino!

author: Courtney Henderson
review_text: It’s rare to find a place that does both coffee and pastries this well. I actually drive here from Monrovia because there’s not too many shops like this. The almond croissants and honey almond danish are hands-down the best I’ve ever had, and honestly, every pastry I’ve tried has been amazing. The Coco Cloud Latte is a favorite too. You can taste the quality in everything they make. Expect a line and yes the prices are a little higher, but it’s worth every bit. Service-wise (aside from the line) there’s a guy at the front who is super awesome and friendly. Rest of the crew is a young staff. You can tell there’s real care and craft behind everything here. It’s become one of those places I always look forward to visiting.

author: Mishary Almutairi
review_text: Amazing experience overall. The lamb shank was outstanding—tender, flavorful, and easily the highlight of the meal. I genuinely loved it and would definitely order it again.

author: Sierra Kushneryk
review_text: Really cute place with great food! I got the Miss piggy breakfast and ice coffee, it was great! Wish I was here longer so I could have it again. Fast service too.

author: yuchen wang
review_text: Food is good, for Arroz con pollo, although it taste good, and we do like dark meat, but it has too much bone, we expect whole piece of meat like chicken legs or chicken thighs that easier to eat.

author: nate smith
review_text: Katrina was the best server we’ve ever had. Super personable. Told us the history of seaplanes in the area. Recommended dishes and drinks. 10 stars! Offered to sing happy birthday to me haha!!

author: Anastasia Ekman
review_text: A small piece of pork belly that fits in a hand palm, topped with a marshmallow, no side whatsoever - $28. An extremely thin and very simple tomato-mozzarella pizza, small - $30. Cocktails - all around $20 It feels like a joke. Interior and stuff are nice. But these prices are unacceptable. If at least we would see some craft in the presentation or something very special about the ingredients. They kept pushing us to order more plates. No thank you. Editing after the restaurant’s response: I know what I ordered! The tomato-mozzarella pizza aka Detroit for $29.50. Saying that I’m unable to see the craft is an interesting assumption. I have lived and eaten in many culinary capitals of this world and I know what high-level craft looks like. Also, by saying this you are putting down some great local eats that serve fresh and yummy food for much less $.

author: Jamilah Ringo
review_text: Pizza Classica missed its mark competely ! | went here for a take out order and the young lady behind the counter seemed completely uninterested. I ordered a carbonara pasta, pasta with salmon, a side of meatballs and an order of fried calamari. The total of the order was roughly 75 dollars and for that amount I could've went to an actual authentic Italian restaurant and had way better food. Since when does carbonara have peas, onions, UNDERCOOKED bacon and cream sauce ? The pasta was swimming in oil and again pork bacon pieces were undercooked. That was money down the drain because I refused to risk getting food poisoning. The meatballs were edible and so was the calamari but everything else was subpar at best. That was my first and last time visiting that establishment.

author: monica xian
review_text: Great food. Just took a bit long to get to us. Slightly pricey but worth it ! Love the hotpot. Natural flavours.

author: Ashavina Arulkumar
review_text: Tried the cheese naan this time around with fresh coconut water, and it was SO good. This is my family’s go-to place for dinner or for supper as it has a very nice atmosphere and the food is really good. Service here is also top notch.

author: Min Kuan
review_text: The service was horrible. They're in a hurry of getting you to order food and drink. The servers didn't give me a feeling that they appreciated my business. (My local friend told me local people actually don't eat Hainese chicken here.) There nothing too special about their Hainanese chicken. It's just free range chicken. Their chili sauce dip was very bland. Any Hainanese chicken place in Penang will win hands down. As for their beansprouts... they're just fatter than regular beansprouts. There's nothing so special about them.

author: Merry M
review_text: Food court atmosphere. Chunky crab meat fried rice. Fried rice deliciously fragrant with char flavoured, serve best with their (green) Thai chilli sauce. 2 portions available - Small (395THB) or Large (495THB) Couple of other menu items too - spicy crab meat fried rice, crab meat omelette etc. Didn’t try the other items cos there’s multiple food options there. Just down the Gourmet market is the Street Food corridor, plenty of choices.

author: crystal
review_text: the food is good here!! ALSO, very cheap!! lots of varieties. also, besides the hawker/wet market there are a lot of other amenities. this place honestly feels so nostalgic, i've been here so many times and it really is a part of singaporean culture!! i would recommend to tourists as the local food here is great!!

author: James Allan
review_text: First time here was 15yrs ago. The office I worked at always ordered breakfast from here! My absolute fave is the Steak and Eggs on Kaiser roll! The other breakfast offerings are equally great. Today I came for lunch. We ordered their Pastrami Sandwich, Philly Cheese Steak, Chicken Fingers, Onion Rings, and Chili Cheese Fries! Everything was D-lish! 100% recommend! Gonna miss this place when I move away from NV!

author: denise phang
review_text: Nice chicken rice, prawns! Do not go with very hungry stomach as there will be people queue up

author: alaska harston
review_text: DEAR OWNER OF THIS STORE You better be paying these people extra to work in that heat!

author: Oliver Glasemacher
review_text: Had an amazing strip steak, perfectly grilled, nice and quick staff, absolutely love this place. Great views of the beach.

author: PH Yeap
review_text: More locals came here compared to another shop selling the same thing besides. Lady boss was friendly , noodle best taken as dry version with soup separate

author: jessica bizzoni
review_text: Came for their signature white pepper crab but sadly it was sold out. Luckily, their signature bee hoon and clams did not disappoint — both were delicious! The crayfish was decent, though not as memorable. Be sure to pre-order the crab if you’re planning to go!

author: Clara Poh
review_text: Liked the fragrant coconut rice and crispy chicken wing. Takeaway box consists of coconut rice, a slice of cucumber, 2 small fish, 2 pcs of ngoh hiang and 5 pcs of brinjal that costs $9 +$0.40 (for the box), 4 chicken wings in a brown bag $8+$0.10cents (for the small paper bag). An additional spoon of ikan bills onto the rice box is $1+$0.30cents.( Why? The 30 cents) Total $28.20. Overpriced takeaway in expensive packaging.

author: Grace Brewster
review_text: Food is great and the portions are awesome. But the only thing that baffles me is... Why if you go thru the drive thru the speaker box is on the passenger side... If your alone it's bit of a challenge 😂 so I recommend if you just want to go thru the drive thru make sure u have a passenger with you 😆

author: Lini Lynn
review_text: Just come to dine for the view. Best to come during weekdays & earlier to avoid the busy lunch & dinner crowd. Self-service. U need to pay in advance after placing an order & collect your own food & drinks. We ordered Daging Salai, Salted Fish, Seafood Tom Yam & Harimau Menangis. It's tasted ok, but there are too many flies. Can't stand it & can't enjoy our food in peace. The price of Thailand & local snacks are slightly more expensive as they are targeting tourists. Total bill RM 150++

author: Mary Curry
review_text: I came here January 2025 and came back 2026 because the food was so amazing. Our waitress Christina was absolutely wonderful. If you are in Miami stop an eat at Fiore Brunch & Cafe. You will not be disappointed. The coffee was nice and strong also. The manager even came and spoke to us!

author: Charles Chan
review_text: In the vicinity of Golden Crown Grand Hotel in Hadyai (this is a great option to Lee Garden which is often a choice for most Malaysian) are tons of little gem/stalls if you could not sleep and want to avoid crowded and touristy spots. I’m sharing a truly hidden gem called Hadyai Duck Noodles. Open for business only in the evening at 5pm and stay open till 4 or 5am. Local taste but the ingredients of duck parts , duck blood cubes and legs (not the drumsticks)😂😂😂😂😂. The soup is a bit peppery but lightly induced, might have some “msg” and loved the taste overall. Sharing so that other visitors can have another choice in terms of midnight snacks.

author: Pinky
review_text: Recommended!! Big portion and halal Local Malaysia food taste good!

author: GH Chau (Desmund)
review_text: The taste is good, just sometimes you might need to wait due to a long queue. The best dai lok mee in Butterworth, worth a visit and a try. A normal hawker stall environment, nothing much to expect for the atmosphere.

author: J
review_text: I was the very first customer on the morning of August 21st, and I ordered a flat white. I was utterly disheartened by what I received, it was the saddest looking espresso I have ever seen. The lack of effort put into it was glaringly obvious, leaving me disappointed. Wanted to start my day with a nice brunch but this is sad..

author: Meng p
review_text: Our first stop in Penang, really good food and plus point is this place is air-conditioned. Price also reasonable.

author: Jordan Napolitano
review_text: Came here for brunch on a Sunday, had a reservation. Sat at the bar for a drink before we went to our table. Drinks were really good we had a few each, service was great. We ordered a few different things, the bloody Maria mignonette with the oysters was tasty and a little spicy. The pork tacos were incredible and of course we got the masa pancakes which were delicious but so filling. The jello of the day was a Concord grape jello with peanut butter drizzle and a homemade whipped cream which was really really good. Would love to come back here. And the bathrooms are huge!

author: May Choo
review_text: Same taste as the original branch in Chiangmai! I've ordered the Earl grey bingsoo that came with boba. As it's not that sweet, I pretty love its taste. The bingsoo is very mellow and smooth. Adding sweet boba is a great combo. The staff can also communicate in multi languages. However, it's super crowded at lunch time.

author: Tim C
review_text: There's a fully vegan place here that I want to. Food was super cheap but some of the best I've eaten in Singapore.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Amanda Luu
review_text: Great atmosphere and dining experience. Presentation was unique and all the dishes were fantastic. Staff were attentive and friendly. The signature drink is fun, but aside from it being pretty, is actually quite refreshing and not too sweet. I’ll be back to try more dishes. Highly recommend!

author: Rudy&Michelle Still
review_text: Great food, very friendly atmosphere - breakfast was excellent

author: Hugo MORICEAU
review_text: We had the chance to enjoy an amazing dinner there. The dishes and recommendations were excellent, especially the restaurant’s best sellers. Every plate was crafted with great attention to flavor, texture, and creative combinations. The oysters with pearls were simply heavenly and perfectly captured the spirit of the whole meal. The crispy rice was also unique, as was the Cuca breakfast dessert. This is definitely a must-visit restaurant in Bali for food lovers—whether you’re with friends, your partner, or family. The open kitchen adds a special touch, allowing you to watch the chefs at work. The only small detail for me was the wine, which didn’t quite match my taste with the dishes, and the spicy sauce, even though I usually enjoy spicy flavors. Apart from that, the mocktails and service were absolutely exceptional.

author: Noah Bustos
review_text: I ordered mixed steak. The chicken and beef was tough and burnt, looked like it was from the day before and they just heated it up. We paid and the lady never returned with the change, we had to go look for her. Needless to say, the place was not packed enough to say that she was busy. Lousy place.

author: A V
review_text: My husband and I were shopping downtown for our vacation and walked by this place, so we decided to stop in and check it out. We were greeted by one of the gentlemen at the door, ordered our food, and waited less than five minutes for it to be ready. Everyone was friendly. We dined in, and the food was fresh and delicious. We had a boss bowl along with chicken tacos and potatoes oles with nacho cheese sauce, all of which were very delicious. 10/10. One of our chicken tacos tasted like fish, so my husband asked if it was chicken or fish, and they confirmed it was chicken but also gave us a new taco at no charge. The food was very delicious, and we will be stopping by again. Congratulations on your new journey. 🎉

author: Tania Zaman
review_text: Amazing food!!! This an absolute must if you are looking for reasonably priced momos in NJ. Sooo good. Recommend the Chilli momos! My younger daughter also loves the Schezuan Chicken Noodles. Have returned 3 times and will continue.

author: DANNY LIN
review_text: We went to the new store across from the original restaurant. The new place is indoor with AC so a better environment to enjoy the meal. But IMO the food was just average. Mostly tourist crowd.

author: Aaron
review_text: This is our 4th attempt at finding the best Babi Guling in Bali and we were not disappointed. The skin was crisp, although I wish there was enough to order an extra plate of skin. The portion of meat was the best I have seen. The pork was delicious and was not riddled with fat as at some other locations we tried. The sambal on the pork was excellent and the spicy sambal on the table was extra hot the way I like it. My girlfriend preferred the soup at this location, although it was not my favorite. Overall a 4 star rating because roasted pig in the Philippines is much better. As for Bali, this is the best to date.

author: Lina
review_text: Fruits were so fresh, wide variety too! However I definitely feel that the taste of the dishes are just average and it’s the visual appeal and photo-worthy plating of the meals that makes them stand out. The portion of the french toast served is very generous — probably would recommend sharing it with someone else. The slices we got didn’t seem fully soaked with egg which was slightly disappointing as only the outside of the bread bore the taste of a classic french toast. So overall, not overly impressed with the toast but the fruits absolutely made up for it! As for the Happy Bowl, the yogurt was vanilla-flavoured and too sweet for my liking, though I guess that could depend on personal preference. Would be interested in seeing variations with soy/greek yogurt offered. Would recommend getting this if you’re just interested in a light meal as it won’t fill you up Lastly, we had the ABF! Bacon didn’t look that appetising but taste overall was good, nothing to write home about but a good typical breakfast~ The cafe isn’t very large which does contribute to the cozy homey vibe, but can definitely feel a bit cramped for some and the few tables present can lead to a wait time. Thankfully we didn’t have to wait long — felt like just 5 minutes! Staff also don’t rush you to clear your table like some restaurants do. Even stayed a little after we were finished to have a coffee :) Coming from Bangkok the prices are just incredible - any brunch spot in Bangkok would probably (over)charge you double for the french toast.

author: Guanny G
review_text: Finally got a chance to try this place, recommended as a top Nasi Lemak in town. Place is crowded despite the rain and early morning for a weekday. Queue can be challenging for peak period and weekend. Food is ordered at the table. Taste wise, rice is fragrant and well cooked with coconut milk. The fried fish and ayam rempah was dry unfortunately. Overall, just ok ....

author: katie Weston
review_text: Lovely rooftop atmosphere. Several vegetarian options (made fresh rice paper rolls upon request). Would come again. Able to get a walk in about 5:30pm

author: Mauro Martin
review_text: Thong Smith at Siam Paragon offers an elevated take on classic Thai boat noodles. The broth is the clear standout-deep, aromatic, and intensely savory, simmered to a rich concentration without feeling heavy. You can choose from pork, beef, or mixed toppings, all tender, well-portioned, and noticeably high in quality. The noodles have a satisfying bite, while the seasoning is well-balanced with herbs and chili-bold yet refined. The freshness of the bean sprouts and leafy greens adds a crisp, clean contrast, balancing the richness of the broth and perfectly completing the dish. Portions are smaller than traditional street-style bowls, but this allows you to enjoy multiple variations or pair them with side dishes and light Thai desserts. Service is efficient despite the crowd, and the atmosphere is polished yet comfortable-ideal for both a quick lunch and a relaxed mall dinner. Overall: A premium, well-executed interpretation of a Thai classic with consistent quality and depth of flavor-a must-visit for boat noodle lovers in Bangkok.

author: Philip Yazbak
review_text: Fantastic food! A massive menu and quick service. I got the Nashville chicken sandwich and my friends got some pizza and the pulled pork sandwich. The food was incredible and the price was fair! All in all you can't go wrong stopping here!!

author: Kancy Eng
review_text: Healthy dim sum. Fresh ingredients. Lack of varieties compared to chok Dee. A bit bland taste. Nice aircon environment.

author: Ann Chee
review_text: The Q was long and eye catching when u pass by the shop one wouldn’t miss noticing why this shop has such long q. So we decided to give it a try, in the q, there were return customers they told us the food is sooo good. Once the shop opened, they can only accommodate 17 ppl, after that one will have to wait for the first batch to finished their meal before there is any empty seats. The shop is not a fancy one, the design layout of the place is not impressive at all. So ppl are here for the food not the environment. On the menu, there are lean, semi lean and fatty pork (pork belly) parts to be deep fried. I choose the semi lean. The portion of the pork is huge thick cut, of course the price also match the portion served which is rm45+. Maybe I have high expectation on the food, I personally think that the ingredients are fresh, well prepared but lack of unique or rather impressive flavour. At first bite, it will immediately give you this “it’s just a regular pork being deep fried” that’s it. If u like deep fried food and pork, this is the place for you.

author: SF Goh
review_text: So far is my favourite Bak Chor Mee noodle in this area. They're so comforting, and have an amazing flavor, slightly high salt level and springy noodles.Ever since I come to this area will think of this stall of lots of Pork Lark of noodle. The chilli in vinegar is a must to pair with the noodles if you can take spice. However dumplings so so, sometimes can be long queue, try to come off peak hour if you can

author: Juan World
review_text: Went there food was good i ate the plantains with fried meat very tasty my sister gad the tamarind juice n she loved it the pasteles en oja were great but the young server with red hair was real off she was like a robot made us feel kinda unwanted she never smiled real dry

author: Chef Tony
review_text: I've been wanting to try this place. Well, no surprise, I was disappointed. I understand busy and wanting to turn tables, but there is this thing called customer service, rather than watch your customers and ask if they are finished, ask them how thier meal is or if they need anything. I really like being asked how my meal is or if I need anything. With that said, the food was good, DO NOT order a Cappuccino from them. That was really my only problem. The waitress was nice and took it off, Reason why I left a good tip.

author: WanderWithWit
review_text: Review of Old Airport Road Food Centre Overall, Old Airport Road Food Centre exceeded my expectations with its impressive variety of Singapore heritage dishes. It’s an excellent place to experience a wide range of local flavours, and I’ll continue exploring more stalls and updating this review over time. I also appreciated the creativity behind many stall names, with references to places like Chong Pang, Kallang, and Blanco Court, which add a nostalgic local charm to the food centre. ⸻ 1. Old Airport Road Fried Hokkien Mee (#01-99) ★★★★☆ (4/5) A wet-style Hokkien Mee with noticeable wok hei. While the prawn flavour is relatively mild, the $8 portion is generous, featuring four prawns along with pork and sotong. A satisfying plate and good value for those who enjoy a slightly soupy version. ⸻ 2. Famous Old Airport Fried Oyster (#01-101) ★★★☆☆ (3/5) Tried the $10 3-in-1 oyster omelette with oysters, prawns, and squid. Portion was generous, but the omelette was soft and soggy, heavy on tapioca flour, and lacked crispness. Prawns were overcooked, and squid ran out quickly. Not worth the price. ⸻ 3. Chong Pang Huat BBQ (#01-90) ★★★☆☆ (3/5) Prices are higher than typical hawker stalls, with $1.60 chicken wings and small satay portions. Value was disappointing, and hygiene concerns left a poor impression. Unlikely to return. ⸻ 4. Jin Fried Rice (#01-63) ★★★★★ (5/5) One of the best fried rice stalls I’ve tried. The mala fried rice with Chinese sausage, sunny-side-up egg, and pork chop was fragrant and full of flavour. Despite switching from Japanese rice to regular rice, the quality remains excellent. The pork chop was juicy and a clear standout. A must-try. ⸻ 5. Chuan Loo Bee Hokkien Food (#01-111) ★★☆☆☆ (2/5) The only stall open after 10pm, so I ordered the Imperial Pork Ribs Rice. Despite being cooked to order, the pork was extremely tough, and the sauce tasted odd and unpleasant. Very disappointing and not worth the price. ⸻ 6. Whampoa Soya Bean (#01-68) ★★★★☆ (4/5) Offers more than just soya beancurd and drinks, with a good variety of traditional desserts. While cold soya drinks can be slightly diluted, the desserts are excellent. Recommended: Soya beancurd with ginkgo & lotus nuts, peach gum soup, taro peach gum soup, yam ball soya milk. ⸻ 7. Unkai Japanese Cuisine (#01-88) ★★★★★ (5/5) A great variety of bentos and set meals at wallet-friendly prices. The salmon bowl came with a generous piece of salmon on fluffy Japanese rice. Simple, satisfying, and good value. Will return to try more items. ⸻ 8. Western Barbeque (#01-53) ★★★☆☆ (3/5) Despite the long queues, the chicken chop didn’t stand out. No bun is provided, and the only sauce available was garlic sauce, which lacked flavour. Decent, but there are better western options nearby. ⸻ 9. Famous Kallang Airport Fried Oyster (#01-55) ★★☆☆☆ (2/5) Generous with oysters, but the omelette was overly oily. The excess oil overshadowed the dish. Still searching for a better fried oyster omelette. ⸻ 10. Salt (#01-128) ★★★★☆ (4/5) A western-style stall selling spaghetti, chicken chop, herbal chicken, and fried wings. I tried the Sous Vide Grilled Chicken with Aglio Olio. The aglio olio was decent, garlicky, and not too oily. The chicken chop was glazed with teriyaki sauce instead of the usual western sauces. While acceptable, $9.90 feels expensive for a hawker centre given the portion and simplicity.

author: Kevin Osborn
