review_text: Nice Vibe and great,creative food. We went there for new years brunch and it was Fabulous. The service was friendly but a little slow after we got our food ( which was quick)

author: Lauren Smith
review_text: Dinner was a lack luster. The best thing to order are the mushroom tacos, the carrots in the tostadas could be softer and use less sauce. Don’t order the chicken Milanese or the steak. Both came out burnT. Brussels sprouts also very burnt. You really shouldn’t be eating burnt food, that causes cancer. bill was close to 200$ which is underwhelming for a sub par experience

author: Shaun Kart
review_text: Go with what they are known for and you can't go wrong However they do have good pastrami burgers and their hot dogs are pretty good too

author: Michael Holstrom
review_text: The ladies that work here are sweet and always smiling. We love Bob's Deli and come every week on our bike rides. They have won us over with their great sandwiches and service.

author: candice chong
review_text: Air conditioned restaurant selling nasi kandar. If you seek for halal food in Batu kawan area, can have a try .

author: nicole Idriceanu
review_text: Jasmine is the best at teamwork, hospitality and efficiency. The food was amazing (Collard Greens, awesome) and Catfish Poh Boy takes me to new Oreelans: crunchy, robust fish, light and smoother tasting. Thanks Cornbread Soul Food! Thanks Jasmine! Will be back soon

author: Lowella Tay
review_text: We ordered the bep cuon platter as well as the bun cha and everything was amazing. Cant choose which was my favourite since all was equally good. Definitely a must try when in Ho Chi Minh! Service from Nhu Y was also great! She showed us how to eat the banh xeo and it was very delicious.

author: Kayla Ward
review_text: Service is very slow here! It is a very popular place so it is understandable. Food is great as well.

author: Zakaria ESSALMI
review_text: La Favela is a must visit in Bali! The food was amazing, from flavorful starters and perfectly ink sauce calamari to juicy steak and fresh fish. Cocktails were creative and refreshing, and the birthday surprise dessert was such a thoughtful touch. The ambience is unique, artistic, and vibrant, and after dinner the place transforms into a lively nightclub with great music and atmosphere. Perfect spot for a special night out highly recommended!

author: Ct Harwanie
review_text: I order a scallop. The scallops are a standout—each one delicately topped with a medley of herbs and peanut that add freshness and texture. A squeeze of lime brings everything to life, enhancing the natural sweetness of the seafood.

author: Sarah Slatniske
review_text: If you’re like us and not from the area and this place comes up nearby… GO EAT HERE!! 100/10 experience. Menu was amazing!! Decently priced. Great staff and wonderful owner. Family friendly!! Perfect privately owned place at the beach and the food was amazing.

author: Modern Spin 7410 Broadway
review_text: Came here for my God father’s repass dinner. Over 50 ppl and i must say they were amazing. Both service and food was impeccable. Very impressive menu and dessert was scrumptious! Highly recommend. Although ill miss my chicken fingers and fries at 3am , the transition to fine dining was a great change. Well done. Coming from another restaurant owner..

author: Ghazal Lotfi
review_text: Good Vietnamese food in Bali. Unfortunately, there’s no air conditioning, which made the dining experience quite uncomfortable.

author: Paabii “Aayusna” Atokved
review_text: Perfect place to stop if you are seafood lover. There wide varieties of grill and fried dishes with dessert makes it worth it. There hibachi is my absolute favorite all the time.

author: Arnab Paul
review_text: Crowded, but worth it. There was a 30 min+ line of locals on Sat afternoon, but it moved fast. Plenty of open spaces inside. I got the bhindi (steamed okra), cabbage and goat curry. Of course, an assortment of curries were ladled on top! The food tasted fresh and was finger-licking good. Highly recommended.

author: turev acar
review_text: Great coffee and snack options. Recommending charcoal coffee and other coffee specialities. An ideal place to work and enjoy coffee at the same time. Not too many food options.

author: Ms Flo
review_text: My husband and I visited Fiore Café; a humble, small scale cafè, last week while we were in town. From beginning to end, we were greeted with smiles and treated favorably. Our waitress was very polite, and checked in on us quite frequently. Our order arrived swiftly, fresh and hot. Our waitress continued to check in on us throughout our meal. We would definitely return to Fiore Cafe again.

author: Xavier M
review_text: I tried the short rib fried rice, with a 3/5 spice level ((3 is definitely hot enough to feel it)) and it was excellent. You’re able to add an egg but I chose not too. Went in on a Monday and got seated without a wait but there’s usually a long line on busy nights, expect to wait 50-90 minutes on weekends. They also have an outdoor window for to-go orders. Bar has a nice selection of wines and local brews on tap, some imported beers and spirits as well. Pedro and Destiny were rocking the bar when I visited. Expect to pay downtown prices, but the portions are pretty large, definitely able to split an entree with 2-3 people.

author: Evelyn Mendivil
review_text: I enjoy this place, it is not overpriced and food tastes good. The staff is also welcoming and kind.

author: Kenny Tan
review_text: Food is definitely overrated. There r better n tasty suckling pig meals in other southeast asia. Food price is pricy relative. Cash only which is inconvenient. Also there r no green leafy vegetable in their vegetable or soup dish mainly carrot beans and potato. Meat is quite dry and the fried pork skin is hard to chew. Location is hidden in small alleyways. Environment is very dark in daytime so that doesnt help either. i will give it a miss

author: Shmiley C
review_text: I would say this is a must try in HCMC for a massive banh mi. The long line should be an indicator that this place knows what's up. The price of the banh mi is higher than the price at street cart vendors because the quantity is bigger here. Banh mi dac biet is 73,000 VND. Wait in line to order first. *Cash only. Then pick up order inside. You can take the food away or there is indoor seating in the room to the right side. It's messy! They separate the veggies. CASH ONLY No wifi

author: Evan Tan
review_text: An absolute hidden gem! This chinese restaurant (with a chef from Hong Kong) is located in such a secluded road in the Pluit area, which makes it quite hard for random passerbys to see and notice. But when you do notice and do decide to give it a try, they truly do not disappoint. To start of, they have a plethora of options for any Chinese food connoiseur to be blown away. They have plenty of variety from their appetizers to the mains and soups and desserts. To put it simply, every dish (as pictured in my uploads) were amazing. But to highlight my two favorites, I would say the Suan Cai Yu and the Bubur Udang Galah are some of the best dishes in town! I would go even further to say that the Suan Cai Yu (ikan sayur asin) they have is the best compared to their peers. All that to say, what a wonderful delight of a restaurant. Most of the older locals already know and frequent Seven Kingdoms, but it's about time this restaurant gets recognition not only from the Pluit locals but also from the younger hipper foodies of Jakarta.

author: Lynn Surnock
review_text: We went at lunchtime and it was lovely. A relaxing and delicious meal. Service was exceptional. The chandelier was a real surprise. I would like to go back in the evening for rat pack type music.

author: Jubal Engelhard
review_text: Really nice folks working here 🤗 The Flannel Hash is my all time favourite 😋 and the HUGE wall art piece is mesmerizing 🤠

author: Sharon Chen
review_text: Love the desserts here! Everything is fresh and beautifully presented. The bingsu is super soft and melts in your mouth. Cozy environment and friendly staff!

author: Cayla Madaris
review_text: Pretty good experience! My eggs were perfectly soft scrambled. Potatoes were goooood. The chai latte was delicious. The biscuits were burned and tough, could only eat about half of it but they did take some off of the check. The waiter could have been more attentive but overall a pretty good visit!

author: Sharvari Thorat
review_text: We were so glad to find this place open late on Christmas Eve. The vibe was warm, welcoming, and the restaurant was spotless. The prices are perfect—meaning super affordable without compromising on quality. Portions were ideal for two, and every bite was top-notch. Hearty, flavorful, and truly satisfying Thai food. Will definitely visit again!

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: Chong Tee Lim
review_text: Goodyear Seafood Village Tampines offers a lovely destination for family and friend gatherings in a laid back kampong style setting. The restaurant’s Pontian style herbal bak kut teh, served in a claypot, is fragrant and flavourful with a herbal depth that’s lighter than Teochew versions but balanced with garlic and ginseng. The ribs are firm yet tender and absorb the broth beautifully, making it a satisfying shared dish. Aside from bak kut teh, the zi char menu shines. The Assam fish head is a standout with a tangy spicy sauce made from scratch that delivers a satisfying depth. It showcases fresh sea bass served with vegetables and pineapple. Other highlights include golden garlic pork, prawn paste chicken, cabbage chicken claypot, hotplate tofu and salted egg yolk pork ribs. Portions are generous and flavours bold enough for sharing. The ambience is rustic and peaceful. Dining here feels like stepping into a Malaysian kampong with open air seating and greenery around. The venue is spacious with both indoor and outdoor seating options, making it family friendly. Service is casual and warm though not highly polished. Staff are generally friendly. Parking can be a challenge on weekends and reservations are wise if dining in larger groups. Delivery and takeaway through WhatsApp is also available if you prefer to enjoy the food at home. Overall experience offers great value. Expect to spend around 8 to 13 dollars per bowl for bak kut teh, with zi char mains starting from 12 dollars depending on size. The generous portions, rich herbal broth, and standout dishes like Assam fish head and prawn paste chicken make it worth the slight effort to travel out a bit. For family or friend gatherings this is a solid choice with delicious dishes suited to sharing, affordable pricing, relaxed vibe, and a touch of rustic charm you don’t often find in the city.

author: Mr Polo
review_text: 10/31/25 Casandra made my day. A beautiful 18 yr old employee who exchanged my fries to make them lighter and more tender.She’s the perfect customer charmer with a beautiful smile to Charm an older wizard like myself and make my strawberry shake sweeter! I’ll be back ! This place also runs like a Rolex Watch! A clean as they go and stock up supplies and condiments gracefully and with ease . Thanks to management. Sincerely M Polo! 6/30/25 Sebastian made my day, especially this wonderful location. From the moment I walked in, he informed me about additives that I asked about that you could put on fries and burgers at no extra charge. He was constantly busy cleaning everywhere from the floor to the windows and the doors. He also rang up my order on the register. I had a wonderful shake fries with chopped herbs on top and a mustard fried patty on my double burger with extra tomato lettuce. A wonderful experience with the wonderful guy who I know will be a huge success and all he does. Thank you in and out Management for having such a wonderful employee such as Sebastian. I’m looking forward to seeing him in the future. +++++++++++++++++++++++++ 10-16-2023 Again a great 4x 4 burger and strawberry shake. Very quick service, clean rest rooms and a fast staff of 8 to 10 workers. ********************************** In and out 9/22 8pm The young lady at the counter was very professional and smiling. And my food came out quickly thank you for that. Of course I had to order my 4 x 4 which the lady said they still had. I ordered it with extra tomatoes no pickles but it came with cheese that I didn’t order but I ate it anyway. It was fresh and delicious and the fries are pretty good as well. The strawberry shake was delicious as well. I was surprised they didn’t have any veteran discounts because all the other burger places I know do. The front door does not have any auto handicap buttons to open the doors and although it’s wheelchair accessible but not handy. It’s a nice clean establishment. Enjoy your food. Be blessed and safe always. Jesus cares say your prayers Amen ****************************** ****New location. Sandhill at Flamingo. Great 4x4 burger. Fresh & tender, moist and delicious. Delayed Service with a smile but counter service seemed ignored even though 5 employees like busy bees. I had to call loudly across the counter and ask if they were taking orders while the cashier was packaging catsup. Food was quickly served, clean rest rooms for male as female. Very clean establishment. Great atmosphere .

author: ChrisTina
review_text: charming restaurant with rustic retro decor. The indoor ambience was cosy, though seating was limited. We've tried the crab meat aglio olio and truffle fries, which were decent but didn't stand out. However, the fish and chips and pizza were quite tasty. The real star of the meal was the beef bolognese; it was superbly delicious, bursting with flavour. Overall, the delightful atmosphere and the standout food makes this restaurant worth another visit for a comforting and flavorful meal. do take note that the entrance is behind the alley. there are few parking spots in front of the restaurant.

author: Laura Castaneda
review_text: I went last night for dinner with my family and we completely enjoyed it since the first moment we walked in, everybody were so friendly. The environment was fabulous, nice music, beautiful place. Food was outstanding that i cant even explain how delicious it was. Wonderful service, always checking on us and making sure we were having a good time. I totally recommend it. They have a new fusion menu with sushi which let me tell u is the best in town and a wonderful seafood platter. THE BEST!!! I will definitely be back!!!!

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: MightyFoodie
review_text: Halal-certified, and known for its signature chicken rice balls, Ee Ji Ban in Malacca serves moist, tender steamed chicken paired with fragrant, compact rice balls. Location: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball, 275, Jalan Melaka Raya 3, Taman Melaka Raya, 75000 Melaka, Malaysia

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Rose K
review_text: All the food is delicious. I really like the soft pork curry rice. Today I ate fried rice with rice noodles. It's exactly like the one I used to eat when I was a kid.

author: long koek
review_text: Came to eat many times....but no chance to review bcos once the dimsum served on table, everyone's chopsticks action faster than camera. Today i managed to capture few photos. This dim sum shop is very famous among the local Thai and even the Malaysian Chinese. The lady boss is charming and her daughter is pretty. The guy boss will fried his golden pla tongko. Recommended on the fish head fried koayteow. Variety of Dimsum to choose.

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: Sryo
review_text: Rice ball was very tasty! Chicken a bit bland for me, but the kangkung was really nice. Sotong also good, just portion quite small for the price. Overall okay to visit, worth trying for the experience.

author: SarElIG71
review_text: Amazing our waiter Spencer made our afternoon so delightful for being our first time visiting you. Food suggestions, even pictures with us Your wings for sure, delicious. My party and I got different stuff to try a lil bit of everything. Salad, pasta and me your lamb chops. Everything was good. If I can point something only, your sweet potato fries those were soft not crunchy as I ate them before. But if it that recipe, I understand. Thank you, you may see us again.

author: Sharon Lee
review_text: Frog leg was good, staff all friendly and nice. Stingray was normal only but the price is considered okay for the amount of food we had.

author: Harrison Nguyen
review_text: **Dragon Express — Nellis Blvd, Las Vegas** Located on the east side of Las Vegas, Dragon Express stands as a testament to the enduring appeal of a vibrant culinary tapestry of Las Vegas. Dragon Express stands as a testament to the enduring appeal of family-run establishments that resist the sterile confines of modern minimalism. With the warmth of a bygone era, this eatery embodies a heartfelt commitment to satisfying its patrons with genuine hospitality. The counter—creatively situated within a thoughtfully transformed former Panda Express layout—exudes an atmosphere radiating earnestness and unpretentious generosity. Upon entry, one is immediately enveloped by an ambiance that prioritizes the diner's appetite over curated aesthetic experiences intended for social media. My culinary journey commenced with Plate B, a veritable feast comprising fried rice paired with two sumptuous entrées: orange chicken and Chinese sweet BBQ pork. The to-go container itself was a marvel—a veritable cornucopia filled to the brim, defiantly resisting closure as its bountiful contents spilled forth. This overflow is reminiscent of a traditional ethos where generous portions reflect gratitude and hospitality, serving as a tactile embodiment of warmth and welcome. Upon its arrival, the orange chicken immediately tantalized both the eyes and the palate. Its outer shell, delicately crisp and audibly crackling, sidesteps the common pitfalls of overly sweet or gummy variations. Beneath this crisp exterior lies perfectly cooked, juicy meat, inviting the diner to indulge. The accompanying sauce enhances the experience with a vibrant citrus note that sings on the taste buds, beautifully balanced by a caramelized depth. This harmony combines a gentle sweetness with a zingy acidity that invigorates the senses. Subtle hints of ginger dance alongside a nuanced soy essence, while a persistent umami resonance compels the diner to savor each bite long after the last mouthful has been enjoyed. This interplay leaves a lingering pucker-sweetness that tantalizes the palate and entices for more. Complementing the exuberant orange chicken, the Chinese sweet BBQ pork presents itself as a more reflective counterpart. Its glossy exterior, masterfully caramelized, exhibits a sticky sheen that entices without overwhelming. Each tender slice yields effortlessly, unveiling juicy morsels imbued with a fragrant medley of toasted garlic and nuanced fermented soy. These layers of umami depth transform the accompanying fried rice from a mere side dish into an essential contributor to the overall experience, enriching the meal with every harmonious bite. Speaking of the fried rice, it is a triumph of precision and restraint—each grain is meticulously separated, imbued with savory aromatic undertones that invite exploration, punctuated by the bright freshness of scallions. This rice serves as an ideal underpinning, effectively balancing the saucier elements of the meal while providing a comforting contrast that delights both the palate and the spirit. The dish unfolds as a culinary symphony, intertwining the luminous zest of the orange chicken, the smoky richness of the pork, and the grounding comfort of the rice into every bite. What lingers in memory is not merely a singular flavor, but rather a harmonious gestalt—a delicate equilibrium of sweetness and salt, a profound umami foundation, and an evident spirit of generosity manifested in both the ample portions and the thoughtful preparation. Dragon Express does not seek to redefine culinary boundaries; instead, it elegantly embodies the art of straightforward, satisfying Chinese-American fare, crafted with authenticity and care. For those who appreciate cuisine as a quiet act of camaraderie—inviting, devoid of pretension yet bursting with flavor—Dragon Express deserves unequivocal recognition. Five stars.

author: Jared Z.
review_text: I’m from SuZhou, and I think in terms of taste and price this place would be pretty hard to beat anywhere in California. Definitely worth a try and I recommend the half fried juicy pork bao (生煎包）.

author: Levent T
review_text: I can say almost perfect. Service and atmosphere is very good. Kitchen if we speak about appetizers 5 over 5, about seafood they know what they are doing 5 over 5, just steak cuts and cooking NY steak and serving that average, it was cold we told server and they act immediately and changed with new one but unfortunately also second one was cold and the cut was wrong and chewy but steak quality was delicious . It is worth to go again but you will definitely order seafood

author: Matt Bernson
review_text: A lil expensive but still accessible considering the area. Pizza was tasty. Beer was good. They had a deal for a cheese slice and the evel ale for $8 which is what I'd recommend. Some seating but it gets packed easy so likely have to wait for a seat. Chill rockin decor. They call out your name for you to pick up your slice. Like a 2 minute walk to the fremont experience. They have slices ready of each of their specialty flavors. T-Shirts for $35.

author: pedro pedrao
review_text: Always have a great time at this place. Specially saturdays with live music. And Leandro is a very nice guy.

author: Carlota Aguiar
review_text: Food was insanely good, super fresh, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. And the views? UNREAL. Watching the sunset from there is just magical, the whole sky turns golden and the place becomes even more stunning. If you want a perfect table with those cliffside sunset views, reservations are a must. Like seriously, book ahead or you’ll miss the best spots. Everything from the ambiance to the service to the food made this one of our favourite dining experiences in Bali. Absolutely worth it!

author: Bernardo Dizon
review_text: Please dont come here expecting fine dining. It's a chain buffet. Come here for a cheat meal. Come here for your protein intake. Variety of choices to fill you up without breaking the bank. I spent >$20 for a Sunday breakfast buffet with water and coffee, and that's including tip.

author: Just Wall
review_text: Many times coming to this restaurant. Great vibe, great food, great service. The Saigon Pho is 10/10. The platter is just amazing! The drinks are also great. This place keeps me coming back!

author: Chlotus
review_text: You can just tell from the outside that this place serves amazing food! The sandwich, Banh Mi, is absolutely delicious, especially with the meat. It may not be the classic flavor you expect, but I really enjoy it! I honestly think it's one of the best I’ve ever had.

author: Su Myat Kyi Sin
review_text: It worths the hype and the flavor the texture are amazing. Even the simple ice cream was so good that the taste was so smooth. The durian rice bun was the highlight of the show as well. It was around 200-300 baht around for one item. But definitely you can share and try because of big portions.

author: The Genesis Family
review_text: Come early to get queue number, long waiting is expected at this Ipoh famous dim sum spot, certainly lives up to its reputation. Be prepared for a bustling atmosphere and potential queues, but it's part of the experience. Their dim sum selection is vast and generally delicious, with classics like har gow and siew mai always fresh and tasty. It's a classic, no-frills setting focused purely on the food. For an authentic and satisfying dim sum breakfast, it's a consistently good choice.

author: Riri
review_text: A lovely little café with a charming outdoor garden filled with greenery, which instantly lifts your mood. I had the delicious Ryan’s French Toast, served with a variety of fresh fruits, and enjoyed a relaxed afternoon chatting with friends.

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: Mike Yong
review_text: Came about 3PM on Sunday. Still pretty crowd; but managed to get a table inside the shop soon enough. Ordered both steam & roasted chicken and a plate of rice balls. Both chicken were equally tender enough; and rice balls were dense and flavorful too. The chili was good & spicy too.

author: M. Carolina Ticona
review_text: The best Venezuelan empanada with ham and cheese I have had in Boston! Freshly served and a filling size. The cachapa was also deliciy, moist and you can taste the corn! Was lucky to have it served with Queso De Mano and perníl (shredded pork). Also the best papelón I have had in a very long time. Reminded me of my childhood in Venezuela. The staff was attentive, friendly and patient with all my questions as it was my first visit. Can’t wait to return for breakfast for a cafecito and an empanada.

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: bo seo
review_text: When I think of and crave Thai food, the first restaurant I go to is Kub Khao' Kub Pla. The flavors and balance of the dishes are absolutely perfect. And I'm a huge fan of the food brand line owned by Khun Pla. Because almost every restaurant she owns has delicious food, and my absolute favorite for Thai food is Kub Kao' Kub Pla. And at the Central World branch, the food was served quickly and the service was excellent.

author: Teh Xin Yu
review_text: Old school bakery which is around for more than 20 years in Penang. You definitely feel like walking through the time tunnel once you entered the shop. You are first welcome with the fragrant wheat smell as the bread was baked freshly in the shop. There are varieties of choices for bread, pastries, muffins and they also have sourdough now! All the items look tasty and fresh. Some of the items was cheap while some are slightly expensive. For example, their sourdough bread are less than RM10 but some of the basic bun such as coconut bun are RM 4. My parents personally feel the coconut bun are a bit underwhelming as the bun might look big but the coconut filling was actually not many, it is not filled up in the middle of bun. Instead, you can see clearly in the picture the darker green colour was the shredded coconut filling while the lighter green part is the bread. The coconut filling is one small circle in the bun. Will probably revisit to try their other items such as baked pastries, sourdough bread and wholemeal bun but definitely not this coconut bun. Also, the architecture of the shop is interesting as the shop owner did not change much of the shop exterior and interior structure, the building has the British colonial era vibe. It is super hard to get a parking there, it is easier to park inside nearby New World Park paid parking lot, and walk to this shop which is only 3 minutes walking distance away.

author: H L
review_text: There were a few famous stalls with queues that we didn’t go for. Seng Huat Western - 4.5/5 ⭐️ not sure if there’s no queue or because they gave out buzzers. Regardless, the food was really good! It’s the traditional western comfort food we used to get. their coleslaw ⭐️ might be the star of the show it’s not the creamy kind that I dislike, instead it’s light and refreshing maybe because of the lime/lemon juice that they added into it! Fries were also well fried and crispy. Riverside Good Food - 5/5⭐️ Kinda sad that there’s not much queue compared to the famous Zion riverside char kway teow. No comparison since I didn’t try the famous one, but riverside’s char kway teow might be one of the best I’ve had!! There’s wok hey and there’s also plenty of fried pork lard 😍

author: OB
review_text: Food looked pretty good when it came out. Everything tasted ok in the end, it was just lacking a bit. Staff thought it was a good idea to give us plastic forks and knives to cut steak. Had to ask 4 times and wait 20 minutes before we got it. Service was worse. It really felt like none of the staff members wanted to be there.

author: Vea Cayaba
review_text: Came for a quick dinner on a Monday night, no wait and service was quick. Chicken is on point, but sides are a little pricey starting at $9.

author: Lay Ying Yeoh
review_text: A hidden cafe in an alleyway with good atmosphere. The lunch set is worth, the portion might be small and the taste just average, more delicious is Chicken Alfredo Penne. The menu slightly change compared to before, now only can choose the main dish from three choice, side dish, appetizers and drinks are fixed. Parking won't be the problem here, can park at the alleyway.

author: Matt Culbertson
review_text: Meh. I tend to love new flavors and items but this was a miss. The chicken skins were weird. The bacon jam was blah. The deviled eggs were good but 16 bucks for 4 is crazy, especially when they aren't the best I've had. It was ok though so 3 stars. Updated to one star seeing they charge credit card surcharge.

author: Kelly He
review_text: first time having ethiopian food! i think it tasted good and felt good quality but 1. didnt realize its vegetarian lol thats on me 2. the tables/chairs were weird heights so it was a little uncomfy and the live music on wednesdays was wayy too loud :// we got the feast for 2 and feast for 3 for 5 of us. it was so big (see photos for size comparison) and the shai tea was p good too! overall the food is good. id imagine youd love it if you were vegetarian and/or love ethiopian food but im not convinced its for me quite yet

author: Yi Ling
review_text: I honestly love this hawker centre so much, and it hits my old soul in the most nostalgic punch. Though there aren't many food options in the 2nd level, this place is bustling with elderly and 1st and 2nd gen hawkers. You really don't get to see this very often anymore. Most of the patrons here are the elderly and prices are pretty much catered to them as well with smaller portions and price point. Facilities wise, there are: ✅️ Great ventilation with multiple ceiling fans and big head room space ✅️ Clean toilets with soap ✅️ Wet market at level 1

author: Alex Canizare
review_text: It was my first time at this restaurant. When we went there it was full. We have to wait for 30 minutes. Once seated, our waiter was good, I think his name was Bubba. He was very helpful and professional. The food was great. Loved the Fajita Trio. Highly recommended.

author: suanne
review_text: love the food here.. first time visit and it amazes me in many ways.. the food here is savory and sweet, many cute spots to take pictures and the coffee here taste super warm. the atmosphere around here is chill and windy.. great spot to chill and relax! will definitely come back again and try other food 🤤🤤

author: Doris Chen
review_text: The Round Market is very crowded on weekends morning. The food price is reasonable while the taste is mediocre.

author: cande topete
review_text: I visit Vegas about once a month and always enjoy coming to this ihop. I often bring my family and we're always greeted with a smile. Ester is amazing, she's always in a great mood with great energy, which makes the experience even better. Friendly service and a welcoming atmosphere every time. Highly recommend!

author: Fahriza Berliana
review_text: prices are affordable and it’s close to the MRT station. a bit hot and some spots could be cleaner, but can’t complain… overall it’s good! will definitely go back!

author: douglas hendrix
review_text: To me one of the best pizza places in vegas....by far my favorite..... don't even have to go for Just Pizza the appetizer menu is second to none a absolute must try are the hot honey chicken strips and the chicken parm egg roles

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Alexandro Gould-Arocha
review_text: An excellent restaurant with unbelievable vegetarian options. The first time I went here I tried a vietnamese pancake for the first time and it was one of the best things I've ever eaten. The staff here are wonderful and attentive. Shoutout to the manager James for his excellent service. He even dropped me off near my hotel when the street was flooded- what a great guy. If I come back to Saigon, this is one of the first places I'll visit.

author: LH Smith
review_text: Emillie is always there for Amanda and me. Not only is the newly constructed bar clean and aesthetically appealing, along with the views being amazing, the service is warm, friendly, attentive and FUN!!! Excellent salmon and rice dish, too.

author: Ong Chun Keat
review_text: I have no idea during the time when we want to do the payment, the cashier asked me what I ordered, I was telling what I ordered and he didn't want to listen, kept sembang sembang and shouting, in the end he confirmed with colleagues what I ordered, apparently he wasn't believe in me, after he told me the price and I paid for it, few seconds later they stopped me asked I got order roti or not, mdfk I at the beginning I already told I got ordered roti, he dint want to listen, kept sembang and shouting with colleagues, eventually asked me to pay for additional price for the roti. In conclusion, if you don't believe in customer don't ask what they ordered lah diu, write it down by your own, during payment just tell the price. Sucks management

author: Sergio Murgas
review_text: We visited Petralunga and had a very pleasant experience. We ordered several dishes to share and overall we were satisfied. The Cacio e Pepe stood out for its great texture and a creamy, well-balanced flavor. The burrata was fresh, pairing nicely with the bread and olive oil. The fried calamari were crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, not greasy at all — a solid start to the meal. The tuna tartare was fresh, beautifully presented, and had a clean flavor. Nice atmosphere, friendly service, and good quality dishes. A recommended spot for a relaxed meal with Italian flavor.

author: Ta'Shana Brown
review_text: Today, I had a very bad experience with the servers/cashiers at Only One Jamaican Restaurant on Hyde Park avenue. I was purchasing a soup and I asked if the boiled dumpling was made with cornmeal. The response given was, “I don’t know sir”. Instead of attempting to find out for me, she alongside another worker decided to make other comments as if I were to know what ingredients were used. This is very bothersome as a paying customer. The customer service was overall terrible. At the end of it I left with regret and unable to properly enjoy my meal.

author: Shaquanna Brown
review_text: Food is usually good -- pretty much what we'd expect of an average / slight above average Jamaican food takeout restaurant. For the dinner plate, I would prefer for the meat portions to be larger and the rice portion smaller.

author: Rachel Iacomini
review_text: I want to start by saying I’ve had burgers and truffle fries here before and they were solid but today’s meal was not great at all and I’m super disappointed. I ordered online directly from the website and went to pick up right away. Was there within 10 minutes and it was already ready….red flag! I got home about 7 minutes later and the food was so cold, it just didn’t feel fresh at all. I got the 3 piece buffalo tenders and truffle fries and first of all these are in WAY too small of a container. Separate the fries and chicken please. 🙏 The chicken tenders were super odd….never seen anything like them and honestly I didn’t eat them at all. They really ruined my appetite. They were HUGE pieces of chicken tenderloin that were poorly breaded, and not crispy at all. All the breading (which was minimal) was soggy and falling off. Partially due to it not seeming fresh or recently fried and then partially from being in a super cramped container with no air vents. This time the fries seemed different as well…like frozen ones when I swore they used to seem fresh and I thought they used to have rosemary but I might be wrong. Not sure if management changed or the quality is just going down hill but I’m not sure I’ll be back.

author: Jarrett Hobday
review_text: Hidden gem. Very ‘local’ feel eating here & the people were super friendly. The food was fantastic and affordable - I went for the beef stir fried noodles. Would definitely recommend.

author: Ron Vega
review_text: The food was delicious. Some of the lightest, fluffiest, and delicious pumpkin pancakes. Everything we ate was so good. Can't wait to go back. The staff was super sweet and nice 👍🏽🙂

author: Wong Kuen siang
review_text: I prefer the normal kopi. The salted coffee is unique like caramel but it is just something new and I prefer the old coffee. Simple, clean and airy location below the apartments. Kaya toast is very crispy and best eaten when hot. It will turn soggy once cool down. Kaya is fragrant. Indeed a nice place for coffee and away from the tourist. Will come more regularly . Parking is an issue. Do park a bit further at main road and walk into the housing estate

author: Pohkim Cheng
review_text: The food is great 👍 really tasty especially the fish in Tom yam soup I don't remember what it called but it was really good that I Plan to go back someday 😋

author: Olga Acosta
review_text: On my first visit to this location after an event at the Kaseya Center, the experience was unfortunately below expectations. Upon arrival, the host immediately mentioned a private event and seemed discouraging about the wait time. However, I had already observed several tables simply waiting to pay, and a couple who arrived before me was seated while I briefly stepped away. Given this, it was unclear why an accurate wait time could not be communicated. During my wait, I also observed a man who appeared to be a manager inform a server that a table was about to leave without paying due to how long they had been waiting to check out. Instead of assisting directly, he stepped back, which gave the impression that staff support and oversight were lacking. After being seated, no one approached our table for about ten minutes, not even to offer water, so I had to request assistance. When the food finally arrived, it was disappointing to find that my meal was cold and clearly not freshly prepared. When I shared this feedback with the server, she appeared unfazed and simply walked away. Later, after asking for the bill, we waited an additional ten minutes before having to flag her down again because it seemed the request had been ignored. To make matters worse, a 20% gratuity was automatically added to the bill, despite the service falling far short of that standard. Having visited other Sushi Sake locations, this experience was by far the most disappointing. Based on this visit, I do not plan to return to this location.

author: George Lim
review_text: Great lounge experience at Changi Airport Had my first visit to the Qatar Airways Premium Lounge at Changi Airport, and it was a great experience. The lounge is cozy, comfortable, and not crowded. The atmosphere is calm and relaxing. The staff were very friendly and attentive — special thanks to Hazel, Montra, Pinky, Start, and Alvin for their excellent service and helpful food and drink recommendations. Overall, very good service and a pleasant place to spend time before a flight. Would definitely visit again.

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Marblelr
review_text: I haven’t tried the pho yet, but the bun cha here is legit — clean, tasty, and pretty true to the original flavor. Definitely makes it into my top 2 or 3 favorite spots for bun cha. Prices are reasonable, and the owner (from the North) runs the place with great service and a warm, friendly attitude. Nothing to complain about — I was actually quite satisfied. The place was recommended to me by a foreign friend, and I’ve heard good things from other expat friends too. Definitely worth a try!

author: Nur
review_text: Kuba On the Bay is a vibrant gem that transported my wife and me straight to the heart of Havana! We savored every bite of the Ropa Vieja, a soul-warming dish with tender, shredded beef swimming in a rich, tangy tomato sauce that danced on our taste buds. The Vaca Frita was equally phenomenal—crispy, marinated beef with a perfect char, paired with caramelized onions that added a delightful sweetness. Each dish was a masterful blend of authentic Cuban flavors, served with a side of warm, island hospitality. To top it off, we sipped on their virgin Piña Colada, a creamy, tropical dream that was so refreshing it felt like a mini-vacation in a glass—pineapple and coconut perfection without the buzz. The atmosphere was lively yet cozy, with colorful decor and a bayfront view that made the evening unforgettable. Kuba On the Bay is a must-visit for anyone craving bold flavors and a true taste of Cuba. We can’t wait to return!

author: Jacquelyn Boyett
review_text: Stumbled upon this amazing Gem. Amazing!! My partner and I really enjoy the whole experience. Victory was our server. She was absolutely adorable and helpful. She also made our tea really well. Her spirit was very warm and welcoming. She always came back to us with a smile everytime. The food was soooooooooo good. I'm a vegan, my partner is not. It was nice to accommodate both of our food needs/wants. Food was a 10/10. The place is a vibe. The decor is industrial/ rustic with high ceilings. They had an amazing DJ the day we went. He kept some good beats going!! I really enjoyed my time there. We will be back

author: Laura Witty
review_text: 2 out of our 4 got horrible food poisoning from it. So gnarly we lost an entire day as we were so sick we couldn’t leave the hotel. I would have rated it higher because it was delicious and the service was great but I want to save someone from getting raging sick. For context we’ve been in country 2 weeks and haven’t had anything remotely to tummy troubles. This was full blown food poisoning.

author: Joe Ruiz
review_text: This was my first time going to a Hell's Kitchen. I asked who the head chef was but it wasn't anyone from the show. During our visit we didn't see him anywhere in the kitchen. Maybe he was in the back.. The beef wellington was amazing, but the portion size was a little small for a $75 plate. We also ordered two lobster risottos.. about $28 each.. unfortunately we received two different portion sizes.. where are the STANDARDS !! like Gordan Ramsey would say.. the corn puree was very bland.. but the steak I ate was very good! but the overall experience was nice.. 3 people, with tip included was around $700

author: Jelena Zekanovic
review_text: Our new go-to spot for Thai food!! The service we received made us feel like we were just at home, such a warm and inviting atmosphere. We tried the Chicken yellow curry, the spicy Thai basil, and pork jerky. The flavor was a solid 10/10, we can’t wait to go back & try all of the other items they have to offer!! You really can’t beat the quality of food, especially for the affordable price.⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: Sprinkles
review_text: It was a wonderful experience. Our cashier was Delilah and she was awesome. Very informative and knowledgeable about the menu. She recommended that we try the banana pudding and the stuffed grapes and she was so right because they were so good. I will definitely be coming back here.

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: Andrew Howard
review_text: Popular local Thai food, but as an Aussie it was surprisingly more like Australian Thai food. The pad Thai was served with Banana Blossums - a really nice touch as they are impossible to source in Australia, but the dish was normal and the prawns were at least a day old The Tamrind fish was served on a Tamirind sauce base, but not cooked with it - so effectively just fried fish with sauce. The deep fried crab with Tofu ball was nicely cooked and served on a bed of crispy light noodles. A good entre choice, but it came out after the other dishes. The highlight was the almond prawn cakes. These were juicy and nicely balance.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Tien Huynh
review_text: The soup is very delicious and the owners are very friendly )))

author: Wisanu Tuntawiroon
review_text: Hong Lim Market & Food Centre is a culinary treasure trove that lives up to its stellar reputation. Nestled in a bustling locale, this hawker centre is home to 4 or 5 Michelin-recommended stalls, each offering a unique insight into the richness of local flavors. The energy of the place is palpable—always packed with locals and food enthusiasts alike, eager to experience authentic, top-tier street eats. One of the biggest draws is the variety of food on offer. Every stall has its own specialty, ranging from meticulously crafted noodles and savory seafood dishes to irresistible satays and innovative twists on traditional recipes. Each Michelin-recommended vendor brings passion and expertise to their craft, ensuring that every bite is a memorable adventure in taste. The quality is consistently high, often rivaling that of more upscale dining establishments, yet served in a refreshingly unpretentious atmosphere.

author: Roman Petrovskii
review_text: Pulled up hungry — left full and happy. This spot’s got mad variety, and most of it actually hits. Nothing too fancy, but the flavor’s there, and that’s what matters. It’s clean, staff moves quick, and the vibe is chill — no chaos, no stress. Perfect for squad lunch or late-night refuel after roaming Vegas. Could’ve used a couple more dessert options, but overall? Solid buffet — would def hit again.

author: crystalb822
review_text: I went to Citrus and Salt to celebrate my birthday, the restaurant esthetics were nice. I loved the vibe of the place. The food was good and I tried the octopus which was very good. I hope they create more dishes for the menu.

author: Lo Allison
review_text: Vibe was awesome, restaurant was clean, staff was friendly and food was delicious! As a vegetarian I never know what to expect, especially at sushi restaurants but the sushi was phenomenal. I got the veggie roll and asked to have cream cheese added. Ended up getting an additional roll. The veggie eggrolls were some of the best I've ever had. So delicious! Our 2 year old loves sushi but she ate more here than she typically does. Very impressed!

author: Paul Anderson
review_text: The restaurant inside and outside is beautiful. The food is absolutely delicious. I knocked one star off of atmosphere purely because I personally am not a fan of live music. There was live music playing outside, and in my humble opinion it was too loud. Thankfully, they eventually took a break and I was able to eat my dinner in peace. - I would definitely go back but I would sit indoors. My wife had one alcoholic beverage. I didn’t. He had two seafood dinners. The check came to a little over $130.

author: Mita Paul
review_text: Our experience on 21dec2025 lunch . During the lunch, We asked for a plate & what was brought by the server was a broken chipped on the edges plate, which ideally should be thrown or discarded Then the server very curtly asked is that enough? As if to say , she’s doing a huge favour & its such a inconvenience that we asked for a plate . We have been to many many places during our two weeks stay in ubud , NOPLACE has been brusque/ rude . Appeasement in the form of bill on the house came & a package of cookies which I vehemently objected. Bottom line ,is its not all about the food its about the experience . Sun sun warung needs to train its staff , after all they are in the hospitality business . We wouldn’t like to go back .

author: Craig Johnson
review_text: Bar food wasn't that great. It wasnt bad but didn't live up to some of the other reviews I read. Lots of homeless camped out right next to the building. Table clothes were thin cotton blankets that were dirty, full of crumbs.

author: Catherine Galea
review_text: I am the first to say how amazing the Rock Bar is… I have been many times. But this time I couldn’t believe that they are charging approx $15 AUD for a 380 ml bottle of water and a can of coke/sprite. Just wow. Food was good, but I was disappointed they did not have the lamb available. Overall a beautiful place and experience but stop charging $15 for a can of coke! Staff have also become much younger and they do not understand a lot of English. Which also made it hard to communicate. Customer service was not their best this visit.

author: Vanessa Yiu
review_text: One of the best steak experiences I’ve had! The steak was insanely good—juicy, flavorful, and cooked to perfection. The crispy fries were the perfect side, and the desserts were just as impressive. The vibe is classic NYC—bustling and full of energy. Staff were super friendly and made us feel right at home. Be ready for a bit of a wait even with a reservation, but trust me, it’s totally worth it. If you’re looking for an unforgettable steakhouse in NYC, Peter Luger is a must-try!

author: Zhang Zhuo
review_text: The food was okay. Yet it is a good pet-friendly restaurant for all of us to rest and have some food. Parking is a bit challenging/expensive though.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Scout Goodey
review_text: Incredible atmosphere, the food was incredible, I definitely recommend the fajitas if you’re looking to fill up or share with another person. There’s plenty of shade and lots of fans if you’re looking to get out of the heat after the beach. Julio was my server and he was fantastic, so nice and enthusiastic, he made sure we had a great time and were taken care of the whole time.

author: S T
review_text: I recently visited a café that left me with mixed feelings, but overall, it was a pleasant experience worth sharing. As soon as we walked in, we were greeted warmly, which set a positive tone for our visit. After a brief wait, we were seated, though I did notice the floors could use a bit more attention; they were quite dirty. On the upside, the tables were relatively clean, and the polite demeanor of the waitstaff really stood out. Now, let's talk about the food. I ordered an espresso, avocado toast with scrambled eggs, and a slice of French toast. The espresso was impressive, presenting a nice strong flavor that I really enjoyed. The scrambled eggs were decent, but nothing to rave about—I'd rate them a 3 out of 4. The standout for me were the French fries; they were exceptionally crunchy and flavorful, earning a solid 4 out of 4. The avocado toast was the highlight of my meal. I rarely give top marks, but the flavor was absolutely amazing, and I’d rate it a solid 4 out of 5. The French toast was also quite good—fluffy and flavorful, deserving another 4 out of 5 rating. While I typically reserve a 5 out of 5 rating for places that are flawless, this café gave off strong 5 out of 5 vibes despite my overall rating of 4 out of 5. I highly recommend it, as it has a charm that makes you want to return. I also appreciated that it seemed to be friendly towards 2A supporters, as I didn't see any signs against it. Additionally, they offer discounts for military personnel and veterans, which is a nice touch. In my personal rating system, a score of 1 or 2 means I definitely wouldn’t return, while a 3 indicates a place I wouldn’t recommend but might revisit in a pinch. A 4 is a place I’d recommend without hesitation, and achieving a 5 requires perfection, which is tough to come by. Overall, this café is one I would happily recommend, especially for their avocado toast and friendly service.

author: Lan Pham
review_text: Got drawn in by a TikTok video. Ordered the Mongolian hotpot. Meat and veggies were acceptable quality, though there was some dirt on the bok choy and I didn't care for the mystery meat bits in the tripe balls. Broth was too sweet. Ambiance was ok. Tables were too low. Service was ok. ₫300k for the hotpot and two Hudas. One and done for us, but those who like sugary savory dishes might like this place.

author: David Pina
review_text: So far. It would be my fav malaysian cuisine. Their Nasi Lemak fried chicken are the best. Huge portion, and tasty chicken. No regret for Their coffee and milktea. But, I need to queue up for about 40 mins tp be seated. You can buy their coffee or milktea to take home away. The also have instant noodles to sell. The Pan mee was my fav too.

author: Sess L
review_text: The restaurant looks very grand in oriental design. Feels like being transformed into olden China the moment we stepped into the restaurant. The food we ordered were mainly spicy but very traditional Chinese flavour.

author: S T 3 P H 4 N I 3
review_text: You guys need more servers, and I'm not sure how many chefs yall have back there. But yall either need to PICK UP THE PACE OR HIRE MORE CHEFS!!! Last night me and my family sat down and asked for our food. We waited for AN HOUR!!! AN HOUR!! They gave my dad's food first. And from what I was looking at the rice looks exactly like THE RICE THEY SERVED, DRY!! even the school lunch is better. Also, WHY IS WAS MY DAD'S FOOD SO EXPENSIVE??? IT WAS JUST ONE PERSON MY GOODNESS. IT WAS LIKE 40 dollars FOR ONE PERSON!!!! Don't think I didn't see the other waiting tables either or the MANY bad reviews i have seen on here, I've been watching at least 5 of you waitresses walking around, some talking to people and the rest just serving a big undercooked fish for supposedly 3 people. How do you get a FLY? IN SOMEONE'S FOOD? A STICKER IN SOMEONE'S FOOD?? there are probably even worse reviews than mine. You ALL need to do better or there will be consequences. Have a good day. :)

author: Thanh Mai
review_text: Com Nieu is located right in the center of District 1, has parking, airy, diverse dishes, suitable for taste, delicious. Fast service, will introduce to friends and come back.

author: Jovan Yeo
review_text: Ordered 2 prawn based dishes and we were blown away. The prawns in the fried noodles were fresh and succulent. Each mouthful of the noodles had the Thai garlic perfectly infused. The egg in the omu fried rice was a tad watery but still pairs well with the rice and diced prawns. As for the pork dish, the meat was tender but the sauce was too tangy and spicy to be consumed on its own. Overall a thumbs up for the both of us, will be back for sure!

author: Ethan Guinn
review_text: Amazing dumplings, skillfully folded and cooked. Fresh flavors including the shrimp. Introverts dream since you order on your phone from start to finish. But hard to eat all the food without friends with you. Best bbq pork steam bun ever :) Simple establishment , simple eats. Done right.

author: Ayaalan.foodie
review_text: Great first visit with warm service and authentic decor. The spicy lamb spine pot and collagen soup were flavorful and satisfying. Loved the beef tripe appetizer and tender lamb ribs. Refreshing dessert to end the meal. Highly Recommended. For more photos and details, check out @aya.yeaney (IG) https://www.instagram.com/p/DF0IVS1p03e/?img_index=1

author: Sofi Koltun
review_text: We had an amazing experience! Our server, Yusnavy, was absolutely incredible — so attentive, kind, and professional. The food was excellent, everything tasted amazing, and the service made the night even better. We will definitely be coming back. We also loved that the place is pet-friendly, which made the experience even more special for us. Highly recommended!

author: HninNandar Hlaing
review_text: I recently dined at a restaurant with exceptional staff and outstanding food. The service was impeccable, and the staff went above and beyond to ensure a delightful experience. The menu offered a diverse range of delectable dishes, each prepared with precision and bursting with flavor. The combination of excellent service and delicious cuisine makes this restaurant a must-visit.

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Tiana Nguyen
review_text: I had made a reservation, then messaged the page to reschedule, but the handling of the situation was unsatisfactory. The staff responded to customers in an unprofessional manner.

author: Sam Danesh
review_text: I tried the thong lor branch and I had very good experience but this brunch doesn't satisfied me at all, its ok to try once but overall they have a long que and the food is not that great, just ok in my opinion, good to try once but I dont think I wanna try again

author: chaoyue
review_text: Reserved a spot the day before and was seated upstairs (would recommend a reservation). First thing I noticed was that the table was a bit wobbly and that there doesn't seem like there was a place to put down our bags, though that is a minor detail. Many thanks to the waitress Vy who attended to our table promptly as well as the server who taught us how to properly eat the bahn xeo. Now on to the food, we ordered the Banh xeo, broken rice with grilled pork, and the fried pork in bamboo with white sesame. I'd recommend all of them but the Banh xeo is definitely a must try. Ask your waiter/server for the proper steps to eat the dish. The sauce also pairs well with it. As for the broken rice, we had to ask a waiter for a spoon which I think could be improved. (not sure if we were supposed to eat in some other way?) The sweet sauce (to be poured over the rice) also does make the food more appetising. Lastly, the fried pork was nice and the sauce made it even more delicious, but I think the sauce provided was too little. Still, overall experience was great. Food was served so fast I was not prepared.

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: Minkytreswa
review_text: Old school but clean and bright environment. Plenty of parking when we arrived at 6.30pm. Fast and friendly service. We ordered Assam fish, baby squid, deep fried pork, salted egg prawn, steamed garlic squid, coffee pork rib, deep fried mushroom with Kailan, sambal kangkong with cuttlefish, bak kut teh, crispy chicken. Total of 8 paxs. Dishes were all good. Herbal bak kut teh a bit too light for my liking. We ordered quite a lot of beer too. Bill came up to $360. Got too greedy during meal halfway and forgot to take quite a few dishes. Will be back again for sure

author: Sassy Que
review_text: First visit to the Michelin guide restaurant… super long queue on a Friday evening. We ordered the signature prawn hor fun, claypot YTF, sweet & sour pork, fu Yong egg, roast chicken & 三色蛋贡菜. Overall a pleasant visit and the dishes were nice though on the salty side. #foodporn #sg #dinner

author: Giovanni
review_text: Definitely the place where to have nice food and where to work at a laptop. They're built for that, there are plugs everywhere and the wifi is strong. The staff will not bother you, but it's good habit to order something every hour at least, and tip the staff appropriately. The food is good, big, and vote expensive. Good quality place.

author: emir akdere
review_text: Charming institution with amazing owners, servers, and food! Coming here every sunday with my boyfriend is one the highlights of my life in san francisco. There is so much soul and livedness packed into this space, and it awaits you to make it a part of your life story!

author: Melissa Texidor
review_text: My Husband and I are Holiday for the holidays and our very first dining experience in Miami… La Industria. LA COMBI COMPLETA had the best of everything on one dish. He began eating before I got the full pic. I ordered NICKY JAM'S FAVORITE -Guava marmalade, cream cheese frosting, graham cracker crumbs served … both AMAZING!! Service was great and even my take home bag was a surprise❤️ with a guava and cheese pastry

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: Rupert Holm
review_text: Quite clean and tidy place. Alot of food options as well. Grateful to see Malay friends again. Definitely a good stomach refuelling place for tourists.

author: Yolanda Jones
review_text: I try to like this place because it's halal but WOW oh mighty never again. I tried this place several times & can't recall as it was some time ago but I won't forget my experience this time. Almost everything on the menu is fried, which is no problem as we know it's not healthy but for every bite I take, it literally is going to give me hypernatremia. Not a pinch or a dash of salt but a literal handful. I feel my blood pressure rising. I could not finish after 4 bites of the garlic flatbread. I shouldn't be dying for water after each bite of food from whatever im eating. What a waste of money as I threw the food out. What's even sadder is that I decided to break my fast by eating from here. Service was good though. I just don't recommend as almost every review is in agreeance that the food is SALTY

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: Kierra Long
review_text: Super yummy boat noodles! So flavorful and the spice was just right. Ask for without liver if you don’t want that. And I should have ordered extra noodles because the amount of egg noodles I got was a little low.

author: Phượng Vũ
review_text: My first impression was that the broth was quite similar to pho broth, without any unique characteristics. I don’t know if the restaurant used a lot of MSG, but the broth tasted quite sweet. After finishing the meal, my friend felt his throat was a bit smooth. I ordered a hot pot set for 2-3 people for 189k, there was a promotion for an extra plate of chicken feet or mixed jellyfish. I found the dipping sauce to be delicious, but the chao was normal.

author: Giovanni
review_text: The food is standard, nothing to complain, nothing wow. The dishes are all well prepared and the ingredients quality is good, but the overall experience will not remain impressed in your remembering. The location is new and is huge, I would try it for work also. Busy at everytime, the staff is still training but the managers are overlooking everything, so give them a bit of time. I didn't find a place soul.

author: Lee Lin Ping
review_text: I have been to some lounges in my time and the Qatar premium lounge blows every one of them out of the water. The ala carte style and the attentive service of the staff left nothing to be desired and I will not hesitate to unreservedly recommend this lounge to anyone. Chicken satay and Thai chicken curry - get these. The former gives SQ's version a run for its money. Hazel, Anthony, Anu, CS, Diuan, Jessy - you were amazing and made our stay so enjoyable and memorable!

author: K Hochiminh
review_text: This is a very delicious Vietnamese restaurant. The location is difficult to find and the surrounding area is very congested, so access is not good, but the restaurant is always crowded with customers. The food is also delicious, especially the shellfish stuffed with minced meat. The specialty of this restaurant is hot pot. We had chicken hot pot this time, but it was a bit disappointing as it contained spicy leaves and the chicken was very bony. The oyster and pork hot pot I had previously was more delicious. However, since I can't eat oysters, I think it would be even better if they had a hot pot with just pork. The food is very delicious and reasonably priced, so I recommend this restaurant.

author: Titus Maximus
review_text: Only downside is the LONG QUEUE during peak hour. Waiter for almost 2 hours, due to only about 10 counter seats. However, the food worth the wait. Chose the soft pork, very juicy. Miso flavour was ok, will try the curry next time. Price is slightly expensive but there are 3 pieces of thick pork so it's worth it.

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: Nuch Suppanuch
review_text: Ok quality, reasonable price. Definitely a lot of MSGs in dipping sauce, but it’s expected. A bit long wait during dinner hour (~30 mins)

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: YappariStory
review_text: Every dish is extremely delicious and the meal is inexpensive. We only paid about SGD 160 for 7 dishes and beverages (family of 8 pax). The staff and the bosses are also very service-oriented and amiable.

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: Lin Zhanquan
review_text: I ordered the Supreme Prawn Noodles and chose the non-spicy prawn broth with dry yellow noodles. The dish came in a piping hot claypot of prawn broth with noodles on the side. The noodles were springy and chewy and very well seasoned with the base. Then came the highlight of the dish - the prawn broth, which comes with 3 prawns, 3 prawn balls, and 2 pork ribs! With the claypot style, it elevates the flavour and keeps the broth and the food warm throughout the meal! The broth was very savoury and very addictive overall! Even though the prawns weren't the biggest, they were all very fresh and easy to deshell! The prawn balls were also very chewy with a few chunks of prawns in it and the pork ribs were very tender and flavourful as well. The portion size was definitely more than enough for 1 pax as even though i am considered a big eater, I was stuffed and slightly overwhelmed by the sheer portion. I also ordered the sotong youtiao which was very crispy on the outside but soft and chewy on the inside, and such complementing dichotomy made the dish very enjoyable to eat.

author: kimberly deschamps
review_text: I started visiting this restaurant about a year ago after trying every Nigerian restaurant in Newark and surrounding towns. My husband has an eclectic palate and so far most restaurants have been a miss. I bought the banga soup with the catfish head and it was soo good, it broke my heart to share it with my husband. After that I tried the edikidikang soup and it was a hit with my husband. I love the different soups every day..bitterleaf, egusi, vegetable is a hit with him too. We ordered jollof and fried rice for my baby shower. It is my go to for food now. I absolutely love the moi moi and akara. The staff recognize me and are very helpful and efficient. There is a sit down area but I do strictly takeout because I am always running errands. They close at 7pm and not open on weekends and I respect that because the food is always fresh.

author: joe Yaz
review_text: It was fantastic honestly. Really enjoyed the food very much. I don't normally eat indian food that often but it was absolutely perfect loved it. If you are in the area I'd definitely check this place out.

author: Ashley Dow
review_text: Awesome spot, lovely staff, great view, will be back for the music later, a definite must as your going past, beers nice & cold, well done guys 10 outa 10, ash Gold Coast Australia

author: YippieYaYa
review_text: Visited Foh San for dim sum, and overall, the experience was quite normal. The food was just so-so—nothing particularly memorable in terms of taste or variety. However, one highlight was the service. The elderly lady server was very nice and friendly, which made the visit more pleasant. The restaurant itself is spacious, but the food didn’t quite live up to its reputation. Worth a try if you're nearby, but don’t expect anything exceptional.

author: Konstantinos Tziallas
review_text: On our Travels through Jamaica Plain we stopped at The Galway House for dinner. It's a Cozy Neighborhood Pub. We sat down at the bar and ordered some 😋Buffalo Chicken Wings 😋 and Ice Cold Drinks 🍹🍻 ❄️ the wings were Delicious 😋. We ordered the Blue Cheese Burger Special 😋 which was Tasty. The Service was Great 👍 Definitely Recommend Galway House!

author: Charlotte Teo
review_text: Had the soup version of the Bah Chor Mee. From food quality to service, all was great. The fried beancurd skin are crispy and comes with sauce at the bottom. I like the soup and bah chor because ingredients are fresh no stench at all. Great meal for rainy morning.

author: Paul Buckman
review_text: What a great place to eat local. The venue is clean and large, with a good atmosphere. Vibrant yet you can still talk, and eat great food. Waitstaff are attentive and very helpful. Kitchen is fast. Food size and quality of excellent. Ribs were fall off the bone and melt in the mouth. Go big on these. Get more. Satays was juicy, smokey and tasty. You need to order both pork and chicken. We will be back #breakfreefromthedesk Mr B

author: Carrie Menendez
review_text: Stopped in for unplanned lunch, amazing food with flavors and huge portions. Planning how to use our extras!

author: Kpop Girl
review_text: SERIOUSLY amazing GOOD authentic Thai food!! My husband and I eat here multiple times EVERY single time we visit Vegas! (A true hidden gem!!) YES, it's THAT good!! And they have crazy good prices!! Try their crazy wings, mussels with seafood sauce, papaya salad with sticky rice and Tom Yum!! WOW! So so YUMMY!! And their service is fantastic!! AND Kay was AMAZING server too!!!

author: Yw Teh
review_text: Cleanliness need to improve. Plate and cutlery is so oily till hard to hold. I see the worker grab the plate, cutlery with oily hand.

author: Hannah King
review_text: Very sweet family. They had many options of pho and other Vietnamese foods. Their many smoothie was also amazing.

author: Carson Nguyen
review_text: The amount of good food that you can get for like $16 is insane. I got the Lamb Plate and it was able to feed me for two meals. And the hummus is incredible.

author: Chelsia Gelbert
review_text: Feel very disappointed customer service. Not cashier lady, 2nd lady trying to take my order not only fail listening my request I asking for less sambal but she gave me more, i did said it was ok but she said she can help me changed the order this time she really did not put any sambal as I said for less sambal and the 3th lady said no need put chicken wing any more which my order come with chicken wing (but lucky she have give me). Was so rude !!!!The way you service customer feel very disappointed me even i staff also consider customer. Please serve customer equal!!!

author: Hakimi Solutions
review_text: Very delicious food and good quality and almost double quantity they provide. Love the restaurant view and vibes.

author: Annie Van Peter
review_text: We had a GREAT experience at Bon Bouquet! The weather was so nice in Miami, we decided to sit outside. Alfonso was our server. He gave wonderful recommendations, and he was so attentive and was helpful with some dietary issues I have. I enjoyed the Royale Benedict (subbing spinach for the muffin). WOW! It was fantastic!! I can’t recommend this restaurant enough! If you’re fortunate enough to have Alfonso as your server, you’ll be treated Royale-ly!

author: Zi Xuan Ong
review_text: RM11 for this small portion of maggi goreng ayam, which is actually at the high side consider the shop is located in BM area. The taste is so so compare to other shops, and it is pretty oily. The service is bad when I wanna pay thay time. I am already at the cashier, then the staff at the cashier can start an argument with another staffs regarding some Grabfood order. I was there waited for few minutes just to wait them to finish the argument. In between the argument, another staff comes to the cashier and hand over the money which is paid by another customer. The cashier settle that particular payment first instead of mine who are waiting there for them to finish argument. The most awesome part is, I start to have stomachache while I was driving back home. And had 2 round of diarrhea when I reached home. This is definitely the first and the last visit to this shop. Totally not recommended.

author: Jamme Ray II
review_text: Went here with a group of 6 for lunch and we got seated almost immediately. Our server was super nice and our food times was very responsive. The seafood tasted really fresh and tasty. I got the Market Fish which was a Bass that day and the sides were the Szechuan Greenbeans and Bok Choy & Kimchi which were both good but the kimchi wasn't as flavorful as I was hoping. We also got Oysters on the shell that were really good sharing! I had a Cucumber drink that was refreshing and I would definitely order again. The place seemed fairly priced and the atmosphere was quite to where you could comfortably have a conversation at the table. Would recommend to people to go for some good seafood.

author: Eileen Lock
review_text: ⭐️ 2/5 Queued for more than an hour and honestly… not worth it. We ordered the Breakfast Club bagel — the texture leans more towards a soft Japanese-style bagel, so if you’re expecting that classic chewy bagel bite, this isn’t it. Felt a bit too soft for my liking. The matcha latte, though… sorry, this was the biggest letdown. It was super sweet and the matcha powder clearly wasn’t sifted properly — everything settled at the bottom in clumps. Really unpleasant to drink. Overall, overhyped and disappointing. Definitely not worth the queue.

author: Kayla Nygaard
review_text: This place has a great vibe. The staff are so friendly and made sure to get me my food even when I changed seats. And the food (I got the warm pretzel app) was so good. Definitely going to be back to try more!

author: Michael Allen
review_text: High Street Place is a fantastic food hall with a wide variety of options all in one spot. The atmosphere is modern and lively, making it a great place to grab lunch, dinner, or even just a drink. There’s something for everyone, whether you’re in the mood for casual bites, creative cocktails, or more elevated dishes. The layout makes it easy to explore different vendors, and the quality across the board is consistently strong. It’s also a convenient location right downtown, perfect if you’re visiting nearby attractions or just want a fun, social spot to eat. A great mix of local flavor and variety under one roof.

author: Elvina Heng
review_text: A lot of shop changes . So long . Recommend a white and roasted chicken rice . I order no 2 . $3.50 .

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: welton seah
review_text: Delicious mookata sets with good quality and variety in cooling air-conditioning

author: CedarwoodPhotos
review_text: We had a great time in the lounge. Quick bite to eat and then sang along with the piano man. Neal was fun and took requests. I would come back just for the piano bar.

author: Lye Guang Yang
review_text: The dishes are packed with flavour, nice! The staffs are friendly and welcoming, making the dining experience even more enjoyable. Recommended for a satisfying local Thai meal. Just that the parking would be a bit of problem as we needed to park at the roadside. The uncle directing the customers was very friendly though.

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Aleksandra M
review_text: Everything was fresh with a lot of taste. There’s also big variety of food to choose. My father took catfish that you prepare by your own so it was nice experience. All of the places are inside but there’s one bar table on the balcony which we took

author: Bianca Alina Mitrea
review_text: Absolutely amazing place to eat in Bali – a true gem! We loved Sun Sun Warung so much, we came back multiple times because it was just that amazing the entire experience! The food was absolutely delicious every single time, fresh, flavorful, and made with love. The place is beautiful and traditional, with that authentic Balinese charm. 🫶🏼 The staff are incredibly kind, welcoming you with that big smile and the prices are unbelievably low for the quality you get. After discovering Sun Sun, we compared every other restaurant in Bali to it… and few places came close. If you're in Ubud, do not miss this place. Sun Sun Warung is a treasure, we’ll be dreaming of their meals until we can come back. 🙌🍛🌿

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Jutamas S (Umez)
review_text: The shop has a nice atmosphere, the food is very delicious, and the coffee is quite good. However, the tables are a bit small, making it difficult for diners to place their plates.

author: Kelvin Ying
review_text: Local kopitiam. Been frequenting here especially when i don't know what to eat because near to where i stay. The nasi kandar is quite famous. Many customers like their fried chicken. Pan mee is popular especially during breakfast time. There is also a soup stall in this kopitiam, which is easy for me to get my soup-craving fixed. Personally recommend their seafood set meal, fried lou xu fan and Kowloon bubble waffle. Chee cheong fun, bun and siew mai also good choice when looking for something light.

author: alena lim
review_text: Visited on a weekday 8pm, ordered the $59.90 set for 2 (price after member discount before gst & svc charge), after the relevant charges, bill was about $72. For this price point, I expected better service (at least for staffs to replenish "unlimited" items included in the set / offer to refill soup base). However, the supposed set inclusive unlimited sauces, and osmanthus jelly were all not replenished (the osmanthus jelly was literally completely empty from the time we went to take sauces til the time we wanted to take dessert LOL) and no form of apology was given... Mind you, you're paying for this 'unlimited dessert'! Disappointing experience for a 4.9 stars rated restaurant, staff even tried to upsell the store credit promo, haha, no way am i returning! 🙄

author: Jessica Bishop
review_text: The food here never misses! Always delicious and full of flavor! You need to get the chorizo sopes. On this visit we had Johnathan and the service was fantastic! He had a full section but took excellent care of us. Very attentive and friendly! We’ll be sure to ask for him every visit!

author: Mukund Kaushik
review_text: If you want a rotisserie style chicken that is juicy and flavorful without being too spicy, and good value for money, Dino’s chicken does not disappoint. The 1/2 chicken with fries tortillas and coleslaw is less than 20 bucks. It’s a no frills atmosphere with tables on the inside and some outside overlooking the street traffic. The parking is a bit tight but if you circle around enough times, you might get lucky. Next time we will order the fries and the sauce on the side as they serve the chicken on top of the fries. The place does not disappoint and this place is a “keeper” on my list.

author: H.T. 6001
review_text: This was the first time coming to this restaurant and it's kinda hidden inside a small road along Beach Street. I'm really surprise with how tasteful their foods are! The texture, taste, favour, everything was really nice! They don't really have much choice when comes to main dishes. We ordered a pasta and a plate of western dish. Honestly, it was super delicious! The food portion is big too. The overall environment is cosy. Quite suitable for gathering with your friends and so on. Overall, I'm really happy to found this restaurant and experience their delicious food. Highly recommended. Just one thing could be improve was their iced latte which was kinda mild. However still consider acceptable, but thicker coffee taste would be better. Looking forward to my next visit here.

author: Kenny Tan
review_text: Ordered delivery from grab. The fish paste noodles were amazing. I also like the fried chicken. They looked dry but tasted quite good and not that dry. The fishballs and meatballs were good too. They came in a very tasty soup. Fried shuijiao is also very good.

author: Julio Andres
