review_text: I had an amazing experience at Bubba Gump Shrimp Co. on Biscayne Blvd in Miami! The food was absolutely delicious — every bite full of flavor, fresh, and perfectly cooked. The whole place has such a fun and unique Forrest Gump theme that makes the atmosphere lively and memorable. But what really made our visit special was our server, Ramona. She was incredibly kind, friendly, and genuinely funny — her great energy made the whole experience even better. She went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed and kept us smiling the entire time. Highly recommend this place for anyone visiting Miami. Great food, great vibes, and ask for Ramona if you can — she’ll make your meal unforgettable! 🍤🌴

author: Ann Zakkery
review_text: The place looks good on the pics and in reality. But the restroom is dirty, the faucet in the restroom needs replacement , it’s so dirty that you don’t want to touch it. The rolls contain too much of sugar, too much. It’s ok for rice to have sugar BUT not THAT much. As for the ramen - it’s tasty, but it’s not classics Japanese. The broth is tasty but not the Japanese style, more typical American. With big chunks of ingredients. Was supposed to find almost the whole zucchini in my ramen. The music was super loud and disturbing. The water has a scent of ray or smth that shouldn’t be in the water. Needs improvement In general - it’s ok place to visit once. But will not return.

author: Bo Zoethout
review_text: Great place to grab a bite to eat and have a drink. Extensive menu, both food and drink. With a nice terrace on the 1st floor and a place to sit at the beach. ( with bali swing!) On some days they even have live music! Very kind staff as well!

author: Rod
review_text: Went in to Pollo Tropical to get takeout for dinner as we were staying nearby. We were pleasantly surprised by the quality and the size of the meals we received. Will definitely keep this place on the list to visit again.

author: Jay (JMan)
review_text: This is 1 of the best steaks I've ever had it was Juicy and tasty cooked perfect. 🔥 Also had the Shrimp were big anuff to knock you out and they were cooked perfect and tasted great. The bread was a hit also. I definitely recommend This restaurant 👌.

author: Quỳnh Như Lê
review_text: Spacious, airy, clean space, very suitable for family, my family often holds parties here, the food is delicious, large portions, reasonable prices, enthusiastic staff

author: N Q
review_text: Food was good service was OK not great the bartender never said your welcome after repeated thank you. She was nice but seemed like she was rushing us and the place was empty. She was cleaning the dust off the bottles which 90 percent of places don't...very clean place but the nail in the coffin was gratuity added for 2 people. I'm a good tipper I say you know I would have left you a bigger tip then 10.95 she says sorry but it's our rules you can leave more if you like. I said sorry to late you already told me how much I have to tip. She did apologize and was nice but I hate places that do that I get it if it's a big party but 2 people for lunch at a bar when the bill was 65.00 lol ....I asked how the soup was her response was its good soup is soup you know...probably won't go back. Brazilian bar tenders I'm Brazilian I spoke English only I felt that it bothered them. I speak Portuguese but wanted the American experience..

author: Mead Baldwin
review_text: I got the Domino Arepa grilled (bean and cheese) added avocado. Super yummy. Not messy. I was very happy. Definitely going to come back for lunch. I’d recommend looking the menu before arrival because I don’t think they’ve printed it out yet.

author: Floz Panseri
review_text: Bunna is always the best. On point from the time you walk in trough the ambience till the first bite. I LOVE BUNNA. One of the best vegan worldwide

author: Art
review_text: Comfy ambiance with delicious food, well presented. Jazzy music sometimes buy always kind and professional service. It can get a bit loud in the afternoon, but you have outside and inside seating options. The long Americano coffee is a tasty deal. Some of the tables are quite large, good for laptops, but a little high too.

author: CS Weng
review_text: One of the best authentic Thai food at jitra with authentic thai herbs and spices. Located on the main street of jitra main road. Environment and vibes are good.

author: Pei Qin
review_text: Very nice Vietnam authentic food! The staff service is very good and knowledgeable in providing recommendations. Very worth to pay a visit! Recommend to call for booking before walk in.

author: Bradley Nakaji
review_text: The family was impressed with the steaks at Texas Roadhouse as the meat was prepared according to their indicated preference. Salads were crisp and fresh tasting. Potato sides are calorie bombs when ordered "loaded". The veggies can vary from fresh to canned (corn and green beans). Service was excellent. Both server and management were a pleasure.

author: Kristia Sekar
review_text: Didn’t get to try everything because the queues were craazy, but I instantly fell in love with the egg tart 🤍 So incredibly delicious, the pastry texture is to die for, and the sweetness of the custard is just perfectly balanced. I’d definitely come back again just for the egg tart!

author: Jigme
review_text: Spacious with an upper deck. What I like about their coconut coffee was how they served the shot separately with the coconut milk and forth. It was in standard price VND 45K.

author: Wenliang Ooi
review_text: Overall very nice place to dine for variety of Chinese cuisine, all decent taste and some special one too. Take note of special discount timing.

author: Ziee Chiam
review_text: Love this place, just look at the picture. No queue as we were the first to arrived. If you come late, then yes long queue. Staffs were friendly. Desserts were awesome. So so so good. Love it!!! Will definitely revisit when I go Hat Yai again.

author: Ellen Brigitta
review_text: They serve so many local menu, both food and desserts. Very good selection of menu and reasonable price too! We ended up ordering a lot, because all looks mouth watering and interesting. My favorite : lidah cabe ijo, cumi goreng crispy, es podeng, tape uli, colenak. The place layout is a bit weird with the circle in the middle and the problem is the aircon. When we came one part has problem with the ac so it felt hot. The thing that they need to improve : the receptionist. The one that receiving the call that is very arrogant and talked like robot and wouldnt answer nicely.

author: C L
review_text: Came here first thing in the morning as we only have a couple of hours in this mall, food is amazing, service staff speaks fluent English. Deco is quite nice. Our fav was their satay and toufu, the fried chicken was great but too bad they ran out of chicken drum stick so the meat was rather tough, otherwise it would have been a great brunch.

author: Jr
review_text: The steak was unbelievable, steak were so tender and it just melted in your mouth… the fried octopus was delicious, The steaks were cooked the perfect way. Duck was all right wasn’t bad was better than usual. Service was excellent, attentive and always making sure we had everything we need and wanted. My biggest and only issues were the bathrooms. trash everywhere, Paper towels just everywhere. The toilet toilets were disgusting. For a high-end steakhouse well-known well established is unacceptable.

author: Hilda Lee
review_text: Had their breakfast menu and it was superb!!! Infact, we tried so many cafes in Bali and turns out, Pison - IMO serves the best breakfast! Service rendered by Nadit was exceptional. He remembered on my second cup of coffee that I opted for skimmed milk. Finally the residential singer’s voice is beautiful!!! Was going to leave and then, decided to stay for another round of coffee. Pison really took me by surprise!! Really enjoyed this place so much!!!

author: Kevin Ajemian
review_text: The food is absolutely stellar. One of my favorite German restaurants. From the authentic layout to the service. All of it is top notch. I recommend this German restaurant to anyone. One of the last bastions of an old German establishment. My favorite is the pork shank or beef rib with horseradish sauce on the Friday specials. 👏👏

author: oscar w
review_text: came here as their famous counterpart across the street has long queue. service is very prompt amd attentive the moment you step into the restaurant. friendly waitress will come over and recommend promotional items. overall the dishes are value for money but taste wise not too memorable. still decent dimsum to have though in a comfortable atmosphere.

author: Eileen Neo (Sgsohotleh)
review_text: Popular among locals and tourists. Basically Ibu Oka 1/2 or 3, are all owned by the same owner. So you see your convenience and travel to the nearest. Don’t really know how to appreciate Babi Guling maybe. Asked for chilli, but it’s not the kind of chilli you re expecting. Ended up enjoying the crackers and magnum ice cream more than Babi Guling! 😂

author: B B
review_text: Exquisite food, excellent service. Valet parking right up front. Super fast service. I enjoyed the location’s decor and open kitchen concept. You can see them making your meal. Loved the atmosphere is very chic and the alcoholic beverages were on point.

author: James Trunnell
review_text: This is my favorite Mexican spot in town. The carne asada is perfectly cooked and seasoned and they give you a good amount of it with your food. I usually get the carne asada plate but this time around I tried chilaquiles and it will be my new go-to. I recommend trying it with both red and green sauce with eggs over medium

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Vy Tường
review_text: The space to sit outside is quite airy, prime location, the taste of the noodles is delicious and light, the shrimp and meat are fresh, the price of wet and dry noodles is 80k/bowl. The staff is cute, friendly, and there is a staff member who helps with parking.

author: Dymond Glover
review_text: Chili cheese pastrami fries. BOMB! I was wondering where this place was from when I drive past I saw pastrami.. I’m like yeahhh they from Cali fasure! But these fries have lots of flavor, not dry, seasoned well and cheesy. Every bite has pastrami. Looking forward to trying more from their menu.

author: Scorpio Lyte
review_text: I've sent a few people to this restaurant after I was ranting and raving about the food during my initial visit on Nov. 9th 2024 Some of the people I've mentioned it to, have been more than me. I had the oxtail burger with hand cut fries that were so good I kept eating before picking up my oxtail burger. The burger was everything too. I also took a lamb burger home that night which was ok but I'll chalk that up to me warming it up in the microwave. Fast forward to yesterday July 12th 2025. There was an Afrobeat festival going on in the park surrounding The Yard. Hold on to that information. Now before I go with what I didn't like about my experience, I would like to give a shout-out to the guy who gave me a different burger after I realized I made an error on my burger and offered to pay for both as it was my mistake. He took back the original I ordered and gave me the kind I wanted without charging me extra. Upon walking into The Yard, there were 2 signs that read "ALL Orders at the WINDOW. NO Bathroom". In my mind I figured that meant all to go orders are to be placed at the window & the no bathroom was to keep the people who were attending the festival, out of the establishment. Crowd control. My mother and I walked inside to a restaurant that had 2 tables out of about 6 tables with customers. In other words there were about 4 tables available. I proceeded to tell the employee we will like a table for 2. From there we were told to order outside at the window. Confused but we complied. Once we were outside by the window, we sat there for about 7 mins while the worker appeared to be getting orders together. At this point I'm ready to leave but I know my mother wants to try the food since I spoke highly about it. The employee came outside to give out a few orders. While walking past us twice not saying a thing then I asked "why are we ordering at the window if there are a few tables available?" She mentioned that they were trying something different because of the festival in the park.😡 We ordered from the window, paid for our food at the window and then were let in to sit down at a table. 😕 One paying for food in advance when I'm going to be sitting in your restaurant is so strange. Two I never got an answer how ordering from the window then immediately being seated was beneficial for a customer whose intention was to sit down at a table and order. In addition to that whole process, the food was t served on plates but takeout containers. We weren't handed a jar/bottle for condiments but one small cup of ketchup for each of us. Mind you we both had burgers and fries. And plastic forks, not that they were needed. I will post pictures I hope whomever goes doesn't ever experience what I did. I didn't feel like a customer. And to think I traveled from another state to try this again and allow my mother to try it as I loved the food. I made up my mind that I will never go back to that restaurant. I think the only thing that could change this is a conversation with the owner.

author: Yani Vanesa
review_text: Such a pleasant experience! The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the food was delicious. Special shoutout to Suci, she was super friendly, attentive, and made us feel right at home. Thank you for the great service!

author: Zy Stan
review_text: CLOSE THIS PLACE DOWN!!!!!! IF YALL SO UNDERSTAFFED MAKING PEOPLE WAIT 30 mins !?!??! Don’t order online fasho cause when you pull up u are GOING to have to wait .

author: Ashley
review_text: Best fried chicken in Williamsburg, possibly all of Brooklyn. Addicting sauce, fluffy buns, and a ton of chicken. The maple wings, the classic sandwich, the Mac and cheese are all stars. We usually order pick up but dining in is low key with good seating.

author: tongwariss
review_text: 🍳🍉🍇This famous brunch spot truly impresses with its beautiful, homey decoration. The place isn’t very large, with around five tables inside and another three outside. The food is delicious, especially the fresh fruits served with the meals. However, there’s room for improvement in the service department. The staff seemed a bit indifferent, which detracted slightly from the overall experience.

author: K B S S
review_text: On my ‘must-go-back-sooner-than-later’ list! YUMMY - delicate - flavors well developed Very professional and friendly staff, mellow atmosphere for quite a busy spot. Decoration and (silent) tv on Chinese cooking channel making one appreciate even more the talent it takes to produce such tasty bites. It feels as though the kitchen is cooking per order rather than batch cooking as in most other dim sum places. Comments on the dishes I ordered as captions per photo. Truth be told: I had just gone for dim sum at a very popular and celebrated restaurant in a SF nearby city and left curiously unsatisfied compared to my previous time there.

author: Ismail Faseeh
review_text: If you’re craving a seriously good burger in Bali, BOSSMAN Burgers Seminyak is the place to be! 🍔🔥 Food: The burgers are massive, juicy, and packed with flavor — definitely made to satisfy. We tried a couple of their signature ones and every bite was delicious. The buns were soft yet held together perfectly, and the toppings were fresh and generous. The fries and sides also hit the spot. Vibe & Service: The place has a cool, edgy vibe with a fun “badass burger joint” theme that makes it stand out. Staff were quick, friendly, and the service was smooth even though it was busy. Experience: It’s definitely not your average burger stop — the portions are huge, the taste is bold, and it’s a great spot to fuel up before or after exploring Seminyak. Whether you dine in or grab a takeaway, the quality is consistent. Overall: BOSSMAN lives up to its name — it’s bold, unapologetic, and seriously tasty. If you love burgers, this is a must-try when in Seminyak. We left full, happy, and already planning to come back for more!

author: Ryan
review_text: As mid as it comes. They try to get you to buy most expensive meats/seafood. I asked for extra gravy/sauce but didn’t get that. Chicken was served cold. Beef was dry. Such a disappointing experience. Having tried multiple Nasi kandar prior to this place, I don’t think I’m wrong in saying it no longer deserves the reputation it once had. The price is also more than it should be for what it is.

author: Cassandra Montes
review_text: The food was amazing. I had the Hot Mess & Cheese. Best burger I have ever had. The prices are also amazing for the amount of food.

author: Henni Lin
review_text: Love the atmosphere . Well designed Food ? Overall 5 points from 5. Their sayur genjer tauso is delicious They have nice Sambal Mangga And their Sambal Cobek is real spicy

author: Mary Liew
review_text: The taste of apricot bread is ok, not bad. BUT then while I was chewing the bread, I found a strand of hair attached to the bread! You can see the hair is holding the pieces of bread I chewed halfway. Quality and hygiene control is very bad! I went outside for better lighting to see the strand of hair and the hair colour and length wasn’t even mine. Feel so disgusted already 😣

author: Meriel Marmanillo
review_text: Just had an amazing meal at Delicias Colombianas Restaurant! The food was absolutely fantastic – every dish was bursting with flavor and cooked to perfection. Seriously, you have to try this local spot. But what really made the experience special was the incredible service. Our server, Carolina, was so attentive and helpful. She clearly knew the menu inside and out and made some great recommendations. You could tell she really cares about her work and making sure everyone has a great time. If you're looking for delicious food and top-notch service, this place is a must-visit. I highly recommend it and can't wait to go back!

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: masaki k
review_text: It seems to be a sister store in District 1, so I wanted to try it out, so I went! Parking is on the sidewalk in front of the store. No car parking is available. The store is on the first floor, so there's an ordering area in the middle. Everyone else was ordering on their smartphones, but I asked to see the menu, pointed at it, ordered, and paid on the spot. After that, you're given a receipt and a plate, which you hand to the staff inside the store and sit at the front and wait. What I ordered was different from last time, but the soup was in the same container with a plate on it, and you could pour it over the noodles to your liking. You can also add chili peppers to your liking. Then, add lots of vegetables and mix them together before eating. The spring rolls were crispy and moist on the inside, the sautéed pork was tender, and the minced meat was very tasty. So, 34,000₫ (about 200 yen) is a bargain. It's great that there are other stores in the same chain in the direction you're heading, so you can eat there no matter which way you go😃

author: 23dilcia
review_text: I visited this establishment Encinitas (Sylmar) today because my best friend recommended it, saying the staff was kind and welcoming. Unfortunately, it seems we came at the wrong time. We had a very unpleasant experience with Mauricio Solís, who was extremely rude. I got a very bad impression of this place, by the way the place was kind of empty with only 2 tables and us … why he was acting like that 😣. When we politely asked for more coffee and a clean fork, he didn’t acknowledge us, threw the fork on the table, and walked away. Later, when my friend asked another staff member for his name, he quickly came over to our table in a confrontational manner, stated his name, and walked off again with the same rude attitude. I was truly shocked by such unprofessional behavior, especially so early in the morning. We were hoping for a pleasant visit, but this left a very bad impression. I wanted to bring this to your attention in case it’s something that needs to be addressed.

author: Gavin Borges
review_text: Had a lovely experience visiting milk and madu for the first time The place totally lives upto it’s name Absolutely lip smacking food We tried the sweet chilli garlic bread with an almond milk matcha and a pinácolada followed by a chicken Parma which was cooked to absolute perfection A visit to this place couldn’t be complete without trying their raspberry and coconut chia bowl which was so beautifully presented Ended the meal with a berry kombucha A special mention to the lovely server Mr Merta who was kind enough to give us insights about some local food as well as the order we placed A must visit place when you are around Seminyak Cheers

author: Daniela Gutierrez
review_text: I’ve been waiting for 15 minutes for someone to come out. I tried to say hello and I even shouted a little but no one listened to me, they were in the back talking entertainingly, until the phone rang and it was my savior. Otherwise I would have waited half an hour or more.

author: Logan Jackson
review_text: I would rate it 6/6 stars if I could. Jason, our waiter, was absolutely incredible. This place is an absolute gem in Miami. Low key vibes and impeccable service. Paperfish is, without a doubt, my favorite sushi restaurant in Miami. The food is absolutely incredible - the fish is always fresh and flavorful, and the chefs are incredibly creative with their rolls. I've never had a bad dish here. The service is also top-notch - the staff is always friendly and attentive. The atmosphere is also great - the restaurant is stylish and modern, but it still feels warm and inviting. I highly recommend Paperfish to anyone looking for a great sushi experience in Miami. This place feels like a speakeasy. Hidden right next to the metro rail. Stop reading this and go!

author: Nurhafizah Ahmadi
review_text: Best ever service😉 I have ordered for iced nescafe but the ice was very less. Without asked, abg waiter came to me and brought extra iced🥰 so nice

author: Share Share
review_text: The Roast Café at EmQuartier is a trendy spot popular for its specialty coffee, all-day brunch menu, and laid-back vibe. Here's an honest review: Positives: 1. High-Quality Coffee**: Roast is well-known for its expertly brewed coffee, with a wide selection ranging from espresso classics to creative signature drinks. 2. Trendy Atmosphere**: The café’s sleek design, featuring industrial-chic decor and cozy seating, makes it a favorite for Instagrammers and casual meet-ups. 3. Varied Menu**: The menu caters to diverse tastes, with a focus on comfort food, brunch staples, and creative dishes like truffle pasta and fluffy pancakes. 4. Great Location**: Situated in EmQuartier, it’s a convenient spot for a meal or coffee break in between shopping sprees. Negatives: 1. Overpriced but you get the quality food**: While the food and drinks are good, the prices are on the higher end, which might leave you wondering if it’s worth it compared to other nearby cafés. Take Note: The Seafood Stew that was on promotion cost 890b. Big serving enough for 2-3pax. However the taste is diluted due to too much soup. The Seafood Stew that i had in 2017 was much more delicious then. Fried chicken serving is for 4-5pax. The chicken is huge. Platter is good but too the chicken is too big. Cost 580b, come with 2 sides. 2. Crowded**: It’s a go-to spot for many, so getting a seat during peak hours can be a challenge, especially on weekends. 3. Service**: The staffs are friendly. Good service. 4. Portion Sizes**: Some dishes, while tasty, may feel underwhelming in portion size compared to the price. Roast Café is a solid choice if you’re looking for good coffee and brunch in a stylish setting. However, it might not be the best value for money, and the crowds can make the experience feel less relaxing. Perfect for a treat and meet up place.

author: Jessie Nolé
review_text: Me and a fellow makeup artist stopped by before heading back to LA and enjoyed the following! We shared the 1/2 lb barbacoa - 10/10 Consome Plato - 10/10 (2) menudos - 7/10 Chamorro De Puerco - 9/10 (2) cafes de olla- 10/10 Jamaica agua fresca - 10/10 Service - 10/10 Lorena was lovely and very attentive to all of our questions and had ease with recommendations based off what we were craving.

author: Dr. Jada Santos
review_text: Fiore is a wonderful brunch spot! The space is so pretty and welcoming, the service is quick, and everything we ordered was absolutely delicious. Perfect place for a relaxing weekend brunch — I’ll definitely be coming back!

author: Cassandra Sun
review_text: The staff there were very accommodating to give my friends a surprise for their birthday! Great service and the carrot cake was very good. Oxtail fried rice was chef’s kiss. The chicken cordon bleau was a highlight too.

author: Ridho Petracivo
review_text: The food is realy delicious, the staff is realy nice. Price ? Worth it 😁. Oh i almost forget, we (me & my wife) met Dude Herlino (Indonesian Actor) here haha

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Sydney
review_text: Paid never got food, gave me a beeper neber beeped, vibrated or anything came back less Than a hour later they gone with my $60 and my food mind u im starving no dinner no refund nothing

author: Kerry
review_text: We came on my birthday for an early dinner. The designated parking lot is perfect, I actually watched the parking antics out the window as we ate 🤣 when you walk in you are in the bar. It seems a gallery of sorts with modern art on the walls small but cozy bar area, enough space for someone to enjoy a meal there. We were seated immediately in the dining room, very pretty atmosphere classic old world art reminiscent of my European grandparents’ dining room art ❤️. I chose this restaurant based on the reviews of the paella, we ordered the paella for two and enjoyed the escarole soup while we waited. The paella was amazing the seafood really does come out perfectly cooked. The meat; chicken and sausage were really good but the amount of meats compared to the seafood seemed less (maybe because it had been said I like seafood more, which there was plenty for both of us). There was plenty to eat and still enough fit each of us to have a full meal the next night. The fresh made potato chips are amazing we wound up taking them home too. The only reason I gave less stars for service was because I had to ask for lemon for my water so many times, there were plenty of servers to attend to all your needs, the service was fine after that was resolved. We both enjoyed the whole experience and plan to return. Thank you for the great birthday dinner.

author: Cher Ong
review_text: Firstly, the service here is not very welcoming. They don't have much seats available, it's all surrounding their counters. They make customers wait even when there's empty seats. Menu is also very confusing. Basically there's only 3 types of proteins available & everything is deep-fried. But the menu is super complicated. Everything is sort of like self-service here. They placed your food on top of the counter & u have to take it yourself. Food not very impressive. The pork smell is very strong. Curry tastes is also not to my likings. Price is on the higher side.

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: Adrick Loh
review_text: Came many times for dinner here. Normally would order their pork mee sua and liver mee sua for wifey. This time ordered their white mee sua. More like soup but flavor and ingredients are to my liking. Their yellow wine lala is our favorite now. At $15 but worth it. Yellow wine is sweet and lala is the freshest I ever had in SG though small sized. We drink finish the yellow wine soup. P.S if you dun like your liver more than 50% raw need to tell them u like them cooked. It will still come out 30% raw. Tried their seafood white beehoon. Stock is good but overall taste no as good as Sembawang popular white beehoon. My gout was activated after 15 mins into eating it. Confirmed rich in ingredients. lol Came on May 2025, their lala got strong fishy taste. The variety is different from the one I raved about the previous month. Came on Jun 2025. Tried their fried mee Sua. Not bad, I like.

author: Sayra Palacios
review_text: We had a wonderful experience at this restaurant! Even though our server was busy, the hostess Fabiola stepped right in to take care of us, and she was beyond attentive and genuinely grateful. The drinks were spot on, the food was absolutely delicious, and the service overall made the night feel special. Everything from start to finish was amazing—I’ll definitely be coming back!

author: Fatima Jane
review_text: THIS PLACE IS SERVING DELICIOUS, GOOD QUALITY OF FOOD AT A VERY CHEAP PRICE!!! They truly deserve their Michelin title. Some would say that the seating arrangement is a little crowded but I really don’t mind. I think it only adds to the authenticity and vibe of the place. All the vegetables served were fresh and crispy! I loved it. 100/10! Will definitely come back. (Pro tip: Make a reservation!)

author: fille cainglet
review_text: Don’t be fooled with the high ratings! They ask customers to rate before even trying the food so you can get free appetizer. I told them i’ll try it first. The food was okay but the tom yum soup we thought it was big for 2000bhat but it was just a small serving size good for 1 person. Overall, I saw a lot of tourists try this shop because of the high rating but I see it as a tourist trap! Nothing special with the place Plus the bathroom is in the 4th floor! Waited so long for my turn just to learn it was a staff inside probable making tiktok videos!

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: steven suman
review_text: One of the best Thai food we have had.The pork belly was very good and the omelette was as well. We also have free rice. In conclusion everything was superb and I highly recommend.

author: LI YUEN TANG
review_text: Every time I visit Batu Kawan, Sandwish is always a must-stop for me. Love the cozy ambiance and the welcoming vibe, it feels like the perfect spot to relax. The food is consistently delicious and satisfying, definitely one of my favorite cafés here!

author: Where To Feed
review_text: THE BEST CHEESESTEAK! THE BEST PIZZA! (the culture fries!!!) Just now realizing I have never reviewed the place I frequent the most in Las Vegas! I took it for granted how amazing it was. Taking the time now to say it!!

author: Roscoe Gay
review_text: Galway House: A Hidden Gem That Delivers Big Tucked away in the neighborhood for decades, Galway House is the kind of spot locals swear by. The food? Always flavorful. The drinks? On point. And the portions? Generous enough to satisfy any appetite. Best part prices that respect your wallet without skimping on quality. If you haven’t been, you’re missing out on one of the area’s best-kept secrets.

author: backup iyan
review_text: Had a fascinating time here, great bar at 56 floor. Great cocktail n other liquor with interesting stories each of the drinks, wonderful views n vibes also, for they experimenting the drinks so it surely have wonderful tasty drinks. Big appreciation for billy and inggih they were such a great guy totally friendly and really helpful explaining everything totally insightful, surely had an amazing time here at skye

author: Laura Martin
review_text: We had our wedding at Mooo… Seaport and cannot say enough amazing things about the entire experience. From the moment we began planning to the very last minute of our reception, the team went above and beyond in every possible way. The events manager Melanie was incredibly organized, responsive, and genuinely invested in making our day perfect. The staff on the day of our wedding delivered flawless service—professional, warm, and attentive without ever being intrusive. The food was unbelievable (our guests are still talking about it), the venue was stunning, and every detail ran seamlessly. It honestly felt like a dream, and we owe so much of that to the exceptional team here. If you’re considering hosting an event or wedding at Mooo… Seaport, don’t hesitate. It was truly one of the best decisions we made. We are beyond grateful for the unforgettable experience!

author: just Wai
review_text: Was served by Fish, he's very helpful. I order vietnam pancake and grill pork. Portion is very big and taste really good. Worth the 5 stars.

author: Alexandra On earth
review_text: Eclectic ambiance Waterfront dining! great service great quality food and fair priced!!! my guy and I had a great meal right next to the water for $160. We ordered 4 appetizers (2 for $25 and we each got a free app with our entree), 4 drinks and two entrees. The kale Caesar salad- freshly shaken at the table, potatoes bravas - on point even better than some I’ve had in Spain, perfect golden crust with a side of tangy red sauce. Chihuahua cheese - my guy had the pleasure of eating the whole thing and when he ran out of toast proceeded to eat the rest with a spoon 😆 For our entrees he chose the Kobe beef burger ($30) and I got the Wagyu churrassico ($47) both served with shoestring fries and a free appetizer. The flavor was DECADENT. meat melted in your mouth so tender and juicy not to mention cooked to perfection. This was a really great dining experience and worth every penny (picture of receipt in photos! Jorge was our server and he was excellent!

author: Juan Xariskara
review_text: Really good place and the ambiance wa so nice, the staff also so good and attentive kk Raissa was sooooo perfect and she must be more than a server

author: Annie Chew
review_text: The food here is satisfactory, though it may not be particularly outstanding. I find that the Tuck Kee in the KL branch offers a more appealing flavor profile in my personal opinion.

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: κεηηγsκ
review_text: A-ròi mâak mâak! 👍🤤👍 I’ve marked this place as my go-to spot for boat noodles the next time I’m in Hat Yai. Seriously next level delicious and hearty bowl of noodles and broth.
Boil it well before eating. People with weak immunity should be especially careful. Hygiene can’t really be trusted here...

author: Phillippe Jesse
review_text: The food was wonderful. It was beautifully prepared, the flavor was authentically Italian while being palatable for the indonesian tongue, and the portion was plentiful. They do suffer a similar problem to what alot of restaurants in indonesia have, a lack of staff issue. The service was very friendly, knowledgeable, and polite. But that only when they are not busy running around. As always the vibe was immaculate. Very classy, very elegant. The table spacing is pretty loose and the decoration is thematically centered. Overall very comfortable with the background noise still being able to chat Spent 3mil++ for 9 people but honestly its worth it. I will say that the price only work because of the harmony that the food, atmosphere, and service bring.

author: Eddy Bretado
review_text: You have to get the chicken plate with the secret sauce to put on it it is amazing. This place has been there forever, I'm glad the flavors have never changed and the service has always been an excellent if you are in Los Angeles I recommend this place for a quick meal.

author: Selina Simmons
review_text: This is the best Mexican restaurant ! The food is so delicious and the service is great! Amanda was the best waitress you could ever ask for. Definitely 5 stars!!!!

author: aloha moon
review_text: Very chill atmosphere and vibe with slow and chill acoustic music and lovely staff♡ The ocean is in front of the place and there's a nice photo spot as well! They said that they have live music on every friday and saturday if it's not raining so I'll be sure to be here for that next time. Suksma for your kind and lovely hospitality, Wayan🙏😊 Oh I really loved my banana milkshake! They make it with fresh bananas🍌

author: Zhang Clinton
review_text: Let me just say this in Chinese : 3.7分，天理難容！ This is a restaurant that conquers you with the taste! We ordered half of a chicken, prawn roll and fried salted egg shrimp ball,they all taste like heaven and especially the shrimp ball, less starch and juicy crispy shrimp, don’t need to tell you that’s hard to find! Worth a shot, will come back again. I don’t think the waiters and boss are rude, they are just tired.

author: Martie Parfait
review_text: I really don’t like this new upfront gratuity! The service should be above par for 20% gratuity. Sat out on the patio, waited a few to get served. The miso soup was tasty. The grilled calamari was bland. The veggie fried rice was good.

author: Sharon Meade
review_text: I almost passed this place. Not their fault that there is construction all around the area. Hard to find parking, even though there’s a lot. The restaurant is in a strip plaza. The burger was cooked to my specifications. The cannolo was filled with fresh ricotta and my party enjoyed their cappuccinos. Our waitstaff was attentive and on point. Before revisiting I will check to see if construction is complete.

author: IamRetamichele
review_text: Pros : The food was absolutely delicious! And the atmosphere was clean and very nice . The service was awesome ! Everyone was soo kind I can’t wait to go again ! Cons : none Price: affordable 2 meals $35

author: J-Ho S. C.
review_text: A very luxurious environment to enjoy dimsum! Reasonable price. Must try those special items. Normal dimsum still can improve. The good part, they wave the tax! The service really must improve. Came weekday, waited 30 minutes before being serve the food ordered. Limited car park.

author: Aman Chawla
review_text: Bangla Night Market, Phuket 🌃🍢🔥 A vibrant spot for Thai street food, fruit shakes, and quick shopping, located just off Bangla Road. After exploring the market, you’re steps away from top pubs and dance clubs like Illuzion, Tiger Nightclub, Sugar Club, and Barfunk — perfect for partying, live DJs, and late-night vibes. Busy, colourful, and great for food + nightlife in one place!

author: Britt F
review_text: Very great vegan food, had the avocado ceviche and red beet pepperoni pizza. Place is a bit too loud for me because of the music. But would def come again because of the food!

author: Derin
review_text: I’ve never been to a Thai restaurant with an hour wait on a Sunday, but I understand why. Probably the best Pad See Ew I’ve ever had.

author: Edgar Pablo
review_text: The food was absolutely delicious, but the best part was the amazing staff — super friendly and welcoming. Definitely coming bac

author: Yen Thung Tan
review_text: My first babi guling in Bali and it did not disappoint. The food was good but it was a bit too spicy for me. Overall, Babi guling is a food that you should try if you are in Bali.

author: GK T
review_text: Car-parking is by the new HDB parking app without the barrier. More lots are being made in view of the 24-hour NTUC supermarket that wld be located in the food centre. The carrot cake and the fried Hokkien mee are must-trys. Also, Ban Mian we got has evenly-sliced ban mian and well-cooked too as they don’t stick together.

author: Jayon See
review_text: The Pandan dessert is not up to standard, no Pandan Smell, cold, and tough to bites. Really disappointed with the quality.

author: Mariah Matt
review_text: Lucky Fish @luckyfishbeachbar 📍Dania Beach, FL Follow @eatzwithsweetz on ig and fb for more! Such a great spot only steps away from the beach! Here's what I had: Kiwi Melon Daiquiri Mermaid Water Rum Punch @ketelone Espresso Martini Tuna Poke Nachos Crispy Calamari Island Chopped Salad with shrimp Florida Fish Sandwich Fried Oreos Key Lime Pie Everything was great! Cant wait to visit again! When are you pulllin up to Lucky Fish? #LuckyFish #DaniaBeach #BeachBar #Seafood #Fresh #OceanBreeze #Poke #MermaidWater #KetelOne #BeachFood #Oceanfront #Vibes #LetsDrinkz #EatzWithSweetz #LetsEatz

author: Carla
review_text: I had the firecracker shrimp tacos bomb. Com. Lol my cousin had them first and recommended them. So freaking good. The staff at the front bar was more attentive than the one closer to where the music is playing hit still good vibes overall and I just realized it's 2 for 1 drinks, all day everyday. I wish I didn't read that but lol that's a great deal especially in this economy. I have no complaints the djs on the weekend really get this place jumping. Pure good vibes. I will be back again and again ✨

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Pizsanupong Sangkaeo
review_text: Delicious food, friendly service, good atmosphere, suitable for social gatherings.

author: Anthony Torres
review_text: Lovely place! My family and I went for my brother’s bday dinner tonight, attention was great, food was delicious and 2 for 1 drinks amazing! Lovely Sofia took care of us and made our experience fabulous. Will come back!

author: Junia Anindya
review_text: I ordered the pad thai and honey chamomile tea — the pad thai was a bit dry and missing that smoky kick, and the tea was just warm, not hot. Probably should’ve picked something else off the menu!

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Trần T Tuyết Nghi
review_text: We waited 20 minutes for our meal, people who arrived later got served first, and when we asked the staff, they were completely clueless and didn't know how to answer. I've been to many restaurants, but this one has the worst service.

author: Karel K. Himawan
review_text: Loved the Christmas decoration and the overall place felt special. The food was well-cooked, but portion wise it was too small. The food we ordered also took longer to arrive. An overall good experience.

author: Valencia
review_text: This is my Favorite food spot when I'm in LA..the food is fresh and the beans are hot and seasoned well and garnishments are fresh and a added bonus(free) I ate chicken burritos both days ( Thanksgiving eve & Thanksgiving instead of turkey) this is how Goood & fresh the food is

author: Estrella Rodriguez
review_text: An exceptional dining experience from start to finish. This all-you-can-eat sushi restaurant truly sets the standard for quality, offering some of the freshest and best sushi in town. Each dish was beautifully prepared, impeccably fresh, and consistently delicious. The service was equally outstanding. My waitress, Brenda, provided above-and-beyond hospitality—attentive, warm, and genuinely welcoming throughout the entire meal. Her professionalism elevated the experience and made me feel truly valued as a guest. The restaurant itself was immaculate, with a clean, inviting atmosphere and a pleasant, fresh scent that immediately stood out. To top it all off, the pricing was phenomenal—surprisingly affordable and easily among the best values in town for the quality offered. Highly recommended for anyone seeking exceptional sushi, outstanding service, and unbeatable value.

author: Dessa R
review_text: On a Saturday evening, worth the wait. The line goes fast because the staff are super efficient. Got a slice of the cheese pie and for fun, a slice of the bacon & fig jam. The cheese slice was delicious, great char, cheese/sauce ratio and flavor….now the bacon and fig jam was soooo delicious (salty & sweet—>perfect balance). It’s gets crowded as it’s a super popular spot, if you find a spot inside along the windows, snag it). Next time would love to try the burrata slice.

author: T-Bone
review_text: This was my first experience at GRECO. I went tot he Newbury St location. I ordered the signature Greek salad with chicken. I wanted to take a foto, forgive me for taking a few bites before I took the foto. This salad was absolutely_delicious_ and filling. I loved all the ingredients. After the first bite I immediately tasted the strong oregano, which I love. This salad reminded of the salads I had in Greece years ago. I'm a huge fan of the Mediterranean tomato/cucumber salads. My Italian parents made it all the time when we were kids. Looking forward to going back.

author: jan Kennedy
review_text: Absolutely love this place! Had the best drunken noodles with shrimp that I have ever eaten!! Richard and Banks are the real thing. Richard came over and introduced himself to us!

author: DAK
review_text: Authentic thai food in Hatyai. The fried rice was awesome so are all the dishes. Tom yam seafood a must try. The owner speaks good english and you can choose the level of spiciness 1-10. We chose 8 and still feeling it

author: Karissa Kang
review_text: Great place to drink before your flight! It was especially quiet during the Midnight, fantastic place to have a drink and chill alone. Was served by Ju seng, friendly fun and warmth guy. Was looking through the menu and there wasn’t any cocktail that suited me, asked if he could do me a whiskey sour (was off menu), he gladly agreed and guess what! I’m a big fan of Whiskey sour and it’s only today I’ve learnt from him that egg white could be added for an extra creamy and foamy texture to the drink. It was my first time trying it with egg added, IT WAS FANTASTIC, probably the best whiskey sour I’ve had anywhere before!

author: Alexis Escaray
review_text: can I just say the food was delicious and the servings were generous! bbq pork was our favorite , haven’t had anything like it in a while! & the customer service was great. he gave us free soup to try with our purchase too. not pricey at all! we’ll definitely be back!

author: Sunli Zynski
review_text: a lux choice for dinnee with family and coworkers. they have so many dishes from all over indonesia. the staffs are so nice and friendly and QUICK. the minus is with the dessert. they should do R&D for it.

author: Yi Wen Cheah
review_text: Their signature espresso avocado is so so so good!!! Must try when you visit Bali! We also ordered a main course bebek, it’s delicious, paired so well with their sambal and salad sides where they mix mint leaves with some local herbs.

author: Carrie Tam
review_text: Super fun location that my roommate and I stumbled upon accidentally! There’s free parking for the first 90min nearby and plenty of outdoor tables where people are willing to talk to new strangers and dance and have fun! Indoor food courts with wide range of super tasty looking options.

author: YMRHRI (Tok Engku Mie)
review_text: The food was good especially the nasi kandar, kuah kari jockey and tandoori but the service.... simply horrible! The workers tend to talk to each other in Tamil and do not seem to bother customers who called to order. Most of the time they took the wrong order and actually cursed customers in their native tongue when they were pointed out the mistakes. Also noticed that most of them actually do not understand bahasa melayu or english. It is dumbfolding how they can get into this country so easily and fast! Overall, places like Line Clear, Hamediah, Ketapang, Medina are much much better in terms of price and food taste. Please consider other options when in Penang.

author: Susan Z
review_text: Such a bad ass hole in the wall gem in the heart of Downtown Las Vegas -Adjacent to the arts district. Love the Evel Knievel theme throughout the dining area and the artsy feel inside with all the slap stickers flooding every wall and blank space. They have a cool bar, small indoor dining area and a small outdoor patio area. Great customer service and good drinks. But the food is what brings the entire experience together. The wings are delicious, meaty, and done well. Love the garlic knots with marinara👌🏻 and the Caesar salad was good too. I look forward to coming back and trying their pizza next 👍🏻

author: Roland Stewart
review_text: I was in Vegas, and stayed at the Grand Downtown Las Vegas. I was hungry so I decided to venture across the street to Triple George Grill. I was greeted at the door by a slim gentleman wearing a blue shirt and wearing glasses. He had a pot belly and was holding his stomach as though he was sick. I asked him if he was OK, he never answered, so I said, for one pls. He responded rudely, "sit at the bar." Throughout my stay, I noticed he seemed very friendly and attentive to others sitting at the bar, but never once did he approach me and ask me how was my meal or how was everything? In fact, I noticed he asked others at the bar on several occasions, how their meal was? He wd look at me and keep going. Other than the seemingly rude host, the food was excellent and the service was great. Everyone else, the beautiful atmosphere and the food made up for the rude, unhappy host. He made me feel like I shoud have never come in there. I would not go back, or recommend to ppl I know to avoid this place. I did speak to a female manager behind the bar, who was very kind, and welcoming The male host in the blue shirt made me feel uncomfortable and unwelcome.

author: Alwyn HoHo
review_text: Highly Recommend this place if you are planning to dine with your loved ones or with your colleagues. There is a KTV room for you to sing your heart out while you enjoy your Korean BBQ.

author: Mirlo Z
review_text: This place has outstanding food. Reasonably priced too. Will come back.

author: Daniel Davies
review_text: A beautiful space with an inventive menu. However, drinks and food service were incredibly slow. It took 25 mins for drinks to be ready and a further 10 mins for the food. The staff told us we’d need to leave very shortly after receiving our food as they were closing. We would have appreciate a grace period seeing as it took so long for our food to arrive.

author: Ray Sim
review_text: Food rating note: Average - 2.5/5 My comfort food - 5/5 Similar to pig organ soup. Nice soup and fresh ingredients. Their chilli is great. Slightly ex. Recommended items: Soup with pork ingredients - 4.1/5 Braised tau gua - 4/5 The meal average at 4/5

author: Poopo Head
review_text: The sever was amazing, he kept hooking us up and even let me buy food even though we were a little short. The food is amazing I recommend it here the customer service is amazing

author: Yuliana Gallegos
review_text: It doesn’t matter what time of the day it is they have breakfast and lunch All day !! This is one of my favorite restaurants in Las Vegas !! Fresh food excellent customer service and their Manager is an amazing and humble person I’ve ever met .

author: sergio valles-blancarte
review_text: The portions are huge and the food was good. Reminds me of a mom and pops spots in cali.,Service was ok the team wirks fast . The bbq pork was probably the only item not worth getting.the expeditor is fast and knows his stuff. I though I was missing an item and he said he knew it was in there just by the weight. He was right but should still open it up and show the customer that all items are in just incase he happens to be wrong especially to go orders. Will try again if we are out on that side of town.

author: Guido de Valk
review_text: I frequently dine at Pison, yet this is my first time sharing a review. The experience during my recent visit was exceptional and certainly worth noting. Upon arrival, we were greeted with genuine warmth and informed that the table was reserved until 9:00 p.m. Since we arrived at 7:15 p.m., this allowed for a comfortable and unhurried dinner. The meal itself was outstanding. I chose the salmon teriyaki, while my companion ordered the fried duck. Both dishes were executed with precision, offering depth of flavour and excellent balance. The addition of the sous vide egg elevated the presentation and taste. To accompany the meal, I enjoyed a glass of chilled Shiraz. Though I am accustomed to red wine served at room temperature, this variation proved to be a refreshing and well-matched choice. Overall, the evening combined attentive service, refined dishes, and thoughtful details. Pison continues to demonstrate consistency and quality, and I look forward to returning on future occasions.

author: Simon S
review_text: Good portion sizes, soup is not oily and lots of meat in each bowl. The mango smoothie was also quite delicious. FYI they do not accept credit card here. They have a few English speaking staff to assist.

author: Keith Lennop
review_text: Love everything about this place. The pizza isnt the best you have had but still good and the overall vibe of the place makes it a cool spot.

author: Nikki A
review_text: Located in a convenient area with easy parking, this brunch spot initially seemed promising. The spacious interior and patio provide plenty of seating, eliminating the dreaded weekend wait. The vibe is casual and welcoming, making it a pleasant spot to catch up with friends or enjoy a leisurely meal. However, the experience fell short in several areas. The food arrived lukewarm, which detracted from what could have been a satisfying meal. While portion sizes were generous, the quality didn’t match. The French toast, a staple brunch item, was underwhelming and lacked the flavor and texture expected from such a dish. To add to the disappointment, attention to cleanliness was lacking. My napkin had a coffee stain, suggesting it hadn't been replaced after the previous guest — a detail that's hard to overlook when dining out. Service was adequate but not memorable. The waitress was polite, but the interaction didn’t leave a lasting impression. In summary, while the location, space, and vibe are definite highlights, the lackluster food and overlooked details in cleanliness hold this spot back from being a top-tier brunch destination. It’s worth a visit if you’re in the area and looking for convenience, but don’t set your expectations too high.

author: Jada Beasley [West Prep MS]
review_text: I had a great experience at Red Lobster on Decatur. Everyone was so nice. The host who brought me in, to the waiter who served me, they all made sure I was satisfied. Then the manager Whitney I believe her name was came over and asked how everything was and was sweet too. Wonderful lunch experience on my late grandpa’s birthday.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Fakhira Mukhtar
review_text: Very efficient and fast. Waiting time even with alot of crowd only around 5-10 mins. Food has more selection than the other branches cause here they have cafe as well. Even the coffee is really good. My favourite is the Ayam Pop. the best ayam pop you can get is from Pagi Sore (at least for me). Came here before we go to PIK & airport. They have a place to store your bag, and will give you a tag number for your bags. Also have mussolla for those who want to pray first. It’s also not so far away to PIK around 5 mins and airport takes another 15-20 mins. A good place to stop by before going back or when you just arrive Jakarta.

author: Ritz Street
review_text: The 2 of us ordered the truffle mushroom soup, spicy Mexican pasta and the prawn pasta. The food was excellent; all cooked just right, seasoned well and you can taste that the ingredients used was fresh. The service was very helpful and polite. We will definitely come again.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Julia Doell
review_text: Attended Serafina Downtown Miami for date night last night. Our server was Daniel and he was very attentive and kind. Our food arrived to our table very fast. It was delicious and you could tell, house-made. I ordered the Gnocci, it was soft and delicious. Only thing I feel it was missing was a nice piece of bread. The tiramisu for dessert was quite good as well. I loved the chocolate shavings on top. Overall we really enjoyed our experience and would return next time we visit Miami.

author: Nick Shaw
review_text: Mangrove was HANDS DOWN one of the BEST places I’ve ever been to eat. The food was outstanding, portions were generous, and the atmosphere was great. We received excellent service from Wensley who served us two days in a row, he was polite, patient, and took great care of our whole team. The Chef himself also came out to greet us and shake ALL our hands which is a level of service you rarely receive from restaurants. Any time I visit Miami I’ll be coming to Mangrove! 🇯🇲

author: Julie Ershadi
review_text: Unfortunately the food was really bad. The service was very friendly and attentive. But the skirt steak in the beef soltani was not browned and tasted very old, like one day away from going bad. The ghormeh sabzi was black(?!) and not very flavorful, the meat in both khoreshes was totally dry and flavorless, like cubes of cardboard. Everything was really oily and salty. The kashke bademjan tasted really off, I don't even know what was going on there. Even the lavash sucked. :\

author: Sunnyside Up
review_text: Good atmosphere but mainly the tourists. Food generally pretty good with big variety but size can be quite large to try more than a few dishes. Though on my visit, they have an extra dish on my bill. When notes a correct bill was given, a little too quickly. So ensure you check thoroughly.

author: Peter Yong (PedroJoven)
review_text: Nice little eatery and good service. Food's mostly ok. Jamon Iberico was excellent. Hanger steaks were done properly, medium rare. Alcachofas were not fresh and tasted like from canned. Mussels were tender. Paella was ok, can't say authentic Spanish, especially the peas but conceptually good lacking the socarrat. Spicy friend chicken wings is definitely not Spanish but ok taste. Pan con tomate was good. Empanadas tasted good but not Spanish. Ensalada was fresh. Lamb chops were done properly and well seasoned. Flan was good. Price wise is expensive for the quality and quantity, New York City high end price. 4% charge for using credit card which is also higher than normal.

author: Seal
review_text: Good food good portions Good atmosphere. Gets packed so come early. Besides the Tabasco sauce spilled half the bottle onto my plate bc it was missing the stopper. 2x within a week. Everything else was good. I especially loved the cute lattes ☕️

author: mahabub ahmed
review_text: Came here on the recommendation of many local friends. We got the mozzarella sticks appetizer and a pizza with pepperoni. Everything was absolutely fresh and delicious. Definitely one the best whole halal pizza shop I’ve had in the city! The space is small but welcoming.Looking forward to returning!

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: Chen May Yie
review_text: Food was amazing especially crab meat in yellow curry sauce and salted egg yolk squid too. Service was attentive as we were seated the moment we walked in. Bout 4.5 dishes for 2000 THB it’s worth the money spent. Would recommend it to other visitors first time to Bangkok to dine here. Pad kra pow could do a better job though, it was chewy and less fragrant. Creamy tom yum soup pairs with it well.

author: Radu B
review_text: Everything is good here, food atmosphere all. Chill and peaceful good way to spend a nice morning ❤️

author: Sara Volpatti Knutson
review_text: We had the most amazing dinner at The Butcher’s Daughter last night! 🍷 Their wine flights were such a fun and delicious way to try a variety of pours—each one was perfectly paired and absolutely delightful. The food was just as incredible—every bite felt so fresh and flavorful. The pasta was rich and comforting, the pizza was perfectly crisp and loaded with flavor, but the star of the night for me was the gnocchi. Hands down the best I’ve had—it just melted in my mouth! The ambiance was warm and welcoming, the service was spot on, and everything about the experience made it such a memorable evening. Already counting down the days until our next visit!

author: Lou Uffer
review_text: Excellent dinner. Great food and service. Best place we have been to in the Ironbound section of Newark. Convenient parking lot across the street.

author: Winfield Chan
review_text: The two times I've come, they have gotten my order wrong (regular plate instead of family size or queso instead of pollo pastelito). At least the food is good. I recommend the picaderas and pollo guisado to share.

author: Coco A
review_text: We love to eat at Thai places around Las Vegas area since there's a variety to choose from but decided to try this place for the first time since it has good reviews online but our food trip got cut short due to the unsatisfactory taste of the food. We ordered Calamari, Drunken Noodles, and Green Curry. And based on my opinion they could do better. The Calamari is hard and you can tell that it has too much flour/starch and it makes it challenging to chew. We ordered the Drunken Noodles as well with NO spice but they still made it so spicy that we didn't enjoy it nor finish it. And lastly the green curry, it's so watery that it becomes tasteless and the rice is not fully cooked as well. The only positive is. the thai ice tea. To make matters worse we waited an extra 30 minutes to pay since their credit card system is not working. Overall it's a one-and-done type of visit for us.

author: Renee Parker
review_text: We thoroughly enjoyed our visit here. Seated quickly, drinks served immediately. We weren't rushed to place our orders and she came within minutes after we had decided. The food was delicious and cooked as we'd ordered everything. Service was great, I can't remember our servers name, she was friendly, professional and gave a couple of suggestions.

author: Zachary Dobran
review_text: Amazing long standing greek established that takes huge pride in the service and food. Drinks were excellent, bartender provided exceptional service and the food was on point. We had the chilean seabass and Athenian shrimp both dishes were full of flavor and fresh. Gorgeous view of the water and a little show to help dinner go down smooth

author: Supapat W
review_text: Their bee hoon is a must that it has crispy edges, packed with wok hei. Loved the fried pork and the silky eggplant. The salted egg shrimp was rich, creamy, and addictive. Always crowded, but worth the wait. Classic late-night zi char spot in SG!!

author: Nau Como
review_text: It was my first time eating at Taco John’s and it didn’t disappoint! The place was super clean and had a cool vibe! The chicken was fresh, flavorful, not greasy, and packed with just the right amount of seasoning. The Potato Olés were so good—crispy, perfectly seasoned, and addictive. The service was quick and friendly, making the whole experience even better. Whether you're craving a classic taco or a hearty burrito, this place hits the spot!

author: Will Tan
review_text: Food: 5/5 Stars Fried chicken was almost impeccable, truly crispy outside and tender inside. Rice was fragrant and well cooked, with peanuts and anchovies just nicely fried, as well as the fresh yet chilling cucumbers. Of course the mouth-watering sambal was the soul of the whole cuisine. Surprisingly, not thirsty after the meal. Highly recommended! Environment: 3/5 Stars The seating arrangement was quite congested and pretty noisy. However, overall it was clean, neat and cosy. Service: 2/5 Stars Dishes serving was swift. However, waiters were impatient and didnt bother to explain too much about the menu. Also kept rushing us to pay the bill even before we finished the food. Parking: 1/5 Star Extremely difficult to find parking around. Price: 4/5 Stars Prices were reasonable, and only subject to SST (no extra 10% service charge). Overall: 3/5 Stars

author: Jenuwine Blu
review_text: Great time. Clean store & friendly staff. Waited no more than 15 minutes for my table. The food was so fresh. Lots of variety.

author: Marina John Gantie
review_text: Located on Campbell Street, Hameediyah Nasi Kandar is one of the most famous and long-standing nasi kandar spots in Penang. There's almost always a queue, and for good reason — the food is absolutely worth the wait. The variety of dishes available is impressive. On my visit, I spotted some unique options like rabbit curry and fried baby sea crab alongside the usual crowd-pleasers. You can choose between plain white rice or nasi briyani (fragrant yellow rice) as your base, depending on your mood. The process is a bit unique: you select your dishes at one shop, pay there, and then you're redirected to another unit to dine. Over at the dining area, you can order your drinks, wash your hands, use the toilet, and settle your drink bill separately at the counter after your meal. Overall, the food is amazing and full of flavor — rich curries, vegetable dishes, and aromatic rice that truly hit the spot. It's no wonder this place remains a favorite among locals and tourists alike. Highly recommended if you're in Penang and craving a truly satisfying nasi kandar experience!

author: Chuin Ling Ung (CL)
review_text: It's a quite hidden kind of cafe if you don't really notice the signboard. It's kinda cute though. The variety of coffee served here are really special and are so good. Tried their nutty cremina and salted iced coffee, and I can say the salted iced coffee is a must try! Panna cotta gives off a very balanced taste and it's really good.

author: mega
review_text: There are a lot of food stalls here! I tried the popiah, pie tee, and mixed carrot cake. The carrot cake was really good (mix black and white), definitely recommend it! 🥕✨ Popiah and pie tee weren’t really my fave, and they didn’t taste that fresh to me. The place was honestly pretty hot, a bit noisy, and kinda dim (could use better lighting). Hopefully, they improve that in the future!

author: Jony Santos
review_text: This is the best Brazilian restaurant ever, the food is fresh and delicious, the staff are totally kind, there’s bands playing music whole day, and the owner is the the icing on the cake, this guy knows how to make it the best experience. If you’re not brazilian, you i’ll feel like you’re, try the “caipirinha”, trust in me, you never tried anything like that before.

author: Hoàng Thu Linh
review_text: The braised pork with pepper was mostly fat, but the other dishes were well-seasoned. So I'll give it 4 stars.

author: Maria Klann
review_text: Is not what I expected. I saw one of those amazing reviews on Instagram about this restaurant, but in real life it’s not like that. The lobster ravioli with zucchini was very rich and salty. The service is fantastic. The meat was also salty—it was ok, but nothing that takes my breath away. The tuna appetizer was fresh and good. Meatballs are good. About the place… The restaurant is located on the first floor of an old building that lacks of maintenance. It’s very informal and there is not ocean view. It’s a view to the marine which is obstructed by some walls. This restaurant is good for local people who around the area and for the marina.

author: Brian Young
review_text: Our third time coming and it never disappoints! Every part of the dining experience is top notch -- location, service, food. Servers are attentive without being disruptive, pacing is perfect, questions always answered with deep knowledge of the menu. Every dish we've had has been an A+: roman bread (so good!), every pasta, deserts. Wine selection is really good with Italian options that complement the meal. Lots of drink options with a full bar. The view of the pasta making station is such a cool touch to see all the handmade pasta. Secondi dishes also so good, we've had the pork and beef. Just everything you would want from an upscale Italian meal that tastes like Italy. We haven't had the pizza yet, but it's coming one of these days. Finish off with a Limoncello or Sambuca, just like you're in Tuscany. A+

author: Nikireview
review_text: My number one place to visit whenever I’m in Bangkok. This is my favorite Tom Yum ever! The taste is rich, a bit spicy, and the combination of seafood, egg, and all the condiments inside is just amazing. We also tried their fried sausage , and it was incredible. The only downside is the long wait, we had to queue for a solid 2-3 hours. The good thing is, there are plenty of trendy cafes and restaurants nearby to check out while you wait. I definitely recommend everyone to visit at least once if you’re in Bangkok.

author: Liam Heron
review_text: The best pho and black pepper beef we have had on our trip around Vietnam. Food came out within minutes and was very fresh. Service from Anna was great. Price was very reasonable as well. Would highly recommend!

author: neal elsey
review_text: If you haven't tried this deli, please do yourself a favor and get here asap. Everything that I've tried has been great or amazing. Made with love and very fair prices. I stumbled upon this by accident, and now I'm hooked. Their patty melt was the best I've ever had at any restaurant.

author: KA YA
review_text: It's been a while since I last visited, but it's still as delicious as ever. It was a weekday, so I was able to get in easily before lunchtime. I think you can only get such delicious Kupatpong curry at this price here.

author: James On Al
review_text: I wish this place was good, but We couldn't find what we're looking for and Price that we paid absolutely does not match the quality we get from the food, Some dishes tasted really but others tasted like nothing , flavorless or flat. They did good job with adding spices to tahini and other sauces and dressings, but again not all dishes..... Waiter was not able focus or answer our all questions , They were just rushing, running.... Our experience was just okay, May be but may be can come back just for specific dishes hope they can keep their tastes good

author: Anna Vlasova
review_text: I came here on a Sunday to try their special brunch, and it was such a great way to start the day! I had the cheeseburger with a beer — absolutely delicious and satisfying. Then I couldn’t resist trying the dessert: an apple crumble pie with ice cream. It was simply amazing! I left with such positive vibes and a big smile. The atmosphere here is wonderful- friendly people, great music, and an overall lovely energy. Definitely a place I’d love to come back to:)

author: Kien Nguyen
review_text: The apmostphere is very good, the food is excellent and the service is great.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Soo Wei
review_text: Best local foods ever!! This stall sells rice noodles with beef/pork as sides. Their foods are amazing, the taste of the soup base tastes great, not too salty or oily, you can add chilli flakes which tasted better. If rice noodle is too much for you, you can opt for bread as your carbs. As a tourist, i can feel the warmth and friendliness of the owner who tried to explain their foods with simple English during our order. The price is cheap and i would definitely recommend to all of you, will come back again when i visit Da Nang. 😍

author: E S
review_text: AUGUST 2025. LOOK AT THE FOOD OMG THE PRESENTATION IS LOL Tourist here. Very disappointed at service (expect to wAit 1.5hours) , they forget orders , and the food was extremely disappointing. Not sure why this place has michelin guide ? Food presentation is lacklustre. DONT WASTE UR CALORIES HERE

author: Mi Hyun Lee
review_text: Usually my friend and myself visit this place quite sometimes for breakfast or coffee :) Love to see staff Wendy here, she is very friendly and provided excellent service , appreciate to Ms Wendy for her table service and all , we would happy to see her next time as well , we are big fan of Harry’s :) cheers :)

author: CEOEatTravelRepeat
review_text: One of the best Nasi Kandar in Penang. Ayam Bawang is delicious. The joki will candi all the kuah and mixed well. The nasi kandar taste became super delicious when you take away and eat after a few hours. Very recommended

author: C T
review_text: I visited the restaurant around 1 pm on a Tuesday and was delighted to find ample seating available. The noodles were wonderfully tender, reminiscent of the authentic Hong Kong style, and the char siew meat was a particular highlight, absolutely delicious! The Thai milk tea was a delightful accompaniment, offering a great balance of flavors. Moreover, the restaurant’s prompt service was impressive, ensuring a swift dining experience. The comfortable ambiance added to the overall enjoyment of the meal. A highly recommended spot

author: Aquarius Dawn Nancy
review_text: Wendy, the beautiful bartender is the bomb! I ordered the tasty All-American hot dog. It was very well done as I requested . My old fashioned Arnold Palmer was the the best I ever had made! Love North Miami Beach Duffy's Oliver took me to. He always takes me out and I appreciate him for always covering and making sure I get enough drinks!

author: Ray Sim
review_text: My food rating guide: 2.5/5 ‐-------> Average taste 5/5 ‐--------> Scrumptious! (My comfort food! 🤩) Very crispy and airy baguette. The BBQ pork (Banh Mi Thit Nuong) was flavourful and savoury. Not too sweet. Similar to 肉干 taste. The vege and herb were fresh and fragrant. Added egg that gave another layer of texture to it and enhanced the overall taste. The chicken ( Banh Mi Sot Ga) was ok. Dine at the low stools and table by a minor road watching grassroots activities was chill and had the locally-connected vibe. The Banh Mi was a 4.7/5

author: Loy Hui Yang
review_text: Enjoyed their Sunday brunch thoroughly with my friend! Go for their foccacia and cheese board for appetisers, pastas/pizzas for a satiating main and end off with their molten lava cake for the perfect finish ❤️

author: Ariel Jones
review_text: Linda was a breath of fresh air! We had wonderful meal here thanks to her incredible service and positive attitude. After a bad experience at a different Red Lobster in Henderson we weren't sure if we'd give the restaurant another chance...but Linda made us fans again!! The food was cooked to perfection too!

author: Michael Ruelas
review_text: The service was top notch! The lady was very polite and went above and beyond to help me with the large order. The food was good, but needed a little more to get that fifth star. The atmosphere is great if your an eagles fan. I recommend the supreme and the Philly pizza.

author: Ashlyn Williams (Ash)
review_text: It's really hard for me to do 5 stars but my experience at Monty's has usually usually always been top notch. Today was definitely another good day. We arrived for lunch not thinking about it being Brunch (thought it's Saturday). Our server, Petrona, was on the ball. She got to my table with my family quickly and made good suggestions on things. We ordered drinks and an appetizer that came at a great speed and she made sure to bring a water when the last one of our party arrived. The food came out hot delicious. It was a great experience and I know next time I'm in town I will be back.

author: Row Pascua
review_text: I’m very happy that Bob’s East Side Deli is still open for business. I love supporting local businesses and I’m cheering them on. Nice size and clean restaurant. Friendly staff and great food always and surely affordable. Keep it up Bob’s Deli Team! I’ve only been here to pick up food haven’t had a chance to eat inside. Glad that they’re open early mornings a good time to pick up breakfast before going to work. We like the Steak and two eggs (cooked over hard) on a Kaiser Roll and Buffalo Cauliflower with Ranch. Oh so yummy!

author: Eugene Khoo
review_text: Bloody good food. The chook rice (Rong Ji) and the kway chup (Shi Le Yuan) here depicted are must trys. Faith Nasi Lemak is God's gift too. It's a hawker centre, so not for a first date unless she's a keeper. Go on. Be a man.

author: Noa Pei
review_text: What a terrible dining experience! I was shocked to find hair in my food, and the indifferent tone and bad attitude of the waitress really shocked me. I really regret choosing to try the dishes here! It turns out that all those who gave bad reviews have their reasons! That waitress in the restaurant simply shouldn't be working in the service industry. She should be a queen at home!

author: Mass Dragon
review_text: It gave me indigestion. Way overcooked the onion rings in what tasted like old oil. Double whammied my insides. Also somehow the Oreo Frost tasted sort of… bland? And I hadn’t been eating sugar beforehand.

author: Chuah Keat Lee
review_text: This chicken rice shop is unlike others. The steamed chicken is cooked all the way through, no bloody bits. What makes it special is the dipping condiments - the chilli and the green sauce. Oh man, the chicken that's dipped with both sauces are to die for. I have also tried the prawn wan ton soup... It's so good that I forgotten to take a photo. Also, the pumpkin milk beverage is also a must try. I really have nothing bad to say - 5 thumbs up, recommend! 👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

author: Pattarapon Buathong
review_text: Dried beef suki. Beef is delicious (but not many pieces given). Other is so-so. Vegetables are crispy. Fermented tofu takes the lead in taste. Quite expensive. Store entrance is wet and quite dirty.

author: William ORourke
review_text: Amazing! Best to visit on an off hour so you don’t have to wait. We were surprised at how friendly service was and welcomed. Be sure to order the combo dish with all the proteins and sauces with a carrot/apple juice.

author: Christina Lui
review_text: The view is super nice IF you can a good seat. And obviously the nice view seat only for the guest and we, walk in guest just to bring to the designated table depends on luck. We got the seat only can see 20% of the sunset. The waitress are super good as in every time they are around to serve us. The food is so so. I went there around 530pm and by 645+, the sky is dark and we can’t see anything. There’s minimum spend too for walk in guest so we have to order something to enjoy the view. Also, it was so hot without any wind

author: Novita Wu
review_text: Great place to hang out with friends here, foods are okay. The interior is great, it’s as if you are being in the set of the Great Gatsby. It’s super aesthetic. Slightly difficult for vegetarian goers, as they don’t have much options for vegetarians.

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: Dan Tang
review_text: Charcoal fried Kuey teow in Penang.... very popular with locals. Spicy octopus is also very delicious!! Only open in the evening... Recommended.

author: Mathew
review_text: My cousin recommended me to this lovely place and I went with my family. We were seated outside. The view and atmosphere of the restaurant was absolutely outstanding. We ordered a spread and tremendously enjoyed the food! Most importantly, the waiter - Don - service was immaculate and he provided such exceptional service! We would definitely be coming back for more!

author: Carl Wong
review_text: Came here for lunch. I've been when it first opened, since then they had picked up 3 Michelin Bib Gourmand awards. This is a nice Malaysian comfort food café, so don't expect immaculate service. The staff is very nice, friendly and multi lingual. The food, however, is excellent. I ordered the Roti Cenai and Hainan chicken rice (to go) and the Hokkien Prawn noodle soup and Malaysian milk tea for dining in. The broth is amazing, the noodles are not soggy, the water spinach (kangkung) is fresh and crisp and the shrimp is good as well. It seems the Hainan chicken rice is rather popular.
