Will find out how it compares to Savoy. I got seated right away, however as I was leaving there was a line outside at 1pm.

author: Isaac Romero
review_text: Funding a good taco stand here in LA, it's not an easy task, came here by a referral, and finding parking is not that easy. They make the tortillas by hand on the spot. I tried several of their meats and I only liked their Cabeza and Chorizo. The Asada was ok. Al Pastor was not well seasoned and tasted more like Carnitas. Their fountain drinks taste fresh.

author: Ann Ng
review_text: ☕ The Workshop has a cool industrial-style interior with spacious seating and plenty of natural light. The bar is lined with coffee equipment, creating a professional vibe — a great spot for coffee lovers. This is my third visit, and the food and drinks are still up to standard: • Pour-over coffee: aromatic, smooth, and beautifully presented. • Omelette with toast & salad: fluffy, tasty, and just the right portion. • Croissant: crisp, buttery, and perfect with jam and butter. The only downside is that the staff don’t seem very welcoming — a warmer smile and friendliness would make the experience even better. Overall, still a great place to enjoy coffee, breakfast, or brunch. 🌟

author: DAT HO TUAN
review_text: This restaurant is cheap, the space is airy, there are 3 Karaoke rooms that can accommodate at least 20 people. The grilled dishes are the best, the service is average, generally affordable, the best thing is that the food is delicious, the drinks are good and cheap. Each person only spends about 200 - 300k. Where can you find a restaurant that is delicious, cool, and cheap? Saturday and Sunday are crowded, so go early.

author: Hyunwoo J
review_text: Delicious Mexican food, enchiladas were amazing. Service was above and beyond. Ordered more after my meal for takeout.

author: Danielle O'Garro
review_text: I'm 38. Tried them for the first time at 15 and still go to this day. Same staff, same food, same atmosphere and I love that they stayed true to themselves amongst all the change around them. The food is A+... and staff is friendly. Give it a try, you won't be disappointed.

author: A.K. Everyday
review_text: Visiting Miami, I was celebrating my 50th bday and wanted a lowkey, speakeasy vibe. I wanted good food, music, and good vibes. Vicky made this experience top notch! She was pleasant, kind, knowledgeable about flavor profiles. The cocktails and food were top tier. Shoutout to the chef too! Much love -A.K.

author: Barry Chase
review_text: This Sonic consistently has the worst service of any I've ever been to. The grill goes down at midnight. The ice cream machine doesn't work at 2:00 in the morning. They're out of eggs at 11:00 in the morning. And this stop, they don't have enough staff so it's drive through only. This location has seen the last of my business.

author: john alexander
review_text: Great time, nice atmosphere and friendly folks. First time here, actually had a great experience and I ate the most my wife said in a couple years. So, there's that. Recommended for sure. Oh, sorry, the one picture was the end of second plate of catfish, excellent.

author: Robin
review_text: We've visited this establishment many times. This trip included a party of 8. The food was good -- nice and filling. The service was thorough, pleasant and professional. There was live music and television screens around the restaurant.

author: Patricia Fields
review_text: We went at night time to order carne asada burritos and when we got home to eat our food none of the 3 burritos had meat. So now we just buy breakfast burritos, or cheese burgers. .. The food is good though...

author: Barrie Waisserberg
review_text: This place is the perfect beach scene. Since it's raised up, the ocean view is great. There is live music 6-9 weekdays and 3 - 6 weekends. Prices are surprisingly reasonable for a restaurant on the beach. Overall, Nice, fun experience.

author: Sridutt Miraskar
review_text: Great spot just steps away from the Fremont Street Experience, yet far enough to escape the crowd and noise. Comfortable seating, a friendly bartender, and plenty of beer options to try. Even late on a weekday night, the staff had the same energy and enthusiasm, encouraging us to sample different brews. We only had a beer and a cocktail since we were full, but both were excellent. Bonus: free parking right in front of the restaurant after midnight.

author: Khanh Khanh
review_text: We ordered a variety of grilled fish, pork, and vegetables, all cooked to perfection. Excellent service, and an authentic cultural dining experience. Whether you're looking for a casual meal or a special dinner with friends and family, this restaurant is definitely worth a visit. I’ll be coming back for sure!

author: Natasha Zeba
review_text: Special thanks to Carolina and Camila for making my birthday super special! Very friendly staff and amazing atmosphere. Muchas gracias. This is one of the best bakeries ever. I went there for some coffee and cake and guess what! Someone ended up paying for my treats.

author: Boon Leong
review_text: Located in the industrial area accessible by car 🚗 Went on Sat evening &with a few tables occupied The ingredients are stored in the refrigerator with a fixed price based on the color plates. Chose the plates & paid at the cashier. The clayport of lala are placed on the charcoal stove. The place is stuffy after a while enjoying. For 3paxs it cost ard $80 Prob find the prices on the higher side.

author: AndreaKiana OK
review_text: Thank you Wendy and Jackie! They were absolutely amazing servers! Food was great as always. I Ordered the dragon sushi roll and jackpot sushi roll.

author: Susie Li
review_text: I ordered catering from Taco John's in Boston for a big meeting at work, and I couldn't be happier! We needed 100 burritos with some specific survival food restrictions, and they went above and beyond to accommodate all our requests. The food was absolutely amazing—fresh, flavorful, and satisfying. Everyone loved it! The staff was super friendly and professional throughout the process. I'll definitely be ordering from Taco John's again for future events. Highly recommend!

author: Chad Hutchins
review_text: Outstanding restaurant, and I can't believe this was our first visit. They are doing everything right... food, service, and atmosphere! Very friendly from the moment we stepped in. The food was cooked to perfection and very tasty! You don't hear many people talking about Triple George, but it's a hidden Gem. Highly recommend and we'll be back for sure!

author: Brooks Reeves
review_text: So the vibe is charming and inviting. I ordered the French Toast combo as I wanted a sample. I was disappointed that the meal came on one plate, which forced me to eat my eggs and potatoes first as I didn’t want to mix the sweetness of the syrup with those savory components. The bacon, while tasty, was limp. Eggs were quite good, but it’s over easy, not rocket science. Potatoes were decent though the serving size was paltry especially when you consider the price. I do not have a huge sweet tooth, and I can’t remember the last time I had French Toast, but I will say: it was great. Pillowy and with a strong cinnamon flavor. So pros: great French toast, and tasty food all the way round. Nice atmosphere. Cons: Way overpriced for what you get, and you don’t get much for that price. While the food was tasty I can get that meal, and more of it for close to half that price at countless diners around Boston. I just don’t think it was special enough to justify the price point.

author: newchicgal
review_text: 14 Jun 2025, Saturday, 2.20pm to 2.55 pm waiting time. Long Queue. After being seated, another period of waiting. I think I will only get my food after 1 hour from the time I get a number. Come on weekdays! I am ordering Fish Maw Soup with Crab Meat 120 baht, Jumbo Fried Rice with Crab Meat 380 baht and water 10 baht. Food is only 3 stars today. Fish Maw Soup with Crab Meat is too salty and has less ingredients than yesterday. Jumbo Fried Rice with Crab Meat is very wet today, not nice, like it is being cooked by an apprentice. I will not visit again after the inconsistent food quality on both visits. 3 stars for today's food. 13 Jun 2025, Friday, 9.30am There's menu and order form in English & Thai. I ordered the Fish Maw Soup with Crab Meat 120 baht. It is slightly sour, very nice, not too salty. I also ordered the Crab in Curry and Omelet 380 baht. Unfortunately, I only ate the crab, the curry isn't to my liking, I left it untouched. I later ordered the Jumbo Fried Rice with Crab Meat Fried Rice 380 baht, asking for less rice but they don't understand English so I still get a big plate that's double the size of usual small Thai serving. The Crab Meat Fried Rice is sooooo much better than the curry dish! Skip the curry crab that's hard and messy to eat. Just this fried rice dish is enough. Thai tea 35 baht is nice but too sweet unless you wait for all ice to melt. Overall, it's a great meal, worth 5 stars. Cash only.

author: Juvanny Joseph
review_text: We had the Kabab Koobideh (which is ground beef kabob skewers, rice, and grilled tomatoes) and the beef soltani (which is one ground beef skewer and one flat filet mignon/tenderloin piece with rice and grilled tomatoes). Everything was delectable. The beef was seasoned to perfection and cooked perfectly. Every bite was juicy and bursting with flavor. It’s clear that they use quality meat. I can’t speak on the chicken kabobs but if their beef kabobs are any indication, the chicken should be just as good. The rice was also cooked perfectly. At a lot of Persian restaurants I’ve been to, the rice is usually undercooked or lacking in flavor and the meat is either too dry or lacks the appropriate seasoning. But this place does both right. They also serve black tea after a meal if you ask. The service is friendly and attentive. The atmosphere is also a nice place to bring family or friends to. It would also work well for a small event (80-100 people). If you’re looking for high quality, delicious Persian food, I strongly recommend Soroush.

author: Marissa Smith
review_text: This place really sets the date night tone with the low lights and tabletop spotlight. The beyond exceptional service our waiter Danny gave, made our experience just as great as the food was! I had a virgin Lychee Mojito (which lived up to my pregnant expectations lol) while my fiance had a bottle of Nigori Sake, which Danny made sure his glass was always full!! We started with the Sake Tostones. Followed by a small ginger salad before receiving our entrees. Our hibachi shrimp and filet mignon plates didn’t survive photos but I 10/10 recommend!

author: William Fong
review_text: For all the hype and wait, I was extremely disappointed. I thought it would stand out but everything we ordered was only OK. The Portuguese tart taste like bought from elsewhere and heated up. San Francisco cafes like this is way better. That is the honest truth.

author: Robert Webb
review_text: Amazing food and phenomenal atmosphere! Five stars all the way! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Sy Tan
review_text: Good environment, good vibes with many spot to take photo. And very good services by the worker. Food variety is good, many choices. Worth a try, but food taste have room of improvement . Thai tea is good

author: Denissa Gonzalez
review_text: We received complimentary pita bread fresh out of the oven such a nice touch! The hummus was delicious as an appetizer, and the lentil soup might honestly be the best I’ve ever had. I also really appreciated that they don’t go heavy on the salt, but my cucumber and tomato salad ended up way under seasoned it definitely needed a pinch more. As for the service, our waitress seemed kind but very out of it. She looked tired and sad, like her body was present but her mind was elsewhere. She kept forgetting things, tripped over her feet a few times, and even dropped the dressing. Service felt a bit off, but I genuinely hope she’s okay. It left me a little concerned.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Joshua West
review_text: Good cheap food. You have to order first then pick a seat. Don't forget to ask for iced tea when ordering. I wish the cashier would say "anything to drink?" Or " uống KHÔNG?"

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Alfred Balaga
review_text: **Context: Weekday Dinner** We visited the restaurant with a group of five, including three adults and two children. We appreciated being seated immediately, which is helpful to note for future visits. The service was prompt, and the ordering process was straightforward. It’s essential to pay close attention, as the delivery of their English may vary. The food was pretty enjoyable. The flavors were well-balanced, with none being overly strong or emphasized. The sauces, served on the side, complemented our dishes nicely. Overall, we had a positive experience and would easily recommend this place. Anyone planning a visit should be mindful of peak times to ensure prompt seating.

author: Mo Jo
review_text: The service was great 👍 and the food was very satisfying and tasty. Atmosphere was good but we sat in a booth in the corner which had worn out seats that felt lumpy. But overall, a good place to get a good meal. Orange juice is fresh squeezed!

author: Gaby
review_text: I deliver food and I came here for two pickup orders. They have 2 big banners hung out front that read mobile order go to the front window, which I did. However they turned me down because they only respect that during the morning making it unnecessary because that's already common sense. Either respect the banner during full business hours or don't hang it up at all, it's completely illogical to not specify the times it's valid if it's not valid during all business hours. I was in line for 20 minutes it was a complete waste of time.

author: Lauren B
review_text: Had to order a bunch of tostones for a last minute cultural event at my sons school and they were perfect, hot, crispy and packed well... everyone loved them and they were better then the ones I make myself😉 and way faster😂 Cant wait to go back and try the Mangu... everything looked so good😍

author: Alexa Fontes
review_text: Coimbra Bar and Restaurant is a standout spot in Newark! The food is absolutely delicious, with authentic Portuguese flavors and generous portions. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, perfect for all occasionds. What truly makes this place shine is the awesome service—the staff are attentive, friendly, and make you feel right in Portugal. Highly recommend for an unforgettable dining experience! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

author: Hazel Ta
review_text: Very mid if not tasteless coffee (latte) and non-coffee (oolong cold brew) drinks 😰 The ambience was amazing which is why the ratings got 3* and why we even came back. Metal chairs with limited support for your back so it will get uncomfy for long sitting and somehow the tables are super low??? (I’m not even that tall…) Staffs were unwelcoming and borderline rude to Vietnamese customers, when we came in it was crowded and they told us to sit at the large shared table despite having a vacant window-side table. They put the reserve sign on it, but when we about to leave a female staff came and said we could sit there (?). I paid 200k for 2 mid drinks and 1 cookie yet they were annoyed when we ask for our free parking tickets 🥀??? Much better support and hospitality for other Non-Viet customers Guess this is one of those places that only welcomes foreigners like the ones in Thao Dien =)))

author: Astrid
review_text: Ayat, where to begin? Sometimes a place draws you in because of its reputation. Ayat was one of those places. Seated on a Sunday, I came in with moderate expectations of a thorough menu dedicated to showcasing Palestinian cuisine. I was not disappointed. From the zaatar to the olives in olive oil, to the heaping mounds of sizzling chicken shawarma, Ayat is a place that beats expectations. Nearly too much food to eat, so go with friends that like to share and indulge to your hearts desire. Food is the star, but the service is excellent too, and the ambience is deeply inviting. Palestinian to its core - what a beautiful place!

author: Bell Chin
review_text: RM4 Kaya Butter Toast in a Kopitiam might should expensive, but the generous butter serving makes it worth it and tastes so good. Always expect the place to be super crowded during lunch hour. Parking is also very difficult. Not many things are good, but its location made it really convenient. FYI, Lorbak not great. And of course, the Yam Rice & Pickle Cabbage Pork Soup, one of the best in town.

author: Venus Saksongmuang
review_text: This restaurant's crab fried rice is absolutely delicious... The fried rice is dry and not oily, and they have a lot of crab claws. The portion is very good value for the price. The only downside is that the flavor of the fried rice isn't very rich and is a bit bland. P.S. You have to add your own chili fish sauce and a squeeze of lime for a perfectly balanced flavor.

author: Patrick Yu
review_text: Again patronised Segar for my Elder Sis her 60th Birthday on Sat 6 Sep. This year She requested something more local cuisine, reasonable price and Cozy ambience especially. Nevertheless, Segar has never disappointed my family and myself. The dishes maintained the usual standard and some were even better than usual time. The service rendered by the Service Crew was warmed and homely. That's one of reasons why we always have Segar as our first choice. Thank you Segar for "being" our family's "private" kitchen in past years. 😜😜😜 Well Done 👏👏👏👏👏

author: Francisco Lozano
review_text: This has been our preferred date night option for more than three years now and even more so after their recent renovations. The menu options feel curated and the quality of each dish shines through. We’ve been lucky enough to try just about everything on the menu and pleasantly surprised by all of the options. My wife is particularly fond of their hookah and has never been disappointed with the preparation or service. Phenomenal staff, food, quality, ambience, and value. This has been our highest restaurant recommendation to friends and family when visiting the area. Highly Recommend.

author: Courtney C
review_text: We ordered two curries and a daal. The dishes were really not tasty and extremely OILY. This is the worst Indian restaurant we've been to.

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: JW
review_text: I love lei Cha in general but this Lei Cha has such good review for a good reason! Simply delicious!! However, I find it too filling so I usually request for no rice and it is just nice for me ☺️ Price is super reasonable too!

author: Norton Erick
review_text: The best club in Seminyak. A must visit if you go to Bali. Came here with my friends on Saturday night. The place is perfect for celebrating birthdays or other events. The music is very fun and the atmosphere inside is very lively. For just having dinner or a party is also fun. The menu is very diverse, the food and drinks are also delicious. Most of the guests here are foreigners, maybe because there are many rumors that say that here they prioritize foreigners over locals. But when I was there the treatment of me and my friends who were locals was all very good, maybe the security needs to be improved to be friendlier and not discriminate against guests. Because the first impression is very important because the security position is at the very front. I am sure La Favela can be more crowded and more successful if the front part can be friendlier, not rude and more polite. Some of the staff are friendly and some are not. Apart from that, I really enjoy the atmosphere here. The atmosphere is very unique and different from most other clubs. And I will definitely recommend this place to my friends who want to visit a club in Bali.

author: Aref Aasi
review_text: This place never disappoints you. This Texas road house branch has been our favorite place to gather with our friends. I love their bread & butter!

author: Mia Settles
review_text: My server Wensley was knowledgeable of the menu and most importantly, personable. I ordered the crispy cauliflower, Rasta Pasta with Jerk Chicken and Pineapple Plaintains. EVERYTHING was fresh, cooked to order and most importantly, tasted AMAZING!!! If you’re on the fence on whether to visit or not, my suggestion is do. I wish I lived in Miami so I can visit again!

author: Tiffany Morales
review_text: Worth Every Bite! From the moment we walked in, this restaurant impressed on every level. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, but it was the exceptional staff who truly set the tone for the afternoon. Friendly, attentive, and genuinely passionate about what they do—they made us feel like VIPs from start to finish. Our server Evelyn was superb!! Now, the food? Absolutely phenomenal. Every dish was a masterpiece bursting with flavor. The ingredients were clearly fresh and thoughtfully combined—each bite felt like a celebration. Whether it was the perfectly seasoned appetizers, the beautifully presented main courses, or the decorative coffees, everything was cooked to perfection. This place is a shining example of what great dining should be: delicious food, outstanding service, and a memorable experience. We’re already planning our next visit!

author: ADRIAN
review_text: Amazing Indonesian food at Remboelan Senayan City! 🍲✨ Highly recommended!

author: Maria
review_text: Absolutely love this bar!!! Marissa, on grave, is the BEST bartender in town with the BEST drinks for every occasion! Amazing food and they make you feel like FAMILY!!!!

author: Wai Man Cheong
review_text: As a kid I remembered coming here and was always happy to visit. Nowadays the food was okay. Not bad but nothing outstanding. If you want a quick dim sum it’s okay but don’t expect to be overwhelmed.

author: Reo. C
review_text: Wait outside to be served, Recommend fried rice, fried noodles and omelette here. Personally I think their Tomyam can be improved. Price is okay.

author: Ianhung Lee
review_text: Among those yam rice in Bukit Mertajam, i find this is one of the best. Though the yam in the rice seems lacking lately. The soup can be customised if you do not take offals and blood jelly. The price is okay for a portion. Other than that, the jawa mee and pasembur are nice too Parking here is somewhat difficult and depends on luck.

author: L
review_text: Very fresh and great balance. Bamboo rice was good, ponzu was good and not too much source like other poke. It would be better to order online and pick up.

author: Sharanya Sarkar
review_text: We couldn’t get a reservation at our preferred time since it was a Saturday night, but it worked out just fine. The bar was full service and had a great vibe. The lighting and decor were beautiful, with warm tones and cherry blossoms that made the space feel magical. It was the perfect setting for a cozy date night. The tacos were amazing. The fish tacos were our favorite — super fresh, warm, and packed with flavor. The ground beef tacos (gordita crunch style) were a close second. The duck tacos were just okay in comparison. The drinks were excellent. I started with the mango cucumber margarita (because tequila is cheaper than therapy, right?) and really liked it. My partner had the espresso martini and loved it. For our second round, I had the "Beautiful Liar" with prickly pear, tequila, elderflower, orange blossom, and black lava salt. My partner went for the "Garden of Eva" with mezcal, watermelon, and basil. Both were nice, but we still preferred our first choices. Overall, it was a fantastic date night with great food, drinks, and ambiance. We’ll definitely be coming back.

author: Bryan Tan
review_text: Laksa for $6.50. Although slightly above the usual laksa prices, the cockles were given generously and size of it were relatively bigger. Soup is fragrant and had all the makings of what a laksa should have. Some of the tofu puffs were slightly hard though. Felt as though they haven't been cooked in the laksa broth at the start😅. The rest were fine. Noodles portioned out fine too.

author: hungryhappyhippo
review_text: Great location, good food and immaculate vibes. FYI there’s valet parking only $5 but worth it in my opinion. The valet was super nice, I forgot my phone in the car and he brought it in to the waitress. I sat outside right by the water for a beautiful sunset dinner and boat watching. The vibes are chic coastal. I had Lobster Rigatoni and a mocktail. And the serving size was great and good amount of lobster meat in there. Be mindful that once it started to get dark I could feel like bugs biting me since I was by the water. Other than that the bathrooms were clean and decorated with fun vintage photos. Love this place, would come again.

author: Luis “Louie” Montalvo
review_text: Had the lunch special, quarter chicken and fried yucca and a salad. It was delicious. The fried yucca comes with a garlic dipping sauce. The chicken was cooked just right I'll definitely be back again.

author: leewei Saw
review_text: We celebrated our BFF’s birthday at Kazumasa Sushi Omakase, and it was an unforgettable experience! We had the fresh unagi omakase, and every course was beautifully presented, fresh, and full of flavor — definitely worth it. Chef Sammy was warm and welcoming. He explained each dish with such passion, making the whole meal feel personal and engaging. The highlight of the night was when he surprised our friend with a special birthday dessert — beautifully decorated ice cream, a perfect crème brûlée, and even a small gift. Such a thoughtful and heartwarming gesture! Highly recommend Kazumasa for anyone looking for high-quality sushi, great service, and a memorable omakase experience — especially for special occasions.

author: William Kim
review_text: Really good neopolitan style pizza. The dough is so good. One of my favorites. Fresh ingredients. I got the Famous Original and Bee Sting. Both had a little spicy kick to it, nothing crazy. Honey on bee sting was perfect combo to spice and soppressata.

author: YVONNE SKYE
review_text: The food taste so so. Portion of spaghetti abit small. Very limited parking as many parking infront of the shop is reserved for their own customer.

author: Daniel Glickman
review_text: A surprisingly good place to eat where you would not expect it. Best for Spanish speakers but they will do their best to accommodate and explain the dishes to you. The food aims to punch above its weight and while it’s not quite upscale it’s definitely very tasty. The staff is the highlight, very chatty and eager to provide a good time. Enjoy!

author: Alain Lafume
review_text: I went to high street place to have a few drinks and the varieties were plentyful enough. I had two kinds of beers. One blueberry 🫐 and another some kind of creamer one. I had a good time with my friend. Would go again. Though I might try some other kinds of drinks.

author: Chin Perera
review_text: We found Cuca just after we landed back in Bali and we really enjoyed our experience there. We ordered the following: Nachos Broccoli caeser Roast pork buns (one of our favs) Crispy fried chicken Spicy crab (my fav) The ambience of the restaurant was really cool. Large open air spaces with drawback partitions for privacy. Dimly lit but not too dark. You can see the entire kitchen as well. The staff were so friendly and attentive we really enjoyed our time there and highly recommend going there. Thank you for the amazing food and experience team!

author: Leala Benally
review_text: The best was TASTY! And the Bloody Marry was cute and fun. Unfortunately our server was not the best. We had only seen our server twice during our time there and had to ask another server for the bill, etc. I recommend coming here if you have time to kill and don’t mind waiting because the food was awesome.

author: B Vite
review_text: Reliable local spot for consistently delicious food. No frills. Clean, family place with friendly staff. I order breakfast burritos for work meetings; always ready on time.

author: SD
review_text: The Notorious P.I.G was a tasty toasted bacon baguette. The bacon was crispy providing a great crunch to the sandwich. It would’ve been nice if the cheese was slightly more melted though. It was paired perfect with an iced Vietnam coffee. The service was prompt and friendly too. Great spot for a quick breakfast bite. My only regret was I forgot to try a hash brown, guess I’ll have to go back

author: Sudeepa Herath
review_text: Very well hyped and rightly so. The place offers a different dining experience. You should go on a busy day just to experience the chaos. Don't expect a peacefully dining experience here. The view during sunset is nice. Payments are done upfront and you have to take a trolley and collect your own food when your name is announced over the speaker. Even on a busy day, our order was ready in 20min. Food is reasonably priced and tastes quiet good. Expect to spend around RM 30 - 50 per person. There is a also a stall to buy Thai snacks and drinks. Large parking area available. You would have to pay RM 5 to enter the jetty area tho.

author: Thu-Nga Ortega, DDS, MAGD
review_text: This rooftop restaurant is pretty cute. It has a nice ambience and overlooks the beach from afar. We came here for brunch. The food is decent, dessert is pretty good. We got the steak and eggs and it was tasty. This scrambled egg with prosciutto and cheese bread was delicious. The pepper pasta ( cacio e pepe ) is also pretty tasty. The mango and pineapple sorbet was delicious. Tiramisu was also delicious. This restaurant is worth going to if you are in LA

author: Naj Barrett
review_text: How did I miss this place? Stopped in for brunch and we were all very happy with our orders, French toast tasted like a delicious Cinnabon, eggs full of flavor and thick pieces of bacon. I also had a fruity mimosa, in a nice lively atmosphere. Our server and everyone working there was awesome!

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Bảo Phạm
review_text: The grilled food was okay, marinated but still tasted bland when grilled! The fried food counter was bad and cold. When a staff member asked for help, they were confused (there were a few male staff members who were still enthusiastic). It was raining and the food leaked? When the staff asked to go upstairs to eat, the staff had already arranged all the seats for new customers, but there was no more room for the old customers who had just had a leak like me? When we took them upstairs above the kitchen, the food still leaked. The experience at this restaurant was really bad. This is the first time I have had to review a restaurant and give it 1* like this. The restaurant should retrain the staff and fix the roof!

author: Kiah J
review_text: Perfect oceanfront breakfast/lunch spot. Ate breakfast then came back to order lunch and eat on the beach. Loved my breakfast burrito and their fresh mango salsa. We ordered the mahi mahi for lunch and it was delicious along with the mixed veggies. All the drinks I ordered from the bar were nice and strong. Service was fast and the servers were so nice I really enjoyed this spot.

author: Richard Carrillo
review_text: So I usually stick to the restaurant side of Ichabods but this time I opted for the lounge since I wanted to play a little video poker. Glad I did! They had my go-to drink: a Heineken 0.0%. I asked for a menu and went straight for my comfort food—the Meatloaf with a baked potato and steamed broccoli. A classic, and reasonably priced (especially in today’s economy). Service was great—Steph behind the bar was friendly and welcoming, and Kelly, my server, was attentive and made sure to time my meal just the way I like it. I asked to finish my salad before the main course came out, and she made it happen. By the time I was done eating… let’s just say I proudly reestablished myself as a member of the Clean Plate Club! As for the video poker… it wasn’t exactly my lucky day, but hey—that’s the game. Win some, lose some. If you’re in the area, definitely stop by. The place has that classic Old Vegas vibe that’s getting harder to find these days.

author: Jess Wills
review_text: A must stop place for breakfast and/or coffee!! The food was fresh and had amazing flavor! If you like feta cheese, the Greek Omelette is amazing! Clean and nice vibe! Employees are polite and kind!

author: Kenneth Khoo
review_text: We travelled from Taiping to Ipoh with high hopes of enjoying some delicious dim sum, but our experience was just average overall. The **Siu Mai** didn’t quite meet our expectations; it lacked the depth of flavours we were hoping for. On the other hand, the **Har Gao** was decent, with a nice balance of shrimp filling and thin, delicate wrappers. One highlight was the **egg tarts**, which were delightful with their flaky crust and creamy custard filling. The **BBQ pastries** were also commendable, offering a pleasant blend of savoury flavours. However, many of the other dishes fell into the standard category, lacking the wow factor that often accompanies dim sum. The service at the restaurant was commendable. The staff was attentive, frequently topping up our tea and promptly serving and clearing our table, which added to the overall experience. The ambience of the place was quite charming, reminiscent of a traditional tea house, providing a nice backdrop for our meal. Interestingly, while we had heard that this spot is usually bustling with diners, it was relatively quiet during our visit, with only a few tables occupied. In summary, while there were some enjoyable dishes, the overall standard of the dim sum did not live up to the hype. It’s worth a visit for the egg tarts and BBQ pastries, but don’t expect an extraordinary dim sum experience.

author: Matthew Ng
review_text: Amazing joint from the original one in Ubud. This place ticked all the boxes for me but with an upgrade on the environment from the original. Think modern sleek woodwork still reminiscent of Bali but in a Texan-Saloon setting. Pictures of old cartoon, paraphernalia & records hung on the walls. A semi-open kitchen gives you a peering insight into the wonders of the flaming grill. A large pot of the signature sauce next to it while the chefs lathers on the sticky-sweet-savoury liquid onto the ribs. The grilled prawns as a starter were an absolute gem. Succulent, plump & sweet (not to mentioned well cleaned which is a big plus). The garlic butter brushed on had the right twang to it and made it even more moorish. Then came the main star. A half rack of ribs weighing in at 600g (bone-in). The steaming aroma was hard to miss and a quick squeeze of lime made my mouth salivate. Even now writing this makes me crave it despite having dinner already. The bones fall apart and the meat just melts over. Sticky, gnarly and downright dirty, this isn’t a first-date meal but boy does it make for one heck of a dinner. Washed it down with their homemade ice tea to cool the palate. I skipped the sides to keep space for the ribs but the patrons around who had them seemed to enjoy it. Do come by & try it when in Seminyak!

author: Willie Battle
review_text: Service was great. Our waitress was kind and attentive. I ordered the Carb Pasta which was ok but I got really full on a few bites. Bring your own crab tools 🛠️ We also ordered the Crab-u-let or whatever.. looks great but unfortunately that’s all I can say that’s good. They were out of Cajun sauce so we had to deal with the only sauce they had at the time. We really couldn’t taste the crab meat cause we had tools to open… our kind waitress tried to go find some but no luck.. We came because of the new promotion ad but it left us disappointed. I definitely won’t be coming back.

author: marina felizardo
review_text: food is nice but served a bit cold and could be a bit more flavourful. still really good local food for a really great price. If you can’t handle your spice make sure to order “no spice” because it will still come super spicy!

author: Steven Cheng
review_text: It’s a good concept with many choices but the food is mediocre at best! But good beer selection for sure! The fish and chips are okay. The calamari is terrible， chicken burgers also bad, but hamburger is better! They even have a band playing on the Wednesday night, that’s impressive but makes regular conversation almost impossible. Lots seating between indoor and outdoor area. There are gas heaters available at the outside area that you can turn it on at you discretion! One other good thing is they have vary clean restrooms!

author: kazu-kun
review_text: I visited a long-established Cơm Tấm restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City for the first time. The restaurant is featured in the Michelin guide, so I went there with high expectations. The restaurant had a spacious area with about 40 seats, but it was very crowded even when I visited around 1:30 PM. You can order in Vietnamese, a little English, and by pointing and using gestures. There are only six basic set menus, so it's easy to order. The food arrived in two minutes after I ordered. It's very speedy. The taste of the Cơm Tấm was characterized by its sweet sauce. The pork was very large and quite substantial, which might be too much for some women. The restaurant lacks a sense of cleanliness in appearance. During busy times, it's common to find trash on the floor, and there's a slight smell of food waste. Some customers were smoking while walking. However, this is a common sight in long-established local restaurants, so if you've visited Vietnam several times, it shouldn't be a problem. Japanese people visiting for the first time might experience a bit of culture shock. If you want to eat a lot of Cơm Tấm cheaply, I think Cơm Tấm enthusiasts will find it worth repeating!

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: Edo Lego
review_text: Waited for about 20min for this yong tau fu egg noodle. Not disappointed as the taste in dark soy sauce is good. It came with five different ingredients by default. There are others can be chosen from also. Price is below $5. Will update the stall name.

author: Danika Randa
review_text: I’m new to the area and was looking a Thai food restaurant. I tried another local place and I was not impressed. It wasn’t very flavorful. As soon as I walked in here I knew the food was going to be good cause it smelled delicious! I was getting take out and just decided to get what I usually order. Combination Pad Thai spice level 3/10, Thai Tea and decided to try their Fresh Rolls. I took a to go menu and sat down to wait. After actually looking over the menu, everything sounded and looked so good I needed to place another order. I decided on the Chinese Broccoli with Crispy Pork, Mango Sticky Rice and the Garlic Crispy Pork. Let me tell you, I was disappointed with none of it! The Fresh Rolls were so fresh! The rice paper was the perfect texture. The peanut sauce that comes with it was a delicious complement to the crisp of the veggies and shrimp. The Garlic Crispy Pork was so good! So much roasted garlic flavor but not being overpowering. The sauce for the Mango sticky rice was perfect! Tonya really knows what she’s doing! I’m glad I ordered it. The sauce that the Chinese Broccoli with Crispy Pork has would be good to just mix with white rice It’s so good. The Combination Pad Thai was good. 3 huge shrimp (usually there’s 1 small shrimp) the beef, chicken and pork were not over cooked or dry like you get at some places. The Thai Tea which is usually pretty much the same everywhere you go tasted better. It wasn’t sickly sweet like most places. Very well balanced flavor and beautiful. I have no complaints. The presentation even for being take out was great. Delicious food! The service was top notch! Chatting with Ole was lovely. I like the welcoming feeling and not just being a customer but a friend. While I was waiting some customers left but not before stopping to tell a worker how much they enjoyed their food like they always do. Since I bought a lot of food they even helped me to my car. I’ve already told my local friends and can’t wait to bring them to dine in next time. Thank you Ole and Tonya and everyone at Boun Thai Kitchen for a great experience.

author: S B.S.S.
review_text: **6years later I have to change my review ** staff have no clue on anything! Starting with the old way when you walk in and order your food sit and eat was the easiest and faster way, they changed that to a way when no one knows how things works! Order they were unable to give me my receipt with my order on it so I have no clue what they charge me for, wait and wait then went to ask the host if they will call my name or I have to wait or what? She was not able to comprehend what I was asking while I figure out my order was behind her waiting for her to let me know my order was ready…while I was there literally 3 people was complaining about the same issue smh…to make things better while I was waiting I saw a mice running around from the bar to the kitchen I understand in a way but they could do better! The burger honestly was still delicious as 6 years ago! However the fried pickles were pretty greasy! Very disappointed and this was my last trip to here unfortunately not coming back! Staff not friendly at all!!! ** 6 years ago review Delicious burgers indeed!!Super friendly workers, fast and delicious burgers!Will be back for sure!**

author: Emmanuel Reyes
review_text: One of the oldest hawker centres in Singapore. We decided to have lunch here as it was in one of the stops on our hop on/hop off bus. Multiple food outlets to choose from covering all things Singaporean. I opted for the Hainanese Chicken Rice and it was delightful. Service was quick and portion size was adequate. Although open air under covered area there was ample fans running to keep things cool in the public seating area. Overall a great experience.

author: See Fly Low
review_text: When did eating in Hawker centre become so complicated? 🍜 Just had the most ridiculous experience at Zion Road. Since when did our hawker centres become so over-engineered and monetized that it’s actually a headache to eat there? The $0.20 Empty Bowl: Asked for a small empty bowl for my 5 year old daughter. Was told it’s an extra $0.20 because "cleaning is outsourced." Since when is a bowl a luxury item? The Logistical Mess: The food stall says one thing, but the drinks stall tells us we must return cups to them directly because they "opted out" of the system. So I had to return noodles and tray to the tray return system, then return the Kopi cups to the drinks stall. WTH. My immediate reaction was why this noodle stall so hao lian. Until I realised they are just the victims as well Why must everything be monetized until it's this difficult? It’s supposed to be a community space, but it feels like every single movement is tracked, charged, or outsourced. It’s hard not to feel like the priority has shifted entirely from serving the people to just squeezing out every last cent. Is this really the "efficiency" we're aiming for??

author: Eileen Kwek
review_text: Bought 红油抄手 from a beef noodle shop. OMG, every dumpling is so big and the sauce is so savoury with black vinegar. Best I have ever eaten!

author: Lauren Pagan
review_text: The food was pretty good, service a bit slow but beautiful outdoor seating to enjoy the LA sunshine. I would say the gluten free toast is decent but hard to cut. The most unfortunate thing was I got food poisoning from either the avocado toast or green juice. I’ve never been so sick. I hadn’t eaten anything else that day but by 5pm I was very ill.

author: Tiffany Nicole
review_text: This restaurant is a decent size with good service. I went for lunch around 2pm and it was slow we walked right in no reservation for a party of 7. Everything that was ordered was outstanding! Lobster mac and cheese appetizer down to the seafood platter, calamari, drinks were strong as well. The dessert cheesecake was also very delicious and authentic. You can tell everything here is super fresh it is a pricey restaurant but good and plenty of seating and a bar.

author: Lionel Sim
review_text: I visited The Working Coffee recently and left dissatisfied with the service experience. Service was slow from ordering to drink delivery, despite the café not being overly busy. The staff member handling my order, Vy, appeared overwhelmed and uncoordinated with the rest of the team. There was visible confusion behind the counter, with staff moving in overlapping paths and frequently bumping into one another. There was also no clear or systematic ordering process. Customers were unsure where to queue or who was responsible for taking orders. Tasks seemed to shift between staff members without clear ownership, which contributed to delays and disrupted workflow. The café has potential, but the lack of structured operations and clear staff coordination significantly impacted the experience. A defined ordering system, clearer role assignment, and better internal communication would improve service efficiency and customer flow.

author: Lim Chin Chuan
review_text: A big No No for me to come again... Food is below average for the price paid...No comment on the taste as this is subjective to individual. But they cant even serve the tomyam hot...i mean temperature hot.. The worst was the bad service...Imagine a boss warn you for a 2 years old kids holding their decorative flower, saying that we need to pay if broken. After order 5 dishes for a table of four, and 5 dishes for another table of five, I told the staff enough for now and too add later if need more..The boss stand at the back ask me to order now in rude tone otherwise will be slow serving later due to many guest. No more next time...Thank you for the bad experience...

author: Jan Dailey
review_text: Stopped in for breakfast on our holiday vacation. Our server was amazing, and the food was delicious. Even though it was a holiday weekend, the staff was working together beautifully. Happy Holiday!

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Mì Tôm Review dạo
review_text: 🥢 Review of Kieu Bao Grilled Pork Vermicelli If you love grilled pork vermicelli, you should definitely try Kieu Bao Grilled Pork Vermicelli. I ate there recently and was very satisfied. The first positive point is that the grilled pork is marinated very well, grilled evenly to a golden brown, and has a light layer of fat so it's not dry. The meat is tender, fragrant, and not overly burnt like at many other places. The vermicelli portion is generous, the noodles are thin and soft, and it comes with clean and fresh vegetables. What I liked most was the pickled vegetables here; they're perfectly seasoned, not too sweet or too strong. The dipping sauce is delicious and well-balanced, and it's incredibly addictive when poured over the vermicelli. Adding a bowl of spring rolls makes it even better. A bowl of grilled pork vermicelli costs around 30k VND, and it's very filling. Especially noteworthy is that the vermicelli and vegetables are FREE! In short, if you like flavorful grilled pork vermicelli with delicious meat at an affordable price, Kieu Bao is a great choice!

author: Graham Parker
review_text: Utterly outstanding. One of my best meals of 2025. I was recommended to come here by my husband, who is a tad obsessed with it, and now I can see why! Nothing better than seeing a thriving spot take food, dishes, ingredients, service and buzz so seriously. The menu is varied and full of surprises, and not all dishes will work for all the pallettes at the table, and that is what makes it fun. You share everything and try lots of culinary ideas and see what sticks!

author: Tony Skeans
review_text: Just one block off Fremont Street, Lay Thai proves that escaping the chaos pays off. The second you walk in, you realize this isn’t another overpriced Vegas eatery—it’s an oasis of flavor and value. The wok sear on the garlic fried rice is, GAWD, the best I’ve ever had—smoky, buttery, perfect texture, and just enough spice to keep you hooked. I ordered mine at a level three, which turned out to be the sweet spot for both me and my wife. You could go hotter, sure, but three gives you that balance of burn and flavor that makes Thai food sing. The crab rangoon? Adorable little handmade bundles of creamy perfection. The spring rolls? Crisp, light, and clean on the palate. And let’s talk about that bartending staff—easily some of the best I’ve ever encountered in Vegas: fast, personable, and genuinely proud of their craft. In a city that’s forgotten what a fair price and great food look like together, Lay Thai nails both. If you’re tired of inflated menus and tourist traps, step a block away—you’ll find flavor, service, and sanity right here.

author: Lee Hui Tang
review_text: Having breakfast with family’s ~ we enjoying our food very much … environment quite comfortable n good service provided.

author: Alex Fuentes
review_text: I had to wait an hour to just get water... but the food was great. They let me bring my personal cake for my bday. The staff was left with most of it. Not a crumb left!

author: Terry Lim
review_text: had this pork rib noodles, decent but the food in this market are more exp than average i feel. the food quality in this place is decent at best not amazing either. tried many stalls but nothing wowed me except a malay stall at the outer ring of the hawker with long queue

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Jacqui Nelson
review_text: Best vegetarian meal I had in Ho Chi Minh - I came back again just for it! The bun cha was deliciously fresh with a range of delightful flavours, and the spring rolls that came were crispy and packed! Thank you!!

author: LN
review_text: Our recent trip to LandShark Bar & Grill at Miami Bayside was everything we love about dining in Miami! Located right on the waterfront, this spot is a tropical paradise where great vibes and mouthwatering flavors come together in perfect harmony. As soon as we walked in, we were greeted by the friendly staff and a laid-back, beachy atmosphere that made us feel like we were on vacation (even if it was just for a few hours!). The views of the marina, with boats gently bobbing in the water, set the perfect backdrop for our dining experience. Now, let’s talk about the food—because wow, was it incredible! We kicked things off with their signature LandShark Lager (how could we not?), which was the ideal way to start our Miami adventure. Crisp, refreshing, and just the right amount of chill to match the ocean breeze. For starters, we couldn’t resist the Peel & Eat Shrimp—juicy, succulent, and perfectly seasoned with Old Bay. It was like a taste of the sea on our plate! Then came the main course, and let me tell you, choosing just one dish was a challenge! But we finally settled on the Fish Tacos and Jimmy’s Jammin’ Jambalaya. The fish tacos were bursting with flavor—fresh, flaky fish topped with zesty slaw and a drizzle of creamy lime sauce that tied everything together. The jambalaya? A spicy, savory delight that transported us straight to the heart of the South. Each bite was packed with shrimp, chicken, and sausage, all swimming in a rich, flavorful sauce that we couldn’t get enough of. Of course, no visit to LandShark Bar & Grill would be complete without indulging in dessert. We went all out with the Chocolate Hurricane—a massive, chocolatey delight that was as decadent as it sounds. It was the perfect sweet ending to a fantastic meal. But what truly made our time at LandShark special was the vibe—casual, fun, and quintessentially Miami. Whether you’re hanging out with friends, enjoying a family meal, or just looking for a great place to unwind, LandShark Bar & Grill is the spot to be. We left with full hearts, full stomachs, and memories of a day well spent in paradise. If you’re ever in Miami, make sure to stop by and experience it for yourself—you won’t be disappointed!

author: M M
review_text: Small pours at the wine bar :( … I enjoyed the variety within the 20ish wine selection. Props for having a wine from New England. I hope they get a much deeper selection as a wine bar. Servers were kind, but I’m not sure if they have any knowledge of wine. Food was good. Wish the wine prices were $9-14, rather than $14-22 for a glass… especially with the small pours. I guess the reasonable food prices make up for it.

author: Grace Crawford
review_text: Very unique menu giving an unorthodox taste of Vietnam with western influences tied in. Everything we ate was very tasty and presented well. The servers were so nice and attentive and it was a lovely experience. For being a fancier restaurant the prices are fair, the portion sizes are a bit small though so keep in mind to order an appetiser or dessert

author: grace ebourefi
review_text: I like the restaurant the food yummy service people just amazing specially Evando nice person so humble happy to serve each table ,all of them they who’s nicer.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Jesus Estrada
review_text: Went for lunch on a weekday. It was busy, but I was seated quickly. The staff are helpful. It's a restaurant that caters to tourists, with tourist prices and strong aircon. The menu has pictures and English descriptions. I ordered the special set. It arrived quickly. The meat pieces were tasty. The spring roll was thick and crunchy, but not particularly flavorful. The noodles with the sauce were very good. The leftover sauce was great, I drank it all. Paid with a card.

author: Sim Hui Cheah
review_text: Found this better than usual banh mi, new experience unlocked- having breakfast on roadside ; baguette was too good crispy outside n soft inside , i had to take away , guess what its only 5k each for a plain baguette 😭😭😭

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: Robyn Elliott
review_text: I was recommended by my hotel, La Passion Hotel Saigon, and it was sooo good I went back on a second day for lunch. My server, Ms Truc, was really helpful and her food recommendations greatly appreciated and extremely delicious. It's a beautiful decorated building, over 3 floors with elevator, with a shop on the ground floor paying homage to local Vietnamese products. I would have returned for dinner but this little gem is very solidly booked. I'd recommend reserving a table in advance, it'll be worth the planning. My compliments to the staff and the very attentive duty manager who made my dining experience so enjoyable, thank you.

author: Vibricia P
review_text: Deens Maju is one of the most popular nasi kandar spots in Penang. You’ll often see long queues, especially during lunch and dinner — a clear sign of its popularity among locals and tourists alike. While the food is flavorful and portions are decent, it may not be to everyone’s taste. If you prefer subtler spices or cleaner flavors, it might feel a bit heavy or overly rich. The curries tend to be bold and oily, which some people love — but it wasn’t quite my thing. Deens Maju is clearly loved by many — but food is personal, and for me, it was just okay. Good to try once for the experience, but probably not a regular stop.

author: IDProductionsIT LLC
review_text: The atmosphere 👌 is top tier Food is very decent and priced well, mostly under $40 averaging around $20-$30 a plate. Salmon was very well cooked, but the rice 🍚 pared with it was bland Shrimp pasta was nice but a little too heavy on the sauce, if they would have lightened up the sauce a bit, it would have been much better The key lime was a 6 out of 10, I bit sour and I never had it in a cup 🥤 not a brilliant move The chocolate cake was a tad rich for me, but my party liked it. Andrew was a great server

author: Lisa Ogston
review_text: This restaurant was the worst I have been to in Florida in a long time. We have visited other Margaitaville restaurants and from the minute you walk in the door the atmosphere is electric. This one there was no atmosphere whatsoever! We ordered our drinks and food. Our soft drinks came straight away but we sat and watched our beers sit on the bar for a good 10 mins before they were taken to us. Then came the food. We upgraded our fries to sweet potato waffle fries which were cold when they came. My daughter’s wings were cold and one was so cold I wondered if it had actually been cooked. We complained to the waiter and ate what we could. Once we asked for the bill out came new meals from the kitchen which were actually cooked, however we were on our way to the basketball so it was too late and the rest of our party had finished their meals long before this. We had also ordered another round of drinks in this time which again took a while to arrive. When the bill came and 18% service charge had been added, I asked if this would be removed however I was told this was compulsory. I always tip 18-20% but I didn’t feel that this meal deserved any tip. I now know why there was only us and 2 more tables in this restaurant! Avoid this restaurant!

author: Adolfo E Estrada
review_text: Naan is great, hummus is awesomeness. Fried coliflower, everything is really good that I've tried. Staff is great and humble.

author: Wavy Bandz
review_text: My actual new #1 breakfast place first time here and me and my lady loved it food came out pretty quick our server was top notch excellent wish I could remember his name but he was amazing if you ever have a waitress Lightskin with no beard kinda looks like Ryan Garcia he’s the man lol he’ll make sure to get you right

author: Andrea Novoa
review_text: Bayshore Club Miami A Perfect Waterfront Escape Located right by the marina in Coconut Grove, Bayshore Club is one of those Miami spots that instantly makes you feel like you’re on vacation. The open-air design, ocean breeze, and tropical aesthetic create the perfect setting for a laid-back lunch or sunset dinner with friends and family. Their food selection is absolutely delicious from the fresh ceviche packed with flavor to the perfectly cooked mahi-mahi and crispy fried fish. Every plate feels fresh and made for coastal dining. Pair that with one of their signature cocktails and you’ll understand why this spot is always buzzing with good vibes. The ambiance is everything you’d want for a Miami night out relaxed yet vibrant, with music, palm trees, and beautiful views that make you want to stay long after you finish your meal. It’s the kind of place where you can eat, laugh, and enjoy the evening without feeling rushed. Whether you’re celebrating with friends, having a casual date night, or just want to unwind by the water, Bayshore Club is a must-visit. Definitely recommend staying for drinks after dinner the atmosphere gets even better as the sun goes down.

author: Sean Sean
review_text: Old shop, that is older than most of us. It's like a tourist spot that most will visit. Nothing much to shout about, just quite normal tasting moonlight hor fun. Remember to add chilli n soya sauce cos it tends to be less than seasoned.

author: Chewielicious T
review_text: Came here as 2 people and just ordered the large bee hoon and salted egg prawn ball. Portions were good and both dishes hit the spot — tummy is happy!

author: Gina R
review_text: The reviews don’t lie!! Make a reservation and come here. We celebrated a birthday here. We started with oysters and they tasted super fresh! For dinner, we got filet mignon with a side of mashed potatoes and side of onion rings. All of the food was out of this world! We both agree it was the best filet mignon we’ve had. Brad was our server. He was very knowledgeable on the menu and made great recommendations. Will be back for sure!!!

author: Lu H
review_text: Tried Brazilian Rodizio for the first time and had a mixed experience. The salad bar offered a variety of options but was disappointed by the dried and hard mini pizza and the less-than-fresh vegetables. During happy hour, the $3.99 beer price was a highlight. The rodizio's meat-serving performance was interesting and enjoyable. However, most of the rodizio meats were salty and tasted similar, which made their mouth tired of the same flavors. Despite this, overall experience was cool and memorable.

author: Karen Shepard
review_text: Our first meal we had once we got to Vegas was this restaurant. It was totally hopping. Busy. Busy. We had no reservation (highly recommended), but got seated quickly since it was myself and my husband. I had a breakfast special with a pancake (a huge one at that),and my husband had a huge omelet. There was so much food we couldn't finish it! But it was so gosh darn delicious! All fresh. All homemade. So we boxed it up and had it later on. This place is so amazing that we went back again, the day we were leaving Vegas 😪. I had sausage gravy and biscuits(huge bowl) and my husband had a breakfast burrito (that was huge also). Soooooo goooood!! So much food we got that boxed up and finished it before we got on the plane. Please go visit Winnie & Ethel's. You won't be disappointed! I guarantee it 👍👍

author: Ilyxoxo
review_text: Honestly, I wouldn’t come here again. The atmosphere is great and the place looks fancy. The food and the service on the other hand, not so great. Our server was friendly, but very pushy. My table noticed he kept insisting that we add additional items to our meal, if you know, this place is very expensive. So that was off. After getting the bill, we tried to tip $15 because I thought tipping was the customers choice based on the service provided, but apparently not. We had to tip $50 which is insane. I don’t know how this is acceptable to these people, you’re already making tons of money from your overpriced items , but that isn’t enough for them. Now the food, it was ok. I enjoyed the steak and the sundae, but it wasn’t worth the price. I’ve eaten at steakhouses with better food and service, where they actually don’t force a $50 tip. I’ll be seeing myself there.

author: Lusiana Gomulia
review_text: Gigi Susu located at: Jalan Pantai Batu Bolong No. 80, Canggu, Kuta Utara, Kabupaten Badung, Bali. opening hours: Gigi Susu Canggu famous for it’s big size croissant, taste very good. Coffee is also very good, we ordered oat latte. The restaurant is very unique, made from wood perfect place for breakfast and brunch lain. The staff are all very friendy.

author: Amelia Lam
review_text: The hype for this place is average, it doesn’t fully look like the instagram videos or reels that you see but it’s still super nice and unique with a great sunset view. We made reservations in advance for a sunset view and had a table at the edge. There were two super romantic spots for couples which one was celebrating an anniversary and another was a proposal which was beautiful! The staff are friendly, our server was so nice and the food was good. Certainly over priced for the location and seafood heavy so don’t come here if you don’t like seafood! There are a lot of monkeys in the area so keep your items close to you. I would recommend a few other spots to check out for food like El Kabron or the cave.

author: Sergio Aleman
review_text: Great chill place for breakfast. Service was great and food was delish

author: Earthworm Sid
review_text: The grilled chicken here is so delicious with a hint of lime flavor. It is my favorite dish to order here. The buttered bread that comes with each plate of chicken is so addicting. The price for half a piece of chicken plus sides and a drink is super affordable for this day and age!! I totally recommend this place. It’s my favorite when it comes to charbroiled chicken!! 😋😋😋🤤🤤

author: Chris Lindsay
review_text: What an awesome 1st experience! Its good to finally have a great quality Burger place on the East side of town that exceeds expectations! The burger meat is fresh, NOT frozen like the guys accross the street. Cooked on a flat-top not in a convection Microwave. The pickles, and all the other toppings where crisp and fresh. The dining room was extra clean and comfortable, with booths and tables that can be moved around for the larger parties, and an awsome soda station for your refills! Service, was above and beyond, Andrea who brought us our food on actual plates not card board and Sophia was full of friendly information. Hats off to the BOH, nothing was over or under cooked, it was perfect! I will try the chorizo burrito 🌯 for breakfast with the awesome fresh salsa I saw Sophia making tonight from scratch... If your concerned with price people....you need to re-evaluate what you would spend at the guys accoss the street, for frozen unhealthy chemically preserved food. Honestly, for my family of three we only spent about $9 dollars more, or $3 dollars more! However, we took Hella left over fries home to reheat in the Air fryer...because, O' YEAH they are using real untreated fries....thx R burger and you will be seeing a lot of us... East side get on board 👌.

author: Everhart
review_text: Stopped by here for a quick Kopi C. It was pretty spacious, with the first level as a market and the second level as the food centre. There was plentiful of seats, which can accommodate various group sizes. There is a plethora of food options for you, as well as drinks. A good place for uou and your family or friends to drop by here for lunch!

author: Ka Wai Ng
review_text: Walked in on a Friday night, had a 25 min wait. The edamame was a taste of Asian and Western fusion, I was a little surprised at first but it was delicious. The salad, I really LOVED their homemade dressing (as someone who hates salad dressing). The curry chicken wings were nice, really juicy but a little bit too salty. The matcha lemonade was great, not overly sweet like other places, and the waiter pours the matcha on top in front of me. To be honest, I enjoyed everything else more than the ramen, ironic cuz it’s a ramen place). The ramen is not bad, but just mediocre, so it didn’t really stand out from the others. The place is pretty popular so it was pretty packed and noisy, a little hard to hear people talk.

author: Joey Ngui
review_text: It’s my second time eating this pho, and it was perfect after walking outside the whole day. At midnight, when I was on the way back to the hotel and feeling hungry, this warm bowl of pho was exactly what I needed. The soup was very, very good, and the beef was fresh. The raw beef is placed into the stone bowl after the food is served at the table, and it cooks just nicely, very tender and delicious. I wanted to try the fried dough sticks too, but the portion was too big since I was eating alone, so I didn’t order it in the end. Hopefully they can offer a smaller portion option next time 😂

author: Bella Yang
review_text: Food was absolutely delicious! My husband and I enjoyed three meals at Pison yesterday 🤣 — breakfast and lunch at the restaurant, and dinner via delivery. Even the delivery packaging was high quality. Truly an amazing restaurant. Love, love, love, love Pison!

author: Sandy Swenson
review_text: This place is the freakin bomb.com. Great food, great prices, amazing condiment bar. Like I’m not even gonna tell you what you’ll find at the condiment bar because you’ll just have to go and find out for yourself. Definitely an LA favorite!!

author: Rupkatha Mukherjee
review_text: I just wanted to mention that their food is good but extremely spicy. Me and my friend ordered mild chicken tenders and chicken waffle and we almost passed out because of the spice level. My friend and I are both Indians from India, and this space offers extremely spicy food which can make you dizzy. The taste is great, no doubt but you will surely get sick the next day. I usually do not write reviews but for others safety it is required. I was extremely hungry so I took a few bite and then felt super dizzy and was sweating. They did offer us extra ice cream since we couldn't eat the food. The ambience is nice. My recommendation will be to add a warning when you are adding that level of spice. My friend is from Delhi who likes spicy momos and paanipuri and this was extreme. Stay safe out there!

author: Charles C
review_text: Clutch coconut coffee. I always dread when the drink is almost over. I find it very refreshing on a hot day. Just like their other locations, you can expect a good, consistent drink here. There is plenty of seating in this location.

author: Olivia Celice
review_text: I observed the consistency that builds Bunna Cafe's reputation. Worker attention was truly exceptional! The portions here are notably generous. The food works well, but the atmosphere truly excels. Hope this place impresses you too.

author: Krasimira Valkanova
review_text: Pretty good fresh sea food one can get in here but be careful because they're cheating with the scales and charge more than they should. We checked a few places before we decided where to eat. For example we told one guy to measure two of the big tiger prawns and they we half a kg on his scale. Went to another picked two smaller tiger prawns and it showed 600kg on his scale.... so yeah watch out. We've chosen yummy yummy and it was very yummy :)) fried rice with vegetables, one octopus skewer and two huge tiger prawns with garlic butter sauce, it was cooked to perfection and just enough for two people. And all together our dinner was half as cheap if went to a restaurant so didn't regret it and will go back again. 4 stars only because some of them are cheating. 5 stars for food

author: Rifki Debi
review_text: The servers are very nice. They can also recommend food. The service was fast (maybe because we were the only customers that time). Out of the food we have ordered (we also ordered Kerapu with Padang sauce, but I didnt take a picture of it), what I like the most is Tahu Kinabalu! Haha. Very soft inside but crispy outside. But almost everything we had was yummy. And it comes with a price. For example, for a plate of tofu, it can cost you around 60k++.

author: Brewforone
review_text: 📍 阿旺咖啡店 ᴀʜ ᴡᴀɴɢ ᴄᴀꜰᴇ - This old-school kopitiam has been dishing out comforting Hainanese-style breakfast for over 40 years. It’s the kind of place you’d miss if not for a local tip-off but once you find it, you’ll understand why it has such a loyal following. Located in the middle of apartments and probably only visited by locals. I kicked off with their signature kaya butter toast and half-boiled eggs. Simple? Yes. But also perfect. The toast had just the right crunch, and their homemade kaya is thick, rich, and not overly sweet, truly homemade and clearly made with care. Pair that with eggs that are consistently soft-boiled (no runny mess or rubbery whites here), and you’ve got a breakfast that hits all the nostalgic notes. Their black and white coffee are both solid picks, but what surprised me most was the Kiam Kopi (salted coffee). I was skeptical since you don't see it often around Malaysia, but it turned out to be a malty, slightly savory blend that weirdly reminded me of a mocha. Unexpected and surprisingly addictive.

author: Jeff Chua
review_text: Prawn cheong fun turned out to be an impostor. It was dry and hard, more like 虾米 cheong fun.

author: Reno
review_text: We went there for dinner and the food and service were great. The food was so good that we decided to return for lunch the next day. However, two female staff members working at that time were very rude and ignored us when we asked for a table, so we decided not to have lunch that day. Overall, the food was excellent, but the poor service at lunch time was disappointing.

author: Andreina Salazar
review_text: Delicious food, beautiful place, and amazing service! Roberto was super attentive and helpful, and the whole staff was incredible. Thank you for a great experience! I truly enjoyed it and highly recommend this restaurant. I’ll definitely be back!

author: Rodney-James
review_text: We got a prompt greeting All food came out hot. App Calamari Came Crispy. A bit bland though. Some fried peppers come mixed in as well. Comes with two sauces. Marinara an spicy aioli. App isn’t terrible. Entree Baby back ribs This was full rack Ribs were falling off the bone. Alabama Chicken linguine Tatstes like a creamy scampi. Alfredo and scampi. This location in Miami did not charge a 20% percent gratuity.

author: Xbox User
review_text: 5🌟 I vote this one of my BEST neighborhood bars One of those hidden gems in Vegas that you don't know about unless a buddy takes you there. Food is great. Bartender is always awesome. Drinks are cheap. Places nice. It's also kind of military-centric sports on all TVs. Bar poker/slot/keno. Totally recommend it. Very community feel so you'll have to put some time in here before you can really get your groove on. Jukebox always playing good jams. It's clean. You'll have the opposite of "sticker shock" when you get your bill.

author: Chandan S
review_text: Giving 4 because I wasn’t that impressed with their steak. I got the New York Prime Rib and it was meh. Their lamb racks and bone marrow on the other hand was solid. Top notch. Thoroughly enjoyed them. Service was great. Staff was friendly and kind.

author: Meghan Knight
review_text: This is a cute little coffee spot but the customer service could use some work. It was super busy when I went and I definitely felt rushed to order and they still messed up my drink. The avocado toast wasn’t very good but I did try it at 9am and a strong tomato pesto that early just is not the move and for the price I just felt disappointed. Their raspberry donuts were pretty good though!

author: Scott Davis
review_text: Great food and service, but I'm pretty sure I lost my wallet hear and it was never found so not all great.

author: Luna Vilasco
review_text: We were made to feel very welcome, the staff are very friendly and cheerful. The food is excellent and the setting is relaxing. I highly recommend it.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Tommy Byun
review_text: A super famous Bak Kut Teh (a.k.a. meat bone tea) franchise in the heart of Singapore city center! This is the one place that opens up one hour early at 10am, whereas the rest of the locations open at 11am! It was packed from the beginning when we got there at 10:08 AM, and we got lucky, and got the last table open after it opened! We ordered a few bone soups, braised pork, and vegetable dish (refer to the receipt), and they were all quite good as expected. The food wasn't heavy, the portion wasn't to overwhelming, and it was one of the cheapest meals we had in Singapore as well! The soup wasn't too heavy or oily, and it was soothing to the stomach. The soup itself was also refillable for free! One negative I have to say is that it seemed to have too much pepper. I actually found the bak kut teh I had in Rasapura Masters food court better tasting than here! Everything was very efficient, ordering online through QR code, and they serve you right away. The staff was friendly and attentive even though it was really busy. By the time we got out (in 40 minutes or so), there was a huge line up outside. However, because there are many tables, and the rotation is quite fast, so you probably won't have to wait too much in the line. I would strongly recommend to go to this place right when it opens, and for only a group of 4 or less.

author: Marcus
review_text: Owner was a sweetheart and the hummus and grilled meat plate was to die for 😋

author: Juliana
review_text: Very very good tavern food!! Highly recommend this place they a lot of good apps and different dinner choices to choose from. I recommend the buffalo chicken dip for an app and for your meal you can’t go wrong with anything! The steak frites were incredible with the sauce !!!! And the burger so juicy and flavorful this place is bomb can’t wait to come back!!

author: Ryan Naman
review_text: Is the hype real…? Short answer… Yeah! Guess we got lucky going in on a cold ass night cause there was no line and plenty of room to grab a spot to stand and eat a slice! This pizzeria has been on the bucket list for a minute and I’m glad I was able to make the trip out to grab a slice! I don’t remember the names of the slices… but they were fantastic! I love pesto and on pizza that’s this killer it was an amazing experience! But I’m here to rate the cheese slice baby! 8.9 Amazing, would definitely be back and would eat it drunk in bed every time!

author: Vaughn-Rian St. James
review_text: This was a dinner treat from the president of my company Nexus 123 who flew out from California just to take us to Brunch and meet my team personally it was just perfect. He is still raving about the food the service and the experience. Everyone from the hostess to our server as well as the Manager greeted us. He checked in with me as we left. Having a back ground in Food service excellence I highly recommend this spot for formal and casual. Great 👍 Job and Thank you Bayshore Grill we will be back!!!

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: Fatdieme
review_text: Hands down one of the best prawn broth. It has everything you want: umami, prawn flavour, sweetness, savoury and pork lard+shallots. The colour of the soup is just 🔥🙏👌✨. For the price, is really expensive but I can recommend the normal prawn noodles ($15), Jumbo prawns and other seafood isn't that special ($26-$30). Personally, I like it better when prawns are not cut in half for the qq texture. The dry noodle portion is MASSIVE, thank goodness we can dabao the leftovers. The hokkien mee is ok. If we never add the lime, easily I can forget how it taste like. Lime is ALWAYS good, must add. Even thou it looks saucey but the noodles absorbs fast and it becomes sticky. Still ok thou, will eat it. Waiting time expect 30mins average.

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: Joanne Lee
review_text: Bring a neck fan or portable fan. It’s horrendously warm. Food standard has dropped. The dark soup pig organ’s mee sua still taste nice and rich but the white gravy mee sua tasted so bland, it’s like water. Not the same taste as we recall. Been having food from them once in a while over the past few years. Ordered some takeaway too and needed to wait for quite a while before they are ready. Hopefully the takeaway hor fun and fish maw soup maintains the standard. Ordered a teh peng, which we were told will be made from 3-1 mix (???). Alright… not sure which is the brand being used but it’s like sugar syrup. Overall, it’s a disappointing experience from the Seng Kee we used to love.

author: Yadira Breland
review_text: It is wonderful to find a breakfast restaurant with so many delicious platters to choose from. My all time favorite is the Tri-Color Chilaquiles with the New York Steak! The green sauce is tangy and yummy. The red sauce is just the right spice and flavor! The steak was cooked medium rare with tons of flavor! The atmosphere is nice, cozy, and relaxing. Our server Lorenzo was very welcoming and on point! I recommend this place to anyone missing home made Mexican food!!! The "Cafe de olla" is the bomb!!!

author: Alvin Toh
review_text: My first visit here. Place was nicely done up, air conditioned, clean and comfortable. Do prepare for the long wait for seats during weekends and peak hours. They have a small open field right beside the cafe with some chairs provided, so maybe you can consider takeaway or relax there while waiting for your table. Deserts here were pretty decent and nicely done. Drinks were normal.
