author: Shankari
review_text: Dropped by for brunch on a weekend and it was pretty packed. Highly recommended to make reservations beforehand. Excellent variety of pastries, all of it looked so amazing! 🤤 Food-wise, good options of western and fusion meals as well as some local dishes. However, could only try the breakfast menu as it wasnt time for the lunch menu yet. The brioche bun big breakfast was definitely unique, and portion was huge. Smoothie bowls were fresh and flavourful. The croissant sandwich was light and flakey, filling was good as well. The breakfast bagel was nice but avocado mash was slightly under seasoned. Both of these came with a side salad. Drinks tasted good as well. Overall definitely a pretty nice cafe to visit. Parking is super duper hard so best to opt for a Grab to get here. They also sell merch like notebooks, bottles, etc at the cafe so can check those out for a nice gift or such. Wait staff were incredibly warm and polite, food was also served considerably fast.

author: m caparra
review_text: Amazing! The food, the people, the atmosphere are all amazing. The rose and white chocolate coffee and any of the PLT sandwich were chef's kiss. I will miss this place and will definitely come back to Miami just for Bobe!

author: yumz
review_text: cơm tấm ba ghiền is that spot that just gets it right the plate of dreams // this ain't your average broken rice situation. for the uninitiated, cơm tấm uses fragrant grains of rice that were once considered fractured or broken, creating a uniquely tender texture that's pure comfort. the sizzling pork chop hits different. crispy edges, juicy inside, and that legendary fish sauce glaze that's straight fire. they absolutely don't skimp on portions either, serving up a pork rib that's noticeably larger than what you'll find at most other spots. heads up though. the marinade leans sweet, which might be a bit much if you prefer savory-forward flavors like i do. crack that runny egg over the rice and prepare for a flavor explosion. the real deal vibe // no frills, just pure energy. the place is always buzzing, plates clattering, and the aroma will have your stomach screaming yes. you order at the counter, grab a plastic stool, and dive into pure food joy. the final call // if you want to taste a true saigon classic that never misses, this is the move. be prepared to wait during peak hours. it's that popular for a reason. michelin bib gourmand. don't forget to ❤️.

author: Nicoly Miyuki
review_text: We has great time at Greenstreet cafe! The ambience is absolutely beautiful,and lovely. Food is good, big portion but the French toast pistachio fell short, I barely tasted the pistachio cream. Eggs Benedict was pretty good and tasty, the sangria was the best. I recommend for a big party family and couple.

author: Hoang Tram
review_text: I was a victim when I went to eat according to the reviewer. The 5 of us all had the same comment: The beef hotpot stinks, the tripe is not crispy, the fish sauce is too sweet, the beef tongue is the most disappointing dish, it is unimaginably soft, I have eaten at several beef hotpot restaurants, and this is the most disappointing restaurant I have ever eaten, when paying the bill I told the waiter about the tongue dish, but he did not respond. I have to review so that others do not become victims like me 😭 A truly wasted meal. The dish that was okay was the mixed beef tendon, which was okay. 🙉 And of course we will never come back to this restaurant. A table of 5, we left with great disappointment. You asked why we ate everything. Because we were sorry for the money. There is no way we would come back or recommend others to eat at this restaurant.

author: Petman X
review_text: Very delicious food extremely friendly and welcoming staff, would recommend to try everything on menu because it will blow your expectations

author: Anna Balingit
review_text: The food was incredible! Everything we ordered was delicious, from the pizza to the pasta, and drinks. The atmosphere felt cozy and welcoming, perfect for a relaxing dinner. Special mention to Vu, who took such great care of us. He was attentive, warm, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our meal. Really appreciated his service; it made the experience even better. Highly recommend this branch. Would definitely come back! 🍕✨

author: Nero
review_text: The deco and design of this place is absolutely stunning. The location may be a bit of distance from the beach, yet, defying all odds, it truly lives up to its name "The Palm". With the beachy vibes, lovely benches, and sandy colors, you can tell the thought and hardwork that has gone to this location. We had different types of meatballs, Swedish style and Italian, both of them taste fantastic. The strawberry milkshake is creamy and juicy, justice done to all strawberry lovers.

author: RJ
review_text: Our first meal in Ho Chi Minh did not disappoint! From the generous serving of Beef Pho, unlimited veggies and friendly staff - everything was perfect

author: Melissa Gomez
review_text: We popped in for breakfast and it was so amazing! Highly recommend.

author: Lochie Matonti
review_text: Awesome experience that is well worth the journey and the perhaps marked up prices or the bar. Go for sunset, and go early around 4.30-5pm to ensure you get in, and get a nice spot. There is a minimum price for either the Tapas or the Dinner (sit down at dining area), but if you grab a couple of cocktails each or a drink and some food, you will hit this no worries The food is nothing to write home about, but it gets the job done if you are wanting to eat here. The main sell is the absolutely amazing setting - there is nothing like it in Bali. It's truly an experience worth visiting, with an amazing vibe, music, drinks, and atmosphere.

author: Shermin
review_text: We’ve found the most delicious gems on this trip. Every dish we tried here was bursting with taste. Limited seating but lucky to have a spot at this delicious spot😋

author: Janardhan MP
review_text: Very poor service and waited close to 1 hour. Totally understaffed and no proper response either from the staff. When ordered they mentioned it will be 20 mins but ended up waiting 1 hour. We had kids who were hungry and asked to expedite and all we got is sorry. Definitely not recommending the restaurant as the staff need to be trained on customer service. Chocolate chip cookie was mentioned as 50 cents in the menu but was charged $2.79. We did ask about the cookie before ordering and was misguided. When asked about this all we got is just sorry again.

author: Carolina Diaz
review_text: The food itself wasn’t anything extraordinary for my taste. I found it a bit bland and lacking in seasoning, so it didn’t really stand out compared to other places. What truly made the visit worthwhile was the service. Samaira was absolutely exceptional, attentive, warm, and genuinely caring throughout the entire experience. She went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable, and her professionalism and kindness left a lasting impression. Without her, the experience would have felt very average, but thanks to her, we felt truly valued as guests. On the other hand, the drinks were quite disappointing. We tried the piña colada, but it tasted more like sugar water than a proper cocktail. We even had to ask to change it for something else, which is surprising given the $13 price tag. For that cost, you’d expect a much higher standard. The location itself is a strong point, spacious, right by the beach, and with beautiful views. With better consistency in the food and drinks, this place could match the level of service provided by Samaira.

author: marilyn V
review_text: I’ve been going here since 2018. It was always great and consistent with taste. Recently it’s really a hit or miss sometimes they make it really well, it’s well seasoned, crispy and you get plenty of shrimp other days you can tell they’re a bit rushed with the food being pretty bland. Over all a good place with great staff, I just hope they get better with the consistency.

author: YoRHa 2B
review_text: I love the food here, especially the Briyani, delicious! The environment is clean and comfortable. The price is reasonable. Service is average though. If there's one thing that they can do better is service. Overall, I am very satisfied with this place and I will definitely be back to try some of the awesome curries!

author: Quittance
review_text: One of my favourite food in Singapore, I absolutely adore the gong bao flavour. 1 frog per person is enough for a tasting, 2 frogs are enough to feel fulfilled.

author: TK
review_text: It’s a nice place situated in the housing area serving mostly the locals. It’s spacious and not stuffy. I ordered the Chee Cheong Fan with pork… it’s flavorful and smooth. Recommended. Their famous dry curry noodle… it’s amazingly delicious but you have got to wait (15-20 mins). Kopi C is also very good.

author: SeeYan Wong
review_text: We had our late lunch there so there was ample of parking space on the street. When I first stepped into the restaurant, the cold air and the majestic decoration welcomed me. I thought the food would be very pricey but it ended up satisfying and reasonable. We ordered mostly the small portion but it wasn't as small as we assumed. The portion was quite big. In addition, the taste suited each of us well.

author: Joshua Fields
review_text: An excellent operation with a chill vibe and a creative menu, taking amazing meals up a notch in unique ways. The Tartare Crostini is well formed and very flavorful, the salad’s cream and seasonings took some mixing up to get used to but that was good. Brown butter Crab with bread was great, and my two favorite starters the Grilled Octopus and the Seafood Rice. The octopus had perfect char and a sweet delicious taste paired great with the egg. The Seafood Rice was a great blend of fish stocked rice and cold fish as a topping. Then the Pork Collar, I loved this it’s a perfect preparation. Great portion with a beautiful seasoned top layer and a wonderful fatty center. We didn’t care much for the side, which for a dish this pricey you’d like solid side as a base but this gets a pass. Lastly to finish off the Panna Cotta was straight up great, safest dessert option.

author: Gau
review_text: Rafei Ali is one of my favourite nasi kandar spots. Their speciality is their ayam goreng! I’ve been eating here for years and always loved it. Today (9/4/24) I came with a foreigner and I was charged RM3.60 for 2 air kosong. I’m aware of the latest 8% SST but am I missing out something? 1 ais kosong is RM1.80? I did not confront them and not planning to make go to KPDN but just be aware that there are workers there who just put the price randomly based on THE LOOKS. The best part is the workers there are foreigners themselves. I’m sure he did not wrongly written it down because I asked him “dua ini 3.60? and he nodded yes”

author: Christopher de la cruz
review_text: classic go-to for breakfast if youre eastside or tampines.. i always go here for my Lor-Mee cravings.. the 137 Lor Mee..

author: Aija ivy
review_text: This place is beyond great! The customer service, the food, the environment is all 10/10. I have nothing bad to say about this place ever. The Blueprint Vegan Burger is my favorite…I love how they give you vegan cheese options or vegan sauce options too. Every time I go there I always see Ivan at the register or serving customers. He is a great part of BluePrint Cafe & I hope the owner knows that. Everything in the bakery is just as amazing as the food. I recommend this place to everyone!

author: Finniss
review_text: Worth the hype. Probably the best meal I had in Penang. Generous with the gravies. Delicious meats and a large selection to choose from. I enjoyed the Quail eggs. A must try in Penang.

author: Swee Koon Ng
review_text: The place is spacious and many fans to keep you cool. Ordered noodle soap, chicken shrimp dumpling and luncheon meat. The luncheon meat is made by the stall themselves with no preservatives, very good.

author: Matas Daunys
review_text: We absolutely loved this place. The stir-fried NZ mussels were incredible (just look at their size!), and the oyster hotpot with beef was soooo good - rich, comforting, and full of flavour. Portions are generous, seasoning is spot-on, and the whole experience felt warm and homely. The cozy atmosphere and friendly service make it easy to see why they earned their Michelin Bib Gourmand status - definitely well-deserved. One small note: take the reviews (mine included!) with a grain of salt, as they offer complimentary homemade grass jelly with coconut milk if you leave a review on TripAdvisor or Google Maps. Still, even without that, this place stands firmly at 5 stars.

author: bianca macedo
review_text: This was my first time at Maracaibo Restaurant and I will definitely go back. I really loved everything. The food was amazing , the service was incredible. Our waiter Harold was so lovely and friendly. We highly recommend this place. Thank you !

author: Adam Fente
review_text: Absolutely delicious lunch here at Anh Mâp Restaurant! I had the Egg & Pork Fried Rice, Bún Thịt Nướng and the Pork Spring Rolls. All three items were freshly made and tasted fantastic. I love how this restaurant is such a hole-in-the-wall, it has such a local charm and ambiance to it. I can't wait to return here again!

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: Ly
review_text: Eating at kub kao kub pla never disappoints! The tom yum was super fresh, perfectly spicy, and full of flavor-definitely my favorite dish 😋 the salted egg shirmp and squid were also really tasty. The place is comfy, though the service was a bit slow, still worth coming back!

author: Denis Uelski
review_text: It’s one of those places that has consistent quality and never disappoints. I have over 100 food photos from here (starting from 2022), and I can assure you — today everything was basically the same as three years ago. That’s a huge achievement if you think about it, especially compared to similar places around Bali. It’s the spot with the best healthy breakfasts I’ve found — and I’ve been to quite a lot of them. I know pretty much the whole menu by now, and the smoothies are especially good. My favorites are Island Life, Choc Tops, and Startup — I just can’t decide which one to get each time I’m here. There’s also this really nice outdoor area that somehow calms you down — you just want to stay there and keep coming back. Whenever I’m staying in this area, I go to Shady Shack for breakfast about 90% of the time. The staff is almost the same as it was three years ago, which is another incredible achievement. I just hope this place keeps going and lives forever — because it’s already something truly special.

author: Krisnhaliani Wetarini
review_text: Nothing beats the ambience of Pison at night. Love spending time here, just to enjoy the live music, sing along, chatting, eating, and drinking. It’s an absolute go-to spot to cherish and celebrate. The menu is varied and exceptional. Most of the dishes I’ve tried were delightful, and of course, there’s no question about their coffee. I’ve also been loving their matcha drinks lately. The cakes are also enjoyable, I usually go for the tiramisu or carrot cake. Their pork belly is something you have to try. And if you’re looking for a light comfort food, my personal recommendation is their Truffle French Fries. They also serve alcoholic drinks, and if you’re into cocktails, I’d recommend their Honey Whiskey Mojito — refreshing and perfectly balanced. The place is often fully booked on weekends, so I’d highly recommend making a reservation beforehand. There’s a minimum spend of 200k/pax, but it’s well worth it. They’re located right by the sidewalk, but don’t worry — valet parking is available.

author: Ariana Taveras
review_text: OMG, the food at Monty’s Coconut Grove was absolutely delicious! We started with the gator bites—they tasted just like chicken and were a fun and tasty appetizer. Our meal included fresh oysters, flavorful Cajun shrimp Alfredo, and a perfectly cooked NY sirloin steak. Although we didn’t try any of the specialty drinks, they looked amazing and are definitely on our list for next time. The atmosphere was lively and enjoyable. The DJ played great music that was clean and appropriate for children, making it a fantastic spot for families. The waterfront setting added to the charm, providing beautiful views and a relaxing ambiance. If you’re in the area and looking for a place with great food, a welcoming environment, and family-friendly entertainment, Monty’s Coconut Grove is the place to go!

author: Aditya Raj
review_text: Crowded places, delicious and local dish, must try lobster here and fish here.

author: Janelle
review_text: Delicious dim sum with plenty of variety to choose from! You’ll need to take a number as there may be a queue, but overall the wait was quite quick. 🥢😋

author: Christopher F
review_text: They have a variety of foods to offer and, personally, the fish tacos were good. The place was a little busy when we got there but not crazy. Most of the seating was outside but covered. There is an automatic 19% service charge on all food and drink which was stated on the menu. The issues I had were that it took a while to initially get a drink. Beers normally come in a bottle or a 16oz draft. Their draft was priced for a normal size but you got a 12oz plastic cup. Kids menu had a semi decent selection but if you dont want a corn cob on the side, you can switch it for normal items like fries for $1. One child wanted a corn and the other wanted fries. We should have switch amongst ourselves when the food arrived because they charged a $1 for each kid because each asked for what the other was getting on the side. (One wanted fries but was supposed to get corn and the other wanted corn but not fries.) The topper was that the service charge is added onto the bill and tax is done after. I asked for clarification since this is a tip and I should have to pay for tax on the 19% service charge. Tax the entire bill and add 19%. The waitress went to ask and came back with an explanation of what the service charge was. I said that I wanted to know why it was added like a meal and I was being taxed on top of that. (Maybe $5 difference overall but it is the fact I shouldn't have to even pay that) The waitress before listening fully just left because she wasn't able to understand my question. We paid the bill and left. I don't need to return there because there was nothing special about that location. Also, if you don't park in a certain lot, then parking is at your cost. Make sure to validate your ticket like we did. We just needed to wait for everyone else stuck at the gate that did not validate.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Gary Floyd
review_text: The menu pictured on the side of the truck looked amazing, but the actual food we received was the exact opposite. Bacon wrapped chicken was as dry and tough as could be, pork tacos were dry as could be. The portions were definitely not as pictured on the menu. We walked by the truck several times and never saw any customers. Makes sense now.

author: MA TM
review_text: Legitimately good food and very reasonable prices. The zucchini sticks are great!

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Loo Wei Shyang
review_text: Their serving is big compared to the normal portion, and it's delicious! I'm also surprised that the portion of meat is more than their vegetables, which is rare in Vietnam with their decent price.

author: L Chan
review_text: It’s very much a morning place. Many of the hawker stalls cater to the breakfast & early lunch crowd & it tends to quiet down significantly by mid-afternoon. By evening, the whole place winds down & feels almost deserted.

author: Ray Liu
review_text: Thong Smith serves one of the best boat noodles in Bangkok, upgraded with premium ingredients and rich, flavorful broth. The pork boat noodles are a highlight—deeply satisfying with tender meat, crispy toppings, and just the right spice. Cozy seating with a great view inside Siam Paragon makes it perfect for a casual yet elevated local dining experience. Their grilled meatballs and crispy wonton sides are also worth trying. Fast service, clean space, and fair prices. A must-visit for noodle lovers exploring central Bangkok.

author: Ben Forbes
review_text: Delicious curry puffs and only $2-2.30. You can't go wrong. Curry chicken and egg was the best.

author: Frank Mario Castellon
review_text: Kimmy and I enjoyed dinner on the 2nd floor patio. Great view of dry docks and bay. Server brought water bowl for kimmy and made her feel welcome. Excellent of surf and turf dishes as well as full bar. Highly recommend for you and your furry friend. Kimmy gives 2 paws 🐾 up.

author: Helen Tan
review_text: On this busy food street, you can find many restaurants and local snack stores. What is popular here is their sesame steamed chicken, juicy fat beansprouts and the smooth silky horfun that slides down your throat or the fragrant slightly yellow colored chicken rice. Another tasty side dish is the mixed fishball and meatball soup. Next time, we will try the Tuck Kee Restaurant.

author: 許睿森
review_text: It's delicious, but it tastes different from what I remember.

author: Koong 8142
review_text: Fresh ingredients with a wide variety of menus. I love how the waiter took time to teach us the right way to enjoy Vietnamese Bua Sae—made the experience even more special!

author: Melissa Lapin
review_text: Absolutely fantastic place. Doc-side dining for the win. The whole experience was fabulous. The menu selection was good. Our food was delicious and our waiter Hector was a dream!!

author: Quayah Seabrooks
review_text: The food is old and nasty .. I paid almost 70 dollars for my children and I to eat and everything tasted the same .. they don’t have enough utensils to serve the food so you have to the same utensil for different dishes (cross contamination) so don’t come if you have a seafood allergy .. the workers hover over you and tell you when your done eating so don’t think your not being timed .. it’s honestly not worth the money (at least not the dinner ) 70 dollars for food that’s been sitting out all day . The sushi bar is ok and the hibachi had great uncooked meat out but it’s small .

author: Victor Las
review_text: Regular looking Mc D's until you're about to pay ... Everything on the menu at this location is about $5 more expensive than other Mc D's ... Wish I knew that before I stopped here... I spent almost $20 on an egg mc muffin meal ... That's crazy ... Im quitting mc Donald's and going to Norms for that price ... I would rather have a full meal for that price.

author: Diamond Path
review_text: There’s usually a big queue and I only got to eat here once. We were able to choose a nice table — arrived at 9 am and there was barely anyone there, so maybe this is a good time to drop by. I had the rye bread with salmon and eggs and my mom had the pancakes. Both tasted amazing 🤩 the lemon cake was absolutely stellar spot on —- pound cake with cream cheese nice and tart with a bit of meringue on top. Yummy 🤤 I can totally understand why this place is always packed! BTW when they served our pancakes these did not come with syrup but you can ask for some if you want it.

author: Vincent Crisol
review_text: Holbox serves some of the best seafood I’ve had, delivering Michelin level quality in a casual market setting. The scallop aguachile was incredibly fresh and beautifully presented, while the octopus and fish tacos were cooked to perfection. Since it's located in the busy Mercado La Paloma, be prepared for a bit of a wait. Because seating is shared with other restaurants, I highly recommend bringing a partner to scope out a table while you wait in line. The logistics take a little effort, but the food is absolutely worth the hustle. It is an absolute must visit for any seafood lover in LA.

author: khrhms
review_text: Good set meal for 4-5 persons worth $118+ after GST. Comes with curry fish head. Dishes are average but for the price, good for sharing. Fuss free meal. Dishes comes out after about 10mins of ordering via the QR code. Efficient. Came for late lunch and there were plenty of tables available. Halal. Located at b2 of Chinatown Point.

author: Ryo Zsun
review_text: Met up with an old friend at Nacho Daddy, one of my go-to spots in Vegas, and it didn’t disappoint. The newly renovated space looks great, and our server James set the tone with friendly, upbeat service. We started with the Daddy Wings (a must!) — perfectly crispy on the outside, juicy on the inside, and always a crowd-pleaser. For our main, we shared the Supreme Nachos, loaded with toppings and just the right amount of heat. My friend loved the vibe and said she wants to come back — same here. Whether you’re catching up with friends or just craving solid nachos and wings, Nacho Daddy is always a great choice.

author: Darsshan Parmar
review_text: Malini Seafood & Sunset is an excellent place for sunset views and seafood dining. The location is absolutely stunning (5/5), especially if you manage to get an ocean-view table—highly recommended to book in advance for that experience. The food quality is good (4/5), with fresh seafood and well-prepared dishes. We walked in without a reservation and had a 15–20 minute wait, but were seated without an ocean view. They accept cards, which is convenient, and parking is available, making the visit hassle-free. Overall, a great spot for sunset lovers, couples, and anyone looking to enjoy a relaxed seafood meal with a beautiful Bali backdrop 🌅

author: Aneesh Vaghadia
review_text: The signature BBQ pork ribs are indeed worth the visit! They’re delicious, fall off the bone, and don’t have the overwhelming smokiness that many US rib places have. The other food options we had were great — the pulled pork burger was tender, perfectly cooked and had a toasted bun. The service was excellent. The servers were able to tell us what dishes had nuts and which didn’t for those with allergies in our party. They split the corn into four pieces to make it easier to share and were able to make the nasi goreng vegetarian to accommodate dietary preferences as well. The restaurant is a two storey location with options for outsider seating on their balcony. The atmosphere is relaxing and there are sometimes shows with traditional Balinese dancing outside that you can see from the balcony. Overall, would recommend as a place to eat dinner if you’re in the area!

author: Sam Goh SE
review_text: Have a host of many interesting and hugely popular local delights such chwee Kueh, fried carrot cakes soon Kueh, wanting noodles, Chinese dumplings, Cantonese roast meats, Hi char, Indian muslim prata, Chinese dessert, coffee stalls. Always something for everyone.

author: Sara Calvey
review_text: I've been to Hollywood a few times and I have to say I always come back to this place. Its open till 4(whoo!) The frozen drinks and priced average for the boardwalk but tasty. They have decent bar food-great for a hangover. If youre a sports fan they will more than likely have it on somewhere in the bar. Good views and good staff

author: Molly Byrne
review_text: Great spot; good food, great service (although they hang around a bit), really cool venue. Pricey for the area I think. Turns into a club in the evening time - which is cool - music is good.

author: Christine Ho
review_text: Nice place for good Indonesian food. If coming in big groups, best to make reservations. We were disappointed that the dishes that we wanted to eat were not available eg the coconut seafood andaman and giant squid. Normally, other restaurants' service staff will recommend other dishes in place of dishes that were not available but it was not done here. More could have been done for service wise compared to other Indonesian restaurants that we had visited. The other dishes that we ordered were well executed.

author: Monica Tuccella
review_text: The food was really delicious, it’s probably the best casual Greek restaurant I’ve been to. The staff is really nice too. Our overall experience was great and we are definitely coming back! Keep in mind that the place is really small and there’s limited seating. It’s more suitable for a group of less than 3 people (only if you are looking to dine in). Don’t forget to try the feta fries! 100% recommend it!

author: O' Neill Morales
review_text: Amazing food! Amazing people! Amazing service! Amazing atmosphere! This place so far has been the best restaurant I've ever been to, compared to other high-end restaurants I've been to. Prices are reasonable, I expected it to be more expensive due to the great quality and service. The food was amazing, so good that I forgot to take pictures of it. But at least I captured the dessert. And on the weekends they have live music, very beautiful classic music as you'll see on the video. So take your wife, girlfriend, mother or significant other here and you'll both leave happy. You won't regret it!

author: joanna tan
review_text: Awesome experience and awesome food. Can always trust PS cafe to serve up comforting fare. Many thanks to Eileen and the team for making our dinner an enjoyable experience! Her enthusiasm and passion is unrivaled!

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: Joel H
review_text: Quite easy to navigate, very easy to spot its location via Google Map’s navigation upon reaching the traffic light. They offer both soup and dry variation. We ordered the soup Bak Kut Teh, along with some side dishes. Appreciate that we are able to top the soup without extra charges. Condiments are offered generously as well. One of the service crew actively offered to top our soup when it’s running low. Overall a great dining experience!

author: Kayla MacDonald
review_text: Sam Walker’s has been our go-to spot ever since it opened in Woburn, and it just keeps getting better! It’s the perfect neighborhood place, whether you’re meeting friends, grabbing a casual dinner, or riding out a New England snowstorm. The food is fantastic across the board, but the nachos and the brisket mac and cheese are absolute standouts! The bar selection is always great too, with fun local options and seasonal picks. The atmosphere is welcoming, the service is friendly, and the whole place has that “local favorite” feel that keeps you coming back. Sam Walker’s is truly one of my favorite spots in the area, and I’m always happy to shout out one of my favorite Toast customers. Highly recommend checking it out! *This review was made in connection with a Toast promotion.

author: Lee
review_text: Found this restaurant on Groupon and the reviews looked pretty good. We ordered Chile Verde and Carne Asada. While waiting for our meal, we were served (4) complementary flour tortillas which, had just been freshly handmade by a lady standing behind a counter in the dining area. It was apparent this was not her first time making tortillas. She was quick and her knowledge of the process was evident. Customers were welcome to walk over and observe her masterful tortilla making skills and ask questions. If there was any doubt as to the freshness of the tortillas that question was certainly answered. The Chile Verde was good but the Carne Asada lacked flavor and seasoning. The meat was a bit thinner than what I’m accustomed to but the portion size was generous. The dining area had a very authentic vibe with streamers, color patterns, and other types of art displayed throughout the restaurant. There’s a very large bar with TVs to watch sporting events and other programs while indulging in a beverage. Our server was great and had a wonderful personality. His knowledge of the menu was vast which, was greatly appreciated. The staff was very gracious and made you feel welcomed. Overall, my dining experience was good but not great. With that said, I think I’ll give this spot another try sometime in the future.

author: Hashim A
review_text: The smell of the bakery as soon as I got in made me melt, pushed me to over order, and go over my budget. There was a line at 8:15 before they even open, I was waiting in my car watching the line getting longer, so I just got up and joined. Unfortunately they did not have the raspberry pistachio today. I ordered the creamy, hot chocolate, chocolate, croissant, and almond honey. The creamy hot chocolate was okay, but not that special I have tried better. The croissants really good.

author: d
review_text: Greco , Newbury St. Quick service, and a great budget meal on Newbury. Store is usually busy. Pork and chicken skewers. You can also get some of the classic Greek foods as well. Compact menu. Greek donuts bathed in honey for dessert! Meats were fresh , nicely seasoned. Seating indoors and out.

author: Noyonika Parulekar
review_text: The pepperoni pizza slice with hot honey: nothing special. The bread was crispy and delicious, but the toppings were underwhelming. The sauce was perfectly tangy, but there wasn't enough of it, or the cheese. I also wish the pizza had come out more hot. Servers are very attentive here. I did notice that a lot of people with reservations were being asked to wait for a while to be seated. The small space is definitely the issue. Mushroom pasta - the mushrooms were meaty, pasta perfectly cooked, parsley was fresh and aromatic, and contrary to popular opinion, the portion size perfect (not sure if it was just this dish). However, it was a little saltier than I liked. I will say, it's nothing to write home about. Cocktail - I got the Bergamot Blush and it was delicious, strong, not too sweet, and very citrus forward. Overall, I think the food here is unnecessarily overpriced. While I would not come back here for the food, I might return for a cocktail in 3 years when I can finally get another reservation.

author: D
review_text: Some of the best chicken you can get just make sure to ask for a sauce on top of your chicken .

author: Shruti Sinha
review_text: Visited San Pedro square market on May 5th so got to witness the Cinco de Mayo festivities, live music and such vibrant atmosphere even though it was Monday evening. Lot of food options including Mexican, Indo-Nepalese and others bars for a good time. This square has a lot of history. Got to know that San Jose was the oldest city of CA from an info placard. Reminded me of The Alamo in San Antonio.

author: J M (Texas Foodie)
review_text: Slow. And I mean painfully slow service. Maybe they are understaffed? IDK. I ate at the bar. I started with the wedge that was ok but it had hardly any dressing and it was supposed to have bacon on it and I maybe had two bites. For an entree I got the filet mignon with bearnaise sauce. The filet was tasty but not Ruth’s Chris tasty. Good flavor but not as tender as Ruth’s Chris or other high end steak houses. Probably won’t be back.

author: Ben Chiou
review_text: Good fried rice. Chunky crabs. The other dishes are very average but not bad either. I went at 10AM on a weekday and got served right away. I wouldn't wait for more than 15 minutes for this though.

author: Heriberto Cardona
review_text: I come from Swampscott just for the food the best food Puerto Rico 🇵🇷

author: Yuka R
review_text: I ordered a highly rated French toast that looked absolutely stunning, so my expectations were high. However, I was a bit disappointed with the actual taste. The egg mixture hadn’t soaked through the bread — it was only lightly coated on the surface. Of course, this comes down to personal preference, but I love French toast that’s thoroughly soaked in the egg mixture and turns out soft and custardy inside. If you prefer a lighter texture where the inside still feels like regular bread, or if you’re mainly after an Instagram-worthy presentation, you might enjoy it. But if you love that rich, pudding-like softness, this one may not be for you.

author: Eddie Coltrane
review_text: Was in NJ from Boston and wanted to find a Black restaurant in the area. Long story short I found Kings. Halal Soulfood!!!! I got Fried Fish, Turkey Chops, Mac and Cheese, Stuffing, and a Beanpie. The Pie was Basic, but the food was a 10. Everything was good! I shared with my wife whom also felt the same way. The staff was also very helpful and friendly which made me feel at home. Everything was fresh and delicious, well seasoned, and tasty. Definitely worth every penny, and price was fair. Thank you! Easy 10 kings on Clinton Ave Nork

author: Leo03
review_text: An authentic Mexican restaurant. We enjoyed our lunch here, it was delicious! If you like coffee you have to try the cafe de olla with the concha bread to dip, it was amazing! I recommend the chilaquiles with the ranchera it’s fire! The burritos are delicious too! Huge menu with many Mexican dishes, we will be back to try the other options soon! The sever was very nice and took very good care of us!

author: Walter Swoboda
review_text: Great service... one of the best chill bowls. The strawberry dessert was wonderful. I spent 5 days in Boston... 3 nights of them spent eating there. All around great

author: James Knauer
review_text: Large selection of food, it tasted great, plenty of indoor seating. Spanish/English menus

author: Jennifer Sellers
review_text: This place was wonderful. Beautiful views and great vibes. We came with a group of 13 for a bachelorette party dinner. The food was delicious. The live music was also so nice! Highly recommend the meatballs and the halloumi. The server and staff did a great job!

author: Greg Mitchell
review_text: Very limited options for vegetarians. The veggie and cheese sandwich I had made for me was only so so.

author: Nambians
review_text: Place has amazing food quality! Looking forward to trying the bar next time!

author: Ranjana Bista
review_text: "Fantastic dining experience! The staff at are friendly and attentive, and the food is outstanding. From flavorful curries to aromatic naan, every dish is a culinary delight. Highly recommend!"

author: Yazmin Bu
review_text: I definitely adored this place! The food was amazing and prices were very affordable. The service was great, friendly staff that make you feel at home. I had brunch with friends after taking a walk and it was definitely a lovely way to finish our morning. Excellent atmosphere with beautiful decoration and great choice of music to complement an ample variety of delicious plates!! I recommend the Dulce de Leche Croissant waffle 😄

author: Austin
review_text: The restaurant was quite full on Friday night. There was no one at the front at the time we arrived so we had to wait around 5 minute. Overall, food was tasty but the price was relatively high. We really liked tomyum and crab meat and highly recommended them. Vibe was also really good.

author: Liam O'Flynn
review_text: Lovely staff and food. We went for the Nasi Goreng and couldn't really go wrong. Recommend catching the sunset here as well. Live singer/guitarist last night was great with a superb set list to boot. Recommended.

author: Steph Tang
review_text: Celebrated my 4th anniversary here, brought our dog along and was given a very good corner seat which was very helpful as we do not want our dog to disrupt service. Service staff - mainly a short hair lady, uncle at outdoor area and outlet manager all were very friendly and attentive. In fact, the best service in all the PS Cafes that I have been to and I have been to at least 5.

author: sergio perez
review_text: Coming for the barbacoa not complain, take my back to mexico flavors Saturday mid-day they are busy Menudo, my son's likes the menudo and quesabirrias. Churros small p good. Thanks

author: Karen Schreiber
review_text: The restaurant is beautiful. We were celebrating our nephews 18th birthday and sat on the private patio. The waiter was amazing. So warm, so attentive and so eager to know if we need a anything else. His helpers were also fantastic. This was our first time. Great people watching, great ocean view and delicious food.

author: Matt Dellamalva
review_text: Absolutely loved our visit to Milk & Madu Seminyak! The food was outstanding across the board — my wife had the chicken pesto melt, our kid enjoyed the pancakes, and I had the breakfast muffin, and every single dish was fantastic. Fresh, flavorful, and beautifully done. A special shout-out to our waiter Dicky, who did a great job looking after us. Friendly, attentive, and made the whole experience even better. Highly recommend this place for a great family breakfast or brunch in Seminyak. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Efsun Peynirci
review_text: I had garlic bread and ginger milk tea here — both were absolutely delicious! I had my breakfast at this place, and the ginger milk tea was especially amazing. Prices are also quite reasonable. It’s located just behind Kuala Lumpur’s famous street food area and is very central. Definitely worth a visit!

author: Martine MT
review_text: Wonderful place – we’ll for sure be coming back! Even though we didn’t book a table in advance, we were seated immediately. The staff were warm, attentive, and very accommodating when it came to food allergies, which we truly appreciated. We were told the food would take around 15 minutes, but it arrived much quicker – a pleasant surprise! And it was fantastic – full of flavor and beautifully presented. Sharing several small dishes is a great way to enjoy the variety on the menu. We wholeheartedly recommend this spot. Already looking forward to our next visit!

author: Aileen Chin
review_text: Thong Smith is a chain of restaurants that’s easy to find in many shopping malls. Prices are reasonable, and you can mix and match your bowl with pork or beef, different noodle types, and your preferred level of spiciness. Available in both dry or soup versions, the boat noodles are simple, traditional and tasty — great for a quick and satisfying meal.

author: Dallas D
review_text: A beautiful loft-style space with true European vibes — spacious, high ceilings, great light. As someone who loves lofts, I felt right at home. Built a couple of documents here and genuinely enjoyed the atmosphere. Excellent espresso, and big thanks to the team for creating such a well-designed environment for focus and creativity.🫶

author: Reyvis Soto
review_text: This place is great overall . I would and will come back hopefully the pistachio croissant will be warm this time. I had a latte with the croissant and has a nice presentation and taste good also , atmosphere is very welcoming relaxed feel. Staff seems to be also very good.

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: Sim Kum
review_text: Finally 1 of the best local restaurants which is not recommended by the internet or influencer! Very delicious! This is what I am looking for! Go for their signature dish!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Selene
review_text: Amazing food and vibes at Taco Beach Shack! The steak fajitas were juicy and full of flavor, and the mahi-mahi taco was fresh, flaky, and delicious. The beachy atmosphere and great music made the experience even better. Huge shout-out to our server Henry, he was super attentive, friendly, and made great recommendations. His service really stood out! Absolutely recommend this spot can’t wait to come back!

author: Jay Culley
review_text: Food was OK. My wife's Huevos Rancheros were delicious. My fish tacos were so-so. The table next to us for the snapper, which was a pretty cool presentation as the whole fish. It looked like they enjoyed it. I did think it was really cool that they have 2 separate kitchens... Mexican and Cuban.

author: celinda.h
review_text: We found the portion size of the chicken basil to be quite small but the thai green curry (not pictured) was quite decent and delicious. Thai milk tea was not great and tasted a bit watered down. Great prices though! So cheap and would go back. Lots of staff who were very attentive.

author: Judy K
review_text: We had a group birthday dinner for over 20 people, and Triple George was a great choice! The room was comfortable, and the wood tone walls made the room very warm and easy to decorate. The staff worked hard, and the food was great. The calamari was a particular hit, and people said it was the best they ever had! The location is perfect with a 2 minute walk to Freemont Street after dinner. I was very happy that I had booked The Triple George!

author: M Purdy
review_text: I’ve had Vietnamese food many times, but Hoang’s Kitchen definitely ranks as one of the best. We had summer shrimp rolls, fried rolls, beef pho and Vietnamese pancakes. Our server Nami explained all of the dishes and expertly showed us how to roll the Vietnamese pancakes. For dessert we had egg coffee (a must-try) and mango pancakes with coconut ice cream. If you find yourself in HCMC anytime soon, make sure to find your way to Hoang’s Kitchen!

author: Jolin Min Min
review_text: Ayam Bakar is very fragrant and tender. Veggies served together is nice too, look like mayonnaise seasoning but don’t taste like mayonnaise, quite nice to keep eating. Sate Pitu is so nice, we order 2 more sets of 7 pieces because the ala carte only 4 pieces, not enough to share around. Mie Goreng Ayam comes with 2 chicken satay. Noodles are quite tasty. Ayam Goreng Asam Manis is fried chicken with something like sweet and sour sauce. But it’s more towards sweet than sour. Definitely worth to come and enjoy nice food.

author: Yolanda Leilani
review_text: I recently won the lottery of bad customer service with Taste Budz. They lost my order, reheated my food, and got it all wrong. I'm just glad I didn't have to pay extra for the excitement. The service was unacceptable and the food quality was abysmal. My party of six had a confusing and frustrating pickup experience, beginning with being directed to the wrong location (the online order failed to specify the correct address). After driving to the correct spot at 333 St. Louis St., a shared-kitchen concept, my order couldn't be found. We spent considerable time sorting out the confusion: four of my companions' meals were at the first location, and mine was completely lost. Forty-five minutes after I left, the restaurant called, claiming to have found my meal. Upon my return, the order was incorrect, and the quality was very poor. The salmon and shrimp were chewy and appeared reheated, and yams were substituted with cornbread. Despite the complimentary sodas and dessert, the entire ordeal and the final product were incredibly disappointing. I cannot recommend service to anyone.

author: fara dzanufiya
review_text: in the middle of alor street , the food is really good especially the mini hotpot so good. definitely will come back and recommend to others

author: Y
review_text: Reasonable prices, no forced tipping, AND the waitress offered to throw out my trash?! In this economy, the fact that the food tasted good is the cherry on top. My only suggestion is to change your interior designer because it felt like I was dining at Trump Tower with all the gold...

author: Ahmed Reza
review_text: Hands down, some of the best pizza I’ve had in NYC Stopped in kind of randomly while walking near Bryant Park, and I’m so glad I did. The pizza here is just ridiculously good 😍 — perfect crust, loads of flavor, and super fresh toppings. I got the veggie pizza and every bite hit just right🤌. It’s a simple, no-frills spot, but that’s part of the charm. Quick service, good vibes, and the prices are super reasonable for Midtown. Also…… they’re open 24/7?! That’s dangerous (in the best way). Definitely one of those hidden gems you want to keep coming back to. If you’re nearby, do yourself a favor and grab a slice. Trust me you won’t regret 🙌.

author: Mohamed Azhan
review_text: Legit Char Kway Teow that's Halal. Flavours are there, wok hei is present......as good as Halal Char Kway Teow can get. Friendly owner and helper. Recommended if you happen to be in the area.

author: Jea Kim
review_text: The rumors were true. Best Italian restaurant in Boston. Finally made my way here this past Saturday night. As expected, the reservation were extremely hard to get. When we arrived, a long line had already formed by the entrance, and it turns out the buzz wasn’t unwarranted - two bar seats are set aside for walk-ins, but with no waitlist in place, it’s first-come, first-served. Tonino’s menu didn’t follow the traditional Italian playbook. No veal chops, meatballs, or even crispy calamari. Aside from a few seafood dishes like the clams and the anchovies, there weren’t a lot of protein options. Here, it was all about the simple dishes - pasta and pizza. The focus on the pasta’s texture and balance of flavors was especially memorable, and overall, it felt like Italian cuisine distilled to its purest, most artful form where very bite felt like a celebration of simplicity done exceptionally well. Favorite Dishes: Pizza Bianca with Ricotta & Hot Honey, Bucatini, Panna Cotta Every dish we tried was amazing. From the first few dishes, my favorite was the Pizza Bianca. Essentially a deconstructed pizza, it came with warm, pillowy bread meant for spreading with your choice of dip. What made it even better was its versatility. We ended up using the last few pieces to soak up the clam juice from Counterneck Clams. The basil they used had a strong fragrance which played beautifully with the briny clam flavors. The Cappelletti, the most popular pasta on the menu, didn’t quite live up to the hype for me. The aged balsamic added a pleasant sweetness on the finish, but the Taleggio cheese felt a bit too overpowering. Wasn’t a bad dish by any means, but the balanced was tipped into overly salty territory. Among the other pastas, our favorite was the bucatini. Instead of relying on a heavy sauce, this dish let two powerhouse ingredients - anchovy chili butter and bottarga (cured fish roe pouch) - do all the work. In other words, a pasta that didn’t lean on the usual tangy seafood flavors but instead delivered a beautifully restrained, deeply umami rich experience. Most importantly, the Panna Cotta with basil sugar & apples. Easily the best dessert I’ve had in Boston. No description could truly do it justice, but here’s my best attempt: the panna cotta itself was exquisitely creamy and impossibly smooth, the kind that melts on your tongue. The finely diced apples added a crisp, refreshing contrast, while the basil sugar brought a delicate, herbaceous lift that made each bite effortlessly balanced. A masterpiece in simplicity and an absolute must-try.

author: Yachai Reilly
review_text: I am obsessed with mofongos, so it was a must to stop here for brunch. Love the bayside market area. So much to do. Brunch was great. Gets very busy & is so much fun!

author: Murray River
review_text: We visited the famous ROCK BAR as part of our AYANA resort experience. We had pre booked well in advance a time slot from 5-7pm local time. From the initial check in and staff who greeted us it was positive. Not to mention our table which had perfect views from the upper deck unobstructed. We enjoyed tapas which were generous in their size and variety. Two deserts finished the experience off and of course several signature cocktails. I would highly recommend adding this to your next Bali adventure. Book well in advance. A lift is available for those with limited mobility and security us on site and has a visible presence.

author: Arif Budi
review_text: Phoenix Gastrobar – PIK ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Been a long time since my last visit, and I’m glad I returned for the festive season. The space is now a full Christmas wonderland — glowing garlands, red ribbons, gold bells, cascading lights, and a stunning carousel centerpiece that turns the whole atrium into a magical holiday scene. Tried their festive menu and wow, the dishes have improved so much — confidently executed and genuinely delicious. Golden Salmon Coulibiac Silky Norwegian salmon, sushi rice, mushroom duxelle, and spinach wrapped in buttery puff pastry, finished with dashi beurre blanc. Comforting yet refined — rare to find a coulibiac this perfect in town. Beef Parmentiere Super-tender wagyu beef cheek with buttery mashed potatoes, red cheddar, garlic tuile, and rich beef jus. Deeply flavorful. Crackling Roasted Pork Leg My top favorite — fall-apart tender with lightly crisp skin, served with sautéed potatoes and onion–mustard sauce. A perfect Christmas dish. Lapchiong Pork Hog Fried Rice A smoky, tasty bestseller with a slight crust at the bottom and generous pork and lap cheong. So good. Bowl of Festive Cocktail Bold, punchy, refreshing, and beautifully glittering — great for sharing. Overall, a highly pleasant visit. Beautiful festive atmosphere, improved dishes, and a grand venue worth recommending this holiday season.

author: aspen inouye
review_text: Everything about this restaurant is perfect!! We celebrated a birthday and it couldn’t have been a better night. The service was impeccable! Jamie was a star and took time to converse, get to know us, ask us if we needed anything, and was always there to create a wonderful experience - he even asked the DJ to play a very nice birthday song!! The food was incredible and to die for!! The jerk chicken and shrimp salad were fantastic options. The chicken was so flavorful and juicy and paired perfectly with the sweet rice and peas. The shrimp salad was refreshing and had a tasty dressing. The vibes inside are very cool. Will definitely be coming back here again.

author: Shankari
review_text: Super nice restaurant to grab a meal at with 10/10 vibes! Has both al fresco and indoor dining options. Many varieties of food options, western and Asian dishes with fusion options as well 👌 Pasta was perfectly cooked with a good amount of sauce. The fish curry was good as well but felt like it was missing a bit of a base flavour, but paired well with the rice. Chicken cordon bleu was nice but super filling, good portion size. Duck fried rice was nicely cooked with tender meat and the accompanying sambal had varying levels of spiciness. Mushroom soup was nice and creamy. The avocado latte was nice and creamy, definitely quite filling. The strawberry and lychee coolers were super refreshing, perfect for the heat of Ubud. Latte was good as well. Parking options are limited. Waiting time was around 20mins to get seated but you can buy a coffee slushie to sip on while waiting, but it is SUPER sweet.

author: Brian Dinan
review_text: Glendale is a pretty barren area when it comes to good eats, but Zum Stammtisch is definitely a diamond in the rough. A neighborhood staple for over 50 years; I have been here over 20 times in my 15 years of living in Glendale and never had a bad meal or bad service. Known for their traditional German fare, I opted for the prime rib - which at $52, seemed a bit heavy handed, but was worth every penny. I got a very generous portion of meat that was cooked to perfection, with two sides. The waitresses are always very pleasant and the service is top notch all around.

author: Kris
review_text: Had a great time at Cuca Restaurant! The food was spot on, and that octopus dish? Easily one of the best I’ve had—perfectly tender, beautiful char, and a savoury sauce that tied it all together. Cooking octopus right isn’t easy, so props to them. Every dish had such a unique twist, making me feel as though "this is what going to a restaurant should be like." Nothing over the top with fancy techniques - just flavour bombs that take a lot of work to get to, with a clear vision of the chef. The service was very attentive without being intrusive. I dropped a pair of chopsticks, and before I could even pick them up, a new pair was given to me. We had less than an hour to eat, but they somehow managed to get all the dishes out quickly without making it feel rushed. The atmosphere was gorgeous too - one of those places you could happily linger in if you had more time. (The coconut cocktail was so good, too!) Definitely worth going back!

author: Spud Racing
review_text: Incredible! My new favorite restaurant in Vegas. Would come here every day if I could. Lol. Portions are huge and the food delicious. The house and hibiscus margaritas were fantastic. Didn't actually like the other two specialty margaritas much, but they were interesting and beautiful if nothing else.

author: Shu
review_text: It was actually very easy to find this place because many people were waiting outside, but the line moved quickly. My wife and I ordered the mix, BBQ pork, passion fruit juice, and mango juice. The BBQ pork was a little spicy, but very good, and the baguette was incredibly crispy. The mix is their signature Bánh mì, and it was absolutely delicious and full of flavor. I’ve really been into Bánh mì on this trip, and this shop is the best place for any Bánh mì fan. If you come to Hoi An, you should definitely try it.

author: Mike
review_text: In my NYC Summer 2025 Pizza Top 5 list, there's a shared second place. One goes to L'Industrie Pizzeria in Williamsburg. This is what I imagine a NYC pizza to be. The crust is a bit crispy, but not too crispy, not too little—just right. The dough is perfectly thin. The tomato sauce is fantastic. The cheese is subtle and not overpowering, and most importantly, there's no dripping grease on the pizza (unfortunately, like with many other NYC pizzas). Be prepared for standing outside for about 20 minutes (in NYC, the waiting line duration is always 20 minutes, no matter where or what you're on line for). The staff is treating you with the typical NYC roughness but everyone is still friendly. Don’t forget: Ya‘ll always get a smile back when you smile first! Around the shop, with a few standing tables—you usually get the pizza to go—you can still find the original, not-yet-quite-gentrified Williamsburg. But don't worry, everything is still harmless here. Highly recommended.

author: Tony Russo
review_text: Good food cant go wrong with anything on the menu. I had the pizza, skirt steak platter & a cold peroni. Amazing food and good service. Always a hit!! Boss man was cool behind the counter.

author: Lay Ying Yeoh
review_text: Come here to try their famous Yam Rice very delicious, I like the yam rice because got yam. Portuguese Tart also taste good, very crispy. Price is reasonable. Hard to find seat and parking here because have many people, very crowded especially peak hours. If really want to come better choose weekday.

author: Charmaine Rosado
review_text: I visited here back in the end of August with my 3 cousins. We are from NY and was there in Miami visiting before our cruise. All of the food was exceptional!! So flavorful and fresh!! Some of the best Caribbean food I've ever had including my time in Jamaica. We fell in love at every bite!! That jerk chicken Mac n cheese is a thing of beauty!!! The staff was super friendly and really treated us so nice. We talked about it during our whole cruise and wanted to go back after the cruise but was scared we wouldn't make our flight in time. Highly recommend trying everything like we did!! Lol You won't regret it!! Lots of food and reasonably priced. 💯💯💯💯

author: Gorkem Topal
review_text: Picked up my to-go order, and I loved it. Tasty food, great service, and the owner was genuinely polite and caring. And back again — couldn’t stay away! And wanted to update my review. I wanted to try something else and it was so good. Thank you for great food and service. Let’s check the photos out!!!

author: widhiari murti
review_text: Had dinner here tonight and had a really good experience. Food were quick to come out and everything we ordered tasted amazing. Ms Eka was super friendly and efficient. She’s really accommodating to the kid’s requests. Even the parking staff was extremely helpful. Very happy with tonight’s experience.

author: RAVINDARAN V RAMAN
review_text: First time eating here and the food is quite good. The food in my picture looks not the best because I packed the food to the hotel. It's fried chicken with kuah campur and mutton curry. When the food is good we come again and again

author: PB Russell (Bernie)
review_text: Francisco was awesome! We had a great happy hour before catching a show later. I had the shrimp three ways and they were all delicious. I loooove me some Shrimp Alfredo. Hubs had the King's Platter or whatever w Lobster and Scallops. I loved his scallops in my garlic butter. My favorite part is that the food was all cooked so well. The restaurant feels dated but Cisco made our visit awesome.

author: Kampung Minion
review_text: Came by for a late lunch on a weekend. Wasn't too packed. They have both indoors with AC and outdoors with some shade. the tables were abit cramped and they have 1 large table which can accommodate bigger groups. Service was average. Lotsa staff around but difficult to get them to take our orders. Although they are nice and polite when you get them, however they seem busy chatting or just walking around, not attentive at all. Food was good though. Enjoyed the pork belly aglio olio. Very nicely done and flavourful with fried onions and garlic. Had a croissant as well but that was honestly average. Will be back for the aglio olio.

author: David Ho
review_text: Great food, sitting on low chairs watching traffic and people go by. We had the roast pork banh mi, the banh bao and 2 iced coffees - all were great and would be one of our goto banh mi spots. Servings can be quite large so if you’re extra hungry, get 2 of the large ones or split one large or 2 small.

author: Kaylah Carruthers
review_text: Dining at Hell’s Kitchen Miami delivers exactly what you expect from the Gordon Ramsay name: drama, polish, and a highly curated experience. The space is sleek and theatrical, with an open kitchen that leans into the show’s intensity without feeling overwhelming. Service is professional and efficient, though at times a bit rehearsed, more performance than warmth. The food is strong overall. Signature dishes like the Beef Wellington live up to their reputation, executed with precision and rich flavor. Starters and sides are thoughtfully composed, though a few felt safe rather than inventive. Desserts are visually impressive and satisfying, even if they don’t fully surprise. Where the restaurant falls just short of five stars is in its predictability. Everything is very good, but little feels unexpected. You are paying for consistency, brand, and atmosphere rather than culinary risk. That said, Hell’s Kitchen Miami is a polished, memorable dining experience and well worth a visit, especially if you appreciate refined comfort food with a touch of spectacle.

author: Ervan Setyo Nugroho
review_text: The vietnam’s ambience is pretty nice. The food also good. But recommended to come at after noon, because I went at noon but not all the food is available due to awaiting the supplies

author: Peter Sujanani
review_text: Tired the Hot Mess & Cheese Burger. It had me licking my fingers and was cooked to perfection, a juicy dripping messy burger, aptly named, just the way I like it. Also got the But Make It Spicy Chicken sandwich. It was a top quality breaded chicken breast with the right amount of heat complimented with the perfect crunch of the slaw. The buffalo tenders were top notch as their quality chicken and Buffalo sauce was one of the best we've had with an awesome balance of heat and tangy flavor. Such Yummy Deliciousness made for a memorable meal.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Ella Lucas
review_text: Traditional bun cha was amazing! Also had the fresh orange juice, it was very good. First meal in HCMC and it was 10/10

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Yvonne Lim
review_text: i find the food average but it’s a popular restaurant for tourist n locals. the food is quite pricey for me. i must say prefer my food serve hot then to be presented in wraps. my review is just a personal preference.

author: Zaahirah Richardson
review_text: Got a platter from here for my work lunch & i had a hair in my food. Had to work a 12 hr shift they wanted me to bring the plate the next day. Employees are unaware of refund policy wasted my time after telling me it’s okay to come back for a refund . The little of food I had yams were bland Mac and cheese was bland. Short ribs were good but for the price they are should been falling off the bone .

author: Yong Hao
review_text: Heard abt this Famous Yam Rice from my Penang friend. Went on a Sunday morning and as expected, it was super crowded—seems like this spot is really popular with locals and tourists alike. Of course we tried the yam rice.The yam rice was flavorful but did noticed the amount of yam in the rice was quite little, which was disappointing. Soup that came with it was really good and comforting. The 猪血 in the soup was especially nice, super smooth. We also tried chee cheong fan and yam cake here and both were pretty good as well. Drinks here were reasonably priced👍🏻

author: Simon McAuliffe
review_text: Great vendors. The cocktail bar (Daisies and Daiquirs) is amazing. You can lots of different types of food, so it is great for meeting up with people who have a variety of tastes.

author: AL S.
review_text: The food is good with nice atmosphere. It’s such a chill place

author: David Hed
review_text: Bob's is probably best for takeout. My food was brought to my table on a Styrofoam plate with plastic wrapped utensils. The price is right (except the 50¢ surcharge PER EGG in your order) and service is quick though, so you'll see the blue collar clientele quickly rotate through the tables.

author: J. Lepianda
review_text: Seafood was fresh and tasty, especially the grilled fish and sambal. Place is spacious and comfortable, good for group meals. Service was friendly, but they seemed short on staff so things were a bit slow. A nice spot for casual dining.

author: Alvin Shin (CYCLOP852)
review_text: A very tasty American Italian restaurant in a casual setting. It was great as I visited on the night when it was stormy and cold and the food was piping hot and hit the spot. Parking is always free and indoors!

author: Hung Bui
review_text: Cheap and affordable. Too crowded. Food isn't refilled in time. The food tray is a bit messy.

author: phang c fong
review_text: Quite a lot's of people's here.. Friendly staff's..They have indoor air con and outdoor seating. Sometimes enjoying the football Channel .

author: Samantha L
review_text: amazing food, best meal i had in jakarta. for sure it's a little more expensive than the other meals i've had, but this restaurant definitely has quality. favourite dish was the sotong (CUMI)!

author: Omar
review_text: Very interesting food to taste. The spices and the texture of the different meats served. If you’re a foodie, you should visit. The atmosphere is really nice. It’s a hidden calm corner with w decent view of a forest for a relaxing meal.

author: TAI pristine
review_text: This place is crowded with people during weekend and we have to wait for a table. The table is close to each other and we could hardly move around. First time we tried the yam rice which has little yam topping, it is just ordinary. Jawa Mee and Pasembor taste better.

author: Kim Armstrong
review_text: The owner is nice and the staff. The fried chicken wasn't good and expensive. The potato salad most people love. The banquet hall is being renovated, so I had to give it a low rating. Overall, this is a good place that doesn't serve pork.

author: Cor Mango
review_text: My family first time dining here. I've never seen so much food! Although I'm vegan their were plenty of vegetables, rice noodles, and fresh fruits. My family are not vegan reason for the none vegan photo's. The dining area was very clean. Waitress always cleaning the tables. My only issue was that they was sweeping around our table which cause to cough, sneeze and my mother constantly blowing her nose. Otherwise we enjoyed the food.

author: Ryan Hulme
review_text: We found this place accidentally but were glad to do so. It was a nice atmosphere and friendly service, with very tasty Cuban sandwiches and smoothies. They also do daily special menus, which was cool.

author: Hungry J
review_text: Surprisingly not hard to get a booking on a friday night. Overall the experience was positive but for the price, the food overall fall a bit short of expectation. Salad was good, meatballs can be better, calamari was decent but the sauce does not seem match. The bread and dip was good too but the eggplant was hard to taste. Cavatelli pasta was good but i think the balance was off due too much cheese. And the sausage was a bit too mushy. The vodka pasta was solid, the the Squash Agnolotti was the best pasta I had in a while. Steak is crowd favorite but the special duck dish is not there. The duck smelled a bit off but unfortunately it happens once in a while. Not much a restaurant can do. Sides was good too. Service is nice an chill. Its worth a try for sure.

author: Dave
review_text: Went with the wife for a date night. Reserved a table just in case because we saw how popular this place is and it doesn't disappoint in that regard, especially with the small yet cosy feel inside. I had done some research on the menu before we arrived, so although we knew what we wanted we were open to hearing recommendations from our server because this was our first time dining at Tonino. These recommendations would not be ignored, as coming in, we knew we would order a pizza bianca but didn't know which. However, as we told our server we wanted the "small" that consisted of mortadella, pecorino, and house pickles, our server knew that we should try the ricotta and hot honey with the pizza bianca. That recommendation did not disappoint as the sweetness of the honey and the creaminess of the ricotta paired perfectly with the crispy and crunchy, yet airy bread of the pizza bianca. Shortly after, the mortadella, pecorino, and house pickles arrived on a platter. Now the mortadella had a nice aftertaste and pecorino cheese is always great, but their house pickles were easily the best pickles I have had in my life, hands down, not even close. In the end my wife ordered the bucatini and I ordered the rigatoni. The pastas themselves on both dishes were clearly handmade as labors of love to the customer. I do want to preface my thought on my main dish by saying that am not too cultured in terms of palatte or food exploration. That being said my rigatoni dish's sauce and topping of guancile I believe it was, was a bit too rich for me. But if that is the only complaint I can find about this establishment, then so be it. My wife (a slightly more travelled diner) told me that her pasta and the culmination of the mouth feel, flavor profile, and freshness made her believe this is a top 5 dish she has had in her life. If you are ever in the southern part of Boston and want AMAZING italian food, stop no further than Tonino.

author: BC C
review_text: We waited about 45 minutes for a table for two, so be prepared for a crowd. The place was packed mostly with Chinese tourists, which already says something about its popularity. Once seated, we ordered the big prawns, scallops, and curry crab meat. Every dish was flavorful and cooked well — the curry crab meat especially stood out. Overall, the food was delicious and worth the wait, though the queue can test your patience.

author: Lovie Latrese
review_text: DONT GO HERE WORST LOCATION EVER.... THE rude assistant manager or whatever she was is the reason businesses want to replace workers with robots. I was there two day prior and they gave me extra sauce but she refused first saying it's against policy then blamed it on not liking my attitude after she refused me... literally stating IM NOT HELPING YOU YOU HAVE ENOUGHT SAUCE. With an attitude... I live up the street and have been at this location again and will not go back until people like her are not allowed to do things like this to customer so I asked for a refund and she shorted my change 1 dollar and would not give me the remainder of my change... she is a disgusting person

author: Apple Ong
review_text: Cộng Cà Phê only accepts cash and does not take credit cards. This generally applies to most places in Hoi An. We loved the drinks here. They only serve beverages and do not offer desserts or food of any kind.

author: Sofia
review_text: Food taste is not bad but given the prices and the fact that they gave me all bones, I do not recommend. Leftover cut up chicken wings, only 4 pieces of meat. I left it and the waiter asked me if I want to take away, I said no need. He asked if it was not to my liking? I responded with that they gave me all bones which he looked and saw. The cashier came over and also looked and saw that it was all bones but no one did anything to fix the situation. I paid 23 Ringits for 4 pieces of chicken and a cup of chrysanthemum tea plus a few bites of bean sprouts, ridiculous. Chicken also was not necessarily tender just decent flavor. Save yourself, overhyped place. There is definitely better chicken bean sprouts out there!

author: Tunde Ojo
review_text: A friend recommended and i decided to try it out. Best tasting Naija food I’ve had in north east area in a while. I ordered half pan of Ayamase and Ogbono and the meal was very well packaged and more importantly so delicious. I shall be back again

author: nads
review_text: food is alright, expensive for what it is but alright in general and enjoyable. the fried beehoon is the star of the show that my table ended up ordering 2 more portions, the pork is good too and the salted egg sotong was alright only minus one star for their yam paste / orh ni , the yam had a hard inner layer that was not edible like it has been prepared and left for very long, then reheated and served to us. there were quite a fair bit of corn as well so it mostly taste like corn instead of yam wont recommend the yam paste.

author: Cyclops Grey
review_text: Tried this Oriental Kopi in Pavilion Bukit Bintang, Kuala Lumpur area. As usual you need to queue and patient to wait to taste their nice foods and beverages. This time, we ordered Nasi Lemak Ayam Goreng, Pan Mee Signature, Chicken Beehoon Curry, Polo Bun, Oriental Egg Tart, Milo, and for sure Milo Dinosaurus.

author: Ahhkhai Studio Official
review_text: A bit expensive, but not well cooked and the hygiene a little disappointed, the housefly is everywhere, not same as the first time I went here for lunch

author: francisco quinonez
review_text: So I order a stake sandwich combo the menu shows sandwich fries and a drink but when I pick up my order they charge me an order of fries cause the sandwich doesn’t come with fries not sure why

author: Márk Lövei
review_text: Best Babi guling I have even eaten in Bali. Spices are just so good, the pork skin is crunchy, I really can't complain about anything, everything was nice and the environment is stunning with a little ricefiled they have, I can definitely recommend it to everyone!

author: Henry Smith
review_text: Good food, excellent service, if the service wasn't good enough, an employee went outside with a tray of sauces to ask people eating on the tables there if they wanted any. Absolutely beautiful service. Food is usually good but for fries I wouldn't order anything besides a large, as I got about 5 full size fries in a medium, although I think that's just Chick-Fil-A portion sizes. There's a huge difference between medium and large. Also, the fries in general always have a problem in this location, it's either too much or too little salt and sometimes the fries are just stale. I'd still give the food a 4 nonetheless.

author: Hoàng Công Vân Hạ
review_text: I arrived late (almost 10 pm) and they were still very enthusiastic in serving me. The meat was plentiful, and for 165k including drinks, it was amazing!

author: Dukwan Adderley
review_text: I received this location to try. I will be honest the food wasn't as hyped as I was told however it wasn't bad. There tacos where okay but not something I am looking to run back to at the first chance. The area it is located is mas o meno (alright / so-so) again not a place if make a priority to get back to anytime soon. The service was good however. Very friendly and helpful staff members. The order and time to pick up was quick and efficient. 10 out of 10 for their staff members.

author: Pokerface S
review_text: The food was by far the BEST, the serving size was enough to fill to the top. The cooks were constantly cooking fresh food, the lines are getting longer by the minute. They have variety of drinks to choose from . The only thing that was upsetting was the thin Hispanic ladies that serve the food had a frown face and had no energy, nor customer service. While a young Hispanic lady was serving i can hear another Hispanic lady talk in SPANISH , “quietly telling the other girl, “Don’t serve so much PUT LESS in there plat and kept telling her over repeatedly!” They have such bad attitude I try not let it get to me I want to come back but they need to not be in the front line serving if they have such a bad attitude for no reason at all. Nor was I rude to them.

author: MA TM
review_text: I would rate this restaurant 3.5/5. Ambiance is awesome, I love the 50s vibe and it is well done. Service is super friendly and welcoming and prices are reasonable. My issue is more so with the food. I ordered an omelette, coffee, and orange juice. The orange juice was fresh and delicious; however, the coffee was extremely watered down and the omelette was very bland.

author: Bea Aguinaldo
review_text: Food: They serve Big portions And the price is just right. The menu is only limited because this is their specialty. Service: The staff are very friendly and also recommends the Best seller and how to properly eat Vietnamese food. Like don’t be afraid to ask any questions because they’re Very friendly. Atmosphere: The place is very chill, to nearby hotels and convenience store and it’s just right around the corner by the park.

author: Breanna Blackwell
review_text: The girl when I went to finally get my food was in a rush for me to get out her drive through , after only receiving my food 2 seconds ago . I received the order , she said thank you . After I went to check to make sure , she repeated the “thank you” again as if she was trying to basically say “move it along” . As I’m about to pull off I said “I heard you the first time” she says then after “calm down . Relax” I then backed up and had to ask her who she talking to and what was the problem?! As I don’t understand what’s the rush for me wanting to check MY food that I paid for . It wasn’t a line at the time while I was checking my food for her to be in a rush for me to move .. I then had to put her in her place to let her know that you’re not gonna get my money & then rush for me to go . After tonight I best believe she clocked out or ended her shift after the embarrassment & respect I needed to show her . Wendy’s teach your employee etiquette .

author: Es Thompson
review_text: Amazing!! Go there!! The service was sooo good. The hostess was so nice and friendly. Staff kept checking on us all night and giving us etas on the food which was appreciated but unnecessary because everything came out faster than expected. Waitress was very helpful and gave great feedback on choices. Food was out of this world. We order so much so we could share and there was not a single thing that missed.
