My friend had to covertly unbutton her pants lol. Everything was soooo flavorful and well balanced and thoughtful. Im not a huge fan of tacos but I ate these right up. Comes with 2 which are about 2 bites each. You really have to finish them there because they didnt look like they would hold up well going home. Steak basically melted in my mouth. Ive never had such a well made steak. The waitress suggested medium rare but I asked for medium and it was perfect. I struggled to finish it but again new that it wouldnt reheat well at home. My friend got the lamb shoulder and that was also delicious , has a nice kick and that was even better the next day reheated. The watermelon....I could eat 100 pieces of it. I had to tell myself not to lick the plate. The churros with blueberry compote.... oh man! I had no idea that blueberries had so much game. Absolutely delicious, not overly sweet, paired so well with the churros and the cream. I was so sad when I reached the bottom of the bowl....churros, I miss you everyday. Only complaint is had out of the whole experience was that it was a bit noisy...it got better as people left for the night. This is also a me thing so I won't judge the restaurant for this lol but I hate bathrooms with black toilets. And just an FYI for anyone with a shellfish allergy, they informed me that they use the same fryer for everything so the lamb shoulder is a caution since it uses the same fryer as the shrimp.

author: Busi Ngwenya - Alexander
review_text: Le Tub was Le OK. Having to pay $3 to selfpark in their limited parking lot, is rarher silly. I am already about to go in and spend $17 on a burgerwith no fries? We ordered le burger and le lobster BLT, the egg nog and margaritas. The BLT came on a multi grain bread surprisingly. Such a delicate meat was overpowered by the bread choice I feel. Burger was ok, very tasty and juicy. Atmosphere was lovely, great views from the dock. Waitress was great. Nice to check it off the list, but most likely not worth a second visit.

author: Nadine Marcellus
review_text: The Joint Review I went to The Joint with my girlfriends for brunch — my first time visiting this neighborhood gem. The restaurant is wheelchair accessible through the second entrance (facing Centre Street). First, I want to give a special shoutout to Antonio, who greeted me warmly and helped maneuver my wheelchair through the door. The restaurant has a cozy, comfortable vibe, and the food is beautifully presented — absolutely mouthwatering! I ordered the Crab Cake Benny (seared crab cake, English muffin, poached egg, Hollandaise sauce, and breakfast potatoes). Every bite was delectable. I also enjoyed the Crispy Calamari, served with pepperoncini aioli and marinara sauce — yum! The Mango Margarita was the perfect finishing touch to a delicious brunch. Antonio and the rest of the staff were pleasant, attentive, and genuinely helpful. I loved my brunch experience so much that I returned the following Sunday!!!

author: Susan Yong
review_text: Food quality was dropped compared last time. Dim sum very normal. Nothing to shout out.

author: San
review_text: Even with a reservation, we waited about 30 minutes standing in a crowded corridor before being seated — and our table ended up being right next to the restroom. The hygiene standards were disappointing: staff handled cash and then served food without washing hands, and several aprons looked noticeably dirty. The food itself was good, but the overall experience did not match the expectations.

author: Gloria Norvell
review_text: If I go to a store and they telling me you have biggie bags for a 5,6 or 7 that's what I expect to pay for it not 6:40 5:40 or 7:40 even the extra amounts they put on after that and then I don't expect to be asked if I want medium or large I wanted the five or six or seven biggie bag the way it comes.

author: Jenn D
review_text: The reviews are very overrated for this place. We got steak tips, which only had 6 pieces for over $30 and chicken parm with was completely burnt on the bottom and dried out. The waitress was nice enough but barely checked in on us. I would not go there again

author: Fabio Lopes
review_text: The food was great. A bit on the pricey side but was worth it. I was treated very professionally by Hendrick. Overall a very lovely experience. Can't wait to try the bar later

author: AC Slater
review_text: Can't wait to return. Everything was incredible, especially the oeuf mayonnaise- which is forever engrained in my memory as one of my favorite bites anywhere. Queued up 30 minutes before opening and the line filled up FAST

author: April Bartol
review_text: Ordered at 11:43p. Said pick up was at 12:03a. So, I went to pick it up, got there at 11:58p. I saw my name on the Carry Out Screen. At 12:02a, my name disappeared off the screen. Asked the girl up front, Irene, why my name wasn't up there. She gave a look of "meh", then completely ignored me. So, I thought it wasn't ready. Yes, I understand they were busy after the concert release. But to completely ignore a customer with a question, a bit disrespectful. So after seeing a set of customers walk out that ordered AFTER I asked about my food. Then, I asked the manger on duty that happened to be at the register. Told her that I've been waiting and my name isn't on the screen. She said classic wings take longer to cook. I said I order at a quarter til. She then turned around and grabbed a bag off the shelf. I told her that NO ONE called my name, and I've heard staff repeat call names when they weren't picked up yet. I told her that her front person completely ignored me when I asked a simple question. So, IRENE cleared my name before even calling my name. Finally got my food at 12:35a, food was ok, but would have been better if I was able to get my order when Door Dash told me it was ready to pick up.

author: Daniel John
review_text: Disappointing. First off, you can’t argue that the pasta itself is god-level. Perfect texture and shape. But the sauces on the pasta were terrible. Extremely oily and heavy, completely overwhelming the beautiful pasta. We couldn’t even finish the Busiate, and quite honestly it looked awful as well. The tagliatelle ragu was so oily after one small portion of it my plate was covered in residual oil, see the photo. The green salad was nice as were the prawns. We didn’t think the pizza was remarkable, super soggy in the middle. We skipped dessert. Wine was egregiously overpriced and small pours. I guess we missed out on this place’s heyday because there is much more refined Italian going on all over the city right now, especially at this price point.

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: Emeline Koh
review_text: A very nice environment but a bit difficult to find for the place because it’s located at the inside of the road. You need to walk all the way to the inside from the main road before you will see the stall. The lady will help to take your order and she can speak English as well. So don’t need to worry about language if you do not know how to speak Thai. For the noodle , personally I find that the soup seems too thick for boat noodle but the taste is still not too bad for my liking. But it’s not really that superb as per what I have watch from social media. Worth to try if you have nothing much to eat around the corner

author: Jennifer Denise (Lulu bell)
review_text: It was nice love the service the food was so much on the plate had to bring hm leftover...Good affordable prices an get there early when we left line at the door, two thumbs up u want good food an nice service an outgoing layback atmosphere, date night after the club food or just to hang out for a drink..😊👍👍

author: Paing Soe Thu
review_text: I went there because of vlogger “what the pho” who shared about great foods in hochimin. It turned out i was scammed by the meal itself. The sausage and pate had odd smell, the baguette is cold and there were only little meat as you can see in the picture (normally 60k can get alot in other shops) Personally, i felt cheated and not worth the price at all. I feel disgusted “what the pho” because of her fake (paid partnership) content, they are not real reviews.

author: William Tan
review_text: Shoutout for Mas Ardi who serve us very well. Food also never fail. Will come back to this outlet every now and then. Thank you.

author: Piotr Treter
review_text: A must-visit for Forrest Gump fans, but also for those who appreciate great food. The dishes served are truly delicious, which, combined with the surrounding Bubba Gump atmosphere, creates something incredible. This place captivated us, wow. I recommend a visit; it's truly worth it ❤️

author: Khaled Bejdough
review_text: Hi , this afternoon was my 1st at this venue. The employees are kind, helpful, hospitality Is top notch. The restaurant Is clean, the entree’s are very delicious too. Will be coming back again

author: Simon Heath
review_text: Great little mom and pop restaurant serving home made food, nothing fancy. The prices are cheap and the portion sizes are good. My fried beef with macaroni was super tasty and the spring rolls well cooked. These both and a soda, 90k. Highly recommend.

author: Yum yum Cool
review_text: This hawker coffee stall right next to KINEX Mall ( next to Wantan Mee n Economic rice) was Surprisingly Good as the popular coffee stall ( coffee Edition) was closed on Sun. I decided to try out new stall n did not want to queue too long for another coffee stall. There was no queue but a clean n neat coffee stall. Ordered 2 yuan yang n 1 tea O ping , our verdicts were all good for this stall . Coffee has a good robust beans taste where is almost like those popular coffee stalls. Tea was smooth . I will buy from this uncle again !

author: Jouni Tiitola
review_text: Nice little cafe with friendly service. Thank You Maria for taking care of me! I had waffles and chicken, perfect combination and chicken was tasty & crispy.

author: Melinda
review_text: This was our first time at Humo BBQ and we're hoping they'll expand across town b/c this one is 20 miles from our house. So good it's worth the drive though. We shared: Two Meats - Two Sides (Burnt Ends, Hot Link - Chorizo Refried Beans, French Fries) for $26. A bit pricey, but a lot of food. Four Tacos (generous portions of Barbacoa, Brisket, Pulled Pork, Potato) for just $3 each! Chan was an efficient and friendly server, honoring our wish to avoid the dreaded soapy-tasting cilantro (which meant we couldn't order the delicious-sounding Hatch Chile Mac & Cheese or Humo Street Corn unfortunately). But he also double-checked with the kitchen and the owner (manager?) told us the Chile Verde served with the tacos also has cilantro so they would eliminate it also. Excellent service and delicious food!

author: Dhiani Satiti
review_text: If you’re looking for one of the best morning coffee experiences in Bali, Livingstone in Petitenget is a must-visit. This bright, stylish café and bakery serves an exceptional cup of coffee, and the specialty Canggu blend is a standout. The vibe here is relaxed yet lively, perfect for a chill morning catch-up. Extra bonus for the amazing services from all the staff. Well done!

author: Kim Soon Chua
review_text: We decided to try something different whilst we were in Penang. And Nasi Kandar was the choice. We heard so much about this redtuarant that we had to try it. We went there at 3.30pm and a long queue had formed. We waited for 1 hour before it was our turn to order. So much for trying something different. We had the ayam berempah which was good. The meat was tender. We also had the sotong which was in my mind average. The curry sauces were standard Indian fare. Overall, not worth the long queue.

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: Jasie
review_text: Ordered a few dishes and verdict: 1st place: Their Thai Milk tea. Surprisingly good. 2nd place: Tom Yum Goong. Taste was unique. They have coconut meat in the soup. Which is quite nice. 3rd place: not in the pictures. But it’s fried Taro. The rest, just normal.

author: Maria Sis
review_text: THE FOOD IS HORRIBLE. THE CHICKEN LOOKS LIKE RUBBER. THE FOOD IS VERY SALTY. THE RICE IS HARD AND SALTY. I ORDERED CHICKEN WITH MUSHROOMS, AND IT WAS ONLY VEGETABLES, AND THE CHICKEN LOOKED LIKE RUBBER.

author: Matthew Walker
review_text: Trust me, take the highway to the Tasty Zone!! For those of you who are familiar with Szechwan food and it’s unique flavors, you’ll be so happy that you finally found THE place. The quality, portions, prices, spiciness/numbing—it’s all just so wonderful.

author: Celeste Abbott
review_text: ★★★★★ 5 stars — Triple George’s is a downtown Vegas must!!! We had dinner at a booth atTriple George’s on New Year’s Day and it was a ballet of hospitality… the kind of service that feels rare lately. They actually pick up the phone when you call! And from the host to the servers to the entire crew, everyone brought their best to the table warm, attentive, professional, and somehow still relaxed and human… even on New Year’s Day. And the food? Perfection. Our steaks were cooked exactly right, beautifully paced, and genuinely delightful from start to finish. You can tell this place takes pride in doing it the right way… no gimmicks, just classic Vegas steakhouse excellence and a fun, professional team that makes you feel like family. Where is that these days? Also: the staff had this bright sense of humor that only comes from teamwork and being appreciated. I truly hope leadership is as solid behind the scenes as what they deliver to the table. If you’re downtown and want a meal that feels special (without the Strip chaos… which is the opposite of what happens downtown), go to Triple George’s. We left happy, impressed, and already talking about coming back… and we still have steak for days!

author: John King (King)
review_text: Tried their chicken rice. Must say that it is really good. Service is great too. Another great chicken rice place in Eunos Crescent

author: Kristin Weaver
review_text: Le Tub is a cool place to eat. Great water views. We had the Mahi sandwich, burger, fries and key lime pie for dessert. The food and drinks were awesome. Great,friendly service. Will definitely return!

author: Will M
review_text: The staff was very nice and the place vibey but the chicken sandwich was just okay. I got the medium and it didn’t feel spicy at all, I got the hot and it was just overly seasoned, not really hot.

author: Cindy S
review_text: Quite popular local seafood restaurant, spacious place with quite many tables. We ordered crabs both in chilly and ego yolk, nice. Other seafood are also fresh. Waiters are too busy, so don’t expect proper service - prepare to clean your own plates and refill tissues.

author: Jeff Petersen
review_text: Great place downtown Vegas, just a block off Fremont Street. Nice old school steakhouse vibe. Real good steaks and seafood. No wait for our table with reservation. Very good service. Very cool long bar with seating; also some booths and tables for dining. Very extensive cocktail list. Tableside prepared Cesar salad for 2 was very nice presentation, but it was just average tasting in our opinion. Good portions- not huge (unless you order the huge steaks) and not skimpy. Too full to try dessert, but it was a nice list. If there is free street parking, we didn’t see it. Paid street parking and a variety of paid garages walking distance.

author: Fazlie Ab Aziz
review_text: Not advised to be here late hours after 1 am. If you are seeking the best quality of freshly fried ayam goreng with nasik panas², I recommend you guys go to chai leng park branch. But If you just wanna eat roti canai roti telur or just having a drinks this might be the right place.

author: Jeremiah Su
review_text: Really good after the Reno. Insiders really noisy though as it’s enclosed and echoes quite a bit. Food was amazing, albeit a little salty. Would definitely return because their Hor Fun has wok hei taste, and super yummy!

author: cleavroy T
review_text: I was happy that someone understood me but didn't mind waiting for them to cook ,ask the price they show the bowl But look at what they gave me for the price very turn off . There cooking look very good. No quedé contento con lo que me dieron por el precio pregunto que talla pero mira

author: Natasha Weleilakeba
review_text: So glad I came to finally try their double smash burger! It was everything & more of what I was hoping for- a 10/10 fabulous meal! The restaurant is lovely-beautiful set up & even better staff! Totally coming to try their breakfast & dinner menus as I’m sure it’s just as fabulous 😍👏🏾

author: Vee 祐宁 L
review_text: I would think it’s quite nice as I love peppery soup. $7 BKT, $8 pork tail, $3- braised bean curbs ..dunno how much is salted vege & rice as we ordered separately. Meat is tender and hard at the same time, came here for dinner as dropping girl for driving lesson. Hard as in I guess it’s freshly cooked and not long enough. Soft as in there are fats in the pork ribs, yummy… Oh ya, I went to top up soup which they willingly gave.. Overall I think it’s good.. but quite costly for $7 BKT w/o rice.. The coffeeshop is very noisy though ..

author: Nicole Heyliger
review_text: What can I say about Mangrove but AMAZING!!! From the time we walked into the speak easy vibe where the warm intimate atmosphere made us feel welcomed, the host and servers made the dinning experience even better. When I say this place is a must it definitely is. Shareable plates we tried were lobsta Mac and cheese and lamb chops 👍🏽 flavors very good. Entrees Rasta pasta and oxtails and drinks red red wine delicious, bel kreati and the hot stepper I’d recommend.

author: asssa ssaa
review_text: It's a great place because it's cheap and the food is delicious. That's why local children often come here. You'll see arrogant white people pretending to be regulars loitering around here, mistaking it for a bar. Do not smoke near children eating. Just because locals do it often doesn't mean it's okay. I think it's a basic courtesy that tourists should naturally observe.

author: Hương Lê
review_text: I've eaten here with my family many times, and everyone is satisfied and wants to come back. The food is delicious and varied, the prices are reasonable. Service is fast. The seating area is spacious and comfortable.

author: Max
review_text: Food and service is amazing. Especially the old aunty that is serving us. However, there is a younger barista at the counter is very rude to her colleague and keep shouting them. It kinda ruined the mood for our meal plan. Hope the staff can handle it more privately.

author: Andrew McDonald
review_text: Tasty burgers. The truffle fries were awesome and the Bintang was cold. Great for a quick easy meal of Burger and Fries.

author: lillian gonzales
review_text: WORST Fast Food location I've been to in a long time 🤢.. I'm the only one in the front area & I end up waiting 3-4 minutes for someone to take my order🤔 .. the inside is filthy/ the outside is disgusting 😲 😠 I tried to order tacos' (only to be told they didn't have tacos).. I'm sorry isn't that what Jack in the box is famous for?? It's okay I have a choice of super gigantic tacos or a bunch of little baby tacos.. SAVE YOUR MONEY!! SAVE YOUR TIME!! AND SAVE YOUR STOMACH!! 🤢

author: Caitlin Anderson
review_text: First proper English breakfast we have found that is just like home! While the full English is more expensive than all the other items, it was definitely worth it. We also had the egg and bacon bagel which was lovely. Upstairs has AC and they offer you a seat upstairs straight away, great service and a great meal.

author: Karn A
review_text: Great local spot with truly authentic flavours. The suckling pig set was good. The meat on sticks was amazing too: smoky, juicy, and full of flavour, definitely a highlight. It gets very busy with lots of locals dining here, so expect a bit of a wait. The menu is extremely short and focused mainly on their signature suckling pig, but they do it really well.

author: Zilver Yys
review_text: Highly recommend their mango smoothie RM 6 👍, very creamy😋 Kopi O panas RM 2.20. Every foods are delicious here! Like pasembur, jawa mee, pan mee 😊

author: LimKoppi
review_text: Our driver suggest this place to us. Need to take number and queue ya. Need to queue at least half an hour to one hour but it is worth to queue 😆😁 we all loves this cafe very much. All food and dessert is nice! And wish to go again.

author: Nikki Williams
review_text: Food is always good they give love portions. Only downfall about my last visit is that the manager was yelling at the lady fixing my bowl. Saying her friendship with the cashier will cost her her job and continued to yell at her and chastise her in front of everyone. That was a conversation that should have been had in private not in front of a full restaurant.

author: Lori Lopez
review_text: I absolutely love their chicken tenders. They're soft on the inside & crunchy on the outside. Their fries are also delicious.

author: Emtalvarado@gmail.com Alvarado
review_text: Great place for family and friends to hang out. The food was amazing and the staff one of a kind. Highly recommend.

author: Terry Herbold
review_text: What a cute place with some great offerings. If you’re headed to airport later in the morning, do yourself a favor and head off the strip to support a local shop. The Specialty Latte offerings are really good - I had the Lavender which gave a nice floral note to the nicely pulled shot. The pastries, made locally were a perfect accompaniment to the coffee. Cinnamon roll hit all the right notes with warm spices, scones and croissants were perfectly baked as well. Get em warmed up!

author: Sebastian Rodriguez
review_text: Amazing plant based food. Honestly the best I had in Ho Chi Minh City, especially the banh mi! The customer service was immaculate as well and the space was extremely atmospheric. Could see myself studying or working there. I also wanna know how the meatballs are made that go in the pho. Oh also definitely try the matcha with oat milk and coconut water. So good!

author: Florencia Rojas-Miguez
review_text: The food used to be good. Now it’s inedible. I don’t know if they changed the baker and chef but this place isn’t as good as it used to be. We didn’t finish our food. Really disappointed that this place lost its quality.

author: Carbon Lim
review_text: I have been to Chai Leng Park foodcourt so many times but mostly for the Lok Lok. This is the first time i ordered their noodle stalls. As a first image you would know this is a 老字号 already. So we ordered a Char Hor Fun, Tai Lok Mee or people mostly said KL Hokkein Mee, Fried Noodle and lastly a Loh Mee with black vinegar. The Wok Hei is enough and the taste was good also. Is just that this is just a roadside stalls so be prepared if you can't stand the heat in the afternoon. Definitely will return to try their other menu. Price is at affordable. You may need to park far away and walk to stall is more easier.

author: Stephen Lewis
review_text: Not gonna lie, this is more a 4.1/5 and it’s also weighted for the neighborhood, but this place is a solid go to for me, especially when I’m feeling really lazy. Low expectations are key here , but I honestly can’t complain much. The one time I ordered celery and carrots they were a bit out of date, but that’s more on me than anything. The 10 boneless wing and French fries combo all day baby

author: travis stirewalt
review_text: April 20th, 2024: It should be noted that this establishment does NOT serve WATER. I kid you not… They’ll only sell you bottled water at a premium. This is the first time in 30 years I’ve patronized a bar that won’t give you a glass of water after ordering 50 dollars worth of food & alcohol. I spoke to the owner (Hank) regarding the policy and he was incredibly rude & almost proud of it. He said it was “the way of the future”. Well in the very near future (Monday morning) I’ll be reporting this to the city of Boston as I believe it’s unlawful to deny paying customers (or human beings in general) a simple glass of tap water. Pure greed, in such an inhumane fashion…

author: David Orridge
review_text: Great food, awesome cocktails, really enjoyed the steak, potatoes bravas and old fashion cocktails. Waiter took really good care of us.

author: MIlton Ramos
review_text: I have mixed feelings about this place. I saw a YouTube and TikTok video where it was pretty hyped as a great place to eat, with a good atmosphere and great location. Visiting today the tacos are all OK, but I would not drive the 33 miles again to this location. The carne asada was excellent Tortillas are handmade. The salsas are spicy, but I think that there’s a lack of selection in meats. They have Al- pastor, Asada, chicken, and chorizo. They are missing lengua and tripas. They have vampiros, which was a hard tough tortilla, so not getting this again, and the guacamole is not real. Place was relatively small with limited seating spaces. Overall not quite what I expected.

author: Harrison C. Davies
review_text: 🎬 🍤🏃🦐🌊 “Life is like a box of chocolates… you never know what you’re gonna get,” and that fits perfectly because every Bubbly Gump Shrimp Co. location really does have its own vibe. This one is packed with throwback film memorabilia and feels like one of the flagship spots of this fictional-but-all-the-more-fun enterprise. The vibes were great, the service was friendly, and they definitely captured the Forrest-verse charm. Just wish they still did the movie trivia — that was always such a fun part of the experience.

author: K M
review_text: What's great? 1) Grass jelly. This is more firm, yummy! 2) Crab roll 3) Prawn dumpling 4) Roast meat platter What to improve? Nothing. Maybe bundle some discount with adjacent desert shop? Visit again? Yes!

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: Eileen
review_text: I went with a group of colleagues as our plan was lunch at old Airport road end up market was closed for washing. I feel disgusting after I finish my meal and I witness this myself. 1st soup was diluted, meat not so tasty, the salted vegetables taste horrible too and totally tasted different and not as good as previous stall we have at Jalan Besar. After our meal, I'm shocked to see the stall helper digging his nose and worst is after doing that he didn't wash his hand! Less then 5min, he went to smoke 🚬 at the walk way and came back to the stall didn't wash the hand and proceed back to cook for the customer who ordered. Omg! Never in my life, I will go back again! This is super disgusting and horrible unhygienic! Hopefully, SFA can visit and access the stall! I seldom give such review and would said this is the 1st time I see such thing! Regret having meal there!

author: Maria Murljacic
review_text: What a cute spot! The wine is very reasonably priced, and the food is quality. I highly recommend, as the food, wine, ambiance, and service were great. Between 4 people, we split 4-5 tapas and the meat platter.

author: Caylin Lancione
review_text: Amazing spot. Top and all the crew are wonderful people and great at what they do. So delicious, great drink options and specials. Sake bombs too! I had the Tokyo Tea and Drunken Noodle with beef. Superb 🔥

author: Nam Nguyễn
review_text: Surprisingly cheap menu. Spacious and airy space. Has a large TV for football Suitable for groups needing to organize parties Friendly staff There is a ball pit for children

author: Gabriel Ng
review_text: Pretty sure this hawker centre has the most stores that sell affordable meal in the price starting from $3.50. The price and taste of the food are 5 stars but the atmosphere is 3 star because it can be a bit dark if u are dining at the inside of the hawker centre. One advice I give is to avoid stores that always have no queue during lunch and dinner hours. There is a reason why they have no queue think about. I would not name stores but u will notice it yourself

author: Faith
review_text: Had the roti telur and Teh tarik here. The roti canai was not as crispy as I would like, but the curry was tasty. The Teh tarik was good and not too sweet. Shop is v busy with alot of tourists.

author: Preeti Sharma
review_text: Rainy day + Namaste Momo Cottage = perfect combo 🥟 Veg noodles were comforting and veg steamed & fried momo were fresh, amazing, clearly made with love. And the ghar wali chai (off-menu!) just hit different when it’s raining. Such a good stop, coming back for sure!

author: Dana Carrasco
review_text: Service, food and atmosphere is always awesome. Very friendly. Huge portions. The food is always fresh and tastes wonderful. This is our #1 Chinese food restaurant when we come to Las Vegas.

author: theo
review_text: I had the pleasure of dining at Osteria, a cozy Italian restaurant known for its authentic flavors and warm ambiance. I decided to try their Lasagna, Grilled Chicken with Mushroom Sauce, and of course, their famous Tiramisu for dessert. The Lasagna arrived bubbling hot with perfectly melted cheese on top. The layers of pasta were tender, and the rich meat sauce was well-seasoned, bursting with tomato and herb flavors. Each bite was a comforting blend of creamy béchamel and savory beef, making it easily one of the best I’ve had. Next, the Grilled Chicken with Mushroom Sauce was equally impressive. The chicken was tender and juicy, grilled to perfection with a slightly crisp exterior. The mushroom sauce was velvety smooth, with a deep, earthy flavor that complemented the chicken beautifully. It was served with a side of roasted vegetables that were cooked just right—soft yet still vibrant. To finish off the meal, I couldn’t resist their Tiramisu. It was light and fluffy, with layers of mascarpone cream that melted in my mouth. The dusting of cocoa on top added just the right amount of bitterness to balance the sweetness. It was the perfect end to a delightful meal. Overall, Osteria delivered on all fronts—delicious food, cozy atmosphere, and attentive service. If you’re craving authentic Italian flavors, I highly recommend giving it a try.

author: Diana R
review_text: The food is really good. The pork eschalot pasta is so yummy I wanted to order two portions. Truffle steak, thai kalian pork belly and spaghetti bolognese were also solid choices. Skin elixir juice was also sweetly refreshing. But the food took very long to come. I came at 12:40pm on Saturday, there was a queue and I was seated at 1pm, I ordered 1:03pm and only got the food at 1:34pm :( 30mins was too long but luckily the food was worth the wait.

author: Giovanna Alfaro
review_text: Such a great restaurant! The open space is beautiful and the food was absolutely delicious — so worth it. Definitely going back! Our server Evando was super helpful and had such a great personality.

author: Rosie Bakes
review_text: Absolutely fantastic experience! From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with warm smiles and genuine friendliness that made us feel so welcome. Novi was an absolute delight! attentive, kind, and truly made our night special with her wonderful service. The food was delicious, with the pizzas being a standout and the Anzac apple pie an absolute treat. My freakshake was epic – so big I couldn’t finish it, but every sip made me happy! The atmosphere, the food, and the service all came together perfectly. We all had such a wonderful night and can’t wait to come back! 🌴🌸

author: Davi Galvao
review_text: The food was okay. All the meats tasted really dry, and the buffet food seemed kind of old and not very warm, likely because it was sitting out in the open without a cover. I was expecting a better buffet and churrasco rodizio for the price. Overall, the food was okay, and Evando provided excellent service, attending to our needs promptly and answering our questions.

author: Sheena D
review_text: First time here and I was overwhelmed in a good way with the menu options. The food was good and the portions are big. The food in the pics are actually half portions to give you an idea. Ioana was the best server I’ve had in a long time. Very attentive and kind. She elevated the experience.

author: photo archive
review_text: Cam Thi Restaurant offers diners a familiar and cozy feeling, like returning to a traditional Vietnamese family home for a meal. From the moment you step inside, the space creates a warm impression with its simple and rustic decor. The wooden tables and chairs, along with nostalgic decorative items, allow you to easily slow down, forget the hustle and bustle of the outside world, and fully enjoy your meal. The most outstanding feature of Cam Thi Restaurant is its cuisine, which is deeply rooted in traditional Vietnamese family cooking. The dishes here aren't elaborate in presentation but focus on familiar, easy-to-eat flavors that are very appetizing. From stews and soups to stir-fries and fried dishes, everything evokes memories of a home-cooked meal, with balanced flavors, harmonious seasoning, and not overly greasy. The feeling when enjoying the food is one of familiarity, like eating dishes your mother or grandmother used to cook. The ingredients used are fresh and carefully prepared, so the dishes retain their natural sweetness and well-rounded flavors. Each dish is simple yet profound, becoming more delicious with every bite. In particular, the home-style serving enhances the feeling of togetherness, making it perfect for family, friends, or colleagues gatherings. Besides the food, the ambiance of Cam Thi is also a major plus. The restaurant isn't overly large but is well-arranged, creating a sense of privacy and warmth. The soft yellow lighting combined with the old-fashioned decor makes the meal feel relaxed and peaceful. It's an ideal place to eat, chat, and share everyday stories. Overall, Cam Thi restaurant is a very worthwhile visit if you love Vietnamese home-style cuisine and want to rediscover a familiar, simple feeling. The cozy atmosphere, delicious and easy-to-eat food, and the memories it evokes make this place not just a place to eat, but also a place to feel connection and love in every meal.

author: Joshua Gonzalez
review_text: Good food for the price, we tried the nachos andvtorta de milanesa with a horchata. The torta was actually really good, no complaints. Besides, I wish the milanesa had more breading, but besides that, it's all good! For the nachos, the chips seemed to be a but stale and not fresh cooked, but I could understand because of the cheap prices. The horchata was good, nothing bad or great about it. The service was exceptional and quick. The restaurant was clean, and the tvs were on with futbol that I loved! If you are looking for a cheap and quick meal, this is the spot.

author: Behnam MA
review_text: High quality and delicious food, reasonable price, nice staff. It’s small place but it’s good for having a quick meal. Beef was fresh and delicious. Highly recommend to try their sauces.

author: Thiha Lu Lin
review_text: One of the top dessert cafes in Thailand. But taking some time to get a table. Maybe this branch is the busiest one in Bangkok. The food is quite pricey. You can have some free cold green tea here.

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: Liên Trần
review_text: We went mainly for the architectural design and atmosphere and it didn't disappoint. The service is 10/10! The food wasn't the highlight though for what we'd expect at the higher price point, but still decent. The pork jowl was good but I forgot to take a photo. The "Homeland brew" was definitely what they decribe as "taste of memory" for me growing up drinking homemade "sâm mía lau" and the like.

author: Zheng Xie
review_text: The Shawarma tastes great. But I don’t have any service. The sauce smells like peanut. The price is higher than I expected.

author: Tabatha Loihle
review_text: Great pizza! I’m very picky when it comes to pizza just because I personally prefer homemade, but sometimes you just need a good fold on pie, that heals everything!

author: H Lib
review_text: My family and I have been coming here for years and we love the food, especially the Lomo Saltado and Ceviche. The lomo is tasty with lots of sauce that I like to mix with the rice. The portion is generous and reasonably priced. The fish in the ceviche is fresh and the sauce perfectly complements the dish. The owner is friendly and the service is great. I highly recommend this restaurant for excellent Peruvian cuisine.

author: Dave
review_text: Oops all ghost kitchens!!!! Never seen worse reviews for a place on google ever. This place operates TONS of ghost kitchens on grubhub. Why? Because if they told you the food was coming from wonder, you would check the reviews and not eat there. Unfortunately, this is something you have to do now for any restaurant you don't recognize. It almost tricked me and I am pretty pissed about it. Go away.

author: Pink Montana
review_text: I love eating here. My favorite is their balsamic chicken! It is so flavorful. I’ve never had chicken from anywhere else with that taste. They also have great pasta dishes.

author: Millie Voon
review_text: The ambience and decorations are lovely. However, the food are just average and way too salty.

author: Sudarta Ketut
review_text: The best restaurant in Nusa Penida by far. They have amazing food, especially the pizza. We also enjoyed a beautiful sunset at Orenda Beach. There's a lively concert in the evening.

author: Richard Choy
review_text: Family like restaurant. Seafood is fresh and delicious. Service is good. The restaurant boss/cook comes out to check with customers any feedback or comments on the the food serve.

author: Bradford Webster
review_text: What a hidden gem Saroush is! We got the filet and the chicken shawarma and the hummus and eggplant and everything was amazing! They have room for big parties and can have a full bar if you need it. We got to meet the owners and they were lovely, we will definitely be back soon, thank you for your hospitality!

author: Londa Rozier-Taylor
review_text: A Whole Vibe on Fremont! Last night’s experience was everything! The dynamic duo on service absolutely nailed it — friendly, attentive, and full of great energy from the first “hello” to the final “baai-baai.” Customer service is everything to me, and they went above and beyond! The all-day happy hour is unbeatable — from the crispy calamari to the juicy pork belly, tasty spring rolls, and that papaya salad with a spicy punch that took me straight to Thailand. Every bite was perfection. The ambiance sealed the deal — tuk tuks, wall art of Bangkok, and a lively atmosphere that made us forget we were still on Fremont. I live over 30 minutes away, but this is officially my new spot. Thank you for one of the best nights out I’ve had in a long while — can’t wait to come back!

author: Debarati
review_text: The food is SOOO good. This was supposed to be a stop during my trip but realized that our rehearsals for our NY performance clashed exactly will Eyval's opening hours. I was super sad so my husband decided to get me take out!! I am SO pleased. He got me photos of the food and the plating is so beautiful. I hope I get to visit NY again just so I can eat at Eyval again haha ..and perhaps next time in person! I got to try the lamb...I don't even know how they made it that good. I loved the dry pomegranates on top. The color is so beautiful too. Tried the salad & the roasted eggplant. Both very yummy. The cardamom chocolate cake was DIVINE!! 😍 Highly recommend!!!

author: BIlly Lim
review_text: The yam rice here is definitely good. A very busy/hectic place. Of noteworthy is the pasembur@jawa mee.

author: Jingyang Guo
review_text: chose for my Sunday lunch, and I wasn't expecting too much tbh. The food actually surprised me, the korma tastes great and I literally ate up every rice and every dip of sauce. The wait is relatively long but tolerable. Very likely to comeback in the future

author: Jonathan Goh
review_text: Ordered sate, beef soup, mint juice and small pork ribs. To keep the story short, sate is alright. Marinate is slightly spicy, meat portion is small. There was no bbq taste. Pork ribs are nice. Good marinate. Very appetising and meat falls off the bone. Worth ordering. Beef soup is disappointing. Hardly any meat in the soup. Soup itself is good albeit salty. For the price, better choices elsewhere.

author: R T
review_text: I come here for my ban Mian fix. So far I find the Hokkien mee and ban Mian nice. The rest is very average. So many vegetarian stalls. Chicken wings and satay right at the end (right side from the bridge). Qiu xiang ban Mian is left side from bridge all the way to the end near the hardware shop at hdb. His mee Hoon kueh is damn yums! Nearby Qiu xiang even has truffle fishball! Laksa from fishball noodle shop is not bad, fishball bouncy and no fishy smell!

author: Ajilex Fajardo
review_text: Lots of hawkers available but nice breakfast options can be a bit limited if compared to other centers in the vicinity What I got is a delicious version of char keow teow with cockles and egg

author: Wiroon Polwattana
review_text: A roadside restaurant with easy parking, delicious food, reasonable prices. Come and give it a try.

author: Shekharr Bhagat
review_text: I struggled to get a meal here, staff nodded and took notes for dietary preferences but then what was served had to be taken back twice since both times they didn’t bother to factor the dietary preferences. This is the first Indonesian restaurant that couldn’t get their classic Nasi Goreng right :)

author: Joost Mi-Maltha
review_text: I visited the Dumpling House based on the reviews here. I was disappointed by the whole experience to be honest. I found the dishes rather bland and I definitely had better elsewhere. You can order with your phone using the QR code on the table which is convenient. Service is quick. Atmosphere is so so.

author: Ken Durbin
review_text: 🌟 A Mesmerizing Evening at Taverna Opa, Hollywood Beach 🌟 From the moment we arrived at Taverna Opa, we knew we were in for something special. Nestled along the Intracoastal Waterway, the restaurant offered a stunning waterfront setting that felt both vibrant and serene. We were seated outdoors, right by the river, where the gentle breeze and rhythmic lapping of the water set the tone for a perfect afternoon. Our server was exceptional — warm, attentive, and genuinely passionate about the menu. He guided us through the evening with grace, offering thoughtful suggestions and ensuring every detail was just right. His timing was impeccable, and his energy matched the lively yet relaxed vibe of the restaurant. As we sipped our drinks and watched the boats drift by, nature added its own surprise: a manatee surfaced just feet from our table, rising slowly to take a breath. It was a quiet, awe-inspiring moment that made the night unforgettable — a gentle reminder of Florida’s wild beauty, right in the heart of Hollywood Beach. The food was equally impressive. I had the Chilean sea bass, perfectly seared and served over a rich bed of sautéed spinach, accompanied by golden roasted potatoes that were crisp on the outside and buttery within. My wife chose the Lavraki Branzino, topped with a bright, citrusy ladlemono sauce that elevated the delicate flavors of the fish. Each bite was a celebration of Mediterranean finesse and fresh, coastal ingredients. Taverna Opa isn’t just a restaurant — it’s an experience. Between the impeccable service, the enchanting riverside setting, and the surprise visit from a curious manatee, our evening was nothing short of magical. We’ll be back, and next time, we’ll bring friends to share in the them.

author: Melvin “Mel” Tang
review_text: The standard like drop liao leh. Rice has nearly zero lemak taste.. prawn taste like frozen kind. Saving grace is the chicken wing, otah and ah zhar.

author: Ti Na
review_text: Don’t judge a book by its cover. From the outside, you question if you’ve come to the right place but don’t let that fool you,the food is great! Highly recommend a reservation. When you walk in, you’ll be greeted by the pizza oven and staff. Atmosphere is cozy, low light with candles on the table. We had a salad to start along with olives and meatballs. All were good and large enough to share. The pizza is Neapolitan style. Crust is very good, soft with the slightest crunch and char. Sauce is good and toppings of sausage and meatballs are flavorful. Staff were attentive and very nice. They’ll box up your left overs for you too. Will return.

author: Danial Durrani
review_text: The spot to go for halal char kway teow. I come here at least once a week. The medium size portion is super filling and full of cockles. Do stop by to support this bro.

author: Boonwei Koh
review_text: Overrated food, no chilli sauce for the meat and the orange juice is very stingy portion. Wanton noodle taste is below average.

author: Jean Tan
review_text: Came for breakfast and lunch separately on the same day. Only remembered to take photos for my lunch. Had the Peruvian chicken and rose penne with salmon. Both are great especially the chicken that was paired with a jalapeño sauce that packs power!

author: Alex Was There
review_text: One of best hookah place in Miami in terms of quality of the hookah product, atmosphere and service. Their signature Hubble Bubble tea is also one of the kind. This place was recently reconstructed and has a much better vibe now. 8 out of 10 overall.

author: Patrick S
review_text: The food was great and fast, I'm not sure for why the scores at this location are low, might be hard to keep up during busy times but everything was great for us.

author: Ng ys
review_text: Food is good , very fast working when theres so much customer, thats why no need to queue for long . Xiu mai , har gao, lao sha bao is the best !!! Bk kut teh taste diff from kl, must try

author: Elfinaa Elfinaa
review_text: hi,, I have eaten at this uncle's shop. My husband and I come from Kulai, Johor, Malaysia. This uncle's story really inspires us to become true Muslims.The stall is very clean.Uncle was welcoming us and very friendly to us.The char kuey teow is Good and delicious.Thanks uncle and May Allah protect and love you always..hidayah milik Allah SWT…

author: PammyxPamela
review_text: It was my first time coming to green street cafe and I brought my family along as they are here on vacation. I had the pleasure of having Zoe as our server she was amazing and told us her favorite entrees and appetizers as we were unsure what to order. She was very attentive, super friendly, and welcoming. Thank you to Zoe we will be back here again. Very enjoyable experience. We will be asking for Zoe next time we come back. Thank you green street cafe.

author: Andrew Vazquez
review_text: Workers were kind I understood were they were coming from very friendly

author: Viet Nguyen
review_text: We discovered this place after trying a few banh mi joints around, including the famous Banh Mi Ba Huynh. This place has a wider selection and their banh mi is better IMO. 45K for the a normal size banh mi to $55K for the larger size. Hands down its the best banh mi I've had so far. Definitely worth trying if you havent yet.

author: Cindy M
review_text: Went for early dinner on weeknight for Rodizio. WOULD NOT RECOMMEND this. Apparently we got lucky with beef rib that was cooked to medium (just as we would have requested if we were asked), Pichanna was next also lucky those 2 meats were awesome HOWEVER that's where it ends. Only offered sausage and chicken, filet wrapped in bacon (well done) and garlic steak also well done. When we requested to server "can we have meat medium" his reply "that is how it is already cooked" he followed with "not good during week, you should have called and requested medium meats" He did absolutely nothing to rectify the situation. So when I asked "do you have pineapple " he said "no we do not have pineapple during t week only on the weekends". We have been there for dinner on weekend and that is why when we were in area we chose to stop there again. We will not make that mistake again.

author: piglene
review_text: came here to complete some work. i think the chair is a bit painful to sit in for a long time. it was a bit difficult to find the cafe since it is through a small corridor and up the stairs but it really feels like a hidden gem. a friendly local street vendor had to help us and point us to the cafe to find it. plenty of electrical plugs available and the staff with provide you a multi plug if you need it! it is just the right temperature but gets really really noisy when it starts raining 😭 i enjoyed the food! the service is perfect for introverts. not much smiles and attention but they will help you immediately if you asked for it!

author: Georgina Leason
review_text: Came here and was so impressed, genuinely had incredible food, it was so delicious!! The staff were so friendly and spoke really good English. The space is so calming and welcoming, I really enjoyed it here. Thank you so so much! (Also haven’t been asked to do a review- this is a genuine original review, one of the only places who hasn’t asked for a review!)

author: Susanna Pettigrew
review_text: Nice, very peppery broth, really tender, soft ribs and nice side dishes. We had the salted veg and braised beancurd. Friendly aunty and good value for money. I would recommend.

author: Selva Murugan
review_text: Came in for a quick bite and the place was buzzing with a lot of quests. The food was neat and came quick. Ask for their specials and ensure they charge right

author: Sailalith Sarupuri
review_text: Visited this restaurant recently and I was blown away by the experience. With an extensive menu offering a variety of authentic Indonesian dishes, it's no wonder this place is always bustling. It's advisable to secure a reservation ahead of time. The food was an absolute delight, not only in taste but also in presentation. If you're in search of an unforgettable culinary adventure, this restaurant should be at the top of your list.

author: My
review_text: This restaurant is great, affordable, and delicious. I ordered a beef dish, and the slices were so thick and looked so satisfying! There was so much of it, and I couldn't believe it only cost 120,000 VND for such quality. I ate several other dishes and it didn't even cost 500,000 VND. The service was excellent, the restaurant was clean and spacious. I didn't expect a place in an alley to be this good. I'll definitely be back many times! 💕😚

author: Vaidesvari Naidu
review_text: The atmosphere was relaxed and inviting, perfect for a midday break. The staff were incredibly friendly and made great recommendations. Service was quick without feeling rushed, and the food came out hot and well-presented.Prices were fair for the quality, and portion sizes were just right.

author: Reza Nia
review_text: We had been long waiting for the opportunity to try Eyval, and it turned out to be a delightful experience overall. The ambiance was warm and inviting, and the servers were incredibly friendly and attentive. The food was a mix of good and fantastic. The lamb ribs were absolutely out of this world. Chenjeh was also fantastic. For both dishes, I would happily give them more than five stars if I could. Koobideh was good, on the upper side of good, I would rate it 4.5 stars. Ghormeh sabzi and tahdig were both below my expectations, I gave them 4 stars. Overall, the restaurant experience was more of a 4.5 to 4, but I had to choose between 4 and 5 stars, it would definitely be 4. I will definitely return if it’s only for the lamb ribs!

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Alexa Gonzalez
review_text: This place is so good!! I love the food🌚 Honestly it is so worth the money! You get to eat as much as you want and the meat is really good quality!! The staff is really kind. They check up on you and overall real sweet. The atmosphere is calm and chill. Very lively with all the people enjoying their food. I brought my friends here and they liked it too

author: 민트초코
review_text: We had a really great experience at Pizza 4P’s Indochina Da Nang! From the moment we walked in, the staff greeted us with warm smiles and friendly service that made us feel welcome right away. The team was attentive without being pushy, and their positive attitude set the tone for the whole meal. We ordered the Burrata Cheese Salad & Margherita pizza (half and half) — and wow, it did not disappoint. The burrata cheese was super creamy and fresh, beautifully paired with the vibrant salad toppings. The Margherita side was classic and perfectly balanced with rich tomato, and just the right amount of cheese. The crust was crisp on the outside but soft and chewy inside — honestly one of the best pizzas I’ve had in Da Nang. Overall, the combination of delicious food and genuinely friendly service made this a standout meal. Highly recommend stopping by if you’re in the area!

author: leonel renteria
review_text: Place was off the charts amazing. One server and runner for about 9-10 tables. The sushi chefs and serving staff did amazing tonight. I didn't get their names but visited on Sat December 20th at about 5pm for dinner service! Never waited very long for anything and the one server and runner did amazing with as many tables that they had. Regret not taking any photos!

author: MiMi T
review_text: Super good food alr server havent used and also atmosphere so good i take pics all the time

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: WILSON WONG
review_text: Fantastic! Very good beef noodle, very good french bread, very good spring roll, great Vietnamese coffee, sooooooo yummy! Just love it 👏🏻👏🏻

author: David Bello
review_text: I recently dined at your restaurant and had a fantastic experience. The food and atmosphere were excellent, and the staff's warmth and friendliness added to the enjoyment. Special thanks to Carolina for ensuring everything was perfect. I highly recommend your restaurant to everyone. Keep up the great work!

author: J-Ho S. C.
review_text: The best Sang Mee in Prai. Highly RECONMENDED!! Just.. You need come early.. Else, you need Q for quite some times to get your food. Up to half an hour. Parking also an issue here. So, kindly park at another block of shop and walk here. Else, you will stuck here, due to those brainless customers that simply park beside the road.

author: Audreanna
review_text: Some dishes were fantastic while others weren’t. The summer squash was drowning in Beurre Blanc and rather gross. The fried crab was soggy. The pork shoulder was delicious. The service was overall good but slow. Their wine selection is one of my favorite things about the experiences. Overall I found the four horsemen to be mid for this type of restaurant and expectation.

author: Hs Auto
review_text: Nice food and serve with big portion.. worth coming to eat very authentic Hainanese boneless chicken rice

author: Ray Mendez
review_text: I fell in love with this place. The food? Absolutely exquisite! every bite tastes like Venezuela itself, rich, soulful, and made with love. The papelón? To die for, sweet like a memory you never want to let go of. And for my birthday, they surprised me with a golfeado.. soft, warm, and sweeter than the gesture itself. The people here aren’t just kind, they’re tender, genuine souls who make you feel at home the second you walk in. This week alone, I’ve already been twice that’s how good it is. It’s not just a restaurant; it’s a little piece of home, a hug disguised as a meal.

author: Lily Newman-Kelly
review_text: Absolutely incredible dining experience - the team were incredibly helpful and seated me in a wonderful table despite not having a prior booking. The food and drinks were outstanding - one of the best meals I’ve had out! Thanks particularly to Listia and also the main hosts who were very proactive and cautious regarding my nut allergies. Would highly recommend to anyone in the area and would love to come back!

author: Mathurada Saisema (Smilesm_zx)
review_text: I came here on my holiday. Nice place which nearby our hotel. Food also yummy. I like the chicken popcorn 🦋🦋

author: Michael Daniels
review_text: Burger was solid, worth getting again. Pad Thai worked well with tofu (replaced instead of egg). Gnocchi and affogato both were good picks. Portion sizes were more European (not oversized, not tiny). Only miss was the hummus, not worth the price, would skip next time

author: Christian G
review_text: Wow!! What a great find!!! Food was amazing, servers were even better. This is a hidden GEM in NJ. Highly recommend you visit and enjoy the high quality food. I ordered the skirt steak and parrilla. Bought some wine and the waiters were very attentive. Absolutely loved this place.

author: Alibi McJohnson
review_text: I had a great experience today. I ordered fried rice and it took longer than expected; I had time so I wasn’t worried. They brought me some fried chicken free of charge to make up for the wait (that I wasn’t even complaining about). Great service and a very welcome touch from management

author: Lindsay L. Bigby
review_text: Place was pretty slow though it was peak lunch time. I had a hard time finding my plate for the first round because most things looked dried out or I recognizable. A few months back it was decent. Hoping it's a bad day vs a trend.

author: Erin Russell
review_text: Great donuts, atmosphere & super friendly staff. They offer tons of different donuts, croissants and coffees.

author: Leslie Schmerfeld
review_text: Eggs Benny was amazing! paired with rich smoked salmon and perfectly seasoned potatoes. Front hosts were very kind but need to work on communication and better flow. Our seat was moved twice. The food and drinks came out super quick!

author: Magna Gopal
review_text: Super cute café, off the beaten path in Newark. Great ambience and music in a huge open and eclectic space. Food was pretty good - had the stuffed French toast & chicken and waffles.

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: Vytautas Majauskas
review_text: It is easily one of the best places I’ve eaten at in Chiang Mai. Once I discovered it, I ended up coming back every single day during my trip. Their beef and chicken dishes were my absolute favorites: rich flavor, great texture, and consistently delicious. I also tried their recommended daily special, the catfish, but personally, I wouldn’t suggest picking that one. Everything else, though, was outstanding. They also have an amazing selection of soups, each packed with depth and authentic Thai flavors. The staff here is always attentive and friendly, and there are plenty of them, so the service is quick and smooth every time. If you’re in Chiang Mai and want genuinely great Thai cuisine, this place should be at the top of your list.

author: Sue
review_text: Probably one of the best chocolate croissants I’ve ever had! Incredibly flaky and the chocolate inside is incredibly smooth and rich. Decent latte as well.

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Philip Cheng
review_text: Lisa is a very service oriented crew and she really serve us with her whole heart! Kudos for Lisa! The food is extremely nice and the portion is big! I definitely will come here again for sure!

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: B
review_text: The atmosphere reminds me of my grandmother's house. The food is delicious and the coffee tastes good.

author: Becky Deitenbeck
review_text: Need to READ the order. I ordered 1/2 sweet/ 1/2 unsweetened ice tea via the mobile app. When I arrived 45 minutes later, the order wasn't made yet and it was wrong. I received all Unsweet tea with NO ice!! Will not be back! Double check your order before you leave!

author: abe valdez
review_text: The prices are all different. When you go to their website its a price, when you call for delivery, its a different price, when you walk in and actually sit down, its a different price. I informed a worker that the prices are ALL different and she told me that "Everything has gone up".. please be consistent.

author: Bas
review_text: Good food. Need a little clean up on the window, kind of dirty, wherr we sit.

author: Sofia Elizabeth Schumo Chwe
review_text: Lovely ambience with a cozy and modern vibe. The sushi is fresh and nicely presented. The staff were attentive and polite, making the whole experience enjoyable. A pleasant place to visit in Miami.

author: Nat E
review_text: Such a cool concept! Everything is gold! Just wish they had some gear to buy in store to take as a souvenir for us visitors. The service was not as great as what I am used to in Texas, where I live but it was ok. Food was also not as fresh but I came in at 10pm (they close at midnight) so maybe that’s why? Overall I would recommend to visit just to check it out if you happen to be in the area.

author: Rebecca McCall
review_text: Worth the wait! The drinks, the decor, WOW. Highly recommend the Brussels sprouts. The saffron cream sauce this sit in is TO DIE. ❤️💚 Friends were out of town, so I went alone anyway and didn’t regret it.

author: Mark Lim
review_text: Segar@Chinatown – A Second Date with Zi-Char Comfort Second round at Segar@Chinatown Point and it didn’t disappoint. Nestled on Basement 2, this Halal zi-char spot remains a go-to for good portions, wallet-friendly prices, and consistently hearty flavours. For this visit, we polished off a couple of comfort classics: • Seafood E-Mee: Springy e-meng noodles enveloped in a savoury, umami-packed seafood broth—perfectly slurpable and deeply satisfying. • Beef Fried Rice, plus an extra egg: generous, golden-fried rice with tender beef slices and that extra egg yolk melding through each grain with a rich, glossy finish. A heaping portion for just about S$6.70 especially good bang for your buck￼. • A shared A&W Root Beer to wash it all down—a fizzy hit of nostalgia that caps the meal perfectly . First-time takeaway? The dark seafood Hokkien mee made it back for our “first lamppost at home” dinner later—rich in wok hei, peppery, saucy, and just begging for an extra squirt of chili. #SegarAtChinatown #ChinatownPoint #SingaporeEats #ZiCharLove #TzeChar #FoodieSG #SgFoodie #EatbookSG #SgFood #FoodieAdventures #HalalEatsSG #SingaporeFoodies #WokHei #FoodstagramSG #SgFoodDiary #LocalEatsSG #BeefFriedRice #SeafoodEMee #HokkienMeeLove #FoodieLifeSG

author: Kirk LEE
review_text: The dining is spacious and clean, there is a wide variety of Vietnamese food, and the seafood is delicious.

author: Elisabeth Ivanov
review_text: Zum Stammtisch is a great spot. The food’s hearty and full of flavor — the schnitzel and sausages were excellent. Big portions and cold beer make it even better. The place has a warm, old-school vibe and friendly service. Feels like a classic neighborhood spot. I’ll definitely be back.

author: Balaji Thiyagarajan
review_text: Orchis Food Court at Changi Airport is a fantastic culinary spot that offers an impressive variety of local and international dishes in a convenient and comfortable setting. It’s perfect for travelers who want to enjoy a delicious meal without leaving the airport. The food court is spacious and clean, with plenty of seating options that accommodate solo diners, families, and groups. One of the best things about Orchis Food Court is the wide selection of food stalls, serving everything from comforting local Singaporean favorites like Hainanese chicken rice and laksa to diverse Asian and Western dishes. The food quality is consistently good, with fresh ingredients and authentic flavors that satisfy cravings and provide a memorable dining experience. Prices are reasonable, especially considering the prime airport location, making it a great value for both quick bites and leisurely meals before or after flights. The atmosphere is lively yet relaxed, with friendly service from the vendors. It’s a convenient place to refuel, whether during a layover or before departure, and the variety means there’s something for everyone. For those looking to sample Singapore’s famous food without venturing far, Orchis Food Court is a reliable and tasty choice right inside Changi Airport.

author: Cherry
review_text: I always come back here, love their shakes, especially the Monkey Magic, which is sublime. The breakfast menu is fairly typical, but everything is executed really well. Cozy, friendly spot that never disappoints.

author: Adam Lambert
review_text: God they have 1 place to take peoples order and it takes them 45 minutes to take 1 persons order. 0 stars don’t waste your time

author: Alice Woo
review_text: We wanted to try some Wanton Noodles and stopped by Nanyuan Noodle Restaurant for lunch. We ordered a few bowls of Egg Noodle with Shrimp Wanton and Roast Pork, Steam Rice with Roast Pork, Steam Rice with Roast Duck (comes with pickled ginger, half hard boiled egg and cucumber slices), Steam Rice with Roast Pork & Bbq Pork and Egg Noodle with Roast Duck, Roast Pork, Bbq Pork, Shrimp Wanton & Fishball. Both the noodles and rice dishes tasted delicious! The noodles were chewy and the meats were cooked to perfection and tasted so flavourful. They also have dimsum but we only ordered the Steamed Taro Buns, which were a bit too sweet for us. Overall, lunch was delicious and satisfying!

author: Talise Berry
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Black-Owned & Full of Flavor! Taste Budz Creole Kitchen is the real deal! The shrimp, mac & cheese, and collard greens were all seasoned to perfection — pure soul in every bite. The seafood Alfredo bake potato was rich, creamy, and loaded with flavor. The staff was FRIENDLY and the vibe felt like home. If you’re in Las Vegas or Phoenix, do yourself a favor and stop by — this is Black-owned excellence done right! 🙌🏾🔥

author: Julie Geng
review_text: This was my third visit to The Four Horsemen since June 2024, and sadly, it was a sharp departure from the consistently excellent experiences I’ve had in the past. The quality of the food has noticeably declined. They no longer serve the signature seared yellowfin tuna. The skewer was aggressively spicy, overwhelming rather than enhancing the flavor. The Gen clam dish came across as bland. The swordfish was dry and overcooked. Even the egg appetizer that people rave about felt uninspired. Equally disappointing was the service behind the bar. The bartenders were visibly drinking while serving us, and one even spat into the sink right in front of us while we were eating. That kind of disregard for basic professionalism and hygiene. It’s disheartening to see such a reputable place slip so far in both culinary quality and hospitality. I hope this was an off night, but given the steep drop in standards, I’m hesitant to return anytime

author: T greensake
review_text: 01/November/2025 Takeaway only. Bought the pandan & custard version, was extremely delicious. My regular snacks when I visit Bangkok. This kiosk is located next to the Novotel Siam Square front entrance.

author: Yusuf Nasrullah
review_text: Fantastic place actually! Nice hot food with great crabmeat, fried shrimp, beef with scallions, hot and sour soup and fried rice. Very nice desserts and fresh fruits for dessert. Good price for a lot of food, comfortable air conditioning and hanging out with a group of hungry friends!

author: Mike Sperando
review_text: Elephante was one of those restaurants that instantly stood out when searching for top Italian spots in the area. I can confidently say this experience was an absolute 10/10 from start to finish. I started with the Caesar salad and ordered the vodka sauce pasta. The Caesar was incredibly flavorful and generously portioned, and the vodka sauce pasta had some of the best flavor I’ve had in a long time — easily the standout of the meal. We sat outside by the window, which was perfect, but the indoor space is just as impressive. The interior has a bright, airy vibe that almost feels like something you’d find in Arizona (even though I’ve never been there), which made the atmosphere feel unique and memorable. I would go back to Elephante again and again without hesitation. This was my first real meal and true taste of Los Angeles, and I couldn’t have picked a better place to start.

author: Jessica M
review_text: I love Pio Pio and have eaten at several of their locations — Long Island, Manhattan, and Jackson Heights. The food was delicious, the chicken super fresh, and that green hot sauce 👌🏽. My only complaint is about the host or manager (not sure of his exact position) — he was extremely rude. The restaurant was mostly empty when we arrived around 8:30 p.m., maybe 10% full, yet he made us wait because he didn’t want to combine a few tables. Thankfully, the waiters were amazing — very attentive and super nice, which made up for the bad first impression.

author: Phimyada P
review_text: Car parking: side road In door seat: 5 tables each table for 3-4 people Out door seat: 2 tables, all about 8-10 seats The menu is big compared to the shop’s size. The price is reasonable. Food presentation was photogenic. The taste was fine. Doesn’t that wow for me Seems like the staffs were busy or else. I cannot feel that they were welcome the customer. However, they sure worked fast. I dunno a bit smile wouldn’t hurt, right?

author: Alan Wong
review_text: Very good Chinese food (Cantonese) here and they have Live Band as well. Recommended.

author: joyce lee
review_text: The food here is scrumptious. We ordered the shrimp tomyam, seafood fried rice (be prepared as a serving for 1 is incredibly small but is full of punch), a Northern and Eastern sausage, omelette, sticky rice, catfish salad and drinks for 3. Total was THB650. The tomyam was really good and full of prawns. Same with the fried rice. Definitely a place to return to next trip.

author: Latrone Huggins
review_text: Was an upscale feel with a down to earth staff that attend to our every need. The atmosphere was very comfortable and music was beautiful. A very nice outing for sure.

author: K C
review_text: Great place for nice food. Especially Gan's Yong Tou Foo which I always support. Of course there's also other great food to try out too.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Duyet Bui
review_text: Bun moc ok, but buy to go will come back to try other dishes, seems ok

author: Banana
review_text: If you're looking for a Vietnamese shabu-shabu experience with a local twist, this is the place to go. The broth is especially delicious. The meat wrapped in a thin layer of scallion is also delicious.

author: MOE JARADAT
review_text: What an unfortunate situation — this restaurant was on my bucket list. Unfortunately, the experience was spoiled by the less-than-professional behavior of Natalia. That said, the restaurant itself tells a wonderful story, backed by an amazing menu. The atmosphere truly reflects and supports the spirit of the people of the land. Special thanks to Susan, who made things better for us. Constructive note: Please avoid serving Arabic coffee in a glass tea cup — you know the culture better than that

author: Francelia Maurell
review_text: We had such a great experience at Green Street thanks to our server Desire. I came in with my mom my husband and my children, and she was absolutely amazing super attentive, kind, and patient. She went out of her way to make my children feel special, which meant so much to me as a mom. Our drinks and food were always taken care of, and she made the whole experience feel relaxed and enjoyable. Excellent service like hers truly makes a difference. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Julianna Diaz
review_text: Nicki Jam's restaurant. I thought the whole time I was going to see Puerto Rican food, but to be honest, I think it's more Venezuelan food. It's very tasty. The arepitas with cheese are delicious, and the arepa with beef is delicious. Everything was great. It's best to make a reservation, especially if it's the weekend, because there's usually a wait time.

author: Kina R.
review_text: I’d rate it a 5, but the teriyaki chicken was a bit bland, although fresh, but lacks sauce/flavor. The orange chicken was good, but my fav was the kung pao chicken for sure! I got a 2 item plate and 3 item plate with half noodles and half rice and spent about $23 and some change so not bad at all! They are generous with their portions so this easily fed my family of 5. I will say, the wait time is no joke! They’re super busy so I get it. I went during dinner time and arrived at about 5:47 and got out of there at 6:52! The line was all the way to the back and because they make the food fresh as they run out, many people had to wait for one of their items to be ready, like my orange chicken. I’d definitely recommend it to others, but probably won’t go back until the hype dies down and it doesn’t take so long. After all, it’s meant to be take out “fast Chinese food”.

author: KH Seh
review_text: The glass noodle with prawn is tasty. Recommended to try. Tomyam broth taste authentic. Lime steamed fish if slight more sour will be the best. Overall is great.

author: Joann Ting
review_text: The first dish of peanut butter noodles dampened my anticipation for the food. The noodles were a mess and tasteless. The other food tasted also not good. Hope it can be improved.

author: Bien Claro Blanco
review_text: I tried this and was REALLY DISAPPOINTED. DEFINITELY NOT RECOMMENDED. I waited for a while and the chicken rice was poorly served — for $5.30, I got a small, unappetizing portion with no soup, and not even any cucumber. Local vendors still offer much better food quality and portion sizes.

author: Edwin Indera
review_text: Hidden Gem Unearthed - Redhill Food Centre Singapore! 🍲✨ Amidst the bustling city, I stumbled upon a culinary oasis at Redhill Food Centre. This unassuming hawker centre revealed a hidden gem - a delightful $1.5 chicken rice with a mouthwatering taste of soup. The flavors danced on my palate, leaving me pleasantly surprised by the incredible value and authentic taste. Redhill Food Centre is a treasure trove of local delights, where passionate hawkers craft affordable and delicious dishes that satisfy both the stomach and the soul. A true haven for foodies seeking a taste of Singapore's gastronomic delights without breaking the bank.

author: Ahri A
review_text: Amazing crispy skin. Garlic shrimp is delicious. Service is excellent and the attention paid to us was top notch. Pedro took great care of us. Coimbra is a flavor-packed experience you don’t want to miss. The citrus notes in the dishes cut through the richness of the fatty pork perfectly—it’s a match made in culinary heaven. Pair it all with a glass of their red sangria, and you’re in for a treat. Definitely try a bit of everything on the table! Pro tip: use the crispy pork skin to scoop up some rice and dip it into the salty, savory sauce. Don’t be afraid to get your hands messy—it’s all part of the fun and flavor.

author: Aryan Mahajan
review_text: Loved this place! fresh, delicious food with great vegan and gluten-free options. Beautiful, green, and peaceful ambience paired with genuinely lovely staff. Highly recommended

author: BREW
review_text: Triple George is on par with the best. We have never had a bad meal or experience. Todd makes the best drinks and his vibrant personality just adds even more fun to the experience. Tana is also amazing and so attentive to requests you really feel special. LOVE this place!!

author: Eugene Khoo
review_text: The bagels are so good, especially super mario. Price on the higher side but match the portion and quality. Highly recommended for white sesame bagel! Go early as the place has limited seating. The queue move quite fast and the service is good. Definitely will be back again.

author: Lydia Cheng
review_text: This is hands down the best bakery in the LA area. The pastries are a bit on the pricier side but they’re some of the best I’ve ever had. The chocolate almond croissant is a must order. It comes with three dark chocolate batons inside. They have a pretty good rotation of seasonal danishes as well. We loved the choco-latte!

author: Victor Khoo
review_text: Not a bad place for a hearty bowl of egg noodle soup with mixed meats, 2 prawn dumplings and a fish ball. This is the first time I’ve been here. Since I wasn’t sure which roast meat to have, I went for a little bit of each so I can sample and taste each of them. Crispy roast pork, bbq pork and roast duck. It turns out my favorite was the prawn dumplings.

author: Quang Chi Do
review_text: I chose Cam Thi when a foreign friend wanted to eat Vietnamese food because it has three things: 1. A true hidden gem of Saigon: I've always believed that how a restaurant "hides" itself is also part of the story. Cam Thi didn't choose the bustling facade of Ho Hao Hon Street. They chose a side alley off Alley 53. This isn't a coincidence; it's a deliberate experiential "architecture." You step into the small alley, and an old wooden house appears, a door completely separating you from the outside world. 2. A culture of "contact" through a shared meal: Instead of ordering individual dishes, we ordered a home-style meal. This is the most valuable "culture." We shared braised meat, picked from the same plate of stir-fried vegetables, sipped from the same bowl of crab and water spinach soup, and shared clams and rice crackers… 3. The space, the story, and the food are all meticulously prepared. I rank Cam Thi in the mid-range nostalgic segment. The price is very reasonable for an excellent experience right in District 1. It's more upscale than a typical casual eatery, but warmer and more intimate than fine dining at other famous restaurants they've visited. After the meal, my friend said, "This is not just a meal, this is a story." Cons: Very crowded during peak hours; people are wearing traditional Vietnamese long dresses and headscarves and taking tons of photos. If you want a quieter atmosphere, choose a time after 1:30 PM.

author: Jessica Coleman
review_text: Overall we were very disappointed with our experience. Our waiter seemed rushed and impatient. He rushed us when ordering and seemed annoyed when we needed something. The food was less than appetizing. The Cuban is apparently premade. My step dad asked to not have the relish on it and was told it’s premade and cannot be changed. It also didn’t taste good. The fries had no seasoning, the mashed potatoes seemed like instant potatoes, the snapper was ok but lacking flavor, and the crab dip was way overpriced for what it was. Overall I wouldn’t recommend dining here. We spent over $100 for 3 adults and 2 kids and McDonald’s would have been much better and less expensive.

author: Thanh Nguyên
review_text: The must-go place when arrived in Singapore. Hot porridge and well marinated frog becomes the best combination. Fried oyster with egg is should be tried also, but be careful if you dont like oily dishes. In conclusion, it is the best choice for a supper.

author: Nazmi Ridzuan
review_text: The food here is all delicious, staff are very friendly, and the prices are moderate. I personally buy dinner here every day.🫰🏻

author: Steven Pardalis
review_text: Been going to the Ironbound for 15 years and tonight’s meal was just pathetic. The service was a complete joke.
