Saw our waiter maybe 3 times, couldn’t get plates cleared, got given two separate bottles of empty ketchup, and didn’t even get to consider dessert because we never got a menu after waiting for 15 minutes. Two of us got lobsters that were barely a pound, overcooked, and had almost no meat. Really just disappointing overall. Go somewhere else.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: C J
review_text: The tom yum soup was absolutely bursting with flavor—spicy, tangy, and aromatic all at once. You could really taste the lemongrass, lime leaves, and galangal, giving it that signature Thai kick. The broth had just the right balance of heat and sourness, with meatballs and fresh mushrooms soaking up all the goodness. It was comforting, bold, and totally satisfying—each spoonful warmed me up and made me want more! The iced Americano Thai Tea was appropriately sweet, creamy, and super refreshing—exactly what I needed to cool down after the spicy soup. It had that rich, deep tea flavor with a hint of spice, perfectly balanced by the creamy condensed milk. Served over ice, it was smooth, flavorful, and honestly kind of addictive. The cafe does not have air conditioning. So maybe a little bit hot. But overall it is a great spot to enjoy local tomyam and thai tea!

author: Lumi Chuang
review_text: My husband and I visited Miami for the first time to get away from the Northern cold wave. It was only for a few days and wanted to try some Cuban food. I have severe gluten and dairy allergies so I researched online and this place kept coming up. We went a little after lunch, got seated inside, the music outside was soooo loud!! It was a little quieter inside, but not much. We ordered two appetizers and an entree to share. It took a while to get served, even to get some water, hardly any customers inside or outside. A lot of servers were just chatting and laughing around. Waited a little longer and a young woman came and asked what we wanted. I got a mocktail too and that came pretty fast, with whipped cream on top. I asked if that was whipped cream and she said yes, I gently reminded her I had a severe dairy allergy. She said no problem. I saw her tell the bartender and also saw the bartender roll her eyes, but got me another drink. Finally, food came, the plantains were tasty, everything else was just meh. That evening I was violently ill all night throwing up and going to the bathroom. My throat swelled up (the gluten part of my allergy), and the GI is my dairy allergy. Let’s just say it was a long night and the next day I was nauseated the whole day, couldn’t eat much. This is a note to the restaurant: when a client says they have an allergy, please, please educate your staff to know what not to do or do in the kitchen. Sure, you don’t need to serve us, just tell us, hey, there’s nothing for you here. Friends and family always ask us where we should all meet up for lunch/dinner, because of our allergies. We won’t pick your restaurant, just let us know. No one owes us a cooked meal, I get it, we just need to be told so we don’t suffer while on vacation. Thank you! I don’t usually write reviews, but I will now because people like me, with different allergies, need to be informed. If you have allergies, give this spot a miss. Even if you don’t, the food wasn’t all that great. I’ve had better Cuban food.

author: oXRYSTALo Ong
review_text: BM Yam Rice Kopitiam: A Delicious Dive into Dannok Dim Sum in Bukit Mertajam (4/5 Stars) Rating: • Food: 4/5 (Delicious and authentic Dannok Dim Sum, with standout dishes like the Yam rice, pig organ soup, and braised pig trotter) • Service: 3/5 (Friendly and efficient, but could be more attentive) • Ambiance: 4/5 (Casual and welcoming atmosphere, perfect for a relaxed meal with friends) • Value: 4/5 (Reasonable prices for the quality of food) Overall: 4/5 Alright folk, Recently, Donkey & I with a group of friends made the trip to BM Yam Rice Kopitiam, a popular Dannok Dim Sum spot located at 7, Jalan Murthy, 14000 Bukit Mertajam, Pulau Pinang, Malaysia. We were eager to try their authentic Dannok Dim Sum, and we weren't disappointed! The highlight of our meal was definitely the pig organ soup, which was flavorful and comforting. The braised pig trotter and braised intestine were also incredibly delicious, cooked to perfection and bursting with flavor. But for me, the star of the show was the Yam rice. It was simply divine! The unique blend of flavors and textures was truly satisfying, making it a dish I would highly recommend. The atmosphere at BM Yam Rice Kopitiam was casual and welcoming, perfect for a relaxed meal with friends. The service was friendly and efficient, and the prices were reasonable for the quality of the food. Overall, I would highly recommend BM Yam Rice Kopitiam to anyone looking for a taste of authentic Dannok Dim Sum in Bukit Mertajam. The pig organ soup, braised pig trotter, and braised intestine are all worth trying, but the Yam rice is a must-order! Their service was ok too.

author: Olga Kiseleva
review_text: Mooo Seaport is an elegant and beautifully designed place where everything feels refined and upscale. The experience starts with a warmly smiling hostess and ends with the sweetest busgirl — the service is truly top-tier. As a lover of great food, I can honestly say this spot alone is reason enough to come back to the city. The steak tartare and bone marrow are among the best I’ve ever had. The tartare has that deep, slightly smoky flavor of perfectly aged meat, and the bone marrow — served under a crispy crust with roasted garlic — is simply unforgettable. If you go, you must try these two. Just pace yourself — the fresh bread is delicious and fragrant, but don’t fill up on it or you won’t have room! The side of mushrooms is also a standout, and everything else holds up to the same high standard. And please, don’t skip the crème brûlée — leave room for this dessert. It's the perfect finish to a truly memorable meal.

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: TheSeanEdit
review_text: Tried their prawn noodles and hokkien mee. Prawn noodles’ broth was very sweet due to the prawns, bones and other secret ingredients. I love how they separated the noodles in a bowl from its soup of goodness. Will go back just for that. Hokkien mee was generous in prawn serving. It doesn’t come with lime for that tangy complete taste. Can tell good broth was used but felt a little flat and too mushy. Overall, I will swing by again to try it again.

author: Mike Fitzpatrick
review_text: The bartender was wicked awesome. She was so incredibly friendly, attentive. The place is clean (the floor can be slick , due to the type of floor), and the little food I had was good. If you are sitting at the indoor side of the bar, and someone on the outside side of the bar is smoking, it blows into the indoor folks. Doesn't bother me personally, but it may bother some. Also a very good beer selection. Dogfish Head, Funky Budha, etc. About 20-25 beers. All bottles, no draft.

author: Lyza P
review_text: July 2025 visit This was recommended to me in 2023 by our tour guide, and I forgot the flavor he suggested. So, my cousin and I ordered "EXTRA MIXED MEATS," which was a disaster - it had I think some sort of Liver spread or taste? Which I do not eat. Should've stuck with pork BBQ or roast pork and read the reviews instead of going to the top order. Kind of ruined the Bahn Mi experience for both of us. Atmosphere is great though and there weren't a lot of people at 9 AM.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Sazali M Salleh
review_text: This Padang styled restaurant is a must try for all visitors to Jakarta. In fact, there are a few outlets carrying the Pagi Sore brand, but we specially decided to choose this particular one, on our way to the airport, before we fly back to KL. Najwa had been mentioning the name ever since day 1, but our itinerary had been quite packed throughout our soujourn in Jakarta. Hence, it was such a great opportunity to be able to try it on our very last day. We have tried plenty of Nasi Padang restaurants before, the Simpang Tiga restaurants in Medan and Ipoh, as well as the various Rumah Sederhana outlets in Malaysia. But Pagi Sore is distinctly unique. Upon our arrival, we were quickly ushered to our Table for 4, and as we were sitting down, some foods were also being continuously piled up on our table. I know that we would be charged only for those we actually ate, but the delectable spread being presented in front of our eyes were very hard to resist!! So, some ground rules needed to be established to ensure we didnt encourage any wastages. This was a major challenge for Daniel, ad he was so used to finishing all the leftovers!! I just couldnt resist the huge Fresh Water Prawn which was staring directly at my face, and decided to do justice to it. My wife and Najwa loved the Ayam Bumbu Putih, the Chicken with White Gravy, and I also found that dish to be marvelously delicious too. Daniel and I ended up finishing a plate of what looked like some crackers, which actually turned out to be Keropok Kulit Sapi, or Cow's Hide crackers...go figure.. All in all, it was such a fullfilling lunch, and Najwa settled the bills with a big smile, as the cost was very agreable to her. Obviously, I would happily recommend this restaurant to others..

author: Sandra Chavez
review_text: Food is fresh and good. Came for dinner, had the fried chicken dinner, plate is enough for 2. The box burger especial they have for 8.99 doesn't include drink but it's good. Restaurant is clean and the cashier is such a nice guy.

author: Leah J
review_text: Reviews say service is slow, but Collin was all over and never left us sitting long. He was taking care of everyone and the bar and was going non stop. We had the pleasure of, also, interacting with Raul and he added to our pleasant experience! Too bad we are just visitors because this place would be a regular for me!

author: Aegean Sea
review_text: This is the best Chinese food in Los Angeles . Thee shrimp fried rice is incredible all of the food is extremely delicious when you walk in you can smell the food you do not smell any kind of sour or fermentation in the air. I promise you you will love this place and the ladies are wonderfully polite.

author: Artur Pytel
review_text: I just love local places like this one. You need to pass a labyrinth of side streets but it's an adventure worth taking. Food is prepared by a local elderly couple, the guy speaks English, prices are very low and food tastes great. For all on the picture I paid 65k VND, including beer of course.

author: Jenny T
review_text: Overall the chicken quesadilla was the best dish. The nachos would have been nicer if they didn’t forget to add the guacamole and I didn’t realise until I looked at another review with it on it. So make sure you check that the guacamole is on the nachos if you ask to have the same dish as pictured!! The burrito was just average, nothing special. I loved the margarita!! Favourite I have had to date. The setting is nice would come again.

author: Johnnie Gold
review_text: Ordered food from here via Uber Eats. They had a Buy1 get 1 free on Jerk Chicken. I am Jamaican. This place did not disappoint. The food was fresh and flavourful. I was surprised at how fast it was delivered to my hotel. From the pictures online, they restaurant seems new and clean.

author: Elissa Massiel
review_text: We love this sushi.. But the place needs attention in cleaning, and better atmosphere. It's better not to eat there. I recommend only order to go.

author: Charlene Elizabeth Clark
review_text: Celebrated a Repass Here and It Was My First Experience and It Was Amazing, Can't Wait 2 Revisit and Be An Actual Customer.. Staff was So Amazing All Out Food Was Free and I Still Left a $30 Tip Chicken Wings Were Bussin 9/10 Cannied Yams 8/10 Greens 💚 8.5/10 Can't Wait 2 Customize My Own Plate 2 Eat

author: Jay Kim
review_text: Got there super as they opened and our waitress was really nice. Ordered the dinner version of the ayce for two. Food was good and I enjoyed it for an ayce spot. I loved that my rolls were not mostly rice ... but the fish slices were quite thin for my liking so it was a borderline wash for me. As I mentioned that my waitress was super nice and was very attentive, however, some of my orders were never fulfilled (but I did not mention this to my waitress). Service would have been a 5 out of 5 but since several dishes I ordered were unaccounted for and still a little hungry at the end of my 90 mins,tis why I have the service a 4 out of 5. Taste wise, I would give this spot a 3 out of 5 (as a sushi snob) but accounting for value, how quick my food came out, and overall the service with a beautiful smile, I gave it a 4. Would I come back? I would probably revisit this spot but with less expectations. Our total with drinks came out to be roughly $115 ish and left a $20+ tip.

author: Justin Wong
review_text: Their Nam Tok is out of the world, how they make the meat so crunchy, chewy and tender at the sametime is out of my mind. Best savour every cjew to bring out the favor, take your time, don't cone when you rushing. The Sai Oua & Sai krok Isan also pretty good.

author: Ino Iljas
review_text: A very fancy Indonesian restaurant, the food was good, the vibe of the resto was also nice, for parking we have to use valet service because they have a very limited parking space.

author: Zhip Phow
review_text: You must have the Salmon Carpaccio and the Larb Chicken, $10 each! This wonderful place has $5 Drafts! Modern, Clean, Inviting, and Service IS Tops! The servers that made my day, Bird and Top, great Bros. A Draft one Must try is Cali Squeeze, sweet, and flavorful. Dont Pass By ... Stop In

author: Julie Siddiqi
review_text: Delicious food along with wonderful Moroccan hospitality. My first time in Boston from the UK. I came to eat after Friday prayers and loved every minute of the experience. I ordered a kebab wrap then was given Harira to try. All of it delicious. I highly recommend this place in every way!

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: laksanan klubtublung
review_text: The food is delicious and the portions are reasonable. It's not hard to find the restaurant.

author: Quoc Dung Phan
review_text: Chula 50 Kitchen is a great spot for tasty food at reasonable prices. The dishes are flavorful and well worth the cost, especially considering its convenient location near Chulalongkorn University and the Banthat Thong food street. The place is quite popular, so it can get very crowded during peak hours, and you may need to queue. The space is small, which makes it a bit hot and noisy, but overall it’s a solid choice for a quick and satisfying meal

author: Mohammad Ilham
review_text: to someone who may get lost finding this place, this restaurant is placed on L4 near an escalator. I ordered a labuan colada + mallacan nasi lemak mallacan nasi leak: the taste is good, however in my case the nasi uduk is said by the waiter thay the quality is bad so she offered me whether I want to seal it with original rice or not, but I opted for original rice. beef rendang beef is very soft and easy to bite but still maintain the texture of the beef. the prawn also taste excellent, because the texture is kinda soft but bouncy means the prawn is fresh. overall the taste I perfect, but - the nasi uduk. labuan colada: so this beverages consist of orange, coconut, and bananas. the combination is perfect, each of the component synergies each other and give an utterly new experience to me. however this drink is taste a little bit heavy, it's not thay fresh because of the bananas and coconut isn't designed for fresh taste at the first. the atmosphere is great and the waiters is very hospital. I ask whether they provide a single place (as I come alone) and turns out he gives me the entire table consist of 4 seats to me. overall it's a great experience.

author: Zoe
review_text: Western food beside fish soup stall located at the back after the toilet was bad and expensive , gave wrong order, ordered chicken chop, gave me chicken cutlet and the chicken cutlet was all bones and not much meat, I don’t recommend that western food stall. The western food stall at the front is much better. Overall hawker food at other stalls were good, I have visited the hawker almost everyday, that 1 star is for that western food stall

author: Dominique Guirand
review_text: Efereń was amazing, he helped me through and through and even helped me charge my computer while attending to busy guests. I got the beef kebab and it was 10/10 — also the matcha was amazing. Def a great study spot.

author: Alex
review_text: You might need to queue up after 7 pm even on a weekday as this restaurant is quite popular. Seems like the big prawns hor fun is a popular dish there and so we ordered it. The small portion is actually good for 2 to 4 person (if you're ordering other dishes to share) and it came with 2 big prawns cut into half. The claypot yong tau fu is also good with lots of ingredient. 9% GST and a 3% service charge will be added to your bill.

author: Rodney Yoswig
review_text: The only negative I have is they sat us at the bar saying it was the only thing available even though the whole time we we there they had empty tables. Food was good, my choice of wild mushroom flatbread didn't impress me. Wouldn't orde ot again, however plenty of others options to try.

author: Justin Koswara
review_text: Its so unfortunate a restaurant with such amazing food have staff with subpar attitudes. Slow service, unresponsive management teams who talk back. Such a shame that we wont be coming back after years of eating here with the family.

author: Yeow Sin Ho
review_text: This restaurant was listed as a Michelin Bib star so decided to try out during dinner time. I came here with a friend during dinner time at 7pm. There are lot of people but we managed to get a table in about 10 min. The service here is a bit slow as there is a huge dinner crowd. It took more than 15 min before the staff noticed that we haven order and came to take our order. We ordered a pancake, seafood fried rice and also others. The pancake was really delicious with the rice paper and sauce. The fried rice was well cooked as well.

author: Alejandra Ruiz
review_text: Everything was good except the manager who was training the cashier really ask to see my daughter ID to prove she was 12. I know people lie but even my daughter told her age and why lie about it. So that means if she was 9 or younger that would be ask too. Other than that it was a good.

author: Monica Edmonds-Wilson
review_text: I do not recommend for a delivery order. I am a long time customer and enjoy the food. There needs to be a quality control process to double check orders before going out. There is no excuse for wrong items and missing items for a delivery. Eat In and pickup only are fine. In 2024 almost 2025 restaurants need to ensure quality is experienced in all service options. Please do better.

author: Deisy Paxtor
review_text: Very nice people work in here. They have an amazing customer service. Food is great.

author: new York bangla
review_text: Prices are amazing for this authentic NY Style pizza! They have so many amazing toppings. Nice place, nice staff, nice atmosphere. Good prices. I would recommend buying a whole pie for cost effectiveness and eating in the restaurant so your food stays at the right level of heat. Can't recommend enough!

author: Phasoka Khiev
review_text: A big banh mi filled with good stuff. The bread is so crunchy and the fillings come with variety of deliciousness. One Banh mi can keep me full almost the whole day. Yummy 😋 It’s my 2nd time here, will come back more.

author: Gary Cooper
review_text: Highly recommend the curry goat, the staff is friendly and kind. We had the chicken shawarma wrap, falafel platter ,and the amazing curried goat all perfect. Please go , dine in and take it all in. Support this oustanding neighborhood spot.

author: I'm a pisces and love food
review_text: The 50's theme was fantastic. There is a car themed table, pictures of cars,and Elvis. The chocolate chip pancakes were good The severs were fast and kind. The prices are very good and low. The impression that I got was I would come back if I was in town. The oreo shake was big and good.

author: Melisa Lalalaa
review_text: This is my first time try a fish poke bowl. Taste so fresh, as Im not usually eating fish. The sauces helps so much.

author: Jack R
review_text: Regretted coming here yesterday for something to eat.Worst cook ever. I’d give negative rating. One rating is too good for them. Skewers burned on one side and pale almost uncooked on the flip side. Inside the chicken is still pink raw. Disgusting.Actual is worst than photo. Better food upstairs. Met a family who transited a couple of weeks back at harry ‘s and also shared their awful food experience. They were given a burger that was pink raw on the inside but burnt on the outside. But, the bacon on the burger was burnt! Bacon on ceasar salad was also burned. Pizza overbaked. Really too bad their kitchen is their weakest link. No quality control. Otherwise, this is a great place to unwind and have drink. Staff are pleasant. Change your kitchen staff.

author: MeeShan -Shane
review_text: Really like this cafe for the food and drink they been prepared. Good to experience and wonderful service with good food good mood and good place

author: Raymond Beh
review_text: The dim sum is very fresh, the taste is good as well, hence the high review online. Strongly recommand to try their bak kut teh, way above my expectation, as the dish is not a star within thailand. I would say that this is as good as some of the best bak kut teh in Malaysia. Must try dish here in Hatyai

author: Angie Roze
review_text: One of my favorite spots to go to… Great spot, amazing food and the staff is fantastic! Plus… the beach view. Can’t ask for more… 10/10 recommend.

author: ツLim
review_text: Zichar takes minimally 30 mins to prepare so be mentally ready, taste wise very bad for zichar too... drinks stall the drinks are SO DILUTED! Cannot taste any tea or coffee. I think the only good store here is the Western food

author: Ashley Pitchford
review_text: We spent an amazing day here on the last day of our travels. We arrived at 3:30pm with the view of staying until sunset but due to the wonderful service and relaxed atmosphere we stayed for dinner and drinks after sunset. Speaking of - the sunset was absolutely beautiful, highly recommend visiting for this alone if that’s all your budget allows. The staff were extremely attentive and customer focused, nothing was too much trouble. Dion and Andy were our servers and I cannot praise them enough. The food was fabulous, was had snacks when we arrived and then pizza for dinner (I was expecting to order the open flame cooked steak but they had already sold out by the time I ordered unfortunately, my own fault for not planning ahead). We had been to a couple of the other beach clubs in Canggu previously and they all pale in comparison to La Brisa in our opinion. This is much more grown up and sophisticated than the other Ibiza style clubs. The price was very reasonable for the experience. To book a table you have to meet a minimum spend limit but currently that amounts to around £50 GBP so if you’re planning on eating here then that’s easily achievable. We were quite lavish on this day so our spend per person is relatively high compared to the amount you would actually need to spend. If you want to feel like royalty for the day without breaking the bank then this stylish, elegant and beautiful beach front day club is exactly the place to visit.

author: Tatyana S
review_text: This coffee is insanely good! I live in San Francisco and love Blue Bottle coffee, which usually beats any other coffee shop for taste and atmosphere for me. I was absolutely blown away by Savor coffee and would choose it over Blue Bottle coffee now. My cappuccino had not only an amazing flavor but it was so smooth that I never imagined one could foam milk that well. I plan on grabbing another cup tomorrow morning before my flight. And btw the owner is a wonderful woman who truly cares and creates a great atmosphere too. Impressive!

author: John Happel
review_text: I had the palm latte and the valley girl (cream cheese and avocado on sourdough with cherry tomatoes, microgreens, and a balsamic drizzle). Both were delicious! Veronica (the owner) is very friendly and makes delicious food and drinks.

author: Neil May (Spartan Claim Resources)
review_text: Great selection. My vendors love it when I bring boxes to their offices. I bought this cute 3d printed spider for my grandson who is obsessed with jumping spiders.

author: Manny Negron
review_text: It has been roughly 1 year since I ate here. Wow how the place has changed. Ownership is definitely different. Customer service is cold and borderline rude. Food is rushed and it shows. This was a great little mom and pop spot years ago. Not anymore. What a shame.

author: Paramveer Singh
review_text: Amazing place overall and a must visit when in San Jose. They have a lot of places and small restaurants. I really loved the Indian restaurant and the small tarts and gelato ice cream. Must visit with your friends!

author: Kenneth Irons
review_text: We came across Tonchin while looking for Michelin starred or recommended restaurants in NYC. The moment I saw the Tonkotsu, I placed the reservation. We went last Thursday around 12:45pm for lunch. The wait, even with the reservation, was roughly 10 minutes, so not terrible. We each got the Chashu rice roll, Tonkotsu Ramen, and we shared the Curry Cheese wings along with the Gyoza. We spoke with the wait staff and found out that the restaurant originated in Ikebukuro, which made a lot of sense. Gyoza - Very traditional in flavor, reminded me of Gyoza in Tokyo. The shape is different than the traditional pleated style but the flavor remained wonderful. 8/10 Curry Cheese Wings - These were delicious. Brought to a perfect crisp, the skin was beautifully coated with the Japanese style curry powder and sprinkled with what appeared to be Parmesan cheese. Incredible overall and a pairing I hadn't considered before. A great way to elevate a classic dish. 9/10 Chashu Rice Roll - A unique take on Onigiri, maybe not perfect for delivery to the mouth, but allows significantly more filling (or in this case topping) to be included. The Chashu was delicious with a good amount of spice due to the spicy mayo. Some may find it "spicy", personally it was a 4/10 for spice which is exactly where I like my spice, with tons of flavor. 9/10 Tonchin Classic Tonkotsu - This was the closest ramen I've had in this country to traditional ramen in Japan. I don't say that lightly. The creamy texture of the broth, the perfect firmness of the ramen noodles, and the jammy egg cooked to perfection. If I had one complaint it would be that it didn't include thick sliced Chashu and rather had 3-4 thin slices. But the Chashu was incredibly falvorful so it didn't really matter. Not a drop was left in the bowl. Highly recommend if you want authentic Tonkotsu. 10/10 Overall a wonderful blend of traditional Japanese ramen with some hints of elevated NYC dining. And with a lunch menu that gets you a rice roll and ramen for $27, the price is more than reasonable. Can't recommend enough.

author: Richard Taveira
review_text: Cozy, delicious and friendly staff - worth coming back again and again.

author: Val
review_text: Best no nonsense breakfast in town! French toast is great, service is friendly, & they accept credit card. A neighborhood institution for a reason, just wish it was open Sunday!

author: Thanuj Pothula
review_text: We had a great time at LandShark Bar & Grill! The Cajun Shrimp was packed with flavor and had just the right amount of spice. The Uptown Top Shelf Margarita was smooth and refreshing, a perfect match with the food. Our waitress Ann was amazing—super friendly and attentive, which made the whole experience even better. Definitely a place I’d come back to! 🌟🍤🍹

author: W
review_text: Great food, we have the freshly baked chocolate cupcake, golden waffle, and pepper bacon sausage sandwich. Everything is tasty!

author: Pradipta Baskara
review_text: Ordered special fried rice which surprise me because they have bunga kantan on the nasi goreng. Fried rice is so tasty i really like it. The fried chicken is also crispy, juicy, and can taste the rempah also. Order the spicy fried rice but i dont feel any slight of spicy taste, haiyaa why so weak add more chili lah. The price itself is actually pretty ok and worth it (if i dont need to remember on how weak the Indonesia currency is). Oh and i love the package of the tissue.

author: Sammie Peters
review_text: I dont often review chains but wanted to give this place a quick shout-out. They have really wonderful management. I've been a few times and they are kind and helpful. Above and beyond. Its clean and spacious as well. Food is good as usual.

author: Kiran Seth
review_text: The cafe has indoors & outdoors seating with a view of the padi fields...so refreshing to have the green view instead of the concrete jungle! Had the avocado coffee, espresso shot on the side and served with ice cream. Guess one needs to acquire a taste for it. The truffle fries were well flavoured however not well fried as they were oily. The staff are friendly & attentive to patrons although they were house full. Do be prepared to wait for a seat.

author: Abiola Glory
review_text: The moment I walked in the atmosphere felt really nice and we immediately got served and put to our chairs.

author: St Francis
review_text: As far as I'm concerned, the positive reviews I read before I tried Lucky's, were right on the money💰. Everything looked fresh and delicious the first time I visited. I had just found my favorite Chinese food in South Los Angeles! That's why they get the 5 stars. The spring rolls are always fresh, crispy, and very tasty. .50 cents extra for sweet & sour sauce. The combination plates are delicious. Served with generous portions. You won't be disappointed ordering at Lucky's. Every time I go back I try new things and I am never disappointed.

author: AshtonY
review_text: Look for Uncle Kuah in the market for your plants and flowers needs. My go to shop if I'm in the area. Quality products with honest pricing and very friendly Uncle. You will not regret!

author: MAX POLOZANI
review_text: Best burger 🍔 joint around!! Great burgers & fries, awesome water views Highly recommend going for lunch or sunset

author: younes nabgouri
review_text: I tried today the Moroccan Lamb Tajine with caramlized sweet apricots. No Comment just an amazing delice . First authentic Moroccan place I visited in Boston

author: Tatianna Benitez
review_text: She gave me a cake saying happy birthday from your wife when it was supposed to be happy birthday from your husband and then she had the audacity to be snotty over the phone never getting a cake there not only other pricey she was rude and nasty on the phone

author: leslie yeoh
review_text: Nice restaurant with variety of food selections. Foods portion is just nice for 2 pax and price is reasonable. The staffs are friendly too.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Tâm Nguyễn Thị Thanh
review_text: Today I visited Kieu Bao Grilled Pork Noodles restaurant, but the experience wasn't good. Parking was full, so I had to drive deep into the alley and park and move my motorbike myself; no one helped. The staff were quite rude. When carrying food or clearing bowls, chopsticks, and spoons, they threw them into the trash can, creating a very unpleasant noise. The space was already noisy, and the service, which seemed to want to drive customers away, made the experience uncomfortable. The grilled pork was also slightly burnt. I hope the restaurant reviews its service and food quality, because having such an experience while eating out is really unacceptable.

author: Datashia Stansell Estes
review_text: We had an amazing time! I took my fiance here for his birthday yesterday and we had great food,service and drinks! Our waitress was so sweet and nice! I'm assuming the gentleman with the hat was the owner he got us seated very quickly and he was very kind. We felt very welcomed. Upon them knowing it was his birthday they came out singing and brought him a tequilla shot!! Very big menu 😋 very tasty! We will be back also great drink specials.

author: Denise Mata
review_text: Amazing barbacoa smell as soon as you walk through the door!! The barbacoa was great. Love the family atmosphere and the vibe of the whole place. Great portion sized meals and taste. Nice and friendly personal. Definitely coming back soon.

author: Ty Bridges
review_text: Messed up my order after asking multiple times for two meals. Ordered a burger and a chicken sandwich. Didn't come with the chicken sandwich but another of the same burger I ordered. Also the burgers are impossible to eat especially with the bag you are supposed to pick it up with. Like sonic and carls jr burgers can even be picked up better than this. Fries are great though. But most likely won't come back do to how expensive this place is for how crappy the burgers are.

author: Jason Leong
review_text: I've been coming to this yam rice shop since I was young, and I am truly happy that they got recognized by Michelin. They absolutely deserve it. Some people might say they've had better yam rice elsewhere, or that this place is overrated, and that's okay – everyone has their opinion. But in my mind, this is the hands-down best. The yam rice - steamed with dark soy sauce, loaded with yam and crispy shallots; The soup - packed with flavor, made with fermented vegetables, a variety of pork cuts (meatballs, organs), and finished with a sprinkle of fresh coriander (It's so delicious, you can get free refills, and trust me, most people do!); and, to complete the experience, there's a unique condiment – a chili paste mixed with dark soy sauce – that adds a complex touch while everything complements each other perfectly. They also offer some side dishes like braised tofu and egg in dark sauce, and braised pork knuckles. Don't expect fancy decor. The place is old-school and hasn't changed a bit since they moved to this premise. You come here for the amazing, affordable food, and that's it. With their delicious dishes and reasonable prices, anyone visiting Bukit Mertajam should definitely check them out.

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: Michael Fernandez
review_text: Kub Kao’ Kub Pla is a must try for all Thai cuisine fans. We passed this restaurant several times and every day we saw a long queue of people seated outside the restaurant. So the best time to come is around 11am when they just open so that you will be seated rather than wait for a table. Dishes ordered for lunch were : Deep Fried Baby Shrimps with Betel Leaves (Starter), Spicy Papaya Salad with Salted Egg, Stir Fried Melinjo Leaves with Eggs and Crab Meat Omelette. The Deep Fried Baby Shrimp is very flavourful, crispy bite sized shrimp morsels, fried to perfection and seasoned with herbs and spices. The inside is tender and succulent and it comes with a sweet and spicy peanut and cucumber sauce. The Papaya Sauce is a dish here that is not comparable to the Thai Papaya Salads in Singapore or Malaysia. This is the authentic Thai style where the papaya and ingredients are fresh and every bite is crunchy and refreshing. The tiny shrimps are tasty and crispy that you can eat the shells too. The salted egg gives it a nice ‘lift’. We enjoyed the simple yet flavourful Melinjo leaves stir fried with garlic. The slightly bitter taste blended well with the savoury eggs. The best dish on the table was the Crab Meat Omelette. Fluffy and tender filled with lumps of succulent crab meat. The sweetness of the crab meat complemented the wrapped fluffy yet crispy egg omelette. Never in my life have I eaten so much crab meat at one sitting ! The crab meat omelette was served with a sweet and sour sauce that enhances its taste. For dessert we had their Taro Pearls in sweet coconut milk which was served warm and had yam pearls, yam cubes and slices of coconut . The fresh mango & sticky rice, a truly Thai classic did not fail to please our taste buds. We will return to try the other offerings in their menu.

author: Seng Kang
review_text: I have visited numerous business-class airline lounges, some of which are cozy while others offer exceptionally refined service. The Qatar Airways lounge in Singapore is absolutely exquisite. The staff are highly professional and genuinely kind, and the drinks and food are simply perfect. I would especially like to extend my sincere thanks to Hazel, Montra, Stary, Alvin, Pinky, and Divan.

author: CB Architect-Builder
review_text: The food here is simply orgasmic! My son and I bought a diverse selection of dishes and loved every single one! Talk about food coma! Hope we can visit again sometime soon! There was a bit of a wait and line to get in as you’d imagine but it moved along and was worth it! The fact that it’s a food court takes away some of the “fine dining experience” and the interior of the place isn’t fancy at all but the food makes up for it! Pricing also seemed reasonable for the quality and flavor! Not being able to buy liquor (cocktails, beer or wine) also helps keep costs down. Anyway, highly recommend!!

author: Sindhuja Poorni
review_text: Had sweet cravings and visited Milk and Madu for breakfast. Pancakes awesome. French toast is a bit overwhelming and too sweet to handle. The milkshake and cappuccino were great. Great place for breakfast.

author: Andre E
review_text: I had such a wonderful experience at Duffy’s Sports Grill recently, thanks to our amazing server, Keyra. From the moment we were seated, Keyra greeted us with a friendly smile and made us feel right at home. She was attentive without being overbearing, checked in often to make sure we had everything we needed, and handled our table with genuine warmth and professionalism. The food was fantastic everything came out hot, fresh, and perfectly prepared but it was really Keyra’s excellent service that made the meal so enjoyable. She made great recommendations, kept our drinks full, and made sure every detail was just right.

author: Kin Han Loo
review_text: Ayam bawang was good, and slightly sweetish which went well towards balancing the umami from the other curry gravies. However, I felt that the overall kuah campur wasn’t pekat enough for my liking, so 4 stars for now.

author: María
review_text: Food could be better, weird people coming in and THE WORST MANAGER EVER she is very rude to both costumers and workers…

author: Satoru Gojō
review_text: Chili cheese fries are a must here! This place gets down with the cheese( super cheeesyyy ) they are not stingy with their cheese it’s amazing! So happy to have found a new spot to order my chili fries. This place is way better than McDonalds. My only issue is that they charged a fee for ordering ranch on the side. Ranch was 50 cents each and their card fee was 50 cents. So I payed 1.50 for 2 ranch with a credit card fee…

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: Chun Kheong Chong
review_text: A not bad spot for those who are craving for charcoal duck egg char kuey teow. It is very flavourful with a balanced level of spiciness. The flavour is rather consistent for each strand of noodles. You will also get to taste the pork lard as well. Not too salty. Combo with iced nutmeg juice will be the best after meal with gives you a refreshing feeling. They have plenty of parking and you don’t even need to worry about it. The traffic here is quite fine too.

author: Vemar Latigay
review_text: Third time in this lounge and it didn’t disappoint. The food, the amenities and the service are the best that I’ve ever had out of all One World lounges I’ve visited in Changi Airport. First, the food is delicious. There are several choices for you to choose and they vary their menus for each cycle. Personally, I love the Lamb Chops, and for this specific visit their steak which was cooked to perfection. A really big shoutouts to the service crew (I have to take their names to thank them personally): Hazel, Divan, Dian, Elsy, Jessy, Marissa. Some of them have served me for all the visits I made, and I say, the service makes this Lounge a standout. Highly recommended and would definitely be back again.

author: Colin Leow
review_text: One of the first places we went to once we arrived. While accustoming to the weather, getting accustomed to local delicacies is a must. The wait time was relatively short, given the amount of people in line. They had a proper que system so you could gauge how long the wait it. The crab and prawn dishes are amazing. Having ready peeled crab is a dream for most while the river prawn was extremely fresh and succulent. Highly recommend this place.

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: JJ Tan
review_text: A Fantastic Lunch at Kub Kao' Kub Pla (CentralWorld) I had a wonderful dining experience here recently. The atmosphere was great, and the food hit the mark. Here is a breakdown of what I ordered: The Standout: Crab Fried Rice 🦀 This was easily the highlight of the meal. The taste was excellent and the portion of crab meat was very generous. One thing I really appreciated was the quality of the prep—about 90% of the crab was free of fins/shells, making it very easy to enjoy. Note: The serving size is a bit small, so keep that in mind if you're extra hungry! Stir-fried Pumpkin with Salted Egg and Crab Meat 🎃 As a big fan of pumpkin, I enjoyed this dish. The salted egg flavor was good without being overwhelming. However, compared to the fried rice, the amount of crab meat here was not as generous. It was still a solid dish, but the rice definitely won the "crab ratio" contest. Tom Yum Goong 🥣 This was served piping hot, exactly how it should be. It provided a perfect "vibe shift" for my palate, offering a sharp, spicy contrast to the richer stir-fried dishes. The Finish: Longan Ice Tea 🥤 To wrap everything up, I had the Longan Ice Tea. It was refreshing, sweet, and the perfect way to end a fantastic meal. Overall Experience: Fantastic. If you're looking for high-quality Thai comfort food in CentralWorld, this is a reliable and tasty choice. Tip: If you love crab, definitely prioritize the Crab Fried Rice!

author: Tamara Hemphill
review_text: Food was good. The fries were hot and that's always a good thing. Service was excellent but the atmosphere was unpleasant. There were about 3 unhoused ppl handing around. 1 in the drive-thru line aggressively asking for money, 1 at the window and one at the end when you leave. That's alot. But it didn't stop ppl from coming maybe bcs the did was good. Maybe they need security

author: Aurelia
review_text: For someone who does not really like the strong taste of briyani, I think the briyani is really delicious. 💜 My husband, who loves briyani, said it's amazing 👏 Can request kuah campur asing for those that doesn't like banjir like me 😂 The sotong is nice, not liat at all. Idk how much each of these cost, but for 4 adults and 3 children (food & drinks), it was about RM120-ish, not so bad imo. Overall, the place is quite clean, but the service is a bit slow when there are a lot of people. Can come here again :)

author: akmlftni_
review_text: The siakap “masak dua negeri” was delicious, but too sweet 6/10. I really loved the daging bakar, it was tender with a very tasty sauce 7/10. The beef soup was also flavorful and well-seasoned 7/10. We got to try many dishes and the price was still reasonable for 5 people. The place is spacious, with indoor and outdoor seating near the jetty. Highly recommended!

author: Susie
review_text: Something is not right about this tea. It tastes bad. Tastes like sweet water. Look at the two of them. They both have a spoiled taste. Not fresh at all.

author: Christeen
review_text: This is our 1st time visit to try their breakfast dim sum. They also serve noodles. Not much choices but overall it taste good. We ordered few items with a pot of tea. Foods tasted good except the popiah.. It's just a plain one.

author: David K
review_text: We walked in on a Tue eve and enjoyed a very good tapas dinner. It’s a good menu with traditional choices and well presented. My daughter has brought small business groups to the restaurant and it’s great for small parties as well and regular diners.

author: Joana
review_text: An amazing dining area with a lovely bar and a fantastic vibe. Excellent food and a lovely selection of home made Vietnamese cuisines. The service is superb and the staff are very friendly.

author: Victor Ramirez Romero
review_text: Joe is an amazing server. My wife and I used to come here all the time, and although we had to stop for a bit due to traveling, it was great to come back and see that he had become a manager or lead. He truly deserves it. His service has always been outstanding, and it clearly shows why he earned the promotion.

author: Elena Winell
review_text: One of those rare places where every single thing on the menu is top notch. I took a friend here who noticed their "Liver, Bacon, and Onions" entree on the menu and ordered it purely on the logic of "It's a ballsy dish to list...they clearly wouldn't list it if it weren't amazing." His hunch was right. My go-to is the chicken parm sub, but whenever I've ordered anything else I haven't been disappointed. Wide selection of good beers. Service quality depends on the time of day and the server you get, but I haven't been kept waiting for longer than 10 minutes at the most here. The more seasoned servers are actually kind of amazing to watch because of how efficient they are. Easily the best pub in JP, especially with the prices! Also the posters are really fun. They have one that looks like a diagram from an ENT's office but the words are the lyrics to 'Comfortably Numb'

author: Kumar Perumal
review_text: Very hot inside. Lunch not even tasty. Dont come upon the name. My lunch was ruined

author: Mohamnad Lee
review_text: Manager is super nice.. However, while waiting on my food. A girl literally dig deep into her nose and wiped her finger on herself👀 say what!! Yes it happened. I reported her and a girl said she isn't the manager. Understandable but lets be real cause its your co worker. When I received my food I tried hard to forget about it. The chicked was old and greasy and fries were also old and cold. Got refund immediately. Shout out to the butterfly manager and I hope she get better workers immediately!!

author: Irwin Carrillo
review_text: The Experience was amazing and the food was delicious and the waiter fabi was outstanding. She helped me out a lot with the menu and was very professional. I will be coming back.

author: Brittany
review_text: Staff was very friendly. I would not recommend ordering the alligator bites. Almost 20 bucks for about 10 popcorn chicken sized pieces. Food was good, not wow. Not worth the expensive price tag in my opinion.

author: Mario Martinez
review_text: We needed to find a place for a quick meal before we headed to the airport to fly back home. We had never eaten here before so we gave it a try. The food was excellent and the service was great. This was around 11 AM and the place was packed. The food portions are perfect and the banana nut muffin was great. We will be back on our next trip.

author: Ale P
review_text: Service was great and the place is beautiful. We had an iced pistachio latte and iced almond milk latte with the omelette and banana cake. The service was excellent and very attentive. We got are food pretty quick!

author: Benjamin Goh
review_text: Got the $4.50 plate, which was 75% filling so most people should be satisfied with the $5.50 one. The chilli is pretty moderate but if you don't eat spicy at all it may be a little too much for you to handle. Flavours are great with the mix of sweet and spiciness that blends well together. Also didn't realise the stall was Muslim owned until writing the review, a nice bonus I guess.

author: Christopher Yandell
review_text: The food here is really delicious, I highly recommend the soba noodles and beef skewers. The sauces that all of the dishes are served with are definitely a highlight. It’s kind of hard to find as it’s on the top floor of a relatively inconspicuous building but if you find it, it is definitely worth it.

author: robert hawkins
review_text: Stopped for breakfast with friends between cruise pickup and airport drop off. Beautiful beachside venue with a nice view of Dania Beach. The food was delicious and the service was very attentive. An all around great experience.

author: Norma Medina
review_text: First time returning after renovations, whole experience made us feel very welcome Julius our server was really kind and generous! Chef George rocks at the food! Will definitely come again 1 million times over

author: M Zulfadly
review_text: Come here for anniversary celebration. Cosy place for dinner. Food is so delicious, affordable and generous portion size for the price. Although only 3-4 table, waiting time for food is quite long around 20-30 min. Interior is so pretty and classic. Live singer performance but not too loud. Staff neek rajiv and lisa very helpful and friendly.

author: Tâm Anthony
review_text: Must-visit bagel store! The bagels themselves are perfection—crisp on the outside, chewy on the inside, and packed with flavor. I tried Philly Cheesesteak bagel with well-cooked steak, scallion cream cheese, and it was hands down one of the best I’ve ever had. The staff is friendly, fast, and genuinely seems to care about the quality of everything they serve. The coffee is solid, the vibe is cozy and welcoming, and the service is quick even they were having a lot of Grab delivery orders!

author: Firstname
review_text: Me and my parents had one of the best dining experiences at Novikov thanks to our incredible server, Alain!! We told him to surprise us with whatever he thought was best, and he curated an unforgettable meal. Every dish Alain brought out was not only delicious, but perfectly complemented the next. He described each plate with such passion and enthusiasm that it made the whole experience even more special. What impressed me most was that Alain didn’t overwhelm us with huge portions or try to push the most expensive items, he genuinely wanted us to enjoy the very best of what Novikov has to offer. After visiting a few times before, I can confidently say this was by far the best experience, all thanks to Alain. From now on, I only want to come back if he’s our server!!

author: Jimmy B
review_text: Not a bad place to eat, drink and have fun, although not as much of a selection as Time Out Market. This place offers a more sophisticated approach to mall dining . Pizza, pasta, bar food, Mexican, ice cream, alcoholic drinks and even a champagne vending machine.... What more could one ask for?? PRO TIP: grab the chicken nuggs from HALEY JANES (be careful of the spice kick 🔥) and combo it up with the Mac n cheese from PENNYPACKERS Then, Grab a cocktail from the professionals at DACQUIRIS & DAISIES After ice cream time! And you've got yourself a nice date. Tenderoni slice was not bad but very small for the price tag of 8$ (tasty slice tho)

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Putthachard Weera-achakul
review_text: Kim is very helpful and kind to show us the correct way to wrap our roll. All diahea are delicious and highly recommend for the Vietnamese pancake, one of the best we ever had with thinest flour. Prdered 5 dishes and all gone very fast!

author: Salty Sauce
review_text: Hate to rate a place because of other customers but two girls were sitting next to me were gross and their conversation was not appropriate for a public place. Other than that, the value and food was good.

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: Richard Tan
review_text: Ate here several times. The floor and tables are cleaner than other HDB hawker centres. The cleaning contractor must be managing their workers better than other companies . Good variety of food choices. No parking problems.

author: Sileirim Ortega
review_text: This is the typical restaurant that is hyped up by influencers but DOES NOT DELIVER. We entered the restaurant and we were not acknowledged by anyone passing by. Everyone would look directly at us and not even ask if we were being helped. After a few minutes my boyfriend asked a waiter who could attend us, and then he served us. Food was mid AT BEST. The food lacked quality and taste. The pizza was the best tasting plate but it is extremely thin crust, which is not my favorite. The view was great and ambiance was good, but definitely not worth it. I suggest skipping it.

author: Vân Anh Phạm Quỳnh
review_text: Good service, really nice staff and the food absolutely delicious!!

author: Jeremiah
review_text: The Food is good the drinks are too but the atmosphere is really dirty it demoled like pee and like a dead animal. The service is bad i tried asking what i wanted but be acuse it was my first time i didn’t knee who to ask and then the one that i accedentslly ask was acting dumb on me and so then yea i would rate it 3/5

author: Liza Chernov
review_text: The reviews tell the truth! I was skeptical at first for such a high review rate but it is true to reality!! The food is phenomenal, we had the panini and Benedict, also the crepe for dessert and it was AMAZING!! Texture spices presentation.. 10/10! My recommendation if you plan to visit during the weekend— BOOK YOUR TABLE ONLINE , it gets VERY BUSY 11-2 pm ! We got it online and waited 5-10 minutes for our outside table. Service was attentive, friendly, thank you Alfonso- I see why many write reviews for him! Friendly guy. Overall 10/10 , recommend 100% , do get your printed coffee! Not only it’s aesthetic but also very tasty! (Especially the vanilla one)

author: Aaliya Chyanne
review_text: We stopped in for a quick bite and we were immediately seated. The restaurant was quite busy and has a beautiful ambiance. The servers were professional and attentive. The food was pretty decent and they had a nice drink selection. Just about every dish came with eggs but they were able to sub some things out and accommodate. I would say the plate seem to be drowning in the hollandaise sauce which took away from the meal.

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: Roger K19
review_text: The laksa from this stall is delicious. Updated 2 Oct 2024 Al-Latifah Indian Muslim stall There is a new prata stall that has opened, which has been operating for 20 years at Orchard Road. Their prata is delicious and crispy, served with flavorful curry. The Malay stall selling lontong is my favorite too. They still make their rice cake, which is very rare nowadays.

author: krishnasamy samy
review_text: Tasty food. We went at breakfast time on Monday morning, less customers. Services good. But location is a problem, like it is in the centre of busiest area. If caught at peak time, the road is very jam. Nearby this restaurant is mcd outlet. So parking will be a problem at peak times.

author: Hakimi Hamizi
review_text: The food and environment is great and cozy. Suitable for family and friends gatherings. I would recommend, Ikan Goreng Khengsom (fried sea bass dipped into sour-spicy soup) when you eat here. Worth the price. As for me, the food taste is bold and delicious. Would consider this restaurant for the next visit.

author: Jamiey Jo
review_text: Not only are are the pastries, donuts and cookies 10 out of 10 Stars, the customer service is amazing! I went into Carl's today and had the pleasure of meeting Carlos. He was extremely kind to me and made my day!

author: Lauren Thompson
review_text: My roommates and I love this cozy spot. True family run place and it shows, from the fresh food to the amazing service every single visit. Our favorite breakfast spot!!!

author: Kristina “Chicklassique” Mateo
review_text: The food is great . I love the Breakfast Sandwiches and Chocolate Chip Pancakes. The prices are $$$ probably because I usually order Breakfast and have it delivered so the prices I pay are higher then if I were to take-out or Dine-in I think.

author: K M
review_text: What's great? Loved the you tiao with Kaya dip the most. Got 2 sets of it. Yam bun is so nicely oozing out! Amazing place with nice decorations. Get a seat number slip from the main shop, then cross the road to choose your steam dim sum from another shop, then cross back. No need to go over, if you do not want steamed stuff. Very crowded, but moves very fast. Visit again? Yes! What's to improve? Bak kut teh and steam pork ribs are ok. Not fantastic.

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: Clarissa Mulan
review_text: I have been eating bak kut teh from this shop since young until now. We are from kulim btw. Still the best in town. From 1 shop expanded to 2 shops. U should try the soup and dry one it's so good plus with the uichakoi.

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: Honglian Lee
review_text: Great place to be at to enjoy the vibe and energy of people going about their morning rounds to buy groceries, breakfast and so on. The food centre on the upper floor is a glutton's heaven with unique food offerings such as Kacang Pool, Mee Siglap, Mee Johor and goodness whatever you wouldn't hear of normally in other parts of Sg. Come early from 8am to be able to find parking at the food centre and take your time to explore this gastronomical carnival!

author: Jasmyn Johnson
review_text: Really tasty food! I had the pork vermicelli and it tasted so fresh and the meat was seasoned to perfection 👌 My partner had sugar cane shrimp and bone marrow beef Pho which she also enjoyed! Friendly service. They charged for the wet wipe I didn't use... I mean it was 6p worth so I didn't really care and I'm sure if I said they would remove it.

author: Joseline Sosa
review_text: I would like to start by saying my rating has nothing to do with the people that work there they were professional and nice people, my rating is because of the menu, im so disappointed in the change the made the menu options are terrible and to the point where the table next to me walked away. Do not recommend this place. Looks nice though.

author: Megan Martin
review_text: The atmosphere is cozy and the people who work here were pretty nice. The food came out quickly. I really wanted to give this place a great review but I was disappointed by the food. The vegetarian ramen was super bland. Cold tofu on top and all the veggies were extremely plain and only boiled. No seasoning or sauce to give it flavor whatsoever. The mushrooms were super chewy and unappetizing along with the bamboo shoots. And I usually love eating both of those foods. The only redeeming thing, food wise, was the matcha crepe cake which was okay and pre-made/refrigerated, but definitely not worth $8 a slice. The only thing I could think of while I was eating was the fact that I just wasted $30 on this meal.

author: Onlyjulieee
review_text: The food is great! My top pick is the grilled chicken — it’s packed with smoky BBQ aroma and comes with a tangy sauce that’s incredibly appetising. For the tom yum soup, you can choose your spice level from 0 to 10. We went with 7, but it could definitely be spicier. The friendly boss even encouraged us to try a higher level next time. It was also my first time trying coconut nectar water! Will revisit when i come to Hatyai next time.

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: CRNX S.
review_text: Guaranteed by locals! This place is a hidden gem. I’m not usually a fan of boat noodles, but this shop made me really enjoy them. The portion is just right for one person, the crispy pork skin is super fresh, and the atmosphere is perfect for enjoying good local food. The noodles are already perfectly seasoned no need to add anything!

author: sumi kelly
review_text: Clare was really pleasant qnd explained that the kitchen closes at 10 so we had some items from the supper menu… my husbands Kilkenny tasted odd but the service staff were very kind to change his drink to a bottle beer. All in all it was a pleasant experience. Thank you Clare and bar tender for you fabulous service.

author: Lockheart
review_text: Most stalls close by late afternoon so go in the morning if youre looking for variety. Sugar cane juice was refreshing for hot weather.

author: Ei Phyu Sin
review_text: The durian sticky rice bun is the best of all! Inside, there’s a soft, chewy sticky rice paste, and the bun itself is incredibly fluffy. The cream on top is rich, smooth, and full of that signature durian flavor — absolutely delicious!

author: Ellis Seul
review_text: Very good salads and sandwiches with generous portion sizes and fast and friendly service every time – they call this place the real deal for a reason!

author: Robert Arzate
review_text: The staff were very friendly and attentive to our requests. When I order a wine it turned (tasted like vinegar). When I informed the staff they didn’t understand but after talking they were caring and replaced my wine with a new glass of a new bottle. The views from the deck are great! Best views for a nice sunset or just watching the waves crack against the rocks. Unfortunately the food is not as great as the views. I ordered the surf and turf which equated to three medium shrimps and a very chewy steak with brown gravy on the bottom. I asked for medium rare and some of the steak was but it was very very chewy and the texture was very off.

author: Cerah Venturo
review_text: Le Thai is seriously one of the best spots to eat in downtown fremont street. The green curry was incredibly flavorful, the oxtail meatball noodle soup was rich and comforting, and the Thai iced coffee was strong, sweet, and absolutely delicious. Every dish tasted fresh and well-balanced. The atmosphere is super cute with plants, warm lighting, and creative décor, and the service was friendly and fast. Brayan was a great server ! Overall, just a great vibe and amazing food.

author: Aditya Goyal
review_text: Living in Texas, I thought there can be no place for a better Mexican food experience. I was pleasantly proved wrong by Nacho daddy . The menu is very refreshing. A lot of options for vegans and vegetarians. It’s not possible not to overeat at this place.

author: Robert Taylor
review_text: This is one of the nicest Duffy I’ve been to. Located right next to the water with outdoor dining amazing view. Bartender Tina is amazing, very welcoming. She suggested the daily special which was amazing. Thank you Duffys for another great time.

author: Dion Harris
review_text: We were visiting Miami for a cruise and this was our first stop from the hotel. Wasn’t anyone in there so we were skeptical but it was a very good experience. The food was amazing and so was the service.

author: Omar Mabrouk
review_text: Chicken was super dry. Family of 5 came on mothers day. Service was quick. Free water bottles with each meal which was nice. They do bribe you for good reviews in exchange for baklava. Upon leaving saw a large Costco-like baklava box in their trash.. so it's store bought stuff.. staff was south American and they didn't seem happy to be there..

author: Shallyce
review_text: January 4th 2026 Juan was the manager and he was snappy and mean, not helpful I called corporate on him to give him more training..don't go here if you want to enjoy your day ..there's another Jack in the box 2 miles down Wendy works there ..she admits Juan is a grumpy man! With food that cheap and greasy at least the customer service should good..but it wasnt!

author: Ricky Shandy Setiawan
review_text: A good experience for iftar here a perfect meals and relaxed iftar. The ambiance is cozy and inviting, matched by impeccable service that enhances the iftar experience. Hygiene is top-notch, contributing to the overall appeal. They provide a prayer room as well. The menu is a delightful journey through authentic local cuisine, capturing the true essence of traditional flavors. awesome for the exceptional service and food!

author: NDSOLDIER
review_text: This was my first trip to Panera and I thought it was great. I was told about the mac and cheese and I have to agree, it was delicious. I also had the turkey sandwich, it was just as good. The restaurant was very clean and presentable. The staff was very professional, courteous and polite. I will definitely recommend Panera and eat here again.

author: Antoine Francois
review_text: Obvious 5 stars review Honestly best burger in Saigon for the price First: it’s not like those trendy place that sell you a burger without fries which is an abomination. Here you get the whole package, and that’s definitely how it should be. And you also get it for a very reasonable price 125~140 against 220~300 for other places. Second: The bread is not mushy, the bacon is incredibly crispy, the sauce is good, meat is nice. Definitely recommend it 🙌

author: Miguel Ferran
review_text: The atmosphere is ok, found the bar prices for the shots a bit high. Food was good but nothing that stood out above a like restaurant, beans were bland, same with the carne asada. Service good,nice employees.

author: Chasom was Here
review_text: If you enjoy Indian food as I do very much, this is the place. They have a great selection, met the owners who were so welcoming, and the food was delicious. If you like Indian food, you will love this place!

author: Abraham Maz
review_text: My favorite hole in the wall chicken spot in LA hands down. Best quality price. Solid plates, you are definitely not leaving hungry. My favorite has to be the famous chicken with fries and sauce. Very unique flavor can’t find anywhere else. And let’s not forget all the guys who work there, they all deserve medals 👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽👏🏽

author: Jentzen Fong
review_text: •Bak Kee Satay BeeHun I recently had the pleasure of trying "Bak Kee Satay BeeHun", and I must say, it left me thoroughly satisfied. The star of the dish was undoubtedly the satay sauce, which perfectly complemented the noodles. The rich and creamy satay sauce had just the right balance of sweetness and spiciness, creating a harmonious flavor explosion, which I find it very creative. The noodles, accompanied by tender squid, succulent pork liver, and thinly sliced pork meat, were a delightful addition. The variety of textures and flavors added depth to each bite, making it a truly memorable experience. One word of advice to fellow food enthusiasts: devour this dish quickly! The noodles have a tendency to soak up the flavors, and while that might sound tempting, it's best enjoyed when the noodles are still slightly firm. •Fried Oyster Out of so many dishes the stall offered, I would recommend their Fried Oyster, non-greasy, and the oyster was just cooked right. Not too raw or not too cooked. Char Kuey Teow was just so.. so only in my opinion, and nothing to shout for. Little do you know: The difference between fried carrot cake black or white are not only the colour of the sauce itself, but also the taste. To all tourist, remember to choose the white instead as that's what local Singaporean will choose. If you are curious with the black sauce, it tends to be sweeter if you like it.

author: Ray Martinez
review_text: Frank was an excellent waiter and he suggested items for us to try since it was our first time here. Food recommendations was great and we will definitely be back and also recommend this place to our friends. Loved this place, the food and our waiter Frank. Best food in Vegas!

author: Selah V
review_text: I had my birthday dinner here. I love the table we were give. It was just beside the river. The people and dog watching was amazing and relaxing. We ordered simple. I particularly liked the Margherita. It's always unassuming but the tomatoes they used were really sweet. It was a refreshing dish. The lasagna was good and meaty too. Everything was light and pleasant. I just kinda wish they have more mains. The service was warm and friendly. I think what I like most is the location. I've been to another Italian restaurant around the area, but their location beside the river and the street makes it really relaxing. Really chill.

author: Shihao Foo
review_text: Came here as my gf and I felt like having some clear mutton soup. I chose the noodles version while my gf chose soup + rice set. We both like what we got, but I preferred the meat in the noodles which was thinner and easier to chew. Soup was clear nourishing. The staff has a phrase that they always repeat, about how the soup is good for the tummy (养胃). I’m not sure if it’s true, but it sure felt that way. Total price was $30 which I felt was very value for money, considering the restaurant environment. If you are wondering why the Google ratings is so high, I’ll let u in on a secret - the shop offers a small side dish for a 5 star Google review. That said, I’m writing this the day after my meal, so I’m not influenced in any way. The only downside I’ll say is that their ordering website is clunky and difficult to use, with errors when it came to payment, so we had to order through staff and pay at counter instead. But their staff’s service was good, so I’ll keep the 5-star rating.

author: Guillermo Bravo
review_text: I usually give a good /fair rating to any Dennys in general, but today was one of the worst experiences, waitress was not welcoming nor nice, plates were greasy, food was charred, servings were not enough, specially the oreo shake and seating was not cleaned properly, found greasy floor under table and silverware too! very disappointed

author: Boonwei Koh
review_text: Decent chicken and the bean sprouts goes well with the rice. Chilli is also nice with a sweet taste. Pricing on the high side, food is served very fast.

author: Lis
review_text: THE FOOD WAS DELICIOUS I WILL COME BACK 😋 BUT THE EMPLOYEE THAT IS GETTING THE ORDER HAD A REALLY BAD ATTITUDE...

author: Marek Dusza
review_text: From the moment we arrived, we felt genuinely welcomed. The staff were incredibly supportive with our order and made sure everything went smoothly. The food was absolutely delicious, and the atmosphere elevated the entire experience. Throughout our stay, the team consistently went above and beyond to make us feel comfortable and cared for.

author: Junhui Ong
review_text: Went for a Sun lunch and was served by Kirv. The service provided was impeccable which made the dining experience amazing. We ordered the cheese and Italian cured meats selection together with the bruschetta which were delicious! Followed up with the generous portion of seafood risotto. Ended with tiramisu, loved the texture and taste of the cream and the bitterness of the espresso. Rosso Vino also has a very relaxing atmosphere with good views along the river.

author: Ng Wan Keat
review_text: Once a bustling hub of authentic dim sum in Ipoh, this restaurant was once synonymous with delectable flavors and vibrant mornings. However, time seems to have taken its toll on the establishment. After years of opting for other dim sum spots, we decided to revisit, drawn by nostalgia and the promise of spacious seating when other restaurants were packed. The experience, however, was underwhelming. The airy dining area, while clean and uncrowded, lacked the lively atmosphere of its prime years. The dim sum offerings, though presented in standard portions, lacked the flavor and charm that once set them apart. At a higher price point, the tasteless dishes failed to justify the cost. While it remains a convenient option when other places are full, the restaurant's faded glory serves as a reminder of its better days—now more of a last resort than a must-visit destination.

author: TEAM BViR
review_text: I ordered a burrito with 2 horchatas using uber eats and got a small quesadilla with no drink. This is preposterous. And when I called no one answers the phone. I recommend others to just eat somewhere else. Totally unsatisfied with this experience.

author: Mah R
review_text: I had the shrimp pasta and a strawberry lemonade. When I tell you that it was $36 well spent. It sure was and the wait time was 0mins. As soon as I entered I was seated and given a menu. 2 mins later chips and dip with water. I love it there.

author: Eleana May
review_text: I'm excited to try the food at San Pedro Square Market in San Jose, CA, which offers a wide variety of options. I recently had a spring roll with fresh vegetables, crispy chicken and shrimp that left me eager for more. My priority is seafood, and I was thrilled by the shellfish combo I tried, which included mussels and clams in a delicious soup. The seafood flavor, combined with herbs and garlic bread, was fantastic! It's a great spot for delicious, affordable food in a pleasant setting with good music and a fun atmosphere.

author: melialvarez23
review_text: Food was good. We shared a hash dish. And a pancake. The pancake was just, ok. The server was really nice when I asked for almond milk with my coffee. She was charming. Tho she did not check on us much after our food arrived. We wanna go back and try the chicken and waffles. It looked amazing!

author: Melissa Rabar-Swenson
review_text: We were recommend to come here from a local bar tender fit the food. He was not wrong, we were so pleased to actually come here. Our first few days here were not impressive due to hot spot tourist traps and less authentic places, so this was a blessing. Then the and guy recommend us to go next door to the coffee shop for true local coffee and breakfast. Anyway back to Hameediyah - chicken, delicious, basmati rice, amazing, the sauces and graveys were nice, little spice and full of flavour 😋 we shared our meal and we were SO full. They really piled it on. Service was lovely and they guided you in all of it.

author: Y Teo
review_text: cashier and server are not working in sync. ordered milk tea less sugar but the tea without any tea flavor is super sweet. ordered chicken curry puff but was given flaky puff. exchange for the right chicken curry puff but the puff is cold. This is far from “tip top” as claimed! A disappointment at a world class airport.

author: Randiano Tamelan
review_text: Circuit Road Hawker Center is the real deal for a chill food adventure. It's got the vibe, comfy seats, and a crazy mix of eats. From classic Hainanese chicken rice to fresh seafood, it's a flavor fiesta. The place stays clean, and the crew is on top of it. If you're into diverse, tasty bites without breaking the bank, this spot nails it. A lowkey gem for sure—Singapore street food at its finest! 🍜✨

author: David DiVito
review_text: Me and my wife stopped in starving for a late lunch and had no idea what to expect. We love trying new places, and Soroush Mediterranean Cuisine did not disappoint! The atmosphere is warm and beautifully decorated. I ordered a barg kabob, and honestly, I wanted to lick the plate clean. The portion was generous, the food fresh, and hours later I was still full and satisfied. We also tried the pistachio and saffron ice cream—absolutely excellent and unlike anything I’ve ever had before. Thank you to Soroush for a wonderful dining experience. We’ll definitely be coming back!

author: Mariana M
review_text: Very tropical restaurant or sport bar with a DJ playing mostly tropical and Latino music very good by the way. Service was great and food too, delicious. It’s big and very popular, in front of a Marina, we loved it. They validate your parking for 3 hours told us.

author: Magdalena Rocha
review_text: Service was fast and friendly, the food is very good and portions are a good size. I ordered plate A, which was chow mein, fried rice, and entrée (salt and pepper pork chops) which was the chef's special, and you have to add $1.50 more. That was a lot of food, the plate was full. I ate probably 1/3 only and you can see in the picture how much was left. (Sorry but I was hungry and didn't take the picture BEFORE eating) I also ordered cream cheese ranguns and paid around $17.00 plus tip. Honestly, that's enough food for 2 hungry people. It was nice to see actual Chinese people cooking and serving the customers. I recommend this place.

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: Beautiful Life
review_text: The food centre has many stalls selling different kind of food. The bak chor mee and the fried carrot cake is highly recommended. Also another good place for foreigners to explore into local food.

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: M Astro
review_text: Mid size hawker center on the 2nd floor. 99% Muslim food. Food is great and the hawker center is airy and clean. Gets gery crowded on the weekends and at breakfast/lunch times.

author: Claudia Michelle Chandra
review_text: I am so glad I came to Holbox in a large group because I got to try a lot of the menu items!! Every single dish in this place is out of this world. As someone who is usually averse to seafood, I have to admit that the seafood here is orgasmic!! Especially the fresh uni 🤤🥲 This restaurant definitely deserves its Michelin star. Each dish tasted intentional and offered mouthwatering flavors. I did not expect such an experience from a restaurant that is located within a food court. honestly, you can't even classify Holbox as a restaurant because it is more of a booth 😅 We arrived at around 11:30 AM and there was already a long line all the way to the car park. Thankfully, the line moved along quickly. The food is absolutely worth the weight and I cannot wait to return to this place on my next trip to LA.

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: akmal abbas
review_text: Visited Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball recently. The staff were friendly and service was quick, which was great. The food was alright—not particularly memorable, but decent. Just a heads-up: parking can be a challenge, and they accept QR payments (no cards), I'm not sure about cash, so plan ahead. Overall, an okay experience.

author: Dio Afiari
review_text: The food was great, and the ambience is amazing with the warmth vibrant on it. but the service is kinda slow, already ordered mathilda's chocolate at the first time ordering, but when im asking it to be showed after meal, i need to wait more than 40+ minutes, and theres a waiter using eyeglasses seems so rude due to not friendly on talking with customers. please be more polite, we're here not free, and with the price i've paid u guys should be more trained.

author: Vijay Kabaria
review_text: This might be my first review ever. I seriously hate this place. My whole heart hates it. I think it’s a cancer to new york city and williamsburg. it’s soulsess. it’s private equity for food. my biggest qualm, apart from the bad food is that their branding is wonder. hopeful. magical. and yet they’re so lifeless. they pretend to be serving all these bespoke restaurants— this is literally a ghost kitchen. they market so hard. i hate them so much. god this place sucks.

author: Amanda St
review_text: All in all a positive experience.
