Only complaints I have is they initially forgot the beef on the taco salad we asked for, our food came out at different times and I felt bad my step daughter had to wait another 5 minutes for her food…and then the restaurant called me saying I didn’t pay, all because they didn’t look under the check where the $100 that included a 25% tip. But the food was good, nothing special and the atmosphere was beautiful.

author: John Wu
review_text: We went to this restaurant because it has a high google reviews score for Chinese food. However I left quite disappointed. We didn’t make reservations as it was a Tuesday evening. True enough the restaurant was practically empty with only 3 tables occupied at around 7 PM. The girl at reception didn’t smile or made us felt welcome in any way. No smile when we asked for a table for 4 people. “What’s your name…. Your surname… your mobile number… “ Suddenly the restaurant phone started ringing, she picked it up without saying excuse me or anything to that effect. She started talking over the telephone for at least 5 minutes while I was standing in front of her. Finally she hung up her phone and said followed me. We were then shown to our table and given the menu. We looked at the menu, decided what we wanted to order and then had to wait for a long time before a server finally came. Remember at that time this large restaurant only had 3 tables occupied so the servers could not have been busy. When the server came, again we were not made to feel welcome. No smile, but just someone who was not interested in his job. The food did came pretty quickly and it tasted ok. No complaints from me about the food. We ordered two signature cocktails but both of them were not good. Waste of money in our opinion. During our meal the server did top up our water or being extra ordinary. However when we paid, the invoice as usual already included the 20% tips. That’s ok, but what upset me was that he wanted more tips before we paid with our credit cards. If we got good service I might consider tipping more but certainly not in this case. When the server saw that we didn’t tip more, his face turned black and stormed off. I think the manager of this restaurant needs to be changed. He or she must be rubbish at managing the staff. Come and eat here if you want to leave feeling angry.

author: Joyce
review_text: Not sure if there's 2 outlets or they shifted so there are 2 different address on grab which you may need to take note when booking your ride here. A low key shop tucked in an alley near Thonglor. This place is a gem! Probably one is the best beef bowl I have eaten. Atmosphere and service is good just that the family beside my table was rather noisy. Definitely will come back again.

author: JayBee
review_text: You do not have to be vegan or vegetarian to enjoy The Joi Factory. We were staying at Christina’s, so coming here for food and drink was convenient. The space is clean and comfortable with different seating arrangements and there is a second floor as well. We ate here two times and both times our food was very good. We ordered smoothies, coffee drinks, pasta, Spring Rolls and the Broken Rice. The food and drink were well prepared and well presented and flavorful. The iced Avocado Coffee and the iced Coconut Caramel Coffee were both unique, bold and smooth. The Milk Coffee, although simple, was sharp and full bodied while the Healthy Heart smoothies was a treat that wagon sweet. Good WiFi and clean WC. It’s worth a trip if you are after a unique dining experience.

author: Trevor Bennett
review_text: Fat Bhat burger aka a Zinger burger+ (more heat) for the Aussies craving a ZINGER..... add a bintang to elevate this burger experience. Clean, crisp food with great service. Update: Went back for round 2!! The Winner Winner burger, it is a 100% winner ...Delicious.

author: hitomi ahmad
review_text: absolutely fantastic! The broth is rich and flavorful, with just the right balance of spice and depth. Ingredients are fresh, portions generous, and everything tastes authentic. The staff are attentive and welcoming, making the whole dining experience smooth and enjoyable. The cozy atmosphere adds to the charm, perfect for sharing a hearty meal with friends or family. Definitely one of the best hot pot spots in Singapore — I’ll be coming back for sure!

author: Jo Lim
review_text: I’m in Bali for 5 Days and I’m back here for 3 days for coffee break and lunch. I love their Cloud coffee, Squid Ink Fried rice with calamari and truffles fries. So delicious and satisfying.

author: P S.
review_text: The price tends to be higher compared to the quality of the food. However, if you factor in the rental costs, the price becomes more understandable. As for crispy pork, it leans towards being sticky rather than excessively crispy. However, this is just a personal experience. I recommend giving it a try.

author: Bugwagen
review_text: Nice Zhi Char (stir fry)! We love the spicy big prawn hor fun. It was delicious! The other dishes we ordered was just ok. Didn’t know they have so many Michelin awards. We managed to get a table outdoor, but there was a queue and everyone in the group has to be present before they let you have a table.

author: hodhan hassan
review_text: In addition to the wonderful dinner and the warm service from Tina and Lisa, we were even serenaded, making it an unforgettable experience overall. Zila and Coline the breakfast team amazing service and makes you feel at home

author: maryjayne elizabeth
review_text: the service here is outstanding! and the food? even better! the caesar salad is my favorite in miami, and the chicken alfredo is made to perfection. raciel is an amazing server!

author: Tanya
review_text: Had an amazing time for my mother's 70th birthday. We had a party of 12. Staff was amazing, everyone's food was excellent!!! We will definitely be back.

author: Nope Thanks
review_text: Sadly the food is only average. The problem is that the dishes are rushed in the cooking process. All the ingredients for great food are there, just not utilized well. Perhaps it will taste better if you eat here after the lunch rush. Maybe. But if you plan on coming here to eat, try heading to their other locations. Also the iced coffee is 3 in 1 coffee. Unbelievable.

author: Alan Goh
review_text: Had the best meal in Bangkok at Nara Siam Paragon. Wonderful high quality food, superb service and nice restaurant ambience. The coconut cake dessert was out of this world. They only had 10 servings per day.

author: Pang Thunyalak
review_text: The food here is delicious, especially the mushroom curry and mangosteen salad—they’re a must-try! On weekday evenings, there’s hardly any wait, and the prices are reasonable. The service is excellent, and the food is served quickly. I can’t wait to try other dishes next time. Highly recommend this place!

author: kirana tiara
review_text: I had an excellent dining experience at Osteria Gia PIK.. From the moment we arrived, the atmosphere felt elegant yet comfortable, making it a great place to enjoy a relaxed meal. The food was beautifully presented and full of flavor—everything we ordered was clearly prepared with great attention to quality and detail. What truly made our visit special was the outstanding service, especially from “Kahfi”. He was extremely helpful, knowledgeable, and attentive throughout the entire meal. Kahfi took the time to explain the menu, gave great recommendations based on our preferences, and always checked on us at the right moments without being intrusive. His friendly attitude and professionalism made us feel genuinely welcomed and well taken care of. Thanks to the delicious food and Kahfi’s exceptional service, our experience at Osteria Gia was memorable. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for great Italian food paired with excellent service, and I will definitely be returning in the future.

author: Agan Agen
review_text: I ordered nasi lemak, it tastes good. I came for the second time to transit at changi airport, first in 2023 and yesterday on January 1, 2025. The taste has not changed. The nasi lemak is delicious and addictive

author: Sinrrys Flores
review_text: We love their cakes we drive from upstate NY almost every we need a cake

author: Ivy Fukun
review_text: Tidy and Cosy place for beef rice bowl. Try the recommendations, you won’t be disappointed.

author: Arlene Reksoprawiro
review_text: First time coming here and everything is so wonderful. They have a parking lot for cars (very important), helpful and friendly staffs, options for indoor and outdoor area. We got caramel pistachio croissant and lava cake which is sooo delicious, and the coffee also very delightful. Definitely will be back.

author: Павел Жардецкий
review_text: We been there for the first time and it was awesome. We didn't expect something extraordinary but we were very surprised when we finished our dinner. Everything was perfect. Food delicious. We ordered Serlion steak tips and it was cooked exactly i wanted. Oysters and shrimps were fabulous. We came from VA and definitely come back again.

author: Eric Lam
review_text: Had a grown-up pizza party birthday dinner here. I haven't been back here for years, and everything's as good as I remembered. We sat in the room in the back. I really liked the shipping container decor. Service was pretty good. Food came out quickly. Although we had a small issue with two of the pastas being way too salty, the rest of the food was excellent. The English Pea caramelle was nice. I particularly enjoyed their Margherita and Lupetto pizzas. I would also recommend their maitake mushrooms as well.

author: THE SOD FARM
review_text: Had reservations and had a 30 minute wait. The lobster Risotto was very good, Pan-Seared Scallops were very good, BUT we did not appreciate the fact that they were cut in half horizontally (making 2-1/2 scallops 5), Grilled Octopus was very nice, 8 oz Filet Mignon was done ok, Beef Wellington was ok, not bad but not great, Baked Mac & Cheese was good and finally the Roasted Brussels Sprouts were very good. Overall it was a good-very good (not great) the biggest issue was the cutting of the scallops, we expected better from Hells Kitchen.

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Mr. Jo
review_text: nice atmosphere. fair prices. friendly staff. order to go or good for brekkie, brunch, lunch. note the opening hours 6am-2pm. banh mi is basic & good. menu see pics below.

author: Khay Yin Tang
review_text: The food here is tasty and delicious! It's also very affordable, which is a big plus. Additionally, the service is impressively quick—dishes arrive in no time! I highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a great meal without breaking the bank.

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: Lorelai D
review_text: One of us have been talking about this BKT place for the longest time, reminiscing the BKT that he has tried, so we decided to head over there. I see a few tables order BKT and also curry fish head, but it will be a bit much for us, so we decided to go for chai po egg, BKT, salted egg yolk pork ribs and also spinach with eggs. Only after we ordered that we discovered we have pretty much ordered a dinner full of eggs LOL. Chai Po egg was okay, goes well with the chili, can’t really go wrong with this one, it tasted like home cooked, I do wish that it comes thicker which will compliment the other dishes better. Spinach with 3 eggs, which are eggs, salted egg and century egg was well done, the broth was really nice and the salted egg yolk pork ribs were tender, just like how it usually come in. As to the highlight which was suppose to be the BKT, it was more on the herbal side, good generous amount of ingredients. I do wish that the herbal flavor can be a bit stronger but the ribs that goes with it was tender. The perks of going to a proper BKT shop is they will refill the soup for you, which you don’t get it here, however still a good bowl of BKT and you get to also order other zhi char dishes which is easy to order when you come as a family.

author: Chong Tee Lim
review_text: Ponggol Nasi Lemak Centre sits tucked in the everyday hustle—unassuming frontage, open windows, and the comforting aroma of coconut rice, sambal, and fried goodies welcoming you in. Inside, it’s a blend of hawker energy and family rhythm: metal tables, plastic stools, lunch crowds, and the occasional diner asking in Malay for extra ikan bilis. They do what they do with no frills but serious care. The nasi lemak arrives with fluffy, fragrant rice, each grain carrying creaminess but not sogginess. The sambal has a measured heat—not numbing or flat but soulful, slightly sweet with a hint of smokiness, picking up complexity at the edges. You’ll find crispy fried chicken with skin that snaps under your fork, ikan bilis that crunch, peanuts toasted, and custard egg just soft enough to ooze without chaos. What stands out is how the flavours balance—nothing overpowers. The sambal, the rice, the sides—they hold their own but also support each other. It’s not gimmicky; it’s the kind of plate you taste room-by-room, noticing little things you’ll want again. Service is hawker speed but with care. The workers are efficient without being robotic—tea top-ups come without asking, and they’ll clear tonight’s empty plates to make space for more. Prices stay kind, making this place as satisfying for daily habit as for those occasional cravings. If you’re around Punggol or passing through and want a solid plate of nasi lemak that hits both heart and hunger, this is one you’ll keep coming back to.

author: Austen Groff
review_text: Visited New York City for a graduation, and we decided on Zum Stammtisch for one of our meals. Arriving there we found street parking near the restaurant, and we entered a cool wooden open German looking building. The light was low (maybe a little too low,) the tables well spaced, and the decor was very intriguing (like a hunting lodge.) Our server was quick to arrive and she was friendly and informative. We were well attended to the entire meal. For an appetizer we started with käsespätzle which is one of my favorite dishes. It came with carmelized onions and it was tasty, but not the best I've had. It was a bit too oily, and it was shaped in a way I hadn't seen before (longer strands instead of smaller oblong pieces,) but I did love the amount of cheese (which may have contributed to the oil) and the carmelized onions were perfect. I saved some for the meal and it was a nice pair to my dinner. For which I ordered the Schweinshaxe mit Semmelknödel which is a pork shank special with bread dumplings which I remember I used to have when I lived in Germany as a teenager. This was enormous! I'll include a picture. I ended up eating it for 3 or 4 more meals, it was a formidable meal. I will say the outer layer was quite fatty, though you don't have to eat it, there's no way you would be hungry if you are the type of person that can finish this. I thought it added a nice flavor as German food is not known for its seasoning. The Semmelknödel gave a nice break from the pork shank and the sauerkraut that came with it contrasted the dish with taste and texture. Overall I really enjoyed it but I think I would only order it again if I was feeling gluttonous. The my girlfriend and her sister shared the chicken schnitzel with the Riesling and mushroom sauce. The schnitzel was good, though not the best we've had before, the crust could be a bit more buttery in flavor maybe by using a different breading, but the mushrooms in the Riesling sauce were delicious. The dish came with potatoes which does not really brighten up the plate, but it was a welcome addition. The meal ended with dessert where we all shared linzer torte and vanilla ice cream and a NY cheesecake. This was the star of the meal. I have never had linzer torte (a raspberry torte) and it was amazing the crust was perfectly soft and the tartness of the raspberry against the creaminess of the ice cream was such a perfect balance my mouth waters just thinking of it, and the New York cheesecake was also very soft in texture and the cake was creamy and the base was crumbly and not too dry. Such a nice ending to quite the feast. The price was very fair, around 100 dollars and I would say if you're in the area it's worth checking out but where it shines is in the value and the service.

author: Amos Lee
review_text: Lau Goh Teochew Chye Thow Kway is run by a half deaf and mute couple. There’s a picture on the counter, what you need to do is point the order you want to let the lady boss know. The price are $6, $8 and $10. There are three types which is black, white and yuanyang. I personally prefer the black one. The portion is quite filling.

author: J L
review_text: * I'm updating my review - down two stars. The last 2 times I've been this month the service is abysmal. Management doesn't care. The one male bartender is a joke. Seriously. Btw, I earned A LOT of rewards on my card. i.e. Ive spent money. Act like you care. Went recently for the first time and was pleasantly pleased. Picked a very slow day to get a real experience. My burger was cooked exactly how I wanted it, as well my fries were nice and hot. Winning. The server was also very attentive. This is when you know. They also have an interesting rewards system so I'll be taking advantage of that. It's a large space with awesome views and will be back soon. Thanks again.

author: yc
review_text: Located in Siam Paragon. They operate using a buzzer system so you do not need to physically queue. Just pay and wait for the buzzer. Both versions of the crab fried rice are v tasty and definitely lives up to all the social media hype. Only regret was not able to have another meal here before we left Bangkok as we wanted to try other good food. There is really so many delicious food in Bangkok😋

author: Tessa van de Pas
review_text: I had dinner tonight with my friend here. The atmosphere was amazing! There was live music and it was just the right sound. The food was also delicious and it had a broad range of choices of food. The people who work here are very kind. Overall an amazing night out for dinner in Nusa Penida! I would highly recommend

author: Joseph Flagge
review_text: I would give them ZERO stars if I could. Even though all was pretty good. The listed kids eat free on Dec 10, 2035 and a visit with Santa Claus. I paid the bill and realized that they DID charge us for the Kids Meal despite the waiter stating YES, Kids Eat Free Tonight! I live in the community and used to come to this place a lot but after tonight I am done and I will make sure to let other know about this scam!

author: Jherson Jaya
review_text: Nicely located in front of the Hoi An River. Its nice to sit here and just observe the people. They have fast wifi too!

author: Amery H.
review_text: Great food! Great atmosphere! Ample parking space, and it's pet-friendly! Will definitely come back here again. It's also very windy so you don't have to worry about it being hot or sweating. The restaurant is located behind the suites (the suites doesn't allow pets though), so just walk around the side and you'll find Palm cafe & Bistro. It isn't crowded either, at least not when we visited, so that's great!

author: Andre Thomas
review_text: If the food was great, I would tolerate the poor customer service. But since it’s not, they need a better staff there at least late night. What happened to service with a smile, what happened to eye contact when talk to customers. How about not being rude to someone helping you get a check? Do better late night staff on 10/24! Or I will find another place who wants my money!

author: Karissa Alberto
review_text: Their pad thai was so good. The highlight though was the fried chicken. It’s tender and flavourful just by itself. The salted egg calamari was also so good. Would recommend

author: Robert Hinton Jr.
review_text: To me they have some wonderful chicken. I can only speak for me. My wife loves their food, she introduced me to this place. If you come by tell them to put extra juice on your fries and chicken. Man it's just exquisite. To get the full flavor punch you have to mix everything together...get the tortilla, bust it open, put the fries inside, then the chicken and put to cold slaw on top and eat that. To get the full flavor kick. It's really wonderful. Stop by. It's worth it. Now mind you only the shop downtown on Pico. Blvd Don't go to the one in Huntington Park, that location is trash.

author: YippieYaYa
review_text: Had dinner at Restoran Tuck Kee and it definitely lived up to its reputation. The Yu Kong Hor (fried flat noodles with egg) was smooth and flavorful, and the baby octopus dish was a standout—tender, springy, and well-seasoned The menu offers a great variety of Cantonese-style noodles and stir-fried dishes, all at reasonable prices. The place gets very crowded, especially during weekends, so expect a queue. Overall, a great spot for local-style noodles and a must-try if you're exploring Ipoh’s food scene.

author: Yi Yao
review_text: Amazing Japanese ramen spot! Super humble yet definitely not low-key — it has received Michelin recommendations for 5 years in a row. We went for lunch during our visit to New York, and the value was incredible. For just $27, you get a starter and a main, including their classic tonkotsu ramen. Hearty soup and super generous portion of noodle which can be rare for ramen places. There are also other great options (some with a small extra cost). Highly recommend trying the Tsukemen as well — perfectly chewy noodles (served hot or cold) paired with a rich, concentrated dipping broth. Absolutely delicious! The restaurant is located right in the heart of Midtown, making it very easy to walk to from nearby tourist attractions. If you’re in town, don’t miss this place! We did walk-in on a weekday 10min after opening time. The restaurant can get busier so reservations are highly recommended for popular times (I.e weekends).

author: Tracey Coleman
review_text: Lines are always long at every Wendy’s .. But This one is always the worst .. always messes up orders , always excess wait time even for just a burger .. Customer Service can definitely be better !

author: Suhaimi Taryo
review_text: The char kway teow by far the best I ever taste. Really tasty delicious, cockles well cooked, wok hey fumes delightful.i recommend all as Muslim Abang is very professional on his char kway teow. Kudos ..👍🏻👍🏻👍🏻

author: Christina Hathaway
review_text: I live in the neighborhood & have been so eager to try… well I tried it & it’s the best sushi I have ever had. I will be going back all the time!

author: Andre Denman
review_text: BABY/BRAH! When I say we loved this place. I’m not exaggerating. The music, the food, the decor, and service was top notch. We had traditional plate with lobster Mac. OMG it was all good. Ordered desert just because. My wife was humming, bobbing her head, and eatting it all up and so was I. Just go here!!! (I took the pictures of food after we had piled up our plates.

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: C L
review_text: Plenty of Chinese market stallholders. Cheaper seafood compared to mainstream markets. You can get a fresh salmon head for $2 but from a hostile fishmonger. Long queue at taxi stand even on weekdays.

author: Jasmere Savage
review_text: My go to place for ice coffee and its affordable..The meals are good here. Nice size portions I normal get spicy chicken or crispy chicken. I also like the Nashville hot mozzarella sticks

author: Abhijit Chaterji
review_text: Anyone seeking a vibrant vegan-friendly dining experience in Los Angeles, The Butcher’s Daughter stands out for its creative plant-forward cuisine and chic ambiance Great experience

author: Ak
review_text: It’s a nice place especially when you wanna refresh and chill or have a chat with your friends. The garden is well designed and many low chairs are installed and those are actually pretty comfy ones. There is also an AC room with workable long tables if you wanna open your laptop. Their tiramisu was not great, but it’s very good for the price of 25k and the drinks were good.

author: Ann Meow
review_text: Super satisfying bowl of soupy BCM! Quite oily soup cos of the pork lards and minced pork that has fatty cuts. However i couldnt stop drinking the salty soup. It was addictive! Few moments later - i was so thirsty and kept drinking and drinking non stop. Watch out for the sodium. My meekia was still quite raw, a bit al dente at the start. It started to soften the more i ate. Can consider asking them to cook the noodles longer if you mind hard noodles. Would definitely be back!

author: Marsha Malinda
review_text: I recently had the pleasure of dining at Cuca Restaurant in Bali, and it was an exceptional experience from start to finish. I ordered a variety of dishes. Each dish was thoughtfully prepared, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. The service was equally impressive—attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable about the menu. I also loved the ambience: the dining room felt relaxed and intimate, perfect for a cozy evening meal without feeling too formal. If you're in Bali and looking for a place that combines inventive cuisine with warm service and a comfortable setting, I highly recommend giving Cuca a visit.

author: Robert Roman
review_text: Sure! Here's a more humanized version of your review with the requested changes: --- I got one of my all-time favorites at **Bobo’s** yesterday—the grilled chicken salad 🥗 paired with my go-to banana berry shake. **Side note**: I ordered extra grilled chicken and added my own bacon bits and extra cheese once I got home... because why not, right? I’ve been coming to this specific **Bobo’s** since I was 3 years old with my mom. Once I was old enough to go on my own, that's exactly what I've been doing! All the OGs who still work there know me and my whole family—we’re like one big family. The food is always on point, the service is top-notch, and the flavor is amazing. **Please don’t change a thing**! I’m also really glad they updated the **place**—it looks even more inviting now, making it even easier to swing by for a bite. Thank you, Bobo’s! -From the Henry Family --- How’s that? Does it feel more natural while keeping the spirit of your review intact?

author: LifeOnEarth
review_text: Dine in during weekday. Food is good, place is clean but too warm to eat comfortably as the food we eat is hot and spicy. Should have keep the temperature in the restaurant bit colder.

author: Thanthar Shwe
review_text: Spicy Salmon Salad - very fresh and flavorful. So spicy though. Would recommend. Signature Mama Noodle - We’ve got the one with mixed toppings. Crispy pork, crabs, pork balls, shrimp, squid etc. topping were all fresh but the noodle and the soup is just your typical instant spicy mama noodles. I really don’t understand the hype at all. Dumplings - good and juicy. Don’t know what they were made of. The waiting - we went on a Wednesday. we did the queue through QueQ app. We had to wait about 2 hours. Took the queue around 7 and we got seated around 8:30 pm. We just went and ate around the Banthatong street while we wait, so it wasn’t so bad. The queue was still long until the time we left the area at 10:30. The total bill - 1400 THB. The menu - there were so many items on the menu but Mama Noodle, salmon salad and crispy pork seem to be the most popular. The menu’s all in Thai. No English menu available. If anyone sees this review in time, the shop is gonna close from 27 Nov to 2 Dec 2025.

author: Sonia
review_text: The lady serving the food was very rude and lack customer service and for what ever reason, in a rush to take the customers orders. I went into this restaurant to purchase food for myself and a friend that was visiting from out of state and was embarrassed by the service that was provided. The character of the lady was extremely poor and tasteless. To the owner please train your staff and employees on how to deal with the public no matter where your customers are from. The treatment was unacceptable and becuase of this I will never patronize this restaurant again.

author: Barbara Smith
review_text: My friend whom I always meet up with when I visit Boston always chose this place. Learning he passed within the last week, I honored his memory by grabbing a bowl of chowder, our normal prelude to their lobster. It was creamier than I had remembered, served with oyster crackers than put it over the top. Truly one of the best in New Dngland if you are in the camp that prizes rich vs.soupy. Paired with a quick Guiness it was heaven. It did take a bit to get service with two regulars getting priority. Waiting on a rideshare I was a bit annoyed, but stuck it out for a taste of my ling-time former home. Hit the spot.

author: Katherine Kisner (Kat)
review_text: Great food. I didn’t expect it to come with sides, but it was a pleasant surprise.

author: Sandra Ang
review_text: 🌴 The Palm Cafe – A Hidden Gem with Bali Vibes! 🌴 Stepping into The Palm Cafe instantly gave me Bali vibes – relaxed, tropical, and cozy. The decor and ambiance are absolutely charming! 🌺 Tried their food and was genuinely impressed – everything we ordered was delicious and well-presented. It’s a great spot to unwind and enjoy a good meal. The environment is lovely overall, though it did get a little noisy at times due to kids running around. But that aside, it’s still a wonderful place for dinner with friends or family. Definitely worth a visit – will be back again soon! 👍✨

author: Mihwa Lee
review_text: Was busy even at 10am, but was seated immediately. Glad they offered small portions and even those without noodles for light eaters. The small portion however was still quite substantial. I had the raw beef pho. Found the beef not that thinly sliced and quite tough. Broth was very tasty and flavorful. Noodles were broad and soft. The fried dough was very nice after soaking up the soup.

author: Anna Pham
review_text: Stepping into the restaurant, I was transported back to my childhood visits at my grandma's house, thanks to the charming, ancient decor. However, I found the service quite slow, and the food didn't quite impress me. Even with a reservation for lunch, I still had to wait 30 minutes without any acknowledgement or care from the staff. It was a bit disappointing overall.

author: Jose Saldaña
review_text: Fast and friendly service at the counter, plus the food was delicious with a colorful presentation..100% enjoyable.

author: Natalie Amat
review_text: Had to show my brother my favorite pizza place in all of Las Vegas! It's evel kenevel themed. We have both worked in pizza places and this place is on point let me tell ya! Their slices are huge! Their toppings are delicious! The names of the pizzas are fun and silly! Absolutely adore this pizza place!

author: Victor
review_text: Ordered the Togo's #33 Triple Dip (1/2 lb. of hot roast beef, turkey & pastrami with provolone. Includes hot au jus) via Grubhub takeout and was quite impressed. While the place was busy during the weekday lunch rush, it only took about 10-15 min to get my food after placing my order. The half pound of meat is substantial and delicious and the bread and meats combined with the au jus made for a super satisfying meal. The indoor/outdoor seating area isn't the most comfortable but it got the job done. No Wi-Fi but was able to hotspot my laptop to watch a video while enjoying lunch. Decent amount of seating that even during peak times there was enough for everyone to get their own table. Most were taking the food to-go.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Alice Wang
review_text: I went here 3 times with my friends, want to introduce them about Vietnamese vegan foods.Foods was good but pineapple fried rice didn't have any smal pieces of pineapple, too dried. Dink was great and always surprised me.

author: S G
review_text: Delicious food but sometimes strange combinations. They put pork into the scallops and pork fat into the seafood soup. The price a little bit higher for such places.

author: Lucy B
review_text: A delicious place for the classic Bali dish of Babi Guling. The internet said I had to get there before 11 or all the crackling would be gone and there would be queues- this wasn’t my experience; we went in high season (August) and at lunch the place was not at all full and no food shortages. Babi Guling was delicious - juicy pork and crispy skin! Very rich food. Restaurant otherwise is simple and clean.

author: AM Lim
review_text: A pleasant food court at Changi T1 for people in-transit like me to grab a quick meal before connecting to the next flight. Plenty of food choices available to choose from - Western, Chinese even Indian cuisines. Reasonable price. The place is clean and spacious. Lastly have a courtesy to clean up and send the tray and your used plates cutlery and everything else back to the designated collection area after finished. Overall great place for traveller looking for quick meal at T1.

author: Fajar Priyanto
review_text: The most popular is of course the char kway tiauw, but there are others that are as good. The bbq chicken, the beef soup, the prawn mee, the zhi char. I like the old uncle chen tng soup $2.5 Simple and refreshing.

author: Helen Colie
review_text: Lovely Italian restaurant with great food and nice atmosphere. Special mention to Mr. Bali, the bartender, who was warm and attentive and even offered complimentary drinks. Would happily come back.

author: Jac Yim
review_text: First time trying this place. Had to wait a while to get a place. Chairs were not comfortable at all. Crowded, place smells of the sizzling meat, noisy. Lucky the food is good. Meat was quite half raw when served, despite we requested medium well. We had to cook it ourselves with the little hot plate in front of us. Free flow of vegetables, rice and soup. Dark and truffle sauces were nice. Service was a little slow. Also the waitress seems very forgetful. Requested for more vegetables, she said ok. But proceed to do other chores. Clearing tables, arranging plates, etc. she needs to be reminded at least twice each time we want to ask for refills. Worth a try here if you have not tried beef hamburgs.

author: John D
review_text: Great quick breakfast and lunch selections with some really nice specialty coffee and tea options. It can get pretty crowded here and the line to order can get a little awkward when it’s busy. The new wine bar is a lot of fun. You can treat it as a before/after dinner stop or make a whole evening out of it. Reservations on Resy might be required for awhile, as it seems pretty popular. Overall a great place to grab food and drink.

author: taylor banasiak
review_text: The food at Felix was good but not unforgettable. The arancini were crisp and cheesy, the rigatoni carbonara was rich and well balanced, and the gnocchi in tomato sauce had that classic comforting flavor. You can tell the pasta is handmade with care, and the ingredients are fresh. That said, the overall experience left something to be desired. The service felt too casual, almost indifferent. For a restaurant of this caliber, you expect warm, attentive hospitality especially given the price point and reputation. Instead, it felt like the servers were just going through the motions. If you’re choosing between Felix and Funke (both from the same chef), skip Felix and head to Funke. You’ll get just as good (if not better) food, and the service and atmosphere are far more polished and welcoming. That makes all the difference.

author: Eva Aya
review_text: Outstanding experience! The whole fried fish was incredibly fresh and perfectly crispy, with rich flavors in every bite. The dish was beautifully presented and complemented by colorful vegetables, crunchy cashews, and just the right level of spice. A squeeze of lime tied everything together and elevated the taste even more. You can really tell care and quality go into the preparation. Highly recommended for seafood lovers - definitely worth coming back for!

author: loo jay
review_text: Food is Good taste,price also acceptable,but the white face waitress is very very bad service ( boss didn’t give salary or what?)

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Clara
review_text: a quaint little store and a simple menu (pho + bun cha + spring rolls of various flavors). they don’t have many staff so be prepared to wait a bit for your food. friendly staff too! loved the seafood spring roll:) the medium sized pho is on the smaller side so would advise to upsize to large.

author: Samantha Diaz
review_text: First off the German chocolate cake.. SO DELISH!! It’s so rich and moist and they’re very generous with the coconut topping, 20/10 dessert choice!! The footlight I got was delish!! They were so nice and subbed my turkey instead of bacon!! It was so worth it!! My friend got the Italian mache was super delish as well!!

author: Mindful Cooking
review_text: This banh mi spot right at the entrance of Hoi An is impossible to miss thanks to the constant queue outside. The menu is simple and clear, and you can see everything being made fresh by hand as you order. They offer vegetarian and pork-free options, plus self-service drinks, and payment is easy with cash or card. The seating is basic and not the cleanest, but it works. The place leans into its Anthony Bourdain connection, which adds character, even if it could be showcased a bit better. Service is fast and efficient, and they bring the food straight to your table. The banh mi itself is excellent. Crunchy bread, soft inside, fresh vegetables, great balance of flavors, and plenty of sauces on the table. Easily the best banh mi I had in Vietnam. Very affordable, authentic, and absolutely worth stopping for. I’d definitely come back.

author: KK
review_text: Best frog porridge in my life. I always go to this restaurant every time that I visited Singapore. Even though there are plenty of frog porridge restaurants including in youtube or influencers review or anything, I think the taste cannot beat this restaurant. Good to try and you will love it. Previously, I’m not the people who gonna eat frog.

author: Jose Lopez
review_text: Delicious Mexican food and very affordable for the amount of food per dish definitely will fill you up. 10/10 Would recommend to others in the future.

author: Jacob Moss
review_text: Honestly everything was phenomenal. We got the Mezze Filistini, the Makloubeh platter, the Watermelon Haloumi salad, roasted cauliflower, and the Baklava Sundae. All the dips in the Mezze were stunning—best tabouleh I’ve ever had. And a huge shoutout to that watermelon haloumi salad, it was revelatory. Like, I didn’t know food could taste like that. Really nice atmosphere, overlooking the park with open concept, and also it was a Saturday and they had live music!

author: Jeffrey Robinson
review_text: The overall experience was 5-star. Food was cooked to perfection. It definitely awakened our palates. Atmosphere was wonderful and inviting. The service provided by Alex Morel was amazing. He was extremely knowledgeable about the menu and accommodating in every way. The experience was heightened by his service. Definitely a must dine for all. Gordon’s signature drink with notes made for a great addition to the meal. All other restaurants have a high standard to live up to.

author: Paulius Paškevičius
review_text: Food: very tasty, yet not very healthy. My father threw up from the food once but it's very convenient and easy to eat. Service: Table Service - Very nice, get the food in 12 - 15 Minutes. But do not try the new fries. It is a scam, you pay 20 cents extra but only half of the fries are the new ones. Atmosphere: good but sometimes crammed

author: Phan Alvarado
review_text: Terrible service. Never fails. We have been to this restaurant numerous times in the last 9 years since we moved to the area. Food is not bad. Drinks are not bad. But the service is slow as molasses. And if you are not a regular don't expect a warm welcome. My husband, two sons and I have been going for NYE dinner here for the last 4 years. We made a reservation for this year 4 days in advance, and it was later than we wanted, but we made it anyway. I was then called and told to come in even later because someone else changed the number in their party. I said that was too late and they basically told me "oh well then cancel". Thanks. Two days before NYE. We have brought friends from out of town and always recommend this place despite the terrible service because it's a cute neighborhood Italian restaurant. The wait staff needs training ASAP, including whoever takes reservations. WILL NEVER BE BACK !

author: tunicatelor
review_text: Decent selection of food. Not difficult to find a table before noon.

author: Michael Holly
review_text: We really loved this place and will be back. The beers were ice cold and our burger and mahi sandwich were delicious. The only negative was the oblivious bartender who was unfriendly and not attentive at all

author: Anthony Lawson
review_text: On my last evening in town for a work trip, our group of eight was looking for dinner in the Seaport area without a reservation, not an easy task. We decided to try Legal Sea Foods and lucked out when a no-show freed up a table for us right as we walked in. The restaurant is large and was buzzing with activity. They also have a great patio that faces the harbor, perfect for an outdoor meal with a view. Since we had appetizers at a prior stop, we went straight to entrées. Faced with a menu full of tempting seafood options, I asked our server for a recommendation of something local and fresh-caught. He suggested the North Atlantic haddock. I had never had haddock before, but I was impressed. It was perfectly cooked, meaty yet slightly flaky, with a clean flavor. It was served with rice pilaf, which was fine but forgettable, and steamed broccoli. One of my co-workers ordered the lobster mac and cheese, and it was both impressive and indulgent. They use a full one-pound lobster, serving the mac and cheese inside the entire lobster shell with all of the meat mixed in. Highly recommended if you are not watching calories. If you are in the Seaport area and need a solid seafood dinner without a reservation, Legal Sea Foods is worth keeping in mind, especially if you can snag one of those harbor-view patio tables.

author: Kishor Lal
review_text: Great place to grab a quick coffee, tea, or snack inside Terminal 1 transit area at Changi Airport, Singapore. Plenty of tables with a nice view of the aircraft. They sell tasty puffs, local food like nasi lemak, bee hoon, and laksa. Fast service and the Malay lady is very friendly. Prices are affordable, especially for staff — hard to find good food at this price in the airport!

author: yc zhong
review_text: White pepper crab is very good !! All the dishes are super fresh and tasty. We called to reserve. Restaurant is quite popular. And asked the restaurant to reserve a nice crab for us. Supper good !!!

author: Enzo Wong
review_text: All the hype for nasi lemak is basically alright. The chicken is not so tender which is easy to eat and taste good with the crips and spices they use. Sambal is very lemak. Rice is normal with spices. The price is surprisingly reasonable on normal hours. Serving is fast. Downside i guess is that the place will be packed with people. If you’re like me who likes spicy nasi lemak, maybe this is not for you.

author: Yeoh Poh Choo
review_text: Delicious Thai food. Self service. Food is ready quite fast. Reasonable price. Very nice sea view. Recommended.

author: Sarah Lee
review_text: Mixed appetizer, fried chicken wings and crispy pork were good and were the only items we think were made from scratch. The rest were just alright - stir fry beef with instant noodles, pan fried pork with frozen fries, pineapple fried rice with frozen pea and carrot mix…No draft beer Staff were very hospitable and restaurant was well air conditioned. Good for quick lunch stop

author: Bylur Xu
review_text: Homely spot. Nice halal place to hangout with my Malay pal in the midst of nots when we happen to be in the area. Service was from a crew of senior ladies who were pretty friendly and gladly shared their views from questions we asked. And perhaps appetites have shrunken, the spread of two mains and two sides had us filled to the brim. Food wasn’t the most flavourful that you know they scream msg and artificial flavourings in it, but was nice. Just nice. Wouldn’t mind to be here again if I happen to be area the area.

author: HS TEH
review_text: Good food, served quickly. Arrive on 11.30am already full house but can go in less than 15mins. Sausage have 2 flavour which can order in mix. The vege is a bit sour and very appetizing.

author: Ben Werakit
review_text: From the crowded customers since early morning speaks volume about the popularity of this restaurant. Once they give you table ticket, you can go ahead to pick by yourself the variety of homemade dim sum and other dishes so they will steam or cook for you. The taste is sumptuous and the price is reasonable. Just give it a try and see if you like it.

author: Tanya Davis
review_text: Been going her since a kid. Pastrami are the best around, service is nice and swift

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: Keikei Foo
review_text: Hidden gem !! One of the best boat noodles I've had !! Taste is better than those already famous , very flavorful. Must try !! Definitely will back when I back to hatyai . Keep it out !!!

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Tongz NP
review_text: Beautifully designed Padang-style restaurant with delicious food—especially the rendang and crispy chicken. The service is great and attentive. There’s also a separate PS Coffee area, perfect for a relaxing coffee after your meal. Cozy vibes and Instagram-worthy interiors. Definitely worth a visit!…

author: renee pham
review_text: Overall pretty good. Lots of free parking. Food did take a while to come out though, but they were busy. My family was satisfied with their meals.

author: L J (Mrs Pauer)
review_text: Stumbled upon this restaurant and we were pleasantly surprised! We chose to sit in the air-conditioned section for dinner and the food was served very quickly. The taste was great and portions were satisfying. There’s also a snack station available, which was a nice touch. Really appreciate that they have a surau provided as well. Overall, a comfortable and enjoyable dining experience. 👍✨

author: Ashlee R.
review_text: Jasmine was very helpful and helped understand the menu, ordering process and what comes with what we ordered. Most folks including myself get their order to-go so don't think you made the wrong choice if you don't see the place packed. Food is a 10 out of 10. I would recommend.

author: Brandon Goh
review_text: Finally found the time to go back and eat at this hawker centre after the renovation. Noticed the wanton mee stall I regularly patronize has shifted to the opposite side where Nam Sing Hokkien Mee is. Cho Kee wanton mee stall is still at the same location. But I noticed the uncle of the stall was there when I visited. I have never seen him there before since my younger days. I am 60 now and I used to stay around the food centre and visited regularly when I was a little kindergarten boy. I can still recognize uncle's face because he is exactly the same just grown older. Amazing! But the wanton mee is fabulous! QQQQQ LOH HAHAHAHA. The other stall is just as good though. Guess I have to go back more often to rotate eating wanton mee from both stalls!

author: Bellybanker
review_text: We have been one of loyal fans of Ibu Oka. For me, this is the best Babi Guling in Bali. Our view was indeed shared by the legend Chef Anthony Bourdain in one of his videos. Our favorite menu item would be SBabi Guling Special with extra skins. The food is here is 4.9/5.0 stars. To avoid long queue (especially during holiday season), please try to be at there before 11:30 am. They take cash only (no cards or QRIS).

author: Morgana Lamb
review_text: 10/10 - AMAZING BANH MI, the best we had during our 10 days stay in Vietnam. Bếp Mẹ In offers a warm and homely taste of authentic Vietnamese cuisine, definitely feel like they came straight from a family kitchen. Staff were friendly and welcoming, though the wait can be a little longer during peak hours or you can also get a reservation via their website, phone or going there, it is hidden gem at the back alley along with other restaurants. Is not easy to see from the street so go inside of the small street and you will find it. We had the traditional bah mi and the meatballs one and was FABULOUS. We did not have a reservation so we had to wait around 10 minutes for a table, however was quick and easy to order and to eat. Cannot recommend more. You will love their food. MUST TRY their Banh mi

author: Nicole Blondin Howell
review_text: Despite the convenient location, I would NOT recommend this branch of Margaritaville. The entire venue is dirty- grime, sticky. The air does not work well, so they have the doors to the bar open which let birds into the main dining area. Their walls are banged up and it’s clearly not well maintained. Servers were understaffed and clearly not caring on a Saturday. Our server showed up twice, took us 15 minutes to get after, and over an hour for our food. The worst was I ordered a chicken Caesar salad and the chicken was green/gray. The service attempted to gaslight me in telling me it was the seasoning, but it was only on one side of the chicken and into it. While they took the item off my bill (I did not receive that salad, I just asked for it to be replaced without chicken) it took TWENTY minutes to replace a plate of lettuce. Also- why is there a 3% charge for credit cards? You bring my bill out on an AMEX receipt holder and then charge me 3% for using AMEX. This is bad business!

author: Mano Recto
review_text: The satay experience at Lau Pa Sat is simply unforgettable — a true slice of Singapore’s street food culture. As soon as the sun sets and the grills light up, the air fills with that irresistible smoky aroma of spice and charcoal. I ordered from Best Satay Stall No. 8 — the chicken, beef, and shrimp satay were all excellent. The meats were juicy and well-marinated, with that perfect char from the grill. The shrimp satay was especially good — plump, sweet, and cooked just right, paired perfectly with the rich peanut sauce. It’s vibrant, crowded, and a little smoky, but that’s exactly the charm. Great food, lively energy, and a fantastic night-out experience under the city lights.

author: William Van Den Ouden
review_text: This place is terrible probably the worst place to eat in Las Vegas hands down The "children" burn your food don't change filters and the manager is a older lady that tries her hardest but the new generation walk all over her They don't sanitize anything All the drinks are nasty Lemonade tasted slimy and gross And I bought two bags of ice and the ice taste like it wasn't clean Manager fixed it though and gave me back my money This place is going to be closed just like the east lake mead location due to the children not taking it seriously Sad

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Quỳnh Nguyễn
review_text: Delicious food, spacious and clean space. Worth coming back!

author: Ryan Kim
review_text: My experience at Seribu Rasa was good. The restaurant captures the essence of Indonesian cuisine without losing a touch of modern flair. The food was delicious overall, providing a great opportunity to explore the diverse flavors of Indonesia. However, the seasoning was a bit strong for my taste. While this can be understood given the bold spices and flavors characteristic of Indonesian cuisine, it might be slightly overwhelming for those with a more delicate palate. Nevertheless, Seribu Rasa is a fantastic place to enjoy Indonesian food. The variety on the menu and the richness of flavors allowed me to fully experience the vibrant culinary culture of Indonesia. Overall, Seribu Rasa is a restaurant worth visiting. I look forward to tailoring my menu choices more to my personal taste on my next visit for an even more satisfying meal.

author: Adrian Ng
review_text: casual zichar place in an industrial place, yet it's packed with people looking for good, fresh and reaonably priced food. fabulous to have fish steamboat on a rainy and cooling night. the sambal made the 四大天王 dish (brinjal, lady's fingers, long beans and petai) highlight of the meal. snack on biscuits, popcorn, bean curd and ice cream (one per pax) before, during and after the main meal ;) only catch is drinks are cash only (beer was added to the food charges though) (I didn't have "money" to buy even a glass of hot tea 😭) service is brisk and friendly, and yet there is no service charge 👍

author: fengzy willa
review_text: Here Hai，a hidden Michelin gem in Paragon, serves incredible seafood that’s totally worth the 30-minute wait! The signature crab fried rice boasts large, juicy crab meat, and the pre-peeled mantis shrimp is tender enough to melt in your mouth—every bite feels luxurious. Don’t let the queue deter you; this spot delivers on flavor and quality that live up to its Michelin name!

author: Amber A
review_text: First time eating at Triple George and it did not disappoint. We were a party of 6 on Christmas Day. Service was great. Drinks came quickly from the bar. The Vanilla Raspberry Martini was delicious. One of the best french onion soups I've ever had. Great downtown restaurant.

author: k clements
review_text: ALL the food was under cook hash brown only cook on one side fruit sour for a kid at that when ask about the fruit she said she don't make it bring someone next to us fruit alot grapes alot fruit fall out I don't think the workers 🤔 or cook like black people they kept looking like we were going skip out on the check when leaving out I seen group people eating plate look perfect neat no bad lettuce or fruit I say yall th e manger she say yes what the problem I say to her all food under cook her amended response a discount I said I don't want one I pay for a service my food should be cook and right not have be brought out twice still not right she said thank you rude as hell im confused and convince they don't like black people here in the HOOD OF VEGAS .....IJS NOT RIGHT AT ALL 4 NEW BUSINESS NEED RETRAINING IMMEDIATELY RACAIL TRAINING

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: Chee Kheong Lau
review_text: The BKT is very tasty. Have tried the soup and dried type. The meat is soft and tender. Service is good. Soup is auto add on as the waiters are very alert and attentive.

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: Sheue Lin Ng
review_text: Ordered a lot of dishes to try. Few favourites. Assam fish curry, the sauce was thick and very flavorful. Crispy pork with garlic. This dish is delicious. The batter on the pork is light and fluffy. It's loaded with lots of garlic. The crispy chicken was bit too salty.

author: Đan Nhi Nguyễn
review_text: The atmosphere is cozy and not too loud. The food was fresh, herbs and fruits complemented the dishes. A little crowded, but the service made up for it. A lovely experience overall.

author: NurAfryna irdyna
review_text: Efficient and can accommodate with aircon place. Very nice ambiance and will recommend for others to try out! Came here a few times, and food is good! Come come and feast!✨

author: Daren
review_text: BLOODY LONG WAIT. Don’t come if you don’t want to wait. Has been 1 hour and not a single dish has been served.

author: Devon Patterson
review_text: There’s a lot of hype around this place because of the Bourdain feature, so I was curious to finally try it. I’m not a famous traveling chef, but with all the attention it gets, I expected something standout. The banh mi was… fine. Pretty average compared to other spots in Hoi An. One thing I did like is that they offer more than just sandwiches. I had the cao lầu noodles, a Hoi An staple, and those were actually pretty good. It’s nice to have options if you’re not in a strict banh mi mood. Overall, it’s worth trying once if you want to see what all the buzz is about, but in terms of flavor and experience, there are other places in town that impressed me more.

author: Tanakorn Lueangkajonvit
review_text: This is an interesting burger because they use bagels instead of regular bread. They offer four different types of bagels, allowing for a variety of flavors. It's crowded, but the wait isn't long. All the staff provide good service.

author: Cheryl Lee
review_text: The western is better than other places i feel, had the salmon and chicken cutlet. The sides are pretty good, macaroni cheese, mash potatoes and coleslaw.

author: Andreas Lips
review_text: I love the location and vibe, but the food is not worth the price. I had the Yuzu Salmon bowl with Bamboo rice. Sounded yummy but was pretty tasteless…could not taste any Yuzu sauce and normal Sushi rice would be so much better. Unfortunately that is not available. Quite expensive, too. I ordered the large bowl which was not really large and had more of said bamboo rice than anything else. And cost me $20 (in tax and tip). All a matter of taste in the end, it’s a different spin on the classic sushi bowls. Service and vibe were good.

author: Marcus Johnson
review_text: I’ve stopped by this location a handful of times now, and honestly, every visit feels like a coin toss. Some days things go smoothly, and other days you walk out wondering why you bothered stopping at all. It’s really one of those hit-or-miss places. The good first: The store looks pretty clean most of the time, and the downtown location is convenient if you’re already in the area running errands. When the right staff is on shift, the service can actually be decent. I’ve had one or two employees who were friendly, patient, and moved things along as best as they could. And when the food is fresh, the subs are exactly what you’d expect nothing fancy, but good enough for a quick bite. But here’s where the place loses me: the service is wildly inconsistent. There are days when the employees look completely checked out, chatting among themselves while customers stand waiting at the counter. I get that fast food can be stressful, but sometimes the attitude is just unnecessary. I’ve also had a couple of moments where I had to repeat my order multiple times because the person making the sandwich just wasn’t paying attention. Another issue is the closing hours they really need to update the times or stick to what’s posted. A few times I’ve arrived well before closing, only to find the doors locked or the employees already cleaning up and refusing to take an order. It’s frustrating, especially when you walk there thinking you’ll grab something quick. Food availability is also inconsistent. One visit they told me they were out of tomatoes, another time out of a specific bread, and once the cookies tasted like they’d been sitting out for days. It’s pretty obvious when something hasn’t been rotated or baked fresh. Overall, I keep hoping the place will improve because the location is convenient, but it feels like management really needs to step up better training, better communication, and just a bit more pride in the service. I wouldn’t say “never go,” but definitely go knowing your experience might depend on who’s working that day. If they could just tighten up the service and stick to their posted hours, this spot could easily be a reliable go-to. For now, it’s a solid “it’ll do if you’re nearby,” but not somewhere I’d go out of my way for.

author: Elok Martin
review_text: The presentation of this dish is absolutely impressive and instantly catches the eye. The mini chicken rolls are beautifully arranged on a wooden board, with the dark buns giving a unique and premium look. Each bite feels thoughtfully prepared, from the soft bun to the flavorful chicken filling. The portion size is perfect for tasting without feeling heavy, making it an excellent appetizer option. Overall, it reflects great attention to detail, quality ingredients, and a creative approach that elevates the entire dining experience.

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: Kevin Tankas
review_text: A must visit restaurant if you are visiting Bangkok / Centralworld, although a bit pricey, i think. But it is worth it, the price and the taste is just superb and worth. I can taste thailand in every dish if i may say. We ordered spicy sea bass and golden needle mushroom (360 thb), stir fried pork with shrimp paste (225 thb) and 2 steam rice. Definitely best buy, even visited couple times during our times in bangkok :)

author: Gabriel Ting
review_text: Great service and great food!! Really fresh!! Enjoyed the Meat and the Kimchi and Lettuce all great! Fresh and healthy Check out the coconut ice cream very light after the meal. Yuzu ice cream will help clean the palate as well

author: Sharif Sha
review_text: Visited for a quick drink and had a lovely cocktail. Pricey but nice. Staff could be more friendly and warm.

author: J. Manes
review_text: The complimentary bread with garlic sauce was a winner. The drinks were nice. The lamb chops were over but tasty. The grilled octopus, shrimp and sea bass were okay. The biggest glaring issue was the traditional paella. When the waiter says it doesn’t look right can I send it back for you it’s not good. Even after waiting for another one it was not great. Not one spec of Socarrat which is what makes the dish.

author: Rafael Alvarez
review_text: I had a great meal and experience at Le Thai. This place gets busy but is worth the wait. I was seated immediately since I was just a party of one and went to the bar. Shout out to Gwen and Destiny for the great service. For my meal I ordered the cheese Rangoons and the 3 Color Curry. I wish I had more pictures to share of the meal but I got too eager and started digging into the curry before thinking to snap a picture. The Rangoons were delicious, crispy and filled to the brim with cream cheese. I definitely recommend for crab Rangoon lovers. As for the 3 color curry, it was exactly what I needed on a chilly evening. The curry was amazing with the right amount of spice.

author: mohd idham
review_text: Fresh Seafood , choose and they will cook .Come here only for eating. Its cheap compare to other place . Portion and drink also big.. 😁

author: Justin Ouellette
review_text: The Butcher’s Daughter – Stylish, Satisfying, and Full of Flavor The Butcher’s Daughter on Abbot Kinney delivers on every front—delicious food, warm service, and a beautifully curated atmosphere. The space has a cool, airy vibe that feels equal parts trendy and welcoming, perfect for a relaxed breakfast or brunch. I ordered the gluten-free vegan waffles with maple syrup and added a side of bacon—the combination was absolutely perfect. The waffles were crisp on the outside, soft on the inside, and full of flavor. The bacon added that savory contrast I was desiring. The staff were friendly, attentive, and created a genuinely pleasant dining experience. Whether you’re plant-based, gluten-free, or just looking for a great bite in Venice, The Butcher’s Daughter is a must-visit spot with great vibes and even better food.

author: Jerry Ngo
review_text: Had an awesome evening at Rosso Vino. The food was appetising and flavourful. The restaurant full of charm and the service was a delight. The wine recommendation was on point. The waiter recommended Doppio Passo IGT which was fruity and smooth to drink.

author: Grzegorz Litwin
review_text: The best breakfast since my stay in Florida. I ordered Fresh Vegetable Omlette and it turned out to be a great choice. At the beginning I was greeted by friendly staff, but the tasty and fresh dish and the large portion made a great impression. Phenomenal place, you will forget about fast food once you try this restaurant. I would highly recommend this place. Greetings from Greg

author: Jose Mijares
review_text: This place is so good , the servers are super nice the food ssshhhhh super good I totally recommend it …..if your local this is the spot

author: Raymond Lai
review_text: Pricey, but worth a visit for the food and air conditioning. This is a good restaurant to experience street foods you find in Vietnam but in a comfortable restaurant setting. Staff knows English well enough to take your order. Banh xeo is decent, grilled meats are good, and the tumeric fish was moist. Air conditioning of both the first and second floors. If you're comfortable with adventuring the truly local street joints, you can skip this restaurant.

author: Hieu Nguyen
review_text: The most favorite drink here is Jasmine tea with Coconut juice that is very fresh and healthy. The food here is okay with broken rice or pho noodles. Bread sometimes quite dry and so much toppings (for myself) :). Restaurant vibe upstairs is cozy, nice and Staff service is friendly, flexible

author: Islam Alaa
review_text: I recently visited La Favela and really enjoyed the atmosphere. The place has amazing music, beautiful décor, and a great overall vibe. The only downside is that the portions for both food and drinks are quite small. The prices are average—not cheap, not expensive—just normal. Aside from the portion sizes, everything else was truly impressive and worth experiencing.

author: Amanda Allen
review_text: I am staying by the river in Hoi An and pass this lovely restaurant daily. I did stop and have drink, the other day, but thought I’d try something to eat. I ordered the white rose dumplings, which were very nice …. I will definitely come back in the evening for something a bit more substantial!!! The restaurant is very clean and decorated very well. Staff are polite and friendly.

author: yukari liow
review_text: tried the chicken pho from here and the owner recommended me to try the salted coffee, both were absolutely phenomenal!! price was quite affordable too. the owners were really friendly and wholesome, i felt welcomed immediately. would definitely come again just to order their salted coffee!!

author: Tom
review_text: Found a gem of a restaurant this morning.Stop by Bentley's Bar and Grill on Sunset for breakfast. The decor and ambience were quite impressive. I had the steak and eggs and it was only $7.95! My friend had the vegetarian omelette and she was quite pleased with it. I will most definitely be back!!!

author: Suzanna Alias
review_text: Best char kway teow, and my daughter, the fussy eater, loves it!

author: Mark Roberts
review_text: So not your typical style of serving Jamaican food. However, it was still good The jerk chicken had good flavor and the complimentary sauces give it a modern twist. I am big on customer service. However the last two times I was there it seems like I was begging them for a favor to serve me. They were more interested in talking to each other undecided amongst themselves who will serve the next customer

author: Denne Goh
review_text: Food was good. Love the dry Ipoh hor fun. Chicken rice and Nasi lemak not my favourite. Luncheon meat which was made in house was good too. But the wonton soup was the most awesome. Especially the soup itself. Very umami. You can see from the last photo we finished all our food.

author: Michelle L
review_text: truly disappointed. this was over $10 if i can remember. it’s so pathetic. the chicken cutlet were also really dry.

author: samay vora
review_text: Cong Caphe, just opposite the river, is a cozy and inviting spot. The seating is comfortable, with a great view to enjoy while you relax. Wi-Fi is strong, making it perfect for working or long chats. You can easily sit here for four to five hours without any rush. The ambience has a rustic charm with a unique vintage vibe. Their signature salted coffee is a must-try – rich and flavorful. Overall, a great place to unwind, work, or simply enjoy Hoi An’s calm.

author: Skidamarink a Dink a Dink
review_text: Food is unique and delicious Service is good, although theres almost always a waiting time Atmosphere - good, almost similar in all locations, some spacious and some not Price - a bit costly compared to local prices + they provide 2 kinds of free tea water + milk bread is also good

author: Neil Alexander
review_text: Always a delight. Authentic Italian cuisine and alfresco dining by the Singapore river. Every time I visit Singapore this is my go to place. Carlo is a great host and all the staff are great. Cyan was my excellent server.

author: Paul Lim
review_text: I really enjoyed my first visit here, so I came back tonight to celebrate my mum’s birthday. Unfortunately, it didn’t turn out as well as I’d hoped. We wanted to order some of their signature dishes like yong tau fu and crispy chicken, but both were already sold out. I wonder why some signature dishes were already gone as early as 7.30pm. So we went with other items instead. The big prawn hor fun was tasty, though it lacked that wok hei fragrance. The kam heong chicken, which I’d tried before, was still just as good as I remembered. Apart from that, most of the other dishes were pretty ordinary. The vegetable dishes also lacked wok hei, the sweet and sour pork was average, and the crispy tofu tasted rather bland. The salted egg yolk prawns were over fried and turned out tough, while the curry fish head didn’t taste fresh as the meat wasn’t sweet at all. To top it off, there was an issue with the bill. My mum had told the cashier we only opened one bottle of wine, but the bill showed two. The waitress agreed to refund $10, but she should have amended the bill straightaway. After we left, we realised the 3% service charge and 9% GST were still calculated based on two bottles instead of one. Overall, it turned out to be a disappointing evening for what was meant to be a birthday celebration. A real letdown, especially when we came with high expectations.

author: Dumitrita Paladi Contes
review_text: We stopped by for lunch on Easter Day and the atmosphere was perfect for the occasion, as well as the food we shared. The staff was very friendly and accommodating even though we didn't have a reservation.

author: Jenna Nguyen
review_text: I liked that the menu had a wide variety of foods to choose from however most of the dishes that came out looked good, but lacked flavor. Wasn’t bad, but the dish could’ve been more seasoned. It is a cute little spot and the portions are large. Good for families. Not pictured was the banana bread dessert- that was a WOW⭐️ I would come back just for that!

author: Justin C
review_text: It’s your basic Chinese buffet place, but the hibachi grill guy was pretty good at making my fried rice. All you can eat so no complaining, and decent selection of food. I left with a full stomach.

author: Umair Saqib
review_text: Burrito Bowl That’s Just Right! Loaded with fresh toppings, flavorful protein, and a perfect balance of textures.

author: Rob C
review_text: To start off I wanted to love this place. My wife and I love trying Mexican restaurants. Very friendly staff and service was great. Now for the food thats another story. We ordered the fried oaxacan cheese and it was a little greasy but good. We also ordered the pork tacos I have to say the pork itself was bland but what they top the tacos with was delicious. For mains I ordered the chilaquiles which was not good. It was cold and had no flavor like it needed salt or something. My wife ordered the enfrijoladas and again was just bland missing those wonderful Mexican flavors. Overall it was a big disappointment food wise. Something me and my wife were excited about.

author: zul mausir
review_text: Gigi Susu is a charming little café with a warm and welcoming atmosphere. The place feels quite cozy, with wooden interiors, natural light, and a relaxed setting that makes you want to stay longer. Despite being popular and often busy, the ambiance remains comfortable and not overwhelming.

author: Beth Anderson
review_text: 10/10 no notes. My only complaint is how hard it is to get a table here. I’ve never had a bad bite of food here, the cocktails are delicious. The service is impeccable and they always help me choose the perfect wine. The panna cotta with apples should not have worked.. but I practically licked the bowl and thought about the intensity of the flavors all the way home. You will find me hovering over my computer at noon desperately attempting to book my next reservation

author: iklil izdihar abdul ghani
review_text: The food was really nice. The steak superb just melting in my mouth. Nick also very nice staff and help to take our picture. Recommended!

author: Yvonne
review_text: Had a great cocktail at the bar. We were seated and had another great cocktail. Service was friendly and they delivered great food! The shrimp, the devil's eggs!! The beat salad was also tasty.

author: Shirlene Tay
review_text: This is a very popular place with lots of locals and tourists. Be prepared to wait for at least 15 minutes but the queue is quite fast and the serving time is fast as well. Many workers and all are efficient and fast workers so no worry about that. They can speak pretty good English which is good. The price is reasonable. Around 100 baht or so per dish

author: C J
review_text: Food choices are a lot from ready to eat fried foods, satay to steambot stuffs like frozen foods, seafood and vegetables. Lot of seats available but may need reservation if you come eat around peak hours at 8pm onwards. Parking is difficult to find and you may need to park far a bit. Tomyam soup is rather too sweet and no spicy for me personally.

author: mathew lawton
review_text: Great place for morning breakfast. Great vibe and the food portions are big. Can be a bit busy and noisy but I think that adds to the atmosphere of the place. Ordering at the counter is quick and simple. Then you just need to find a seat and they will deliver the food to you. Perfect for small or big groups as they have different table sizes.

author: Cris Buck
review_text: Work brought me to the area and I stopped by for an afternoon refuel. The location was fairly unassuming but maybe that’s just me being used to the Northwest. I found it to be a wonderful establishment juxtaposed by the dense (but neat) industrial area. Better parking and interior space than I’ve grown accustomed to around here, wonderful separation and options for seating, service was quick and they’re very considerate. Last of all but most importantly, they’ve officially taken first place for best dirty chai this side of the Mississippi. Creamy but balanced, slight anise flavor that’s just perfect if you like that. Check it out. Food menu looks great just didn’t have time.

author: Sidney Ng
review_text: First time at the Qatar airways lounge and was blown away by the atmosphere and service! The team's service is tremendous and always ensuring that we are taken care of. Shoutout to Hazel, Elsy, Dinky and Divan for taking care of me before my flight!! Special shoutout to Hazel for helping me find ways to cut away my hangnail on my finger!! 💕

author: Lindsey Charbonneau
review_text: Went for huskers game and had fun. The Husker fans were great. We even won an item on the raffle!

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: Sourav Kalra
review_text: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball Restaurant is a must-visit in Melaka! The chicken is tender and full of flavor, and the rice balls are perfectly soft and fragrant – a unique twist on the traditional Hainanese chicken rice. The sambal and sauces served alongside add the perfect spicy kick! The restaurant has a clean and comfortable setting with friendly staff who serve food quickly, even during busy hours. I also loved the variety of side dishes, especially the nyonya-style dishes that give a real taste of Melaka culture. Perfect place for lunch or dinner with family and friends if you’re visiting Jonker Street or exploring the city. Highly recommended for anyone who wants to try the best chicken rice balls in town!

author: dominique ordinario
review_text: TASTY & BEAUTIFUL! Milk & Madu blew me away with their kind and attentive service, delicious lattes and wonderful food. i ended up going back the next day and the food was consistently remarkable. my server Rita had such a kind soul that enjoying the space felt like home. thank you to the whole staff.

author: Jaime Schlegel
review_text: Rony is the absolute best!!! So familiar with the menu and makes the very best Espresso Martini’s❤️❤️❤️ Definitely will be back again!! Don’t miss this gem Lima Peru on the Hollywood broadwalk

author: Muhammad Fakhrullah Nor Azmin
review_text: Had our honeymoon dinner at Malini Uluwatu truly unforgettable. Delicious food, sunset right in front of us, waves crashing below… super romantic. The place is clean and beautiful. Special thanks to Ms. AISYAH, our waitress very friendly and helpful, took our photos and recommended great food. They even surprised us with a free “Happy Honeymoon” cake 🎂 such a sweet gesture. If you’re coming to Bali, you MUST visit this place. Perfect dining experience. 🌅

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Audric strongestkarate
review_text: Good quality of meat. Cooked well. Right amount of seasoning. Friendly staffs. But no tables to eat. Try them out. Servings are huge too.

author: Nathan Renaud
review_text: This place has it all excellent atmosphere, delicious food, and a great staff. The food is delicious and they give you surprisingly a lot of seafood in your dish. The food is absolutely delicious and at a great price. If you are T the beach you need to come visit At Peru.

author: Lauren Prado
review_text: Always a great experience. Loved the location on the Strip. We ate outside on the patio since it wasn't too hot. Place was packed but they move so fast you don't even feel the wait.

author: Gino Haddad
review_text: Being a huge Banh Mi fan, I made it my mission to find the best one in Hoi An. The top contenders, of course, were Banh Mi Phuong and Madame Khanh (The Banh Mi Queen). We started with Banh Mi Phuong, it’s the one that Anthony Bourdain famously loved, so expectations were high! Both places have indoor seating, which is great since you can actually sit down and enjoy your sandwich comfortably. I ordered a pork and a chicken banh mi to compare fairly. Unfortunately, the chicken banh mi at Phuong’s was quite a letdown; the meat was dry, the filling wasn’t generous, and the pâté didn’t have much punch. The pork version was better and had more flavor, but the bread could’ve been fresher. Overall, it just didn’t live up to the hype. Next stop: Madame Khanh, and wow, what a difference! I ordered the exact same sandwiches, and this time I was blown away. Both were packed with ingredients, full of flavor, and the pâté… OMG 😲 unreal! The BBQ pork was my absolute favorite, but honestly, I’d order both again in a heartbeat. So yeah, for me, Banh Mi Phuong sadly lost this round. Maybe it’s not quite what it used to be back in Bourdain’s day. Hats off to The Queen 👑 she completely lives up to her title! 🥖

author: Roche Whittle
review_text: Went to Mangrove to celebrate a birthday and it definitely hit the mark for an intimate dining spot with a nice vibe.
