They had a live dj with good music bumping; loud for low volume table conversation. Our server, Jimmy, was super attentive and made sure we enjoyed everything. We were first seated at a middle table for two but asked to move to a booth; they were very accommodating about it. For apps, we ordered the wings, lobster mac, and patty. Then came the mains: curry oxtail, jerk fried rice, rice and peas, and pineapple plantains. Loved how most of the food came out hot. Everything was flavorful, and sooo good. To finish it off, we had the ice cream and rum cake—light, fluffy, not too sweet, and just the right amount of rum to keep it moist at the bottom. Overall, a great Jamaican cuisine spot for great food, good service, and an elevated vibe.

author: Irina Uvarova
review_text: This is hands down the best hookah lounge for me and honestly one of my favorite places in Miami. I’ve been coming here since the very opening, and after the latest full remodel the place looks absolutely amazing — more space, a completely new design, and an even better vibe. Every Friday and Saturday they have DJs, plus daily specials and great deals. Even though it’s a hookah lounge, the food here is delicious — you must try the beef tartare, calamari, Caesar salad, syrniki, and tiramisu. They also recently had a sushi chef, and the sushi was incredible: super fresh and huge rolls. They have some of the best hookahs in Miami, with high-quality tobacco and a great variety of flavors, along with a wide selection of cocktails and alcohol. Amazing hookahs, tasty drinks, and great food — all in one place. The atmosphere is always beautiful and cozy, and the staff is absolutely wonderful — friendly servers and professional hookah masters who really know what they’re doing. I highly recommend this place for birthdays, events, corporate parties, or just to come, relax, smoke hookah, and enjoy the vibe. Truly the best of the best

author: Lisa Russ
review_text: Great food, salsa great went for lunch with others. The street tacos with rice and beans and the quesadillas. Check this place out and try the scorpion shot. Cool decor 😎

author: Хетик Царгасов
review_text: A disgusting organization. They couldn't unload one car for two hours. No one comes. No one cares. They don't value other people's time. I don't recommend anyone to use them.

author: Yeoh Ts
review_text: The pumpkin pork rib porridge was really comforting and warming, cooked till super smooth and silky. The dim sum siu mai and har gao were just so-so for me.

author: J. P.
review_text: I ordered the seafood platter, and the entire dish was extremely overcooked to the point of being completely inedible. The texture and flavor were ruined, and it was honestly disappointing considering the price. What made the experience worse was that the staff didn’t offer a discount, replacement, or any attempt to address the issue. For what they charge, I expected far better quality and service. Overall, the food was overpriced, poorly prepared, and the customer service was lacking. I wouldn’t recommend this place based on my experience.

author: SAJI SR
review_text: Food as usual Subway food. But the staff doesn't know English

author: Flo Yeow
review_text: This bak chor mee soup stall shares its roots with the famous stalls at Bedok 85 and 58, tracing back to the same hawker in the 1920s. While I found it to be a decent bowl of noodles, other stalls offer a more flavorful experience, though taste is subjective. This version is less crowded, which is a plus, and the soup-based bak chor mee is similar to what you'd find at the other locations. However, it could use a bit more umami. Considering the price and the absence of a queue, it's a satisfying and convenient option.

author: Franco Abrina
review_text: Conveniently located near Bedok MRT station. It has plenty of affordable food options, and finding a table wasnt difficult at all. Bought some egg fried rice and a huge bowl of chendol, partner had some delicious roasted pork 👍

author: Shahil Patel
review_text: I love this Pizza Hut, the service, wait time and quality of the pizza is excellent. Specifically while I was there, the manager Vianna and Lilian were very kind and made the experience of visiting here great.

author: Akinobu Ray
review_text: Great Nasi Kandar. Queue to get served. If it's raining, bring an umbrella and if you are allergic to the sun like a vampire, bring an umbrella. The queues can be long but don't be deterred. Didn't try the lamb shank goreng(fried) but will do it next time. The lamb curry is flavourful and just nice spicy. Fried chicken drumsticks a bit dry but tasty all the same. The taste of the food leans towards the sweeter side of neutral hence only 4* from me. Place is relatively clean and ample seating since they expanded to yet another shop house. For the ice cream people who melt in the heat, there are limited air conditioned dining spaces. Overall, a great place to experience Nasi Kandar in Penang.

author: Yvonne W
review_text: Disappointing experience. They only gave two people one menu to share, which was already strange. Plates weren’t properly cleaned and even had greasy fingerprints on them. The shredded carrots and lettuce used as sushi garnish were dehydrated and wilted — either not fresh or being reused. On top of that, they still automatically expect a minimum 20% tip for this level of service. Would not recommend.

author: JOE THOMAS
review_text: Le Thai Delivers Big Flavors! Le Thai on Fremont Street in downtown Las Vegas completely blew us away! From start to finish, it was a truly five-star dining experience. We kicked things off with the spring rolls and chicken satay, and both were absolute perfection. The spring rolls were fresh, crisp, and bursting with flavor, while the chicken satay was incredibly tender with a rich, delicious peanut sauce that we couldn't get enough of. But the real showstopper was the beef short rib with fried rice. Seriously, if you go to Le Thai, you must order this dish. The short rib was fall-off-the-bone tender and incredibly flavorful, and it paired perfectly with the savory fried rice. Every bite was a delight. Beyond the amazing food, the atmosphere was fantastic and the service was top-notch. Le Thai is now firmly on our must-visit list whenever we're in Las Vegas. You won't be disappointed!

author: Randy
review_text: Beer selection is very good, with multiple bars with large selection of taps. Various food options, all quite good. Outside garden area is very well done, with live music. As long as it doesn't get too crowded, this is a great place to have a few and enjoy the ambiance.

author: ZULLY GELLER
review_text: Food was good, service on the other hand was awful! The servers in the front were so rude and unfriendly

author: Bryan McAllister
review_text: Excellent experience. The team here is welcoming and customer service-focused. The food is excellent! For me, I love the sweet potato tots and the marsalla dipping sauce - I'm probably spelling that wrong. The Yard is on my rotation when I visit Newark for work.

author: Nem Mang
review_text: 5 stars all around! Pison completely exceeded my expectations. From the very first bite to the last sip, everything was spot-on — thoughtful flavors, great textures, and a cozy atmosphere that made it one of the true highlights of my trip to Bali. The truffle fries had that perfect golden crunch — addictive and flavorful. My only wish? A few truffle shavings on top would’ve made them absolute perfection. The duck fried rice was phenomenal — rich, perfectly seasoned, and made even better with the crispy chicken skin. The Thai beef salad was another standout — fresh, bright, and full of flavor. And the drinks? The cream cheese coffee was unexpectedly amazing — smooth, balanced, and slightly indulgent in the best way. The watermelon cooler was light, refreshing, and the perfect finish to the meal. Every dish felt crafted with care and creativity. Pison is hands down one of the best dining experiences I had in Bali — I’d go back in a heartbeat. I will also let the pictures speak for themselves. ps: price per person may vary since there was just me and my friend that ate.

author: lee berman
review_text: I know this review would be better with a picture, but I just finished a Veg. Cachapa and just wanted to give credit where it’s due. Nice to have something back on the corner!

author: lara tang
review_text: They have the BIGGEST ice coffees lol! And I like the sandwiches on fresh bread. I like the avocado and the omelettes. Nice spot for breakfast!!!! I think the potatoes they come with are little weak like they’re never crispy but it’s free potato and not a bag of chips so that’s better. And I brought a cake to a house party and everyone loved it. So get the sandwiches they’re not a bad price.

author: Loh Soon Shan
review_text: Kimly Seafood is perfect for a festive CNY feast! The Vegetarian Salmon YuSheng was fresh and flavorful, the XO Sauce Smoked Duck Fried Rice rich and aromatic, and the Prawn Paste Mid-Wings were crispy and juicy. Loved their Scratch & Win campaign—spend $45 for a chance to win up to $11,000 in cash and prizes. Great food, fun vibes, and exciting rewards! Highly recommend!

author: Sangeeta Joshi
review_text: Some restaurants leave a lasting impression with their food and service. Hellbender is definitely one for me. Fried oaxacan cheese and crushed cucumbers set the bar high and the dishes that followed got better and even better. Pork carnitas tacos, chilaquiles very satisfying but the highlight of this brunch was soft scrambled egg tostada and heirloom masa pancake. The tostadas with the chilli oil and sesame had a Chinese dish vibe, so flavourful! The pancakes with a generous slice of butter…something very special, unique taste for a pancake. First bite tasted almost like gulab jamun, an Indian dessert. Service was excellent! Hope to visit soon.

author: Thinh Nguyen
review_text: Meeting place for medium sized groups. Public area on the ground floor, private VIP rooms on the upper floors.

author: Lea Flego
review_text: Unmarked missing items from the menu. Food is mediocre. Drinks from the fridge not cold. Rude service when asked to correct an order. Decor is cute, but seating is awkward. Surprised at this place having such a high rating on Trip Advisor. Wouldn’t come back.

author: 11 Lê Tuệ Giao
review_text: The food here was fairly decent, and the security guard was genuinely kind and helpful, which I really appreciated. However, the attitude of the staff was extremely disappointing. When the restaurant got busy, they seemed indifferent and unwilling to assist customers properly. It’s a pity, because with better service, this place could be much more enjoyable. The marketing campaign on 20/10 is such a ridiculous story:)

author: Francisco Hernandez
review_text: Food was alright, but it was extremely slow, ordered 3 tacos and one burrito all asada, took 40+ minutes. Over priced in my opinion. Never going back to this location, go to any other restaurant, or location.

author: Conner Smith
review_text: Evening shift deserves some respect tonight! Dining room perfectly clean, food out quickly, and I even had my sauce and drink before the food was done with a mobile order! The guy working tonight was particularly caring, and I appreciated it!

author: A Rosen
review_text: I had a GREAT experience At the wonderful Golden Corral on south lamb boulevard in Las Vegas! The food was absolutely delicious and what a great variety ...more than any Golden Corral, that i've seen in my life. I went there for breakfast and it was a wonderful experience! They had everything you could imagine For a wonderful brunch...Including things you normally find at a more expensive and upscale type restaurant like Delicious Quiche and an omelet station! Not only did they have all the breakfast meats and egg dishes you'd expect... They also had freshly made Belgian waffles with strawberry compote and other toppings... Along with Pancakes, french toast, cinnamon rolls. Muffins... And the incredible list goes on. They also had a fabulous salad bar, and wonderful Soups, and chicken and fish and so much more... The building is modern and clean, and the staff we're wonderful and friendly and dressed in the same color and everyone was neat and clean. They play UpBeat music... And they have lots of comfortable booths and tables if you prefer. Even the parking lot was clean and well paved and well lit in case you dine at night. It truly was an amazing experience and I will be back when I visit Vegas again... It will be at the top of my list of places to dine.😀

author: Sakshi2 Jaiswal
review_text: We stumbled upon this little gem and tried their “Hidden Gem” pizza, which is perfectly named. It was honestly the best pizza I’ve ever had. On top of that, their tiramisu was absolutely mind-blowing. I don’t even have the words to describe the flavor, but I would recommend this place to anyone visiting or living here.

author: Nicole M
review_text: We’ve lived in the neighborhood for years and finally decided to check this place out. We are so disappointed we waited so long! The wine, the food, the ambiance is amazing. The bacon wrapped dates were to die for. The only reason I gave is a 4 was because the staff was so off putting trying to turn the table that they were rushing us to leave when we were finishing our bottle of wine, even when all the tables around us had gotten there before us. Other than that, it was amazing. We will definitely be returning.

author: Susie
review_text: Really good Chinese food in our neighborhood. Definitely recommend it. Love that they have boba too, and staff is very helpful and friendly.

author: Gu Sar
review_text: Everything was terrible. I don’t recommend this place at all. Better go somewhere else. By the way, I do not usually behave in the manner you are suggesting. I believe it would be more appropriate for you to focus on improving your customer service, as the attention we received was truly disappointing. The overall experience left much to be desired, and honestly, I would not return to your establishment. The people who were with me that day also left with a negative impression and share the same opinion about your restaurant. I genuinely hope you take steps to improve, for the sake of both yourself and your staff, as no business can succeed without its customers.

author: Revel Ramjewan
review_text: We recently visited Monty’s in Coconut Grove, and it was a wonderful experience! The food was absolutely delicious, and the drinks were incredible. I especially enjoyed the fish and chips, which were perfectly cooked and full of flavor. The atmosphere relaxing, making it an ideal spot for a family dinner or casual evening out. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food and a laid-back dining experience in Coconut Grove!

author: Clara Poh
review_text: Love the soupy mee pok version of this Famous Eunos Bak Chor Mee ($4.80). The minced pork and crispy pork lard pieces compliments the al dente Meepok very well and makes the broth very delicious. Three very good size huge chewy pork dumplings makes this simple meal a fulfilling one. Be prepared for the queue can be a 10-15 minutes wait depending on the time of the day Ordered a bowl of fishball soup to try ($5). The fish ball is big and bouncy but the soup is bland when compared to the minced pork soup. Definitely a must try for Bak Chor Mee lovers. Highly Recommended.

author: CK Tan
review_text: This is one of the very popular kopitiam next to the USM. Many hawker stalls providing wide variety of local foods and snacks. I particularly like the Zhu Chong Fun, every visit must order the small plate. I noticed some of the food quality is not maintaining recently, even the famous stalls. Penangites are picky eaters, they should have maintain the food quality. Pricing is hiking with recent inflation, eating out is no longer a cheaper option. Parking is available around the kopitiam, but it is a real headache, as the parking space is limited.

author: Michelle Sterling, PMP
review_text: I had the chance to try Kazumasa and was not disappointed. After trying 8 local sushi places since arriving in Penang. Most were highly recommended but only one was passable. As an avid lover of good food I had a lovely experience with the Kazumasa Set Lunch a good value at $55RM and an attentive service team. The lunch set gave me a quick understanding of their approach to food preparation and service. After struggling to recover from the effects of Covid 19, they in my opinion got it right today. Service was attentive and informative and the food was prepared with care. As I watched the chef grate the fresh wasabi at the Omakase station my excitement grew. Food preparation in the kitchen and at the sushi station were closely synchronized and hot items were still piping hot when they arrived at the table and sushi and sashimi was what I hoped for, fresh, clean and tasty. If you have time and feel nostalgic for a taste of Japan, Kazumasa provides that. Whatever challenges they faced are meticulously overcome through care, attention and craftsmanship. Planning my next visit and will try the Chef's Choice Omakase.

author: Braulio Bethancourt
review_text: One of the few Peruvian local spots from back in the day. Thank you for being around!

author: WY N
review_text: Sentosa Corner Coffee Shop – A Bukit Mertajam Food Haven If you're in Bukit Mertajam and craving authentic local flavours, Sentosa Corner Coffee Shop is a must-visit. Located in Taman Sentosa, this long-standing kopitiam is bustling with locals and food lovers who know where to find good eats. The highlight here is undoubtedly the yam rice with pork offal soup — a signature dish that's both hearty and comforting, and has become a favourite for generations. The soup is rich and flavourful, with tender ingredients that pair perfectly with fragrant yam-infused rice. It's no surprise that most tables are seen ordering this dish. Beyond yam rice, the coffee shop houses several other stalls offering a diverse range of Malaysian hawker fare. From mee jawa, pan mee, and pasembur to fresh chicken rice, Portuguese egg tarts, and traditional dim sum, the variety ensures there's something for every palate. Despite the busy crowd, service is quick and efficient. The kopitiam is clean, airy, and has a nostalgic charm that adds to the experience. Prices are reasonable, portions are generous, and the taste is consistently good. Sentosa Corner is a local gem where tradition meets flavour — a perfect place to enjoy a true Malaysian food experience.

author: Greg Henry
review_text: Great Lasagna super HOT! Server was on her own but handled it like a PROFESSIONAL!!! Bathroom needs something me upkeep but otherwise Great stop for food off the 5Hwy.

author: Louise Cooper
review_text: Fabulous!!! Such a wonderful evening. It is hard to believe you are in Bali when you step into the immaculate modern space. Every effort is made to make you feel welcome. We had a drink in the beautiful garden area surrounded by fairy lights. I had the Bloody Mary- wow!!!! This is one of the nicest drinks I’ve had in a long time. The ice was tomato pearls and the drink itself was so light and flavoursome- I need ti go back just to try this again. We did the tasting menu. I highly recommend sitting at the bar overlooking the kitchen. It was wonderful to watch the talented staff at their stations working their magic. Food was so inventive and different. So refreshing to go somewhere where the talent is so high and the skill levels to try imaginative pairings that work so well and are all cooked to perfection. I cannot recommend this restaurant more highly. It is not just a dinner but an experience. My favourite was the octopus- I have no idea how they made it so tender. My partner loved the beef bone marrow. Hopefully we can fit in another visit before we leave Bali to try some of the dishes that weren’t on the testing menu and to have another Bloody Mary!

author: Aysel Karakurt
review_text: The food was super delicious, very clean and spacious. I loved the olive tree picture on the wall. Thank you.

author: Kevin T
review_text: Really enjoyed the kuey teow soup, the broth was flavorful and comforting. The chicken was juicy and tasty, and the soup sui gao added a nice touch. Also loved the drinks: the pumpkin milk was smooth and unique, while the cold ginger drink was refreshing. Overall, a satisfying and delicious meal It's a place worth visit whenever I go to Chai Leng Park.

author: Q
review_text: The food is good if they didn’t run out of stuff all the time . They got good people working there good service, the atmosphere is alright you have to sit out side an eat nice in the spring too hot in the summer to cold in the winter would like it if they had seats inside the restaurant.

author: K P
review_text: Food would have been perfect if not for the dryness... The Grilled chicken and arroz con gandules man.i could taste the greatness but it was shortlived. Smh should I ask for gravy or something next time?

author: Dixon Chai
review_text: Had a wonderful dining experience at Kazumasa Japanese Restaurant! The sashimi was exceptionally fresh, and we enjoyed the sushi set which was delicious. We also tried the gratin crab which did not disappoint. Although the prices are on the higher side, the quality and taste justify the cost. We’re already looking forward to trying their omakase on our next visit. Highly recommend for anyone craving authentic Japanese cuisine!

author: Joanne Wardell
review_text: Fun little shop, I got an entree of fries, he got an ENORMOUS burger, I got so much fries I could barely finish them, not a bad price either. Very attentive server with the round glasses. Thank you for having us!

author: Ming Dao
review_text: This has been one of my go-to coffee shops since the early days of specialty coffee in Vietnam. After 9 years, it still feels the same. Great coffee. Delicious food. A space that strikes a quiet balance, not too loud, not too quiet. The large windows open to a beautiful city view More than just a coffee, it’s a place that still carries the spirit of old Saigon

author: Cori E.
review_text: We chose this location for my daughter's wedding celebration. Every single person we interacted with was wonderful from the phone calls to the service and the meals. Everyone raved about their food and fantastic cocktails. Such a wonderful evening of exemplary service and food. Thank you to all the staff for truly making it a magical night for all of us.

author: Eldrie Abdul KADIR
review_text: We had a wonderful dining experience at Seribu Rasa, where traditional Indonesian flavors are presented in a beautifully premium and luxurious environment. The ambiance was calm, elegant, and perfect for both casual dining and special occasions. Every dish we tried brought out the authentic taste of Indonesia, with rich spices and well-balanced flavors. The mango salad was a refreshing start – tangy, sweet, and light. We also enjoyed the kangkung goreng which was crispy and full of wok aroma, the golden prawn butter Siam style that was rich, creamy, and flavorful, and the ayam goreng kampung – crispy on the outside, tender and juicy inside. Everything tasted delicious and satisfying. The presentation, service, and quality truly reflected a premium dining experience, while still staying true to traditional roots. Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy genuine Indonesian cuisine with a refined touch.

author: Herman Ng
review_text: In my opinion it is the best pizza in NYC that I’ve had. What I like about the pizza is it isn’t too heavy, more on the light side. The bottom is crisp with hardly any flop. I went to the Brooklyn location on a Monday, early afternoon. There was a banal line but it moved quickly. There are spots inside or outside to eat your slice.

author: Ailin Goh
review_text: Clearly I looked like a tourist! But jokes aside, the service is excellent. I got a 1 on 1 lesson on how to eat my bowl of Pho. Pairing with the vege and sauce I need to dip my meat with. Food is good. It was an easy 3mins walk from my hotel. First meal when I landed. Thumbs up! Will be back for sure.

author: Antony KW
review_text: All menu selections are reasonably priced. There are 2 sizes (small and large) for most food items, which would perfectly suit food tasters having a go at a few items during the visit. I had their signature items, Sau Ho Fun and Prawn Dumpling Soup with a pumpkin barley drink, all for MYR 14.10. Tables are placed with enough space from each other for social distancing and the restaurant is properly ventilated with ceiling fans, creating a cool setting for customers to enjoy their food selections. Definitely an eating haunt not to be missed if you are in Butterworth (Penang).

author: Thomas Gross
review_text: I wasn't aware the restaurant was in a hotel and it was a little hard to locate. But, my wife and I are glad we found it. The atmosphere was quaint and quiet. Our server, Joseph did his job well. We didn't have to wait all evening for our food. It was brought to us promptly and the presentation was excellent. My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed ourselves. And again, kudos to Joseph for his service. I had the t-bone, mashed potatoes, asparagus and rice w/bean sauce. My wife ordered steak w/onions and french fries. We both had salads. All foods were cooked to perfection. Very tasty. If there's a negative to our visit, it's the portions are large. I'm a big eater and I had to carry home leftovers. To much food. I highly recommend a visit.

author: Bima Darussalam
review_text: We’re had an amazing dinner experience at Skye, the service from waiter is very nice specially from Gibran, he is a good waiter. And thank you for help me to celebrate my girlfriend’s birthday

author: Edwar Kartio
review_text: What I remembered the most from this dining experience was the shock that I got from the "encyclopedia" of a menu. It was big and each of the dishes had these big pictures, truly overwhelming with the choices especially some of them that are not your typical famous Indonesian dishes. The portions of most of the dishes are not too big, perfect for sharing between 2 to 3 people which allows you to order many different things. I wouldn't recommend the tahu Gejrot as it wasn't that good but the rest of the food is decent. Service is a little slow granted it was on the weekend lunch time. Food - 7 Service - 7 Vibe - 7 Price - $$

author: Sakura Stan
review_text: East Coast Lagoon Food Village in Singapore is a beloved hawker centre renowned for its wide variety of local seafood and grilled delights. Set by the beach, it offers a unique open-air dining experience with a laid-back coastal vibe. Popular dishes include barbecued stingray, satay, sambal squid, and Hokkien mee, all prepared with bold, authentic flavours. The smoky aroma from the charcoal grills fills the air, drawing in locals and tourists alike. Diners often enjoy their meals under the stars, accompanied by a sea breeze. It’s a perfect spot for affordable, delicious Singaporean food in a scenic, relaxing setting.

author: muibadah
review_text: One word. Actually TWO!! Delicious & Patience. To gain deliciousness, you'll have to be patient. He's a one-man show, but believe me when i say it, it is worth the wait. Just have lots of patience. Seriously... 😋👍

author: Lucy Ruiz
review_text: Delicious cake Was of dulce de leche, peaches and vanilla custard

author: Michelle Tey
review_text: I visited Joja Bagel recently and it was such a pleasant experience! I tried three flavors -Super Mario, The Breakfast Club, and Pistachio. Among all,The Breakfast Club was definitely my favorite😋 Their coffee was also really good, smooth and aromatic, the perfect match with the bagels. The staff were very friendly and welcoming, which made the whole visit even more enjoyable. Overall, a cozy place with great food, great coffee, and even better service. Highly recommended for all bagel and coffee lovers! 💛

author: Peter B
review_text: This place is authentic and delicious food. These other reviews are absolute trash and mostly lies, written by delusional Karens with no idea what Sichuan food is. People saying they had allergic reactions when the numbing peppercorns are literally foundational to Sichuan cuisine. This place is great. Don't listen to the dumbos. Get the beans and spicy chicken.

author: Kerly Skaret
review_text: Great atmosphere! The food portion was amazing, the food itself was delicious. The drinks were great! Waitress was very attentive and positive. All in all we had a great time here.

author: Sherlyn M
review_text: Great place to eat. The food is amazing. Very tasty chicken! Great customer service, everyone was super friendly. Graciela was super helpful and prepared our food with love. My family and I love this PT location.

author: GK
review_text: Ordered garlic Roti Canai and plain roti canai. Customers came after me was served before me. The curry was extremely diluted and watery. All the staff had savour long face. While being seated on the table having coffee one of the staff was mopping the floor hit the table leg which I was seated on and did not even bother to say sorry. He completely ignored and went on mopping like nothing happened. When my food was late as I asked I was not given proper response. They were all seated just giving hand signals tht food is coming with sulky face. Went to pay at the cashier. The guy collected the card keyed in the price n chucked the card in front of me with sulky face. Went there at 5am on 26th Sept 2025.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Suzalinna Sulaiman
review_text: I finally had the chance to try Pagi Sore after hearing so much about it. The place definitely has a lot of buzz, but personally, I found the food to be just average. While the menu offers a good variety and the presentation is neat, the flavors didn’t quite live up to the hype. Service otherwise fast, efficient and tip top. Overall, it’s worth a try if you’re curious, but don’t go in expecting a culinary experience that matches the hype.

author: Chris Guarnieri
review_text: Stephanie was one of the best waitresses we had came across. She gave great service and recommendations for food. The mango mimosa was the best one we sampled and ended up getting a big one to share. Will definitely be making this a regular stop.

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: YAT Lifestyle
review_text: My parent first choice. Food is delicious enough, with bak kut teh soup and dry type. The service is outstanding, crew will auto top up soup for you without calling. The crew is equipped with Chinese multi dialects and communicate well.

author: Henry Cheng
review_text: I must admit the Nasi Lemak is pretty decent here. In fact, it’s better than many places. The rice was light and fluffy, each grain infused with coconut taste. Chicken wing was served hot and crispy as well. The sambal was good too as it was flavourful without being overly spicy.

author: Torn Marom
review_text: I ordered the Banh Mi Chao Upgrade, and it was very good with a taste different from a regular Banh Mi. I recommend trying it. The staff also provided good service.

author: Khoi Pham
review_text: Interestingly enough, my personal favorites were the smaller dishes rather than the larger ones. Notably, the oeuf mayonnaise and the warm house bread (the butter especially) were great. Otherwise, everything else was fine although nothing too particularly memorable. The staff is very attentive and helpful. The vibes are lively but also serene, which I like.

author: Hatsune Miku
review_text: Another over-rated food centre. Most of the food here is either average or below average. Nothing fancy here that taste good. Honourable mentions here are the nasi lemak and fried carrot cake. So bad, that i almost puked my food out. Not going to call these stalls out, but you know who you are. Did I mention how arrogant the people selling the sarawak kolo mee are? Overall, I have not had much good experiences here at this food centre. But the fishball noodles at Hui Lai is pretty decent, and I think is one of the better stalls there.

author: Wayne Eichler
review_text: Food was average at best. The two entrees were not seasoned and tasteless. I asked what the waiter recommends and read all the entrees. What was one or two that were really good. My mistake on my part to ask. Plenty of other options to try in the area.

author: Jureena Sisuwan
review_text: The interior is beautiful. Food quality has declined. Had a tough time eating the squids, both from fried squid and tomyam was very tough. Tomyam is too sweet & strong artificial flavour. Lemonade was too sweet too.

author: karine belhumeur
review_text: Tavern OPA was just as delicious as I remembered from a few years ago! The food was fresh, flavorful, and so satisfying. I’ll definitely be back again.

author: lourdes lopez
review_text: Great experience at this IHOP in Vegas! Our waitress Ester was amazing, and the manager Miguel was very attentive. They went above and beyond with excellent service and even explained the rewards system. Way better than the Strip—no crazy long lines. Food was fresh, and as a decaf coffee drinker, I really appreciated that they brewed a fresh batch just for me. Highly recommend

author: Karina Adianto
review_text: Wahaha jimbaran We were seated on the outdoor area. It was a comfortable breezy spot. We ordered: Corn bbq Corn cheese French fries Mashed potatoes Colesaw 👍 Carbonara Pork knuckle 👍 Roast pork belly 👍 Wahaha Pork ribs large 👍 Draft beers Wahaha is one of the best pork ribs restaurant in Bali. All the pork were juicy, flavorful and tasty.

author: Duy Tung Vu
review_text: The food was a bit salty but overall it was ok. The babi guling was juicy and not dry.

author: Sandy Johnson
review_text: My server Ms. Debby was awesome. She was very attentive tour needs. Not to mention the food came hot!! Perfect meal

author: Chang Yu
review_text: BEST PHO AND SERVICE EVER Love the soup and mango smoothie so much. The staffs were so friendly and supportive. They recommended their signature drink and asked me if I get any allergy or no dairy. One time, I didn’t have enough money to afford it — I was short by about 2,000 dong. The staff was very kind and let me have it without paying the full amount. I felt grateful of their service. However, I still decided to come back the next day and pay the full price (don’t copy me, always bring cash guys). I highly recommend this restaurant you all

author: BiG Yu
review_text: I ordered food to go. I wanted to try the food out and it was BAD. I had a chicken gyro and fries. The fries were solid but the chicken gyro didn't have traditional tzyki sauce. Whatever sauce is on there was BAD. I wouldn't even call this a gyro, it's really a pita sandwich and it's Wack. The chicken was chewy and I tasted a hint of vinegar. I also ordered Salmon, Collards and Cabbage. This is all basic in its flavor profiles. All boring and lackluster but edible. However the cabbage was horrible. In closing I will never eat there again.

author: E. Clara Verill
review_text: Wings were a bit tough and dry and the wait time was fairly long. No napkins were provided or visible. However, the offer of water was much appreciated, so 4 stars for service.

author: Abba Studios
review_text: The food is good. I'm always greeted with a smile by employees. Good is served in a reasonable time. They bring the food to your table when it's ready and I appreciate that good service.

author: Irene Chung
review_text: 1st time visiting this place, the place is just next to the Ubi Driving school. Arrived around 6.30pm, less crowded. Lala soup based is tasty, not to forget to add the 花雕酒 to enhanced the flavor and more tasty and its refillable! Price is reasonable too. Recommend to be seated outdoor and it’s quite hot seated inside.

author: Oli H
review_text: Had my birthday meal here, and really enjoyed the Omekase. As we sat down some of the fish arrived from the airport straight from Japan.. so we got to see the chef go at it full on! The staff were extremely attentive and super fun to chat to; honestly they will do anything to help make your experience too notch and have superb knowledge of the cuisine. The Sake Sommelier really knew his stuff too and picked out a lovely few Sake for us to try with the meal. The chef was excellent and explained everything in great detail....very Interesting indeed. He even grated the real Wasabi for us to try straight off the grater!! Delightful and so Aromatic! A great experience and such a treat! Come give it a go People! 👍👍👍👍👍👍

author: Lucia Podmanická
review_text: Great sushi and sashimi. Amazing place to eat at the omakase dining table! What an amazing experience to remember.

author: Poh Zhi Nan
review_text: This was my first meal in Hatyai and I am glad I started my solo trip on a good start! The fried rice with BBQ pork was so fragrant (there was wok hei!) and every bite was packed with flavour. There was a side of cucumber as well which I believed was to cleanse the palate. I ordered a coconut nectar drink as well but it felt too healthy for me and I was not really used to the taste haha. The owners here are very friendly and they are bilingual (can speak English and Chinese aside from Thai). There is seldom some fruit flies flying around but it doesn’t affect the meal experience. I thought it would be warm but there is ample ventilation. Overall, it’s a really authentic experience and I highly recommend this place!

author: Hank Goldman
review_text: This was our first visit to this newer location. We were there between 2 and 3 on a Thursday. The food was well stocked and hot. It was not as fresh as we have experienced at their other locations but I think that was to be expected because it was pretty slow while we were there. The one real disappointment was the server. It was very slow yet we had to chase her down for refills and to clear a large pile of plates. We love the Flaming Grill Buffets and will be back again.

author: Raisa Ceron
review_text: Was visiting Boston for the weekend and was craving a Dominican breakfast. Listen my mom is a great cook but I have never had Mangu this smooth. Everything was delicious, would definitely recommend and have again when in Boston.

author: Francisco Casal
review_text: They overcharge every time and claim their system doesn’t let them charge the right amount. They claim they can’t use the simple menu, so they select a ready made sandwich with a higher price than what you actually order. Adds 15% to the price.

author: Krystalinh Magick
review_text: Overdue review!!! I have coming here since 2017, that was my 1st vegan restaurant in Canggu, still one of my favorite : lots of yummy good quality ingredients. My tops are Protein Bowl, Vegan nachos, Falafel bowl, Açaï smoothie & the choco mousse dessert is delicious😍💖✨ I always bring my friends here 🙏🏽🌸✨

author: Stephanie Troncoso
review_text: The restaurant was beautiful. Great food, clean space, and Christine was so kind and helpful. We would definitely return and recommend the space.

author: long vo hoang
review_text: Fresh and delicious food, reasonable price Especially the owner is enthusiastic and friendly

author: Shawn Sheng
review_text: The different flavors of fries just hit different. They are super tasty and cause a flavor explosion in your mouth. Their chicken wings are decent too. A nice spot to go to after walking around the Americana for a snack. Nice and simple fast food. Make sure to enjoy while it is hot.

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: YKC
review_text: Free parking along the road is no more. Gantry carpark by G-Tech. Should have stick to the potain bak ku teh. Tried the following dishes. String bean fried ok, Assemblies fish not so fresh, dry and asam sauce too thick. Coffee spare ribs ok, but Clayton tofu can be improved. Rice is of low quality type. How expensive is the rice that you need to lower your standards? The JB vibes no more after gantry installed. Beside this aircon restaurant, there is a non aircon restaurant seems to have a much bigger crowd.

author: Syaz Subhan
review_text: The food was decent and the shop was clean. It’s definitely nice to have a halal restaurant right in the middle of Jalan Alor. They even have a prayer room, which is a big plus and super convenient. That said, for the same price, I’d probably choose a restaurant in a mall where the food quality is better. But if you’re there for the Jalan Alor vibe and atmosphere, then the price is acceptable. We paid the food around RM150.

author: Joceline Setiawan
review_text: This is my second visit to Milk & Madu, and it’s still one of my favorite cafes in Bali! The food is consistently delicious (fresh ingredients and beautifully presented☺️) The coffee never disappoints, and the staff are always friendly and attentive. The cozy atmosphere makes it the perfect place to relax, whether for breakfast, brunch, or just a coffee break

author: Don Miller
review_text: I haven’t been there in years but stopped in recently for a late lunch to satisfy a craving for a taste of the old country, and a good German beer. Food, service and atmosphere was very good. Das jaegerschnitzle ist Wunderbar 😋🍺🇩🇪

author: Sadiel Serrano
review_text: Its the forth time now, and still really good sushi, not that expensive and have a natural ambient and decoration that brings you at least to me peace, nice decoration and service its nice also

author: Humberto Lameda
review_text: I wasn’t sure about coming here at first since it’s a chain and I wanted an authentic Boston seafood experience — but I’m so glad I did. The clam chowder is fantastic and might just rival my long-time favorite She Crab chowder from Charleston. No wonder this soup is served at the Presidential Inaugural Luncheon every year! I also had the swordfish — beautifully presented, satisfying, and full of flavor. The service was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. Highly recommended!

author: Eddie Khoo
review_text: 🥢 Thong Smith Siamese Boat Noodles – A Premium Twist on a Thai Classic Thong Smith offers an upscale take on traditional Thai boat noodles, known for their rich, flavorful broth and high-quality ingredients. Located in prime Bangkok malls like Siam Paragon, CentralWorld, and EmQuartier, it’s a go-to spot for locals and tourists looking to enjoy comfort food in a clean, air-conditioned setting. ✅ What’s Great • Deep, savory broth: Thick and full-bodied, especially the beef broth—intensely aromatic with hints of spices. • Premium meats: Choose from Wagyu beef, marbled pork, tenderloin, or Kurobuta. Meat is usually tender and well-cooked. • Customisable noodles: Various noodle types (rice, egg, vermicelli) and soup bases (beef or pork). • Crispy pork rinds & garlic toppings: Add satisfying crunch and aroma. • Sides like fried wontons and grilled pork neck also shine. ⚠️ What to Note • Price is higher than typical street stalls (expect around 150–300 baht per bowl). • Small portions – more suited for tasting or sharing, not for big appetites. • Some find the broth too salty, especially in the beef version. 💬 Verdict If you’re after a clean, modern setting with gourmet-quality Thai boat noodles, Thong Smith is worth a visit. While it may not have the rustic charm of a boat-side stall, it makes up for it with quality ingredients, great presentation, and reliable service.

author: Alice Sok Peng
review_text: Chokdee closed then we try here. First time. Came around 12pm+ on Thursday. No queue. The bah kut teh and dim sum taste ok. Dim sum cost around 25/40 baht for each. Not sure which one is 25 baht or 40 baht. They will give one order list to order. The paper translated in English and it was easy for customer to order their type of bah kut teh and drinks. We ordered small bah kut teh meat only and ripened pu-er in pot. I would recommend to eat the prawn type steam dim sum. Char siew bao so so. Lor mai gai too strong five-spice powder, personally not prefer. Must eat their half boiled egg, the texture like onsen eggs and taste not like cheap eggs. All cost us around 580 baht if I not mistaken.

author: Harry
review_text: Found this place while browsing the Internet for cheaper food options in Changi! 🍽️ Tried Item 14 – Fried Noodles with Fragrant Mushroom and Pork from the Taiwan Delight stall — and it was surprisingly good! You can really taste the smoky “wok hei” flavour, and the portion is big enough to share if you’re a small eater. Definitely worth checking out! Will try more dishes next time I’m at Changi Terminal 1. ✈️🍜 #ChangiEats #BudgetFood #TaiwanDelight #HiddenGem #Item14 #MustTry

author: Daniel Clyburn
review_text: This is a fine dining restaurant. Service is upscale. food choices fits all categories. Large portions. I had the duck breast which could've cooked for about 5 more minutes it was somewhat chewy but acceptable. The restaurant is large but i suggest having a reservation. Very comfortable atmosphere. I learned of this place from a conversation with an Uber driver. He raved about it and i became curious. Easter Sunday after church a few of us was trying to figure a place to go. I remembered me wanting to try this place and it was in the area. It was a good decision. Whew ... I would not have survived the backlash from my friends had it not been. We all agreed it was a good place.

author: Angela Wong
review_text: The dalu noodles were average, lacking in flavor, and not as delicious as people say online. The braised noodles were better than the dalu noodles... The tangshui was good, with plenty of ingredients and was delicious. Conclusion: The tangshui was better than the noodles.

author: Kody Kai
review_text: There was a lot of buzz around this place so we decided to try it. We got the chicken broken rice and the pork broke rice. Our food came out in no more than 2 minutes. The only part of our dishes that were hot, was the rice. The meat was room temperature. If this plate was hot, I would have easily given it 5 stars. It’s also weird because we arrived about 10 minutes after opening.

author: Amanda Taylor
review_text: Omg! The sushi was beyond what I thought it was. Sake options were fruitful and my friend and I could not get enough of the one fish! Must try! Service was accommodating and atmosphere with music was catchy.

author: SeaWhy Adventures
review_text: Absolutely delicious and tons of selection. We picked this place since we were in the area and the reviews were good. My husband had the grilled grouper sandwich and I got grouper fish fingers, both were cooked and seasoned to perfection. We will absolutely eat here again. Great service and great food!

author: shannon filson
review_text: Togo's always hits the spot, although they seem pretty crazy expensive these days. A half a salad is $10! I used to get the half salad, half sandwich combo which was perfect amount of food. Now you can get a half salad and a mini sandwich, on the mini sandwich you can only have one meat unless it's the Italian.

author: Avijeet Sen
review_text: Have visited this outlet of Punggol Nasi Lemak as few times. I feel it’s like any standard 4 rating (out of 5) Nasi Lemak place. Nonetheless, it’s a decent place to quench your Nasi Lemak cravings. Dunno if they have a standard Nasi Lemak set which you can order because whenever I’ve visited, I’ve just chosen the various side dishes to go along with the rice and fried chicken. Overall, a decent place to stop by for lunch for dinner if you’re in the area. But not sure if the place matches its hype.

author: Félix
review_text: Nieces and nephew, while in KL I definitely had to try Uncle Roger! On the 7th floor of the Pavilion shopping mall, it’s a very colourful (orange!) diner style restaurant. Even though the atmosphere seems a bit cold, probably due to its location and uninspired service, it’s very popular especially with families and younger kids. But at the end of the day, who cares when we’re here for one thing and one thing only?! And I have to say, Uncle Roger delivers! The fried rice is full of flavour and unmistakable wok hei. Even on a low carb diet I couldn’t help but finish the plate… And come back the day after for seconds! I highly recommend to check it out if you’re in Malaysia, you won’t regret it, and it’s reasonably priced - FUIYOH!

author: Manuel Melara
review_text: Place was amazing! Food was delicious server was great! Had a blast! Highly recommended! 🥚

author: Danny
review_text: Food is cold PS: much cleaner and better food. Will come back more often. Just quick question: why collect people money beforehand?

author: BusyB
review_text: Blast from the passed! Last time I was here was when I lived in the neighborhood…30 years ago! I was looking forward to a fantastic meal. It was ok, but not as good as I remember it. The prices were very high. Our service was great and the ambiance was exactly how I remembered it. My favorite part was the store full of German treats.

author: KRISDIAZ
review_text: I'm a fan of good burgers... and if you're looking for that, this is the best place. I also want to highlight the customer service provided by Gary, an older man with a great attitude toward children and young people, offering stickers and hats... thanks IN-N-OUT Burger...

author: Chon Picha
review_text: The food is really delicious. Each dish comes in a big portion. There are a lot of people lining up. It's close to Chulalongkorn University. If you're visiting Bangkok, you definitely should try it!!

author: Kevin Drost
review_text: San Pedro Square Market is a really cool indoor market with plenty of outdoor seating as well. It’s made up of three different buildings, all packed with a wide variety of food vendors and bars, so there’s truly something for everyone here. I had to try the Hella Good Burger, and it definitely lived up to the name. The burger was very well seasoned, super juicy, and served on a soft potato bun that was honestly one of the best parts. It was a little messy, but in the best way — overall a really hella good burger. We also shared a margarita pizza from Pizza Bocca Lupo. The pizza was excellent: the sauce had great flavor and the crust was even better, perfectly cooked with a nice texture. Overall, this is a fun spot with tons of food options and a great atmosphere. Definitely a place you can come back to multiple times and try something new each visit. I’ll for sure be back to try more.

author: wan ling
review_text: Came during dinner. It was pretty busy. However, the service staff was friendly and attentive to the guest needs . Food wise, ordered fried chicken wing , salmon papaya salad add on corn, and sticky rice . Best sticky rice i ever have in bangkok . It's tender and goes well with the dishes ordered. The restaurant to go to when in Ban tha tong.

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: Ah Zhi & Jie Wen
review_text: Went there for consecutive 2 days, great services, waitress can speak Chinese and English. The chef gave us the sweetest smile that made us feel like home. Noodle taste great (personal opinion) very aromatic 👍

author: Kenzie Winther
review_text: I went here three times. Twice in the same day. It was my first banh mi and my last of the trip. First off. They are cheap, big, and they don’t skimp. Every time I got the traditional number one with the cold cuts, veggies, liver pate etc. I loved every single bite. The bread is so fresh not matter the time of day you go. It was the best banh mi I had in all of Vietnam. You can eat on the curb or carry out. We did both. They are kind and patient. This was by far my favorite food experience while in Vietnam. Don’t miss it!

author: Trong Nguyen
review_text: The food was okay, but the staff seemed to be rushing the guests to eat quickly and leave; the party started at 8 PM, but all the dishes were served by 8:45 PM. It was like they wanted us to eat quickly, clean up, and go to sleep or something.

author: Go Local New Jersey
review_text: Had some of the most comforting food of my life here at this hidden gem. The momos were so filling and satisfying and paired great with the paneer. Jhol Momos are great if you want to eat something warm on a cold day. If you love Indian or Chinese food you need to try this restaurant out! I only wish the restaurant was a little bigger so I could invite more people.

author: Iced Latte
review_text: I was there with 7 pax (4 elderly, 1 teenager). Food was alright, wasn't extraordinary. Service was extraordinarily rude though. We ordered their 3 in 1 appetiser and ended up with 4 dishes (fish, omelet, stir fry vege and stir fry tofu). We only wanted to go with 3 dishes but the waitress almost had her jaw dropped and did not want to leave our table and demanded that we proceed with the 4th dish. Two waitresses were unhappy, told us we cant add on orders later cause they have tooo many customers and quickly kept the menu. So if you are not a big eater, dont bother dining here. The restaurant should perhaps put up a minimum spend per table :)

author: Ratih Safirawati
review_text: I visited Mevui Vietnam Kitchen at Legian today. The place has a good atmosphere. The food is full of Vietnamese flavors and really comforting dishes. I love to order Pho Saigon, Nem Nuong, Banhmi and Com Soun. It’s was delicious. The staff are super friendly. Thank you to the staff tonight. Ayu, Santya, Melinda, Dwi, Komang, Pandu and Okta. The manager is also really kind and attentive. It’s the kind of service that makes you want to come back. Overall, Mevui Vietnam Kitchen is a great spot for tasty Vietnamese food paired with genuinely good hospitality. Definitely worth to visit! 🤍

author: Vishal Shirsat
review_text: This restaurant was a customer choice for a quiet dinner. Away from the hustle and bustle of Clarke Quay and more famous places and nearer to the airport, from where he had to catch a flight. Its a very nice place to have a good, quiet dinner and drink. The cool sea breeze flows into this place, and light music plays in the background. The place is accessible by taxi or nearby car parks on the ECP. The ambiance is very good with a combination of high chairs and normal seating. The food is amazing. We chose the Chicken Tikka platter and were full with that. It was tasty and filling. The staff is very polite and nice. Would go again here to have another quiet and calm evening with good drinks and dinner

author: Khasseli Tanuwijaya
review_text: Nice live music, good service and nice food. Good place to hang out with family and friends. ☺️

author: Isabella
review_text: Exceptional food, didn’t even take the time to capture some photos. All you gotta do is just go and try, you won’t regret it.

author: Lance L
review_text: Good food, consistent quality. Dishes are well-balanced, not overly sweet, and portions are decent. Service is professional and efficient, especially considering it’s inside Siam Paragon. A reliable choice for Thai cuisine in a mall setting.

author: Jeffrey Gomez
review_text: I thought New York didn’t have a chilis for a long time. We definitely need more. I came here to celebrate Mothers Day with my family and this was the perfect spot. Our server was the best. I think his name was Ben. He showed us hospitality and even though he was juggling with multiple tables he still made sure our table was taken care of. Service was good. Food came out pretty fast. I love how the tortilla chips for the chips and salsa came out warm. I had to try the viral fried mozzarella and it was really good. I also had the triple dipper. It’s a great deal. The restaurant was spacious and perfect for families and smaller groups.

author: D P
review_text: The food was perfect. Every little details was spot on authentic Vietnamese flavour. Will come back!

author: Vince
review_text: The servers here are veryyy very nice, helpful, quick, and knows what you want. There is a live music too at sunday night, the band is very good you can even request the song. Great food

author: rudy lee
review_text: It’s breakfast time, we’re hungry, and let’s face it we need to eat. But that doesn’t mean we’ve lost all standards. Now, we’re not being snobs here… just practical. Dim sum in Thailand? Really? That’s like flying to Italy and ordering sushi. Sure, it exists but should you? It’s not indigenous, it’s not iconic, and it’s definitely not what Thai kitchens wake up thinking about at dawn. We’re in the land of tom yum and mango sticky rice. So, while dim sum might be available, it’s a no-brainer to stay away. Why settle for lukewarm siew mai pretending to be Cantonese when there’s a steaming bowl of boat noodles waiting to give you a hug? Some might say we’re being picky. Nah — we’re just making smart choices with our stomachs. After all, breakfast is too important to waste on mediocrity.

author: Noyonika Parulekar
review_text: The staff is very sweet and friendly. Unfortunately, the shawarmas my friend and I got were bland and did not taste like shawarma meat. Similarly, the baklava was underwhelming — flavorless and lacking in pistachios and rose flavoring.

author: Haley Phan
review_text: The menu looks great, with proper presentation and manners. The service is quick and polite. The Pad Thai and papaya salad are delicious. I especially love the Thai iced milk tea and the coconut cake. I’ll definitely come back to try other dishes.

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: Luis See
review_text: It's a must try in Bangkok Thong Lor. Just down the station very convenient location. Got a seat immediately at lv1, there's more seat at lv2. Food is very authentic love the noodle with abit of everything, but sad thing is you can't do add-ons. The fried rice is also superb with hints of wokhei. Also ordered mixed trio of crispy pork, char siew and duck; huge portion and value for money. Overall good food and reasonable price. Definitely I'll be back. HERE: 24 SEP 25

author: Jolina SM
review_text: I found this place just by searching brunch spots what caught my eye was it is family owned and operated. Also I wanted a place away from the strip. Boy it didn’t disappoint! The service the food was amazing the selection of savory foods and sweet was amazing. Rob was outstanding personality and hospitality!

author: Rosa Almonte
review_text: Atmosphere is wonderful, great music and view. Service was not bad. However the food was terrible by far the worst ceviche I have ever had and the fried fish looked amazing and was decently seasoned but it was over cooked and extremely dry. Drinks look deceivingly great but taste like cheap liquor and cheap mixer. Overall, great ambience and view decent service but terrible over priced food. 1 appetizer 1 entree to share and two drinks for 175 dollars. Will not be returning.

author: Daryl Combs
review_text: Arrived at about 9:30 Sunday am. Was told there would be about a 20 minute wait and that I would get a text. An hour later, still nothing. Went inside and was told, “sure we can seat you.” Of course that was true, she had 6 empty tables. FYI: an important metric for restaurants is turns of the tables – if they are empty, there is no revenue. So, we were seated, and almost immediately, Catherine showed up. Catherine had just finished the last of a coffee pot and a Dentyne commercial, so she was way too hyped for us. She then proceeded to tell us about every single new drink that was available from the bar, and each one was better then the last. Sorry, we were not interested in drinks. Next the menu. After my wife decided on the pancakes, next came all the add ons, blueberries, eggs, hot chocolate, etc. She felt like she had just chosen the Dodge in the back and had been pushed to get the seat covers and spinners. I ordered the haystack. Wife was satisfied with her pancake. The haystack was not as I pictured in my mind – it basically was fries with chorizo gravy dumped on it and the worlds smallest egg on top. We came here for the chorizo gravy because of @brandonfromvegas, but it didn’t live up to his hype. All in all, the food was edible, but the experience was not so much.

author: JH Tang (Jia)
review_text: Just came back for my kid’s favorite yam rice — still tastes just as good! The soup is clear but full of flavor, with soft pork and yummy meatballs. The price is okay, and the food quality hasn’t changed. A nice place for a warm, comforting meal that brings back memories. 😋😋😋

author: A G
review_text: Someone in the kitchen was smoking. The pictures make this place seem cute but it’s just a dressed up cheapo place. The server never said a word to us and the guy in the kitchen was smoking. I was so distracted by the unclean vibe that it really detracted from what could be a good enough meal Bao was clearly frozen. All of this stuff is just heated up cheap packaged food

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Eric Hayes
review_text: I have been a loyal Serafina customer at both NYC locations and now the new Downtown Miami World Center location. I am a Condo owner at a neighboring building called Marina Blue at 888 Biscayne Blvd. I am so happy that Serafina is my neighborhood restaurant. I order takeout most of the time due to the proximity of the restaurant to my home. The bartenders and hostesses and especially the manager are always professional and respectful, which I expect as a New Yorker and they have always gone above and beyond to make me feel like family which is rare as a transplant from the Northeast. The food is always delicious and ready on time. Best addition to the neighborhood!!!

author: Tiara
review_text: ✨ As bomb as the hype says – Gigi Susu absolutely delivers! ✨ Everything was just so good – the food was delicious and perfectly balanced, and the drinks? Not overly sweet (yay!) with such a fun variety to choose from. The vibes were spot on, and I have to say… their hospitality was top notch. Truly appreciated and respected that! 💛 Already thinking about my next visit. Highly recommend!

author: Madison Maloney
review_text: Very good atmosphere. Drinks were good. Food was good. Happy hour was worth it! Drinks were good, oysters were ok but for the HH price was worth it

author: Frank Wan
review_text: Friends recommended this Japanese restaurant to us. We came one day but it was full and had to wait for at least 30 mins. So we went to other restaurant. We came early this time to ensure that we would get a seat. If you want to try this restaurant, please look at their opening hours and came well before the opening time and queue. If not, you should prepare to wait for at least 30 mins. We are not disappointed!!! The Tonkatsu (deep-fried pork is so juicy, soft and tasty. Although they are using local pork, the cooking makes it to the same standard of the one that we had in Japan. They also serve deep-fried seafood. All are freshly made at the counter. You can have set meals (comes with a small starter, and refillable soup and rice) which are value-for-money, or order individual dish. The portion is big and it should satisfy most people. The staff are very friendly and efficient. The restaurant is clean and air-conditioned. We will came back to try other dishes (especially the black Curry).

author: Johnny Ch'ng Wei Loon
review_text: The Yam Rice was great... The Yam Cake and Otak-otak from the Chee Cheong Fun stall is nice too... Jawa Mee was nice...

author: Arlene Patel
review_text: This is a Queens, New York hidden gem! Literally hidden in a shopping plaza is this oasis of Italian food. I could have eaten 3 to 4 plates of the baked clams. Don't let them take the plate! Dip your fresh crusty table bread in it, you can thank me later. From the fried calamari to shrimp Rockefeller you will not be disappointed. Service was impeccable. The staff was friendly. The restaurant has a beautiful outdoor area.

author: Ashleigh Walker
review_text: Visited on Christmas Eve and had a great experience. We ordered the Rasta Pasta (both the vegetarian version and the one with jerk chicken) along with the snapper, and everything was absolutely delicious. Authentic Jamaican flavor and large portions. The atmosphere was warm and inviting. The manager was so nice and friendly and gave great recommendations, which made the experience even better. Highly recommend!

author: Tony Tan
review_text: Delicious food in a nice, spacious area. They prefer cash payments, so please be ready with cash.

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: Jayon See
review_text: One of the famous Pork Organ Soup in the area. Ingredients were fresh, the portion is pretty big for its price as well. However, the soup has a bit of porky smell, and their Kiam Chai (Pickled Veggies) is not tasty. To me it’s just average, plus the uncle is pretty sarcastic toward his other customers, not really friendly.

author: Jessie Reis
review_text: Eating in this Denny's is not great and that's putting it nicely. The table service is non-existent and the server I had was an older Hispanic woman who was very rude and inattentive. The food was also very lack luster, it's something you could make at home yourself for far less money and it would probably taste better. Unlike other Denny's this one is a miss, hopefully they do better soon.

author: Nataly Romero
review_text: Came for the first time and the experience was absolutely amazing. Joao Neto was our sever and he was very polite, friendly and made excellent recommendations. Casa Nova Grill went above and beyond my expectations, definitely coming back.

author: Sandra Tam
review_text: I definitely get the hype over this! The Thai milk tea shaved ice was really refreshing and true to its name as there was sticky rice hidden within the shaved ice, alongside generous servings of cubed mango. Their Shibuya toast continues to impress even though it has been around for a long time. I came with my partner so was particularly appreciative of the fact that they had mini sizes of their desserts available which allow us to try multiple items without wastage.

author: Paul Pistore
review_text: On our third visit to Cuca, we decided to try the Tasting Menu. We really enjoyed the almost theatrical experience of sitting at the bar overlooking the kitchen. Watching the team of chefs prepare their amazing dishes was hypnotic and exciting The service was impeccable, as always. The staff always make us feel welcome and well taken care of. Although, not every dish hit with all of us (it is a tasting menu after all), the ingredients and presentation were excellent. We thoroughly enjoyed the experience. Even though it's been a few years since visiting Cuca, we felt like we were recognized and appreciated. As a bonus, one of the owners visited us at the end of the meal to re-welcome us and asked us how we had enjoyed our experience. He even presented us with a special gift! As a fun and special fine dining experience, Cuca is unbeatable.

author: Caroline Tomon (Carrie)
review_text: What a great experience!! I recently had the pleasure of dining at Peter Luger while visiting my son in NYC. We did jit gave reservations the evening we dined however we did arrive earlier in the evening. We shared a house salad and tried the bacon to start. The salad was perfect as a start to our meal, simple yet fresh and delicious. The main course was absolutely amazing. The steak was cooked to perfection and just melted on your tongue. We enjoyed our server Mr Lou immensely who added some fun to our meal. Nothing beats spending time with those you love especially when the time you get is limited and spending a bit of that time with a bottle of champagne and a delicious steak and great service is appreciated. This experience was a treat I won’t forget and I hope to repeat on another visit to the city.

author: Cheshire Cat
review_text: Wow what an amazing sushi place....absolutely delicious and affordable. Wonderful experience with José and the entire staff. Chill atmosphere, and they also habe great wine, sake and beer. Highly recommend!

author: Ee CW (Ecw)
review_text: Nice and popular street food place at Perai. Limited parking space, come as early possible to avoid long waiting time. My favorite is dai lok mee... 😘😘

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: marie benjamin
review_text: The food is tasty but salty. Over all portions and presentation is very good. The sauce with the grilled beef was great. Variety of drinks is good. Tom yam creamy soup was too salty recommended to have with rice. Bill for two persons was THB1540

author: Anoulack Chanthakhat
review_text: I read online that there’s usually a queue, but I didn’t realize how serious it was. The shop opens at 8:30, and when I arrived at 8:31, about ten people were already in line. I tried two bagels, but since I have a sweet tooth, I especially enjoyed the pistachio one. The matcha latte was also high quality. While I was peeling the sticker off my matcha cup, one of the staff noticed despite how busy they were and kindly offered me new stickers. I was really impressed by that level of service 😊 I’d definitely visit again!

author: Suzi
review_text: Stopped by Jadu on opening day to get the lay of the land, and they so did not disappoint! The latte ($5) was creamy and came out at a drinkable temp, and the avocado tartine ($11, $13 with jammy egg add on) was divine: crunchy crust, flavorful avocado spread, perfectly soft egg. They did just a light sprinkle of the spice topping for me and it was perfect. While I normally stick to coffee, Jadu breakfast will be going in the rotation for when I want to treat myself!

author: Panploy Kunket
review_text: Super hot!!! But understandable cuz we can’t control the weather tho😂 no air conditioner but fan. Coconut coffee is so gooooooooood👍🏻

author: Evelyn Garcia
review_text: Worst unsanitary place ever!! Bought my kids some fries here and they both got food poisoning. Worst experience of my life witnessing my toddlers 2 year old and 3 year old having diarrhea, throwing up, screaming in pain, shaking and sweating from this. Never again will I buy from here. Please clean your stuff or wash your hands make everything so this won’t happen to anyone else or any kids since every kid loves fries. The feeling as a mother to not be able to do anything and see your kids in pain is the worst feeling ever.

author: Orlando Morales
review_text: I got a knife pulled on me after I left the drive through but the food and service was extremely satisfactory, very nice employees

author: Dina Gamez
review_text: Lovely place. Nazar was a great waiter! Cute too 😋 Overall great food. Just a little bit warm inside.

author: Marilyn Sanchez-Osorio
review_text: I grew up in Miami where Monty’s has been a huge part of the vibe, a go to place to grab a bite or have a drink, meet up with friends after a movie, and just hang out in front of the water and the boats docked in the marina. Never known for excellence in food quality, but at least fair enough for the quick bite. By gosh, it had been years that I had not been at Monty’s and I was sadly disappointed. The simple mozzarella sticks I ordered were nothing short of horrific! The Margarita was 90% ice, and the rest was a mystery, but the worst was the “service”! This woman must do us all a favor and quit. ASAP! She literally dragged herself to my table and her facial expression was so unpleasant, it made me want to just get up and leave. She really was the cherry 🍒 on top of the whole disappointment, not to mention that the chair I sat on was falling apart and I almost fell to the ground..! Just horrible. 😣 OH! Super expensive too… run 🏃🏻‍♀️

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Sasha de Witt
review_text: PHENOMENAL food. The make your own bowls were incredible as well as the protein shake. Will definitely be back!

author: Justin Rojas
review_text: Rose was great! Made me feel very welcome and showed how to do a proper rice paper wrap. Her English is very good also. This is a good spot for foreigners to come and try some northern Vietnamese food. They also supply you with plastic gloves if you want. The beers are also the lager size so are reasonably priced.

author: Catherine
review_text: Had a fantastic time here for a birthday recently. The food was delicious, and the atmosphere was fantastic. Technically everything is tapas style, but my friends and I all ordered our own plates as meals, with chips to share, and were satisfied. I had the avocado toast, which was very tasty. Tried a bit of the cornbread pancakes, and they were absolutely amazing. Will definitely be getting those as my meal next time! Vegetarian options are available. We were seated in a smaller private room (seemingly because it was a birthday, but it also might have been because our party was a bit big), but it will be fun to visit again and see more of the decor in the rest of the restaurant.

author: Marlon Lierz
review_text: We had an amazing dinner at Cuca in Jimbaran. All the tapas were creative and full of flavor, and the cocktails were excellent. The atmosphere is beautiful and relaxing, perfect for a special evening. But the best part was the service, especially from our waitress Putu. She was incredibly warm, kind, and attentive – we truly enjoyed talking with her. Her hospitality made the night unforgettable. We highly recommend Cuca and will definitely come back! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

author: Joan Ng
review_text: Probably my favourite beach club in Bali so far! 😍 La Brisa has the perfect balance — chill, beautiful ambience and not too crowded or “party” compared to many other beach clubs. We came for sunset and it was absolutely stunning, with the waves right in front. The seating area is cosy, lots of bamboo and island vibes, and I love that the music isn’t too loud, so you can actually relax and talk. Service was friendly and the food was surprisingly good too. One thing to note — they will hold your credit card after you order. I understand the policy since people can walk out to the beach area, but it felt a little uncomfortable to hand over the card. Maybe a tap-to-open tab system in the future would be great 😊 Overall, still a beautiful place to chill without the heavy-party vibes. I’ll definitely come back! 🌙✨

author: Phumiphat Supanya
review_text: I love stir fried crispy pork. 🐽 Nice atmosphere and good service from smiley manager. ✨

author: 回答用
review_text: Everything was perfect! I want to thank all staff, Hazel, Stacy, Piwky, Jessy, Divan, Eva and Ann. They are all kind and sweet to my family. This lounge was the best place I ever experienced! I recommend Singapore sling and stake especially!

author: Jennifer Cintron
review_text: Great place — classy, sexy, and sophisticated. The drinks are top-notch, the food is delicious, and the whole atmosphere feels effortlessly stylish. Perfect spot for a night out!

author: Adriel T
review_text: I actually enjoyed the food here. Popped by for a quick lunch which wasn't too quick being that my food took about 32 minutes to arrive. All I ordered was a plate of noodles.. It was otherwise a nice place to dine at that is also halal.

author: 00Y
review_text: The food here is decent—nothing extraordinary, but satisfying enough for a quick meal. Be prepared to order and queue before being seated, though the dishes come out surprisingly fast once you do. The biggest downside is the limited parking, so plan accordingly.

author: bhanu khera
review_text: Love this brunch place! This was my second time visiting during my Bay Area trip, and I love their food. I definitely overate. I tried the veggie omelette, pancakes, and French toast. Everything was amazing except the tiramisu pancake (it was okayish; the cream on top tasted a bit too milky). But apart from that, everything was so good. Definitely recommend this place for brunch!

author: Braksigmog C
review_text: Food is good, service is normal. It's very difficult to find parking and their fountain drink machines are always out of service or soda.

author: Phummara Sirisombat
review_text: The Kopi truly hits, the egg tarts are phenomenal. Since it's super busy and popular, long queue is expected. Come at the earliest if you don't want to wait (they open at 10am) OR you can have takeaways and sit at the food court instead.

author: Praym
review_text: *** Update after 11 months: Original location in Pom Prap has since closed. A shame as it gave a classic and authentic old Bangkok atmosphere. I have ordered food from the new location, still delicious! Apparently they are in a bigger space now.

author: Eren Erol
review_text: first of all, this is not a Michelin starred restaurant. They were only "mentioned" in the Michelin guide. And to be honest, there's nothing Michelin here. First of all it gets extremely busy during lunch hour in that small place. Some of the tables are for 8-9 people, and if you're not a big group you might be sitting with somebody else that you don't know. Prices are so cheap, and so the quality. when you take a look at the kitchen from your table, you can see there's no form of hygiene in there, and there's heavy use of cheap plastic equipment. I can't review the food here because they took my order and FORGOT to bring it. after waiting for 45 minutes, I asked where the food is and they said they forgot to send it to kitchen. That was very disappointing and I had to leave because I had to catch my flight from the airport. Very upsetting experience with them.

author: Queeny Qiu
review_text: Loved the ambiance of the restaurant! Lots of seating and great service. Didn’t know what to expect for vegan Ethiopian food but was not disappointed. The flavors were amazing and really enjoyed the roti that we got with our main dishes. Brunch prices were reasonable and portions were generous! Highly recommend!

author: Robert DeVine
review_text: Went to watch the Nebraska game September 6th. Spent $62 on food. Alumni raffle ticket guyGuy yelled at us for not b uying raffle tickets. He threatened my wife and I and said we won’t ever be welcome here again. I said no problem we’re from Nebraska. And we left at half time. We will never be back and we will tell others never to go back. People from Nebraska don’t act like that and neither should they if they represent the University of Nebraska.

author: Dean Sonetirot
review_text: Best southern Thai food I've had in a long time. The 'Gaeng Som Pla' was the best I've ever had in all of Thailand. Amazing food at a very cheap price 👍

author: steve herman
review_text: We ate here on Christmas day and Linda our waitress and server was the best, the highlight of our dinner. Linda talked to us, cared about our service, she was amazing. 76 year old waitress working on Christmas and giving the best service ever

author: Ben Yee
review_text: Had the option 5 on the menu, which is mixed, the price is at 166k VND, which is on the pricier side. Portion wise generous, the pork chop is huge and well marinated. Would recommend to go for option 2 which consist of the pork chop and fried egg, that would be sufficient, as I don’t find the mixed option to be very worth it as the star here is the pork chop.

author: Nikita Mittal
review_text: "Manas Indian Restaurant in LA is a culinary gem! Exceptional flavors, aromatic spices, and friendly staff create an unforgettable dining experience. Must-try dishes: Butter Chicken & Vegetable Biryani. A delightful taste of India right in the heart of LA!"

author: bryan debarbieris
