review_text: It's good overall. You know what you're getting when you come here and in my experience it's always been consistent. You can get varying sizes of chicken boxes with different numbers of strips. It's pretty much all they do. I get no slaw with extra toast. I got the caniac combo and it filled me up.

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: johnnykuochung
review_text: So I saw these zhup zhup prawn noodles blowing up on TikTok... and I had to try them! Here’s what happened. 🍲 I ordered the SUPREME PRAWN NOODLES three plump prawns, two tender pork ribs, lala (clams), and a generous portion of pork meat, plus an ice lemon tea to wash it all down. 🔸 The Noodles: I’m a bee hoon fan, so I went for that. The texture was perfect slightly chewy, and it soaked up the broth like a sponge. And the broth... oh man, it had that zhup zhup vibe. Thick, hearty, and packed with deep flavor salty, slightly sweet, and oh-so-satisfying. It wasn’t greasy either, just a touch of oil to make it rich. 🔸 The Prawns: Fresh and juicy! But honestly, I was hoping for a little more tenderness. They were solid but didn’t wow me. 🔸 The Tea: 🍋 Complete letdown. Watered-down tea with a sad lemon slice. No refreshing kick just bland. I’d rather grab a Pokka or Ant Band ice lemon tea. 💸 For nearly $30, I felt okay about it. The broth was definitely the highlight, but the prawns and the tea didn’t really justify the price. Would I recommend it? 🤔 If you’re a fan of rich broths and don’t mind splurging a little, it’s worth a try. But if you’re looking for a more balanced, satisfying meal there are better options out there. "If you're into food reviews like this, make sure to follow me on Instagram @Johnnykuochung for more delicious food adventures!

author: Natalia Reliszko
review_text: We visited this restaurant on our first day in Thailand, and it was outstanding. We traveled all over Thailand from Chiang Rai to Phi Phi and returned on our last day, curious if our impressions were a result of our first day of Thai cuisine, but no... the food was delicious, not overly contrived, not too sweet, not too heavy. Everything is fresh and served very quickly. AUTHENTIC UMAMI <3

author: Piyamas S.
review_text: I have been eating here since high school, almost half of my life. I so much in love with stir-fried sukiyaki, it's my number one dish.

author: palash Sikder
review_text: It was amazing experience to having a slice of pizza with fantastic staff. I made a friend shams. Wont hesitate to cone again😁

author: Ne Ale
review_text: Very enjoyable dinner, good menu choices, nice food quality and presentation wth good portion sizes. Would certainly go back to try some other dishes. Friendly helpful staff.

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: VL Phượng
review_text: 179k per person Cool and breezy. The food is okay, but there aren't many dishes. The panna cotta took a long time to arrive. The beef wrapped in betel leaves and oysters were also slow. Other dishes were served regularly. There weren't many types of dipping sauces, not very diverse.

author: Nikita
review_text: Came here to celebrate, and were amazed with the food and service!! Our waiter was very friendly, and fast. I demolished that chicken burger in 20 seconds flat, and everyone at the table loved their meals. Loved our lunch, thank you!

author: Bertrand Levesque
review_text: I frequently go at Golden Coral for my meals. I only have excellent things to say about the quality of the food and the service. I seek to sit in Alicia section to be my server. She has alway been curteous, polite, sociable, attend to my table promptly, is available and pays excellent attention to my table, as she does with all her customers. Alicia is an excellent server with all the great qualities to represent Golden Coral. She has alway been pleasant, respond immediately and a hard worker. She has no hesitation to say hi with a smile. Golden Coral is very fortunate to have such a great loyal employee, who promotes the restaurant and extend her services to make sure that her customer leave with a good experiences and return. Thank you so much Alicia you are the best and wish you longetivity with Golden Coral because you make my experience a very pleasant and enjoyable one.

author: Jennifer Cañas
review_text: Went with my group of 7 friends. We had an amazing time. I made a reservation just un case but luckily it was no wait time for dinner that day. Host was really nice with us and we had a good sized table for all of us. Our server was really nice with us too. He speaks Spanish that was very helpful because some of my friends don’t speak English. Menu was good with different options if you don’t like ceviche. Food was amazing, good portions and seasoned to perfection. No complaints at all. I think prices are good for the portions. And it was one of my friends birthday so they sang Happy Bday for him with a delicious chocolate cake. It was a really good experience for us.

author: Ishel lao
review_text: Ordered their special bread in small size, but it was already filling and satisfying to the heart’s content! 🥖✨ Banh Mi is flavorful and hearty, service is great, and they even have a cozy space to enjoy your sandwich with refreshing fruit drinks. Definitely worth a visit!

author: Jeffrey Lim
review_text: Worse place to order food. Do not patronise even if there's nothing else available. They made us wait for so long and in the end told us it's not even being cooked after we had enquired. Frankly don't even deserve 1 star.

author: Lili McFarlane
review_text: Not a single miss. Everything was standout, flavors are thought provoking. For 2 people we shared the mushroom toast, fennel salad, bread, hiramasa, pork collar, and halibut. Toffee pudding for dessert. Portions are smaller but with this order we left full. Service was excellent especially for recommending wine.

author: Khadija
review_text: It’s cheap. The food is decent. I wouldn’t get my hopes up going into this place. If you’re big on volume but not big on eating a good meal, this place is for you. If you have any allergies, run. As a picky eater who also has allergies, I found this to be a pretty big disappointment. I wouldn’t come again.

author: Don Sien
review_text: New place in neighborhood so we finally decided to try it. Ordered takeout...arrived early so needed to wait about 6mins. At 5pm, place was not full but, as others mentioned, quite noisy! Ordered their whole chicken & signature fried rice. Chicken well seasoned & tasty but breast meat very dry! Fried rice was good but had these "fried" pieces of chicken(?) on top which were hard & dried.

author: Kiariladyboss
review_text: One of the most delicious Persian dinner and food in NYC. They are usually booked 2 weeks in advance but people cancel all the time so keep checking for a spot to become available. The squash spread and the eggplant dish were out of this world🤯🤤 Loved the Persian cocktail too. Service was fast and staff very nice. Spot super recommended!

author: Enrique Cardoso
review_text: Bought a stake sandwich was raw so sad was happy to get home and enjoy my meal gladly they did give me my money back offer to get a different meal but I just decided to take money instead

author: Christa West
review_text: I’ve had mixed experiences at Jadu.. my regular order is a small regular milk iced latte, often with a syrup flavor ($7+) which I find to be a steep price for the quality of the drink and area/competitor cafes. The atmosphere is bright and welcoming, but the staff at the register are often stand-offish. The most recent latte I tried at Jadu was unfortunately a huge miss and the flavors were way off. I usually have no problem speaking up for myself but the impersonal impression I’ve received from the staff made me decide to bit my tongue. Unsure if I will be trying again.

author: BOON LEONG TAN
review_text: Our family members came to this famous restaurant at Jitra after we went for prepared our Thailand car insurance at Changlun. This restaurant famous among locals and outsider. The restaurant prepared the Thai style dishes. Most of the dishes are hot and spicy. The pricing are at upside as this only a small town at Kedah.

author: Alt Ernate
review_text: Great food terrible service! Waited 30 min seated at a dirty table, staff cleaned tables of guests that arrived later than us. Waited another 30 min before the first dish came: eggs, with no rice, plates, or cutlery. Went to get it ourselves after a few mins. Wrong orders served, duplicate dishes given, went up to ask about missing dishes and they asked us to cancel. Waiter was also incapable of calculating bill, so we did it for them. Overall impressive how terrible everything was, really couldn't be worse!

author: Jim Painter
review_text: We have been here a few of times for lunch, when in the area. We usually order a fish plate. It is always good and fresh. And a nice presentation. We usually sit upstairs on the deck. Overlooking the bay. On our last visit we were a little late during the lunch rush. It looked like there was some event and most everyone sat outside. We were one of the few seated inside. Our waitress was very friendly and tried her best to serve us, as well as many tables outside. We still plan to return next time We are in the area.

author: Leilla I.
review_text: Food was great, service was excellent. Place is small but cozy and very family oriented. Had a great time w my friend

author: Margot Perry
review_text: Absolutely phenomenal! This Thai restaurant blew me away from start to finish. The flavors were bold, authentic, and perfectly balanced—every dish felt like a masterpiece. The service was warm and attentive, making the whole experience even more memorable. I honestly can’t recommend it enough; if you’re craving Thai food that’s both comforting and exciting, this is the place to be!

author: Kylie Whitaker
review_text: **Caution: Double-Check Your Receipt and Bank Statement!** Our recent visit to Margaritaville was a mixed experience. While the food was decent and our server, Eric, provided excellent service, we did have some concerns. The nachos were enormous and easily fed both my husband and me, although we would have appreciated a bit more meat. The drinks were a bit pricey but tasted good! However, upon reviewing our receipt and bank statement after returning home from vacation, we noticed a significant discrepancy. Our receipt indicated a gratuity of $23, bringing the total to $167, but our bank statement reflected a charge of $201. Even accounting for a potential 20% additional tip, the final amount still doesn’t align with what was stated on the receipt. Whether it's a $5 or $25 difference, it raises questions about the accuracy of the final charge. We just wanted to share this experience to encourage others to verify their receipts and bank statements for peace of mind.

author: Joseph Tella
review_text: This should be a 5-star review as these are truly the tastiest arepas in Boston (and make sure to try their side sauces!), but paired with some of the worst service. They routinely take an hour+ just confirm your order let alone cook it. You will absolutely be waiting much much longer than you expect to get your food, but then it will absolutely delicious. Just tragically inefficient for such amazing food

author: Dmitrii
review_text: The Dr ABC juice was heavily watered down with ice. The Hipstar Smoothie bowl was tasty, but it was impossible to finish all the yogurt. In general, the food here seems to be for people who love to eat a lot. I believe the focus is on quantity over quality. The tables are clean and nice, and there were almost no queues. You can't hear the road noise; the music is loud enough so that surrounding conversations don't stand out — it's a cool vibe. The prices are nett (tax included), which is rare for Bali. There is a large parking area.

author: mellie settie
review_text: Only the Dan Dan noodle was good. Dumpling is better at all other dumpling time and dumpling kitchen chains. Do not order the shrimp scallop mostly Flour and no shrimp taste the scallop is also the one that's supposed to be dried for rice dish. The specialty Fried dumpling also too dry. All just too thick and dry. They also do not care about quality when I reported the shrimp. Other chain that has similar good quality Hayes, Fillmore, Noe (nearest to this Castro) and the Design district. Not comfy people too loud. Other Chain also lots of people and loud but within social standard

author: It's Nass Fitness
review_text: The food was absolutely delicious, and Alfredo was an exceptional host. It’s now my top breakfast spot whenever I visit Las Vegas—the lively atmosphere, combined with Alfredo’s friendly and helpful nature, made for a fantastic experience. I highly recommend trying their legendary three-layer pancakes! Parking is available on the street for a fee, and I suggest making a reservation in advance to avoid long lines.

author: LEE LEE
review_text: The KL style hokkien noodle is the worst I ever tasted. No wok hey, not flavorful. (I thought they are famous for it). Total disappointment. I came all the way from Johor.

author: C K
review_text: The deco is lovely and ambience is lively. There is good mix of tourists and locals. We came without reservation at dinner time (Tuesday) and were able to find a table for 2pax. As a whole the food taste good especially the fried beancurd. Wanted a fish and the waitress was kind to warn us that this is by weight (per 100g) which we obviously didn’t notice the fine prints. Ordered grilled squid instead and it was good.

author: Andy Southern
review_text: Really tasty, I had the Special, which comes with a bit of everything, however I especially recommend the battered and deep fried meat, sooo good. Very reasonable as well. Good juices also.

author: Laura Jeraci
review_text: came for a quick breakfast / brunch before heading on my flight. ordered a hot coffee with milk, got no milk. asked for milk, was met with confusion and given like half a shot of it. whatever no big deal, some places use creamer mainly. we ordered a waffle and eggs benedict. the eggs Benedict came with balsamic glaze on it?? not sure why but that's not usually a dish that needs acidity. and the waffle was "like cardboard, no flavor" according to my friend. i guess i was expecting more for it being near so many hotels and the ports. if you need a quick bite go for it, but don't expect too much.

author: Michael Goh
review_text: Crowded during week end and after office hour. Full of human noises. Be prepared for for cooking smell on clothes and hair. Full of exotic local food (eg seafoods). Overall, fun place.

author: JUAN BONILLA
review_text: **Il Poeta: A Masterpiece of Italian Culinary Art** Il Poeta is a hidden gem that transports you straight to Italy with its authentic flavors and welcoming atmosphere. The moment you step in, you're greeted by the warm, attentive service that makes you feel like family. The star of the kitchen, Chef Mario di Chiara, is a true artist, crafting dishes that are as visually stunning as they are delicious. Every bite reflects his passion and mastery of Italian cuisine. From homemade pasta to perfectly cooked seafood, each dish is a testament to his skill and creativity. Whether you're indulging in a classic carbonara or savoring a more contemporary creation, the flavors are nothing short of extraordinary. The experience doesn’t stop at the food. Julio, the restaurant’s talented bartender, elevates the meal with his exceptional drink pairings. His extensive knowledge and passion for mixology are evident in every cocktail he crafts, adding the perfect touch to an unforgettable dining experience. For anyone seeking an authentic Italian meal coupled with outstanding service, Il Poeta is 100 percent recommended. It’s more than just a meal—it’s an experience that delights all the senses.

author: Gray Stone
review_text: Élephante is a must-try and a classic LA brunch spot. Anything you order on the menu is guaranteed to be great because of the high quality of the ingredients. The ambiance is unbeatable—think chic, beachy, and effortlessly cool. It’s the perfect place for a brunch with friends, a casual date, or even out-of-town visitors. I would absolutely recommend it, whether you’re a local or a tourist looking for that quintessential LA brunch experience.

author: Shannon Dickinson
review_text: Huge portions of amazing food! And the cheesecake was fantastic!

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: Tan Jie Kai
review_text: Note to order before being seated, staff will assign seats depending on the dishes you ordered too incase the table is too small. Ordered 6 dishes for 3 pax and surprised that it was just nice, few highlights included Sesame oil claypot chicken which was quite flavourful and the Mee sua with pork and seafood stir fry is must try. Would come back again to try out more of the dishes didn’t disappoint so far Service wise you will have to walk to the counter for any add on, drinks too. Atmosphere better to sit by a fan or air conditioned area as the assigned area we sat was quite warm with only 1 fan on oscillation.

author: Feliz
review_text: Awesome traditional Malay kueh Kueh, try their epok epok ( potato curry puff and sardines puff ) Each cost $1 . They started 10 years ago by selling their Kueh Kueh at the mama indian shop below their home . Now they have their own stall , #01-45. Open : 6.45am to 2pm Everyday. Enjoy 😋

author: JW
review_text: Best place to buy fresh bakery in Penang. Traditional type of bakery. Affordable and many choice.

author: Leong Wilbert
review_text: Had the chicken which wasnt too tender type, and also the ipoh horfun. The horfun was silky and smooth but the soup might be just a little too salty. Chicken feet was good. A good to try if you are in the area.

author: Johnny Wyatt
review_text: Food was pretty good. No long line and service was impressive. I found it very unprofessional of the young man behind the counter constantly on his personal phone the entire time for the people in line ahead of me and through my entire check in. Needless to say he was still on his phone as I left

author: viona yong
review_text: The café has a really nice and cozy environment, perfect for relaxing or catching up with friends. The food is okay, not outstanding but decent for the price. Overall, it’s a good place to enjoy the atmosphere.

author: S Yoon
review_text: I'd describe the pies here as modern Neapolitan. These have a bit more structure than traditional Neapolitan pies. That said, the ingredients are fun and the vibe is cool. It's been a few years, but I'd definitely go back.

author: Linda McLoon
review_text: For a small take out poke place, this was great. The fish was fresh, and all the ingredients in our poke bowls were well thought out. We had the mango albacore poke bowl and the shitake chili tofu bowl. Lots of people came and picked up takeout. They do have two small tables in the front on the sidewalk. I would definitely get their poke bowls again. Not much atmosphere needless to say.

author: joe fong
review_text: My second time here. Definitely a local zhi char place, that served top grade ingredients and local delights. Recommended to local and tourist too It is a local eatery so dont expect resturant style service but yet good food. Had the wet style seafood bee hoon, is full of umami and generous portion so reasonable price. Chili crab was good quality, sauce is towards the sweet side..for me I like it less sweet more spicy so it is a preference. Overall i can say the crab is great like jumbo for the look of it.

author: Zara Zulkipli
review_text: good bagel but pricey. i ordered everything in standard form, but i think the bagel and the drink would have taste better with some customization. the philly cheese would be a bomb with extra cheese and caramelized onion. standard portion of cheese seems small, to me. i went alone so i was lucky to get a table for one. i heard there can be long queue, so if you are in big pax or on their busy days you might experience long wait as the shop size is so cute and tiny 😊 i went there on thursday around 10am so it wasn't that busy. i appreciate the QR ordering and online payment as i am an introvert myself. im not so chatty, but the worker there are chatty and social butterfly. the extroverts would definitely appreciate that.

author: FR. WENCESLAUS E. Y. Yoh
review_text: Among many in New Jersey, I found this restaurant the best. Real naija taste is here that will wow you. Original delicious Nigerian food with a clean environment and kind, welcoming and understanding staff.

author: Robin Baker
review_text: Blackened brisket spinach croissant eggs Benny Chilli rellanos omelet Watermelon mimosas Ice coffee. Amazing experience. Will be back to try more!

author: Nghi Thuyết
review_text: The claypot rice here in District 1 is delicious. Clean, reasonable price Seasoned according to Northern taste, not too sweet Big restaurant with 2 fronts, comfortable parking, will come back to support long term

author: vu nguyen
review_text: This place is situated just outside Bui vien walking street and is a very busy and popular shop. For such a small spot they do churn out a large some of food. I had the banh mi nem thit nuong, which was packed with meat with generous portions of pate and butter. I also ordered some banh day, which is essentially steamed mochi as the carb portion of the sandwich and steamed pork. This thing was one of my favorite things to eat growing up in the states.

author: Sheringham Zhou
review_text: Missed out on Heng Kee, so I headed to Ah Heng upstairs. The curry was rich and packed with flavor, and the tau pok absorbed the broth perfectly. Overall, a very satisfying bowl of curry chicken mee. Thumbs-up!

author: Yve
review_text: You know the food is good when the boss dare to scold customers.

author: Bong-Ki Jung
review_text: The salad in the poke bowl was honestly terrible. It felt like it was spoiled — mushy, with no freshness at all. It seems to depend on the staff, as some carefully choose fresh ingredients while others don’t seem to care whether the vegetables are fresh or not. I ordered this meal to eat healthy, but the texture was unpleasant and the lack of freshness in the vegetables was really disappointing.

author: Julio Gonzalez
review_text: one of my favorite brunch spots in the lower haight. every time i go here i order the steak and eggs 🍳

author: kevin uhlin
review_text: Finally tried R Burgers on Nellis, & have been back almost every day for the last few days. Tonight I asked for a custom burger not on the menu, a double chile cheese burger & it was GREAT!! Please add this to the menu. Love the buy 1-get 1 breakfast burritos, 2 fat loaded burritos for 10.95? Can’t beat it. The fries are excellent too, all in all a great little spot for everyone’s appetite!

author: abner
review_text: This place is amazing. Staff is very attentive and friendly and the food is AMAZING. Great vibes with live music and a comfy atmosphere to go with friends or family. Drinks and Hookah were also top quality. You won’t regret coming here it truly is a gem

author: Nothing
review_text: A great place to watch the sunset in Bali. Located in the Ayana resort grounds, you will be guided to the entrance. I had a good seat to watch the sunset and the sea view. The drinks were delicious and the decoration was beautiful. One of the most valuable and unforgettable experiences for me in Bali, and I want to come back here again. My raw pictures are not enough to capture the dreamy, vast and brilliant beauty here, you should come and experience it yourself. From Vietnam with love.

author: Kyeong Eun Kim
review_text: Absolutely amazing. My friend and I stayed in Jimbaran for about 5 days and this is the best restaurant that we have visited. The food of course was on the top and the service delivery was amazing. We absolutely enjoyed every dish and would definitely come back again. It is the place that you must try the chef menu and you know you won’t be disappointed at all! We went with 9 different options and added oysters on top of that. Oysters were so fresh and it was one of the best ones we have tried all across the world. My absolute favorite was their scallop and my friend’s favorite was the bao. We both loved their special on that day, which was the oyster. I have been recommending to all my friends who are visiting Bali soon and especially whoever is visiting the Jimbaran area! With the horrible Bali traffic and a closure of the road the day we were visiting, we had a major delay. However, the staffs were very understanding and friendly. No reason to not visit this restaurant. The price is extremely reasonable as well.

author: Kristie R
review_text: Excellent service, food & atmosphere. Our waitress Kirsten (hope I spelled that right) was friendly, and our food came out pretty quickly. Everything tasted fresh and was cooked perfectly. We've been to other Wahlburgers locations in other states, but the surrounding area of this one is the most beautiful we've seen so far. Took a quick walk across the street to look over the water for a little bit and relax. Free street parking was easy, but there is a parking lot also.

author: Miranda L
review_text: Came here due to recommendations from everyone.I had crab with rice. Be really honest, the food of course is nice. It is like normal good standard like everywhere else. Not exceptionally excellent as described as the hype. The environment is clean and food are fresh.

author: Lay Ying Yeoh
review_text: Come here for tea time. Their coffee super gao, we try 小黑 and 小白 this time and want to try other type of coffee for next visit. The toast with butter and Kaya very delicious. Price is reasonable. Quality is definitely excellent 👍 Hard to find parking here, can park at the road side or in the car park of temple

author: Candy Y
review_text: Service wasn’t bad but they were running slow on 1/4/26. Food was delicious. I had to send my Long Island Iced Tea back and get another drink because it tasted like a glass of Cola instead of alcohol with soda as an ingredient. Our waiter was a very nice person and made every attempt to provide good service but the forces of nature were against him. Overall, it was a decent experience.

author: Cheska Bantillo
review_text: Food is amazing!!! Fish is so helpful with all our requests. The atmosphere is good too. It feels nice to eat cause it’s peaceful and quiet. Will come back again 😍

author: Rui Min Soh
review_text: Prices are relatively steeper for the portion but the quality was great. Good use of different flavours for the sauces. Banh xeo was awesome.

author: Gayathri Gopal
review_text: Had a wonderful time at this Mexican place! The cocktails were great, and the chicken tacos were absolutely amazing. The service was friendly and attentive, and the place had a lovely Mexican vibe. Overall, a fantastic experience — would definitely visit again! 🌮🍹

author: Riley Cohen
review_text: I come here almost every day after work so I think I should leave a review at this point. Super nice staff and great poke :) they’re super sweet. I get orders in this location since it’s pretty fast service and i always get time to sit down and eat during my 30 minute lunch breaks.

author: Vonnie H
review_text: I never had Beijing beef with potato’s in it but it truly was flavorful. I am so picky with Chinese food but the reviews spoke and it was delicious. I’ll be back to try some other entrees.

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: B K
review_text: Pleasantly surprised with the food. The place is definitely a hidden gem 💎. I'd say that's the freshest Pho I have tried in Vietnam. I could taste multiple flavours and the beef was perfectly cooked. Comfortable tables and chairs as well as nicer chop sticks than most places generally. It's a peaceful environment and quiet too. The owner takes care of their restaurant well, it's clean. Will definitely re-visit! Note: The lady that served us also speaks very good English which is rare. Great hospitality and customer skills.

author: Ong Lee Huey
review_text: Good banh mi with vegan option as well! I love the coconut coffee, very creamy and coconuty and the stir fry morning glory with rice is honestly a family favourite despite its simplicity. Definitely has the "wok hey"! The chicken rice is great too! Overall highly recommend and price is reasonable despite being a tourist spot. Do try out the local huda beer if you like light beer.

author: Eli Briggs
review_text: Food was good, prices relatively high but you get a lot. Most of our party had the chicken and sides and enjoyed it. Limited options if you don't want chicken. The seafood pasta was good. It is one of the loudest restaurants I've been in. Had to yell to converse with my 80 year old mother in law.

author: RA Rivera
review_text: Foods are sumptous and fresh! I love the seafoods that they served us. They gave us a generous serving of our meals. Service is okay, a typical asian restaurant but its really the taste of the food that made a mark for me. Pricing is not cheap but definitely not expensive.

author: Tiana
review_text: I came in around 6pm. The store was pretty empty. Both workers helped my friends right away. The sandwich was nice. The restaurant clean and the workers friendly. 👌🏽

author: Brittany Ng
review_text: Eyval was nothing short of fantastic! This was my first time trying Persian food and I was truly amazed by every dish we tried. The flavor combinations were unique and delicious, with the perfect mix of sweet and savory. We tried both the komaj bread and barbari bread, which had perfect textures of soft and fluffy. The citrus date salad was super refreshing and light with deep flavors from the dressing and dates, which was the perfect appetizer. We decided to try the lamb ribs, octopus kabob, and kabob koobideh as our entrees. The meat for all dishes were amazingly tender and flavorful, with the ribs falling right off the bone and the octopus perfectly chewy. The star of the shows in these dishes however, was the tomato butter that was served on top of the basmati rice in the kabob koobideh! It was so savory without being salty and wish there was more on the plate. I recommend all of these to share! The interior was simple but beautifully designed, creating a nice ambiance that takes you out of New York City. As you walk further in, you’re able to view the kitchen where chefs are carefully crafting each dish. The service was exceptional also! Our server was very attentive to our table, making sure dishes were cleared and plates were swapped out for an easy dining experience. I also mentioned it was my birthday and they served my dessert with candle, which was a very thoughtful gesture. Overall, this place was the perfect birthday dinner and glad I ventured out to try new food here! We are already thinking about our next visit to try more of their menu as I’m sure every dish will not disappoint.

author: Clover Ying
review_text: I would like to thank you Nick for served us during my birthday dinner. He are so helpful and help me took a lot of nice photo. He did very well and more than enough. If you have any celebrate please look for Nick, for sure he will give you the best support!

author: Anonymous
review_text: Very authentic Hainan chicken rice and laksa even better than places in SG and Malaysia. Outdoor seating is warm and cozy. Long wait but food is excellent.

author: MissChelle827
review_text: I think I've died and gone to Mexican Food Heaven. The Chicken Mole had me almost in tears. The Sopa De Fideo was rich and tasty. The table salsa and chips were heavenly. Service impeccable. Muchas Gracias 🫡👌

author: Greg
review_text: The filet steak kabob is very good, and sliders were probably the best I've ever had. Also, ask for Cheyenne, she makes the dining experience worth going back for.

author: Nomadicus
review_text: Four Horsemen feels like stumbling into a very well kept secret that somehow never tries to impress you… and still does. I decided to try getting in without a reservation and luckily they thoughtfully keep bar and window seats available for walk-ins. The best approach is to line up right when the kitchen opens, or wait until the initial 5pm dinner rush tapers off and secure a seat at the bar. The dining room is quietly romantic but a bit snug nonetheless creating a relaxed, understated atmosphere. Service is genuinely warm and technically precise without a hint of theatrics, striking an ideal balance of professionalism and ease. The menu consists of tapas-style plates that are intentionally restrained. With minimal ingredients and thoughtful execution, each dish allows the quality of the product to shine rather than relying on excess or embellishment. The result is food that feels confident, focused, and deeply satisfying. Four Horsemen is refined without feeling formal, and thoughtful without being precious, making it a place worth the effort, even on short notice.

author: Catherine Shelton
review_text: Everyone loved the ceviche trio, pisco sours and yellow seafood rice

author: Ahmed Mohammed
review_text: Amazing experience at Hubble Bubble Lounge! The food was delicious, the service was exceptional, and the atmosphere was absolutely perfect for relaxing and spending time with family and friends. The place has such a cozy and welcoming vibe — everything from the music to the presentation felt top-notch. A special shout-out to Olga, who truly made the night memorable with her outstanding customer service. She was attentive, friendly, and made sure every detail was perfect. Her positive energy and professionalism really elevated the entire experience. Highly recommend this spot — it’s easily one of the best lounges in Miami!

author: Vivek Vijay
review_text: Really nice cozy food. There is lot of love and story in the store and the team than just the food.

author: Michael Stemmeler
review_text: A pretty simple burger and Mexican food joint. You order at the counter, and your number is called up when the food is ready. The steak sandwich with fries was quite tasty, and so we're the French fries. Lots of locals enjoyed their food, too

author: Melissa Mahecha
review_text: We had a wonderful time at Koro Ramen & Sushi. It's exciting to have a Japanese food option in East Boston. The food was delicious, fresh, and very flavorful. We tried the veggie and shrimp sushi, and we will definitely be coming back!

author: Banuaji P
review_text: Nice chicken and beans prout. The chiken is soft and flavourful. The fish meatball also good. You must try it.

author: Cheong Loong
review_text: The Cantonese tze char stall on the ground floor produces creative fushion jap chinese dishes. Manned by a lady chef , she is fast in delivering each order over her 2 woks. She comes up with new dishes so that sveasier gfoe customers to order during busy lunch time . Each dish served pipping hot from her wok n has great visual display that makes it so appetising .

author: A
review_text: Very good Wendy's. It gets really busy, especially during lunch time. The staff is on point. The food is fresh and very speedy. They have a separate area for delivery folks so it doesn't get too crowded. When I went there, the girl at the cash register was very nice and welcoming. There was a guy, I believe was the manager, was expediting the orders and made sure everything ran smoothly. I ordered a double and some nuggets. It was fresh and I enjoyed it. The atmosphere was great and the dining area was clean. Good location in Newark.

author: Josephine Ong
review_text: Ordered the assorted sashimi which comes out fresh sweetness and moist. The lunch set that was ordered is perfectly cooked. The tempura is thin and crispy while the unagi and white fish are grilled just right

author: Leonard Behaj
review_text: Gent, listen: We stoped at this restaurant by accident just because we liked the view, but this restaurant is one of the best restaurants I ever visited in my life.(45 today is my birthday) The food was wow, fresh, delicious and very tasty. Service was the best part of it, Alex our server was amazing, he explained everything about the dishes about spices, cocking temperatures and everything else. I don’t usually write reviews but when I do they generate a thousands of views. This restaurant is the best in Miami, you don’t need to travel to Greece, save the tickets and come and enjoy a great traditional Greek meal in this location you will thank me. Ask for Alex he is the best ever team member at this restaurant.

author: Billy Kok
review_text: When you see locals crowd a restaurant it signalled good food. We were recommended to visit and on arrival to Hat Yai we took a tuk-tuk here. Easy pictorial menu, point and point. Portions are for 2, so order more if you have a group. The 8 of us had 2 veggies, 2 whole fishes, 4 som-tam (as we liked it), 2 tomyam, 2 deep fried sotong and 2 pork.

author: Chin Yan
review_text: The details they put into the deco and the food is spectacular. Recommended to be there during brunch, crowd starts around 1-2pm. Got the salted egg coconut bingsoo, unsure of the original name. Hint of saltiness but sweet. Free parking available here.

author: Johnson Ong
review_text: Mains are all served hot to my wife's delight. The lamb chop we ordered is tender and flavourful and it tasted even better with the fantastic sauce. The wedge potatoes that came along with it is crispy on the outside and fluffy inside. The palak paneer is the most delicious that we have ever tasted. The naan is fresh and soft. Last but not least, the service is excellent, serving us a jar of cold or warm water each. We will definitely be back to try other dishes.

author: Theo Judge
review_text: Amazing place with wonderful staff. The food is always delicious and very fast service even when busy. We can hear more than once and it never failed us. If your looking for breakfast / lunch food anywhere in Ho Chi Minh make it this place

author: susan chow
review_text: Had lunch at No :01-95 Laksa Yong Tau Foo & Char Kway Teow. Food is deliciously good and lots of crispy pork crackers ontop wok hei char kway teow. Indeed a worthwile meal.

author: Mihir Kulkarni
review_text: Excellent lunch special. Really solid panang curry and Manny’s service was awesome. Thai iced tea was a bit watered down but still great. $17.34 after tip for my meal makes this a great value.

author: LaJuan W
review_text: I still love this place. However, every time I go it seems like there are new employees and the service is always slow. The Fremont St location has stepped up their game tremendously. The food is always good and the orders are correct more often than not. Busy times are the lunch and dinner rush and Friday nights at 5 am going into Saturday morning.

author: nimrod
review_text: This restaurant truly lives up to its Michelin recommendation. The food is excellent, the atmosphere is inviting, and the overall experience is absolutely worth a visit. A great choice for anyone looking for quality dining and thoughtful dishes that stand out. Highly recommended.

author: DiM 1
review_text: Place is small inside, but there's some seats outside. Servers are very relaxed. Need to speak slowly and confirm your order. Food is really good they rush so make sure your potatoes are fully cooked. The Cuban coffee is BANGING! great! They make fresh OJ. French toast is great as well.

author: Benjamin Freeberg
review_text: Pretty nice experience overall. Very warm and welcoming inside. The staff is a little standoffish they didn't make any conversation which was off-putting but my friend and I had a good time together. BYOB is nice too. I'll definitely come back to try more of the food.

author: Victor
review_text: I had one of the best hot pot experiences at Chuang Yang Ji. It's such a lovely restaurant with mutton related hotpot, ingredients and ala carte dishes. The mutton skewer is definitely a must order. Spiced version isn't super spicy, good for everyone. Tender lamb with generous portions of spices, eat it while it's still hot. We had the lamb collagen set which comes with a ton of ingredients. Our favourite was the lamb meatballs, it's so springy and flavourful. Second would be the lamb ribs, the meat still sticks to the bone but it's amazing. Soupbase was great, it's light and easy to drink. None of the mutton had a strong lamb signature smell but they all taste good. Ingredients were fresh and portions were of a good size. Staff service is excellent, comparable or better than HDL. The staff were cheerful and seemed happy working here. It was easy to get attention. They even helped scoop out the floating scum without us prompting them. Dining environment was clean and spacious, our clothes didn't smell too much of steamboat after. Aircon was cold enough, didn't break a sweat. There was a good selection of condiments, their special chilli is pretty good. Overall, a great experience here. Will definitely return in the future to here or their other outlets.

author: Petra Vrábková
review_text: We went here because we saw a lot of recommendations. Upon arrival, we had to register via a QR code and wait for a table to become available. There was a large selection of meat specialties, Balinese specialties, and various drinks. The service was very friendly. They asked us if we had everything we needed and if we were satisfied. The food tasted excellent. The food was ready quite quickly. The prices are high, but I understand that for such high-quality food.

author: Eric Chan
review_text: Okay, let's be real, sometimes you just crave a good sandwich. And that's where Sandwish in Batu Kawan comes in. This spot is a total gem! Their sandwiches are stacked high with fresh ingredients, and the bread is seriously on point. I especially loved "the ms avocado and honey mustard chicken”, the chicken was so tender and crispy”! Beyond the sandwiches, their pastries are a must-try. I indulged in a “tiramisu croffle" and it was pure heaven. The service was super friendly, and the cafe itself has a really chill vibe. If you're in Batu Kawan, definitely check out Sandwish!

author: J H
review_text: I was an out of towner who needed a place to sit for a couple hours while I waited on a medical emergency to be resolved, and I didn't feel unwelcome here. This place had delicious fried pickles, cold beer, and by chance I stumbled in on Stand Up Comedy Night, so I had a few good laughs. Turned a crummy night into a good one, so thanks.

author: Venecia Wong
review_text: I came here with my family for lunch and the food was such a variety and absolutely tasteful and delicious. Really enjoyed my afternoon here it was. Everything was pleasant and the staff was really attentive and helpful. I will come back again!

author: wiyuna teoh
review_text: Nasi kandar kuah campur with sotong, egg & fried bitter gourd …curry was flavorful…for murtabak taste good too…more seating available at 2nd floor

author: Thien An Nguyen
review_text: One of the best burgers we’ve tasted. Got the truffle fries and numero uno burger!! Fries were so good. Staff were very accommodating!

author: Dimas Wijaya
review_text: Recently, we visited this restaurant on the recommendation of our tour guide—just a day after trying Warung Babi Guling Pande Egi—which made it the perfect chance to compare the two. This time, we ordered the Babi Guling (without the soup, since it’s not really our preference) along with a side of crispy pork skin. The flavors here were spot on: the roasted pork was savory and well-seasoned, and everything came together beautifully with the lawar. The pork skin added that extra crunch, making the meal even more satisfying. Overall, I’d say the taste here edges out the other place we tried. If you’re in Gianyar, Bali, this spot is definitely worth a visit for an authentic and delicious Babi Guling experience.

author: NATHALIE KRIEF
review_text: I just had such a great dinner in this restaurant. It's all I was looking for. Some nice green restaurant with good food. I had the fried sea bass with Thai sauce in the side and it was delicious. I will go there again for sure!

author: Jacques Rerolle
review_text: Rm36.50 Free Flow best Mookata 🤩 So tasty. Pork available, ice cream and soft drinks too. All free flow. Video review is on my youtube channel. Please subscribe : Jac reviews stuff

author: Cole
review_text: Manny was absolutely amazing, best bartender I’ve had in a LONG time. Le Thai is easily the best restaurant I’ve had in Vegas, especially when factoring in quality, quantity, and price! The happy hour is great and the waterfall beef is insanely delicious. Also tried the beef short rib which was insane. I would recommend this place 1000 times. It was so good, we went back a second time. Got the yellow curry with short rib and it was fantastic as well. Definitely recommend!

author: Mohammad Mahmoud
review_text: We had an amazing overall dining experience. The food flavors were incredible, the view was breathtaking, and the staff created such a warm and positive atmosphere — shoutout to our wonderful waitress Yori for his professional service. A couple of small suggestions: the AC was extremely cold in our first spot, and we did need to change tables to get comfortable. Also, the portions seemed a bit small for the cost. Still, thanks to your friendly and welcoming team, it was a truly memorable visit, and we would happily return.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Herman Soh
review_text: This place has the best meat ball I've ever had. The lady is so friendly. The food is very clean. The restaurant is air-conditioned and clean. Highly recommended!

author: Carmen L
review_text: This is my third time trying the BCM here and it never fails to disappoint. For $4.80, you get a pretty decent bowl. The soup is not too salty for my liking but still very flavourfully meaty in its own right. I feel another difference between this and other BCMs would be the minced meat; Famous Eunos is quite generous in this aspect but do expect the texture to be much softer than that of other stalls. Overall, the taste is very balanced and should be likeable by many. My recommendation - get the soup version, not the dry one. This is even coming from me who prefers the dry version in our hot country; for some reason, the soup version slaps more. You can also top up for other ingredients such as solefish for $1.20.

author: L Chan
review_text: One of the most iconic hawker centres, known for its wide variety of local favourites & legendary stalls. Lively, spacious & full of heritage. Linked sheltered walkway to MSCP Block 49A. Expect long queues at famous stalls

author: José Torres
review_text: Il Poeta is a lovely establishment serving tastebud tantalizing northern Italian cuisine. The food is delicious and the ambience is perfect. Add to that excellent service and you have a recipe for an outstanding dining experience. 💯 recommend!

author: Stan Mellstrom
review_text: The reviews on here are chatting absolute rubbish. i had the BEST meat dishes from here and the atmosphere is super chill. clean facilities and the workers did their best considering the language barrier. Remember people always try for yourself!

author: Braden Penny
review_text: The absolute best Carne' Asada fries in Las Vegas... By far! I've tried them everywhere and I keep coming back here because they are so much better. Everything else I have ever tried here is great too! Truth be told, I haven't tried much else though because the Carne' Asada fries are so good.

author: Srik Kath
review_text: Meeting a colleague in a good setting. This cafe rocks it. Coffee cups were unique in a way and my Americano just had enough caffeine. Wonderful setting with fall foliage outside. The cheesecake was a decent accompaniment for the coffee. Enjoyed the coffee only to realise that there was no picture.

author: Dharmananda Lukito
review_text: Great food, come at the right time so we dont need to wait. Price reasonable, sticky manggo is good, the thai noodle is great. Atmosphere : 4.5/5 Food : 5/5 Staff : 5/5 Worth to try : yes Wort to come back : yes One of best padthai we tried..

author: Ngọc Hải
review_text: we came because the giant cake and it really funny and suitable for taking photos. The milk tea is super delicious but garlic chicken really dried, the giant cake is not suitable for eating hic. The nasi noodles over salty that we cant eat. Luckily the staff really nice and they acp to paid by card

author: Will
review_text: At ard 8pm, most stalls were closed. There was a smell from the disinfectant, cleaning and waste food. At level 1, hunt for the staff canteen sign, turn left, there’s 2 small n one larger lift. Take either of the 2 small lifts n not the large lift to reach #B1. Lifts looks like door, poor design, walk all the way inwards to look carefully for the lifts. If no signage, I would properly not walked in to spot the lifts.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Erick Morales
review_text: This spot is a must when you are in the area and are craving delicious steaks and burgers, very flavorful food. My favorite is the Picada with their delicious chimichurri sauce. And Let’s not forget, the great service I received from the staff.

author: Marina Jethrine Castro
review_text: I had a fantastic dining experience at Pizza 4P’s in Da Nang. The food was really excellent — from the fresh, flavorful pizzas made with quality ingredients to the rich pastas and refreshing salads. We ordered the Salami and Chorizo Margherita and were given the chance to make it half and half. What stood out just as much as the food was the service. Our server, Ha Vi, was friendly, attentive, and professional. They spoke good English and helped in making it easier for us to order, even during a busy evening. I felt well taken care of from start to finish.

author: Minor
review_text: As a first-time customer, I can confidently say Crazy Good Kitchen lives up to its name. From the moment I received my food, it was clear that care and attention went into both preparation and presentation. The flavors were bold, well-balanced, and genuinely satisfying—nothing tasted rushed or generic. Will definitely be going back often.

author: Gerri
review_text: My first time at this restaurant and it was great. The service was on point and the food delicious. Definitely going back again.

author: samuel gerald
review_text: I ordered two Salmon Mariners. I asked her can she change the rice to picture number two with rice and vegetables she told me it would be an extra charge. I said OK not a problem. The order ended up being $60.00 When I opened the package and seen I was overcharged for rice with Sazón seasoning I was very disappointed because I planned on spending a lot of money with them. Unfortunately, everyone’s looking for a fast buck.

author: Hoan Truong
review_text: Great breakfast restaurant. It has that family vibe. The food quality is fresh and you get a large amount for what you pay. It is one of favorite breakfast location everytime i come to Las Vegas. The pricing is pretty affordable and friendly staff. I would recommend this restaurant to anyone who want a good brunch in Vegas.

author: 01234568 i
review_text: Nice sandwich/salad place around the neighborhood. Ordered the salmon bowl which is discounted on Fridays, leans more to the healthy side at the cost of some flavor. Salmon was slightly dry, but the accompanying sauce was quite good. Service is good and friendly, decor is nice, environment is decent but gets a little noisy when the weekday lunch crowd arrives. * This establishment provides rewards in return for reviews or social media posts, but the food and service is very good regardless

author: lolli _k
review_text: A satisfying fix for nasi lemak cravings. The chicken wing is crispy and tasty. I personally prefer the usual ikan bilis over the tiny silverfish version (银鱼仔), but it’s still alright. The chili is flavourful with a nice kick. The rice is nice and fragrant, though not the best I’ve had. Overall, still a solid and enjoyable plate of nasi lemak.

author: ShaBen 2000
review_text: Our waiter fish was the nicest guy ever. He was very thoughtful and ambotious to serve our needs. Those onion-rings were the best ones we ever had. This place has a nice vibe, it is well cooled and the volume was very pleasant. Thx for having us!🇩🇪🇻🇳

author: Guillermo Cubillas
review_text: The lady was super nice taking orders, the food took a bit longer but nothing to be unfair for. The food was great. I'd say the lobby was a little sloppy but I'm guessing they were just short on staff because the were doing their best with some demanding costumers at the moment.

author: Farena Virginia Lawalata
review_text: Everything about this place hits the spot. From the face-sized, juicy burger that’s seriously tempting, to the ice-cold Kura Kura Lager that’s perfect under the Ubud midday heat. And don’t even get me started on the dessert—hands down one of the best dessert combinations I’ve ever had. Amazing food, great portions, and effortless Ubud daytime vibes. Definitely a place I’d come back to.

author: Josephine Ruth
review_text: The ban minh is good. Flavourful. Ordered the BBQ pork and Roast pork. The bread is abit hard for me but this is just my preference. My friends find it just right.

author: Ranae Michell3
review_text: Had Hanks honey chicken sandwich was pretty good convenient and great idea

author: sarah lloyd
review_text: Great branch of the Cong Caphe! Managed to sit in the lovely seats outside the cafe overlooking the river. The coconut coffee here is the best I’ve had while in Vietnam, very creamy and delicious! Only downside is that they didn’t have any of the food advertised available, however the coffee is great!

author: Chea Voon Hung
review_text: A nice cosy restaurant with real authentic Vietnamese cuisine. The fish soup is particularly good. The setting is very cultural, a lot of good corner to take great pictures

author: John Catalano
review_text: Very hard to get parking, food was asnyounwould expect though. I guess I'm just a tourist that isn't used to there not being a drivethru.

author: Yaw Cheng Chong
review_text: Great place to chill and take pretty ins photo, salted egg bingsu and caramel bingsu are nice. Definitely would come back to try other flavour

author: ariel M
review_text: We made a reservation for New Year's Eve for the 5 of us but the restaurant is huge so we probably didn't even need one. The parking lot was very full but we managed to find a spot. We started wit the nachos and added pork and Guacamole. They were delicious and the chips themselves are seasoned and spicy! For an entree, I had the braised short rib and the blue cheese mashed potatoes were fantastic. The rest of the family had the burger deluxe, OG classic pizza, and hot bird sandwich. For dessert, the kids had sundaes and my boyfriend and I split the apple pie cheesecake and it was good. If we are ever in the area again, we would definitely go back. The bar area was huge and looked like a good place to watch sports as well. We were seated in quieter area off to the side (which was great for us!) and they gave us a sling for our baby car seat. Our server was excellent and everyone we came into contact with was very friendly and nice. The drink lady seemed quite extensive but we didn't order off it. They have a kids menu but my kids ordered off the main menu. Our total bill before tip was $144.

author: Anna
review_text: I saw this spot on TikTok and made the drive into the city to try it out; what a disappointment. At prime lunch hour, we were the only ones seated, which should have been the first red flag. Service was attentive and friendly, but unfortunately the food just didn’t deliver. We ordered the pan-fried dumplings, pork xiao long bao, shrimp gyozas, and scallion pancakes. All of it was just…meh. I’ve had far better at dumpling restaurants in the East Bay for a fraction of the effort. Overall, not worth the hype or the drive.

author: Mark
review_text: Good chicken kuei tiao soup, great broth, nice flavour. Must come early (by 11am) or they run out. Curry Mee also very nice as well as dry chicken kuei tiao. A good addition to the Ipoh food circuit.

author: P Oneliv
review_text: Great place to eat right on the Boardwalk facing the Beach and Ocean. The restaurant was clean and well staffed by friendly employees. Restrooms were also available. The Food and Drink menu has something for everyone and the prices were fair and the portions were more than adequate. The Burger was gigantic and cooked as ordered. Our Server EDDIE was the Best!

author: Beau Brasseaux
review_text: Almost miss it being it's like a food truck, there's another location on same road with the same name. Be sure to check for the michelin recognize spot. The food was amazing and quick!

author: Lyn Cass
review_text: It’s not your pretty multicoloured latte drinks or matcha-whatever hipster. This is pure wholesome coffee, in a kopitiam that probably your great grandpa would approve of. No frills but the Hainanese coffee slaps like you wouldn’t believe. I don’t write many reviews but this one, deserves a shout out. I will be back.

author: Kyle Mcintire
review_text: This Mcdonald has come a long way since it reopened. I remember waiting 40 minute for my food and the staff not have an once of good customer service. Now it decent, and the most important part is that you aren't waiting a life time for your food.

author: Lorena Gomes Rocha
review_text: Fantastic Waterfront Dining Experience I had an amazing time at this waterfront restaurant! The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was top-notch—friendly and attentive. The atmosphere is relaxed and welcoming, perfect for a summer outing by the water. I especially loved the fish tank—it adds such a fun and unique touch to the dining space. Highly recommend for anyone looking for great food with a view!

author: C Y
review_text: This hawker centre is loaded with a large variety of stalls selling different delicious cuisines at reasonable prices. Sambal stingray, chicken chop, bbq chicken wings, nasi lemak, oyster omelette, soya beancurd, satay, mixed veg rice, pig organ soup, duck rice, chendol, zichar, and many more! The only prominent food missing is roti prata.

author: Angelica Moore
review_text: Best sushi spot. So close to the stip. Sushi so fresh and lots of flavors. We had a great time. Nice and cozy inside. Miss Suzette had the best recommendations and her playlist was on point. It’s super cute inside. Lastly desert was amazing. We came twice in a row!!!

author: Caitlin Lin
review_text: The food here is absolutely delicious. Definitely recommend the set #9 (Hanoi traditional fried fish), you will get to experience the fun of making the fresh roll by yourself! The service and people are also very nice.

author: NGUYEN KHUONG
review_text: The price is OK, the food is delicious, the owner is enthusiastic, I will come back to the restaurant 100%

author: Loretta K.
review_text: Awesome delicious tonkatsu. I have never been disappointed with the quality of the food here. Tender n juicy meat. However, no rsvp, so getting a seat could be a hit n miss. Place feels like a typical homestyle, cozy setting.

author: André
review_text: Great spot with a rustic warm interior serving some good coffee options, juices and good for a brunch with a variety of seating indoor and outdoor the service is friendly and attentive no waiting time and dishes are served fast.

author: Manjusha Ray
review_text: Love the sandwiches and the baked goods. As well as the cakes. Can't go wrong. Plus they are very nice and helpful with any questions

author: Ralph Torres
review_text: Had a great time eating and drinking Pisco sour. The Lomo Saltado has the best steak cuts.

author: Richard McGar
review_text: I work till late night early morning and it can be 2am 3am or 4am and drive through always says the same thing, we are sorry our systems are rebooting. Too many times leads me to think thats code for we dont want to work

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: Sean T
review_text: I was quite disappointed with my experience here. The food was standard and didn't stand out, especially considering the prices are quite high for Chiang Mai standards. The only highlight was the complimentary steamed rice. While ผัด 3 เหม็น was okay, ฉู่ฉี่ was poor…a few prawns weren't fresh. By the way, the drink they served before meal (to open the palette) was way toooo sweet.

author: Duke Poolpangnga
review_text: A stylish spot in Siam Square serving a wide variety of Thai dishes with great presentation. The tom yum noodles and steamed egg stood out both in taste and looks. You can ask for milder seasoning without sacrificing flavor, which is a plus for those who prefer less heat. The atmosphere is modern and inviting, with attention to detail in both décor and utensils. Staff are helpful and attentive, adding to the overall positive experience. A great place to enjoy flavorful Thai food in a well-designed setting.

author: Julie Monast-Nadeau
review_text: Great experience dining at Joi Factory. The food was very good and enjoyable even for non vegan/vegetarian. Great service and absolutely beautiful space.

author: Chen E.
review_text: I brought my foreign friend here and we were impressed by both the food and the incredible atmosphere! While the prices are on the higher side, definitely more than you’d spend on everyday Thai food. I can say it’s worth it for a special occasion. The flavors are authentically Thai, so there’s no need to worry about taste. The decoration, filled with various flowers, made you feel good. The place itself feels like stepping into a fancy yet cozy home. If you’re driving, parking is hassle-free with plenty of spaces available. Highly recommended!

author: kimberly Clement
review_text: 8pm at night. # 1, i did not get a welcome in or anything. #2, ordered my food, so i was a paying customer #3. I needed to use the restroom while i waited for my food and they said they close the bathroom at 6:30pm everyday… Why is the dining room open then?? 6:30pm closing bathroom for what?

author: Daryl Marcelo
review_text: If you're looking for a vibrant and diverse culinary experience in San Jose, look no further than San Pedro Square Market! This bustling marketplace offers a fantastic selection of food vendors, each serving up delicious and unique dishes to satisfy every craving. From savory empanadas and flavorful tacos to gourmet burgers and fresh seafood, there's something for everyone here. The ambiance is equally impressive. The open-air setting creates a lively and welcoming atmosphere, perfect for gathering with friends and family. The colorful decor and live music add to the overall charm. Plus, the easy parking options nearby make it a convenient spot to visit, even on busy weekends.

author: Moon Nguyet Tm Vu
review_text: Hanoi Kitchen truly delivers an authentic taste of Hanoi right in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City. From the very first bite, the food reflects the soul of Northern Vietnamese cuisine—balanced, delicate, and deeply flavorful. Each dish is thoughtfully prepared, using fresh ingredients and traditional recipes that stay true to Hanoi’s culinary heritage. Nothing feels rushed or overly commercial; instead, every plate feels like a respectful homage to home-style Hanoi cooking. The service is equally impressive. The staff are warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming, always ready to explain dishes or make recommendations with a smile. Orders are handled efficiently, and the team strikes a perfect balance between being attentive and giving diners space to enjoy their meal. The atmosphere is another highlight. Hanoi Kitchen offers a cozy, elegant setting that blends classic Hanoi charm with modern comfort. It feels calm, inviting, and ideal for both casual meals and meaningful gatherings. Despite being located in the busy center of Ho Chi Minh City, the restaurant provides a sense of calm and familiarity—almost like stepping into a quiet corner of Hanoi. Overall, Hanoi Kitchen is a must-visit for anyone who loves authentic Vietnamese cuisine or wants to experience the true flavors of Hanoi without leaving the city. Exceptional food, heartfelt service, and a warm atmosphere make this place well deserving of five stars. 🌟

author: Erica Quah
review_text: if you're rethinking whether you should be queuing for so long, i say just queue, it's worth it but go on an empty stomach because you should feast here! also the queue wasnt as long as i thought considering there were 20 groups in front of us (this was at 3pm) jumbo crab curry is a must buy, the portion of crab is bigger than other places i went to and the sauce was pretty good (i'm a big crab curry lover and this was the best i tried so far) the tom yum soup was so good too, it was spicy enough and flavourful, kind of like a clear-my-sinuses spicy rather than a i-just-drank-fire spicy which was really nice! the stir fry glass noodle with crab meat was also 10/10 ❤️ there's also a nice matcha place nearby (good cha matcha) if you need something to do while waiting p.s. note their new year opening times

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: Sakura Fujio
review_text: I ordered crispy pork! It was great, I wanted to order more cucumber and the staff give me two more pieces 😂 that was the funny part! I couldn't eat pork without many cucumbers! Anyways they didn't charge me for two extra cucumbers, thanks❤️

author: Anthony Huszar
review_text: Friendly, nice vibe, and good food. The Peruvian chicken was delicious.

author: Andrew Wang
review_text: One of our local favorites for dim sum specialties. The dumplings are, of course, the star attraction, but I also really enjoy the wonton soup, garlic green beans, and fried chicken wings. Also very kid friendly, my toddler loves going here and watching the Chinese cooking show they have playing on the TVs. If you're around for the lunch special (dine in only), it's also a great deal!

author: Chris Ayers
review_text: Solid Indian staples served by kind staffers. May be the best Indian food in JP?

author: CariAnne Behr Huffman
review_text: We stayed the Downtown Grand for one night and wanted a delicious meal with great service without a strict dress code, but not a tourist place, so we chose to eat here. The ambiance was perfection, but the service even better — with (of course) delicious food and drink!! Our server, Rebbecca, was one of the two best servers we’ve ever had, and she tied with the other: beautiful smile, friendly, perfect timing! The food would bring us back, she makes us recommend it to others!!

author: Eiríkr L
review_text: My absolute favorite croissant shop. Everything is crispy and flaky with rich buttery flavor. My favorites are the plain croissant, almond chocolate croissant, monkey bread, and kouign amann. Be prepared to wait because there’s usually a line, no matter what time you go.

author: Dump Dump
review_text: Love the lemongrass chicken rice and the sugarcane prawn (appetizer). Very authentic taste. Nice deco. Personable service. Price is fair for the great quality.

author: Marcus Chan
review_text: Very good supper place for a Saturday night, the crowd was not overwhelm. Quite a lot of empty parking space by the road. The lala soup was good & clams were fresh, ingredients such as the Shabu pork, prawn paste & beef were good & decently priced. The soup base & huadiao jiu is refillable and no msg I think, as we didn’t feel thirsty thereafter or even next day. Only downside is the overall cleanliness of the coffeeshop can see quite a few small roaches here and there, not the stall, the stall is clean. Will still visit there again hope the overall coffeeshop management do something about it

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Dan Bob
review_text: Great spot for people watching seated at an outdoor table. Conveniently located just outside CitizenM hotel. Delicious mussels in garlic butter, shallots, cherry tomatoes and sprigs of fresh thyme. My waiter, Samet, was informative, attentive, efficient and very cute. Enjoy your time here!

author: Julian Aguilar
review_text: I had special Bánh mì chảo (beef, egg, sausage, cheese, meatball, ham and pate) and it was so good. Price: July 3 = 55k July 4 = 57k July 5 = 60k Date: 5/7/25

author: Ashley Perez
review_text: This restaurant is beautifully put together — the decor feels polished and intentional, and the overall atmosphere is upscale and welcoming. Customer service was great from start to finish, the restaurant was very clean, and the food was excellent. The steak was prepared to perfection, and the drinks were well made. Everything we ordered was on point. The bathrooms are not located inside the restaurant but downstairs in the main lobby, which wasn’t a big issue, just something to note. The only reason this isn’t a full 5-star review is the valet parking situation. Valet was $25 and required payment upfront, which was surprising — especially for a high-end restaurant. This was my first time experiencing mandatory upfront valet payment, and it definitely took away from an otherwise excellent experience. Great food, great service, great atmosphere just wish the valet process matched the rest of the experience

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Carlos Rafael Fernandez
review_text: Cheap, yummy, clean. If you want Bun Thit Nuong, come to this place. For 30,000 vnd you get a really good meal.

author: Alice Cooper
review_text: I love this place, food is delicious! Also, atmosphere is good for meeting with friends. Staff is very helpful and friendly! Will back soon.

author: Willy Illas
review_text: Went here with friends for my 50th. birthday. Food was pretty good and with a service to match. Atmosphere wasn't bad but not great. Kinfa family oriented I guess? But again, great to just go there to eat in supposed.

author: Hikigaya Hachiman
review_text: Nested and Hidden away from those who aren't local to MacPherson. After walking around Circuit Road I managed to find this hawker centre. I came the following week in the morning (as it closes early afternoon) I had the Black Carrot Cake (Facing the Provision shops), Porridge and Soya Bean. I had spent a total of 7 dollar for this. Hawker prices kept low , this is really a rare find in sg with everything getting more expensive. My favourite is the Black Carrot Cake being a 8/10, good amount of egg, nice texture with the garlic and Radish along with the sweet and just enough sweet sauce. The porridge was a little of a miss, 6/10 , on the mild side , I imagine their audience being older folks who wouldn't want too salty. They have porridges around 2.80 and you can add on Ingredients found in like economical BEEHOON stalls. The 1 dollar Soya Bean was amazing for me , so cheap! Definitely give them a try when you are here. Nothing beats morning with coffee or Soya Bean. I hope to come here in the future , as it seems popular with their Prawn Noodles , Wanton Mee and Laksa.

author: Linjie Shen
review_text: The food there is pretty good. I tried lamb pita, the lamb was fresh and smelled good. The atmosphere there is really nice, I like the music in the restaurant. As for a fast casual,the waiting time here is not so long. so I really appreciate everyone to try here.

author: Mmhewy S
review_text: This is an Isan restaurant decorated in a casual dining style. Those who like spicy food will probably like it, but I personally don't eat fermented fish, and each menu focuses on that. Fortunately, there are some interesting dishes on the menu. We ordered the Somtam Thai with Chan noodles and salted eggs, which didn't have any fermented fish. The taste was really good, sour, sweet, salty, and had a variety of flavors. However, the price was a bit higher, but compared to the ingredients and location, it's understandable.

author: M. C. B. P.
review_text: So chill this place, my preferred place to hang out for a couples of drinks before my flight. Do drop by and find out yourself. And all the staff here are so friendly and nice. OMG 5 stars for sure ! Nice nachos too btw.

author: Jaylene Low
review_text: Good location at Siam Square, very easy to find. Tried their crab meat curry and a vege, both were delicious. Tourist price but food worth it. Ambience is ok overall but will be better if the music at second floor can be lowered.

author: Sammi L.
review_text: I visited this place around noon on a weekday. I was eager to try their renowned croissants, particularly the almond and chocolate flavors. They are incredibly delicious, and each croissant costs around $8. The drinking chocolate was also quite good, and I particularly enjoyed the hot chocolate on a rainy, cold day. I highly recommend the croissants; they are truly exceptional!!

author: D G
review_text: Average spot at best. The skillet was flavorless. They have a kids area but almost no options for kids breakfasts. Bathrooms were very dirty. All around not impressed. I came here years ago and it was a much better experience.

author: Charles Binau
review_text: Our waitress was Aniyah and she was amazing. She convinced me to go with the Oxtail Burger. I am glad I did! Seasoned well, lots of flavor and cooked perfect. My colleague ordered the lamb burger and he really enjoyed it too. We both got the sweet potato tater tots. I got mine dusted with brown sugar. I’m definitely going back.

author: Anudeep Jain
review_text: Food was decent but I gave 3 star because of poor billing. They charge gratuity on the bill irrespective of the group size. Wonder whether that is even legal.

author: Jason L
review_text: Large open space restaurant with great latin themed music. Beautiful view of the beach and boardwalk. The fried snapper was huge (MP~$40) and very well cooked, very tasty with plenty of rice and salad. Probably better for 2 people, but I eat alot. My server Tatiana was very nice and provided wonderful service (also very beautiful ). The piña colada was also huge lol. If I had to give a complaint, I wouldve preferred sitting by a fan as it was very humid but that's Florida in the midday for you. I will definitely come back again! saludos de NY!!

author: Johnny 2by4
review_text: Food was great as always. Never had any issues at any Bubba Gump location I’ve been to. JP took care of my sister and I at the Biscayne BLVD spot. Food was great, and service was quick and great.

author: Nemo Atlantis
review_text: Batter Pandan pancakes, opened for decades, great when eating hot.

author: Max Reid.
review_text: It’s more about the name and pretty photos than real flavor or good customer service. The service leaves a lot to be desired—it feels cold, unprofessional, and indifferent. The coffee is basically watered down; my friend ordered a cappuccino and what he got was more like cappuccino tea, completely diluted. Bottom line: it’s not worth coming to a place that’s just a pretty front for reviews but fails at the basics.

author: Robert W. Rescue Beats AED
review_text: Vinny and Lisa and just as important the staff that works with them average best on the beach. Drinks, food, and service are way above others.

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: Gavin Zheng (GavinEats)
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ The black vinegar trotter was super tasty — tender meat with just the right balance of sour and sweet! The soups were rich and comforting, perfect on a rainy day. Everything tasted really homemade and full of flavour. Definitely worth coming back for!

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: Mr Wang Wang
review_text: Despite the vendor's notably brusque demeanor, this stall earns its reputation through impeccably cleaned pig organ soup. The offal—whether liver, intestine, or stomach—arrives without a trace of that gamey aftertaste that plagues lesser versions, a testament to rigorous washing that borders on artisanal. Where they falter is portion control: servings lean modest, making the automatic inclusion of meatballs and three-layered pork feel like filler rather than value. Truthfully, I’d prefer an organs-only option to savor their star ingredient undiluted. Come prepared for old-school transaction rules—cash is king here, with digital payments firmly off the menu.

author: beth b
review_text: Food is HEAVILY OVERPRICED for what you’re getting. For starters, the photos on the kiosk menu does not match what you’re gonna get at all. The food is fast food level at best. I got some pho, chicken tenders, fries, and two drinks and paid $110. No place to sit and eat.

author: Wilson Shum
review_text: Had the whole fish pot that has prawns and clams and a few other bits and pieces in it. The broth was so flavourful. Even for me who don't like coriander cant stop eating it. The fried fish had really nice texture and everything is super yummy. Way better than beauty in the pot. The dessert and snack bar also super good, the mango passion fruit soft serve helps balance the heat of the meal. Highly recommended.

author: Eian Tang
review_text: Kirv and his team’s excellent table service goes great with good tasting foods. I’d recommend Rosso Vino for cozy family meals and small group get-togethers. 👍 The only gripe was the level of cleanliness in their restrooms — not pleasant enough. On top of that, it’s located outside of restaurant where it’s not sheltered.

author: Kay Foulkes
review_text: The only downside was the bathrooms which only had hand sanitizer. Lived the gold theme of the restaurant and the food was some of the best fast food we had visiting the states.

author: Jakub Chrzanowski
review_text: Portions are a little small, also the taste was just so so. I had much better experience in Patong.

author: Réka Fehér
review_text: Incredibly tasty and super generous serving! I had the breakfast club one (the omelette melted in your mouth) and the super Mario with an amazing mushroom cheese patty! Best to come early in the morning to reduce queuing time. The service is kind & efficient, waiting times were never too long. Thanks, I will be back ❤️

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: Evon Tan
review_text: 🍜 Zhup Zhup hits the spot Tried both the Jumbo and Supreme prawn noodles (dry and spicy). The noodles portions are generous and the soup is refillable. The prawns are sweet, broth is comforting, and everything feels nicely balanced. Personally, I would go for the Supreme at $20 per bowl - more than good enough for me and great value. Comfort food cravings satisfied 😊

author: Vien Nguyen
review_text: The rice tastes like home-cooked rice, the seasoning is just right for the taste, my family ate a combo of 4 people and the bill was less than 500k. Too cheap compared to similar restaurants and the location is in the center of District 1 Will come back

author: Glara Y.
review_text: Where to begin with Rock Bar? Perched literally on the rocks, it offers an indescribably stunning view of the ocean—truly one of the most iconic sunset spots in Bali. On a clear, sunny day, a breathtaking sunset is all but guaranteed. The sound of waves crashing below, the golden light reflecting off the sea, and the panoramic horizon stretching out in front of you—it’s an experience that leaves you in awe.
