I felt incredibly fortunate to have celebrated my big birthday on the Round Deck, a more intimate setting with uninterrupted views. It made the moment feel truly special—surreal, even. The staff go above and beyond, not just with attentive service, but also in helping guests capture perfect photos. They understand that this place is not just about drinks, but memories. The cocktails are well-crafted and refreshing, but honestly, the view is the real star. If you’re visiting Ayana, Rock Bar is simply unmissable.

author: sarah aisya
review_text: Such a fun and vibrant place to dance and enjoy the night! I had an amazing time dancing and soaking in the festive atmosphere. The music was great, the crowd was energetic, and the interior feels like you’re stepping into a hidden, jungle-themed world. For ladies, entrance is free — a big plus! For guys, there’s a minimum drink purchase required if you come after 10 PM. Totally worth it for the experience. La Favela is definitely one of the must-visit spots if you’re looking to party in Bali!

author: Aslee Vongphakdy
review_text: Stumbled upon this place and it does remind me a little bit of Tokyo! The TSUKUNE bao was very flavorful. Even though the ramen were about $21-$22 it was still good. The thing that surprised me was how tender the roasted chasu pork was. You can tell the restaurant stayed busy but even as a walk in, the wait was 15-20 min. I would say 8.5 out of 10

author: Rick Reinhardt
review_text: Good food with real onion rings. Lots of different choice burgers but they didn't have hot fudge Sunday. I'm not supposed to eat it anyways so probably a good thing but our Hardee's have it. Good service

author: Vivian Hera
review_text: First time trying out this place, the food looks appetizing. I ordered custom bowl and it was delicious and healthy, the ambiance was very relaxing too, will definitely visit again next time 👍

author: Jess Liu
review_text: Very nice coffee place! I tried their cold brew and ice latte, both tasted great!

author: Chris Benvegna
review_text: NOT THE SAME! My wife and I have been coming here for her birthday for the last 3 years and we loved it. Not any more! They renovated the place this past year and it ruined the experience. The ONLY good thing about the place is the food (my wife's fish, however, was lukewarm). The servers are incredibly rude and rush you to order. They won't let you put in an appetizer order unless you order everything at once, again, feeling rushed. We were 1 of only 2 tables in the place but I was told the chef is too busy to make any kind of change to my order. The music was terrible, sounded like club music, and the entire atmosphere feels like you are eating at a restaurant in Las Vegas, it's extremely bright and sterile. The tables are crowded together on one side with couch seating! You used to get such a warm vibe from this place but all that is gone. Sadly, we will not be celebrating her birthday here any longer.

author: Ash Kash
review_text: I love their food I been going to this restaurant since 2019 best customer service ever & best Cuban food in town

author: Kristopher Kuss
review_text: The food is pretty good. The fried chicken sandwich was cooked well. Not much flavor going on other than the chicken. The spicy cheesy beef sandwich was tasty, only slightly spicy. The curly fries were well seasoned and crispy, but not hot. The regular fries were good.

author: Andrew G
review_text: This place is great. Amazing quality in the baked goods and coffee. Not cheap, but that’s ok. You do get what you pay for. I had cappuccino and chocolate almond croissant and it came to $13.05. I changed my mind on the stars. All is still true and it’s good, but when they let the dude in with the big dog that was sniffing everything poking around hairy and drinking out of a cup that he gave him, I just thought that’s too much.

author: Hoang Ngan
review_text: Great place to experience baguette with a combo pan. They have inside seats as well as outside seats. The food is served very fast and hot. The first one (mix option) is good enough for breakfast. They also have free special butter which is usually served in Banh Mi food stalls. I do not recommend the kumquat tea here, so tasteless. Price: 45.000 - 60.000/ person

author: Gregor Malcolm
review_text: Me and my girlfriend visited here last year many times last year, we have now returned for the second year of our trip and we have been here many times again. This time we chose to both have the pancakes as we can remember how tasty they were last year (they still taste fantastic!) they’re location is generously sized which accommodates lots of seating options which can host from a couple up to 9 people +. We would definitely come back here again for breakfast and would recommend it to anyone looking for a scrumptious breakfast ! 5 ⭐️

author: Anna Chen
review_text: The best meal experience in Miami, hands down. The food is delicious and affordable at its quality, service is excellent and attentive. We were so blessed to have Franco serve us. He is amazing and truly made our experience wonderful. Shoutout to Franco!

author: Nattarika nana
review_text: If anyone comes, I recommend ordering the dry pork sukiyaki. It's very delicious. The crab fried rice is also delicious. The stir-fried chicken is also delicious. If anyone comes to Hat Yai, I highly recommend coming to this restaurant. Every time I go back to Hat Yai, I stop by to eat here. The price is not expensive. I recommend coming to eat during lunch time so you won't have to wait in line for long.

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Vanessa Leang
review_text: Squid with Flowers - Marinated Pork Stomach - Flower Beef - Beef Belly Rolled in Cabbage Leaves is not available ❌ There is only one type of beef, not many like on the menu ❌ When asking for Marinated Squid Teeth, the staff didn't even know the restaurant had that dish Shrimp skewers are so soft❌ Clams are shriveled, snails have a smell that can't be released in time Other dishes are marinated to taste. Staff are okay, proactively change the tray for customers The security guard is cute Plastic dishes don't feel very clean I went around 5:30 and saw a group of guests from the planet of flies fluttering around like in the clip Eating for the experience is okay The restaurant space is airy. Toilet is clean 3/5 🔥🔥 stairs have a ledge Customers should be careful not to trip

author: Kavya Sebastian
review_text: The omakase at Paperfish was absolutely incredible and well worth the money. It was the perfect amount to split with someone else and still be full! The lychee martini was also divine, one of the best I’ve ever had. Even though we were one of the last customers left at the restaurant, the staff didn’t rush us or kick us out. Incredible food and very professional team!

author: Shaolin Leong
review_text: This place is special ! Grandpa's favorite hawker center ! Curry noodles , CKT, prawn noodle, kuey chap, laksa, wanton noodle, curry puff etc . Right in the city ,so things are more expensive over here .Pity those that worked in the city ! But to be fair no dinner crowd. Therefore LPPL ! Can complain can kpkb but nothing can done ! Not happy don't eat type!

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Mohsein Sani
review_text: Very popular with Malaysian tourists, this restaurant serves a variety of local dishes in a plethora of small plates covered in plastic that the servers bring to your table along with a tub of white rice. Choose whatever dish you fancy and the servers will calculate your meal cost at the end by counting the plates that have been uncovered. Go there for this experience, but the food isn't all that great, to be honest, and it's kind of pricey too.

author: Mark LoGiurato
review_text: Large Italian restaurant with very good service. However when you have pizza in your name, you should make great pizza. This is not the place to go for pizza. Toppings were good but the actual dough was not very good. Just flat and in need of olive oil and salt. The cannolis were prefilled, but tasted ok. I did not have any entrees so my review is based on the pizza only.

author: Ceo wa Mairura
review_text: First paying before you eat is a good sign to start with , food was cold, just few options unlike other buffet . I don’t even finish my first plate

author: jacqueline azar
review_text: Cute little Café with awesome choice of breakfast, very very delicious and generous servings - but slightly overpriced. Staff is polite but seems to prefer thai costumers or is just generally busy. 4 costumers who arrived after I had ordered were all fully served including hot meals before I even got my drink. Sadly they have 3 wifi networks by name yet none is available for guests. Wanted to plan my day during breakfast as usual, that was quite disappointing - with company I wouldn't have minded it. If seated outside mind the smell, if you have a sensitive nose you might prefer to sit inside. However, the plants and decor outside are nicer. Outdoor seats are in the shadow during mornings. Cafe is usually busy especially after 10 am, many people waited or moved on as it is a small cafe with limited space.

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: My KING Seah
review_text: One of my favorite local zhi char restaurant to go to whenever we have a large group. Food is good and not pricey. Ingredients are fresh and don’t have any unpleasant surprises. Parking is difficult and will have to go early to avoid the queue.

author: B E
review_text: We ordered salads from Royal Greens and overall it was tasty just like other salad places in the area. There wasn’t a lot of each of the toppings added and they forgot the avocado which were paid extra for. They also don’t note which of the salad dressings have dairy and which do not. Overall the app works well, quick and easy ordering/pickup, and good promo for new customers. Customer service was also responsive to issue with missing avocado and credited the account. I’d give a half star extra for that. We’ll try again and see how it goes. Decent concept of being able to order different foods from one place to pickup.

author: Du Rainie
review_text: Agreed—an incredibly overpriced wine list. The food is okay, but one pasta dish was very salty, and the inside was still hard and undercooked. We arrived after 8 PM, and by 9 PM, the patio was empty. Staff started checking on us every 10 minutes while we were still finishing our last two dishes which were served very late (including the salty undercooked pasta). For over $100 per person, there are better options in the area.

author: Hatsune Miku
review_text: Living in the east and near Paya Lebar, this food centre is no stranger to me. But truth to be told, I dont really like this food centre. Most stalls here serve mediocre food, and the MacDonalds nearby might be a better food option. Yes, there is a rather famous stall selling duck and fish porridge, but it goes downhill from here. The carrot cake here sucks, kway chap sucks, nasi padang sucks, wanton mee sucks. And there is a very long list that goes on from here. The stalls that narrowly escape my wrath are the two congee stalls and pig organ soup. If you are not here for the duck and fish porridge, you shouldnt be here. Geylang East Market Food Centre is a total let down.

author: Kimberly Vallejo (Kimbuyanda)
review_text: Good experience server was very nice. Food took a while to arrive and my father's plate was the last one we were waiting for with was only a sandwich so we sat at our table watching out food getting cold waiting for my father's sandwich to arrive. It was his birthday too. Food was ok. I had to ask for tomatoes on my plate so it didn't look all brown. Dad enjoyed his sandwich with was good. Overall good experience.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Siam Srisuwan
review_text: It's a vintage-style cafe where every angle you take a photo is beautiful. The single-dish meals are also delicious.

author: Sandy L
review_text: The Chick-fil-A pizza is interesting and delicious. I was pretty skeptical how a chick fil a be incorporated into a pizza but they did it. The crisscut fries were very crispy, the sauce was on point to the chick fil a sauce. Very creative. The Bird is spot on with spicy-ness and the ooey gooey cheese on top. The meatball sub was alright but not great. The meatball was a little dry. The Classic Philly is also tasty. The meat was very tender n it melts in your mouth.

author: Roberta Ballista
review_text: High quality food, very fresh fish, with a relaxed ambiance and a perfect friendly service and reasonable prices. I tried many dishes, and I can recommend especially the super fresh tuna carpaccio, oysters, squid skewers, bora bora and all the homemade desserts! Special mention for Ayu the manager who let us feel like at home. Congratulations to all the staff

author: Isabella Grandic
review_text: Maybe I got a bad apple, but this was some of the laziest, sloppiest service I’ve had… ever. Especially for a restaurant of this calibre. (Will elaborate) The food was good. Some of it was not good. The beef short ribs tasted were filled with what tasted like canned beans. Lamb ribs, which everyone seems to holler about, were not for me?? I couldn’t eat more than 1. A combination of the texture + the overpowering sauce. The bread is good but y’all it’s $6 bread. It should come with the dips. The yogurt dip was basic but good. The Brussels sprouts dip was good. Desserts were good! Only thing I would order again is the Wagyu kebab situation. That was yummy I think the play here is a lot a lot of dips. Maybe the fish / chicken is better than the red meat, it didn’t hit for me. The drinks. The Saffron martini tasted purely like moonshine, I got exactly zero saffron. Their coffee based cocktail I didn’t love (tasted cheap?). The cucumber mint one was alright and the mezcal pepercorn one was good. Draft beer was super whatever. However, our server was on a different planet, one where attention to detail doesn’t exist. She came up to us for the first time asking for dessert. I was like we’ll start with the meal first 😂. Ordered cocktails which took 30+ minutes to come. Then, when it came to ordering food, we asked for recs. She started just recommending something and then adding it to our bill. I had to stop her, ask her to please stop adding things to our list and let us choose lmao. “I will add one of those” should not be something the server says, unless it’s on the house! It took her 45+ minutes to return with a draft beer. When I asked for the dessert menu, she gave me the drink menu and returned 20 mins later asking what we wanted for dessert, to which I had to say, I don’t know because we didn’t have the menu! They also delivered the wrong bread and the wrong cocktail during our dinner A lot of people have loved this place and I fully went in hoping to join the club, but unfortunately this meal and experience fell quite short for me.

author: Leslie Jones
review_text: From the time, I walked to the front patio with the hostess greeting me and my cousin, to the bar staff and servers everyone here are pleasant and welcoming. Then the food just amazing, I had the Cream Cheese Rangoons when I said cooked to perfection 😊 The owner mother did her big one with that amazing treat, my taste buds were pleased 😋 Wait one more thing, I had the Garlic Fried Rice with Chicken and a fried egg on top,no spicy because I can’t 😫but you can choose your level of heat 🌶️ My taste buds are so pleased, I had to stop eating because I was full for one and I wanted to write this review while still here

author: Bernhard VDM
review_text: I had an absolutely amazing time here. I felt so at home that I want to learn to speak Spanish😊 I got seated at the counter (I called last minute for reservation and was on my own) which seemed at 1st a bit impersonal, but since I was on my own, this is the best place to be part of the action. Everyone was super attentive and even though I don't speak Spanish, the manager and staff all stuck up a conversation to make me feel welcome. I liked the atmosphere created by El Carajo because it seems it used to be the convenience store at the gas station, but is now a wine shop and Restaurant. In fact, you feel as though you actually dine inside the wine shop (or shopping inside a restaurant 😁) They have a good wine selection that is part of the restaurant and you can just browse for something that takes your fancy. A good variety of tapas. I had the ham croquettes, boquerones, meat starter plate and later the pulpo de gallega. All food was very good and well presented. For wine I had the Vina Ardanza Reserva which was superb. What I liked most was the friendly atmosphere created by everyone. I felt like a regular on my 1st visit, which is a special quality not many restaurants can manage, and I want to thank all the staff for making my evening special.

author: Devane Sharma
review_text: Visiting from Asia, Cheesecake Factory was top of my list and it was great. The menu is overwhelmingly big, mains and the cheesecake and the over-the-top decor sets the atmosphere right! Everything feels massive and of course the food is great. I had the chicken parmigiana and the tiramisu cheesecake which were both awesome. Portions here are huge so I suggest skipping the complimentary bread.

author: Nelson Brunes
review_text: While visiting Las Vegas I wanted some good Mexican food and I found a post on tiktok about this place. I ordered the molcajete for 2 people for take out, and it was amazing, so much food and so much flavor. Next time, I'll make sure to eat in

author: Andrew Z
review_text: One of the only good Chinese food places I have found. Their noodles are spectacular!

author: Християна Петкова
review_text: Great lasagna and sneaker bar. Great bowls and burgers. Highly recommend. Boho style - great atmosphere.

author: Shivani sharma
review_text: I ordered three items from this restaurant, but I was very disappointed. The food was really disgusting. The chutney was made without salt, and the vegetables used in the chow mein and fried veggie momos were all raw. Never order potato chili; you will get mashed potato with sweet and sour sauce. I feel like I wasted my money, and I definitely won't be going back. I wouldn't recommend this restaurant for momos.

author: Elizabeth Amadiz
review_text: If you’re looking for soul food that feels like it came straight out of grandma’s kitchen, this is it. I ordered the turkey wings with mac & cheese and cabbage, and let me tell you—those turkey wings hitttttt. The portion sizes are generous (so much that I couldn’t even finish mine), which means I get to look forward to leftovers tomorrow. Definitely worth every penny. What made the experience even better was the staff. Kim, Bernice, and Nana treated us like family. We weren’t just customers, we were sitting, talking, and laughing as if we were at home in a southern-style kitchen. That kind of warmth and hospitality is rare, and it really made the meal special. Between the incredible food and the welcoming atmosphere, this spot is a gem. I’ll definitely be back!

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: Allen Teo
review_text: Must try with its egg noodles served with pork balls, and liver if you want. It’s located in a hidden street located back of the flat. Environment is quite nice, with their high hospitality.

author: Raymond Coshuner
review_text: I recently had the misfortune of ordering the strawberry poppy seed salad from Panera Bread, and I was thoroughly disappointed with my experience. The salad was an absolute disaster as it contained rotten produce, which completely ruined the entire meal for me. The strawberries were mushy and had an unpleasant smell, while the lettuce was wilted and unappetizing. It is incredibly disheartening to spend hard-earned money on a supposedly fresh and healthy salad, only to be served subpar ingredients. Panera Bread, you need to prioritize quality control and ensure that your customers receive fresh and edible food. This experience has left me with a strong distaste for your establishment, and I won't be returning anytime soon.

author: Jenny Monroy
review_text: Decided to try something new closer to my home area, and WOW the combo B was so good the rice was soft and not salty, orange chicken was also so good along with the beef and broccoli I would recommend!! My new favorite chinese spot to eat at now!

author: Usir Wulf
review_text: As one of the only places truly capable,. of not just tapping into the scenic dining experiences the Bayside Inlet is known for providing, but also an accessible menu ; with the host being flavor, into the wide range of gustatory and olfactory delight the Caribbean and Canjun descendants of the Americans are historically known for providing 😋, i am delighted to bring to your attention the amazing food, drinks and customer experience of Margaritaville Bayside. Ok that's the most of my big brain anyone gets before I start writing a food review site. So let's gets to it From the very first steps up to the bar from the front porch, I felt like i was stepping onto one of the many yachts or cruise ships circling in the port just behind me. Even walking in at 11 30 on a Thanksgiving its a good amount of people here. Gotta be decent right? RIGHT! I hadn't even made it past the bar before I was greeted by 3 different employees, once by the bartender and once by a server and a host just walking in. Buddy I've eaten in luxury restaurants not sitting in a tourist venue on a Thanksgiving already busy 30 mins into the restaurant opening... so let's just say I was "above impressed " as my intro into the place. I was offered a bar or a booth, i slide into my bench and start my war with the menu. I say war, because even though I don't really suffer from any dietary restrictions (other than , ewww that's nasty) I battle with indecisiveness when it comes to good food. The eastern border of taste was being represented by a pacific stir-fry bowl , with them broccoli I like!.. flash fried vegetables lil teriyaki sauce and the chicken over the rice, a hit! But end the it was the Caribbean that won. That summer taste beat my hunger into a willing retreat, and through combined efforts of Jimmy's jammin' jambalaya , set of his jerk Caribbean wings( extra sauce) and a tall bottle of Landshark to wash it down, the afternoon lunch/ dinner war of 2025 Thanksgiving was won.

author: Olivier Guillard
review_text: Good pad thai at Mae Thong Bai. We went there for lunch and it was good, considering the price. The size of my plate wasn't very big but the price and taste somewhat made up for it.

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: Cadell Teng
review_text: Fantastic food and atmosphere at reasonable prices. Perfect for large family gathering and dinner. Table size for 4 to 8 available.

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: Y.K
review_text: After my massage at Po Thai Massage, I was walking back to the hotel and randomly found this noodle shop right next door. Honestly, it was sooo good! Such a happy little find. I came for massages three times, and every single time I ended up eating noodles here too. Three massages, three bowls of noodles – sooooo great!!😌

author: sergio valles-blancarte
review_text: I've been coming here for at least 4 years now, but the last 2Xs, the food has been horrible . No flavor and just not good. The service is still amazing and the sever is really friendly and good atmosphere is cool local vibe plus kid friendly for lunch. Hope they get a new cook soon and bring some items back. Hey taylor thanks for responding back i will definitely like to go back and give it a try again .like I said the last 2x have not been the best but at least 8 other times I had great food and great service,The Pic I posted is from a Lil less the 2 years ago and didn't take pics of my most recent visit.

author: Russell Ariagno
review_text: We had the Japanese Wagyu beef dumplings as an appetizer and they were incredible, the sauce they came in was delicious and the beef inside was perfectly cooked. I got the A5 Japanese wagyu which was very good, some pieces were a bit cool which I understand happens with the A5 but I feel it should have been properly heated up and brought out immediately. It was seared on the outside with the right amount of crisp and the warm pieces inside melted like butter. As a complimentary side they gave exotic mushrooms which were delicious and had some kind of a raspberry vinegar glaze/sauce which was perfect with these mushrooms. My wife got the American Wagyu filet whip was cooked and seasoned perfectly, came out delicious. We also had there tater tots which were crispy on the outside and a mashed potatoe filling on the inside. It was my birthday and they gave me a complimentary chocolate filled with marshmallow and graham cracker. The service was excellent, our waiter was very friendly, everyone who waited on our table was excellent, top class service. All in all a great experience

author: Mia Marroquin
review_text: Stumbled upon this gem and couldn’t not be happier with our decision. The wings, burger, onion rings and clam chowder were out of this world. Bartender was so friendly and attentive. Couldn’t recommend this place enough.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Đi chơi
review_text: If you want to wait, clean the table yourself, and go to the restaurant to order the food, I recommend it but I sat and waited for 30 minutes without the food coming the staff took the bill and lost it when I went back to the cashier, they kept asking me to wait ? experience 1/10

author: Lewis Ramster
review_text: We came to Hell's Kitchen for my partner's birthday. It's in a great location in Downtown Miami and has a fantastic atmosphere. We came on a Friday evening and they had a DJ on. We arrived early but were still seated promptly. We opted for the prix fixe menu, which was incredible. The food was cooked perfectly and I would recommend this restaurant and experience to anyone. We would definitely return!

author: Suspish
review_text: Steph our server was so nice, and on her game! Give her a raise! She kept our cafe filled, and was very helpful and attentive. The food really is amazing, and priced well! Please come!!! You will not regret it! Better than any breakfast spot around!!

author: Rick Takeshita
review_text: Still my fav hawker, just avoid lunch queue, unless its Outram ckt n ji ji then always crowded😆

author: Lydia Perez
review_text: The lobster tail was over cooked, it was tough to bite it. The broccoli had brown coloring, as if it had been burned by having been frozen. Please look at the pictures. Everything else was good, The waitress was on point, great service.

author: Emm Gee
review_text: Bad experience at this food court. Firstly, the air cond doesn’t work and it was stuffy. Food is expensive by food court standards . We ordered ban Mian and it was simply just a bowl of carbo for $5! The amount of mince meat was less than a spoonful with very few super small ikan bilis. Pork chop or nugget size cost $1 per piece

author: Sara Shump
review_text: Had a wonderful experience at Harry’s in the Singapore airport. Wendy was my server and was so friendly, helpful and made the absolute best aviation drinks !

author: Jackie esquivel
review_text: I was here earlier with my family for our first time service was bad constantly had to keep reminding our server for what we asked .. I got my 4 year old the nugget basket with French fries she took couple bites of it and to find out it was raw.. look at this like how can this happen very disappointing I will not be coming here again .

author: Yelloboi Jaysen TJ
review_text: Just drop a while after visiting IKEA and Décathlon since it's quite trending place now. Reached around 8pm++, not a good time to see sunset. it was crowded and self service from ordering to picking up the order. Only tried sate and baked chicken. The chicken was cool🙄 and taste average only. At the other side, they sell snacks from Thailand too... Not to miss popular dessert brand from Thailand 🇹🇭, Afteryou, 🤔

author: Eleanor Li
review_text: I couldn't sleep because I stayed up late, so I went out to find something to eat. It was so delicious! The two of us ate three bowls! I highly recommend the duck leg noodles!

author: DREX Official
review_text: Went here for the grand opening and was 2nd in line; super friendly staff and customers lol; I had the jerk chicken and bought a bag of chips!

author: Gary Gao
review_text: Great vegan food with wide variety and also good coffee. Personally I liked the samosas the most

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: Dedra Luna
review_text: The food is ok (not memorable), the service is really nice, staff is very attentive and they work hard and fast always with a smile. The place is nice, convenient, and comfortable. But overall, too expensive for what is is

author: Maria Bashko
review_text: Great customer service! Cute decor and a large menu. I appreciate the vegan options. I had the Spicy Vegan bowl which filled me up for a long convention day. Highly recommend :)

author: Oghenetejiri Okpodu
review_text: the food tastes great , i miss nigeria so much that it made me feel at home again, i will definitely come here again

author: Amber Caracol Noguchi
review_text: Alfonso was such a great server. He gave us really good recommendations (we got the Turkey and Brie Crepe and the Pepperoni sandwich on a croissant with provolone 🤤) , was super attentive to our needs, read my mind when I needed a coffee refill, and also helped us order more for carry out. The coffee hit the spot, food was really tasty, and service was exceptional! Mahalo nui (thank you) Alfonso!

author: Dkei Espinoza
review_text: Food is good but honestly customer service needs to improve drastically , its literally the same thing everytimeg at least let there satisfaction training , its not every staff because some are great but overall needs to looked into

author: josh lee
review_text: Tortillas are handmade after you order, the folks handling orders are kind and warm while being very efficient. Meats are well-seasoned; I like the chicken most, chorizo second. There's a decently sized seating area so you can enjoy the freshly made food immediately on-site. Legitimately one of the best, though they're quite well known now and prices seem to have risen a bit.

author: Us The Creators
review_text: platter gives you everything you need to try when you’re here! a nice restaurant to dine and try out (almost all) the vietnamese food you gotta try. priced slightly higher than others but the food quality is good!

author: Jessica Rusli
review_text: one of the best italian restaurant I’ve ever tried. the place is warm and cozy, love the ambiance. ordered layered potato and mushroom soup for the appetizer. soo soo geewd! and then ordered spaghetti and salmon for main course. unfortunately too full to try their dessert. next time i’ll try the dessert for sure! highly recommended

author: Uyen Tran
review_text: Always come here for lunch whenever we visit Hoi An. Everything is great, good food, good service and atmosphere. Try “cơm âm phủ” - the best dish ever!

author: Nicholas Woo
review_text: Super nice dim sum with affordable price. More than 50 variants to choose from!

author: Daniyal Arai
review_text: The Plate Bar & Grill – Review: The Plate Bar & Grill offers a welcoming atmosphere with a diverse menu featuring American classics and comfort food. Known for generous portions and well-prepared dishes, favorites include burgers, steaks, and hearty appetizers. The bar selection is solid, with a good variety of beers and cocktails. Service is friendly and attentive, making it a great spot for casual dining or meeting up with friends. The ambiance strikes a nice balance between laid-back and lively, perfect for both dinners and weekend hangouts. Overall, it’s a dependable choice for good food, drinks, and a relaxed vibe.

author: William Ten
review_text: The bun is quite nice but not surprised Price is reasonable The environment is good, they have a small aircon room for sitting beside the store

author: Daniel L.
review_text: Unsure what the hype is about this restaurant. I dined here around 5pm, and the place was fairly empty. They had run out of the crispy pork skin so we were served some crackers in its place. The pork meat was dry and bland. Perhaps I went there on an off-day, but I would find it difficult to recommend this restaurant to anyone.

author: Anel M Abreu
review_text: Best place to get great steak and seafood. The Rodisio is my favorite. Deserts are delicious and the staff is very friendly and attentive.

author: Ce Ce (Cece)
review_text: The taste are good and I love the crab meat fried rice. And the Tomyam shrimp 🦐 and the garlic mantis prawns surprisingly it was equally good 😊 With this quality and the portion they serve consider fair. Recommended been there early to avoid the long Q. The restaurant only have limited seat. If you want to skip the Q they also have Grab food delivery service 🚚

author: Lexie Corrie
review_text: Deanza served AMAZING service I will come back only when she is working and solely for her service. She brought personality and customer service to the maximum. She didn’t make me feel like just another customer she made me feel like THE customer. She made my night and I will come back only for her. Thank you <3

author: N8s Obregon
review_text: It's one of the more popular hawker centers in Singapore. We had our meetup with friends here for an early dinner. They knew what to order and the food was great. Lots of choices of local delicacies and grilled food with generous serving sizes. They have a big open-air dining area, but as peak dining hours drew near, the place was full and there were already people waiting for available tables. East Coast Lagoon Food Village is located by the beach and so after dinner, we strolled along the shore as we continued catching up with our friends.

author: Kurt Tan
review_text: Nice ambience with friendly and attentive staff. Food is decent and reasonably priced. Loved the kimchi and the generous side dishes. They even let us try the beers before ordering — great service all around!

author: Peiyi (Potato)
review_text: green pandan pancakes are the best!!!! Butter pancakes are nice too

author: Trường Chu
review_text: I rarely leave reviews, and this was my first time at the Southern-style BBQ village, but what I disliked most was the parking. The restaurant is large and spacious, and they charged 30,000 VND for parking outside, which is completely unreasonable.

author: Roxanne Raphael
review_text: Tony was amazing! It was so nice to be sitting out by the water enjoying good food! My friend and I had the chicken nachos and we split the firecracker shrimp.....scrumptious! The drinks (espresso martini and cosmos) were delicious and potent. I will definitely be back!

author: Joanna Schnurman
review_text: Absolutely loved our dinner at Novikov Miami! The sushi was incredibly fresh, creative, and beautifully presented. Every bite was a standout. The rest of the menu was just as delicious, and the service was top-notch from start to finish. A must-visit spot for an elevated dining experience.

author: Galina
review_text: It is one of the best coffee shops ☕️ around Saratoga. The espresso served with sparkling water to allow you to experience the coffee in the purest of flavors. By drinking sparkling water prior to drinking your cup of coffee, you cleanse your taste receptors before the first sip of coffee, and you can fully appreciate the flavors. It's very busy on the weekend morning.

author: Bijan Ardalan
review_text: The restaurants they have here are great. They only have pickup to go since these are basically ghost kitchens. Check out their website to see all the restaurants and put together an order. You'll get a text when your food is ready, usually within 15 minutes of your order being placed. I'm especially fond of Figeroa Philly cheesesteak. The sandwiches and onion rings are great!

author: Ms. Teacher
review_text: Awesome breakfast spot right on the MBTA line across the street from Forest Hills T on Washington St you will find Forest hills diner. If you love diners, you will not be disappointed! They offer yummy diner eats and an actual diner menu in Boston- hard to find! Something for everyone on their menu!

author: Shaquana Williams
review_text: When asking to use the restroom the manager Terrence would not let me use the restroom until I order something even though I advised him it was an emergency... I was making a purchase but my order had coupons that needs to be used.

author: Joon Wei Teow
review_text: A popular dim sum spot offering a delightful fusion of Thai and Chinese flavors. The variety of dim sum options is impressive, catering to different tastes with flavorful and well-prepared dishes. The taste is satisfying, making it a great place to enjoy a hearty meal. However, the dining area is quite packed with tables, making it a bit challenging to move around comfortably. The staff are busy and rushing to serve customers, which adds to the lively but slightly chaotic atmosphere. Despite this, getting a seat isn’t too difficult, and the pricing remains reasonable. Overall, it’s a must-visit spot when in Hatyai, especially for dim sum lovers looking to experience a unique Thai-Chinese twist.

author: Cass
review_text: The curry noodles are really yummy! They’re Michelin listed… idk if they’re thatttt good, but they’re good. There’s lots of options (prawn noodles, fish balls, ban mian, economic rice) and at 7pm on a Thursday, lots of space to sit. The soy milk is good but apparently famous? And I don’t think it deserves fame but it’s good.

author: matt pesino
review_text: Waited hour and twenty minutes for a terrible salad that said grilled chicken and came out with deli meat. Don't recommend unless you want to wait forever for horrible food and breathe cigarettes in

author: Kenny Chong
review_text: The variety considered a lot. Staff are quite friendly. Good not so bad. Bak kut Teh is kind of different. Overall can consider to come for breakfast. This place is easy to find with the signature logo. The staff can converse in Mandarin.

author: Nurin Jazlina
review_text: best kway teow ever! me and my husband's favourite, we always go there. uncle is very friendly too. cheap and there is even a qr code for those who dont pay by cash. and it's halal so i really urge the muslims who crave genuine chinese kway teow to try.

author: Jonathan Speights
review_text: All food great. Service not to bad just gotta grab attention when drinks are needed

author: Michael Eng
review_text: stopped by Milk & Madu and was really impressed with the quality of the food. The carbonara was creamy and rich with just the right balance of flavor — perfectly seasoned, with a silky sauce that coated the pasta beautifully. The lasagna was a standout too, with generous layers of sauce, cheese, and tender pasta that all came together for a comforting, homemade taste. Both dishes were served hot and fresh, and you can really tell they care about quality and ingredients here. Combined with the cozy atmosphere and friendly service, it made for a great dining experience. Highly recommended if you’re craving hearty, well-made Italian dishes in Bali.

author: Alma Laraxadu
review_text: I’ve been getting delicious vegan cakes here for my son’s birthday the last few years. I always get the vanilla one and it NEVER disappoints. Probably one of the best cakes I ever tasted. definitely the best vegan cake I have ever come across. They also always have it ready on time. Thanks Fiore for making my kids birthday that much more special every year. Anytime I need cake this is where I will be heading. It’s so good I may not even wait for a special occasion haha :)

author: Casey Namana
review_text: Best Banh mi I’ve had in Hoi An. It definitely lives up to all the hype and the price is amazing. The best part or what made them so amazing is the quality of the pate. You can tell it’s heavily seasoned and has been cooked twice which I haven’t seen in many Banh mi restaurants. It’s definitely what makes it taste so good. The bread is very light and crunchy it holds the sandwich together well. The ingredients are all very fresh and the turn over of ingredients is so quick. There are 5 chefs working to assemble the sandwiches at all times. There is an inside seated area if you want to get off the street or out of the heat/rain. The hardest part is dealing with the Instagram/tourists who aren’t sure how or where to order or wait for their food. I came back here 3 times and tried two everytime. One isnt enough try two at a time it’s a good amount to be full but not bloat yourself as one just makes you want another one.

author: Dolores Damian
review_text: Such a cute mom and pop spot. Got the cold brew it was good. But asked for flavor and basically had to make my own coffee. They even brought out the milk for me. Got the club sandwich and man that was huge! But good. The sausage in the biscuits and gravy were not that great.

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: leotrails
review_text: A good Thai mookrata buffet spot located on Banthat Thong Road. The atmosphere is great—perfect for cooking, chatting, and hanging out with friends. The fried chicken wings and enoki mushrooms are nicely crunchy and really satisfying. For the BBQ, the sliced pork neck and pork loin are good quality and flavorful. Beef and pork can be cooked separately, which is helpful for Muslim diners. Would definitely come back again to dine with friends!👍

author: Irvan Irawan Jie
review_text: The place is gorgeous and the service was excellent. We went there as a big group of 30 people. The food came quickly, the waiters are all nice and helpful. The food was good. The only hassle is the limited parking space when there is a big crowd, need to park on the side of the road.

author: lisa moore
review_text: Amazing food and people! Highly recommend this wonderful restaurant if you are in town. Will definitely be back!

author: Linda M
review_text: With such a reputation to live up to, sometimes it’s hard to meet it. The banh mi (roast pork #6, 40k VND) had a fresh and crispy baguette and a fair amount of bbq pork filling. I didn’t think the pate was that great and the herbs were all at one end. I normally like more sweet pickled carrots and daikon and cilantro, sadly it was so skimpy that I almost missed it. Strangely, there was some minced meat (Possibly tuna since it tasted like seafood) in my sandwich. Ordering was quick and sandwiches were made quickly. Went back for more banh mis because it’s close and the restaurant we wanted to go to want closed &!wanted to try other banh mis. We got ostrich (a little tough but well sauced) and their specialty (mixed)- these wet better with scallions for ostrich and a load of meat fillings for the mixed. Upped some of the ratings. Jan 2026.

author: HAZWANI AZMAN
review_text: Had a great breakfast experience here! The food was fresh and tasty with a good variety of choices. The staff Nick were friendly and provided excellent service throughout. I also loved the beautiful view.. it made the morning feel so calm and refreshing. Definitely a perfect way to start the day

author: Daniel Aiden Leo
review_text: specially come here for the satay,saw some reviews that the satay there is good and indeed is good, for 10 stick satay cost $9. I ask for 5 chicken, 5 mutton and a rice, in total cost me $10.Satay sauce was very nutty and a bit on the sweet side, also ordered lemon sugar cane $3 and finally be for i leave for home, I took this bread ice-cream cost me $2 where you hardly find these days.

author: DAVE MACKENZIE
review_text: Definitely a five star free it was clean. It was friendly. Oliver was fantastic. The food was warm and fresh. Definitely worth the value definitely worth the time. Something for everyone.

author: Handoko Lie
review_text: One of the best indonesian food in town. Idk how many times I’ve been here and it always amazed me, my family and my friends. Staffs are very friendly, cozy place. After so many times , we had one bad experience, by the time we had our dinner, a cockroach step on my wife’s foot, a bit disappointed but it got all solved out. The manager came to us , apologized and gave us free dessert, which I appreciated it. But actually i really don’t need the free dessert, sir , i just need you guys to make sure, the place is clean. I will definitely come back again for the food and the hospitality.

author: Maria Valenzuela
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ I had a wonderful experience at Bon Bouquet Coffee Shop, thanks to Calista! From the moment I walked in, she was warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. Her customer service was exceptional—friendly, professional, and thoughtful. She made great recommendations and ensured everything was perfect from start to finish. Calista’s positive energy truly elevated my visit and made it feel special. Outstanding service like hers is the reason I’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend! ☕🌸

author: Iqbal M Salleh
review_text: The food tasted great. The at atmosphere is very cozy and quite private. The decor is stunning. Traditional Indonesian dish. Overall, I like it.

author: Jeanine Stark
review_text: Viviana was our meal-curator. EVERY item she suggested was excellent and well within what we were looking for: whole fried red snapper, broccoli, skin-on mashed potato, duck surf n turf....and very timely! Thank you for a great meal, and time well spent!

author: A
review_text: Delicious flavored French fries can’t speak for the rest of the food or drinks but the French fries are yummy.

author: Monica Febriana
review_text: Seribu Rasa always be my favorite Indonesia restaurant. Their menu was delicious and the service was great. I usually ordered fish head curry, fried tofu vegetable, sapo tahu.

author: Todd Luoma
review_text: Another excellent choice in the Castro District. I had a variety of dumplings. My favorite was the pork/shrimp dumplings. The wait staff was very helpful. I even had the opportunity to practice some Chinese Mandarin language. I highly recommend the Dumpling House!

author: Budhy Heru
review_text: Then place for eating with your colleagues with the utmost atmosphere, so exclusive, and enough variety of menus.

author: Omar Waqar
review_text: Great prices and portions. Lots of seating and clean. Close to the water. Much better than Chipotle

author: Mingsheng Lum
review_text: Local neighbourhood coffee shop Why you should come here ? 回答我! Why? tell me why?! Because of the anchor tenant ⬇️ Yam rice with pork soup 🍠🍲 The other foods are also nice as well Usually packed during lunch hours Those are the photos over period of time!

author: Des P
review_text: Beautiful food here - and nice seating - even an outdoor section where you can hear the waterfalls. I will come back here - the food is exceptional

author: Saowanee Paweenwich
review_text: Nara Restaurant, the original and traditional Thai foods are very delicious. The staff are nice and well-trained. The atmosphere is great. Reasonable price with good quality.

author: Carpe Diem Pirate
review_text: This restaurant feels like a victim of its own hype. The food? Meh—some dishes were overcooked like they took a nap in the oven. The ribs looked promising with that glossy sauce on top (delicious!), but once you dig in… it’s basically Costco ribs in disguise. You’re paying for the marketing, not the magic.

author: Stephanie Soto
review_text: Packed on a Saturday evening. Party of 4 , wait time was 45min-1hr but felt like we got called for our table in 25 mins. Was super surprised… took a few moments for the waiter to arrive since it was so busy but he was great. Ribeye could’ve used more salt

author: sümeyye kabasakal
review_text: The place was super cozy I loved every little detail. It was simple, but the small touches were so aesthetic. My friends ordered the Chicken dhamaka fries, the Waffle Sandwich, and the Tikkaville Sandwich. I was full, so I didn’t get anything at first, but I ended up taking a bite from their food and it was delicious! They loved everything and said they’ll definitely be coming back. When it was prayer time, I asked if they had a bag or anything I could use to pray on. One of the employees went to the back and brought me a prayer mat. They were so kind and thoughtful. We loved the place, the food, and the people. Definitely going back again!

author: James Sailor
review_text: Not a bad place. Food is decent wings had a good taste. They followed instructions if im in the area again will deff come again

author: Misu
review_text: Truffle Mashed Potatoes really really good！！but beef just ok also the egg not that good enough，i need to admit that it is a really good place for friends to go and chat

author: LATASHA GALLEGOS
review_text: I really liked the spacious dining room, decor, and music. The restaurant and restroom was very clean. Our staff was friendly and attentive and I really enjoyed my fish & chips!

author: All Year Inc
review_text: We had such a great experience at Sam Walker’s on a Saturday evening! The place was super busy and they put us on a waiting list with 30 min estimate time, but ended up calling us in 15 min. The atmosphere, food and service were amazing! Unfortunately my wife forgot her purse and we realised that next morning, we called the place and we were told that they found it, that was such a relief since she had everything in there, documents, credit cards and cash! Thank you guys for being so kind and honest! Definitely coming back for another lunch or dinner and we recommend the place to our friends and relatives. By the way the espresso martinis are the best there🍸

author: Yuwalak Uthairangsi
review_text: Chicken thighs is my fav and duck thighs for my mom. Been eating here since I was a kid

author: Adrien Qi
review_text: fire vibes inside but ordered takeout. satisfying chewy crust and very good flavors. texture couldve been better but we got takeout and ate after 20-15 min of walking

author: satsuki hoshino
review_text: We came here to sign up the queue and found out that you could just do it by yelp’s app for faster seating. Mostly seating are for two or four. There seems a section that could accommodate larger party like 5 or 6 people. A lot of families came too. We already came couple times before. It actually has been our favorite place for laksa noodle soup. I like its flavorful soup and very bouncy noodle texture. Also included a lot of fried tofu boiled egg shrimp and fish balls. We had already tried stew beef with bread so this time we tried fried beef with wide rice noodles also sweet buns with butter. Both were great. For drinks you could customize the sugar levels. Our favorite dish is fried chicken wings in peppercorn and salt flavors. Also waiters were always friendly and courteous. The only things was it could be a bit of noisy since everyone was talking loudly and sometimes seating was very close.

author: Vadym Kasyan
review_text: Really great place! The fish and seafood are super fresh, you can actually taste the quality. The dishes are prepared clean and balanced, without heavy sauces or too much oil, so you get that natural flavor of the ingredients. Service was friendly and attentive, and the staff helped with recommendations. The atmosphere is relaxed and cozy, a nice spot to enjoy a slow meal by the sea. Definitely recommend if you're looking for fresh, tasty food and a calm vibe. I’ll be coming back for sure 🙌

author: Tan Minhwa
review_text: Sandwish was truly an amazing experience. The service was fast and nice. The place gave such cozy vibes and really made my day unforgettable. This is definitely a five star cafe and I really recommend this place.

author: Daniel Navrozidis
review_text: The staff were great and kind, the food on the other hand is bland not worth it for the price. There are better fast food alternatives.

author: Isawasquirrel Ilikepiekinda
review_text: They always park me when I go ...what's the point of going thru the DRIVE - THRU if I'm just going to be parked?

author: Dunia Cala Bértolo
review_text: We celebrate Christmas Eve at Bayshore Club with our family. Dana was an excellent server. He was very attentive. We love it there and will definitely return!

author: Yesle Hong
review_text: At first, we were a bit concerned because the restaurant is very popular with tourists, but the food was actually very tasty. We had the beef skewers and the red bellet burger, both of which were delicious. The coffee was good too.

author: Jakub Szrodt
review_text: Cozy and welcoming, the spicy tuna burrito is AMAZING, must try!

author: Ong SV
review_text: Love this tiny little restaurant that serve dishes with nice plating. Food tastes amazing too. Their petai bit spicy for me. Love the crunchy crab meat spring roll too.

author: Dolly Harriet
review_text: Hands down one of the best Italian restaurants in Jakarta. Everything we ordered was delicious and pleasing. Yes, the price is quite pricey, it's pretty good for special occasions as well. We enjoyed the pretty interior and atmosphere too, it was a bit too hot because we went for lunch, but overall was nice.

author: Winnie Lee
review_text: Long Q means is good food! Waited less than 20 mins for our turn. We tried ice caramel shaken espresso, pistachio grandeur and smokin beast. Thought will be waiting for quite some time but not. The serving is fast. First visit here and overall the food is good. will come back to try more other flavour.

author: ken tan
review_text: Totally enjoyed the food here. Carlos made such great recommendations to me. His service is hospitable and warm. He is the one to look for. The ceviches are great starters. The grilled octopus has such a wonderful charred flavour. And I never know corn can be so sweet. The seafood rice is delicious to round off the meal. Would come again!

author: Lionel Tolmay
review_text: Great experience at the Old Airport Road Food center. I tried the Lor Mee as it seemed like everyone was having it. I also had a curry potato pie and it was fantastic!

author: Crystal
review_text: Queued 2 hours for our turn (thank god for the online queue system). Didn't have much expectation but the taste and experience was really mediocre for all the Michelin stickers and hype around this shop. Tom yum taste was not rich and creamy. However, broth was flavourful from the pork and seafood. Ordered the deep fried tofu and fried kale which definitely tasted better than the main dish.

author: Dorene
review_text: Great value for money! The portion sizes are generous and really satisfying. There’s a nice variety of dishes to choose from. The Hainanese chicken chop was decent—huge serving, perfect for one very hungry person! The mushroom soup is a highlight—rich, flavorful, and clearly homemade, not the canned kind. I also enjoyed the tiramisu—not too sweet, just right. Definitely worth a visit! Just a note, it can be very crowded during the weekends so the service will be slower. So, come earlier or call ahead to book a table.

author: Fury Mah Thailand
review_text: It is a sukiyaki that is quite expensive.But I have to admit that it tastes good and has a dipping sauce that makes it taste deliciously spicy.

author: Evi Pandiangan
review_text: Had the fish curry, fried bebek, matcha, coffee and kaya butter. Alll super good 🥰The food was tasty, portions just right, and the drinks hit the spot. Really enjoyed eating here. Would definitely come back!

author: Jared Myers
review_text: What a great restaurant to visit! We went twice on our trip and did both tasting menu one and two! They were both very good with number one being the better of the two! The desserts were excellent! They have tons of staff who are all very friendly and helpful throughout the whole dinner experience! Overall a great restaurant that would otherwise be more expensive back home!

author: Dino Bands
review_text: “I had a great experience at Wingstop thanks to the amazing crew—Ruben, Ivone, Edwin, Henry, and Jason. Their service was fast, friendly, and professional, and they made sure everything was perfect. Big shoutout to the team for their hard work and great customer service!”

author: Freddy Kua
review_text: Thoroughly charmed by this restaurant, about 10 minutes walk from Terminal 21. The restaurant serves authentic Thai cuisine with upgraded ingredients. The enchanted restaurant is nestled amongst lush greenery, and the interior is beautifully decorated with flowers and plants, adding splashes of colour in every direction. I'm surprised that they have so many real flowers on the table too. Ladies will love it. Had a pleasant surprise from the humble shrimp cake, filled with chunks of succulent shrimps. This is a must-have starter. Their crab curry is another dish to enjoy, with plump and juicy crab claw meat swirled in creamy curry. To complete a Thai dinner, a pot of Tom Yam gung soup does the job. Was again surprised by the upgraded ingredients, with two pairs of big river prawns simmering in a rich golden broth. Heard their mango sticky rice is another must-have, but didn't have room for dessert this time. Had a fun time during dinner as well. The lady manager was very helpful to diners. She would offer to hold the portable table lamp as lighting for diners to take food photos and to take photos for diners as well. Highly recommended to drop by if you go shopping at Terminal 21.

author: Sisilia Mataele
review_text: Amaaaazing taste! Customer service was great, very helpful explaining how to order. TasteBudz did NOT disappoint. Every bite was goodt! We’ll be coming back when we visit again from Cali.

author: E. T.
review_text: What a gem!! Was brought here by a friend or I will have problem locating the place. It was hidden within the low cost council flats by the coast / main road. Place is very very clean. Brightly lit courtyard & not a single fly! Great breakfast meals - good for brunch too. Highly recommended to try the salty coffee (Kiam Kopi). And the nasi lemak bungkus... 👍🏻👍🏻 The half boiled eggs & toast with peanut butter, kaya & butter was good too. They use QR coded menu where you can order from your table (except for the nasi lemak, you have to take it from the stall & pay separately). After order was placed, they will send the food to your table. Payment to be made at the stall before you leave. The seller was very friendly & polite too but sorry for the 4 stars, due to the parking condition. 🙏🏻

author: Marielle J
review_text: Laura was our server and was exceptional! She was precise in taking our orders and refilling our waters. Very attentive and courteous, and she was patient in giving my sister updates for gluten free and dairy free options. The ambience of this place is divine! Colorful, classy and cute! The food was AMAZING! The cornbread is a must — you have to try! The ham croquetas were tasty! Everyone loved their dishes. The grilled salmon salad was delicious and the salmon was moist. I had the wagyu skirt steak wedge salad and it is by far, the BEST wagyu steak I’ve ever had! We also tried the “world’s best chocolate cake” and it was very unique! We LOVED it here and will recommend! Thank you for a lovely experience and a great time!

author: ng Sp
review_text: having supper here taking roti canai and murtabak with some drink overall the roti and murtabak taste good with acceptable pricing seating come with and without aircon area

author: m daniels
review_text: Great Vibes, Overwhelming Portions The vibes at this brunch spot were absolutely amazing—stylish atmosphere, great music, and a fun crowd. However, the food itself was just okay. What really stood out (and not necessarily in a good way) were the portion sizes. Each dish easily serves about four people, which might be great for those with a big appetite, but as someone with a smaller stature, it felt overwhelming. I ended up wasting a lot of food, which was disappointing. I wouldn’t recommend this place unless you're coming hungry or planning to share.

author: Santo Gore
review_text: The bacon cheese omelet with home fried potatoes and white toast with sweat tea was amazing. The servers are very friendly and do an awesome job. The atmosphere is very welcoming and friendly. Give the Farmers Market Restaurant a try. You won't be disappointed.👍✌️

author: JC C (CuteDracul)
review_text: Very high quality food with generous portions and surprising affordable. Love this place!

author: C Llazari
review_text: The ratings did not lie! The Peruvian restaurant had amazing ceviche (Ceviche Nikkei Tartare forgot to take pic it was beautiful) and traditional dishes! Will definitely come back on a future visit to Miami!

author: Andrew S
review_text: We ordered two salads: mangosteen salad and schrimp salad. Both salads have very interesting combinations, and both are tasty. Some vegetables I would never eat raw, but here they are in the salads. The small fried fish were too much in both salads. The steak was a bit chewy but I like it that way.

author: L Chan
review_text: One of the best hawker centre around. Packed with about 100 stalls - many run by veteran hawkers with decades of experience. Some stalls are even Michelin-listed. One can find a huge variety of local favourite dishes here - from smoky wok hei noodles & rich curry chicken bee hoon, to bak chor mee, Hokkien mee & even traditional desserts. Prices are fair & portions generous. Expect long queues at popular stalls, especially during the lunch rush (12 - 1:30 PM). Seating can get a little tight & warm during peak hours, but the atmosphere is vibrant & authentically local. A must-visit for anyone wanting to experience real Singapore hawker culture.

author: R Juliza
review_text: Honorary mention to Luis who worked diligently and gracefully even when something wasn’t up to par Luis ensured to fix it right there and then no hesitation no attitude or mal intent. Such a kind soul made me feel like I was right where I belonged. Thanks Luis. S/o kitchen staff also food is yummmieeee

author: Jeff Bell
review_text: Amazing spot for great service and fantastic food. We had the watermelon margarita, seafood platter, tuna poke, and the spicy salmon crunchy rice. Our server, Mila, was very attentive and helpful. It was all incredible and well returning!

author: Junze Cao
review_text: Homemade food is alright, service is very unprofessional. Atmosphere is crowded and loud, no air conditioning.

author: Ams Kalya
review_text: Food was big in portions and delicious. 👍The taste was just right, not too salty or heavy. I was very impressed with the otak-otak seafood spaghetti, which tasted unique and delicious. Drinks taste average. Betta fish coffee is a bit sweet.The service attitude is good and the food comes quickly. They also ask the customer feedback when payment. The restaurant is not big in space, I went for lunch on weekends, not many people. Last weekend I wish to went dinner there, but it was full, and I been informed to wait for more than 30min. Suggest if weekend dinner to call for inquire/reserve.

author: My3ti534
review_text: Talk about service with a smile. As soon as we entered we were greeted with a warm welcome. Oseeta, our waitress, sorry for botching your name, was a ray of sunshine, warm, pleasant and courteous. The food was to die for. I ordered the rasta pasta with beyond which comes hot or cold. I opted for it hot. While my husband had the shrimp burger with sweet potato tots. We fell in love with every bite. We also ordered fried cauliflower with sticky icky sauce for the table. There were other sauces but this one stood out for me. And let's not talk about the fried Georgia banana pound cake which we initially ordered for our son, but after the first bite we changed our minds. They deserve twenty stars and more

author: Nhi Huynh
review_text: Nong - Farm to Grill is a hidden gem in Ho Chi Minh City, offering a unique farm-to-table dining experience. The menu highlights fresh, high-quality ingredients, expertly grilled to perfection. The meats are tender and flavorful, while the vegetable sides are vibrant and well-seasoned. The cozy, rustic ambiance adds to the charm, making it a perfect spot for a casual dinner or a special occasion. The staff is attentive and knowledgeable about the menu, enhancing the overall experience. If you’re a fan of wholesome, thoughtfully prepared meals, Nong is a must-try.

author: Eddi3 Selph
review_text: Thanks to Mr Satya for serving us! We came around 4pm and got a table in under 5 minutes. Food and service were great, and the prices were pretty decent for a touristy area. Portions were big too. We ordered the pork ribs, pork belly satay, roasted pork, and Crazy Corn. Will definitely come again!

author: unitedravers
review_text: This is my favorite after work spot. If you find yourself here during the weekend do yourself a favor and sit in the inside bar with Julissa if there are seats available. The sweetest bartender ever and she makes the best old fashions and cosmos. On top of that she is extremely quick juggling orders from the whole restaurant, coffee and the bar top. It’s truly inspiring to be served with someone with such good work ethic and that cares about their guest. I have a great experience every time.

author: Lee Youn
review_text: We recently visited Yusuf restaurant and had a wonderful experience! The food was absolutely excellent — fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, making it a perfect place to relax and enjoy a great meal. A special thanks to Mr. Yasir and his amazing team for their outstanding hospitality. They were very cooperative, professional, and made our event truly special. Everything was perfectly organized, and we really appreciate their efforts. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food and excellent service! 👏🍽️✨

author: Meia Ford
review_text: Ono Sushi was definitely ONO!!! They really live up to their name. We just had our Reception dinner there and the service Bell and Wendy put down was on point❣️❣️They service was fast, clean and friendly. FOOD was delicious 😋 😍, especially for the price! 🍣🍢🍤🍥We are putting it on our list of regular spots!! Go Check em out...

author: CKBates AKA Farm Grammy
review_text: Fun and surprising. Great stand up comedy in a small venue. Reasonable tasty food and Guinness well poured.

author: Maria Vasquez
review_text: I went today with my coworkers for the first time to this place and I'm sure will be the last one. The costumer service was awful, the 15% of gratitude is included and they do not deserved it, besides that the food is nothing special and too expensive, I ordered a croissant breakfast sandwich and It was so small that it looks like a free sample. I definitely do not recommend this place.

author: Anzhelika S
review_text: I think it’s one of the best Greek restaurants in Miami. The amount of detail put into the decor and atmosphere, it looks very authentic. The food is on another level, every single dish is top! I celebrated my mom’s birthday there recently and it was perfect.

author: LList rmz
review_text: If i can give them a 0 star I would. Food: the food was not cook well it was raw! Like how can they serve raw meat we always tell the server well done. 🤦🏾‍♀️ Service: when we arrived they seat us by the kitchen close to the bathroom; we were 9 people and They Forgot about us. We had lots of patience because we waited 30min for the lady to come and take our order. She was just gossiping and flirting with the male clients in another table that she forgot about us. 🤦🏾‍♀️ Atmosphere: the atmosphere was pretty good just not we didn’t like the food or the service. And plus they still get mad that we don’t leave a Tip.! We always leave tip base on the service! Horrible customer service And horrible experience that none of my family members want to go back. Hope they change their service and please cook well all the food!! But in the meantime we will never go back. Reply: unless you guys renovate it. When you opened the entrance take a right and there turn left there is a corner and tv on the wall on top. Any ways this does portrait the restaurant because I would never right a review if it was true. Have a nice day keep watch at your employees.

author: An Le
review_text: First time at this famous spot and it lived up to the hype. The broth was amazing, with good noodles and beef. Appreciated the air-conditioned space, and the portion sizes were just right. Would come back.

author: Takahiro Koyama
review_text: Crispy Chicken Sandwich with Delicious Original Sauce! Chick-fil-A is a popular American fast-food chain known for its top-notch chicken sandwiches, nuggets, and friendly service. 【Chick-fil-A Deluxe Sandwich】 This sandwich includes a seasoned, freshly breaded chicken breast, pressure-cooked in 100% refined peanut oil, served on a toasted, buttered bun with pickles, lettuce, tomato, and American cheese. The delicious sauce complements the fresh ingredients perfectly.

author: ShuiHung Tan
review_text: Hidden menu from Spooky till 🎃 After sampling Hameediyah’s famed dishes, it’s fair to say the culinary experience was a real treat for the taste buds. The biryani burst with aromatic spices, while the murtabak was every bit as comforting as its reputation suggests. Yet, one can’t help but note that the pricing left a rather odd taste. Apparently, the bill varies depending on whether you can present a MYKAD or MYPR—meaning locals get one price and foreign visitors another, despite identical portions. This distinction isn’t exactly advertised upfront, which could catch travellers on the hop. The real twist came with the Mango Lassi, mysteriously charged at a higher “fresh Indian mango” rate from what seemed like a hidden menu. None of the staff could give a clear answer or show the price anywhere in the shop, which felt more than a little eerie. A cracking meal, but transparency on pricing would make the experience far more palatable.

author: jimmy quek
review_text: Go for the food and old school atmosphere.... Lots of nice food.... Can't go wrong lah...

author: Janu Prado
review_text: Filipino Review 🇵🇭🍽️ Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka 2 is a well-known spot for trying Bali’s famous roasted suckling pig. The crispy skin and tender, flavorful meat make it a must-try for pork lovers 🐷🔥. The spices are bold and aromatic, though they might be a bit strong for some Filipino tastes 🌶️. Funny enough, we were brought here by our Muslim driver—who, of course, didn’t eat, but he mentioned that many tourists tell him they love this place! 😂 The restaurant has a casual, local vibe, but it can get crowded. Service is fast, and the prices are reasonable for the quality of food. Overall, a great place to experience authentic Balinese babi guling, but be ready for bold flavors and a lively atmosphere!

author: Brightone Nik
review_text: Great location near beach. Wifi access, mixed toilet. Venue is comfortable, kids friendly and refreshing. Pizza was delicious, thin and crispy straight out of oven, fast service. Great for date and families. Music in late afternoon Would go there again for that rustic pizza.

author: NG BB
review_text: Impresses with its elegant interior—classic European charm with a grand, cozy vibe. The cocktails are not only delicious but also come with a wow-worthy presentation that adds to the experience. It's a perfect spot to unwind and enjoy quality drinks with friends in a stylish setting. A great blend of atmosphere and creativity.

author: Jan Jan
review_text: Really delicious food and lovely place to sit down for a meal. We had the crab fried rice (crab was really fresh), and pad thai as well as tom yum soup. Longan drink was great too. Also great to be able to watch the chefs in action at the front.

author: William Zitzmann
review_text: Was a rare 10/10 meal for me. Loco Moco was so delicious. The texture and flavour of each part meshed together really well. Rice was nice and crispy. The lemongrass patty was perfectly spiced and nice and crispy. The sauce really tied the dish together. I wanted another plate right after. The shrimp on sugar cane was the best I’ve had and the spicy dip really complimented it.

author: Anchal Sikka
review_text: Must try🍽️ Tijuana Burrito ( Veg) (limited Veg options, but the burrito tasted so so good. It was a lot of veggies with fresh sour cream was m and the habanero sauce) The presentation and ambiance was lit. The music was so so loud!! But the vibe was great. Perfect was a bigger party if you want to have fun and have amazing food. The DJ seemed chill and the mixes were really good. Gratuity is included and the prices are kinda high. Overall worth it!!

author: Cory Stoehr (Raith)
review_text: Slow service, was the only car in the drive thru, still took 15 mins to get 2 items. They got the sizes wrong, and some of the order wrong. I normally dont review places poorly, but this was wild.

author: Alvaro Plazas
review_text: What a fantastic experience at Opa Taverna! From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere felt warm and inviting, lively but still comfortable enough to relax and enjoy a meal. The place is spotless and clearly well cared for, which made a great first impression. The chicken skewers were absolutely delicious, juicy, perfectly seasoned, and cooked to perfection. You can tell they use quality ingredients. I also tried the shakshuka, and it was bursting with flavor, rich, hearty, and beautifully presented. Every bite had that authentic Greek touch that makes you want to come back again and again. Parking was surprisingly easy, which is always a big plus in my book ($5 for valet). Overall, everything from the food to the service to the ambiance was excellent. Definitely a spot worth visiting and revisiting!

author: Michelle S
review_text: Our favorite place to eat !! We live here and can’t get enough of it! The wraps are all ver good! The portions are great and everything is fresh! You can request to have them cook in coconut oil ! Special thanks to Lia always remembered our order! Everyone here is super sweet and awesome! Remember to tip!!! Must order Crispy Mushroom Vegan Boss Burrito ( so filling ) !!! Bahn Mi Wrap Lentil Soup ( actually big size other than many places in Canggu give you less than 250 ml 🫠) And Their nacho hot sauce 🤍🤍🤍

author: Balmore Rene Esquivel
review_text: The food was good. The chicken wings can be a little bit more tender. Sometimes they're a little bit dry.

author: Jess St
review_text: I love this place - easily one of the tastiest restaurants in Miami. The atmosphere is simple, but the food more than makes up for it. Every dish is packed with flavor and creativity, with combinations that feel both unique and comforting. A real hidden gem for anyone who cares about amazing food

author: Yeo Heng Choon
review_text: Just find back old time feeling eating at the market. Really nice and economic prawn noodles.

author: Mahedi Bhuiyan
review_text: I’ve been coming to this Namkeen for years now and the food, service, and quality has been consistently outstanding to this day. Most recently I went with a big party and the crew there handled all the orders with confidence and professionalism. Major props to the guys in the back pushing out all this amazing food. Definitely try the Nashville sandwich if you’re there, the clucking waffle sandwich is also a great option, but do not miss out on the loaded pataka fries (my personal favorite). Thank you Namkeen, and keep up the great work!

author: Miguel Angel del Toro Diaz
review_text: I don't know why Uber eats or posmates never works, I hate that, I don't know why they want service applications if they are never available 😡

author: REO
review_text: Even though the owner's aren't puerto rican anymore they kept the the tradition and menu the same as the original owner's...really good authentic tasting Puerto Rican food!!!

author: Sandee Tour
review_text: Fusion and modernized eastern Thai food. The salad dishes were very tasty, fresh ingredients, nice French and aromatic. However the protein dishes such as the beef was over cooked, tough and under flavor. This was also the same thing with the grilled pork neck, which was way thinly cut and not that aromatic. We dine during lunch time and no wait even for large group

author: Sakura Stan
review_text: Chin Chin Eating House at 19 Purvis Street is a classic Hainanese restaurant that has stood the test of time since the 1930s. Known for its authentic steamed chicken rice, the eatery gained extra fame after JJ Lin visited and declared it his must-eat spot in Singapore. The chicken is silky and tender, paired perfectly with fragrant rice infused with chicken stock and ginger. The accompanying chilli sauce adds just the right amount of heat. The restaurant’s old-school charm — marble tables, ceiling fans, and nostalgic vibes — offers a glimpse into Singapore’s dining heritage. Besides chicken rice, dishes like Hainanese pork chop and curry fish head are also crowd favourites. Service is brisk and portions generous, though the place can get crowded, especially after JJ Lin’s endorsement. While not fancy, Chin Chin delivers honest, comforting food that embodies the true taste of traditional Hainanese cooking. For fans of JJ Lin or anyone seeking an authentic local experience, it’s a worthwhile stop for a satisfying, old-fashioned meal in the heart of Bugis.

author: Tony Channel
review_text: The rice here is near my company. Delicious and clean. Overall, thank you for the location in District 1.

author: Aliena Abidi
review_text: Tried their Mango Lassi, Gulab Jamun and Chicken Biryani, very authentic and delicious. Good hospitality, many good food options. Definitely going to visit again.👍🏻

author: Brian “Zimo” Jin
review_text: Camping site vibe with beautiful plants inside the cafe. As you walk in, you can enjoy your little getaway from the city. I’ve been coming here almost everyday for less than two weeks of my stay in this neighborhood. I tried most of coffee drinks in the menu and you won’t get disappointed. If you are looking for a cafe to work? This cafe has a great wifi, I worked hours with my laptop everyday.

author: boonhong wong
review_text: One of the best food in the region, yet price is very reasonable and portion is quite big. Worth the long queue. Hotel guest next door get 10% discount too!

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Lobna Akl
review_text: Their bowls are delicious, I’d have breakfast there everyday if I could!

author: Antony Lim
review_text: Initially we asked our driver to bring us to a local warung where the locals will go, he brought us here. Well I am not sure if it is a place where locals will go, the food here is good! We ordered Spesial Pisah, the portion is very generous. If you are not a big eater, I suggest sharing instead. The staff was also very honest with us, their pork skin was fried. Overall it was a very good meal.

author: Carmen Guerra
review_text: My godmother and I had a delicious fish with mash potatoes and vegetables. Then we tried a tasty dessert (mango sorbet), which was amazing. The service was spectacular!

author: Christy Boiles
