review_text: We travel full time around the US. Hardly EVER do we get the kind of service like we did here at a fast food place. Didn’t get the managers name but he obviously does a great job in hiring and training. Place was clean and everyone was so nice! I will add we are from TX so it’s all about Whataburger lol. This place has won me over! Even though my husband ordered it “doggy style” instead of “animal style “ 😂😂 🤦‍♀️

author: Asli Leone
review_text: Great spot for breakfast and getting some laptop work done with a solid cappuccino. It’s spacious, with power outlets, reliable Wi-Fi, and decaf coffee available. It tends to get busy after 10 a.m., so if you need a quieter atmosphere, it’s best to go early when they open at 8.

author: Wendy Philley-Curtiss
review_text: OMG! DEFINITELY DELICIOUS A LITTLE SLOW. BUT SO WORTH IT. So Fresh and the protein is overflowing

author: The Hungry Road
review_text: (Last visited October 19, 2023.) Hanging out in Boston for work and it's Taco Tuesday! So naturally, I do some Yelp'ing and found Citrus & Salt! Here's how it went... Atmosphere/Appearance: Set right downtown Boston tucked among the skyscrapers is this gem. Obviously, it's downtown so it won't have a private parking lot. I'm sure there's plenty of street parking in a neighborhood nearby, but be careful to really read the signs carefully. Once inside it felt a little like a nightclub! Lol. Not that the music was loud of anything, but the energy inside or lively, the vibes were high and everyone seemed like they were having a good time. I was also surprised by how big the place was! So many downtown restaurants have a small footprint, but this one was about the size of 2 "normal" restaurants. The decor was awesome, the lighting was a little dark, but it was colorful and energetic. Service: We sat at the bar and even though it was quite busy, we had no issues at all. Food: My friends and I were sharing so many plates that I can't remember everything that I had. Lol. However, I remember liking everything that I tried. The drinks were also good! Everything was so picturesque, but the flavors definitely matched the plate's visuals. Value: This place is a bit more "upscale" than your "traditional" Mexican restaurant. So you will pay more here, but it's totally worth it. I probably spent $75.00 myself on a few taps and some drinks. In conclusion, I really liked it here and would absolutely return here! I have nothing bad to say about this place!

author: Huiyi
review_text: This is the 7th time I came to this small yet busy establishment Be prepared for a long queue, do not worry though as the staff kindly takes your name and number and gives you a call when a table is available, in the meantime you can have a walk at the mall next door. The wait is 100% worth it. The best tonkatsu you can find in Penang (and better than most tonkatsu specialty shops in KL) with refillable rice and soup. The panko breadcrumbs gave the crust the perfect crisp, the pork fillet so soft and juicy, the soup so filling with lots of ingredients in it, and the rice is so fluffy and fragrant. The staff are all very nice and helpful, kudos to them!

author: bianca magadan
review_text: sushi sale was an exceptional dining experience with tasty food, gorgeous interior design, and attentive staff. i ordered the volcano roll with the steamed gyoza, the result was a beautifully garnished platter with an even more flavorful taste. we couldn’t help but order more sushi later that night. besides the sushi, there are plenty more options to choose from, so there’s a taste of heaven for everyone!

author: Brandon Giolzetti
review_text: Raul was absolutely exceptional. He brought us extra sauces and made us laugh! Will be coming back.

author: Su Sie Yap
review_text: Popular place for local and tourist. Roasted pork if u like half fat half meat is good as not too salty. Char siew soft, good. Duck meat was tender and deep fried crab meat roll was yummy. Wantan noodles considered good. They even have the noodles that you can buy to take back to cook. Don't have vegetable option, only Kai Lan was available during our visit. Cold milk tea recommended. Worth eating here as overall service good.

author: Rebecca Thurston
review_text: I love the retro/modern girly vibe - light pinks and florals with an old diner style! Breakfast was delicious, so if you like Nutella, I suggest those pancakes. The warm syrup combined very well with the Nutella for flavor and a non sticky texture. I also observed the servers working together to maintain the cleanliness of the restaurant.

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: Shah G
review_text: Finally had the chance to dine here during the peak hour during the Raya Haji weekend.It was crowded but thankfully we got a seat. Ordered Chicken rice with roasted chicken. The rice is fragrant and flavourful and we ended up ordering second serving of rice..Lol. The chicken is tender and juicy.Service was fast considering it was packed. Overall we enjoyed the meal and thank you for the soup!

author: Sao Vang Da Nang
review_text: 🇻🇳 Nice local Vietnamese hotpot restaurant. They seem to always be busy so staff can be a little bit slow and they didn’t get our order exactly right. But the food is good, well priced, and the portions are appropriately sized. Busy location so better to sit inside to avoid the traffic noise if you can get a table there.

author: classical9034
review_text: I order a small pot but surprisingly the serving of the lala is quite a lot. The soup is very rich and tasty. I am impressed with the prawn size which is quite big and fresh. The sauce selection is limited but good enough for a simple hot pot. The place I sit has some housefly with no fan. It becomes very hot and humid as we are eating. The overall environment could be better for a more enjoyable dining experience.

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: Melvin Lim
review_text: First time visit with friends. Staff very friendly we wait for our table 20minutes. So we at ground floor shopping buy some sourvenier than went up to 3rd floor for our dinner. Surprise us the food was so good. Try urself you will know. Will visit next round to call other choice. Staff recommend us the food as the picture show.

author: Yusuf Limbada
review_text: The Hype Definitely over hyped there is zero atmosphere in the store at all!! You know it needs a personality…. Feels like a cateen vibe… Food i enjoyed main because cant compare it to much as i hardly nice eat fried rice… but was nice flavour i enjoyed, food came quick and hot… the attention to detail also good the cups are super cool ♥️❤️♥️ It only lacked vibe and energy!!!

author: LW Chua
review_text: Their frog porridge is the perfect late-night treat. The porridge is silky and savory, and the tender frog meat with fresh herbs makes it both comforting and flavorful.

author: PH Mon
review_text: The white chicken meat and pork chop is normal. The 铁板豆腐 came with a lot of dishes even for "small" size and is definitely worth trying.

author: David
review_text: For a great dine in experience with the family, Los Cedros Mexican Restaurant is the place to go. This was highly recommended by my fellow peers on Google. They were spot on. I ordered the Wet Burrito with Carne de Pastor with red sauce, and the portions are filling, I would say huge, but I ate the whole thing....lol. The sauce was flavorful, not too thick or watered down. It had a great consistency, and the flower tortilla is not homemade, but a good quality and held up to the sauce and carne. The pastor had a great flavor and also not to salty, and you can taste that hint of chorizo. It's topped off with sour cream and side of salsa. Dish does not come with rice or beans but can be ordered separately. The atmosphere is amazing also, you feel like you're in a different country. The corn tortillas are hand-made fresh to order, so any dish you order, I recommend asking for the corn tortillas. I included pics of other dishes my family ordered. It's a 10-minute drive east from the Las Vegas strip

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: Joselyn Lim
review_text: Excellent food, service is ok for they forget to serve us our veggies. We follow up on it then they apologize. Good conduct. At least they apologize. And they did not charge us the veggie. We ordered the 2 styled duck which i love it so much. The crab soup has a special taste which is so delicious also. Squid with lime is also excellent. Thumps up!!! Hope you can keep up with your good service, good foods!!!

author: Massimiliano Lombardo
review_text: 5 minutes walking from the very city centre (Grand Plaza and the 5 stars hotels) this is a high level journey through the main south east asian cuisines with a predominant Indonesian taste. Wonderful location Not so good the beverage, only few wine cellars are available despite they are in the list which has a good variety of. Considering the location, the atmosphere and the quality of the dishes the price is a very good deal. Recommended

author: Carol Leonard
review_text: We dined in. Service was fantastic. Crispy fish sandwich was dark brown, hard and dry, disappointed. Burger was ok. Fries and shake were great !

author: Norhazwani Azami
review_text: Had lunch here and honestly, everything was so good. The service was excellent — special shout-out to Anna for being super friendly, attentive, and making the whole experience smooth from start to finish. Staff like her really make you want to come back. Food portions were satisfying, flavours were consistent and fresh, and they definitely don’t skimp on ingredients. ♾️/10 for Angus Beef hamburg! Overall, a solid 5-star experience. Thank you Anna & team! Highly recommended! 🍜🔥

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: MML Reviews
review_text: Disappointed with the food. The chicken is very soft, I prefer a chicken that has a chewy texture. Rice was soggy Sorry not to my taste 3 chicken rice fish veg and 3 drinks 92 rm

author: Inneke Ficianirum
review_text: Naughty Nuri’s has been my all-time favorite since 2015, and honestly, it has never changed — in the best way possible. Every visit feels like coming back to an old friend. The flavors are always consistent, bold, and absolutely delicious. From the first bite to the last, the food is just as yummy as I remember years ago. What I truly appreciate is how they’ve managed to maintain the same quality and taste over time. No shortcuts, no disappointment — just solid, satisfying food every single time. On top of that, the staff are always friendly, welcoming, and attentive, which makes the whole experience even better. You can really feel the warm, relaxed vibe that Naughty Nuri’s is known for. It’s rare to find a place that stays this good for so many years, but Naughty Nuri’s does it effortlessly. If you’re looking for a place that’s reliable, flavorful, and full of good energy, this is it. Will always keep coming back. Highly recommended! 👌🔥

author: Estela Duque
review_text: I came to know this hawker centre in the mid-1990s while at my first job as professional in the Tanjong Pagar area. I ate here at least 2-3x per week for lunch, plus the occasional supper, when there was overtime work to be done. This week I'm visiting 30 years later, it's now called Maxwell Food Centre and the whole area around it is completely different: new skyscrapers all around and an MRT station built in 2022. The 2001 renovation that changed it from a medium sized shed into +3,300 msq facility with more than 100 stalls, apparently cost SGD3.2M! I'm very pleased to say the food stalls are still excellent quality, I had my fill of old favourites: black carrot cake, fried kway teow, and Hianese chicken rice. If you're here for Tian Tian Hianese Chicken Rice with Michelin Bib Gourmand rating, it's better to come early rather than late. There's always a long queue at the stall, and they tend to run out of items late afternoon. When I came on Sunday at 18:00 there was none left of the lovely rice cooked in chicken broth or the roast chicken. So I was able to get steamed chicken only, served cold with warm brown sauce (the only downside of this visit).

author: Rodrigo Sanchez
review_text: Horrible! I ordered the tallarines verdes with "meat" and they gave me some mcdonald's looking meat. The food had absolutely no peruvian taste. Also, they WILL try to steal some money with tips or taxes. The lady at the front changed our price from $80 to $65 because we noticed they over charged us. If you come to this place you will waste your trip. No vengan!!!!!!!!!!!!!

author: Eduardo Marrero
review_text: We drove through the area to try these restaurants we noticed, which are popular among Italian food fans. They recommended specific pastas and their pizza. It was quite a drive for me since I was in Doral and it was pouring rain, but it was definitely worth the trip. If you’re nearby, try the thin-crust pizza—it's worth it even if you’re not close by. You won't be disappointed, and you can also take a walk along the marina and enjoy a bit of North Bay Village.

author: Victoria Marie
review_text: I came here for the seafood and left questioning my emotional readiness for a live cooking demonstration. The tostada? Was amazing. The aqua chile? Just ok, but I’ve had better elsewhere. I also tried the uni scallop — buttery, oceanic, and definitely worth a try. The real plot twist was watching a lobster flailing after being cut in half alive. Not exactly the tableside performance I was hoping for. 🦞😳 All in all, the food’s fresh and delicious, but the hype is in the Michelin rating. There’s great seafood in L.A., and Holbox is up there — just maybe… bring emotional support if you’re squeamish. I’ll go again to check it out one more time. The line is real.

author: A R
review_text: High Street Place is a fancy food court in the financial district / seaport area of Boston. We stopped by here for some after dinner coffee and dessert. This food court is very nice and highly recommended if you live in or are staying in the area!

author: Physique Fitness
review_text: Very busy here but food was good beef pattie was good but idk what happen I think they forgot the cheese. Awesome got the oxtail and rice with cabbage. Wasn’t spicy which was good cuz I’m pregnant

author: Timothy Smith
review_text: These people here are very kind. However, the Mexican sushi had no flavor at all. A Japanese Chef would commit harakiri had he ate the sushi I bought. It was warm and bland and the sauces were also nasty. I though it was a traditional sushi place and when I realized it wasn’t I was hungry enough to give it a shot. I got what was recommended to me by one of the workers. And boy do I regret it. If you hate actual sushi maybe you’ll like this place. But don’t expect Asian sushi when coming here. They have cheese and steak and chips in theirs. So i hardly wanna even call it sushi. Sorry :/

author: Healys Internet Training
review_text: This is the best kept secret in Las Vegas. The food was amazing and the service went above and beyond. I was particularly impressed with Tanya the general manager who helped me get across the street because I am visually impaired. I come to Las Vegas monthly and will definitely make this my new go to spot.

author: Tiago França
review_text: Man, I gotta tell you… What an amazing breakfast!!! I’ve had the “Papillon Special Omelette” with a fresh and real sweet orange juice. Absolutely divine. It’s a well deserved place to visit and enjoy the low back playlist and “zen” environment.

author: Danny Cardenas
review_text: I can say that this will be the last time I place an order in this restaurant for many reasons, bad costumer service, order always gets late, pizza is not hot, personal not helpful, they don’t care about our business, Kimberly and the supposedly assistance manager EDUARDO in this restaurant were not helpful and VERY DISRESPECTFUL!!

author: Yasmeen Wilde
review_text: The best and most authentic Malaysian food I ever had in the United States. Ipoh kopitiam is a famous chain in Malaysia. I am so happy when I found out they opened a store in Alhambra. We had the chicken rice, kway teow noodles and roti canai. All amazing. The place is always crowded and service is quick. There was a waitlist but it went by super quick.

author: Dylan
review_text: This family run restaurant has the best fried rice. They will modify to your liking and is SO cheap. I like the chicken fried rice with egg

author: Lizbeth suarez
review_text: The venue is beautiful both inside and out. The food is exceptional; I devoured my plate—it was delicious! The server was very friendly and attentive, checking on us multiple times during our visit. The bathroom is impressive as well, featuring a baby diaper changing room and easy access. Additionally, they have a bar and a VIP room, and the space is quite large.

author: Kristen Kirkwood
review_text: Really couldn’t have had a worse experience here. Called in an order with a completely rude woman. Then we go to pickup food and it wasn’t there/ready. We waited over 1.5 hours for the food. Then when we got the “veggie burger” and side of asparagus it was awful. No bun. Four soggy strips of asparagus. Their food is so blah here. The staff was not nice or apologetic for this either. They were also talking rudely and complaining and guests could clearly hear. Have been here at least 4 times and the only positive thing this place has is their location and outdoor seating other than that it’s a complete waste of time and money. Will never come back.

author: Erin F.
review_text: Fantastic food! I love a good savory brekkie and this delivered. Extremely busy little shop. Staff and food were wonderful. Cute atmosphere but due to how busy it was, I would not come here to have a long catch up over coffee with a friend. I got the Jacson... perfect waffle, egg, bacon, and fresh veg.

author: Catherine Santos
review_text: We found this amazing spot before attending a concert at NJPAC. I wish there were enough words to describe the quality of our experience. The staff were so kind and friendly. Our food was delicious! This Philly girl will happily admit that I had one of the most delicious cheesesteaks of my life! I hope we attend another show in Newark just to eat at The Yard.

author: Emily G
review_text: Let’s just start with the white truffle pasta, out of this world divine, and yet so simply prepared and perfect in every way, worth the $100, for us yes! We much prefer quality over quantity. We had two other pasta dishes, all extremely good. The market salad was light, simple, healthy and delicious, for us the way prefer a salad. The Somm help us choose a perfect bottle of wine to celebrate our anniversary. The cannoli and the gelato were also worth the calories. If I were a local, this would be my neighborhood spot! We loved sitting next to the pasta making room.

author: Ahmad Dammak
review_text: Everything was perfect. The food was really tasty and the balance of the flavors in the recipes was on another level. Drinks were also great with no exception. The pastries also are all perfect and we wanted to try as many as we can. The service was on point and they were extremely friendly and helpful. I always try new restaurant/coffees, but this one I tried its breakfast and the day after I tried its lunch and it did not disappoint. I recommend anyone in seminyak to visit and try Linvingstone.

author: Evelyn Cota
review_text: Great food and even better atmosphere. We have been here plenty of times and combination of delicious food and live music make this spot a great choice. If you like mariscos Sinaloense this the place to check out.

author: Dayu Tania Wardhani
review_text: Get ready for an unforgettable culinary adventure at Mevui! The Vietnamese food here is absolutely extraordinary! From the mind-blowingly delicious pho to the crispy, savory banh mi and mouthwatering grilled chicken, every bite is a burst of flavor. What’s even better? All Mevui locations maintain the same high standard of deliciousness! But the Legian store takes the prize with a more extensive menu, featuring scrumptious pork dishes and being the very first store in the chain! Plus, if you ride a bike, parking is a breeze! Overall, I can’t wait to come back here again and again for more amazing food! Oh one more thing! Their Ginger Pandan Tea will always be my favorite drink!

author: Todd Bowman
review_text: Chaos is the best way to summarize this horrible location. No order or organization with staff. Customers screaming across the counter at staff. Over 30 minute wait for simple food. Avoid at all costs.

author: Kimberly Renteria
review_text: Went in and there were only two people ahead of me, but somehow I ended up being one of the last to pay. The portions are huge, I’ll give them that. I ordered half noodles, half fried rice with teriyaki chicken and beef & broccoli. My brother-in-law got half noodles, half white rice with BBQ pork and teriyaki chicken. The rice was dry, so it wasn’t enjoyable, but the noodles were great. The teriyaki sauce definitely carried the chicken, and the beef & broccoli had a weird texture. When it came time to pay, they couldn’t find my order even though I was already at the counter. They kept moving other people ahead of me. About three customers, while trying to figure it out. I mentioned it to what seemed like the owner, and he just shrugged. To top it off, they only gave my brother-in-law and me one teriyaki sauce to share for both plates, which was ridiculous. Overall, definitely not worth the TikTok hype. I won’t recommend this place at all.

author: Billy Fyfe
review_text: Great place…tough to find, you have to go up three floors but that’s normal in Vietnam, I love it. Definitely recommended. Good coffee and the Benedict was perfect.

author: Matt Begley
review_text: When I walked in the door, I was greeted by multiple of the friendly employees. They were a little bit busy, but my order came out fresh and then a timely fashion. This is a good spot to go eat if you have a vehicle and can get away from the strip.

author: Robin Stephens
review_text: We had the best experience here last Friday. We celebrated the holidays from work with our families and were treated like royalty. The food was delicious, the kids were comfortable and the service was very laid back and friendly! My pork chop dinner was sooo good! The minestrone soup that comes with the bread is fantastic!! Our drinks were also really good! Can’t say enough good things, yummy and friendly and parking across the street!!

author: Noel Travel Log
review_text: Amazing experience at Gordon Ramsay’s Hell’s Kitchen. We ordered the pan-seared scallops and the Beef Wellington, and everything was outstanding. The service was quick, professional, and attentive — the staff even took the time to recommend what to order, which we really appreciated. The food was incredible. The Beef Wellington was absolutely the star of the show — perfectly cooked and full of flavor. To top it all off, the sticky toffee pudding was amazing, easily one of the best desserts I’ve had. Highly recommend starting with the scallops or other appetizers, choosing the Beef Wellington as your entrée, and finishing with the sticky toffee pudding. Overall, an amazing experience — loved the place and would definitely return.

author: Notorious
review_text: Trying Bingsu for the first time, and what better place than the country where it originated. The shaved ice is cooling and refreshing, and you can adjust the sweetness yourself with the syrup provided. The café itself is cozy and clean, though the outdoor tent seating isn’t particularly impressive. A highlight for me was the friendly cat lounging out front 🐱, which added a bit of charm to the visit.

author: Miriam Noyola
review_text: Casa Nova Grill (Brazilian Rodizio) is a wonderful place to go with family. We were well taken care of and the staff was friendly and professional. Our food was delicious. I had the paella and it was full of seafood 😋 It’s a bit far from the train station if you’re walking but definitely a place to experience delicious Brazilian cuisine!

author: REGINAwongXIAOyi
review_text: Spend 2.2 million cocktails are amazing, surprisingly food tastes amazing. Ambience and live band is totally 5 stars. Not a single miss from all our order. The server Husky is fantastic, takes amazing photos 🤩😍

author: Tiphanie Wright
review_text: Nehry was absolutely amazing from the moment we arrived—she was patient, attentive, warm, and made us feel genuinely welcomed. She was super nice and very intentional with our table, always checking in at just the right moments. Her service was fast, efficient, and she listened carefully to everything we needed. You can tell she cares about her guests and takes pride in providing great service.

author: namredwop
review_text: Very impressed, here on vacation and stopped in. Very nice breakfast place. Great atmosphere. Very fresh ingredients. Had the salmon bene came with fresh till on top.

author: Vibhav Deshpande
review_text: Extremely rude attitude! They refuse service to you for bringing a complaint! I had bought a idli/dosa batter from them which turned out to be expired 7-8 months prior. When I brought the complaint to the lady (probably the owner), she not only refused a refund but refused the service itself to me! She took my shopping cart from me and asked me to get out. When I brought her the expired box to show, she said that she does not want my business and asked me to get out or else she will call the cops!! Let this sync in. She refused service to a customer for bringing a complaint and threatened to call the cops! They can manage to run a business with this kind of attitude because that is the only Indian store in the area and most of the international students have to depend on their service. Extreme lack of business ethics! Edit :- The owner seems to have replied. Well if you buy fresh, then you should investigate why you had an expired batter instead of refusing service to your customers Lol! But after reading through all the 1 star reviews of your store, the rude behaviour of the lady seems to be a recurring pattern. I would suggest get treated for anger issues instead of shouting at your customers. This will help your business far more than calling your customers 'bogus'.

author: Yoana Kurnadi
review_text: Went there for the fried beehoon, very crispy and nicely done. Unfortunately the cereal prawn is not great, though it looks nice and smell nice. The creal got nice crunch but prawns got no taste.

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Michelle Wong
review_text: The food is amazing, love the black coffee which has very nice after taste and also egg coffee!!! The staffs are very friendly and especially Bi who always has a smiling face throughout and very professional. He is also very considerate that when we ordered too much, he stopped us. When we asked for recommendations for one more dish, he explained since we had ordered fried spring roll, hence he will suggest the non-fried. Very considerate!

author: angelica uto
review_text: The whole restaurant from start to finish is an incredible place. Our server Juli was attentive and kind and the food was delicious and generous servings. Some of the best food I have enjoyed in Ubud, Bali. The atmosphere is breathtaking. It’s not just a restaurant but an experience not to be missed.

author: Zoe Kay
review_text: I’ve been in Vietnam for a couple of days and I couldn’t find anywhere that had that fresh vietnamese food i was looking for, until I found Com Tam Moc!! I had a Vermicelli Noodle Salad with Pork and it was so amazing, exactly what I needed. The staff didn’t speak much english but they always made sure you were okay and used Google Translate when needed. 100% Recommend

author: Jacob Hill
review_text: Our visit to Oceans 13 on the beach in Hollywood was nothing short of fantastic! From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with warmth and hospitality. The Ahi Tuna Nachos were a delightful start to our meal, absolutely mouthwatering. My son was thrilled with his chicken tenders, and the complementary fries were a thoughtful touch from the manager. The service was fantastic & the bartender went above and beyond to ensure we had a great time. The ambiance was perfect for a relaxing evening, with stunning views of the beach. Plus, my son couldn't stop talking about the extra cherries in his Shirley Temple! We're already looking forward to our next visit. Highly recommend Oceans 13 for a memorable dining experience by the sea!

author: Zaryab .Z
review_text: Salad Bowl - Light yet filling, with a perfect mix of fresh veggies and flavorful dressings. A great choice for a healthier meal option.

author: Jimmy Tran
review_text: Got the combo pho and it was great! The portions were huge and at an amazing price. The service was incredibly fast and the owner was really nice!

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Clint MacLeod
review_text: Really decent steak sandwich, comes with 3 mini dips - the hot sauce and chimichurri are excellent, didn’t try the third & includes a portion of chips. All for $16. As a Scottish tourist here I did not expect that much of a bargain. Thoroughly worth a visit. Only downside is no seating - but it is a snack van so understandable.

author: Venkadesh A C S
review_text: I’ve been to Milk & Madu over 20 times now, and it never disappoints! The food is consistently fantastic, with a menu that’s both creative and full of fresh, delicious options. My personal favorites are the French toast (hands down the best I’ve ever had), the burrata, and the sandwiches – all incredibly tasty and satisfying. The smoothies are a must-try too, always refreshing and perfectly blended. The atmosphere is so laid-back and welcoming, making it the perfect spot to relax, catch up with friends, or enjoy a solo meal. The staff is always friendly and attentive, which makes every visit feel like home. If you're in Ubud, don’t miss out on this gem! I always look forward to my next meal here – it’s the kind of place you’ll find yourself coming back to again and again.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Yanely Balbontin
review_text: Serafina in downtown is hands down one of my favorite spots. The food is consistently amazing, but the mussels are on another level—absolutely delicious and always perfectly cooked. What truly makes this place special, though, is the service. The bartenders, Kat and Alyza, are incredible. Their energy, professionalism, and genuine care for guests are the reason I became a regular. They always make you feel welcome and taken care of, and they know exactly how to elevate the whole experience. Great food, great drinks, and even better service. Highly recommend!

author: Amy Rash
review_text: I was recommended this spot by a friend, I owe her big time. The food was amazing for a fast casual spot. We came at 12 pm on a Friday and we received our food surprisingly quick despite the line. Also the servers were so incredibly friendly. We ordered a lamb gyro, a pork platter, and the new lentil salad - everything was delicious. In fact it was so good that we went back in after we finished to order their donut and it was honestly the best decision we made that day - they were so incredible. We will definitely be visiting Greco again next time we’re in Boston.

author: fei
review_text: Siam Pandan is a popular dessert shop in Bangkok's Siam Square district. Their specialty is the traditional Thai snack "Khanom Krok," a bite-sized dessert made with coconut milk, rice flour, and flour, similar to takoyaki. Siam Pandan uses pandan leaves to create a vibrant green color and a uniquely fragrant aroma. The soft, tender, and slightly sweet texture makes it a favorite among people of all ages. This shop has been operating in Siam for over 30 years, and despite relocations and name changes, it remains a classic dessert landmark in the area. Their creations are made to order and are best enjoyed while hot. Each box contains approximately 9 pieces, and prices are affordable (approximately 40-50 baht). The shop is located near the Siam BTS station and the Novotel, making it easily accessible to tourists. Besides their signature Khanom Krok, they also offer a variety of other Thai desserts and snacks, making them a favorite among locals and tourists alike.

author: William Louistiawan
review_text: The food was very good and service was very helpful, overall a very good authentic chinese restaurant.

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: Thant Cin
review_text: The meat, sauce and soup, everything’s so delicious. Service is also good and fast.

author: M Lee
review_text: MRT to Chinatown Station, connected via Chinatown Point (exit near KFC). Saw queue for curry noodles. Went to upper floor to locate the crayfish hor fun. Found Tuck Kee (Ipoh) Sah Hor Fun (unit 02-40). Only a few customers in the queue since it was after 2.30pm. Had the crayfish with shellfish as lady informed that they had run out of prawns. The quality was good, crayfish were very fresh, sauce was robust not the starchy type. We also enjoyed the Hokkien rice dumpling from Hiong Kee Dumplings (unit 02-37). Portion was huge with generous fillings (pork, mushrooms n chestnut). Saw a group of tourists enjoying numerous curry puffs. Went to check it out, found out that there were 2 stalls (Tanglin Crispy Curry Puff) with rather similar names selling almost the same items. Didn’t try as we were rather full after the crayfish hor fun n rice dumpling. ‘Hi Coffee’ near to crayfish hor fun had perpetual long queue with signage something like ‘expect to wait on the average 35 to 55 minutes’. Keen to give it a try one of these days.

author: Mrs Brown
review_text: I ordered the chicken plate and the chicken is dry and old. 😣. My tortillas are hard and I so wasted my money. I usually come during the day and it's wonderful. What happened? I am here years later. Combination chicken the chicken is old and hard. The french fries weren't done.

author: Gary Liebchen
review_text: I'm starting this off with what I didn't like. They put a $6 fee on our bill for credit card. I get it. They get this ridiculous fee from them, they pass it on to you. The establishment has to wait to get their money. But to charge for debit card is wrong. They had the money in their account before I got home. On top of that they put the fee and tax in suggested tip amount. Now onto Spanish Tavern. The place is beautiful. Old school charm. The staff is terrific, also with a bit of old school charm. Our waiter Jose was great. They start you off with soup served up at the table. We started with garlic shrimp and paprika. Just fabulous. (Bread was stale and other tables had same issue) I got a seafood paella with shrimp, mussels, clams, scallops and lobster in a fantastic tasty rice. Lydia got the lobster dinner and was not disappointed, though she would have like a bigger lobster as they only have 1.25 lb size. We finished with flan which was very good. I also need to mention the pitcher of white sangria which was delicious, well made and among the tastiest we can remember.

author: Gunjan Karamchandani
review_text: Veggie potstickers and scallion pancakes were too oily :/ scallion pancakes were soggy. Mango pudding was ok. Spinach dumplings were also ok

author: HuBCiTy 310
review_text: BIG^SS asada taco - made 2 outta 1; this is besides the point tho. The meat taste is real good and easily beats other Mexican taco spots. Got a bacon cheeseburger here yesterday and taste expectations were superseded also. Brkfst burrito 🔥 🔥 🔥 as well. I recommend... Better than most burger spots.

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: Sharon
review_text: We walked from MBK. The place is good. Staff try to understand us even we don't speak Thai. They are very kind and always help us what we need. The food is also good. The source is spicy, but we can eat without it. Meats and vegetables are fresh too.

author: Truth Fairy
review_text: Great hawker Center beside the river. Surprised that there were seats during lunch hours, which is a good sign. Tried the food king good carrot cake and wonton Mee. Both are better than average. Was mind-blown by the carrot cake taste at first, but thought it was jelat as we continued eating. Queue was quite long for carrot cake, expect 15 mins. Wanton Mee not bad, have a variation of fried and dry wanton. Soup was good. If you are wondering why their drink stalls are long queue, not because it’s good or special, it’s because one person is mending the whole stall. Queued for sugar cane longer than for wanton Mee. Ps. A lot of OLs and OMs come here. Avoid if you don’t want to meet your colleagues or your ex classmates who are working around the area. Edit 25/2/25: wanted to try their big prawn noodle as they are famous for it here. Sadly. Didn’t bring cash and the store only accepts cash. Got their cai fan instead. Would say, taste flavourful but the price … for student/the broke/ or those who have saw cheaper caifan. Actually the worst part is, their banner wrote $3 for 3 veg. Ordered 3 veg (1of it is tofu but there’s no meat I have inspected before buying) they charged $3.7. So more of i got cheated. Sad. Just buy with caution and be prepared to pay more than what’s advertised.

author: Rian Krisna
review_text: tried The Classic two eggs, bacon, and their Habla Diablo seasoned potatoes plus their homemade Banana Nut Muffin, and honestly everything tasted just okay the eggs and bacon were exactly what you’d expect from a standard diner breakfast, the potatoes didn’t really show off the “Diablo” seasoning people rave about online, and the muffin, which many reviews call a must-try and one of the best in town, felt pretty ordinary and forgettable; overall, it was a decent plate, but nothing special like the glowing reviews suggest

author: Mauro Martin
review_text: Such a great spot for coffee & brunch in Petitenget! The coffee is really good; smooth, strong, and just right. Their desserts and matcha drinks are also beautifully presented and delicious. The warm rustic interior creates a cozy, chill vibe. What makes it even better is the live music, it adds such a nice atmosphere, perfect for a relaxing afternoon or evening hangout. Friendly service, good crowd, and overall a lovely place to spend time in Bali. Highly recommend! 10/10

author: Darrin Tebbe
review_text: I just can't say enough.. we lived in Greece for a few years and just loved the food and Greek hospitality. Taverna Opa takes us back every time we visit. We usually work weekends so this is our first visit on a Saturday nite... WOW!! A wonderful dinner, amazing entertainment, and simply THE best service. George, we ♥️ you! Oh, and the food was simply amazing, just like we remember from our early 90's stay in Greece.. Sincerely, "The retsina guy" 😁

author: Ng Ng
review_text: Nice vibe with excellence service. Ordered their signature beef rice bowl. The rice itself is abit dry so I wished the yolk was more runny. Would probably mixed really well with the fried garlic. But the beef was nicely done medium rare.

author: Cindy Khan
review_text: Just wanna acknowledge the manger tonight , I didn’t get her name ! Shes a beautiful dark skinned woman , about 5’6, she went out her way to assist me and she was extremely sincere. The new guy also , HE IS A BEAST !! He is trying so hard and it shows! I love when these 2 are on shift!!! Thank you for being you.. the entire staff tonight was extremely great and trying there best!!!! Keep it up guys !!!

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: Fritz
review_text: I recently had the pleasure of visiting Mà Mới, a Vietnamese restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City, and it definitely lived up to the hype! If you’re a fan of authentic Vietnamese cuisine, this place is a must-try. The vibe of the restaurant was super chill—casual yet stylish. It’s a great spot if you’re hanging out with friends or even having a relaxed meal by yourself. The staff was friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even better. Now, the food. Oh wow. I started with their pho, and it was everything I hoped for. The broth was rich and flavorful, and the meat was tender—just the right balance of spices. I also tried their banh xeo (Vietnamese pancakes), which were crispy on the outside and packed with savory fillings. Honestly, I could eat those all day. For dessert, I went with che ba mau (three-color dessert), and it was a refreshing sweet ending to the meal. The prices were pretty reasonable for the quality of food you get, and the portions were generous. If you’re craving authentic Vietnamese dishes that hit the spot, Mà Mới definitely delivers. Overall, I had a fantastic time, and I’m already planning my next visit. Highly recommend it if you’re in Ho Chi Minh City and want to taste some amazing local flavors!

author: Alvin Choo
review_text: I was recommended to try this place years ago during covid, and recently, someone recommended the place to me again. I decided to make a reservation for Sunday to go down. Please take note that if you want to call in to make a reservation, you would either have to call before they start business at 5pm or call at 11+pm like I did. We got quite a few dishes, their signature bee hoon, white pepper crab, dragon chives, fermented pork belly, salted egg prawn balls and stir fried clams. I came with rather higher expectations but most of the dishes were quite normal and nothing delightful. I liked the sauce from the white pepper crab but there was too little to enjoy it.

author: Manuel Dresselmann
review_text: The Shop got our attention after seeing an incredibly long queue that went on for ages. Every morning. It just had to be great, we thought. Luckily for us, the long queue in the morning is pretty much all delivery drivers so we were able to order right next to them immediately. You have a choice between a banh mi or s special banh mi. Lets be honest, who would even consider not going special. We chose the small version and took a seat inside. The food arrived before we could sit down. Incredibly fast. You get many side ingredients like pickles, Chili, cilantro & chives. Although supposedly small we barely finished it. The sandwhich was packed to the brim. Whatever you expect in a banh mi volume wise, double it. So flavourfull and filling. A great place to start your day.

author: Hatsune Miku
review_text: Sorry for dashing all the foodie's hopes, but Haig Road Market & Food Centre isn't as great as many make it out to be. Food there is mostly average, and I haven't been served bad food except on 1 occassion by a noodle stall, which I will not name here. This noodle stall is newly opened, and has not been around for a long time. Lesson learnt? Buy from hawkers who have a long time presence here and you won't go wrong. And there is no lack of them too. Some of them have been here since I was in primary school and is still in operation. The wanton mee here is very popular although i find it average. Another stall worth mentioning is the fried oyster stall that also serves carrot cake. The auntie here actually fries her carrot cake with thin bits of fish cake. This adds an extra layer of unami that further enhance its taste. This is one of my favourite carrot cakes. Yong tau fu isn't bad but a tad expensive and the cai peng here is pretty affordable(most stalls). Also have a mutton soup stall here which is a plus as mutton soup is hard to find in Singapore. Another ok hawker centre in Singapore, but over-rated by many reviewers.

author: Harry Plendl
review_text: There’s the usual busy crowd from the beach, tourists, locals who are obsessed with being at the beach. Come during a storm and it is your play ground. Otherwise it is a beehive of activity. The food is above par for the course when it comes to bar food. It’s nice island vibe. What needs improvement is there should be a food allergy codex for the menu. What is halal what is kosher, what has the gluten monsters in it? Actually add some stuff that’s gluten free and we’re on the right track . The staff is great. They need to authorized to wear crocs or proper footwear for wet and humid climates. It’s raining half the time and wearing wet shoes and socks is crazy. Want to talk about safety? Listen to a podcast on trench foot. I know no one reads at insurance companies or else their documents wouldn’t suck so bad. I’ll be back.

author: Melisha Mahakumara
review_text: We had an incredible experience at Elephante thanks to Angelo who offered the best service! He was attentive, friendly, and knowledgeable. He made us feel truly taken care of from start to finish. The food was just as amazing.. the corn truffle agnolotti and truffle pasta were absolutely fabulous, perfectly balanced, and full of rich flavor. Every bite was a delight!

author: C C
review_text: Colombia's food is amazing. I recommend this place to anyone who wants to try some amazing Spanish food. It's excellent. the staff are very friendly and courteous

author: Bebek
review_text: Interesting fine-dining twist on tapas - this was definitely a unique eating experience and a creative approach to tapas style cuisine. Whilst the establishment claims to not be a fine-dining experience (as written on the menu), everything about Cuca suggests otherwise. Being escorted through the courtyard on arrival, each small plate being introduced as they were served, the special service provided by the staff and, of course, the price. Whilst we had an enjoyable experience here, we didn't actually eat much - just three tapas dishes and a couple of (non-alcoholic) drinks between the two of us, whilst the menu suggested six tapas dishes per person. Despite the small order, we still ended up spending over one million rupiah, and sadly left still feeling peckish. Nevertheless, the overall experience was pretty enjoyable and the food was tasty and creative, albeit overpriced. Considerable wealth is required to fully enjoy this restaurant without feeling guilty for visiting, so we aren't likely to attend again.

author: Yuwono Alim
review_text: Went there once and came back again the next day. No doubt the food were deliciousss, but service. Next time when ordering pho, the red pinkish colour beef slices is a sign not to be missed.

author: Randall Hicks
review_text: This was a bucket item place for me. I didn’t know if I would ever have a chance to eat here. Reservations were easy through their website but plan ahead the time slots are taken up and it can be difficult to get in here. The staff are very welcoming and knowledgeable about their food. We did arrive about 30 minutes early for our reservation and the staff were gracious enough to fit us in with under a 10 minute wait. We ordered the Sizzling Bacon and tomato and onion appetizer. Both were phenomenal. Side note, the bacon slices are very big. We ordered 1 a piece and that was 1 too many. We started with a Cesar salad that was great. Then for our entree we had steak for two. We have different preferences for our doneness and the restaurant was able to accommodate that without difficulty. For dessert she had the chocolate mousse cake and she was impressed. Peter Leugers is a world class steakhouse and is on many people’s list to try. It’s worth it if you’re given the chance. Very important-they only accept cash or a Peter Leugers card.

author: Laurent Dubois
review_text: We went in 15min before they closed and they were already cleaning up. When we asked whether they still serve food and what they recommended as we never had Dominican food, they took the time and explained all the dishes to us. We ended up getting a platter with different samples for takeout. It was amazing food at a very reasonable price. I'm a big eater and just came from a run, so I was very hungry: But the plate was so big, that I was more than full afterwards. So, we will definitely go back to try the other dishes they have. This might become my go-to-place!

author: Sarah Wilson
review_text: Great Carlo Jr Location! My Husband & I stop to grab a bite to eat here and the serves was great & the food well made well & quickly! That Jennifer & her Team!

author: trinisha nguyen
review_text: great banh mi dac biet. lots of bo and pate if u like that! i only got one pickled carrot in my bag which was a little sad but ok. very filling and yummy!

author: Ray Dalto
review_text: I must say I'm very impressed with this place, It's very clean , owner is very welcoming, and service is fast , wings were great they have a variety of different flavors, my favorite was the Chile, you guys they even have rice on the menu. First time I ever purchased food from here but I must say I'm returning. For my brothers in Blue Highly recommend.

author: Anna Minets
review_text: I am such a fan of everything this restaurateur does, from Davinci, All You Need to Hubble Bubble. Whatever he opens next, I already know I will be a loyal guest. The main reason is the atmosphere and care you feel from the team every time you walk in. The service is consistently exceptional! Wonderful Olya remembers all my favorite dishes and tea and always greets me with a big, cheerful smile. The bartenders go out of their way to make sure you get exactly what you want. The food is delicious, and I really appreciate that they stay open late.

author: Aylin A
review_text: This Persian fusion gem never misses. Every visit delivers incredible quality, from their must-have kashke bademjoon to the perfectly seasoned koobideh. Their seasonal additions—like the new mahi and kabab torsh—bring a bold, sour-leaning flavor that’s just as unforgettable. Reservations can be tricky at prime hours, but the first-come, first-served bar seating is a lifesaver. If you want consistently exceptional Persian fusion, this is the place

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Paola Fuentes Hernandez
review_text: Stopped by Serafina with a friend to kill some time before a Miami Heat game and really enjoyed the pleasant atmosphere. We first sat at the tables near the bar, but no one came by after several minutes. As soon as I moved to the bar, we were helped within two minutes. We had two glasses prosecco, a Margherita pizza, and the fried calamari. The pizza was just okay, but the calamari were really good. Overall, a nice experience, and I’d come back to try more of the menu.

author: Fauzia D. Andani
review_text: This place in the corner near of BTS train and serves really delicious food and has some of the best pastries we’ve had in Bangkok – fresh, flavorful, and clearly made with care. Ofc we try milk bun, which was super refreshing and definitely worth a try. The space itself is a bit tight and can feel a little hectic, especially during busy hours, so seating might feel slightly cramped. That said, the quality of the food and pastries makes it a place we’d absolutely recommend!

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Reardon
review_text: Had my first bun Bo hue here in southern vietnam. Excellent dish, tasty, fresh ingredients, and quiet if you sit inside. Open-aired giving you the feel of Vietnam. No English but that’s okay when you can point and choose. :)

author: charnetta holley
review_text: The restaurant itself is beautiful with a great atmosphere, good vibes, and very reasonable prices. The food was delicious, and our waitress, manager, and the rest of the staff (other than security) were welcoming and professional. Unfortunately, the security experience really brought the mood down. We were only in the area briefly while waiting for my daughter’s concert to finish and decided to try the restaurant after checking the website and reviews. The website states that the dress code only applies after 7pm on Friday and Saturday. We went on a Sunday, but my son and I were almost denied entry because we had on Crocs. Security made a big deal about the shoes and we stood out there for 5-10 min just waiting because of the shoes (there was no line) After I pointed out the policy, security checked with the manager and then let us in. My sister also had her Stanley cup with water because it was hot outside, and the security guard was extremely rude and snotty about it, saying “you can’t bring that in here, y’all must not go out much.” He then made her leave it at the front door. That comment felt unnecessary and unprofessional, and it took away from the excitement we had walking in. We mentioned the situation casually to our waitress, and without us even asking, the manager came to our table to personally apologize. That gesture meant a lot, and it showed that management truly cares about their customers. Overall, the food and vibes were excellent, but the security staff needs more professionalism and consistency with following the restaurant’s actual policies. Parking is also tough, so be prepared to use valet (around $30). If the security experience matched the quality of the food and staff, this would have been an easy 5-star review.

author: Jason Foo
review_text: Great food. Fast service. Had an absolute great time eating there. Really great sauces and chickens. Use an app to order for faster service. Probably lacked a bin for rubbish, otherwise all good.

author: Ronex D Bonex
review_text: What a amazing Dining Experience 😱 What else you can ask for The Sea waves, The Sunset, Live DJ and music, Amazing view, The smell of the sea. Everything is amazing. You should experience this place. 👍🙌👏

author: WorstDad
review_text: Overall, had an acceptable dining experience at this branch. We reached at about 3.30pm and the restaurant was largely empty save for 2 tables. The waitress informed that the kulit guling has been sold out hence opted for kulit goreng instead. I think the goreng version is a lot better hence no complaints. Service was good with constant smiles from the waitress. A few issues that I see with this branch:- 1. Flies. There were quite a number of flies inside the restaurant despite it being air conditioned. I see that the front glass door to be constantly open hence could be where the flies penetrate in. This was a nuisance when we dined. 2. Cash only restaurant. No other form of payment is accepted. 3. Smokers. There was a table of gentlemen who were smoking inside the restaurant. I find this a bit shocking for an air conditioned establishment. The saving grace was the food. It remained good thru the years hence weighing out the issues which I have highlighted above. This branch seems to be the better one of the chain hence I hope the proprietor would ensure it lives up to what is is suppose to be.

author: 林大原
review_text: The food was delicious, with well-balanced portions and reasonable prices. The restaurant itself is beautifully designed, creating a lovely dining atmosphere. Our server, Leony(the girl in selfie), mentioned she had just returned from a trip to Taiwan,she was incredibly friendly and adorable. Her service was outstanding, and we truly enjoyed our experience. We highly recommend this restaurant!

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Colleen Grant (Wanderfrequently)
review_text: Just picked up my order that was ordered online. I asked for an 8AM pick up. I live in the area and this place is the only place to get decent healthy food. However, their customer service lacks. My latte was starting to freeze. I nicely told the front counter person that I thought the refrigerator was programmed too cold and that my drink is starting to freeze. She replied that it was sitting there for a while. I am 5 minutes late. Drinks don't freeze in the refrigerator for 5 minutes. Freezer - yes. Frig - no. She dismissed me. No offer to make it over again. Have you tried a frozen latte? I assume that if the refrigerator is operating correctly, she probably made my order at 7:30 when I ordered it and it sat there for 35 minutes. Either way, their staff are not willing to take ownership of their errors. If you go and order in person, things are typically fine - still have staff attitude. But if you order online, you have a 50/50 chance things are good.

author: Mia mia
review_text: the fried chicken wings and tom yum with fish are must order! Really enjoy the dinner with Thai foods here.

author: Meri Slaughter
review_text: Are lunch here with a friend and it was a perfect place to catch up. I have a dairy allergy, so they made me a Monument sandwich with no cheese - it was a little overpowered by the tart cranberries and green apple. I'll try a different sandwich next time. The side of potatoes are delicious! I did get a vegan carrot cake cupcake and it was phenomenal 😍 staff is knowledgeable about their menu and had no problem navigating my allergy. Will be back!

author: Andre W
review_text: I had the chance to visit Warung Babi Guling Pande Egi in Gianyar, Bali, and it was an unforgettable experience. Tucked away on the way from main road to Ubud this warung is a gem surrounded by lush rice fields, offering a serene backdrop that instantly sets a relaxed vibe. The open-air dining area is spacious, clean, and modern yet retains a traditional Balinese charm—perfect for soaking in the cool breeze while enjoying a meal. I arrived around 11.30 am, and the place was buzzing with locals and tourists alike, a testament to its popularity. Despite the crowd, the staff was incredibly efficient, using electric buzzers to manage the waitlist, which kept things organized. I was seated almost immediately with a stunning view of the rice paddies. I ordered the **Nasi Babi Guling Jumbo** (IDR 38,000, roughly $2.50 USD), which came loaded with tender suckling pig, crispy pork skin, pork sausage, lawar (a traditional Balinese vegetable mix), pork satay, and a savory pork soup. The pork was melt-in-your-mouth soft, with a smoky, well-spiced flavor, and the skin was perfectly crackly. The sambal matah added a fresh, spicy kick that tied everything together. I also tried their “es daluman”, a refreshing dessert beverage of mixed grass jelly in coconut milk and palm sugar, which was a great palate cleanser. The service was friendly and professional, even with the hectic pace. The warung has clearly evolved since its early days as a small local spot in 2016, now boasting a larger space and extras like coffee and Balinese “jajanan pasar” (local cakes and desserts). I noticed a group next to me order a whole roasted pig for takeout, which looked impressive and apparently feeds 6-12 people for around $120 AUD. My only minor gripe was the wait time during busy hours (noon), but the food and ambiance made it worthwhile. If you’re planning a visit, I’d recommend arriving early (before noon) to beat the rush or catching the sunset for an even more picturesque experience. Warung Babi Guling Pande Egi lives up to its legendary status as one of Bali’s best babi guling spots—highly recommended for anyone craving authentic Balinese cuisine in a beautiful settings and local price! Worthy note: Pande in Balinese = craftsmen Him/his family line previously probably metal craftsmen

author: Richard Wehmeyer
review_text: Came here for a birthday dinner. We had great service and got all questions answered professionally, especially one person has an allergy. All the food was delicious so at the end there was nothing left on the plate :D

author: Anjan Pariyar
review_text: Food was great. It has a authenticity. I highly recommend anyone to try and feel the taste of Nepali food here.

author: EG
review_text: First time trying Yam Rice and it is surprisingly good! The soup is a bit on the sour side, not my thing but it's unique for sure. Overall it's affordable and will definitely come again!

author: Apivigorn Longrak
review_text: Food: Delicious. The tom yum is rich and flavorful, while the sukiyaki is a bit bland. You can request extra dipping sauce. Parking: The restaurant is on the roadside, but there's no parking. There's plenty of parking across the street, just a short walk away. Service: Very staffed. Upon arrival, the staff will bring you ice and are always on hand to assist you. Opening Hours: The restaurant is open in two shifts: 10:00 AM–2:00 PM 4:00 PM–9:00 PM

author: Peter Michel
review_text: Wanted wings only amd was forced to get a comboniani unless I ordered a 10piece. We are forced to buy a soda when we only a drink. ALSO I ORDERED BONE IN WINGS AND I GOT BONE OUT WINGS.

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: Ni Nguyễn
review_text: It was good but not that’s good! MBK have a better Moo Krata (Better price and also better atmosphere)

author: Gabby GG
review_text: Best time to come when there's no people around so you just can just enjoy the music and watch the live sport match without interruptions. xc always come to check on me, can see that she is good person but I am a bit worried if she really ok working alone at midnight til sunrise.

author: Cathy Brelly
review_text: It was our first time going there but definitely not the last. The steak was delicious, overall the foods we've ordered were perfect. The service was commerdable as well.

author: Abby Y
review_text: There are 2 ong kee restaurant almost opposite each other and we went to one of them. Spacious interior. Menu wasn't fancy but has the staple. Hor fun was silky smooth. Tauge were juicy, crunchy. Chicken was excellent, well seasoned with fragrant sesame oil/soy sauce. Not super meaty, which I prefer. Curry chicken was different to the usual, and a meh.

author: Arief Ramon
review_text: The popular Italian eatery brings its retro-vintage charm to PIK. It’s always buzzing, so book ahead! The Spaghettoni al Burro e Pepe and wood-fired pizzas are crowd favorites. Lively atmosphere, great cocktails, and authentic flavors make it a hit.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Jane Le
review_text: Came in during weekend, the place not very crowded but serve a bit slow. Ordered curry and the food came with cool temperature. Will not come back.

author: Richard Lau
review_text: This Hor Fun is really unique in Penang! Totally different style of Kway Teow. The ingredient might looks simple, should be combination of soy sauce, scallion oil and chicken. However it really taste amazing! The texture of the Hor Fun is so smooth, slurp inside the mouth and immediately you can feel it will flow inside to your stomach. Must try the signature white chicken also. The meat is really soft and tender, and the sauce is not overpowering the taste of the chicken. Simple sauce also, and you can add their ginger paste as the topping of the chicken. Delicious!

author: Zlatka
review_text: I was absolutely delighted with this place🔥 and the staff❤️Everything was incredibly delicious, the portions were generous, and the team was so warm and welcoming🥹😻🥰 I want to give a special thank you to the staff for their kindness and attention. My daughter was sleeping in her stroller, and there is a bell in the café that makes a loud siren-like sound. Some kids were pressing it, and my baby got really scared. The staff immediately apologized multiple times 🥹and by covering the button so children couldn’t press it anymore🙏❤️❤️👍 That meant so much to me❤️❤️❤️This level of care and thoughtfulness is truly priceless🙏It’s rare to meet such attentive, kind, and genuinely caring people. Thank you so much we felt really valued and will definitely come back🥰❤️

author: James Wilson
review_text: Secret Garden is a charming little oasis in the middle of District 1. The greenery and cozy setup make it perfect for relaxing with a coffee or catching up with friends. The drinks are well-made and the staff is friendly. A lovely spot to unwind in the city.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Zheng Yang
review_text: So lovely, so happy to have dined here! Owners were really cute and welcoming even though I don’t speak any Vietnamese… Anyway, the food is so lovely, lots of topping for their special bowl. I wish I could have it again. Thank you for being good at what you do and being so passionate! Cam on! 😻

author: Javier Tan
review_text: Legitimately surprised by this shop! Felt that it may not be as delicious but after eating, the price point and the dishes did not disappoint! We came here with a large group and everyone was satisfied with the food!

author: jamie chue
review_text: Better watch out. They will give you a Large if you didn’t state the size of drink you want, even though the choices are Regular & Large. When questioned, the staff said it’s because you didn’t say, therefore a large one was assumed. Luckily they didn’t have a choice of an extra large cup of coffee 🙄

author: Kevin Shapiro
review_text: Kitchen cool Brooklyn vibe. Indoor and outside seating. 2 bars. The one we were at you could get food from, but every time you went back up for anything such as a drink or anything like that you had to stand on an enormously long line and wait quite a while, which wasn't great. The meatballs were very good, and the regular and Margherita pies were very tasty. Crust was soft, not crispy and thin.

author: Samuel Lin
review_text: Did I mention this was the best dinner of my 10-day trip to the U.S.? An absolutely wonderful experience — every dish was fantastic. I especially recommend the Cajun seafood pasta; it instantly became one of the top three pasta dishes I’ve ever had. Beyond the food, the service truly stood out. Every server was warm, friendly, and attentive, which made the whole experience even more memorable. Highly recommended if you’re visiting Las Vegas!

author: Dominik Wroblewski
review_text: The sandwiches they serve here are really good. I was skeptical at first but the ingredients they use are not of cheap quality processed meat but have whole chunks of meat as well as their homemade pate. I've ordered the sandwich with chicken and cheese and grilled pork with pate. Both were great and couldn't really tell which I preferred more (make sure to add their own chilli sauce). Avocado smoothie was perfect. The salt coffee was good too but a little bit too sweet for my taste. Overall pretty good value for the price paid. This place is clean and most times of the day full of customers.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Sam
review_text: First and last last time coming here. Food was pretty good. Came in for lunch wasn't too busy. Asked for the check or how to best pay they went and got the bill brought it back out didn't say anything , so I left cash plus cash tip. Waited quite a few minutes finishing my food and drink no one came so go to leave say thank you to the staff as we're leaving and this random chic employee comes running out after us yelling did we pay for our food . Totally uncalled for and rude.

author: Muhammad Aliff Imran
review_text: Recommended, boleh try once and see if you like it. 1. Vibes/Cleanliness - The area itself is quite large, lots of tables, and when we visited, it was sort of self service. - Tables were a bit unkempt, needed to call service staff a few times to clear the tables (they were part-timers). 2. Staff/Service - was okay from the ordering, pickup station. Need to improve on response time clearing tables. 3. Food/Drinks - Ordered a few of thier 'must haves' - overall was OK, a pricey, but overall quite satisfied. 4. Price - standard fare, dining with a view - slightly pricey I think 5. Other of note - there are some snacks/sweets from Thailand that you can buy displayed there. - they a surau for muslims too

author: Laurel Chen
review_text: I went there on a date with my boyfriend and really enjoyed the experience of dining there. The atmosphere was relaxing with a beautiful view and our waiter Nick and waitress Tina were friendly and helpful. Most importantly, the food was delicious!

author: Edward Park
review_text: Food not bad, I just put Taco John's behind Del Taco, Taco time and, the Bell. Restaurant interior is very nice, enjoyable to spend time there.

author: K VC
review_text: Returned for a large group gathering again (our 3rd here so far). This time we were seated indoors. Complimentary bread and butter to start. Calamari was good. Stuffed mushrooms were on the salty side. Had the Pasta Pescatore - seafood in a spicy marinara sauce. Liked the seafood but the linguini was not al dente anymore. I much preferred the side of capellini with strong garlicky-flavored oil, which went well with the Chicken Sorrentino (with eggplant, prosciutto and brown sauce). Delicious. We no longer saw the sandwich options on the menu. Service was great. Restrooms available. Wheelchair accessible. Lots of parking.

author: Lisa Matos
review_text: I work across the street and I came across this location decided to come in before my shift in the morning will I was the only customer there the women did not greet me after I stood there for about 8 mins straight while she set up her station when she was done doing her sit up she decided to acknowledge me finally gives me a blank stare so I can give her my order even after I order and paid she still did not say a work to me and I know she wasn't a minute cause she was having a full conversation with her coworker while making my order I work as a waitress one of the most important things we do is greet and make customer feel welcome as soon as they step in the fact that this women felt the need to be so rude as to ignore me in such a nasty way I will not be coming back the sandwich was good but the service was horrible

author: EugeneFCS
review_text: PS.Cafe at East Coast delivers a calm, polished dining experience that feels like a quiet escape from the city. The space is airy and relaxed, with tasteful interiors that blend well with the laid-back coastal atmosphere. Food quality is consistently good. Portions are generous, flavors are well-balanced, and presentation is thoughtful without being overdone. Whether it is brunch, coffee, or a full meal, everything feels carefully prepared rather than rushed. Service is attentive and professional without being intrusive. Staff are familiar with the menu and handle requests smoothly, which adds to the overall ease of the experience. It is a good place for a slow meal, a long conversation, or simply to unwind after a walk along East Coast Park. Comfortable, reliable, and well-executed.

author: Ghivan Christine
review_text: Celebrating my cousin's birthday here. The staff is very friendly. The food is quite tasty. I enjoy the fried prawn with oat. The ambience is also cozy.

author: Zazirash
review_text: Having dinner at Deens Maju felt like joining a Penang ritual — queue first, eat later. The line was crazy long, but with good company it didn’t feel like such a drag. Staff kept things moving and were friendly despite the chaos. When the plate landed, it looked like a masterpiece, drenched in kuah campur. Taste-wise though, it was more hype than punch — the curry felt a bit watered down and the flavours didn’t wow me. In Malaysia, queues don’t always equal greatness, but the vibe here still made it an experience worth having once.

author: Sano Chia
review_text: Joi serves hearty, wholesome plant-based food served with a heart. The pho was lovely. Pesto pasta was tasty and the ingredients used were simple and fresh. The ambiance is great to spend an afternoon chilling with friends or working on your laptop as there is ample space to choose your own cozy spot at Joi. Would love to come back and try other items on the menu. Thank you for the experience! We had a joyous time.

author: Yeoh Yuan Ya
review_text: The staff there had a very poor attitude. When I called to ask about placing an order for pick-up the next day, their reaction was as if I owed them a million dollars. Very very bad experience and when i go and take my order wah their reaction was so bad and so blur do not know what to do. Overall i did not recommend anyone come to this bakery and suggest everyone not to come. You come and buy their bad attitude with money

author: Maria Bp
review_text: Moana Fish Eatery is one of my favorite restaurants in Bali. It’s always the first place I visit when I arrive, and I usually go at least once a week. Recently, I came with my family, and they loved it as much as I do. The food is always fresh and delicious, the atmosphere is cozy, and the service is excellent. I’d like to give a special mention to the manager, who has been incredibly kind and welcoming. Thank you for making every visit such a wonderful experience!

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: INQUSE GENERAL CONTRACTOR
review_text: I stopped by this food truck, and I can confidently say it has nothing to envy from the big steakhouses. The quality of the meat cuts is simply outstanding—perfectly cooked and full of flavor. The service was incredible, with friendly and attentive staff that made the experience even better. Definitely a highly recommended spot for true meat lovers. A solid 10/10!

author: Adrick Loh
review_text: A highly rated restaurant (branch) along the famous Banthat Thong road. Nicely decorated but space is tight and noise level is high. Food wise is above average and price wise is alright for tourists. Just note that the large river prawn prices are high here. Service here is commended. Overall a good place for a meal.

author: Lee Rong Chen
review_text: Best Thai Food in Malaysia. Available in not too spicy version As for the drink such as the Yen (Original Milk Tea) and Kiew (Green Milk Tea), literally is the most delicious and healthy version! Super refreshing and authentic💞🌅🌌🤓👍👍

author: lily kay
review_text: BEST CLUB EXPERIENCE EVER. i would whole heartedly recommend coming here. there is three level; first two is pop & highest is techno. it’s more happening on the first floor. i paid for entrance 180k with one free drinks. there is indoor and outdoor area. it’s so stunning with the statue & there is a sofa in the female toilet. i would say it’s relatively clean & the music was very good. i noticed they are very efficient in cleaning up when there are guest who broke their beers/cup. there is a photo booth on level 2 which cost 50k. would recommend!

author: Châu Nguyễn Hoàng
review_text: This restaurant is fantastic! The food is perfectly seasoned, the ingredients are fresh, and the service is very quick. The space is clean and airy, creating a comfortable feeling like eating at home. The staff are friendly and welcoming, making me want to come back many more times.

author: Terence Kyaw
review_text: Interesting Peruvian/Japanese restaurant. Interesting menu and excellent service. Some of the menu items are never heard of before. Good Japanese food with Peruvian twist.

author: Taiji Master
review_text: Used to love the San Lou beehoon here – still decent, but the flavour is noticeably less rich now. The lala remains as fresh and tasty as ever. Unfortunately, the kang kong was a letdown – extremely dry and lacking in sauce. Overheard staff mention it was done this way to make it look better for photos, but honestly, taste should come first.

author: Ed Wong
review_text: Hands down our favorite boat noodles spot in Bangkok! The only thing we wished for is if the soup that comes with the noodles can be a little more generous!

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: Joe Goh
review_text: Nice old school pig's organ soup. Price slightly on the higher end at $6 for hawker prices.

review_text: It's totally a Chinese vibe to come to this place and take a picture with the The longest roti tissue. 1 meter. The restaurant and roti.. but if you're Chinese and have a "red book" app, maybe you have to try it and take a picture ;)

author: Shane Morrison
review_text: The best atmosphere, the coolest bartenders and staff and the adult beverages and food are second to none in this town and I've been here since 1997... check it out, you won't be disappointed

author: Alex Buchanan
review_text: Checked out San Pedro Square for the first time—definitely got that Hispanic vibe going on! Tons of energy, a bunch of restaurants, parties happening, and people just chillin’ outside with some seriously cool rides parked up.

author: Gary Markosyan (LaserHere)
review_text: This is the Place to go for everyone with kids who are "constantly hungry". I do not know how they can meet ends with such low prices! Good selection of food to feed whole family.

author: Jenifer Mattock
review_text: We’ve eaten at this IHOP a few times and it’s always been great. Even though it’s located in a casino and therefore cigarette smoke is unavoidable, the restaurant is always clean and very comfortable. We ate there last night and there was only one visible employee on duty, Roger, who took excellent care of us. He was polite, attentive, and genuinely seemed eager to provide excellent service. There’s one key detail that I believe makes the biggest impact on guest satisfaction that many, if not most, restaurant servers fail to understand. That is checking back a minute or two after order delivery to make sure everything is satisfactory and asking if they need anything else. Roger not only did that, when I asked for a side of mayonnaise, he brought it promptly along with a refill of my husband’s soda which he noticed was nearly empty when he delivered our food. At the end of the meal, he thanked us for coming in—another thing many restaurant workers fail to do a lot of the time. It might seem like I’m Roger’s mom or friend based on my glowing review, but I’m just a former waitress who remembers what it’s like to only have negative experiences reported. Last but not least, our meals were delicious. We’ll definitely be back soon.

author: Jana Batista
review_text: The burgers are delicious. Well stuffed and varied. Very well served and really worth it. The milkshakes are very good too. Only the service is sometimes not so good. The staff seem forgetful and take a while, but they do serve you well! It's a nice place to go with the family.

author: Ms. Boyd
review_text: The food here is trash every time I come here something is wrong. This time the Onion rings are burned and there is no hot sauce on my tacos where I ask for extra sauce. They are getting paid 20 an hour for what to mess up orders come jack do something. This is really ridiculous and I can't even eat my food and no one has time to turn around to go back. It should be right the first time.

author: Denny Andrade
review_text: Mooo…. Seaport is hands down one of the best dining experiences in Boston. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere strikes the perfect balance of modern elegance and cozy sophistication. Our server, Alexi, was outstanding—warm, attentive, and incredibly knowledgeable about the menu. He guided us with great recommendations and made the entire evening feel special without ever being overbearing. The steaks are the star here: perfectly cooked, melt-in-your-mouth tender, and seasoned to absolute perfection. Each cut feels like it was chosen with care, and the presentation elevates the experience even further. The sides are equally impressive—creamy whipped potatoes, decadent mac & cheese, and fresh seasonal vegetables that complement the richness of the steak beautifully. Don’t skip dessert—the warm butter cake is an indulgence worth every bite. Pair it with a glass of wine from their thoughtfully curated list, and you have a flawless night out.
