Whether it’s for a special occasion, a business dinner, or simply a treat-yourself evening, Mooo…. Seaport delivers excellence on every level. Truly a must-visit in Boston’s dining scene.

author: Paul Britton
review_text: They have done a fantastic job with the renovations and keeping the bar area and patio open with minimalsit furniture and clean lines. There are lots of cozy corners and areas to sit as individuals or groups outside on the bar patio. The views are amazing and they have a flat area near the pool for people to take pictures for the INSTA! We ordered a few apps which all were delicious and came quickly. The cocktails are one area that could do with a bit of improvement but as it's only been open about 2 plus months I am sure it will get more consistent. Definitely a great place to have a romantic date or bring someone from out of town and enjoy the views or even after work drinks. We had a small incident and the manager was on it immediately and handled it professionally, thank you again for that. Would recommend it to anyone who is staying in Jakarta.

author: Tarun Goud Golyalla
review_text: Looking for quick grab in the evening for a snack? You are at the right place. Must not miss the Chilli momos, and specially the crispy ones.

author: Pragyan Bezbaruah
review_text: Better than Huynh Hoa - for sure. More food options. The roasted pork was delicious. The sad thing however is that the Dac Biet, which is supposed to be special Bánh Mì, felt empty. Yes, meat was in abundance but no eggs given. Have had better ones on the streets - everything in abundance and still will charge 40k. Hong Hoa charged us 55k.

author: Nam
review_text: Review of Crate Café I had an average experience at Crate Café. They only offer matcha with sugar, but to be fair, they were transparent about it from the start, which I appreciated. I ordered the breakfast plate—nothing special. The bread was quite average and the eggs were slightly undercooked. I also asked for no rocket salad, but it was served on top anyway, which was a bit disappointing. The prices are okay, and overall you get what you pay for. Not bad, but nothing that makes me want to return.

author: zaki zuriel
review_text: I ate alone. My wife couldn't come, so I ate twice. Everything was amazing, delicious, great atmosphere, aesthetic place, every dish I had was excellent. And the owner of the house, beautiful and amazing.

author: andrew O
review_text: Taco Bell employees are well equipped for serving the community with a wide variety of different meals including a delicious late night meal with a healthy environment clean and fresh friendly service

author: Andrew Hudson
review_text: First time eating at Wahlburgers. It was all around great! The hamburgers had a great ratio of meat, veggies, and bun. The brioche bun was a nice touch. Bryce our server was very friendly to everyone who walked in the door and sat close to the bar. The fries and tots were cooked and seasoned well.

author: Irina Otto
review_text: After a year, I came back again—just as enthusiastic as last time. The value for money is just as good. Everything is fresh, delicious, and authentic. Genuine Balinese cuisine with all its special touches! Absolutely worth trying!

author: Asyraf Rahim
review_text: Scrumptious!! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 for Sup tulang/daging! The meat was so tender and the soup was tasty! But, since I’m not a fan of ayam bakar, i cannot say much, but the chicken was soft and well cooked 👍 Good ambience as well as a lot of parking spots available (RM3 per entry). The workers also were friendly and helpful✌️Overall, good experience with a good food!

author: Del Mar Dave
review_text: Love it or hate it - it's incredibly popular and not always easy to get reservations. New York mainstay, tradition, with a cult following who fiercely defend its reputation as one of the top steakhouses in the country. I'm probably one of those. Your waiter will likely be a stodgy older gentleman with years of tenor. I don't know of any other restaurant that only takes CASH - no credit cards wow. Unless you have a Luger's house account charge card. I'm one of those; had it for over 30 years. Be careful don't forget about this - bring CASH. I'd love to tell you everything is excellent, but I've always ended up ordering the same things, never did a deep dive on the menu. STEAKS. Important advice, if you go solo, don't get the single steak, order the steak for two it will cook to your temperature better, the single is too thin. You're going to love the dry-aged (they age in their own butcher shop in the basement - some creepy stories down there over the years for sure), it's a Porterhouse cut with both Filet Mignon and New York Strip, in an extra thick-cut steak. So, take the rest home for sandwiches and skip the steak for one. SIDES. Recommend several: Shrimp Cocktail they are giant - add side of extra-hot horseradish. Sliced tomato and onion (goes great with the Peter Luger Steak Sauce). Thick cut bacon, also great with the sauce. My last trip, for the first time ever I went with a Caesar Salad which was excellent. If you're looking for a rich, creamy, cheesy Creamed Spinach, you'll probably want to pass on their version - it's more "spinachy". DESSERT. I've only had one. The giant Ice Cream Sunday - assuming you have room in your stomach after dinner. Outstanding love the globs of chocolate sauce. This is not a new and shiny place, for those looking for an upscale dining experience. 100% OLD SCHOOL. I love the place, its cozy to me despite all the high energy and touristy crowds. Arrive, check in, have a Martini at the bar and take it all in. Love it or hate it - you'll have an experience you won’t regret.

author: Vling Chong
review_text: There are many branch here, this branch is open most early than others. Recommend by friend is must eat in Hatyai. It is delicious enough especially their fried crab ball , Thai milk tea is must also. Love all the food here, fast service and food be reserve with fast and hot . Will visit here again next time come back travel to Hatyai 😀

author: Charles Wonsey
review_text: Gave it a try with the $25 off from the hotel. Would rather pay full price for decent food. Lobster mac was basically undercooked pasta covered in bisque served lukewarm. Maybe served hot the pasta would have been a bit better. One scallop was slightly under and the other was rubbery. Steak was cooked properly but doesn't have much flavor and the peppercorn sauce was abysmal and arrived with a film on top and tasted some kind of rancid. Waiter encouraged a small Caesar salad, didn't expect $17 for a side salad when that's the same as my scallops or a side dish but the salad was the best tasting part of the meal. Bill was $140 before the discount so not badly priced just poor quality. The food, including the salad, was quite slow coming out.

author: Jiunnfa Khoo
review_text: Congee is the best food available here for me. Dimsums are just average. Place is cozy with air-conditioning. Worth a stop before going to songkla from hatyai

author: YC Wong
review_text: Amazing food with amazing service. We were waiting for closed to 30 mins, they offered free drinks as a compensation. Their pizza was amazing, full of flavours with extremly fresh ingredients. I didn't expect to fall in love witb Italian cuisine in Vietnam. Will definitely be back for this again.

author: Camila S
review_text: I was really excited to try Crema Gourmet because the bowls look great, but I left disappointed. For the price ($24), the portion of chicken was shockingly small. The bowl itself had a decent amount of quinoa and veggies, but the protein — which should be the main part of the meal — was barely a few thin slices. It felt unbalanced and not worth what they charge. If Crema wants to keep customers coming back, they really need to increase the chicken portion to match the price ($24) and the rest of the bowl. Unfortunately, I wouldn’t order this again.

author: Brittany O
review_text: This is a great new food option in Eastie. Very clean inside and we were able to get seats right away around 6pm on a Thursday. I had the shrimp tempura roll and a build-your-own ramen. I thought the sushi was very good and a good size for the price. I love the option to pick all your own ramen components. The tonkotsu broth was delicious and the pork belly was super tender. I would highly recommend and I will definitely be back!

author: Wendy Foster
review_text: My sister n i...went to celebrate our hubby's b.day...they both where happy...we come from brooklyn n this its one gem we keeping..lol..food good waiter was on point n again the food was goooodddddd.

author: Moonlight
review_text: Review of Katong Fried Oyster stall. Taste good but don’t order 蚝煎. Too much flour and only 5 whole oysters for $6 portion. the 蚝蛋 might be more worth it. update: weeks later, i went back and bought the egg version also $6 - take out. a lot more oysters but overall i prefer the flour version ONLY because i could further fry it up at home until its super crispy and the flavour with each crunch is so much more satisfying.

author: M miss
review_text: Pan Mee tasted bland. Chee Cheong Fun was average. Good food was the Pork trotter vinegar, Chinese dumplings and Japanese dishes... but the quality is not the same, sometimes it tastes good and sometimes it doesn't. The music on TV is too loud. It's too noisy, making it uncomfortable to have a meal in such a loud environment.

author: Wun Hui Chong
review_text: First time tried uncle ckt, ordered extra spicy and he delivered. Not many hawker will use chilli padi to fry it. I was quite surprise! The taste is very pleasant even though he don’t use lard. And the uncle is very chill and friendly . Even though our interaction is short but pleasant. After eating I dabao one for my brother. You guys can come and support this stall!

author: Giancarlo Spata
review_text: Two horrible experiences in a row. This place needs to be closed. On my first visit, they said they couldn't accept the coupon that I had because the machine that scans the coupons was broken. The manager got defensive as if this were my fault. I hesitantly accepted and paid full price anyways. After about 2 months on February 22nd, I decided to give it another try (THIS TIME without coupons) and upon check out they said that the Tuna Sandwich (FOOTLONG only, not the meal) went from $9.99 to almost $15.00. I asked the manager why prices on the menu haven't been updated and she decided to start yelling, saying she couldn't do anything because it was a system thing. She simply took the sandwich from my hand, threw it in the trash bin and started to be verbally aggressive towards me. I feel like the machine being broken is a lie and they try to charge customers more. TERRIBLE SERVICE. TERRIBLE EXPERIENCE. SUBWAY, CLOSE THIS LOCATION SINCE IT'S NOT DOING ANY GOOD FOR YOUR BRAND!

author: HMK Ithnin
review_text: Posted awhile ago. 2025 came back n giving an update....still the same taste. The best i must say....chinese style with a chinese muslim chef. No doubt the slow waiting time...but its worth every plate u go. All the ingredients are fresh..especially the cockles. He cook basically each plate at a time. Dont expect to get your food fast,to those who is hungry please skip this place,or maybe get something quicky,the rojak nearby not bad. Must avoid praying time... 100% satisfactionq

author: Flo Yeow
review_text: With a rich history of excellent local food, Geylang East Hawker Centre remains a staple for the community. While it might not be the "best" hawker centre in Singapore, it is home to many stalls with impressive long queues that speak to their quality. It’s a reliable spot for a simple, authentic meal. If you live or work in the area, you should definitely check it out at least once!

author: Helen Benson
review_text: It’s still the best babi guling around. However the setting of the original place is so much nicer. We went for the food. The traffic was too bad and we couldn’t reach Ubud, so we settled for Ibu Oka 2. The portions were generous, the food was good and fresh. And proper fresh pressed orange juice.

author: Ed Taylor
review_text: Went at 3 AM and had a Huge Plate of Steak and eggs cooked to perfection .. The Service was Amazing and so was the whole vibe of the place .. Definitely recommend this Great East Side Gem ..!🙂

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: Ohaiyo Simidaa
review_text: Stumbled upon this bak kut teh place unexpectedly. Delicious food – • Soup is rich with herbal flavor. • Meat is tender and not dry. • Dry version is fragrant, with squid adding extra aroma. Popular spot – • Arrived around 5pm and it was already nearly full. Good service – • Staff were friendly. • Requested soup refill and it was served quickly. Minor downsides – • Vegetables were slightly overcooked. • 油炸鬼were too oily. Reasonable pricing – fair for the quality and portion. Overall – Highly recommended and would return!

author: E. Wong
review_text: Char Koey Teow tasted good,even though I prefer soy sauce CKT style. But this one CKT has Wok Hei. Jawa Mee also nice. Only Yum rice not as good as we tried in SP. It is self-order beverages.The young lady who order beverages wasn’t friendly. Hard to find parking.

author: Daniel Bray
review_text: I found this place by accident while looking for free parking near USC. Decided to give it a try. Really cool concept. Ordered a cheese steak. Waiting about 8 minutes in the lot before I got a text that my food was ready. Pull up through the alley to the vendor and grabbed my food. Cheese steak was middle of the road (my car still smells like it two days later). I’d like to see this concept rolled out in more places. Great idea

author: david Hurst
review_text: Great place for work, friends or family dinner. Well cooked food and nice atmosphere. I have been a few times before and it’s consistently good.

author: sarion chow
review_text: Terrible noise level at the centre aisle of the food center, worse than before renovation. Not sure what they did during renovation but noise seems to come from the ventilation fan system. Extremely high pitch and disturbing, can't believe they would allow this to pass inspection. Spoils the whole eating experience when the food stalls are still great as before.

author: bl tan
review_text: Premium price food court, just wonder the students and university area the food price can be like George town food price. The environment is better and chilled, maybe that is the reason food price so high.

author: Matthew Somerfield
review_text: We had so much anticipation visiting this place in Penang, however we were sadly disappointed, I got the lamb shank the taste was ok but the lamb was swimming in oil and very chewy, my wife got the Nasi Kandar and she was not impressed at all by the food. However this may be not our flavour as many people coming and going. So might be a personal taste.

author: Dan Buckle
review_text: I had seen outside and thought it was just another Bar/Casino. But OMG this is Vegas nostalgia! The food is amazing, service is great. Went on Sinatra Saturday and the performer was fantastic, people were dancing - a perfect night out!

author: Ang Low
review_text: I stumbled upon this shop while walking to MBK. The ambiance is beautiful, and the food is normal. Prices are a bit on the high side, but with the lovely setting and good service, it’s worth a visit.

author: Jia Chyi
review_text: Enjoyed the food and the ambience very much! All the ingredients are served freshly 🥰 Chef and waiters are friendly and helpful 😚 Suitable for couple dating or japanese food lovers 🥰 Highly recommended!

author: Deana McDonald
review_text: The food is always amazing with great service. Never disappointed.

author: Phuong Le
review_text: We had a great dinner at Nhà Tú! The food was flavorful, especially the oyster hotpot, which my boyfriend (who’s not usually into Vietnamese food or seafood) really enjoyed. The bánh xèo and grilled lemongrass beef were also delicious. Friendly and attentive service made the whole experience even better.

author: Food Soul
review_text: The food are totally really great here but you have to wait a little bit for the service. Maybe, it's just busy and they have to take care all costumers. It's all you can eat but you have to order everything from the staffs. The crab legs were a little salty for us. But all the sushi and Japanese food were delicious. Also, all deep fried food was amazing. They also gave us plastic gloves to eat crab legs.

author: Gray Stone
review_text: Fantastic meal at Felix! You really can’t go wrong with an Evan Funke restaurant. The pasta was perfectly made, and the flavors were spot on. That said, I do wish the menu felt a little more distinct from his other restaurants. It’s definitely in line with his signature style, so if you’ve been to his other spots, you’ll find a lot of overlap. The quality and service are definitely there—the staff was knowledgeable, friendly, and attentive without being overbearing. The atmosphere is cozy but lively, with a great energy for date night or a special dinner with friends. Overall, Felix is absolutely worth a visit.

author: Cynthia Salamanca
review_text: 5-Star Review for Maracaibo I had an absolutely spectacular experience at Maracaibo and can’t stop thinking about how perfect the evening was from start to finish. Everything from the moment we arrived to the final farewell felt thoughtfully curated and genuinely guest-centric. Service Alex Valencia** was beyond amazing. From the moment we sat down, he exuded warmth, attentiveness, and a remarkable amount of knowledge about the menu and pairings. He anticipated our needs before we even realized them—refilling drinks without being asked, recommending dishes tailored to our preferences, and sharing little stories about the ingredients and origins behind each plate. His troubleshooting for a dietary preference without compromising flavor was flawless: he suggested alternative preparations that maintained the integrity and style of the dishes we loved. He checked in at just the right intervals, offering gracious pauses between courses so we could fully savor the experience. Alex’s genuine enthusiasm for the cuisine and for ensuring we had a memorable night shone through in every interaction. He treated us like VIP guests and left us feeling warmly cared for long after the check was settled. Food The menu showcased a masterful balance of bold flavors and thoughtful technique. Every course felt intentional and cohesive with the overall dining narrative. Star dishes included [insert standout dishes if you know them], each delivered with precise execution: vibrant textures, harmonious seasonings, and impressive presentation. The pacing was perfect. Courses arrived in a rhythm that allowed us to appreciate the artistry without feeling rushed, and the kitchen’s timing was consistently on point. Venue The venue is truly stunning—an atmosphere that feels both inviting and refined. The interior design, lighting, and acoustics contributed to a warm, celebratory mood without being stuffy. The dining room offers a sense of intimacy while still feeling expansive, and the ambient music complemented our conversation rather than competing with it. The bar area deserves special mention for its chic vibe and the bartender’s flair—great craft cocktails and carefully chosen wine pairings that elevated each course. Overall Experience From the welcome to the farewell, the entire Maracaibo experience was elevated, professional, and joy-filled. The staff’s attentiveness, the cuisine’s sophistication, and the venue’s beauty combine to create a rare, memorable evening. If you’re looking for a dining experience that excels in hospitality, flavor, and atmosphere, Maracaibo is a standout choice and definitely a 5-star destination. We left inspired by the care and passion evident at every touchpoint, and we’re already planning our next visit to relive this special night. Recommendation Highly recommend asking for Alex Valencia by name when you book for an extra layer of personalized service. Consider the tasting menu or chef’s specials to truly savor the kitchen’s breadth and depth. If you have dietary needs or celebrations, share them in advance; the team is incredibly accommodating and will tailor the experience to you. In short: Maracaibo delivered a flawless, memorable evening. Five stars all the way!!!!! Los Amo!!!

author: Philip Saulescu
review_text: Long queue but the food was amazing. The tom yum was very rich in flavors and had amazing toppings. The broth was very thick and perfect for someone who likes the tom yum with more coconut milk. Dumplings tasted amazing as well and the prices were really good.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Jenny Ng
review_text: Support the local. Bun bo hue here is good. My daughter is Aussie and likes the noodles and broth here alot.

author: Maritza Yellerdo
review_text: Ladies there charge for extra sauce when they don’t give you any to begin with like why am I paying .30c extra for an extra ranch when I don’t have any ranch to begin with???? , always forgetting to hand drinks over before leaving drive thru window, then make you get back in line just to receive it and they never understand correctly when you make your order so they don’t even give you the right order when they give it to you then make you pay for the correct items even when it’s their fault they didn’t hear or understand you.

author: Sergio Solis Checa
review_text: Burgers are good and very similar to the pictures, but dining in ia definitely not a good choice. There are like bar seats for roughly 15 people, and we did that because we don't live that close. However, it's not comfortable, not enough room, temperature and wind were bad. I could definitely have the burger again, but at home

author: Kevin Olivas
review_text: Ah! The old Zep Diner! Home of the Hinden-Burger! And chicken & steak dinners! And malts & sodas! You youngins don't know what you missed! The restaurant was shaped like a blimp. And everything! McDonald's should make its restaurants look like a bunch of blimps! I know that blimps make me hungry! They make you hungry, too! Zep Diner! Yes!

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Hai Phan (Francis)
review_text: The restaurant serves delicious Chinese food. The restaurant is usually crowded so you have to queue to be served. The staff is very friendly and enthusiastic. The prices are reasonable.

author: Joshua Wong
review_text: Prawn noodles and kolo mee both always long queue. Both good but I like the pigs tail soup from prawn noods stall more. Malay food and nasi legal stalls also very decent. If only they could solve the parking issues during peak times.

author: R. Joseph
review_text: 🚨🚨Listen up!!! This is hands down one of the best steakhouses I’ve been to. Our server Susan was absolutely a charm! I typically go to steakhouses weekly and Susan was by far the best. Great conversation, personality, local content sharing etc. she was very attentive to our dinner service. I highly recommend this location for a date night or just a wonderful experience to celebrate yourself.

author: Kevin Santos
review_text: Potato Corner is the best flavored fries at the best location! Sometimes this is our only reason to visit Americana. 😂

author: Travel_Love
review_text: Food was good, but I ate better rice pancakes. I didn't like that when I asked if I can sit upstairs, the waitress told me that no because of the "rest time" (whatever it means). Then new customers came in and they allowed them to sit upstairs without any problem.

author: JP O
review_text: some of the best rotisserie chicken you’ll ever have. everything on the menu is great however. Fresh Salads. Amazing Sangria.

author: Kathleen Sullivan
review_text: Picked up a shake for my husband. Service was excellent. The pickup area and stairs could use some sprucing up. That may be on the “to-do” list in the spring.

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: Sam Root
review_text: If you're in Thong Lor and need a quick bite, check out this egg noodle shop. You can get your noodles dry or as a soup and add whatever you like—prawn, crispy pork, and duck are all on the menu. They also have a ton of condiments on the table so you can spice it up yourself. The shop is tiny but clean, and the service is super fast. I loved that the menu had photos and English, so it was easy to order. Plus, it’s really affordable; I paid less than 100 baht for my whole meal. Since they're open from early morning until midnight, it’s a great reliable staple in the area.

author: Steven W
review_text: Right around the corner from the other famous banh mi spot. This place was really good, it came filled with lots of meat and veggies. I wish I got the smaller size as we thought it would mot have been that big. If you want to avoid the long lines and have a similar tier banh mi this place is on par.

author: Joyce Lin
review_text: Yummy beef bowl in town! 🥩 Yummy beef bowls at decent prices! The menu is limited but focused - and when you come here, you know exactly what you’re getting: a really good beef bowl. The egg yolk and Thai sauce on the side are perfect additions that take it to the next level. Cozy ambience, though it’s mainly tourists visiting. Definitely worth checking out if you’re craving a quality beef bowl! ✨

author: Ken Loy
review_text: This is a very old hawker centre. Been there for more than 50 years but recently renovated with a new parking scheme in place. Only some of the original stalls have remained. These ones have been there for the longest time. One example will be the prawn 🦐 noodle stall operated by the 2 sisters. Must try... Overall food quality is pretty standard. No standouts.

author: Derrick A. “Salut3SoRaw ¡That'Tho3!” Webster III
review_text: I visit here pretty often, so I guess I'll just have to go when certain people who actually want to work, are on the clock before I order ... the receipt didn't match the meal.

author: Julia Tsang
review_text: This is probably my third or fourth time eating here, it seems every time I come the queue got longer and longer. This time the queue reached the beginning of the adjacent parking lot, maybe about 100 people, crazy! We stayed anyway, queued in the cold and rain for at least 45 minutes. Since it is within a food court, you have to find your own table, though we party of 5 found a table instantly. They provide free water and 4 levels of hot sauces. Food is excellent as always, hence so many people are willing to queue into the rain! Note to those dislike cilantro, their ceviches are very strong in cilantro taste, plenty mixed into the sauce that can not be picked out.

author: Chelsea Adams
review_text: Always feel welcome and food is always reliable comfort go-to. Waitress was friendly made our 10 month old happy with smiles and encouragement! Will go again the next time we need a night out of the house.

author: Kim Kimora
review_text: The chicken rice is marvelous. Must give it a try. But must come before 2pm. They close around 2 pm and we were lucky to get two more places before they close.

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: oXRYSTALo Ong
review_text: Donkey and I are obsessed with prawns, so we'd been wanting to try Zhup Zhup by One Prawn & Co for ages, especially since it has a Michelin Bib Gourmand! We finally got a chance to go when we were on our way to the Garmin service center. I had Zhup Zhup by One Prawn & Co saved on our Google Map for a long time. When we got there, we saw they had a pretty big menu, and a lot of people were ordering the clay pot dishes. It's in a coffee shop, but they had a good variety of food, as you can see in the photos Donkey uploaded. The liver roll was amazing! It was super savory and used pork liver instead of the usual stuff. The owner said we'd like it if we liked pork liver. I don't normally like liver, but even I tried it and thought it was good! There was no weird smell at all, and I actually enjoyed it. The crispy prawn crackers didn't have that oily taste, either. They were clean and tasted great. For our main dish, we got the claypot prawn noodles, which seemed to be really popular. They had both dry and wet versions, and we went with the wet one. I was surprised that they put the clams, pork ribs, and prawns in their own claypot instead of cooking everything together. The claypot definitely added to the flavor of the whole dish. If we had known that, we would have order the dry version instead. The Hokkien Mee also came in a claypot, and it tasted so unique. I can't really describe it, but it was different from any Hokkien Mee I've had before. The owner recommended the Hibiscus Orange drink, and it came in a teapot with two glasses. But it was only lukewarm, and by the time we were halfway through our meal, it was practically cold. That's definitely something they could improve. Overall, Zhup Zhup by One Prawn & Co is a great place to eat if you like the dishes we talked about. It's definitely worth a visit. • Food Quality: 4.5/5 - Standout dishes include the liver roll, crispy prawn crackers, claypot prawn noodles, and Hokkien Mee. Unique flavors and fresh ingredients. • Ambiance: 3.5/5 - Coffee shop setting with a decent variety of dishes. • Service: 4/5 - Friendly owner with good recommendations. • Drinks: 2/5 - Hibiscus Orange beverage was served lukewarm and became cold quickly. • Overall: 4/5 - Recommended for those who enjoy prawn dishes and unique flavors.

author: Sammy Sage
review_text: Expectations were absolutely met and exceeded. From the moment we arrived, the service was fabulous—warm, attentive, and genuinely welcoming. The staff made us feel taken care of without being overbearing, which really set the tone for a great experience. The food came out piping hot and was beyond tasty. Every bite was full of rich, authentic flavor, clearly made with high-quality ingredients and attention to detail. Portions were generous, presentation was beautiful, and everything tasted fresh and perfectly seasoned. You can tell this place takes pride in both their cuisine and their hospitality. It’s the kind of restaurant that makes you want to come back again and again. Highly recommended for anyone looking for amazing food and outstanding service!

author: Gordon Wong
review_text: Needless for food pictures as this well-known Round Hawker Center filled with choice of great local meals. But since government guidelines of clearing and returning our own trays after meals, tables are often left dirty and staining wet for most cleaners consider not their job in ensuring table cleanliness no more. Here is a differing fact on a weekend morning packed with breakfast crowd while the Cleaners been busy pushing their trolley of plates & bowls for wash central, but also making time going around to help customer wiping tables for their meals. This way, there are more table turnovers to serve timely. Will definitely make this a top choice for my weekend breakfast places.

author: Tan Tessa
review_text: We tried several dishes and really enjoyed them! Grilled Octopus – Nicely charred with great flavor, and the sauce balanced everything perfectly. Chicken Skewers – Nothing like your typical satay; they were soft and moist, and the arepa underneath was grilled to perfection. We even ordered extra to go with the duck! Duck – A very generous portion that can easily be shared between 2–3 people. It does get a bit jelak after a while, but still delicious. The vibes were amazing and cosy. Service was excellent — they paid attention to our allergy notes, which we really appreciated. We mentioned we were celebrating our anniversary, and they surprised us with free churros that were chewy and full of flavour. Overall, a wonderful experience. Highly recommend!

author: web master
review_text: The lady behind the counter is very, very rude. After a very long wait time, the food did not make up for the rud3 attitude. Very bad experience and a waste of money. I don't recommend this place.

author: Harry
review_text: Boun Thai Kitchen in Las Vegas offers a great experience for a casual dinner. The friendly staff makes you feel welcome from the moment you arrive. Ample parking ensures a hassle-free visit, which is always a plus. Their quick service is perfect for a convenient to-go option after a busy day. The portions are generous, providing excellent value for the price. The food is flavorful, with dishes that strike a great balance of authentic Thai taste. The to-go packaging keeps the meal warm and fresh until you’re ready to enjoy it. It’s a solid choice for anyone craving good Thai cuisine without the long wait. Perfect for takeout or a relaxed dine-in experience. Definitely worth a visit if you’re in the area.

author: Jim Uren
review_text: Terrific local place near the Courthouse and Main Library. I had a Cuban sandwich in Cuban bread with a cafe con leche. Tasty, fairly priced and service was friendly and efficient.

author: Sally Nguyen
review_text: This restaurant is overrated, and I honestly don’t understand how it has held a Michelin star for several years. It’s definitely not worth the price. The portions are tiny, the flavors were either far too salty or overly acidic. Despite spending over $200 for just five dishes for 3 people , none of us left feeling satisfied. On top of that, getting a reservation here is unnecessarily difficult. For the same price, we had a much better experience at Theodora, which doesn’t even have a Michelin star but served food that was both delicious and filling. Save your time and money—skip this place and go somewhere else.

author: Jessica Sarinana
review_text: Disputed the wait for the table, the food was spectacular!! The huge bowl of Tonkotsu ramen was just spicy enough. Would go back every weekend if I lived here.

author: MX
review_text: Best buns EVER. So crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside. Pandan custard was fragrant without being overly sweet. I wish I had more stomach space to try every single flavour on the menu. Very good

author: Maitte
review_text: I enjoy coming here for a healthy and tasty bowl. Drinks are also good and the iced latte is balanced and a generous portion. The service is pleasant. It's a nice venue for breakfast, lunch and also dinner. Alcoholic drinks are also served. Although it doesn't have a bar vibe, but if you want to enjoy a drink with your meal or simple a quieter place than a bar, this is a great option.

author: Gary Looi CW
review_text: This is my first time visiting n here are the things I tried: Nanyang Fat Spread Sugar Toast set, Cold Royal Black Coffee with Milk, n Tumeric Fried Rice with Ayam Goreng. The fried chicken is huge! The toast set comes with soft boiled eggs. The price is reasonable although slightly expensive. The service crew are very attentive! They'll guide you to an available table, give you a menu n an order chit. Payment at the counter after you're done ordering.

author: anant kumar
review_text: Straight to the top of my fast food rankings! The chicken was unbelievably tender, and those crinkle-cut fries might be the best I’ve ever had. Didn’t dig the sweet tea tho, should have gone for the lemonade

author: Ryan Schroeder
review_text: This place is definitely a vibe! The pizza was amazing for sure! My wife and I walked down from fremont street to get a pie before going back to hotel and we were not disappointed. So good and the slices were huge! Loved it!

author: Mucho Garcia
review_text: Really enjoyed this place!! The food was really yummy! The fries was warm but on the colder side when it was served to us and so when I told them about it they gladly made me a new fresh one and it was soo tasty with a nice crunch. The playlist was really good too lots of Charli xcx and Ariana Grande so good vibes. Really happy with everything we ordered and would be back the next time we are in the area.

author: P T
review_text: Food was incredible. Had the prawns, in-house focaccia, squash blossoms with herbed ricotta, and the pappardelle w/ragù toscano, fennel pollen & parmigiano reggiano. Nothing fell flat, everything was perfectly seasoned and cooked. I will definitely come here again when I'm back in LA for work. Server's were extremely helpful and kind.

author: Clifford Sorrell
review_text: I came here from Philly excited to try the shrimp, lobster, crab and grits. Unfortunately the grits weren't ready to my disappointment. I had the oxtail, rice beans and collars which were amazing. The white sangria was to refreshing. The chef came out later and apologized and gave me an order of the shrimp and grits to go which was appreciated. Great atmosphere and service I also seen Jason Tatum.

author: Michelle Quichimbo
review_text: STILL THINKING ABOUT THIS FOOD SPREAD me and my husband went to 🌶️ s to eat some FLAVORFULL and DELICIOUS food, so much so that just by looking at these pictures, the 3 for me deal is so GOATED and u get so much food for less than 20 bucks, it was DEFINITELY an experience for me and my love and we SHALL be coming back 😋

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Snir
review_text: Pho is tasty, too bad the waiter didn't serve the complimentary greens and leaves along with the dish. while the edible meat parts were delicious, most of the protein served was pure fat I couldn't eat

author: Stephan Papandrea (Skpapandrea)
review_text: The food is great and inexpensive, the staff is friendly, and the restaurant is kept very clean.

author: Jay Carrillo
review_text: Amazing food, friendly people. Came 2 days in a row and got a special banh mi for lunch. It's one of the best banh mi choa's I've ever had and regular banh mi is best in the area. The homemade chilli paste is amazing, the bread is crusty and fresh, pate is tasty and I love the cheese - nice touch.

author: Özge Evlek
review_text: I don’t know how I missed this place before! It was my first time at Bubba Gump, and I enjoyed every single moment and every bite of food. Everything was delicious—even my son, who is very picky, ate everything! We loved the classic shrimp plate, ribs, mac & cheese, and the crab sandwiches. And the mojitos… OMG, they were amazing! This will definitely be my go-to spot for daytime lunches. Highly recommend!

author: Your Honest Neighbor
review_text: I tried a white pizza and a lavender latte. Both were delicious. You can really taste that everything is made fresh and that the cooks enjoy being creative. I’d definitely come back and would recommend this spot. Service was super friendly and attentive. Atmosphere is relaxed.

author: Shafeena Asmidar (midotb2uty)
review_text: The food was decent and ambient was very perfect for ootd. The service was top notch. Love the food

author: Caleb Lim
review_text: My first Ipoh chicken and beansprout meal and I loved it! Nicely cooked bean sprouts, tender chicken with some bite and the curry horfun I ordered has some oomph! The chilli sauce is also well balanced. I also ordered a 2nd bowl of soup horfun to enjoy the chicken soup. I chose outdoor seating for better ventilation.

author: D H
review_text: If I could give negative stars I would but 1 star is as low as you can go. This was a disappointment to say the least. After the stellar service and excellent food we got at Hell’s Kitchen in Las Vegas, me and my BF thought this would be nothing less than the best, but boy were we wrong. My BF and I went here for my birthday (few days before my actual bday), because we went on a trip to Orlando and had planned to go here and were really excited and had planned to have dinner at Lucky Cat that same night after we had our lunch here. Not only was the service appalling, the food was unappetizing and not the best at all by what we believed to be Gordon Ramsey’s standards based on Las Vegas location. The prices for lunch were also a rip off and there was a service fee added to our bill, what did we have to pay a service fee for? We barely got service. They seated us and gave us nasty tap water and after our food arrived there was no checking in or anything. We received way better service from the valet parking attendant out front. Regardless, we were not pleased and the cheesecake for dessert that we ordered was not very tasty and although they were nice to have added a chocolate Happy Birthday onto it as a surprise, it was still just overall a really bad experience. We were so unpleased that we wanted to get out of Miami as soon as possible and canceled our reservation for Lucky Cat because we were not wanting to have anything more to do with Miami or their service.

author: A Google User
review_text: Great energy, bold flavors, and solid drinks. The ribs were fall of the bone good, and the cocktails hit just right. Lively crowd but still cozy enough to chill. Perfect spot to unwind after work or kick off the weekend.

author: Mohamed Izlanshah
review_text: exceptional. dare i say one of the best meals ive had in my life. from start to finish every bite and every sip is so well thought out, so stunning and so so delicious. complicated flavours served in a non pretentious setting, laid back sunday lunch in the best restaurant in brooklyn. life changing stuff.

author: Willie B
review_text: The night market is pretty awesome! It is a massive maze of food and shops. Pricing is great and its covered as well as can be. Consider it a large flea market if you're from the states. It is hot so bring your fan and a towel if you're a sweater like me. If you're a germaphobe bring hand sanitizer. You can haggle on prices here so give them your best offer before you settle on souvenir prices but don't cheat them. They are trying to make some money after all.

author: Patrick Wass
review_text: If you’re looking for some nice porkmeals than you don’t really need to look any further. We tried the ribs, fried pork belly (seemed like what I refer to fried bacon, yet surprisingly ”fresh” for being fried fat) fried pork roast (this was to me more like classic pork belly), skewers, grilled corncobs, mashed potatoes and some greens (lawar kacang, recommend!!). Everything was REALLY GOOD, couldn’t complain absolut anything. The sides as well, totally awesome place, kinda fast food atmosphere rather than a finer restaurant but trust me you go here to get greasy!

author: Md Rijwan Razzaq Matin
review_text: The food was below par, but the drinks were the real disaster. We ordered teh panas and nesacafe ais — the most basic drinks you’d expect any mamak to get right. Instead, what we got was so diluted and poorly made that it was practically undrinkable. If a mamak can’t even handle the basics like teh panas and nesacafe ais, it’s not worth anyone’s time or money.

author: Hien Duong
review_text: An excellent place to try authentic Vietnamese food in Hoi An. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and reasonably priced. The service was warm and welcoming.

author: LEE TONY
review_text: I had a very satisfying duck noodle soup at Duck Noodle Hatyai. The owner and wait staff were very welcoming and warmly welcomed everyone, making everyone feel right at home. While the restaurant isn't particularly upscale, with seating outdoors, the atmosphere is relaxed and comfortable. The menu offers a variety of noodle options, all of which were very delicious. The duck broth was savory and the toppings were plentiful—very tasty. The prices were very reasonable for Malaysians, making it a great value. If you enjoy noodles, especially duck noodle soup, this place is highly recommended. After learning about this place, I'll definitely recommend it to my friends and family who love noodles, and I'll definitely be back!

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: Aw Yao Feng
review_text: This has got to be an undisputed winner for prawn noodles. The soup is just like a good “Tonkatsu” equivalent to ramen - but in this case, it’s a thick creamy prawn broth simmering in a hot clay pot with really adds to the flavour of the overall dish. The portion was worth the price tag, with 3 big fresh prawns and 2 meaty/lean pork ribs, can’t get any better with proper and fresh ingredients! Highly recommend if you are craving any prawn noodles and you definitely won’t be disappointed with making a stop here! 💪🏼

author: Kuang Yueheng
review_text: On Wednesday, I went to Tasty zone with my husband for dinner. This is a restaurant my husband and I often visit. We like their food very much. My husband and I like almost every dish, including rice noodles, jelly noodles and cold dishes. The restaurant is beautiful and clean, and the service is very good. In particular, the Sichuan cuisine made by their chef is very authentic and flavorful. I think it is the best Sichuan cuisine in Costa Mesa and I never get tired of it.

author: Louis Lin
review_text: Came here for my lil sweet treat after dining at Chula 50 and on my way back to Siam Centre 🤭 It was recommended to me multiple times from my For You Page as a popular/ viral charcoal toast place, and I was so so glad that there wasn’t a line when I arrived (it was also bordering on drizzling/raining and before the huge dinner rush time). The staff was incredibly kind and helped me decide on the flavors (cue me: indecisive and overwhelmed by the options available 😂), and their interior was nice and clean as well (I was able to use their washroom while I was waiting). Now, onto the toast itself. Listen, I’m a HUGE sweet tooth, like, I can devour a full chocolate cake to myself if I really want to in one sitting (neither here nor there don’t judge me 🫣🥴), but holy. Moly. The condensed milk flavor one I almost couldn’t finish because of how sweet it was. That’s just a personal preference though, as the other two I got (Ovaltine Crunchy/ Thai Milk Tea) were fantastic. I love they you can see them grill the bread right in front of you and how fluffy they are when you bite into them. My favorite was definitely the Ovaltine Crunchy one with the nutty flavor combing with the slightly charcoal taste to create an amazing infusion of texture and taste in your mouth 👄 The best way to describe it is literally eating a pillowy Ferrero Rocher 🤤 I want to come back to try other flavors!

author: Happywifehappylife
review_text: I went here yesterday it was my first time,but it won’t be my last.Everything was so good and I mean everything from the service to the food.Thanks so much guys.I’ll be back real soon.

author: O. G.
review_text: Denise was awesome, we had a family dinner. We all enjoyed everything. Perfect place for food and drinks.

author: Necie Aevum
review_text: Sarah was our server and was amazing! My mom always loved going to Red Lobster for her birfday for lobster, but has passed away. So for her birthday we went in to maintain the tradition and Sarah brought out an adorable sundae in my mom's honor 🥰 So thoughtful!! Great service and great food.

author: Emily Caste
review_text: My family and I came to this chinese restaurants for the first time. The customer service was great, food was delicious, the serving is a great amount, and the cost was affordable. This is now are go to restaurant when we crave Chinese food. Thank you for giving me and my family a good lunch to enjoy fully. 😊

author: Eric Johnson
review_text: Tonino Italian Restaurant is exceptional. I’ve been here twice now, and both visits were outstanding. The food is exquisite and prepared with real care. The standout dish for me is the balsamic tortellini, perfectly balanced, rich, and genuinely memorable. The atmosphere is warm, the service is thoughtful, and everything on the menu feels elevated. Easily one of the best Italian spots in the area. Highly recommend.

author: Miguel Alvarez
review_text: The Boricua Burger at La Industria had great potential the flavors were there, but the arepa was served cold and could’ve used a creamy sauce to tie everything together. Our server seemed distracted and missed two of our items, which took away from the experience. When it came time to pay, she mentioned that a 20% tip was already included, and seemed upset when I didn’t add more that was uncomfortable. The milkshakes were beautifully presented but a bit overpriced and not as sweet as expected. Overall, the atmosphere and concept are nice, but there’s definitely room for improvement in both service and food consistency. Overall I would not recommend or return!

author: Evelin Reichardt
review_text: Nice atmosphere. Great service. The food was prepared quickly. Everything organized. Super clean bathrooms.

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: al
review_text: I come here few times whenever I crave for chicken rice ball. The food is okay for me. Even the price may look pricey but the chicken portion quite big for one person. Worth to eat. I prefer chicken rice ball instead normal chicken rice. Service is good and fast. There’s one day, I was lucky bcs the boss gave free fishball soup. I was so happy. Recommended for anyone who wants to try chicken rice ball to come here 😊👌🏻

author: Hannah Barkell
review_text: Fantastic small burger bar in Seminyak with an awesome vibe. The service was genuinely great — friendly, attentive, and happy to help. I have a food allergy and really appreciated how clearly and confidently the staff explained the ingredients and preparation, which made the whole experience stress-free. The food was outstanding. The burgers were incredibly juicy, packed with flavour, and cooked perfectly. You can tell a lot of care goes into both the ingredients and how everything is made. Easily one of the best burgers I’ve had. Highly recommend.

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: Alan Tang
review_text: We arrived at the shop lot restaurant at 1:15pm. Restaurant was still full of patrons - both outside restaurant as well as indoor. Our party of three was lucky to secure a table when the diners ahead of us just completed their meals. We knew exactly what we wanted as we read their reviews. We had their popular chicken rice balls (charged by the number of rice balls), their white and roasted chickens, oysters omelette and small plates of livers and gizzards. And our orders came with a large bowl of fish ball soup good for 3 pax. Both the poached and roasted chicken meat were rather ordinary. The much talked about were simply “mashed cooked rice” squeezed into lumps bigger than fish ball size. Interesting but not something I would repeat ordering. The oysters omelette was delicious; would be better if bigger sized oysters were used. The complimentary fish ball soup was good. The fish balls were “bouncy”.👍 Overall, we felt that prices were a little on the steep side.

author: LaMozae Kelley
review_text: I stumbled upon this neighborhood bar, checked it out in a night Marissa was there and fell in love with the bar huts based off of her energy and service . The food exceeds your average “dive bar” expectations and I feel like I found my home bar ❤️

author: Donna Arnold
review_text: Great start to our cruise vacation, we're in Miami for only 1 night and Crazy About You was our choice for dinner, I think we chose well! Food was very tasty, service wonderful and of course the view was amazing. We got the 2 to Tango shrimp and steak dinner and sangria. An absolutely amazing night dining on the patio. Atmosphere and view is stunning and the food rocks!

author: Aisha Pleasant
review_text: If you’re in Las Vegas and craving an unforgettable slice of pizza, Evel Pie is a must-visit. This funky pizza joint/bar has a super chill vibe, great music, and a cool, down-to-earth staff that makes the whole experience feel laid-back and fun. I ordered a slice of the chicken and ranch pizza and another one (wish I could remember what it was—probably too busy enjoying it!), and let me tell you, these slices are HUGE. Like, one slice could easily take up a whole small pizza box. At about $6.25 a slice, you’re definitely getting your money’s worth—and then some. The pizza itself? Insanely delicious. Crispy on the edges, cheesy in the middle, and full of bold, creative flavors. Honestly, it might just be the best slice I’ve had in a very long time—hands down better than any slice I’ve had before. They call your name over the microphone when your order’s ready, which just adds to the fun and casual vibe. Whether you’re just grabbing a quick bite or hanging out for a drink, Evel Pie delivers on taste, size, and good energy. Highly recommend! Don’t forget this place is on Fremont Street as well.

author: Michael Trenggono
review_text: Excellent pasta, very cozy and cool place. We had the vodka rigatoni and grilled chicken, both excellent. I also had Lychee tea it was great, the strawberry juice is just OK though. I was served by Arsen, he was really friendly and nice to us. Excellent ambient cozy music, played with perfect loudness, works very well with the decor. Beautiful outdoor area with view out to the city at night. Also if you don't like heat, this is probably the coolest restaurant i've been to in Jakarta, the AC is really strong.

author: benson ang
review_text: Kimly Coffee shop setting. Meat is big bone with meat still ok. But the side dishes portion are small and $2 up. The same price can eat at those established BKT restaurants. Not worth. Try once will do.

author: Yvette Kelley
review_text: I had a bowl of your THIN WATERY broccoli cheese soup yesterday at your location. I also have broccoli cheese soup at other Panera locations. Have you changed the recipe? it's very watery and thin. I will not be returning to Panera very disappointed. My order number was 2633360. Yucky thin soup never again.

author: L Chan
review_text: Nice, clean & airy place. Ground floor has provision shops & wet market. Upstairs food centre serves a good mix of familiar hawker dishes. 2 passenger lifts makes it easy to get around.

author: KrisKat Meow
review_text: Came here because I know Coach House to be opened late. After a little change, the renovations are lovely. Martin was our server and he was attentive. The trio appetizer and burgers were delicious. Will be back to try the rest of the menu!

author: jurgita maciulskaite
review_text: Amazing Service from Fish! Had a great dining experience in District 1 thanks to our server, Fish. He was friendly, attentive, and gave perfect menu recommendations. His positive energy made the whole evening even better. Delicious food, great atmosphere, and truly outstanding service. Highly recommend asking for Fish!

author: Jessica Chin
review_text: One of the best meals we had in Bali. The pork rib best to pair with their chill craft beer, you'll regret for not doing so. I had 2 glasses for a lunch session and I usually don't have beer during lunch. It's very popular and crowded, best to reserve before coming.

author: katiie nguyen
review_text: Gia A was really patient and friendly. Her personality was top notch. A must try place.

author: Tan Thomas
review_text: Worth the trip for the sukiyaki as it was well done for me but not for my wife. ( as some say , either u like or don’t). Don’t fray, the Seafood will make up for it. Top - must order is the Scallop ( BBQ Style with bacon 🥓 chips and minced meat with a salty buttery taste 👅). The grilled squid 🦑 is really good too with the chilli sauce. Almost perfection juicy and tenderly nice with tiny areas charred. Vegetable was good and Thai styled. Oh…. Do not miss Green Mussels as it was good but a little for me. And lastly some shell fish grilled . Overall , filling and satisfying!

author: Jaris B
review_text: After landed at AOT HatYai, we were randomly looking for good local breakfast place. We found and we ordered dim sum, herb soup, fried buns, and Thai tea. The best part of this place is a signature dessert called "Ginkgo and Taro Sticky Rice Cake" (โอนีแปะก๊วย) SO GOOD and the rest was good, no complain.

author: ntp
review_text: My first time trying sambal here and it was amazing! The bread with a big chunk of butter in the middle was also something I’ve never had before. absolutely loved it, 10/10. Highly recommend visiting!

author: Priscilla Hernandez
review_text: The food here is amazing!!! I had the short rib fried rice and yellow chicken curry! Both spice level 3 which was perfect! Although the food is awesome what makes this place stand out to me is the service! My waitress was so attentive and all the employees were so friendly. The host Luis was amazing definitely set the tone for the evening. Nothing worse then when you get a rude host to ruin the evening. Definitely recommend.

author: Tay Liang Chou
review_text: Very nice hidden cafe with excellent dining atmosphere. Serving time slightly slow but all the food were great. However, portion might be small for heavy eaters. Recommended for gathering or family dining.

author: Ryan Wenzel
review_text: Hellbender is a standout spot with fantastic food and a great vibe. We tried the fried cheese, aguachile, mushroom tacos, and pork ribs al pastor—every dish was memorable, and I only wish we had room to explore more of the menu. As someone who loves meat and takes tacos seriously, I was especially blown away by the mushroom tacos—absolutely a must-try. Can’t wait to come back!

author: Kelvin Wong
review_text: This place is hidden in the industrial building area in Tiong Bahru. This restaurant is well known for their seafood, however this time we only order simple Chinese dishes. The food is unexpectedly great, even comparable to Hong Kong style small restaurant standard. The pepper beef is tender and savory. The frog is sautéed well with the sauce. The veggies do not look appealing but tasted unexpectedly fresh and soft. The shrimp is great as well. The satay was great too. One thing is that the portion is not big enough. Most importantly, this place is value for money. When you can see so many local families dinning with their family, you know you did not go to a wrong place.

author: Terry Singh
review_text: We ordered takeout from this place. We always get the family meal. And they do a really good job. A lot of food for my family for we enjoy everything. The salads fresh, we usually get whatever. Is available usually use the chicken grilled chicken BBQ style or the chicken tenders? We haven't tried the other items yet. We're going to we're planning to they give a lot of bread-and-butter and their bread is to die for with the butter. When I go to pick up the staff is great.I really like this location

author: Megan Alvarez
review_text: What a gem! Food was amazing, awesome atmosphere, and the service was excellent. We had the breakfast sandwich and country fried steak and eggs with a side of pork belly! Yum! Had the Cherry Lemonade to go and it was delicious. Our waitress, Melissa, was attentive and sweet. Will definitely be sharing Winnie and Ethel’s with any and everyone we know visiting Vegas.

author: Daryna Paterylo
review_text: The food was amazing — the sushi was just wow! I especially recommend the Volcano Roll. The atmosphere is very nice, but the big downside was the service, which felt very unorganized and messy.

author: St Francis
review_text: A very disappointing experience. There is nothing famous about Tom's Junior Burger #4. I don't understand the good reviews. They are over rating the place. In actuality, the food is overpriced and of low quality. And they will charge you extra for using a debit card. The service crawls when they have customers. The "famous pastrami" is grilled. Tough, chewy, and grisly. I don't recommend it. When I finally got my order, the burger was cold, and the bread on the Pastrami sandwich was soggy. If you can't make a decent "famous pastrami sandwich," how can you trust the rest of the menu? There are many better choices in the area for good food. As for me, I won't be back.

author: Apeksha
review_text: Amazing place with good food .. Ambience is perfect for your evening dining with Live music... Very spacious & huge sitting... Service is also fast & good.

author: Angela Abney
review_text: This was an amazing place to eat. We came here for my fiancé birthday. We received a birthday card from the staff congratulating him. The tables were spacious and a beautiful ambiance. The meals were divine. We had steak, seafood pasta and prime rib. All the sides were ala carte. The waitstaff were very attentive. This is a must try outside of the strip

author: Keegan Talbott
review_text: The overall taste of the cooking is considered really good, very tasty and the herbs made them aromatic to the max. This is not my first time patronizing this shop. But today is another level, Rm28 for a piece of ¼ Mutiara Chicken is the biggest let down when comes to the texture of the chicken meat, was as if cutting off from a lamb shoulder. Color of the meat looked like a mummified chicken. I thought was chewing a Wrigley's gum. Beef was leathery though it managed to beat the chicken. Glad enough to have ordered their fried bigger gourd, acar and papadam which managed to bolsterd the rating.

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: IUVA sg
review_text: Has been a favourite shopping site for the Malays and other races for fresh produces and on the 2nd floor, wide range of Malay Culinaries. All food are Halal. Prices are affordable. Try the Nasi Briyani or the Nasi Padang. There are many desserts too. All under 1 roof. It is accessible by bus or MRT.

author: booboo booboo
review_text: This place is the worse customer service suck here god help it if they can make and deliver a pizza

author: parisa ighani
review_text: We had their peel and ear shrimp, crab dip and chips, chipotle bowl, quesadillas, chicken tender, andddd steak Philly sandwich. Everything tasted great. We had an amazing View and the best server. Christie was amazing, sweet and attentive.

author: Oopszahdaisy Crayola
review_text: I was in line for 20 minutes with 2 cars in front of me and 19 behind me. This location is slow and don't know how to communicate behind a speaker. It's too slow for a location that's not in the best of neighborhoods. I live 1 block away. We trying to get in and out. Look my Dad worked here in high school in the 60's. I have no hate for the restaurant. I don't think it's cool to be sitting in a drive thru at 8 pm for 29 unnecessary minutes, that's all.

author: Ortiz Ortiz
review_text: Food is ok but service is bad. They talk to you as if they're doing you a favor for serving you. Very rude.

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: Xin Hao
review_text: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup is a solid go-to spot for late-night zi char, especially if you’re craving something hearty and comforting after hours. Located along Changi Road, it’s well known for staying open late, making it a popular supper destination for night owls and shift workers alike. The food here leans towards classic, no-frills zi char done well. The chao ta bee hoon is a standout, with good wok hei and generous ingredients that make it satisfying without being overly greasy. This was my favorite of all. Starts from $10 for a small portion which can feed about 3pax. The herbal mee sua is another highlight — warm, soothing, and rich with herbal flavours, perfect for something lighter yet nourishing. Portions are generally generous, making it suitable for sharing among a small group. Herbal Chicken Soup was also a good standout for me. That said, prices can be slightly on the higher side compared to typical hawker fare, and some dishes can be a little inconsistent. For instance, while the overall flavour is good, certain ingredients like pork liver may not always hit the mark texture-wise. The fried pork with fermented beancurd was also really average for me and not super unique. Still, most dishes are well executed and comforting, especially when enjoyed fresh and hot. Overall, Seng Kee delivers reliable zi char with a strong supper appeal. It may not be the cheapest option around, but if you’re looking for a filling, late-night meal with familiar flavours and decent portions, it’s a dependable choice worth returning to.

author: Jack Gray
review_text: Visited the restaurant for the first time today and everything was flawless. The guy that built my bowl was friendly, accommodating, and diligent. Everything was incredibly clean and the AC was working overtime, and while I didn’t dine in, the seating looked comfortable and ample, as far as the Chipotle-esque restaurant model goes. The bowl itself was a great value; it tasted great, was uniformly constructed, the ingredients were fresh, and it was extremely filling, which is a hard find around here these days. For $15 I can’t think of a better value in the neighborhood to be honest. I’m vegetarian/pescatarian so the impossible meat and fish options were clutch. I enjoyed this over Chipotle by a long shot, and am happy to have a quality alternative.

author: Adriana Rivera
review_text: We arrived at 9:30a, got seated right away. I ordered the mimosa flights, Jorge (server) recommended some yummy flavors! My crepes combo hit the spot, came w/2 eggs, bacons & sausage all very good. My daughter loved her cafe de olla & my son his chocolate milk shake. Jorge was very attentive, great customer service! Will def be back soon.

author: Becky
review_text: My experience was horrible so much so I had to call corporate because I just couldn't let go how dissatisfied I was with my interaction with the general manager. I didn't want the young man to lose his job I'm sure he has a family to support but I wanted to make a point that in his position he should treat people with respect and with some common courtesy. I just want him to stop and not treat people the way he did my husband and I .

author: Jacky Lam
review_text: Came here 3 years ago. The food was amazing. Back again today, a little disappointed on the overall taste of the food. The crispy pork Kra Pao was very dry, tough, and not crunchy. The pork leg was very dry and not as juicy as before. Still good, but not as good as before or in Thailand. Sorry to give this place 3/5, from 5/5.

author: Luca Tonino
review_text: this is an absolutely amazing restaurant and all the dishes that i tried are simply outstanding. the mocktails are delicious and the coffee is excellent. i’m going here and to the other branch a lot and it’s perfect for any time of the day. really nice job of the owner, service is great as well.

author: Cheong Loong
review_text: A nostalgic food place where one can find most hawker food of the past under one roof. My fave stalls are the dry chillie prawn noodles , sarawak mee with your choice of ingredients. Local finds like fried carrot cake, nasi lemak, mee siam, prata, sugar cane, fried fish balls and chinese dessert . A family n friends hang out during weekends. Do come early and not be disappointed, as most stalls start in the morning n food run out by lunch time.

author: Donna Donato
review_text: Very nice ambiance. Great food and service. We got the set meal, pho, scallops, and coconut juice.

author: Alpesh Patel
review_text: Food was ok, service was attentive. I expected more from basic nachos. Not spicy at all even though we asked for Jalapeños (I get it, Jalapeños are a hot or miss), but the fish didn’t make up for it.

author: Bogadi Prashanth
review_text: Dined at this restaurant yesterday as we attended a university event. Not so crowded around 5 pm. The menu is great, but the food quality isn’t great! Ordered Pasta Catbonara, with the pasta not fully done. Korean chicken with rice had rice undercooked but everything is served so hot!! Microwaved not sure. The original cake cake was pretty good. All in all a hit and miss at the place.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Sara Lee
review_text: Such a great vibe and food! Had the chicken pesto bowl and green hornet smoothie. Both were delicious

author: Alan Staton
review_text: Lovely local cafe, we past it a few times on our walks to and from the hotel so we went in on our last 2 mornings for breakfast. You order and pay at the till, then take a seat. The decor is lovley, all neon signs and plants, theres a few TV screens but they were just showing a screensaver. The food was excellent and set us up for the day, think we skipped dinner we were that full. Crispy bacon and maple syrup is so nice. Infact thats why we went back a second time.

author: Artem Aleksanyan
review_text: I came for trivia, drinks and bar food. This bar would be perfectly fine except for the fact that they WILL NOT SERVE TAP WATER, instead offering plastic bottles of water for $1.50! Who does that?? I am shocked it is not against the law to serve food and alcohol without tap water for free but here we are. Apparently every other sit down restaurant, bar, and coffee shop I’ve ever been to in MA has been just doing it on good will. Shame these guys did not get the memo to be normal good guys. So disappointing.

author: Kagu Kagus
review_text: Food is really good. Portions are fine only if you buy at the store. Used uber eats to get their food the other day.... bowl had such a small portion in it. For a moment i though driver ate some of it 😆 (he did not)

author: Amanda Herro (Mandy)
review_text: Great spot for quick, delicious brunch! There’s plenty of seating with an L-shaped bar, couches, tons of tables and outdoor seating. Your walk up to order then the food is brought to the table quickly. I ordered the Croissant Breakfast Sandwich with egg. It was delicious and far more than I could possibly eat in one sitting. My fiancé ordered the Open faced Breakfast Sandwich and he loved everything, but said the bacon was especially good! It’s a little pricey, but on par for the area and well worth the money!

author: Camila Luque
review_text: All was excellent! Perfect spot for Sunday’s breakfast. The service was amazing, ice latte and orange juice on point! We ordered the salmon bagel and the classic breakfast with two eggs. The chocolate croissant was delicious. I love that they are pet friendly 🩵 very familiar ambiance. We will be back!

author: Austin
review_text: Cool place for lunch or dinner. [+] -Very tasty and fancy foods -Services were nice [-] -Portion was not much compared to price

author: LS SPK
review_text: I'm kinda surprised to see Michelin in food court. The quality of fried rice with crab was quite good. The portion definitely not for Thais. The size S I ordered was really big that I could only finish half of it. The crab meat was fresh and juicy though. No regrets that I had tried it.

author: DJ Reynolds
review_text: Waited 1.5 hours for a terrible salad that said grilled chicken but came out with deli meat. Terrible atmosphere filled with cigarette smoke. Don’t waste your time or money

author: Nuno Barbosa
review_text: Food was great. Bar tender was terrible! We were there for the open mic comedy night which is through RANDOM PICKS OUT OF RAFT BOX. As soon as the host noticed that we were a large group he asked for the name and just kept the card for the WHOLE NIGHT! Just so they could keep us around until the end of the night! That was a terrible experience! We could’ve definitely hung around after our friends set but the fact that they played us to stay just shows the type of people who run this business.

author: KC
review_text: We didn't have reservations, but the host still seated us anyway. I had the most delicious birthday dinner. Thank you Mangrove!🫶🏾🙏🏽🎂💖🎉🎊💯

author: May M
review_text: We were a big group and everyone was very happy with their food. Music was great too. The service was excellent. Overall experience was amazing! It was our first time. We will definitely be back. :)

author: Chan Yenny
review_text: Taste is ok. But portion too little for the pork trotter with rice which cost $10 ish. Ordered takeaway and seller gave me one pcs of big bone with like almost no meat at all... The portion is even lesser than my house area coffee shop which sells cheaper then him.

author: Billie Perrone
review_text: Great west coast spot. Always fresh ingredients and fast friendly service. Everyone gravitates to this place. Drive thru is always crowded. Love the huge safety pins on their uniforms! I'd hate to keep those white uniforms clean!!!

author: Irene Lee
review_text: We ordered the signature platter, fried mushrooms and fried prawns. All the dishes didn't disappoint but lack the wow factor. Maybe we came with high expectations as it is a Michelin restaurant. We thought the fried mushrooms would go well with Vietnamese sauce instead of the Japanese sesame sauce. Strange to have jap sauce in a Vietnamese restaurant.

author: Vzar zack
review_text: Walked in and ignored for 10 minutes by someone walking back-and-forth with new items for the display case. Not even a hello, I’ll be with you in a minute. Forced to walk out when they disappeared to the back.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Luboš
review_text: I appreciate that this Vietnamese restaurant is open from early in the morning. The portion (40 thousand dong) was nice and slightly spicy. However, I was a bit surprised that the Bánh mì was empty when it was served to me.

author: Grace Chua
review_text: Vibrant , good and prompt service. Food is good and affordable! Pre-ordered the Lotus Seed Chicken which is hard to come by these days. The sweet and sour pork, la la soup and yam ring is very good too!

author: Nancy Cintron
review_text: It had been a while since I made it to Mompou. I was starving after our flight back home and decided to stop for some tapas. As always, Mompou did not disappoint! Our bartender was amazing and every tapas dish was excellent! We splurged and ordered the chocolate trio dessert! AMAZING!!!

author: Kee Kelven
review_text: This is the Japanese restaurant that went viral online for its huge tonkatsu, and it truly lived up to the hype. The tonkatsu portions were extremely big and very well cooked. I also really liked their miso soup and Japanese rice, which were surprisingly good. It was my first time having miso soup filled with so much chicken meat and vegetables, instead of the usual small amount of seaweed and tiny tofu found at most restaurants. Their opening time was 6pm. We arrived at 5.30pm on a Saturday, but there was already a long queue waiting outside. The restaurant only has around 16–17 seats, and unfortunately, my friend and I were the 18th in line, so we had to wait for the second round. Luckily, the staff took down everyone’s name on a waiting list, so we didn’t have to stand there the whole time. We finally got our seats after about 1 hour. The staff patiently explained the differences between the various pork cuts, and we could watch the chef cooking right in front of us. We ordered the fatty Sakura pork set and the lean premium pork set, and later added an à la carte small muscle katsu. The set came with refillable rice, cabbage, and miso soup. Out of the three types of katsu we tried, the muscle katsu was my favourite. It had a springier texture and stronger flavour compared to the others. The Sakura pork had a layer of fat that gave a unique texture and taste, but the meat itself was slightly tougher. The premium pork was somewhere in between, and honestly, I couldn’t really tell what made it “premium,” even though it was the thickest cut. That said, it was still cooked nicely with a slight pinkness in the middle. The best part of all was the light and crispy crust, which was not oily at all. Even after eating so much fried food, we didn’t feel heavy or jelak at all.

author: Harold Piel
review_text: Amazing food experience: looked at menu and was a bit overwhelmed. The cook dude just called us over and said he’d show us the food, and build a plate to our needs. Results outstanding! You got to give this a try.

author: K
review_text: Came here during a holiday and was able to get seated quickly during tea time. I got the Singapore style hainan chicken and rice and Malaysian style BBQ pork and rice. Both dishes were delicious. For the drinks, I ordered the hot lemon tea and milk tea. Both teas were good. The milk tea came in small teacup and was on the heavy side. They refill on these. They have heaters if you are seated outdoors, which was great. I'm glad I got to try this place out. The customer service is great. The restaurant is nice, clean and cozy. Overall, I enjoyed my experience here. I can't wait to come back during dinner time since the menu changes. Free street parking.

author: Liting
review_text: First time to this restaurant based on google’s recommendation. There are many food options and i ordered the crab fried rice with egg and rice noodle in soya sauce with crispy pork. For the fried rice, the restaurant was generous as quite a substantiate amount of crab meat was given and the egg was well-cooked. As for the rice noodle, it taste was just nice with abit of the ‘char’ taste. And the crispy pork was soft and not fatty. The restaurant is located near Siam Square hence, not difficult to locate. Highly recommended!

author: Robert Knott
review_text: An excellent location for dinner! The staff were friendly and attentive, the food was delicious, and the prices were an absolute deal considering the location and quality of food. I would absolutely recommend coming here for dinner. All the entrees are reasonably priced and include a free appetizer with the order, and there are great happy hour drink deals. They also get very creative with the presentation of the dishes which makes the meal even more fun.

author: Gary Bressler
review_text: AYCE is opening soon on Ft Apache in Spring Valley right by our house so we drove to Henderson to check it out and everything was great.

author: Barrett Zeto
review_text: Highly recommend this place 100%. The staff here was on top of their service, especially right after a show at the NJPAC theater. Small dining room, but made up for the very nice servers and attentive care they put on their customers. Food was fantastic, sauces are DELISH! Burgers are amazing. Cauliflower tots just as amazing. Very transparent on what they have to offer. Black owned business as well, love being able to support 🙌🏼 Much love to yall!

author: Alex Cole
review_text: Delicious food options in a fun atmosphere with attentive staff. They also offer some items to cook at home, such as packs of arepa de choclo and quesito Colombiano. They make a delicious jugo de mora en leche that I almost always get as a treat when I pick up food.

author: mikiah fribbley
review_text: Great food and even better service! Everything was fresh and flavorful, and the atmosphere was welcoming. Dani, our server, was absolutely amazing—friendly, attentive, and made the experience even better. Overall, a smooth and enjoyable visit. I’d definitely come back and recommend this place to others.

author: Chinsiong Lee
review_text: Food expensive and portion small. Asked for $12 bak kut teh was given only 4 pieces of pork rib. Didn't even asked if I wanted rib....which I didn't want. No going back again.

author: Kevin Flores
review_text: Nachos fries with cheese and steak were really good but it was a small portion. 8/10

author: Seth L
review_text: Really great food, had trouble deciding which store to eat since there are two stores selling the same dishes. But after trying this place I definitely think this is much better. Staff was also extremely friendly. 10/10 would recommend

author: Kanokrak
