review_text: Food came out really quick. Good portions and nicely balanced flavour too. We ordered less spicy which is already spicy enough, make sure you don’t go for normal spicy if you’re foreigner..

author: Ray Ju
review_text: The parking spaces for the place is more than enough. The decor is simple. The dining area is a good size. They had some pastry on display. They have coffee, tea, and soda choices off to the side. The coffee was tasty. The bear claw and muffin was pretty good. The service was good too.

author: Helder Rodrigues de Araujo
review_text: Nice food market with quite a few choices. They have two dedicated rows for Muslim food and the remainder of rows served other varieties. I settled for char siu with plain rice which came in at less than $5 SGD. very good value for a decent portion of food.

author: Isaac Kong Ley Hon
review_text: The service is good and wagyu beef Hamburg is awesome. However you should stop forcing your staff to ask for review on purpose before your customer finished the meal! This was so killing the enjoyment about food! Please consider to stop all these nonsense by asking for feedback and making it voluntary with QR code and not forcing your customer!!! Your management is such a shame!!!

author: Jerald Ici
review_text: Tried the crab fried rice and stir fried mantis shrimps that met our expectations. The Gourmet Eats food court is a gem in the city centre. Prices are expectedly higher here but you pay for convenience. Various payment modes avaliable, including credit card.

author: Brad Paradis
review_text: We snuck into the Bubba Gump Shrimp company for dinner while in downtown Miami. It was really great. The staff was attentive and amazing and we loved the Forests Gump trivia challenge amongst tables while waiting for your food. We won too!

author: Kai Neo
review_text: Super popular place with tourists and locals serving up phad thai and phad see ew, as well as krapao dishes. Personally prefer the phad see ew as it is less sweet, with an amazing chewy texture and roasty burnt garlic flavour. The tomyum soup was great too, with fresh plump prawns. Highly reccommended if you are looking for a quick bite after shopping at Siam.

author: Revelmonger
review_text: They were hosting a "Christmas Party" inside and the kitchen was apparently delayed. Anyways took over an hour to get our food and when it came out out of 5 people only 3 meals were ready. First time going to Hard Rock Cafe as my friends were telling me how great it was. Anyways it basically ruined the evening. If the kitchen can't handle a party and it's regular activities maybe they shouldn't be open to both at all. Wish we had just been told there was a delay instead of being seated and starving.

author: Hatsune Miku
review_text: MacPherson Market & Food centre offers food that start off at lower prices that seems to cater more to the eldery. Lower prices here also translate to smaller portions. Food served here is slightly below average and you won't find anything stellar here. The only stall worth mentioning here is the vegetarian stall that serves vegetarian food at affordable prices. You will be hard-pressed to find vegetarian bee hoon at $3.50. Portions of vegetarian bee hoon are also generous, and this is one of the stalls I frequent often. Another stall worth mentioning is the yong tau foo stall that also sells laksa and char kway teow. Personally, I rather enjoyed their laksa yong tau foo and I feel that this is a hidden gem. Whatever the case, the food here will not blow you away. There are a few stalls here, but there is still a good variety of food options. This place is good if you want to spend a little less on your meals.

author: DIEGO MORALES
review_text: Ordered the Al pastor torta. I was surprised it was really good. Small portion, fries were cold. Appetizers we ordered queso fundido and guacamole. That was really good. The drinks were okay, but the service was terrible. I had a torta de al pastor and it was really good, but it’s hard to appreciate a solid menu when the poor service drags everything down—especially with gratuity already included. I ordered one drink I really liked, but the server never came back to see if I wanted another; I probably would have ordered three more rounds. I was with a group, and even though the menu states that gratuity is included, our server acted like they didn’t need to earn it. Our bill was $200, and paying an added $36 for almost no service felt steep. Overall, the dine-in service is bad, and I won’t be coming back.

author: Leelawadee Mangade
review_text: This was my first time trying Babi Guling. It was delicious. Unfortunately, the day we came, the crispy pig skin was already sold out, so we got pork floss instead. If you're Thai or anyone else who likes spicy and flavorful tastes, don't miss this place! It's delicious and deeply savory! (Pro-tip: Don't hesitate to add more chili for extra heat!)

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Giancarlo Manco
review_text: We had a fantastic breakfast at The Hive. I went for the salmon toast with poached eggs, while my girlfriend chose the avocado toast. Both dishes were really well done—fresh ingredients and great balance of flavors. We also ordered two cappuccinos, one with almond milk, and finished with a gluten-free chocolate donut. The cappuccinos were spot on, and the donut was a perfect sweet treat to end the meal. Everything tasted fresh, and the ingredients were well-balanced and flavorful. The portions were satisfying without being too heavy, and the overall quality really stood out. If you’re looking for a spot with great food and attention to detail, The Hive is definitely worth a visit.

author: Lester Chong
review_text: Although it's a touristy joint and a little pricy compared to the more local ones. Would still recommend it. Friendly staff with fuss free ordering system. Delicious food with easy to choose options. Don't miss this Babi Guling when around here.

author: Qiao Yi Ng
review_text: Food portion very small with price given. Food not as good and affordable as before renovation. Green curry is too sweet.

author: Tom Lloyd
review_text: this is a classic malaysian indian mamak restaurant place. Serving great range of nasi kandar, best to go up get rice and pick what you like the look of to accompany your rice. I had some beef curry, brinjal (eggplant) and veg curry with biryani rice. tasty and cheap. It seems as though this place has become internet famous in China for their roti tissue dish, with many young tourists coming to order this and take photos, so it can often be busy currently. By only trying out the large photo oppurtunity of roti tissue, you will miss o it on the many traditional excellent options of nasi kandar and other dishes they do have available here!

author: Veronica Lim
review_text: Very nice ambience, delicious food. We ordered : ✔️Spicy Food and Pork Noodle Hotpot The soup is very rich of flavour, and it’s not too spicy ✔️Grilled Pork Jowl The meat is very juicy with a bit crispy layer outside, it’s so good even without the dipping sauce ✔️Stewed Pork and Egg with five spices Just like taiwanese braised pork, it’s nice as well Overall i’ll give it ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

author: SY Tan
review_text: Love the wide selection of indo food here! Food came very quickly too and I love their spicy nasi goreng as well as the side dishes (not the chicken satay which was too sweet for my liking)

author: Ken Tan
review_text: Haven’t had curry puff for a while and wanted a light snack. Saw TipTop curry puff stall and tried out their flaky puff set. Chicken curry flaky puff tasted ok but will prefer the normal curry puff which contain egg and have a firmer bite. Teh tasted reasonably good.

author: Richard Cheah
review_text: A Disappointing Experience at Onn Kee Chicken Rice. I'm usually not one to write negative reviews, but my recent experience at Onn Kee Chicken Rice was a letdown, to say the least. My family visited this popular eatery, expecting a delicious and satisfying meal. Unfortunately, our expectations were not met. We ordered the 3-portion chicken for the three of us, but the servings were surprisingly small. There was hardly any meat on the bone, and we were left feeling unsatisfied. For a chicken rice stall, you'd expect the chicken to be the star of the show, but sadly, it was a letdown. The oil rice was another disappointment. It was plain and felt like eating glue. The rice stuck together in clumps, making it unappetizing to eat. I've had better oil rice at other stalls, and this was a far cry from the delicious, fluffy rice I'm used to. The chilli sauce was also a letdown. It was diluted and lacked the spicy kick I'm used to. For a stall that's supposed to the specialty of Ipoh well known and specialize in chicken rice, you'd expect the chilli sauce to be a highlight, but unfortunately, it was a disappointment. To be honest, I've had better chicken rice in Singapore, and I wouldn't recommend Onn Kee to anyone looking for a delicious and satisfying meal. Unless they seriously revamp their recipe and improve their service, I'd advise eating at Onn Kee at your own risk. Honestly, hiring foreigners has affected the image. To make matters worse, living in its yester years of past glory, sooner and not later, you will see the name become a past history. Rating: 2/5 stars Will I return? Unlikely.

author: Andrew Truong
review_text: This place is huge with private rooms but you’ll have to book early because it is very busy! They do several course meals depending on what you choose. Usually hosts parties and events so not the place you go to if you want a quiet evening. Service was great

author: Alondra Robertson
review_text: They messed up on my order and had to send it back to the kitchen. Main entrée was decent, hashbrowns over cooked hard on top! The server had an aggressive attitude service change after the manager came out. Sat in the booth area drink area was extremely dirty. Someone spilled coffee over 5 different employees, walked by, and none bothered to clean it up. Ice been maintained open only ONE server closed it the whole time I was there. NO server used a scooper for the ice all scooped up ice with cup in hand.

author: HL Yap
review_text: The Google review you read are real and genuine. All their food are so great! We have a take away ordered through Grab and the serving are professional and generous. The take away is nicely packed. Jumbo crab curry and Jumbo crab glass noodle is must try items from menu

author: Neil Fairley
review_text: We have eaten here many times. The food, atmosphere and service are all tremendous it I superb value for money too. The satay sauce is to die for. Please if you read this get me email and send me the recipe so I can make it at home. 🙏photo says it all.

author: Mayra Ortiz
review_text: At first when I saw the menu i didn’t know what it was and I was unhappy, than came our waiter to help us explain the what the dish were I was still a little off until the appetizers came they were delicious than came the main course I was blow away with the taste and the presentation I do say you need to try this restaurant if your not sure exactly the menu is ask for help and they would be gladly to help I do t like to give 5* but they deserve it. You might think it’s expensive but it’s not we had drinks appetizer main dish and dessert all for under 150. Yes we order many drinks

author: Christopher Benitez
review_text: If you're craving the real taste of the Dominican Republic, drop everything and RUN—don't walk—to this incredible Dominican restaurant serving up some of the best mangú and authentic Dominican dishes in all of New England. Yes, you read that right. Delicious! From the moment you step inside, you're greeted with warm smiles and an unmistakable aroma that hits you right in the soul—like abuela's kitchen on a Sunday morning. The place is spotless, cozy, and full of good vibes. Whether you’re grabbing breakfast or lunch, this spot NEVER misses. Their mangú? Creamy, rich, perfectly seasoned and paired with the most mouthwatering onions, salami, eggs, and queso frito you've ever tasted. It's the kind of meal that makes you sit back, close your eyes, and say, “THIS is what life’s about.” And everything else on the menu? Equally 🔥. The food is always fresh, the portions are generous, and the prices? Very reasonable Customer service is great. The staff makes you feel like family from the second you walk in. It's no wonder regulars keep coming back, and new customers quickly become loyal fans. This small business is easy to find and deserves all the love. So next time you're thinking about where to eat, skip the chain restaurants and do your taste buds a favor—go here ASAP. ⚠️ Don't sleep on this place. Your stomach will thank you. Your soul will too. Dominican flavor. New England’s best. Support local. Eat unforgettable. GO NOW. 🇩🇴💥

author: Ryan Tanjung
review_text: I truly enjoyed having a meeting and dinner at this restaurant. The authentic Indonesian food was exceptionally tasteful, with rich flavors that really stood out. I also loved the ambience — warm, comfortable, and perfect for both casual dining and professional discussions. It was a pleasant place to unwind while still staying productive. No worries, I will definitely be back, especially with my academic colleagues on future occasions.

author: Scott Bradford
review_text: Chirping bird sounds was a bit much. Although some will like the very busy decorations I felt it to be plastic feeling and too much. The prices were reasonable and food passable. They were able to seat our group of 20 at one table.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Heang Malaythong-Suy
review_text: The Bun Bo was very good. The couple that owns the place were so personable and very nice. Would definitely come back again!

author: Angela Spafford
review_text: Best chicken bánh mì in the Mission! The bread is cooked perfectly. We came for lunch and will be back often.

author: Batuhan
review_text: Absolutely do not go to this McDonald’s in Miami. I ordered a large milkshake and got a medium instead. The female employee who served me was rude, disrespectful, and completely unprofessional. Worst service I’ve ever experienced. Totally unacceptable. Avoid this place at all costs!

author: Faith
review_text: Atmosphere kind of busy because it's located on the boardwalk. Great for vegetarians. The congris: black beans 🫘 and rice was okay. Maybe i should have tasted it before eating the Kuba Fried Rice (V) I added eggs 🥚 it was delicious 😋 one of my top best rice I've had so far. The snapper & Sandwich Kubano was also very flavored and succulent. Only downside is gnats was swarming around my personal vinergeret salad 🥗 I just covered all my plates up until I was ready to divulge into them 😉 great servers kind of pricey but you pay for quality of food right? 😉 It was wroth it will visit again

author: Bugwagen
review_text: Food was excellent, especially their prawn creamy rice. We wanted the creamy crab but it was out of stock that day. Hope to try it next time. The large prawn dish was out of the menu, delicious but expensive. Service was good. We arrived just before noon and managed to get a table. The place soon filled up cause it is not very big. Few tables.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: NJ H
review_text: I love this place. They have the best fresh catch salad. I get it like once a week. I’m obsessed. Staff is nice. Food is clean. Try it out.

author: Joseph Thomas
review_text: Live music, good ambience and lots of food options. A great place to hang out with friends. Also there are a lot of other bars to hang around in the area outside.

author: E H
review_text: On Christmas Eve, we had dinner at Lau Pa Sat, an iconic hawker centre housed in its distinctive octagonal cast-iron structure, recognised as a national monument. With around 80 food stalls, it truly offers something for everyone. From chilli crab and dumplings to teppanyaki, the range of Asian cuisines is impressive—I even got a little lost trying to find our table. My 82-year-old mother couldn’t stop talking about the egg tarts for days. Just outside is the open-air Satay Street, where the entire road is lined with tables and chairs and around ten satay stalls. The smoky aroma from the grills is irresistible and naturally draws you in. Some may say it’s a tourist spot, but I’m proud to be a tourist. Places like this are exactly why we travel, and we absolutely loved the experience.

author: Ray Ray
review_text: Went there with family. Luckily it's the period of time kids can come in. I went in through the stairs entrance. But turns out there's a ground level entrance. The design of the place is really cool. As if being thrown back to the old times full of luxury vibes. Ordered the food and drinks. Unfortunately kids do not enjoy the food. And there's no kids option. Well that makes sense, since the concept i guess supposed to be a lounge. Even the main centerpoint is actually this cool looking bar with the top shelf is like 4 or 5 meters high. But aside from there's no kids food option, among all the food i ordered, only 1 of them i can say that i think is good and will order more. The drink collection is impressive though. But since i was there with family, couldn't give them a try. So next time when returning, will try the drinks.

author: Tay Huiyi
review_text: Bun Cha was very good, dipping sauce was well made and flavourful, and the meats and meatball were exceptional

author: Chris Duffy
review_text: We went to Sam’s for breakfast today. Our server Caroline was amazing. The staff was friendly. The El Jefe Burrito was top 3 breakfast sandwiches I’ve ever had! We’ll back next time we’re in town

author: Chris Yanke
review_text: These people work so hard to keep this place clean the food taste delicious and I am so thankful for McDonald’s. I’m going to end them. This particular location has a lot of fun music from the app is super easy but sometimes I still like to go to the real person the girl was very quick and very helpful. The old standby is burrito plus the extra one things to rewards in the sugar-free vanilla iced coffee. Let me tell you nothing puts the sweet bag in my sugar again yummy McDonald’s burgers. These guys do a great job !!

author: Anova Fatimah
review_text: There’s usually a long queue in front of this place, which says a lot about its popularity, both for the food and the interior atmosphere. We visited right after our morning run around 10 a.m., so there was no line and we were able to get in immediately. The interior truly lives up to the hype, and the food is classic Indonesian cuisine with rich spices, many dishes leaning toward the spicy side. The staff were friendly and helpful, taking the time to inform us about ongoing promotions. Overall, it was a pleasant and satisfying dining experience worth coming early for.

author: Jea Kim
review_text: Amazing views, & vibes and solid seafood dishes. Came here with my colleagues for an early dinner on a weekday. The restaurant was in a secluded pier with all the boats and storage yards, so compared to other bay area restaurants I’ve been to in the area, it felt more private. The patio got eventually packed by the time we were about to leave, but we were able to snag a table right away. We started off with some oysters, shrimps, and sautéed mussels. To be honest, the oysters and the shrimps were disappointing. The oysters lacked brininess, and overall it was just too mild. The jumbo shrimp looked great, but they were slightly overcooked and came out a tad rubbery. The mussels were satisfying and the white sauce was on point. For the entrées, we opted for the scallops, swordfish, and the blackened chicken pasta. My colleague said the scallops were his favorite, and it was the most solid dish of the three. The rice grains were perfectly al dente, and I liked how they used the claw meats instead of the tail to amplify that natural lobster flavors. They also cut it in long chunks which helped accentuate its texture. Some of the scallop pieces weren’t exactly the freshest, but a solid dish overall. For entrées we had the scallops, swordfish, and blackened chicken pasta. My colleague was all about the scallops, and I’d say they were the best of the three. The rice had a good al dente bite, and I liked that they used claw meat instead of tail as it gave the lobster flavor a little more depth. Cutting it into long chunks made the texture pop too. Not every scallop tasted super fresh, but overall it was a pretty satisfying plate. The swordfish was probably the thickest I’ve ever seen served as a steak, and even with the crisped edges it stayed fairly moist. Swordfish is usually kind of boring to me, but the crunchy bits in each bite kept it more interesting. Small tip: swap the fingerling potatoes for risotto—the extra moisture makes a big difference. As for the blackened chicken pasta, it had a pleasant kick, but otherwise was pretty standard. Would come back to soak in the vibes and enjoy the waterfront setting. Food’s on par with some of the good seafood places I’ve been around Boston, but not the best in the area.

author: Anita Robin
review_text: We dined here on our trip to Bali last week, it turned out be one of the best meals we had! We tried the Pho, Bahn mi, the spring rolls, kefir and more...The food, the ambience and the whole experience was brilliant, must try place in Kuta

author: L Chan
review_text: A long-running neighbourhood market & hawker centre built in the 1970s, with both wet market stalls & cooked food. Popular in the mornings & afternoons for affordable local eats, but like most heartland markets, most stalls close by late afternoon. By evening the place is dark & quiet, with only a handful of stalls still open. Recently upgraded with better flooring, lighting & ventilation, it remains a true community hub serving the daily needs of Geylang East.

author: Tom Tyrone Beiron Tay
review_text: Where is there a quiet yet happy environment in Terminal One Transit you can enjoy a sip, delicious meal and a respite from work or travel… Right here at Harry’s for sure. Whether in airport staff uniform or holiday travel attire, Kuya and Claire will be perfect hosts to welcome and help you chill before you get up go. Love the Jazz Burger - my favourite here, thanks to the wagyu beef patty (not in the photos) - and have had the chilli crab pasta and sweet and sticky pork skewers (highly recommend these!), as well as the superbly prepared chicken tikka served with naan flat bread. The latter has won the heart and palate of at least one mate. Service here at Harry’s T1 is warm, cosy, genuine and yes, just about the best within Changi’s Transit area. You can also find them at Terminal 3, and the staff do move between both locations. Again, Kuya and Claire and their terrific colleagues, will be on hand to help you enjoy your meal and chill. Don’t be shy, come in… and yes, do drop a tip and neat review here for them, too.

author: Christina McGold (Christie)
review_text: I have been coming here since 1994. Im great friends with the owner, Hasan! I'm a big fan of a few specific dishes here. A Grate Salad, add Fried Chicken. M&M sandwich No bread. Homemade sausage patty, side of red beans, side of smoked bacon collard greens. Thats a full meal.

author: Paul Kohn
review_text: Even though it was busy, I still got great service. Food is amazing!

author: Travis Lim
review_text: One of the best there is. Not too small either. Although not the cheapest compared to other places but it is worth every cent. Highly recommend if you are shopping in the vicinity.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: iingz TD
review_text: There are a lot of mosquitoes in the evening, so food comes out slowly.

author: Sharron green
review_text: Food is amazing staff is so friendly and prices isn't bad you need to tell them how saucey you like your wings but that's fine it's more than enough for my family of seven they don't disappoint

author: Don Perry III
review_text: This place is incredible. The food was ridiculously good. The service was amazing. The drinks were delicious. The food, drinks, dessert and service make it worth the money. Will definitely be coming back here soon!

author: Rui Woon
review_text: This review got a 3 star purely base on food. Dim sum originated from the China and is consider part of Kantonese dish. If you are from China especially Hong Kong Malaysia, Singapore, I'll say give it a pass.

author: Joel Koh
review_text: I recently enjoyed the set meal for lunch for two at Rosso Vino and had a wonderful experience. The food was delicious and well-prepared, but what really elevated our visit was the excellent service provided by C Yan and Danny. They were attentive, friendly, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our meal. The combination of good food and outstanding service makes Rosso Vino a great choice for lunch, and I'd highly recommend it to anyone looking for a quality dining experience.

author: Wai Yee Leong
review_text: We ordered the chicken kuey teow soup and dry curry chicken mee. Go early, before 8am, or the waiting time gets very long. The chicken kuey teow soup had smooth, silky kuey teow and a light prawn fragrance in the soup. However, the soup portion was quite little and slightly cold when served, likely because the noodles are cooked in batches. The dry curry chicken mee was good. I liked the mint and curry combination, and the calamansi worked well with the curry. The pork ball and fishballs also are recommended! Very tasty, and bouncy. Waiting time was around 1 hour. After eating the dry curry noodles, the chicken kuey teow soup tasted quite mild in comparison. The service is good as the waitress are attentive. Personally, if the waiting time is around 1 hour, I wouldn’t come back.

author: Sean Goh
review_text: Finally tried this Halal fried kway teow from Bukit Merah View Hawker Centre. I wanted to try this the other time round when i was here for lunch, unfortunately they were closed and i try their neighbor stall, coincidentally also sells fried kway teow too. Got to know of this stall through a Tv interview and saved the place ever since. Reached there late afternoon and there wasn't any queue and i was able to order immediately. Prices for the char kway teow starts from SGD$4.5 onwards. Portion for the fried kway teow was generous. its comes with sliced fishcakes and cockles which was a little small. Taste wise, not bad, hint of wok hei but seems to be lacking in flavors. Overall, a decent fried kway teow that i have tried lately. The owner is actually very friendly, even managed to strike a conversation with him while he was preparing the food.

author: Meidi Anhar
review_text: Remboelan is a highly-recommended the authentic Indonesian cuisine,Friendly ServiceStaff are consistently described as friendly, interiors for being comfortable. The best 👍

author: Hank Peng
review_text: Seriously, I don't get it. Mama noodles are okay, but definitely not worth waiting an hour and 40 minutes for. They make you download the QueQ app to get a number, and then you wait to be called. And if you're not there when they call your number, you gotta start all over. One dish worth mentioning is the spicy salmon salad. It's good～

author: flo joylene
review_text: Absolutely loved my meal at Korata Bangkok. the spicy pork ribs were fall-off-the-bone tender with just the right heat that lingers pleasantly, and the crab omelet was rich, fluffy, and generously filled with sweet crab meat. The friendly, attentive service made the experience even better. Comforting yet exciting flavors with a warm welcome, a must-try in the city!

author: Ernest Webb
review_text: It's clean but there is no taste except for style lettuce and taco shells . I'm done with this place for ever.

author: Stephanie Grant
review_text: The best food I’ve had in my ENTIRE life. My husband and I shared the steak dinner for two and it was perfect. Cooked to perfection. Flavored to perfection. I just cannot stress enough how delicious the food was. The atmosphere is so charming and romantic. Please visit this place!!!

author: Paula Calleja
review_text: My family and I came to have lunch and loved this restaurant. We had the set menu with papaya salad, dumplings, grilled chicken and eggplant. Everything was delicious. I am gluten free and I was able to eat everything in the menu. I would very much recommend it.

author: Eddie St. Louis
review_text: Amazing Christmas dinner. Our annual tradition of a nice steak dinner and A movie lives on!!! Such a great restaurant. I may have to come once a month at minimum!! Thank you for an incredible experience.

author: s vivekananda
review_text: Excellent food court with variety of local hawker food offerings including dosa, noodles, popiah, rojak, chendol, fried rice 🍚. Open 24 hours. Pricing is reasonable and preparation of orders is prompt. Dine in or takeaway options available

author: Swiss
review_text: Here the menu is simple . They only serve bali guling with minimal variations and drink, crisps on the table . Babi guling was good but similar to other local Indonesian food, you got to enjoy this meal with open, adventurous mindset, to explore different taste profiles in food .

author: Charles G
review_text: Wow! what a great place to eat, relax, and enjoy the great vibes, that the kind folks at Hubble Bubble Lounge have created. The best hookah ever, great drinks.. INCREDIBLE FOOD! You will feel completely welcomed by the whole staff who are all lovely, and very attentive to make sure that your whole service is perfect! They also showcase some great DJs that bring amazing sound live to the lounge setting. What more could you ask for?! This place is epic! Go for dinner, a date, a drink, some tea, great hookah, and awesome music. Excellent! 11/10

author: Marve Darwin Peter Gutierrez
review_text: ALWAYS Double check your order , every time I order something they swap it to other customers, and sometimes my order is incomplete.

author: C B
review_text: I LOVE Panera and I eat here a lot!! The food is always fresh & delicious and the drive up works great when you are in a hurry. The soups & sandwiches are THE BEST and the bakery items to die for especially the french baguette!! It is addicting!! Love the bagels & orange scones too!! YUM!!!! Friendly staff too!!

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Pu Lê
review_text: I ordered SPF but there was no fish sauce, so what am I supposed to eat? The restaurant intentionally provided the wrong phone number so I couldn't reach them; they're dishonest in their business practices!

author: Zachary Warmath
review_text: Great value for money. I have never finished my plate ($17), and I always leave fulfilled. Also, free water with entrée is a great touch, and the honey walnut baklava is incredible. I will keep coming back, even though it is near Northeastern.

author: Pratha Shan
review_text: 6 of us came for dinner and we had a good time. Staffs are well trained. Food was good. I loved the salted egg pasta, calamari, fruit de lune and rack of lamb. Nice ambience too. Nick and Tina took good care of us.

author: Michelle Zhang
review_text: I was impressed by the portion size and the quality of the pho!! I got some shumai as well, and it was also soft and tender! Will come back!

author: Kee Kelven
review_text: One of the hottest spot on the street that always full of customers. Many customers waiting in line to take away, and their tables are always full of customers waiting for the food. The food usually served really fast but to be honest the hygiene of this place was not really satisfying lah. We loved both Dai Lok Mee 大碌面 and Sang Mian 生面. The Dai Lok Mee was cooked with hot wok hei, thick soy sauce and pork lard, also came with pork meat and shrimp. The Sang Mian was noodles fried until crispy and then covered with thick soup with pork meat and shrimp, so we could taste both crispy noodles and soft noodles that soaked with the soup. You must have it with their pickled chilli and sambal chilli sauce.

author: Sabs A
review_text: Ipoh Kopitiam in Alhambra is a great spot for authentic Southeast Asian flavors that are hard to find in California. The roti was easily my favorite dish - crispy, flaky, and absolutely delicious. The wantan mee with curry chicken was very tasty and especially nostalgic, reminding me of my trips to Singapore, though I would’ve loved the option for boneless chicken or BBQ pork instead. The beef rendang was flavorful and rich, with a noticeable kick of spice. Service was genuinely excellent - friendly, attentive, and often anticipating our needs - and while pricing was decent, the generous portions meant we happily took leftovers home.

author: Simon P
review_text: Delicious food that you order online via the app for pickup in store. Service is usually good but can be a miss sometimes.

author: Victoria Prokopovych
review_text: I really loved this place! We had breakfast inside, but there are also plenty of cozy tables outside in the backyard. The atmosphere was great and the service was excellent, the staff were very friendly and welcoming. We ordered the avo toast, PLT croissant, and Dubai latte, and everything was delicious. Highly recommend!

author: Linda Nador
review_text: We had Americanos, which were perfect, perfectly brewed and delicious. We also had a cinnamon stone and a blueberry scone. The scones are softer than typical scones, but I enjoyed them that way, it was different l.

author: Cary Rich
review_text: I was early for a business meeting nearby and had not had breakfast yet. I was told that Cacique was THE place that all of the nearby construction crews dine at. So I tried it. Great, friendly service and wonderful food. I highly recommend it!

author: Carlos Cuello
review_text: I’ve been going to Coach House for decades now. My first time there was in 1987 or 1988. God I loved this place. It was my daughter’s favorite spot to go eat. Throughout the years the food quality and service declined. As I was parking the car to go in there, I called my daughter to let her know that I was there. She told me her last time there was not a good experience and that she would never go back. I got upset but we had parked the car sans we were hungry. From the very beginning, the upgrades were extremely noticeable, the service exceeded any expectation that I may have had. Isaac, our server went above and beyond. Nothing was forced, it came naturally to him. If you could clone Isaac that place will never fail any patron. Without writing anything down, he remembered every detail of our appetizers, main course and the many different desserts with specific requests that all 3 of us had. This place is back on my to go back and eat again list. He didn’t even mention anything to us about writing him a review but his service was 5 stars. The cappuccino and the simple but classy strawberry cheesecake drizzled with chocolate syrup was to die for. The pistachio cheesecake with pistachio ice cream was delicious and presentation on point. Extremely elegant! The raspberry white chocolate cheesecake was extremely delicious. What a great experience. Again, kudos to Isaac for making our experience there a great one. Can’t wait to go back!!!

author: vu nguyen
review_text: Michelin recommended pho spot in d1 in Saigon. Lots of iterations of pho and a extensive beverage selection

author: Stacy Rohrer
review_text: This place is great. The food is good and very reasonable. The staff have all been very friendly. We will be back again and again and again. Cheers!!

author: Evelyn Cota
review_text: This place is stunning! The staff is fun and playful. The food is delicious! Our waiter had great suggestions for us. They were very attentive to our table. The food marked labeled as "spicy" is moderately spicy but nothing overwhelming. The portions are sizeable. If you're looking for authentic Mexican food, this is a great choice.

author: Kitprasert Srisamran
review_text: Really enjoyed the food, the chill vibe, and how fast everything came out. It wasn’t crowded, and they had some good promos too. Great place to hang out after work.

author: Isabella Nobriga
review_text: They should let you know when they have a special menu for certain holidays. Dishes were much more expensive on mothers day and my favorite dish was excluded from the menu. Service was subpar even though I've seen it busier. Overall I resent having to pay more for food I really didn't want.

author: Ashley C
review_text: Step back into the 1970s with this evil Knievel-themed pizza restaurant located right on Fremont Street that offers some no-frills New York style slices and a whole lot of evil iconography. You can even try your skills on the evil pinball machine while you wait for your pizza. We started off with the cheese slice and evil ale for only eight bucks. The slices were large, hot, greasy, and everything you’d want in a New York style pizza. The aisle was really good, too, and the price can’t be beat. We got a little adventurous with the sweet heat slice. I love the pepperoni and jalapeño, but the hot honey was a little much for me - still good though. We finished with an order of the Led Zeppoli, and if you haven’t had these yet, you’re definitely missing out. They’re delicious! This one is 4.5 out of five, and will definitely be back. On to the next!

author: Nate MrInk
review_text: Must try when visiting vegas. Portions are Huge and Very Very Fresh. Pricing is excellent aswell. So if you want to save a few dollars versus eating at the strip this is your spot. Food quality is better than most asian cuisine on the strip

author: Datcanraw Chandrarao
review_text: Great service, the sandwiches are hefty, reasonably priced and has balanced taste. Underrated store in Batu Kawan

author: Blasco Sanchez Neira
review_text: Do not come. They scam and include $10 dollar tip under the “taxes” section. They systematically do this and I confirmed this by their attitude when I exposed them. The food is BELOW average. Avoid them at all cost.

author: Joseph Chin
review_text: My review is on (not the food center) but L2 vendors. Many old time vendors have been there for over 40 years! And NTUC is opening an outlet too. But i like to promote one interesting used book stall run by a lady named Ah Fang very friendly and worthy of our browsing through and support oki

author: Lisa Eckel
review_text: Do not miss this spot! Our waiter Alfonso was awesome!! Get the latte with your own photo! Coffee delish. Crepe amazing. So glad we came!

author: MRS. KR
review_text: This barbecue spot is really good, it surprise me. The host was straight forward not friendly. It took a while for our server to come to the table. But when she did and the drinks and food came out, the story changed… delicious margarita and the platter was amazing however the Mac n cheese just not my style. The dessert was just enough to satisfy the sweet tooth. Really good place, I would go back and recommend!!

author: Joseph Yiong (Joseph Yiong)
review_text: This is absolutely worth to try as it’s delicious. Especially like the half boiled egg with gravy.

author: Brendan Collins
review_text: Best food I’ve had in Boston. This place is one of my favorite restaurants in the city!

author: Michal Carmel
review_text: Great place for drinks & small/big plates :) The place is vegetarian but it’s a non issue as everything’s so good so you can enjoy a whole meal without paying attention to it. The drinks are VERY good - especially on happy hour (afternoon of discounts on specific wine glasses, beers and cocktails) + they have daily offers (Wednesday afternoon all wine bottles are half price). A MUST - appetizers of broccolini and cauliflower alongside with cold sangria & a twist of espresso martini

author: JASON
review_text: 9.5sgd definitely not worth the price, the soup is basicly tasteless and the YOUTIAO is HARDER than my life!! I usually dip youtiao in soup like few seconds but now i leave it there like fishball nia.

author: Bianca
review_text: Good food at Milk & Madu Seminyak. Great service from waiters named Dicky. He explains the menu and promo to us while other waiters didn’t explain as well as he did. He told us theres brekkie set and shows whats the best menu patiently. Hes also fast response and helps us a lot. Thanks Dicky!

author: Uyên Nguyễn Ngọc Phương
review_text: The meat is fresh and tender, but the ribs should be scored or divided into long strips to make it easier to grill. The jellyfish salad is not very harmonious in taste, the spicy taste is overwhelming the other ingredients. The restaurant has a dish of salted leaves with fragrant flavor, which goes well with the meat. In addition, the vegetable tray is fresh and the portion is just right.

author: 밥버걸
review_text: I had one of the worst dining experiences at Felix Trattoria. Our server, a white blonde woman, seemed friendly on the surface—but what happened with the food was unacceptable. First, we ordered the walnut salad. It arrived with absolutely no walnuts. Strangely enough, the table right next to us got the exact same salad at the same time, and theirs was full of walnuts. When I pointed this out, the server apologized and just brought walnuts on the side. At first, I thought it was just a mistake or bad luck. Then the shrimp (gamberoni) came out—salty but still decent. The real nightmare started after that. We waited 20–30 minutes for our pizza while the table next to us got theirs much faster. We brushed it off, but after finishing the pizza, we ended up waiting another 40 minutes for our pasta. By then, we were furious. When the pasta finally arrived, it was inedible. It was so salty it actually tasted bitter. It was the kind of salt overload that makes you feel like even in death, your body still wouldn’t decompose. Everyone at the table took one bite and gave up. The pasta texture itself was fine, but serving food like that is disgraceful. On the outside, the staff put on a smile, but if you’re going to play games with the food, that’s something this restaurant should be ashamed of. Especially since this place was recommended by someone we trust, and they specifically said it wasn’t salty. That makes me believe this wasn’t an accident—it felt deliberate. And as if that wasn’t enough, when we asked for the check, they brought us the wrong bill. We had ordered four dishes and a glass of wine, but the check showed $440—obviously not ours. Imagine if we hadn’t noticed. So here’s my advice: if you ever dine here, always double-check your bill unless you want to get ripped off. So thanks for giving us the worst dining experience possible. But here’s a tip: don’t ever do this again. Tourists aren’t stupid. And if this was rooted in discrimination, that only shows your true lack of class.

author: kevin B
review_text: Very nice and delicious. Have a good private room and best service

author: Juliana Alhattab
review_text: I had a great experience here! The pizza was absolutely delicious — fresh, flavorful, and perfectly cooked. The service was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere was calm and relaxing, which made the whole visit even more enjoyable. The place itself is beautiful and has a peaceful vibe. After the meal, you can take a lovely walk by the river — the riverbank is perfect for a stroll, especially at sunset. Such a perfect spot for a cozy and relaxing evening!

author: Celena L
review_text: Didn’t like the meat or buffet selection. The hush puppies were good, fries and fried banana were good also. Drinks were strong, didn’t have a big cocktail menu. Disappointed they didn’t have the cheese ball. Never been to a Rodizio like this. Barely received any steak options, meats were either over cooked or too seasoned. Oh they gave fresh chips, those were good also. Service was slow, no one came back to us for a while to see if we wanted anything besides the Rodizio.

author: Adrian C.L.
review_text: La Chuperia is definitely a must! It’s the perfect spot to pregame if you’re heading to an event at BMO or the Coliseum. They’ve got a great variety of specialty drinks from Micheladas to spiked agua frescas and every one looks better than the last. As soon as my eyes landed on the Chuper Mango Cart Michelada, I knew what I was ordering. Topped with fresh mango chunks and paired with Mango Cart beer… 10/10, hands down! I even had to snap a pic and send it to my wife, promising a trip here soon (though let’s be real, that promise was more for me 😂). The vibe is lively, the drinks are on point, and while the food menu leans more appetizer-style, it’s still solid. Just don’t roll in starving come for the drinks, the energy, and the good times.

author: Wendy Nunez
review_text: these females at the window are disrespectful and lazy they don’t wanna do they job! all they do is wanna yell and get mad ! I’m a UBER EATS DRIVER i didn’t wanna wait on the drive thru when i’m just picking up a order and they got mad because someone was ordering and i went in front of them i had to cancel the order ! DONT WASTE YOUR MONEY HERE

author: qwxxn_ isabella
review_text: The customer service was awful and they were rude. They gave small portions for the food I ordered and the food was cold. In my wrapped quesadilla there was a dot of sauce and the chicken was charred and the cheese wasn’t melted. Additionally, they forgot to put rice in the combo I ordered.

author: RED EVE
review_text: Tried this restaurant due to their good ratings. Would have given higher ratings if the fried chicken and lele were not overcooked. Expected the rice to be fragrant Thai rice but turned out not. Overall the food portion was adequate and price was reasonable.

author: Kaye Aboltivo-Yason
review_text: There's a lot of food and drink choices that are affordable! Located just a few steps from Bedok Mall and bus station. This Curry chicken bee hoon was so good. There was a short queue to get your order, but it's worth it. I paired it with iced milo to ease the spiciness

author: Kismet
review_text: Best pizza in town and reheats the next day even better (that’s if there’s leftovers)! I enjoy supporting a small family business that really cares and creates delicious food. Can’t wait u until the next time I can treat myself!

author: BUSAIKUNA ISHIMOTO
review_text: Food here slaps and is not overpriced. It has a WIDE variety of selections compared to other small mamaks I’ve been to and the chefs here know how to cook well. Warning though, it is better to dine in than ordering on grab, as the portions are very small. This place is quite good and is very busy even during midnight.

author: Ed Hendel
review_text: Fantastic pad see ew and morning glory. The crab fried rice and the spicy catfish were mediocre. There can be a long line if you come after 5pm.

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: Glen Yu
review_text: Mind-blowingly good! Every spoonful was packed with authentic taste. These boat noodles truly capture the essence of Bangkok street food. Authentic and incredibly tasty! Seriously, best boat noodles in town.

author: Savira Sandra Priscilla
review_text: Definitely will come back here! The best Osteria Gia branch I’ve ever visited. I had a wonderful dining experience here. The staff were friendly and attentive especially Suci, the dishes were beautifully cooked, and the portion sizes were generous. The restaurant has a warm ambiance that makes it perfect for both casual meals and special occasions. Highly recommended!

author: Bảo Hân Hồ
review_text: Shop 1-21 My first meal in Singapore after a while I order 1 pork leg and 1 rice: the pork so tender and well marinated, sauce is little bit thick and perfectly pair with rice highly reccomend this shop

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Linda Yonemoto
review_text: Excellent steamy hot bun bo hue dac biet (special beef noodle soup bowl with lots of toppings) for 50k. This version came with cha, blood cube, sliced meat, pork leg with skin on, green onion and cilantro. Added 5k for the crisp banh mi. The broth was very flavorful. The pickled garlic and carrot in a jar were a delightful addition. There were also green chiles, limes, dried red chiles, and fish sauce on the table. I left the restaurant happy and very, very full and committed to returning again. The family that operates the restaurant is friendly and nice. Pricing is transparent. If you are a tourist/foreigner, don't hesitate to come here. It's across a school and lots of families eat in the good and extra clean restaurant. Tip: the price varies according to toppings. Just like a pizza, the more toppings or more premium toppings will be more money. You can get a lower price bowl, but I highly recommend the dac biet for 50k. It's very delicious and lots of food. Come early! It's a great spot for breakfast and the restaurant was extra busy in the morning.

author: Bobby Lornimitdee
review_text: It's comfortable for families, with average prices and great flavors. I especially love their Dirty Coffee.

author: Chris Low
review_text: Have been to Banthat Thong a number of times and finally have a chance to try this restaurant. Omelet rice with shrimp taste really good. However, the eggs seems undercook to my liking. It was too watery. But overall tastes great! I will remind myself to inform the staff to cook it slightly longer on my next visit! Shrimp noodles are really delicious! Definitely coming back for more!

author: Lourin Costa
review_text: This place is my best places for food everything is prepared fresh and the baked potatoes with rack of baby ribs or steak is so good I love the clam chowder and the prices so reasonable not expensive quality size is pretty good I will give a 5 star for food and prices

author: Arisuありす
review_text: Yummy duck noodles soup in the midnight.. Siew Mai a bit sweet, not my taste..

author: A Dan
review_text: Love Fiore's. Each sandwhich comes with a nice lil side salad and some solid potatoes. My BF is a vegetarian and obsessed with the Vegan BLT. Meanwhile, I love their Christopher Robin, its a nice refreshing sandwhich. The folks are super friendly and its always such a child environment. Normally can get my order nice and quick. A true JP gem.

author: Dakota Braze
review_text: Their portions are well-sized. I ordered a chicken salad and it was enough to split between three people with no shortage of meat. The quesadilla plate was tasty and came with a small side. One issue to be resolved is the merchant surcharge to use debit cards which is illegal in California. Surcharges are to be applied when using credit cards, not debit. I'll be looking to see that this issue is resolved in this community. I rarely see this happening in other communities and that's probably because it's reported and not overlooked in those areas. The driver-thru is totally backward as it's located on the passenger side only, so if you go alone, be prepared to reach over.

author: melanie quiroz
review_text: skimmed out on the fries, ordered a large expecting it to at least be more filled

author: Kristen Stewart
review_text: I love this restaurant so much, the food is always phenomenal but the service today was so bad I don’t ever want to come back. When I asked for more bread and lentils my waiter told me flat out “NO”. When I asked why he said “because it’s an extra charge (as if we didn’t already know that). Then when we asked for our food to be packed to go, instead of taking the plate to the back and properly packing it… he brings an aluminum pan to the table for me to pack it myself as if this were Applebee’s. I’ve been here maybe 10-15 times and never spend less than roughly $80 so to treat a good customer like that was so disappointing😕 Great food, great atmosphere, waiters attitude sucks.

author: Grace Chew
review_text: Great food, vibe and staff! We had the Margherita Pizza, Buffalo Chicken Bites, Shakshouka, Sticky Date Pudding and Carrot Cake! For drinks we had Sangrias (Red and White) We enjoyed everything and the staff were so warm and friendly, especially Eileen who kept coming to check in on us ❤️

author: Julie Killeen
review_text: I had read an article about this “local gem” and decided to try this morning. It is a good no nonsense breakfast with fast & friendly service. The staff were welcoming & friendly, there were a couple large parties but our server was still attentive. All three meals were tasty.

author: Doreen Tan
review_text: Everything was wonderful, tasty, a lot of seafood, and seafood was fresh too! We highly recommend the boiled rice - we had the sea bass one. So good! We also had the tomyum, crab omelette, shrimp crackers and deep fried baby soft shell crab. The drinks were wonderful too - Nam prick jaew soda, the mango sticky rice smoothie, calamansi sour plum soda too.

author: kl33tus
review_text: Maaaaan this food is good. The staff was very kind and helpful since it was my first time. The restaurant has a lot of tables and chairs and they were all clean. I highly recommend the jerk chicken and shrimp. The cornbread is amazing too

author: Phanit Duong
review_text: Went on a Monday for dinner and everything was fresh. My raw clams and mussels were on deck and I ate 6 platters all for $20 with tip, you can’t go wrong here! Full review on YouTube@hellachluy

author: Amanda Ferreira
review_text: Absolutely loved my visit to Jadu Cafe! The food was fantastic – the Avo Tartine was a standout, fresh and flavorful with just the right balance of textures. The brownies were also perfect – rich, gooey, and indulgent. The staff were incredibly friendly and welcoming, which made the experience even better. A perfect spot for a cozy brunch or coffee break!

author: shabbazzen
review_text: Top of the line services.very clean in& outside.food the best in town.

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: Francis Tan
review_text: Noodles was nice and chewy BUT the pork and wanton was just bland. Had much better wanton than this. Nor sure about the hype is all about since you can get better ones outside of Bangkok for half the price. Expensive for 90B and not so great atmosphere.

author: Sumarno Khoo
review_text: Although the location is very touristy, Lau Pa Sat food center is one of the most organised and comfortable hawkers center in Singapore. The outlets are very well curated in terms of quality and varieties and the seatings are adequate and spacious.

author: Tina Bueno
review_text: LOVE LOVE Triple George Grill for dinner and lunch… we stopped in today for brunch and again, LOVE!! Always a memorable downtown dining experience, decadent steaks,classic cocktails, and the BEST service!! Thank you to our bartender this morning, exceptional service by Joy!

author: Aline Martinian
review_text: I ordered the 8 oz. Sirloin with rice and grilled shrimp. Second side was green beans. Steak was delicious but a bit overcooked. The green beans.... let's just say I would jot order again. Way too overcooked, soggy. Overall a good experience. Wait staff very nice. I changed my review to a lower star level because within 40 minutes after eating here, I got severe stomach and intestine pain and cramps and have been in the bathroom for the past 3 hours off and on. Horrible! Will never rat here again!!!

author: Lucia Spill
review_text: Delicious homemade Persian food !! Authentic and tasty. Stumbled across this place and happy I walked in. Owner and staff are lovely. Highly recommend will be coming back soon.

author: Kai En Ng
review_text: An Unforgettable Dining Experience! From the moment we stepped in, the ambiance was warm, elegant, and inviting. The service was impeccable — attentive without being intrusive, and every staff member made us feel genuinely welcomed. We tried the chef's tasting menu, and every dish was a masterpiece. The flavors were perfectly balanced, presentation was stunning, and the ingredients were clearly top quality. The [insert signature dish here] was a standout — melt-in-your-mouth and absolutely unforgettable. What truly set this restaurant apart was the attention to detail, from the perfectly paired wine selections to the little touches like palate cleansers and a hand-written thank you note at the end of the meal. Whether you're celebrating something special or just want to treat yourself, this place is worth every cent. Highly recommended — we’ll definitely be coming back!

author: Zie Rose
review_text: Worth for a try! The oyster is very fresh and the soup of the hot pot is very tasty! The staff here are very nice and friendly. Definitely would recommend those who travelling in Ho Chi Minh City!

author: Natassja
review_text: tried the pho Saigon, banh mi, and egg custard coffee. While the pho was just okay (I was hoping for more flavor), the banh mi was excellent! It was fresh and hit all the right notes of sour, sweet, and spicy. The egg custard was also a highlight🍮

author: JY
review_text: One of my family’s go-to places for casual family dinners in a comfortable environment. The fish head curry & prawn paste chicken are our favourite dishes from this place. So far everything that we’ve ordered over the years have been good, and the prices are affordable as well. Highly recommended!

author: Tabitha Hall
review_text: This place! Was fantastic!! On my first night in town, we laughed, we ate, we danced, we partied, and we had such a great time! Duffy's was a 10 out 10. The dj really kept the night going!! Being next to water, enjoying great food, great friends, and craft music was just what this tourists needed to settle in to Miami!; To get the feel of the Saturday night life for those want to have a great time, meet new people, and listen to a huge variety of music. I will definitely be back on my next trip.

author: JuthaMars C
review_text: The location is really good to enjoy dinner. It is in the park but quite far from downtown. The food is fresh and reasonable price. There are many restaurants and many types of food, such as seafood (chili crab), satay, Chinese, indian, porridges and etc.

author: John Hu
review_text: A no-frills place with very friendly staff serving a specialized menu. I opted for the combo of steamed veg momos with veg chow mien. The freshly steamed momos went great with the accompanying sauces. I found the chow mien very delicious (sweet and savory) as a straightforward dish. I'll need to come back and try the other momos.

author: Peiyi (Potato)
review_text: So far food is ok, not very wow. Mutton soup quite bland but meatball is nice. Live prawn noodles are good. Western barbecue is decent, old school western but I’m not a fan of the garlic sauce. Salt fried chicken quite salty and herbal soup isn’t very Gao but not as bland as the mutton soup. Charsiew from idk which stall is not bad. Nyonya chendol is nice

author: sabrina gonzalez
review_text: The food is pretty good also for a great price. Service is fast and the staff are friendly and professional. The only reason why I'm doing 4 stars is I think they could be a lot better customer service and greeting when customers walk in the door.

author: HAM cannon
review_text: HIGHLY UPSET lmaooo like idk if the cook Is new or if the cook is getting older but everything don’t taste the way it used to taste if you used to go here don’t expect the old goodness that came with it. Now it’s just tryna make money even the chicken sauce taste different or spoiled and I ordered on uber eats it came wrong so I went in to fix it and it’s still not what I’m used too. I’m disappointed.

author: Janne Smeets
review_text: Super nice place in district 1 Saigon . It wasn’t super easy to find but we loved the food. Atmosphere was amazing with views over the city. Vegetarian friendly!

author: Faiz Soudagar
review_text: Deen Maju never disappoints. There’s something special about the food here the flavours are beautifully balanced, that slight tartness mixed with spices hits perfectly every single time. You can really taste the care and consistency in every dish. One of those places where the food just speaks for itself. Absolutely love it and will always come back!

author: Yeoh Ts
review_text: They offer a variety of flavors, all made fresh to order. I tried the pandan flavour it was delicious! The bread has a slightly crispy outer layer, is fragrant and soft, with just the right amount of sweetness not too heavy at all. The place has seating, air conditioning, and even free drinking water.

author: Cory Schwab
review_text: Stopped in for a quick breakfast and really enjoyed it. Staff was friendly and food was delicious.

author: Violet Chan
review_text: We bought curry puffs from two stalls side by side on the 2nd floor — and the verdict is out. The stall run by the two ladies is hands-down the winner! 🥇 ✨ Why it’s the best: • Super crispy puff pastry • Generous fillings • Flavourful and well-seasoned They offer a mixed potato + sardine filling if you like both, or you can choose just potato or sardine. 💰 $2 each and definitely worth it. Highly recommend giving it a try! 👍

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: SO
review_text: The restaurant is truly architecturally beautiful, the building was very artistic, modern yet cultural at the same time. Absolutely loved the vibes. Service was also pretty great, staff were polite, friendly and also efficient. The food however was a little disappointing. Bear in mind I did not order their signature dishes. We’d order their chicken as appetiser and that was the only solid dish. The rest were a flop, imo. Shrimp friend rice was alright but nothing out of this world. The baby shrimp was overly salty. Chives with mushroom dish was also just alright. The vegetable soup tasted fine but the odour of the veggie was very strong, while I was able to endure, I don’t think many others can.. The squid dish was the most disappointing, sauce was very good but the squid itself was really tough to chew on and there’s no QQ aspect to it. I wanted to love Man Moi badly. Most likely would not revisit again, unfortunately. Price was on the high side which I don’t mind but the food was really mediocre.

author: Kitty Kat
review_text: My Googlers, when I say this is the best CHICKEN CAESAR PIZZA I ever had In NYC. Forget about Gabby's Pizza in Queen's. If you don't mind the drive then come here. I mean now. You won't regret it. You're my Favorite Pizza Place So Far. So to give an update, I stopped going here. Which I'm very sad about because I loved that Chicken Caesar Pizza, but you know I'm big on customer service. So they don't get my business anymore. Every time I ordered a pie, I would open it and the pizza would never be cut. This happened 3 times and every time I said something about it I would get a major attitude. Especially from the cashier girl. I asked for an additional sauce, which they put on this type of pizza, it's like a sweet sauce. She threw it in the bag. When I got home it was a tomato sauce. This Chicken Caesar Pizza doesn't have tomato sauce on it at all. That was my last and final experience with this place. Just because your Pizza is good doesn't give you the right to give a side of attitude. Treat your customers the way you want to be treated.

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Jake Yau
review_text: What an amazing find! Tucked between shop houses, this place offers a wide variety of delicious food from Hanoi. I ordered bun cha, which was so delicious! Sauce was perfect and the grilled meat was smokey and savory. Also ordered some fried spring rolls and coconut white coffee; all were delicious. Do come here to enjoy their hospitality, friendliness and obviously the amazing food!

author: DARSH (DJSUMO)
review_text: Nasi Kandar Rafei Ali holds a cherished place in my memories, transporting me back to my childhood where the rich aromas and vibrant flavors of their dishes created an unforgettable experience. The journey through the years has been remarkable, as I have observed the establishment not only preserve its authenticity but also enhance its offerings to meet the evolving preferences of its patrons. The introduction of two distinct seating options reflects this commitment to customer comfort and satisfaction. One can now choose to dine in an air-conditioned environment, which provides a respite from the tropical heat, or enjoy a more traditional experience in an open area with normal fans. This thoughtful expansion caters to diverse preferences, as some patrons may appreciate the cool respite of the AC, while others might prefer the outdoor ambience that allows for a more casual and social dining atmosphere. Moreover, it is noteworthy how Nasi Kandar Rafei Ali has managed to maintain the essence of its culinary offerings amidst expansion. The flavors that once captivated my youthful palate remain vibrant and true to their origins, while the improved facilities enhance the overall dining experience. Such dedication to quality and customer experience is commendable and speaks volumes about the establishment's commitment to excellence. As I reflect upon my visits over the years, I cannot help but appreciate the journey that Nasi Kandar Rafei Ali has undertaken. Its ability to adapt and grow while still evoking the warm nostalgia of youth is a testament to its enduring legacy. I look forward to many more visits, where I can enjoy not only the delicious food but also the increased comfort and ambiance that this beloved establishment now offers.

author: André Thierry
review_text: Scored à free night from Marriott Bonvoy, staying at the Courtyard Newark Downtown (I broke up with a woman after we saw Wu Tang & Nas at Prudential, but y’all don’t need to know about that.) Annnyywaayz doe …. My main motivation from taking the train from Manhattan to NJ was to return to Cornbread Farm to Soul, and it did not disappoint! Had honey chicken & black eyed peas and macaroni and cheese and sweet teas! (Just one sweet tea, but I had to keep the rhyme scheme). Absolutely delicious!! Ten-course menus in Manhattan are nice to flex with, but nothing will satisfy me like soul food done right. I cleaned my plate and filled my heart. Glad to be back. And the service by Bernice Kim was as professional, warm and faith-restoring as the food and drink. Thank you Cornbread and Bernice, for making my Friday night and return to Newark memorable And also making me forget what’s-her-name. Much love to y’all. P.S. yes, I know there is a Cornbread in Brooklyn, but THIS location is where it’s at. Felt like I was back in the ATL ❤️

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Iza Ishak
review_text: Food was cold although the spices more than make up for the lack of heat. 20 minutes drive from Soekarno Hatta Intl Airport. There’s space to place your luggage and convenient ramps.

author: Me We
review_text: Outstanding restaurant. Great menudo with a mondongo consistency. Clean tripa. Good quesabirrias (Mexican French Dip). Best place to get grub at 6 am. Bathroom clean and spotted a rare pay phone. Don’t mind the parking lot zombies.

author: Mauro Martin
review_text: Gigi Susu is such a lovely spot, great vibe, friendly staff, and a wide range of baked goods that look ang taste amazing! The pastries are flaky and flavorful, and you can’t go wrong with any of their coffee selections. The place has a cozy, earthy design that feels warm and inviting, perfect for a morning coffee stop or a relaxed brunch. Everything feels thoughtfully done, from the rustic presentation to the service. Definitely one of my favorite bakeries in Bali!

author: TEULIE Xavière
review_text: Perfect experience from start to finish! The ribs were the best I’ve ever had, and the staff were incredibly kind and welcoming. Highly recommend!

author: Kenn Mullen
review_text: If you havent tried the char koay teow here before, you are missing out. Its got such a rich flavour and hits all the right notes. Smooth buttery texture mixed with a nice consistency of noodles make it such a wonderfull experience. There is no better char koay teow than here. I dare you to tell me one better. I have yet to try anything else in this food court other than the fried chicken (not bad) but if you see this and havent tried it PLEASE DO!

author: Grace Freed
review_text: It seems that because I asked about the allergens for one of the food items, they decided to "punish" me by making me wait over 20 minutes for my order, a burger, and not putting any strawberries in my strawberry limeade. The workers seem unhinged. (Btw, if it's true they have no way of telling what ingredients are in the food, as the manager supposedly said, then this place should be shut down because that's dangerous.)

author: Brian Kwok
review_text: Great place for Japanese food in Las Vegas. Very reasonable price with quality food. Fish is fresh, and many items are for choice. But tempura is not that great.

author: Ceiledh Monk
review_text: Lovely restaurant! Wanted to have bun cha one last time before flying out and this held up to my expectations. Lovely and welcoming staff too.

author: Leslie Perez
review_text: Do not order from here. Waited 20 minutes for my order. Cashier hid in the back for over 10 minutes. Had to assert myself just to give my name only for my pizza order to be wrong. Place was full of Uber eats drivers who apparently get priority.

author: Christopher Wu
review_text: From Melbourne, which already has a pretty strong banh mi game, I had to give this spot a try after seeing it hyped all over social media. Tried the mixed ham banh mi — I’ve never seen one packed with this much meat before, it was absolutely loaded. Flavour-wise though, it didn’t quite hit for me. It was a bit too full-on and the balance just wasn’t there. They give you salad on the side to add into the banh mi, which helps freshen it up, but the bread didn’t have that signature crisp I look for. Probably because they’re pumping them out so fast, so the consistency can vary — still decent overall though. Queued up for about 10 minutes — they’re efficient and move quick. The banh mi itself is massive, easily shareable between two people. Towards the end, the texture got a bit weird on mine, might’ve just been my roll, but I wasn’t a fan. Definitely could’ve used more chilli or a spice kick. For around $5, you can’t really complain, but coming from Melbourne’s already strong banh mi scene, I was expecting a bit more given the hype.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Jonathan Wildman
review_text: Perfect all you can eat K bbq! Lots of sides, lots of meat options, three levels of meals, good quality on all, the service is quick and attentive and they have cool service robots that even sing happy birthday and say the person's name. Place gets busy as expected but it is large and good for big family groups. Will definitely be back again.

author: Michelle Medrek
review_text: Tiki Tiki has quickly become one of our favorite spots, especially for their outstanding ceviche! It's absolutely delicious, bursting with flavor, and the fish is incredibly fresh--definitely a must-try! I typically indulge in their amazing churrasco steak, but I find that the ceviche leaves me feeling satisfied every time. My partner usually opts for a fish dish, but he decided to switch it up with the fish and chips this time, and we were thrilled! The fish was lightly battered, cooked to perfection, and the flavor and texture were simply excellent. The staff is wonderful, and the bartenders are always welcoming. Plus, the view of the intercoastal and watching the boats pass by adds to the charm. It's the perfect spot for a romantic date or a fun outing with the whole family. After every meal, we always ask ourselves, "Would we come back?" The answer is a resounding yes! We'll definitely be returning!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: sally blankenship
review_text: I probably could have had a better meal at a chain restaurant for half the price. Do not order the chips and queso. Unless you went nachos, like you get at the basketball games. This place had the most reviews and their reviews gave it a 4.6 rating. I'm gonna say a bunch of young partying tourists are the ones that rate this place. The steak tacos were too hard to chew. The chips were overcooked. The cheese for the chips and queso was nasty, liquid cheese from a can and wasn't even spicy. The only mexican sauce they provided was a bottle of valentinos. Believe it or not the best thing I ate there was the "street corn" and that wasn't even all that. They rang us up for somebody else's order. Not bringing us a ticket, just ringing us up. It was two meals and a kid's meal And one beverage. They rang us up for 139 dollars. I then tipped without realizing they already give themselves a tip. Gratuity is added no matter the size apparently. Because we were charged for gratuity for a party of two and a half. I then asked if I could see an itemized statement, because I couldn't believe that's what we just paid. And thankfully, I did that because then I realized we were being billed for a picture of margaritas. And for adults that were sitting a table away from us. The beans were beyond salty. I literally think someone dropped a container of salt in there and said, i'm gonna run with this. The rice was mediocre. Needless to say, we would not recommend this place to anyone.

author: Shmiley C
review_text: Date of visit: June 2025 English menu available. Nha Tu is recognized with a Bib Gourmand by Michelin. I was able to find the location pretty easily. The place is small and does not have much seating. I was here around 2 PM, so maybe the lunch rush was done. There was no wait for a table for two. I may have been judged for ordering too much food: Cha gio (fried spring rolls) 88k VND - good, would recommend Lau hua sua (oyster hot pot) 495k VND - I wish this dish came out earlier. It came out too late. Good to try! Ca loc kho to (braised snakehead fish) 85k VND - eh, I wouldn't order this again. Nac dam nuong mat ong (grilled pork w honey sauce) 105k VND - This dish was ok. Cuon nem nuong (pork spring roll) 25k VND - I wouldn't get this again either. Ok to try. Drinks were ok. Guava juice 50k VND Beer 39k VND They do have Wifi. Need to ask for password. Toilet is upstairs. Be careful the stairs are steep and no railing. Credit card/tap accepted. Service is meh.

author: Jaimy De C
review_text: The order machines, only 2 active. Not big inside so delivery guys and people who are waiting for take out, where all waiting inside so they took also space. Tables were not cleaned. Service was ok. Apparently our number was called but if you don’t respond they don’t bother at all.

author: Anantaya G
review_text: Had this for breakfast on my first morning in Penang, totally loved it! A great choice of protein after a morning run. The combo of bagel, beef, and sauce is perfect. I usually have a problem eating burgers/bagels for its size and disproportional slice, but here they made it so easy for someone with a tiny mouth like me haha. And the signature beef bagel goes really well with the lemonade. Will def come back to try other menu! :))) Just a bit on the bgm, it was a bit loud for the size of the shop. But still a really love place esp for the morning eat :))) <3.

author: Vaibhav Jain
review_text: Loved the food—lots of great vegetarian options and tasty dips. The atmosphere is lively, but the loud music can make conversation tough. Overall, a fun spot with flavorful dishes

author: Ha Tran
review_text: Got the order as take-away and veggies packages always included, fresh pickles, onions, pate and the banhmi itself is always top-notch. The waiting line was long but efficient-organized line made it fast!! As a local and been having Huynh Hoa since the banhmi was around 45.000 VND until now, I gotta say the price goes with the quality. The portion is huge, 2-3persons/portion so recommend to share it or big eater!!

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: k4rsaya
review_text: in my visit list everytime i travel to singapore. light but flavoural broth. the ribs were so tender and juicy. worth a try

author: Judy Trimarchi
review_text: This In n Out burger is next door to the regional headquarters so we expected it to be a great cafe. The regular hamburgers were tasty with free extra toppings. Not anything spectacular, but tasty. The French fries were outstanding! Service was fast despite it being very busy. The cafe was clean and bright.

author: Suzet Lora
review_text: Jimmy was our server. He was wonderful!! The ambience is quaint. The food…OMG…I have no words to describe. You must experience yourself. It’s the most delicious food you have ever had,

author: Justin Webee
review_text: Great BBQ and worth the drive! I’ll start by saying I don’t usually go to places I see on Instagram or TikTok — but my son asked if we could check this one out, so we made the drive. Totally worth it in the end! First impression: the place looks kinda closed from the outside (half the signage is out, so maybe fix that, guys). But don’t worry, it’s definitely open during normal business hours. We walked in and were greeted right away. The hostess asked if we wanted a booth or table, we went with a booth. The dining room isn’t huge, but it’s clean and comfortable. Looks like they do a lot of takeout, too. Our waitress could’ve been a little more upbeat, but the food runner totally made up for it — super friendly and took time to explain everything. We ordered the Grande Family Platter ($110) which came with: • Full rack of pork ribs • 1 lb pulled pork • 1 lb brisket • 1 qt Hatch chili mac & cheese • 1 qt sweet & spicy Brussels sprouts • 6 Hawaiian garlic biscuits • Plus pickles and pickled onions Everything came out hot and fresh. The smoke was on point, the flavors were fantastic, and the OG BBQ sauce was legit — a little spicy but really balanced. All in all, great food, solid service, and definitely worth checking out. You won’t be disappointed!

author: Honzie Khong
review_text: Instead of the better know tourist dim sum place you should venture a little further out to A Ma's This has a 60 years history and the place is very nice and comfy. Choose your dimsum and it'll be on your table in time for the tea to brew. What's good. The hargow, bitter gourd, phoenix claw Thai style, Chai kueh, are worth the try. But what's surprisingly good is their char siew wanton noodle . Can fight with KL. All in very enjoyable breakfast. Reasonable for 9 pax 1275 Baht.

author: Tunisia Ellis
review_text: The service was great. They provide vegetarian option as well. Very fast service.. and flavourful. The watermelon juice is super refreshing. My mom likes her meat well done and the staff were super nice and accommodating. They allowed us to place our luggage while we ate. Thank you so much Cam on :)

author: 5679 W
review_text: very good restaurant. Super authentic shengjianbao and dumplings

author: Boey Cheah
review_text: This food court rose to popularity mainly because of the Gei C Hor Fun stall. While the noodles were decent, the wait was long and the soup portion rather small — overall not bad, but not particularly impressive given the queue time. We also tried the char kuey teow and the Hong Kong–style chee cheong fun. The chee cheong fun was smooth with a flavorful soy sauce base, while the char kuey teow could have been better if it were cooked a little drier.

author: Pierfrancesco Martilotti
