review_text: Definitely the best brunch in Miami Huge buffet with some options a la carte. Delicious cocktail, amazing music and Lovely staff Thank you all for everything

author: Catherine
review_text: A large local-style hawker area suddenly appears in the middle of central Singapore, and the atmosphere is great. Even though it’s designed for tourists, it still keeps the charm of a real hawker and feels very comfortable. We tried several dishes, and the Indonesian satay was especially tasty. One downside was that the beer pitchers were different sizes even though we ordered the same item. The place was clean, but since many foods are eaten with your hands, tissues weren’t always available. It’s better to request some or bring your own. Overall, it was an enjoyable tourist experience.

author: Darryl Paraison
review_text: Some Food is good while others are bad, the crab lagoon, mac and cheese. Pizza taste horrible. The rice and chicken taste pretty good, the spaghetti is flavorful

author: Onkar Bhamra
review_text: Amazing restaurant with a New York style vibe! Ricardo, our server, is such a huge credit to the establishment and very patient with us whilst we were deciding on our dishes. Popped in to celebrate mine and my wife's 20th wedding anniversary on the recommendation from someone who works at Mon Bel Ami Wedding Chapel (look out for the review for them 😘). We were not disappointed with the recommendation! There is a bar you can sit at as well as tables and booths. We popped in on a Wednesday at lunch time and whilst it was not quiet, we managed to bag a booth to ourselves. Food was amazing; I opted for the meatball starter whilst wifey decided to skip the starters and opt for just a main due to portion sizes. Wifey selected a turkey club sandwich with fries and I opted for a medium rare steak, which was cooked to perfection, along with truffle fries. The steak was so nice, even the fat was edible (it was very crunchy!) The sandwich was nice but as anticipated, too large for my wife to finish. The restrooms, located on the other side of the bar from where we were sat were nice and clean, which is always good. Staff overall were friendly and polite and it's just a shame I am a visitor to Vegas and not a resident as I would frequent this establishment at least a couple of times a month (the Big Dogs Lager goes down VERY easy, even at $8!) Thanks for a very memorable meal and top notch service, the food and service in this place are second to none!

author: Jace Lee
review_text: Good place for vegetarian food , local noodle stall , malay satay , western food , fried Hokkien mee , economical rice , local dessert store , steamed fish. All the stalls operate at different timing and start from 630am - 1130pm.

author: Sarah Chansriharaj
review_text: Food so good and delicious! Very small place but plenty of seating but no bathrooms.

author: D. Smith
review_text: I was in the Northeastern University area visiting places I used to know when I lived here in the mid 90s when I ran across this spot. Im pretty sure this is the same spot I used to frequent back in the day, but of course the inside has been updated. I didn't really want anything too heavy to eat but decided to grab a lamb gyro wrap anyway. The lamb was very well prepared and the wrap was delicious. The taste of the meat and the sauce with the vegetables was amazing and I ended up eating the entire thing. I highly recommend this spot if you are in the area and have a taste for shawarma

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Dana Beisengaliyeva
review_text: I had a wonderful time at Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant, with my mom and auntie. The staff were friendly and attentive, I would say Big Thanks to Nicholas, our guy who gave us great service! Even though it was raining, short stuff, he was so respectfully talking to us and being super nice! I think he is a great asset for this place who made our experience in this place so easy, so we could relax.

author: Stephanie Xu
review_text: Super interesting to try this dish. I almost didn’t order the soup cause it was already so hot but would recommend you to order it in the set meal. Taste of the soup was great! The sausage was very spicy, the pig skin was nice and crispy. I also enjoyed the fried meat, the grilled one was ok. It just got way to hot after I finished drinking the soup. A few more ventilators would definitely help. Staring into the forest to eat was a nice touch though!

author: Taylor Deni
review_text: There is probably a reason why they were so empty! I had a light late lunch. The seafood lettuce wraps were OK. Something you could make at home. Not worth the price. The seafood salad was gritty. I think they need to devein the shrimp. No atmosphere. Staff were pleasant. Would not recommend.

author: Chien Min Tan
review_text: After 10 over years, this is still the best nasi lemak we can have in town. Good atmosphere with airconditioned, and well placing seat. Waiting time is usually 15-30mins Fried chicken is always consistent with crispy skin and tender meat, sambal is always on point. Not forgetting the ikan bilis and kacang always fresh! The only downside of here is the parking, but Starling Mall will be a good alternative for parking without the worry of getting summon

author: Nadya Larasati
review_text: Wonderful atmosphere and great selections of Indonesian food. Family friendly, seatings are spacious, and service is great.

author: Vincent Tang
review_text: It's a nice cafe to study at with the basics--coffee and snacks. Well kept space, just okay food. We ordered the toast with spread, earl gray milk jam, and yuzu marmalade. For drinks, I got the cold brew. The cold brew felt like 75% crushed ice and some coffee. If you order x2 toast it's essentially 5$ per toast. The flavors for the spread were muted, nothing really stood out for me or popped out. It might be good if you are looking for a light flavor. This place is a good spot for the scenery and maintenance, but I wouldn't go here to eat.

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Beatrice Tan
review_text: Had a wonderful meal here! The food was delicious, and the service was excellent. Special thanks to James for being so helpful and attentive!

author: Hidden Bites
review_text: I got recommended this restaurant from Singaporean! So I tried. The seafood was very freshh! The chilli crab was delicious! 😜 also the fried rice wassss really yummy. This place *only local people not much tourist*

author: Mythical Dreams
review_text: A dream come true! I have been a fan of the show and Gordon Ramsay for many years now, and to say this experience was amazing is not enough. I am on my honeymoon with my husband, and I was thrilled to see there was a Hell's Kitchen right by our hotel! We made a reservation but it was not needed. The inside is clean and elegant, the staff is friendly and accommodating, and the food was out of this world. I FINALLY got to try the beef wellington, and it did not disappoint! The meat is rich and flavorful, especially in that beautiful wine sauce. The wagyu meatballs and braised short rib were also incredible to say the least. The chocolate sin cake came with a little candle to celebrate, and it was the best dessert I had ever eaten at a restaurant before. Expensive place, but totally worth it. Thank you Hell's Kitchen for making our first night in Miami so special!

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: Albert Tan
review_text: Been patronising Seng Kee for more than 10 years Today am pleasantly served by Melvin , he is very professional, friendly and attentive to our needs and ensure our request are taken care of. Can see he has great passion in his work. Thank you Melvin

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: opo c
review_text: Can’t believe i hadn’t tried this place before. Food was really nice. Monday had special offer on fish head curry and they did not skimp on quantity or quality as the fish was really fresh.

author: Melina Solorio
review_text: I come here almost all the time, and every time I do they forget something. I'm only leaving a review this time because whoever was going my order has me repeat myself 3 times and when finally getting to the window, she seemed pretty high and still forgot something. It's getting irritating, do better. **Had to edit my review because they overcooked the chicken on the sandwich and it was inedible.

author: Shane
review_text: Absolutely best place we’ve been in the whole of Vietnam for breakfast and burgers, lovely owner and staff, excellent consistent tasty food, I fell in love with Bacon cheese burger, so juicy and tasty, also had a few full English breakfast’s with big mugs of Twinings tea, if your missing a good fry up that’s not greasy, or a juicy burger, then this is place to go, defo give it a visit if your in walking street. They also do really good muffins and French sticks, BLT was my wife’s favourite, super crispy with plenty of filling, oh and the iced coffee is really good too, in fact we tried nearly everything of the menu and loved it all 😙👌

author: Winnie Briggs
review_text: I am so happy that my family and I ate at this restaurant after our walk around Jamaica Pond. As some reviewers mentioned before, the menu and ability to order/ pay is through a QR code. The waiter was a jack of all trades- he was the host, expediter of food, cleaned the tables, and brought out the food. My family and I shared the guac and chips for an app. And all of us really enjoyed our lunch/brunch- egg white omelette, chicken Caesar salad, chicken avocado club, eggs with pancakes and bacon. Everything was so flavorful and well cooked. The guac and pancakes were especially yummy!

author: Hangry Joobert
review_text: The flavors are bold, fiery, and everything people have been raving about. They offer more than 100 dishes covering everything from somtum, yum, soups, deep-fried, stir-fried, grilled, and laab—literally every style you could crave. The vibe is super relaxed with air conditioning, making it great whether you’re dining with family, friends, or a big group. The flavors lean toward authentic Isan—spicy, punchy, and definitely not toned down. We tried quite a few dishes today and loved every single one. Highlights from our table: 🥩 Grilled beef brisket with jaew dipping sauce 🦀 Somtum with blue crab 🐜 Red ant egg omelet 🥓 Fried rice with pork cracklings 🌶️ Glass noodle somtum with minced pork 🍲 Spicy soup with pork cartilage

author: Niki Anand
review_text: Takes like food from home, such kind people who make such such amazing people. They provided my dad free chai and free water after we moved to the area. If you want authentic food come here

author: Natasha Tjahjadi
review_text: Still really good, today the shop ran out of skin at around 2pm - offered to be replaced by gorengan (fried pork), was sooo good and they gave a lot more than expected. Really good!

author: Elham Mohamed
review_text: Amazing spot! The food is super delicious. The broth is so deep and aromatic! The staff are very nice we went very late and didn’t have cash on us, they offered to take us to an atm machine! Although they don’t speak much english they were very helpful showing us how to best enjoy the pho! The food is already a 10\10 and the hospitality makes it even 10000/10 It’s my first day here and I’m struggling not to eat here everyday.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Jon
review_text: Absolutely fantastic Bun Bo. Will come back next time I am in da nang. Flavours were amazing and friendly staff.

author: R K
review_text: Review only for 2 specific things.Otherwise is not bad. Pineapple juice was so diluted that it was hard to taste any Pineapple at all. the Normal popiah was soaking wet. Not sure if that is supposed to be that wet.

author: Leonard Lim
review_text: Legal Sea Foods in Boston is a highly regarded restaurant chain known for its fresh, high-quality seafood and impressive wine selection. The Legal Harborside location stands out for its multi-level design, featuring a lively rooftop bar with scenic waterfront views. Signature dishes such as the New England Clam Chowder and Lobster Roll are must-tries. While it’s a renowned destination for seafood lovers, the diverse menu also caters to various tastes and budgets.

author: Chi Ling
review_text: Best char siew pau I’ve had in a long time. Slightly fluffy pastry all the way through. The yam taro pastry was super fantastic too and thoroughly recommended.

author: Kenzie Winther
review_text: All the reviews are spot on. So much meat on one sandwich. They are popular so they have it down to a science. You order at one window. Wait in line to pick up at another. There is an eating area next door. You are paying more money but the sandwich is FULL of meat. They give you the toppings in a bag so you get to make it yourself. It was a delicious sandwich and I wouldn’t hesitate to get it again.

author: Kelly Daley
review_text: This is a new location, and I'm giving a 1 star in hopes feedback will be taken. I was delivering for UberEats. I asked the female preparing the order for an additional bag to put the beverages in. She refused and continued to argue with me. Saying "if you put them (2 large beverages) in a bag, they will spill). **if someone asks for an additional bag, don't argue** First, ALL of the order should be bagged, including beverages, for the customer's safety. Second, the bag with all the food items was so heavily packed, when I picked it up, the safety seal tore from the weight. This order was not packed properly. You need to put the beverages in a bag, and distribute the remaining order properly so that it will NOT spill or tip over. SN: I have been doing deliveries for over a year now. IF the order does spill, I'd rather it be in a bag (paper or plastic) then all over my car while I'm driving. Please set up delivery orders for success.

author: Neal Bakshi
review_text: There is a reason this place is so highly rated on tens of thousands of reviews. The food is SO good although service can be a little slow. The interior is also very well done and vibey. The menu is somewhat intimidating so take a look ahead of time and ask the server for suggestions. The ceviche is really good, just drink ample water with it because the food is salty.

author: Bartosz B
review_text: We tried **Warung Babi Guling Pande Egi** and the **Nasi Babi Guling Special** was really tasty, with pork served in different styles — the crispy skin was definitely my favorite. The **Vege Nasi Ayam** was less impressive, quite dry and lacking flavor. We also tried **Es Kolak**, which had a very unique and interesting taste. The prices are extremely low, making it a great place to experience local flavors without spending much.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Joie
review_text: Very good bowl of noodles - my Singaporean taste buds love it. It’s just a little spicy with sourness, really perfect. They give you a baguette to dip the soup but it’s super filling. The staff here are really friendly and will help with translating. Shop is also cooling and well ventilated!

author: Bello Solano
review_text: We had a great experience at Tiki Tiki. We were able to pull up in our boat, and staff immediately came over to help us tie up at the dock, which was a huge plus. Service was excellent—everyone was attentive, friendly, and quick. Our drinks came out fast, and the food followed not long after. The chicken wings had great flavor without being overly salty, which can sometimes happen with Asian-inspired sauces. The kids’ chicken tenders were a generous portion and surprisingly flavorful. The grouper tacos could’ve used a touch more salt, but that was easily fixed at the table. The coconut shrimp were delicious—perfectly cooked with a dipping sauce that paired really well. Overall, a great spot with solid service and tasty food. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Sheila Agosto
review_text: The stew chicken was too salty for my taste, only eat one piece out of the three on my plate. Also, the white rice had a burnt smell to it.

author: Jas Singh
review_text: Great food, authentic flavours, attentive staff in a relaxed environment

author: Ece Kavuncubasi
review_text: The best Vietnamese black coffee in Da Nang. They also have sugar-free banana bread that’s absolutely delicious. A great spot to hang out and play with the cute cat.

author: Chen Darek (Areken)
review_text: Not too bad.. but less choice..only fried rice available. Taste of fried rice is good ... No complain on that. Environment nicely design with Uncle Roger signature orange color. Price wise.. consider one of the budget price available in Pavilion mall .

author: John Castillo
review_text: You know, I hate like heck to be so negative about this place, but I have to be honest. In the quest for the franchisee to realize profitability, unfortunately they have gone down a rabbit hole. The problem is that they have cut back on staff because it is slow. The last time I came in was to pick up to go order last Wednesday at about 8:45 am. When I walked in, all the tables were empty. The server was just seating 2 people. Considering the location and time you would think the place should be packed, but they have disappointed too many guests with bad service because of lack of staff when it does pick up. Not to mention very inconsistent food quality and cook times. Also the app is not well developed and confusing. The rewards program is a joke. To redeem a reward, you have to first pick what food you want, then they give you a long set of numbers that you cannot copy or transfer to the payment page. You have a write it down on a piece of paper, because it is too long to remember. And half the time it says it is not valid. Want to hear something funny? I cashed in some of my rewards for a short stack of pancakes. Guess what? There is no short stack in the app or online menu, so it can't be redeemed! I sent an email to IHOP customer service asking about it. After 3 days they wrote me back. You know what they said? They want me to CALL customer service to get an answer. Bottom line: After ordering from this location in person, pick up and delivery, at least 10 times unfortunately, they consistently disappointed me. All of it self inflicted. Considering, as of this posting, they have several breakfast specials for only $7, the place should be packed. Set for success. Fix the service , staffing shortages, food consistency, app, online menu, rewards and customer service.

author: Keng Fai
review_text: Nothing fantastic. Humful Laksa only a name doesn't reflect on the amount of hum in the dish. Noodles also not cooked well. Clumped together and stick together. Wondering what was I eating. For $6.50 can get much better laksa with more Hum at many other places.

author: Nancy E
review_text: Food is always great! This time I rated 4 stars because the red chilaquiles were pretty much just chips and salsa, not a chilaquile sauce (yes, there's a difference). We ordered them without chicken and the price remained the same, I expected the price to go down, but I didn't ask. The breakfast items like eggs, bacon, pancakes, are always great. Coffee tasted great, ordered the TikTok coffee and it was huge and delicious. Everybody is always friendly and despite the place being full, we got seated right away and served in a timely manner.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Raina M.
review_text: I got the iced strawberry matcha and the smoked salmon toast. I stood at the register quite a while before anyone acknowledged me. Food and drinks were good though. Almost all the customers there who stopped for a coffee had 1-2 dogs with them, which i loved! Plenty of outdoor seating.

author: Eric Lamy
review_text: The food was great the service was on point. Will go there again

author: Jakey Low
review_text: Nice ambience, cozy and the service was excellent👌 Food and price, okla. Ordered the following 1. Mushroom fungi pizza, ⭐⭐ ⭐ ⭐ 2. Wagon Fried Fish, ⭐⭐⭐⭐ 3. Roast chicken leg, ⭐⭐ 4. Smoked duck pasta, ⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5. Mushroom pasta, ⭐⭐⭐⭐

author: Stanley C
review_text: We went at around 2pm so very few customers were there and staff was cleaning up. Food was exceptional and the view to the bamboo forest was nice. Must try if you come to Bali.

author: BKK
review_text: Bad experience. 1. When I first entered the restaurant, I saw many birds flying around inside and even bird droppings on the floor — very unhygienic. 2. The menu had no prices. When I asked the owner, he said the menu for foreigners is different and told me to just ask him for prices. This felt very dishonest and made me uncomfortable. 3. The food was not tasty at all. Definitely not recommended. My first visit — and my last.

author: Kevin Zhang
review_text: As a sushi lover I was so excited to hear that this restaurant was opening in Eastie. Unfortunately, the food did not live up to the expectation. The chicken karaage was good but the sushi was disappointing. I had the golden sunset and philly rolls. The fish did not taste very fresh, rice was not seasoned well, the mango was unripe, thin and leathery, and the roll quality was poor (see photos: not filled and pieces cut unevenly). Their specialty roll was so small, the same size as a basic maki despite being double in price. I do hope things improve so we can have some good Japanese food in East Boston.

author: Paola Fuentes Hernandez
review_text: I recently visited Sushi Sake for lunch and I really liked their variety in lunch special options. I ordered beef noodles and my friend had shrimp noodles; we liked it. I am giving it 4 starts because we arrived to the restaurant and no one was in the front so I ended up asking the security guard where was the person and he asked me to wait until someone showed up; after seated, the server took a while to come and take our order plus we ordered sriracha sauce and were charged $1 for it. Who charges for sriracha?? It is like charging for ketchup 🤷🏻‍♀️

author: Nick Chung
review_text: Fluffy rice , chicken not too oily , soy sauce taste spot on . Ipoh has the best hor fun, but here also quite good. Toasted bread Ipoh style , pretty decent Clean environment, fast service , well organized business .

author: Deb B
review_text: Drove in from Berkeley, stop by Togo for lunch but Really had to use the bathroom Very badly. I was told that I had to purchase something first , even in my dyer state, before I could use the bathroom . I have purchased many many sandwich trays for work presentations for many years from this location. Needless to say, I have never felt so humiliated in my life!!! Very very awful feeling especially to have gone to the bathroom on yourself!!!! Of course I couldn’t dine or take out as I was so embarrassed!

author: Hooi Yin Kee
review_text: Good place to hang out with friends. Open environment and fast servings. Enjoy evening sunset view . Foods taste average acceptable at reasonable price. Self servings and the continuous calling loud speaker spoil the nature view. Need to pay MYR 5 parking fees at the entrance.

author: teeku mulu
review_text: Very delicious sandwiches at this location. Friendly staff as well. 10 stars 🌟 🤩

author: Trần Thanh Thảo Nhi
review_text: I really love this restaurant 🤤 It has two sections, one outdoor dining area and one indoor café with a tiny library for book lovers. The menu is quite diverse with a lot of Western-style dishes. Everything tasted fresh, from the veggies to the soft-boiled eggs. The mushroom pieces were a bit big though, I’d prefer them thinner. The sauce was unbelievably good and the view of the mini rice field made everything feel calm and relaxing. Drinks were tasty but a little too sweet for me. Staff were super cute and friendly, definitely worth coming back!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Glenn Gatineau
review_text: This spot captures a vibrant, authentic Mexican atmosphere complemented by exceptional customer service. The food was outstanding!!! The beef burrito was fresh, flavorful, and the best I’ve ever had. 🌯 The brisket taco was perfectly cooked, and the sauce really enhanced the flavors.🌮 A must-stop spot if you’re at Hollywood Beach! 🏝️

author: Ciwi Paino
review_text: It is located on the 56th floor of BCA office building, achievable from mall on thr lift behind Gramedia at the 3A floor, East Mall. Renovated recently...particularly significant changing on the restaurant, more private rooms and nicer... On the bar, more seatings and open... There is entry fee 350K which you can use the vouchers to pay your bills Very nice views to the city...

author: Susan Poon Chung
review_text: We were a party of 14, and they did not rush us to make our order or to leave. Recommend making a reservation as it can get packed. Delicious good and generous portions! Went again, same group. Same deliciousness and generous portions. The service was superb. Very attentive to everything we need. Excellent wait staff! The bathrooms were also very nice and clean.

author: Kelly Aieta
review_text: We enjoy the take out options and app is very user friendly. Kids love smahlburger and adults are team bbq burger. Fries are fresh. Truffle fries are a nice addition. Sweet potato tots are also tasty. Mexican Cola also delicious.

author: WT
review_text: Very comfy ambience. We came here for breakfast and had their crab eggs royale, pancake stack and P.S Full Breakfast. Service by Eileen is amazing. So thoughtful of her to give the kids colouring materials to keep them entertained while the adults do their ordering. She also offered to make the scrambled eggs well done to have it look like omelette when the kids wanted omelette instead of scrambled eggs. Upon knowing the cup of Alright Orange is being shared by 2 kids, she also have it split into 2. Seeing one of the kid upset, she brought 2 cups of babycino (milk foam with cocoa powder) to cheer them up. Kudos to her! Overall, we had an enjoyable experience!

author: Mischa Ngan
review_text: Always feeling stress that the soup will soak up by the noodle as not much soup is given and the magical soup is the soul of this noodle. Yet, it still tastes so good that i always come back. Great ingredients. Amazing service, the waitresses are so considering, with great attitude. The iced milk tea less sugar is amazing too!

author: Genesis Leon
review_text: I was so pleased with my daughter’s birthday cake, as I have been with other cakes I ordered in the past. Everyone complimented the cake for its flavor. The sweetness was just right, including the frosting which was airy and velvety. I also loved the design and felt they did an amazing job delivering what I asked for. I will continue buying my cakes from Argentina Bakery.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Sky Grace
review_text: This place is absolute phenomenal. It has amazing vegan sushi so authentic and delicious and healthy. We had such a phenomenal time here this is probably one of the most amazing authentic vegan sushi places I’ve been to in my life. Only recommendation is not to use mothballs in the bathroom, they make some of us very nauseous.

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: LP Pua
review_text: We are exploring various Zi Char stalls and seafood restaurants in Singapore with 4-star ratings on Google Maps. Although this restaurant had a 3.9-star rating, we decided to give it a try due to its unique JB-like location. The Kai Lan was of the same standard as other Zi Char stalls. The Golden Garlic Spiced Pork, a dish we hadn’t seen elsewhere, turned out to be the star of the meal. The weekday dinner promotion, Fragrant Garlic Chicken, was crispy, sweet, and enjoyable. However, the Curry Fish Head was the Assam Curry type, which wasn’t to our preference. Rice was slightly pricier than average at $1.20. While there is a 9% GST, there’s no service charge. Overall, the experience had more hits than misses.

author: yang soong
review_text: Food is moderately expensive. They have a separate menu for foreigners. I attached a receipt as a reference guide of the price of 5 pax. It is quite close to the chinatown MRT(m line) station way mangkon. It's walkable, about 500m away from the mrt station. Suggest to have dinner here and walk to Chinatown afterwards. You may enjoy the night street light of chinatown.

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: Ramesh N
review_text: Great old school hawker centre. Enjoyed the NaNa Curry. Spicy but tasted good. Hokkien mee was also tasty with bits of fried pork crackers on top and mixed with into the noodles. It was hot in the afternoon but will go there again.

author: Steven Weston
review_text: Bittersweet I don’t think the designer kept in mind what Brassica was before they moved. It used to be a hip, quirky spot with an artsy vibe. The new place has its own vibe, but it doesn’t feel like Brassica anymore, and it doesn’t feel like the same restaurant either. Lighting is bright and a bit chaotic. The space reads as modern, with contractor-white walls, and bookshelves , office like floor. In the bar, you can see the sound system, lighting, and some odd shelves. The fake bar top and the blue floor tiles look like something you’d find in an maybe an office food court or something.. it can read like one of those coworker places or a franchised bar rather than a unique dining experience. The food is still good, but it doesn’t feel as distinctive or exciting as It use to be.. portions seem a bit bigger too - which isn’t a good thing imo - the redesign lost the essence of what made Brassica special, leaning toward something more generic. I would have loved to have seen them leverage the older bones of the building and use warmer, more tactile finishes (tile, wood, stone) low lights, plants, brick to add character. Quick fixes: - Rework the lighting: dim down the general lighting, add a couple warm low vintage lamps, get your vibe back - Hide or integrate visible tech: conceal the sound system and shelving behind the bar - Curate the soundtrack: a more cohesive, hip vibe with music - turn it up a bit - supports conversation without overpowering it.

author: Fernando P
review_text: Its just OK... Got half a chicken and a green sauce for $18. Not worth it for the price to be honest . Staff was nice , but thats about it.

author: Sora Yew
review_text: The steam chicken is really tender and soft but abit on the saltier side even without the dipping sauce also fine.The garlic also adds a different flavour to the chicken.The prawn wanton soup doesn’t taste as amazing as I expect but the soup is rich.The sa ho fen and the wanton soup is the same so feels like similar stuff but different ingredients.But the pumpkin milk is recommended.

author: sisi
review_text: Please bring back the old Potato Corner and the original staff—this new setup just isn’t it. The experience has gone downhill. The cashier was fine, but the girl who handed me my food was incredibly rude. Seriously, someone needs to address her attitude. It’s disappointing to see how much the service has changed.

author: Honest Asn Travel Reviewer
review_text: Ummm not too sure why this place is so busy/popular? The banh mi is your average banh mi. Didn't think it was anything special tbh. Had their special with the mixed meat. It was crispy and fresh. But again, just average. Maybe I'm just not a big fan of banh mi. It's a good thing we came early so there wasn't much of a wait. Definitely wouldn't be too happy if I had to wait for it 😂. You have to pay when you make your order so get your cash ready!

author: Rachel
review_text: A great cultural experience. The food was great. First night we ate inside the hawker stall with a lot of choices tho lacking dessert options. Second night we went back for satay and otah. The street is closed after 5pm and many rows of tables and grills are setup for satay. On a cool night it’s a great experience.

author: Elson Tang
review_text: The food at Remboelan is authentic and full of rich Indonesian flavors that truly comfort the soul. The warm ambience and beautifully presented dishes make dining here a delightful and memorable experience.

author: Manisha Purwaha
review_text: OMG, I think this was the best banh mi so far I had in Vietnam so far. We had bbq pork and pate, mixed (pork and pate), beef and cheese, chicken and cheese. The beer was very inexpensive, they had super cheap beer and coconut lassi, if you like the taste of dried coconut you will like it ( I did not). My rating/ranking (as per me) 1) beef and cheese 2) mixed (pork and pate) 3) bbq pork and pate 4) chicken and cheese (skip skip skip) Super fast service, the line was so long that we almost skipped the place but all reviews were pointing back to Phuong, so we trusted the people and reviews.

author: A Day with Melo Melo
review_text: I’ve been here not once but many times. I loved the service and food! Reasonable prices. Wendy our server is very nice and professional. Thanks for outstanding customer service!

author: Catharine Ong
review_text: Small restaurant with cold aircon Stir fried spicy crab meat rice is fantastic 👍👍👍 Stir fried rice noodles with crispy pork belly abit disappointed as the crispy pork belly not crispy anymore after stir fried Longan Juice is good 👍👍 Deep fried crab ball is delicious, eat tgt with the sauce will have another different taste 👍👍 Service maybe can improve abit, if first time here was thought to queue nobody approach to you, until we saw another group to ask some question then we just aware but actually you just get the number from the waitress and wait they calling your number. But luckily is quite fast so do not need to wait long time..

author: E. Garcia
review_text: I’ve been trying to come here and every time I come it’s closed. New business hours are posted on window but apparently those aren’t accurate either. Don’t waste your time like I have multiple times.

author: Brandon Will
review_text: Came here to celebrate getting engaged to my fiance with my family. Great drinks (especially the margaritas), the grilled octopus was delicious, and they had very pleasant service. I would recommend this place

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Michael EY Lee
review_text: Underrated place, not crowded but serves the real authentic and delicious Vietnam food. Reasonable pricing.

author: Joe Kwong
review_text: In Saigon Centre, B2 floor (Ho Chi Ming city) you will find this little Vietnamese restaurant. Looks like they’re serving different broken rice here, it’s authentic and tasty. Besides, we found other dishes are really nice too, the taste of their food is just right and details, with reasonable price as well. Recommend.

author: Sophie Seltzer
review_text: Kept asking locals where to get good food, this place kept being named. Did not disappoint. Loved the octopus nigiri, so many amazing rolls and the vibes were super cool. Lots of sick neon.

author: ramon perez
review_text: The food is decent but prices are very hi for a regular Dominican food Restaurant. The breakdown on the prices when you add something extra is really tricky.

author: Kinney
review_text: Joojeh (chicken breast) and Koobideh (beef) charcoal grilled! Delicious fluffy basmati rice. Grilled tomatoes. Authentic. Spiced perfectly! You will love it! Clean and bright restaurant, inviting hosts. Very enjoyable dining experience.

author: rose si
review_text: I really enjoyed the food here! The chicken pho and chicken spring rolls were super delicious, and the portion sizes were just perfect. We also had sweet potato fries, which were great too. I can highly recommend this place — the service was amazing, especially thanks to the staff member named Fish!

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Jens W
review_text: We had an outstanding dinner at De Tham in Saigon. From the moment we arrived, Sky took care of us in the warmest and friendliest way – it truly made us feel welcome. Our starters and main courses were extremely tasty, so good that I almost wanted to order them again right away. Every dish was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. The coconut coffee and the egg coffee were also excellent – rich, unique, and definitely something we’ll come back for. A wonderful restaurant experience with fantastic food and heartfelt service. Highly recommended!

author: Shriya Thakkar
review_text: Loved this place for its awesome pizzas! We loved their cheese pizza! Tanvir was especially sweet and went out of their way to make us feel comfortable. Such great hospitality and we will return again! Thank you so much for the great experience Tanvir! We really appreciate it 😊

author: Pancho Villa
review_text: The chicken was OK, the best food were the beans, they had a side of coleslaw which tasted rotten, the 1/2 a chicken look more like pigeon, than a chicken. The person hiding on the other side of the window, was not friendly at all. It literally felt like he was doing me a favor, instead of providing a service. The overall feeling wasn't good. Never coming back.

author: Lyn Tual
review_text: Wendy is always cheerful and very helpful. She provides excellent service.

author: Chengjie WANG
review_text: I've been here twice, and overall, it’s been a great dining experience. All the pizzas are made to order, and it takes about 15 to 20 minutes for them to be served after placing your order. Watching the guys working busily at the oven adds to the whole vibe. The freshness of the food is pretty good. The squid ink rice is tender and comes with a skewer of springy squid meat, which is quite nice. For pizzas, you can order half-and-half. I recommend the Burrata Parma Ham flavor—the parma ham adds a savory taste, while the creamy cheese brings a rich texture, all on a crispy thin crust. The combination of flavors and textures is very satisfying. The cheese pizza is also good. The table comes with honey, which you can drizzle on top. Two slices of pizza are enough to leave you feeling content. The tuna salad is fresh and tasty, though the portion is a bit small. For drinks, they serve beer with meals, about 250ml per glass. I wouldn’t recommend the Da Lat Whey Stout—it lacks the rich, bold taste of a stout. The honey wine beer, on the other hand, is great—it’s quite sweet and very drinkable. The only issue is that there’s often a queue. If you don’t make a reservation in advance, you might have to wait even after arriving. I once saw someone come at 2 p.m., only to be told they could only get a table at 4 p.m. They left looking disappointed, and I’m not sure if they ever came back. Alternatively, you could ride a motorbike here and, if there’s a wait, take a stroll to the nearby Pink Church or the My Son Sculpture Museum, which are just a few hundred meters away. Time will fly by before you know it. The My Son Sculpture Museum is truly amazing! But that’s another story. By the way, Ngoc provides a very good service as well.

author: Marquise Bailey-Dillard
review_text: I visited Bay Point Restaurant today with a family group of eight. The atmosphere was definitely the highlight — they have outdoor seating with a breezy, relaxed summer vibe, as well as drink-only high-top tables where you can enjoy a drink before sitting down. We waited outside with a drink before heading indoors for our meal, and the outdoor setting felt inviting. Once inside, service for a large party was decent. The staff took appetizer and drink orders in a reasonable time, refilled drinks, and checked in as needed. Food, however, was underwhelming. Two people ordered steak tips and found them enjoyable. Two others ordered chicken but found it dry. Two of us ordered the “catch of the day,” which was said to be haddock — but as someone who enjoys fish regularly, I didn’t taste anything resembling true haddock. Overall, the food was mediocre and lacked anything memorable. In the end, while the atmosphere is a nice spot to grab a drink on a pleasant day, the food doesn’t justify a return visit for me. If you’re looking for a place with a good summer view and a drink in hand, it works. But for a satisfying meal, I’d look elsewhere.

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: Ezekiel Dixon Lim
review_text: Had a late lunch there so there wasn't any queue. Top notch no nonsense in-ya-face flavour. Can't go wrong if craving for some salty goodness!

author: Jessica Le
review_text: I had such an amazing experience dining here! From the moment I walked in, the staff were warm, welcoming, and attentive without being overbearing. The atmosphere was cozy yet modern, making it perfect for both a casual meal or a special occasion. The food was absolutely outstanding — every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. You can really taste the quality of the ingredients and the care put into the cooking. My personal favorites were Cơm Tấm, but honestly, everything we tried was delicious. Service was quick and efficient, and the team made sure we always had what we needed. Prices are very reasonable for the portion sizes and the quality you get.

author: Chloe - Recommend
review_text: The ambience is absolutely stunning. Good to bring family and friends here for celebration. They even have birthday placard and play birthday songs for birthday. Taste wise some are better, some are not as good. Porridge is not bad, crispy shrimp roll and leek shrimp paste are also good. However, we are not happy as we placed order since 11.17am but they only deliver one dish. Upon checking with them, the waitress immediately said that for dim sum needs to wait for at least 15 minutes but it was already way more than 15 minutes. Another lady then came to us and said their kitchen only receive one order and not the remaining orders. We waited until over 12pm (about 50min) for the remaining dishes to arrive. Quite disappointed as they don’t sound apologetic at all. Nor the cashier apologise for that. Overall the service level is bad. Completely lack of customer service skill.

author: WILLIAM WHITE
review_text: Somewhat more of a "diner" type feel in a luxury condo bldg. Food was very good & portion size was excellent. I ordered the buttermilk pancakes w/whip cream & mixed berries. One portion cook really feed 2 ppl so if you're out with your girl fellas, order 1 & split it with your lady & it will be enough. Service was fine, plates & utensils were clean. Overall, I'd give it a 7.5- 8/10

author: ESTELLE MERISIER
review_text: Went today and got served by Freddy and all i can say is there was AMAZING service. On time for everything and was very attentive to our needs. Next time you go to Chili’s, ask for Freddy!

author: Suriani
review_text: Saw this online and I thought it's a must to try this. So glad that we did coz it's so yummeh! Enjoy every bite of it and thank you so much Zi Yu for your awesome service. Highly recommended!👍 P/S: Please come early coz the queue can be long. Managed to snap this when we left. But worth waiting for sure.

author: Maiara Pizzetti
review_text: This place is amazing is my 4th time here every time I'm in FL I stop by Great food, live dancers, great music very entertaining for all ages. Me and my family had a blast.

author: Lorie Brandenberger
review_text: Eric was a most excellent server and our food was fantastic! Food arrived as ordered and hot vs the room temp food we have been getting many places. The chicken stir fry deserves special mention—rice was perfectly done, chicken crispy outside and tender and juicy inside, and the SAUCE!!! I will order this again for certain.

author: Shirley Goicochea
review_text: From the moment you step into Il Poeta, you’re transported to a world where Italian hospitality and culinary artistry reign supreme. The ambiance is warm and intimate, perfect for a romantic evening or a soulful family gathering. Chef Mario Di Chiara’s creations are nothing short of poetic — each dish is a masterpiece, blending tradition with innovation. We started with the eggplant croquettes and grilled vegetables drizzled with truffle oil — divine. The gnocchi melted in our mouths, and the seafood specials were fresh, flavorful, and beautifully plated. The wine list was thoughtfully curated, and the staff made excellent pairing suggestions. Service was impeccable: attentive, gracious, and genuinely welcoming. You can feel the love and pride in every detail, from the decor to the dessert. Il Poeta isn’t just a restaurant — it’s an experience that nourishes both body and spirit. Highly recommend for anyone seeking authentic Northern Italian cuisine with heart. Forest Hills is lucky to have this treasure!

author: 马焕昭
review_text: Last night, I made a special trip to the Chulalongkorn University Night Market and finally got to try the legendary Jeb O Chula Banthatthong! Even though we waited in line for almost an hour, the first bite made it all worth it. We ordered the signature "Mama Noodles." The steaming copper pot was packed with ingredients—large, fresh prawns, tender minced pork, a runny egg, and refreshing straw mushrooms. The most amazing part was the soup: the Tom Yum base was perfectly sour and spicy, with the richness of coconut milk balancing the heat just right. Every spoonful was incredibly addictive. I especially have to praise the spiciness level—it had a strong kick but didn't upset the stomach, making you crave more with each bite. Even though the place was packed, the service was surprisingly fast. Highly recommended for anyone who loves spicy food. This is absolutely a must-try, god-tier supper spot in Bangkok!

author: Sabrina Cheng
review_text: We got there right before the rush, which was good because the food came out slowly after that. Overall, a nice place to eat a hot bowl of pho, especially before a show. I had the basic beef pho, which included beef balls, flank, and some other beef. The broth was a bit bland for me. My hubby and son ate the spicy beef pho and they both liked it. Large portions. Spring rolls were fresh, as was the egg rolls. The fish sauce for the eggrolls was a bit bland, but the peanut sauce for the spring rolls were yummy.

author: Inzaikun Chiba
review_text: Great place to enjoy local beer 🍺 🐅 on the rocks 🧊 😳 and satays while sun setting on the beach 🏝️ You can walk from Siglap MRT station 🚉 per map attached

author: Jessica Mao
review_text: Delicious food with generous portions, fast service, and a great overall atmosphere！

author: Nizam Abdul Aziz
review_text: Came here after reading all of the positive reviews from tourists visiting Indonesia - had a brief wait since the place was full even after the lunch rush, but was eventually seated. The menu was akin to an encyclopaedia but it was certainly very helpful to have pictures of all of the dishes available to order together with a brief description of each dish - eventually decided on the Nasi Campur Medan Padang Bulan, Sate Sambal Mentah & Soto Kayo Lamogan, all of which was great! The soto was one of the best I’ve tasted. While there were certainly a lot of options for dessert, ended off with what I know which was Jus Aplukat and Es Teler. Would come back to try the other items on the menu

author: James Pappas
review_text: Nice people here and it's convenient. The food is a little slow sometimes and you go up to the counter to get your own food. But it seems like one of those places where everyone knows each other. They probably do. Decent prices for good food.

author: Giselle T
review_text: We had a wonderful dinner at GreenStreet Café on Sunday. My husband and I really enjoyed the cozy atmosphere, the delicious food, and overall great vibe of the place. Our server, Zoe, was amazing — very kind, attentive, and professional. She made sure we felt comfortable and well taken care of throughout the entire evening. It was a lovely experience and we’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!

author: Elizabeth Martina Kelmaskosu
review_text: The babi guling is very tasty even we went here on Dinner Time. The pork skin is still "kriuk". Although is quite pricey for a plate, but it's packed with tourist and online drivers. Should try when you are visiting Canggu area.

author: Teck Chye Yeo
review_text: I read about this place online sometime back, but I never got around to try it. Truth be told; I'm an old-school foodie, & Char Kway Teow must be laden with pork lard for me, or it's a no-go. However, I serviced my car in Alexandra Road, and this was close by, & as luck would have it, the workshop finished withe the car early, so off I went for a bite of Halal CKT. I was apprehensive at first, but the soft-spoken hawker took to his wok as I waited, & done, I dug in with bated breath. Just look at this photo of my plate. It looks like the real deal, lard and all ya? It's got the Wok Hei I tell you! None of that sinful oily taste, but in its place, a clean clear, sweet-sauce induced flavour, with generous amounts of fish cake & cockles. I liked it! It's smoky, charred strands of kway teow, layered in just the right amount of sauce, with none of that eekie aftertase of lard! Will I be back? Well. If I'm in the neighbourhood, why not?

author: I
review_text: I've tried Boat noodles on several occasions in Thailand and whilst I found it ok, I didn't really enjoy it all that much. Intrigued by the long queues, I tried another Thong Smith branch (CentralWorld) and loved it. This review is for my most recent visit 2 weeks ago in Siam Paragon. We went here for dinner at 6pm and there was a sizeable queue. They have a number system where you get a ticket, and your number will be displayed on a monitor (and they will call it out) when your turn is up. We probably had a 20 minute wait so it wasn't too bad. We ordered the following: Beef Boat Noodle with Ox Tongue, Beef Ball, Sliced Beef, Braised Shank and tendon. This was excellent, with the soup having a deep, rich taste. The assorted toppings were plentiful and there was also plenty of chopped vegetables in the dish. This dish is the reason to come here and it did not disappoint. Chicken Noodles with clear soup. My son chose this dish and found it very tasty. The soup was clean and refreshing, which was perfect as he was feeling a bit under the weather at the time. Nothing like Chicken Soup to make you feel better! Pork Boat Noodle without soup - Braised pork, pork ball, sliced pork. My wife chose this dish as she is not a fan of the blood contained in the soup. The dish was good, with the noodles being nice and chewy, and toppings being tasty. One thing to note is that we also ordered a little plate of Crispy pork fat, which are these wonderful bits of crunchy lard that add incredible flavourful taste to every bite you have. Highly recommended. This restaurant chain is a favourite of mine and I will make it a point to return on any subsequent visits to Thailand.

author: Nikiea Hawkins
review_text: Food was delicious (albeit not hot) so I'll give 4 stars. And the atmosphere was amazing. The staff was very unfriendly I guess bc my sister and I are Muslim. We sat there in am empty restaurants at the smallest table they had until I just got fed up and moved myself. I'll attach some photos so you can see that is actually beautiful. But they only want Spanish people in their spot 🙄 of the owner or manager disagrees then by all means invite us back. We spent $140 for cold food. And weak drinks! This is my honest respectful review!

author: Laura Kyle
review_text: Delicious vegetarian falafal sandwich and fantastic service! I appreciated the free water bottle and the honey baklava was just perfect, not too sweet. I'll definitely be back for more!!

author: Hungry Happy
review_text: Food is great! They have 3 different concepts in the same lane, bahn mi, noodles and eatery. Queue is long so be sure to make a reservation before going or else be ready to wait. Service is quick and prompt, servers can speak good English and food is great! My must pre-order: bahn mi and beef skewers!

author: M Goldman
review_text: Best pizza in the neighborhood! Solid salads too. Everyone is nice and patient with the kids.

author: Billy Kok
review_text: Another recommended restaurant to visit for noodles and rice. Good Thai Chinese food. Reasonable prices. Menu with English and wait staff with knowledge of Chinese dialects. Fish balls, veggies, sui-kau, roasted duck, crab meat balls (not in menu) and must have their 'leong-fun' ice.

author: George P
review_text: Petralunga is one of those places that stays on your mind after you leave. The standout is the thin, crispy pizza, which you order first and then compare all other pizzas to. Their simple yet really good fresh lemonade is perfect, especially when enjoyed outdoors overlooking the marina and bay. It’s on the pricier side for casual dining, making it more suitable for “date night” or special outings with friends rather than a regular weeknight dinner. However, with the scenic water views, the Italian pizza-and-cocktail atmosphere, and that fantastic crust, it definitely deserves a solid 4 stars.

author: David Stejkowski
review_text: Honestly, the food fell short today. Everything we ate was terribly over salted. Ironically, they included extra packets of salt to go with the salt that I think also consisted of some meat and potatoes. The service was fine the atmosphere was good. But I’m going to have to drink about a gallon of water to flush out all the extra sodium.

author: Carrie Z
review_text: My go-to spot for Sichuan cuisine takeout. The flavors are authentic, and dishes like the twice cooked pork are must-orders. It’s one of the few places my dad genuinely enjoys, which says a lot. The restaurant is located right across the street from South Coast Plaza, in an area with many dining options. Whether you’re dining in or grabbing takeout, service is quick and reliable. It’s a small space, but there are plenty of tables. A hidden gem for real Sichuan flavor.

author: Morla Angelia
review_text: It was such a lovely experience from start to finish! The food was delicious, and the portions were generous and beautifully presented—definitely Instagram-worthy. Everything we ordered tasted great, though a few dishes were on the spicier side. The staff noticed right away and kindly offered us water. Super attentive! We also tried one of their signature cocktails, which was tasty and served with flair. The ambience sets this place apart. It’s so colourful, whimsical, and full of floral charm. It feels homey yet fun, like stepping into a joyful garden. The owner is beautiful and warm, and the service overall was fantastic. There’s plenty of parking, and the menu has many great options for seafood lovers and vegetarians. We’ll 100% be coming back—with family next time!

author: Salokya Sarira
review_text: I got the Orange Blossom Honey Latte, Maple Ginger Latte, and the Labneh Parfait. I really enjoyed their lattes as they are really smooth and balanced. However, the orange blossom one was better as the orange blossom elevated the flavors. I could barely taste the ginger in the other one. The Labneh Parfait is stunning! The creamy and whipped yoghurt is luscious and is elevated by the tartness of the pomegranate molasses and the crunch of the hemp crumble! I wish they still had the Cardamom Clove Latte (seasonal latte) as I had heard good things about it and wanted to try it.

author: Рудольф
review_text: Good place with good interior. Serving is fast But food needs to point more attention. I Ordered Tuna starter and got CANNED TUNA😂 For seafood restaurant this is unacceptable . Prawns really good. Fish is average So total 4 points from 5

author: Jonathan O'Buckley
review_text: There are so many different dishes, you gotta come here multiple visits to try it all. Can't go wrong with getting Snitzel and a nice cold beer. Tried Käsespätzle for the first time, and that was a great appetizer. If anything, be ready to take a doggie bag home because of their big portions. Always leaving full and happy.

author: Vickie Lam
review_text: we went early so there's no wait. but some people dont queue or they asked for a table for 2 and ended up having 6 people, which is very rude. also some people simply walked in and thought they can sit wherever they want, despite having a notice asking customers to wait to be seated. the servers are not handling this kind of issues very well. the bagels are ok, the fillings are good but the bread is soso. the drinks are good, very refreshing for the hot weather in penang. toilet is clean. ac available.

author: Marc Cooper
review_text: Great breakfast joint!!! Ainsley was an awesome server. I highly recommend the, "In Yo' Face Breakfast Sammie Sandwich!" Soooo good. It's fried eggs, bacon, American cheese, advocado, with a spicy aioli sauce on a soft brioche bun. 😋 oh yeah, the advocado toast with corn and tomatoes is ridiculously 🔥 as well. Yes, I read a lot of reviews in order to find this gem.

author: Philip Zanghi
review_text: I have to say Alex Chimis has become my ultimate comfort food. Their carne frita with rice and Yuca with onions is otherworldly. This is a gem and an absolute 10/10.

author: Trista
review_text: We came here because it’s listed in the Michelin Guide. Pho Viet Nam has many branches, and this is the one mentioned in the list. It is delicious. The noodles are homemade and have a great texture. I ordered the wagyu hot stone pho with mixed beef (oxtail, tendon, raw beef etc.), while my spouse chose the wagyu pho bò tái (raw beef only, no tendon). Both were excellent, and the broth was especially impressive: rich and deeply flavorful. There are sauces and pickles were ready on the table as well to adjust to our liking. They also serve fried bread sticks for 20,000 VND (5 sticks), which pair nicely with the pho. P.S.: I enjoyed it so much that I ended up going back again to another Pho Viet Nam branch that was closer to our stay (Sheraton area) and the quality and taste were very consistent, and for us it even felt like it came with larger portions of noodles.

author: Maureen Ryan-Hoffman
review_text: I'm so glad I picked this restaurant. The stuffed lobster is the BEST we've had in about 30 years. The quality, preparation (all cleaned out, meat removed from claws, mixed in the stuffing...). Our Server, Eddie, was smiley, friendly, wanted to take good care of his customers, which he did with great ease. Beautiful, relaxing atmosphere. Very comfortable. It was a nice experience and meal to remember. Thank you .

author: Baggage Claim Philosopher
review_text: Phoenix Rising (and Ordering Tequila) A neurotic love letter to steak, staircases, and traffic gods in Jakarta. You don’t go to Phoenix Gastrobar — you embark on a pilgrimage. If the traffic gods smile upon you (which they rarely do, those vindictive bastards), it’s a one-hour drive from Jakarta proper. If they don’t, it’s a two-act opera about mortality set inside a Grab. But when you finally arrive, sweaty, hopeful, and spiritually tested, the place hits you like a mirage designed by Hogwarts’ architect after a night out with Willy Wonka. There are stairwells that cross each other like a M.C. Escher drawing that gave up trying to be logical, secret passages that make you question reality, and lights so warm and moody you start narrating your own life like a noir film. I half-expected Dumbledore to walk past with a martini. The food? Exceptional. Capital E exceptional. The steak — divine. Charred outside, tender inside, like it had been serenaded by angels with tongs. The service is impeccable in that polite, silent way that says, “We know it’s expensive, but we also know you’ll forgive us.” And you do. Because the moment you taste that first bite, you realise this isn’t just dinner — it’s repentance for every bad meal you’ve ever endured. Yes, it’s expensive by Indonesian standards. But so is happiness, and this place delivers both on a plate. When you’re done, stroll (or stagger) next door to Tiger Club, the kind of place where the lighting is forgiving and the tequila is not. Order recklessly, stay irresponsibly late, and watch as night dissolves into day — because that’s what happens when you mix good steak, great music, and a small existential crisis over the bill. Phoenix Gastrobar isn’t just a restaurant. It’s a fever dream with cutlery. Go. Bring friends. Bring a map. Bring a sense of wonder. And pray to the traffic gods on your way back — they might just grant you mercy.

author: Liz Dunn
review_text: Went here recently for dinner. We were seated quickly and our order was taken relatively quickly. My husbands food (Cuban sandwich) and our d inks came out in about 15 minutes. The rest of our order did not come. After 45 minutes I asked about it and was told it’s a restaurant and it’s busy. No apologies. No offer to expedite. We ordered a burger (for my five year old and 3 year old to split) and two orders of tacos. Nothing fancy. The attitude of the wait staff and management was unreal. I could not believe how rude they were. Also the music is unbearably loud. Do not go here.

author: Khoo Jolyn
review_text: Is a well established bakery. Has been around for many year. Has so many varieties of breads, buns, puff pastry, pies, kaya. Quality of bread is good and do not skim on ingredients. Prices are much cheaper than many other bakeries in town. Open from 10 am to 5 pm. Best time to grab your choices of bread is before lunch time, or else some popular ones will be sold out.

author: Joy Ni
review_text: Rice is undercooked. Can’t pick them up. Service people has food in mouth to talk to me …

author: Michael Tsang
review_text: For a comedian that has a massive emphasis on fried rice, this disappointed me. I didnt come in expecting the worlds most gourmet fried rice, but I expected it to be decent and tasty. Decor and ambience is very much uncle Roger. And you know you're in a themed restaurant. Service was slow! And there was only maybe 8 people eating at the time! My meal came out before my drink. Cashless payments only. Upon my first bite, a over powering burnt taste and bland then. Hard bits. So, Part of the rice portion must have been literally fried in the oil while heating up the wok. It felt like I was eating tiny bits of plastic, but no, it was just rice that had lost its fluffiness. Wok hei was way overdone and basically overpowered any other taste that could have come from the rice, and ofcourse MSG! Chicken satay was decent enough, not much more I can say about that. The drink i ordered was a berry lychee which was lovely, but I think it was missing the lemon slices as i had none but it says it on the menu. Also its a souvenir cup with the drink. Overall, I'm happy I've tried it. But its not a place I would really go back to. But who knows.

author: Jeremy
review_text: Stop by here from time to time to grab buffalo wings and fries, which taste great. A lot of reviews are bombing the place, but if you get the tossed medium buffalo wings with regular fries, im telling you, you can't go wrong. It's more so up to you whether the price is right. It could go for being a dollar or two less but still would buy as is.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: 巴圖
review_text: The dry pho is delicious, the pig's feet are also soft and nice, the soup of the pho is great, but I don't know if Vietnamese pho soup is salty, but it is delicious.

author: salwana salim
review_text: Hi everyone! It was our first time eating Donkai. We have been serve by Mr Gam, he was very good in serving us by sharing the secret chef sauce recipe and making our rice mixing together with egg yolk, tartar sauce and others(i dont remember). But i have really good experience today! The beef was melted in mouth and so good .Oh ya I take the cheese one. Thanks Mr Gam!

author: Nickyta Cahaya Putri
review_text: Pungdet offer more than 20 fillings you can choose, and we end up getting the thai tea custard and ovaltine crunch. the bun has crisp crust and pillowy texture, combined with smooth and not overly sweet custard that blends well in our mouth. overall, this is the best option to go instead of the famous Yaowarat bread. less queue, same ambience, same price, plus you can dine in next to the shop!

author: Vanessa Rosaria
review_text: Exciting night out at La Favela. Food and drinks are at the pricier side but if you're there for dancing and party, it's the spot to be. All the DJ's produced good music. Atmosphere is great party vibes. Place is also thematic and really nice. It's cozy earlier in the evening but wild past midnight. For women, it's free entrance. For men, it is advisable tk come in before 10pm so you don't have to pay the entrance fee.

author: arjun adinata
review_text: After a thousand of miles from my place, finally can taste a most popular dessert place in Bangkok. Well known with their milk bund fluffy bread, I prefer to give another things to try. Surprisingly good, their dessert is beyond my expectations. I was skeptical because they are too viral and hype at the moment. But I was totally wrong, their taste is amazing. They also provide free drink which is great after a heavy sugar load hahahaha. Can’t wait to back to this place soon 😋

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: Skye Cai
review_text: Environmental and atmosphere is great. The fried chicken wing is nice. Very juicy. Squid salad is quite refreshing, which is the baby squid. Prawns yellow curry is not to bad, with very fresh prawns. Coconut pudding not too sweet. With some old coconut floss on top. Not worth the price but in general it’s okay.

author: P Gill
review_text: Had a fun Sunday afternoon lunch. We did the Tappas items from the menu. Octopus was very good. The highlight was the flamenco trio plus drummer. They were spectacular.

author: JoJo
review_text: I always take my visiting foreigner friends here. Good quality traditional food, with staff dressed in traditional clothing, playing traditional music in a more modern setting that still somehow showcase Indonesian culture. The food is a bit pricey, but it’s good and presented well - some with banana leaves, adding to the overall Indonesian cuisine exprience.

author: Anastasia G
review_text: The curry puffs and laksa were delicious. The prices are reasonable. Very quick service and plenty of tables nearby. Nothing fancy but good food. The place is obviously popular. I would recommend this place for a quick bite between your flights.

author: Cassius Clay
review_text: Bobe Kitchen & Bakery is incredible! The environment is really cool with such a creative design that makes you want to stay and enjoy. The staff were so friendly and helpful, which made the experience even better. I ordered a pizza and a latte through Uber Eats and both were delicious. Everything on the menu looked amazing, so I definitely want to come back to sit down and try more. Highly recommend this spot!

author: Daniel
review_text: Delicious brunch with a Mexican twist. The masa pancake in particular was unreal. The fried crispy edges mixed with the soft and moist center. Perfect blend of sweet and savory with the syrup, butter, and spices on top. 10/10

author: Jaevion Heyward
review_text: Good food. Service is terrrrrrrrible. I understand hard long days… i understand not being in the best of moods.. but this SERVICE here baaaaaaby NO! Literally been coming here for 5 years… ordering or dine in. Just terrible! Food is almost like your home cooked so no complaints. But Damn the attitude, I’m sorry to say they lost a customer, because I liked the food

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Meredith Sanders
review_text: The food was amazing and the restaurant is phenomenal. I got the crispy calamari, risotto of the day which it had all the seafood in it and definitely didn’t taste super fishy it was a super nice blend. Their tiramisu was really good and better than I expected. Definitely took me back to Italy for sure! The service was so great. Samet helped me with what I should choose and he was very knowledgeable about everything on the menu as well with the restaurant even if he’s been there for short time. Excellent service, food and atmosphere definitely will be back again!!!

author: EmilyAnn1115
review_text: I was so surprised with this place! I have passed it many times and finally decided to meet a friend here before a walk in the park. The decor was so peaceful and it was a nice atmosphere. My honey vanilla cinnamon latte and oatmeal was amazing. They were also playing christian music and there was a small room in the back selling christian books and artwork. I was so impressed and I will de be back. I am also telling all my church friends about this place🙏🏻

author: Hannah Tohir
review_text: The atmosphere is comfortable with artistic decoration, but the food is mediocre for me compared to the price. The mocktails have no taste, too much water from melted ice cubes. The service is slow because there are no staff available to serve the overflowing customers who are looking for a beautiful Christmas atmosphere. We had to wait 1 hour for the food to arrive and they didn't prepare spoons and forks, because I was so hungry, imagine the steak pieces being taken by hand.

author: Maria Pellini
review_text: I had Jury duty today and had no idea of where to go for lunch and saw this place across the street and decided to give it a try. The place appears small when you walk in to place your order but there is a good amount of seating in the back. This place was a pleasant surprise. It was the first time to try Jamaican food and wow what incredible flavors. The staff was very friendly and welcoming and quick to serve. I had the jerk fried rice with jerk chicken, topped with curry sauce, cabbage slaw, mango pineapple salsa with the jerk ranch. You can make your own combo of protein, toppings and sauces. There are helpful signs right where you have your choices to let you know what is available and how many items come with a purchase and what the extra cost are if you should order more. The portions are incredibly, and the prices are more than reasonable. After you order you can take your food to go in a sturdy bag or choose to eat it in a room in the back. I chose to eat my food there because I had time and I found it to be very comfortable and a very enjoyable atmosphere with interesting surroundings to look at. So happy to have made the time to eat here.

author: Roberts .J06
review_text: I came across this place while staying in the area. I actually could see this place from my hotel balcony. I looked it up and saw the amazing menu they had and wanted to go and try it. I really enjoyed the food and the staff was great! The coffee I had was amazing, first coffee of the day so my whole life depended on this coffee! Healthy delicious brunch! They have a seating outside that the water is across the street as well. Very great location and vibes .

author: Maryn C
review_text: The food is incredibly flavorful, the staff are really kind and attentive, and the atmosphere of the restaurant in the park was very enjoyable. The dipping sauces were the highlight! Spicy ketchup and sweet tots were an excellent combo 👌

author: Blake
review_text: Don't expect a sophisticated bahn mi, expect a fresh simple ingredients bahn mi with a good balance of flavour. I'll happily visit again.

author: Koyushi
review_text: Varieties of hawker food meams spoil by choices. Its rather a big food court but narrow between tables to table at certain sections Overall you almost find all hawker food under one roof its worth to visit.

author: winni weaver
review_text: I highly recommend this restaurant because the manager, Mr. Riki, provides outstanding service to his customers. He goes above and beyond to ensure that every guest has a pleasant dining experience. Additionally, he makes sure that the kitchen staff prepares meals to the highest standards. This establishment delivers food and service comparable to that of Michelin-star restaurants. Keep up the fantastic work, Mr. Riki!

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: Raymond Yee
review_text: Michelin Bib-Gourmand Zhup Zhup — Local Comfort, Levelled Up Where prawn broth turns into poetry, and “zhup zhup” becomes the sound of satisfaction. 📍 Zhup Zhup (formerly One Prawn & Co) is all about tradition meeting innovation — think soul-warming broths, luxurious seafood, and the kind of local flavours that make you smile after every slurp. 🔥 What we tried (and loved): 🍜 JFive Fortune Jumbo Prawn ($30++) — packed with lala, shabu pork, tobiko prawn ball, and pork ribs in that GAOGAO prawn broth. It’s rich, savoury, and full of depth — every sip screams umami. 🦞 Jumbo Lobster Paofan ($88++) — an indulgent bowl with a whole wild-caught spiny lobster, egg floss, and clams poached in their signature broth. Fresh, meaty, and a total must-try for lobster lovers. 🍗 Har Cheong Gai (5pcs, $11) — crispy, juicy, and seasoned just right. 🥢 Tasting Platter ($9) — perfect for sharing and sampling. 🥤 Don’t miss the drinks: 🌿 Pandan Lemongrass ($5++) – refreshing, earthy, and soothing. 🌾 Barley ($4++) – simple and cooling (a bit diluted). 💭 My take: If you love rich prawn broths and hearty local flavours, Zhup Zhup will hit you right in the feels. ⭐ Rating: 4/5 – A comforting, flavour-packed meal worth gathering your makan kakis for. #ZhupZhupSG #SingaporeFoodie #BibGourmandSG #PrawnNoodlesSG #LobsterPaofan #SeafoodLoversSG #SingaporeEats #FoodieSingapore #SGFoodies #SingaporeRestaurants #ComfortFoodSG #ZhupZhup

author: R w
review_text: It’s a small restaurant and the workers are very fast. Overall nice 👍🏾 my favorite is the honey walnut shrimp best honey walnut shrimp I had in my 35 years of living.❗️❗️❗️ I usually order the small honey one shrimp by itself when I don’t want a whole full course meal, but they only give you a few when you do that!! But the plates are very large they give you a lot.✅✅

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: Celestie Liew
review_text: I love their boat noodles very much. Despite the noodles texture a bit soggy (not so chewy), I love the soup base. It will be even better if can have fresher beansprouts. The space is spacious and you cna choose to sit outdoor which is under the trees or indoor.

author: marina dee
review_text: I'm one that normally goes to chain restaurants but it's an easy go to when at Atlas Park with the kiddos. I was expecting to hate it but actually really enjoyed it. The kids ate no problem and I ended up lovingggg the Nashville Hot mozz sticks. The service was excellent. Would definitely go back.

author: Subhankar Das
review_text: San Pedro Market Square is always buzzing with life — a vibrant mix of locals, travelers, music, and color. With tons of great food choices and stalls to explore, it’s easy to lose track of time. The blend of indoor and outdoor spaces makes it the perfect spot to wander, eat, and soak in the atmosphere.

author: Carlos Aguilar
review_text: Truly a phenomenal restaurant with excellent service. Our server, Daniel Castillo, was outstanding and guided us through the menu. I was really impressed with the details.

author: Eunice Ang
review_text: To be fair, food is good. I like the honesty of the staff, they informed the price of the crab and prawn before we ordered. Love the grilled prawn, cuttlefish, clams and also the vegetables. The vermicelli crab...not so nice, a bit sweet. Overall is good and reasonably priced.

author: Jo aisen
review_text: Love this place! The store is clean and bright. Their coffee is strong smells so good! We ordered cappuccino and ice latte. I love them! We also ordered Avocado toast. It’s great as well. Thick avocado with Balsamic…yummy 😋😋😋

author: Muhammad Izzwan
review_text: Service is good and food was prepared fast. Except for our dessert. Had to wait for awhile now while writing this review. The bakwan sayur is the man of the match. Rest of the food was okay. And the dessert just came. It is very nice. Worth the wait lol

author: R Kim
review_text: We were looking for ban xeo and saw the high ratings for Bep. Food was very good expect the chicken skewers which were dry as if they had been precooked and kept in a warming tray. Really no excuse for that. Skewers grill frairly quickly. Other than that, the staff were very friendly and the setting was warm and inviting. Love that the wet naps were free!

author: Farz Tex
review_text: The food was just okay below. Good quality. The service was super friendly and the restaurant was okay clean but the bathrooms were really bad And the sushi was not fresh at all but the rest of the food was just okay. The staff were super welcoming and very professional.

author: Suuraj
review_text: An excellent spot for authentic Thai food with one of the best ambiances in Las Vegas. The walls are beautifully painted with scenes that truly resemble Thailand, and popular English songs playing in the background add to the vibrant atmosphere. The restaurant was almost fully packed when we arrived, which speaks volumes about its popularity. The location on Fremont Street makes it even more special. Beng, our server, warmly welcomed us and provided outstanding hospitality; from taking our order to serving the food. She thoughtfully asked about allergies and spice preferences, which we really appreciated. We ordered the Red Curry with Tofu (similar to Panang curry), and it was one of the most flavorful and delicious curries I’ve ever had. The Veggie Pad Thai was equally impressive—perfectly balanced with a tangy taste, and the noodles had a unique dark brown, glass-like appearance. The Thai Iced Tea was absolutely amazing and a must-try. There are plenty of vegetarian options available; just ask the server for recommendations. Highly recommended for anyone looking for authentic Thai cuisine with great food, service, and ambiance.

author: Kevin Yeoh
review_text: Whoaaa... This place is so so nice. The moment you stepped in, I bet you will be impressed on the overall deco of the restaurant. It feels so nice and comfortable. The food is also great and I personally enjoyed almost all of the dishes that we ordered. There is one simple yet delicious dish which is the fried cabbage with meat. Then you can also order the spicy soup fish meat which I like as well. Service is very prompt as well. They have a few other outlets too so for example if you stay at island side you can go to the Island outlet near Bayan Lepas area. Price is not too expensive but a bit above average. Recommended to try !

author: Shiela Kim
review_text: If you’re looking for a no-frills, authentic Singaporean zi char experience, JB Ah Meng is a must-visit. Tucked away in the heart of Geylang, this casual eatery is beloved by locals, foodies, and even Michelin-star chefs — and for good reason. The White Pepper Crab is the star of the show. Unlike the more commonly found black pepper or chili versions, this dish stands out for its intense aroma, fiery white pepper kick, and juicy, perfectly cooked crab. It’s spicy but addictive — a dish you’ll crave long after the meal ends. But I highly suggest booking an appointment to avoid waiting time.

author: Ju Nguyen
review_text: From the food quality, service to atmotspher, personally I would like to give 5 star.

author: Z M
