review_text: Lau Pa Sat FOR THE WIN... forget going to restaurants and paying a premium. Go to Lau Pa Sat and try all the delicious mix Regional food that Singapore has to offer. In one very clean very, affordable spot. You could try Korean, Indian, Chinese, middle eastern all-in-one go. Fan at night it turns in to satay street. Great food and awesome atmosphere. You'll have a great time whether you're with family friends or a Solo Traveler.

author: Cristy Anne Bustillos
review_text: 1st time eating here! My husband and I came here for my birthday! And it was so amazing the atmosphere was so beautiful! Very friendly servers especially Scott. You guys must try their very new Ckg moroccan salmon, very delicious!! I want a 2nd plate but, I was full already 🤣. Best place to eat!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: MiKayla Delmont
review_text: This place was amazing!!! Kourtney and Chelsea really made our first time here something to remember! Would recommend this to anyone. Food is amazing

author: brysca rentcar
review_text: The Calamary was so bad , the size was too small ( doesn't like the picture in the menu), The Mango Salad wa the worse ever & also too pricely, my guests was so disappointed.

author: Dani
review_text: you can always depend on great food here. lots of meat in your sandwich, perfectly cooked on the grill; creamy eggs and crispy juicy bacon; stuffed burritos that will never fall apart. this place reminds me of the very best diners back east. the bustling ambience of those diners is, alas, not present inside Bob's, which seems best suited for well-packed to-go orders. but always, the food here is a satisfying pleasure, and the prices are a relief among other surrounding higher-priced breakfast joints.

author: Evelyn
review_text: My family and I arrived at around 7.30am for breakfast on a Friday but the kai si hor fun broth was not ready so, we sat down and waited for some time. Overall, everything is good. I had dry chicken curry noodle from another stall, curry gravy was on the sweet side. Nevertheless, the taste was ok.

author: Kat Olowu
review_text: 11/13/22 - 6:15p reservations Arrived right before 6:10 and got seated right away. It was a busy night. Although our server (Lindsey) was great, the kitchen was behind and our food took an hour to come out. Service and food were GREAT but the timing to get the food was poor. Despite the delays with the kitchen, I would give this restaurant another try as the food and service were great. The server indicated that it's typically not backed up like it was tonight.

author: Danielnhebe
review_text: I sit for very long and wanna order a drink with the waiter bringing water then she said you need go counter order. I wonder they hired only to take water. Service bad so decide don't wanna order a drinks then lucky chicken rice got soup to drink. Don't come here to here. Not encouraging

author: Rogue Sheepdog
review_text: The reason for my two star rating is because I love their pizza.But all too often they burn the bottom black, and this last one I got was literally black.It was totally crunchy, not chewy with the crisp that we all love. And I had to pay DoorDash to bring it to me. So that was like a $70 Pizza, not too happy. Probably won't water again.Because this is the second time, and it's just to the impensive, to get a mediocre pizza That's burnt.

author: Janna Rae
review_text: I LOVE LOVE Miami Cafe! Laureen & Judith are the absolute sweetest! the service is great and the food even better! it can get a little busy , they do their very, best to accommodate you and get you seated as soon as possible. We had no prob and got seated right away. Miami cafe is a miami brunch staple and a must go to!

author: Anthony De La Puente
review_text: Nestled amidst the charming streets of Jamaica Plain, MA, lies the Forest Hill Diner, a haven of warmth and nostalgia that beckons travelers and locals alike. Here, every sip of coffee is an invitation to journey back to simpler times, evoking memories of cozy mornings and hearty conversations. Served in classic Styrofoam cups with traditional pull-up lids, the coffee speaks of timeless quality and care. But the experience extends beyond the steaming brew. Forest Hill Diner’s pancakes are a symphony of flavors, each bite a delicate balance of fluffy texture, creamy butter, and sweet syrup. With every indulgent mouthful, diners are transported to a realm of pancake perfection, where every bite is a celebration of culinary craftsmanship. Yet, it is not merely the food that sets this diner apart. It is the intangible warmth that permeates its atmosphere, the genuine hospitality of its staff that makes every visitor feel like family. From the moment one steps through the door, they are enveloped in smiles and kindness, welcomed into a sanctuary of comfort and camaraderie. In essence, Forest Hill Diner transcends its role as a mere eatery; it is a sanctuary where the harmonious blend of good food, great coffee, and genuine hospitality creates an unforgettable dining experience, leaving a lasting impression on all who pass through its doors.

author: Lim Lim
review_text: The Shibuya toast takes quite a while to be served, but it’s worth the wait—the taste is as great as always. However, the price is slightly on the higher side.

author: Piow Piow
review_text: Must make a reservation first to avoid long queue during peak hours. Overall tastes normal and on standard but not really impressive. Reasonable price and portion. The crews respond with be slow during peak hours.

author: Yogesh G
review_text: one of the best food centres in SG. must try items - 1. fried snacks (vegetarian stall) 2. beancurd rice balls with soy milk 3. xiao long bao 4. durian chendol 5. items at Market stall (at the entrance from Buddha temple side) 6. hainanese chicken rice 7. soybeancurd

author: Andrew Yeoh
review_text: This nasi kandar shop is one of many of the Pelita chain. The shop is quite big. They have the usual Pelita set up. There are many types of curry to choose from. Nasi kandar and roti are available for breakfast, and nasi kandar and mi goreng for other times. The nasi kandar here is just average standard.

author: Mary Rod
review_text: The food is good but what I don’t like is the fact that it’s super hot 🥵 they don’t turn on the AC they don’t even turn on the fans because they say the lights are going to heat up the place up . I am no longer eating at this place there’s flies and they don’t even turn on the Ac . It is super hot 🥵 it’s ridiculous

author: Jason Tan
review_text: I’ve been to this place twice now, and both visits have been really enjoyable. The food quality is consistently impressive, and everything I’ve tried so far has left a positive impression. One of my favorites is the unagi dish — the eel was fresh and perfectly prepared, with rich and well-balanced flavors. The whole plate had depth and character; it wasn’t just another plain healthy meal. My friend ordered the Kampung Rasa ones, and agreed it was another standout. The sambal had just the right level of heat — not overly spicy, but still full of bold, flavorful notes that complemented the other elements on the plate. Then there was the salmon dish, which was another highlight. The salmon itself was fresh, nicely cooked, and the skin was perfectly crispy. It paired wonderfully with the tartar sauce, creating a great balance of texture and taste. If I had to point out one flaw, it would be that the rest of the salad came without any dressing, which made it feel a bit plain. A light passion fruit dressing or something with a bit of tang would really lift it up. The environment during both my visits was quiet and relaxed — a great place to chill and chat with friends. However, since I came during workday rushing lunch hours, so I wasn't enjoying the vibes much. Overall, this spot offers quality food, fresh ingredients, and a calm dining atmosphere. Definitely worth visiting again!

author: Catlin Chase
review_text: Absolutely loved this place! The food at Ruen Pair is incredibly authentic — the flavors are rich, balanced, and just the right level of spice. Everything tasted freshly made and full of that real Thai home-cooked vibe. The staff were super friendly and welcoming from the moment we walked in, and our dishes came out surprisingly fast even though the restaurant was quite busy. You can really tell they care about both the food and the guests. Highly recommend if you’re craving real Thai food in LA. Definitely coming back!

author: A P
review_text: cute garden patio. decent typical home-style dishes. but not a standout. cozy atmosphere at night.

author: G Santana
review_text: Ok food, dumplings above average, noodles soups recommended for sharing n the chrysanthemum tea was great.. recommend tor try if you are in the area

author: Rola Daoud
review_text: Def a MUST VISIT!! Huge variety of food that you don’t know where to start!! You do have to hunt for a table but it’s so much fun with a big group. Food prices are very affordable and the food is delicious. There is something for everyone. Highly recommend the bbq meat and squid skewers. And the traditional rice with chicken and veges on the side. Variety of drink options. Such a vibe and great experience.

author: Anupong Wongkulluck
review_text: Popular restaurant on Social Network. We arrived at 12.15 and got our hand on the first serve at 12.45 and it was a simple sticky rice without any main dishes. 10 minutes later we got mangosteen slad which was very salty and overpriced. Grilled chicken was okay but still overpriced as well. Lastly, papaya salad tasted weird and was not worth a try. Summary: overpriced and too long waiting

author: Melissa Benbow Flowers
review_text: We ordered the vegan chicken and waffles, the banana pancakes, the skillet side (potatoes and eggs) the matcha, chamomile mint tea, and. Chai tea to go. The food is good, and the chai and matcha are fantastic. Like the ingredients they use for the matcha and chai and the tea are quality. I would definitely come back and try more menu items. I should also say the staff are nice too!

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Rocky Ali
review_text: I went twice, the first time I got the steak sandwich and was great. The 2nd time I took my wife, we got the steak sandwich again w churrasco and an order of lamb chops We both got extreme food poisoning. Would not recommend, at least not the food truck. Dont even want to bother with the restaurant if they cant keep their food truck to safely handle food

author: Willyan Aleksander
review_text: Absolutely loved Sun Sun Warung! This was, without a doubt, one of the best dining experiences we had in Ubud - and definitely the best value for money. A special thanks to Santika, who took care of us with so much patience and kindness. She explained every dish in detail, helped my friend choose great vegetarian options, and made the whole experience feel genuinely warm and welcoming. The food was outstanding. My friend's vegetarian dishes were full of flavor, and my Bebek Goreng (crispy duck) was simply perfect - super crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside. As someone who loves duck, this was easily one of the best I've ever had in this trip. This place was recommended to me 2y ago and reached all the expectations, and now I'm happily recommending it to everyone. If you want authentic Indonesian food in Ubud, Sun Sun Warung is a must-try.

author: Alvin Ho
review_text: The sweet and sour pork was delicious! We also really enjoyed the superior la la soup, which had incredibly large and tasty clams. The tofu was decent, and the crab was alright. Service was excellent, and we appreciated the complimentary bean curd and ice cream.

author: Jeanne Mendoza
review_text: The food was absolutely amazing, every dish was full of flavor and beautifully presented! We really wanted to try the desserts but were way too full, so that just gives us the perfect reason to come back. 🤩 The service was impeccable, and a special shoutout to Sri, who was so warm and helpful in guiding us through the menu since it was our first time here. Definitely a must-visit in Bali — can’t wait to return!

author: Nathan Folk
review_text: Worst lobster Ive had ever. It was frozen and rubbery. The butter they served with it was fake and the veal i got was even worse. The veal had no seasoning at all. The tbone was very burnt and the only half decent thing was the bread. It is way overpriced and they lie about their portion sizes. My order said it would come with 3 lobster tails and it only came with one. The veal was no more than 8 ounces when it should be about 12. It was small and pathetic. The service was pretty good though. The meals are overpriced to hell.

author: Harsh Kothari
review_text: Their chili momo’s are really good, you got to try it and i also liked their chawmen. Fried rice and chili panner was average.

author: Freddy Gonzalez
review_text: Absolutely wonderful food! You definitely get your money's worth here, great proportions for your meal, the pancake flight was the perfect size to not overwhelm you. Mimosa flight was very good as well. Shout out to Lorenzo for being a great server, very attentive and wasn't helicoptering over us, came in just in time to refill drinks, customized breakfast orders were executed perfectly and was friendly the entire time we were there. Some of the best Mexican food in Vegas, and bonus stars for being a local business. Highly recommend and can't wait to return.

author: Minh Hải Đoàn
review_text: Booked a table and food in advance, but when I got to the restaurant, it was crowded so I couldn't read the order message in time, so I waited for 30 minutes. Continued to order food and waited for 30 minutes but still didn't see the food, probably because the restaurant was crowded. When I entered the restaurant, it was crowded so there was no staff to guide me to find a table, I actively went to find it but the staff was too busy, so I stood there for about 10 minutes before getting to the table. When the food arrived, there was no dipping sauce, I asked twice, waited 15 minutes for the dipping sauce. I don't blame the staff, the restaurant was too crowded. In short, I won't visit the restaurant again, it was a pretty bad experience, I went with my family, waited for almost an hour and waited another 15 minutes for the dipping sauce.

author: Mulan Lover
review_text: I came back twice for this green juice. 1st try their breakfast bowl and the size is quite big. Highly recommend! Dining alone is also chilling!

author: leslie paredes
review_text: really nice place to go to. Service here was good and especially the food ! Walking out I loved that I was able to see them feed stray cats it shows that the restaurant cares about their customers and the less fortunate ❤️.

author: N A
review_text: Tastes light and delicious. The price just OK The best Nasi Kandar that I ever tried. The queue quite long even the inside not full.

author: Michelle Budiali
review_text: Service by Kak Wiwin is excellent! Signature pork ribs so delicious and yummy! The crispy pork belly just okay, you can find a better pork belly in another place. Since the place is outdoor, there's no non smoking area, so you can smell cigarette smoke from another guest.

author: Gerrich Behrendt
review_text: Best Hawker Center for vegetarians I have found so far! No idea why , but it has a high density of vegetarian stalls and they are great! Also get an iced kopi at the coffee and drinks stall , it's amazing!

author: Nachiket Mehta
review_text: Angel - wow. Never experienced better service in NYC. Amazing burrito also. Highly highly recommended.

author: Siwat Phansuwannakee
review_text: Delicious food, great vibes, and fair pricing. A must-visit! 👍👍

author: Steven
review_text: Always enjoy Carl's Jr. My go to is the Double Western Bacon cheeseburger.

author: Zella Keiko Bawr
review_text: I really wanted to love this place, especially since my first visit (before it became an an 'Insta hit') was much better. Unfortunately, my second and most recent visit was quite disappointing. I understand why it’s famous online, but I care most about the food quality, and unfortunately, it seems to have declined. I must say, however, that the staff were consistently friendly and nice throughout our visit. We spent over 500K IDR on breakfast, which I don't mind if the food is excellent, but paying that much for a poor meal was frustrating: Avo on Toast with Extra Salmon: The sourdough was incredibly hard and burnt in places. The avocado was plain and had a bitter taste. I couldn't finish the meal. Brisket Bagel: The beef brisket was tough as hell, and the bagel itself was also very chewy. The dominant flavour was just overpowering mustard. Green Smoothie: Had a very weird taste and we couldn't finish it. The Almond Croissant was better than the rest, but even that wasn't as creamy and delicious as the one I had on my first visit when the cafe was quieter. It feels like the focus is now on the aesthetics/hype rather than consistent food quality. I would hesitate to recommend it now, which is a shame.

author: David Nguyen
review_text: Great place for digital nomads looking to do some work. Great views near the windows and lots of coffee options from pour over to specialty flavors.

author: Carla Acosta
review_text: I am Venezuelan and I enjoyed this place very much. They have a large selection of food and drinks. Price is very reasonable giving the area. The portions are good as well. We tried the arepas, steaks and appetizers. The music was a little too loud for my taste and I think they could pick better restaurant music to provide a more relaxing experience to their customers. Otherwise, everything was on point, clean and good customer service! I want to come back soon

author: M Batiste
review_text: Bobo's is always on point. They're the best hamburger stand around. The have the best Patty Melts & Fried Zucchini. The employees are always nice.

author: Lamemamabear Sonja
review_text: A hole in the wall type, local back alley type food, off the “night life” street. 6 of us sat in this small little joint over stainless steel tables n chairs and had dinner, while a small Vietnamese family runs the business at a super affordable price. The owners speaks decent English and very warmth, like going back to a family home. We ordered 2x Bun, 2 broken rice with extra sunny side eggs, 2 beef stir fried noodles, 2 sides of spring rolls, and 4 drinks, 2 Large beers, which came out to be a total of 410,000vnd, it’s insane. We would definitely return, small place and we were so glad we opted for a local street joint for dinner

author: Allison Doody
review_text: Food was absolutely incredible, we had Calista as our waitress and she was wonderful. Her service felt like fine dining! She was so bright and kind. It added to the whole experience! If you’re visiting Miami definitely stop by here for any brunch and breakfast needs!!!

author: Kanoon Siri
review_text: Personally, for the mango sticky rice bingsu, the coconut sauce was too salty that day. 🥹 (I’ve tried this menu at other branches and it wasn't salty there

author: Tandie Nunez
review_text: From Utah trying here loved it definitely go eat there real Mexican food so good I had chilaquiles kids had carne asada burrito and other kid Nutella pancakes coffee was amazing 🤩

author: Erika Armstead
review_text: Great food excellent service! Nasa was an amazing server! Answered all my questions thoroughly!

author: Willie York
review_text: The food is the best thing I ever had and I will be back for some more amen on God

author: Leandra Edelson
review_text: First off, the churros are INCREDIBLE and I can’t say this enough. The whipped cream is salted a tad, which perfectly balances out the peach compote and sweetness of the churros. I love a salted whipped cream and have never found a restaurant to do it. 10/10. we got a seafood platter special app which was truly fantastic. The steak was also great especially with the charred peppers, we got tortillas on the side which was perfect. Mushroom tacos are a must and so is the fried Oaxaca cheese !!!! Really great experience and super friendly staff

author: Kan WD
review_text: Food was great but it was a bit salty. The sangria is nice and strong. Not sweet. $3.99 fee for credit card and the suggested tip on the receipt is based on the total with the fee. If you're a big group, be careful.

author: Lee Mijares
review_text: The Old Airport Food Center was my first taste of hawker center dining in Singapore. There were so many choices that i found it hard to choose the food I want to eat! We settled at the first stall and ate fish and i found a stall at the back that sold beef stew and xia long bao. The place is spacious and there were a lot of people and black birds! Tips: Save your spot near the entrance. Its breezy here with the giant fans. Avoid dining in the middle because its too warm. Also, take your tray and tableware to the shelves at the back as a courtesy to the next customers. Food here us affordable. I only spent less than 8 dollars for my meal.

author: Jimmy Y
review_text: Ordered uber eats from here, paying full price for half the portions isn't fun. Can't recommend the delivery here.

author: Heng Khai Shen
review_text: I had such a great experience at this stall! The food was fresh, delicious, and full of flavor. The portion sizes were generous, and the prices were very reasonable. The owner was friendly and welcoming, which made the visit even better. Highly recommended if you’re looking for quality and good service!

author: Matthew Gudenius
review_text: Nice little unpretentious, unassuming little spot with good food! Popped in here because we were craving Peruvian food and waiting for a concert across the street at The Knockout. The prices are a little high (like most places these days) and we weren't super hungry, so we shared a ceviche de pescado (I believe it was red snapper) and some fried plantains. Both were quite good, and the server was friendly, and brought us additional bread and plantain chips. It was a nice and relaxed, casual experience with fresh food and no nonsense.

author: David M
review_text: I asked my muay thai instructor where to get authentic Balinese food, and he recommended this place out in the sticks😁 I looked at the menu, and they asked do you want 1st or the special plate...what?!?! The food was pretty tasty! Would not come back again, but it was a memorable experience

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: Joanne Lee
review_text: Overhyped. Underwhelming. Broth - failed. It looks thick but on taste, it’s the sugar type of sweetness which was building to a puke towards the end of the bowl. I go for umami meat sweetness taste but the broth here is simply sugar sweet and it feels like a thick concoction of prawn head juice with sugar. Overly pungent like 腥 and not 鲜. At $18 before GST and service charge for the pao fan, the prawns seems to be the small, regular size, quick freeze type, together with the lala clams. Hubby ordered the dried version of prawn noodles. Dried noodles was average, like any coffeeshop standard but wait… this is afterall a coffeeshop setting too. No aircon and really, it’s a coffeeshop. Overall, it’s not worth it. Simply overhyped. Will do better in terms of taste and prawn size with similar concept one at Killiney Road plus… there’s ac there!

author: Peter Joseph Tapia
review_text: This McDonald’s feels like the McDonald’s from hell like an emergency room at a third world country. We no one really answers even though you’re bleeding to death on the floor. I live right next-door at The Alea, and I’ve never seen it worse than this.

author: Gabriel DeRose
review_text: The ladies in here were so friendly. I ordered a Mediterranean Chicken Wrap. It was great. Thanks.

author: Eagle Bound
review_text: We went for brunch and overall had a good time. We got the pretzel biscuit, brown butter pancakes, omelette, and breakfast fried rice. Everything looked great and the food did taste good, but towards the end of our meal we did start to feel it was a bit greasy and heavy. The vegetarian options were extensive, which I really appreciated. I would come back if I wanted to take some friends, but I think it’s slightly out of my budget to become a regular option.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Nancy Garvin
review_text: The Hive is my go to spot in Marina del Rey! Delicious, health, fresh, + Inspired 🍒🍓🫐🥗🌯

author: James Smith
review_text: My favorite sandwich place in the US. Always great service and fresh sandwiches.

author: Erica Oh
review_text: I was extremely surprised by the portion! Didn’t expect it would be this small loll. And look at how mini size the satay is. In my opinion, the food itself wasn’t that great. The pork meat has lots of soft bones and some of the meat is quite hard to chew. I like the pork skin, the soup and the lawar veggies, but other than that, I don’t think it’s worth the effort to reach this place. To get here, the traffic is pretty bad. But good things about this place is, that they have spacious parking lots

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: Zhihan Yeo
review_text: One of the best boat noodles I've had anywhere in Thailand. They only have the pork version, I had the mix of everything with pork balls, intestines, liver and stewed pork. Ingredients were higher quality than usual without being expensive. Grab some fresh pork crackling and khanom thuay too! Thick, creamy, coconut and pandan fragrance without being overly sweet. This place is a little hidden but its walkable from the main tourist centre and definitely worth seeking out in Hat Yai.

author: lea'nora spencer
review_text: I came in on Monday and had an amazing experience thanks to my server Nehry!She was attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was perfect from start to finish. The service was quick, professional, and welcoming. She truly made the visit enjoyable and I’ll definitely be back!

author: Ollie Boon
review_text: Great breakfast with proper sausages! Upstairs there’s a nice Aircon room as well, which is nice in the hot weather. Nice for breakfast or brunch and definitely recommend.

author: Fenny W
review_text: Good service. Great vip rooms. Great staff. Nice live music!

author: Floriane Ying
review_text: Very disappointing overall. The portions are impressive and beautifully presented, but the quality isn’t there. We waited over 30 minutes to get our plates… reducing portion size but improving service speed might help. Giving 2 stars because I’m a mango smoothie fan, and theirs was easily the best in Bali.

author: M. Alvarado
review_text: We hosted my aunt’s birthday party here and couldn’t have asked for a better experience. The food was delicious, the service warm and attentive, and the atmosphere perfect for celebrating. Thank you to the team for helping make her day truly unforgettable!

author: MAA 91
review_text: All-in top notch experience! Contacted the HQ reservation team, enquiring on private room and celebration decoration. All went smoothly and was given the 10-pax private room which was equipped with washing sync with towels and handfoam. There is a minimum spending of IDR 4mil for the 10-pax room, but with around 6 pax, you can easily reach that. On the food and beverage, everything was good and was prepared exceptionally. Our favourite was the salted egg jumbo prawns. Finger licking good! Menu was extensive and you could easily come here many times to repeat and rotate your choices. Yummeh!

author: PH Chan
review_text: I visited here for dinner early on a Thursday evening. Asian buffets are my guilty pleasure. Please don’t tell my Chinese mom ; ) Maybe I caught them on an off night, but it was disappointing. The good: large selection of Asian entrees and some not-so-Asian offerings too (including cheese pizza, mac & cheese, and tater tots). The roasted meats were solid. Duck was surprisingly good. BBQ chicken and pork ribs were also solid. Sushi was good too. Mostly assorted rolls, but everything was well prepared. The other seafood dishes were also tasty. They were fresh and nicely sauced. Desserts were cafeteria quality, but there was a big selection of ice cream bars and cups in a freezer nearby. I didn’t try the hibachi, but it looked good too. Server was friendly and efficient. The not-so-good: pretty much all of the fried foods were limp or soggy, including the fried shrimp dishes, Gen’l Tso’s chicken, calamari, potstickers, eggrolls, etc. I think this could have been because it wasn’t too busy when I was there, and they were bringing out lots of food. So a lot of the food was sitting on the steam trays for long enough to loose its crunch. But that also meant that the food on the top of the piles got kind of cold. So my recommendation would be to either visit when they’re really busy and replacing the food quickly or get a seat where you can see when they bring out the refills and make your choices accordingly.

author: Lisa Weber
review_text: Had breakfast here for the first time and it was a very good experience overall. The service really stood out – the waitress was incredibly kind, attentive, and fast, gave great advice, and genuinely thought ahead. She made us feel very well taken care of. The only small downside was that it was quite loud, which made it a bit less relaxing. Looking back, I might have been a little unfriendly that day myself – which makes the professionalism and warmth of the service even more impressive. I’d definitely come back.

author: Mika Astono
review_text: Really good Dominican food! No frills, uncomplicated yet heartwarming meals and a certain local local favorite It’s a small shop with no dine in seating, but the portions were extremely generous and the Chicharrones were both tender and crispy. You can get a plate with different sides, or a sandwich(“chimi”)

author: Jason Sandoval
review_text: This was by far the best ceviche I’ve ever had in my life. Every single dish was prepared with such intention in flavor and execution. Truly there was not a single bite that I had that did not make me close my eyes to savor the dish. I ordered the Tetras de Ceviche and the Tiradito Apasionado and split it between two people. This was more than enough. I also ordered the SOBE and Cholopolitan and neither were a disappointment. Honestly they were the perfect pairing for the dishes so I highly recommend. We were waited on by Yuri and he was such a gem and did such a great job caring for us. He makes it that much easier to recommend this place. Not only did he describe the dishes and the drinks and assist with recommendations within the restaurant he also gave us local recommendations around Miami. All the way from Chicago, thank you CVI.CHE105!

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: อภินันท์ รุจิระกรกุล
review_text: Sit back and relax, focus on conversation, not snacks. Comfortable, but there's no backrest. Older people should consider it.

author: L Chan
review_text: Not a morning place - many stalls were still closed. The space feels stuffy, likely due to low ceilings & inactive exhausts, with fans just circulating the hot air from above.

author: YEREMIAH PRINCE
review_text: To give Pepe's Tacos just five stars feels like an injustice. If I could, I'd give them 45 stars for their exceptional food, incredible value, and consistent quality. This place is a Las Vegas institution for a reason. Let's start with the food: authentic, flavorful, and generously portioned. The carne asada fries are legendary—piled high with perfectly seasoned steak, rich nacho cheese, and a perfect blend of toppings. It's a full meal that could feed two, and it's easy to see why it was voted the best in Las Vegas. For taco purists, the street tacos are a revelation. Whether you go for the succulent carnitas or the spicy adobada, the meat is cooked to perfection and served on fresh, warm tortillas. The condiment bar is stocked with fresh salsas and toppings that add the perfect final touch. Service is fast and friendly, even during the busiest hours. The fact that it's open 24/7 is a gift to anyone looking for a satisfying late-night meal that's a massive step up from fast-food chains. This isn't just a restaurant; it's a dependable, delicious cornerstone of the community. Pepe's Tacos delivers a fantastic, authentic Mexican food experience every time, and that's worth more than five stars in my book.

author: Celina N
review_text: Wonderful place with delicious food! The staff were welcoming, friendly, and attentive. They made sure we were comfortable and enjoying the food. I never tried bun cha and goodness, it was yummy! 😋

author: Leanna
review_text: I love everything about this place. The food, service and the atmosphere, everything is great! Nothing to complain and totally worth the hype! We chose the typical thai’s specialty; sangkaya & mango. The mango ice shave is so sooo good! Not too sweet. And the mango is not too ripe. So, it was a bit sour and it compliments the sweetness from the ice. And their sangkaya toast also so yumm! Sangkaya with coconut ice is such a perfect combo.

author: Jin Giap Koh
review_text: Just choose your favourite patty. They serve angus beef and wagyu beef patty. If you do not like beef there chicken in the menu also. They will pan fry the patty in front of you. So you control the doneness of your beef your own. All choice come with unlimited rice, miso soup, vege. The food is super nice, highly recommend for people like to eat burger but with rice instead of bun. Oh yea, there is kimchi at the desk together with the sauces.

author: Eric Tan
review_text: A lot of variety of food but the quality is averaged only, in taste versus its value. We ordered Pan Mee Soup, Hoo Tau Bee Hoon, Chee Cheong Fun, and Siow Bak Rice. This time around, we ordered Xiao Leung Pao plain + Malak, Vegetarian Dumpling, Fried Pork Gyoza, Bitter Gourd Soup, Hockien Mee, Chee Cheong Fun, Fish Meat & Dumpling Soup, and Otak². The Hockien Mee is so diluted and inconsistent in taste. A few days ago, we came and the HKM was superb, but this time, it was so diluted and sweet. The notable dishes are the Fish Meat & dumpling soup. Previously, the Siow Bak rice was good but was overwhelmed by its sauce. Half a portion of the sauce is sufficient rather than wetting the whole rice and plate. FOOD : Non-Halal LOCATION : Beside USM (Sg Nibong) CHOICE : Good TASTE : Good PRICE : Satisfactory AVG.VALUE: RM5.10 - 18 per plate / set

author: Miguel Silva
review_text: Food here was ok but it is a little pricey. Not saying it was bad because it wasn't just nothing special. I feel I could have gotten the same meal somewhere for a better price. Went on a Saturday night at 8pm and it was packed. Couldn't even get into valet parking so we had to look in the street. Doesn't seem like the best area to be walking around late at night. Make sure to make reservations. The service was good, the issue I had personally was I felt I was being rushed. We were having apps and he came and took my plate away before I got more calamari. I felt they could have come a few times more to check on us. I was looking for a waiter because I ran out of drinks. The place itself is nice and big. We were seated upstairs and it was pretty crowded. No music in the background but it's really loud. I could barely hear a friend 2 seats away. We also had this unnecessarily loud group behind us. It's a 25min drive for me to get here so I probably won't be coming back. I feel I can do same or better closer to me. If I was from the area I would like to give it another shot.

author: 834r_
review_text: Ordered a pizza, had the wrong phone number that was my bad, but then i called to get it redilvered, they said they would, they didnt, called again, they hung up on me, and now i just want a refund

author: William Dawson
review_text: We had several starters and everything was delicious. Enjoyed Dates with bacon, stuffed mushrooms, patatas bravas, tortilla and Croquetas de Chorizo.

author: Agatha Sitepu
review_text: Went here with a few friends. There was a wedding event on the first floor, so service was a bit slower and the food took a little longer to come out. Despite that, the staff were friendly and the food was really good. Would love to come back on a regular day

author: Laurie Gibbons
review_text: If the thing in the wheelchair on the corner doesn't catch me every time I come here!👊 This spot is plagued with beggars and audacity! I probably won't ever come here again I barely do as is anyway lol EVERYTHING (and I mean everything cooked) is dried out and lukewarm 🥺. But if u must go... I'd recommend the frosty and baconactor ONLY lol

author: George Dickerson
review_text: Winnie & Ethel's Downtown Diner is a true Las Vegas gem. All of the food items are homemade. My favorite is the Diner Breakfast. I always get all bacon that comes with 2 eggs, home style potatoes, and a biscuit. In addition, I get coffee and water. I can say that this place never disappoints and the staff here are absolutely amazing! This truly is the best breakfast place in Las Vegas!

author: Steven Chen
review_text: I’ve always enjoyed dining at Smith & Wollensky and most parts of my recent visit were great the service, the atmosphere, and the rest of the dishes were all solid. However, I was really disappointed with the Wagyu Ribeye. For a steak that costs $150, the experience fell far below expectations. I waited almost an hour for it, and the first one that came out was extremely salty. After sending it back, the replacement steak arrived noticeably undercooked. I had ordered medium, but as you can see, the doneness was nowhere close to what medium should be. I understand mistakes happen, but for a premium priced cut like this, I expect more consistency and attention to detail. I hope the kitchen can take this feedback seriously, because everything else about the meal was wonderful just not the steak, which ironically was supposed to be the highlight.

author: J Celtic617
review_text: I've been here multiple times over the past few years and I love this location. I have personally never experienced any bad service. The food Is delicious and portions are worth the money

author: Omer Aswad
review_text: This place is so cute and aesthetic .. small, but full of good vibes! The atmosphere feels cozy and stylish at the same time. The service is amazing — everyone is super friendly and welcoming, with great customer service. The drinks are honestly to die for, and the food is really good too. Definitely one of those hidden gems in Miami you’ll want to keep coming back to.

author: Dirty Souf Yankee
review_text: My first experience was good. Second two, meh. Their avgolemono soup isn't made the way I'm used to but was still ok. Chicken souvlaki is good, Feta is not. Fries are ok. Rice pilaf is bland. Their rewards system and online ordering are something no one seems trained on and is confusing. Online ordering also does not make anything easier. My food took nearly 30 minutes to come up.

author: Mulyadi Syariffudin
review_text: Had a superb meal at Kampang ISAN. First time ever trying Ants Larva but it doesn’t have any taste really but the omelette was superbly fried. The grilled Pork Neck was done to perfection!

author: David Monson
review_text: Loved everything I ate here. Took me back to my year living in China. So flavorful. Soany of my favorite dishes. I'll be coming back for sure!

author: Sala Smith
review_text: They donuts are so delicious. Got a mystery box a dozen and every single one was delicious. The Croissant was so good. It had a believe it was pepperoni and jalapeños and cheese so good. I tasted it. The kids loved them and the adults let them I will be back.

author: shaivya poudyal
review_text: Might want to carry an insect repellent. Tried the Yummy Babi guling with crispy fried skin. Looked like a local fav, clean WCs and friendly service with comforting ambiance. Would totally visit again and happily recommend. Delish food and surper reasonly priced.

author: Business Assistant
review_text: We were very satisfied by the service and food! We tried pizza (Saturday promo - take 2, pay for 1) — Vegetarian Green and Pumpkin pizzas was amazing! 🤩 Also we tried Masala tea and cappuccino decaf, as well as pancakes 🥞. Everything was sooo tasty. But I think that 77k for Large cappuccino decaf with oat milk is too much 😊 Anyway, we want to come back! 😃

author: Mary Carmona
review_text: The chicken was salty and the sweet plantain tasted old. She was nice but the food was a big no yesterday. So disappointed.

author: Banuaji P
review_text: Nice place to get some noodle. Dont forget to get the Octopus one. Its so good and they chop to bite size. The noodle also good too.

author: Mackaz Sajiaos Tan
review_text: Lau Pa Sat is easily one of my favourite places to enjoy a meal in Singapore. The moment you step inside, you’re greeted with the lively sights and smells of truly local food. From satay and chicken rice to laksa and char kway teow, it’s a place where you can taste the heart of Singapore in one stop. What I love most is how Lau Pa Sat brings together both locals and tourists. It’s a must-visit spot for anyone wanting to experience authentic Singapore flavours, and yet it still feels like a gathering place for everyday Singaporeans. The atmosphere is always warm and buzzing, especially when the satay street opens at night. On top of all the good food, Lau Pa Sat is full of history. Housed in a beautiful historic building with its iconic cast-iron architecture, it’s a reminder of Singapore’s past blending seamlessly with its modern city life. Eating here feels like enjoying a meal inside a piece of the nation’s heritage. A vibrant mix of flavours, culture, and history — Lau Pa Sat never disappoints. Perfect for both first-time visitors and anyone who loves great local food.

author: Barbaro Moya
review_text: If you are looking for a good food, a lovely Staff and a friendly ambient. This is the place.

author: Junior Franco
review_text: This popular Michelin awarded spot is charming and the service is friendly. However, the food doesn't quite live up to the hype. The flavors often taste muted and one-note, lacking the fresh, vibrant punch of authentic Thai cuisine. Some dishes ingredients don't always taste garden-fresh. It's a decent meal, but for the reputation, you'd expect more exciting taste and better quality. It's good for a casual fix, but not the culinary destination it's made out to be.

author: lvlisa
review_text: Online selection and advertising is false to what the store provides. Been there twice and they are out of everything. Jelly filled donuts are maybe a quarter filled. Donuts do not taste fresh, but stale. Not worth your time or money. Recommend Pink Box for jelly filled donuts- they are loaded with filling and quality of pastry.

author: Josh
review_text: The food is really good here. And there is SO much of it! The variety is good. And the quality is good. The staff are efficient, but not overly friendly nor obtrusive. It is also VERY reasonably priced.

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: Anne Lin
review_text: My fiancé and I came here around 6:30 pm and parked easily in the big lot right in front. We had our hotel call earlier to book a table, which I’d definitely recommend since the place gets quite full during dinner. There are three dining areas — an outdoor riverside balcony, an upper indoor deck, and a basement section (where we sat, not much view). The place is clean and nicely lit, but if you care about the view, let them know when you book. Food and service were both excellent. The staff spoke decent English and were super friendly, patiently explaining the menu and giving great recommendations. We loved the stir-fried prawn with shrimp paste, deep-fried chicken wings, and crab egg curry. The only miss was the steak with chimichurri sauce — the steak is not very tender despite having a “Michelin recommendation” sauce aside (so we were told by the staff). Overall, amazing food. Would totally come back to try more dishes!

author: Paul Almashi
review_text: Absolutely loved GRECO! The food is fresh, flavorful, and truly authentic — every bite feels like a trip to Greece. The atmosphere is cozy and stylish, and the staff are super friendly and attentive. Prices are fair for the quality you get. Highly recommend to anyone who enjoys real Mediterranean flavors! 🇬🇷✨

author: Subhankar Dey
review_text: Cộng Cà Phê is one of my favorite coffee chains in Vietnam. It beautifully preserves the authentic values of the country's history. The thoughtfully curated interiors always remind me of Kolkata’s vintage charm. The coffee is quite good and reasonably priced. The staff wear uniforms that evoke the spirit of a significant movement in Vietnam’s past, adding to the immersive atmosphere. If you sit by the window, you can enjoy a charming view of the river and watch the boats gently pass by. The name "Cộng" is inspired by “Cộng sản,” meaning “communism,” reflecting the café's nostalgic tribute to Vietnam’s historical era.

author: Mel Teoh
review_text: The best yam rice I had so far! The rice has been cooked with fresh yam and tiny dried shrimp mixed in it. You can see the melted yam in the rice! Also the soup is unlimited to refill!!! Tastes sour and umami with the pork meat in the soup which packed with lot of flavours in the soup. Heard from one my friends said this is the Michelin starred restaurant. Not sure is it true or not but for me, this restaurant is worth to try out their food!

author: Cédric Lignier
review_text: The food at this place is outstanding. We ordered a ban mi (highly recommend), spring roll (highly recommend too), + 2 different rice noodle bowls. Oh and the desert! We tried the cheese cake and while pretty small it was delicious! The atmosphere at this place is also amazing. It is pretty much a co working space with 3 floors that offer plenty of space and great light quality. We will definitely come back for another chill few hours at this cafe!

author: Austin Hollopeter
review_text: Wonderful service! The waitresses were very sweet and accommodating. My wife loved the crispy chicken sandwich and the pistachio latte was excellent.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Abc Abc
review_text: Great flavors. Not the cleanest, but its at a beach in open air. The tacos are great, could develop a signature drink, non alcoholic options are limited. Opening for breakfast instead of 12noon, is also helpful-especially for their guest that check out at 11am.

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: Briam isari
review_text: Geylang Serai is one of Singapore’s key Malay cultural districts. Once an area filled with lemongrass (“serai”) plantations, it later became a hub for the Malay and Nusantara communities. Today, it’s known for the lively Geylang Serai Market, Wisma Geylang Serai community centre, and the vibrant annual Ramadan bazaar. The area remains an important symbol of Malay heritage and culture in Singapore.

author: YS Cheng
review_text: Quite a number of nice stalls to choose from but they usually closed very early. I reached around 1pm and most of the stalls already closed. This hawker centre is rather old so ambience is not that pleasant. Food wise was okay.

author: Binshuang Li
review_text: The view is absolutely spectacular, making this a prime spot for a meal. The food is decent and satisfying. Unfortunately, the dining experience was significantly marred by the inconsistent service. We encountered a few issues that were frankly unacceptable. For example, despite being the first group at lunch to order clam chowder, we were told there weren't enough bowls for our party. Furthermore, one of the waiters seemed to be in a very bad mood: they were yanking menus from the table and even spilled food while clearing a used dish.

author: Pedram Nick Aryan
review_text: Viral for a reason, but maybe not the right one … case of volume over quality. If you’re coming here because of TikTok, just know what you’re getting into: a massive meat mountain. It’s takeaway only and no seating. The Pro: The portion size is insane. They give you the veggies in a separate bag, which is a smart move to keep the bread from getting soggy during transport. The kitchen looks clean and staff were polite, friendly and quick. The Con: It’s almost too much meat. The flavor profile is heavy and lacks that light, herbal balance of a traditional banh mi. The bread was also a bit of a letdown, lacking that signature airy crunch. Verdict: There’s no denying the "wow" factor when they hand you this heavy bag. However, after the first few bites, the novelty wears off. It’s a fun "bucket list" item for the sheer scale of it, but as far as flavor goes? It's mediocre. Unfortunately, the sandwich itself misses the mark on the fundamentals and the delicate balance Saigon’s street food is known for. It’s a bit of a "stunt food" experience.

author: Kim Chii
review_text: I had tried similar salads at other places and really enjoyed it, so I gave this place a shot — but honestly, it was a huge letdown. The soup was absolutely terrible, with a strong, unpleasant smell that made it almost inedible. The salad was just plain and forgettable. The salad was okay at best, but nothing worth coming back for. The only good thing was the service — staff were polite and attentive. the atmosphere is lovely also. Unfortunately, the food was bad enough that I won’t be returnin

author: Avery Watson III
review_text: Went Back For An Encore! With all of the seafood choices in Boston, to opt for this restaurant twice in a 4-day vacation….says alot. The seafood is obviously excellant. But the ambiance is every bit as enjoyable. We dined outside, among a cozy set of tables on the harbor. It was a pleasant combination of relative seaside serinity and circus just inside. I had and truly recommend the basic Fish and Chips. Wifey selected the Crabcake& Shrimp, a signature dish for the restaurant. Both were truly delicious. We will definitely return!

author: Ellis Seul
review_text: ridiculously long wait time given how many people they had on the line and that it wasn't super busy, but the food was very tasty and the portion sizes solid; i'd recommend the chicken arepa and the maduros

author: Chanel G
review_text: This hands-down has been one of my favorite dining experiences in Miami. I was blown away by the service, the food, the ambience, the music, a 10 out of 10 experience I was just so happy to be there. It is the perfect place to go especially for date nights. It’s also really cute to take pictures. The prices are amazing. The quality of food is superb. I cannot wait to go back to this place. It was truly amazing and I’m vegan. They had so many vegan options for me and that also meant a lot. I had the vegan Rasta pasta. With pineapple plantain's. My friend had the rice with salmon and jerk fries.

author: Travis Coleman
review_text: This has to be one of the worst Sonics I've ever been to, they mess up orders quite frequently and the quality of it isnt very good. Not to mention that the wait times here are insanely long most times you order, Ive order on the app, drive to a stall, alert them I've arrived and sat at the stall for over 15 mins on several occasions. I live next to this sonic and we now drive miles away to a different one whenever we want sonic.

author: Margalit M
review_text: I'm happy that I found this spot near my hotel for a lovely sushi dinner. The tuna roll was good, and the nigiri tuna with Truffle and something else was divine! Edemame was too salty--like we are obsessed with salt, and sometimes I think restaurants go a little too heavy, which I don't need when there's lots of soy sauce on the table. Service was excellent and food came out very fast... like maybe too fast because I got my cocktail after the sushi was on the table. But overall, great spot with lots of space for large groups.

author: Brandon T
review_text: The food was absolutely delicious and authentic - I ordered the bruschetta, napoletana (one of the best pizzas I've ever had) and tiramisu. Service was also exceptional and professional. I would definitely come back if I'm ever in Singapore again.

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: Ding Heng Lee (harryldh)
review_text: The prawn broth is way too sweet with MSG taste. After eating can clearly feel my inner lips tearing. For prawns, regardless of small prawn or big prawns there were overcooked. Pork ribs are also filled with gaminess. Had the dry noodle with beehoon as recommended, no fragrance. Pork lard was gamy, fried shallots cannot be tasted without actually biting into it. Overall the noodles were badly seasoned. I’m really questioning how was the Michelin Bib Gourmand given on this. Ngiong hong however was decent, pass standard but definitely can’t compare with good ones in Penang.

author: Brooke Greer
review_text: Excellent location and view. Outstanding service all the way around. I only wish they had mermaid merch to match their logo & branding ;). Food was great, a couple people said the dishes could be elevated, but that is more of a casual place so it was perfect. Great place to bring huge groups or small groups, especially if you're going to an event nearby. On the waterfront!

author: Phuoc Long Nguyen
review_text: Nam Bo Grilled Village is located on Duong Duc Hien Street, Tay Thanh Ward, Tan Phu District, an ideal culinary destination for those who love traditional grilled dishes with rich Southern flavors. The restaurant's location is quite easy to find, located right in a busy residential area and convenient for travel, with a spacious parking lot, so it is very convenient for both motorbikes and cars. The restaurant space is spacious and airy with a style close to nature, imbued with the Southern style. The restaurant has many areas, suitable for many different groups of guests such as families, friends, or company parties. The space is very sparkling when lit up in the evening, creating a cozy but equally comfortable feeling. Regarding food, the restaurant serves a variety of grilled dishes - from seafood, beef, chicken to rustic dishes such as hot pot with fish sauce, grilled snakehead fish, grilled chicken with salt and chili... The flavor of the dishes is rich, delicious, the ingredients are fresh and delicious, and the preparation is standard. In particular, the dipping sauce here is very unique, contributing to enhancing the flavor of the grilled dishes. The staff is friendly, quick and enthusiastic. Even though the restaurant is crowded, you still don't have to wait too long to order. The price is reasonable compared to the quality and space it provides. Overall, this is an ideal place to enjoy Southern cuisine in the heart of Saigon, from seafood, beef, chicken to rustic dishes such as fish sauce hotpot, grilled snakehead fish, grilled chicken with salt and chili... The flavor of the dishes is rich, delicious, the ingredients are fresh and well-prepared. In particular, the dipping sauce here is very unique, contributing to enhancing the flavor of the dish!

author: Yuri Choi
review_text: The restaurant is beautifully decorated and has a nice atmosphere, which is why we chose it for dinner before a concert at the Prudential Center. We had a group of six and came in on Friday night around 5 PM with a reservation. Unfortunately, the experience was very disappointing. They advertise lamb right at the entrance, but when we asked for it, the server told us they didn’t have any. On top of that, a few other menu items we tried to order were also unavailable, which was frustrating. The menu looks extensive, but most of what we tried fell flat. The Caesar salad was probably the worst I’ve ever had.. the chicken was dry and flavorless. We ordered our steaks medium, but they came out almost well-done. Pasta and risotto were the only decent dishes, thankfully. For a place calling itself a steakhouse, the quality didn’t come close to expectations. Even the restroom felt like an afterthought as their toilet paper was not stocked inside the dispenser, just hanging outside, which was sloppy. Overall, despite the nice décor and convenient location, the food and service really missed the mark. Sadly, I wouldn’t come back.

author: Tony Yip
review_text: Hit and miss. I ordered two different orders from them during the Xmas week. One was done correctly and tasted so good. Another time was done so sad and very little topping and didnt have enough cheese and the crust was so thick.

author: AG
review_text: Miam Cafe was relatively close to our hotel. We’ve been hunting to find a good breakfast spot while visiting Miami, and man am I glad we found this place! They were really busy so we had to wait outside for a little bit but we had cover from the rain. The atmosphere inside is amazing, service is amazing, and the food is AMAZING! Probably some of the best food I’ve had, especially the breakfast burrito. The Dubai pancakes were so unique, presented beautifully, and tasted fantastic (although you can definitely split it with others, the portion is huge). This is just the place we were looking for the really get the Miami experience. Would absolutely recommend to anyone wanting some tasty breakfast/lunch that is unique and delicious!

author: John Guo
review_text: Good authentic Vietnamese cuisine. The place has Michelin bib gourmand sign so is always busy and needs prior booking. Tu - the owner is often there and very friendly. You can tell she really puts her heart into making the food. Really love the baby clam and the beef & oyster hotpot in coconut water

author: Lilly B
review_text: I stopped by this café and it was absolutely worth it. I ordered the Madagascar vanilla latte, which was really nice — smooth, comforting, and perfectly balanced without being overly sweet. I also tried the plain croissant, and it honestly ended up being one of the best croissants I’ve ever had. It was incredibly buttery and flaky, with light, airy layers and just the right crisp on the outside. There was a bit of a line, so you might have to wait, but once you get your order, it totally makes sense why it’s popular. If you’re into great coffee and truly amazing pastries, this place is a must-stop.

author: Matthew Gormley
review_text: The food was absolutely amazing! True traditional Balinese cuisine with an amazing atmosphere and brilliant service who are so welcoming and kind. Lili our waitress was incredible, kind, friendly and had amazing knowledge of bali and the restaurants cuisine for recommendations! I wouldn’t go to bali without coming here! 100/10

author: Marieme Diop
review_text: Halal pizza that is delicious! I definitely recommend stopping by when you can. The service is quick and they're quite nice!

author: Mimi
review_text: This is a must-visit every time I’m in Singapore. The frog meat is always fresh, tender, and perfectly cooked, with no gamey taste at all. The sauce is rich and aromatic, pairing beautifully with the smooth, comforting porridge. I personally prefer this place over Eminent, the flavors here are more balanced and satisfying. Simple, local setting, but consistently great food. I never skip this spot when visiting Singapore.

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: May Wong
review_text: Carrotcake clean no burnt bits. But michelin 2024... i don't agree. Not as good as toa payoh green mountain but better than tiong bahru market carrot cake.

author: racheal Ooi
review_text: Such a shame, really. The tehC peng(both tarik and non-tarik) here is one of the better ones — smooth, fragrant, and not too sweet. Their eggs and toast are classic and done just right too. But the attitude of the staff (possibly the owners) just kills the vibe. Not the friendliest bunch, and it kinda makes you feel unwelcome even though the food’s really good.

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: Kock Sing Tan
review_text: We reached the restaurant on weekend at about 8pm. There were plenty of parking spaces at the roadside. There was no queue time for the table. We chose the airconditional seating. First of all, we needed to order at the fried koay teow stall. Serving within 20 minutes, although the server said waiting time was 45 minutes. Fried koay teow was delicious but not that great. It had wok hei but not enough. Prawns were too small and had too few ingredients. It's just slightly above average. The skills were normal only. RM7 per serving. 3 stars We needed to collect an order form from the fried koay teow stall for drinks and side dishes but very strage, the drinks and side dishes were not belonged to the fried koay teow stall. We were told to bring the order form back to our table and fill in. Then, another server would come to our table to collect the order. The side dishes octopus was the star of the night. It was very special, fresh and juicy. We never try before such a delicious octopus. RM25 wasvaluede for money. 5 stars The side dishes steam lala with onion ginger was delicious. The sauce was so addictive. RM28 per serving was value for money. 5 stars The four fruit desert 四果汤 at RM10 per serving was the best we tried so far of its kind. The ingredients were so rich and many varieties. The soup was not too sweet and just nice. 5 stars We came for fried koay teow of Michelin but ended up finding other gems.

author: Emily Lojewski
review_text: Didn’t think I’d be hearing club music at a breakfast cafe but it is Miami after all! Loved the overall vibe of the cafe. The lattes are delicious. Got the Tiramisu French toast and it was so good! The portions are huge! A little on the pricier side for breakfast food but I don’t have much else to compare to for Miami dining so it’s probably average pricing. Definitely a cute little spot for a yummy breakfast or lunch! Our waitress Maria was very attentive and sweet.

author: Papa Lim
review_text: Good food like intestine soup & chicken wings. Crispy skin bbq wings But majority of e food stalls (9 stalls) sell vegetarian. So if u are big fan, this is a must go place.

author: mark phea
review_text: only 5 star rating will represent everything, nothing much can say so..

author: Todd Curtiss
review_text: Waterfront dinning with a spectacular view and food that rivals anything upscale restaurant in the major New England area. The staff were extremely friendly and helpful. Live music and drinks were excellent. Live music was the cherry on top of the cake. I highly recommend this place if you’re in town or simply just driving through it is definitely a destination stop.

author: Denise Bailey
review_text: Food didn't disappoint. However, the service and attention to the details are essential and they failed. It wasn't even busy. I ordered and paid for items I didn't get because I don't have time to check the bag. Oh well 🤧

author: Rosie Bakes
review_text: Absolutely loved this spot! 🌿 The tropical vibes are unreal—lush leafy seating, relaxed atmosphere, just so inviting. The food is a feast for the eyes and the taste buds: vibrant, colorful, and incredibly fresh. Even as a non-vegan, every dish was packed with flavor and totally satisfying. Generous portions, happy tummies, and a seriously chilled, fun night out. Highly recommend! 🌺✨

author: Sandeep Anand
review_text: This ain't for the the sensitive stomach kind. You can have the normal seafood here of course. What I tried are experiences ☺️ Grilled frog and a sea conch.. near the end almost of the market. It really is true, they taste like chicken. Disclaimer I don't have a well developed pallet 😂

author: Prianca bakshi
review_text: Absolutely love the food here!!! I used to eat almost every day. So so reasonable too! But, the staff, oooff. Most of them are rude and full of themselves. The one star goes because of those couple of waitstaff who were barely doing their job well! Do try their red curry, cashew chicken, tom yum with fish, pad kra pao -some of my favourites.. but almost everything here was decent! Oh and also ask them to give you their seafood sauce. Yum yum!

author: John in NV
review_text: First time at this place, it's a very cool diner type in a pretty busy strip mall, there's a capriotti's, roberto's, and a wing place. The parking lot is pretty busy but I was able to find parking at 10:30 in the morning on a Tuesday. The food was delicious particularly the pancakes with their homemade syrup. The country fried steak with pork meat was also very tasty. They were very busy, so I had to wait a bit for my coffee refill. The coffee was worth the wait, one of the best at a diner I've ever had. I would come back here anytime.

author: Nara Story
review_text: Always like the food here Beef dishes are great I just wish they have some petite cake for dessert so we don't have to walk to nearby place for dessert

author: Sern Teh
review_text: Love the banana bread, not too sweet like supermarket sold. Fri-Sunday have only.🫢

author: Patrick
review_text: I found this place on IG. This is the best BBQ I've ever had anywhere. Better than John Brown in LIC Queens, Mighty Quinn in NYC, Hometown in Brooklyn or Truth, and Pinkerton in Houston. Their sausage links were on point! Can't wait to bring the family here next year when we come for the Big Foot Tournament.

author: Brenda
review_text: I will never stop at the Domino’s again last time I ordered a chicken Parmesan and there was no marinara. No one asked for no marinara. I didn’t make a big deal. I didn’t call do nothing. I need to review nothing now. I went in today and I been there going for about four or five times a week because no I don’t cook so Domino’s is across the street anyways I paid for why is my sauce not in this bag? I’m home and I’m throwing your chicken wings away. I order plain wings and a dipping sauce. Why would I eat the plain wings without the dipping sauce now I’m not spending no more money at your establishment, but then I called to speak to a manager and the person that answered the mail is belligerent. I just called at 2:50 PM. I’m asking for a manager and he’s asking all this additional questions like Domino’s still come here if you want your food to be accurate.

author: Pearl Lee
review_text: Koro leaves much to be desired, food and service wise. We eat a lot of ramen and were excited to see a Japanese spot open in Eastie; I signed up for the weekly specials newsletter as a reminder to go. Won’t hold to Tokyo standard, but will hold it to other ramen that we’ve had in Boston (e.g., Santouka (our go-to), Yume Wo Katare, and the place in Chinatown across from Asana Sushi that rebranded recently) Service/Ordering : • No wait to order and seat 4 around 7:30pm, though seating quickly ran out after. Would recommend for parties of 4 or less • Several of us had questions on type of wavy/straight noodles used. Descriptions or photos would be helpful, because the wavy noodles turned out to be a non-conventional recipe. • When I ordered miso ramen with wavy noodles, I was met with “oh I think they already come with wavy…nevermind it doesn’t say on the menu.” Staff should be more knowledgeable; I expect this from a student pop-up, less so from a restaurant that’s been open for more than a month. I’m just following the 1-2-3-4 ordering steps, it was choose your broth and then your noodles. • I doubt many folks know what kukirage mushrooms are. Might be clearer to say “wood ear”, if you ever do a display revamp • During ordering, it is unclear whether you still get a third free topping if you opt for a paid topping. Partner got the bok choy, mushrooms, and $1.50 egg, but should’ve been able to add a fourth. • Kitchen was out of pork chashu two hours before closing, not a great look. • Please offer your guests cups and/or a setup for free tap water • Lights were lowered about 40% halfway into our meal even though it was ~8:15pm, far from 10pm closing time—mildly disruptive to our table’s conversation but mostly just confusing for a second • Most people’s attention is on the main menu when ordering and the weekly special flyer is easily missed. Just an observation. Food: • Chicken karaage was the highlight of the meal. Crispy batter without being too dry and good flavor on the chicken. The scallions don’t add anything when they’re underneath the chicken though, suggest leaving them out. • Miso ramen: the shiitake mushrooms were cold and watery (they should be marinated), the noodles were oddly spongey (instead of chewy & bouncy), and the miso broth was a disappointment—sharp but also lacked flavor and umami, as if the broth was thrown together 30 min ago and wasn’t given time to meld. Curious what kind of miso was used. Portions of corn and mushrooms were generous but only two leaves of bok choy? Chashu pork belly was reasonable—could be more tender, but the flavor was there. • Partner got the tonkatsu ramen. It was a thicker broth but still lacked flavor, as if flour was used to thicken it instead of aging pork bones properly. Was there any tare (seasoning sauce) added? He was similarly disappointed with the plain, cold mushrooms and $1.50 only netted half an egg. • I acknowledge this is subjective but the ramen spoons are comically large. I initially thought they were spoon rests. • I mean this in the nicest way possible, but perhaps consider lowering the frequency of your changing specials and focus on perfecting your mains. tl;dr would come back for the chicken karaage, would not come back for the miso or tonkatsu ramen unless both noodles and broths are significantly improved. Recommend taking a couple pages from Santouka and reworking some of your recipes & processes if you want to build a following. I genuinely want the best for this shop; Eastie deserves to have good (East) Asian food!

author: Alisa Kremer
review_text: Wow! What an unexpected surprise. My husband & I walked around from our hotel, and found the Bayshore Club restaurant. The service, the food, the staff were so accommodating, friendly and caring. Our entrees were delicious (I ordered the Snapper special and my husband had the Spice menu special). We will definitely return! Our waitress, Viviana was absolutely lovely, Javier, the manager & Chris were a pleasure to talk to. Apparently, there is a very good brunch here on the weekends which we will have to investigate! Thank you for an amazing dinner experience while visiting our daughter during Family Weekend at the "U". Go Canes!

author: Sharee Edwards
review_text: CHEF'S KISS 💋 the snapper was absolutely amazing .. we were a little hesitant because we didn't think it would be seasoned well, but WHEW it was seasoned perfectly .. it was enough at least 4 people, but we were so hungry my cousin and I ate majority with a little to spare LOL My only complaint was that our waitress was non-existent.. I guess because 18% gratuity was already included, there's a feeling of "no need to check on tables im getting paid regardless." she didn't check on us once .. other than that, it was well worth the $120

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: จิรภา หลีมานัน
review_text: The Thai tea is delicious. The shop is beautiful and great for taking photos. The price of the drinks is not too high.

author: santosh kumar
review_text: Did visit this place during our visit to Bali. It’s very close to Uluwatu temple around 500mtrs. If you visit this temple you should visit this place for dinner or sunset time. It’s situated on the cliff with the sea 🌊 view. Open area seating facing the sea would be ideal for an early evening. Wonderful scenic location with the cliff and sea view. Prior booking is suggested to visit this place. Inside seating is there too apart from the seating with the sea view. Rest rooms are clean and tidy. Staff are courteous and helpful in suggesting what to order. Had ordered calamari, chicken grill with rice, prawns , tuna fry with veggies, cocktails. Food is pricy and decent quantity. Roughly spent around Rp 550K per person for couple of starters, main course , few beers and cocktail. Must try especially for couple for a romantic dining during the sun set. Overall a nice dining experience.

author: Michelle V
review_text: One of my favorite Peruvian restaurants. I was given the wrong order today and was disappointed in my meal. Not because it was bad- but its when you think you're getting one thing but you get something else. Guy told me I ordered Lomo saltado, even though I ordered the Lomo a lo pobre. They did offer to give me what I actually intended on getting after the clarification but I didn't want to inconvenience the kitchen. The sangria was good.

author: Honestadie
review_text: You walk in and there's no one at the counter, just a bunch of people waiting for service while everyone talks in the back. Lady literally slammed on the counter and no one came out. Terrible service

author: Michael Mataanda
review_text: The food is delicious, great customer service and comfortable to sit and dine

author: Taweesilpa Achanond
review_text: As the name suggests, this restaurant is famous for its delicious crab fried rice and tasty dry sukiyaki, along with many other à la carte dishes. There's seating both indoors (air-conditioned) and outdoors in the cool breeze. The food is reasonably priced, tastes great, the owner is friendly, and the staff are well-mannered. It's a popular spot for diners, and the chefs maintain a consistent standard of taste every time. If you're in the area, I recommend this restaurant – delicious and reasonably priced.

author: Gary Arnesto
review_text: Both the kids and I were on the mission to taste the best banh mis Da Nang has to offer. The best recommendations always come from the locals, this shop was a recommended by our driver/guide. It did not disappoint! The baguette was warm and had a crusty shell but soft interior. I think the portioning of the ingredients and spices were on point. They asked upon ordering if we wanted them spicy which was a plus. We liked it so much we went back the next day and ordered 5 more.

author: Lizet Corona
review_text: Avoid this place if you need any minor accommodations or have kids on the spectrum. My family members went to this establishment in which multiple adults would be purchasing meals but were turned away bc my nephew who has food aversions due to being on the autism spectrum brought in his own fries (his safe food). This place is not family friendly or inclusive. The experience was traumatic to my family.

author: Magda A. Jabbar
review_text: Nice vibe and colors, fresh food, service was a little slow. Grilled shrimp tostadas have great flavors, churros - not impressed.

author: B I G P O P P A
review_text: This joint was just across the road from us and we went a few times as they have really creative coffee choices like the soft serve Latte, cloud Latte, creme brulee Latte and others. Good was also real good. I had the Turkish eggs which was really different. If you're nearby definite check it out.

author: Cody Belanger
review_text: We tried the Ice Cream Chicken Sundae Sandwich, the Sweet & Spicy Fries, and the Hot Mess & Cheese Express, every single item was a 5/5! I was especially excited (and curious) about the ice cream sandwich, while my wife was a little hesitant, but even she loved it! The food was incredible. Just make sure you show up hungry, you’ll want to try everything!

author: Tyler Cumella
review_text: My husband and I have been to Jadu a few times for coffee, breakfast, and pastries, and have been delighted each time. We recently went for their dinner/wine service, though, and loved it even more! Our server was lovely and provided great recommendations. The food was delicious and the portions allowed us to try a bunch of menu items. The vibe was cozy. We're so glad to have a spot like this in JP.

author: Jameelah Wright
review_text: An absolute delight and fantastic time. Passed through on recommendation from a family friend and we all went together. They have many halal options for other muslims passing through for a bite. A few things we got were the chicken salad fish meals and mine a deluxe cheeseburger. And an Uptop (what I usually called an Arnold Palmer) the portion sizes for us all were great and hearty and filling and the fries that came with my meal were the perfect fresh and crunchy. Our server Vivian was an absolute delight and helpful. We happen to be there at a time it wasn't extremely packed but still busy. I liked sitting down but by my own habits I definitely would take my meal on the go, there were many beautiful areas around to rest and eat. All in all would love to visit here again when I'm in town.

author: Royy
review_text: My absolute favorite Babi Guling spot! The suckling pig is so tender, and the crispy skin is perfection. I also love that they serve genyol (fatty pork) which is so flavorful and soft. To top it off, their Es Teler is the perfect refreshing dessert after the spice. All of this paired with the best rice field view—you can’t beat it. Huge menu and delicious food!

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: Killer Tank
review_text: One of the best Noodles in Hatyai, I try 3 types of noodles and it's worth 🤤 recommend to all food lover out there 🤙 the atmosphere is amazing to

author: Ms. Monrare
review_text: Came here for Thanksgiving. Everything was amazing. Did wait in line, but the line moved fairly quickly. The food was up, kept very well. The servers were on top of keeping the tables previous bus very impressed

author: Hemma M
review_text: We had to wait for 15 minutes as I went with my team during lunch hour. I had the vegetarian poke bowl which is an huge portion and it was good. The lychee drink tasted refreshing as well. A recommended place for those looking for a healthy option around Batu Kawan.

author: Pet N
review_text: What a great place! There’s lots to eat here and it’s clear it’s a local favourite. We had the yam rice with pork soup which required a bit of a wait but it was worth it! We loved it a lot! You can select the parts you want in your soup and the soup was just the right amount of sourness. The yam rice was really soft and yummy. Our other favourite will have to be the Pasembur. It was really delicious and when served, the items were still nicely crisp.

author: Leslie Teo
review_text: The Econ beehoon stall is cheap and good. The Kolo Noodle stall has great delicious options and the noodles are served in a unique metal plate. Most of the coffee stalls serve good traditional coffee.

author: Flying White
review_text: Had dinner here and couldn’t fault it. I had the chicken with cashew nut plus spinach with garlic dishes, total was 65,000D. Nothing fancy, just a good cheap place to eat

author: Shane
review_text: Had an excellent meal here. Ramona served us and she was lovely, walked us through the basics and made sure we were catered to. Ordered the shrimp and crab boil, man was it so good. If you are travelling or on holiday, definitely make the stop in here. Markets are right next door so you can grab some souvenirs also.

author: Jacqueline 5000
review_text: Visiting New Hamshire from Florida. Stopped for a quick back on my way to Boston airport. OMG. Delicious. You will not be disappointed. I had the Short Rib Ramen Bowl; the broth was so flavorful, and the short rib was so tender and juicy.
