author: Kyla Burton
review_text: We had been hearing a lot of good things about Winnie & Ethel's and being locals, of course we had to give it a try. We went mid-week to avoid the long wait times on the weekend. We had to wait for just a few minutes and we're seated. The restaurant decor was nicely done, with a comfortable feel. The waitress came immediately with a great attitude and a friendly and knowledgeable demeanor. We ordered right a way. I chose the catfish & grits with their special Mothership coffee and my husband got steak & eggs. Everything was well prepared and tasty. We really enjoyed our meal. The only downside was, it took quite a long time to get our food, close to 30 minutes and we weren't the only ones. But it gave us a chance to chat with some other locals sitting on either side of us. We also thought it was a little pricier than other breakfast restaurants, $75 for two regular breakfasts and 2 drinks plus tip. Overall, it was a good experience.

author: Madison Ramirez
review_text: A little hidden gem. Ordered tapas and wine and everything was delicious. We had croquetas, garbanzos with spinach, tortilla and the dates for tapas and ordered the dulce de leche crepes. Star of the show was the crepes. Wow wow wow. All the tapas were hot and fresh. We walked around after dinner and the selection of wine AND prices - you cannot beat it. I’ll be back to buy some wine and order more tapas.

author: Raj G
review_text: Everything on the menu was served properly. Food is delicious. The pad Thai is on top of the world. Great drinks to complement Coconut water is definitely not something you should miss and stay away from the hot sauce obviously dip it in, add photos and videos but take too much of it and you get the heat

author: chip soon ng
review_text: Newly opened JWS Grille Factory: The patty in Hawaian Pork burger was grilled to the right juciness. The yuzu fries is a must-try. The yuzu mayonnaise, with actual bits of yuzu zest you can see, adds the perfect tangy taste to the plain fries. If you are not too hungry, go for the 2 pieces chicken wings with 1 side (sweet potato fries recommended).

author: Stephanie D.
review_text: We tried Koro for the second time after trying them on opening week. The food was greatly improved this time- my partner really loved his ramen and I felt like mine was pretty decent. I love the atmosphere of the restaurant , it's so nice to have a place like this in Eastie. However, I found it really odd that they won't serve customers tap water to go along with their meal. For a sit down restaurant, I've never seen such a thing, and it left a weird impression, since the restaurant ambiance is so nice. At the least, it seems like they would have a water dispenser. I will most likely come back, but likely because there isnt much competition for food like this right now in E Boston.

author: Rachel Ochoa
review_text: Great place for authentic Peruvian! Our old favorite spot closed down further down the broadwalk, so we tried this place today, Christmas Eve, for lunch. Arrived at 12:15 and our party of 4 were seated right away by our friendly server, Roberto. It was a gorgeous day at the beach and a little crowded, but not crazy. Menu options are great! The kids ordered lemonade refreshers with popping boba (what a fun item to have on the menu!) One got mango and the other got strawberry. The kids split arroz chaufa with steak (my husband tried it and said the steak was excellent). Hubs got seafood ceviche which he said was tasty and spicy.I ordered aji de gallina (one of my favorite Peruvian dishes). It was delicious! I couldn't even finish it! So happy we tried this place out!

author: Daniel H
review_text: Ordered the pork plate with Fries and no pita. Had hoped to get more fries instead of pita but was the same amount. The meal was fine. I’d get rice next time instead. 25% tzatziki on the plate. Probably a good deal in comparison to other offerings in the area. It was a pretty easy and quick meal despite it being on a bust marathon weekend.

author: Lim Yan Xuan
review_text: Food and service was fantastic! Our server Ayu Mas really took care of us and is very attentive to our needs. Our first experience at La Brisa was amazimg from the reception getting us the best seats to the waitress and then the food everything was a vibe. The atmosphere was fantastic as well.

author: Lorena Gomes Rocha
review_text: Citrus & Salt never disappoints! The food and drinks are always fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The service is top-notch — friendly, attentive, and welcoming. Definitely worth a try, and absolutely a place I’ll be coming back to again and again.

author: Keane Leow
review_text: Been disappointed with babi guling since last trip few years ago but giving it a second chance this time and I am glad I decided so. The fried and grilled pork are very very very delicious. The chilli paste is a must.

author: Noah Jaid
review_text: Liu was amazing! She was super kind, attentive, and made our experience really enjoyable. She checked on us often without being overwhelming and made sure we had everything we needed. She was genuinely one of the best servers we’ve ever had. You could tell she cared about giving great service, and her friendly personality stood out the whole time. She made us feel welcome, and her positive energy made the visit even better. We really appreciate her and hope to have her as our server again. Highly recommend!

author: Maria T
review_text: Lively area inside Bayside. Very nice views by the water. Food was delicious. Anthony gave us great service.

author: Toon Tran
review_text: Bangla Night Market: Hits, Misses, and the Famous Roti! The Bangla Night Market (บางลา ไนท์ มาร์เก็ต) offers a buzzing late-night culinary hub near Patong Beach, selling a variety of seafood, Thai food, drinks, and desserts until the early hours. What to Expect: * Offerings & Price: You can find almost any kind of street food, though it is considered quite pricey compared to Bangkok's markets. * The Drinks: Your order of iced Thai tea and iced Thai coffee were noted as "OK," serving as standard refreshments. The Disappointments: * The market's famous Thai dessert, mango sticky rice, was unfortunately disappointing, described as having dry rice that sticks together and mango that is not so sweet. The Recommended Alternative: Based on this experience, a better dining alternative for overall quality is suggested: "I would consider going to nearby mall food court to eat instead." The Must-Try Street Food: Despite the disappointing mango sticky rice, don't miss the street vendors just outside the market: the roti banana nutella along the main road is nice, made with ripe and sweet banana—a perfect, sweet ending to your evening! Bangla Night Market (Near Patong Beach)

author: M F
review_text: The worse McDonald u can ever eat on it .. The restaurant it self is dirty and smells really disgusting, the bathroom dirty .. Run way from this facility..🚫🚫

author: valeri bolkvadze
review_text: Just had the best pizza experience in Brooklyn, and it's no wonder L'Industrie is topping everyone's lists—it's the best for a reason! Tucked away in the heart of Williamsburg, this spot nails that perfect balance of no-fuss vibe and top-tier quality. I grabbed a classic cheese slice and the mushroom one, and holy cow, the crust is insanely crisp and thin without being floppy, with that ideal char that screams "made with love." The sauce has this rich, tangy kick that pairs perfectly with the gooey, high-quality cheese—none of that rubbery nonsense you get elsewhere. What sets it apart? It's not just the pizza; the whole setup feels effortless. Minimalist counter, friendly crew slinging slices like pros, and that fresh basil on top? Chef's kiss. I scarfed down two slices and was already plotting my next visit with friends—maybe the pepperoni or sausage next time. If you're in Williamsburg craving pizza that actually lives up to the hype, skip the lines at the tourist traps and head here. Hands down, one of my new favorites alongside spots like Martha's for that reliable quality hit. 10/10, would recommend to anyone who takes their slices seriously! 🍕

author: Eric Lee
review_text: I takeaway at least 2X per month from here coz nasi lemak is my favourite. Service The staff here is very efficient and fast so even if there’s a queue, it’ll clear pretty quickly (customers need to decide what they want earlier to facilitate this). They’ll also accommodate any reasonable request (eg:separate pack the chicken wings). Food Love their rice (very fragrant and fluffy) and their chicken wings is insanely crispy (really shiok). The Ngoh Hiang is also very good, but I don’t see much customers ordering this. Conclusion A little ex, but worth paying the premium coz it’s nice. The must order stuff: 1) Chicken Wing - Mac shiokkk 2) Ngoh Hiang - bite into the chestnut and feel the crunch. 3) Egg - ask for runny and let the yolk seep into the rice. 4) Silver Fish - crispy and best combo with the rice & chilli.

author: Jeffreyl Ella
review_text: We ordered Coconut coffee and it did not disappiont us. The blend of coconut into coffee is so perfect, the coffee is strong and the creminess of coconut is the perfect combination. It has also crush coconut. The place is quiet so you can have your relax moment and just watched the people walking outside. Staffs are also welcoming and accomodating, there plenty of them so they can assist you right away. This is a best place when you are with your friends after you ate lunch or dinner just to talk and have your relax moment. Oveall, will definitely comeback here.

author: O D
review_text: Petralunga is one of those hidden places that you must visit in Miami. The food is delicious (the bolognese, caccio e Pepe, and cocktails) but the best part is the service. Every single member of the staff is very friendly and knowledgeable, but especially Sofia and Naza. They made our experience so much better

author: Jennifer Krueger
review_text: Did a takeout order on Veteran's Day. Staff was incredibly nice. I've dined at this location before, dine in and takeout. Always clean, friendly staff, who work well together. Food is hot fresh and delicious and very quick!

author: Danica Bahadur
review_text: Great breakfast spot! Drink option was insane in the best way. We had the mimosa flight. Service was excellent. Manager was also great in that he checked on all the guest to make sure their food and service was great. I can definitely recommend this location as I know there are a few.

author: justin wormley
review_text: They have me standing here for two large fries and the manager is walking pass me saying nothing at all as if I am.not here no type of customer service and didn't even offer to say I was waiting . It took someone who didn't take order to actually ask if I got my order yet real customer service will get small orders put and then have one work on big orders . Totally unprofessional wish I could take the photo.. took me 21 mins to get this simple order

author: Don Massa
review_text: Went for lunch, not crowded, valet parking. The Grilled Octopus was fabulous! Grilled, nice char and seasoned to perfection! Greek salad was fresh cut and we'll seasoned. I added Gyro meat for 6 bucks, seasoned well but on the dry side. Taste was good. My wife wanted a Gyro sandwich and was informed they only had platters. It was good but not what she wanted, plus the meat was on the dry side as well. Service was excellent and on ;b;;the water. Indoor, OUTDOOR dinning, Watch the boast go by with a nice breeze. All and all a nice lunch

author: Prettyme Yu
review_text: Love the wanton mee and prawn noodle here. My hubby likes the char Kuey tiao.

author: Allan Lambert
review_text: One of the more popular Hawker Food Markets - located above a normal veg, meat and hardware market. By far the most choice which can be intimidating. Follow the crowd. Easy to find from the local metro. Enjoy.

author: Aryan Shah
review_text: Great food and great service. The food was so good I wanted to keep eating but had no space left. Cant believe this place isn’t more popular. I must suggest the chicken kabab

author: Pratik Paddle
review_text: Everything we ordered was delicious and the service was great. I also like the vibe and the music here. It would also be a good spot to come and have a drink at the bar. We had the pinchos de pollo, the octopus, the squid tapas paella, the batatas bravas, and the mushrooms. The complimentary bread and dip they give you is sooooo good too. Our favorite was the mushrooms but everything we had was delicious. We had the tres leches for dessert and it was AMAZING. Very rich though, definitely share it.

author: Rashid Ismail
review_text: Next to highway heading northern. Best nasi kandar then continue back journey.

author: Felisia Micky
review_text: One cozy place for breakfast with delicious meals they serve is Ipoh Kopitiam. They got breakfast menu with affordable price until 10.45am. The price start $12.95++ for menu A and $13.95++ for menu B. I attached the menu which you can choose. First you choose the main course such as nasi lemak or noodle soup which is both are super recommended, the you choose the topping you want which is i love the spam, then the bread (toast) which is i recommended is the toast with Kaya and butter. This included choice of drinks which you can get freeflow, such as hot coffee, hot milk tea, hot chinese tea or hot lemon tea for cold (ice) got extra charge for $ 1.50. No wonder they got michelin bib gourmand since 2022! Super duper recommended.

author: stephen shustock
review_text: Wow just amazing pizza and one of the best I’ve ever eaten! The bee sting was amazing and so was their famous original. The atmosphere is eclectic and definitely funky and strange but it’s an amazing experience and the food is so good I can eat this every day and not get tired of it!!!

author: janice bush
review_text: Beautiful atmosphere it’s always clean and neat. The staff and s very friendly and professional. The food is prepared hot and fresh

author: Patty Lopez
review_text: Love outdoor seating looking at the beach. We shared while fried snapper, sent should've warned how big this thing is $85 worth it was 2 of us, this is enough for 4 people. Flavor was great but the wait is long. Enough room for large parties.

author: sam si
review_text: “Rodizio Experience That Delivers!” Went for the rodizio experience, and it did not disappoint! I got to try at least 10 different meats (I lost count because they were bringing them out so fast). While not every cut was to my taste, they were all served hot, fresh, and flavorful, which made the experience truly enjoyable. The sides—rice, plantains, beans, and fries—were solid, with the fries being the standout. I do wish the pineapple had been grilled a bit more for that extra caramelized flavor. We also tried the lava cake which were absolutely delicious and a great way to end the meal. A big thank you to the servers who took such great care of us. Their attentiveness made the evening even better. If you’re looking for a fun and satisfying rodizio experience, this place is definitely worth a visit!

author: Cliff G
review_text: I really liked this place. Its tucked away on an alley close to walking street but its more spacious then you'd think. The service is fast even though they're dealing with a lot of orders. The food was delicious and they allowed customization.

author: Carlos G
review_text: Mompu nails the vibe with a sleek, modern dining room, chill back patio, and genuinely friendly staff. The sangria was spot-on, but the papas bravas stole the show—crispy, perfectly seasoned, and utterly delicious. The chicken skewers and house bread with spicy tomato sauce were solid picks. The mussels were just OK, and the tres leches dessert, while clever with its pound-cake base, could’ve used more moisture.

author: Adeife Johnson
review_text: This is my go to taco bell. They often don't have my order despite ordering ahead. Which kind of defeats the purpose. But last time I ordered not only did they not give me the signature ranch dipping sauce, which the app makes you select. But one of the nuggets was an inedible brick, that was way over fried. Do better!

author: Rajesh Ramchandani
review_text: Great place near the waterfront. Beautiful views and peaceful atmosphere. Went to try out cocktails which turned out to be mediocre. The bar looks great but for some reason the drinks are a little disappointing. Pina colada was purely coconut milk topped with extremely sweet cream. We returned it and they were more than willing to exchange it for Margaritas, which turned out it be much decent. The Old Fashioned drink is renamed here as New Fashioned and was overly sweet. It lacked the main ingredient of bourbon and was purely low cost Germain liqueur. The glass it was served in seemed unhygienic. French fries were great, well made and crispy almost to perfection. Didn't wanted to order anything more since we lost our appetite. The place is great but unfortunately the drinks were disappointing today. SF chronicle and other food blogshighly recommend this place for happy hour but I doubt if they have been here to try it out themselves. I am sure the food here is great but will give it a try so time soon.

author: Per Hamrén Lundström
review_text: Lovely seafood restaurant with very good service. We both are different dishes with shrimps and both was very good. Coffee was not good and they only had Americano.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Lutthanee Sattharatanatri
review_text: Authentic Korean food with an all-you-can-eat buffet option. There are Set A, B, and C available. Desserts not included. Free parking is available in front of the restaurant. They use robots for serving and iPads for ordering. The food comes out quickly, and the staff provides excellent service. A must-try! 😍😍😍

author: Joseph Capatosto
review_text: Another great reason to head to JP, I love this simple menu with so many options for savory and sweet for breakfast and lunch. They have great coffee and a bright open space. Try all the little things that you don’t know what they are. I can’t wait until they have a wine program and I can stay all day long.

author: J H
review_text: My first time at this place was this past weekend and I wanted it to be so good as I love my Boar's Head Meats. I paid almost $15 for a sandwich and drink which I have no problem paying, but when I get the amount of meat I got on my sandwich, that's when there is a problem. I know what they pay per lb for the meat I got and I feel ripped off. The meat was also not very fresh looking like you would usually get at the grocery store or other places. It had definitely been sitting around for a bit. So disappointed as I was hoping this was my new go to spot. Such a shame and it looks as though I should have gone when Bob was alive. I feel duped

author: Kien Tran (Kin)
review_text: ok this one kinda nice cơm tấm (broken rice) spot i’ve hit in saigon recently, maybe the best for tourist. it’s a bit pricey for cơm tấm and def feels a little catered to tourists, but honestly… i’d still go back. the sườn nướng (grilled pork chop) hits hard—perfectly caramelized edges, juicy inside, the marinade’s that sweet-savory goodness done right. the cơm (rice) itself’s fluffy and lightly fragrant, not dry like at other places. big win: they give plenty of mỡ hành (scallion oil) and mắm chấm (fish sauce dip), balanced just right—not too sugary, not too pungent. love that. skip the soup unless you’re really craving side quests.

author: Rupert A.
review_text: The restaurant/Cafe is around the corner from the Marriott Cadillac. It has a small indoor dining room and a large patio with umbrellas. The menu is relatively e tensive for a cafe. Service is exceptional and very accommodating. Their specialty coffees are tasty. The various mains that we had were very fresh and tasty and special requests for modifications were accepted with a smile. The freshly made beignets were hot and delicious. Very relaxed lunch in a laid back environment.

author: Michael Pay
review_text: This place was very clean, had a good selection of seafoods, sushi, hibachi grill, and they had a ton of varieties of ice creams. Their dessert chocolate cake was very good as well! We were comparing the buffet with a restaurant downtown and the quality of food and taste weren't that far apart and the whole buffet was the price of a single dish! Would definitely come back again, the only problem is we end up eating way too much food! 🤣😭🤣

author: Patricia Guerola
review_text: I only had a drink and it was really good! I really enjoyed the atmosphere. The food looked amazing so I can’t wait go back for brekky. I love the location and the place itself surrounded by plants:)

author: Vanessa Raquel
review_text: I called to order a agua chile negro , my order was ready in less than 15 minutes and it was delicious. Best one I’ve had in Las Vegas.

author: Derrick L
review_text: Average bowl of noodles, haven’t tried their chicken yet, will update again

author: David Mariscal
review_text: Amazing Barbecue!!! The burnt ends and brisket are as good as any place in Texas, and those ribs are so meaty and tender, the smoky flavor is here with a fantastic selection of sauces. Don’t miss out on the sides the street corn and sweet Brussels sprouts were straight fire. Great service and personable staff make this hidden gem a BBQ goldmine!

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Yiee Tiee Chan
review_text: Very nice and delicious vegetarian food! The dishes were fresh, flavourful, and prepared with great care. Special thanks to Han for the excellent service — she was extremely polite, attentive, and impressive with her ability to speak multiple languages. Her warm hospitality made the dining experience even better. Highly recommended!

author: H G
review_text: We were in the vicinity and opted to dine at a Brazilian rodízio, which turned out to be a significant error as the meats were not fresh. Additionally, we ordered some beverages that were excessively diluted. We expressed our concerns to the waiter, who informed us that this was the standard. At that point, we asked to speak with a manager. The manager, named Victor, was exceptional. He made every effort to accommodate us, and I genuinely felt sorry for him. As we informed him of our decision not to return, it became clear that this establishment is utterly disappointing, especially considering the Ironbound area, which boasts numerous excellent restaurants.

author: William Roldan (xoll75)
review_text: The food was amazing. Everything came out fresh and delicious. Very friendly customer service. The servers and staff were excellent!

author: Cathy Dang
review_text: Delightful laid-back atmosphere. Definitely a good spot for locals and families to enjoy a breeze by the water or a nice sunset. Portions were relatively generous. Food was nothing special, but it definitely served its purpose. Lots of families and people just coming to have a chill time. Would definitely recommend for a casual get together with friends. Wouldn’t necessarily come here for a special occasion or looking for anything spectacular.

author: Elizabeth Wong
review_text: Passing by on street nearing downtown L.A. two locations, big inviting building with a comical chicken logo, a local chain??? The place looked clean fresh maybe newish amidst a not-so- clean or fresh or inviting urban neighborhood. I just felt like a little adventure, so I pulled in and found the parking lot full but one happy space for me. I went in to use the restroom, but the menu and wide open cheerful red-accented modern plexiglass screamed buen comida, eat something. And all the Hispanic clientele cannot be wrong. I got a super burrito. 5/5...carnitas 4/5 (saltiness is subjective, but i thought the carnitas too salty, my mom who shared this huge bad boy with me thought it was perfecto). She took a bit and said, " mmmmmm, is good!!) You get your choice of protein for anything you order -- they have sopes!! And the quesadillas look huge and impressive as other people were dining in and I snuck a peek at their dine-in trays...omg the soft street tacos looks good....gosh I wanted to try it all....they also had mulitas, tortas, and even a Cuban sandwich. I dont even know what a mulita is, but i wanted to try it. About my burrito, I wondered if I wanted to add a scoop of al pastor if I could have done it....I should have asked. Also the burrito was well built and held its shape great. I got it home and at it an hour later, still warm! Not soggy!@ Everyone there was friendly from the owner manning the order desk to the guys assembling your food...to the lady bagging takeout orders. She read my mind as I stood waiting nearby for my takeout, bec without me having to ask, she gave me a plastic bag for the handful of condiments. She's a mind reader!! Great service. Also great attention to hygiene as the salsa bar has everything prepackaged and ready to go. Also there was a traditional salsa bar. Very clean and sanitary. While I was there a guy came to wipe the counter with a clean towel even though it wasn't sloppy or dirty, very impressive. There's so Taco Gavilan where I live, the owner told me they are a chain of 15, maybe the closest is one in Huntington Park. I hope they establish in the SGV someday soon. Because my mom loved her burrito. Thanks for the fun foodie adventure while passing thru an unfamiliar part of town, I wish I had my cell phone with me so I could take pics of your well designed open large friendy colorful dining room. Next time!!

author: Bassam Alam
review_text: Quality dinner with really good service. The portions are quite small so you need to order a lot of food if you’re a big eater but the food was amazing. Spent approximately $220 AUD between my partner and I. Oka took great care of us. Thankyou.

author: Fellicia Swanny
review_text: RM16 for a plate of fried rice topped with a sunny side up but without other sides. I tried without chilli. I could taste a nice Wok Hei on my first spoonful of rice (without eggs). The sunny side egg was still runny and it does make the dish appetizing overall. It was not greasy and overall the plate was filling enough. Obviously different from Ding Tai Fung (which emphasizes the taste of the eggs). Funky and joyful ambience and decor. I won't come here on purpose to eat but if I am around, this is an option to consider, especially lunch. Am glad for uncle Roger being able to monetize his brand; fits his image quite perfectly and the food is not bad.

author: Fitri Nasaruddin
review_text: Came here for lunch and while the place itself could use some improvement in terms of condition, the view and food completely stole the show. The view is absolutely spectacular, breathtaking, mind blowing and honestly beyond words. It’s one of those views that instantly elevates the entire experience and makes you forget everything else. For food, I had the seafood spaghetti in white sauce, a mango smoothie, and finished with chocolate brownies. Everything was delicious, but the brownies truly stood out, soft, tender and served with vanilla ice cream, making it the perfect way to end the meal. Despite the condition of the place, the view and food make it worth visiting, especially if you are looking for an unforgettable cliffside dining experience.

author: Jessie Lan Pham
review_text: I used to notice that the shop charged extra for takeaway boxes and for cutting the banh mi in half, but those fees are now waived. This willingness to listen to customer feedback is truly commendable. I ordered the banh mi with char siu pork, pâté, butter, and pork floss, meaning there was no cold cuts or Vietnamese ham. Personally, I prefer this version as it feels lighter and less greasy. Since I ordered quite early, the pickles only included white daikon, but the shop was generous with scallions. A nice detail is that their scallions are not pungent at all. There were fewer cucumbers and chilies, but overall the vegetables and pickles were fresh. Overall, the banh mi was flavorful and generously filled. The char siu pork was well balanced, neither too fatty nor too lean and dry. The portion size is not overly large, but it is satisfying enough that even hearty eaters can easily finish one whole sandwich.

author: B W
review_text: Ridiculous "rules" I ordered 8pc combo and wanted a 6pc wings only but they said I could only get the 5pc if it wasn't a combo then the 5pc does come with ranch u have to pay $2 to get a ranch if I order wings no matter how many I should at least get 1 sauce

author: Achyut Shrestha
review_text: Once I discovered this place, I stopped cooking at home! Best vegan sandwiches, great price, good people!

author: Isaac Zepeda
review_text: No hate to jack in the box the reason I rate it a 2 star is because it made my stomach hurts all the time i eat it this time it made me vomit but it's not jack in the box fault because fast food like make my stomach hurt but the food is 6.6 thank you for the food even though I rate it a 1 star I want to say thank you and I'm grateful

author: Eren Baştuğ
review_text: We ordered michellin recommended foods. Seafood omlette was delicious but fried rice was just okay, nothing special. Ambient and service is good.

author: Ray Pine
review_text: It is a true delight to find a Michelin-rated spot like Here Hai within the Siam Paragon food court, making for a convenient and enticing stop while shopping. While the crab fried rice was flavorful and notably generous with its toppings, the salt and pepper prawns were merely okay and would benefit from more culinary restraint. Given these are best-sellers, the staff should recommend a dish with acidity or freshness to better cut through and balance the heavy umami spread. Furthermore, the service, while friendly, was inefficient, taking 35 minutes to prepare a fried rice from a supposedly simple kitchen operation. It's still worth a try for the experience.

author: Anders
review_text: Beautiful restaurant, very friendly and helpful staff, hot delicious food and reasonable prices. Classic American chain location serving it up hot and juicy. Not a lot to like here if you’re vegetarian or looking to broaden your food horizons. The main attraction is steaks, but they have beef, pork, chicken and salmon done several ways. I really enjoyed the table buns with whipped cinnamon butter. Of particular note were the rattlesnake bites, jalapeño red pepper and jack cheese balls fried and served with ranch dressing. I had the half rack of ribs, which sadly was somewhat overcooked and parts were inedible, but was very tasty nonetheless.

author: James Tene
review_text: Jolson was very helpful and friendly so is the rest of the staff and every time I get of a stressful day from work or school I always leave with a smile on my face. Sometimes even if this place is packed I can always count on getting my food before my 15 minute break ends. Every time I enter I am in awe seeing how clean the floors are. I recommend this place 110%

author: Deborah Loh
review_text: Amazing place! Food is affordable and staff is super friendly 😊 Food is mouth watering .. slurpy! Just outside of Siam square by the street.. a cute little restaurant! You need to visit 😍

author: mini kimtae
review_text: For the first dish, which is fried fish with chili and salt, the fish was cut into nicely sized pieces, but the frying wasn’t very impressive — it wasn’t quite crispy. The seasoning was fairly okay, but overall it still wasn’t memorable. As for the second dish, which is their signature glass noodles, I could only choose the crab-meat version this time because the whole-crab option was sold out. The seasoning leaned noticeably sweet, which personally wasn’t to my liking. Regarding the price, it was fairly reasonable — not cheap, but not overly expensive either. Overall, the ingredients were of very good quality, but the seasoning and execution still weren’t outstanding enough.

author: Ericka Henderson (BlackGal)
review_text: MacKenzie and Maddhie were amazing 👏Thanks ladies and working as a team "You Rock" 🏆 see yall soon 👋 I'm still eating the 🥩today! My son ❤️ his Togo order as well.

author: MeMyself Andi
review_text: Order is wrong and was given less that what I requested. I asked for pancakes and add strawberries and whipped cream. Not banana pancakes. Also I asked to swap out the sausage for bacon. I was given 1 slice of bacon for exchange of two pork sausages. I won't be coming to this location again. Pancakes were not very warm. Bacon was cold. Strawberries are still frozen and not fresh.

author: Isabelle Shavlik
review_text: Went through the drive thru. We waited 10 minutes. My husband went in and they weren't even making our order. We showed them our receipt so then we had to wait for them to make it ..

author: Daniel R
review_text: The Dumpling House is a great restaurant to eat dumplings. I have visited many times and always love to eat there. Sometimes it gets busy, but the service is usually fast. Personally, I do not like that they do not have printed menus and you can only order on your phone. Highly recommended.

author: Reaching The Soul
review_text: Just a short walk around the corner of the Fremont street experience and you will find yourself at Nacho Daddy! It’s a fun casual atmosphere nothing fancy, but they have a great menu with lots of choices for unique style nachos. We were just looking for a snack so we shared the Al Pastor and had a margarita and we dug into it before I even had a chance to take a picture, but it was very good, but if you’re hungry, I would not share it again. To me, the portion size was a little smaller than I expected, and that was the larger size nacho platter that we were told we were getting. I would definitely go back to try another one of their creations . They have a tequila shot with a scorpion in it that they offer and you get a free shot glass if you down the scorpion 🤣 I did not partake as I’ve already had close encounters with scorpions since I live in Arizona 🤣

author: Hang Tran
review_text: Really a nice place for meals and drinks. I like the drink. The food I ordered was ok. The price is nice. The place looks beautiful but small. It was crowded when I visited. There are books, which is a big plus. There are also healthy products with reasonable prices. I like the owner's style although I don't know her.

author: Marisol Colon
review_text: The restaurant is not in the greatest area, just to start. The service was awful our waiter forgot our appetizer order, forgot our drinks - he said he’s a little busy and didn’t even apologize. When we ordered dinner they didn’t have the steak fajitas, how is this possible when you’re a Mexican restaurant. The sangria tasted like kool aid - yes KOOL AID!! The only reason I came was because of the Christmas decoration and the ambiance that was supposed to feel magical. Don’t waste your time coming to this establishment. The gratuity was also added without our consent - apparently it’s done this way. I guess that’s why he sucked as a waiter.

author: hans tuesta
review_text: Stopped here before we left Vegas. It was a great dinner. Extensive menu with lots of options executed very well. If you get coffee they leave a whole pitcher. Lots of options for everyone in the family. Pretty large portions and reasonable prices. Servers were attentive and the food came out at a timely manner.

author: N. Sergew
review_text: Phenomenal place! Ver tasty vegan Ethiopian dishes, along with delicious coffee and spicy tea. Wonderful and attentive service. Went for brunch and the live DJ just enhanced the whole experience so much! Highly recommend!

author: Billy Lim
review_text: Tried the dessert at Siam Pandan store nearby Siam Square. It's affordable and delicious 😋 One box is about 50 baht and my personal favourite is their signature Pandan and Taro pancake. The taste is just simply amazing 😍 Not too sweet, but just nice 🙂 If you are near by the area, should try 😉

author: FM Fortus
review_text: Awesome people, exhibiting the true Indonesian hospitality. Great food and ambiance. Kudos to all the friendly staff!

author: Robyn Lewis
review_text: Excellent everything. Really good food, nice wine, great service. Loved the octopus and squash dip in particular. I will be back and send others here. I wish I could have tried the whole menu! Just amazing. Also loved the radish etc salad!

author: Zai.busaya
review_text: Very good service,Top quality of material and so so delicious. I will come back for sure. I’m Thai and I’m satisfy with the food here

author: Denzel Espinoza
review_text: First time there an waited for more than one hour for my ceviche, I have cooked ceviche an it doesn't take that long to cook an the oyster shots didn't had the whole oyster lol just juice (really bad service)

author: Ferran Arlandis
review_text: The coffee was very good and the food was made with love! Definitely would recommend

author: Arin Dutta
review_text: Bushwick branch of the Ayat Palestinian restaurant network in the NYC region. Was pretty crowded already on an early Friday evening. The location also opens a small patio facing the Maria Hernandez Park so you may want to target that. Food: - at this location at least, not that amazing. Pita is flaky and thin, and nicely flavored. You can have better in the 5 boroughs area, sure. - hummus: my dinner companion is bit of an expert and according to her (I concur), it was heavy on the tahini and lacked bite (traditional Palestinian hummus can be a bit creamier than other Levantine recipes so this may well be true to design). It is nicely presented in a traditional earthenware bowl, as is most of the food. - Shawarma platter : we got the mixed grill version. The rice and toppings were generous and the meat was flavored though not excessively - Fattoush: nice and lemony, with a good helping of fried pita chips - We asked for kibbeh, and only after 15 minutes of waiting, were told that they had none! Overall: not the best nor the worst Palestinian food you’ll have in the region. Service is a bit klutzy. Ordering tip: the shawarma platter is pretty large. Can satisfy two people (with a starter like hummus) if you are not ravenous. Photo of mixed shawarma platter, hummus, and fattoush attached

author: Lulu Berger
review_text: amazing views and location. stayed here the whole day to watch sunset and the whole time was 10/10. Vera our waitress was also so lovely and couldn’t do enough for us during our time, thank you again, Vera! x

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Araya S
review_text: Ordered through Grab. Price and quantity of food are not appropriate for the portion. Picture is not as shown. Disappointed. Ordered pork dumplings with pickled plums. Thought it was a pig spirit. Expensive compared to quantity.

author: Sarah Bolano
review_text: I guess I’m just disappointed. I grew up in Jersey City Heights and often went to coach house with my family. They definitely improved the atmosphere, but I would say overall, the food was just…decent. For me, I say, if it ain’t broke, don’t fix it. This was a community staple for years and when I was there I heard other patrons complaining about the fact that the place and food were so different. The starting bread was stale, the pizza was 5/10, the lobster bisque was 5/10, the lobster ravioli I had was pretty good though! 7.5/10. I think the price was fair considering that both my husband and I got lobster. I brought my two kids and it didn’t feel family friendly at all. It was extremely quiet, and they gave us a coloring page for my son but had no crayons. Not sure if it’s the nostalgia, but I just feel the old coach house was better /: either way, best of luck to these new owners.

author: Ronette Yarbrough
review_text: We love going to Lucky Fish Bar & Grill in Dania Beach. It’s our go to place when we want to have a relaxing lunch or dinner. The food is great! No matter what we have it comes out perfect. My favorite is the shrimp tacos. I get them fried. So yummy. I think I have tried most of the seafood on the menu and everything is great. My husband’s favorite are the chicken tenders and chicken Mediterranean wrap. Our favorite server is Zoe!! She is the best. So friendly, sweet, helpful. We always ask for her. The managers are awesome too. Kevin and Shane always stop by to see how we are doing. Lucky Fish is a great addition to Dania Beach!!

author: B “BurrrBarrry” S
review_text: Evel Pie didn’t live up to the hype for us. The place was extremely loud to the point where the staff could barely hear our order. Unfortunately, our pizza came out burnt and making it hard and unpleasant to eat. Honestly, Pizza Rock down the street was ten times better. It’s a shame, especially after seeing so many great reviews, only to end up with a burnt, hard slice.

author: Chad Vazquez
review_text: Excellent food and decent service - we come here often when we’re in the area. Consistently great food!

author: The Soto Standard
review_text: Great Customer Service. Solid food but I could feel how cold some of the ingredients were before I ate it. I also had trouble with ordering on the tablet because there was so many customization items that I accidentally added an extra side of sauce. Other than that, my experience was great. Best Comparison : If Burger King and Taco Bell had a child !

author: JR
review_text: Gabby was very nice. Her recommendations were on point! The Burnt ends and brisket were great. The chorizo refried beans were delicious. Almost wish I did not have to leave.

author: Jack
review_text: Very nice pet friendly restaurant at East Coast. Really well ventilated and doesn't feel warm at all. We walked 4km with our furry friend and the service manager quickly offered ice water once we were seated. Food is good and yummy but the service is what really stood out. Thumbs up to super friendly and attentive Eileen who even offered tips for our dog who needs to shed few pounds. Will certainly be back soon.

author: Rachel Deterding
review_text: Worth the hype, although expect to wait in line for a bit (we waited about 20 minutes on a Saturday around 2:30pm. If you want to dine-in inside, expect standing dining only and to be elbow-to-elbow with others with a fair ampunt of noise. The line moved pretty efficiently, and the pizza was really good, and decent value. The staff were efficient and friendly.

author: Jean-Christophe Blachere
review_text: Good place to enjoy Indonesian food, even if it is produced in a bit standard way. Service isn't great, with staff usually turning their back to the dining room

author: clara lau
review_text: This hawker centre has 2 sections. Lots of vegetarian food stalls here. Tried the vinegar pork leg. Nice ! There's also a big stall selling pig organ soup.

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: John Tango
review_text: Decent service. Good price value. Taste overal for the mix pork soup with white rice is 7.5/10. Tau kwa (soya bean curd) too salty 6/10. Tau pok (spongy soya bean) 7/10. The pork ball & pig’s stomach are tasty. Pork slices a little tough. A repeat? Yes.

author: K Carter
review_text: This is a phenomenal restaurant that exceeded our expectations. The food is absolutely delicious. I wasn't really a pizza lover but now I am! The Spicy Garlic Shrimp pizza is superb! More than that, the Caprese salad with Dalat Tomatoes and hose made mozzarella is very flavorful. The mixed green salad with the house made garlic basil salad was a very delicious healthy start. Coupled with delicious food is consistent outstanding service (this is our 4th time visiting in less than two weeks). Vu and Thuy are phenomenal staff that are a part of a great team! We love Pizza4’s!

author: Ogy Reiusch
review_text: The food is okay, the munchie meal is the best deal. The thing about this location is no dine in available. Only drive thru. Im not sure if they are remodeling or just closed it off due to the homeless people around the neighborhood. The lines in the drive thru do get big at night but the service is quick so don't get impatient.

author: Hanli Bubu
review_text: Love the service and the food! We had white rose, pancake and beef pho which was the local cuisine. Or you can also opt for their combo set 180,000/pax. Avocado smoothie was awesome

author: Hanna Lin
review_text: Rsvp is highly recommended! We love the service and the atmosphere of the rustic steakhouse. The steakhouse for 2 was perfect for me and my daughter. My husband and son opted for a couple of burgers instead, but they unfortunately wasn't impressed.

author: Mory Rabi
review_text: The food was absolutely delicious and tasted very authentic. The kebab koobideh and ground chicken were perfectly seasoned and juicy, and the saffron rice was fluffy and fragrant. The atmosphere was warm, clean, and welcoming, and the staff were extremely friendly and attentive. Higher recommended.

author: Natasha Georgiou
review_text: Excellent Vietnamese. The best spring rolls we’ve had on our trip. The food was fresh, authentic, tasty & cheap. The service was super fast. We had an appointment to get to so we ordered and got served in 10 minutes!! The only downside is that they don’t have air con. Only fans, which makes it hot inside.

author: Amanda Tan
review_text: Better to make reservation before coming, even on a weekday dinner as the restaurant is not very big. Else have to wait 1.5 hours. Best service and atmosphere over here. Thanks for the birthday surprise and gentle song for the husband. Will come back when we are in Vietnam again! The handsome waiter even offered to help us take group photo. So nice gesture! Also caught the spilled water made by the son very quickly.

author: Brandon Matthew
review_text: Got their Nasi Campur. It’s 50.000 IDR, which is nearing the premium spectrum (for local food). Honestly, it’s worth it with the amount of pork that they give. Each portion gets two piece of the crispy skin, which is incredible. Got the balung soup as well, which includes a bit of meat. The chilli is a bit spicy, but still manageable. Also ordered the same-sam guling for 50.000 IDR too. Not quite as expected, the skin is not crispy. However, the meat is tender and the spices are great.

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: Wan Qing Leck
review_text: Perfect meal to have on a cool evening! Thoroughly enjoyed both the orders. The classic prawn noodles soup had a thick tasty broth and the kwayteow was soft yet chewy. Shout out to the classic prawn soup with pork ribs - it had a sweet lingering taste on top of the already delicious broth. The prawns were also fresh and the ribs were tender. The coffee shop space is also newly renovated making it comfortable and clean to dine at. Will recommend!

author: Lexxi
review_text: From the UK came to Miami on holiday and stopped off here for lunch. Lovely place very cosy vibe and lots on the menu. I had pancakes scrambled eggs and bacon it was very delicious! Tried some of the pastas too and they were also great. The strawberry oat matcha was the best matcha I think I’ve ever had.

author: Ashly Morales
review_text: Ordered a Cobb salad. It was delicious. Someone came by to clean my table as well. Great attention to detail.

author: Vipul Gupta
review_text: It was a very good experience. Food was really delicious and Truong was really helpful and accommodating.

author: Arindi Arisani
review_text: I went here for dinner to try their Indonesian dishes and left quite impressed. The oxtail soup from the main menu was rich, aromatic, and deeply comforting, with meat so tender it easily fell off the bone. The broth had a beautiful balance of warmth and spice, complemented by the chili and sweet soy sauce served on the side. The dish came with rice and emping (melinjo chips), which rounded out the flavours perfectly. The second dish, featured on a seasonal menu, was grilled octopus with finely chopped snake beans stir-fried in Balinese spices. The octopus was juicy and smoky with a distinct char that added depth, though I personally wished for a touch more salt. Since rice wasn’t included, I ordered it separately to complete the meal. The combination of the tender octopus and the crunchy, aromatic snake beans made this dish memorable and full of texture. As for drinks, the watermelon juice (despite with no additional sugar added) was refreshingly sweet with a slushy consistency, ideal for Ubud’s tropical weather. I also appreciated the staff’s clarity when explaining that “Draft Beer” referred to a local brand rather than a traditional keg pour. Hence, a classic Bintang was ordered instead. Overall, the experience was satisfying, with attentive service and well-balanced local flavours worth revisiting.

author: Allen Teo
review_text: Served authentic Thai cuisine but the taste might adapt to Malaysian. Anyway the experience is still good to try. Ordered thai sausage, tomyam soup and Thai basil pork.

author: Andrew Chan (www.roadtrippers.asia)
review_text: Nice boss, easy to converse in English. Menu is rather limited with a lot of focus on yam and somtum, grilled meat, sai krok isan and sai oua, and tomyum. We ordered the sai krok isan and sai oua platter, a yam woon sen (glass noodles) kai, seafood tomyum, and a minced chicken omelet. I like their sai krok because its not as sour as most sai krok, we ordered a level 5 tomyum and find it not spicy enough. The yam woon sen portion is generous, and taste is there. Omelet is standard. Overall, we spent 720b for 4 pax with 2 bottles of coconut nectar and 2 bottles of water. The food taste and freshness and pricing are fair.

author: A QUEEN 2 HER KING A KING 2 HIS QUEEN
review_text: I GOT ONE OF MY FAVORITES AT BOBO'S YESTERDAY (GRILLED CHICKEN SALAD)🥗 WITH MY FAVORITE BANANA BERRY SHAKE.. SIDE NOTE: I ORDERED EXTRA GRILLED CHICKEN AND I ADDED MY OWN BACON BITS AND EXTRA CHEESE ONCE I GOT HOME.... I'VE BEEN GOING TO THIS PARTICULAR BOBO'S SINCE I WAS 3 YEARS OLD WITH MY MOTHER, ONCE I GOT OLD ENOUGH TO GO ON MY OWN THAT'S ACTUALLY WHAT I'VE BEEN DOING. ALL THE OG'S THAT STILL WORK HERE KNOW ME AND MY WHOLE FAMILY WE ARE LIKE FAMILY. THE FOOD IS ALWAYS COOKED TO PERFECTION THE SERVICE IS BRILLIANT AND THE TASTE IS VERY GOOD...PLEASE DON'T CHANGE ANYTHING!!!!!! GLAD BOBO'S UPDATED ON THE BUILDING IT LOOKS EVEN MORE APPEALING TO GO AN GRAB A BITE.... THANK YOU! -FROM THE HENRY FAMILY.

author: kerry robb
review_text: Just visited this place and how it gets the amazing reviews is beyond me. Drinks were old fashioned and pina colada. I honestly think they forgot the alcohol in both!! Starters arrived within 10 minutes then mains were fetched before starters were half eaten. We sent the mains back as we knew they would be cold. When we did get them they were indeed cold. Sprouts were rock hard, mash potato cold, sweetcorn chargrilled but stone cold. The steak was nice but for the price so disappointing. Honestly this place is just a gimmick and we have eaten better in the mall for far cheaper.

author: Nat T.
review_text: Just like many tourists, we were bought here by our guide instead of original babi guling place we wanted to go to. However, it is ok because the food was good and came out quick, allowing us to quickly get to other sightseeing place. The restaurant was also quiet as we visited on a weekday lunch time allowing us to unwind a bit on a long day. Price was reasonable with food for 2 + 1 beer coming out to around $11.

author: Elena Volkova
review_text: We visited this restaurant as a family and were very pleased. Our daughter had the pumpkin soup — delicate, aromatic, and perfectly balanced in flavor. My husband chose a meat dish, I had fish, and both were cooked to perfection: juicy meat and fresh fish with well-matched sides. For dessert, we tried several sweets, and each one was a perfect way to finish the meal. The service was attentive, the atmosphere cozy, and the cuisine truly top-notch. We will definitely come back again!

author: Andrew Ardis
review_text: I'll start this with a "not new to coffee, but new to vietnamese egg creme coffee" as I'm sure most of you are . I got the classic salted egg creme coffee iced, all I'll say is WOW! One of the better cups of coffee I've ever had, honestly. It was so robust and in the same time so creamy. The salt on top was the perfect balance to the deep flavors of the coffee first , then creaminess of the egg foam and the salty noted to finish off the experience. Each sip was so fulfilling that next time I'll probably get the large size. I didn't try any food but the pastries looked nice and fresh! The kind of place you can sit for hours and enjoy the slow life. Free wifi, and plenty of seating with 2 levels . Will definitely return and will definitely recommend. Atmosphere 10/10 Staff 10/10 Coffee 11/10

author: Syifa Fajriani
review_text: Had a very pleasant dinner experience here. The service with Mr.Rama and his team was great, they're very helpful. And the food all superb! No wonder the rating's high, keep up the good work!

author: Emily Porter
review_text: Love this place . Mya does an amazing job every time I order a meal. She’s very pleasant and professional. I appreciate her customer service.

author: James Sawyer Ford
review_text: The food was absolutely delicious — every dish was full of authentic flavors and perfectly cooked. The staff were incredibly welcoming, attentive, and made us feel right at home. Highly recommend this place if you’re looking for amazing Indian food and warm hospitality. Will definitely be coming back!

author: Anggie Puji
review_text: Always a great experience at Seribu Rasa! The food is consistently delicious and full of flavor — always on point. The restaurant has a high-end ambiance, and all the dishes are made with quality ingredients. Highly recommended for dinner meetings or if you’re looking to enjoy authentic Indonesian cuisine in a refined setting.

author: Ramon Alomar
review_text: Food was very good not Greasy and not salty they had napkins and forks the service was good

author: Chanya Anu
review_text: I ordered the cheddar cheese toast and it was absolutely delicious! The butter was rich and perfectly balanced, giving the toast a wonderful flavor. I also enjoyed the ice cream and whipped cream — both were fresh and creamy, making the whole experience even better. The atmosphere at After You Central World is cozy, and the staff are friendly and attentive. The wait was a bit long, but the food was worth it and easy to forgive. Definitely a place I’d recommend for anyone looking for a sweet treat or a relaxing break in the city.

author: Giovanni
review_text: I loved it. The atmosphere is calm and classy, retro, very south American. It has a second floor with view on the basement, perfect for romantic dinner. The kitchen is very organized and efficient. The dishes are perfectly prepared and all the flavors will balanced. The staff is attentive and super kind. We loved all the dishes we had. A place to back.

author: Mingsheng Lum
review_text: Local nasi kandar If your near sg dua / USM. Try ~ Aim for their fried chicken 🍗 This food court have many others local Chinese food for everyday meal

author: Yi-Ping Ku
review_text: 🍣 A Truly Delightful Japanese Dining Experience – Perfect for Families We had the absolute pleasure of dining at this charming Japanese restaurant, and I must say, it exceeded all expectations. Every dish was a masterpiece — beautifully presented, exquisitely balanced, and bursting with authentic flavour. From the first bite to the last, it was clear that great care and craftsmanship had gone into every element of the meal. What truly set this place apart, however, was the warm and thoughtful hospitality. The owner personally visited each table, offering detailed explanations of the dishes and checking in to ensure everything suited our taste. It was a lovely touch that made us feel genuinely welcomed and cared for. The restaurant is also wonderfully family-friendly. Our children were not only accommodated but made to feel right at home — a rare and much-appreciated quality in fine dining establishments. We left with full hearts and satisfied appetites, already planning our next visit. This gem of a restaurant comes highly recommended — a must-try for anyone who appreciates exceptional Japanese cuisine and heartfelt service. We will most certainly be returning.

author: Tan Chiew Ming
review_text: Food is definitely awesome and for local, not those designated for tourists. Should try for food lover!

author: Esther Hew
review_text: Had an Ipoh Ho Fun with Coffee set & toast. Food arrived promptly & it was yummy. Coffee was great! Ho Fun portion is very small for the price charged & not much shredded chicken. All the waiter & waitress had very good manners & customer service was top notch.

author: Emre Acar
review_text: The place was very unique and beautiful; however, our burgers were a bit dry. The staff member who took care of us was very kind and attentive. We had a lovely time with our children. We would recommend it as a cozy spot by the water.

author: Felton Brown
review_text: I recently had dinner at Crazy About You in Brickell, and this place absolutely lives up to its name — I’m crazy about it! From the moment I walked in, I was taken by the stunning view of Biscayne Bay. Sitting on the terrace with the soft breeze, city lights reflecting off the water, and that vibrant yet peaceful Brickell energy — it felt like Miami magic at its finest. For dinner, I ordered the Zucchini Carbonara, and wow — this dish was on another level. The creamy texture, savory depth, and the way it balanced flavor and freshness was simply perfect. You can taste the chef’s creativity and attention to detail in every bite. And then came dessert — the restaurant’s famous “The Best Chocolate Cake in the World.” That name sounds bold until you try it… and then you get it. Moist, rich, melt-in-your-mouth chocolate perfection. Easily one of the best desserts I’ve had in Miami. The service was top-tier — warm, professional, and attentive without being overbearing. You can tell the staff genuinely care about creating a great experience for every guest. Whether you’re a local looking for a relaxing night out or a visitor wanting to soak in Miami’s waterfront charm, I highly recommend Crazy About You. Between the view, the food, and the vibe, this spot captures everything that makes Brickell such a special place to dine.

author: Dalfin Chow
review_text: bowl was changed to plastic ! not environmentally friendly nor is it good for us diners to put hot porridge into plastic bowls.Micro plastic being consumed alongside our food for the convenience and cost cutting measures of the owner .Will not patronise again until proper non toxic bowls and spoons are used.

author: H Holly
review_text: Chicken wings were just ok . I've been there twice and no one is ever in there. But the kicker is they charge you a service fee to use your credit card. I will not be returning.

author: Htoo Shwe Yee Win Elleri
review_text: Absolutely loved this Thai cuisine restaurant! The food was very delicious, authentic, and full of rich flavors. The atmosphere was warm, lively, and welcoming, perfect for casual dining.

author: Anasuya Roshan
review_text: This is a fantastic spot for satisfying your sweet cravings. The bingsu servings are impressively large – easily shared among three adults, making it perfect for a group dessert outing. The finely shaved ice, paired with a variety of toppings, ensures a refreshing and delicious treat. However, the highlight for me was the waffles. They were perfectly crispy on the outside and fluffy on the inside, with just the right amount of sweetness. Paired with their selection of toppings and syrups, the waffles were absolutely delightful. The ambiance is cozy and inviting, making it a great place to hang out with friends or enjoy some quiet time with a good dessert. The staff are friendly and attentive, ensuring a pleasant experience.

author: Michael Johnson
review_text: Was doing some shopping and ended up stuck in the fuel tanker roll-over traffic jam for hours. Made the best of the situation by stopping in and grabbing dinner solo. There was a wait for a seat at the bar, but seats opened up quickly! Bar staff was quick to take drink orders and patient with dinner decisions. Tito's dirty martinis were perfect. Ordered the "Chicken Critters" with two sides; house salad and fries...salad first. The house salad (which I think might be called "Road House Salad" was a 10/10!... Fresh crisp lettuce, tomatoes, cheese and even egg slices that made it seem like a small chef salad. After the salad, there was room for only half of the chicken tenders and fries. The tenders were crispy and didn't need any dip/dressing but had a small side of ranch. The fries were great....right out of the fryer. Didn't ask if they were fresh or frozen. (Ask your server)

author: WaterMelon Foodie&Traveller
review_text: A local friend brought me here 10 years ago, and I finally came back for a second visit. Saw some reviews saying the cinnamon roll is a must-try, so I gave it a shot — and it was really good! The curry puff and walnut sourdough were great too, definitely worth trying! Plus, there is a huge foodcourt just 5 minutes walking distance… where u can try the chendol too.

author: Sam Allen
review_text: Amazing food, super friendly owner and staff. The salted coffee is one of the nicest things I've ever tasted. Highly recommended!

author: Emerald “Emerald Violet” Violet
review_text: Prices did not match food, I know everything is expensive now still overpriced for what you get. Food was okay, you are basically eating a ton of rice and a few pieces of whatever protein you choose. The sauce is what makes the food, without sauce food not great. Looooong wait time, didn't add up.

author: Ernest M
review_text: This is in my neighborhood so I want to try this out. I wanted something to go so I can chill at home and do some errands as well. They do have. Launch special from 11-3pm which I just missed by 40 minutes. No big deal. Just like any Thai restaurant if I never had anything there, I'm gong to try their pineapple fried rice. Service: I got to go. No wait to order. Just pulled up and placed my order. There's a 4% discount if you pay in cash. Ambiance: clean inside, they have a small stage for small performing acts. They have a an old vinyl record that's just for looks but a small speaker playing today's hits. Food: pineapple fried rice. Plenty of meat inside. Rice is cooked well. Everything to make a good pineapple fried rice. Well done.

author: Lewis Piggee
review_text: I and my girl ordered food here and they got the entire order wrong. They didn't want to exchange our item for the right ones, so we just asked for money back. The area is really scary as well be careful at this location.

author: Aiste Ber
review_text: Absolutely amazing service and food! We had a wonderful experience, and a huge part of it was thanks to our waitress Yusnavy. She was incredibly friendly, attentive, and genuinely caring from the moment we arrived. Her positive energy and warm smile made us feel truly welcome. She went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect, always checking in on us without being intrusive. It’s rare to meet such a lovely and professional waitress who clearly loves what she does. Thank you for making our visit so special — we will definitely remember this experience!

author: Aurora
review_text: Warm inviting atmosphere. Attentive, friendly staff. The food is delectable. We tried the Paella and it was divine. They carry a large selection of quality wine. Will definitely return again.

author: Mahesh Balkarran
review_text: Their fruit juices are freshly made. The food is definitely homemade and fresh. It's one of the top columbian restaurants i been to. Delicious and friendly staff. Portions are huge and definitely would be a regular customer if i live here.

author: Kai ce Yap
review_text: This restaurant is a cozy mamak spot. The nasi kandar is good, and the roti canai is very delicious, crispy and nicely done. However, the kuah isn’t that tasty. As for the Maggi goreng, the taste was a bit weird for me, kind of like it had a taste of peanut, which I didn’t quite enjoy. The price here is high, likely due to the area and the nice environment, it feels more like a high-class mamak. If I compare it to Ali Khan and Nasmir: Nasmir is my No. 1 choice, good taste and value overall. Ali Khan is cheaper, but the taste is just average. This place has the best environment, but also the highest price.

author: Joseline Animates
review_text: I ordered 22 original hot wings , and 5 cajun wings. BUT THEYRE ALL PLAIN! i’m calling them to talk about my order but they have put me on hold for more than 30 minutes.

author: Shali S
review_text: Second time I’ve been here. Love it. So many options are available for food. All the restaurants are worth trying. Already planning on returning soon.

author: Julian Perez Granizo
review_text: Stuff so kind as always in Bali 🌸 Now food was seriously good! Had the tuna platter oh yes baby yes put it in my mouth

author: Kevin Yeoh
review_text: Oh my god. This place serves really good nasi kandar food and I kinda regret not visiting this place earlier. The biryani and the dishes are mostly good. So far, the only dish not worth buying is the lamb shank as my colleague ordered it and feedback that the meat is hard, so it is not worth paying RM48 for the lamb shank! Price is more on the high side. For example one piece of fried chicken cost RM11 but strangely mutton curry also cost RM11, I always thought mutton will be more expensive. 🤔 Seats are aplenty as you can also go to level 1 if the ground floor seats are fully packed. Parking is also plenty around the shoplot area. All in all, still worth visiting. Taste really good compare to other famous nasi kandar stalls around Penang.

author: Remika
review_text: Great experience but please book before on queQ so you don’t have to wait! the noodles are so yummy and they have so many options. Staff are friendly and helpfully. service is also quick. try everything! for 5 people we paid 1600 baht

author: Timothy Grace
review_text: It's pretty good food, and priced VERY well. It can be a bit messy to eat, but such is the nature of these things. The music was very loud, as was the restaurant as a whole, which detracted from the experience in my opinion. The price my lure me back here, and the food is good enough to make it worth it.

author: K P
review_text: This place gets it right! The donuts are incredible in flavore AND texture. The filled donuts are filled completely, no unhappy endings of just dough, there's filling in every bite. The flavors are incredible and they taste exactly like they are named. Now this is a donut spot right.....well why am I about to talk about brisket?? BECAUSE THE BRISKET CROISSANT IS INCREDIBLE! Tender and flavorful. Not just that though, the garlic rosemary croissants are also a hit and the ham, cheese, and red sauce (I cannot recall the name) quiche knocked my socks off. Now for my very biased very part, the blueberry thyme matcha!!!!!!! It tastes like a dream and is just perfect. The young lady with the black hair was also just wonderful from a customer service POV. I will absolutely be back and have already raved to all my Henderson folks about this place.

author: Oracio Hernandez
review_text: This wingstop is by the USC. I was there on 06-19-25 around 2:00pm. I spent 50 dollars for a family meal. The chicken strip were hard and those were for my kids, the wings were flavorless, my fries weren't fully done. I'm actually gonna stop eating out for a while.

author: Nick Boyd
review_text: This place is really gross and not worth trying even if you get one of the coupons they offer. Nasty reheated meals premade in a commercial kitchen in NJ and heated up in a water bath or microwave for you. Completely cynical corporate restaurant concept that’s essentially a ghost kitchen masquerading behind marketing budgets and false claims of being a “food hall.” Terrible for small business, terrible for your taste buds. Skip it.

author: Paul Ciprian
review_text: A kind of fast food/canteen often found in Singapore. Many small stands selling cooked food, in spartan conditions. Tables and benches fixed to the floor, trays not very clean. You don't get napkins, I haven't seen them anywhere, neither here nor in other similar places. The food is tasty, there are long queues at some stands. Crowded! Cash only.

author: Alisha cruz
review_text: We were visiting from NYC and wow. I knew once I saw the menu that this place would be awesome. Authentic Dominican food. We had the mangu platter and the serving size was great. The taste? Amazing, everything balanced each other so well. I also recommend getting a fresh fruit juice. The chinelo was such a refreshing, sweet unique taste. I wish I had something like this back home! The staff was also very friendly.

author: Viktoriia Stepanushko
review_text: The most incredible hookah place to visit! Food was so delicious, I highly recommend to try sushi, skirt steak shawarma and fried calamari! I’ve got Sicilian Sour and Pineapple martini cocktails - really good, believe me. Hookah was also as strong and good as I wanted

author: Geocentricity
review_text: The momos reminds me of how my mom makes dumplings. An order of steamed came with 10, plump momos with noticable hints of spice and sweetness. The two sauces are very contrasting: yellow is a slight curry/turmeric flavor and not salty while the red was spicy and strong flavor of dried chilis and maybe paprika. Eventually I ate them plain and it felt right. The seating area is small and cramped, plus most of the store is like a deli. Although $12 for 10 pieces seems kinda steep currently, the quality of the momos will bring me back again.

author: Lucas
review_text: Bali’s best Babi Guling! We were instantly intrigued by this famous dish as we arrived on the island but we were in search of something fresher and tastier. We found it here! An abundance of fresh and delicious meat, salad and sauce! The price was exceptional and we left feeling supremely satisfied x

author: Ryan Moran
review_text: Wow amazing food !!! Rose was so kind and helpful- she made our trip to hoangs kitchen incredible! Overall its an adorable and an amazing place to eat - some of our favourite in Vietnam. PLEASE ORDER THE PANCAKE ! Its amazing diy make food . Please take a visit so hoangs kitchen - you wont regret it! By Meg

author: Ali Reneé
review_text: I’ve been counting down the days until Koro opened & the ramen was even better than I expected! So many toppings to choose from and they FILLED the bowls 😋 - so worth it!! The staff is also amazing and very friendly. When I walked in, I was handed a menu and got served very quickly - really great first impression before I even tasted the food! I can’t wait to come back soon and try the sushi!

author: Regine Lee
review_text: It was a Saturday 4:30pm, most of the stalls are closed. I haven’t take my lunch so wanted a quick bite. I saw braised duck stall has 3 person queuing so thought it will be fast. End up i queued for 20 mins. And the food was not worth waiting for. The soup was too salty to be edible. The rice had a rotten taste (maybe weather too humid, rice spoil very fast), the rice was also cold and hard. The duck meat was too tough. Overall, i regretted getting this. I did not finish it even though is my first meal of the day.

author: Jason Mendoza
review_text: Amazing Thai food, the quality is exceptional with so much flavour. The ambience is also very classy with great luxurious touches. The staff were also very attentive and knowledgeable.

author: Kach Opinion
review_text: Was craving Mediterranean food and came across this place on a whim. The koobideh is absolutely delicious!!! The plate was enough for 2 people to share. Will definitely be back :)

author: Leidi Chavez
review_text: This restaurant’s location is excellent since it’s right at the Hollywood Beach Broadwalk and offers a great view of the beach. They open until late and they have indoors and outdoors seating weather permitting of course. This last time we visited during lunch and ended up ordering some burgers which tasted very good as well as the drinks. Our server was attentive and welcoming.

author: Jowe Chu
review_text: A little underwhelming. Please dun be mistaken, the food is alright but the ingredients are really not top notch. From online review I had the expectations of chunky crab but all the small portions turned out to be sprinkling of crab meat. Ordered a small crab with bee hoon, small crab with egg and the creamy tom yum seafood soup. Pretty tasty but dun expect restaurant standards.

author: Paul Alty
review_text: I used to go to The Hungry Pig quite a lot when I was in the area, and I must have worked my way through most of the menu. My go-to was usually the full breakfast — you really can’t go wrong with it, and the sausages and the hash browns in particular are excellent. If you’re looking for something a bit lighter, the Caesar salad is top notch, with proper chunks of succulent chicken. And a special mention for the garlic bread — it’s *proper* garlic bread. I’ve had some pretty dire garlic bread in Saigon, but theirs is genuinely good. Other highlights for me were the BLT (of course), the British Pig (not offended by the name 😉) which is English muffin with pine-smoked bacon and egg, and the Porco Rosso, which I thought was outstanding. The burgers are excellent too. Hats off to the kitchen staff: the food was always consistently good every time I visited, which is really what keeps you coming back. The atmosphere is nice and chilled, and Jasmine and the rest of the team are lovely and always attentive. I’d highly recommend The Hungry Pig if you’re in the area. *Pictures might not be great, I'm no photographer but rest assured, it tasted excellent*

author: hector coyoy
review_text: Service was top notch 👌 the waitress were so nice and the food was cook as we asked.

author: Inspired by the Sun
review_text: It's probably the most flavoursome pho I've had in Vietnam. You can add as many greens to your soup as you wish. The broth really has depth. It's a local place but caters nicely to foreigners. The beef was ample and was really tasty. The beef at many other places is just bland.

author: Chris Cappola
review_text: LOVE LOVE LOVE Fav Place in the US. The Boston restaurant is such a feast for the eyes, beautiful inside. The food was amazing! The cakes are scrumptious and full of flavours - love the Fall range. Our server Jairo deserves to be the Employee of the Month - he was absolutely attentive, proactive and very approachable. Only feedback - we waited 30 minutes for a table. This despite at least 15 tables we saw visibly available. We went to the bathrooms and could see so many available spots. The front desk hosts were so laid-back with no sense of urgency or care to have people seated. This would deter us but after all it's the Cheesecake Factory!

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: Martin C
review_text: I noticed the rating was under 4, and that actually made me more determined to leave a good review because this kind of traditional food shouldn't be overlooked. Ming Qin's charcoal-fried duck egg char kuey teow is genuinely delicious. The charcoal aroma is something you can hardly find outside anymore. The duck egg was cooked perfectly - yolk slightly runny but not too watery - and it coated the noodles so well. The kuey teow was full of flavor with strong wok hei. I ordered the large with two eggs, and before leaving I even packed another one to take home.Truly one of the rare places that still keep this traditional taste alive.

author: Darren Jones
review_text: Rough and untidy, bins overflowing, tables covered in sauces and packets etc.

author: Rosalinda Cremeans
review_text: I brought my neighbor there to eat and we ordered the Gambas AL Ajillo (shrimp sautéed with garlic sauce) and we ordered the Milanesa de Pollo ( breaded chicken steak served with rice so good! I had gone there two times in one week! Love that place.

author: Jeffrey A Brick
review_text: June 12, 2025, 10:22 PM PDT Nestled on Hollywood Blvd., Ruen Pair, a quarter-century beacon in Thai Town, welcomed me into its snug, buzzing dining room—a true community of spice-seekers. Vegetable Egg Rolls arrived first: golden, crisp shells hiding cabbage, carrots, mushrooms, and glass noodles. With a dance of sweet‑sour sauce—vegetarian if you mind to check the fish sauce—it was a lively, light opener, priced at a modest $7–$9. Then came Pad Kee Mao with Tofu (~$11–$13), the meal’s bold heart. Flat noodles, chewy and hearty, twirled with bell peppers, onions, garlic, chili, and fragrant Thai basil. Ordered “medium” spicy, it struck that ideal note—vivid, aromatic, and spirited without beating you down ￼ ￼. My drink, misnamed “Tom Yum Beer,” turned out to be a Thai iced tea with coconut milk (~$5). It cooled the tongue’s fire splendidly; whether it was truly inspired by Tom Yum or just happy accident, it paired just right. Service was unassuming yet attentive—no hovering, but enough care to note my lack of egg and offer to omit it. The dinner tab came to about $36.50 before tax—a fair exchange for flavors this honest and vivid. The dining room was a lively mix: Indian, Korean, white Angelenos—all tucked shoulder to shoulder, savoring the same healthy kick of spice. No frills, just authentic Thai done right. If your palate calls for chewy noodles, crisp bites, and a dash of well‑tempered fire in the heart of Los Angeles, Ruen Pair stands ready. Even a modern Twain would tip his hat.

author: C
review_text: Fabulous breakfast. Outstanding service and very generous servings! I've eaten here several times and it never disappoints. The French toast, and waffle with scrambled eggs are superb. Great coffee and teas and darling atmosphere. This is a MUST!

author: Doany Will
review_text: Il Poeta hits a sweet spot of offering elevated Italian fare in a neighborhood setting — perfect for a date night, a dinner with friends when you want something better than casual chain fare, or for celebrating something special without going ultra‐formal. The dishes, service, and ambiance all lean toward the positive. Just be aware that if you’re after a super quiet, spacious setting, this might feel more intimate than you expect. If I were rating it, I’d give it something like 4.5 out of 5 — strong recommendation, with small caveats around space and noise.

author: Irvan Irawan Jie
review_text: A very good Malaysian food restaurant. All the things we ordered was excellent. The wait for acceptable and we can order first so that the food came right after we sat down. They also sell good egg tart, kaya jam, coffee mix, instant noodles and chilli paste.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Bee Choo Cheng
review_text: Michelin star restaurant and there was no Q. I checked with the staff how to order and they give me a QR code to order. I ordered pork rib soup and pork tenderloin. Both were delicious and the meat was tender. The salted veggies was soft. The dough fritters were not hot and crispy. The caixin was a bit too soft.
