The staff will walked around to offer to refill the soup if you have finished it. The disappointment with this outlet is when I asked the staff to give me extra soup when they served the food, he did not give us extra bowl or soup. I have to ask from other staff. Overall still a perfect and highly recommended place for Singapore style BKT.

author: Joao
review_text: I have to say the food at this restaurant is really good — totally worth it. I wish I had discovered it earlier so I could’ve visited more often. I highly recommend the bone marrow beef noodles; just thinking about it makes me want to go back. The service is also excellent. Thank you so much for the great experience!!!

author: Pitchaya Chanthawong
review_text: We came here 2nd time already this year as we live in England. I am Thai and my husband is English. We love Thai food so much as I cook every day at home. This restaurant is very good and all the food is so delicious and authentic. We love Ribeye waterfall ( Nam tok ) so much and all the other dishes are amazing too. P’ Kay assisted us with the order and even offered me to change a bowl of rice if it’s not hot anymore. He is very friendly with us. The food portions are big and we allowed to take some back to the hotel as I can’t finish all the dishes I ordered. Thanks so much for making me feel like home. We will definitely be back again soon ❤️

author: Vanessa Tan
review_text: Located in a central area popular with tourists. I visited around 6:30 pm and only waited about five minutes in line. As it was my first dine in visit, I wasn’t familiar with the menu, but the lady taking our order seemed quite busy and rushed, there wasn’t much time to look through it properly, I just made a quick choice and skipped the side dish. The chicken was smooth and tender, and the accompanying soy sauce had a unique, delicious flavor. Overall, I enjoyed the chicken rice, just wish service had been a little better.

author: ESQ Fresno
review_text: Very good atmosphere ambience is great. Everybody looks happy in community. The food is amazing. Presentation is spectacular.

author: CP-AT Pham-Tran
review_text: Located right in the city center, the restaurant is clean, has a diverse menu, and reasonable prices.

author: arir
review_text: To order: Trash Can Nachos, Cockburn Special Reserve (w ice!), Ribeye MB 6-7, Truffle Mashed Potato, Creamy Spinach, Salmon Coulibiac Don’t order: Chili Crab Bun

author: Patrick Burton
review_text: I always make it a point to visit a Margaritaville when I'm near one on vacation. This is located in a nice area with multiple shops and boats you can take trips on. Service was a little slow as there was only 1 bartender who was also waitressing tables. I recommend getting the Volcano Nachos. Retail store had some good offerings but be aware the price on the shirts is wrong and you'll be charged slightly more. I don't agree with that as they should charge how it's marked.

author: Alexander
review_text: Finally was able to snag reservation that worked after a few weeks of trying to corral people together. The restaurant itself was great. I thought it was a little too dark but overall had a great ambiance and cute, subdued aesthetic. The music and general noise was also at a comfortable level, a nice touch which many restaurants get wrong. The service was also great. Very attentive and helpful for guiding us through the popular items, specials, and personal favorites. As a hungry group of three first-timers, we ordered 4 pastas, 2 desserts, a pizza bianca and sauce, and a slice of pizza. This amount ended up being right for leaving satiated without overly stuffed. The pizza pianca, like breadsticks, and pizza slice, like a "granny slice," was surprising light and really enjoyable. If you like crispy new york style this pizza won't scratch the itch but for lovers of flatbreads this is exceptional. The stracciatella dip was so good (the tomato relish was incredible!) as was the hot honey and pepperoni topping combination. We skipped the starters and went straight for the pastas. We split the taleggio cappelletti and each ordered our own: a seasonal butternut squash filled pasta, bucatini with anchovy chili butter, and rigatoni amatriciana. The pasta itself was outstanding. I love pasta with a bit of bite and this delivered. I thought the dishes could have all been a bit more flavourful. The popular cappelletti are little pockets of molten taleggio, a slightly funky cow's milk cheese and one of the favorites. I also really liked the rigatoni amatriciana. It was a much more tomato-ey sauce than I am used to for amatriciana and I really enjoyed it. The butternut squash raviolis were well done and bursting with sweetness. And the bucatini had all the umami from the anchovies and roe without being too fishy. Everything was good but they all lacked anything extra to be particularly special. I thought each dish could have used one more strong flavour to make the dish a bit more interesting. I had extremely high expectations due to the hype and hassle to make a reservation so that could have led to me being a bit underwhelmed. We finished off the meal with the tiramisu and panna cotta. Both were delicious, my favorite was the panna cotta. Overall, extremely good pasta and pizza and would love to return but for me, not sure I think its worth the hassle of planning a multiple weeks in advance.

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: Chloe H
review_text: Very nice food. Average service. We walk-in at around 17:15 on a weekday and was able to get a seat quickly. The appetizer (Sausage) tastes much better than I expect! Deep fried chicken wings - super juicy! But a little too raw, some still have red blood inside. Today's special catfish dish is indeed special. Tender fish and sweet flavor mix in a great way.

author: c chan
review_text: Ordered a beef pho during lunch. The quality is amazing and there are 3 types of beef (brisket, beef balls and flank). The portion is big but the price is super affordable. I work around the corner and I can’t believe I didn’t discover this little gem earlier. Definitely will come back and try other dishes.

author: Ciara
review_text: i love this spot so much, best calamari and 2 for 1 drinks all day! last night i had the pleasure of having Tony as my server and he was the BEST server i’ve had at any restaurant recently. he was consistent, funny, fast, and on point! the other servers who brought our food out were great as well. i also had the ribs that were falling straight off the bone and seasoned so well. if you come to this location, ask for Tony!!

author: Amanda Brendel
review_text: Had to call in order because website wouldn't let me check out. Ordered 6 meals for a business lunch for pick up. I arrived early, ordered a smoothie to wait. Out of bananas which took too long to notify and then to make with another option. Once food was ready, no one offered to help with bringing to my car. Took 3 trips to my car with food bags and drinks. I regularly order from AZ locations and they ate much more willing to offer assistance and appreciation for ordering. Will order somewhere else next time in town. Too many options when given poor service.

author: Venus
review_text: I had to check out this restaurant since it’s so popular—and it totally lived up to the hype! My best picks were the nasi lemak and the pandan toast—absolutely perfect. The rest of the dishes I tried were just delicious all around. Definitely worth the visit!

author: Jennyfer Suero
review_text: Fresh food, great taste, amazing prices, I loved it! I want to go again and I live 40 min away. You need to try there chicken and tostones there natural drinks are amazing as well. Oh there chimis too was good omg everything was amazing just go and try it you won't regret it!

author: Eclipse classic
review_text: Way to HOT!!! 🔥 🔥 Hottest jalapeno pepper they could find. I asked the staff and they thought it was funny.

author: Eric C Huang
review_text: Literally the best chocolate croissant I’ve ever had. As someone who doesn’t usually go for chocolate croissants (and have had many mediocre ones), this one truly is quite something. They also make them on the spot, so fresh! (In fact, the croissants even survived pretty much about 12 hours when I brought them for my friends up in Northern California) Their hot chocolate “drinking chocolate” is also super creamy and decadent but not too heavy nor sweet! Feels like a warm cozy hug 🫂

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Vi Hoang
review_text: I tried Bun Moc here and it was a good experience. Meat's juicy and big, other pork pastes also good. Love the greens!

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Matt Gibson
review_text: Great food for a great price and awesome staff. I'm staying in a hotel around the corner and have been eating here everyday at least once, sometimes twice, for a week and I will come back every day until I leave. Fantastic spot.

author: hm rfmn
review_text: Loveee Anna’s service. Very friendly and welcoming. And other staff were very helpful too. A bit steep but overall, a great experience and food.

author: timothy meier
review_text: Jack in the box contacted me about the hours. I couldnt figure out how to respond from here. They let us in and served us. Even the actual crazy guy who i bought tacos, in exchange for helping me get fed.

author: Noah Parker
review_text: Good food and a cool little vibe. Just note prices listed do not include tax and service charge. 😕 We got the smashed patty burger meal and the winner winner chicken burger and the were both great. The chips were also cooked well 😋. I would recommend over Grill'd next door.

author: Jeremy Marcellino
review_text: have been coming here for 6th time already and i think today was the right time to put a review on this place: TREMENDOUS FOOD!! Squid Ink Fried Rice definitely our favorite. Truffle Fries felt crunchy and amazing too, if you're looking for a well deserved price this is definitely a best place to go!!

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Ida Bagus Putu Surya Nanda
review_text: I had a great dining experience at Quán Ngon – Bún Chả Hà Nội. This place is a solid choice for anyone wanting to try authentic northern Vietnamese flavors, especially the famous Bún Chả. Pros: • Authentic taste: The Bún Chả here was flavorful and satisfying. The grilled pork had a nice smoky aroma, the broth was fresh and well-balanced, and the herbs and noodles were generous and fresh. • Local vibe: The restaurant has a simple, clean, and local-style atmosphere. It feels very genuine and relaxed, which adds to the experience. • Affordable prices: For the quality of food, the prices are very reasonable. It’s definitely good value for money. • Friendly service: The staff were friendly and tried their best to assist, even though their English was limited. Their helpful attitude made the experience pleasant.

author: Teresa Demos
review_text: Don’t get the hand breaded chicken sandwich. It is very rubbery in the texture is not good even though it is cooked fresh. I’ve already eaten it so I don’t really have a picture, but it is edible, but I just didn’t like the texture at all. Everything else was perfectly fine.

author: Adibe Garces
review_text: The food was presented beautifully and tasted delicious. Dayanara was so kind and friendly, she made us feel so welcome. Everyone had wonderful customer service. And the ambiance was increíble! I will definitely come back next time I’m in Miami!

author: Adlai Pappy
review_text: Solid food and very well presented. Second time here and both dinner and breakfast was good. Chicken and waffles was good and my wife loved the breakfast sandwich

author: Christian Ford
review_text: I came to Dino’s Famous Chicken & Fries (Pico Blvd location) on a whim after seeing the solid reviews. I was open to trying something new, even though the prices gave me a bit of sticker shock. I asked the cashier if the fries were good and whether they could be made crispy — he said yes, so I went for it. When the food came out, it was… baffling. The chicken was soaked in juice — not sauce, not marinade, just watery runoff. And the fries? All dumped underneath the chicken, completely soggy and drenched. It was like they had been boiled, not fried. Maybe that’s a “house style,” but there was no heads-up that the fries would be swimming in chicken runoff. If they had placed the fries on top or on the side, they might have stood a chance. Instead, what I got was a soggy mess. I politely brought it up to the cashier — the same guy I spoke to earlier — and mentioned the fries were completely soggy because of how the plate was put together. He just shrugged. No apology, no explanation, no offer to make it right. Didn’t even ask to see the problem. I literally said, “Okay, well, I’m not coming back,” in front of a line of other customers, and he didn’t seem to care. That kind of dismissive attitude is enough to guarantee I won’t be back. It’s one thing to have a unique food style, but it’s another to treat customers like their feedback doesn’t matter.

author: Cate. S
review_text: Great Italian Restaurant near the river. Perfect place to sit outside and enjoy real Italian food. Also the service is friendly and fast. I did not had a reservation which is recommended when you come on a Sunday. Had the burrata fresca and the fettuccine Bolognese - will come definitely again.

author: Diva Navy S
review_text: amazing experience! The food was great, the vibe was beautiful, and the service was super nice!! perfect for special nights🥰

author: Sarena Nicole Arokiasamy
review_text: My friends and I had a great time at Cơm Tấm Ba Ghiền! The place was packed, but we were still able to find a table without much trouble. The food was served right away, and everything was delicious with generous portions. I absolutely loved the chico fruit shake — highly recommended! On top of that, the customer service was friendly and attentive, which made the experience even better.

author: Marcela Lindo
review_text: Came to the restaurant for a private event so we were upstairs. They have valet parking which is great because it’s in a busy area. They work off tips. We were greeted upon entering. The event space is really nice with a bar area. Loved how they set it up. Servers were very attentive. The appetizers were delicious. My faves were the calamari and chicharron. The food was buffet style which included sweet plantains, white rice, chicken and beef. They also had salmon. They served churros and tres leches as the dessert. The churros were so good and fresh!

author: Kim Quick
review_text: This is my first time here and the food is absolutely delicious. Had an issue with, and it was resolved immediately. Thank you, Bernice, Za’Myah, and Hassan for providing top-notch service. Very surprisingly it was quite affordable. We have five fish, mac & cheese, collard greens, black-eyed peas, and chicken for under $35. And then we got the Southern Twang beverage that topped it off perfect!

author: Tan Lai Heng
review_text: Many many choices of food to choose from. But if you are parking, might have limited spaces to park unless you park at the multi storey carpark.

author: AJ F
review_text: Vietnamese with their own twist—steak banh mi steals the show .Pho was OK.

author: PP K.
review_text: The food was a mixed bag; some dishes were good while others were not. The portion sizes were quite small. Interestingly, we were asked to give a five-star review in exchange for a free dish (my friend did that, not me! 😂). The clam dish was disappointing because it wasn't fresh, and some of the clams were closed. We were offered another dish instead: chicken with cashew nuts. It was very sweet and had only three pieces of chicken! Overall, I wasn't particularly impressed. It's not terrible, but it didn't wow me either.

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: Wendy C
review_text: WORST EXPERIENCE EVER! FOOD POISONED... STILL AT HOSPITAL... I had dinner here on the 27th with my entire family of four. We were very excited to try this Michelin-recognized restaurant, but unfortunately the experience that followed was extremely distressing. About three hours after dinner, I began experiencing severe vomiting and diarrhea, followed by intense abdominal pain. The pain became so overwhelming that I was unable to stand or lie down, I will rolling on the floor in pain and had to be taken to urgent care. At the hospital, I received multiple IV infusions for pain management, fever, and dehydration. Blood tests tested positive of infection, and I was diagnosed with A09 – infectious gastroenteritis and colitis (unspecified). I was given antibiotics and am still completing the course today. The hospital visit cost approximately $500 USD. The following day, my brother and father developed the same symptoms—fever, vomiting, and diarrhea—and both required hospital treatment as well. As of today, my father is still experiencing a low-grade fever. I want to keep this review as objective as possible. The restaurant itself is beautifully designed, and the shop on the first floor is charming—we spent around $450 there buying a lot of crafts. The food was good, though given the reputation and hype, we were expecting more. Notably, the only member of our family who did not become ill was my mother. The only dish she did not eat was the crab hot pot. When the hot pot was brought to our table, it was not boiling. After waiting for some time, we asked the waitress for assistance three separate times. The first time, we were told to wait a few more minutes. The second time, we were told that the soup had already been boiled in the kitchen and was safe to eat. Coming from another Asian country, my understanding is that hot pot should remain actively boiling while cooking raw ingredients to ensure food safety. We were reassured that this was the traditional way to eat it and that it would be fine. Eventually, the staff portioned the soup and cooked the meat and vegetables for us in the pot, which was still not boiling. Trusting their guidance, we ate the dish. My mother chose not to eat anything from the hot pot, and she was the only one who did not fall ill. I cannot say with certainty what specific pathogen caused our illness. However, three out of four people becoming seriously sick within hours of the same meal is deeply concerning. While local diners may be accustomed to certain practices, a restaurant of this caliber—especially one frequented by international guests—should take extra care with food safety and preparation standards. This was an extremely painful and costly experience for my family, and I hope this feedback is taken seriously!!!

author: Raymond Lim
review_text: Delicious food, good service, in what looks like a housing area. Seafood paella is chock full of shrimps, clams, scallops, mussels, and half a lobster. Very good. We have a nice dessert, not unlike a crème caramel, which is quite nice. Well priced, recommended if you're in the Newark area.

author: Dang Loi
review_text: Not good not bad, the price is higher than other restaurants in the neighborhood, the roof is useless when raining, and it quite hot even after raining

author: omarwanderlust
review_text: The menudo definitely tastes like I was in California . The tacos were good . The bowl is huge. Coming from East Coast it's good food.

author: Roz
review_text: First time here, I think the girl at check in gave us the wrong directions because me and another 2 pax ended up at the SATS Premium Lounge instead. The entrance of the lounge is designed quite uniquely but I think a proper concierge desk to hide the unsightly paperwork would have been a lovely finishing touch. The lounge is smaller than the cavernous spaces at Doha but it was warm and inviting. I liked that they had the little pods like the QSuites and there were plenty of seats. The staff were so kind and friendly, and would have served me the whole menu I think, if she could. I had the lamb, the sushi and the laksa. All the dishes were tasty and done well. The only weird thing was that the laksa was served in a plate instead of a bowl. A fellow guest was loudly FaceTiming and one of the staff went over to ask him to lower his volume. Big bonus for a halal menu!

author: Kevin Craven
review_text: This was a STELLAR experience! My friends said that we should all try this place out before the Brandy & Monica concert, and I couldn’t be happier that they did! This place felt like HOME! First off, the service is TOP TIER! There are many places that need to take note because the service I experienced was unmatched! It’s a lovely set up with the full menu on display. I ended up ordering the whiting fish with a side of mac n cheese, and it was absolutely divine! Soul food at its FINEST! Don’t call it soul food if there’s no soul! The fact that they call it farm to soul is spot on because I tasted the love! The fish was so nicely seasoned and crispy! The Mac n cheese got me ready for Thanksgiving! Perfectly cooked, cheesy and flavorful! I also tasted my friends yams, and collard greens, and they were NEXT LEVEL! Those were the best greens I’ve had in my life! The cornbread was also amazing! The woman who took our order was thee absolute kindest! I believe her name was Na, or something like it. She understood hospitality, and my friends and I all greatly appreciated her! All of the staff were just so helpful and friendly, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience! I can’t wait to get back!

author: Vanessa Huynh
review_text: Absolutely love this Warung! I cannot recommend this place enough. It quickly became my comfort spot and I visited several times. The food is absolutely delicious, with a wide variety to choose from and it always looked so beautiful. The service was always warm, welcoming and kind. This place was good for the tummy, but also for the soul! I loved the Nasi Campur and also the duck - best duck ever!! and the desserts were also veryyy good! Suksma.

author: Hướng Dương Shop Hoa
review_text: Basic prices range from 125,000 to ~155,000 VND/person, depending on the package (regular buffet or combo with hotpot). Soft drink buffet package adds about 30,000 VND, and can include craft beer packages (~75K). More than 40 diverse grilled dishes: American beef, pork belly, chicken wings, seafood such as shrimp, squid, octopus — marinated with special tamarind sauce, green chili salt, salted eggs, etc. Dishes change seasonally to ensure fresh ingredients. On-site processing line, fried food, desserts, fresh fruit, ice cream and detox water if you choose an additional package. Youthful design, black-red color scheme combined with neon LED lights, vibrant party vibe, suitable for groups of friends or young families. Spacious, airy space, neat tables and chairs, good distance between tables to avoid smoke and grease. Friendly and enthusiastic staff.

author: CT liaw
review_text: Spare ribs: Tender and easy to eat, ever encounter some rib not really not easy fall off the bone. Soup not so favourable. Pig's trotter: The sauce is thick and nice but meat is a bit tough.

author: Mark Krug
review_text: We had heard about a weekday dinner special and decided to give it a try. We had a great experience with the Pio Pio on Northern Blvd some time ago. This was closer. We arrived and were greated by the bartender who was extremely nice. We were seated nearly immediately, with only a short delay while they cleaned a recently vacated table. The interior was spacious and well done. It had a nice atmosphere. Our server came over and immediately began speaking in Spanish. I am clearly not Hispanic and gave no indication of understanding anything he was saying nor was my wife. Once we got through that, he spoke English and got our order. We both ordered the special with the upgraded water (which turned out to be Smart water in a bottle. We had a ask for glasses). Service was sporadic after that. I felt like because we didn't order the high dollar foods, we were ignored. The food was good and well priced for the special. No complaints there. However, it was not a nice experience, and I don't think we would return to this Pio Pio.

author: Dana Curran
review_text: A great quiet place to get delicious food in generous portions. This is like what Chipotle used to be, but with better quality and not a massive corporate chain.

author: Chloe
review_text: Perfect spot for those Instagram 🤭 worthy pancake shots 📸🥞 The pancakes were yummy, but the toast with whipped cream was definitely the winner for me 😋🍞💛

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: Erwin Wagner
review_text: Excellent claypot BKT. We had the dry one with soup served separately. Was very fragrant and not too salty. The fact that they use ikan bilis and shrimp paste enhances the flavor of the BKT. Meet was very tender and veggies excellent too. I actually enjoyed it way more than the usual BKT place I go to in Klang.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Shannon Jones
review_text: Smelled so good we had to try it!! We were not disappointed!! It’s very good!!

author: Cher Ong
review_text: Was stunned by the atmosphere. It's huge with a really nice wooden vibe. Service is bad. We were looking at the menu & the crew were standing & waiting without any patience. We were contemplating what to order, but no suggestions were given. It's just 2 of us & we ordered 4 dishes. Staff didn't warn us about the portion. Was shocked when the dishes arrived. It's good for 4 people & above. We wasted a lot of food. Pricing is high, but the portion is big. Food taste average only.

author: Paul T Nguyen
review_text: This place is a gem. The food here is excellent! Service is great too. Wife and I had pineapple fried rice and drunken noodles with dessert not 1 but 2 mango dessert which was delicious with just ripe mangos perfect to eat. We've been here almost every week to eat and the chef and owner she is so wonderful and great cook! Chef comes out to make sure everything is perfect for us. I have never had to thank the chef in person because usually they are busy cooking. Chef here in glad she comes out and we thank her for such excellent cooking. I definitely will be coming back over and over again and definitely recommend this place to eat to others! We've added other dishes prior too in our photos. All the dish we are yummy too

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: Shaolin Leong
review_text: Building a wet market near a hawker center in oder to support & provide the daily necessities as well as providing convenience to the residents living in the estate has always been the mission of HDB and URA. This hawker center is actually quite big ! As I moved in lately so I took the opportunity to explore the area. Tried the fishball & meatball noodle,carrot cake & coffee today. As for the wet market side most stalls were closed as it was around 1 plus when I was there. Heard the wanton noodle is quite nice but an old man like me can only clear 2 items maximum in a meal ! Looking forward to my next visit now to walk 2km back in order to burn off the extra calories !

author: Jaxson Alexander Rourke
review_text: I recently visited Bangkok Street Thai Street Kitchen and overall it was a decent experience. The food was good we tried the Pad Thai and some of the curries, and the flavors were pleasant and reasonably authentic. The service was friendly and polite, which added to the visit. On the downside, the portion sizes felt a bit small for the price, and the atmosphere was nothing special just average. I might come back if I’m in the area and craving Thai food, but I wouldn’t go out of my way for it.

author: Reto K
review_text: After all, apparently this is one of Santa Monicas best (italian) restaurants. As an almost Italian I have to say this place is not living up to its promises. In my opinion their only advantage are those tables at the front site facing the sea. Watching sunset from there is really nice. As a walk-in, they just put you on a waiting list that allows you to sit on the bar. Totally unclear whether at one point you will actually get a table. Luckily we got a table after 1 hour wait. The food menu is pretty strange as neither dish seems to be a full dish. You order the chicken, you will only get the chicken (in a chinese chili sauce - this is supposed to be an italian place, no?). Pasta is just the pasta. So I ordered both. The bucatini were nice but ordering them alone would be like ordering a burger without buns. The bottle of wine I ordered… yeah I definitely had nicer Primitivos with more flavor. The service at the bar was pretty good, the one at the table not so inspiring. It seems like a place you go for the reputation and to be seen but not for the rest.

author: James.KahHuat Seet
review_text: The scallops are superb and the beef in the beef sukiyaki is so tender. The grilled squid goes very well with the sauce. Price is pretty reasonable especially with the great tasty food standard. Definitely will return again on my next trip to BKK.

author: Pa Papi
review_text: If you want the best freshest Authentic Argentine food you MUST stop by here and ask for Pablo. He greeted me with a big warm smile took me to the best table with a view of their TV’s and the service was best Cloth with table cloth and they serve Alcohol for those that might want to try some of De best Wine

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: N (Princess)
review_text: Known of this mookata place from few Thai food blogger but didn't have the chance to try it. We were craving for mookata, was contemplating between this or everyday mookata, silom branch as the google reviews are not really promising. Long story short, we decided to come and not regret with our decision. Meats and vegetables are fresh and soup is 👍🏻 (didn't feel thirsty after meal). In here, we prefer pork and chicken over beef. Service is great even though there are language barrier. At least they will try to understand and fulfilled the customers' needs as best as they could👍🏻. Interior is simple, clean and with aircon which is needed for Bangkok weather now. This place is definitely under rated whereby it was full even on wet Sunday evening.

author: Victor Ng
review_text: Even though I ordered to eat at the shop the bread was served in a closed plastic box. Bread was soggy and mushy - as though it came from the microwave. Thai tea had no sugar.

author: JOE THOMAS
review_text: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Amazing Breakfast Spot – A Must-Try in Vegas!** My visit to **Egg Works** was absolutely fantastic! The Mexican omelette was packed with flavor—perfectly spiced, loaded with fresh ingredients, and cooked just right. The sticky rice and avocado on eggs was a unique and delicious twist that we have never had anywhere else. Every bite was a delight! Our server Ariel was friendly and attentive, and the atmosphere was cozy and welcoming. The portions were generous, and everything tasted fresh and high-quality. If you’re in Vegas and craving an outstanding breakfast, this is the place to go.

author: Justin Santos
review_text: Amazing food. Fast service. We did a catering order from them for my work and it's hott & fresh. Very busy location at it's peak but worth it.

author: Susan Chai
review_text: Finally got to have it again after so long — I’ve missed it so much! 🥹💛 Tried their baby-size Hojicha this time — it’s just too cute! Even though it was crowded, it didn’t feel rushed at all; the staff managed everything so well 👍🏼Plus, they offer complimentary tea for customers — love the thoughtful touch! Definitely recommend 💫

author: Yvonne A
review_text: We absolutely loved our visit to Ipoh Kopitiam!Everything was so delicious and packed with that authentic Malaysian flavor we’ve been craving. The nasi hainam was incredibly tender and fragrant, the dry wanton mee was perfectly seasoned, and the sambal had the right amount of kick. Even the Milo drink tasted just like home! We’re already missing Ipoh’s food, and of course we’ll definitely be back. Highly recommended for anyone looking for real, comforting Malaysian flavors! 🍜🇲🇾✨

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: Sarah Wong
review_text: Came here on a Thurs evening so there is no parking issue. It’s our first time. The service is friendly, and the food is VERY good. I’m not sure if this sounds comprehensible, but we can taste the “labour of love” from the chef(s)? Some food is prepared “simply because” it’s an order, but some food, tho’ simple, like homecooked food by a loving Grandma, can be tasted. Goodyear’s food is like that. We ordered lala beehoon, yuanyang kwaytiao, spiced pork, sweet potato leaves and prawn rolls. Except for the veggie, the rest are signature dishes. Bill is $87 including tea. For the food quality and portion, rural town vibe, cleanliness (old but clean), plus warm service, the price is reasonable. Will definitely be their repeated diners 🤣

author: Dinato Podcast
review_text: I love the vibe and aesthetics here. Staff are so nice and the food is so great and affordable. I highly recommend it here

author: King
review_text: So many bad reviews, and so many good reviews, therefore I come to take a look. Order time and service time is that that long, it is reasonable. Unlike many bad reviews that wait long time and no food left. The lala pot is reasonable price, but the fish dumplings definitely is at the high price that 5 pcs for $6.9. If I want to standardize for $6.9, it can be 6 pcs or 8 pcs , because every pcs is quite small . The soup added too much MSG, because I can easily tell when my heart beats go too high. Overall, can try la.

author: Yuliia Kartamysheva
review_text: Delicious dish and welcoming staff. Very local atmosphere, feels like visiting grandma’s house. Prices are good too.

author: humphrey phery
review_text: I always love coming here. Had moi moi, veg soup, banga soup, some fried turkey 🍗 and fried kidneys ..... with poundo yam and amala.... that's like 2 days food gotten one time... I really enjoy the moi moi here... so tasty, succulent and nice color 😋

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Amy Liz
review_text: Me and my partner had a very delicious meal here - portion sizes were perfect. We had the mahi mahi tacos and beef tacos, and nachos. 10/10. Nice drinks too. Jonathan was a great waiter! Attentive and kind. We will definitely be back :)

author: Thanh-Mai Nguyen
review_text: We had a delicious meal here. Food was tasty, staff was friendly, and the restaurant vibes were cool. Highly recommended

author: Bamin Razali
review_text: Food is just fine. Self service system. Food ready was quite fast despite the many patrons. Too noisy and hot and humid. Choice of food is limited as well. The only food I enjoy here is the Daging Bakar. The rest is okay nothing to shout about. Also it's a RM5 paid entrance/parking area.

author: Adeline Ng
review_text: It’s like our fortnight event with Katong Punggol Nasi Lemak! I wouldn’t say which dish is my favourite as in fact, every dish is top-notch and it’s always a challenge to pick what will be in my box. A good thing we always pack at least 8 to 12 person boxes so we can go home and “mix and match” kind of fun! We will always pack extra cabbage curry and Achar for the next day lunch!

author: Judith Hurtado
review_text: First, did not like that they did not have a kids meal. Second the place was HOT. Third they charge for everything! 25 cents for each ranch, even to use they nasty restroom. Food was decent but not for the price.

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: L Chen
review_text: One of the best hakka lui cha ever eaten! Veggies so fresh and crunchy, soup so delicious! The fried fermented pork belly is a little fatty but nicely seasoned and super tasty! Happy meal $5 (brown rice), add fried pork $2. Awesome, love it, will be back again soon for more!

author: VC Loh
review_text: Love the dim sum and bakuteh, very fresh ingredients and nice.

author: Ghufran Musta'an
review_text: Seribu Rasa in Gunawarman, Jakarta, offers a comforting oasis amidst the city buzz, perfect for business meals or relaxed dining. The ambiance is cozy and inviting, matched by impeccable service that enhances the dining experience. Hygiene is top-notch, contributing to the overall appeal. The menu is a delightful journey through authentic local cuisine, capturing the true essence of traditional flavors. Every dish, from the aromatic curries to the succulent meat and vibrant vegetables, is crafted to perfection, making it a standout in near the SCBD area. The taste resonates with the authenticity of home-cooked meals, a rare find in the restaurant scene. While prices are on the higher side, the quality and portion sizes make it well worth the expense. Seribu Rasa has earned its place as my favorite dining destination in Jakarta, offering a memorable experience that justifies every rupiah spent. Thank you for the exceptional food and service!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Thomas Strehle
review_text: Stunning space in a beautiful newish area downtown. The space is amazing. Realize it is Miami but I just got back from NYC and felt the comparative prices here were ridiculous for the quality of food. The least expensive spaghetti with tomato sauce (no protein) is $25. It was ok. They advertise San Marzano tomatoes in it but I question it. Service was VERY friendly and accommodating. Shortrib ravioli was ok for $36 for lunch. Looks like it would be a lot of fun at happy hour. Raspberry espresso martini was wonderful!

author: Marcel Chatenet
review_text: First time there to catch with a friend. The food is very good, the only drawback is the noise. But eh!! Enjoy the food, and speak loader!! Good place to enjoy good food, having good mood experiencing Thai typical life.

author: Jack Rosenberg
review_text: I think we all get big expectations for Hells Kitchen because of the TV show and we expect something. I had heard in the past it's not great but.... I loved it! The service was spectacular, the food was amazing, and the experience as a whole was top notch. The prices I felt were very reasonable. We tried all the classics... the Wellington etc... everything was on point. I can't stress enough though while everything was great... the service was the best part. Just a great time!

author: Janine Chang
review_text: great cafe on the 3rd or 4th floor (can't remember which exactly). they seat you and present the menu for you to select from. the prices are a little higher, though they take their coffee seriously so it's definitely for those with a high appreciation of coffee. everything we had there was delicious! my sister-in-law isn't a coffee person but loves tiramisu and loved theirs. they have a restroom on the same floor, outside of the cafe.

author: Quavail Leontay
review_text: I’ve always loved Sonic as my go to fast food restaurant. It was my first job and it’s nostalgic to go back to, but every time I go, especially to this location, something is wrong. Usually, I just brush it off because mistakes happen but consistent mistakes and always have to wait 10+ for the meal I preordered is inexcusable. Usually, the mistake is that my kids burgers still have pickles even though I asked for them to be plain. Tho lately my strawberry limeade slush ordered as a (limeade slush add strawberry) has barely a spoonful of strawberry sauce in it. I used to be frustrated trying to suck up all the strawberry pieces through the straw as I drink this drink. The last few times though, my lime green drink has hardly even turned red because they fail to put enough strawberry sauce inside.

author: Trey Neely
review_text: This place is awesome. 100% delivered for exactly what I needed in the moment I was there. I was in town for a work event on the beach and was traveling in a large truck with a trailer. Miami isn't exactly made for this type of transportation, so when I found Duffy's with the huge parking lot - I was very relieved. I was tired, and hungry, and didn't want to deal with a crowd. When I walked in, I was immediately surprised by how huge it was! I can imagine this place is hugely popular for big sport days. I went outside and easily found a seat at the bar. It's next to a POOL, which had no one in it at the time, but I'm sure it's awesome when in use. My bartender was KiKo and he was on fire. He had the whole outdoor bar to himself and was taking excellent care of everyone. Very impressive! The food was pretty good. The calamari was great and I was in the mood for chicken tenders, so I wasn't very adventurous, but they were good! Beer was cold and Kiko never left me hanging empty. Another big plus when you sit outdoors is the scenery. You're right on the water and get to see all the high end yachts come through...saw some amazing million dollar yachts pass by. All in all - if you want an EASY, well serviced, good bar food type experience - Duffy's is THE PLACE. Highly recommend!

author: Monique Quiros
review_text: I stumbled upon this hidden gem while waiting for my vehicle windows to be tinted, and I’m so glad I did! This local restaurant and bar has a fantastic atmosphere with a Sleepy Hollow theme that adds a unique charm to the experience. The bar area offers plenty of seating options, and they have live music every evening, with karaoke kicking off every Saturday at 11 PM and going strong until 2 or 3 AM. It’s a perfect spot for a late-night hangout. What’s even better is their separate family-friendly dining area, so kids are more than welcome. Dinner is served all day, and I couldn’t resist trying their steak with breakfast potatoes and eggs—absolutely phenomenal! The food quality, paired with the ambiance, makes it a place I can't wait to return to. Service is pretty good as you’re promptly attended to, regardless of where you seat yourself and whether there was anyone at the front when you walked in. Ample parking that is free and directly in front of the lounge is available it is nestled in the complex next to the planet fitness. Highly recommend stopping by if you're in the area!

author: Aiden Nguyen
review_text: The new kid on the block!!! Came here on a Monday afternoon, and it was bustling with people working on their laptops and chatting with friends. Sad I wasn't able to grab a seat, but it's another opportunity to come back 😉 I love that the owner came out and greeted me and my friends 🥰 I appreciate the thoughtful selection of products in the store. I can't wait to come back! Support your local business ✨️💕🫶🏼

author: Zachary Feigman
review_text: One of the best restaurants I've been to in a long time. It reminds me of my grandmother's and mother's cooking so to me it was very authentic. The staff were excellent. Our waitress was very nice and fun. I think the prices are very reasonable. You have to try the steak tartar and the herring in cream sauce. For entree, I tried all my friends dishes and everything was excellent, especially the jagarschnitzel. Unfortunately the Pork Knuckle was out, or I would have ordered that. One of my highest ratings in a long time. Go here immediately.

author: Habibu
review_text: Good vibes and delicious food. Staff were very friendly and efficient. There is quite a number of Indian dishes but there is also a good selection of other types of food. Decided to go more Western instead. Will definitely return in the future!

author: Michael Robinson
review_text: If you’re seeing a show at the NJ Performing Arts Center and are looking for a bite, this is the place. Even if you aren’t seeing a show and are nearby, this is the place. I grabbed their chicken sausage roll before a show. It was so good I had to come back again after—to my memory I don’t think I’ve ever done the same restaurant twice in a day. Their fried chicken sandwich was one of the best I’ve had in recent memory (photo included), and they’ve got *sweet potato tots*—nuff said. Many thanks to Owner Kai and The Yard staff will definitely be back again🔥🔥🔥

author: flightmedic333
review_text: It’s always a great experience here at Kuba in bayside, bartenders are very attentive especially Dalila, she’s always on point with the drinks, and she’s absolutely beautiful so that’s always a plus. chavely works very well with her as another bartender, she’s always working on something but somehow has time to ask if we need something. Also very pretty. This place is definitely a whole vibe. I recommend 100%

author: Franco Chan
review_text: Came here craving teh tarik, satay, and tu tu kueh — and all three wishes came true! ☕ Teh tarik was fragrant, smooth, and nicely pulled. 🍢 Satay was juicy, well-marinated, and smoky with delicious peanut sauce. 🍰 Tu tu kueh was soft, warm, and freshly made — comforting and nostalgic. Perfect place if you want a mix of classic local flavours in one visit. Will definitely come back again 👍

author: Porter KHOR
review_text: Food not great. Vi Da Vietnamese eatery at Ben Thahn market was so much better. Feels like typical chain restaurant using frozen meats cooked without any soul. My pork chop and braised pork belly tasted like microwaved leftovers. Dry and hard at some parts. Don't get fooled by photos on menu. The real dishes all turned out alot smaller. Crab meat ball is one good example. Pricey not great. Walk out for better food . I'll never be back here again. Bill was 480k for two pax

author: Jack
review_text: Saw on TikTok and decided to pay a visit. The lala broth is pretty good but feels like the clams are rather small and the shells took up a lot of space in the small pot. The ingredients are fairly fresh and also fairly priced. Beef slices are fatty perfect for hotpot. The prawn paste was also very fresh. Broth is refillable self service so it's good. The environment can be rather stuffy with the hot fire and smoke sometimes get in your face. Maybe sitting in the open will be better. We paid $75 for 2 adults and 1 kid which is alright I think.

author: Sherman Hanke
review_text: Helpful staff, accommodating sushi chef. Even right at opening, much of my food was lukewarm tho. They seem capable of doing much better than what I saw. I'll try again and update!

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Mohammad Azri Yaacob
review_text: Abit overcrowded for me. But I’m unable to adjust my liking of placing multiple dishes on the table even though I didn’t ordered it. The table looks crowded. Probably that’s Padang food is all about but not for me who prefers it differently. Maybe not now, it’s getting used to it.

author: Chong Evon
review_text: Was there this morning for breakfast, very windy environment. I choose the vegetarian stall today. The zai-er super nice freshly fried and combo with fried tofu and curry veg super delicious. Do support!

author: lontongstroong
review_text: This place is already pretty famous among budget-conscious travelers who are based in SG or connect through SIN. It's intended as staff cafeteria and thus not surprising that the location is pretty hidden. Unlike the staff cafeteria in Terminal 4 which is readily accessible through the landside/check in area, one has to exit the terminal and enter the basement, which is next to the parking building. Follow the signage "Staff Canteen" to get to the place. The stalls are of standard fare and variety of normal food courts. Of course for everyone who isn't airport staff the price is slightly more expensive, but it's still far cheaper than the stuffs inside the terminal. Always come before the dinner crowd, the ventilation quality inside the food court is acceptable (CO2 concentration never goes above threshold of 800 ppm), which is surprising since it's location in the basement. Note that the only drink stall isn't well stocked and often run out of the menu before dinner time *shrugging*.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Yovanna2 Pardo
review_text: Love the pican̈a sandwich. Cravings for steak. Great price . Buying another skirt sandwich for my coworker 😋

author: Yongkwan Song
review_text: The food itself was excellent—especially the steak and the shrimp bucket, both of which were very tasty. We ordered the steak medium and medium rare. The medium was slightly overcooked, while the medium rare was much more tender and flavorful. The overall atmosphere of the restaurant was nice, but it wasn’t easy to get a staff member’s attention. If you wanted to place an additional order or ask for something, you usually had to wait around three minutes before seeing a server. Personally, when it comes to steak, I thought this place was better than Hard Rock Cafe.

author: Wa'El Ali
review_text: Nice place with good vibes and friendly staff. Special thanks to Mr Yoga, he made our 1st year anniversary with my wife a special one.

author: Ben Aronson
review_text: EDIT: I appreciate what they are doing with their “rice & beans” pop-up, increasing a star Cute, homey neighborhood coffee shop with some thoughtful additions. The cakes look impressive, though I haven’t tried, and I think it’s super cool that they have various dinner pop-ups serving different parts of the community. I always appreciate a locally-owned coffee shop that opens their space for people to gather and this is the only one in the neighborhood. That being said, the coffee is only ok and the two or three pasties I’ve tried, including the scones, were seriously underwhelming. In the several times I’ve visited I have also not felt welcomed by the staff. I don’t need baristas to be singing hello but when I have other options, having a warm smile and an inviting feel makes a difference. Maybe the staff aren’t too happy there, idk, but my experience has turned me off from coming here.

author: Ray Cooper
review_text: Never understood a word the male cashier said. There was no greeting, and no attempt to repeat when asked to. I had to check my bag AT THE WINDOW to make sure he got the order correct. Of course this is after waiting over 10 minutes when I was the only one in line

author: Ching
review_text: It was packed, even at 6:00. We ordered fried rice noodles, and it took almost 25 minutes for our turn. The rice noodles were traditionally cooked. The taste was average.

author: Katy Wang
review_text: The food taste good but not sure if it's traditional style, the dish was cold. But it's flavorful. But unfortunately my husband had small rock in his pork dish, we don't know where that from, so be careful when you put the food in mouth.

author: Jas Khaw
review_text: Very yummy UMA omakase prepared by chef Sammy, every bite has its wow factor.

author: Donyel Byrd
review_text: There were many choices in the marketplace to eat. However, we were SO happy with our choice to eat here. We really wanted Cuban food. It was so good! It was very hot, so we opted to eat inside. The ambiance and service were excellent! Highly recommend!

author: Antonio Perez Coss
review_text: We loved our brunch at the Farmers Market Restaurant! 😍 The food (we had a breakfast for the entire family) was delicious 😋 Home made food, super tasty and in a nice and cozy environment (it really looks like granny house) We recommended 100% let’s support our local businesses 💪

author: Tasheena S
review_text: We came here for brunch and we LOVED IT! We will definitely be back. From the moment we arrived until we left the service was amazing. The views of the water really add to the ambiance. Let’s, add the food. The food was amazing. We started with the fish dip and conch fritters; followed by shrimp & grits and French toast. We loved every single bite. We can’t to return.

author: Christine Aaron
review_text: Came for the crab omelette and left FULLY satisfied. This place is absolutely amazing. I did not have to wait at all. Also the butterfly pea tea and chrysanthemum teas were so tasty and good for recovery after massage. Highly recommend stopping here when you’re in Bangkok.

author: Shirling Ang
review_text: Beautiful ambience, great food and lovely cocktails! The crab with mince balls and the fried sea-bass were my favorite. Another worthy mention was the southern sour fish soup which my camera did not get to in time.

author: Shannon Lee
review_text: First day in Miami and we stumbled on such a gem! Love the whimsical decor inside! The shakshuka was so hearty and the lox bagel was perfect! Belen was our waitress and she made sure we had everything we needed. Can’t wait to come back tomorrow!

author: Xiomara Osrod
review_text: Since the moment you arrive at the valet, you feel so welcomed! The food is always SOOO good! The Opa Eggplant is amazing! And the lamb stew is my favorite. Ozkan, the server is a very professional waiter who takes care of every detail of your dinning experience. And I love all the dancers they are all beautiful, sweet girls 💝🙌

author: p p
review_text: One of my favorite cafés in Hoi An. The drinks are reasonably priced, and you can relax and enjoy the river view while sipping your coffee. The coffee tastes great and isn’t expensive. The staff are friendly and provide excellent service. Highly recommended!

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: Mia Malgioglio
review_text: We sat in the Vegetarian floor. Good food and nice place to sit. Would have loved if all plates were hot when served, would have made a huge difference. Overall nice experience to try, but not as flavourous as more traditional, cheap viet restaurants

author: Dai Wen Sim
review_text: Kinda disappointed with their sanlou mi fen. I was expecting a more crunchy texture and wok hei taste but it turned out to be really average. Shoutout to their white pepper crab though! One of the best I’ve had. Really fragrant

author: Mike Richardson
review_text: 12/10 will be back. Don’t sleep on this spot! The charred oysters are not a dish, they are a life event. Smoky, briny, buttery perfection that made me question every decision I’ve ever made that didn’t involve ordering more of them. Pro tip: be like me. Order the charred oysters as a starter. Then, when the server asks about dessert, ignore all social norms and order the charred oysters again. Sweet? No. Satisfying in a deeply emotional way? Absolutely.

author: Gregory Rack
review_text: Nhà Tú earns its Michelin Bib Gourmand reputation. What impressed me most was the precision of flavor: bright acidity, clean herbs, and deep savory notes without anything feeling heavy or muddy. Each dish tasted intentional—balanced, layered, and very “Vietnamese home cooking,” just sharpened. We did have a small hiccup (the fish didn’t arrive as ordered), but it barely mattered because: • the rest of the table was excellent (crispy bites, a vibrant salad, perfectly garlicky greens, and those shrimp bites were addictive) • the owner handled everything with genuine warmth and professionalism Cozy room, calm service, and food that feels both comforting and elevated. I’d come back without hesitation.

author: Sai Arathi
review_text: Came here for our sister's Sangjit. Nice place. They dont have much of Veg options.

author: Brooks Reeves
review_text: This cozy Irish/American/Italian(??) pub exceeded my expectations. I admit, this kind of generic American pub fare is not at all my favorite, but I went with a friend. I ordered the soup of the day (escarole) and a cheeseburger. The escarole was definitely the highlight (not bad for three bucks!) and my cheeseburger was definitely above average. The steak fries were under seasoned, but nothing a personal application of salt and pepper couldn’t fix. To be clear, this bar is not promising anything it can’t deliver. I’m confused why it’s an Irish pub when the entire menu seems clearly Italian/American. Pasta, steak, and seafood (broiled or fried). It was definitely well attended the Friday lunch I came in, and the staff was friendly and cheerful, if a bit swamped. If you are in the mood for above average American bar-food fare it’s definitely a strong option. I doubt its menu has changed in decades, but I think for a certain clientele that’s probably appreciated.

author: A G (Pourover Traveller)
review_text: Review of Wahaha Pork Ribs Jimbaran: A Reliable Dining Option Wahaha Pork Ribs in Jimbaran is a solid choice for anyone craving delicious ribs in Bali. As part of a well-known chain, the quality remains consistent across locations, and the menu is refreshingly simple, focusing on what they do best. The pork ribs are definitely the signature dish, and while they were tasty, I found them not quite as tender as those from Nuri's. However, they still delivered on flavor and were enjoyable. The fried rice didn’t impress me as much, and I found it to be a bit lackluster compared to other offerings. On the brighter side, the grilled corn was delightful, though I wished it had been grilled a bit longer for an extra depth of flavor. Service at Wahaha is commendable—friendly and attentive, adding to the overall pleasant dining experience. Overall, Wahaha Pork Ribs Jimbaran is a nice spot to enjoy good food in a relaxed setting. While there are a few areas for improvement, it’s worth a visit for the ribs and welcoming atmosphere!

author: Ruby Graves
review_text: Had the fondest memories of this place, but it's been totally sold out since the previous owner passed on. Such a shame, stay away in 2025, it's a shell of its former self. :( Food is now mid and overpriced, bread is soggy from overpoured oil/vinegar. No mayo when it used to be homemade. Inside has been corporatized, so it's empty and lifeless. Slower than it ever was when it was busy. Somehow 4 people working behind the counter, but 3 cold sandwiches took 35 minutes.

author: Leah Borrino
review_text: Absolutely unacceptable treatment — I’ll never return I used to genuinely enjoy San Pedro Square. It used to be one of my favorite casual spots in the area. But after tonight, I’m honestly shocked by how poorly we were treated. My friends and I grabbed slices of pizza from a shop around the corner, then headed to San Pedro Square to buy beers and sit down. The moment we walked in, a security guard stopped us and said we couldn’t bring in outside food. We decided to try going to the other entrance around the block. After all, we intended to be paying customers. We weren't just going to bring in our food and not pay for something. Except…the same security guard FOLLOWED us. Around the block. To the other entrance. We walked inside anyway, and my husband and my friend’s boyfriend immediately got in line to purchase drinks there, but within 30 seconds, another guard approached us and told us we needed to leave. They were wearing earpieces and openly communicating about the “pizza box people” over the radios, like we were some kind of security threat instead of customers trying to buy drinks. We were escorted out of the marketplace. Escorted. For carrying pizza slices we fully intended to eat quietly while giving this place our money. The whole situation was bizarre, humiliating, and completely unnecessary. If San Pedro Square wants to run a cafeteria-style marketplace but act like a high-security event venue, that’s their prerogative — but they’ve lost my business for good. There are plenty of places nearby that don’t treat paying customers like criminals. I’ll gladly spend my money anywhere else from now on.

author: Z Rao
review_text: We don't usually leave reviews but hoping that prividing this feedback might be helpful for the restuarant and other diners. We had dinner on a week day here. First impressions were good, buzzy atmosphere, restaurant is well decorated. However, the service we recieved just did not match up to the restaurant's reputation. Food took over 45min to arrive (ok.. it's a busy evening so we can understand that). The food tasted good, but not something to rave about, especially at their price point. We were disappointed by the service for the evening: - Our server checked up on us once very very breifly immediately after the food arrived , before we even tasted anything, and then didn't check again after we'd actually started eating. We would have loved some mustard to go with the steak for example. But no one was around to check up on us. - We asked our server if we could pack the remaining cheesecake dessert to take away. Rather than the cheesecake being carefully into the container, the server came over with the box to our table, and literally flipped the plate with cheesecake on it into the box, so the cheesecake landed upside down. We watched with much surprise. We really wanted to like the experience more but struggled to in the end. We felt there was a general lack of attentiveness and care throughout our evening, which left us rather disappointed.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Luís Tiago
review_text: Very good, in a high pace Street. Kinda small but you can get the local vibe. The food was very tasty, and the spring rolls were of a decent size and full of flavour... All the staff attended our needs and were very helpful. Fast and funny

author: Vania C
review_text: finally got to experience rock bar as we got complimentary 10% off as in house guests from Ayana. the vibe was everything! and the drinks were delicious. we had Sunset Dragon & requested Long Island which was not in the menu book. worth the hype. definitely coming back again. notes for Rockbar (if u’re reading this): please add some fan or anything to make sure that we could enjoy the night better. last time we were there, the wind was absent and it was so humid & hot. thank you!

author: Leslie Lai
review_text: Came here for dinner with my family and we loved everything about this place! Ole was an attentive server and he described dishes in detail (including the Lao & Thai influence). We aappreciated the heads up in the spice level and also the condiment set that allowed you to adjust flavor and heat as desired. Ole said that the mango sticky rice was the best on the west coast and coming from California, I might just have to agree. Can’t wait to return!

author: Shantelle
review_text: Found a hair in the salad unfortunately. Gave it to a staff member - not sure if they misunderstood but the same container was brought back to me, still with the hair in it. Sent it back again and was given a replacement container. The banh mi itself was a big serving size with generous fillings. Good flavours but the pate was a bit overpowering for my liking.

author: David Owen
review_text: The best food and service received in Saigon. Loco moco and Bun tran(dry beef noodle with side broth) were amazing. Sad we visited on our last night. Highly recommended

author: Inna Fedorchuk
review_text: It's late at night and I NEED to go back here. Specifically the iced matcha was delicious. They had the perfect ratio. It was a sweetened matcha (3 scoops which was perfect!). The coffee was also so so good. The vibes amazing. Very clean. I want to come back and I'll be dreaming about till morning.

author: Charu Goyal
review_text: One of my favourite cafes to eat at in Bali. I have been to their Ubud location 4-5 times in the past few years. Every visit has been great and I have no complaints. Highly recommend trying their house fries, fresh juices, avocado toasts and pizzas.

author: Oscar Rayo
review_text: So this review is for this last visit this afternoon, I ordered a McRib sandwich no sauce, the pictures tell the story...BTW I understand that maybe that ran out of the sandwich bun..but what I got was ridiculous...lol

author: Liaw Ben Hsia
review_text: Second visit here, but sadly the desserts were below expectations. The Thai milk tea especially was a big disappointment – definitely not worth the price. Overall, not a satisfying experience.

author: Allie Marini
review_text: Tucked off the main strip, this is a little gem past the airport that's perfect for breakfast. Good portion sizes, lots of options, good standard American diner fare with a Latinx flair. Bespoke sauces, salsa, & seasonings available for purchase. We took home a bottle of the Verde hot sauce, it was super-fresh, balanced, & cilantro-forward. The restaurant's cartoon eggs on the menu & a full-scale model train running the top of the area are great touches of whimsy that kids (or your inner child) will be sure to enjoy. Bonus: You can choose a banana nut muffin or toast, & you really should get the muffin, it's ☆ heavenly ☆

author: Ramesh Vadiveloo
review_text: Just had lunch at Restoran Tauge Ayam Lou Wong, and it truly lived up to its reputation. We ordered the steamed chicken, bean sprouts, and gizzard—simple dishes, but done exceptionally well. The chicken was tender and juicy, the bean sprouts perfectly crunchy, and the gizzard surprisingly flavourful. What really tied everything together was their signature chilli dip and soya sauce—so addictive that it lifted every bite. A satisfying, classic Ipoh meal. Would definitely come back!

author: Rachel
review_text: Hup Hup Mee Siam (#02-14) is a must-try! The laksa and orh nee are both fantastic. The orh nee is so authentic (I steamed at home), and their laksa is even featured on Malaysia Airlines. Really delicious!

author: Michael Elias
review_text: Definitely the best spot for a Mexican family breakfast! Authentic comida that’s full of flavor—perfectly seasoned and prepared. The atmosphere is great, almost like when I was a Lil one. Customer service is truly beyond on point. I highly recommend Frannie as your serve, she was the best! It felt like we were part of her familia, and even though she had other tables, it was like we were the only ones there. I’m sure all her tables would agree. We’ll definitely always come back here. Thank you, Frannie!

author: Ana Maria Carrillo
review_text: Fiore had great food, service and vibes! Our server Cristina took great care of us and was very sweet and attentive. The food was soo good and the cocktails were original and savory. I got the crispy chicken tacos and my partner the chicken waffles and they were both delicious. Would definitely come back whenever I am back in Miami!!

author: gina theesfield
review_text: Delicious food and friendly service. Large portions. We ordered country fried steak, French Toast w candied pecans and fried chicken sandwich. Biscuit was a bit doughy and claggy. Cornflakes were a nice touch to the French toast. I ordered the season drink of apple horchata coffee. It was not a good flavor profile. I do not recommend that drink. Plenty of parking, but currently hard to get to with the amount of construction going on in the area. Kinda pricey. $100 for 3 including tip. Definitely a great stop during our brief visit to Vegas.

author: Vanesa Rodriguez
review_text: I just wanted to drop a quick line about my first visit to your place recently, a few things didn't quite hit the mark, and I thought you'd appreciate a heads-up! When I ordered a "Jamaica" with lots of ice , i received more like a really sweet iced tea, no ice. No biggie, mistakes happen, and the team was quick to try and fix it, which I totally appreciated! However, the corrected drink ended up tasting a bit artificial and, wow, it was super sweet – like, *really* sweet! I ended up just sticking with plain water after that, which was a bit of a bummer. Also, a little heads-up about the avocado that came with my meal – it looked like it had seen better days, if you know what I mean. Just a thought for quality control! And the sushi was whatever. I will also suggest being extra careful with packing the food,that would make a customer happy, because I had to get up three times and ask for napkins, forks, chops sticks, sriracha, etc.... It kind of broke up the flow of the meal , I was-annoyed by then. All in all, these little hiccups just added up, and honestly, it made my first visit less enjoyable than I'd hoped. As a result, I'm not really feeling like coming back . I'm just sharing this because I genuinely believe in giving constructive feedback, and I hope it helps you guys make things even better for future guests!

author: Melita Henderson
review_text: Nothing like real cooked food!! My husband and I enjoyed our meals and were full! And they are open 24 hrs!! Yaaaas Food was amazing!! Thanks again yall

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Thanh Nguyen
review_text: The place is peaceful and suitable for family. We could buy discounted buffet by buying online vouchers through fanpage. The staff are nice, friendly, and supportive. The food is varied and worth for money.

author: Bill Munger
review_text: Random Google find. Amazing food and great value. The waitress walked us through the menu and how the ALL YOU CAN EAT worked. Left stuffed and happy. FatKid friendly for sure.

author: Jon Tan
review_text: Feedback on the Chicken Biryani Served at the Orchis Staff Canteen I would like to raise a serious concern regarding the quality and food safety standards at the Indian food corner of the Orchid staff canteen. Recently, I ordered the chicken biryani from this stall, and the experience was extremely disappointing. More importantly, it posed a potential health risk. To begin with, the chicken served in the biryani was noticeably undercooked. This is not a minor issue, as consuming undercooked poultry can lead to severe foodborne illnesses caused by harmful bacteria such as salmonella. It is alarming that such a lapse in basic food preparation could occur, especially in an establishment that serves a large number of staff daily. Beyond the food safety concern, the overall quality of the dish was far below acceptable standards. The biryani lacked proper flavour, aroma, and texture—elements that are essential to this classic dish. Instead of an enjoyable meal, it left a negative impression that raises questions about the stall’s cooking practices and quality control. Given the potential health hazards and poor food quality, I strongly urge the canteen management to review the stall’s hygiene and food preparation processes. Regular checks, proper staff training, and strict adherence to cooking standards are necessary to prevent such incidents from happening again. Ensuring that all food vendors maintain high standards is crucial not only for the well-being of staff but also for upholding the reputation of the canteen. I hope that prompt action can be taken to address this issue and improve the overall dining experience for everyone who relies on the Orchid staff canteen.

author: FoodWanderer
review_text: I’ve never been to France but my assumption is that their croissants taste like a French croissant would. I got their popular chocolate croissant and it was amazing. Crispy and flaky in the outside and nice and buttery on the inside. The cocoa cloud was awesome too. Nice and chocolatey but not too sweet. The place lives up to his name.

author: L Luo
review_text: Decided to get some food from here despite stopping for many years due to a bad experience. Unfortunately they have used up all the goodwill. There was hardly any meat on my pig trotter and the kiam chye tasted like there wasn't any effort to cook it at all. All these plus a rice for 9.50. And I'm already browsing my phone for other food

author: Bill Lin
review_text: In my memory when I used to work in Indonesia, this BBQ Pork Rice tasted way better than this time I brought my family to. This time the pork was served cold and less flavored, lack of the "Balinese taste" it used to carry.

author: China Smith
review_text: The place is beautiful to look at. We had an awesome time. The food was okay for me. The atmosphere I loved. The music and staff were good. The music was great but not to loud that you couldn't talk over dinner. I would go again.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Shelley Skrine
review_text: This was the coolest place! They fully commit to the atmosphere, quality and service. The food was fresh and excellent. Yela was our waitress and she was very sweet and quick! The best part is that our hotel partners with them for discounts and margaritas. I highly recommend this place and if I ever come back to Hollywood Beach. We will revisit!

author: cool man18
review_text: Had a bad experience with the staff. I accidentally used EBT, and instead of handling it professionally, they made a weird face and complained about it. Completely uncalled for and made me feel judged. Do better.

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: Doraemon
review_text: Kitty and I were on the lookout for a lunch spot and turned to Google to find Lei Cha options, which led us to a highly-rated Lei Cha restaurant in the Geylang area. Our experience at this establishment was a mix of satisfaction and room for improvement. The Lei Cha dish, though flavorful, lacked the ideal temperature, not reaching the comforting warmth that would enhance its overall enjoyment. Additionally, the soup, while tasty, was a bit dilute, missing the robustness expected in traditional Lei Cha. The service at the restaurant was commendable, with attentive staff creating a pleasant dining atmosphere. The presence of free-flow peanuts for self-service was a nice touch, adding to the welcoming ambiance. Pricing was reasonable, with white Lei Cha rice at four dollars fifty cents and brown rice at five dollars, a justifiable value. During our meal, Kitty noted her preference for the Lei Cha served in the Punggol area. While the taste of the soup was similar at both places, she found that the soup at the reviewed establishment was slightly dilute in comparison. Nevertheless, she expressed a continual preference for the Lei Cha experience in one Punggol hawker centre. The stall owner recommended their 客家南乳炸肉 (Hakka Fried Pork), which Kitty found to be very nice. If you visit this place, consider ordering this dish to enhance your dining experience. Taking all aspects into account, including feedback on the dilute soup and rice temperature, we awarded the Geylang Lei Cha establishment a four-star rating. Our culinary journey highlighted areas of improvement for an even more enjoyable dining experience.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: sofia
review_text: AMAZING FOOD AND EXPERIENCE!! We got the combo spring rolls, soba noodles, pineapple fried rice, lions mane with ginger and Thai teas and it was all delicious 10/10 ! The highlight were definitely the combo rolls and the lions mane with ginger! Come here if you are vegetarian, you won’t regret it :)

author: Hong Aun
review_text: Classic local delicacies on the hidden gem. Their signature coffee is a must try ! Top up with half boiled egg, Nasi Lemak and Bangalli roti. Perfect combo !!

author: Ahmad Fauzi
review_text: We love the drinks option, and wide array options for the foods. The drinks were amazing- we almost ordered a second glass of caffeinated drink because they look tempting 😁 but we find the foods okay and reasonably affordable.

author: Ed Murphy
review_text: Great sandwiches! Love this location, super clean and very friendly staff!

author: Anthony Gage
review_text: I wish I had read some of the recent reviews, I waited in line for 30 minutes and got my burger and it was pure grease, the slushie I purchased was melted and the tots were cold. I could not eat the Hamburger it was not edible.

author: JoRdi HoBee Lo
review_text: Highly recommend to all, this is a prefect restaurant for group gathering especially family group. We are a group of 13people, but we did not have reservation, so that we need to wait about 10mins for a 5-person table and 7-person table separately. Please make earliest table reservation if you want to go there. Staff service here were excellent, speaking good english and always with smiles. Especially Ms “HA VI” , she provided professional service with passion, my family had a great time here and dishes are definitely delicious! Thank you for your recommendation! Bravo 👏🏻

author: Tazio Lai
review_text: Finally made it before last order for Friday lunch & well worth the previous attempts to come! Ordered the Wagyu beef fried rice bowl + the beef skewers and they were as delicious as advertised! Decoration/ambience is a bit on the eclectic side BUT was there during the day so imagine that in the evenings it comes more to life. Restaurant is spotless, service was with a smile and very prompt, and food came out piping hot in short time. Will definitely be back again to satisfy beef bowl cravings!

author: Ngoc Tram
review_text: My family and I ordered the Com Nieu combo for 10 people. The food is delicious and of good quality but the price is very cheap. The Kho Quet is very delicious, everyone. Being in the center of District 1 like this is great. Convenient parking on Nguyen Cu Trinh street, the restaurant has 2 street fronts.

author: Vani Patro
review_text: Ayu Mas, from the moment we stepped into La Brisa was an absolute sweetheart. Her service is impeccable. She’s amazing in every way, she took care of our family in the best way possible and explained everything calmly and with so much respect. We had such a lovely time watching the amazing sunset! An evening well spent all thanks to Ayu Mas’s hospitality ❤️❤️

author: Hayqarl
review_text: La Brisa Bali Beach Club Review 🌊 La Brisa Bali is a great spot for those who prefer a chill and aesthetic atmosphere. The overall vibe is beautiful and relaxing, making it perfect for unwinding by the beach. The food was decent not extraordinary, but it’s clear that most people come here more for the ambience than the taste. The minimum spending for the pool table area is 2.9 million rupiah, which is quite reasonable considering the setting and experience. We only stayed for about two hours since it closes at 11 p.m., but it was still an amazing experience overall. Th view, music, and aesthetic setup truly make it worth a visit. 🌅✨

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: XinTong Pang
review_text: The food was awesome we finished it all. Mari was very helpful with her service as well. She demonstrated to us how to wrap a spring roll, and checking up with us frequently. This is a great place to experience vietnamese culture and food together as we can do the spring rolls by ourselves. People that do not want to can also order normal spring rolls. The restaurant is very inclusive, having a great variety of vegan and vegetarian vietnamese food options available.

author: Scott Ferreira
review_text: This was a great little spot we stopped in at while driving through. I went with a vanilla latte and coffee cake. The latte could have used slightly more vanilla. Overall still a great way to start the day. I really enjoyed the coffee cake as it wasn't overly sugary as they sometimes can be. Also, the cute little cups they use for the lattes were great. They held the heat well! I usually try to do a coffee shop internet test but didn't do that here. I'll have to try on another trip. Should you stop in, I think you'll find the place warm and welcoming. Enjoy! PS - They have a little gift shop in the very back! Don’t forget to check it out.

author: Peck Kim Loh
review_text: Absolutely fantastic experience! From the moment we walked in, everything was top-notch — the ambiance was warm and welcoming, the staff were incredibly attentive and friendly, and the food… absolutely unforgettable. Every dish was beautifully presented and bursting with flavor. You can really tell that high-quality ingredients and care went into everything.
