Whether you're going for a casual night out or celebrating something special, this place hits the mark. I’ll definitely be coming back. Highly recommend!

author: Teck Boon
review_text: Food standard at this location is always consistent. Service is prompt and efficient and tables are cleaned quickly to ensure that people will always be able to find a table soon. Slightly more expensive than other nasi lemak store but quality is good and that’s why there’s always a queue for food. It also means things are always fresh and hot.

author: Jason
review_text: A pleasant place to have an ol' school breakfast. Their teas and kopi's are all super gao! Buns and egg toasts were good. Nasi Lemak is the typical Chinese style; sweet, non-spicy sambal. Their kaya is on the sweeter side and on sale too (I ended up getting one at RM6). Parking is limited since this cafe is right in the vicinity of low-cost flats.

author: Meka Simms
review_text: I don’t know how this place has 4.8 stars Tacos were horrible. The lettuce were wilted and soggy. They got my order wrong. I order the super taco and got regular tacos. I gave one star only because the potatoes were good.

author: Chong khai tjie
review_text: Forget about the Michelin Guide. This was one of the juiciest and most flavourful pork chops I've had ANYWHERE. The reviewers leaving anything less than 5 stars don't know what they are talking about. I got the mixed platter and it was incredible. Every single ingredient was done perfectly and was an explosion of flavours in my mouth. I just wished I had more stomach space to eat an extra portion of everything. The pork chop was infused with a delicious smoky aroma, while being sweet and juicy at the same time. The pork skin, pork sausage, pickled vegetables, fried egg, and egg loaf (they call it "roll") were all masterpieces in their own right. Combined together with the soft broken rice into a huge and hearty plate, it was well worth every single cent. Please find time to visit this place if you're in HCM! It seems to be a family run business and they know what they are doing. They do grabfood as well if you can't find the time to go down in person.

author: Lai Meng
review_text: Super soft red bean bun. The vegetables ccf was soft and silky. Nice chicken and prawn horfun, too. Coffee was good. Staff were pleasant. However, the restoran makes no effort to inform or through means of a notice to notify patrons on days it is closed. The lack of regard for patrons reflects poorly of the restoran. Unreliable.

author: Angel Saavedra
review_text: The fries were dark brown as if they never change the oil, the onions rings were flavorless and the breading on it fell apart from the onion rings and the breading tasted like if they also use it on shrimp, the buns on the burgers were burnt and a huge piece of tomato took up most of the burger, not a good food experience.

author: Kevin Montoya
review_text: Great food, not a sit-down and est spot at all, but always ask for extra pickled onions

author: Joshua González
review_text: Wow, this place was incredible! I was just passing through and heard great things about it from a friend. The service was top-notch! We had two people with allergies, and the server was an absolute lifesaver. She knew exactly what ingredients were safe for us and made some amazing recommendations. The food, drinks, and ambiance were all 10/10!! Thanks for a fantastic night, Will definitely be back next time I’m in town!

author: Double R Detailing NYC
review_text: I’m never disappointed!! Great food and even better service. I just wish I had more space for the food it’s so good !

author: Ernest M
review_text: Food: I had their version of avocado toast. Took a couple mins to receive. For someone who hasn't been to a coffee shop in a while and was hungry. It was delish! I also had their iced vanilla latte with oak milk. Made to perfection. Service: I love the nice touch delivering the food when its super slow. Very very nice touch. Ambiance: the space is very clean and loving the wood tones inside the coffee shop. I came in a random Tuesday afternoon. This is really close next to my house, so when I am in the mood for coffee and vibes, this is the spot.

author: Sam Root
review_text: Consistently good grilled chicken. This location looks well maintained and opens til midnight.

author: Fathima Azzahra
review_text: Beautiful place to dine in, i prefer during the day but having dinner here would also be nice. Great for couples or big groups, I came here with a group of 11 people. The food is amazing, everything was well made. Some are more uniqus and special than others, like the seafood cakwe, jumbo prawn golden egg yolk, and dendeng balado!

author: Christopher Wu
review_text: Men Lari Babi Guling was my first ever babi guling experience and honestly, it was a solid intro to what to expect. It’s definitely a bit of a tourist-friendly spot, so I felt safe in terms of prep and hygiene, but the food still felt authentic and eye-opening. Coming from an Asian background, a lot of the flavours were familiar — I’m sure I’ve eaten similar things before without knowing exactly what they were — but here, it was clear it was all pork, just done in different styles. The pork skin wasn’t super crispy, more on the chewy side, but I didn’t mind it at all. Chewing through that and then sipping the hot broth after made me feel like I was doing it properly, local-style. The staff were super friendly and helped me order, and I went with the smaller portion since I wasn’t too hungry — even though it looks heavy, it actually sat really well. A great first taste of babi guling.

author: Ericka Lorenzo
review_text: I’ll start by saying the food is good, especially the pork knuckles, which were a standout. However, the service and organisation definitely need improvement. My brother made a booking for 25 people, with pre-ordered and fully paid meals. When we arrived, we were told they couldn’t find our booking and that it was under someone else’s name, which was quite frustrating. After about 10 minutes of back and forth, they eventually realised the mistake but unfortunately, that wasn’t the end of it. The venue is quite small for large groups (just a heads-up), and despite specifically requesting a long table, we were initially given two separate tables upstairs. This defeats the purpose of booking in advance so arrangements can be made properly. Eventually, they set up a table outside on the balcony, which actually worked out well. Once settled, the food was tasty, the service improved, and the staff were pleasant enough. One important safety note: there is only one unisex toilet, located downstairs. This can be challenging, especially for senior citizens or anyone with mobility issues, as the stairs may pose a risk. Overall, good food, but better organisation and planning for large groups would greatly improve the experience.

author: Bu Rashid Harun
review_text: Loved this place! We stopped for a coffee, smoothie, and muffin and were instantly impressed. The coffee is top-tier, the smoothie was refreshing, and the muffin was deliciously fresh. The atmosphere is what really sells it a beautiful, plant filled space that's both stylish and relaxing. Seeing other plates come out, it's clear we need to come back for a proper breakfast next time.

author: Ni Luh Putri Honey Dewi
review_text: I visit this place almost every week after my beach walk. Their coffee and food are awesome. The service is also great, especially Kak Gung Mas, who took care of me during my visit today and provided excellent service.

author: Andrew C
review_text: The order arrived very fast within 5-10 minutes. Vege, squid done not overcooked but the fish is a disappointment. Fish too oily and seems to be pre-prepared earlier, refried few times. Price reasonable. Fish dish at Jia-lek is much better but need to wait if the place is crowded. Still like Jae-lek better even bit more expensive.

author: Joshua Wong
review_text: Nested in a local coffee shop, this stall sells minced pork noodle at an affordable price. Be prepared for queues at peak hours especially during the lunch crowds. While the taste may not be comparable to a popular Michelin Bib Gourmand stall that sells similar food, this stall has its own unique taste that keeps me coming back for more. If you are not a fan of lard, you can request for it to be excluded, else the crispy lard brings the flavour to another level. The dumpling that comes with it is big, but the skin is a little thick to my preference.

author: Keith Alllmeroth
review_text: It's a chain. It's better than typical fast food, but not a standout. The onions on the pork were boiled and bland. The rice was dry and not very tasty. The beans were delicious, and pork was good but small portion. Again, it's ok for a chain, but there are much better places in town.

author: Teoh Sin Yee
review_text: Quite nice: -Cantonese style loh mee (beside fried rice stall) -Siew Mai (Surprisingly fresh) Can eat but no wow factor: - Cheese Prawn rice set (beside chicken chop stall) - Taiwanese chicken chop rice - Rice set with soup (beside wantan mee) - Nasi kandar - Pan Mee Just small list that I've tried.

author: Stephen Carvalho
review_text: We got there at Happy hour and got the Fremont salad and Steak and frites. The salad was one of the best I had. So refreshing and savory. The steak was cooked perfect. The bartender mixed up some great drinks. This was our first time here and it won't be our last!

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: James Eakins
review_text: I have come here for breakfast nearly every day of my trip and I love their three types of soup. The ladies are nice and lots of fans pointing at us to stay cool.

author: Dr. Sergio Nieves
review_text: My wife and I had an amazing brunch at Citrus and Salt thanks to Manuela our fantastic and attentive server. Jenn, the manager, was a very hospitable host. We felt very welcomed.

author: Zen Yong
review_text: Visited Ipoh Tuck Kee Restaurant during dinner time, and it was easy to understand why this place is always packed with customers. Despite arriving around 5:45pm, the restaurant was already full, and a queue had formed outside. Luckily, the waiting time wasn’t too long as the staff manage the crowd efficiently. The staff here are friendly, attentive, and extremely fast. They move with purpose, clearing tables quickly, taking orders proactively, and ensuring customers are seated as soon as possible. Even with the high customer volume, they remain polite and alert, which makes the whole experience smooth and pleasant. The environment is typical of a popular local eatery — crowded, lively, and full of energy. Even though it gets busy, it remains comfortable and organized. Tables are fairly close to each other, but the quick turnover ensures that the place doesn’t feel stuffy. In terms of price, it’s reasonable for the portion sizes and the quality of food served. The food portion matches the pricing well, with ingredients that feel fresh and dishes that are cooked with consistency. Now, onto the highlight — the braised chicken leg. This dish is truly outstanding and highly recommended. The chicken leg is tender, juicy, and packed with flavour. The braising sauce is rich and savory, absorbing beautifully into the meat. It’s one of those dishes that instantly stands out and becomes a must-order for future visits. The other dishes we tried were also good, maintaining the flavorful and satisfying taste that Tuck Kee is known for. Overall, Ipoh Tuck Kee Restaurant lives up to its reputation as one of Ipoh’s top spots for delicious local dishes. The long queue might seem intimidating, but with the fast service and efficient turnover, the wait is very manageable. If you’re visiting Ipoh and looking for a dinner place that balances taste, value, and local charm, Tuck Kee is definitely worth a stop.

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: Mike Tse
review_text: This place is legit. People who say it’s “too sweet” doesn’t understand seafood umami. This so called “sweetness” is the natural flavor of shrimp heads and pork bones. This is natural sweetness not sugar! Sorry but there is a difference. This is really good. I recommend getting it spicy and getting it with thick noodles. The supreme with larger prawns is really good.

author: Chui Mun
review_text: When you’re in Geylang, trying frog porridge is a must — it seems to be the most recommended dish in the area. I arrived around 7pm expecting a queue, but luckily there were still a few seats available. I had never tried frog porridge before and couldn’t quite imagine how it would taste, but it completely exceeded my expectations! The frog meat was incredibly tender and bouncy while the porridge was so smooth and soft. you could almost eat it without using teeth, haha! We also ordered cockles and grilled fish, which were both fresh and full of flavor. The dishes came out quite fast too, so there was no long wait. Overall the experience was satisfying from start to finish. 👍🏻

author: Tracy Betts
review_text: Fritters are my go-to order whenever I have brunch, and these were the best fritters I’ve ever had. Mind blown! Yumang, our server, was lovely. The aesthetic of the place is beautiful and it’s spacious. The price for breakfast which includes a juice and coffee, was great value!! I highly recommend coming here 💜💜💜

author: David Kho
review_text: Quick to serve. Good to give it a try but it did not fit my family's taste buds.

author: Jacob TAN
review_text: Came here this morning to try the crab omelette rice. Place my order and waited for the buzzer to vibrate. A nice plate of omelette with crab on top of steam rice. The omelette and crab meat were excellent especially with the green chilli. Next time will try the fried rice. Service is very good.

author: Wasita Jirakajohnchai
review_text: ▪️ Taste so the food quite simple and salty ▪️ The price too high if compared with the ordinary market price. ▪️ The shop so narrow and feel uncomfortable to sit. Ps. Suggest to get the sit without get the line come early around 3:30-4:00 pm

author: Ivey
review_text: Stopped for lunch and really enjoyed it. The double smash burger was well cooked and tasty, the apple crumble was unique and comforting, and the pineapple juice was very fresh. Nice atmosphere and friendly service. A good spot to chill in Ubud.

author: Vee
review_text: Stopped in for the first time the other day and was pleasantly surprised! The space is very clean, bright, and open. We ordered a hot The Palma latte (coconut) and an iced toffee latte, both half-sweet. Both drinks were delicious—I never thought I’d enjoy a coconut latte, but this one was so good. There was only one barista working, and she seemed a bit overwhelmed with orders, so the drinks did take a while. I didn’t mind waiting, but just something to note. The shop has a lot of open space—almost too much. With the limited seating, it would be great to see more tables and definitely more charging outlets for people looking to work or hang out. Only Christmas music was playing during my visit, which personally isn’t my vibe, but that’s subjective. On the plus side, the bathrooms were very clean! I’d definitely come back for the coffee itself (it was genuinely great), but probably just for a to-go order rather than sitting down.

author: Min Wen Mo
review_text: Skillful fried vegetable, very delicious 👍🏻👍🏻 but the taste of gaeong som might not suit me, more to sour side and very spicy. Fried Shrimp cake is worth for a try.

author: Victor Boyle
review_text: Ordered the McCrispy.Chicken was dry, hard and tough to eat. Obviously it's been sitting for a long time under a heat lamp. Guess I could have picked a better location. Crazy warning signs everywhere 🤣 (see PHOTOS) and the staff working behind bullet proof GLASS.

author: Richard Harrison
review_text: I stopped in town while visiting a friend and searched for nearby restaurants when Cornbread popped up. I’ll admit—I’m very particular about my soul food. But let me tell you, this place more than held up to my standards. Every dish was packed with flavor and you could tell it was made with love. The highlight wasn’t just the food, though. The customer service from Janelle and Mike made me feel like I was right at home. They were welcoming, attentive, and truly made the experience memorable. And listen—do not sleep on that baked chicken. It is nothing to be played with! Cornbread fed my soul in every way, and I’ll definitely be back whenever I’m in town again.

author: Chris Ang
review_text: One of the best place for claypot froglegs cravings. Excellent service even when the crowds keeps coming. Service staffs were prompt and fast in any requests. Well done!

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: Ibtihal Alrasheed
review_text: The food was good overall. I ordered several different dishes and they were all tasty. The photos are available in the post. The only thing I didn’t like was the service, which could be improved.

author: Tom Quelch
review_text: Crate serves up massive portions, every dish is packed with flavour and made with fresh, high-quality ingredients. The atmosphere is lively and full of energy. Easily the best brunch spot I found on the island. No doubt about it. Perfect for starting your day right.

author: Hans Griese
review_text: Really great breakfast spot, easy to get to. Staff (Noah and Derrick) were awesome, really attentive. Vibes were cool but chill, nice easy start to a morning. Food was very tasty. I had: Chicken & Waffles Benedict: 8/10. Was really just chicken and waffles, but it was very tasty. Add syrup! Golden State Benedict: 10/10. delicious, hollandaise was well made, good balance of elements. Biscuit and Gravy (side): 7/10. Solid, nothing special. Presentation was meh, but I did like being able to add butter under the gravy. Bloody Mary Flight: 6/10. Solid options. Gin was meh, adding tobasco helped. Tequila was better, but wanted more spice. The two vodkas were both solid, but nothing crazy. The salt rim was really good lol.

author: yasmeen sayad
review_text: Loveddd this place definitely a must visit when in Seminyak The atmosphere is super relaxed and chilled with both indoor and outdoor seating in a spacious setup. We came here for breakfast and tried The Bakers Scrambled Egg Croissant Sausage Shakshuka Hot Hazelnut Latte Cappuccinos Chicken & Shrimp Spring Rolls Choco Almond Caramel Pistachio Madeleine Original Oxtail soup Mixed rice (Nasi kampung) Everything was amazing but the star for me was definitely the Bakers Egg Croissant perfectly done and so delicious. Their coffee and lattes were also top notch smooth and full of flavor. Everything felt fresh, and the croissants were easily some of the best Ive had. Big kudos to the staff very humble, welcoming and the service was fast. It’s the kind of place you can sit for hours enjoying the vibe and food. Will be coming back to try more dishes and spend more time here

author: L Chan
review_text: This hawker centre has been around since the 1970s. Set beside the Alexandra Canal, it’s one of the few places to enjoy a meal with a waterfront breeze & city lights. Despite renovations over the years, it has kept its bustling, open-air charm, remaining both a community dining hall & a slice of hawker heritage by the riverside

author: Zoe chin loy
review_text: Unforgettable Dining Experience! From the moment we walked in, the ambience set the tone for an incredible night—elegant, inviting, and effortlessly cool. The food? Absolutely next level. We don’t even eat raw fish, and yet we found ourselves savoring every last bite of each dish. The duck wraps were a standout—easily some of the best in Miami. What truly made the experience exceptional was the service. The manager, Daniel, personally checked in to ensure everything was perfect, and our server, Nick, was the real star of the night. Knowledgeable, friendly, and genuinely passionate about the menu, he made sure we had an unforgettable experience. If you’re looking for fresh, flavorful food and top-tier hospitality, this spot is a must-visit. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Don Williams
review_text: I had enough points to get a free pizza so I just ordered it on line. When i got to the store the lady behind the counter told me it's a cheese pizza only. I told her I wanted pepperoni on it like all my other orders. She rudely throws the pizza back at and told me that's my order and I had to take it. it was 2 other Black ladies there and they thought this was an easy fix. She did not want to deescalate the situation so in kind I esculated the situation to match her energy. if you don't speak Spanish you can forget about resolving the smallest of issues. Then her so called boss called me back on my phone to let me know she is Hispanic and also hate Black people by defending her employee and threatening me. This is what they do, they treat you like crap and when you respond they want to get on your case. We as Black people are past this phase, you don't get to treat us any kind of way and not get responed in kind.

author: Jurassic world
review_text: This place is a hard NO for me, and it’s all because of how horribly we were treated after our meal. Paying upfront at a buffet is totally normal, and we did so without any issue. The meal itself was nothing to write home about average at best. But what absolutely ruined the experience was the behavior of our server, Jenny. As we were leaving, Jenny confronted us and flat-out demanded a tip aggressively and in a tone that was completely out of line. This was after we had already paid and were getting ready to walk out. She literally dragged us to the front and wouldn’t let the issue go, making a scene as if we owed her something beyond what we had already paid. Tipping is a choice not something that should be shaken down from customers under pressure. To make things worse, Jenny took the customer copy of our receipt, and forced us to sign for a tip. That receipt is supposed to be ours to keep for verification, tracking expenses, or just basic transparency. Without it, we have no idea what the exact final charge was or if anything extra was added. It felt sneaky, dishonest, and completely unprofessional. There’s no excuse for this kind of behavior. It’s one thing to ask politely if we’d like to leave a tip. It’s another thing entirely to harass customers at the door and confiscate receipts like we’re being scammed. We left feeling uncomfortable, disrespected, and frankly disgusted. Avoid this place unless you enjoy being bullied for more money after you’ve already paid. Jenny’s behavior was outrageous, and if this is how they train their staff, then management is just as bad. Spend your money somewhere that values basic customer respect and knows how to operate a restaurant without resorting to intimidation tactics.

author: Evan Tan
review_text: This place looks real fancy from the outside, but it's much more affordable than most might think. Most of the food options are around 40-50k and though it could add up to a lot, most meals would cost about 100-150k per person (if you don't order whole fish dishes), which is an amazing deal considering how "snazzy" the place looks. The food options overall were pretty good, and their dessert options actually impressed me. I have no complaints simply because you truly are getting a bargain here and getting more than you would expect for the price that you're paying for it. I would recommend and would most likely come back.

author: He Lyu
review_text: One of the best local restaurant have ever been i think their carry cabbage and also their chicken is so good and chicken is very tender and juicy and they really love the source to it

author: KATHERINE HANDY
review_text: I tried park 54 for the first time during dine out week, we were a group of 4. The food was great I had the fried snapper, I was surprised it was flour fried I'm use to skin fried snapper but it was still delicious. I will say the peach cobbler came out cold, the manger did apologize about that. The lemonade and cornbread are absolutely delicious. The hostess did come over and tell us she needs our table about 10 minutes after we paid despite the 5 tables around us being completely empty and upstairs was empty as well we were there around 430 pm on a Thursday.

author: Fay M
review_text: Nice brunch place downtown. I recommend getting on the wait-list through Yelp and then head over. There can be a wait. Large portions and lots to choose from. I got the veggie skillet. It was great and all fresh ingredients. There were 5 of us and everyone enjoyed their dishes. I would come again.

author: Trung Nguyen
review_text: This isn’t a large place. It’s well decorated, very hip. The walls are made of brick so voices bounced quite a bit. Fortunately the patrons keeps the voice down, but unfortunately some the waiter would yell across the room breaking the silence. The food average. Nothing stands out. Though the portion is generous amount of meat in comparison to others. It appears to have 4 person in the front (waiters), I don’t know how many in the back. They are so so slow. My rice plate took forever and it wasn’t just off the grill, so don’t know why it took this long. Amazingly my Pepsi took longer than my rice plate. And the finally, my goi cuon came out last.

author: Dana “Pineapple Drop” Miles
review_text: Good service, food tasted good, I purchased their chicken burrito for $10+. The only problem to me is that their burritos can be bigger for that price, it tasted good

author: serin_rxses
review_text: Good food! I like the mango habanero sweet and addictive but spicy.

author: YippieYaYa
review_text: Visited Lou Wong during my trip to Ipoh and tried their famous bean sprout chicken. The steamed chicken was tender and paired well with the crunchy bean sprouts and smooth hor fun. Service was fast despite the crowd, and the atmosphere felt lively and traditional. However, it was quite hot and crowded inside, and the food, while good, felt a bit overrated compared to other local spots. Still, it's worth a visit if you want to experience one of Ipoh’s iconic eateries.

author: KE XIN CHUA
review_text: The mama noodles are on the sweeter side, and the food overall is fairly average. The taste really depends on personal preference, and nothing particularly gave me a “wow” feeling. Remember to download the QueQ app to get a queue number for your table.

author: Ramdas Prabhu
review_text: This Michelin star restaurant deserves their rating as the Pho is very delicious and one of the best I've had in Vietnam. Their juice items were also tasty. We tried the Beef shank and Beef rib pho..the Shank was very soft and juicy while the Ribmeat was a bit chewy. Must try the Mulberry juice and orange carrot juice. Shop is very clean and service quick and efficient.

author: Jackie Lau
review_text: the food tastes good and the atmosphere is great - the live music is very entertaining and full of talent!

author: Eli Hernandez
review_text: My family and I love coming here! I usually always get the same thing, the mole enchiladas. They’re delicious! Also their agua Fresca tamarindo flavor is so good!

author: Diana Anghelus
review_text: This place definitely deserves 5 stars! It is the perfect restaurant if you are looking for a fine dining experience. From the moment you get to the gate till the end , they make you feel special. They have a tablet where they show you how each dish looks which is very helpful. Just be mindful that the portions are pretty small. We ordered the Almost Bbq Ribs and the Bbq Octopus and they were very small. So if you are very hungry, keep this in mind. We only wanted to check it out and didn't come starving, otherwise we would have ended up ordering more. FYI, the ribs come in two small pieces. They also offered us some complementary dish that looks like small marshmallow with the texture of a cotton candy - Cotton Betutu. Definitely give it a try.

author: joseph allocca
review_text: Went to dinner on Friday 01/02/2026 at the Hingham Shipyard location. Three of us got burgers which were very good however my sister got a chicken sandwich and the center of it was still pink. Under cooked chicken can make you very sick. They did take it off the bill but that is not acceptable for any restaurant.

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: Rai Syazwani
review_text: Big and clean market selling not only fresh produce but also clothes etc. The food court offers variety of halal food with cheap prices. There are two food courts one at the ground level, another upstairs. The appom and mee siam we had (upstairs) were so delicious. Must come in the morning, a lot of stalls upstairs start closing early afternoon. The ground level food court opens till evening.

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Nguyệt Dạ
review_text: Good food and drink, friendly staffs, thanks Mr. Luat for assisting me.

author: P M
review_text: Several dishes on the menu were not available. We ordered a vegetable dish and they brought it to another table. When we asked to bring it to us they were out of it. Left kind of hungry. Not the best experience.

author: Gerardo Cruz
review_text: Got alcapurrias for takeout. They didn't have enough so I got some fresh ones! Good size and value for about $3

author: LW
review_text: This location has always been our go to after concerts and LAX. It's right off the freeway and out of the chaos. We were welcomed and seated quickly. It was really warm. Only one waiter, he gave us our drinks. Our iced tea tasted old. Once we got out food he never checked on us. Our food was great. No complaints. A waitress arrived but our waiter was still to busy to check on us. We had to ask for our check and he said he'd get it but did not. Watched someone else ask for theirs and he brought it over. We just got up and walked to the register. He was ready for us by then.

author: wan r
review_text: Had an amazing dinner date with my mum here! The service, from the moment I made the reservation, entering the restaurant and until we left, was impeccable. The staff were very attentive and friendly, and they even had great camera skills. Plus, the food tasted delicious.

author: Chan MeowMeow
review_text: We came early, so we got a table for walk in at 5.30pm. Excellent atmosphere with wonderful Indonesian food. We tried the tofu starter which was amazing (not spicy). The curry dish for me was a bit spicy, but nice with the bread that it came with. Will certainly visit again.

author: Samuel Wale-Oladimeji
review_text: Considerable prices, food is 100% Nigerian delicacy. An Afican Restaurant to visit in Newark Nj area. Njoi ur meal

author: BREW
review_text: What an awesome place! It is a chain but this was our first visit. Well worth the trip! Great food and service! Emily, Kenna and the team are attentive and fun. We had a great experience all around. We will absolutely visit again. Walking distance from every hotel on Fremont street.

author: Michael Anderson
review_text: Staff were very rude and I felt like I was a burden just ordering food. The wrap we ordered had some hard and chewable parts in it. The spicy chicken sandwich was put together very sloppy, I had to fix it to be able to eat it.

author: Yoke Lan Sun
review_text: All these good food for just SGD33! Gem of a find in this day and age!

author: Akhila Illa
review_text: We had to wait for 40 minutes to get our table. We tried 3 color curry, garlic fried rice and the mango sticky rice. None of them were good. There was no flavor at all. Mango sticky rice was the worst. I never imagined mango sticky rice can ever be bad, but it was a disaster here. Service is very slow, prolly because the restaurant is very busy. Overall, a let down :(

author: Rah
review_text: Super pricey dessert but worth a try since it’s viral. Kakigori is a mango sticky rice in bingsu style Milk bun portion is hugeeee there’s 6 pieces inside but they packed it in takeaway boxes :) Service is good too

author: samlivestoeat
review_text: Comforting and satisfying meal! We can choose from a wide variety of fresh ingredients to complement the flavourful lala soup! My personal favourites are tiger prawn, shabu shabu beef, scallop, fish slice, chicken slice, burst ball and shiitake. 📣Check out my IG/Lemon8/Tiktok @samlivestoeat for more detailed foodie reviews! 🥰

author: Serg Jara
review_text: I knew they were going to be out of the chocolate cake! Order was correct despite our confusing order. So they get gold stars, I guess.

author: Latisha B
review_text: My first time using the R Burger app AND eating at R Burger’s was very different! After using the app to order my food, I went into the Nellis location and was advised my food was ordered for the California location when I’m actually in Las Vegas. Idk how that happened but the manager, Andres came over while I was on the app talking to a customer support agent via chat and asked what happened and explained the app is fairly new and asked to check out the chat to see how it worked. After he checked out the app, he offered to make my order and to simply advise CS he had done so since it was very clear that there wasn’t really a resolution to my situation as CS stated I could hire a third party to pick up my food from California and have them bring it to Nevada. Andres was very helpful and friendly!!! His actions alone has made me an R Burger customer for life!!! FYI, My burger and fries were so delicious!!!!! 🤤😋

author: Edgar Pineda
review_text: Very good cheese burger & fries. I really enjoyed it. Pepsi refill will cost you 75 cents. Funny.

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: Shawn Tan
review_text: Standards have dropped. Braised dishes are ok. But the soup is not as flavourful, and has an unpleasant ‘pig’ taste. Would prefer to go to the other outlets.

author: Gourmet Rara
review_text: Sun Sun Warung in Ubud is the perfect spot to enjoy authentic Balinese food at great prices. The flavors are fresh, the portions are generous, and the atmosphere is warm and welcoming. The staff are so kind and make you feel at home, which really adds to the experience. If you’re looking for local Balinese cuisine in Ubud or just a cozy place to eat while exploring Bali, this warung is a must-visit. Highly recommended for anyone wanting a true taste of Ubud!

author: Simon C
review_text: Great restaurant. You go to the main places on one side and then get a number and seat. With this number you cross the street and choose the food you want to eat. Mainly you find a variety of great tasting dim sum. The prices are super fair. With about 12-14 plates, beer and water we ended up with about 550 BHT. Would definitely come again!

author: Hieu Chi
review_text: The restaurant was cool and comfortable. It was very crowded when we arrived, but the staff served us very quickly. The food was served a little slowly, probably because it was busy that day, but the food was delicious and high-quality, so I'll give it 5 stars as a token of appreciation for the staff and chefs!

author: Khai Shuen
review_text: Food here was sooo good the sambal taste really nice. A little bit expensive but the portion was big. Drinks and coffee was so aromatic

author: Mishu T
review_text: Experience fresh, juicy burgers bursting with generous fillings! We highly recommend ordering a set menu—it's perfect for sharing between two people. Plus, the servers are incredibly friendly and welcoming!

author: Celio Centeno
review_text: The food was good. And the service too. They serve a lot, so have this in mind when you order.

author: Ryan
review_text: Simply the best nasi lemak I’ve ever had. I genuinely struggled to pick the best item on the plate because everything was close to perfection. The fried chicken was juicy and seasoned beautifully. The coconut rice was fluffy, with distinct grains and the perfect fragrance; neither too heavy nor too light. And the sambal, often overly sweet in many KL spots, hit the perfect balance of sweetness and spiciness. Absolutely worth the hype (and the queue… though thankfully there wasn’t one on a Monday at 1:30pm!). A definite must-try when you’re in KL. Solid 9/10.

author: Brittni Dillon
review_text: The food was delicious and the waitress was very friendly and very professional.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: O Ting (Stardust)
review_text: Not actually bad the Bakuteh. The pork ribs are very tasty. And the tea also strong and nice. Staffs were quite attentive. But found dish-wash scouring pad after I finished my meal.🙃🙈

author: Thanaschaphan Suphantakit
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ SMOKIN’ BEAST is our absolute favorite! The sauce blends perfectly with the juicy beef patty — such a great combo of flavor. Definitely recommend giving it a try!

author: Yw T
review_text: Waiting time is on average 30min, food is ok normally but i got the salted egg fish today and it was void of any salted egg sauce and fish is overfried

author: Happitel Apartment
review_text: Som Som, a well-known Thai restaurant situated in the city center, carries the Chinese name "Song Song Restaurant." The venue features a vibrant orange color scheme, matching it's Thai name. The restaurant is specializing in a range of classic Thai dishes, stands out particularly for its crab and shrimp dishes. The place tends to be quite busy, attracting mostly international tourists who come seeking an authentic experience. While the portion sizes are somewhat modest, possibly aligned with local Thai standard. The price is on the higher side. The dining environment is fairly standard, with limited space and closely arranged tables, creating a cozy but slightly cramped atmosphere. In terms of flavor, the food delivers a solid and authentic Thai taste. As a foreigner, I can’t claim definitive expertise, but based on my experiences with various Thai restaurants, the quality here is quite commendable. Service, however, is average; while there appears to be an effort in staff training, some of the foreign employees seem not attractive enough perhaps due to cultural or communication gaps. The drink menu is fairly standard as well, without any particularly standout options. At this price point,one might find more genuinely traditional Thai meals elsewhere in Bangkok. That said, considering its central location and the convenience of paid parking available nearby at the stadium one, Som Som remains a decent choice. A special mention goes to the glass noodle shrimp pot, a delightful dish with excellent flavor and appealing presentation. Keep up the good work!

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: blossom
review_text: food is quite nice and we enjoy the chicken fried rice. the portions were good and everything was served fresh. however, the mushroom aroma was a little stronger than what I’m used to, but that’s just personal taste. Snow was very attentive and friendly throughout our meal, making sure everything was okay. Great service overall!

author: Mai Huong
review_text: The food was great, so delicious even they're vegan, Vietnamese cuisine. Drink was good as well but run out of some interesting coffee. Small place but cozy and located in the alley of center of Saigon. Seem they have live music at the weekend. Reasonable price, quick service, but we can't pay by credit card since their machine wasn't working. Pet friendly restaurant, as my friend brought her poodle there few times. Clean restroom.

author: Carmen Toure
review_text: Good breakfast. The veggie skillet was great. I usually eat lots of ketchup but it tasted great without ketchup… the veggies were kinda sauter which gave good an elevated flavor. My partner has the French toast which was really good as well

author: SCOTT CONTRERAS
review_text: It's gotta be one of my favorite restaurants around my area! The service is pretty good. All the waiters and waitresses are always ready to assist you with anything, and the atmosphere is pretty good because the place itself looks clean and not that full. Now the food is pretty decent. I personally tried the chaulafan with shrimps it was really good, and I also loved the fried calamari!!

author: Gabriel Arnaudville
review_text: The restaurant is beautiful. The food was not very tasty, and the server Evando was really slow and bad at his job, on purpose.. It wasnt busy and he had a smug attitude and face. He of course included gratuity for his bad job which we paid. But definitely ask for a different server. We unfortunately will not try it again.

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: Reina
review_text: Food is very good. The most affordable and healthy lunch option you can find around paya lebar area. But they really should change their opening hours to 13:00 so it does not mislead anyone. Every time I come in just after 13:00, they are always sold out.

author: Susie Li
review_text: I just found the best tacos in Boston at Taco John’s! They use fresh, high-quality ingredients — you can actually taste the difference in their sauces and meats. My favorites are the Boss Bowl with steak, cheesy quesadillas, and the spicy jalapeño burrito — perfect for heat lovers! Don’t miss the churros — only $3.49 and 6 inches long! Plus, they have amazing deals, especially on Taco Tuesday — tacos under $2! If you want Mexican-inspired fast food made with care, come to Taco John’s. Trust me, I’m now a total taco fan!

author: Jimmy Vee
review_text: This place is great. I love you he atmosphere, the people are friendly and it's just a great place to have a coffee and share a great convo. Staff are friendly and take care of you. All round it's a great place to be. I come here regularly. I recommend the Salmon and avocado 🥑 on toast or the blueberry protien smoothie.

author: sergio valles-blancarte
review_text: Food is good service is even better. Juan Carlos was or waiter and the younger kids was his runner both did a great job ! We will be back. Also glad they're open earlier again.

author: Laura B
review_text: We went 2 nights in a row because the pumpkin pizza was phenomenal!! Absolutely loved it! Fantastic service too. There is a small slide for the kids and they bring pencils and paper for them to use at the table too. There was live music one night, but it wasn’t too loud and we could still easily talk. So lovely.

author: Cherry
review_text: I thought Crate Cafe was just a TikTok-raved spot, but it really exceeded expectations! The portions were huge and worth every penny, the food was delicious, and there were plenty of vegan options. The shakes weren’t just Instagram-worthy—they tasted amazing too. Definitely a spot I’d return to!

author: Sophia Liu
review_text: This is a very nice vegetarian restauraunt. They offer a variety of options which is nice, but as someone who isn’t vegetarian, the flavors were a little bit weak/off to me. The Greek Style Eggs were pretty good, but the burnt flavor from the charred sourdough was a bit overpowering. I liked the addition of avocado on the side, but I think more feta would’ve enhanced taste. My family also commented that the Surfers’ Burrito and Impossible Burger both tasted okay, but that they were both a little flavorless. The Pure Passion juice was delicious and refreshing though, especially if you like sourness! Other than that, service was good, and the atmosphere was probably the highlight of this restaurant. Really nice to sit in the outside area, much quieter than inside. Overall, I think this is a good option for vegetarians but if you aren’t used to vegetarian meals, it may not suit your taste. I will mention, we didn’t get to try the salad or pizza but both looked very yummy too.

author: Ying Zhou Soo
review_text: Newly opened restaurant in the district. Owner was very friendly and conversant in Viet, English and Mandarin (会说中文). The chicken pho was outstanding. Grilled pork that accompanied the Bun Cha and Banh Mi was out of this world. 100% would recommend you l check this place out!

author: Alexis Sabbaghian
review_text: Smith & Wollensky Boston never disappoints. We shared the porterhouse steak — perfectly cooked and full of flavor — along with creamed spinach, fried onions, and mac and cheese that were all spot on. Finished with a rich, crackly crème brûlée that tied everything together. The food, service, and classic atmosphere make it one of those places we just keep coming back to.

author: Lesley Johnson
review_text: Bit of a mixed bag here. Arrived around midday and what a palaver to get in. Firstly, bags were checked for what I presume must be hidden alcohol or weapons ...? Not sure exactly of the reason. Then seating. So many different seats at different costs that we felt we were on an episode of 'Black Mirror'! Settled for the minimum spend of 800,000 IDR which was taken in advance and we were given rickety chairs and an unstable table that looked like they were throwbacks from a 1980s conservatory furniture sale. We didn't like our original seats, so asked if we could move. Again, another big palaver whilst the seats/cost was checked. So far, so disappointing but the view of the ocean was great. Staff looked stressed and uptight. They seemed to be watching everyone and it was not a comfortable ambience. I guess maybe this is more of a sunset/evening venue as I certainly didn't get the chilled, relaxed vibe I was expecting. On a positive note, the chicken pizza was lovely; nearly didn't order as it stated on the menu it comes slightly charred. Fortunately, it wasn't! Would I return? Not sure.

author: Sheila F
review_text: I love the place! The staffs are very friendly, full of smile. They are very accommodating for someone who is not familiar with the name of the dish. The best part is the food, made fresh with halal ingredients and tasty seasoning! It might be too spicy for some, but it is perfect for me. The menu that I order always been packed with high protein from the meat or chicken and fiber from their salad. The portion is so big, I can’t finish a meal by my self. Totally recommended and will go back to try another menu.

author: Shruti Rajiv
review_text: We came in during lunch hour but they have long brunch hours until 4pm and later dinner with different menus. We had the Mushroom quinoa burger and Mushroom Truffle pizza. The burger was the most delicious vegetarian burger I have ever had. Completely recommend it!!

author: Daniel Gehriger
review_text: A Culinary Oasis at the Highest Level! A fantastic Thai restaurant with a true high-end touch. The cocktails are outstanding – creative, well-balanced, and beautifully presented. The Pad Thai, whole chicken, and beef salad were all incredibly fresh and perfectly seasoned. The restaurant itself is a peaceful oasis with a stylish atmosphere and top-notch cuisine. Absolutely recommended – we will definitely be back!

author: Ojitos Rodriguez
review_text: I only bought a soda and if I would have known there was a 50 cent charge I would have just paid with cash. The issue is not the 50 cents. It's that she failed to communicate this charge. Nobody likes hidden fees with their food.

author: Ryan K
review_text: I’ve been eating at here specifically Joyce Pan Mee stall since my primary school days back in 2017, and now as a university student close to graduating, this place still hits the same. (8 years and still going) Joyce’s pan mee never fails to impress, It’s simple, handmade noodles shaped to perfection with that familiar taste that never gets old. It’s a humble, family-run stall where the wife is the heart of the kitchen and the husband quietly preps fresh vegetables by her side. The whole atmosphere feels nostalgic — every bowl reminds me of the old days. Honestly, Joyce Pan Mee singlehandedly made me eat so much till I became fat, but it’s worth every bite. Consistent, comforting, and full of heart.

author: Joseph Meoli
review_text: Greeted , nicely and professional and were seated in the bar area .. a little loud to our liking for brunch .. but very clean … Our waitress Erin was very nice and introduced herself .. took drink order and gave us time to order very professional and helpful with explaining any questions.. superb service… waited a little long for food ,, but was definitely worth waiting for our country Benedict , and Breakfast egg rolls.. food was delicious.. recommend both ! And ask for ERIN O .. for waitress she was just superb .. Bon appetite

author: TELU VENDING LLC
review_text: Caroline was great! She took great care of me and my friends and was very attentive and brought out or food in a timely manner. She was also very pleasant and made sure to give us the best service!

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: Claxton Ng
review_text: Recommended by my colleague. Came to try out the foods. Food is acceptable and variety of choices, price is very reasonable. No wonder the Q are so long. One things I don’t like is the payment type are limited and drinks is order separately from the stall, very inconvenient.

author: David D
review_text: Food is excellent, almost as good as my wife's cooking! This restaurant is ALWAYS busy. There is almost ALWAYS a line. So we always try to visit before 4pm, usually you can get a table quickly. After 4pm it's a wait. Food is spicy, not super salty, it's a rare treat, to have food actually prepared properly. Bravo.

author: Juan Betancur
review_text: During a visit to the McDonald's located in the city center, poor service was experienced. The staff displayed an unprofessional attitude, with unfriendly expressions and a lack of willingness to provide proper service. This resulted in a negative experience and a perception of indifference towards customer service quality.

author: Jhon Melky Chumacera
review_text: Bếp Mẹ In is one of those rare places that instantly makes you feel like you’ve stepped into everyday life in Ho Chi Minh City rather than a tourist stop. Located conveniently near the market, the restaurant buzzes with energy from morning until evening, filled with locals and visitors alike — a reassuring sign you’re in the right place. We ordered the bánh xèo, and it absolutely did not disappoint. Perfectly crisp on the outside, fragrant with turmeric, and generously filled, it struck that ideal balance between texture and flavor. Fresh herbs and greens accompanied the dish, making each bite vibrant, satisfying, and unmistakably Vietnamese. The quality of the ingredients really stood out — everything tasted fresh, well-prepared, and made with care. Despite how busy the restaurant gets, the service remains impressively fast and efficient. Orders come out quickly, staff stay attentive, and the flow of the place never feels chaotic. It’s the kind of organized bustle you only get when a restaurant truly knows what it’s doing. What makes Bếp Mẹ In special is how authentic the experience feels. Sitting there, surrounded by chatter, sizzling pans, and the rhythm of daily life, you genuinely feel like one of the locals. Great food, great energy, and consistently top-notch quality — a must-visit near the market.

author: Thelma Ortiz
review_text: We recently ate there for my daughter’s wedding. Thalia and Mr. Velasquez treated us with kindness, respect and integrity. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone. We were welcomed like family and they are so generous too. The food is delicious, freshly cooked and served. The atmosphere is pleasant and the decor is beautiful. Thank you both for making this experience possible and we hope to see you soon.

author: Layla P
review_text: Here’s a clean, friendly review you can use: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Amazing Experience at Miam Café! Miam Café is truly an amazing place, and Judi made the experience even better. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, and the servers are super kind, attentive, and always on top of everything. Judi especially stood out with her friendly attitude and great service. The food came out fast, everything was fresh, and the overall service was smooth and efficient. If you’re looking for a spot with great vibes, delicious food, and staff who genuinely care, Miam Café is definitely the place to go!

author: Carolynn LaRocca
review_text: The ordering and pick up process, and convenient location were all fantastic! We got our order from Detroit Pizza Depot. Their pizza made this born-in-Detroit woman VERY happy. Now I don’t need to wait for a visit to family and friends in Michigan to get Detroit-style pizza. And they have Faygo pop too!

author: SoyAlonsoDc
review_text: We have been visiting this location for years. All the staff of the place are friendly and very attentive. The photographer always comes to greet us and today we decided to take pictures to remember the beginning of this new year as a family. She was very sweet and friendly 100% I recommend this place

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Annie
review_text: My partner and I decided to check out Taco Beach Shack today given the great reviews and our craving for Mexican food and I can say it definitely did not disappoint! Kourtney, our hostess/ server was the friendliest person; she had a great personality and gave us the scoop on all the different foods on the menu. The food itself was amazing and fresh. We had dined at another Mexican place earlier in our trip on the Broadwalk but Taco beach shack was so much better! I tip my hat off to Kourtney and the gang at Taco beach shack, great food and service. I would highly recommend.

author: K.Z.
review_text: Very cute spot. The food was definitely visually appealing, but wasn’t quite what I expected. Service was great, drinks were good, and the music was a vibe. I’m not sure what standard prices are for drinks in the area, but expect to pay $18 per margarita. If you want to hear the latest reggaeton hits while eating a duck taco, this spot is for you!

author: Dawit
review_text: Dino’s famous chicken and fries was not bad. 🍗 They like to sell the chicken already packed. I requested fresh chicken and fries, but the cashier kept saying, “Everything is fresh x100” with Spanish swear in whispering “Pinche…” My chicken was burned hard and tepid..🍟 My fries were not crispy but soggy. Not enough sauce on fries was disappointing me enough. 🥲 It is a good place to visit once out of curiosity

author: khamdan mahamud
review_text: Flavorsome Halal Char Kway Teow! Rating: 5/5 I'm so impressed with this Halal Char Kway Teow! The dish was expertly cooked with a delightful balance of flavors. The noodles were tender, and the ingredients were fresh. The large portion was incredibly value-for-money, easily enough for two meals. I loved that I could enjoy a satisfying, filling meal without breaking the bank. Service was friendly and efficient. Highly recommend for those seeking delicious, authentic Halal Char Kway Teow in generous servings!

author: Natasha's pov
review_text: Warm and friendly service, and the food came out really fast. The menu has a wide variety of options and plenty to choose from. Tried The Madu and the Cubano sandwich, both were super tasty and satisfying. Portions are generous for the price, definitely worth it! The space is big, with both indoor and outdoor seating. There’s also a playground for kids, which makes it very family-friendly. Lots of parking for scooters, and valet service for cars. Great spot for brunch, chill time, or family outings!

author: CP
review_text: When it comes to Nasi Lemak, it isn't far-fetched to say that everyone in Singapore knows about Ponggol Nasi Lemak. They do a few things consistently well: the coconuty rice, the sambal, and the crunchy fried chicken wings. Among their outlets, the Serangoon and Tanjong Katong locations always attract snaking queues. It is a meal that feels both heartwarming and hearty every single time.

author: Wocka
review_text: Enjoyed Sugar Cane Shrimp for entree to share with the wife who also had the Bone Marrow Spicy Beef Noodles ( Marrow was melt in your mouth ) and I had the King Grilled Beef Short Ribs . Drinks of a coconut and watermelon juice . But that didn’t stop them topping up the supplied glass of cold water with a slice of lemon constantly . Our Service Lady was amazing and even the friendly doorman had was a huge positive to the atmosphere. Total of 649k was fair for beautiful meals , great service and a nice night out . Christmas music and the Christmas tree up at the start of November was enlightening and added a smile to our faces . Thank you !

author: Fy Jasni
review_text: Had such an awesome experience at P.S. Café! The service was warm, attentive, and made us feel so welcomed. A big thank you to Manager Bernie for welcoming us with such a warm smile and making us feel right at home. The team’s hospitality truly made our visit extra special. 🙌✨ Special mention to Eileen, the trainee, who impressed us with her professionalism, friendliness, and genuine effort to ensure we had a great time. For someone in training, she really went above and beyond . 💯👏 Can’t wait to be back again. 😊😍

author: Caroline Auger
review_text: Amazing new cafe! Such a beautiful space, and the staff is helpful & kind. The food is delicious! We got the Turkish style eggs, chicken & rice, and the mezze situation. Everything I've had so far is perfect!

author: Thuc Nhan Tran
review_text: We came for a Saturday drag brunch and it was so much fun!! The ambiance and decor in this place is absolutely stunning! The food was super fresh (from the ceviche to the chips, you can tell everything was made fresh) but could use a bit more flavor. Overall great experience. Would probably come back for the drag brunch experience but not just for the food.

author: Sin Han Lee
review_text: We went to PS.Cafe East Coast Park for a birthday celebration and had a wonderful experience. Eileen, Maggie, Bernie and Kent were all very thoughtful and attentive throughout our meal. The food was excellent, and the ambience was perfect for the occasion. We truly enjoyed our time there and will definitely return again.

author: Tottochan
review_text: Went after work hours and sad to find out some stores close at 7pm or before 7pm. Not many options left for dinner, especially those featured on blogs. Managed to order food but not our first choices.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Katka Cinková
review_text: This happened to be a really lovely food experience. The soup was delicious, a little spicy with a nice hint of lime. You can add more chilli or some pickled veggies. The owners were lovely and welcoming. Still don't understand the price because it was nothing like on the menu, it was actually lower so I don't complain.

author: Mizu NTT
review_text: The first thing to mention is: Very dirty Secondly, it's the service of the staff My group went on Saturday night. We waited for a long time but no staff came to ask anything. We called 2-3 times before the staff came. We ordered a special hot pot but the vegetables were a bit dirty. I asked "Hey, is this really the vegetables for the special hot pot?" The staff replied "yes" and turned away. A while later, a friend brought out another plate of vegetables to exchange, but the vegetable plate had a snail on it. We asked them to wash the vegetables again. Then they brought out a different plate of vegetables :) Next is the dipping sauce, there were 5 people but they gave us 4 bowls of hot pot dipping sauce. When we ordered grilled food, there was no sauce or dipping sauce as the tiktoker reviews said The staff's attitude was terrible, they were negligent and didn't take care of the customers. They answered customers curtly. Especially the guy with the buzz cut and earrings (probably the manager or owner). The customers were still sitting and eating at the restaurant, but he was humming and singing like there was no one around :) There were also rats crawling around. NEVER COME BACK

author: Yvette Caamano
review_text: Had the Pistachio Pancakes, they were so fluffy and delicious. Server Patricia was so nice everyone that was in close proximity was very friendly, and the music was good and the whole place was a good vibe.

author: Harrison Nguyen
review_text: **Carl's Donuts: A Legacy of Culinary Craftsmanship** Along Sunset Road, Carl's Donuts stands out as a family-owned bakery that blends traditional techniques with innovative practices, rooted in a rich history dating back to its inception in 1966 by Carl and Lyn Sanders at the Wonder World variety store. What sets them apart is their commitment to quality and our ability to balance time-honored methods with contemporary culinary trends. Currently, the third generation of the Ramsay family, Amber and Brock, meticulously uphold the bakery's heritage, ensuring that every product we offer is a testament to our culinary craftsmanship. **First Impressions & Atmosphere** Upon entry, the bakery welcomes patrons with a complex olfactory profile that combines notes of sweetness and warmth, evoking a sense of nostalgia. The design ethos is characterized by minimalistic elegance; carefully curated display cases showcase a selection of pastries, while the customer service area, designed to foster a welcoming environment, makes you feel right at home. A transparent view into the operational kitchen enhances the experience, allowing guests to observe the meticulous production processes that define the bakery's offerings. **Culinary Mastery: Donuts & Pastries** Carl's Donuts showcases a carefully curated menu that emphasizes quality over quantity. Signature offerings, including the classic glazed ring—characterized by its delicate structure and balanced sweetness—are complemented by other traditional varieties such as glossy maple bars and the visually appealing pink sprinkle doughnuts, which pay homage to the bakery's nostalgic roots. Innovation plays a crucial role in the bakery's evolution. Seasonal and monthly specials, such as the crème brûlée raised doughnut—which features a torched sugar crust that offers a tantalizingly contrasting texture—and the toffee-crunch bar enveloped in dark chocolate with English toffee accents, highlight the establishment's commitment to creative culinary expression. The incorporation of flavors like matcha and chocolate in a filled doughnut exemplifies an understanding of flavor profiles and ingredient synergy. Beyond donuts, the bakery excels in creating high-quality pastries. The almond croissant is a prime example of laminated dough mastery, filled with a rich almond paste that enhances the flavor profile. Their quiches offer intriguing flavor combinations, such as spinach and jalapeño-turkey, known for their creamy consistency and layered textures. **Final Verdict** Carl's Donuts serves as a paradigm of how disciplined craftsmanship and respect for culinary heritage can elevate comfort food into a sophisticated art form. Each product, from the iconic apple fritter to the avant-garde crème brûlée donut, reflects decades of dedication, interwoven with contemporary innovations. Pairing their pastries with meticulously brewed nitro cold brew coffee further enhances the experience, offering a timeless connection between tradition and modernity.

author: Ewa Marcol
review_text: Best sandwiches I had in my life. Definitely recommend visiting! The french toast was indeed a bit dry, but the fruits very fresh and sweet. It takes a while to get your order, but once you have it it's so good, you forget about the wait time

author: Jasmin R
review_text: My family and I came to this restaurant for dinner and was pleasantly surprised but the atmosphere. Our server, Fabi, was attentive and super friendly.

author: Joshua Moses
review_text: I've been a few times and I have Amazing experience every time. The service is amazing. The servers are provided an awesome level of service. The ambiance is very chill with a variety of good music playing. All of the food I've tried is delicious from the sushi, steamed snow crab legs, to the seafood boil, and the price for all you can eat Crab Leg, and Seafood Bowl along with the Sushi is for an unbeatable $45.95. I highly recommend this place to everyone I come across whether it be friends or family. This place is in my top 3 favorite places to eat in town.

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: Vivian Chu
review_text: Second time here. Prawn noodle tastes delicious and prawn biscuit is very fresh and crisp. Definitely we will come again. First time, there was a staff, Indonesia woman, her service attitude was really bad , my friends said they wont come back. Second time, served by two chinese women (one was cashier , another one helped us to order food) that service was good. 👍

author: Inshrah Siddiqui
review_text: Salad Bowl - The perfect light meal that’s still full of flavor. The fresh ingredients make it a refreshing option for any time of day.

author: Daniella Favila
review_text: Good was amazing! Liz, our server, was the most kind and tentative server! The food was very warm and comforting, we loved the BYOB aspect and the people were amazing and kind! They knew how to explain the dishes well and were personable.

author: Chong Huong Wong
review_text: The experience is wonderful. I didn’t like a dish we ordered, we were given a new choice. The restaurant didn’t charge us for the dish we disliked. It was a pleasant surprise. The gentleman serving us is very polite and understanding.

author: maurice solner
review_text: Great local spot, right down the street from our hotel. The food was excellent and so was our waitress. I love the fact they are BYOB as well. I highly recomend getting the country fried steak dinnner.

author: Trúc Thanh
review_text: The food at this restaurant is delicious! The staff are super attentive and enthusiastic. I give this restaurant a 100/10 rating.

author: Netta Szekely
review_text: Come here if you just landed in Vietnam and want the tourist friendly version of street food. And I mean it in every good way as we came back here couple of times. Everything we ate here was delicious. Try their pre set combo plates, morning glory and pork belly. Yum.

author: caitlin mathews
review_text: We found Taste Budz Creole Kitchen thanks to TikTok recommendations, and it definitely lived up to the hype! The menu is on the pricier side, but honestly, it was worth it for the quality and flavor. We ordered the large seafood gumbo, a side of mac & cheese, banana pudding, and two waters — total came out to $54. The gumbo was packed with bold, rich flavor and just the right amount of spice. You could tell it was made with care. The mac & cheese was a pleasant surprise — creamy, cheesy, and delicious all on its own. The only thing we weren’t crazy about was the banana pudding. It was mostly vanilla cookies with very little actual pudding and no bananas, which was a bit disappointing compared to the rest of the meal. Overall, the food was delicious, and we’d definitely come back again. A solid stop in Vegas if you’re craving authentic Creole comfort food!

author: Daniel
review_text: Laid back old school hawker centre with some good original hawker stalls. Highly recommended for dinner. Lunch time, half of the stalls are closed.

author: Planet Mars Exploration 2033
review_text: Most of the food is slightly above average, with the coffee and polo bun possibly being the highlights. The coffee must ordered from Counter is better than the premix brought previously. The premix packets is very normal standard and actual drink in store is better offer.

author: LeAngela Robinson
review_text: We were celebrating birthdays! The food was delicious! The drinks were delicious! Ask for the house hot sauce. It's so good!The music and atmosphere were a vibe. Couldn't stop eating the good food and couldn't stop dancing while eating. Yummy Fun! 💃🏽💃🏽💃🏽💃🏽

author: Andreea Cecilia
review_text: Such a cute place! Not only the drinks and the food are delicious, but the place and the atmosphere are lovely, so many good vibes! A must visit when in Saigon!

author: CH Yong
review_text: Not crowded on weekday mornings. I enjoyed the rice and pork parts.

author: Marek Dusza
review_text: Recommended to us by a local, this spot offered a pleasant experience overall. The food was fairly average—I tried the daily special along with chicken and rice, which were decent but nothing particularly memorable. Service was friendly and efficient, which made the visit easy and enjoyable. The real highlight was the setting, with a beautiful view overlooking the rice paddies.

author: Erin Orth
review_text: My friend and I stumbled across this place while on vacation on The Union Presents “Blackout” open mic night, and didn’t realize how lucky we got! The entertainment was amazing, the atmosphere was incredible, the food was on point, the drinks were strong and the service was the best I’ve ever experienced. To our waitress, I wish we’d gotten your name, you made our night and thank you for the recommendation for other places after you closed. We will definitely be coming back!!

author: Priskha Trivenna
review_text: A budget-friendly place to eat at Changi Airport — the concept is like a canteen, with lots of different food stalls. To get here, you really have to ask the staff for directions because we kept getting lost 🥲 even though it’s cheap, the portions are huge — one serving is enough for two people! As for the taste… well, it’s a bit plain 🤏 and it turns out there’s even a price difference between staff and visitors!

author: darius
review_text: Good plate of nasi lemak and an even better supper spot (till 2330). The rice was fresh and fragrant, with a good hint of coconut taste in it. Egg and luncheon meat is what you expect from it. The stars of the show are definitely the chicken wing and sambal. Firstly, the chicken wing was extremely crispy with a good layer of batter, followed by juicy chicken breast. The sambal was spicy and has a good kick to it. It complemented the rice extremely well. My only regret was not getting the ikan bills with it. This plate costed $7.50, a little pricy

author: Klara Chua
review_text: We stayed nearby, so it only made sense for us to drop by Paragon for Here Hai. We arrived around dinner hours (6pm+) and we managed to find a seat in the foodcourt. Ordered and it was a 30 minutes wait till our buzzer rang. It was so worth the wait and look at the amount of crab meat. Great wok hey, fresh crab meat. If your friends don’t fancy this, go check out other food stalls in the foodcourt - just like we did.

author: YZYZY Yeung
review_text: We had tried this BBQ Pork Rice for lunch, we ordered Soup, Spesial Pisah, Pork Skin, Young Coconut. Food is ok and a bit spicy but the rice little bit hard, the pork skin is crunchy, if you like the pork meat you can try this restaurant.

author: Yemani Mason
review_text: We had such an amazing experience at Jrk Restaurant! From the moment we walked in, Samantha, the host, went above and beyond to accommodate our large party of a dozen people. She was warm, organized, and made sure everything flowed smoothly, which made our lunch stress-free and enjoyable. The food was fantastic with so much variety, there truly was something for everyone at the table. As a vegan, I was especially impressed with the delicious options available for me, and my non vegan family were just as happy with their meals. Everything was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. Between the incredible hospitality from Samantha and the diverse, flavorful menu, Jrk! has definitely become one of my favorite spots in Miami. Highly recommend!

author: Ivan Cheok
review_text: @Food Signature / Best selling Food - Nasi Lemak Ayam Goreng Food Tasted - Nasi Lemak Ayam Goreng, Nasi Lemak Ayam Rendang Recommend - Nasi Lemak Ayam Goreng 👍👍👍 Portion - Good, reasonable portion Taste - Excellent, aromatic coconut milk rice match with crispy quarter chicken and the famous sambal. The best Nasi Lemak I have so far 😍 @Shop Cleanliness - Good, they install air purifier to ensure clean air in restaurant Service - Fast (*When you're seated and need call out for order, sometimes waitor is overwhelming with crowded customer) Price - Reasonable, RM 13 for good quality single portion of Nasi Lemak Payment - **CASH or CARD ONLY @Experience Last visit - 01/11/25 at 8.30am Number of Visit - Once a while, been here a few times. Personal Note - The restaurant upgraded to 4 shoplot of dining area space so I observe less people queue outside. Better experience for customer. 👍

author: Arturo Picicci
review_text: Amazing spanish food! Best tomatoe bread then Artichoke, paella, octopus, camarones al ajillo! And sarah the best giving the best service!

author: Nandika Acharya
review_text: La Brisa is an absolute dream of a place. The vibe is immaculate effortlessly bohemian, laid-back, and magical, especially with the ocean breeze, rustic décor, and sunset views. It feels like you’ve stepped into a perfectly curated Bali postcard. The food was just as impressive as the ambience. Every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented, with a great balance of local and international influences. the music, the energy, the warm and attentive staff, and the way everything comes together so seamlessly. It’s the kind of place where time slows down, and you just want to sit, eat, drink, and soak it all in. Easily one of the best dining experiences I had a must-visit if you’re in Canggu. 🌊✨

author: Zairien Sofea
review_text: Highly recommended breakfast kopitiam spot! Went there at 10am on weekdays for breakfast. So there was no long line of queue if u go early. A truly 10/10 experience & definitely will repeat it again. Good taste of food, big portion, worth the price. This branch in Pavi Bukit Jalil have friendly staffs. The cashier chinese guy was being so friendly & nice. Keep it up 👍🏻😋

author: SoJuNey
review_text: Cheap, good, and vibrant! So many types of food, but we started with the classics of chicken rice and shrimp satay. Winner winner chicken dinner. Will come back to try other things. Some places take cards but better to be safe to bring cash. Short walk to catch the light show at Marina Bay.

author: D C
review_text: This is my second visit, so you know the food has me hooked! Even though it’s tucked inside a fancy mall with all the luxury glitz, this spot still steals the spotlight. The food? It’s like a big warm hug from home—but with a cool twist that makes it unforgettable. Let’s talk about their dipping sauce—one taste and you’ll know they mean business. And that chicken? Crispy on the outside, juicy and tender on the inside—basically a party in your mouth with every bite! It’s also the perfect hangout for drinks with friends. Trust me, the corned beef and a cold one are a match made in heaven. To top it all off, the staff are so friendly, they make you feel right at home. Still wondering what to do this weekend? Problem solved—this is the place to be!

author: Monica Fernandes
review_text: The best place to enjoy real Portuguese food!!! It was my second time going. I took my friends, and they instantly fell in love. The prices are really good, considering you get big portions. The chouriço was perfect. The service was really friendly and welcoming. They explained all the plates on the menu and gave suggestions. I would completely recommend this place, and for sure, I will be back

author: Unknown Unknown
review_text: We had such a great experience thanks to our two waiters! Chantel and Renan. They were both friendly, attentive, and made sure everything came out perfectly. You could tell they really cared about their guests, we never had to ask for anything twice. Excellent service from start to finish!

author: R W
review_text: Good indonesian food..but service below average andnatmosphere sterile due too bright lightning in main cavernous dining room

author: Hesam Azimi
review_text: Tonino has been one of the hardest reservations to snag in Boston, so our expectations were sky-high—and it did not disappoint. The restaurant itself is tiny, warm, and inviting, with carefully chosen art and soft lighting that create a charming, intimate vibe, and kind staff with amazing service. From start to finish, everything we had lived up to the hype. We started with both salads on the menu: the Trevisano and the Tomato. The Trevisano was tangy in the best way, while the Tomato Salad was even more impressive—fresh, vibrant, and beautifully balanced with stone fruit, tomatoes, and Fresno peppers. For mains, we tried the Pepperoni and Honey pizza, along with three pastas: Lumache with mushrooms, Cappelletti, and Bucatini with chili-anchovy butter. The pizza slice is served in two pieces, made on house-made focaccia, giving it a texture reminiscent of an elevated, crunchier Sicilian style. The sauce was beautifully balanced and paired perfectly with the spicy-sweet combination of hot honey and pepperoni. The Cappelletti was the star of the night—rich, cheesy, and elevated by a touch of aged balsamic that cut through perfectly. The Bucatini came in a very close second. Despite not usually loving anchovies, we were blown away by how harmoniously the flavors came together, with the chili butter adding heat and the breadcrumbs providing a satisfying crunch. The Lumache, while good, felt a little one-note compared to the others. Desserts were just as impressive. The ricotta cheesecake was incredibly fluffy and light, and while the panna cotta could have been a bit firmer in texture, the flavor was outstanding. The fennel and Snapdragon apple on top made for a delightful finishing touch. P.S , don’t sleep on the amazing tea selection they have, we tried the Yuzu genmaicha tea and it was delicious! Tonino might just be the best Italian restaurant in Boston right now, and I wouldn’t be surprised to see it earn Michelin recognition this November. We’ll absolutely be back—if we can manage to get another reservation!

author: Arrieana Tolentino
review_text: The place is spacious and the service was quite good but it could be better. On the other hand the food was not worth the price and the size of the dim sum all was small and it is expensive,but the beef ramen was quite good and also I hope they make some changes to their food because i think place like that people with expect more from it. From what I can say my experience it was not worth it

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: J Luke
review_text: This is a Michelin Star Charcoal Duck Egg Char Koay Teow with Siham/Cockles. Dammmmmmn Gooooood 👍👍👍👍👍👍

author: Aravind R
review_text: Nice place to visit and hang out while at downtown. Variety of food choices, plenty of seating including outdoors, a bit noisy atmosphere but the vibe is awesome. Parking across the street at the garage .

author: Kimberly Do
review_text: Maxwell Food Centre is my favorite hawker center, and I always find myself coming back here. I usually stop by for the sugar cane drink, a coffee drink from the Vietnamese stall, and especially the fishball soup from Teochew Fishball Bak Chor Mee. The line for the fishball soup is usually around 20 people, but it can easily take close to an hour. I’m not entirely sure why, and it does feel like it could be more efficient, but honestly, the soup is so good that it’s hard to complain. It’s rich, comforting, and incredibly satisfying. Despite the wait, I’m always craving it and always end up coming back. Some places are just worth the time, and this is one of them.

author: Martino Avallone
