review_text: Alright, after three weeks in Vietnam and several Banh Mi eaten along the way, I can say that this one was the absolute best. Out of curiosity, I ordered also a rice stew banana leaves which was extremely tasty. The rice pudding was filled with mince meat that reminded me a bolognese ragù. The meat was super tasty and perfectly cooked, with visible Maynard reaction spot on. Quail eggs inside were good and gave a nice touch to the overall plate. The banh mi was incredibly good. Let’s start by saying that all the ingredients were top quality. Fresh and tasty. The bread was crunchy like if it came out of the oven 5 mins before. The meat was really good and all the different pieces were well balanced together. The vegetables were also fresh. If you wanna taste the best Banh Mi, I highly recommend this one here. Let me know what you think about it.

author: Alice Woo
review_text: Our tour guide K. Mimi, suggested dim sum for breakfast and took us to Ama Dimsum. This restaurant is cozy, spacious and have different sections for indoor seating or with air conditioning. It’s like a ‘buffet style spread’ where you can choose and pick the dishes you like, thus no menu is needed. There is a huge variety of dimsum offered and you can eat to your heart’s content! Some dishes are pre-cooked, baked, fried and ready to be eaten. After you have selected your choices of uncooked dishes, you can hand the tray over to the staff and they will steam and warm up the food for you. We chose some traditional style dishes to try but our teenagers preferred those assorted flavoured fish balls. Overall, food was tasty and prices were reasonable with the portion size given. It’s not as authentic as the Hong Kong style dim sum but still good. This restaurant is a tourist spot for breakfast/ brunch, so expect a large crowd especially on weekends.

author: Lone wolf
review_text: I went to this place because I was in a hurry to get something to eat fast but I ended up paying for a simple sandwich without any vegetables just meat and cheese. $19 for a very simple sandwich meal come on. Just go to mcdonalds cheaper and better. Never coming back again

author: Phuong Nhu
review_text: I've always been hesitant about hot pot with its strong beef fat smell, but I stumbled upon this restaurant and their Mongolian-style beef hot pot was surprisingly delicious. The broth was sweet and savory, and the vegetables were incredibly tasty. The pan-fried beef tripe and braised oxtail were also excellent. The only downside is that the tables are low and the stools aren't very comfortable.

author: Kseniya
review_text: Don’t recommend👎 it’s like a cheap warung. Look at all pictures in the reviews and you’ll understand. The food is average, it is not very bad, it’s just not the taste and quality that you expect to get. We ordered shrimp curry and raw tuna.

author: yohanes kusika
review_text: It’s so good, no wonder they got the Michelin reputation. The hor fun is super nice!! All the food is very nice! Highly recommended!!

author: Petter Hawk
review_text: The restaurant very busy, service was fast and engaging, and one of the male staff members was very helpful in finding a taxi back to the hotel. Overall: The food and service were excellent. I will be back👍👍

author: Janelle
review_text: Super delicious and tender octopus with chilli peanut sauce pair with Wat Dan Hor 🥹 Fried chicken wings are just okay, it's on the sweeter side.

author: Ivy ali
review_text: More than half of the lala served were not fresh, either couldn't open the shell or with rotten taste. Informed the counter after dinner, the lady who looked like boss unhappy with my feedback, no apologies from her and sound like accusing me of cheating her when I didn't even ask for a refund.

author: Anna Huynh
review_text: Great place for a snack so I tried the mango sticky rice, individual serving. I liked that there's an individual size because I know I will overeat it-silky, smooth and sweet. I also tried the lotus root juice, light in taste and refreshing. I love lotus root and to see it in juice form was interesting.

author: Favorite Things
review_text: Disappointed! I keep seeing videos of this place and it looks good so my hopes were high. Unfortunately they were dashed quite quickly after taking my first bite. Zero flavor! Very surprising since everything is made fresh right in front of you. I wanted to like this place, but I have to admit... this might be the worst road side taco stand I've been to.

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: Steven Neo
review_text: Not bad for Local Fovourite Pig Organs Soup. Kinda expensive though, 1 bowl of soup with all the various organs with rice, salted vegetables and Tofu at $6.

author: Ronrapee Leelawong
review_text: The boat noodles are good - taste good and authentic, beef quality is perfect (no need to pay extra for the wagyu, the ordinary one is good enough.) Bigger portion than the typical boat noodles, so beware of over-ordering them. Grilled beef balls and dee fried wontons are also good. Kanhom-tuay is also great - not too sweet and creamy. The service is quite slow, and the queue is super looooonnnggg. Be aware that the price is excrutiating!!! Around 4 times over the normal boat noodles.

author: Nur Hidayah Ruslan
review_text: 24 Sept. Cloudy and windy. Calm spot. Friendly crew. Nice outdoor setup. We had beef bolognese spaghetti and fries. Quite nice and good portion. Complimentary home made ice cream given. Appreciated. Nice vibe and atmosphere. Less traffic and recommended for mind healing ❤️🌿🌸🥰😘

author: Charles Kong
review_text: We arrived at 5:30PM. Since we didn't make reservation, we were asked to sit outside even though there are plenty of empty seats inside. We didn't like the $50 ceviche dish. It was too sour. If you like flavor of lemon and onion, then you might like it. Here are 3 dishes that I like 1) Parihuela Amelcochada Expotenciada, seafood rice 2) Pulpito a la Herradura (octopus) flavorful small plate. 3) Pescado a lo Macho, Fish filet in rich seafood sauce with rice. Also, order kid's meals. They are big portion and good value.

author: Brittany I (Mitts13)
review_text: I ate here with my friend 2 days in a row. The first day we had breakfast which was amazing and then the second day we had lunch since they opened later on weekdays. Both times were fabulous with great service! Drinks were amazing! We ate the bacon egg and cheese sandwich, grits, eggs Benedict, turkey club, and blackened mahi tacos. Great atmosphere, good music, great service! Awesome view of the boardwalk too!

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: Lex Takgu
review_text: Delicious BKT with great service by staff. Will automatically refill soup without asking them.

author: Gissella Lightsey
review_text: Loved the food, loved the environment. The lady who served us was very attentive, polite, nice and gracious. Her name was Carolina . We were blessed to have her. We were party of 3. We. shared some ribs, blue cheese burger 🍔, empanadas and some frappes .. We enjoyed what we had The ribs was about $30ish (I think) The blue cheese burger $22 Each empanada about $6 The frappes $14.99 each We had an awesome time. 20% tip was included in the bill and after that you have the option to tip 3, 5, or 7% more .

author: ns ps
review_text: Food and service was so good, we kept coming to this restaurant for 5 straight days! Big portions and fresh ingredients. Must try: their fish burger and Mexicana salad.

author: Amanda Fazekas
review_text: Really cute place to grab a coffee and some food! The coffee was high quality and made very well, and the iced latte was HUGE. Also tried their breakfast sandwich which was good too. It has a very modern vibe and friendly staff and is a nice spot to sip on your coffee for a while.

author: KAT OLARTE
review_text: Our entire visit was stellar! The staff was so hospitable and accommodating. The view is prefect. The food was amazing and creative. I highly recommend requesting Tyrone! He's kind, on point, genuine, and passionate about being present with you. He's been with them since they opened and loves to answer questions with enthusiasm. It's right next to the shipyard and if you're there early enough, you'll see them lifting vessels out of the water to Dry-dock them. We took a walk after and it was so peaceful! Enjoy!

author: D S
review_text: Best to go if you are in a group or a pair. If you are alone, you will likely sit at the bar or the high tables even if there are other tables available. Food has good sized portions. Crazily huge menu hence I do not know what their speciality is. Ordered some chicken breast cakes with some batter. Think that I ordered the wrong dish. Beer was ok. Pretty dark environment in the evening.

author: - Romanoz -
review_text: Good service, friendly staff, very tasty natural lemonade! Very clean inside🤗

author: Kenny King Yu Lau
review_text: Banh Mi (Vietnamese bread)using McDonald all-day-breakfast concept,. Bread was very crispy, dip with the sauce and it marches the meats. No air conditioning, seating can be on the street which can be good to taste the Vietnamese style Serve with very hot plate, just caution.

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: Jinghorjiak
review_text: 28/07/2025 First time try this wonton mee. The fried pork belly is good. Noodles are springy. Char Siew and Wonton is fresh and tasty. We ordered a place of crab fried rice to try. Not bad as well. Got wok hei. Can try. 😀👍

author: jasper oh
review_text: A simple corner store offering reasonable prices with generous ingredients and flavorful taste- love the seafood fried noodles and fried rice with plenty of crab meat. Plus points for being not too oily and well balance for the taste. It's great value for money and definitely on my go-to list whenever I'm back in Hatyai!

author: Maryam
review_text: I come to Bali twice a year, and every time I make sure to visit this restaurant. The quality of the food, drinks, and service is truly top-notch. At this point, the standard they maintain is so high that whenever I dine anywhere else ,even at 5-star hotel restaurants it rarely compares. The flavors, presentation, and overall experience here are just on another level. They are remarkably consistent, which is rare and so appreciated. The photos I’m sharing are from the Ubud location I visited on this trip, but I can confidently say the Canggu location is just as amazing. Highly recommended if you want an exceptional dining experience.

author: Marai Jimenez
review_text: I recently had the pleasure of eating at Healthy Organic Catering and indulged in their Grilled Chicken Pesto Sandwich and Turkey Club. The experience was nothing short of delightful. The Grilled Chicken Pesto Sandwich was a burst of flavors with its fresh basil pesto, ripe tomatoes, and juice tender chicken, all nestled between perfectly toasted bread. Each bite was a harmonious blend of savory and herbaceous notes, leaving me craving more. The Turkey Club was a classic favorite done right. The tender slices of turkey paired beautifully with crispy bacon, fresh lettuce, and juicy tomatoes, all held together by soft, toasted bread. The combination of textures and flavors made this sandwich a true standout. Overall, my experience at Healthy Organic Catering was exceptional. The use of fresh, organic ingredients shone through in every bite, and the attention to detail in the preparation of each dish was evident. I highly recommend trying the Pesto Sandwich and Turkey Club for a satisfying and delicious meal.

author: Goran Vadina
review_text: Everything was absolutely perfect at Peter Luger. The steaks were flawlessly seasoned and cooked to perfection. The meat was beautifully seared on the outside while perfectly juicy and tender on the inside. The house beer was top quality and complemented the meal wonderfully. Overall, it was an excellent dining experience that I would highly recommend. Ps.. cash only is a little bit down side as I dont like to travel with to much cash in my pocket.

author: Mun Jun Yong
review_text: If you are looking for delicious lamb skewers, soup, pancake, noodles, and everything lamb, you've found the right place. The food is absolutely yummy and the service amazing with great attentive staffs in a comfortable environment. Worth every penny!

author: Miché U
review_text: Food is great for the price. Service is so-so because wait time even when there is a small line. Overall the restaurant is small and gets packed with people to the brim that I wouldn’t recommend visiting during peak hours you’ll be in line for 20-30 minutes. The men’s restroom needs to be cleaned and maintained more properly. The plumbing is slow when flushing, the knob is a little loose and the urinal is out of order. There is a mop bucket in there as well. I feel dirty just being in there. You can tell a lot about an establishment by how well they maintain their restroom. For now it’s more of a carry out place for me. I wouldn’t recommend dine in.

author: isaac nagode
review_text: If you're craving late-night tacos in South LA, Tacos Gavilan on Broadway is a solid go-to. It's open crazy late (like 2 AM on weekdays, 4 AM on weekends), so it's perfect for post-party munchies or just a spontaneous taco run. The carne asada and al pastor tacos are my personal faves—super flavorful, with just the right amount of grease to hit the spot. The salsa bar is a nice touch too (if it’s open), with all the fixings to dress up your tacos just how you like. And the portions? Generous. You won’t leave hungry. The vibe inside is pretty chill—clean, fast service, and usually sports on the TVs. It’s not fancy, but that’s kind of the point. Prices are reasonable too, especially for LA. Only heads-up: double-check your order if you're doing takeout or delivery. A few folks (myself included once) have gotten a wrong item or two. Overall? Tacos Gavilan hits the spot when you want something fast, filling, and legit tasty. Definitely worth a stop if you’re in the area.

author: Lizabeth Walsh
review_text: I was able to walk in and sit at a 2-top alone, just before the real Sunday brunch rush began. Delicious chicken apple sausage, split and browned perfectly. Gluten-free options made choosing a dish delightfully difficult, but I finally settled on the French toast, which came beautifully topped with a banana, strawberry, blueberry mix. Hot coffee, plenty of it, brewed fresh often was the perfect accompaniment. My neighbors ordered the hush puppies, and I longed for the days of eating gluten when their bowlful was delivered. I will certainly return on my next trip, and I'll likely repeat the walk up the hilly part of Haight to Ashbury to burn off a few of the happy calories I'll take in then, too.

author: Clarissa Mulan
review_text: Went here for lunch during weekdays. There weren't many people. Parking is rm3. The view is just stunning by the sea. The food we ordered was daging salai, tomyam, kailan and fried egg for about rm110. It was just nice and affordable for 3pax. It is self service hence no service charge haha. They have stalls selling thai snacks and desserts such as cakes. It is a nice place to take photos and across the sea is penang island. Recommended to come for a gathering!

author: Bee Leng Leong
review_text: Last week I was at Pavilion, Kuala Lumpur to meet up with an old friend from overseas. After our dinner at one of the eateries there, we walked around the shopping mall for some snacks to munch on. We stopped by this Oriental Kopi which serves a wide variety of popular , local Malaysian cuisine n street food. There were long queues on both sides of the shop. On the left side of the shop was a long queue of customers waiting to pay for their items they wanted to get. On the opposite side of the shop n on the right side was also a long queue of customers waiting to order their food n drinks n paying for their food. On the opposite here , are tables n chairs for the dining in customers. Wow the food n drinks must be so excellent to attract such a large crowd! Look at the nearby eateries- you can see only a few tables were occupied! This place was overcrowded. I also joined in the excitement n joined in the queue cos I wanted to buy a box of their signature white coffee to try back home. I queued up on the left n paid for my box of instant white coffee. With that, I drove home. I have tried the coffee n it’s really a good local coffee. Worth the waiting n joining the queue in getting it. Next day , I would like to try the local cuisine at this place.

author: L Chan
review_text: A convenient hawker centre right next to Bedok MRT, bus interchange, Bedok Mall & surrounding HDB shops Wide variety of local favourites at reasonable prices, with popular stalls often drawing queues

author: Khanh Vu Huu
review_text: I visited Banh Mi Huynh Hoa for the first time after seeing all the hype on Social Media. The sandwich costs 73,000 VND and is definitely huge and generously filled. For my taste, though, it was too generously filled, there was so much pâté and mayonnaise that it squeezed out of the bread with every bite. The shop had a good idea by packing the herbs and vegetables separately to keep the bread from getting soggy during transport, but unfortunately this creates an extreme amount of plastic waste since every single ingredient comes in its own little bag. A more sustainable alternative would really make sense here. Flavor-wise, the banh mi was okay, but definitely not worth the hype. I’ve had much better banh mi‘s in Saigon since then.

author: Kelsey Munger
review_text: Jadu has been such an amazing addition to our neighborhood! The owner Maya is the sweetest and the staff and vibes are equally as wonderful :) delicious food and fun drink menu - you gotta check out their wine bar at night too!

author: Xin Lin Ng
review_text: I had the best burrito ever here! Each element of the burrito was well thought and intentionally prepared. Flavours were balanced, and portions were just right. They were slightly short staffed, but they kept us regularly updated on the progress of the food without us asking. The cafe also had great vibes. High ceilings, cool, no insects. It was crowded but it felt like there was a lot of space, which made this a very comfortable experience.

author: Nurkhalida Rahman
review_text: Very beautiful place. Went there in the evening Saturday, less people. Washroom complete with bidet. The wild berry ice shave so good, not too sweet. Clear matcha drink also nice tops with caramel. Will repeat again.

author: shin ri
review_text: Food is great, price is cheap as well. Love their Tom yum soup with fish, it's exactly what I wanted. They open from 9am onwards, so we had breakfast here everyday.

author: Ava Alfaro
review_text: Miss Yen, the owner of the restaurant greeted us with a lot of enthusiasm. We only had an afternoon snack here but the banh mi was delicious! I also like their lime tea :) Place has good energy and friendly staff. We finished our meal quickly!

author: WillEatsAsia
review_text: Food is quite good. Had the chicken Hamburg. Served by Ei who was attentive. However my 3 friends received their patties first and I waited for very long, as they forgot mine! To be fair they did apologize. Shop is also a bit warm- need stronger air conditioning. I was sweating while eating. And there was a housefly flying around. Need to be taken care of!

author: Bill
review_text: I don’t have too many steakhouse reviews but our experience at Mooo Seaport was outstanding. My wife and I, who live across town and don’t frequent Seaport, Ubered to Seaport last might for what turned into one of our best steak experiences in recent memory (yes it was that good). We decided on the tuna tartare appetizer, followed by the Beef Wellington and cap steak (the latter, one of their specialties) and said we would be sharing everything. The tartare, a delicious combination of tuna, seaweed and a yummy sauce with seaweed and sesame oil flavor, was perfectly portioned on two separate plates for us, as was the Wellington, arguably the star of the evening (for my wife especially). Thin, crispy pastry surrounded the tenderloin and inside was an amazing duxelles with foie gras that topped the steak, served on a perfect red wine reduction. However, for me, the cap steak was another level in terms of both richness and tenderness. Of course both steaks were cooked to a precise medium rare and paired perfectly with simple sea salt fries and a glass of CA cab. Very solid beer and wine by the glass menus (and dirty martini loaded with blue cheese olives for my wife). Service was outstanding. In addition to everything being separated and perfectly presented, one of the servers from another table (Zach), whom we had known at the Capital Grille years ago, had recognized our name from the reservation list and came by to say hello! In addition, the manager came several times to make sure we had everything. That level of detail, the “through the roof” level of the food and preparation, set Mooo above nearly every other Boston steakhouse, in the same conversation as Grille 23. Cheers, Mooo!

author: Anu Rao
review_text: The tacos here are absolutely delicious, especially when paired with their flavorful guacamole and salsas. The prices are very affordable, and I love that they customize everything right in front of you, ensuring the ingredients are fresh. The place does get very crowded, but it's definitely worth trying. Since this shop is located in the Carniceria Market, you can explore other food options in the night market as well. Just a heads-up, this shop is only open in the evenings.

author: Stephanie Logan
review_text: Very tasty. The chips and guacamole were crunchy and fresh. The Oaxacan cheese was perfection. I also really enjoyed the specialty drink. It contained a liqueur made by monks. The drink was a great compliment to the meal

author: Lin Cheng
review_text: The pig skin is hard as a rock. The fried pork rind is also hard as a rock and chewy. Perhaps that’s the way it is supposed to taste. Some people might like it.The pork though looks like chicken, is juicy and delicious. I didn’t eat the blood sausage . The fried minced pork is not great. Everything is cold. It’s a speciality restaurant( cafe ), like part of a chain. But we went there because it’s a must try. If I could just order the pork without the skin and the rest, I would come back.

author: Christina McFarland
review_text: The food was verry tasty, chicken quesadilla could use a bit more sessoning with the meat but salsa helped, if you order the coffee is it a light/medium roast so not really on par- with dark/french roast. Server was happy and attentive. The flaming fajita mix (stake and shrimp) Was awsome easily enought for two if your light eatters Blackened Brisket Tip Natchos- were tasty, think we would have prefered tortilla chips- the potato chips got soggy really fast.(still tasted great)

author: Joseph Fong
review_text: Meat was fresh n juicy. Staff were friendly and attentive. Recommended !! Will revisit .

author: Dikan Reyes
review_text: The architectural design of this venue alone is a sight to behold, videos and pictures simply don’t do it justice. The views and design elevate this place to true bucket-list status. The service is world-class, the food is exceptional, and the shisha service is supreme. It’s uncontested why Rock Bar is consistently ranked as one of the top lounges in the world, and I will gladly second that choice. This place is absolutely breathtaking. With top-tier service, excellent food, drinks, and shisha, it delivers an unforgettable experience from start to finish.

author: mud mee
review_text: Atmosphere is sooooo gooooood Staff is also friendly and welcomed FOOD!! perfect Recommended! - Grilled beef tongue you definitely get good vibe and positive energy here 👍🏼

author: Gary Paul
review_text: I’ve been to Roast over a dozen times over the last 2 years. The EmQuartier branch is my favorite, but all 3 locations are great. Comfort, quality and consistency are the best descriptors for Roast that I can think of. Always satisfying and delicious, with good mix of old favorites and new dishes to try. I will be back again and again!

author: Bảo Phan (ĂN NGON HÓC MÔN)
review_text: DELICIOUS FOOD IN HOC MON. The food is cheap and delicious. The beef tripe salad is amazing, the egg fried rice is only 30k, and they're currently running a promotion on a BBQ set for 149k, so good.

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: Mr Low (미카님)
review_text: This place is where your nose, stomach and soul all say thank you. Full of amazing Malay and Indian food like nasi lemak, curry puffs and all things goreng, it's a food coma waiting to happen. Prices are friendly, portions are no joke and the vibes are old school chill. Come hungry, leave rolling around (Because of food coma)

author: rochelle Berliner
review_text: My new favorite restaurant in Forest Hills. The new decor is cozy and warm, the food is amazing, the service is top notch, and the chef/owner is friendly and grateful. I always get the Tagliatelle Bolognese which is lick-ypur-plate delicious. And you must try the strawberry napoleon for dessert. It's divine.

author: shan xie
review_text: A mediocre restaurant, every dish using the same sauce, taste nothing more than soy sauce. The portion is small, their chicken also taste less.

author: Reynaldo Garcia
review_text: 10/02 I bought 3 combos and 3 large Thai tea boba. The drinks were missing sweetener. I don’t live close to the location. I called in and told them the situation. I was told to come back whenever I get a chance and they will replace them. I went back today and was told I was only to receive one med drink. I paid for 3 large boba, I was going back and forth with the cashier and asked to speak to the manager. I was refused any communication with him. At the end I said “keep the drink I don’t even want it no more.” I wasted over $15 on 3 large drinks. I’m disappointed with the Customer Service I received. I used to like this place, time for a new location.

author: Anna Maria Sotiraki
review_text: Interesting options for food, drinks and desserts and tasty good. Everyone was very nice and polite! The prices were aligned to HCMC prices. The bathroom had some very beautiful flowers! Only positive impression 😊

author: Bigman
review_text: Came here to have my Dim sum with my friends - place is aircon and you get to pick your Dim sum and give it to the waiter with your table number Taste to me is so so only compare the other more popular dim sum outlets I still prefer the other Dim Sum taste

author: Dameain Mims
review_text: The food is excellent. I recommend the curry chicken or stew chicken but my favorite is the escovitch chicken it's a fried chicken in a hot pepper sauce with carrots and onions. I usually order the escovitch chicken with cabbage and yellow rice and veggies with the stew chicken gravy over the rice

author: Johnnie Victor Ferrer
review_text: We came to this restaurant which is quite near the villa we were staying at while in Mas Village in Ubud, Bali. Babi guling is one of the iconic food in Bali which I wanted my family to try. Apparently this is the 2nd time for me to be in this particular restaurant. I was also there before the pandemic, when I first went to Bali. Food was good. Although my family found the food quite spicy. The place hasn't changed as far as I could remember. It has this oldish feel which I think needs upgrading. Service is ok. We didn't wait that long before our orders were served.

author: Gilmanos 94
review_text: Celebrated Mother’s Day at Remboelan Grand Indonesia and had a great time. The ambience was comfortable and inviting, and the food featured flavors from different parts of Indonesia that were really enjoyable. Everything came together nicely, making it a relaxed yet special way to celebrate with family.

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: Yvonne L
review_text: Ordered 3 things for dinner, clear hot and sour sea fish soup, deep fried chicken wings and Singha beer. The fish soup is terrible. It is obviously not made to order, scooped up from a big pot of ready made soup. The fish was very firm and broth nothing special. The chicken wings are too sweet, nothing else. Beer is cold and good, however. Server also seems to have a little attitude. There are many better places to go for a good and enjoyable meal in Chiang Mai.

author: Nava Neetha
review_text: Food here was delicious!! The flavours were fresh and bold (and loved that we could ask for free flow vegetables that were crunchy and for more sauces). I was here 3 times in the 1 week I was in HCMC!! The service is excellent too. Would definitely recommend🤗

author: Rachael — home
review_text: Wow! A must visit hidden gem in Singapore! Clay pot chicken curry was the tastiest soul food ever! Great vibe with food and also vegetable market.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Gia Le
review_text: Pros: Tasty broth Great location Average portion Cons: Some of the meat (heart i think) was pretty tough.

author: Marvins Auto Care LLC
review_text: They didn't have cup holder, no plastic bags. I spilled my drink. I asked for a refill the manager at the night shift said I had to buy another drink. Other places would be ready with whatever we need as a customer and I would pay for another drink 🍻 f I had to but not with her attitude. I don't hate this place but I recommend other McDonald's better.

author: Neil
review_text: I ordered their fixed menu specialty, scallops (or salad),beef wellington, and sticky toffee pudding, $115. Everything was very good, they used to give you 5 scallops, now they give you 3. But the Beef Wellington is amazing, as is their Sticky Toffee Pudding. I'd recommend the Coco Old Fashioned too.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: KASI PHƯƠNG
review_text: 📍 Space: Spacious, airy seating, but no air conditioning so it can be a bit hot at noon. 🧾 Service: There are many staff so the food comes out quickly, but you have to order at the counter first so it's a bit inconvenient if you go with a large group. When I went, the restaurant was quite empty, I saw the staff gathered together talking to each other, it didn't affect anything but it was a bit unprofessional. 🍜 Food: depends on your taste: flavorful grilled meat, well-mixed fish sauce, fresh vegetables. 🛵 Parking: There is parking in the alley, free for customers eating at the restaurant - a big plus!

author: Edwin Ting
review_text: The waitress here is attentive and can converse in Mandarin fluently. You’ll be spoilt for choice when you see the menu, which includes exotic options like ant eggs. By the way this is a non-halal restaurant.

author: Tia Carden
review_text: The place is really nice and cute, good place to chill and read without being disturbed. Maybe cuz I was sitting outside in a corner but I didn’t actually get served after being seated for 30 mins… Loved the coffee, the eggs were great (bread a tad soggy but tbh that happens with avo toast) needed a bit more salt, the pain suisse was warmed which was so nice but could be more moist and flavourful. Overall cute just needs a lil bit more but definitely recommend for a coffee ☕️ 😌

author: Isis Adams
review_text: Probably the worst tasting so-called Puerto Rican food I’ve ever tasted in my life. All the food was bland and had no flavor. Spent $70 and I expected the food to be way better than what it is. I definitely will not go back.

author: Ally L
review_text: I regret looking at the menu for the purposes of this review because now I want to go again and I was planning on crossing off a few new places first. This was the first modern brunch-exclusive place in the South Bay. Before that, there were old school places like Bill's Cafe and Stacks in various locations. Also, Country Holder's Inn. Now, even though this place has churros inside horchatas, it still supplies very hearty food. It is not like those instagrammable places that sprung up later. The omelet, scrambles, and benedicts are amazing. They have at least 10 different types of benedicts and you can mix-n-match. I recommend the crab cake Benedict and the Neptune, which is scrambled eggs with crab and shrimp. Bit unorthodox but it's good to scramble things up, especially if you get two flavors. The New York Benedict is made with bagels if you want to switch up the bread. For the sides, I prefer the country potatoes over the hash browns here. The sweets are fine but just too sugary for my tastes. There's an option to choose 3 types, another combo they offer. It's limited to pancakes and French toast though. As you can see in my photos, it's quite a lot. The graham cracker really adds a nice touch. I don't remember those things tasting so good. My favorite of them all is the raspberry cream cheese stuffed French toast. I would say the last thing I have to talk about are their sandwiches. The club sandwich is so classic, comes with fries and a long pickle. The breakfast sandwich is made of grilled brioche and has hash browns, eggs, ham, bacon, cheese. It's good if you are feeling breakfast. Otherwise anything with grilled bread like the reuben or tuna melt are good options. The service can be so slow. There was only one designated waitress working the tables when we went. Very nice lady, though. The tables may get a little sticky and the wait is long on weekends if you don't go early. Last I went was an weekday afternoon at 2:30, right before they closed at 3 and it was pretty empty. They are pretty chill and don't rush you out.

author: PurpleGreen
review_text: Gave this place a try and overall it was alright. The fried rice dishes were acceptable and surprisingly had some wok hay which was nice. The petai fried rice could have had a stronger flavour but at least they were generous with the petai. The drinks were way too sweet, we had both hot and iced lemon tea and even after adding water they still tasted sweet. Overall a decent meal but there is room for improvement.

author: Ray Eguavoen
review_text: Elephante for lunch with a friend, and we did their $40 per person express lunch( one starter, one main, and one dessert). Even though it was overcast and the view wasn’t at its best, the food definitely delivered. The vodka pasta and branzino were the clear standouts. I also really enjoyed the calamari, though the balsamic aioli was a bit too bitter for my taste. I highly recommend asking for the lemon aioli instead. A must order is the whipped eggplant (not included in the express lunch). Overall, the express lunch is a great deal for the amount of food you get.

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Preston Wong
review_text: Our server Kim was friendly. Spoke English very well. Ambience was relaxed. Tourist hot spot. Ordered the stewed catfish (no picture), seafood fried rice, bokchoy veggies, banana flower salad & banana split. Food was tasty and not bland or over salty.

author: Ali Safarov
review_text: Stopped here for an early lunch. Great food, great service, great location—and of course, a great view! It was enjoyable sitting outside watching the boats. I had the Beef Empanada, Sandwich Kubano, and a beer. I’ll definitely recommend this restaurant.

author: Trung Chu
review_text: Tried Hanoi Kitchen recently and really enjoyed their Cà phê trứng Hà Nội (Vietnamese Egg Coffee). From the first sip, it was creamy, smooth, and comforting. Sitting outside on the street with a cup of egg coffee felt calm and peaceful, almost like being in Hanoi during a cool autumn morning. What impressed me most is that they do several authentic Hanoi dishes very well. The Chicken Pho, Hanoi Bun Thang (traditional Hanoi noodle soup), and Bun Cha (grilled pork with vermicelli) were all flavorful and tasted true to Hanoi style, which is not easy to find in Saigon. The restaurant is newly opened. I passed by before when it wasn’t open yet, so it’s nice to finally see it open. The location is also very convenient, within walking distance of Bui Vien Street, Ben Thanh Market, and close to Bánh Mì Huỳnh Hoa. A lovely place to enjoy real Hanoi flavors and take a relaxed break in District 1. Highly recommend for Hanoi food lovers.

author: Ari Soemedi
review_text: One of the best place to dine and meet. The staffs are very friendly and helpful. We stayed there till we are done and they wait for us

author: Ali Bakhsh
review_text: Contemporary Persian food with a lot of great menu options executed at a higher level. Overall I enjoyed my dining experience here, there wasn’t really a standout dish that blew me away.

author: Garrett R
review_text: This is one of my favorite lunch spots, especially as someone with a gluten allergy. They have lots of gluten-free options. I got the Christopher Robin on a gluten-free bagel and it was delicious. Sandwiches come with a small side of salad and breakfast potatoes which are both really good. I normally order ahead as it can be very busy in there. Seating can be limited because it is extremely popular and the inside is not huge so best to plan ahead. Would very much recommend.

author: David Ooi
review_text: The food portion is generous. Taste wise is also good. Additional request for tar tar sauce is served in a mini sos bowl and chargeable, dont do the mistake like us and ordered two 🤣. Order one cukuo, can share share yah Tried the vodka and malibu dessert. Nice

author: S Glover
review_text: A literal GEM in downtown Boston. Lobster rolls are everywhere but THIS place is one of a kind & truly special! Delicious food, tasty bevs, artsy decor & friendly staff all combine for the coolest vibe. Make this a priority stop when in Boston!

author: MEWilke MEWilke
review_text: This place is tightly packed with tables and quite popular even during weeknights, so we wish we had a reservation for our group of 5. They have a kids menu, which is rare in NYC, and the portions were substantial for both kid and adult plates. I thought the two fish dishes we got (salmon encrusted with mustard and pistachios and a whole halibut) were both prepared excellently though the sides of broccoli and spinach were overcooked and not flavorful. My favorite part of the meal was their outstanding, homemade Napoleon. Service was great. Definitely will return!

author: Arvin Rahmatian
review_text: Persian here, food was amazing with PLENTY of options. We got the family platter and it was at a great price and plenty. I cannot stress how AMAZING our waiters were, they were nice and very funny. One of them even were so nice they called someone famous who I like, I didn’t even ask them or anything. They just were so nice because they realized that I liked the person, but I didn’t even say anything. This completely made my day. He even told my family amazing stories.

author: Jared Byrne
review_text: I was in this area for one night, a (not very busy) Monday in June 2024, as a part of a work trip; and myself and a colleague stumbled on San Pedro Square Market. The market turned into a highlight of my time in this area, as the food (and service) was good, there were lots of food options (I'll have to come back and try some other vendors), the location was clean, and the entertainment (a band) was good as well. I can't speak to the comparative price of the food (I only spent one night in this area), but it seemed reasonable for a California restaurant. As noted, I had a great experience and, because I'd love to come back to the San Pedro Square Market, I would recommend this location to anyone visiting the area.

author: Fairraiting
review_text: Highly recommended! Very friendly staff, the server was great! She checked on us all the time. They deserve every penny you give 💗

author: Olga Bobykina
review_text: This place is a hidden gem! Food is delicious I always come back for my favourite dish and take coffee with a bottle of homemade cashew milk. Atmosphere is so calm. A lot of places to sit. TheJoi never disappoints me ☺️

author: Benedict Chua
review_text: Servers were readily available and took orders rapidly. The porridge smooth, had a claypot taste to it which was unique; higher end restaurants sometimes use milk to smooth out the texture. The frog was really fresh, springy and chewy, with the cartilage still crunchy. Bad part is for flavours wise, it is be-your-own-chef and add your own amounts of soy sauce and ginger. So you do not really get to know the chef’s skill.

author: richard g
review_text: Had high hopes with lovelys chicken almost as high as the prices, yet was extremely disappointed. The chicken wasn't even tenders like I ordered and were some reheated old stale chicken that was hard as a rock. Then the waffle was dryey than the dessert. Absolutely terrible food worst chicken I've received in LA.

author: John Papazoglou
review_text: My girlfriend and I went for an early Valentine’s Day date. Our sever was Michael L he was amazing created a wonderful experience and went above and beyond to ensure we had a great time. I asked Michael if you could cater our experience and he did deliver. The food was amazing and the experience was better. Thank you for the great time!

author: Monica Tj
review_text: One of the well-known babi guling spots in the Ubud area. The place is slightly hidden inside (need to walk past the narrow aisle), but it’s quite spacious with a nice greenery view. In terms of taste, it didn’t quite hit the mark for me. The spices weren’t as strong and flavorful for my liking. The fried pork were a bit tough (alot), but the meat is tender and plenty. The highlight was definitely the crispy pork skin - BEST I've eaten. If you come too late, the lawar might be sold out and they will replace it with sayur labu. Oh and the soup is similar with sop sayur with carrots and green beans. The price is quite steep (tax included), and fyi they only accept cash payments.

author: Filip Świercz
review_text: Thanks to Susana, I’m giving this place 5 stars. I met the manager(probably), and he wanted to serve my coffee in a paper cup because of some rule. Honestly, if it wasn’t for Susana, I would have left a negative review — when you pay over $4 for a coffee, you don’t expect to drink it like it’s from a vending machine. Luckily, Susana really cares about the restaurant’s good reputation and made sure I had a great experience.

author: Felix C
review_text: Overrated. Need to call the waiter a few times when ordering and pay bills. If you like smooth chicken then it's not to your taste. Hor fun is average taste. You can get better chicken and Hor fun else where.

author: Carolyn Bradford
review_text: Took my 18 year old son to eat breakfast where I used to eat breakfast when I was pregnant with him when I worked downtown however the food wasn't as good anymore neither was the atmosphere. However our waitress was very sweet. I probably will not go back

author: D J
review_text: The food was average. It didn't have a lot of flavor. The grape leaves were the best item for the taste that we ordered. The beef kabob wasn't char grilled which made a difference in the taste I am used to getting. While eating the heating ventilation system kicked on and was horribly loud. We left early because of the loud noise. You couldn't hear the other person talk. I expected a lot more for the price point of the dinner. We did not get any free soup as others outlined in their reviews. We asked for a glass of water and was told we would be dissatisfied with the tap water and to order the bottle of water for $2. Somehow I don't think they will be in business for long. I won't be returning soon.

author: Nick Diamantidis
review_text: I would definitely recommend this restaurant. The food was excellent, and the staff were very friendly. Matias did his best to take great care of us. We will certainly come back again!

author: Lilliana Vallejo
review_text: Food and drinks were really good, and the hookah was yummy and smooth The staff were really sweet as well But honestly, all the stars are because of the DJ,, he was AMAZING and completely set the vibe for the night. The music, energy, and overall atmosphere were on point. Definitely made the experience i was bumping

author: Jalayla Red
review_text: I had one of the worst customer service experiences I’ve ever encountered at this Wingstop location, and I feel compelled to share it—not just for myself, but as a warning to others. I walked in and waited in line for over 15 minutes. When it was finally my turn, the employee Edwin completely ignored me and allowed two women who arrived after me to cut in front and place their order. He didn’t ask who was next, didn’t acknowledge me, and when I spoke up, he brushed me off with, “I already started their order,”—as if that made it okay to skip someone who had been clearly waiting. I’m a Black customer, and the women he served first were Hispanic—like him—and while I can’t say for certain, it felt very personal. Whether it was discrimination, favoritism, or just plain disrespect, it was unprofessional, rude, and deeply uncomfortable. This experience completely changed the way I view this location. If you’re someone who expects to be treated with basic respect and fairness—especially if you’re a person of color—you may want to think twice before coming here. No one deserves to be disregarded, dismissed, or made to feel less than because of who they are. I truly hope corporate takes this seriously. Edwin’s behavior is unacceptable and reflects very poorly on the brand. Until there’s accountability and proper training at this location, I won’t be returning—and I suggest others don’t either.

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: Connie Lim
review_text: Went here today to give a try, food was okay. But the service of a short, black hair uncle was super unfriendly. Understand that being a hawker is not an easy job, honestly, which job is easy? We’re not your scolding bag, as I couldn’t find the chili plate, the uncle could have say nicely instead of replying you cannot see? Walk over there and see yourself. I mean I am okay to walk over; but the tone seems like i own him a thousand bucks. Improve your service. Nobody’s job is easy. If I could rate the service, it will be ZERO!

author: Ami Lanning
review_text: One of the best burgers I’ve ever had. Great truffle fries and fried pickles, too. My parents had the chicken sandwich and the meatball sub, and they said everything was delicious. Great, fast and friendly service. Hey Wahlburgers, open some locations in PA, please!!

author: Darsshan Parmar
review_text: Milk & Madu is a lovely café and a great place to relax in Ubud. Location: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (5/5) Very convenient and easy to reach, making it a perfect stop while exploring Ubud. Taste: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4/5) The food is fresh and well-prepared with good flavors. Plenty of options to choose from. Ambiance: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4/5) Comfortable, lively, and welcoming. A nice balance between relaxed café vibes and a social atmosphere. Service: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ (4/5) Friendly staff and fairly quick service. Additional highlights: • Parking available • Free Wi-Fi • Cash and cards accepted • Vegan & vegetarian options available • Live music performances, which add to the overall experience Overall, a great café in Ubud for good food, good vibes, and a pleasant time 🎶☕

author: I komang Budiarta
review_text: Had an amazing experience at Crate Canggu! I ordered a salad and a smoothie bowl, and both were delicious. The ingredients tasted really fresh, the flavors were balanced, and the presentation was on point. The café has such a cool vibe with friendly staff and a great atmosphere. Highly recommend for anyone looking for healthy and tasty options in Canggu.

author: Tom Kennedy
review_text: Be careful that you’re not being ripped off by the server. I dropped into What Da Pho on a quiet Friday mid-afternoon for a pho (10/10/2025). I was the only customer. For this time of day the restaurant offers a discount; Half price. That’s a good deal. Except, when it came to paying for my discount pho. The discounted price appeared on the display and it was then changed by the server to the full price. I enquired why it changed to the full price and the sever told me the the discount price was a mistake. I had the sense forethought to take a screenshot of the discount offered at the time I placed my order and showed it to the server. The server, knowing that he’d been caught lying, glumly corrected the total without offering an apology. My guess is that that the server thought a tourist wouldn’t question his deception. To the server: think about the choices you make in life. Best of luck. For everybody else: Beware.

author: Paris
review_text: I truly love this buffet, they have it all sea food, sushi, hibachi and everything in between. If your in the mood for buffet style asain cuzine this is the place, especially if your local!

author: Kasemsan Predaboon
review_text: Amazing Thai noodles served with high quality ingredients. Strongly recommend to order beef tongue. Very soft as if it could melt in your mouth!

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Van Cao
review_text: The noodle soup was delicious. The beef noodle soup tasted a little too much MSG, but it was still good. The iced tea had a strong, bitter taste.

author: Carlos “Carlos H Mencia” Mencia
review_text: Place is a great quaint cafe I got breakfast in. Food was excellent along with the service and ambience. Definitely recommend going here if you want to have a good breakfast. My server Fabriccio was excellent server making sure food was on time and we were always comfortable. He was also not intrusive just checking the right amount of times.

author: Siti Fairuz
review_text: Finally made the trip to Village Park in Uptown! The famous Nasi Lemak definitely lives up to the hype—it is perfectly balanced. The sambal isn't too spicy, sweet, or salty; it sits right in the middle and pairs perfectly with the rice and fried chicken. We also ordered the Rendang Kerang (cockles) to share, which was amazing and had a really balanced taste as well. The Kaya Toast and soft-boiled eggs were standard, a decent add-on if you want variety. I arrived around 11:30 AM and the queue took about 15–30 minutes, but it was absolutely worth the wait. Despite the crowd, the service is efficient and the food arrives very fast. Highly recommended!

author: Maria
review_text: Happy New Year... Enjoyed a fantastic meal... The swinging tomahawk was a hit. Igly, our waiter, was exceptional... A gift card and recommendation from my son Markie made it special. Grateful for the experience.

author: Antonio T
review_text: Why, why, WHY did I wait so long to come back to Carson Kitchen? This place has officially become one of my absolute favorite restaurants in Las Vegas — downtown or Strip. I first discovered it years ago during a New Year’s trip with visiting friends from Boston, and I still remember being blown away. After taking a year-long break from downtown Vegas, I recently returned… and instantly regretted staying away for so long. Carson Kitchen is tucked away behind one of the most nondescript entrances in downtown Las Vegas. My limo drove past twice before I realized the place was right in front of me. Hidden in plain sight — and I love that about it. Inside, the vibe is warm, friendly, and genuinely welcoming. Downtown staff always feel more grounded than the Strip, but Carson Kitchen takes it to another level. It almost feels small-town — think Biddeford, Maine or Snyder, Texas — smack in the middle of Vegas. Over the years I’ve come with everything from parties of nine (five kids and teens — the pickiest eaters on earth) to smaller family outings. Every time, the food hits. Here are the essentials: ⭐ Must-Order Dishes • Bacon Jam This is next-level. Served sizzling with a strip of baked brie running through the middle. I’ve had bacon jams all over the country — this one is truly artisanal. An automatic order every time. • Fried Chicken Skins My whole family demands two orders right away. I grew up partly in Indonesia where this is normal fare, and Carson Kitchen nails it. Crunchy, savory comfort food with smoked honey dipping sauce. If you’re a chicken-skin person, this is heaven. • Pork Belly My wife’s forever favorite — perfectly rich and flavorful. • Deviled Eggs My oldest son insists on these every visit. • Chicken Thighs A recent new favorite. The charred chicken pairs with an Alabama-style mustard BBQ sauce that brings way more depth and complexity than expected. This is joining the permanent rotation. The Finale: Glazed Donut Bread Pudding The absolute showstopper. If dessert could be described as soft, bouncy, moist, warm, creamy perfection — this is it. I’ve said it before: we could’ve ordered nothing but nine of these and everyone would’ve been thrilled. Still my top dessert in all of Las Vegas. Final Verdict Carson Kitchen delivers consistently fantastic food, warm hospitality, and a downtown vibe that’s casual, elevated, and refreshingly genuine. After coming back recently with my family, I’m kicking myself for staying away for a year. Highly recommend — and I’ll be returning regularly.

author: Andy B
review_text: If you’re searching for a dining experience that combines mouthwatering food with outstanding service, look no further than Delicias Colombianas in Hyde Park. From the moment you step inside, you're enveloped by the inviting atmosphere that radiates warmth and authenticity. The decor reflects the vibrant culture of Colombia, and it sets the perfect backdrop for the culinary journey that awaits.! Each dish is a masterpiece, bursting with flavors that transport you straight to the heart of Colombia. Whether it's the arepas, empanadas, or the traditional bandeja paisa, every bite delivers an explosion of taste and a comforting familiarity that keeps drawing me back for more. But what truly sets Delicias Colombianas apart is the incredible service, and that’s where Caroline shines! Every time I visit, she greets me with a warm smile and genuine enthusiasm that instantly makes me feel welcome. Caroline's attentiveness and personal touch elevate the meal to a whole new level; she's never too far away when you need something but also knows the perfect moments to check in, allowing for both personal interaction and the space to enjoy your meal. In short, Delicias Colombianas Hyde Park is a culinary gem, and with service like Caroline’s, it’s a destination I wholeheartedly recommend to anyone seeking authentic Colombian cuisine in a friendly and welcoming environment. Treat yourself to a meal here — you won't be disappointed!

author: Klyde Bacala
review_text: We came here to celebrate my father-in-law's 60th birthday with the whole family. We were ushered upstairs to a very nice private space that could sit 10-15 people. The whole atmosphere was pleasant and suprisingly kid friendly as we had a total of 4 children. We had the fine dining set order by candlelights. Our server was Rudy and his team, they were very welcoming, fun, and hospitable. Food wise, we started off with Mahi Mahi with potato bread. This for me was probably the best combination of bread and dipping sauce. The Mahi Mahi was marvelous, very creamy with that hint of fishy taste at every bite. It was a wholesome experience. Then came the tuna tartelette and jamom croquette. The tartelette was zingy and flavourful as a mouthful, I personally liked that. The croquette was creamy and blended perfectly with the saltiness of the jamon. As for the ceviche, it was alright though, my famumily had the same sentiments. We probably expected it to be a bit more sour and vinegarey, but this one somehow lacked a bit of those elements for our liking, some even commented it tasting a little sweet. Now for the shared mains, we had dry aged grouper, lamb shoulder, and potato mille. Not many of us appreciated the grouper, although it was presented well and had that crispy skin, we found the meat a tad bit mushy in some parts. The lamb was a delight though, very soft, almost a melt-in-your-mouth kind of attempt. It tasted a little gamey, but we all were used which we didn't mind at all. On that note, most of us wished it was a potato mash instead of mille. We thought it would've been a more rounded pairing with the lamb. But the mille was crunchy and soft inside, we all liked it. Finally, as a dessert person, my winner would probably be the churros. It had that perfect crunch and soft core. The dulce de leche was a nice touch as it melts the chocolate on top of the churros. The amalgamation of all the components in this dessert was very well executed. It was a delightful experience altogether. The staff also prepared a candle for my father-in-law to blow, and they catered very well to the children. Our team of servers were very fun and accommodating. This definitely made our whole experience a comfortable and memorable one. The restaurant should be proud of their staff, very kind and go above and beyond. We highly recommend this restaurant if you want to try a fine-dining experience with its own flair and genuine service!

author: Wittapon Jawjit
review_text: This is a great place to find many traditional Chinese dishes. You can find a branch of a Michelin-starred noodle shop, classic Singaporean pancake, fish ball soup, and many more!!

author: Gilo
review_text: Found this place through a social media review and really pleased we visited! A proper local plate of food — tender, slow-cooked suckling pig with a generous square of crackling, accompanied by a spicy sausage and a tasty local vegetable dish. It’s a very simple, no-frills spot but centrally located with quick, friendly service. The flavours were spot on — not too spicy, just enough to give it a lift. If I’m being picky, the pork was a touch on the dry side and the crackling could have done with that final blast of heat for extra crunch. But overall, definitely worth a visit — I probably just arrived with expectations set sky-high!

author: Renee Davis
review_text: okay so this place has really good boneless wings. crispy. but they literally get the order wrong every time. they handed me bone in wing and this is a COMMON occurrence i saw the reviews and they do this so often i thought it was just a fluke but literally happened to me. i would be so annoyed if i got home and didn’t notice. but luckily i did before i left. also they take like 20 mins to cook 5 boneless wings not normal. also they charged me for the boneless wings and it’s basically the same price to add fries as a combo but they won’t tell you that… bc they want you to spend money. kinda shitty would give service one star but it’s not like they cussed me out they were nice just kinda slow at everything

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: buck low
review_text: Usually we only eat BKT in Port Klang and seldom in other places. But bcos it was raining, we wanted to find something with soup. And so glad we had this. Can easily rival with any top BKT shops in Port Klang and anywhere else. Their dried one is a must try.

author: Ashley
review_text: Nice venue, drinks were very good. Street parking. Food was decent definitely would return.

author: Brendan Thomas
review_text: EDit 1/6/2024: I updated my review to reflect a few changes I noticed since I first wrote this. I was one of the first to eat from here when it opened five years ago in the former D'Angelo's location. They food is outstanding, the service is friendly and the space is VERY clean. That's where the compliments stop unfortunately. Three and a half years after the Pandemic closed the dining area, I was able to use the dining area myself. The staff person I spoke to said they reopened the dining area "a while ago" but I saw no proof or evidence of that--as in customers eating in--until I finally asked a few months ago. It would help if they simply posted signs saying indoor dining is open again. I have no idea why they never did that much so people can know.The only possible explaination I can think of at this point is they got used to not having to bother cleaning those spaces several times a day. . That aside, the prices on the entrees and even side items have been gradually increasing without notice. When they first opened in 2018, the Oxtail plate came in three size options (Small, Medium and Large). In the summer of 2019 they announced due to rising prices on oxtail meat, they were dropping their Small and Large options for the Oxtail and would sell the Medium at a higher price in a styrofoam container. It started at $18 and is now $24. About two years ago, they brought back the Small size that started at $11 and is now 14. I like their Oxtail but I'm not willing to pay $24 for a "Medium" Oxtail. I'm better off buying the meat and cooking it myself in that case (and you can buy raw Oxtail meat at some meat markets in the Boston area). It's sad that Only One has decided to pass those rising costs onto their customers, most of whom they know live in the neighborhood--myself included. Other entrees have also had price increases in recent years. The pandemic sucked for everyone financially. People get you need to be profitable to stay in business and pay your employees but this is really pushing it. One myth/rumor I've heard for a while that I can personally confirm is NOT true is some think the food is cooked at another location and brought there. This is NOT true. All food is cooked on site in the kitchen in the back. The food is SAFE, Sanitary and good. They also take custom requests on all orders within reason. For example if you want to mix and match certain items in the same plate, you can. Just ask. On that last point, here's a tip you can use at not just Only One but any other West Indian restaurant that plates the food in front of you: If you want more, speak up. That's how you get more bang for your buck. I always tell them to drown the rice with gravy no matter what I order for example. I don't like my rice dry but I know others only prefer enough sauce to cover the meat. One time the sever looked at me like I was crazy and I said "I'm paying for it and I'll eat it, keep going." My mother tells them not to skimp on the meat which they will if you let them. Why should you pay $14 for a Small Curry Goat with mostly bones for example? It's something to think about. When in doubt, see how others order their food and take cues from them. I live in the neighborhood and walk there but the very limited parking is shared with the other businesses including the health center. If you don't mind walking a little, you can park in the Shaws Parking Lot. More so if you plan to eat in.

author: Denella Gaona
review_text: We live right down the street and never knew this place existed. We went yesterday and were so impressed. Right when u walk in, it's absolutely gorgeous, nice, cool, clean, and smells great. The food was delicious, and the waitress was very attentive. We were impressed with this restaurant so much. It's a bit out of eyesight, so you don't see it right away. But I really recommend this place if anyone wants some great Mexican food.

author: L G
review_text: Needs to be faster... Two times I've been there and both were 30-40 minutes wait to get the food to go.

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: Emily Ho
review_text: Food wasn't as good as other hawker centres. The char kway tiao had little ingredients and no wok hei. Just lots of fried carbs. The satay was decent but there are better ones. Rojak had too much sauce in it, not much fruits and the you tiao was hard, asked for spicy but the sauce wasn't very spicy. Wouldn't waste calories at this hawker. centre.

author: Joshua Cooke
review_text: Came here with some friends and tried many different dishes from the tapas menu. Most of them were very good and we enjoyed the experience. I liked trying things that I normally wouldn't have ordered by myself. The staff was very attentive. Pictured below is the baked potatoes, hangar steak, fried calamari, empanadas, and avocado crab salad.

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: 박애정
review_text: I found this place on Google for its delicious banh mi. It wasn't the typical sandwich-style banh mi you'd expect from a Korean, but it was delicious. I dipped the banh mi in a rich, rice noodle soup, reminiscent of hangover soup. It was absolutely delicious. My two children, ages 10 and 5, loved it! Highly recommended as a true local favorite!

author: Chris Ayers
review_text: Exceptional burgers & fried chicken sandwiches at this small stand. Eat your lunch and watch the happenings on Eastern Ave.

author: Michelle T
review_text: The food was terrible the service was terrible everything was cool we told him to heat it up it took them forever we ended up getting up and leaving

author: harrymik100
review_text: This is one of my favorite places to eat. I come here for breakfast, but I will stop in from time to time for the fresh baked goods. The pan de bono, the empanada, the buñuello, are perfect. The coffee is great, and perfect with one of the baked goods, but even better with a hot breakfast. My favorite is the Calentado Paisa. Grilled sirloin steak, scrambled eggs with tomato and onion, rice and beans, served with arepa with cheese. The chicharron is the best I have ever had, also. If you have a big appetite or even for two people, the Super Bandeja. It is a little of everything, and a great way to find out how amazing it all is. I noticed the people don't only come here for the food either. The Chef/Owner, Miguel, will come out and greet guests, and they love him. His sister Erica takes care of the restaurant side and is so hospitable. She knows almost every guest by name. She will burst out singing from time to time, and if you are there to catch it, it's amazing. Definitely check this place out for amazing hospitality, service, and even better food.

author: 권희윤
review_text: Lila and Coline were always there for me, helping with everything and bringing so much laughter to my family. They truly touched my heart. Lila, especially, impressed me with her kindness and the sincerity she puts into everything she does. Her smile stayed in my mind—it made every moment brighter. I truly hope that they are always happy, because they deserves that and more. The food and music were wonderful too, but what made this place special was them. I wish I could stay at this hotel even longer, just to keep this warm feeling a little more.

author: Debbie Gettler
review_text: Fabulous vibe, great food and outstanding service by Stu! Highly recommend the wings , fries and cadillac margaritas. Perfection with a lovely ocean view. We will definitely be back.

author: Susy “REALTOR” Velazquez
review_text: Loved it! The atmosphere at Roberta’s is rustic and inviting, creating the perfect setting for a great meal. We tried four different pizzas, and each one was delicious. The flavors were well-balanced, the crust was perfect, and everything tasted fresh. Highly recommend for anyone looking for good pizza in Brooklyn!

author: Ambi Glass

author: Jeanne Herawati

author: Morgana Lamb
review_text: Food was amazing. We ordered the burrata Parma Margherita and the 5 cheese pizza and it was delicious. The staff were very friendly and kind. Delivered the order so quick, was impressed. Prices are great and service wonderful. I really recommend this place! We did not have a table reserved as we found this place last minute but they gently accommodated us at the bar and we had a brilliant experience. 10/10

author: Farra Natalea
review_text: had breakfast at Milk & Madu Beach Road and absolutely loved it! I ordered their Super Brekky Bowl — a beautiful mix of tropical fruits, quinoa granola, yoghurt, goji, chia, cacao, bee pollen, flaxseed, nuts, coconut, and honey — and it was so yummy and refreshing! Super healthy yet really satisfying. I also had a flat white, and the coffee was excellent — smooth and well-balanced. The service was fast and friendly, and the staff were attentive even though the café was busy. Overall, it’s a great spot for a healthy breakfast or brunch with good vibes and quality coffee. Definitely a must-visit when you’re in Canggu!

author: Monica King
review_text: The food is great and the staff are so nice. Very helpful helping me with my selections.

author: Apple Galaxy
review_text: We went to Chinatown and ate at Bangkok street food. There was a lady who serenaded everybody while they were eating. I ordered the orange chicken and my wife had the garlic chicken. I highly recommend going there! The food was everything I thought it would be!

author: How Foong
review_text: Fuiyoh! I finally found this restaurant, is the building tower at Level 7 beside Pavillion Mall, not the level 7 in Pavillion Mall. Fuiyoh! author: Tan Soo Xian
review_text: Reasonable price for a all-you-can-eat buffet style hotpot and grill; provided meat and some seafood. A bit hard to get parking and the location is hidden behind the shop lot and housing area.

author: Phatt H.
review_text: 🍟 Fries: Absolutely delightful — crispy, golden, and clearly made from real potatoes. They’re the kind of fries you’ll crave again. 🦆 Duck Confit: Honestly, this dish didn’t quite wow me. It’s decent, but I’m looking forward to trying other menu highlights. 🍰 Mille-Feuille: Loved it! Each layer was perfectly crisp, and the cream was just the right amount of sweet — not too overpowering. A truly elegant dessert. 📖 Menu Variety: The restaurant offers a wide selection of dishes, and I can’t wait to come back and explore more. ✨ Ambience: Beautiful setting — cozy yet sophisticated. Perfect for a casual lunch or a special dinner.

author: James
review_text: This is possibly the most hyped pizza spot in a city that's known for pizza, so I had to make my way over here to this Brooklyn spot. The line was present, but not too long - about 15-20 minutes or so I got the Burrata slice, which is just a basic cheese pizza, with some burrata on top If I had one word to describe this slice - it would be light. It was so thin, and so easy to eat. There wasn't an excess of anything - cheese, sauce, or thickness. The dough was probably my favorite part. The air bubbles near the top showed how well-fermented the dough was. It was very airy and fluffy overall. The only downside was I thought the bottom could've been cooked a bit more - it was missing that cracker-like crunch associated with other NY pizzas. While still cooked well - there was a good char on the bottom, better than most places, it wasn't quite at that absolute top level The mix of cheese & sauce over the top was very high quality. Like mentioned before, there wasn't a lot of it. I think I prefer a pizza with more cheese as it's a little bit plain for me, but the fundamental aspects of each ingredient are fantastic. I thought the cornicone on the outside was also very good The burrata topping was very nice, and probably the highlight for me. It's not something you see at most classic pizza places, and it added a super creamy nature to the sections where it was present This pizza cost me around $7, so it's on the slightly more expensive side when compared to a typical slice. I would say it's enough for a light meal, but don't expect it to keep you full for long. Overall, I think this pizza is excellent, and one of the best individual slices I've had. The artisan style is impressive, but if given the choice, I think I'd stick to the more classic NY-style variety. 9/10

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: Caleb Tan
review_text: Affordable tze char in the east! Their signature beehoon is really good. Didn’t get to try their crabs cause it was sold out so we had the slipper lobsters instead. Very crowded so might need to queue if you don’t have a reservation. They have multiple seating areas spread across different units. Hard to find parking so need to park at a small open air carpark 5 mins walk away.

author: Nivic Aun
review_text: Stepping into Dim Sum Delight is like entering a culinary paradise for dim sum lovers. This cozy eatery offers an authentic and unforgettable dining experience, perfect for both seasoned dim sum enthusiasts and newcomers alike. The ambiance is warm and inviting, with traditional decor that exudes charm and a hint of nostalgia. The layout is designed to encourage a communal dining experience, making it a great place for gatherings with family and friends. The service at Dim Sum Delight is top-notch. The staff are friendly, attentive, and efficient, ensuring that your dining experience is smooth and enjoyable. They are knowledgeable about the menu and happy to make recommendations, which is especially helpful given the wide variety of dishes available. The star of the show, of course, is the dim sum. Each dish is a testament to culinary excellence, crafted with fresh ingredients and cooked to perfection. The menu offers a great balance of classic favorites and unique creations, ensuring there’s something to please every palate. Overall, Chokdee Dim Sum is a must-visit for anyone looking to savor the best of dim sum. With its welcoming atmosphere, excellent service, and mouthwatering dishes, it promises a dining experience that you’ll want to repeat time and again.

author: Maria Colomy
review_text: Super cute place - excellent service. Bacon could’ve been cooked a lot more - crispy is best lol… Would visit again- they had a huge menu. Had the BLT with a side of fried zucchini - it was fast, fresh, and the servers were super fast and friendly.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Eddy
review_text: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh at New Bridge Road is one of those places I keep coming back to, and it never disappoints. This particular outlet is my favorite. It sits on a corner shophouse, open and airy, with a very comfortable feel even when it is busy. I have never dined at their other branches because this one already feels just right for me. The atmosphere here is simple and welcoming. Natural airflow, high ceilings, and the classic shophouse charm make the whole meal more enjoyable. It feels relaxed and unpretentious, exactly how bak kut teh should be enjoyed. The star of the show is, of course, the bak kut teh. The peppery broth is bold, aromatic, and deeply satisfying. Every sip warms you up and keeps you reaching for more. The pork is tender and cooked just right, soaking up all that beautiful peppery goodness. It is the kind of dish that tastes consistent every single time, which is why I always enjoy eating here. The sides deserve special mention. Honestly, do not skip them. The sides here elevate the whole experience. From the ones I ordered, they are easily some of the best sides you can pair with bak kut teh. Each dish complements the soup perfectly and adds variety to the meal. I really recommend ordering the sides generously, as they make the table feel complete. Apologies for my photos, as a few side dishes were missing when I took them. We also had the braised pork samchan and intestines served on one plate, which were rich, flavorful, and very well done. There was also the trio of boiled peanuts and tofu, plus one more item on the same plate that slipped my mind, all comforting and nicely seasoned. And of course, the dough fritters are a must. Dipping them into the hot soup is one of the best parts of the meal. Song Fa Bak Kut Teh at New Bridge Road remains my go-to spot for bak kut teh in Singapore. Great food, a comfortable setting, and consistently satisfying flavors. This is one of those places I will always return to without hesitation. Highly recommended.

author: Lillie Marshall
review_text: Awesome experience trying The Ride (their epic tasting menu) at their new larger location! Delicious, fun food, lovely staff, and great vibe. Incredible deal for how much food you get — I took home most of a pizza (never seen a whole pizza in a multi-course tasting menu!) and entire second dessert. Eating the leftovers the next day was wonderful, too! Highly recommend.

author: Scarelion Tanned
review_text: Their Lo Mee no joke….thick and slurpy! Bonus points for self serve garlic and chilies 🤤

author: I. Molnar
review_text: Great selection of sushi for dinner or lunch AYCE! My favorites are baked muscles and nigiri salmon egg, also the hand rolls are pretty good. Fresh fish, well made. For the price you get top for your dollar, so dont expect some royalty ikra and real lobster, but there wont be any shortages of goods... Mochi mango for dessert was delicious and just scratched the right spot. Place is clean and well designed. Would definitely come back!! Update: I did come back and ordered the Gigi, No Name, and Flamingo. Reason is, Ive seen you can order them only once. Absolutely delicious sushi rolls! A MUST TRY! Now I know what Im ordering until I get tired of it :D

author: Debra Doyle
review_text: The bartender was very rude! She had horrible customer service skills! I will not be going back there!

author: Shelby Schwilke
review_text: This is one of those places where you walk in and you just know that you're comfortable there. The food is awesome and the services as well. For the couple of times I have been there the machines have not been very nice to me though. That is no fault of ichabods though. That's why they call it gambling.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Heather Martin
review_text: We moved to the neighborhood recently and have gone to The Hive a couple of times now and definitely plan on making this a weekly treat. So far we have had: hot PSL, iced PSL, Green Hornet Smoothie, the Açaí berry champ smoothie, and the breakfast sandwich with bacon. Everything we’ve tried has been yummy. Cute and quiet little coffee shop in MDR. Pricing can vary depending on if you just get drinks or if you get drinks and food. For 2 beverages and 1 breakfast sandwich we spent about $45

author: andronicus pannell
review_text: Their sweet potato casserole is thee BEST in the world!!!! You can order a whole turkey or ham holiday meal for small and big families or for a giant crowd with their online catering. It's just me and all I wanted was gooey, marshmallow sweet potatoes. But Their website when I tried to order the sweet potato casserole online it wouldn't allow me to pick it up the next day but for like a week later. But I went inside today and the manager said I could get it today. So there I was scooping up buckets of sweet potato casserole. It was a marshmallow mess. I could of took a bath in the stuff. Ha ha ha They only have this during the holidays and I highly recommend you stock up on it while you can. I'm sure you can freeze it and have some other than the Holidays. And it's to long a wait until next Thanksgiving/ Christmas. OMG It is SOOOOOO good. It really is the best ANYWHERE. I'm having mine for breakfast, lunch, dinner, snack, late night snack. Thank you to the manager during lunch on Dec. 9, 2025 and to the cashier. Thank you for allowing me to grab it today and not wait a week. Your the best!!!! I'm in sweet potato casserole heaven!!!!!

author: Fathin Yusuf
review_text: Trying the oldest nasi kandar restaurant in Malaysia! Service is fast even though long queue. Bought lamb shank RM55, tiger prawn 2 pcs RM90 and two sets of nasi kandar (rice, thick curry soup, lady finger), beef murtabak and drinks. Total RM167.80. You can dine in here as they were a lot of tables (3 floor shop). Overall is a good experience!

author: Dru Lu
