review_text: Ordered the grilled giant prawn and crabs which are the most expensive items here. But they grilled the crap out of it, till the point there’s no moisture left in the meat and it’s like tasting prawn jerky. The crab meat was so dry you can hardly get any meat from the claw. Do not order!

author: Anuj Bhatia
review_text: Good food and fast service, middle of boston with gold theme amazing atmosphere

author: Emilio Gonzalez
review_text: Amazing places good food and really nice services. The waitresses are super friendly definitely is a place you most come

author: rose jojie
review_text: The chef used to be good. Now it's changed a lot but the price is the cheapest. You can eat it. Big chicken. Ice Milos water if you ask...you can. Don't ask for it. Overall it's okay.

author: Nadim Ahmed
review_text: Truly the best authentic restaurant in the area, with a huge menu. The staff is incredibly nice and always a pleasure to interact with. I always go here for halal food whether Pakistani, Mexican, Moroccan, Persian, or American style. Their Pakistani chai is the best in the city without a doubt. Also, they have a dedicated prayer space available for anybody that needs it

author: Marco Marcheggiani
review_text: Wow a real German restaurant in Brooklyn. Their food looks amazing and delectable! Beer, beer, beer…so gut!

author: Ticha Pescod
review_text: We dined here twice during our stay in Bangkok and both times were a great experience. Firstly we found it by chance hidden away in the north west corner of Siam paragon floor M. The staff were friendly and attentive and the menu had photos and English descriptions so it was easy to find what you wanted. There are some impressively visual dishes and the coconut dessert is a unique and tasty option. The second time we booked a table and took a friend as there were lots of options. Well worth a visit if you want an extra special experience.

author: Cami Tussie
review_text: Love this place, always my go to for fresh food on Newbury that tastes delicious. The zucchini chips are DIVINE. A must get when they are made fresh (some days you aren’t as lucky but it’s a risk worth taking). My favorite is the horiatiki salad with charred eggplant. The keftedes are so good. I wasn’t a fan of the Brussels sprouts, just to note, but truly you can’t go wrong with Greco. Expensive for fast casual but so much better than so many other options on newbury

author: Mary Curry
review_text: The food was average and the server took forever just to come and take our order and forever to bring our drinks. The view of the water and activities around the restaurant was good.

author: Carol NS
review_text: The food is delicious. The place is spacious. The service is friendly.

author: Mark Menensez
review_text: Dumpling house is one of many dim sum restaurants here in San Fransisco but to me, and a lot of people, highly regarded as one of if not the best in the city. Not only is it easy on your wallet but the food was so delicious and comforting. Biting into some of the food felt like being a baby cradled by your mother with a blanket on a cold day. It was seriously all so delicious but my favorite dishes were the chicken wings and the bbq pork bun. I cannot describe how good those wings were but I sadly didn’t take a picture but please, take my word for it, it’s worth every single penny.

author: Steven Teo
review_text: This is my second time dining at this restaurant. I felt the food does not live up to the hype. The curry and gravy lacked of flavour and is not as good as many other nadi kandar that I have visited. And it's quite pricey too. Overall, I will say it's average.

author: GA EUN AN
review_text: really good taste, like Korean chicken noodle soup. everything goes well with Korean taste, and feel healthy

author: Brian C.J. Chang
review_text: Crab Meat Curry and Crab Roe Glass Noodle are the standout dishes. The Creamy Scallops are just average. Overall, it’s definitely worth a visit.

author: Fuentes
review_text: The birria was amazing, very flavorful and the service was exceptional, pleasant music in the background was gratifying. I will definitely be back for more.

author: Melany Bernard
review_text: Loved the service here , I came with my friends after work, we also had a few drinks , and ofc the triple dipper !

author: Viral J
review_text: Miam Café in Miami is one of the best places for brunch, breakfast, and coffee in the Wynwood area. The café has a modern, cozy vibe with a menu full of fresh, flavorful, and healthy options. It’s perfect whether you want to grab a quick coffee, enjoy a relaxed meal, or meet friends for brunch. The menu offers a great mix of eggs, avocado toast, sandwiches, salads, pastries, and fresh juices. The ingredients taste fresh and high quality, and the presentation is always on point. The coffee is excellent, and they also have great vegetarian-friendly choices. The café atmosphere is relaxed yet stylish, making it a great spot to hang out, work, or simply enjoy a meal. The staff is friendly and welcoming, which makes the experience even better.

author: İpek Delikkulak
review_text: We came here based on reviews and had breakfast and dinner. Everything was great. They had breakfast promotions, and it was incredibly crowded. A line formed after we sat down, but it wasn't as crowded that evening, so we enjoyed our meal comfortably. Since we don't eat pork, they offered to swap our menu items for other items, which was very nice. We enjoyed the lasagna for dinner. The ice cream is safe, and the food is delicious. We recommend it.

author: Lee Lin
review_text: Good food:) The service here is very good and the staff are really friendly!their chicken rice is so good too!their steamed chicken rice is really very tender and juicy and their chicken rice is extremely affordable.is a must try

author: Inneke Mayachita
review_text: Highly recommended. They also have nasi ayam and lots other food including cakes, snacks, fruits

author: Mo Mo
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Pande Egi Review – Totally Lives Up to the Hype! Pande Egi is one of those places that actually deserves every bit of hype around it. The restaurant was recently renovated, and you can really feel the improvement—more seating, cleaner layout, and an overall more comfortable dining atmosphere. Parking is also super convenient with a spacious lot available right across the restaurant. The menu is simple and straightforward, which I love. Even though it’s known for its pork dishes, they also offer chicken options for those who prefer alternatives. We ordered the Nasi Babi Special, which basically gives you a bit of everything. The portion was generous, the flavors were on point, and honestly, it’s such great value for the price. Their sate babi and sate ayam are also must-tries—perfectly grilled, juicy, and delicious. And the vibe? Even better. Eating with a view of the rice fields gives the whole place such a relaxing, “just chill” kind of feel. For dessert, I tried the Es Teler Mix. It was good, but if you want the best experience, I’d recommend choosing the regular one. The mix version can get a little overwhelming because they add a lot into it. Overall, Pande Egi is a solid 5-star spot—affordable, delicious, relaxing, and absolutely worth visiting. Must try!!! 🌾🍽️✨

author: Daniela Wild
review_text: Veggie pho, soft crab spring rolls and beef stew pho were fantastic!

author: Katy Urda
review_text: An easy 5 stars. We’ve been here twice now and can’t believe that the second visit exceeded the high expectations set by our first. Everything we ordered was genuinely standout. Best Caesar salad we’ve ever had! Just go.

author: David Hernandez
review_text: Checked off one of the bucket list places I’ve wanted to eat today. Food was fresh and delicious.

author: Hoàng Nhi
review_text: Delicious food, friendly boss, happy and enthusiastic staff, will come again

author: David Ganzel
review_text: What an excellent find off Fremont! The food was well designed and extremely flavorful. I loved the drink selection and was tempted to double back to the bourbon headliner - Just the Tip. We sat at the bar, which I feel like gives the best restaurant experience. Adam entertained with great conversation and top recommendations. The vibe was intentional, as all staff were wearing grunge band tees, with an eclectic music selection and low key ambiance. If I was local, I would be a regular. DO NOT miss out on the dessert, Glazed Donut Bread Pudding. It’s worth every single calorie.

author: Sexy Eyez
review_text: Today November 22,2025 I went into this diner I have been into many of times before . There food and prices have always been reasonable . Placed my order over the phone to pick up was on the way to work and was on my way . I pulled into the parking lot to pick up my food and it was a ghost town that should have been my clue to get on .This place is one of those places you can never find a parking spot went in the lady told me the price and I almost fell out for what I usually order is $ 11.00 she told me $19.49 I really just wanted to walk out I paid and picked up the bag and the bag felt like a bag of paper how light it was. I get to work and open my bag and this is the worst $20.00 ever spent for food special them I will not be back 2 scoops of eggs and a few potatoes is a dam shame I understand prices go up but this is really ridiculous I WILL NOT BE GOING BACK ..

author: Samuel Cintra
review_text: Carolina was our server and she was amazing!! Food and drinks were great and I loved celebrating my birthday with y’all!!

author: Skyla Nava (La)
review_text: I really love going to this little shop. It’s close to my work, it’s cheaper than expected, and the food is good! The service is great as well. They recognize me from my past orders and offer me free drinks and always thank me for ordering. The banh mi’s are pretty good and they have a lunch special for only $10! Would recommend! It’s also very quick within 10 minutes of me ordering it’s ready!

author: Yvonne Tan
review_text: This hawker centre is pretty airy. To avoid the crowd and queue, best to come before 8am, both weekdays and weekends. If you are a wanton mee lover, wouldn't want you to miss this - Xing Ji wanton noodle! Its mee gia served is springy (al-dente), veg given is always fresh (unlike many wanton stalls that sell "old" caixin that is "too fibrous" to swallow) & wanton size is just nice - bite-sized. Paired up with its boss' homemade chilli, it's simply heaven! It's usually sold out fast (esp Mon, before 11am) on weekdays.Closed on Tue & Wed. For weekends, best to arrive before 12pm to grab a bowl. Xing Ji is definitely a good food rep for SG-style wanton mee in Tampines. Note: If u r into HK-style noodles, this may not be for you. Next must-try: Thosai, Appam @ Rajarani Thosai. Another long queue if you come after 8am.. every thosai is served fresh n piping hot. It's no wonder its queue never stops (unless sold out, oc) For nice aromatic local nanyang kopi, go for Quan Fang. $1.40 for Kopi - ask for di lo siew dai (di lo: direct down; siew dai: less sweet) - then u can savour the pure goodness of the kopi with condensed milk added. Ask for Kopi-O, if u just wanna enjoy a cuppa coffee with only sugar. No sugar option? Ask for: Kopi-O Kosong Xiong Kee fried carrot cake (2 stalls - one operated by a couple, the other operated by their son) is another go-to if you enjoy a savoury plate of fried black or white carrot cake. Both stalls are yummylicious. The other carrot cake stall on the other side of the market is pretty good too, offering tumeric option. For glutinous rice lovers, can try the stall located right behind the Tiong Bahru fried fish ball, Yi Le Shu Shi. Oh ya.. the Chai Chee Pork porridge is for you, if you fancy thick savoury bowl of porridge, cooked to perfection. Each portion is of reasonable size, so if you have a smaller stomach space, best to come with a few friends so you can try all the different stalls. If not, just make a few more trips!

author: Austin
review_text: Came at 5pm on weekdays and some tables were available but we recommend you better call for reservations since it’s always crowded. The meat was a bit chewy, tastes not bad though. Grilled chicken was really delicious, but the meat stuck to the bone making them hard to eat. Vanilla jasmine lemon tea was not our favorite. The price was quite high. The table next to us tried to call the staffs for 3 times before they noticed.

author: Bob Carey
review_text: I went to ipoh for a holiday and decided to eat here. lets just say i prefer the Teh C more. the horfun was quite average not suprising. and yet its overhyped with alot of people. the broth was questionable like something is up the noodle had a weird texture the.. chicken. doesnt taste right like something so i would rarely come to this when i go to ipoh again. im heavily dissapointed on the horfun and i will never order it again.

author: Yellow Bear
review_text: The Orchis Food Court (Staff Canteen) is a budget-friendly dining spot compared to the usual airport restaurants and cafés. For vegans and vegetarians, there’s a Chinese vegetarian stall (温馨素食园) with vegan options and other non-vegetarian stalls with meatless options like Bismillah Food Express, an Indian Muslim food stall. ** To get to Orchis Food Court (Staff Canteen), just walk all the way to the right hand corner of Terminal One Level One, then follow the signage to the Staff Canteen and take a lift down to B1.

author: Erin Elizabeth
review_text: This was the hands-down worst restaurant meal of my life; the food was, quite literally, inedible. The samosas came sitting in a puddle of about half a cup of cold, sloshing orange cooking oil. The naan was burned black — to the extent where, when I opened the foil, all I could smell was burnt food. The tikka masala sauce was the consistency of water, and — to top off the single worst meal I’ve ever ordered — they only sent about a teaspoon of each chutney; the little plastic containers were 3/4 empty. Possibly the deplorable preparation had to do with the fact that I ordered it for delivery? I can't imagine that any restaurant would serve up half a cup of cold cooking oil, or burnt black naan, or teaspoon-sized servings of chutney, to people dining in person. Disgraceful.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Ivo Salazar
review_text: I am writing to formally express my deep disappointment regarding an order I received today from your Bayfront Park location. I ordered two pounds of meat, but what was delivered was approximately 90% fat and scraps, completely unfit to be served as food. I have photos and videos of the order to support my claim. It is unacceptable and frankly a shame that whoever prepared and dispatched my order considered this quality of product acceptable. I have always enjoyed eating at your restaurant, but after this disastrous experience, I am left feeling deceived and frustrated. Out of a $50 order, the only thing I was able to eat was the $4 rice. I strongly urge you to review the quality control at this location, as serving customers in this manner seriously damages trust in your brand. If you would like, I am willing to share the photos and videos of the order for your review.

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: Nikki L.
review_text: A hidden gem tucked away inside an alley (look out for the banner and sign at the alley entrance). Having tried the most famous boat noodle in town, I think the pork boat noodles here are much tastier with more generous portions! They have an English menu and the staff can speak Bahasa too. Be sure to try their khanom thuai dessert, commonly eaten with boat noodles. There's a parking lot beside the restaurant, I believe it's paid parking.

author: Edison
review_text: Nice lounge cum bar with instagrammable spots for photo taking. Friendly vibes from the staff especially to Zila & Coline who were hospitable and affectionate during my multiple visits on my four days tour to KL this week. The duo warm customer service has made me a repeated customer these few days. Thank you for making my stay here a memorable ones.

author: Jenny Ramos
review_text: We have been coming here for years. The food does not disappoint. They make the best grilled prawns - langostinos around. The dish comes with the potato slices. The steak was cooked as requested and had good flavor. There is always complimentary collard green soup when you have dinner. We drank the mango sangria. For dessert we had the bread pudding and crema catalana. The crema looks like crem brûlée but it’s a little more lemon flavored. The waiters were very attentive and moved our items out of the way quickly to make room for the next course. The place is an inviting intimate setting.

author: Jon Nakamura
review_text: Tiki Tiki in Hollywood, Florida is a laid-back waterfront escape with a breezy island vibe. The open-air patio overlooks the Intracoastal, making it perfect for sunset cocktails. Their menu features fresh seafood, casual bites, and tropical drinks made with care. With live music, friendly service, and a chill, coastal charm, it’s a great spot to unwind and soak in sunny South Florida.

author: DemonHideki
review_text: Best place to grab a good breakfast from i am from Louisiana and will happily travel here again yo try their food and also if you ordering foor make sure you get the potatos you wont be sorry!

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Steve Isaac
review_text: Just had business lunch here, gotta say with all the hype going around, it's pretty good. Staffs were very courteous and knowledgeable on the products offered here. Fast service too. One of my fave dish for Padang is the Dendeng Belado, unfortunately the one sherw is the soft kind, and not the hard crispy type. Nonetheless, still good. Overall it was a good 1st experience fer me, but not enough to make me need to go back for more in the long run. Great job by the management though 👌🏻

author: Dennis S
review_text: An amazing find! We dined on the patio in very relaxed and casual atmosphere. The patio is large an even has an upstairs area. Plenty of tables that seat 4 or pull up a chair to the large fire pit and relax with a drink from the bar. We had the short rib steak which paired well with the creamy mac and cheese. The steak is small but oh so juicy and tender. The mac & cheese was creamy and did not have an overwhelming cheese flavor. Just perfect! We finished off with the bourbon fudge brownie.

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Đường Thảo Nguyên
review_text: 166k/person combo of drinks, dessert, 1 wet towel Food is okay, panacotta is delicious. Enthusiastic staff, constantly changing trays.

author: Fang Phattha
review_text: A lovely food court near South Station. They have a lot of seatings. Most people here seem to be office workers looking for lunch. The vibe is quite nice and not rushing. I had a DIY bowl from a healthy place with a long line that I can't remember the name. It's very fresh and very delicious. Ingredients are already seasoned and go well together. I'd give it 5 stars if there are more variety of food to choose here.

author: Julian Ramirez Perez
review_text: I went with my wife for for dinner anniversary. We always are Bar lovers so, we had 2 seats at the bar ( the most comfortable bar I ever been ). We were not extremely hungry so we just try a couple dishes. The carpaccio was good, and nice portion. The octopus was actually not my favorite, I like my octopus juicy inside an we’ll roasted outside, but it was actually just burn and dry. I loved the steak tartare, I actually think is the best I have try. We order the 24 Oz ribeye, with the truffle butter. OMG the steak is just to perfect. Margarita was our bartender, she is such a charming person and so attentive. She makes really good tequila espresso martinis. I really like the place and the friendly staff. “Note, the place is more in the fancy side, so dress up properly”

author: Gina DeGesero
review_text: the warm welcome from the ultra friendly staff set the atmosphere for a meal filled with layers of flavor, spice and the right touch of heat. get the walla sauce and put it on EVERYTHING you will not regret it. save room for the coconut cake, slightly grilled , warm with a moist crumb *chef’s kiss* this is a meal I will say dream about for a long while. can’t wait to come back to Newark, thanks to the yard <3

author: Toan la vinh
review_text: Delicious Claypot Rice. Especially the special dish of black chicken stewed with coconut.

author: L.A. T
review_text: 💎 Gem in the heart of Military Park! It gave me an at-home feel with comfortable seating, friendly service and the best playlist adding an extra razzle dazzle to the experience. The menu (which is digital) has eye catching names for the selections and everything we ate was made to order. From the Fried Salmon Cakes to the Chopped Chicken with grits we thoroughly enjoyed each bite. There is an outside seating area, concerts in the summer and live music regularly. It’s a beautiful spot and would highly recommend.

author: Natalie Jean (Nala)
review_text: I had the absolute best birthday dinner at Hell’s Kitchen! Our server Alex Morel was attentive, kind, and incredibly knowledgeable he made the whole experience even better. I’ve always loved the Hell’s Kitchen brand and used to watch the show, so finally dining here felt special. The food met every expectation everything was cooked perfectly, full of flavor, and even the leftovers were delicious the next day. Truly an unforgettable experience. Can’t wait to go back❤️🔥

author: Ying Xin
review_text: Had a great dining experience at Som Som Seafood! The seafood was incredibly fresh, and you can really taste the difference. Everything was cooked perfectly – flavorful, not overdone, and served hot. Definitely a hidden gem for seafood lovers. Will come back again! ❤️

author: Dr. Reynaldo. Evangelista
review_text: Straight up foodies and flavor enthusiasts! Prepare your taste buds for a soulful journey through the heart of New Jersey, where hospitality meets mouthwatering cuisine. My recent visit to Newark's gem of a restaurant left me utterly speechless and completely satisfied. As I placed my order with the courteous cashier, I could sense the passion and dedication that went into every dish. And oh, the food! Each bite was a symphony of flavors, a tribute to the rich traditions of soulful cooking. From the tender fried chicken to the decadent macaroni and, every morsel was a delightful revelation. But the true star of the show was the impeccable service. The gentleman who served my meal did so with an air of grace and genuine care, ensuring that my dining experience was nothing short of exceptional. I urge you, dear reader, to embark on your own culinary adventure and discover the magic that awaits you in Newark's best-kept secret. You won't be disappointed. So, why wait? Treat yourself to an unforgettable dining experience and indulge in the phenomenal offerings of this soul food haven. Trust me, it's a journey worth taking. Enjoy!

author: KNote
review_text: I got the Mediterranean Chicken salad. The chicken was basically cold cut slices of chicken that didn't taste like chicken. The lettuce was not crispy and just about every single leaf was from the core. The salad was mushy. I got a chocolate chip cookie that was stale. Luckily the Dr pepper was okay. But even the slice of bread that came with the meal was as hard as a rock. I don't think I'm ever going to go to a Panera again. The cashier was really good, very friendly. The food wasn't her fault at all. But over $20 for that? What a waste

author: Ryan Huber
review_text: Poor quality food served at a premium price. Disrespectful to the consumer.

author: Parker:xgps
review_text: good service, burger more like beef jerky. can't feel spending more if value buys arent. waiting in front of the store for not fresh hurts even worse.

author: Bob Ortega
review_text: I've been going to Kate's Kitchen since late 90's. I was always a big fan. After Covid, I noticed the quality and quantity had decreased, but that was to be expected. I was happy that they survived post-Covid downturn, while many small businesses did not. However, last time we were there, I wanted to give the owner some friendly advise, which was to take the word "thick-sliced" bacon off of the menu as I the bacon was no longer thick-sliced. I told him it was still good, but I knew that he might save himself some grief over customer complaints, just by removing that word from the menu. Instead, the owner went on a loud tirade about how "he doesn't need us" and he is retiring in 2 years. Very disappointing, and I will never go back.

author: Eric Foo
review_text: Amazing, tender and delicious Hire Katsu. Tasty refillable soup. It’s a small place so be prepared for a queue. Tip: go early, leave your name, number and order. Then go shopping next door. Still my go-to Tonkatsu place. Had another really good dinner here. The Menchi Tonkatsure is not simply ground pork but coarsely ground to have texture and a cheese stuffed inside. The queue seems to be getting longer, with weekend latecomers turned away. I would suggest getting there before 6 on weekends to get your spot

author: Mohamad Osama
review_text: I live close to Sonic warm spring in Las Vegas this is not a one-time thing it's a regular I have been waiting for like 20 minutes and we are only two cars the other car left and there is even no one in the Drive-Thru no one even bothered to answer us on the thing, or to come ask us. The stuff also are super rude especially the White guy with the blue hat this is my third encounter with him, except for maybe one or two. I looked from the window and checked they was literally talking to each other they didn't even bother look at us. And this is exactly the second or the third time ftor the same people I always come in around the same time after my work. It was Aug. 25, 2025 from 7:50 pm to almost 8:30 pm youbcan check the cameras both inside and outside the store.

author: SE Teoh
review_text: A must visit in Hatyai! Very affordable, our meal was only 300 baht. The stir-fried kailan with roasted pork is a must-try, and the crispy garlic sotong is delicious. Fast service and a very clean environment. Highly recommended!

author: Eric Cheng
review_text: Visited the new indoor air conditioned branch just opposite the old main store, the environment looks much comfort than the main store. Ordered few dishes including the famous fried crab meat with curry powder, crab meat fried rice, fried squid in salted egg yolk and tom yum. The portions for seafood is quite at value as there are lots of crab meat. The salted egg yolk is in nice smell and flavor and matched with the squid. Fried rice is not bad and it is good to eat with the curry sauce of the fried crab meat. The ton yum is strong in flavor but not very spicy or sour. Overall the meal is at great value.

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: Steve Chan
review_text: A very beautiful setting for lunch or dinner. We booked a table online for dinner, and it was very convenient. The entire place is full of surprises and is great for taking photos. The service was excellent from the time you get off the car to your table. The only disappointment is the food is not as great as I expected. However, the presentation of the food was excellent. Again great for photos. We ordered grilled chicken and duck breast, they were both either overcooked or dry / tough. Overall, it is still a great place to spend an evening.

author: Andrew Rodriguez
review_text: Jeh O Chula is crazy busy but totally worth the wait. The Mama Tom Yum noodles are rich, spicy, and loaded with toppings—I couldn’t stop eating. The crispy pork belly and salmon sashimi were also fantastic. It’s chaotic, crowded, and fun—exactly the kind of Bangkok food experience I was hoping for.

author: Shubham Gupta
review_text: Great place to have local food. They have crab which is recommended. Very limited vegetarian food options

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: MrJayquak
review_text: Nice portion for SGD 5.50 Add 50c for a bowl of rice Chill sauce is spot on, suitable for most taste buds. The salted vege is strong, so its suitable for those prefer their soup on the salty side of things.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Mona
review_text: Delicious vegetarian restaurant with a cozy atmosphere and friendly staff. Quiet and clean. Recommend it!

author: Vĩnh Phúc Khánh Đoan
review_text: I recently visited O Ty Beef Hotpot on 2/9 Street, ordered a beef hotpot set for 2 people and felt very satisfied with the experience. The hotpot portion was quite full, including many types of soft, delicious, very fresh and high-quality beef. The hotpot broth was moderately sweet, eaten with fresh vegetables and side dishes, making the meal more appealing. The restaurant space is spacious, clean, has cool air conditioning, very comfortable to sit for a long time and enjoy. What impressed me most was the feeling of fullness after the meal, a lot of meat but still retains its delicious softness, just like a standard beef hotpot. The price is reasonable, suitable for the quality of food and the space of the restaurant.

author: i . am . kenny
review_text: Possibly the best Thai Omelette Rice in Bangkok. Eggy omelette is cream, watery and tasty, adding thick crab meat and prawns, this is simply amazing. They do not scrimp on the meat and every plate is valued for money. Beware..the waiting time and queue can be very long due to the limited space but you will feel satisfied after the meal. The seafood omelette can be slightly pricy but these are the recommended ones that you should try. Another thing to point out is the pork neck is soft, easy to bite and very good. Try if you have the stomach to eat them all. Do note that the toilet is on the 2nd floor just in case you need to go there.

author: Yvonne Yee
review_text: Joja bagel shop really live up to the high ratings ;) as someone who has tried many bagel shops in different countries (London Bagel in Seoul, TwoMenBagelHouse and Keen Bagelry in Singapore + a bunch of bagel shops in KL) JOJA definitely ranks high in my heart now. We ordered pistachio, portobello cheese, spam & egg and a fish bagel. Sauces on the generous side, should have gone for less dressing (available option when placing order).. really enjoyed the portobello one eventho I usually go with the ones with meat. Pistachio cream cheese was nice but cream cheese was too much for my liking , it's also the most expensive one among the 4 I ordered. Fish one taste like elevated version of filet o fish and spam one is classic and you can't go wrong with this combi. We reached the shop just around 9am on a rainy Saturday and there was already a queue outside. Waited for 50mins to get in and strangely there's no Q at around 10am... one could easily walk in. Maybe we should have gone abit later. Worth the hype nevertheless I would go back at anytime to try other flavours.

author: JOYN
review_text: Went on November 3 2023 at 4:30 pm . Woman working the counter was extremely rude. I stood in line for almost half an hour just to get up to the front and have them tell me they’re out of most items . I would think a sign saying that they’re out of food would be appropriate which I kindly let her know. she then told me “oh we’ll get over it” I’m literally in shock

author: Duong Van Hieu
review_text: The rice was cold, the customer asked to change to another pot and it burned. Overall, not as advertised.

author: Jessen Tan
review_text: Overall food ordered is delicious. Huge portion with reasonable price. Not as spicy as others which ia a good thing. Ample seating area and nice environment.

author: Sylvia
review_text: Super casual and fun cantina style spot on the Hollywood boardwalk overlooking the beach and the sea! Serving great authentic food from Cuba and Mexico! The whole fried snapper is a must try! It is big enough for 4 people to share. Enjoy it with savory cocktails while taking in the awesome Latin vibes. The service was great, and our server, Karen, was awesome! She went above and beyond to make sure we enjoyed our meal and the time. If you don't want a huge meal, there is plenty to choose from in the extensive menu. Great place to hang out and have drinks, too! It has Latin music playing the whole time. You will not be disappointed if you love Latin food, music, and vibes!

author: Raj
review_text: Extremely cute cafe - I can't wait to try their wine selection, I've heard extremely positive things about where they source their wine. It's a small cute coffee shop most days of the week and then Th-Sat in the nights they are a wine bar. It's a really nice space. The iced Americano was well made and the food smelled quite good inside. I would highly recommend this spot in JP.

author: Amanda Lynch-Smith
review_text: I’ve been to Roberta’s a bunch of times and it never disappoints, but I want to give a special shoutout to the staff who always make the experience memorable. I ordered the pizza with ricotta, white sauce, and added mushrooms (delicious), and even though there was a delay with it coming out, Simone went above and beyond. She was so attentive, kind, and genuinely fun to talk to — she really made me feel special. Also huge thanks to Blair, who has helped me and my boyfriend out on Valentine’s Day and other visits to snag a table. Between the incredible food and the amazing team, Roberta’s is one of those places you always want to come back to.

author: Mary Lou Matteson
review_text: The food is delicious, there are vegetarian options, and you can choose mild, medium, or spicy. It is perfect for our family where each person has preferences.

author: Sam
review_text: Went for the rodizio experience, and it did not disappoint. Tried at least 10 different meats (I lost count cause they were bringing them out so fast). Not all cuts were my taste, but they were hot and fresh. The sides of rice, plantains, beans and fries were good (especially the fries). I wish they grilled the pineapple more though. We also had the dulce de leches cheesecake and paella. Both very good 👍 Thank you to the servers who took care of us! We had a great time!

author: Julia Oliveira
review_text: This place is so pretty, especially at night. The hosts give you a table immediately and the servers are always available. The food is really good as well. I've been there 3 times already and i loved it every time.

author: Shena Diaz
review_text: Everything is great here and I mean everything but I am very pissed off that I just spent 88.28 in this store tonight and got some candies yams that were ten dollars…. I was never in my big back mind thinking they were ever gunna turn around and give me the smallest container of yams going…clearly this is a big order for more than one person but the serving of these yams is for one person and yet they are charging folks ten dollars for it with my order being 88 dollars the least they could have done was throw in a free cup of yams I means why not I purchased two cups anyway if you ask me

author: Eric Zago
review_text: The Parmesan Truffle Tots were amazing. Loved the burger, too! We got there at 4:30 on a Wednesday, and were the only customers there. But, our server was fantastically attentive, and it was great meal after a great day. Wish there were locations in the Worcester or Milford areas!

author: Gabriel Oleastro
review_text: Absolutely amazing authenticate Vietnemese food. Extremely friendly and attentive staff. Beautiful setting along the river, we could even see a small parade on the otherside of the river and we could also watch the boats with their beautiful lanterns cruising past. The entrance and inside is also very romantic and set up well.

author: Ronnie
review_text: I saw a viral foodie review that featured the oxtail burger and the shrimp burger and knew I had to try them both. It was an hour drive each way but I wasnt going to let that deter me. Although the place looked completely full and there was a very large party of about 10 people seated, we were greeted immediately by the host when we arrived and seated. I noticed the owner going around to all of the tables and actually talking with every different party. That really stood out to me. When he made his way over to my table, my husband and I really got the sense that not only does he take great pride and accountability in the quality and taste of the food but he is also a very warm individual who goes out of his way to welcome everyone. I didn't feel like I was talking to an "owner", I felt like I was talking with family. My pictures don't do the food justice but everything was phenomenal and well worth the drive! We got the oxtail burger, shrimp burger and a chicken sandwich. I actually have made plans to visit again very soon and I absolutely can not wait. This is food that is worth an hours drive each way.

author: ANDREW HANS
review_text: So, I went there with my son to catch up after his vacation. Figured we tryout a new s, ot and maybe we could use it as a regular hangout. Ordered a Ribeye and a pizza. To split. The server asked how we wanted steak, and we said medium rare. The server says thanks and walks away. Food comes. The pizza was great. But it was just the steak on a plate. Im thinking to myself why didn't he ask what sides we wanted. So I said, "Where's the sides he said I could get you a menu. So we spent $40.00 on a steak with no sides. Never going back there. It's not like it's a 5 star restaurant. It's a dive bar with slots, pizza, and sandwiches. As far as ambiance, we had to walk around buckets as the roof was leaking. The only reason I gave them 2 stars is because the pizza was good.

author: xin
review_text: stumbled upon this local breakfast spot. not many tourists around and the seating is a bit limited and packed, but the food taste really delicious! worth coming if you’re nearby!!!!

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: แอ๊ด อิน
review_text: I like the decoration of the shop, it is nice and chill. The coffee is nice. The staff are very knowledgeable about coffee.

author: Cromex Makine ve Dis Ticaret Ltd. Sti.
review_text: I recently visited Rambolean in Jakarta and had a truly enjoyable dining experience. The restaurant has gone through a renewal of their chain, and the improvements are clear—from the ambiance to the service and especially the food. What stood out most was the authentic taste of Indonesian cuisine, prepared with care and a modern touch. Each dish was flavorful and well-balanced, allowing me to appreciate traditional ingredients in a refreshed way. I particularly appreciated the attention to presentation and the welcoming attitude of the staff. The revamped setting is cozy yet stylish, making it a great place for both casual meals and more intimate dinners. If you’re looking to experience Indonesian food in a refined yet accessible environment, Rambolean is definitely worth a visit. I’ll be coming back for more.

author: Clive G
review_text: Maxwell Food Center is super easy to get to by train, which makes it perfect for a quick food stop. It’s located right opposite a beautiful Chinese museum, so you can soak in some culture before or after eating. Most of the food here is Chinese, and the must-try dish is definitely the chili crab—so tasty and full of flavor. It’s a great place to experience authentic local eats in a lively setting. Just note that it can be crowded with a wait time to get tables and the food

author: les wong
review_text: I found my favorite zichar. We ordered moonlight Horfun, cheese pork ribs, sambal kangkong and crab fried rice. I love the wok hey from Horfun, cheese pork ribs was flavourful too. Paid $35 for 4 dishes, quite a good price for today’s pricing standards. It’s also a nice touch they have free flow newly cooked pop corn, soya bean curd and ice cream / ice drops. Service was also good, friendly and not pushy to sell you expensive dishes. We would definitely be back soon to try more. Highly recommended.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Henry Hsu
review_text: Top choice if you are looking for nasi padang. I loved that they cover all plates of food with plastic. U open, u pay. The taste is authentic especially the ayam pok. Top of choice for diners.

author: ray toei
review_text: You know this place is specially when 1/3 to half of the people are eating the noodles. So so so reminds me of the Bedok south (morning)and the Bedok north (night) bcm. From the type QQ thin-broad noodles to the bakchor that surrounds the soup and the wanton. The soup is very slightly more salty than the Bedok north one. 4.80 sgd

author: Jose Miguel
review_text: Funky spot with an amazing vibe and seriously good pizza! The Bee Sting was hands down my favorite – spicy, sweet, perfectly balanced. We also tried the Lil Stinky, and it was packed with flavor. Surprisingly, the salad blew me away. I’m not even a salad person, but this one was super flavorful and creative – a total standout. The place has that refined grit – it doesn’t look fancy, but everything’s done with care and intention. That contrast between raw and elevated? It just works. Definitely coming back!!!

author: Norah Burch
review_text: My car broke down, so we ducked into this place for a quick bite to wait while the tow truck showed up. I had a Cubano sandwich. I have only had Cuban Cubanos, but this Dominican one was AMAZING. It was like you take all the good bits from a normal Cubano and make them better. I want another one. Right now. We also got some pastelitos which were likewise amazing! I can't wait to go back here!

author: Ray Smith
review_text: What an amazing experience! Every ounce of the food we ordered was top tier! Outstanding service, tourists and locals alike dining together. I will revisit soon we didn't have a chance to try the vast coffee selection, and if it is anything like the food, then it is also incredible. We opted for lemon iced tea which in itself was a surprise to say the least, mint leaves with a hint of vanilla. You must eat here!

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: May Ling
review_text: I like the soup and the special dessert, Khanom Thuay(similar to our Malaysia Kuih Talam).Nice place different from the Busy market area.

author: Tn T
review_text: Had a great meal at this Rich Asian Western food shop! The chicken chop was juicy and well-seasoned, and the fries were crispy. Cozy atmosphere and friendly service. Will definitely come back again!

author: Yeoh Ts
review_text: The food is really good, and the place is clean and tidy. Dishes are served quickly, and you can choose portion sizes based on the number of people which helps avoid waste and ensures everything gets finished. They don’t just have soup noodles, they also have dry hor fun. The soup noodles’s soup is prawn dumpling soup. The crispy fried prawn wontons that are packed with real ingredients. Paring them with the noodles and bean sprouts is prefect. Parking is a bit limited.

author: Alfredo Pereira
review_text: I stopped by for lunch and had the beef pho and pork banh mi. The flavors are on par with some of the best Vietnamese spots in the city, but at a more affordable price. The interior is clean and inviting, and the service was quick. If you're in the area (Mission) and craving authentic Vietnamese food, look no further—this is the spot!

author: Luis Hernandez
review_text: Bad experience. Food looked good but service is bad . My family and 3 other walked out because no body was getting seated or served. They need more staff .

author: Abb T.
review_text: Stunningly delicious food, loved that they prepared the food in such a fresh and balanced flavour. The grilled squid, sambal kangkong are some of the best that I’ve tried. If possible I would return again and again. This restaurant is a must visit if you are craving to have Indonesian food. The price is reasonable too! The atmosphere itself is beautiful and calming, it’s a villa by itself.

author: Addie Monopoly
review_text: I had The shrimp cocktail that was yummy & my daughter had chicken Tenders w/ fries but wasn’t a big fan & she’s very picky. So don’t be discouraged I saw a lot of the plates looked really yummy and people seem to enjoy them. It’s on the board walk so if ur on the beach u can take it to go. Also had a yummy piña colada to go and my daughter had a virgin daiquiri.

author: Matt Sanda
review_text: Get the Detroit pizza. You can tell they have perfected the dough. It gives Tonino a run for their money! New location is spacious. Food is delicious. Cocktails are great. Cheaper than it seems on paper because gratuity is included in the prices.

author: Fong Siew Poh
review_text: After few years decided came back to visit this shop again, Overall the foods makes us disappointed and feel pricey, portion so small especially the fried Kuey tiaw and chicken feet(look at the picture the chicken feet cut into half only to makes the portion looks more). The Cantonese noodles gravy too thick, makes us eat half way to stop it. It might be not the real chef to cook and pass to the worker to cook it, corn flour is putting so much into gravy become so thick(apparently portion is bigger than kuey tiaw). Braised yee mee is tasteless and a bit bitter due to black sauce too much, got to pair with their sambal belacan to finish the noodle. Prawns in noodles smelly, it might be in the packaging and workers didn’t wash it well(it’s frozen prawn). For the whole meal me and my family only enjoy the sambal and octopus, workers serve food so so no smiling face don’t feel welcome from them. Environment is good with aircond and clean. Hopefully the boss take note on this, as an eater we give comment and hope the quality of foods maintain all times.

author: Noe Amighini
review_text: The experience was bad from the start, when they seated us at a bar facing the street next to the entrance door, which opened every two minutes and froze us. There were four empty seats at the other bar, and we asked to change, but they said no, that they were busy, even though no one was sitting there. On the other hand, the food is scarce and not very tasty for what they charge, especially for a restaurant that is supposedly recommended by Michelin. We ordered rice with seafood, and it was almost impossible to find. For starters, we had mayonnaise eggs that were cold!!! They didn't warn us, they were tiny, not incredible and the price was extremely high. In conclusion, if you want to eat ordinary food, meager portions, nothing particularly sophisticated in terms of flavor, and pay a fortune... this is the place! Oh, the bread was very good!

author: theresa heng
review_text: Decided to have chee cheong fun for breakfast and it was really delicious. Best thing ever? I added char siew to my prawn CCF and it was only $0.50 for adding ingredient. Total price of fresh prawns+char siew CCF was $4. Good value for money

author: Towanda “Princess”
review_text: Came with a huge party for a meet and greet. Service and food was good. I only got a drink and an appetizer. The peel and eat shrimp was enjoyable. I wanna come back and try a couple of things I saw on the menu. Great view if you eat outside.

author: Sadface Records
review_text: I have been eating at this location for about 30 years or more now. The food is exactly the same. Great burgers, fries, and pastrami sandwiches. The fries are always freely cooked when I order. Sometimes they need a lil extra salt but all you have to do is ask. They have good burger family pack meal options for families or groups looking for them. The customer service most of the time is excellent, but It can be a little compromised at times depending on how busy they are it might seem like you are being rushed. Sometimes it's hard for them to here you at the speaker which can be a littlefrustrating, but they always confirm my order at the window, which makes it okay. They do sever breakfast as well but I haven't had there breakfast in a while not to say it's not good, but I only usually do lunch or dinner items from here, but the breakfast is worth a try being I see a lot of people order it. Overall A great location that has been around for a long time and I feel will be there for a lot longer.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: MultiBeatlesROCK
review_text: We were staying at the hotel+suites next door to the Taco Shack, we had dinner and lunch there. It was A-MAZING!!!!!! Super delicious food! The Churrasco Steak was mouth watering. HUGE SHOUTOUT to our server Alexander, he was very welcoming and gave great service!

author: Rathian
review_text: Few Balinese recommended us to try sucking pigs in Bali. It’s pig in various forms. The pork was delicious. When we want to order more grilled or fried pork skin, no extra plates left. I believe that the spicy level has been adjusted lower to suit the foreigner’s tongue.

author: Marlyn Fransiska
review_text: We had brunch here and Milk & Madu remains one of our favorite spots to hop to. This Seminyak branch is fairly new (opened around 20 Nov 2025, if I’m not mistaken), and the vibe here feels more neutral and airy with lots of direct sunlight. Fully air-conditioned, so no worries about Bali’s heat, and the toilets were clean with a fresh lemongrass scent—always appreciated. Food quality is consistent, just like their other branches. We had the cinnamon bun French toast (great portion), classic pepperoni pizza (large & gluten-free), and fresh young coconut. Love that they offer gluten-free pizza options—such a win. They also have a kids’ corner that’s quite decent, plus free face painting, which our kids absolutely loved. Service overall was good. Just one small moment that made us smile—we asked to sit at the sofa area. The sofa tables are designed for two, so for a group of four they need to be combined. We were initially told it was only for two, but shortly after, a family of three was seated there with the tables combined 😅 Not a big deal at all, and the team kindly offered us a bigger table right away. All in all, a solid brunch spot with great food, family-friendly touches, and a comfortable setting.

author: Mia
review_text: For someone who usually avoids pork, finishing a whole plate of tonkatsu curry rice says a lot about how delicious it is. The soup is also tasty and comes with free refills.

author: Kk Stix
review_text: Wow! One of the best Delmonicos I've ever had! Cooked perfectly and not overly seasoned like many places do. The sauce and the potatoes that came with it were delicious too! Staff was all very friendly and honestly I don't have a single complaint. Highly recommend!

author: Leanne Pais
review_text: An absolutely beautiful place with amazing food and good service. It was a feat to get a table and after 3 attempts I finally got a table for lunch :) and it was well worth it! The grill duck was tender, juicy and filled with flavour. Highly recommend it! Will definitely go back when I'm in ubud next :) it is entirely worth the hype.

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: Nuttaporn Boonyateera
review_text: Everything is superb. I brought my BF to try the food here. He said it is the best thai restaurant I have never tried. He likes spicy. We love Squid dish. Service and staffs are well trained. We also enjoy the little market here in the community.

author: Lalo Salamanca
review_text: When i say this place is absolutely overrated to bits, i mean it. Ordered a chicken salad and got a big feeding bowl full of lettuce and a couple of chicken pieces. No way a COW can eat these many veggies at once let alone a human. This is the last time i let insta influencers dictate my breakfast options

author: John Chong
review_text: 5-Star Rating for the amazing variety of food from all over the world !! All my favourite Singapore dishes are also available. Chicken Rice, Biryani, Nasi Lemak, Mee Pok, Dim Sum, Ban Mian, Mee Soto, Prata, Thosai and of course Satay. Lots of international options including Turkish, Indian, Fillipino, Indonesian, Western, Korean and more. And all at reasonable prices. Only downside, place can get quite warm during the day as its not air-conditioned

author: Erycka Ortiz
review_text: such a good experience and accesible. the food is fresh and taken care of.

author: Scott Alan Blanchard
review_text: Decent food, but for the price and robots that "greet" and "serve" (and want/expect a tip). I did find one person today actually conversing with a customer and that was lovely. I'd like more options and customizations for salads. Also don't be so stingy with napkins!

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: Garry Reviews
review_text: Location is wide open space with plenty of tables. There are 2 sections of seatings 1 is an air conditioned room with about 10 tables while the open space area has lots more tables. Ordering is simple, there is a small table with the menu with pictures displayed and prices. However everything is in Chinese but a simple point and showing your digits is sufficient unless you have special requirements like extra egg and sides, could be a challenge if you are not proficient in the Chinese language. Depending on the crowd, it could also take quite a while to be ready. The CKT is average, not too salty or oily. Decent wok hei with small prawns and teeny bits of lap cheong. The octopus however takes the limelight I would say. It was cooked perfectly with soy sauce and oyster sauce, served with some coriander which provides a crisps and sharp fresh contrast to the savoury dish. The sauce is salty and addictive to complement the tender octopus. It doesn’t matter which part you eat, they are all tender, not rubbery or chewy. The head of the octopus, kind of satisfyingly pops when chewed. The chilli sauce that accompanies it is delicious and enhances the taste a little bit to the already delicious dish. Overall it’s a good meal to try for these two dishes. A single toilet is available at the end of the air conditioned room. For these 2 dishes, octopus rm28 and Ckt rm10.

author: CAi Zhenken
review_text: The Fish soup sells one of the cheapest fish. I ordered the seabass at $9.90/fish and to my surprise it was the whole fish served. They drizzle some Hongkong style style sauce with coriander leafs and fried garlic and alas it was a very fulfilling dish. Vegetables can be bought here at $6-$8/fish. They have red chilli and lemon lime sauce for you to dip the fish in. came ard 5.30pm on a weekday n hence waited jus 8 mins to tuck in. portion is very big ,ard 4-500g/fish,recommend 2 pax to share 1 portion haha

author: Esther Kong
review_text: My good to place for well-prepared tzi char. The staff are friendly and the chef is very experienced, especially when preparing crab dishes. Do call to reserve if you want to try out any crab dishes.

author: pamela grandon
review_text: Great service from Ronny. Ceviche was delicious and the Yellow rice and seafood was also good. Big portion and great view.

author: Desiree McNabb
review_text: It is an affordable halal restaurant, the staff was friendly and attentive. Food was good I had the fried chicken with potato salad and vegetables.

author: Samer Salib
review_text: Amazing very high quality seafood taco options at an affordable price. The Baja fish tacos were so crispy and so tasty, my wife loved it, we had to order a second round! The Baja shrimp tacos were also great and a good size compared to any shrimp tacos I ever had. The octopus tacos were cooked just right and were large enough to have a good chew and bite and I really liked the sauce that came with it. The scallops taco was cooked to perfection like I’ve never tasted scallops this well cooked before! Finally, it was my first time to try sea urchins, and they were absolutely delicious! I loved how it was presented and the I really enjoyed the ceviche that came with it. It was so fresh and creamy it melted in my mouth. Great staff and food service. I highly recommend as a first time Michelin star restaurant on a budget.

author: Chenzhe Cao
review_text: Koro Ramen and Sushi fills a much-needed gap in the Jeffries Point neighborhood, offering fresh sushi, hearty ramen, and flavorful poke bowls. I am so glad they opened since there hasn’t really been any good, healthy, and Asian spots. This restaurant focuses primarily on takeout, making it a convenient option for locals seeking good food without the fuss. During my recent pickup order, I was impressed by both the value and quality. The poke bowl was generously portioned and well worth the price - clearly made with fresh ingredients that showcased the restaurant’s commitment to quality. The karaage chicken was a standout, featuring crispy, perfectly seasoned pieces paired with a creative chipotle mayo sauce that added a nice fusion twist to the traditional Japanese preparation. While I didn’t have the chance to experience the dine-in atmosphere, the takeout process was smooth and efficient. The variety on the menu - spanning sushi, ramen, and poke options - gives Koro an edge in a neighborhood where fresh, well-prepared Asian cuisine has been hard to come by. I hope to return soon and often!

author: Ori Aphek
review_text: The ceviche was so so... The fish was chewy, and there was very little added to it. My partner ate the Salmon which wad OK. Not more. The fried calamari was pretty good. It's a fun place to sit and eat while watching the sea and the bypassers. But the food is nothing to write about.

author: Mukskie
review_text: The fried chicken noodles are very delicious. The dry seafood sukiyaki is good. They give a lot and have a spicy taste. The food comes out quickly and is hot. You can park on the side of the road.

author: Jacob Ferdman
review_text: Excellent food, authentic flavors and creativity. Linch special is a great deal, Manas special curry is fantastic.

author: Владимир Меженов
review_text: here I felt Mexican cuisine, what is taco, Mexican serving like wild cactus, stewed everything with lime

author: Maureen Kwok
review_text: Went twice during my stay in Bali- alone and with my family. Love the food here, taste is simple and clean with no heavy spices, but overall impressed by how everything is salted evenly. Nothing is too salty, too sweet, too sour, or too tangy etc. very well balanced. The kitchen did a v good job. If you came with 2 other people, order their 14 days dry aged duck. So good In the evening the staff gave me free limoncello shot and kept on checking on me. I think they didn’t want me to feel alone. Thanks for the hospitality guys (and girls) Love to be back next time & keep up the amazing work

author: Frederique De Sousa
review_text: Nice restaurant located in Siam Paragon. They have calm indoor seating. Food were really tasty and delicious. They have as well a vegetarian menu. Price is on the higher side however good quality and portion. Staff is very professional and kind

author: William Go
review_text: The steak menu is for sharing, so practically the main course option is only pasta if you want individual meal. Not much to choose from. Taste is so so, and generally is a bit too salty. Nice decoration and good service.

author: Lety Juarez
review_text: Had the Tostada Salad with steak... OMG, was it good!! It has A TON of tomato, so if you are not a fan, order without. The Avocado salad and Chicken salad are also freaking delicious! Ah, who am I kidding... everything is good!!

author: Tasheena S
review_text: We stopped by here for happy hour and go enjoy some sushi. Please note the location is pretty interesting. It's before the train station, behind a restaurant..it's as if you're going into a parking lot and it's tucked away. Yeah u know that's a lot but it really gives the feel of hidden gem. The service was great we had a lovely waitress who was very knowledgeable of the menu. It was a Wednesday evening so it wasn't crowded or so busy. The decor and ambiance was really lovely. Now on to the food. We were not blown away by the options on the happy hour menu. We only ordered cocktails and the edamame from the happy hour menu. The cocktail was a big size for the price BUT it tastes more like juice. We decided to order rolls from their regular menu. We had the ACEVICHADO and SALMON FURAI rolls. I can't say we would go back because we are not in that area often. However, we would recommend it to our friends in that area of Miami.

author: LaMisT Neo
review_text: Despite some patrons not clearing their own plate and trays, the tables here are generally clean. There are tray return points at every row of the hawker center which is manned by a young staff each. These staffs actively goes around clearing the table. Due to the good service by the staff at the tray return points and also he location of the tray return points there were hardly any pests. Food options are quite limited by dinner. However some of the popular ones are opened till quite late (chicken wing bee hoon, chinese noodle, roast meat, curry rice etc.)

author: Nathalie
review_text: Food is pretty good! As a vegan, i like that they have a good amount of options for me ! So far I’ve had the tofu scramble & vegan cheesesteak wrap, & both were good. I also tried their vegan maple walnut donut which was amazing . Sunday’s they have a DJ, which is pretty cool ! The server’s are nice & friendly. Overall, great experience. I’ve been here twice & will def be coming back again to try their other menu items.

author: Łukasz Kuźniar
review_text: Good food, atmospheric decor. One star for the totally hopeless service. Ordering dessert while ordering soup is clearly a problem and the service does not understand that someone may want something sweet earlier than two hours later and does not know what they are doing in a restaurant. If someone comes across a mature blonde waitress I recommend changing this lady to someone else. Only if not this problem, dinner with a group of friends could be a pleasant experience and not having to deal with an unpleasant lady when ordering food, blocking the passage and not being interested in customers for at least an hour on every occasion. Maybe next time with different services it will be better.

author: corenzo wilkerson
review_text: Beautiful spot It's looked in maybe not so beautiful place on route 1 &9. But there is parking lot. The service is very good the staff is attentive. The food is amazing the steaks melt in your mouth. The sausages are exploding 🤯 with flavor so delicious 🤤. The ribs are delicious. We had several side all were great. If your in the mood for steak 🥩.

author: Pablo Marisol
review_text: Quite a number of choices around the hawker centre. Overall the food is moderate, but still okay for a quick meal. The fried rice was not bad and probably the better dish among what we tried. A decent stop if you want variety, though nothing particularly standout.

author: Angelo Cantrell
review_text: Great customer service. Welcoming and heart warming. Clean and nice smelling. And they were friendly. The type of restaurant that has a good staff. I definitely appreciated the customer service. A great place!

author: Aaron Lee
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Absolutely loved the Korean BBQ here! The meat was fresh, beautifully marbled, and full of flavour. Every cut was perfectly presented, and the side dishes complemented the meal so well. The staff were friendly and attentive, making the whole dining experience even better. Paired it with some beer — just perfect! Definitely one of the best BBQ places I’ve tried. Highly recommended! 🔥🥩🍺

author: Rosario Dowling
review_text: Bathroom was not clean. Someone tried opening my stall door. No cinnamon rolls available.

author: Michael Smith
review_text: Even when the place is packed, service is still quick, friendly, and unassuming. There's much to like on the menu with big portions and fair prices. Some establishments, with their simple approach and attention to detail, can turn everyone into a repeat customer. Egg Works is that kind of establishment.

author: Kien To
review_text: The menu isn't very diverse, but they refill frequently, and the prices are reasonable. Seating is a bit cramped; you're definitely going to be stuck sitting against the wall. Parking is handled by a security guard who escorts you in and out. However, the restrooms were quite disappointing; the faucets were leaky and the water pressure wasn't enough for washing hands.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Friederike Voß
review_text: If you are a vegetarian or vegan, this place is for you! I loved the food and the service is great! I recommend coming here with friends or family and order a lot of dishes to share with everyone. My favorite was the lotus salad, but I'm sure you will love anything here.

author: angry vaultguy (angryvaultguy)
review_text: Didn’t feel safe in there homeless asking for change, tried to open bathroom and someone was pushing door closed and security had to drag a man out of the women’s restroom

author: Scott
review_text: Very attentive and patient. When I explained that I was buying a pizza for a friend who was vegan, she helped me correct the order to comply with a vegan diet. Saved me from the embarrassment.

author: Bree M.
review_text: 0 It was my first time coming to this place, I happened to stumble upon it on google being I was in area and my children and I were looking for a good breakfast place. This is cute quaint spot, a little small but seems to move people in and out very quickly. They do things differently here which was a surprise to me (in a way I liked it) so when sitting down you scan a QR code which brings up a menu, you place the order and pay right from the app, individually or as a group, which I though that was cool…In a matter of minutes give or take 10-12 min (depending on how busy it is) your food is being served to you at your table. The workers are moving all over the place so there really is no connection with one specific waiter/waitress but with a simple excuse me I need assistance and they are at your side ready to assist. Again we dined in at a VERY busy time and on this specific day unfortunately they were short staffed so the owner and others did their best! Now let’s get to the food😋😋 Wow oh wow is the best way to describe things.. I purchased a omelette which came with potatoes small portion of fresh fruit and I did a side of French toast which seemed to be a hit. And boy oh boy I’m glade I did it was A-M-A-Z-I-N-G ( highly recommend). My guest ordered Sweet Chili wings which were out of this world👏🏾👏🏾 so good I ordered some to go for later.. The classic margarita pizza (individual brick oven style) was also another amazing choice. Honestly our food was Divine!! Upon looking at the people around us their food choices seemed to be as well! After finishing our meal there was no regrets coming to this hidden gem. Besides the spacing inside, and possibly having to wait a few extra minutes to get a table, (food we’ll worth the wait) left us feeling the need to definitely come back to enjoy more authentic dishes.. 8.5/10 * I didn’t see where to tip on app, ( hey maybe I missed it ) but there is a tip jar at the very front cash register, in which they all split!

author: The WAT31
review_text: Staff is very helpful and attentive, ensuring we get a seat quickly and food too. The nasi lemak rice is fluffy and fragrant, each bite is mouth watering. The cutleries, came warm - which is very surprising and showcases high standards to customer, brilliant! The fried chicken is packed with flavour, each bite crispy while tasty, wanting me to keep eating it. However, the sambal was not to my preference as it was too sweet, maybe give us some spicy sambal too? Customer service and food are very satisfactory which hence explains the 5 star.

author: Christopher Ho
review_text: Punggol Nasi Lemak is highly praised for its exceptional quality, featuring fragrant, coconut milk-infused rice, a balanced sweet-spicy sambal, and consistently fresh, piping hot side dishes like the famous crispy fried chicken wings. Be prepared for a long queue during dinner, with wait times often around half an hour, as this is a popular spot with a high demand for its delicious fare.

author: Zee Ibrahim
review_text: French toast was very tasty! Loved the whole meal. Ambiance was great too! Definitely recommend!

author: Laurinda Esteves
review_text: I had a nice celebratory dinner there with 15 people last Saturday. The food was great as always but they packed us very tight, and you couldn't even get out. The other negative was the singer. I made a couple of requests for Portuguese songs that are very popular and perfect for dancing and he never played them. I asked him 3 times, I said when are you going to play the songs I requested and he replied "when you leave". He kept played stupid slow Brazilian songs and the Portuguese popular fast songs were not his priority. He needs to go or I will not be going there while that rude man is there. Usually the singers play songs requested for any event but I did not even bothered to ask him for anything more after I experienced is foul demeanor. This restaurant needs to find a DJ, who will do a much better job.

author: J S
review_text: Casual vibe on the water with great food and good service. The seafood is on point. Our server Jonathon recommended the stone crab and minuta ssndwich and it didn't miss!

author: Cédric Hochsticher
review_text: Friendly staff. Great Steak! I think this is the highlight of this restaurant. They have plenty of steak options, which is great. It was my first time there, but I’ll come back!

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: Thomas low
review_text: Good Year Seafood Restaurant is always my choice when thinking having a nice meal together with group of friends . The restaurant is clean and spacious with friendly staff and boss . Food tasty and fresh ingredients and the prices is very reasonable 😀 Good Year Seafood Restaurant definitely worth to visit 😀 Garlic pork 👍 Curry 🐠 Head 😋 🦪 🥚😋

author: Maricela Herrera
review_text: I'm from Texas and have been a fan. Ever since watching the show I had always wanted to come to a Whalbugers. Finally had the chance and let me tell you, it did not disappoint especiallythe fried pickles, best by far. Great service, food and prices. 10/10 wishing I had been able to see one of the brothers bit the manager made up for it with his great attitude/service. Will make another trip just for another wonderful experience.

author: Starasia Starr
review_text: Fantastic view, fans blowing, great breeze, amazing server and decent food. Loved the salad with salmon, better than the mahi mahi. Good clams steamed in a delicious garlic wine and butter sauce. Big portions. Excellent sweet potato fries. Great place to eat when at Hollywood Beach. Nightly live music but we were there for lunch.

author: Andrew Limo
review_text: Had a scrumptious super sized breakfast here with a couple of buddies and it did not disappoint. The pork chop was grilled to perfection as was the sausage, the fried egg tasted so nice and the ABC soup that accompanied the dish was another highlight. I also ordered their "kiam chye" soup because I was curious and it was delicious. Overall, if you are looking for comfort food that uses homemade recipe and cooking style .... this place will blow you away for sure. Best thing is that it is so CHEAP ....... ENJOY !!!!!!!

author: Luca
review_text: The best fish I’ve eaten in Bali. I had tuna carpaccio and it was absolutely delicious. Fresh, well prepared, and full of flavor. Highly recommended if you want to eat great fish in the center of Bali. The staff was very kind, welcoming, and attentive, which made the experience even better.

author: Gloria Raymond
review_text: Can't speak for the other combinations but my Sweet Heat slice was soooooo good that I had to run it back before I left Vegas. Everyone in my party was happy with their pizza. Will def go back next time I'm in town. Creative pizza joint/bar with something for everyone.

author: Kiran Aravapalli (akakiran)
review_text: Went here a while ago and then came back, I think it has really dropped off - the tenders I ordered were cold, and the mac and cheese was also cold and given to me before my full Oder, And possibly the worst cole slaw I’ve had in recent memory and look how small it is! Biggest issue was they no longer offer tap Water! - Aparently people broke the cups (in Williamsburg really?) - it is a disappointing cash grab and I won’t be back because of it.

author: Ryan
review_text: One of the best Nasi lemak in SG. Power in Boon Lay is my other favourite. Rice is fragrant consistently and chicken wings are to die for!! Pricey though, expect to spend ~$10. Expect to queue if you go at peak meal times

author: Kseniya Karpova
review_text: The food was amazing! It's a cosy place with a relaxing atmosphere.

author: Jason Mackinnon
review_text: Had an incredible meal here! The burger was juicy, flavorful, and cooked just the way i ordered. Easily one of the best I’ve had in a long time. I also came in late when they were on "fried food only" but the owner made me a burger regardless. What really made the experience even better was the service. Crystal was amazing—super friendly, attentive, and had multiple check ins with me. Top notch service.

author: Carla Harris
review_text: The food was great when it finally came, the wait to be seated was an hour and after being seated and getting our orders taken right away, the people next to us got served first though they were seated after. We waited and additional 30 minutes for our food to arrive to the table. Shrimp was huge and juicy in the molcajete, and the beans (which I hate) was absolutely delicious! The staff was great and our waiter was the greatest. He was funny and gorgeous. The prices were high but very well worth it and you can tell the food is authentic and made to serve, also if you think you don’t want to tip that’s out the question the tip is included on the receipt automatically.

author: Rose Mar
review_text: Food was good but the service wasn’t so great. Waitress took her break and we were left unattended for quite some time. My husband had to find another waitress to take care of us. Not sure if we will be back. Really didn’t meet our expectation.

author: Maya D
review_text: If you're looking for an affordable meal with fast service, Kimly is a good option. The food is okay, but the value is definitely there

author: Twila Kawai
review_text: This location on Flamingo is the cleanest In-N-Out Burger I've been too. The staff was friendly. They stopped to ask if they could take away our trash. The food came out fast.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Jenny Drysdale
review_text: Enjoyed a lovely meal here. The food was fresh and delicious, the service was attentive which made for an enjoyable experience. The vegetarian spring rolls were just so good. Well done on providing a a great place to eat.

author: Luke Marden
review_text: Absolutely amazing breakfast and coffee! Everything was fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. The coffee was rich, smooth, and clearly made with care — easily one of the best cups I’ve had in a long time. The breakfast was just as impressive — generous portions, beautifully presented, and full of flavor. The staff was friendly and attentive, making the whole experience even better. I’ll definitely be coming back — highly recommend!

author: Iveta Petelova
review_text: To be honest Roberto’s is so much better; I got a burrito asada; the meat was not seasoned and sometimes some beef has this..very unfavorable old fatty like taste -that is just not a good taste . I asked for sour cream (in hopes u can kill the beef flavor and eat the rest) that’s $3 but no one tells you it’s extra; I had a smoothie - not home made; rather an ice packed with cool air taste.. service charge for credit card is another $1; tip is automatically added for parties. The “regular” burrito and soft drink ran me $34 and for $24 the next day I went to AYCE sushi/ Asian food I did enjoy the authentic items as decor - and I always try to find something good in any situation so here - enjoy the atmosphere :)

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Irena D
review_text: This place is located just downstairs of the building where I live, so I had visited it for a couple times already. I can say, very average and definitely not for a special occasion. Beautiful interior, nice patio, but food is not so great.

author: hardika dave
review_text: We had a fantastic experience at The Butcher’s Daughter! We ordered a waffle, a burger, and a coffee, and everything was absolutely delicious. The restaurant offers a great selection of vegetarian and vegan options, making it a perfect spot for plant-based dining. The ambiance was warm and inviting, with a beautiful garden-like vibe that made it feel incredibly cozy. The service was excellent, making the entire visit even more enjoyable. Highly recommend!

author: Bhavika Gondhalekar
review_text: I was looking for a place to have a nice coffee. I came across cong caphe as their reviews were nice so I decided to go there. I ordered vietnamese cold coffee, It was really very good. Worth it! Also the ambience was great!

author: Gavin Peterson
review_text: Had outdoor seating for a quick bite. Or indoor seating for a more dedicated experience. 10/10 staff. Music was upbeat and kept the mood lively. The food was fantastic. Service charge is a part of the meal. It was a bit pricy, but some of the best breakfast items I've ever had. Definitely worth it.

author: John Wood
review_text: Great food, fresh and hit. Handmade tortilla. A bit spicy but so worth it and great price. Loved this place!

author: Sara Al Zarooni
review_text: I’m here visiting from Dubai, I must say this has been one of the best food places I’ve ever tried. Came here for dinner yesterday and breakfast today! Servers are super friendly and welcoming as well

author: Ammz Drrt
review_text: Nice food especially tongue and beef fried rice is so great to try. Don’t forget to order sweet potatoes fries, it’s so so so delicious I love it. Someday they will have party to join, it’s so fun and many people there. Cocktail at Chunn are also interesting. 🫶🏼

author: Ummu Pertiwi
review_text: They serve comfort Indonesian food. Love the fast service, despite our visit during lunch time, most food came around in 10-15 mins. flavor was not the best but pretty decent and comforting. my favorite was their pecel pincuk, lidah sambal ijo and asinan betawi. the fish couldve been a little less sweeter (it came out too sweet).

author: H Woodson
review_text: Food was just alright. Everytime I visit Boston I look for black owned restaurants and the atmosphere was great but the Restaurant Pasta is waaaay too spicy for my liking and the Mac and cheese had no flavor. The calamari was very chewy. The oxtails were good but fatty. The water boy stayed on his job and I approached that. The manager did give us a round of drinks on the house though so that was nice of him. I would go back though just to support.

author: Aliene Sasaki
