review_text: The reason for going to Sonic was to fulfill a request or an out of towner. They wanted a Hot Chocolate Malt and an Orange Shake. Sonic does not do malts anymore so settled for a shake. The shakes were great but it took 45 minutes to get them. I know the business seemed a little busy for mid afternoon but this wait was excessive. It seemed like drive thru customers orders came first, that is a management decision to prioritize.

author: Paramita Rut Setiawati
review_text: Everything were so good! The coffee, snack and food ❤️ Know I knew why this place was really famous! Around 30 minutes in queue for the table. But its worth enough!

author: Penguinrating
review_text: Excellent place, excellent atmosphere, good service. The sandwich was excellent. The waffle was very fresh. The chicken was fresh. All the ingredients were fresh, a little spicy for my taste, but everything was good. The bathroom was a little dirty. The entire place on the outside was very clean. I liked hearing the chefs singing in the kitchen. A little expensive. The chicken had a lot of flour. Speedy 6/10.

author: Jonathon Chua
review_text: One of the few places with reasonable price but awesome food. Highly recommended Hakka Yong Tou Fu which operates in early morning 530am to 9am. Handmade YTF each at $0.80 without minimum order. Add pork into your dry noodle. Dancing Char Kway Teow, as the name goes. The chef stir fry your dish, he shake, rattle and roll. His own chilli recipe only at $4.50 with an egg. Fish Ball Noodle. Good decent serving with newspaper interviews. One of my favourite too. Dessert - end your lunch or dinner with dessert from here. Not too sweet, average price $1.80 - $2.00. Tau Suan my favourite.

author: Gina K
review_text: I understand that everyone has their own taste when it comes to dim sum. I’ve tried dim sum in many places—both in Thailand and abroad—but honestly, this is the one place I just don’t understand the hype. Most of the customers here were foreigners, with only a few Thai diners. As for the taste, I personally found the dim sum quite disappointing. It was edible, but definitely not something I’d come back for. That said, I really appreciated the staff here. They were friendly and attentive, and the service was excellent. While the food wasn’t for me, the warm hospitality made the experience more pleasant, but overall, this place still didn’t meet my expectations.

author: Paul Leong
review_text: Foh San in Ipoh is a bona fide town institution — the kind of dim sum house that generations have visited, where the building itself feels like part of the city’s culinary heritage. The space is grand, bustling, and unmistakably old-school: large round tables, trolley energy even without the actual trolleys, and that signature din of families, tourists, and regulars all converging under one roof. It has the atmosphere of a place that has always been there and probably always will be. But when it comes to the food, the experience is… fine. Their standard dim sum offerings — siu mai, har gao, char siew bao, chee cheong fun — are competent, familiar, and reliably executed, but nothing particularly memorable. It’s exactly what you’d expect from a long-standing establishment playing to a broad crowd: serviceable and comforting, but not pushing boundaries or standing out from the pack. You go to Foh San for the nostalgia and the institution-status charm; the dim sum itself is standard fare, and that’s perfectly in line with what the place intends to be.

author: Kevin Caro
review_text: I can only say good and great things about the food. The kitchen team really knows what they are doing. The food was delicious, and the presentation was great without trying to do too much. It just worked. I have to thank the wait staff as well as they were very courteous! This is a must go place for Asian cuisine in Brickell and Miami in general.

author: Joe Kleyner
review_text: I placed a pickup order at Sweetfin and was told it would be ready in 10 minutes — it ended up taking over 30. On top of that, while I was waiting, I noticed flies hovering over the food behind the counter, which was really off-putting. The food itself was decent, but between the long wait and hygiene concerns, I’m not in a rush to go back.

author: Chris McGuirre
review_text: Don’t waste your time or money my son and I were starving. All we wanted was a burrito. We ordered two California burritos waited over 30 minutes and charged me $17 each it was the grossest smallest mushiest burrito I’ve ever had it was the size of a Taco Bell Dollar menu burrito and it’s not in the greatest of area of town

author: Kenny Yap
review_text: Easily the best meal I’ve had in awhile and possibly the best I’ve ever had in Bali at any price point, yet the price is highly reasonable for the quality you’re receiving. I headed there on a Friday night without any booking, a ballsy move which paid off as I was dining as a single pax. I got the bar counter at first but was able to move to another high table. I went with mixto ceviche, wood fire grilled chicken and 2 of their starters - the beef tartare and squid. Finally ended off with their frozen cheesecake. Everything was superb, and while the chicken felt somewhat normal I wanted a meat instead of ordering all seafood items, so it went well in the end. Service was also tip top, constantly checking in on me without feeling too imposing and also topping up my water and clearing the empty plates. The vibes was also pretty cosy with a live DJ in the background. The interior needless to say is one of the nicest you would see in Bali, with high ceilings.

author: Nic Hallberg
review_text: Really cute authentic street food shop in a small alley. Food was amazing, best food I had in Saigon so far. Ordered the Pork neck and salt fish fried rice. The chef is a lovely lady and all seems clean and orderly as well. (They have a huge fridge) Felt confident to go here and wasn’t disappointed! I’ll be back every day.

author: Ivna Aragao
review_text: They have a greta combination of ingredients, but the burger was a bit rare and falling apart. I haven't quite summed up the "want" to go back, despite how good the food looks. Also, avoid parking at the gyms parking lot, next to their place.

author: Thien Do
review_text: 10/10. Enjoyable as always. Highly recommended for others. I left a review for the vegan restaurant but I enjoy being here for the open mic so much and I had friends over here numerous times for drinks so I'll leave another one. Today I went for the open mic and ordered guava juice. The juice is good and tastes absolutely natural. Service was good as usual. Friendly host for the event. The atmosphere was amazing.

author: Joey S
review_text: Finally fixed my chilli crab craving here. The seafood quality is top-notch; both the crab and prawns were remarkably fresh and sweet. The restaurant is crowded, but the vibrant atmosphere adds to the experience.

author: GirlgeniusNYC
review_text: Excellent! The avocado salad is great! The sushi is delicious! The affogado dessert was awesome! (Small but mighty -- perfect!) The menu is very clear and easy to understand. I suggest ordering only one or two dishes at a time, you need it eat it ALL. You can order as often as you like. Excellent friendly service! I will be back! *** You have 90 minutes to enjoy the ALL You Can Eat ***

author: Cahyo Rubiyanto
review_text: This is my very first time to visit Seribu Rasa and got recommend from my colleague in Singapore, He told me to try the foods in this restaurant. And Yes finally I come and get excited for every single dishes. My favorite one is Seafood Cakue, at least you have to try. Absolutely will come again!

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: cklee 1121
review_text: we can pay but you serve us less meat only give more soup no meat ,small pcs together we boikot so everyone can cheap bakuteh to eat 22/4 send fren go there eat realize that pork they used is imported one smell taste different its meat has a weird taste,green colour no quality meat

author: K O
review_text: Delicious food and generous portions. Service was so kind and attentive, the atmosphere was clean and very nice. If you're in the area I definitely recommend it!

author: David
review_text: --food is on point --always nice and friendly --I also pop in sometimes, always let's me use the restroom- love it

author: Justin Webee
review_text: Bentleys Steakhouse and Bar is a great spot with a local vibe. The staff is super friendly and helpful, adding to the welcoming atmosphere. The only downside is that smoking is allowed at the bar, so there is a slight cigarette smell in the air. I tried the meatball Parmigiana Sandwich, which looked amazing but tasted underwhelming. It seemed like frozen meatballs on a hoagie with marinara and melted mozzarella. However, the onion rings were a hit - crunchy and well-cooked. My wife had the chef salad with blue cheese dressing, which was just okay in terms of taste. The fries were pretty good, especially when dipped in their spicy teriyaki sauce. Overall, the food was decent but not outstanding. It's more of a casual hangout spot than a true steakhouse, but still worth checking out for the friendly staff and relaxed atmosphere. Perfect for grabbing a few drinks and enjoying the local scene.

author: Ashby H
review_text: Very friendly staff. The atmosphere in general was pretty overstimulating, and the food had little to no flavor, other than grease and salt. I felt sick after eating one taco

author: Under Cover
review_text: We came here for lunch and were really happy with our overall experience. The restaurant is located just a couple of streets away from the main beach road, making it easy to find but still quiet enough to relax. The atmosphere is casual, clean, and comfortable, and the staff was very friendly and attentive. All dishes were freshly prepared and arrived quite fast. I started with a Caesar salad, which looked nice and fresh, although there was a bit too much dressing for my taste. I would have preferred it lighter, but overall it was still enjoyable. We also ordered chicken wings on skewers, which looked amazing and came with a delicious sauce — perfectly grilled and full of flavor. Another highlight was the Laab, a Thai-style minced meat salad with mint, onion, and herbs. It was served cold and packed with flavor — perfectly seasoned and very authentic. We also had squid with sauce, which looked great and tasted just as good. Another dish we tried was chicken in coconut sauce, which was absolutely delicious — creamy, flavorful, and perfectly balanced. For drinks, we had water and pink milk, which was very sweet but refreshing. The restaurant offers a wide variety of dishes — both Thai and Western options like pizza and sandwiches — plus a great selection of beers. In total, we paid only 530 Baht for everything, which is incredibly affordable for such a touristy area. At the end, they even gave us a small mint candy with the bill — a nice touch. Overall, a great experience and definitely a place we’d recommend to anyone visiting the area.

author: Natchonlathon Kodsup
review_text: Love this place! The ribs is amazing, don’t even have to use knife. The side is delicious also the soup (sorry no photo!). The staffs is so friendly and very attentive. Food is a bit slow but acceptable. Very good location and nice atmosphere. We were so happy to travel this far for this. Recommend!

author: Thalia Pardo
review_text: My boyfriend and I had dinner here and wow… everything was so much better than we expected. The food was incredible seriously, every single thing we ordered was delicious. We tried a bunch of different dishes (we definitely went all out), and not one disappointed. The flavors were rich, portions were perfect, and it all looked just as good as it tasted. Our server Amanda was amazing — super friendly, helpful, and just made the whole night feel even more special. You could tell she actually cared. The vibe of the restaurant was also really nice cozy but classy, and just felt like a great place to unwind and enjoy the evening. We left full and happy, already talking about coming back again. Highly recommend.

author: Somya Patro
review_text: Amazing surfer chill vibes at this restaurant! The bartender Dinesh had greaat energy. It was my husband’s first time in Singapore and first time trying a Singapore sling, and 10000/10 best one I’ve ever had. I told Dinesh I wanted to experiment with different drinks and he kept em coming - each one better than the next. Chili chicken and garlic naan was such a good combo, can’t wait to come back and try all the other food they have! Definitely a must have in Singapore. 😍

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Eva Athanasaki
review_text: Delicious food! We had the special bun cha with the spring rolls and we loved it! Flavourful and fulfilling! The spring roll was one of the best ones we had! Do not miss this place!

author: J Fong
review_text: We have been a few times and it is one of our go to places for Ipoh chicken & bean sprouts. Here are some points bout this place and my dining experience: - Seats & tables are by the roadside or in the restaurant though limited tables. There is no air conditioning in the restaurant. For a more airy seating, the outdoor seating is better. - They have retractable awnings which will provide a level of protection if there is rain. - Order is placed with staff who will approach to take your order. It is stock standard service as you would expect. - Payment is by cash or e-payment. - Chicken is of firm texture. The sauce was a bit on the oily side. Flavour wise was pretty alright. - Bean sprouts too were a bit on the oily side. Flavour and texture wise was pretty good. - Sometimes there may be street vendors who approach diners selling their wares. I would come back but probably may need to tell them to cut down on the oil.

author: E L
review_text: Old school Vegas spot with great food and service. I enjoy that they have a seperate enclosed dining area away from the gaming and smoking. Been coming here for years with family and friends and we've never been disappointed.

author: Camila Mora
review_text: Great service! The owner came to check in on us multiple times. The food was delicious, we got the grilled octopus, grilled shrimp skewers, chicken chaufa, and the steak with pesto pasta. Will come again!!!

author: Andrea Chua
review_text: Soup is very sweet and fragrant after all the lala are cooked. We dig in immediately the lala is cook. We did not even managed to take any pics only at a later part for this review. I definitely will come again.

author: Shivam Patel
review_text: Was looking forward to coming with my friends after looking at some of the reviews, especially the crab rangoons. Well, you get what you pay for. Stay away from the seafood later in the day. Everything else was ok, chicken dry/overcooked but edible. We accidentally paid extras for soda (which was fine) but we had to ask our server for water instead 3 times, she kept asking us what kind of soda. Not sure why that’s an issue, you’re getting extra money for nothing? Can tell the staff has an attitude problem, from the front desk to the waitress, maybe just a bad day? A couple of waitresses were talking amongst themselves near us and kept glancing at us, not sure if they had some issue with us? We were still polite regardless because we don’t have time to cause problems. What finally did it was seeing a mouse scurry from the buffet food area running towards behind the front desk from where we were seated. Was hoping to come back with my family, now you won’t see us again. Hope others have a better experience. Or just get a much better quality plate from anywhere else for $18. Reviews from other take out restaurants nearby say they have generous portions anyways. Will be going there in the future

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: Chelsia Chan
review_text: Generous mixed organ soup! Value for money. Really a lot of ingredients, very generous. The salted veg is very tasty, adds on a tinge of sourness to cut through the meatiness porky taste.yummy

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: Koonma Souriya
review_text: Service was great! Food was delicious! Very reasonable pricing! Staff were polite and fast service! Variety of ice cream!

author: Andy Bullard
review_text: You can count on consistency when you ho to an in-n-out burger place. One time I went and the drive through was a super long line, so I just went inside and the wait was not so long. The next time I saw the drive through was clear so I went through there. The service in both instances was the same, great. No differences in food quality or service. I will make it my choice when the need arises.

author: Jessica Rush
review_text: We had a great time in Beverly Hills, and the Mexican food was an added bonus. Our server was excellent, and the food was good. However, as someone who hasn't had Mexican food in LA before, I wouldn't have too high of an expectation, It was good but could have been better. The atmosphere was lively, which matched the fun vibe of the town. The restaurant did a good job keeping the energy up. Although not cheap, the prices were reasonable considering the location.

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: Dyi Wong
review_text: This Michelin-star char koay teow is next-level goodness, with that rich duck egg flavor coating every strand of noodle. It’s the kind of taste that wraps around your taste buds and stays there, with just the right balance—not too salty, but still packing all the flavor. Is it the absolute top best? Maybe not *the* best, but it’s definitely in the hall of fame for char koay teow. If you’re a fan, this one’s worth every bite—it’s one of those dishes that makes you proud to be Malaysian!

author: arif rahmanto
review_text: Good for looking affoy food The interesting is Halal food and Haram food has different place including the utensils. Perfect

author: Brandon Brabender
review_text: Such a great find! Out of all the places you could grab lunch in San Francisco, I’m sure glad we stumbled upon Kate’s Kitchen. Highly recommend!

author: Melanie Empting
review_text: Used to love this spot, but the poke quality just isn’t there anymore — not worth the price. Staff is friendly!

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Yessi Gomez
review_text: First time here and I can honestly say I had a great experience. The food was good quality and overall, the atmosphere is amazing!! 10 out of 10

author: Gianna Freitas
review_text: foods good, but horrible service. a guy came here 3 times with the wrong order, horribly busy, barely doing orders and EATING PIZZA instead of DOING THE ORDERS??

author: mohamad arif
review_text: With nice place and nice food. Surely great to come with whole family

author: Huynh Nhu Nguyen
review_text: I stumbled upon this "secret recipe" while attending a meeting in District 1 and happened to find a great restaurant. The food was delicious, seasoned perfectly, and very appetizing. The coconut-flavored pork belly was unique and addictive. The dessert, like the "xu xoa" (a type of jelly dessert), was also excellent. I wish there were more vegetables, because the stir-fry was fantastic. I noticed many people taking photos on the restaurant's wall. You can combine it with a traditional Vietnamese dress (áo dài, bà ba), or something similar to create a beautiful photo shoot with your delicious meal.

author: Farahanani Azri
review_text: It's hard for me to say anything i ate is good but this one won my heart. Didnt realize i finished the whole plate with murtabak too. Kuah campur and everything is tasteful instead of you tasting nothing when u mix it. Best one to get is ayam bawang, peria goreng, bawang goreng, kambing kurma. Try their murtabak daging with its dipping its so good. Good ambience with aircond and clean restaurant. Drinks are delicious and service is fast. Would repeat again here.

author: Ceciliana Betancourt
review_text: Luis and his boss were both amazing!!! The food, drinks, and desserts were amazing as well!!! The drinks definitely do not disappoint! I've had an espresso martini, a passionfruit mojito, and a blueberry martini, and I loved them all. Shout out the bartender making them 🙌🏼 .. nice, chill place. Will definitely visit again soon!

author: Christopher Gallacher
review_text: The Pho was amazing so flavoursome and lots to add at your own choices. The staff were great and the lay out was good. All in great place. I had a mixed meat and it was great I also had an iced tea and dough sticks (quãy) would definitely go back.

author: Princess Lizzy
review_text: This food smelled and tasted so good I forgot to take a picture before we started eating! Mike and Nana (I hope I’m spelling her name right) were so enthusiastic and inviting, from the moment we stepped through the door. The catfish was HOT, fresh out the fryer, the mac & cheese was amazing and the cornbread was too! Coming from Atlanta, this was a great first stop for some food and we already agreed to order more tomorrow. Thank you Cornbread!! 🤎

author: Sayu Devi
review_text: Perfect spot for sunset! It gets pretty hot before 6 PM, but they provide umbrellas. It’s an outdoor bar, so they’ll close if it rains. Loved the vibe, just wish the food was better!

author: Nghĩa Nguyễn Tấn
review_text: 1 star – WORST DINING EXPERIENCE IN BALI This place is a total disaster. I ordered their signature pork ribs – the most basic and iconic dish in Bali – and guess what? “Sorry, we ran out.” They forced me to switch to beef. The beef was disgusting – tough, dry, and had a weird smell. Honestly felt like chewing on an old shoe. The place was dirty, with greasy tables and flies buzzing around. I ended up with a stomach ache right after eating. Totally ruined my day. To make things worse, the prices are ridiculously high for such low-quality food. This is the kind of restaurant that survives on tourists who don’t know better. Avoid at all costs. Don’t waste your money, your time, or your stomach here. Never again.

author: Michael Vu
review_text: One of the best broken-rice (Cơm Tấm) in Saigon. The portion is quite big, but tasty grilled pork ribs are great to try.

author: J L
review_text: Second time lucky as there's usually a very long wait here. The virtual waiting queue helps as you can't book! I grew up in Malaysia and Laksa is my go to. My broth was rich from the coconut milk, fragrant from the spices and umami from the shrimp and curry flavours. The noodles were different from the mix of Hokkien noodles with Vermicelli I'm used to, but still chewy and contrasted with the textures of the other ingredients. My friend's Bak Kut Teh (pork ribs in herb soup) were tough and dry, like the meat is overcooked. The ratings reflect this chewing exercise for her jaw. Service was very efficient as we would expect for such a busy place. The front patio increased the seating area and the whole place was bustling. They didn't kick us out as soon as we finish, which would be very common in many countries. Maybe this is because of the tipping culture?

author: Jay Tham
review_text: Circuit Road Hawker Centre is a hidden gem with that old-school neighbourly vibe I absolutely love. We grabbed a seat outside, where the breeze was cool and uncles next to us were deep in beer, tea, and stories. It felt like stepping into a childhood memory. But the food? Pure magic. First up, the claypot rice — every grain smoky and fragrant, with lap cheong and salted fish adding bursts of savoury sweetness. That crispy rice at the bottom? Heavenly. Then came a surprise: the fried egg with oyster, or orh luak — not your usual. The eggs were extra crispy, the oysters plump and fresh, and that rich gravy poured on top was next-level. A slight char in the flavour made it insanely addictive. I accidentally ordered the dry bee hoon with fish, lala, and Napa cabbage, expecting soup — but what a win. The seafood was fresh and generous, and the sauce clung to every strand of vermicelli, bursting with ocean flavour. The Batang fish was thick, juicy, and rich. And the fried Hokkien prawn mee? Absolutely divine. That deep prawn broth flavour, the perfect wok hei, and nostalgic taste hit all the right spots. It’s been ages since I had Hokkien mee this good. Around us, the sound of clinking beer bottles and chatter made the food even better. Circuit Road isn’t just a hawker centre — it’s a flavour-packed escape.

author: Sophia Rivera
review_text: I’m horrified with the customer service here. The French fries for one are plain they don’t even carry salt and pepper which would be nice since Dipping sauce isn’t Free…I’ve never heard of a food business that doesn’t offer at least one or two dipping sauce complimentary.I’m talking 10 DRY LEMON PEPPER WINGS and nothing but ketchup to dip it in…gross.I’ll also add that it costs $1.00 for sauce a size of a dollar coin.ridiculous.Then we have the front desk worker who looks like he rather be laying back chilling at his house than to Be doing his job.This guy for one BARELY spoke English.For two Got my smoothie Order wrong three times even though we pointed out the image of which drink we Wanted.THREE he was eating a meal like he was on his lunch break when we walked in and FOUR took OVER 30 minutes to make our SMOOTHIE in the first place! This man took his sweet time with EVERYTHING and Had to be reminded that we ordered a drink and never received it.THE GAG Was when he finally did make it after the 30mins went by IT TOOK UNDER 5 minutes to make!!!! So why were we waiting a HALF AN HOUR?THE AMOUNT OF CUSTOMERS IN THE SHOP IS NOT AN EXCUSE BECAUSE THEY DIDNT START COMING IN UNTIL A FEW MINS AFTER WE ORDERED AND THE GUY LITERALLY DIDNT HAVE TO DO ANYTHING BUT TAKE THE ORDERS.Horrible Horrible Horrible! will not be coming back.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: JMA Amaya
review_text: Real good service. The meats and sides are delicious. My group of 6 enjoyed menu A. Personally, enjoyed the beers on tap, they're better on tap. Lots of variety of Soju. Their radish paper is really good, preferred it over their rice paper. Good for a dinner on a Monday night.

author: Damon Fleming
review_text: This restaurant is in the hood so it's only open inside during daylight hours. And it's actually closed by 5 inside. Even in the summer. If you order ahead you have to go through the drive thru. They won't bring the order curbside and you can't go in to get it. It gets crowded because the parking lot is small but the lines move fairly quickly.

author: Chelsea Hallford
review_text: Amazing experience!!! Loved the food, the atmosphere and most of all the service. Nia was so kind, knowledgeable and a joy to have as my server. 10 out of 10 recommend. When you come get the local catch ceviche, delish!! Thank you Nia!

author: Veronica Parakhin
review_text: This is my go-to cafe for pastries, and their croissants are the best I’ve ever had! I think I’ve tried every pastry they offer and, while all incredible, the almond honey and raspberry pistachio are my personal favorites — I really wish the pistachio was offered year-round! Skip the chocolate chip cookie (neither chewy, nor crispy) and monkey bread (quite dense), though. The line can get very long (especially Friday 10-12, Saturday 11-12), but I always wait for the great coffee and pastries.

author: yf lim
review_text: This is the best pork ribs I’ve tried in Bali so far! The meat was incredibly tender and well-marinated with delicious sauces. We also ordered the fried pork with a slightly sweet and spicy sauce — it was so good that I completely forgot to take photos 😅 The side dishes were tasty as well. The only downside is that the environment can be a bit hot if the fan isn’t blowing in your direction. Will definitely come back again for the pork ribs!

author: Daniel Church
review_text: The staff at Real Deal are amazing. Always helpful, friendly, and efficient. The food is reliable and tasty - with plenty of gluten free options (including French fries made in a separate frier). We get takeout from here often and always enjoy it. Recommend!

author: Michelle Siggers
review_text: Went there on the word of a co-worker but also from a taste test before seeing type of thing. I experienced the food many weeks earlier from a delivery situation it was very delicious. So, I had to visit and experience the food firsthand. They did not disappoint, from the fast service of the bar/waitresses, the cashier/owner working the register so his employees can focus on the tasks at hand, and to the friendly customers waiting to be served. It was all really nice and a welcoming sight to see at 6 in the morning.

author: Patricia Cordero Perez
review_text: This is one of those places you never forget. The flavors are truly unique and unforgettable. Totally recommended, one of the best quality-to-price experiences you can find in San Francisco.

author: Pak Soon Lau
review_text: Nice small market and food centre serving the local residents adequately. There's a stall selling very reasonably priced Yong tau foo (uncooked) here. Most of the stall holders are elderly and quite a few stalls are left vacant. Hopefully this estate will see some rejuvenation and more young families.

author: Lucille Rose
review_text: Food is delicious!!!!! Everyone is friendly One long table, no decor on the table, or tablecloth on it. So it doesn't really feel inviting to sit and eat. No music playing So it feels more like a come order, take your food and go type of place.

author: Atia Allen
review_text: I went here to celebrate my daughter’s 24th bday back in January. Me and my family had such a great time!!! It was a chill atmosphere and we were able to simply relax and enjoy ourselves. The food was phenomenal!!!!!!!! My boyfriend and I went back last weekend but we arrived right before closing and were unable to dine in. I wanted to introduce him to the establishment since he had never been. We arrived too late, but we will definitely try again another time.

author: Sam Kai Xiang
review_text: Well this is one of the best food court in singapore where you can get local delight for the true taste of Singapore ! The chicken rice here is underrated nice

author: Ruben
review_text: This place deserves a review. The drink (creamy tiramisu frape) was really delicious. The ultimate croissant sandwich with salad was made so well! The poached egg, prawns and other ingredients so refined! My boyfriend had the chicken pita. Also that meal was so tasty! The pita not too thick, the fries crunchy and not too greasy, the chicken tender. Best place! Compliments to the staff, keep up the good work!

author: Kurt Kurtenbach
review_text: I highly recommend this restaurant. You shouldn't believe me. Go there for yourselves to test my judgement. Ask if the old chef is cooking - he makes the magic. I was driving around looking for a place to eat with my wife. Being in Las Vegas as visitors had left us missing a little bit of home. We couldn't eat in a casino restaurant again - neon lights, loud music, people smoking ten feet away, someone trying to sell me a watch - couldn't do it again until we had a normal meal. We trekked around town in my truck until we got into a very Hispanic neighborhood. Like our home town of Tucson, AZ, that tends to mean good food. My wife pointed out the restaurant, El Canelo Restaurant. We pulled in and went inside. The owner, I believe, greeted us immediately. She was colorfully dressed to match her beautiful attitude and genuine smile. We chose the seats we wanted to sit in. They serve canned soda or Mexican imported bottled soda along with a selection of beer. After a time of our looking over the extensive choices in the menu, she took our orders. My wife got a cacerola campirana while I ordered the molcejeta mixta. Chips and a delicious medium heat salsa were served. Not long after our food was served. If you have never experienced a molcejeta, let me tell you about it. Great big stone bowl on carved legs. It's been in a very hot oven till its super hot. Then they add thin sliced beef. Chicken strips. Fish filet. Shrimp in styles butterflied, peeled with shell on the tail, and bacon wrapped. All this goodness is in the bowl with a generous leaf of lettuce draped over the side, a grilling (and grilled) onion, and a halved jalapeño. It's all afloat in a generous amount of delicious broth and cream. When the molcajeta arrives at your table, the heat from within the stone is boiling the broth and mixing all the flavors. I could not believe how good it tasted. I've eaten good Mexican food at fine restaurants before, but this was honestly great food. The service was awesome. The atmosphere was typical Mexican restaurant affair, except it all was clean and well placed - nothing crooked on the walls, dust was absent, not even a single fly. We leave town in two days and hope to return before doing so. My wife really liked her food. Normally I would talk you though it, but I was busy head down working on that molcejeta. (Did I mention the Queso Fresca in the broth?)

author: Mr Fock
review_text: This Nasi Lemak is overpriced basic ikan bilis is charge instead of including it 3 dishes $6.30 ridiculous the taste also more or less the same as the ordinary Nasi Lemak 👎🏻

author: Sharminii Edween
review_text: My husband booked this place for my birthday and we had a wonderful dinner.. The service team Neek ,Tina and Rajib did an amazing job serving us time to time. The food here is absolutely delicious and presentation is beautiful too. We will surely come here again for another occasion.

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Thanh Ngân Trịnh
review_text: Very good I really like this place, very unique and very conveniebt, also cheap and not too pricey, should come here when I have time

author: Aleksandra Abdulgazijeva
review_text: The bar is located in a truly beautiful spot. If you arrive about 1.5 hours before sunset, be prepared — it gets very hot, even though there are umbrellas. We didn’t make a reservation and came by chance about two hours before sunset, being among the first guests. The sunset itself was truly unforgettable. We paid nearly €300 for some snacks and champagne. The food certainly doesn’t match the prices, but for such an incredible view, it feels worth it.

author: Chungster UK
review_text: First time at a Qatar Premium Lounge, and the lounge at Changi T1 is simply amazing. Special thanks to the team of Hazel, Elsy, Stary, Pinky, Jessy, Divan and Alvin for their superb, professional, 1st class service throughout. The food was also excellent and very tasty (had tempura prawns, chicken satay and red thai chicken curry with rice). Thank you so much for making us feel so welcome . I will definitely try to experience a QSuite flight in the future!

author: Simone Pantaleoni
review_text: Their signature dish, grilled pork, is fantastic and definitely different taste than classic and traditional thai food - very suggested of you want to take a break from the usual Bangkok flavors. Staff is kind and service is quick - prices are very fair

author: teng teng hor
review_text: Simply walked in to this restaurant as I was around Siam Square area. The mama hotpot is 👍🏼 as well as the crispy pork belly. Price is a lil high but worth the price 😋

author: R E “Florecita Rockera” Villalta
review_text: It has been 10 years and still the same or better. A little renovated with packing salsas still a place to go.

author: Bernard Bulwer
review_text: Great variety and taste! The very best combos, so you won't be disappointed!

author: JCelyn Y
review_text: Very satisfied with the service provided by Zi Yu. Attentive, she will ask our preference in soup, veggies and even rice. Cheerful too. Definitely added points to the whole ambience. Taste wise, I think you could start with original first. Truffle sauce will overwhelm you fast, if you are like me, not into heavy cream. 4 for atmosphere as it's rather hot from where I sat

author: Luis Ardon
review_text: The worst delivery experience possible. It’s almost like they try to get it wrong every single time. I keep ordering because it’s conveniently close to home but they either don’t deliver and don’t communicate it to us making us waste time. Or they get the order wrong and miss items. Or they deliver the food without notice and we find it full of flies and bugs hours later. TERRIBLE service. I never write reviews but I have to at this point.

author: Nabeal Nasser
review_text: To find the truly good luxury spots, you have to gatekeep a little. They’re not obvious—you need to earn them by looking hard. Be patient, explore, and eventually you’ll discover those hidden gems worth everything.

author: Anthony C
review_text: First welcome to downtown Boston, growing up in the Midwest allows me to become familiar with Taco Johns and im so glad to see you all finally open up! The prices that im used too are alittle lower but this is Boston so the price of everything I ordered was fair. Service was excellent thanks for being so welcoming! I will be coming back again !

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Xuân Trần
review_text: The Chill restaurant I went to in Binh Thanh was very good, so I stopped by Tan Phu branch 2 to try it, and the quality of food and service is still the same! Buffet price 166k/person with a wide variety of meat and seafood.

author: Alan Tan
review_text: My wife discovered this place, and we decided to give it a try — and I'm so glad we did. Hands down, the best Thai fried rice I've ever had. It’s easy to see why this spot is so popular. They take their time to perfectly cook the rice, and the crab meat is absolutely incredible. This is definitely a must-visit and will be a regular stop for me in the future. Highly recommend!

author: Sandra Figueroa
review_text: The staff here was very friendly. The food was subpar. It wasn't bad by any means, but if you want some really good tacos, then definitely look elsewhere. their aguas frescas very refreshing

author: daniel garcia
review_text: The staff was perfect the food was perfect it was a perfect Birthday Dinner for my beautiful wife of 35 years thank you Triple George for the perfect Dinner and drinks. We had the dinner for 2 and added a Tail Ceasars Salad was excellent as well and the loaf of warm fresh baked bread was awesome we did not finish that whole porterhouse it was cooked to perfection, we left there completely satisfied. I never new this place was here will definitely go back next special occasion when we come back Downtown Vegas

author: CY “Pixandroid”
review_text: Ok. I love the texture of the noodle and will miss it. Recommended to order big size The dessert drink beside the stall also good in servicing

author: Sharon Lim
review_text: Near Malay mosque and Indian temple, near Chinatown Mrt station. For lamb lovers. I didn't know what to order as it was my first time. The staff helped with mobile ordering and recommended 1 person hotpot. The soup was very nice and comforting for me. The self made noodle taste nice when it's more cooked (near the end) in my opinion. Vegetables were nice especially the black fungus 银耳. Tried the BBQ too, was ok. Prefer it to be meatier. The staff are very attentive too, will refill/adjust heat etc., made the solo dining experience very pleasant. Will order ala carte next time as I think I prefer cut boneless lamb meat to the rest but still appreciative of the recommendation.

author: Hang Le
review_text: First of all, Nong would like to sincerely thank you for taking the time to evaluate and share your opinions about the quality of service and food at Nong. Your feedback is a source of motivation for Nong to constantly improve and enhance … More

author: Koh Gary
review_text: Old school market for center, no frills, genuine local flavors. Love this duck noodles stall, Uncle Lee is friendly and cheerful, makes your meal a happy one.

author: Tom Duffy
review_text: One of the best local pubs I’ve been to flying out of Logan stopped to visit. My niece came to Jeannie’s ordered some food but the grill was not on the owner. Hank said if you’ll be here a while, I’ll fire it up and cook for you. it doesn’t get any better, the food is fantastic as well as the selection of adult beverages Can’t wait to stop back gotta try the chili. Thanks Hank

author: Felix Hernandez
review_text: This mc Donald's varies in quality from food to customer service. They need a dedicated person at the register,.the person is always in the back somewhere and people have to wait because they prioritize the drive thru over people inside. I should have to wait longer to ordemthan the actual time for the food to come out. Lastly please.only hire.people who can speak English,.half the time when I order,.they don't understand me.

author: Panar Taw
review_text: Food is ok but I feel like the price is a bit high compared to the quality, the beef on the set is too chewy, but the picanha beef is nice

author: cxcxline
review_text: No wait on weekday morning but mostly full. Ordered the signature bagel, generous portion size and I was very full, only around 6-8 tables and not suitable for groups bigger than 4. I got matcha yuzu and pistachios bagels takeaway and both were great as well!

author: José Guevara
review_text: I’ve been here a couple times in the bar area because the 2 times that I went you have to wait for a table, otherwise the service is great, I always like came to chilis very good food, excellent margaritas and compare to other restaurants is relatively cheap for that you can get. The 3 for me is one of the best deals, appetizer, main dish, drink for up to $18.

author: Mian Wu
review_text: One of the best meal we had in Bangkok! Would highly recommend the mango sticky rice smoothy, sausage, stir fried veggies! Love them all!!

author: Lord Dragneel
review_text: Good for a quick bite prices are decent and the place is clean.

author: Lokman Black Jr
review_text: Nice curry for curry hunters. I love it so much. The price is affordable for everyone subject to the selection of foods. 1 thing I feel so annoyed about is that they will recommend the high price of foods without telling the price. They suggested to me ayam piru without telling me the price which cost me RM45 for 2 pcs of ayam piru!!!! So be careful not to repeat the same mistake like I did. Ask the price 1st before proceeding with the meal. That's the only thing I feel bad about about this place. The rest just enjoy your food and I believe you'll love it so much.

author: K.W. Ng
review_text: Yes, their chicken hor fun is very good. One of the best in Ipoh. No regret eating here. Pls come before 12 noon, as other stall start close down at 12. The white coffee here also authentic, taste is very kaw, definitely worth the try. Chicken hor fun soup is thick and full of taste, not like other shop. Definitely a 5 star for the chicken hor fun.

author: Jilla Marie
review_text: Great service and a great Friday bar experience overall. Got the for the start of HH when the bar was 95% vacant. Had a very reasonably priced seafood/shellfish platter and a couple of tasty drinks. Would visit again because the location and vibe is great!

author: Celio Centeno
review_text: The food was good. The service was good too. Be advice that they serve a lot of food. We order "la convi completa" and we ate two out of it. The "arepas were really good too".

author: Janet Stiles
review_text: We always enjoy our trip to Wahlburgers. The food, service, and atmosphere were perfect. The food was cooked perfectly, and I loved the truffle fries. Our waitress was very good and attentive. The atmosphere is cozy and very clean.

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: Mike MY
review_text: Average kopitiam, super attentive staff and courteous. Even recommend other various side dishes. (Did not see a menu or I wasn't too attentive because of delayed lunch). Overall, a good stop.

author: m. melody
review_text: Was worth starving myself the night before to get a table and eat early lunch the next day. The ambiance and location was impressive. Loads of dishes to choose from their menu. Excellent customer service. Will definitely come back.

author: Gabriela García-Astolfi
review_text: This is some gooood ramen. I went after work with some friends visiting NYC, around 5:30pm on a Tuesday, and it was busyyy. Luckily, they had a table open for 3, but we only had 45 minutes to eat since they had a table reserved for 6pm. I hate being rushed but this ramen was so dang good I didn't mind scarfing it down. My only qualm is the staff reminded us of our remaining time every 10 min or so. 1 1000% understand the importance of making sure your guests leave on team so the table can be cleared and set for the next party, but it was a bit excessive this time. It didn't ruin our experience and meal, but felt it was important to mention!

author: TAL TAL
review_text: I love this place for its variety of local food. My favourite 3 stalls are: 1. High Kee BBQ seafood 2. Leng Heng chicken rice 3. 60 BBQ Satay These 3 stalls have been serving great food for many years. The owners of High Kee BBQ Seafood started off in the 1990s selling chicken rice. Reasonbly priced, great service. Leng Heng chicken rice is one of the best in Singapore. The chilli is superb. The guys at 60 BBQ Satay are friendly. Satay is well cooked and gravy is shiok. All three stall owners have now become my friends. There are others you must try too like BBQ chicken wings, soto ayam and fried oyster. Parking is a plenty. The place is well patronised during weekends.

author: Frank Garcia
review_text: I was wowed by my experience at Ey-vál. This has been one of the best Persian food I have had, they certainly ey-vál which is a Farsi(Persian) word that adds positive emphasis to an idea. I’m surprised they are not in the Michelin guide but I’m sure they will make it sooner than later. The service was top notch. Super friendly and professional, fairly fast, knowledgeable about the menu and attentive. Ambiance was dark, enigmatic, hip, I liked it a lot. The food, what we came for, was beyond delicious. We started with the Mast o Musir and I gotta admit I have had great ones before and thought it would be hard to beat, but this one goes to the top of the list now. So so creamy, with shallots cut at the perfect size and acidity balanced out. I continued with a salad( can’t remember its name) and while this was not a truly Persian dish, I loved the modern approach and all the flavors they accomplished on this dish. It was my second favorite dish after the mast o musir. The lamb ribs were a solid dish. The sauce had the perfect sweetness/acidity as well as spiciness and the barberry on top complemented so sell. The two kabobs were nicely done but my favorite was the koobideh. This is a personal preference as I’m more into koodideh than steak kabob. I understand the chenjeh is more premium, but it is just my preference. All in all, the 2 kabobs were 5 out 5 stars. Tahdig which is one of my favorite Persian dishes and a really simple dish, was perfection in a single bite. That sauce they had the rice on, it was spot on. They made it also so good looking. I loved it. You can’t leave a Persian restaurant without having Persian ice cream. However, to be honest it didn’t do it for me. There were a few flaws : typical Persian ice cream sandwich is with crispy and thin waffles, this one was with a soggy bread, also the ice cream was not as creamy as it should be. The ice cream sandwich was subpar compared to the high quality of the food I had. All in all, looking forward to my next time at Ey-vál. Please open a location in Miami :)

author: The Soto Standard
review_text: What I ordered : a virgin piña colada, a stack of, Nutella banana pancakes and a meat lovers, and BYO omelette with onion peppers sausage bacon cheddar cheese, ham. The host was nice in seating me in the back which is more private. I was told to scan for the menu which was a whole lot easier to pick and pay electronically. The food came not even 10 mins later . Quick and was hot and ready to eat. The omelet came with toast and was so delicious. The pancakes were the highlight. Easily the best pancakes IVE EVER HAD in the state of Massachusetts. It was a little pricey but totally worth it. Visit The Joint if you want an elevated breakfast experience .

author: QITING LIU
review_text: The seafood pot is generous in portion and the soup is extremely delicious; I had two to three bowls. Other stir-fried dishes also come with abundant ingredients — the water spinach and salted egg yolk chicken are particularly tasty, which deserve high praise. So delicious! The environment is nice too.

author: Q W
review_text: Our very first try 😋 There are already a lot of people queueing up before the store opens. Refillable rice and soup , huge portions , we ordered two different kinds of tonkatsu, was amazed by the taste, very nyumm 😋 But It takes some time to be served because it is freshly made

author: Shamiha S.
review_text: Amazing spot! Affordable and delicious. Everything we tried was flavorful and well-spiced. We ordered the clucking waffle sandwich, the tikka melt, and their spicy smash burger. All of them were great!

author: Ah Rui
review_text: Curry is cooked with milk instead of santan. nice curry despite a little bit spicy for me. overall nice food served. service nice, the staffs are friendly and helpful 👍 they came over and explain food menu patiently , thank you 😊 The drinks we felt a bit too sweet, hopefully can prepare others option for customer, like sugar level / sweetness level of the drinks 😉

author: Kei Fung Lee
review_text: We (2 adults and 2 boys, 8 and 5 year’s old) enjoyed the dinner around 19:50, weekday. We ordered half chicken, two rice, one mixed vegetables, one standard fried rice and one beverage. The price is reasonable. Staffs are helpful and lovely.

author: Varada K
review_text: Most incredible meal at Tonino. Went on a Sunday night for a birthday dinner and was absolutely blown away by the most incredible food. We started with the Pizza Biana woth ricotta and hot honey which was so smooth and creamy. Would definitely recommend everyone to try. Actually ended up getting more bread since the dip was so delicious . We also got the Margherita and eggplant and ricotta pizza slice which was so flavorful . The Lumache mushrooms pasta and the Taleggio Capelliti was like a taste of heaven. It absolutely melts in the mouth! Was so lucky to finally get reservations and so thankful to our amazing server for making it such a special night !

author: Jamie L
review_text: Outstanding service! Somehow our group reservation wasn't in their system, but they quickly accommodated us, and they were happy to do so. From walking in the door to paying the tab, everyone we encountered was friendly and helpful. Our server, Jaredh, was very attentive and nice. Even the manager, Kevin, took care of us at times with a kind and friendly disposition. Also, the food was delicious! And the drinks... Get the margarita flight!

author: Karla Cortez
review_text: We visited on a trip from Texas, right before Thanksgiving. I was not disappointed. Walking in, the store was clean and welcoming. The staff was friendly and right away started conversations. They gave us the locals recommended places we should see and visit on our trip. It was really nice. The food was fresh and delicious. There's nothing like a good, juicy burger with crispy bacon! The chicken burger was good, too. We also had the fried pickles! Delish!! I personally loved the tots, but my family's favorite was definitely the onion rings! We would definitely visit again!

author: Lee Zhao
review_text: The egg is wonderfully creamy and rich, living up to the hype for a premium street-food experience. The shrimp are large and generous, and while you noted they are firm, that confirms their freshness and quality, though a bit more tenderness would be a great touch. At around 390 THB, it’s a high price point, but the excellent taste and the trendy, clean atmosphere

author: Kristina Bates
review_text: The Restaurant was clean and well put together. The food was great & the blueberry lemon drop was excellent. Coming from a 20 year Server/Bartender our server wasn’t very attentive ☹️. We just felt like she disappeared a lot during our meal, and it was weird because the restaurant wasn’t crazy busy. But she was sweet! The guy pouring waters was extremely nice and sweet as well, The chef even stopped by to ask us how our meal was. Overall I’d return and hope the next time our server would be more attentive.

author: Selva Murugan
review_text: Come with a heavy appetite and you will not be disappointed. Has a huge selection of Chinese food and includes hibachi grill and sushi. The desert is good too.

author: Ezgi Melody Yurtseven
review_text: I had such a great experience at The Butcher’s Daughter. Our waiter Emily has such a kind soul — she was super friendly and took the time to explain everything to us about the orange wine. The manager Ashley was also very welcoming, which made the whole experience even better. I can honestly say that not only is the food good, but the people are too. We had the margarita pizza, and it was amazing. We also had white wine and rosé, both incredible, and we tasted some orange wine which was also very good. The aesthetic of this place is just unmatched. It’s such a clean, aesthetic, Pinterest-worthy restaurant that I will definitely visit again. The food came fast, the vibes were so on, and overall it was just a perfect experience.

author: Thomas Tam
review_text: Hard to go wrong with chicken rice in Ipoh I think. Also tried Lou Wong across the road and found the chicken here slightly more tender, particularly the breast meat. Rice flavour was a bit better too, though slightly soggy in texture. The beansprouts here aren’t quite as al dente as I’d like. Overall very nice and feels a little less touristy and possibly more authentic than the competition across the road.

author: Abhrajit Choudhury
review_text: The Hungry Pig: Where Bui Vien’s Chaos Meets a Culinary Twist Tucked away in the labyrinthine alleys behind the ever-buzzing Bui Vien Walking Street, The Hungry Pig isn’t a café you stumble upon — it’s one you discover. Hidden behind the raucous hum of backpacker bars and street music, this unassuming spot has earned a reputation that quietly travels through word of mouth. This café isn’t chasing authenticity in the traditional sense. Instead, it delights in reinvention — a playful collision of East and West. Think King Kong meets Godzilla, but on a plate. The result is familiar comfort food with an unexpected Asian edge — bold, inventive, and surprisingly harmonious. The menu reads like a witty conversation between culinary cultures. Forget about finding your standard Bodega Sandwich or Molesey Beef-Dripped Chippy. Here, the creativity lies not just in the recipes but in the names themselves — clever, tongue-in-cheek, and impossible to resist. Here’s what stood out during my visit: All Day English Breakfast – crafted by someone who truly understands that the way to a man’s heart is undeniably through his stomach. Fish & Chips – a nostalgic nod to home, though I found myself longing for those traditional beef drippings (curse you, healthy living!). Hamlette — bitten by the Bard, yet a charlatan in the written arts; but, I dare say, a master in the divine art of cookery. Pig Lebowski – hearty, unapologetic, and undoubtedly made by Dudes for Dudes. Notorious P.I.G. – because some dishes don’t just speak; they declare. Each plate carried that satisfying blend of humour and heart — a café that doesn’t take itself too seriously yet delivers on every bite. So, next time you’re wandering through the chaotic charm of Bui Vien, take a detour down its quieter corners. There you’ll find The Hungry Pig — a tiny nook where fusion finds its fun, and brekkies might just last all day.....Cheers!

author: vania
review_text: This place have a very nice atmosphere, gives off industrial and rustic vibes. The food is absolutely divine, me and my family enjoyed everything. You can go here to just have a snack or a full meal, and you will be satisfied.

author: Dr. Ravikiran Barigala
review_text: Stepping into in-n-out felt like walking into a time capsule. The burger was objectively the best burger I've ever had. There was a nice employee who gave my kids the in-n-out hats and some stickers, making them really happy. It was a great experience on the whole.

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: Ian Li
review_text: The shop front is relatively small, which makes the place look like it only does takeaways, but there is actually seating space inside and upstairs. The food is cheap and good, offering a variety of egg noodles and fried rice options, which come with various combinations of wanton, roast pork, roast duck, char siu, crab meat, and prawn. The noodles, if you choose the dry option, are coated in pork oil, which adds alot of flavour. Portions also aren't too big, so light eaters do not have to worry. During busy periods, expect to share tables. Only cash is accepted. Overall, it's a fuss-free place if you're looking for a quick meal.

author: Mrs L
review_text: Used to frequent this tzechar years ago but the food has deteriorated so so so much! Sambal prawn was so gross - more oil than sambal, sambal flavor mediocre and the worst part, the prawn was not fresh and badly executed. Pork chop was average at best. Mee goreng ordered at a tzechar when it’s good it’s good but this one was yucks to the max. The only dish worth stomach real estate was the egg furong. Overall a disappointing meal which is such a pity given how good the food here was back in its heydays. Thankful we have so many great tzechars in Singapore we can frequent. Lots of mainland China tourists who will sustain the business here though. Though for me, never again.

author: Anissa Be
review_text: A truly American bar experience! The place is very unique and beautifully designed, with an absolutely stunning sunset view. The burgers and ribs were delicious full of flavor and perfectly cooked. The only downside was the service: our waitress barely checked on us, which was disappointing. However, the rest of the staff seemed great and attentive. Overall, a memorable spot worth visiting for the atmosphere and food.

author: Ashley Hackett
review_text: Very disappointing experience. We ordered calamari, chicken Cesar salad and cheeseburger. The chicken was very stale and rubbery. It appears to have been rewarmed several times before serving. Order burger medium - came overcooked. The calamari was also very rubbery. I cannot understand how this restaurant has any more 2 stars honestly.

author: Joseph Saperstein
review_text: A wonderful space for hanging out, socializing, eating, or grabbing a drink right in downtown San Jose. It felt, calm, pleasant, and lively. I also loved feeling the connection to history. We need more places like this in downtown!

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: Mindy Wong
review_text: The restaurant is on the second and third floor, the first floor is a souvenir shop and has so many things worth buying. Definitely worth a visit, the staff were friendly and the place is really nice. The food was FANTASTIC, I would eat it again. The squid was the highlight for me. Do your research before you order your food, the food I’ve ordered were delicious but I’ve seen people slandering the restaurant when they didn’t order the right things.

author: ARMANDO HISUAN
review_text: Cuca Restaurant offers an exceptional dining experience that combines creativity, flavor, and elegance. Each dish is thoughtfully crafted using fresh, locally sourced ingredients, highlighting both artistry and taste. The restaurant’s ambiance is modern yet relaxed, providing a perfect setting for a memorable meal. The staff deliver impeccable service — professional, warm, and attentive throughout. Overall, Cuca stands out as a fine example of world-class dining that celebrates culinary innovation and local inspiration.

author: Gene Soares
review_text: The atmosphere is very nice, super friendly staff and very nice. I felt bad for the waiter as it seem he was the only one working but he nice . Now the food smh … I had the lobster ravioli with grilled shrimp now the ravioli was flavorless and I don’t know what type of lobster that filling was but yeah no it was nasty , the shrimp was over cooked and no seasoning. The wing let’s talk about frozen wings that you can buy from the store to much breading just yuck. My sister got crab cakes and said they were obviously frozen crab cakes and nasty. The calamari was decent could have been seasoned some more. My son enjoyed his chicken bacon ranch pizza and my brother in law liked his chicken parm. Oh my sister didn’t like her minestrone soup . But like I said the staff was nice.

author: Asyraf
review_text: Amazing how it can still withstand the flavour and complexity despite it’s journey from Bukit Merah to Pasir Ris 🤣 Super friendly uncle and it was nice that they are extremely thankful for every single customer that came to purchase their food. In terms of the food itself, it’s just spicy enough and flavourful enough, but the key ingredient is the hum. So I will ALWAYS go for the extra hum option. Go for small for a snack, medium for a proper meal, and large if you’re famished! The best part of the whole thing, when I went there around 7+, there was NO QUEUE! Amazing. Would definitely come back again and again if I stay in the area. Best halal certified kway teow in SG hands down.

author: 6CRAN
review_text: Place is packed. Very narrow on the bar side and nice size booths on the dine in side. Great prices. Lots of bang for your buck. I get the fish and chip which is always fresh. Great drinks. This is that neighborhood feel. Diverse crowd. Prices cannot be beat

author: casual gamer
review_text: I occasionally stop by Potato Corner at the Americana, usually about once or twice every two months, for a quick bite. I’m not a regular customer, so the staff doesn’t recognize me. Unfortunately, the service has been consistently disappointing every time I’ve visited. While I’m not a big fan of wings or chicken tenders, I do enjoy the food from Potato Corner. However, the lack of customer service leaves a lot to be desired. The staff, who seem to be fresh out of high school, never acknowledge me when I pick up my order. They simply hand it over without so much as a “thank you,” even when I make the effort to thank them first. It’s clear that the young employees lack the work ethic and customer service skills necessary for this job. It’s frustrating as a customer to be treated with indifference, especially when all I’m doing is ordering food. A little politeness and appreciation can go a long way, but unfortunately, that’s been missing every time I’ve visited.

author: Christian Breitkreutz
review_text: You can almost forget that you sit in a mall. Until you have to use the bathroom. But ok. As long as this cosy restaurant feeling carries you through your lunch / dinner it‘s ok. When you eat at Roast you get Roast. No matter which place you choose. And that’s good. Because the food is delicious! A nice creative fusion approach to many Western cuisines. And they just revamped their menu. I had the Peruvian chicken. Very nice. My girlfriend had the chicken pasta (actually gnocchi) - great!

author: Jimmy Tanico
review_text: Ordered the brisket and gotta say I was pleasantly surprised. I get the concept and was skeptical. Got the brisket home and I was genuinely impressed with the price and value. My daughter lives in Williamsburg and I am in the suburbs and I expected the typical Williamsburg price gouging. Honestly, I am writing this after buying the same brisket meal a second time. When you go back to a food establishment and order without looking at the menu - that's good food.

author: Min Khant Zaw
review_text: Bustling old school dimsum place right in the middle of the city. A must have for breakfast! Also, their thai tea is one of the best in the city. Who knew pairing thai tea with dimsum will be such a great combo! Friendly staff. Room with aircon available across the road. Plenty parking spaces available on the side of the road. Very affordable price.

author: Dwi Novita Cahyaningtyas Permatasari
review_text: Always want to come back for the poke bowl. The ambiance is equally inviting—cozy, warm, and perfect for a relaxed meal. Whether you’re dining solo or with friends, it’s a spot that makes you never feel disappointed.

author: Simone Rendell-Shelby
review_text: This is my new go-to coffee shop! The owner, Veronica is lovely too, friendly and knowledgeable. Amazing coffee and pastries, beautiful interior design which fits the overall relaxed/chill and Chic environment too. PS I recommend the Lavender Lattee with macadamia milk, the coffee cake and the blueberry and lemon scone. Even better there are vegan options too.

author: Mauyeeyee
review_text: They have an extensive menu and lots of dishes they don’t serve in Australia, I wanted to try them all! 😄 My favourite dishes were Crispy Shrimp Rolls, Pan Fried Chinese Chives Dumplings, Glutinous Rice with Chicken and Wolfberry Cake. 😋 I loved about their great ambiance with spacious interior, high ceiling and lots of natural lights. The open air seating was welcoming, the restaurant was well ventilated with multiple fans around. I will return for my dim sum fix when I visit Ipoh next time~ 🙂

author: Rayan Kidia
review_text: I rarely leave reviews but I had to this time, I went with my friend at around 8pm and we both got the chicken pita sandwich and one serving of their greco fries to share for a total of 35 dollars (not cheap at all for what we got). The fries were served ice cold and both sandwiches were uneatable, the chicken was extremely greasy and flavorless, I asked to get it without onions and tomatoes and guess what happened... I got it with extra tomatoes and extra onions... The cherry on top was the stomachache we both got a few hours later. I would NOT recommend to anyone and I really don't think it deserves he 4.6 rating it got on here.

author: Sten Sun
review_text: It was my first visit here and I had a perfect experience. Oyster of the day were the best I’ve had, I ordered them twice because it was very fresh. Of course other plates are excellent as well. It’s a 15 min Uber ride from the city center, so if you want to have a leisurely meal, make sure to come here.

author: lee sin jean
review_text: First time dining here , very good for my first impression. Nice food and clean environment. Although we stay at LeeVana hotel.. it's a 8 minute walk to this restaurant. Fresh coconut water it's a must order in menu. There is a traffic control person outside from this restaurant to manage parking convenient. The food is delicious and the price is consider worthy to the portions. There is a little museum beside this restaurant belong to same boss. The boss also come to greet us welcome. Definitely will come again here . Highly recommend for family restaurant.😊😊

author: The Lost Forest Mum
review_text: We visited Warung Babi Guling Ibu Oka 2 during our trip to Ubud and it truly lived up to the hype. The roasted pig was incredibly crispy on the outside and tender inside, full of rich Balinese spices. The set meal came with rice, spicy sambal, blood sausage, and vegetables, flavorful and satisfying. It’s a casual, local-style eatery with quick service. Go early, as the best parts like the crackling skin sell out fast. A must-try spot for authentic Balinese food lovers! 2 🌟 - Below Average: Needs improvement in multiple areas, not meeting expectations. 3 🌟 - Standard, Average: Meets basic expectations, nothing exceptional but acceptable. 4 🌟 - Standard, Above Average: Exceeds expectations slightly, better than the norm. 5 🌟 - Special & Unique: Outstanding experience, highly memorable and exceptional.

author: Omar Ramos
review_text: Good food, very reasonable prices, and significant portions. I found this place via a TikTok posting and I have to say, it didn’t disappoint. The restaurant is medium sized and it’s family owned. The decor is Mexican to the max but that doesn’t really impact the food. I had two salsas Azada wet burrito and it was really good. I added some of the spicy green salsa that comes with the complimentary chips to add more spice to it. Overall, great food with plenty of parking space. The customer service is great too. The staff is super friendly.

author: oh wei
review_text: Foods are savoury and salty . Ordered 4 dishes. The clear soup tomyum is too salty, fried pork is ok. The money vegetable with egg is the most delicious. The foods are not as delicious as the other comments mentioned. Wouldn’t recommend for others to come.The food quality is not worth for the price we paid. You can find better authentic and local Thai food in other places in Hatyai. This is the worst I had so far. The staff is unfriendly and rude. Can’t wait for long and roll eyes while taking order. lol what a joke. Bad service overall. Good atmosphere and ambience though , full of decorations.

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: Frankie Lim
review_text: Infamous kidney mee sua soup and many other good dishes ( sesame chicken, dried fragrance fish head, vegetable...etc) from this long history authentic restaurant at changi. There's another one at kaki bukit food center.

author: Jayson Roy
review_text: Reviewing in January 2026.. I'm truly disappointed by the entrance staff! I was just a single person to enter.. first they asked me about the reservation? I said no, then they asked me to buy whole bottle of 750ml of whiskey to enter. I said I'm just one person, why should I buy the whole bottle, I can drink inside as much as I want.. but they refused entry for not buying the whole bottle..!!! This is INSANE!! Very BAD! The WORST part is that, the play a bit RACISM game on entries... they keep changing the rules for different patrons! I talked to other person who were refused too... and the reason he told me was that the staff asked him to book the WHOLE TABLE WITH WHOLE BOTTLE OF WHISKEY!! WOW!!!!!!++

author: Brian Tai
review_text: The social media advertisements make this place look pretty good. The BBQ and food overall however, is very average. The pork ribs fell off the bone; that's not a good thing. Over steamed ribs fall off the bone. Well prepared BBQ comes off cleanly with the bite but still has structure. The brisket was very dry. The burnt ends were hit or miss. I did like the sides however. For vegas, this is "fine". I'd eat here again, but I wouldn't go out of my way to take people here bragging about it.

author: Pamela Barron
review_text: A-mazing food taste and presentation! A delight for the senses. Atmosphere has a cozy, but busy bar vibe.

author: Miya FM
review_text: I’d been meaning to come here for months, and I’m glad I finally made it on Monday. The waiting list was only five people, so it went by quickly. The service was excellent—the staff were very friendly and informative. I loved all the food, and I was shocked at how big the chicken was! The coffee was also impressive; the caramel with almond milk is my favorite. Definitely worth the hype.

author: LeePing Phuah
review_text: Very poor food taste and quality Papadam masuk angin Inform waiter no chili and no pedas still end up with spicy plate of noodles.

author: Jason Tan
review_text: We came here for breakfast. The queue is not too long, we order mee Kia soup. The soup is delicious and the noodle is not too soft type. The wanton is also good. After we order the queue became very long but move off quite quickly. My personal favorite is still the closed down bak chor mee stall at blk 58 new upper changi road hawker centre.

author: Wing Chan
review_text: Heard about this Lala hot pot and tried it for dinner. Ordered the large hotpot and portion is reasonable. Lala hotpot is delicious and it's a fusion of Lala and steamboat. Service from kevin is excellent, he came over to check on the food and dinning experience from time to time and ensure everything is good. I like the idea of the fusion and the food is good. Parking could be a problem, be sure to be there early.

author: Sha Natasya
review_text: Excellent service from staff member Nick!⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ He was very friendly and even helped us take a lovely family photo. I celebrated my father’s birthday here, and Nick made the occasion even more special. This staff member is truly outstanding as he represents the company with a very positive image. The company should really appreciate and value staff like him. Thank you for the warm, attentive, and professional service truly a great experience. Highly recommended!

author: Sander Hicks
review_text: Hey, this is a really great place positive place to eat! Wow the $8.99 five boneless wings and waffle fries combo special is a great value. The chicken is solid breast meat, not composite nugget meat. Inside, friendly atmosphere with music videos. Julio always remembers me and remembers I don’t like to use plastic bags. Nice guy, great food!

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Angel Travieso
review_text: THE WAITRESS WAS VERY CANDID IN EXPLAINING THE MENU AND RIPPED US OFF 2 PEOPLE A 179.00 PLATE . THAT IS JUST WRONG.... AND A 44.00 SERVICE FEE PLUS A TIP.... THAT IS WRONG. THE FOOD WAS UNDER COOKED WHEN ASKED WELL DONE. HORRIBLE EXPERIENCE

author: Adrian Bridglal
review_text: Service there sucks as staff would rather have conversations than serve people and get a line moving in for far too long. I have supported this business and every time I come there people walk out from behind the counter to go do something other than serve the customers while a line builds up. There’s usually one person, servant, and they will all look at you and leave you there to suffer like you’re begging for the food do better only one you have potential to be great I walked out of that restaurant today and told myself I will not come back and support a local business that can get things done right simple service etiquette they lack.

author: Jason Fong
review_text: This is it! The hype is real! This is the most delicious pizza I’ve ever had. Lots of flavor from the grana padano, the sauce was deep and tangy, basil was fresh and beautiful. Crust was perfectly crisp, with just the right amount of chew. It’s worth the wait. On my trip I also tried best pizza, John’s of bleecker, Angelo’s, and I liked this the best by far. Service is impeccable as well.

author: Robert Williams
review_text: Popped in randomly and ordered the catfish, yams Mac and apple cobbler. All of it was great. Nice creamy Mac and cheese fresh fried fish. Customer service was on point. And the dining area is nice, cozy and clean. Would definitely come back

author: Jim Khoo
review_text: 🌟 Foodie Adventure 🌟 Tried Famous Eunos Bak Chor Mee after many years—nostalgia hit, but with so many stores now, that retro charm feels a bit lost. The noodles were decent, though the minced pork dumpling soup was a tad too salty for my taste (lesser salt would be perfect!). It’s a solid quick fix, so I’ll be back, but it’s not a monthly must for me. 🍜💧 #Foodie #BakChorMee #Eunos #SingaporeEats #NoodleLovers

author: Prasit Aphiphunya
review_text: Excellent breakfast in Had Yai Great selection of Chinese Dim Sum and others specialties dishes. Restaurant are full of customers. Great experiences!!!!!!

author: Wai Wai
review_text: Quick, Authentic, but Missing the Punch We barely had time to settle in before our “large” pho hit the table—talk about fast service! If you're in a rush, this spot is perfect for a quick, satisfying slurp. The pho comes with a generous helping of lime, bean sprouts, and herbs—definitely a nice touch. That said, the broth leaned on the milder side for me. I have had pho that tend to be more aromatic and herb-forward, I found myself missing that fragrant depth. I ordered the mixed beef large bowl, but was a bit underwhelmed—only one piece of each meat type, which left the bowl feeling more noodle-heavy than expected. Still, the portion of noodles was fair, and the overall bowl warm and comforting. The space itself feels authentic, clean , with open fans circulating air and adding to the relaxed, street-side vibe. It’s not the most flavorful pho I’ve had, but for speed and simplicity, it definitely delivers. Verdict: 3.5/5 ⭐️, could have definitely be a 4 if the pho was bigger in portion for the “large” size and more fragrant!

author: Jim Blair
review_text: We ordered several small plates / appetizers for brunch and shared them. Literally every one was delicious. In total we had about 9 or ten different plates, from guac and chips to mega thick cut bacon (pictured) apple pear salad to enfrijoladas and more. Probably the best meal so far of our visit to Brooklyn. Don’t miss it!

author: Yan X.
review_text: Came here for lunch while some of us were windsurfing at Passion Wave. It is a great place to relax on weekends, and you can watch people sailing as you enjoy your meal. The food is delicious, with the meat especially well-marinated. The stuffs here also very friendly and accommodating. We will definitely come back again!

author: Hannagh Jacobsen
review_text: Amazing food! Have been here before but first time in the new space. The brunch is so good, get the fresh hot sauce or else you’ll regret it. The house hot sauce is especially important for the chicken and waffles. The service is great as it’s always been. The new space is much more comfortable but I wish the lighting were a little softer for those of us sitting at tables. 10/10 my favorite brunch restaurant in Boston.

author: Peter Vu
review_text: L’Industrie absolutely lives up to the hype. The crust is light, airy, and perfectly blistered with just the right chew, while the sauce is bright and balanced—not overly sweet. Every slice feels thoughtfully made, from the classic Margherita with fresh basil to the richer toppings like burrata and pepperoni that add real depth without overwhelming the pizza. Even when it’s busy, the quality stays consistent, and the slices come out hot and fresh. Easily one of the best spots for authentic, no-nonsense pizza that still feels special, and well worth the wait.

author: GWZ85
review_text: This place has amazing yam rice and the pork soup is so flavorful. It's a really great little spot for a casual meal. The neighborhood is lucky to have such a gem of a kopitiam. I highly recommend checking it out if you're in the area. You won't be disappointed.

author: Jaimy Reuter
review_text: I am a fan of Bubba Gump Shrimp and anytime I am in the USA, I need to get my portion of shrimp there. I‘ve been to many locations and this bayside/downtown Miami Restaurant was no disappointment! It was exactly what I wanted. Good food, good service and an ok price. Overall, worth the visit!

author: Karen Liu
review_text: I had a great dinner experience at this Legal Sea Food’s rooftop enclosed patio! It was hardly busy at all on a Monday night, so the place was quiet and very easy to talk. Our server was attentive and helpful. We started with the fisherman’s platter, which consisted of a variety of fried seafood and veggies (onion, fries, coleslaw).
