The calamari was fishier than other ones I’ve had at restaurants, but everything else was tasty! We also ordered two soups: the clam chowder and the lobster bisque. The clam chowder was delicious, cheesy, and creamy. The lobster bisque, however, was weirdly caramel-y and off putting; we did not enjoy it. Onto the mains, the prime rib cooked medium rare was delicious, and cooked just a bit more rare than expected but I actually prefer a rare/medium rare so it was great. The szechuan beans and mashed potatoes were also decent, they paired well with the steak. The other two mains (white fish and lobster tails) met our expectations as well, as they were tasty and well-portioned. The one main that we were let down by was the clam pasta (I forgot the specific name), but everyone thought it was overly sour, perhaps due to lemon? Overall, we enjoyed a great meal at Legal Sea Foods; the atmosphere and service were both great and I would recommend this chain to anyone visiting Boston.

author: Georgina Liew
review_text: Best tonkatsu I had so far. Pork tonkatsu is delicious with big serving and the soup is amazing. However they only have 17 seats so queue up is unavoidable. And no bookings allowed.

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: derek neo
review_text: Good and popular thai food but not cheap. Be prepared for a long queue. The pandang chicken was really good, the chicken was wrapped in pandang leaves and was perfectly charred. Service can be improved... they were sold busy and they forgot to smile.

author: Joseph Lauenroth
review_text: Atleast Nebraska won. While in Vagas find the Nebraska bar. We are used to busy Huskers games and this was exactly like home. Sadly the food is just uninspired bar food. FromNacho cheese sauce to bad chicken fingers. The burger was actully pretty decent but a bit over cooled. Service was a little lacking even for a busy game day. I've worked them and it's tough day but it seemed like we were last on her list. Will we give it another chance... if it's a Nebraska game yes but other nope.

author: Ruben
review_text: I live in the neighborhood I’ve been here 3x and every time the staff was in a hurry and a bit rude (being annoyed when they didn’t hear something or not wanting to explain something on the menu etc). I understand that these simple customer service things don’t come naturally to people that don’t get paid a living wage, but Roberta’s is very group-oriented with tables (I don’t think they let you order just a slice 🤷🏻‍♂️) and that’s just the kind of thing that happens when dining as a group so I think the staff should be patient when someone has a question. So far I haven’t felt any kindness from the servers so I won’t be returning anytime soon. It’s also way overpriced, there’s way better pizza and cheaper cocktails right nearby. Go to Moondog for cocktails and to Starrlight for a full-size pizza

author: Danny Graffice
review_text: So, the food itself was not bad I don't do sushi witch they have a lot of. It was everything else that earned a 3 star rating. They had everybody creamed into 1 side of the restaurant. The wait staff was scrambling to stay caught up,to the point that I had 2 dishes dropped on my placement. The entire team seemed very unorganized,and I was still charged full price. I don't think between the 2 of us we are 80$ worth of food. Needless to say, probably won't be returning anytime soon.ps there was no wait when we arrived,but when we left they were telling people 20-30 minutes, while still having 1 hole side of the restaurant unused.

author: Bill G
review_text: Tried the jr chili cheese burger with bacon and egg, and it was amazing. Also tried the pattymelt and some zucchini fries. Everything was fresh and really good. no lie though I didn't care for the fries, which is why I chose a substitution which they available with the meal either zucchini fries or onion rings.

author: Katherine Rodriguez
review_text: Absolutely Incredible Experience! We had an amazing time at this steakhouse! From the moment we walked in, everything felt welcoming and top-notch. The atmosphere is classy but comfortable — perfect for a date night or a nice dinner with friends. Our server Alexis was truly outstanding. He was friendly, professional, and made us feel so well taken care of the entire evening. Alexis knew the menu inside and out, gave great recommendations on the steak sauces, and made sure every detail was perfect. It’s rare to get service that good these days! The food was beyond delicious — our steak was cooked exactly how we ordered, juicy and full of flavor. The sides were good but the Lobster Mac and cheese were very dry. The Moo steak sauce was impressive. The cocktails were meh.. I’m not a huge fan of savory cocktail which the Devils Advocate was strong but savory. The milk and cookies dessert was the perfect finishing touch. That moo milk is something else!! Everything about this place was exceptional. Great food, amazing service, and a wonderful atmosphere. Huge thanks to Alexis for making our dinner so memorable! We’ll definitely be coming back!

author: Will Tan
review_text: Nice food, fried rice is very flavorful, wanton noodle also quite good, fish ball tasted like from SGP in a good way. many tourists driving from Malaysia will stop here for breakfast.

author: Kristie Ann Van Winkle
review_text: The Cheesecake Factory is a fairly reliable option for dining. As one person in our group said, the food is always good. The menu is amazing, extensive and there's something for everyone. My only complaint is it's loud. I've been to 3 different locations and it's the same for each one, loud. I think it's the design. This is fine for groups that are familiar with everyone else. It's challenging to have a conversation, which may or may not be a problem depending on your group dynamics. Our food was excellent. The service was good. I would certainly go there again. The cheesecake is next level. I would definitely want to try more of their cheesecake offerings.

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: Beng Lee Tan
review_text: 🚫carcinogenic because no have wok屎， taste very very good, must try ya!!! But, very very small portion, can eat 2 plate 😂might due to CNY Lantern Festival (Chap Go Meh) or CNY special price, no have much people, after back from washroom already serves the food

author: Phuong Do
review_text: The food is western style with breads, burgers and spagetti. It served hot when you start orders. Seafood is fresh, the taste is also good tho and proportion is not small. Drinks here also good. Coconut is so sweet, coffee is average. I came here for lunch, its a bit hot so sit inside. The decoration outside with trees, wooden tables and chairs are cute. It must be very chill when sitting outside at night. Maybe then time them :) The price is lil high compared to standard.

author: Jason Tiu
review_text: First time trying Donkai and it was a great experience. The waitress Anna was very attentive and took the time to explain the menu in detail, which made ordering easy. The food was delicious – the Japanese Wagyu hamburg was juicy and flavorful, especially cooked medium rare. The highlight for me was definitely the A5 Wagyu skewers – absolutely tender and packed with flavor, a must-try! Service was warm and efficient, and the open kitchen counter added a lively atmosphere to the meal. Overall, a satisfying lunch and I’ll definitely come back again to try other items on the menu.

author: Adrick Loh
review_text: Our first lunch in Jakarta trip. Saw the popularity and good ratings on google map. Must say the deco n environment is a good place to be in having your food. Service wise, it’s also above average just that English is not well understood. Food wise we only loved the mee goreng and the rest is just normal. The pea drink is nice, price wise the cost is still affordable by tourist standards. By the way noticed the name of the dishes all seems to reflect the regional tourist attraction but the taste is lacking attraction.

author: Shaina
review_text: I actually had a mild case of gastroenteritis that day, but since I was in Singapore, I couldn't miss the things on my bucket list, so I ordered a quarter chicken and vegetarian fried rice. The chicken was incredibly tender and not greasy at all! It was much lighter than I expected, and I highly recommend it. The vegetarian fried rice was also delicious! The drinks were a bit average, nothing special.

author: Cynthia Spenard
review_text: We sat at the bar, our server Jese and team had our drinks in before we knew it we had food sitting in front of us hot and ready!!! Thank you for a tasty evening...

author: don Toh
review_text: Very small hawker center next to a wet market. Opening till afternoon, hence mainly morning crowd.

author: Jane
review_text: Nice restaurant with indonesian-style and thai-style dishes. Love the prawn, meat, fish and dessert menu

author: Annaliese
review_text: I’ve been to this place a few times and unless you’re getting specialty donuts, quiche, or their freshly made cinnamon rolls their general donuts aren’t that great. Specific instance is their glazed donuts and donut holes are cakey not airy. And others like maple bar are pretty dry. But if you get specialty ones they pay pretty good attention and have fun flavors. One of my favorites are their peanutbutter and jelly. They also made some pretty good caramel and blueberry pie donuts as well. Perfect amount of filling in those.

author: B. R.
review_text: Staff was great. Place was nice and clean. Food was good. We liked the loaded fries.

author: Catherine Tan
review_text: What a hidden gem! I came to Ah Wang Cafe out of curiosity and left completely impressed. Tried their salted coffee—wasn't sure what to expect, but it turned out surprisingly delicious with a perfect balance of saltiness and smooth coffee aroma. The half-boiled eggs were done just right—runny, silky, and paired perfectly with a dash of soy sauce and pepper. The toasted Kahwin bread was crisp on the outside, buttery inside, with that nostalgic kaya-butter combo that hits all the right notes. And the peanut butter toast with milk? Absolutely on point—creamy, comforting, and indulgent in the best way. Definitely a spot worth returning to for a hearty local breakfast!

author: Josh
review_text: Very good location but very expensive. Coffee and cheesecake and tip is $20. Limited parking spot. Pumpkin latte is visually good but not hot enough right after served and disappointed. Request to warm coffee and owner served with remade hot latte. Satisfied. It would be wonderful if they serve filtered water, instead of tap water. It smells chlorine on water.

author: Dea Proborini
review_text: I was looking for a famous Pho restaurant near my Airbnb in HCMC and gladly found this Michelin Guide one. My friend and I ordered Beef Shank Pho, Passion Fruit Juice, Mulberry Juice and Crispy Bread. The Pho was served in a big bowl with some generous beef shank. The beef broth was very comforting and it really shooted my sore throat. Get some herbs and chili sauce to your bowl and it goes much flavorful. Don't forget to dip the crispy bread into the broth, it adds a delightful chrunchy texture. Overall, it is a simple yet heartwarming dish that feels perfect for a cozy meal!

restaurant: BÚN BÒ HUẾ BÀ KHIỂM ( CON GÁI )
author: Alex Bui
review_text: I’m from North of Vietnam and I was here with my family on holiday. I’ve heard a lot of good things about bún bò Huế in Danang. They said it’s because Danang is so close to Hue that their bún bò is the closest to Hue’s. So we picked the one closest to our hotel. The food is nicely priced. They don’t overcharge us even when they can tell we’re not from here. The owners are this lovely couple who were so welcoming to us. And the food portion was huge, took us a lot to finish. Definitely need to go check it out 🖤

author: Joseph
review_text: Our first Michelin spot in Vietnam — and it definitely lived up to the hype! The grilled pork with broken rice was flavorful, juicy, and perfectly cooked. Simple but so satisfying. Fast service, friendly staff, and that authentic local vibe you can’t beat. Totally worth the visit!

author: Sha Zamrinor
review_text: IT SHOULD TASTE LIKE PENANG. NOT KL. I came to Hameediyah with my friend and my mother, expecting the comfort of a good plate of nasi kandar. Instead, what I got was an experience that felt half-show, half-food — and only slightly satisfying. The queue was long, as expected — but that’s not the problem. What really threw me off was the behaviour of certain people in the line. There were customers more focused on filming themselves than ordering their food. Loud TikTok narrations. Tripods set up in the middle of walkways. People posing with plates while others waited patiently behind them. It was disrespectful, disruptive, and honestly, exhausting. If you came here for makan, you had to push past a content-creator circus just to get to the counter. When it was finally my turn, I stood in front of a wide range of lauk, trying to decide. Classic kuah campur for me — I like the chaos, the flavour, the mess. The prawns caught my eye — fat, glossy, drowning in orange curry — but I hesitated. Pricey, intimidating, and I didn’t want to be disappointed. So I passed. Taste-wise, Hameediyah sits in a strange space — somewhere between KL’s polished, curated tourist scene and Penang’s unapologetic bare minimum. It tries to hold onto heritage, but feels semi-delivered. Safe. Predictable. Sanitised, even. Then came my mother. No chaos, no confusion. She stood at the counter and said clearly: “Kari kambing. Sayur. Jangan campur.” No extra instructions. No need for the gravy drama. Even the abang hesitated — like her request went against some kind of nasi kandar rulebook. But she didn’t flinch. Her plate was focused, grounded, and quietly bold. It reminded me that sometimes, less truly is more. We also shared a murtabak, which unfortunately, was the low point of the visit. Murtabak should be judged by how generous it is with filling, how thick it folds, how the meat spills at the edge. Hameediyah’s wasn’t a textbook — it was a primary school exercise book. Thin, underfilled, dry. Definitely not worth the price tag. I’ve had better from pasar Ramadan stalls under plastic tents, wrapped in oily brown paper. To me, a good nasi kandar should haunt you after the meal. It should cling to your fingers with spice, leave your shirt faintly smelling of curry, and stay with you for hours — in all the best ways. But Hameediyah didn’t do that. It felt… semi-delivered. Like someone had wrapped up a memory and served it reheated. Come here if you want to say you’ve been. Take your photos, maybe even enjoy a decent plate. But if you’re looking for that true, finger-staining, gravy-sticking-to-your-spoon experience — the one that tastes like a messy plate at 11am in Penang or Butterworth — you’ll need to keep looking.

author: Hai
review_text: - The beef(?) patty inside Loco Moco is overcooked and BITTER. - Ordered Steak and Frites in medium but it came out as almost well done. This dish also took way longer than the other 3. - Surf n turf Benedict and Shrimp and crab omelette were both good. I think they are better in making seafood than beef?

author: Scott Zimmerman
review_text: The vibe in this place is off the charts...and the food is just as amazing. They have some dishes that you're not going to be able to get at any other restaurant in Miami. The quality of the oysters was better than i've ever had in my life, and that's saying, a lot, since I work in the seafood industry.

author: Vanessa Diaz
review_text: We wanted to spend a relaxing and memorable afternoon with my family. We found this lovely place with a perfect view, and the food was amazing! We ordered fish and chips, and since the portion was generous, I shared it with my husband—it was more than enough. Such a blessed afternoon :)

author: Liss Garcia
review_text: Best dominos in los angeles bomb thick crust! Great service worth the wait lots of people there though! Thumbs up!!!!

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: HUYEN NGUYEN
review_text: It must be admitted that you get what you pay for. Although the price is quite high compared to many places, around 70,000-85,000 VND for a bowl like the one pictured, the taste is definitely different from other shops. The shop is located right at the intersection of Thai Binh market, easy to find. The shop is clean and tidy, with a wide selection of fresh vegetables and various sauces to accompany different dishes, depending on your preference. The drink menu is quite diverse. Overall, apart from the slightly high price, everything else is very good 👍

author: Oscar Pozo
review_text: Last Saturday I ordered 3 beers ($24) at the bar. Upon checking my debit card statement, I was charged $100 for this order. Highly unprofessional. LAST MONTH WAS THE SAME THING!!!! Be careful with these people 🚨🚨🚨🚨

author: Evan Montgomery
review_text: Food is good, I got a breakfast burrito and it was great. Good size and they cooked the buffalo sauce inside which is nice. I’ll eat here more.

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Christine Cordova (xtineecordova)
review_text: We’re tourists visiting the area, and we had such a wonderful experience dining at De Tham Restaurant. The atmosphere was welcoming A special thank you to Peter, our server, who was very friendly and attentive. My mom preferred rice instead of vermicelli for her dish, and Peter gladly accommodated our request without any hesitation. It’s a small gesture, but it really showed their excellent customer service. The food was delicious and freshly prepared. a great way to experience local flavors. Overall, we had a smooth and enjoyable dining experience, and we highly recommend this restaurant to fellow travelers!

author: Xing Ying
review_text: ordered on grab food cos i needed a early morning breakfast. special bahn mi in large - shared for 2 pax and the portion was really really big. i could not finish it despite sharing. bun was really crispy and the filling was generous. would recommend!

author: Doron Bracha
review_text: It's a nice down to earth neighborhood pub, conveniently located on a main street. Pretty good bar, decent food for a pub, at very reasonable prices. Comfortable seating, clean restrooms. We enjoyed a comedy show on a winter Saturday night. Yet I can't rate it 5 stars due to a few things. The interior decor is not as rich as in other pubs. They held our credit card thru the evening, which we never saw in other places. It made me uncomfortable thinking that they could take pictures of my card and use it as they wish. I understand they're afraid that people would run off without paying, but in this case they had all my info since I bought the comedy tickets online. After the comedy show, we couldn't stay much longer for more food, drinks and conversation, because they played very loud music, so we left. Good experience overall :-)

author: Miguel Lopez
review_text: This place takes the cake for the worst Dennys around they messed up my order took to long to bring the food restaurant was empty and only one server it's a complete joken

author: 이예인
review_text: The staffs are very kind And the food is fantastic. Especially the homemade fluffy pancake is the best and you can have the salad together. The fresh fruit is very juicy. Also, Airconditioner in Bali is very important for my parents and they were very satisfied with this place. The music is subtle. This place is the best café in Bali in our experience. Also this place is very clean and has no bugs :)

author: Kamal J
review_text: Had fun time finding this place and climbing more than a few flights of stairs. We ordered the chicken main dish and I was unable to eat it due to the toughness of the meat. My friends also were very disappointed in their meals. Cocktails were good. My one and only meal that I wasn’t able to eat on my whole south east Asia tour! Disappointed

author: alie sm
review_text: Amazing, we tried the tom yum crispy sea bass soup, it was our favorite. The original happens moo soup it is good in normal spicy.

author: Abeygayle Lee
review_text: Exquisite omakase experience! Each dish was a masterpiece, beautifully presented with fresh ingredients. Flavors were well-balanced, and the chef's creativity shined throughout. A must-try for Japanese food enthusiasts!

author: Dee Parmar
review_text: Had an incredible experience at this Vietnamese restaurant! The food was absolutely amazing, rich, flavourful, and truly authentic. The menu offered a great variety of options, so there’s something for every craving. The ambience was warm and inviting, making it the perfect spot to unwind and enjoy a good meal. Plus, its prime location makes it super convenient to visit. Highly recommend if you’re looking for delicious Vietnamese cuisine!

author: Sergio Morales
review_text: Chicken sandwiches were really good. Idc about the “quality of service” so it gets a 5/5.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Anthony Montijo
review_text: Came in today as a dad on a mission, my daughter was working hard on her homework and really needed a coffee break. I wasn’t sure what to get her, so I asked the team for help. They were so kind and helped me pick out the perfect drink. She absolutely loved it! Thank you for the friendly service and for making her study session a little sweeter.

author: Marie Gail Stratford
review_text: The food here is absolutely amazing. Staff was super friendly. Our orders took a long time to get to our table, and there was an issue with one of the things we ordered that had to be remade. But our server was super accommodating and pleasant. She even gave us a free empanada for the trouble, and we appreciated that. When we got our orders, they were delicious. I will definitely be back.

author: BulbousBrain
review_text: Simply world-class. The scallops are purrr-fect! And the glass noodles are just as good! Worth the hype!

author: Humble Servings
review_text: 1st time actually coming here & they deliver! I decided to call in & do a pick up today & glad I did! The staff on phone & in person are the best! The food all looks is great! Pizza hit the spot! Love their fries! Will be back for their homemade cookies 🍪 We really need more good customer service like this place, 10/10 Highly Recommend 😋

author: Jane Sh
review_text: Excellent and very stylish and beautiful place, looks like a food court with a large number of different restaurants, from sushi to halal cafes, there is also Mexican and Indian cuisine and many others, there is a bar where you can drink beer and eat fresh oysters, in general a complete variety. The sushi was great, we also ordered shawarma with halal chicken, we also really liked it. I recommend this great place

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: HeLiX Truong
review_text: Good taste, cheap price, but the seat have a little hot. You must take your seat first, remember the table number and then talk to cashier when you order

author: Jonathan Harris
review_text: Solid, although not outstanding German food. Quite busy on a Saturday afternoon. Cozy restaurant with an Oktoberfest feel. The Jägerschnitzel was excellent. I've eaten better Sauerbraten. Kids menu was sufficient. Was nice to have a Hofbrau beer to wash everything down. Good service considering how busy the restaurant was.

author: youjin Song
review_text: Previous experience in Pison Ubud made me to visit this place again …!!!!! And yes, they served much better Steak than Ubud area !!!!! Loved it so much. But the view was much better the Ubud as they’ve got the nature there haha. I should come back this place for coffee 🤎

author: Cheryl Chua
review_text: Came down to try their Spicy Pork and Seafood hotpot, and it's amazing for people who like very spicy food! Tom yum taste is not the typical MSG powder type of flavour! Love it. I must give a special shout out to this chicken wing that looks dry but its so tender and flavourful. Very suitable for people who likes stronger flavoured food, 10/10 for me 👍

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: Patrick Riddle
review_text: Got there around 11 am and it wasn't too busy but that didn't last long. Rice balls were very good and went well with the sambal. Ordered both the steamed and roast chicken and both were equally delicious. Overall would I would recommend stopping in and giving the place a try.

author: Jorge Narvaez
review_text: 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟 5-Star Review – A Blast from the Past at 50’s Diner! Stepping into 50’s Diner in Las Vegas is like taking a time machine straight back to the golden age of jukeboxes, chrome, and rock ’n roll. The vibe is spot-on vintage — black-and-white checkered floors, red leather booths, and walls lined with classic pin-ups and retro memorabilia. They even have a Chevy Bel Air booth — yeah, an actual car turned into a table. That’s how deep they go into the theme! The service? Fast, friendly, and downright old-school in the best way. You’re treated like family the moment you walk in. Now for the food — top notch. I had a hearty plate loaded with crispy chilaquiles, two perfectly runny sunny-side-up eggs, grilled steak, creamy refried beans, fresh avocado slices, and sour cream. Full flavor, no shortcuts. And for the kiddo? Classic pancakes with butter melting just right, scrambled eggs, and sausage that was cooked to perfection. Clean plate = happy customer. Whether you’re craving comfort food or just want a legit retro experience, 50’s Diner hits the mark. Nostalgia, great food, and better service — what more can you ask for? Highly recommend. Will definitely be back!

author: The Guy
review_text: Last weekend, I had the absolute pleasure of dining at Kaitainam, a Thai restaurant that’s quickly become my new favorite spot. Tucked away in a cozy corner of town, Kaitainam offers an inviting atmosphere with warm lighting, subtle Thai decor, and a soft hum of chatter that makes you feel right at home. From the moment I walked in, the staff greeted me with genuine smiles and a level of hospitality that’s hard to come by these days. The menu is a delightful journey through Thailand’s culinary landscape, and I started with their papaya salad—som tam—which was a revelation. The balance of spicy, sweet, sour, and salty was spot-on, with fresh green papaya shredded to perfection and a handful of crushed peanuts adding just the right crunch. For my main, I went with the green curry with chicken, and it was nothing short of spectacular. The creamy coconut milk melded beautifully with the fragrant herbs and tender chicken, served alongside a fluffy mound of jasmine rice that soaked up every bit of that rich, aromatic sauce. I couldn’t resist trying their mango sticky rice for dessert, and it was the ultimate finale—sweet, ripe mango paired with sticky rice drizzled in coconut cream that melted in my mouth. What sets Kaitainam apart is the attention to detail. Every dish felt fresh, vibrant, and made with care, like it was crafted just for me. The service was impeccable—attentive without being overbearing—and the prices were surprisingly reasonable for the quality. Whether you’re a Thai food aficionado or just dipping your toes in, Kaitainam delivers an experience that’s as authentic as it is unforgettable. I’m already counting the days until my next visit!

author: Felita Ekwegh
review_text: The reviews I have read don’t give this place credit first of all the red color on the chicken is tandoori style chicken. A pastrami burrito will never have rice in it! Chilli cheese mustard and pickles!

author: Ricardo
review_text: Excellent food, fast service, but I find the place a bit expensive.

author: Agus Santoso
review_text: Finally got to try the original milk bun that used to be super popular in Thailand! Honestly, it tastes so different from the ones sold in Indonesia. It’s really soft and delicious, but I couldn’t eat too much—it gets a bit heavy. As for the drinks, I think the prices are a bit on the expensive side

author: Anthony Nygren
review_text: So glad I tried this place! Mango smoothie might be the best I've ever had. Alcapurria was hot and delicious.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: 권하림
review_text: Overrated and Poor Service Waited over 20 minutes at this Michelin-recommended spot. While the welcome drink was a nice touch, they only accepted cash or Alipay due to a machine issue—with no prior notice. Food was okay, but the service was terrible. Staff were unfriendly and couldn’t communicate in English, which made things difficult as a tourist. When I complained about undercooked noodles, there was no apology, and they were still not properly cooked when returned. Asking for a napkin resulted in being scolded and told I had to pay for it—which felt very unwelcoming. Despite the wait, there were plenty of empty tables inside. Would not recommend for tourists. Disappointing overall.

author: Juan Hernandez
review_text: I gave you 1 star. Your food the best. Your service the best Your atmosphere awesome. The part I completely did not like was. That you have to impose minimum 20% on tips. Come on be real. The people that eats around you or come in to your stablishment are regular folks. From the neighboring businesses. Be more humble and change that. I'm sure Mr. Bob would never have done that. If he was alive.

author: sally
review_text: Restaurant is convenient and comfortable (aircond), with lift to 2nd floor. I want to suggest to add more tables and chairs. Restaurant is spacious but not enough seatings (during peak hour lunch). So you can see empty space but not enough tables & chairs. Food is okay and price is also considered affordable.

author: Teri Nardello
review_text: Can someone please sell a salad?! Or better yet, open a salad restaurant. Everything is deep fried and greasy and a person can only eat so much pasta or pizza. And maybe a breakfast spot with actual egg dishes. If nobody wants to open early, maybe a current vendor could put an all-day breakfast on their menu. Eggs are cheap and people love hash browns and toast. So simple. Out of the more than a dozen restaurants, there is nothing healthy. I've heard out-of-town people comment on it too. They have the courthouse crowd as a captive audience - people should not have to drive to get a decent meal. It saddens me because I eat there multiple times a week because I work at the courthouse, and I am constantly struggling to decide. It's worth the short walk to Nick the Greek's to get a gyro bowl, which at least has lettuce and tomatoes. I wish they would open a MIXT or Sweet Greens or something similar.

author: Loyd Djirosse
review_text: My girlfriend and I came from very far to try this place. It took us an hour to get there just for the staff to tell us they were close? It was 10:15pm, they said they closed at 10pm on Saturday but everywhere online and even at the store it was written 11pm. I even took a picture of the sign saying “Open” but when we got in they instantly kicked us out. When I tried to have a conversation with staff to ask why they’re closing way ahead of time they just brushed me off like I didn’t take over an hour to come try this. Very disappointing. Whoever the owner is, you need to fix this or you need to update your time everywhere online, this is unacceptable. I never write reviews this is only my second time writing one and that should tell you how dissatisfied I was.

author: J G
review_text: Run away from this place. First of all it is not an attractive place, raw and dry. Some of the waiters are well trained to deal with clients. There is no ambience and the inside resembles those shady places in Brazil. The food is horrendous pricey for no reason. The portions are small and tasteless. The old crowd that hangs in the bar seems to be local farmers employees. Go to any other places but avoid this one. trust me you will be glad that you did.

author: GH W
review_text: I am not sure why this place has such a high rating. I have eaten hundreds of papaya salads in Europe, the US and in Thailand, where I spend 1-2 months every year and this was not a good papaya salad. It looked pretty authentic, but the taste was just not very sophisticated / refined. The Pad Thai was also on the lower scale in terms of taste. Further, the location is very busy and service rather slow. Nevertheless my waitress was pretty friendly at the end and asked me how everything was. Would not return here.

author: Darren Loo
review_text: Went on a weekend early evening before 6PM, not much queue, so it is recommended to visit during this period as it will get relatively packed, and the time your pot gets ready is long after 8PM. It's very stuffy if you are sitting indoors, so do find a seat outdoors. Food quality was fairly decent, but the additional ingredients were pricey around $6.90 or $9.90 each, depending on the color. The lala soup base is more on the milky side compared to the other known lala stores. It is strongly recommended to order the large pot as even for two individuals, the amount of lala felt rather little. Price is reasonable for the large at $22.90.

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: Singer
review_text: I try to frequent this place fortnightly or weekly, food has always been great and healthy Two types of rice offered, White and Brown. There is also Fermented Pork on the menu and a sizeable piece of Meat Tofu specially on weekends. The Vegetarian option is with no Shrimp added to the regular Tofu served Thanks for serving this area

author: ufcguru official
review_text: Only 1 person waiting for food in the restaurant, the place was empty at 11:15 am. We waited over 20 minutes for 2 breakfast burritos that were filled with refried beans, very little meat and it's like they put 1 egg in the burrito. Salsa Roja was "Tex Mex trash" NOT traditional Roja. The burrito itself was also NOT traditional. Traditional breakfast burrito has eggs, hash browns, chopped jalapeño, Pico De gallo and choice of chorizo or American style sausage Pepe burritos are trash! Burritos was so full of beans it was falling apart. I will never go back and be sure to tell my UFC guys to stay away! Terrible food and service..

author: SuBi BH
review_text: I think this branch is very popular among foreigners. Expect a 15min queue if dining in on a weekday for lunch. Located quite far inside L1, need to walk quite a bit from Pavillion side entrance. Amazing food as always. I love the dry pan mee and nasi lemak very much! 😋

author: Michelle Entwistle
review_text: I had an excellent meal at Rosso Vino last night. The pasta and sauce were delicious and so was the panna cotta. The service was excellent I was served by Cyan. There was a lovely atmosphere and beautiful setting. Thank you so much for a lovely evening at your restaurant. Highly recommend a visit.

author: Summer Smith
review_text: Visited this place by chance years ago and fell in love with the waterfall sauce. I have frequented over the years when traveling. Stopped in for a light meal before a music festival. Enjoyed the Larb chicken salad, mango margaritas, and always mango sticky rice. I have over the years decreased my heat level from 4 to 2. However i still find 2 on the Thai scale fairly spicy yet enjoyable. I sat at the bar and was surprised by the delightful bartender. He was knowledgeable, efficient, and attentive, Jose if I remember correctly. Regardless he was great! Food and drink were delicious and I took the dessert to eat in my room later, excellent option for no microwave.

author: Brian Beardon
review_text: Still the best Babi guling in Bali. The meat, sausage, skin was enak We came around 1pm and the place was packed. They found us a seat and we enjoyed a good meal.

author: Lauren Castaneda
review_text: Marissa and Zoe have always made my experience here amazing and have always kept me returning! My new favorite place to go with my friends and especially to see all the amazing staff that is always so friendly :’) 10/10 recommend !!

author: Kh Ong
review_text: crispy roast pork.. melts in your mouth.. one of the best i have tried in my life.. crab meat dumplings, beef tripe noodles great. wanton dumplings equally good.. and dont forget to try the dessert french toast.. a must visit place. price also very reasonable

author: Thida
review_text: AMAZING. I never leave reviews, but this experience was so special. I took my love out to celebrate his hard work, and our server Adam took such good care of us. The steaks were great, and the sides were even better, but note that you may want to order up on the level of doneness because our dry-aged ribeye was thick and came out a bit undercooked. No problem because Adam COMPED our dessert, the signature massive chocolate cake, which was the perfect level of sweetness. 10/10 would come here again.

author: Rafael Rivera
review_text: Stole my money after showing receipt. They sent order to different location. When they said they remake food had me sitting there 30 minutes waiting and did nothing. Never again. Stole my money with no refund direct through website.

author: MudCrab Sea
review_text: Hidden gems in Hatyai. Superb local food. Always eat here and the price is reasonable cheap as well. More well known to local and less tourist.

author: Onika Burrowes
review_text: IVAN is amazing!! My sister and I have been coming to this cafe for 3years or more and it is much better when IVAN is working because his patience is amazing. We both are picky eaters and picky coffee drinkers. Out of all the employees who work at this cafe Ivan is the best not just I say so but people who were recommended to come here. What a humble young man! The food is pretty good!!!!!!!!!! My favorite is the Blueprint vegan burger and my sister's is the vegan sausage sandwich. The prices for the food as raised which was surprising. Which Slows me down from coming as often. But overall the environment and food Deserve more than a 5 start. So check it out if you are ever in the area you're not going to regret it.

author: Lester Adea (punkmonkey92)
review_text: Food was good. Ordered the eggs Benedict and it hit the spot. Also has that nice 50's theme if youre into that.

author: Candace Lennon
review_text: Wow! Wow! Wow! Out of all the places we googled, I picked the yard. The staff, the food, the grilled pound cook!! My friends and we're so happy I did. We were not disappointed by a long shot! The staff greeted us as soon as we stepped in. They were very attentive to our needs the whole time. Even though our flight was cancelled this past Saturday 11/8/25, this excellent experience at The Yard made up for it. Thank you to all the staff at The Yard. C Lennon Jacksonville FL

author: Lori Santiago
review_text: I had the Extreme Pepperoni pizza...2 slices. Thin, crispy crust, perfect amount of cheese and pepperonis (2 types with extra pepperoni).. Loved those big slices where the cheese strings start when you bite and pull away. Fresh herbs were there for sure. Everyone got something different, and it all looked and sounded yummy 😋

author: Shonalya Fonseka
review_text: Amazing food, amazing atmosphere truly one of the best restaurants in the city. Staff was so kind and helpful especially Chris, the art was so beautiful and you’ll see only smiles on everyone’s face. The energy was great definitely excited to come back again

author: Jimmy Vee
review_text: I wanted authentic breakfast in the area and decided to give this place a try. I was impressed. And to see that this place has been around for quite some time, I'm glad I eventually had the experience. Food, service and atmosphere was wonderful. Great location, right across from Forest Hills T station. Free street parking as well. Their menu has many options to choose from. Staff was pleasant and catered to every request I had. If you live in or around Forest Hills, make sure to give this place a try. You won't be disappointed.

author: lim zhian
review_text: Ordered kerabu chicken chop and otak otak spaghetti, both taste delicious. It tastes unique and yummy. The food was in big portion and price is reasonable. We order root beer float as our beverage, it tastes good as well. Service was great. Easy to find parking around this area. Highly Recommended to try a new style western food.

author: NURUL AINA BINTI MAZLAN ANUAR
review_text: makanannya enak. the staff also very tentative. love it here definitely will come again whenever im visiting Jakarta

author: Faye Ysabela Ong
review_text: Great restaurant in central Canggu. We had breakfast smoothie bowls here and for the price, we were fully expecting something small. It turned out to be such a huge portion and was so good too! The menu is also quite extensive and I would have loved to try more of their stuff. It wasn’t the easiest to find a table at around 11 (brunch and lunch rush), but it’s a great crowd of mostly tourists and we were all quite happy to share the tables with one another.

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: Rayne
review_text: Decent big bowl of pig's organ soup. I like the braised intestine but the soup is not as flavourful as compared to the one at Foch road. We went at night for dinner so not much crowd.

author: SICILIAN-AMERICAN
review_text: This food court is smaller and more expensive than Chinatown complex. They also have fewer tables and fans. Not as many choice either but still worth going to if in the area. I got some good food here and it just a little more expensive. I got all this for $13 sgd ($10 usd)

author: Jolene Ng
review_text: Absolutely tasty, flavorful food. The spare ribs are tender and juicy. The roasted pork leg with crispy skin and tender meat is amazing. Nice view from the balcony to enjoy sunset and the local dance and music. Friendly staffs, they all can speak English too.

author: Shu Ou
review_text: Friendly helpful staff and hot good food. Check out the hibachi at the farthest point from the door!

author: Zulma Aguiar
review_text: Tacos Gavilán is hands-down one of the best taco spots around! 🌮🔥 The food is always fresh, flavorful, and authentically delicious. Their tacos are packed with perfectly seasoned meat, fresh toppings, and warm tortillas that taste like they were made from scratch. The salsa bar is amazing, and the aguas frescas are the perfect refreshing touch. The service is quick, friendly, and efficient, even when they’re busy. Whether you’re dining in or grabbing food to go, Tacos Gavilán never disappoints. 100% recommend for a true taste of Mexico! 🇲🇽💯

author: Katrina T
review_text: I love this place!! I came on a Monday and it was a little busy, but overall the food was amazing and even though I found a few things that shouldn’t have been in my food and water I gave them the benefit of the doubt and asked our server to get us new waters and food because i know these things are accidents. But the waffle was yummy and the food was great! I recommend getting the hash browns instead of potatoes, I wasn’t a big fan.

author: Lexi Lopez
review_text: Super super super delicious food omg!! The burger and the sauce on it were amazing. But the highlights were truly the fries and chicken tenders, all so flavorful and perfectly crispy. The ultimate stand out was the delicious ranch. Order was ready quickly despite being so fresh. 10/10 would definitely go back again. Super good prices as well

author: Gek Triana (Ms. Jung)
review_text: After a long time, I finally returned to the increasingly popular Babi Guling Pande Egi in Gianyar. It's changed a lot, and there are also new menu items. I didn't take many pictures because it was too crowded.

author: Nolan Rizzo
review_text: This restaurant is exceptional! This is hands down our best meal my wife and I had on our vacation. The atmosphere, Service and Food were all wonderful! Our waiter Luis was so nice and helpful walking us through the menu and giving us recommendations which were perfect! My wife ordered the Maracaibo sampler which gives you a little bit of everything and it was delicious! Luis walked us through everything that came with the sampler. I ordered the Patacon Apollo Mechado and it was incredible! To finish off this awesome meal we ordered the flan and it was the best I have ever had. We enjoyed our experience so much we made reservations to eat here again before we leave. Thank you Luis for our wonderful experience. We will be back for the service and food!

author: Sara Meagher
review_text: Had the British pig two days in a row and it was amazing ! The girl who served us was super nice and helpful! I definitely recommend. The price is very reasonable too!!

author: Cheryl T.
review_text: This place is practically an institution in Geylang. Everyone knows JB Ah Meng. I’ve heard of them for years but never came because we’ve heard of the long queues. But we just came here on a Friday evening at 7pm and guess what - no queue. Not only was there zero queue, there were even many empty tables. Did we get lucky or have people moved on from this place? We ordered a bunch of dishes for 2pax and spent $183. The crab goes for about $10/100g. To be honest, the white pepper crab is not my favourite style of having crab but I can see why some might like it. I have to say we got a good crab though, as the flesh was firm and not mushy. The chaotah beehoon is also renowned but I’ve had better elsewhere. They should make it crispier and add pieces of pork lard or belly instead of using lean pork. Overall we left feeling stuffed and satisfied with leftovers to spare. We wouldn’t mind coming back again but would definitely not queue for anything more than 5mins for a table, as this has turned out to be a pretty run-of-the-mill tzechar spot. Not bad, but not mindblowing.

author: cindy davis
review_text: Our food came hot, and it tasted fresh. We got the sandwiches that were circled, and to go with them I got white sweet potato (very good), husband got Cuban rice and beans (really good). Erin is a good server. As you can see on the ticket they already do a 20% tip. I would go back but we're just visiting.

author: John Fronczak
review_text: First time here. Being a local I usually stay in my local spots but decided to venture out to Dania Beach. We came here to Lucky Fish. What a great discovery. Fabulous place. Food, price atmosphere and the service. Rachael was the best. Attentive, funny, prompt and excellent customer service. 5⭐️ When in Dania I recommend coming here and asking for Rachael. You won’t be disappointed. 🍺👍🏻

author: Brenda Luna
review_text: To Whom It May Concern, I am writing to formally report a highly unprofessional and unacceptable experience I had at your McDonald’s location. I expect this complaint to be taken seriously and addressed by management and, if necessary, escalated to corporate oversight. On [06/09/2025], I visited your drive-thru. I was behind another vehicle and waited several minutes at the ordering speaker without any communication or greeting. After three full minutes of silence, I asked aloud if the location was open. I received no response. I proceeded forward to the second window, where there was also no employee present. When I reached the third window, I was shouted at by an employee who claimed someone was at the ordering speaker. They proceeded to refuse to serve me, even though I was attempting to purchase a simple coffee. When I asked to speak to a manager, the situation escalated rather than improved. The manager on duty was dismissive, confrontational, and completely unwilling to acknowledge the breakdown in communication or take basic accountability. Instead of resolving the issue, the manager instigated further hostility and excused the behavior of the staff. To make matters worse, a drive-thru employee named Miguel—who I’ve had issues with before—mocked me and laughed at me during this visit. This is not the first time he has behaved unprofessionally. In a previous incident, Miguel served me scalding hot coffee without a lid, which resulted in me getting burned. I reported that incident, and I believe he now targets me because of that prior complaint. I am deeply concerned that your staff: • Refused service without cause. • Failed to communicate properly at the ordering station. • Reacted with aggression when questioned. • Allowed personal bias and retaliation from a previous incident to impact current service. • Showed a lack of basic professionalism and critical thinking required for customer service. This is unacceptable for any business, let alone one operating under the McDonald’s brand. I request: 1. A formal apology. 2. A review of staff training, especially regarding customer interaction and drive-thru procedures. 3. Reassignment or disciplinary action for employees who engage in retaliatory behavior. 4. Clarification on how complaints like mine are being tracked and followed up on. I am a paying customer, and I expect to be treated with respect and dignity. I hope your company will take the necessary steps to correct these issues.

author: Zari St Jean
review_text: The place you hope to find when you think of getting Caribbean food in the middle of a major metropolitan city like Miami. Hopes that the food isn't gentrified and over priced. Coming from someone who traveled on the brightline on a budget being able to walk from the station 3 blocks and get a plentiful meal, while enjoying the music and atmosphere of Jrk. It has set the bar high for Caribbean food. From a Caribbean born woman. The spice level is amazing.

author: Peter S
review_text: My first experience with restaurant ramen. Although it was good, I was a little disappointed in the noodles. I expected something much better than store-bought. These were better, but not a lot better. The veggies and protein were very good and just the right amount of spice. With the tip it was over $21 which seemed a little overpriced for earthy, working class, East Boston.

author: Olena Yolkina
review_text: Cozy spot for breakfast or brunch with a stylish vibe and indoor/outdoor seating. Delicious food pancakes, chicken & waffles, avocado toast and excellent coffee. Friendly staff makes it even better.

author: Catalina Leuro-Rey
review_text: I had high expectations for this restaurant — the social media posts made it look very appealing. To start, I tried to make a reservation, but there were no openings, so I was advised to arrive and wait, which I did with my family. Parking was quite difficult even though there’s valet service, since the space fills up quickly, so we ended up parking on the street after driving around for a while. The decoration and presentation of the dishes were very creative and visually appealing. We ordered the Venezuelan Sampler, which allowed us to try five different items. For our main courses, we had the Arepa La Venezolana, Arepa Manjar Llanero, and the Classic Pabellón. Unfortunately, the meat for all of the entrees were very tough, which we mentioned to our waiter. He was very polite and offered to replace the dish, but by that point we weren’t in the mood for anything else. We hope to have a better experience with the food next time, as the concept and atmosphere truly stand out.

author: Gavin Ransom
review_text: Brilliant! Love the crazy busy vibe, the old school charm and the fantastic food. Started with the awesome bacon and a cedar salad, both perfect. We hit steak for 3 between the 3 of us and it tasted wonderful but was easily enough for 5! The PL fried potato was nice and tasty. Cheesecake and Holy Cow fudge sundae were both fantastic and massive and the side of cream was enough for days and days!!!!

author: Jonathan Hisham
review_text: Still the best Nasi Kandar in Penang if not Malaysia. The curry taste is still going to make you smile with happiness and feeling satisfied to the last drop. Queue is always there but it moves fairly quick. Just know what you want when the guy ask you what lauk you want. Pricewise still reasonable. I took 2 large prawns and still below RM 20. If I taken this at other mamak, for sure will charge me RM30 to 50 on average. Tips- you can still order what you want after you sat down to eat. They will bring it over to you in a jiffy. So changing minds is allowed here. Enjoy!!

author: Michelle Walter
review_text: They accommodated our need for a larger table than we originally requested. I had the French toast which was great but too much for me to finish! Everyone else said they enjoyed their food. A short walk from Fremont street, much better prices than any casino restaurant!

author: Bosco Khoo
review_text: There are 2 stalls here, no. 16 and no. 20. This one is right at the corner of the alleyway (No. 20). The lady boss knows Mandarin language. I chose a bowl of duck noodles soup, it tastes good. More locals are seen eating here than at the other stall. Support it.

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: C.N. Cheng
review_text: I’ve got nothing to complain about, went there for a dinner, pretty authentic Thai food. We ordered crispy port with morning glory (this one was a bit too hot for us), fish and basil beef. I am saying this is one of the best restaurants we’ve been to in Chiang Mai. Based on my Asian standard 👍

author: gochase85
review_text: Grand opening of Taco John’s in Downtown Crossing. So much better food than the Door Bell further down the street. Friendly staff, great food and great location. Can’t wait to try the Fish Tacos next time!!! 👍👍

author: Tze Shan Tan
review_text: Good taste of food and atmosphere is good 👍🏻 One of the favourite western food cafe in Butterworth. Highly recommend ! ☺️✨

author: Rory Staff
review_text: Stunning spot. A real must if you are over this way. Food was decent, but the views just absolutely make this place perfect for sunset dining. If you're not staying there you can risk it and try to get a spot for sunset otherwise you have to book in for after it.

author: Andres Al dah dah
review_text: I was craving Bun Thit Nuon and saw this place so I gave it a try. I was pleasantly surprised by how delicious it was! The taste is very similar to the Bun Thit Nuon I had in Ha Noi and the portion size is good too. I’ll come back here again.

author: Peter Tam
review_text: Good place to come to try multiple options. Yam rice is the most popular here but the rice had sold out by the time we came so had to settle for white rice with their soup. Char Koay Teow was a hit too. As was the curry mee. There’s also a Winner’s Fried Chicken that was just setting up around 2pm. We were too full to try but there was a steady stream of customers the moment the chicken was ready. Drinks are self service at the counter to order. Parking is a bit challenging with limited parking nearby. Be prepared to walk a bit.

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: Yw Teh
review_text: In this bakuteh restaurant, staff notice you before you enter the store, arrange seat for you then ask for Order. Food is nice and staff alway notice you.

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: Oliver Khaw
review_text: Very good bak kut teh and friendly boss that offers a free refill of the herbal soup. Everything tastes fresh. Seating was not ideal right next to the shoplot on the roadside but par for course for BM establishments, I think.

author: Nicole from HBCU 20x20
review_text: La Industria Bakery & Cafe has the best food in Miami, and I stand on that. We stumbled in while walking through Bayside before a boat ride and ended up eating here twice in one day. For breakfast, my husband had La Combi Completa and couldn’t stop talking about how fresh everything tasted. I had the Chicken Bacon Waffle Sandwich and it was perfect. And their bacon? The best I’ve ever had. Forget millionaire bacon elsewhere. We later skipped a dinner reservation at the former Versace Mansion just to come back. I had the ribs (fall-off-the-bone amazing), my husband had the La Boricua Burger, and we tried a Venezuelan empanada out of curiosity… unreal. Best empanada I’ve ever had. We actually risked missing our flight to have 2 to made to go. Amazing food, kind servers, attentive managers, great ambiance. Believe the hype. 10/10.

author: Prince Shah
review_text: The Indian restaurant provided an exceptional dining experience. The lamb korma I ordered was exquisite, with tender meat and a flavorful, creamy sauce. The service was impeccable, with attentive staff ensuring a pleasant meal. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for delicious Indian cuisine and excellent service.”

author: huy phan
review_text: Anyone who doesn't want to eat there should go ahead :))) The portion is much smaller than advertised and it's VERY SWEET. Sweetness comes from the dipping sauce, side dishes, and pre-prepared meals. I'm from the Mekong Delta and I couldn't even eat it. The food isn't FRESH, it's VERY SWEET, VERY SWEET, VERY SWEET. One time, goodbye.

author: BMWGal
review_text: Expected the creamy prawns to be the best dish but it wasn’t. The egg was creamy, the prawns were crunchy, I felt thirsty after the meal. The red curry soup was too spicy till it tasted like extra spicy chicken rice chill sauce. It felt more like a sauce than a soup. The staffs was not able to help us add any water nor provide and solution. We left without taking the soup. It’s was disappointing and wonder how did they get 4.9 in reviews.

author: Nikita Mittal
review_text: Taco Bell offers a unique fast-food twist on Mexican favorites. Budget-friendly, it serves up familiar tastes with a modern flair. Though not authentic Mexican cuisine, the brand nails consistency and speed. Perfect for late-night cravings or a quick bite. Some hits, some misses, but always dependable. 🌮🔔

author: Cassandra Furst
review_text: My favourite Vietnamese restaurant hands down! I always come to this place when I’m in Bali and am never disappointed. The chicken spring rolls slap. Highly rec their ice/smoothie drinks — elite.

author: Fair reviews Based on my Experiences
review_text: Update 10/9. Paperfish replied "Paperfish applies a standard service charge that is fully disclosed on our menus and receipts, and it’s distributed among our entire service and support staff to ensure fair and consistent compensation across the team." To this I respond. It is not the Publics responsibility to pay your staff. Compensation-That's your responsibility. And if audited I'm sure more than half of these restaurants would not pass the sniff test. Food was great — but the forced service charge was shady. The food at Paperfish was excellent and the server did a great job. But I left feeling frustrated and misled. A mandatory service charge was added to the bill without any clear explanation or signage. When I asked, the server said it gets split among staff and she only sees a small portion — but if I tipped extra, that part goes to her. Which I felt obligated to do. This feels like a manipulative tactic targeting tourists. I’ve eaten at several restaurants in Miami this week, and this was the only one to quietly add a charge like this. If you’re going to force guests to pay extra, be upfront about it — don’t make your staff explain it awkwardly after the fact. Tips should go to the server providing the service, not get pooled by ownership. Be transparent — no one likes surprise fees on their bill. Legislation should be written to force restaurant owners to pay staff properly and not tack it onto their patrons.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: stephanie von lapcevic
review_text: Last night I visited this place and had an Amazing experience! The place is super warm and welcoming, with a really nice atmosphere✨. We tasted several dishes recommended by our waiter, Federico, who was incredibly kind, cordial, and attentive. Every single dish was delicious, and his suggestions were spot on. Thank you for such a great experience, we will definitely be coming back!🥂🤩

author: Kagura Misaka
review_text: Our family came here for brunch on the last day of our Vegas trip after seeing it recommended online, and it absolutely lived up to its name. The food was absolutely incredible, flavorful, and the menu is such a great blend of classics. The service was so amazing as well, with Cheri being such a sweet server and taking such great care of us. The rest of the staff were also just as kind and their energy really adds to the comfy atmosphere. We are already excited about our next visit to Vegas so we can hit this gem of a diner again! Highly recommend and many thanks!

author: Zhi Ting
review_text: Awesome location with great warm services. The people there tend to our need greatly and changes our disposal bowl of food scrap very promptly. All food we ordered was on point albeit too much for two. Great meal to start our bkk trip!

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: Wei L
review_text: Went at night and everything was bad. Pork, pig liver, pig stomach, etc were all v hard. Soup was bland, sauce was bland and so was Chilli. Only good thing was the store owners' ' good attitude.

author: YMC
review_text: Stopped by Bánh Mì Bà Huỳnh and it hit the spot. Fresh veggies, great flavor, and super clean packaging. Worth the stop if you’re craving real Vietnamese bánh mì.

author: Anonymiss Angel Mami
review_text: The food was disgusting and I have had good quality Mexican food before. They say it is regular Mexican food and sea food the dish washer didn't properly wash any of the dishes even while ordering regular food you could still taste the sea food on their dishes. The Waitress had a Nasty attitude and was extremely slow bringing the food and when she brought the drink we never got cups with ice she just brought hot drinks. To top it when she brought the food she only brought 3 of the plates we ordered and nearly forgot to bring mine out . I don't appreciate the bad service especially when you are asking for close to 100$ and i don't care if it was a different part of Mexico or not I know good service when I see it . It also is loud and hot. Where is all the money going from customers if not to fix the place up and its right their on Mojave and pecos

author: Sammy Six
review_text: Quality food in a well designed environment, just like their other outlet at Hanoi Corner. Super friendly owner, passionate about her products. I had the vegetarian curry with a premium type of mushroom that tasted just like beef, very interesting!

author: Elaine DeFelice
review_text: This restaurant has wholesome, delicious food. I recently had the haddock which was so wonderfully cooked and they gave me enough for two people. This place is sort of vintage Vegas. The owner has a old car collection and he usually is displaying one at the top of the parking lot when you go there try this, you’ll like it. It’s also a great place to have a good conversation with friends or go on a date.Enjoy!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Artem Moldsvskiy
review_text: The restaurant is beautiful, with a pleasant atmosphere, and the food comes out very quickly — that’s a strong plus. However, several issues affected the overall experience. The bread served with both the tartare and the bruschetta was extremely dry — so much so that it actually hurt my gums. The Caesar salad was disappointing, no better than a 2/5. The dressing didn’t enhance the flavor at all. I was offered water, but it was never brought to the table. Also, the salad plate was unstable and kept moving every time I tried to take a bite, which made eating quite uncomfortable. On the positive side, the calamari were tasty, and the beef tartare itself was very good. The Margherita pizza was also enjoyable. Overall, the place has potential, but several details need improvement.

author: Aye Tine
review_text: The Mozzarella Stick & The Mini Burgers Were They Best. I Wasn’t Feeling The Steak & Shrimp Fajita.

author: Syah Zakaria
review_text: came for dinner, the food was acceptable, for penang lang, myb the curry was not so kick enough, but for us outsiders is acceptable, hv aircond area, price wise really reasonable compared to other nasi kandar place. recommend dish “ayam bawang”

author: Ebenezer A. Awolesi
review_text: This restaurant evokes memories of my youth in Nigeria. The food is excellent, service is professional.l, there are a wider variety of choices. Having a catering service is also a plus. I ordered ahead and it was ready upon arrival. This is our go to Nigerian restaurant. And strongly recommend this to anyone looking to enjoy Nigerian cuisine.

author: theErn
review_text: Yusuf Restaurant Vervea is a two-story malay restaurant that sells local malay food located in Batu Kawan Penang. The restaurant sells Nasi Kandar, roti Canai and many more. The food is nice and the price is reasonable. The nasi kandar cost around RM12. One of the unique: use the lift go to the second floor and it has free WiFi. Overall, it is good.

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: Sky leo
review_text: First I was surprised to hear this place, the Bak Kut Teh soup can only add once. Then after adding, it didn’t even reach half of the claypot. The waitress attended to us still argue this is the standard. Quite disappointed with this restaurant.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Drew
review_text: Good was great . However they do add a gratuity fee to your bill with out any notice and it's hard to get a waiter to come to your table when it's busy .

author: Arsalan Atta
review_text: Incredible! I used to put chutney on my burgers as a kid, never expected a restaurant to do this. I should’ve taken a photo of the meat after taking a bite, it was great!

author: Patricia Owen
review_text: My parents frequent here often and they love it, all the dishes they have had they rave about. I've been here a few times with them and have enjoyed as well. Very nice staff and service and nice environment. I personally dont like the parking lot but we've always found a spot.

author: Goh Ching Hong
review_text: Delicious food , nice environment , friendly staff. Will visit again

author: Vny Cia
review_text: Come to there, walk in in saturday, and got booked at 21.00 with min MC 1 million The decoration for Xmas too great, their service also good

author: Eevonn Ng
review_text: Famous for their toasted milk bun will filling, must try when you’re here. Butter sugar seem average would recommend other flavour! Nutella is good! Full of filling

author: Pamela Yap
review_text: 85 Redhill is a great spot for local food lovers, offering a variety of stalls with different options. I tried the satay bee hoon, which had a rich and flavourful sauce, and the carrot cake was perfectly crispy. It’s a fantastic place to explore the food scene at Redhill Market!

author: Laurence Jackson
review_text: Such a fun spot for an evening! We did trivia on a Tuesday, but check out live music, sports or family programs! Melbourne laneways maybe inspire this use of commercial space.

author: Olivia Walsh
review_text: I stop here at work every chance I get. I usually get jerk chicken but today I got curry. Both are delicious and you get a lot of food for a good price.

author: Baes Lea
review_text: Food is really nice and service is good, really welcoming as it at your grand parent’s house ! I recommend !

author: Cecilia
review_text: Friendly staff, good prices and food. Turkey fig panini was amazing

author: Joyful Explorer
review_text: Conveniently located beside Bedok Mrt Station. Big hawker centre with many food options. Some stalls have extremely long queues during lunch crowd. Love the dishes we had.

author: I Am Who I Am
review_text: The cashier had great customer service, she was very welcoming. Food was good. Presentation wasn’t all that but it taste better than it look.

author: Benson B
review_text: Ordered delivery on their app yesterday. It took an hour and 22 minutes exactly to arrive. The shop is just a bit over half a mile away. No update in the food or delivery status regarding the delay. The food was cold, my wings were soggy and the breadsticks were an unholy brick of carbs and cheese. Called their shop and got put on hold forever only to find out they don’t know why there is such a holdup, because they depend on third party drivers. All I know is I spent 50$+ and received terrible service and goods. Might as well stock up on frozen pizza from stop and shop, the food will be way cheaper, timely, and taste about the same. (They also forgot to give me the one of the dips I paid extra for, so that was fun.)

author: Y Sun
review_text: Had high expectations for their New Year’s special menu at $120 per person, but unfortunately it wasn’t a pleasant experience. Courses were not paced properly: before we finished one dish, the next arrived, and by the second course we had both the second and main course on the table at the same time. It felt very rushed and overcrowded. When the main course was served, utensils were missing and only arrived after a delay of about 10 minutes so we had our food there and waiting for knives to arrive. Definitely need more training to their staff. The food overall was quite ordinary. The tuna tartare in particular lacked flavor and tasted very bland. There were also no vegetables included in the courses, other than two small garnish leaves, which ended up being the only greens I had.

author: Kyla Shaw
review_text: Shady Shack quickly became one of our favorite spots in Canggu. The setting feels calm and leafy, with a relaxed energy that makes it easy to linger over breakfast or a late lunch. It is the kind of place where the music sits in the background, the staff greet you with a smile, and you never feel rushed. The menu leans fresh and vibrant, and everything we tried tasted clean and satisfying without feeling plain. Service was friendly and efficient, and the portions were generous enough to share. The smoothie bowls were excellent. Creamy bases with bright fruit, crunchy toppings, and a good balance of sweetness made them feel both indulgent and light. We also really enjoyed the Mediterranean platter, which was full of color and texture. The grilled vegetables were charred just right, the dips were smooth and well seasoned, and the bread was warm and soft, perfect for scooping. It is the sort of plate that works for a light meal or for sharing while you sit and chat. Prices felt fair for the quality and the atmosphere, and everything arrived fresh. Overall, this is an easy five stars from us. Shady Shack delivers on what people come to Canggu for, a beautiful space, healthy food that still feels special, and a pace that lets you relax. We would happily return for more bowls, another round of that Mediterranean platter, and a slow afternoon in the shade.

author: Rajib Hossain
review_text: Amazing experience with Napoli pizza. Delicious every bite. Do not hesitate to come again with family. And stuff are friendly and helpful. Special Shams. Keep it up guys

author: Debra Tencio
review_text: We dined here on Saturday, September 27. The food was cold, the dance floor in the separate area and the rooftop was closed. The DJ played a couple of bachata songs and 1-2 merengues but it was mostly rachet music. I didn't expect to listen to Pop Smoke at a restaurant called Little Tijuana. Our server Fernando looked bothered the entire night and was eager to give us our check so we could leave. The vibe was NOT it.

author: Mika Salmela
review_text: Very good quality food for a cheap price. Ice coffee was great (sweet) and the breakfast set tasted better than many hotels that have over twice the price. Kind service. Pad thai was good. I asked for Thai spicy tom yum soup and it truly was Thai spicy, be careful what you ask for. Must have been one of the spiciest so far. Still, the taste was amazing. The neighboring table was praising even the chicken wings. I don't think I will go to any other restaurant for thai food this whole vacation.

author: The Funk Child_662
review_text: Great food, but a bit "Pricey". The service is ok, most of the time. However, I don't like when they put all of the food in the same bag, after multiple people order, then don't even bother to tell you what's what nor mark the differences. Just because 1 person is paying, they shouldn't assume everyone's eating together nor wants anyone opening multiple containers trying to sort everything out. If 2 people order, put the items in 2 bags. To me, it's just common sense. For what they charge, a second bag shouldn't be a big deal. Lastly, the beggers and vagabonds are too much. I'm not always in the mood for that. But, as I said, Great food!

author: Laura
review_text: My mother and I had a lovely dinner at Bunna Cafe. The staff was attentive, kind, and courteous. Every bite of their food was a delight and the wine and tea were also delicious. The lighting and atmosphere were soothing. We were visiting the neighborhood for the day and would love to dine there again if we're in the area.

author: Devan “D Leg” Legington
review_text: Broken Yolk Cafe was amazing from start to finish. My waitress D’Essence was fantastic. She was friendly, attentive, and went above and beyond to make sure everything was perfect. I even requested a special order that wasn’t on the menu, and she made it happen without hesitation. The food was on point. The chicken was amazing, the eggs were fluffy, and my special cinnamon roll waffle was absolutely delicious. Everything came out hot and exactly how I wanted it. Great service, great food, and an overall excellent experience. I’ll definitely be back.

author: Sook Hwa
review_text: Went there on a weekday morning for breakfast. Not many customers yet service is slow. The decor was nice. Limited dim sum options with a few other fried rice and noodle soup options. Initially when we placed order, the staff didn't inform us there's no fried noodles available. When we add more orders, it took half an hour for the additional orders to arrive. If u have no time to loose, better not come here. Only 30% discount is a plus point, food is only average. Dimsum in ipoh and kl is much better.

author: Jerry Min
review_text: The menu doesn't show whether a dish is spicy or not... Staff didn't pay much attention to customers sitting in the corner...Definitely not worth the price.

author: Tony the Old Guy
review_text: The employees are pretty rude and disrespectful to the customers... there is no communication... fries are mostly soggy and under cooked... SAD

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: Bernard Huang
review_text: Absolutely impressed with Kub Kao Kub Pla! From the moment you enter, the cozy ambiance and friendly staff make you feel instantly welcomed. The menu is full of authentic Thai dishes, and every plate we tried was bursting with flavor. The Tom Yum had the perfect balance of sour and spicy, with a rich broth and generous portions of seafood. The Pad Thai was cooked perfectly chewy noodles, fresh ingredients, and an amazing smoky aroma. I also loved how the staff paid attention to details, recommending the best dishes and adjusting the spice level to our preference. Service was quick, portions were generous, and the presentation of each dish was beautiful. You can truly taste the authenticity and the passion in their cooking. Prices are reasonable for the quality you get. Whether you’re craving comfort Thai food or looking for a place to enjoy a good meal with family or friends, Kub Kao Kub Pla is a must visit. Can’t wait to come back and try more dishes!

author: Ed Steell
review_text: Wow very nice place.. I've lived in the area for years and it wasn't until last week that I realized this restaurant is the best, great atmosphere, good prices, excellent food, I highly recommend it.

author: Jose Rodriguez
review_text: Awesome Pub and grill, the bartender was very attentive and the locals were very welcoming. A comedian by the name of Pierre made great conversation right off the back and welcome us in.

author: megan marckini
review_text: Walked in and staff immediately greeted my husband and I so kindly, food came out steaming hot and absolutely delicious. One of the best sandwiches I have ever had. A MUST.

author: Chef Champ
review_text: Cool spot with affordable prices. They have daily specials and taco Tuesday prices. The only issue which may not be a big one is the taco meat has no flavor. You definitely need to use the sauce packets for an extra boost. But the potato oli's are 🔥🔥🔥

author: viet hoang
review_text: Good bbq (we ordered fresh pork set), tender chicken. The korean pancake is good too. Free flow banchan. I rate this a 6/7 🫴🫴 Cleaned everything left no crumbs

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Hector Leon
review_text: A new Miami staple right here. I feel like they’re bringing the quality of service and amazing food I love from NYC top spots, but with their unique Miami flare. Good place for Happy Hour and date night

author: Amy Cebada
review_text: The food here was amazing and service was quick and friendly. Ordering was easy using QR codes set on the table. We had their cucumber salad, soup dumplings in the regular and spicy varieties, the leek and shrimp dumplings, wings, and bbq pork bao. Everything was scrumptious. This establishment has an unpretentious feel—authentic, and likely a local's favorite. We were recommended to visit by some locals we met at Black Hammer Brewing, another local gem. 10/10 would recommend.

author: Marcus Ang
review_text: bread was toasted over charcoal, crispy and fluffy. pandan custard is like singapore's 'kaya', but its way more coconutty and less sweet. 'special' as theres nothing of this sort around the area, come for consistency, not for 'wow'

author: Maribel Sanchez
review_text: Local & cute eatery! As soon as we walked in we were greeted and felt a super homey ambiance. The food was 10/10! we had some Miami fluffy pancakes topped with fruit & whip cream, a breakfast croissant with a side salad & a Miami sandwich with some side of sweet potatoes. I loved it !!!!

author: Scott S
review_text: A great selection of hawker stalls spread out on 2 floors. Excellent kopi/ local coffee with great service (so you can avoid the Starbucks stores that are popping up on every street corner). Very friendly vendors who will help out but the vast majority do not speak English (nore should they). One of the more authentic hawker centres in the area.

author: Jiun Yuen Teh (Brandon)
review_text: Great atmosphere but super slow service. Took 30 minutes for dim sum to serve (only 3 tables in the restaurant at that time). If you don't have patience, this place doesn't suit you.

author: Fluke Chan
review_text: Ever since I have been coming to HCM since 2012, I’ll start by saying that I used to argue with people that com tam ba ghien was better than com tam van cu. I am not sure what has happened to the food quality, but just had delivered what looks like boiled pork chops and an over cooked egg. Ba ghien was known for the big charcoal grill out front which resulted in juicy charred pork chops, but what I got today was the equivalent of a boiled pork chop. No smokiness, no char, no flavour, stringy and chewy. Unfortunately it was inedible. Sorry to leave a bad review like this, but hope this is a wake up call - from a 13 year customer. Com tam van cu is definitely better.

author: Melissa Deleen
