review_text: Not worth the price. Quality of food is poor and the environment was a bit dirty.

author: Wong Teck Jung
review_text: My five-star rating is exclusively attributed to the nasi bakul, which I found to be exceptionally aromatic and flavourful. I also thoroughly enjoyed the sate. The extensive selection of dishes and desserts is highly commendable.

author: ATasteOfWatermelon
review_text: The food was delicious and well-prepared, with great flavors and good portions. Everything tasted fresh and satisfying. The service was also commendable. Our server ~ Ei ~ was attentive, friendly, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout the meal. Overall, a pleasant dining experience and worth coming back for.

author: akarosco
review_text: Very popular nasi kandar (mamak) restaurant especially with locals suggests good quality & value. This has been exactly our experience. Speedy & friendly service was a bonus. Our recent breakfast included roti telur bawang (egg & onion roti) and Malaysia's national dish nasi lemak. Both were delicious and on our table in no time, closely following our teh tarik. My now favourite place for breakfast. Looking forward to visiting again for lunch & dinner sometime.

author: Yvonne Lean
review_text: Loved the noodles here, and the big plus is the high number of fans and cool temps in this restaurant. Opens for dinner, and service is fast and efficient. Photos to have a better idea of what to order if you’re not familiar with it.

author: Loh Woei Kang
review_text: Nice sandwish and salads. They provide calories for all their foods sonyou can control you calories intake for your meal!

author: Nadya Malik
review_text: We had a wonderful dining experience. The food was delicious and beautifully presented, but what really made our visit special was the service. Rara, Andre, and Tivany were incredibly attentive, friendly, and professional. They made us feel comfortable from the moment we arrived. Truly great hospitality

author: TheMikey1865
review_text: This place has a down home neighborhood bar atmosphere. It's a locals hangout off the strip that has great food,at reasonable prices. The wife and I haven't been disappointed yet. They serve burgers,sandwiches and a lot more.

author: Cesar Ruiz
review_text: We went for brunch on Sunday with the family what a great place! It was completely packed, lucky we had a reservation. We got seated quickly and our server was on point. We pretty much ordered everything he suggested, everything was delicious!! The seafood tower was a great way to try a little bit of everything! Location gets 100 points really beautiful place with relax atmosphere and great service! We will be back for sure!!

author: JaneYeow
review_text: (1/5) Food (0/5) Cleanliness (0/5) Environment (0/5) Services (0/5) Ingredient They do not open the lights and fan too for the guests. And the shop is dark. The air flow…. omg No comments Disappointed.

author: Aimee Nessling
review_text: I had the special bánh mì here and it was absolutely amazing! The bread was perfectly crispy on the outside and soft on the inside, and the fillings were so fresh, flavorful, and generous. Every bite had the perfect balance of savory meats, fresh herbs, and that delicious homemade sauce. The staff were friendly and welcoming, and the shop had a really local, authentic vibe. Easily one of the best bánh mì experiences I’ve had in Ho Chi Minh, highly recommend stopping by if you want a true taste of Vietnam!

author: Тамара Гулина
review_text: Cobb salad is not tasty, very salty ingredients and sauce, it would be better if the chicken was grilled, I eat it deep-fried. Grilled Chicken Club is tasty - the grilled chicken was tasty and soft, the chicken in the salad was not tasty. The staff is friendly, the prices are affordable, the service is fast. In the hall they asked us if we liked everything. I recommend. P.S. The cafe plays classical music. It is very rare to hear such a repertoire in a fast food restaurant.

author: Catherine Flynn
review_text: Everything was delicious and portions were plentiful (so had.leftovers for lunch). It was my birthday and they made it very festive!

author: Mṻni Mash
review_text: Great interiors. Delicious Indonesian food. Ordered Gado gado, Cumi Sambal and some Kue to break fast during Ramadhan. Friendly staffs with great energy.

author: D.
review_text: First time here and it was very nice. Everyone knew each other and the bartender. I found out that the menu that's on the website is about 3 or more years out of date. So they have a new menu at the bar to look at. Not a bad place to stop in to from time to time.

author: Felipe Vargas
review_text: Got a cheese burger combo to go and all was really good. I like that the burger patty is the size of the bread!

author: Megan L
review_text: Amazing service and food! 10/10 Super Dog-friendly as well! One of the servers even brought water for my furbaby! Vibe was on point and everyone was super friendly!

author: John Williams
review_text: My first experience eating Tastebudz was by Doordash, but after tasting their food, I had to go there in person. My experience was great. The food was even better eating coming out freshly prepared.

author: Scenic Routes
review_text: The second time I came here, I tried their 鸡丝河粉 for the first time. This time, I came to try their famous 干咖喱面, and they were really delicious. I'm giving it four stars because the food took quite a while. We arrived around 10:30am, and it wasn't until close to 11:20am that all the food was served, especially the 干咖喱面 took too long to arrive. However, the food was worth the wait. I personally prefer their 鸡丝河粉, but their 干咖喱面 are also worth trying. As for the tea, fish balls, and other stalls, I find the food to be average. I've heard that the 烧肉here is also delicious, but it was already sold out when I came here twice. Hopefully, I can try it on my third visit. If you want to try all their food, make sure to come early.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Emelyn Ortiz
review_text: Great music!! Macaroons are no longer sold temporarily because the warehouse burnt down 9/29/25. They have robots that take the food trays to your table for quicker service.

author: Astrida McFarland
review_text: Yesterday I met up with a friend for lunch and she suggested Cacique. I had never been there and wanted to check it out. Cacique has been around for many years in downtown Miami and has kept its Cuban vibe. It is very popular with the county employees because of its close location, good food, and reasonable prices. It is casual and the staff are friendly. It is always busy there. They do have table service. I ordered the Vaca Frita with black beans and rice. It was good but not the best that I have had. My friend ordered a Tuna Sandwich with fries. Hers was good also. Our server was super nice. Service was prompt and friendly by Nina. Parking is not the easiest because it is in the business district, but there are parking garages nearby.

author: Naii Nadia
review_text: Nice place to start our day.. I ordered Ice Americano & Tomato Foccacia Bread for breakfast.. The coffee was good!!! Houseblend Arabica roasted by themself.. and the bread is super yumm.. the atmosphere was pretty good, super comfort.. definitely will come back..

author: Chasing Sunsets
review_text: Its one of my fav beach club in Bali! La Brisa Bali is one of those places that feels like stepping straight into a boho beach dream. The whole vibe is effortlessly stylish with rustic wood, hanging lights, and coconut trees swaying in the breeze. The ocean beds are the perfect spot to relax while watching the waves, but you do need to pay in advance to get one. It is always packed, so booking ahead is the smart move unless you want to wait in line. There are two large pools that look like they belong in a tropical garden of Eden. They are surrounded by lush greenery and good music floating in the air. Sundays are extra special with their famous market full of local products, vintage pieces, and handmade treasures. The food is surprisingly good for a beach club. Fresh seafood, tropical flavors, and well-made cocktails make the whole experience even better. The vibe is lively, full of energy, and people from all over the world come here to chill, swim, and enjoy the sunset. If you want the best spot, come early, order a cocktail, and let time slow down. It is the kind of place you do not forget.

author: Tin Nguyen
review_text: At the time I was here, they could not handle the large crowd... food took 30 mins to arrive, decor is nice though... The retro decor is nice, but they need to be aware of cleanliness because this is a restaurant + coffee...

author: Rithvik
review_text: I recently had a meal at Brassica, and overall, it was a great experience. The risotto was creamy and flavorful, and the pizza had a wonderfully thin crust, very much like a classic New York-style pizza. The rigatoni pasta was tasty, though not particularly standout, but still a solid choice. The fried rice was packed with flavor and really hit the spot. The BK fried chicken (we ordered the larger portion) was incredibly tender and had just the right amount of sweetness served with a small portion of homemade mustard sauce on the side and lemon wedges, it was definitely a winner. However, the real star of the show was the Brussels sprouts. They were absolutely fantastic, crispy, perfectly seasoned, and bursting with flavor. Definitely the dish that left the biggest impression, and I’ll be coming back just for those!

author: Esmeralda Isufi
review_text: I had a great experience at Noble Castella! Their katsu sando is absolutely delicious! And the desserts are heaven 🤤

author: annt
review_text: We at the restaurant about 6.45pm, didn't make any reservation, waited 20mins in a very hot small tiny "courtyard". Decoration & presention of food looks good, Taste of food are really normal. Staffs not friendly.

author: Cedric Cha
review_text: Vietnamese food with a homecooked feel. Food is considerably cheap for a restaurant but portions are on the smaller side. Staff were friendly and helpful and the restaurant was cozy.

author: Ahmed Farid
review_text: When I entered the restaurant, there was no one at the counter. Three workers were outside talking, and I had to call them in for assistance. They came in with a bit of reluctance, which didn’t feel very welcoming. I ordered the Pataka Fries with chicken ($12), which turned out to be delicious, topped with a sweet sauce and served in a generous portion, perfect for one person. I also tried the Beef Smash Burger ($9); although it was quite small in size, it had a good flavor. The ambiance was pleasant and comfortable for dining. Overall, it was a good experience, and I would recommend visiting.

author: Terence Ng
review_text: On a Tuesday evening, 75% of stalls are open, unlike most old hawker centres. A good dinner venue. The Teochew satay beehoon is really good, prepared with pride. Wish the liver is less cooked.

author: Donny Ahern
review_text: The guy charged me 20bucks for a burrito. I tried communicating in both languages to them and felt like they didnt want to help me or make suggestions on a meal. It seems like a nice place and I wish it was a better experience

author: Justine Hwang
review_text: Scrumptious meal for 3 😋 quality and taste that exceeds the price tag 👌🏻ordered the fried wanton, noodles soy sauce, chicken, tauge, pickled apple cucumber and pumpkin milk. 🍏🥒 The pickled dish is not like what I've tasted before. Sweet sour from the asam with a hint of spicy. def will come here again with my family 😉😉

author: Laura DeYoung
review_text: Phenomenal meal tonight - thank you!!! We went for “The Ride” - and enjoyed every dish. Tons of flavors, and this was an incredible value to get to try “a bit of everything”, plus the creamiest Tiramisu ever. The standouts for me were: Endive Salad, the Fish Collars, And the Pork Belly. Yum yum yum!! Thank you for s lovely evening, in a fun space. Our servers were all incredibly friendly and good pacing.

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: LALIJING JJ
review_text: Original Thai hot pot , yummy and good services , staff are always welcome and take care of customers. Near MRT station.

author: Brenda
review_text: Wonderful new concept of multiple food offerings in one interesting location. The process was simple and food was ready for pick up in 8 minutes. I am looking forward to trying other food shops here. I will probably order prior to arrival next time so I can just drive right through. Finding a nice place to sit and eat is going to be a challenge as the area is still up and coming. I have faith

author: Axel Koh
review_text: All the staffs are friendly. There are many variety of foods but all of them are just mediocre or normal. Beverages are too sweet, once you drink you will get even more thirsty and drink more. Surrounding is fine but if there's better ventilation it'll add points. During rainy time I still sweat a lot during my visit. Overall the restaurant is fine, with reasonable pricing.

author: Clari M
review_text: This place is great! I get the carne Frita with arroz de morro y yuca con cebolla . (Pictured on my review)If you want chicken, the combo Dominicano is also amazing - you get a half roasted chicken with 2 sides - they have cho fan rice which is Chinese rice aswell. The relleno de yuca is so good too must try! There is no seating , you just grab your food to go. They definitely give you a good amount of food,which is why I love it there,they have small medium and large portion sizes .

author: Anna Safa
review_text: I think I’ve almost tried every single dish they offer here at Seribu Rasa Gunawarman, and overall it was a spectacular dinner. The interior design and architecture are absolutely beautiful—elegant yet cozy, making the whole experience feel special. The dishes themselves were perfectly cooked and full of flavor, with that comforting touch of home-cooked meals that I really appreciate. I especially have to mention the es teler—so refreshing and absolutely delicious, definitely a must-try! There was a small mishap where I found a spider on my plate, but the staff immediately replaced the entire dish with professionalism and care. I do hope more attention is given in the future to avoid such incidents. Still, the way it was handled left a positive impression. Good service 👏🏼 All in all, flavorful food, wonderful atmosphere, and memorable dining—I would gladly come back.

author: Ali J
review_text: Great experience here before our flight. The staff were very understanding when we said we were in a rush and did their best to help us. We had Beef Rendang, Tauco Tahu Udang, Nasi Putih, and Nasi Lemak with Beef Rendang, all tasty and well prepared. Friendly service and good food, would love to come back with more time.

author: Apple Jee
review_text: Need to self service for drinks and food also. Atmosphere ok and nice view. Came at rainy day so won't so hot. The fish and soup is super nice.

author: Rameen Mansoor
review_text: Salad Bowl - A fresh option packed with crunchy greens and your choice of toppings. It’s light yet very flavorful.

author: Wan Ling
review_text: MUST EAT: Nasi Bakar (Beef)! The smokey flavour perfumes your mouth from the very first bite. The beef is super tender. The second top dish is deep-fried fish with shredded mango, radish pickles & house sweet and sour sauce. The young mango is fragrant, refreshing and balances the fried fish so well! Corn fritters with sambal roa is also very delicious. I can eat the sambal by itself! Tahu telor was nice but forgettable. Save your stomach space for the above 3 dishes instead!

author: Maria Ruvalcaba
review_text: This is the go-to spot for amazing Chinese food! Their chow mein is absolutely my favorite—it has a unique flavor that sets it apart from other places I've tried. The food here is consistently excellent, and the staff are incredibly friendly, always providing fast, outstanding service. Highly recommend

author: Nieca Baybez
review_text: I’ve been here 4x’s and each visit was a great time!! The food and drinks never disappoint with reasonable prices, not overpriced at all. A restaurant like that is hard to find- it’s usually hit or miss but not here and I love that. It’s a nice ambiance, atmosphere, & vibe. They definitely cater to the people, even down to the music. The music is not loud which allows you to still communicate with your guest. Love that! If you’re thinking about going, Go! I’ll definitely be going back.

author: Jennifer
review_text: The chicken here is always a let down. Full of flour and no meat inside. Tomato egg has shell inside. Wasted money on such low quality food.

author: Angie Ling
review_text: Was searching for a pet friendly place and this pops up! Decided to give it a try since I'm staying nearby, so why not... Mainly they were selling Indian and western food. But of course, we had to try the Chicken Tikka Platter, well recommended Minced Lamb Pizza and a Quesadilla! Was surprised that the quality of the food really turned out to be good! Avoid the lamb pizza if you cannot accept the lamb taste. Ordered a little too much for 2 person but it was superb worth it!

author: Brent Cham
review_text: Been here about 5x now and it’s one of my fave Thai places in LA. The cons: parking in the area can be hard to find, sometimes there’s a wait, it’s not a place to have a long drawn out dinner (because it’s so popular but I’ve never felt rushed). The pros: food is fantastic, lots of variety, even if there’s a wait it’s never that long, pretty standard pricing as well maybe even cheaper than some other Thai places. Fave dishes: northern Thai sausage (insanely good), any of the curries, boat noodles. Everything else is fantastic as well but those are the stand outs I’ve tried. Haven’t had one bad dish.

author: normie_ loser
review_text: R burger has decent food, out of all 3 locations in Vegas, the one on Russel and valley view is the best one, but this one, I went today and the manager had a very mean look as soon as I walked in, luckily he wasn't the one to help me with our order, it was another worker who seemed very nice. Another thing to state that, the manager was wearing sandals, sandals in a restaurant? Very unhygienic and can cause a work place accident. After today, I rather spend more money on gas just to go to the other locations.

author: Danny Ng
review_text: This is one of my checklist whenever I visit Bangkok, hence it was no exception when I was here on the 3rd September 2025. Never failed me and love the umami from the beef broth, choice of Angus Beef and other cuts too. Highly recommend anyone should try not because the influencer said so, this is really authentic beef broth and not super expensive.

author: Allieaya
review_text: Very disappointed with an experience with a waiter. Upon reaching the restaurant to voice my concerns, I wasn’t upset that the waiter wasn’t attentive, however, I was perturbed the waiter stated I lied about ordering the soda. This I found bothersome. Apparently, manager Edward had no problem cutting me off and brushing my concerns off. Good customer service begins with accountability.! After 15!years of frequenting I am saddened to say I will never go back.

author: Tommy Koh
review_text: Food is decent Service wise not so much? Couldn’t find anyone for 30-40% of the time , wanted to add dishes and drinks but I couldn’t find anyone Wait time was super long if you’re hungry don’t come by here

author: Tera Nakata
review_text: A solid, tasty pizza. Slightly pricey. Got the Waingro and Bee Sting. A bit out of my way to get here but would recommend if you're in the neighborhood.

author: Erik Echezabal
review_text: This is a legit coffee shop. I would recommend to anyone looking for good coffee shop. The owner really cares about serving great coffee and food. The attention to detail on the equipment and store are all indicators of an actual coffee lover. I'm definitely coming back when in town.

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Shen Leo
review_text: Delicious grilled meat, spring rolls, and rice noodles; reasonably priced and quite cheap. The initial portion size is just right, but if you want to be full, you can add extra vegetables and noodles for free, which is great!

author: Zahra Zepeda
review_text: The food is good but, the service is the worst: I was waiting with my family the food and we wait an hour, they didn't call us to get the food and when they give us the food it wasn't hot. The atmosphere isn't clean I found a lot of hair on the floor and napkins.

author: KC KC
review_text: Long wait on Friday night but no one seemed mind at all! Good food and good place to hang out and wait staff would come out to celebrate your birthday at your table, Texian style! very fun place to be

author: Melissa C
review_text: We came on our one night before our cruise, and the food was solid. Very flavorful, fresh, and great portions. The staff were friendly and attentive. The food came out quicker than expected, and nice and hot. The sauces with our calamari and the coconut shrimp appetizers were so good as well as the mango pineapple salsa that came on our dishes. Having a beach view was icing on the cake. We had a great time!

author: Andrew Yeoh
review_text: Located in a rather busy part of Chai Leng Park, this restaurant is very popular with locals. Parking can be a problem. This is a very clean restaurant. The chicken rice is simply delicious. The chicken is smooth. Their noodles are also excellent. They also have the dry version. Customers can order bean sprouts, vegetables and wan ton, too. I like their pumpkin milk drink. The price is quite reasonable.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Ng Kah Yan
review_text: I cannot recommend this place enough! While the food was delicious, the staff truly made the experience memorable. Our server was so kind and helpful, she purposely walked out from the bar table, crossed over the road to get a tuk-tuk for us after we had our lunch there. It's rare to find service this genuinely warm. We will absolutely be back!

author: Giovanni Velez
review_text: Ruben was awesome! He paid attention to detail and constantly making sure that we are not missing anything and keeping our table clean. He really take care of us. Always smiling and friendly no just with us also with everybody else as well. He is the best. Thank you Ruben.

author: Jasmine Caez
review_text: We dined here on Christmas evening and had an exceptional experience. Despite how busy the restaurant was, our server remained attentive, professional, and genuinely welcoming throughout the night. He would pop in on us constantly to see if we needed anything! The food was outstanding from start to finish. The warm bread served at the beginning was so good we had to stop ourselves from eating too much before the meal. We ordered the Surf & Turf for 2 with mac and cheese for our side, and everything was prepared perfectly. The steak was cooked just right, the lobster tail was tender and flavorful, and the mac and cheese was rich and well-seasoned. We ended the evening with the coconut cream cake, which was unique and absolutely delicious. Unlike anything we’ve had elsewhere. Overall, it was a wonderful dining experience, and we would happily return. Thank you for making our Christmas dinner memorable.

author: Lina Khelouat
review_text: I came here two times for lunch and for dinner. The ramen was tasty. It’s a nice place, but there is a small problem with the air after eating, our clothes smelled a lot like food. Everything was good, the waiters were kind and smiled. They also helped us choose some good sake. But the administrator was not nice. She talked to us in a rude and unfriendly way.

author: Chong Yew Kee
review_text: After breakfast Ordered Kopi Gao Gao 👍 Half boil eggs perfect timing 👍 Stall owners helped remove the egg shells Excellent good service 👍 Stall No #01-48 New Leaf Coffee Will definitely come back ❤️

author: Arlene Rivera
review_text: We had a horrible experience at this restaurant and would not recommend it. My nephew, who is on the spectrum and has food aversions. He is very sensitive to different foods. We brought in french fries. After being seated, a waitress approached us and informed us that we had to leave because we had outside food. We tried to explain my nephew’s needs & tried to explain that we would be ordering from their menu as well but she was completely dismissive and kept insisting that we had to leave or throw the fries out. We decided we would leave, She snatched the menus & waved her hands up in a sho sho motion. We were very disappointed with their customer service. Do not eat here and do not support this business.

author: Peter & Rachel Badgett Real Estate Agents
review_text: Tempura green beans were the bomb and the desserts. Fruitcake buckle sounds like a terrible idea, but was our group's winner! Shortrib steak was terribly fatty - couldn't fully chew any one piece! Pork chop overcooked but still very flavorful. Burgers were great.

author: Cani Esma
review_text: Don't get me wrong, their Philly Cheesesteak, Supreme Pizza, and Garlic Parm wings were good, but the customer service could be better. I had to cancel an order because we unexpectedly had to take our dog to the emergency vet. I called the store when they were still located next to 7-11, apologized profusely, and was assured by the employee that they would "take care of it" (whatever that meant). -- Several months later, they move near the Walmart Supercenter on Pecos and Trop, and I decided to place an order. The employee seemed nervous on the phone, told me he was getting the manager, and I was immediately told that I had an outstanding balance from the time I canceled. I explained what happened, and the manager claimed that he was never informed and that I still had to pay, or else I was barred from future purchases. -- Well, since I like the food and had hyped them up to my family, I paid the outstanding amount. The total came to about 80 something dollars. I've had my fair share of working retail, so I don't really give a hoot that the employee forgot, because we all have those days. What I didn't really appreciate was the awkward and unnecessary tension in that phone call and in-person pickup, as if I was trying to cheat them out of 40 dollars. I can understand where they were coming from, but my family and I won't be returning. *Edit: Love the response from owner continuing to claim that there was no documentation about the incident, yet here they are replying, scrambling to their defense, and getting dates mixed up as if they know what I'm referring to; because the incident was fairly brief. As previously mentioned, I don't care that the employee forgot their own store's policy and let it slip that they would help me. At the end of the day, I remembered this place and gave my own experience in exchange for points. They can complain about it and respond all they want; I have every right to express feeling uncomfortable enough not to return as much as they have the right to reply.

author: Manasi Datar
review_text: Tonino is a little gem in the heart of Jamaica Plain. They have a small and simple menu, but you can't go wrong with it all the pizzas are delicious. Noteworthy pastas include the buccatini, cavatelli, rigatoni, and cappareli. They usually also have a seasonal pasta (for us it was a corn pasta) and it was sooo tasty. They also have a superb cheesecake on the menu. You must try it. We love this little place, and our hack is to go there either early or late on a weekday. Their bar seating is given to walk-ins and IMO the best seating in the house - it's almost a chef's table. Highly recommend this place; you won't be disappointed.

author: Neil May
review_text: Excellent food. Their waffles are savory and lovely. One of the better coffees. My wife's club sandwich looked fresh and massive. I'm also glad to see the arts district is growing and improving.

author: Mary B
review_text: Green street is a great staple on a strip full of other restaurants you can pick from. My favorite dish for breakfast is the Grove Benedict with grilled tomatoes as my side instead of potatoes, for lunch I love the Salmon salad, The salmon dip appetizer and the Salmon Penne pasta. The meat lasagna is delicious and so is the Lamburger. This place has been around for over a decade. Thanks green st for amazing food , service and atmosphere .

author: Connor Scotton
review_text: Fun….super fresh fajita’s!!!!! This is a small authentic Mexican restaurant that is tucked into a corner end plaza. Keep going!!!!! Its great food served very neatly and very fresh. So well done.

author: Jayy L
review_text: Many varieties of foods , very good serving portion sizes worth the price !! Amazing customer service, always help you out. quality food, definitely worth it! The staff is top notch always ready to assist us customers for a great customer service experience! And to top it of all store is clean and ready for new customers to enjoy the dine in experience!!!

author: Natalie Mendez
review_text: Paperfish Sushi is an absolute gem if you love fresh, beautifully made sushi with amazing flavors. The vibe is modern, cozy, and super aesthetic perfect for a date night or a cute dinner with friends. The presentation is gorgeous, and every dish tastes as good as it looks. The fish is incredibly fresh, the rolls are creative, and the menu has so many unique options that it’s hard to pick a favorite. The cocktails are just as impressive, and everything comes out with great attention to detail. The staff is friendly and attentive without being overwhelming, which makes the whole experience smooth and enjoyable. Overall, Paperfish Sushi is a must-try for sushi lovers. The quality, atmosphere, and flavors make it worth every visit.

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: Maverick Ng
review_text: Horrible and arrogant attitude! The soup was also so bland and not nice at all. A China National helper gave my mother a dirty dollar coin change, then my mother asked to change to a cleaner one, but he gave a even more dirtier one! Then a aged 60 plus big size uncle from the stall said my mother that you think my food are dirty, and my mother told him that I did not say your food was dirty. After that, he told my mother don't ever come and eat again! "Your soup was so bland and not nice at all!" My mother retorted. FYI, they are already famous for being lousy and arrogant service attitude too! * Never ever gonna patronise this stall! Even if you were to offer for free, I would not waste it but I would give it to a street dog or cat to eat. If there is a 0 rating, you deserve it, I am very sure!

author: Livinus Tjhindana
review_text: Celebrating old buddy's birthday at a place where foods were great, services were flawless and coolest birthday songs ever! Great night!

author: Bryan Goh
review_text: The nasi lemak is very very good. It’s worth travelling out to try it. The nasi lemak can be had with fried chicken, which is their signature, and crispy on the outside and succulent on the inside. The sambal is sweet and spicy and really delicious. The rendang is also very good.

author: Siwahdol Chaimano
review_text: This place is Esaan (northeastern Thai) food. Personally, it is a bit too sweet and salty. I thought it was good but after few spoon taken, I had to take a break for the saltiness. The pork is very good and the soup was alright. The. Staff are nice, and the location was good. We got free tea just to add Line of the restaurant. The price was quite expensive compared to other Somtom (papaya salad) especially for the one that has noodles in it. Overall it was good to try.

author: Raymond Lai
review_text: Very much a tourist hotspot here. If you fancy a bowl that is "Michelin recommended", then I would make a visit. There is better pho from local joints just a block away, but a pilgrimage here is worth it just to experience the hustle and bustle of a Michelin recommended joint. Broth was good and clear, slightly sweet. Meat quantity was good. Noodles were softer that those from northern Vietnamese restaurants. The place is PACKED with tourists, with Insta360s and GoPros everywhere. If you're looking for a locals only experience, it's best to check elsewhere.

author: Sakulrat Satayanan
review_text: Very friendly staff and Amazing service! Beef and pork belly is very tender and fresh too

author: xiaoyu guo
review_text: Too many people and It’s a little noisy. I ordered three dishes and all test normal. The ham has a fishy smell. The quality is not deserved their price.

author: Juan Mendoza
review_text: R Burgers on Nellis is a very welcomed surprise in the Eastside. I went through the drive-thru after work to get my family some dinner. The service was fairly quick for the large order I placed. I ordered 4 double cheeseburgers, 2 carne asada Fries, chili cheese fries, zucchini fries and a grilled chicken salad. It took about 10 minutes to receive my order. The burgers were what I consider a good California style burger, delicious thousand island dressing that got my bottom bun all soggy and delicious. My mouth is watering just thinking about it. The chili cheese fries have got to be the BEST in all of Las Vegas. The seasoned fries loaded with that delicious chili and tons of melty cheese is the perfect combo. The carne asada fries were a hit with everyone. Perfectly seasoned fries and asada. The zucchini fries in my opinion were a 3 out of 5. They were a little soggy in the middle. The grilled chicken on the salad was perfectly grilled and a very nice portion. I will definitely be returning to try more of R Burgers delicious menu. Can't wait to return!

author: Cher Ong
review_text: Huge dim sum place with double storey seating capacity. U can dine comfortably as it's very spacious. Service isn't on par. Those aunties are chit chatting & eating when they're on duty. This is a bad impression for customers. They're not as crowded & popular as last time. I used to quite like this place but after this round not anymore. The dim sum is not fresh. Bad quality control. Taste also below average & price is high. Cashier has no basic manner as well.

author: Stefanny Sengkey
review_text: A lovely brunch spot with great vibes and a beautiful space 🤍 The place was quite busy, but the atmosphere was still cozy and enjoyable. The interior is really nice and makes it a great spot to relax. We had the almond croissant and the plain croissant—both were flaky, buttery, and tasted fresh. The almond croissant had a rich filling without being too sweet, it was perfectly crisp outside and soft inside. For drinks, we tried the iced oat palm sugar coffee and the cold brew. Both were smooth and refreshing, with well-balanced flavors. Overall, a great place for brunch with good food, good coffee, and a pleasant vibe. Would definitely come back!

author: EA TO
review_text: Ordered the ginger onion frog legs (2 servings - $22) and porridge ($11) which was enough for 2 people. The frog legs are tasty and the muscle fibers are slightly shorter than chicken and have a flakiness like fish. Meat falls off the bones easily. I enjoyed it. Prefer to eat the porridge and frog legs separately because the sauce of the frog legs will make the thick porridge more watery. Fast service - ordered and paid soon after we were seated. Staff was helpful in her reccomendations which helped as it was my first time trying frog leg porridge. Seated outside which was quite windy that night. Good vibes and breeze. Crowded at 7 but still got a seat outside

author: Julia Jones
review_text: Had a great experience here today, after traveling to Miami from Virginia. We were sat and then greeted by our server Carolina, who was genuine, kind, and straight to the point which was great because we were very tired and very hungry. Her service maintained that same energy throughout our time there and it made all the difference. You can tell Carolina knows her shit, and doesn’t take any either! Thank you!

author: Sandra
review_text: This is my go to place in canggu! I am a meat lover, but everything they have on this menu is so tasty, high protein choices and looks amazing on the plate. Everything from smoothies, bowls, eggs, oats, coffee or pancakes! Highly recommend🫶 aways smiling staff/super friendly !

author: Tan Gary
review_text: Preparation need to speed up. Understand when there is big crowd but when subside it still took some time to serve. Nevertheless servers are polite. Food tasted good, spice and curry has it’s own unique flavour. Curry chicken a bit of a let down. Meat did not cook well. Called to return and prepared a second time on the same bowl still resulted with a stiff chicken drumstick. Would like to complement the drink. Pack enough power to stir your taste bud. Thumbs up for serving cold drink without ice to preserve the flavour instead of being diluted with ice. Overall, good enough to make me think of another visit. Price was acceptable. But really need to work on the curry chicken. Not everyone can stand the spotted stain blood when cut it up.

author: Alexandra
review_text: The food is really good. The burger patty is soft and juicy, honestly one of the best burgers I’ve ever had. Highly recommended! The only thing I’d suggest is getting it to go since the place is a bit small.

author: D S
review_text: Shawarma with beef is not what I expected, it looks more like shawarma, the meat is strange, as if pressed, in general the establishment is not bad but the name Boston Shawarma needs to be justified, this is not a real shawarma but a good parody. I will not come again, only once.

author: Shing Low
review_text: I recommend these 2 stalls. The black carrot cake has crispy edges and taste is juz right. The steamed dumplings are very tasty...no 'porky' smell. Both stall owners/staff are very patient and polite. Great buys!

author: Ketut Artha
review_text: I had a good overall experience here. The vibe is relaxed yet still feels like a proper sit-down Italian restaurant—comfortable enough for friends or family, and nice enough for a casual date night. Pizza: Pretty solid. The crust was decent and the toppings balanced; not mind-blowing, but enjoyable and worth ordering if you’re craving pizza. Pasta Carbonara: Tasty, but not an authentic Roman carbonara. If you’re expecting the traditional guanciale-pecorino-egg emulsion style, adjust expectations—this version leans more “creamy comfort pasta.” Still enjoyable if you’re not a purist. Service: The standout. Staff were warm, patient, and genuinely helpful with menu questions. That hospitality carried the meal and is a big reason I’d come back. Bottom Line: A 4-star experience. Come for friendly service and a relaxed meal; order pizza, try other pastas if you’re picky about classic recipes, and enjoy the atmosphere.

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: TN Lam
review_text: Got the queue number from the host, but she didn’t acknowledge or greet me. However, once I was seated with my local friends, the service was great. Most of the dishes were good, especially the crab curry noodle. This place never fails and usually is the place to go if you want some good Thai food.

author: SITI N
review_text: Love it. My first time trying omakase in Penang. We went for the omakase RM588++ per person... everything was delicious. fresh air-flown oyster from japan, dry aged maguro, uni, various sashimi, cod sperm, rice popcorn, fish roe & caviar, black truffles, female snow crab. my friend had tuna eye ball soup... yummy haha. very friendly and informative staff members - front staff & chefs. Highly recommend!

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: Nubert Sawarimuthu
review_text: Very good and tasty CKT….. will definitely return when I’m in BM next Wok Hei 👍 Portion 👍 Taste 💯 Overall- 9/10

author: Nicole Elkhatib
review_text: The ladies working were so nice, the staff overall is very nice and welcoming, we ordered a bunch of food, the fish and chips were good, the shrimp and Mac n she’s was AMAZING !! The fries were cold:/ the salmon was okay.. I don’t think that sauce goes with it, if that salmon was a Cajun type of sauce it would have been amazing..

author: Ocean Medell
review_text: We come here at least once a week . You need to try these tacos . Salsa is spicy . Watch out . Tortas and mulitas are delicious.

author: Sue-Ann C
review_text: Eyval wants to be taken seriously as a dining experience, but someone forgot to plan for New York in winter. Let’s start with the absurd: there is nowhere to put a coat. No rack. No hooks. No designated space. Just guests awkwardly draping long winter coats over weak chair backs and laps like it’s a casual café in April. And if your coat is long, it’s now dragging on the wet floor from snow laden shoes in the dining room. I even asked the hostess (who asked the manager) where can I put my long coat and both had ZERO solutions; so, I ended up resting my faux fur coat on the edge of a planter off the ground. This is NYC— we are fashionable and winter isn’t a surprise! If you’re charging these prices and aiming for elevated dining, basic hospitality logistics matter. Service didn’t help. While very polite, our waiter messed up the order, he missed an item then gave incorrect information so we ended up with three very hefty rice bowls which imbalanced the meal. They also delivered a slice of chocolate cake for my birthday with a candle with no fanfare… no song, no “happy birthday,” no joy; it literally felt like a plop on the table. The cake wasn’t even good - tasted like it absorbed the smells of the fridge (they professionally removed that from our bill - thank you). And speaking of balance: serving a feta dip with no bread (and no proactive explanation or accompaniment) is just baffling. Dips require vehicles. This isn’t revolutionary dining—it’s basic sense. The frustrating part is that the food itself has moments of brilliance. The flavors are thoughtful, layered, and crafted with care. Very rich. Which makes the execution issues even more glaring. Eyval isn’t missing the mark because of ambition—it’s falling short because of avoidable oversights. In a city overflowing with restaurants that understand both food and fundamentals, Eyval needs to decide what it wants to be: a memorable dining experience or a beautiful concept undone by preventable mistakes. Right now, it’s hovering uncomfortably in between—coat in hand. It’s not worth the reservation scarcity.

author: Louis Wain
review_text: This gem is the neighborhood’s finest. Expect consistently amazing food and zero regrets—every time.

author: matt matt
review_text: I visited Ong Kee Restaurant and ordered half a chicken. The meat was tender and smooth, paired with a distinctive sauce that leaned slightly salty. The stir-fried bean sprouts were perfectly balanced — crisp yet not undercooked — and very flavorful. The oil rice carried a fragrant aroma, complementing the meal well. The flat rice noodle soup was another highlight, with silky noodles and a clean, naturally sweet broth. Overall, Ong Kee delivered a thoroughly satisfying dining experience.

author: Joshua Fields
review_text: Beautiful Pita Sandwich! I got Bifteki with Spicy feta and it’s simply an amazing pita, the beef patties are so well seasoned and packed with flavor. The Charred Pineapple and Lime Mayo Sauces were power moves and would highly recommend them both.

author: shannon
review_text: I came on a Saturday around 4pm. It was a lot busier than I expected but luckily we got seats pretty quickly. The food was really good! I understand they were probably short staffed but we were there close to 2 hours when we didn’t want to stay that long. We had to ask for multiple items more than once. It got to a point where other customers came up to us asking if we were almost done and I was like yeah but we’re waiting for our food lol.

author: Christopher Blair
review_text: Ordered about 9 or 10 dishes here and all were incredibly delicious. Dishes are ordered to share. Also tried a margarita and a bloody maria, very well made cocktails. Highly recommend, worth a trip to Ridgewood just to visit the excellent Mexican restaurant

author: Matt Krick
review_text: Great servers at this lounge. Great pasta but the steak was so so. The chocolate bomb cake was amazing! Very affordable prices!

author: Noble Noble
review_text: One of the best. Unrivaled despite having a fierce rival a few stalls away. Been eating for years. It has a seafood taste in it. Pardon my photo. Gobbled it up before taking photo. Aunty is very sweet and uncle very chatty!

author: Shabrina
review_text: I’ve visited Babi Guling Men Lari several times, and it never disappoints. The babi guling is consistently flavorful, offering a delightful blend of spices that keeps me coming back. The restaurant maintains a clean and tidy environment, making dining here a pleasant experience. Additionally, they provide ample parking space, which is a significant convenience. For anyone seeking authentic Balinese cuisine in a comfortable setting, Babi Guling Men Lari is a must-visit.

author: Marcellus Barron
review_text: I am new to the area. I have been to Olympian Burgers twice now. The staff is friendly. They greet you as soon as you enter. The food is very good. Large portions, too. The pastrami sandwich is very good. I highly recommend this well-established restaurant.

author: Thinley Choden
review_text: Harry's was a nice, ambient, and quiet place to sit down in the hustle and bustle of Changi airport. I really enjoyed the french toast with the fresh coffee. I am glad I happened upon it while exploring the airport. I appreciate XC for being so friendly and for the excellent service! :)

author: june megumi
review_text: Very family friendly buffet. The food is pretty good. Not gourmet but no complaints. Gave 4 stars because the frozen yogurt machine was broken and they did not have biscuits and gravy. The birria tacos needed more meat and less cheese. Dessert station is AWESOME. I would go again.

author: Roger Hamilton
review_text: This was our first visit, and we loved it. There is no free parking, but that is expected in downtown Las Vegas. There is a public parking lot attached to the building that is very convenient. The restaurant is modern and clean with floor to ceiling windows open to the street, and there is outdoor seating on a patio alongside the sidewalk. The staff was polite and friendly, while also being efficient and unobtrusive. Our food arrived within 10-15 minutes of us placing the order, which was pretty good since the place was at about 70% capacity. Once the food arrived, we couldn't wait to dig in because it looked delicious! We weren't disappointed with the flavors of the food either; it was excellent. In conclusion, I definitely recommend The Broken Yolk Cafe if you want some good food near The Freemont Street Experience without the big crowds.

author: Cierra Gallego
review_text: Ordered through postmates, ordered a burger with bacon no bacon on it, ordered the pretzel burger to just get a regular cheese burger, ordered jalapeno poppers didn't get those either and to top it off ordered 2 shakes that were spoiled one was an oreo with no Oreo and other strawberry banana and I'm not even joking I took one sip and knew instantly it was spoiled!!! $60 worth of food and I was afraid to eat any of it and obviously couldn't drink the shakes. Postmates took care of what they could I called location to let them know order number and whatever they used in the shakes was spoiled they seemed to not care as if I was making it up. Saying they don't know how it could happen!

author: Melinda D
review_text: Delicious 😋, I recommend the mango salsa on your burrito bowl

author: Erica Liguori
review_text: Came here for dinner before seeing the NJ Symphony at NJPAC. We had Karina. She was fantastic!! Being first timers, we needed help navigating the menu. She recommended some items and we ordered all of her recommendations! Sooo dang good. We had the birria nachos, the crispy shrimp tacos, and the California burrito. We were STUFFED but everything was incredible. Our drinks were yum too!! Such a cool spot. Looks like it turns into a club at night! And they have so many events to attend; brunch, special DJs, drag shows, birthdays, hookah, bachelorette, etc etc. Only downside was that we had to pay $25 for valet.. thought that was pretty steep for just dinner. If we were staying into the night and attending the club scene, totally understand, but just for dinner? Idk I feel like $10 would have been more reasonable.

author: Nazran
review_text: Hi, I would like to compliment your staff member, GAM, for the excellent service he provided during my visit. He was incredibly attentive and seemed to understand exactly what I needed even before I asked. When I was just about to request something, he already anticipated it and acted immediately that level of awareness and customer care is truly impressive. His professionalism, friendliness, and ability to read the situation made the entire dining experience smooth and enjoyable. It’s rare to meet someone who serves with such dedication and attention to detail. Please extend my appreciation to GAM he really made a positive impact on my visit, and he represents your restaurant exceptionally well.

author: Adam Adam
review_text: I visited the store on Monday 07/24/2023 at 8:15 pm and most of the drinks were out, they closed most of the dining area...usually they don't say "welcome" or "have a good day"! This location should be closed by 9 pm by they start cleaning so early...poor service.

author: Sharon Soh
review_text: It was just behind our hotel so was very lucky to have such a high quality restaurant nearby. Boss was friendly and the place has very nice interiors. Above all food was perfect. Do reserve before visiting to avoid disappointment...or finish your meal before 6pm if you can come early. I will be back.

author: Jolin Min Min
review_text: Food portion is 👍. Taste is also good! Just that their signature fried rice is slightly saltier. They also sang birthday song before presenting the birthday cake to the table. Very friendly staffs and helpful with the kids.

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Thiên Lộc Trương
review_text: The food and service were average, nothing special. But today (September 23, 2025) I went to eat with 2 people at 6:45 pm, and came back at 8:45 pm and discovered that the bike had fallen: the brake lever was missing the round button, the fairing was scratched and cracked slightly. I called the staff and was instructed to go back to the restaurant to check the camera, but it was raining heavily and my house was far away so I didn't go back. The damage was small (100-200k) but quite annoying. I advise everyone who comes to this branch to check the bike carefully before leaving to avoid trouble.

author: don Toh
review_text: Crowded place with a lot of foreigner these days. Find a seat may take some times but it maybe the shortest time spend there.

author: Hiep Nguyen
review_text: Cong Caphe is the best. We had it in SaiGon and loved it. Glad they have one in Hoi An too! Service is just efficient and friendly. I had knocked down my drink before even taking a sip. It was all over the floor. Within seconds 1 guy came and cleaned up the mess, another server got my another drink made in 1 min. No questions asked. That is amazing customer service 👏. Great atmosphere and they got fans blowing from all sides. Feels nice and cool during the 30° C day. 130,000 Dong for our drinks is $7 CAD.

author: Jia Tian Ng
review_text: Tuck Kee offers classic Chinese stir-fried noodles packed with wok hei and flavour. The moonlight hor fun with raw egg is silky and rich, while the baby octopus in soy sauce is a must-try—tender and perfectly seasoned. We accidentally ordered the Wat Tan Hor, but it didn’t disappoint. A happy mistake! Service is fast and food comes out piping hot. Great for a quick, satisfying local meal.

author: Mike Milner
review_text: Was not expecting this. Attached to a gas station i was thinking like a spanish WaWa. Couldn't have been more wrong. This little gem serves some of the best tapas I've tasted. Octopus and spanish sausage were amazing, as was the exceptional paella. Great service and a notable HUGE wine selection. Highly recommend.

author: A
review_text: We were there for lunch and had the whole restaurant to ourselves. The food kept surprising us in a great way, service was amazing. We felt extremely well taken care of. Everything was pristine! Highly recommend. They have a park and kids menu so it’s great for families too!

author: Harrison Nguyen
review_text: **Lucino's Pizza — A Philadelphia Gem in Las Vegas** Lucino's Pizza is more than just a place to grab a slice; it embodies East Coast authenticity right in the heart of Las Vegas. The dining room is a tribute to Philadelphia sports culture, adorned with framed jerseys, memorabilia lining the walls, and TVs playing the latest games, creating an atmosphere of camaraderie and excitement. This is a venue where the joy of sharing a good meal pairs perfectly with a sense of tradition. In the kitchen, classic techniques are employed with skill and care. The hand-tossed crust is a standout feature, striking a balance between chewiness and char. It boasts a gently blistered edge with just the right amount of texture and a tender center. The "original" slice delivers a harmonious flavor profile, with tangy tomato purée, stretchy mozzarella, and a touch of salinity that enhances the overall taste. The pepperoni version adds a delicious contrast with crispy edges from rendered fat and a hint of spice, while the cheese slice, satisfying yet straightforward, highlights the beauty of quality dairy. Value and practicality shine through with Lucino's 2-slice-and-a-drink lunch special—a wise choice for a midday meal that offers both comfort and affordability (the complimentary soda adds a charming, nostalgic touch). The portions are generous yet sensible, fitting perfectly with the lively sports-bar vibe where patrons gather, cheer, and enjoy their food throughout the game. The Lucino's Fries deserve special mention. Their crinkle-cut shape provides an extra crunch and maximizes seasoning retention. Dressed with the house garlic-parmesan sauce, the fries achieve a rich umami flavor. The addition of Pecorino cheese adds a salty, nutty contrast, while parsley flakes provide a fresh touch to keep the dish exciting. Overall, the fries are well-crafted and complement the Pizza beautifully. Service is efficient and friendly, matching the casual pace of a sports-themed lunch or a lively evening of game-watching. The staff handles orders with a warm, approachable demeanor that fits the restaurant's confident charm. For anyone craving an authentic East Coast pizza experience and a lively, sports-friendly atmosphere in Las Vegas, Lucino's Pizza is an excellent choice. It avoids gimmicks and instead focuses on delivering honest, well-prepared food at a fair price, making it ideal for gatherings, game nights, or anyone looking to savor a taste of Philadelphia with genuine craftsmanship.

author: Joshua Tarabek
review_text: The food was spicy which I like but they didn't have sour cream and that's like a must for my wife. Especially when it's spicy. But overall the size was good and price wise it was medium priced.

author: Clayton Dass Chalodass
review_text: Very bad service, sitting for the past 30 minutes and they can't clean the tables

author: Evi !!!
review_text: Amazing place for brunch and coffee! The food is excellent, the coffee is high quality, and the atmosphere is beautiful and very welcoming. Everything is spotlessly clean, and you can really tell that attention is paid to every detail. A place that adds something special to your day. I highly recommend it!

author: Lala WK Wang
review_text: Staff were friendly and courteous, making the dining experience here pleasant. Ambience with background xmas music was good. Staff are able to communicate well in English and explain the menu products. Would definitely recommend and come back again for good pizzas and pasta.

author: Hannah Swann
review_text: Amazing sushi! Every roll was delicious and no wasting any sushi because it's all so good you cant resist eating it. Destiny and Bella gave us such great service which made the whole experience that much better. This is our new go to AYCE Sushi 🍣

author: George Okinaka
review_text: We went looking for a new Thai restaurant since our usual one wasn’t open today. So after a quick little search online, we decided to try the Buon Thai restaurant, and we were pleasantly surprised! Sure the walk up to the restaurant doesn’t conjure up a nice dining establishment, but once you inside it was quaint and clean. Then came the food, we ordered fresh rolls, Pad Woon Sen, crab fried rice and mango sticky rice. All of which were delicious! Lastly the staff were very friendly and helpful with their food suggestions! We’ll definitely come back for sure!

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Sergey O
review_text: This is my go-to place for pho bo. The flank pieces are tender, and the rich flavor of the broth feels so right. Then you get sprouted beans and some greens, which are just wonderful additions. In the picture, you see a medium-sized bowl, which is only 35k right now, and I asked not to add any onion/spiciness. Organ-lemongrass juice is rich in flavor and feels refreshing. The people who run this place are friendly, and the service is fantastic. The only downside I can think of is the flies, but that comes with an open space. The place is well-maintained.

author: Sam Goh SE
review_text: delicious traditional food like fried kueh teow, fried carrot cake, fried oysters, fried Hokkein mee, bbq chicken wing, bbq sting ray, satay and popiah. All super good. we enjoyed our picnic lunch. bought takeaways to have picnic by the beach. so fun eating near the beach and splashing waves.

author: RJ C.
review_text: The staff members are all busy in the kitchen, so you’ll be waiting for a long time to pick up your food. It would be nice to have at least one person attend to the food pick-up people! They made our burrito wrong, so we had to wait 10 mins to get it fixed. Otherwise, it’s like any other Taco Bell.

author: Michael Forkin
review_text: This spot has a great sunset, a lovely, albeit cramped layout and some very attentive and wonderful staff. Despite all of this, I must admit that the prices at the venue are on the expensive side and the “++” on the menu only adds to this. The food is very overpriced for what it is, we ordered the beef and lamb kebabs which came out as eight small meatballs, the crispy red snapper bites and the golden fries. None of which were show stoppers and for the price paid, the flavour and size was quite disappointing. The venue is great for a sunset photo shoot if you are that way inclined, and a cheeky pre-dinner drink but I wouldn’t say it’s a must see if you aren’t staying at the Ayana Resort (or if you are).

author: Raushanah Ahmad
review_text: It was pretty good service although it only seemed to be one server. Food was good but I've had better French toast still ate it though 😂🤗

author: Joe Lim
review_text: Sarawak Kolo Mee Stall offers one of the best wonton-based noodles in the East. This is the second time I came at the last minute before they closed and the owner was kind enough to take my order. We ordered the Kolo Mee which comes with braised pork ribs. The noodles are QQ and the soup stock is rich and umami flavoured. The dry wonton noodles with char siew and fried/boiled wonton is a winning flavour bomb. The chilli oil sauce is spicy, umami and flavourful. I will definitely come back again. The owner is very friendly and welcoming. Kudos to that despite slogging from dawn till 2pm+ 🙏

author: David Levy
review_text: Best tacos in Los Angeles. Granted there are a lot to choose from but these are the best. Wonderful people great service. Totally authentic.

author: Dania Zaidi
review_text: Amazing Experience at Namkeen! Food at this place was on point! We tried the Nashville and Tikkaville burgers, and both were absolutely amazing. I loved their Dhamaka fries – perfectly seasoned and paired wonderfully with all the sauces. Everything was made fresh, so it all came out hot and delicious. The staff were incredibly helpful and attentive, ensuring a great dining experience. Highly recommend this spot for anyone craving flavorful burgers with a unique twist!

author: Erick Maitin Morales
review_text: I received this recommendation as the best representation of Spanish food in Miami, and it was a disappointment. Service: Unprofessional with wines, lack of knowledge about the menu and allergens, but the most notable issue was charging for dishes that were not served. Food: The dishes were very risky and lacked refinement. The recommended paella had overcooked rice, and the artichoke was undercooked.

author: Jesse
review_text: Mediocre at best. Not worth the drive and can’t understand what the 5 stars is all about. The wait and maintenance of a waiting list is inadequate. There seems to be no logic behind the “list”. People were upset and frustrated with how or when names were being called. Would not return.

author: Andrew Mcmahon
review_text: Staff were extremely attentive and polite. Had the filet mignon and shrimp. The sauce was delicious and surprisingly not sweet given it had slices of banana. My friend had the hamburger which was huge. Shrimp and octopus in garlic sauce appetizer, almond tart and tiramisu for dessert. I have been to all Fernandes' restaurants and all outstanding.

author: Dharven Panchal
review_text: It's one of the best outlets of the cheesecake factory in Boston. The menu is elaborative with drinks and food options. The food quality is awesome. Fettuccine Alfredo, pasta, etc. Their cheesecakes are to die for. We were all vegetarian people and still got decent options. Ample parking spaces were available.

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: Wariz Game
review_text: I finally tried this place today, a spot highly recommended by locals! It wasn't crowded at all, which seems to be the case if you avoid Friday, Saturday, and Sunday. The food was absolutely delicious – seriously, let the pictures do the talking! Everything I had, from the prawns, fish, and squid to their most popular dishes, was incredibly tasty. Honestly, you've just got to come and try it for yourself!

author: SD
review_text: This was my first time having Bánh Mi and I enjoyed it! I had the mixed meat combo as that was recommended. The bread was super crisp and flaky with a decent amount of meat inside. If you’re not a lover of pate/sausage then I’d try something else on the menu. Taste wise, the only thing that was lacking for me were the pickles, it needed the tangy sourness to bring it all together. The mango smoothie was thick, sweet and refreshing, perfect for the humid climate. I’d definitely go back if I have time to try the roast pork Bánh Mi as I think it’d be more up my street. Note: this is more of a takeaway spot but there are a couple of deck chairs and small tables out front

author: Sara Perkins
review_text: Love it here! I never see that many people dining in but it’s actually a lovely place to sit down and grab something to eat. Large portions, amazing taste, good service. I also do pickup fairly often. Lots of vegan and vegetarian choices. 10/10 I hope they never close!

author: Jenny Ramos
review_text: The food was well made. But it was not anything spectacular. The Tomahawk was pricy for the size. I have had bigger ones for the same price. The gin and tonic was mid at best. Service was good. I feel like this place is overpriced for Newark and especially the area in Newark. Hidden in the back. I think Newark has better offerings.

author: eveasyful
review_text: So good not skimpy with there plate they pack it up you defently get your money worth. The lady that serve you are so kind you will never FIND a place like this it's so yummy !!!!!

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: Jana Chris
review_text: We passed by this noodle shop several times during our stay in Bangkok, and no matter whether it was morning or late at night, there was always a queue outside. The display of crispy pork belly alone was enough to tempt us, so we decided to make it our final food stop before leaving the city — and it did not disappoint. You can build your own bowl and choose exactly what you want. We went for the dry noodles with pork belly, duck, and crab meat, and everything was incredibly flavorful, tender, and perfectly cooked. But the true highlight? The egg noodles. They are unbelievably fresh, springy, and full of flavor — honestly the kind of noodles you could happily eat any time of day. If you go, do yourself a favor and order extra egg noodles! With amazing meats, great variety, and truly outstanding noodles, this place is absolutely worth the queue. We’d go back in a heartbeat.

author: Azizan Omar
review_text: This restaurant has delicious food, good service, delicious rice... the fried noodles and pasembor are top notch, and the service is fast. When it's crowded, the counter chief himself goes down to serve customers.

author: Sianna Lee
review_text: Thee best Indian resturant in L.A county hands down. Its amazing!!! I told the staff not a lot of spice (i cant take it) and they obliged, the flavor is perfect everything complement each other. I got a Chicken Lunch special its 15.23 with tax but it came with Rice, Chicken, Garlic nann, veggies. They do have vegetarian options as well.

author: Sachin Prasad
review_text: We had a great brunch experience here! We tried the California French Toast, Mexican Scramble (with Soyrizo instead of Chorizo), and the Cookies and Cream Pancake. Everything was excellent, and the food presentation was impressive. I’d highly recommend the Mexican Scramble for its unique flavors, and the California French Toast is a must-try if you have a sweet tooth—the Bavarian cream really takes it to the next level. We had to wait 45 minutes, but it was worth the wait.

author: Michael Chu
review_text: The Suon Bi Op La was delicious and the place is welcoming. Nice open concept with plenty of seating. Food was cooked fresh and you can taste the variety of flavors. One of the best combo rice plates that I’ve had here in Saigon.

author: Terrick W.
review_text: Finally had chance to revisit Punggol Nasi Lemak. Their queue is still consistently long but it moves pretty fast. We did both dine in and takeaway. Dishes wise their standard pretty comsistent. But sadly their food temperature is not right. Especially the rice, it was less than room temperature. Later we noticed new batch of rice and dishes came out hot. Perhaps just bad timing?

author: Victor G
review_text: I’ve been coming to Lucky’s Chinese Food for a while now, and it never disappoints. The portions are super generous for the price, and the food always hits the spot hot, fresh, and flavorful. The chow mein and fried rice is fire too, always cooked just right and not overly greasy like some other spots. What really sets this place apart, though, is the service. The staff is always friendly, fast, and welcoming. Even when they’re busy, they move quickly and stay polite. You can tell they care about keeping customers happy.

author: Eye4 Cyou
review_text: Maybe if my pizza was accurate it could have been better. Reading is fundamental, that's why the customer is able to customize their order. If a pizza is supposed to have 1 topping on one side then that's how you make it. You don't put the toppings on the whole pie because you want. And that's why I go to PIZZA HUT. THEY Passed KINDERGARTEN

author: Denis X.
review_text: Probably one of the better bahn mis i have had in ho chi minh!! The queue was insane but it clears quite quickly so don’t worry about that. There is a dedicated sitting section but it was so oacked that we decided to takeaway and have it at one of the cafes opposite the street alongside some vietnamese coffee. Highly recommended!!

author: Aury Ortiz- Rivera
review_text: Hosted my best friends proposal in the Red Room & everything came out perfect !! Diana and Elena accommodated all our needs & our server Julius was super attentive. We had a delicious dinner & a great time celebrating our friend. The restaurant itself was beautifully decorated for Christmas !! Would recommend 100% and will definitely be coming back for dinner.

author: Debbie Voon
review_text: Local cuisine and has the taste of Penang. The fried chicken and rempah fish are my favorite. Love the milk tea and coffee too!

author: Ngoc Minh
review_text: The restaurant near my house is always crowded with customers. I went to the restaurant on a weekday and booked a table in advance, so I didn't have to wait, I got a table right away. Because it was a weekday, it wasn't crowded, although I saw customers coming and going constantly, there were still many empty tables in the back. The staff were friendly and enthusiastic, and the order was taken very quickly. The food we ordered was quite a lot. The grilled pork belly and sturgeon with green mustard were delicious, the meat was soft and moist, the restaurant used medium charcoal, the fire wasn't too big and smoky like other restaurants, it took a bit longer to grill but it was worth the wait. The jellyfish salad was okay, with a little jellyfish it was a bit boring to eat. The chicken cartilage was normal. Everyone praised the crab and sweet potato vermicelli, so I ordered a portion. The vermicelli made the sauce richer, there was real crab meat but it was dry, I didn't like this dish. The avocado salad and fried taro were delicious, very attractive. The fried sturgeon cartilage was firm, the grilled fish was soft and delicious, there was a lot of garlic. The vegetable tray was big like its name. As for the drinks, they were all similar, the lemon tea was strange and strange, I couldn't get used to it. Overall, the food was okay. 300 fish per person was enough to fill us up.

author: i . am . kenny
review_text: Tried their (in)famous tom yam seafood Mama. I would say it tastes and looks good. Order a veggie as a side and i was stuffed. I came early around 4 when there is still space, but crowd started to stream in and queue formed when i left. I guess this place is really popular. Staff were sometimes non-attentive likely because i sat at a corner where no one can really see me. Best to come in group to enjoy more of their food. Overall great experience. Will patronize again.

author: Omar A Morillo
review_text: We had an absolutely wonderful dining experience at Petra Lunga in North Miami Beach! From start to finish, everything was top-notch. The service was attentive and friendly, and the owner even came by to greet us, making us feel truly welcomed. We started with the Metzi meatballs, which were absolutely delicious. The tableside cacio e pepe was a highlight—prepared in a giant wheel of parmesan and topped with truffles, it was simply phenomenal. We also loved the pizza with pepperoni, stracciatella, and a drizzle of hot honey—it was the perfect blend of flavors. The New York strip was a bit overcooked for our liking, but still flavorful and enjoyable. To top it all off, we indulged in their desserts—the tiramisu and the berries panna cotta—both were delightful and the perfect ending to our meal. The atmosphere, with outdoor seating by the bay, was just perfect for a relaxing evening. We even got to enjoy a digestivo, including a lovely limoncello. Overall, we highly recommend Petra Lunga and can’t wait to come back!

author: Michael Jacobs
review_text: Fantastic food in a beautiful room . Highly recommend . In my top 5 for Rock shrimp tempura

author: Ninetales
review_text: Overall food is decent except fried shrimp not fresh. We love squid, chicken and bone soup.

author: Brian B
review_text: Overall it was not a bad spot for a coffee. I had the cortado, which was actually presented very well. The prices were not horrible on the coffee. I had the turkey omelette, and was not particularly impressed. It was bland.

author: andi yani
review_text: Remboelan Restaurant is a wonderful place to experience the soul of Indonesian cuisine presented in an elegant and refined way. The restaurant brings together rich flavors from across the archipelago—classic traditional dishes that are full of taste, well-balanced spices, and beautifully prepared. The atmosphere is comfortable and classy, making it ideal for both formal business meetings and casual gatherings with friends or family. Despite the elegant setting, the food remains authentic and comforting, reminding you of the richness of Indonesian culinary heritage. If you’re looking for a place that celebrates Indonesian food with quality, tradition, and style, Remboelan is definitely worth visiting.

author: Sheryn Choong
review_text: Good food. We had 4 items and cost us thb1200. Service a bit slow but that's probably because it's peak time n a lot of customers. Server very sweet and apologetic, but one can see they worked very hard, serving at full speed as fast as they can. They also hv a lovely band playing live when we were there on Sat.

author: סברינה בלהסן-נימצוביץ
review_text: Créma should have been the best place for coffee. It was not. Not for coffee nor for food. The coffee was awful, the Greek salad was a shame to the Greek cuisine and the tuna sandwich was served in a baguette which has seen better days.(maybe it was tasty yesterday) However the stuff tried its best to improve the feeling, but if the foundation isn’t good, no service in the world will help.

author: Wana Azmy
review_text: Everything was fine. But they used chipped cup and the cup got stained too. I asked for change, second time the water got some dirts inside. What a shame. Unsafe to use chipped crockery ya, basic food safety guys!

author: Cindy G
review_text: These are authentic street tacos and some of the best in LA! Any meat you choose will be so delicious and the guacamole sauce they pour adds so much flavor! My family and I travel far just to eat these tacos every year!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Sarah Anne Duncan
review_text: Hidden gem. You need to look for this place, it's just off the boardwalk. What a gem. Excellent tacos. Excellent, friendly, helpful, cheerful staff. Lovely restrooms. Clean, fresh, well looked after Exceptional.

author: Tanya Nguyen
review_text: Excellent modern-fusion Vietnamese food. Our group tried almost everything on the menu and it did not disappoint. Highly recommend the pork chop—so simple yet so flavorful. The atmosphere was intimate and comfortable, would be great for a date or family meal. They even had crayons and toys for our baby!

author: Steven W
review_text: Went during middle of the day so was seated immediately. Found the place as it was really close by to our hotel and it was just okay. The broth itself had good flavour but nothing overly special. The one thing that was good was the fresh rice noodles. For the price it is also on the more expensive side relative to other restaurants and pho places.

author: Wrthg Hvn
review_text: Went there for some food and drinks. My friend had the rodizio, which I sampled as well. The meat was super tender and not salty. We also had a passion fruit sangria and beers. The sangria was excellent. The crowd was really nice. There was music playing inside and outside. There were a lot of nice people around. It was a good crowd. I look forward to returning soon .

author: Chuah Keat Lee
review_text: Superb service and delicious food. We orders the turmeric rice with deep fried chicken. The rice portion were decent and the chicken was delish! My wife had the sambal prawns - it was yum! I ate the toasted black bread and half boiled egg. This was decent. The waiters and waitresses were attentive to us. Some were able to speak English and some can't speak English well. Those who couldn't, tried to speak professionally anyhow 👍🏻 My only gripe is the price. Each dish cost nearly RM20. The toasted bread and half boiled egg was RM12! (I wasn't that hungry, therefore, ordered the "cheapest" and smallest portion) Go to any coffee shop, it cost less than RM5.

author: GT Nguyen
review_text: My family of 9 came in for brunch and we had a great experience. Grandpa has a wheelchair, so we sat on the first floor. Most of Vietnam isn’t accessible, but this restaurant was as most accessible as it could be. The food was sooo good. We almost over ordered but our server informed us it might be too much food and she was right. I’m so glad they didn’t try to oversell us. The service was awesome they really care about their customers. Hera was our server and she was AMAZING! You should definitely give this place a try when you visit HCM

author: Lanny
review_text: The one I really liked was the Ube egg tart. It was so delicious. Nasi Lemak was just ok since the rice was not too flavourful luckily the chicken was flavourful. Surprisingly, the Curry Pan was so good. The coffee mocha was ok. The price is a bit pricey. The waiters were not friendly. So overall everything was just ok.

author: Zen Yong
review_text: Krua Pa-Yad is one of those restaurants in Hatyai that many people talk about, so we decided to give it a try — and it did not disappoint. The restaurant opens at 4 PM, and we arrived early, becoming part of the second batch of customers for the evening. This turned out to be a great decision because the place can get very busy later on, with long waiting queues forming rather quickly. If you plan to visit, I would highly recommend going early to avoid the crowd and enjoy a more relaxed dining experience. The staff here were friendly and attentive. They greeted us warmly and took our order promptly. Despite the restaurant starting to fill up, service remained smooth and efficient, which made the whole experience enjoyable. The environment is clean, spacious, and well-maintained, providing a comfortable setting for a casual dinner. The open layout and neat arrangement of tables create a nice atmosphere where you can enjoy your meal without feeling cramped. Price-wise, the menu felt reasonable and fair for the quality and portion size of the food. The dishes we ordered were served in portions that matched the price, which made it easy to order a variety of items without worrying about wasting food. Taste-wise, everything we tried was delicious. The flavors were well-balanced, and you could tell the ingredients were fresh. It’s the kind of food that feels homey yet flavorful, perfect for sharing with family or friends. Overall, Krua Pa-Yad is definitely worth a visit if you are in Hatyai. Between the friendly service, clean and comfortable environment, reasonable pricing, and tasty dishes, it makes for a satisfying dining experience. Just remember to plan ahead and arrive early — it’s popular for a reason, and the waiting queue later in the evening can get quite long!

author: Low Siew Keong
review_text: Bad experience, bad services, and the environment is terrible. They don't even listen to you when you make order, terrible behavior. Food is not that good but the price is damn high. Strongly not recommend

author: Chintia Ahmed Niha
