review_text: Great Pizza, Great Staff! As a first timer I am very pleased with this pizza spot. The line was outside when I arrived, but it moved very quickly. A variety of pizzas were displayed for your viewing pleasure, but I liked their Gluten free pizza with pepperoni. You can dine in get it boxed up to do. You can also dine in, and I enjoyed it. Great Location and very close to Bryant Park.

author: Escilpe
review_text: We came on a Sunday evening and didn’t get a crowd. Food is great and the lala claypot soup taste delicious. You order the soup and the hotpot adds on ( beef, fish slice , luncheon meat and vegetables etc) Kids love the food. Family of 5 and costing below a $100.

author: Troy Foltz
review_text: Waffle was undercooked, rubbery and bland. They no longer provide butter for customers. Fried chicken was over cooked, and flavorless. Over priced and terrible food. Wouldn't come back

author: ROMMEL RIVERA
review_text: Great place for seafood, salads and little appetizers plates. They offer great alcoholic and non alcoholic drinks. Beautiful place to have lunch. The staff is very helpful and kind. Can't go wrong with this place

author: Manuel Gonzalez
review_text: This Subway in downtown Miami is a solid choice; the shop is always clean and the service is consistently fast. The manager, Kenya, is great and runs the place really efficiently, making sure everyone is taken care of quickly. It’s my go-to spot for a reliable meal, especially since the delivery is always so prompt.

author: Ajay
review_text: Waitress was very helpful and attentive. I forget her name but she's blonde and I remember her saying she's from an island. All the food we had was really good, I just wish they served the oysters in half dozen or a dozen instead of only 3. The outside looks a little suspect but once you're inside its worth it. This is a little hidden gem. Prices are not too expensive "but", certain dishes are a little over priced seeing that the portions are small. The question you all want to know...Will I come back?...The answer is yes! Not only will I come back, I will bring my friends and family here when they come visit. Right off Fremont street so once you eat add drink,you can go on a nice walk and get some good pics.

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: laura korwa
review_text: Had lunch here today and it was one of the most delicious meals I’ve had during my Saigon trip. Ordered the two-style duck breast, grilled pork, and shrimp rolls all fresh, flavorful, and beautifully served. The place feels cozy and green, with a relaxing scent and unique design. Staff were kind, attentive, and gave honest advice on portions; rare and much appreciated. A refreshing, high-quality dining spot. Definitely recommend!

author: Atul Kumar
review_text: Really tasty authentic India food. We ordered dahi papdi and Mali kofta and it was delicious. The service by the girl at the counter was really great.

author: SHARMILA NAIR
review_text: Had a great time celebrating birthday here. The food portion and the price was reasonable. Nick was very kind and helpful throughout the planning. He also help us took alot of pictures in various spots. It was a memorable dining for us.

author: TAN ANDREAS
review_text: Came here few Times , for Indonesian cuisine lovers are recommended, most of the food tasted great , and suitable for our flavor , sop buntut👍ayam bakar👍sate ayam👍..food are worth of price, good environment for Lunch as well dinner , huge place for meeting or gathering 👍😊be back soon Pondok kemangi.

author: Kiauna Washington
review_text: Attended on Mother’s Day. They were very friendly and accommodating, though we didn’t have a reservation. There was live music. A little confusion at times due to the language barrier, but I used google translate to assist. Overall things went smoothly. Would definitely eat here again. Highly recommend the modongo soup and truffle fries. Drinks were really good too…best mojitos since my trip to Puerto Rico. Plenty of off street parking in the rear.

author: lloyd teo
review_text: Great food and top notch services by the team here at Qatar premium lounge. Big shout out to Hazel, Elsy, Jessy, Pinky and Divan for the hospitality. Thank you all for making my journey with Qatar a pleasant one!

author: charlie purdue
review_text: driest chinese food i have ever had. was burnt black, had almost no sauce, no side of rice or vegetables to add flavor... portions were also offensively small for $18... girl at the counter was quick but not very friendly, not that i care, since i will not be coming back

author: Common Courtesy
review_text: La Lechonera is hands down one of the best spots for authentic Puerto Rican food! The pernil (roast pork) is perfectly seasoned and tender, and the arroz con gandules is full of flavor. Everything tastes homemade and cooked with love. The portions are generous, the prices are fair, and the service is always warm and friendly. Whether you’re grabbing a quick bite or sitting down with family, La Lechonera delivers every time. Highly recommend if you’re craving real, delicious Latin food!

author: Anna Cammarota
review_text: Great food and service, music every night, place to come back over and over, nice atmosphere and right in the boardwalk

author: Dio Fitzgerald
review_text: Food and Music was awesome!!! I had the Chicken Kabob and it was the best chicken kabob I’ve eaten! And the waiters are very nice and friendly! Don’t miss out on amazing Persian food so please eat here.

author: Danielle M Liquori
review_text: I’ve never heard of this place and I went there for a party. It was a pretty good party and the people I New had a party in the dining room and they accommodated and set a really large table for them. I enjoyed my euro salad, and I had a iced tea. All the other dishes looked really good too.

author: Nicole Freed
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ First-Class Experience at Paperfish Sushi on Española Way! Allison and Joy truly went above and beyond to deliver first-class service — prompt, friendly, and incredibly attentive from start to finish. The atmosphere on Española Way is such a vibe — lively, colorful, and full of energy — and Paperfish fits right in perfectly. The food was phenomenal — fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. I’m not even usually into sushi, but they offer such a variety of dishes to suit every palate that I was genuinely impressed. Everything tasted so good and was prepared with care. If you’re in Miami Beach, do yourself a favor and stop by Paperfish — and if you’re lucky enough to have Allison and Joy take care of you, you’re in for a treat! 🌸🍣✨

author: Phương Duy
review_text: Delicious food. Spacious and cool restaurant. Enthusiastic staff. Everyone should try the roasted suckling pig. Very delicious Located on a big street so parking is convenient Everyone should try it

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Kero Chan
review_text: We waited for around 15 minutes on a Sunday early evening. The line was quite efficient; staff handed out QR code for you to place order in advance so food could come accordingly once you seated. Food were overall very tasty and in small portions, which was good because you could order many more to try. My personal favourites are their Pork Ribs Soup and the large intestines. The fact that they would refill the soups nonstop makes the experience even better.

author: Danielle Claros
review_text: cozy atmosphere, friendly staff, tasty tapas with beautiful presentation, fun variety of drinks, and everything came out super quickly! my friends and i had a blast pregaming here before our concert at prudential - totally looking forward to coming back soon🤠✨

author: Logen Willey
review_text: My friends and I wanted to try a cute little place for a delicious breakfast and that’s exactly what we got. I couldn’t decide because everything sounded so good but I chose French toast and a caramel frappe. I was not disappointed. The atmosphere is very aesthetic and pleasing and a fun place to go with friends. I would come again for sure !

author: Irania Rodriguez
review_text: Randomly found the place while visiting Vegas and on Fremont St area. We told them we were celebrating his birthday and they were generous enough to provide a fried ice cream dessert with cinnamon sugar chips! They tasty food and the nachos order we had was enough for 2!

author: Chen Walter
review_text: Good old school vibes , as a Singaporean couldn’t really find much of a place like that, But special shout out: KANG JAPANESE CUISINE: Had the Unagi bento set, lovely unagi with 2 tempura ebi & 2 Takoyaki balls , lovely Japanese rice drizzled with Tare & a pellet cleansing salad which is sour yet sweet & a very nice hint of umami, totally worth a try when you all come down and dine here. For the sides I ordered a set takoyaki ball, lovely crust outside with a very soft batter, drizzle with mayo and bulldog sauce that compliments the heavy flavours of the takoyaki really reminds me of Japan. My partner ordered the cheesy chicken katsu curry rice, Moist Chicken with a very crispy outlet breading , The side of the most tastiest Japanese curry I ever had, nice savoury with a hint of sweet, containing potatoes and carrots. Price wise is very worthy with a huge portion size.

author: Duy Hoang Quoc Dang
review_text: Best Babi Guling (Roasted Pork with rice) in Canggu. The staff felt a bit cold and unwelcoming, but the food definitely made up for it — every dish was a mood booster. Prices are local-friendly, the restroom is clean, and the seating area is spacious and comfortable.

author: Aisling Nox
review_text: Would never recommend this place. If you’re ordering takeout, be prepared to wait A LONG time past their time they tell you it’s ready. Also double check your order before you walk away. They’ll sometimes just “forget” a dish. So if you order takeout add on at least 15+ minutes to their estimated time. You’ll be waiting 30+ minutes and they won’t tell you anything about how much longer. They won’t even offer you a cup of water. Absolute zero sense of customer service. Not an ounce of thanks for waiting or sorry for the delay. Food is mediocre at best. Just drive to Irvine and get your Szechuan fix. Beware. Also, I’m pretty sure they reuse their oil day after day. Pretty shocked the food inspector hasn’t shut them down. Never again.

author: chanvk
review_text: The broth for the kai see horfun was very flavourful. You can taste the prawn and chicken stock in the broth. The 'dry' curry chicken mee was thick and rich. The calamansi provided, add an extra tangy kick to the taste. The fishball was spongy and tasty. Too bad the stall do not have any bean sprout as a side dish. It would have been a perfect meal if there was.

author: Wong Kok Ming
review_text: The place is pack with tourists from all over the world to try their food and bingsu. The environment of the place is very comfy and comfortable to enjoy food and drinks with friend and family. The staff here is very friendly and helpful. Number is given for the customer to wait for their turn and there is a bar code where you can scan and see their menus before getting your table. The food here is delicious and got variety of selection to choose from.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Nicole N
review_text: SO HAPPY I FOUND THIS PLACE🙌 9/10 The quality of the food is so good and fresh. Someone recommended the radish paper in an older review, it has been a life changer imo! Overall the service is great, but I like that there's a button to call the waiter over. This place dosent get packed like most kbbq's, which is always a surprise to me because this place is just as good, if not BETTER than other kbbqs! I love getting Menu B, it has a good variety of dishes beyond regular meat options like fried rice, fried wontons, corn cheese, and i love the squid! Good for going solo or for a big group. A few things that dont make this place a 10/10 is there is a robot that brings most of the dishes, usually the waiter helps and unloads the dishes but not at all the time so its awkward having to standup from the table to get the dishes and you only have about a minute before the robot leaves so you have to be fast😅 Its also awkward when the robot stops in a spot where youre unsure if its meant for you or the table next to you... certain tables are too close to each other. Also the paying situation, I never know if Im suppose to ask the waiter for the bill or get up and pay at the exit. I always get up and pay on my way out but then they ask for my table number and i have no idea. Maybe this is a me problem? IDK, but this is the only restaurant that gives me this confusion. Confusion or not, I will be back😊

author: Watcharapong Homprang
review_text: I traveled from Thailand to visit Singapore during July 25–28, 2025. On the morning of my last day, just before heading to the airport to fly back to Thailand, I stumbled upon the restaurant in this photo by chance. I didn’t know the name of the place, but I tried the food and it was really delicious. The young woman who was serving was also very lovely. It’s a pity I discovered this place on my last day—otherwise, I would have gone there every day!

author: Andrew Mowat
review_text: This bistro has it all. Don’t be misled by the somewhat unassuming looks from the entrance, this place has fabulous coastal vibes and friendly staff to match. Everyone who works here has a genuine interest in customers, including a positive food experience. Talking of which, every dish we had was very enjoyable, from the simple but well put together Aglio Olio to the Indian and fusion dishes we tried. And unlike a recent experience with a nearby and well-known Greek restaurant, the prices here are very reasonable. A lovely little gem on East Coast Park.

author: Tengku Ana
review_text: Order and collect your own food. Queue is quite slow and long on weekend. Parking cost RM5, but not many parking spaces available. Parking is available behind the restaurant but u need to hike up to the restaurant and pass by a big garbage bin which is so smelly. Food price reasonable. Taste is so-so, ikan 2 negara tasted like they cook it with some readymade sauce. Ayam bakar served cold. I can say it is famous only bcoz of the atmosphere & view. Will not return.

author: ERNESTO ALVARADO
review_text: All around rating five star food was excellent. The service was great. The atmosphere inside the building is good, outside the building is a little sketchy but you're not eating your food out in the parking lot, but other than that this place Pepe's tacos was the bomb.

author: Tinaye M
review_text: The food was amazing! Highly recommended ordering the marry me chicken it was so good. live music aswell

author: Jon Wan
review_text: Wide variety of menu. They have set combinations too. Halal. Digital order and payment. Polite staff. Spacious and comfortable seating

author: TK Chew
review_text: Owner's mom who helps to run the place was super nice and gave great recommendations on their dishes. Their Indian and Nepal cuisine are genuinely delicious. Great atmosphere to enjoy the sea and look at planes departing from Changi Airport.

author: lio mas
review_text: Worth it with its price,they offered a vast variety of foods,the cutlery is very clean and the place is considerably pleasant,will definately come again

author: andrea Isaac
review_text: 45$ for two plates whole medium of oxtail was fatty got my food early morning so I was clearly the first order. Sad, I'd was gonna go my money back but I wasn't wasting my gas to Go back across town! Not even given forks. NEVER AGAIN

author: Jannah
review_text: Both the beef hot pot and the butter-grilled meat were delicious; the meat was fresh and the portions were generous. The waiters were also warm and friendly.

author: Jaclyn D
review_text: Stopped in for drinks and apps and everything was great! The lobster avocado was so unique and a great combo! The sticky ribs were AMAZING and the clam chowder I look forward to having again. Overall a great place with a bright, fresh ambiance.

author: Nomadicus
review_text: Pho Viet Nam in Ho Chi Minh City is undeniably a destination spot, the kind of place travelers seek out because of its Michelin star rather than because a local nudged them there. I visited at the very start of my Vietnam trip, which ended up being helpful—I had a well-recognized version of pho to compare against everything else I tried along the way. Service is quick and efficient, and the broth is clean, flavorful, and well crafted. But beyond that, not much else signaled a Michelin-level experience for me. It was good pho, but not transformative pho. A couple of notes: the Chinese fried bread costs extra, and the stone hot pot option—while dramatic—is more gimmick than enhancement. Skip the theatrics and go for the simple bowl. I’m glad I tried it, especially as a benchmark, but whatever magic the guide recognized didn’t quite translate to my visit. It's a solid stop, just not the standout I had hoped for.

author: Iniyazh
review_text: The food is more pleasing for western and not very authentic. I celebrated my birthday here, and the staff were really, really friendly and nice Their hospitality truly stood out. We went for dinner, so unfortunately we missed the sunset. Honestly, this place is not about the food. You're paying for the view and the overall experience. The hospitality and the stunning cliffside view are what make it worth the price, not the food itself. If you're coming, come for the atmosphere and scenery.

author: Andesita Ryanesia
review_text: so so soo good! much better than the famous thai Yawarat bread! the size of the bread is perfect, not too big not too small. I buy 4, and got the free one for butter and sugar bread! Its always full of people, but their service is top! No need to wait for long cos they have enough staff to make your bread ready, and professional having queue number so its fair for everyone. If youre in Banthatong area, this is a must try one!

author: J W
review_text: This is my favorite thai restaurant in LA. I have been a long term customer here since 2018. Very authentic and delicious thai food, packed with flavors in my mouth. Also, I am happy to see their prices are not inflated like crazy like other restaurants in 2025. You can tell this is a honest business with a loyal customer base. P.s. The spicy raw shrimp is very spicy haha, but i love it! The sauce brings me back to Thailand.

author: Lily Sandoval
review_text: Despite being right in the heart of USC and always packed with crowds from the students, this Chick-fil-A never misses a beat. They consistently get my order right and it’s always ready on time. The place stays impressively clean given how busy it gets, and the staff does a great job keeping the service friendly, fast, and efficient. It’s clear they care about maintaining high standards — even during the rush. Definitely one of the more reliable spots around campus. Only down fall is that parking really sucks. Unless you park in the parking garage, but even that seems a little bit overpriced for my liking.

author: Vivian Vivian
review_text: The roasted pork should be the best part but not that really WOW us as we expected cuz if I have to compared with roasted pork skin we had, this is not really really the most amazing one lah. And the pork meat feel a bit try and the skin is not so crispy as we expected and less juicy. But I give the credit to their juice which taste so good not so sweet.

author: T Y
review_text: We recently dined as a family at Legal Seafood in Boston and were thoroughly satisfied with our experience. Seated on the terrace overlooking the harbor where the boats are moored, we appreciated the picturesque and pleasant setting. Despite the busy atmosphere and high occupancy, the ambiance remained friendly and warm, especially thanks to the proximity of the bar, the display of fresh fish, oysters, and lobsters. The open kitchen demonstrated remarkable expertise and transparency regarding the quality of the products offered. This experience fully met our expectations for a seafood specialty restaurant. We highly recommend this establishment.

author: Dionne Warren-Palmer
review_text: We stopped in here to eat for dinner after seeing the excellent reviews and food pictures. This restaurant did not disappoint! We were greeted when we walked in by NaNa and Shakerea. They are friendly, funny and very outgoing. The dining areas are clean with modern decor. We didn't have to wait long for our food to be brought to the table. My husband and 2 children ordered different entrees and they were all delicious!! It was a lot of food. We couldn't finish it all. Unfortunately, for us, we couldn't take it with us because we were staying at a nearby hotel before a cruise. We are looking forward to our next visit, and Cornbread Farm to Soul will be on our first stops to visit!!

author: Randy Johnson
review_text: Their chilly is the best and the rest of thier for is alway fresh and delicious.

author: Mode Nicolas
review_text: Nov 16, 2025, at 9am, visited this location that's walk in only and in the middle of a very busy intersection. So that area is always busy and surrounded by the rudest occupants including the staff that works at this Mc Donald's location. It took an hour just for my food to be ready after ordering from the only kiosk that was working out of four. There was no issue with my food, but the drinks were made incorrectly and when I informed the cashier, she took her sweet time to even acknowledge me and correct the issue. Prices seem to be higher than others. This place isn't worth wasting your time.

author: J P
review_text: Really clean. Staff is friendly as always. Parking is a beast around there, but I'm assuming they are catering to museum visitors and students.

author: Ann Nguyen
review_text: Late-night dinner when we are in Las Vegas. We ordered Mexican Corn as a starter. Rating our orders from most to least favorite: 1. Chicken Tinga Nacho was my top pick, great seasoning, and it's hard to find chicken tinga sold at stores, usually only grandma makes it at home. 2. Filet Mignon Nacho, very good. 3. Al Pastor Nachos. The drinks came in huge sizes, perfect for a birthday celebration. The staff were very kind.

author: Eron Damaska
review_text: This restaurant has a very nice and lively vibes especially at night. The food is outstanding! Beat spot for hangout and chill with friends and family.

author: Ana María García
review_text: KORO is what we needed in the neighborhood, amazing ramen!! I loved the wings, soo crispy and tasty! I am a big fan of the edamame and the offer 3 different flavors which I loved! Beautiful place and nice atmosphere! Thank you!

author: Bing Dun Tan
review_text: I found my favourite kbbq place. Came here a couple of hours ago. The jap chae maybe a bit too much sauce but the noodle is very springy and q, like what I had in korea. Would suggest to lessen the dark sauce. Also, no cold noodle so it was one minor blemish. That being said, the ajooma sets are great value. Comes with seafood (or beef) soup and the steam egg. Usually i dont take the steam egg coz most places make it too sweet or too bland. Here? A sweet (no pun intended) spot was hit. All in all i will be back for sure in the near future.

author: Rohan Dmello
review_text: Amazingly fresh donuts and friendly people. I don't think I have ever had such fresh donuts anywhere. They even made a custom donut for my son. Coffee was great too. Anytime I'm in Vegas I am going to get donuts from here. I would recommend anyone who like to eat donuts once in a while this place is worth the drive from strip. Compared to other places it's is extremely affordable.

author: Venus GWC
review_text: Delicious and big portion oriental chicken chop. Well liked by elderly. Gambas is yummy! Muscle pot is not bad too. Nice ambient and atmosphere. Sitting outside will be a good idea if the weather is not too hot.

author: Clement Gomes
review_text: Amazing, amazing, amazing! Such an awesome concept to get a delish variety of food options and can be delivered right to your home!

author: WanderWithWit
review_text: 🍽️ Here Hai @ Siam Paragon – Michelin Name, Disappointing Reality I walked into Here Hai at Siam Paragon with high expectations, trusting its Michelin-acclaimed reputation. But after this meal, I feel compelled to speak out — because what I experienced today was not deserving of a Michelin status, not even close. 🌟 To the Michelin Guide: I urge you to re-evaluate how your name is being used across multiple branches. The original recipe might be there, but the cooking standards, execution, and value at this particular outlet are severely lacking. A Michelin title represents excellence, consistency, and culinary integrity — none of which I found here. 🍲 What we ordered: 1. Fried Cabbage with Fish Sauce & Pork Crackling (170 Baht) This dish was shockingly salty, and the cabbage was undercooked — crunchy in the wrong way. For the price, I expected a refined version of a humble classic, but this felt like a careless kitchen effort. (See photo for reference.) 2. Stir-Fried Mantis Shrimp with Garlic & Pepper (455 Baht) Another disappointment. While the mantis shrimp was a premium ingredient, it was again over-seasoned, making it hard to enjoy. Salt seemed to overpower every other flavor on the plate. 💸 Total bill, nearly 650 Baht — for two poorly executed dishes. In such a prestigious location and with a Michelin label, diners deserve more than just branding. This experience felt like a cash grab hiding behind a name that no longer represents the quality it promises — at least not at this branch. ⸻ ⚠️ Bottom Line: Michelin status should not be used lightly — and certainly not as a marketing tool when the food doesn’t uphold its name. Disappointed, overpriced, and not worth the hype. Both dishes were below Michelin standard and we were very disappointed as we waited for 30mins.

author: Julio Figueroa
review_text: We tried their expresso and it was very good. Guava pastries were fresh and good. The only negative was the small dinning area. They do have a large wine area but we stopped for the Café.

author: Devina R
review_text: BEST AYAM TAUGE RESTAURANT. The texture of the chicken is nice. The sauce of the steamed chicken and the beansprouts are just right for us. This is one of the rare times when chicken is better than the pork. Char siew is my order. Once you've eaten tauge in Ipoh, you can't go back. No tauge will top Ipoh tauge that's for sure. Eating tauge will never be the same. The crunchiest and the fattest tauge ever.

author: MOURAD MOURAD
review_text: I just loved that butter chicken so creamy and tasty. The place is so clean from inside have a counter sitting and also family style tables

author: Felix Aje
review_text: Great experience at Skye Bar. The atmosphere was amazing and the service was excellent. Special thanks to Tivany, Julio, and Diaz for being very friendly, attentive, and professional. Definitely made the night more enjoyable. Will come back again.

author: Emi Mustarudin
review_text: Used to be a very great place for authentic food but somehow the food quality is getting bad,not all of course. We have encountered 3 times undercooked chicken ,salty vegetables and smelly cabbages. Hope the owner can have an eye on the cooks . All the best!

author: 9TF M
review_text: We had the best experience in this restaurant. The manager was so sweet and smart. She gave us a feeling like dining at home. My son observed her dealing with some difficult customers in a very nice and smart way. Every staff was so dedicated in making you feel comfortable. Will come back again for sure!!

author: Duane DePhillips
review_text: The breakfast menu is awesome. The eggs benedict was great, the apple cinnamon pancakes are amazing, the banana nut muffin is amazing and the chicken fried steak and eggs are also amazing. Our experience here was great and this restaurant does offer gluten free options. We will be back the next time we visit Las Vegas. This is our new go to breakfast spot!

author: Phillip Delgado
review_text: The pizza was spectacular!!! Light, thin and yummy!! We got the Margarita with pepperoni and the Brusklyn is a must have!!! Our waitress, Sophia was amazing!! Kind, attentive and friendly. We are definitely returning for pasta!!

author: John D'Cruz (Kajangfood)
review_text: This is my go-to place for Nasi Kandar in Tanjung Bungah/Tokong area. It’s not famous but has good curries, buzzing vibe with mainly locals and reasonable prices. All the nasi kandar favourites are here - ayam goreng, daging masak hitam , ayam Ros, telur sotong etc. Eat to your hearts content and look for a place for a siesta afterwards. 😅

author: St Francis
review_text: I love the charbroiled burgers. Olympian has a good breakfast menu and good service too. They sell a lot of grilled chicken. It's very good. I've been a satisfied customer for about 15 years. You won't be disappointed. Recently bought a double Cheeseburger at ASTRO Burger for $12.+ It was good. Olympian uses higher grade quality meat, and the buger is about $10.

author: O
review_text: Food, vibes, and service were immaculate. Drinks were good. We really loved the shrimp and grits and the fried chicken wings (not pictured). Service was truly above and beyond exceptional, so attentive and professional. Awesome music was playing. The bar looked fun too.

author: Emmeline Siak
review_text: Fried rice not bad wor. Had the wok hei and tasted good. Even my hk colleagues also say the fried rice was fantastic! If they hve more other dishes will be even better.

author: Joslyn Deschenes
review_text: Great date spot- cute bar set up setting looking outside. I tried the buffalo chicken fries and the I’m Crazy for Cookies shake, and both were amazing! The fries were loaded with tender chicken, just the right amount of heat, and plenty of flavor. The shake was rich, creamy, and packed with cookie goodness—basically dessert heaven in a cup. Friendly service and a fun vibe made the visit even better.

author: Lydia Lee
review_text: this is our must visit place anytime we come to vietnam. incredible food, great vibes and amazing service by all the staff. our server Vu was extremely helpful, attentive and enthusiastic, delivering above and beyond 5 star service!! he helped us take great photos too and really made our night! we will definitely visit again and be sure to look out for Vu 🥰👍🌟

author: Ivan Balandiuk
review_text: Been stopping by every week to have some proper tea and hookah and let me tell you, even on the busiest day I had a proper ETA and high-end service from both servers and hookah specialists. No matter who assisted us, Olga, Zlata or Victoria, we had and have a great time here. Quite a difference to local spots because of the European quality of service. Definitely a place to check out and recommend.

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: Anna M
review_text: I tried the fluffy egg white cloud omelette with some local vegetables inside. It was crunchy on the outside and flavourful and soft inside. The fried crunchy pork sausage chips were excellent, super yummy and flavourful and super crunchy! I also had the coconut drink which was delicious. The place wasn’t very clean. The service was pretty good.

author: D E
review_text: Easily the best Crab Fried Rice I've ever had. Cooked to perfection, you can taste a variety of flavours and the flames of the ultra hot wok. Every bite was special, this is certainly worth every baht spent!

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: sumo rubi
review_text: The restaurant is very chill and thank you for the fresh food and spacious space, suitable for 2 to 10 people.

author: Valerie Johnson
review_text: Prepare to be delighted by Delicias Colombianas! This hidden gem consistently delivers on all fronts. From the moment you step in, the service is truly exceptional – warm, attentive, and incredibly friendly. But the real star is the outstanding food; every bite is a delicious journey of authentic Colombian flavors. Pair that with the casual and inviting atmosphere, and you've got the recipe for a perfect meal. Don't miss out on this fantastic spot!

author: Hieu Trong
review_text: After you is one of the most famous dessert shop in Thailand, its really good, reasonable price too. The bingsu and toast or some more drinks are quality, its taste unique in each one. The size is not too big so everyone can try numerous plate at one time.

author: Victor Hugo O.D.
review_text: Walking by caught this beauty of a place and wondered in, ordering is simple and fast. Tons of great food options and each was delicious. No dine it but you can carry out or order ahead and drive thru pickup.

author: Angelica Pabon
review_text: The food here is absolutely spectacular, and the place feels so authentic! If you want to try the best cuisine in Bali, this is the spot. The staff are all incredibly kind, but a special shoutout to Yumi, who attended me. She went above and beyond, giving me hotel recommendations and tips on things to do – honestly, 20/10 service! I can’t thank her enough. I highly recommend Sun Sun Warung to anyone visiting Bali.

author: Flan Tran
review_text: An ancient house in the middle of Vietnam, not big but that make an amazing ambiance. Food is delicious and well decorated.

author: Cristian Diaz
review_text: This place has been here for years and it is always amazing. I love all the sweets and cakes and empanadas. Gotta try it out you won't be disappointed

author: Evelyn Ladera
review_text: We, the women, loved our lattes, toasts, and pancakes!!....However, the men weren't too happy w/ theirs. One asked for medium rare steak, but got medium well, and expected more steak than what he got. The other wanted medium well, but got medium. Steak is everything to these men, so I had to knock off a star for that. Our server was welcoming, helpful, and attentive. The environment is what was expected...hip, modern, yet homey, and moderately noisy....all indicative of a great place to eat! Space is limited however, so go early! Parking can also be a challenge if you go during the busy hours.

author: Juan Liz
review_text: The food is very tasteful and fresh. The staff is very friendly and attentive. Pio Pio is a hit in Forest Hills, NY VIVA PIO PIO

author: Daniel
review_text: This place used to be amazing. Now it is just ok. Only got one refill. Plates stayed on table for a while. Hibachi person looked like he couldn't be bothered to put effort into making your food good.

author: Natasha
review_text: If you’re looking for really good Indonesian food, this is the place to be. The food was really good with very rich flavours. A must try when you are in Jakarta.

author: John Eckelbarger
review_text: Evel Pie was the perfect spot for our wedding weekend kickoff dinner with both families. We wanted cool + casual… and got it here! 🍕 We started with wings in 3 flavors — BBQ, buffalo, and lemon pepper — plus mozzarella sticks, then moved on to the Goblin Sausage and Barry White whole pies. 🐔 Everything was delicious and plenty to go around. The atmosphere was lively and fun, which was exactly what we needed to kickoff the celebration 💒 Afterwards, we walked Fremont Street and soaked in all the energy of downtown Las Vegas. It made for a very memorable night out bringing our families together over some pizza, wings, and beer 🍺 Highly recommend Evel Pie if you’re looking for great pizza, good vibes, and a quintessential Vegas experience. 🎲 Thanks for being a part of our wedding weekend! 💍

author: Daniel L
review_text: Went there at 5.30 pm, and strangely, pretty much everything we wanted to try was sold out despite opening at 5 pm. on a Friday night. Nonetheless, spring rolls with crab meat and pork were good. Claypot pork trotter has a similar taste to Cantonese style Cheong Zheng. Couldn't taste the other signature dishes and might have had a higher rating given the limited food choices they had at that time. It was disappointing despite being conferred a Thai Select award.

author: sh ewe
review_text: AMA Dimsum has great deco homely atmosphere. Service is excellent with great selection of dim sum.

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: Lim CY
review_text: The soup version is decent, though we were expecting a slightly richer broth. The dry version is enjoyable, with a pleasant squid aroma and flavour. Everything is well balanced, the you char koay is nicely done, crispy on the outside yet still soft and doughy inside, and the vegetables are cooked just right. Overall, it was a satisfying meal, though the price is slightly higher compared to some other bak kut teh shops that offer slightly larger portions.

author: Elna Tan
review_text: Snack shop next to Siam Novotel, very popular and tasty with a hint of salt

author: 胡钰婷
review_text: The experience was very bad. We just sat down and were asked what we wanted to drink before we were given the menu. We were given one menu for two people, and asked for another menu and waited a moment. As soon as it came, we were asked if we wanted to order food? There was no paper towel on the table, and they said they would bring it in a while, but they didn't bring it in the end. There were only a few waiters, and they were all serving large tables of customers. They just kept urging us to order food. I won't come again.

author: Nicholas Ringo
review_text: Pretty fast, but very disorganized. They called out my order number a handful of times. I said some variation of 'I'm here' 'that's me' 'that's mine' every time, but they just called it out without paying any attention to whether someone answered or not

author: David Nguyen
review_text: Great spot that's foreigner friendly and a good cleaner introduction to Vietnamese food vs the street carts. The charcoal banh beo was amazing, first time I've seen that spin on that dish. The bun thit noung was good but not great. I'm used to the grilled pork having stronger flavor with more smokiness. All in all a nice place to beat the heat and get some food.

author: Gabriel Torres
review_text: I had the Menudo with the pig feet and no corn inside it. It was perfect - just like my grandma never made. My wife had the Lengua burrito - very good portions, but she said it was dry. Maybe they could use some more moisture infusion next time.

author: whiplash girlchild
review_text: Came here after a concert and we ordered a sandwich with nuggets but they didn't give us the sandwich. Didn't notice till we got to our hotel and chik fil a was closed so we couldn't go back. Very disappointed. Spent 12.95 for no sandwich.

author: Trinity D
review_text: I had a disappointing experience dining in here for an anniversary. It started with a 30 minute wait when we had a reservation for 8pm (it happens, but that is a long time and we were starving). The place is very small so seating is tight and you are very close to nearby tables. The service was good and friendly once we were sat. It is the mains that are really lacking. The bucatini was basically flavorless, just tasted a little spicy but not actually seasoned (noodles were a great texture). The cavatelli with Italian sausage was so heavy on the lemon I couldn't taste anything else; I could only take a few bites of this one. The lumache with mushroom and the taleggio were good but nothing special for the price tag. The pizza (tried the hot honey and pepperoni) was disappointing after having the pizza bianca; there was barely any hot honey and the sauce lacked flavor. There were a few exceptions: the pizza bianca with ricotta and hot honey is a 10/10, delicious. The tiramisu dessert is also good, even though I don't usually like tiramisu. The cheesecake was not really a cheesecake; it was more like whipped cream frosting on a biscoff crust (we did enjoy it, just don't order it thinking you're getting a typical cheesecake). I am just very underwhelmed and disappointed, as there were great reviews and reservations booked months out, and it's not cheap - plus they charge a 5% "kitchen appreciation fee" with a note that basically reads like "we don't pay our back of house staff enough so we're charging 5% extra," which I find a little tasteless. Maybe the chefs were having an off day, but I won't be back for dine in and I wouldn't recommend it. But I will go back for takeout for that pizza bianca, they have me there. The three stars are for the friendly staff and the pizza bianca.

author: mag Chong
review_text: The food is excellent in many stalls we visited a good place after cycling

author: Brandon Yap
review_text: Very good food, when I used to live there my mom used to mostly go there to buy stuff to eat. Very nice food.

author: Mallory Horton
review_text: I would suggest having stronger utensils for Togo orders. I ordered my food 10 minutes into opening. The oxtails had soooo much fat on them that once I got done peeling the fat off I was left with a little of unflavored meat. I would suggest to skim most of the fat off. I would also suggest to separate the food. Not everyone likes their food touching. Plus it allows you to taste the flavor of the dish. I asked for oxtails and Mac but the oxtails were served on top of the Mac in the same container. Thanks for not using styrofoam but a smaller portion size would be a great option too.

author: Mistique Hernandez
review_text: The food was great and the atmosphere was lovely. Our waitress was Kayla she was efficient and nice. She even sang happy birthday to my friend twice which made the experience fun and playful. It was a great time. Highly recommend.

author: Papa
review_text: Joined friends for dinner, it was our first time and the meal and service was amazing. We sat in the patio area, which was nice it being a warm night. The food came out delicious and the service was on point. Perfect place for date night.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Erica Matos
review_text: Tammy was an excellent server at Serafina—on point, super efficient, and genuinely attentive. I never had to track her down for anything, and she knew the menu inside and out. The food was amazing, and the tiramisu was absolutely out of this world. Thoroughly enjoyed!

author: Merry'sHouse
review_text: I had pasta and it was very delicious. The atmosphere was nice and tropical. There is no air conditioning, but it's not that hot.

author: ganzschoentutka
review_text: We discovered this lovely vegan restaurant tucked away on a quieter street in Canggu, and it instantly became one of our favorites. The location is perfect – peaceful, beautifully maintained, and such a nice place to sit down and enjoy a meal away from the busy main roads. The staff were extremely kind and attentive, and everything was spotlessly clean, which made the whole experience even better. We ordered the jackfruit burrito, sweet potato wedges, and a fresh salad – all of it was absolutely delicious and prepared with great quality. The prices are on the higher side, but totally justified by the taste, freshness, and atmosphere. For anyone vegan (or simply looking for amazing plant-based food), this spot is definitely a must-do in Canggu. We can truly recommend it from the heart! 💚🌱

author: Henry Paige
review_text: 1. the sushi looked dry. 2. The rice tasted like it was cooked with dog food - I tossed that out. 3 the vegetables were good and beef and broccoli was great

author: na ah
review_text: The restaurant is located right in the heart of District 1, but the prices are reasonable, the food is delicious, and it suits my family's taste perfectly. I'll definitely bring my family back to eat there sometime.

author: Dory Boyce
review_text: Had a great experience at Jack in the Box today! The cashier greeted me with a smile and was very patient while I took my time deciding. I went with the Ultimate Cheeseburger, and it was fresh, cheesy, and delicious. The curly fries were perfectly seasoned, and the Oreo shake was the cherry on top! The dining area was tidy, and even though it was busy, they kept up with the orders efficiently. I love the late-night hours—it’s my go-to spot after a long day. Highly recommend for anyone looking for variety and great taste!

author: Nyisha Haynes
review_text: I was supposed to have a HK built in my neck of the woods but heard it got canceled. I was excited when my friend told me of the one near him and the pictures he sent her mouth watering. Tonight was indeed an experience I'll remember and don't think I can duplicate. I came to this restaurant only knowing who Gordon Ramsey is. I've only watched clips of his various shows he created over the years so I came in with no expectations. Though we were 15 min late the staff was very kind to us and we didn't wait long to sit. As a first time guest, the atmosphere was peaceful. Both my friend, who is a fan, and our server educated me about the decor of the place which I enjoyed. Phase 1 was the lobster risotto. Taste buds danced! Texture was smooth and creamy, the flavor was subtle without the lobster, but when put together a combination I wouldn't expect. Phase 2, I chose the salmon with a bed of rice and green bean curry. My compliments to the chef because to pan sear the skin of salmon where is not too burnt but that perfect amount of crisp and crunch from the skin was what I was going for as I cook my salmon like that at home so I was not disappointed. My friend let me try his braised short rib: Juicy, tender and the just all mouth watering and smooth like butter. Phase 3 got to try the sticky toffe which was nice, but what brought me to literal tears as I sank my teeth into my dessert was the apple butterscotch cheesecake. It wasn't the cheesecake so much as the apple, pecan, butterscotch combo punch that brought me back to my childhood when I discovered Apple crumble for the first time. It was indeed a ratatouille moment even if I wasn't a food critic. To this day, I haven't found a dessert that tasted like that until tonight. So I again I thank the chefs, the many staff members that checked on us, giving us the warm welcoming experience down to the friendly valet. I look forward to coming back again to try the other dishes.

author: Shay Asael
review_text: Nice place, Ok food I drove here for 20 min ! It wasn't as good as I'd expect, Since I don't eat Pork, I had maybe only one option, dissapointing..

author: bo seo
review_text: Today, my mother and I had lunch at Thong Smith, Siam Paragon. If you're looking for premium boat noodles with pork, beef and shredded chicken that are delicious, rich, and well-balanced, I highly recommend this place. The price is a bit on the high side, but I feel it's worth it. The service is also excellent, polite, and attentive. I visited between 1:00 and 2:00 PM, and there were already tables available, so I didn't have to wait in line for long. My order arrived fairly quickly, neither too slow nor too fast. The taste was as good as ever. I frequently eat at Thong Smith, at the branch near my house, and I've always enjoyed their food and service. I hope the brand maintains this same high-quality food and service.

author: dawn sun
review_text: Simple yet so delicious! Such a comfort food. It’s a must have, where locals would go instead of going to the Main Street.

author: Aubrey
review_text: First time trying Boston Shawarma and I got the Chicken Shawarma plate and I was expecting the chicken to be flavorful but it wasn’t. Chicken was very dry, little burnt and had no taste. The rice didn’t have a taste either but it was good. Salad was fine, the orange sauce sorry I don’t know the name of it but it was very good and spicy. I wish I had that over the chicken to give it flavor but overall wasn’t satisfied with my meal and I felt like it was over priced too.

author: Minsub Song
review_text: We went here last week and enjoyed the view, environment, and food. But one problem. Idk if this is restaurant wide issue or our server. When we got our check, everything looked normal. We asked to pay with Apple Pay, and our server brought the tab machine. When he was ready, I simply tap my iPhone. After that…he was just going to leave, saying have a good night. We were all confused. “What about the tip? What about the receipt?” I mean don’t people usually get the receipt, leave a tip, and sign? When we asked about the receipt, he said their tap machine doesn’t print the receipt. So I said we needed the receipt cause this was business meal. He went inside the restaurant, saying he’s gonna ask his manager. He came back shortly with the receipts, but didn’t even give me a pen or anything. So I looked at the receipt and found that he had charged a credit card surcharge and 20% tip by himself. And that 20% tip was not only charged to the food, but also charged to the surcharge!! If the food was $10 and surcharge was $1, 20% to $11 was charged as a tip. Why on the earth I’m paying the surcharge? No one explained to us. And why am I paying tip to the surcharge? Ridiculous.

author: Ben Katof
review_text: Good food. I get the lunch special which is fairly priced. A couple of correctable issues. Take away soda cans are always warm. The overall quantity of food is really large - the side dish portion in particular. It would be good if you could get 2 half portions of different sides. When you order maduros as a side, the amount you get is insane. Who eats a whole large plate of maduros? Still, I’ll definitely go back.

author: Quimera Tenebris
review_text: It used to be my favorite Chinese food place, but the quality has dropped horribly for a while now. The food is absolutely awful and not worth the price. I'm sad to leave this bad review, but not even a cat would eat that. 😭😾

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: Ed K
review_text: A simple lunch at a self service coffee shop or sort. A special healthy food that a friend introduced. Food Quality A+ n Quantity A Service None

author: Arash Yazdani
review_text: Fantastic spot in Da Nang right beside the river. Attentive service, very clean and amazingly flavorful local foods. Highly recommend!

author: J DLS
review_text: Super ecstatic that we didn’t skip on this restaurant. We missed our reservation the first day and our week got so busy, but so happy we made another reservation for our last night. The entire staff were so friendly and smiley and the atmosphere was very unique and cozy. The drinks, the food, the dessert, were beyond amazing. Like nothing we’ve ever had before. Would come all the way back to Bali just to eat here again. Thank you so much to the entire La Favela team for making our last night in Bali so super special.

author: Denise D.
review_text: We had a blast celebrating my friend’s 40th birthday in a private room here. The servers were friendly and attentive. The room has a modern rustic vibe. That with our birthday decor for the place was so pretty. The food was delicious our group of 20 people enjoyed Tapas: dates stuffed with blue cheese and wrapped in bacon, empanadas, chorizo al vino, tostones, and grilled Pulpo 🐙 Mains: steak, paella pasta, vegetarian paella, and grilled pulpo with potatoes and spinach. The place has a beautiful design overall and the food was great.

author: Roxana Gonzalez
review_text: Lots of options, everything is fresh and delicious! Love their all you can eat options.

author: Mohammed Elkholy
review_text: Prices are insanely good. A full meal for just $5! Totally recommended.

author: Rolland Colis
review_text: The paella was as super tasty as it was generous - I felt like I had kept eating it as it went on forever (which is important to me).. unfortunately no frond, but still an awesome dish.. my partner got a shrimp salad which was also quite generous . And I topped it all with a flan.. so decadent and good ! ! I plan on coming back here, especially if staying at RT again !

author: Joachim Martin Devassy
review_text: Stayed here for 3 days 2 night.. It was a wonderful stay here. The restaurant her is so good.. The choice of food is not variety. However the service and atmosphere is super duper good.. Nik and Zilah was so helpful by guiding us the way to the restaurant and always being there when ever we need them

author: Sean Hyland
review_text: We had a very nice meal in Pizza 4Ps. The meat in the spaghetti bolognaise was excellent, so was the pizza. Tiramisu was also very tasty. The service was great, everyone was so friendly. Just thought the portion sizes were on the smaller side, considering the more expensive prices compared to other restaurants. Bill is the last photo.

author: M
review_text: Great good service and atmosphere obviously. Nobody asked but the waitstaff is cute too (respectfully). Seeing instant porridge /jok/juk/zhou on a grocery run made me realize it was an option so I looked and found they made it here — picked up with another recommended popular meal to make it easier — double win. Also it was do fast- they said 10-15 min and I came back from the sweets place across the lot to find it ready

author: Yee Hoon Tee
review_text: Old-school breakfast that brings back memories — kopi, soft buns, and half-boiled eggs. Feels just like the mornings I grew up with. A place must go in Penang!!! ☺️

author: betty Ramirez
review_text: We arrived at this McDonald’s at 5:50 a.m. and waited outside because the posted opening time is 6:00 a.m. By 6:07 a.m., the restaurant was still not open. At 6:13 a.m., an employee finally arrived and opened the doors. When we asked why they were opening late despite the sign stating 6:00 a.m., the employee responded dismissively with, “Well, it’s open now.” The lack of punctuality, poor communication, and unprofessional attitude were very frustrating. If this location does not consistently open at the posted time, the hours should be corrected to avoid misleading customers. She said "no she can't help us" she walk away.

author: Elsie Siew
review_text: Forget to take pictures, the chicken is good, but rice is too soft, as in too much water. The coffee not too fantastic.

author: Food Panda
review_text: I often tell my friends titipapan roti canai is good, but last night I received two roti canai that were burnt on both sides. I was very disappointed and won't be going there again

author: Aloyscious Lee
review_text: The frog legs are fresh, tender, yet with enough bite, paired with sauce that is flavourful (umami, a bit gingery / soy / sweet / spicy depending on version). The congee is neutral enough to take on the flavours of the frog sauce. For people who like spicy, the dried chili / gong bao style gives the kick. For me, I always go for the mild/ non-spicy, preserving more delicate flavours (ginger, spring onion, the frog’s natural taste).

author: Flo G
review_text: This bustling hawker centre next to the market has plenty of food choices especially as a breakfast haunt. There are a few porridge, chee chiong fun ( including fresh made) stalls, wanton noodles, prawn noodles, lor mee and many fishball ball noodles plus 2-3 vegetarian stalls. Also has a good variety of Muslim Malay Indian choices. Lunch options include chicken, roast stalls, satay bee hoon, Hong Kong slice fish beehoon. Plenty of food and nostalgic choices. Seatings are cramped and always full, not a comfy hawker centre to sit and linger. More of eat and run. Such a pity.

author: Min Loo
review_text: Heard that they were good and thought was the same style as the bedok minced pork soup BCM. Nothing like it. Was pretty amateurish with room for improvement. My noodle was not cooked properly with some still tangled like a knot. Soup was bland.

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: See Chun Keat
review_text: First time eating BKT here. The taste is good, but the disappointed thing is all the pork given are fat. Who willing to pay money just for eating fat?

author: Verouska Ferrario
review_text: Great location and lovely customer service. Food was a bit of a mixed bag. The tuna nachos were excellent. The fried seafood platter was a good size but fries were soggy and fritters overdone. Key lime pie was ok (but I'd get rid of that artificial radioactive looking syrup). Overall a nice experience anyway, prices are good for the area.

author: Lim CY
review_text: My favourite spot for sandwiches and poke bowls, with branches in Batu Kawan, Bayan Lepas and Georgetown. The sandwiches here are generously portioned and made with fresh, quality ingredients. My go-to is the avocado/egg/sweet potato sandwich. It is wholesome and well-balanced in flavour. The poke bowls are equally satisfying. I have tried the salmon, spring onion chicken, and tofu bowls, all were flavorful, fresh, and packed with generous portions of toppings. They also offer Daily Savings items from Monday to Friday, making imore affordable.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Khang Le
review_text: Our first time dining here during lunch! Ordered plenty of food for 2! And the menu was fantastic Great choices! Servers was very knowledgeable. The interior design is another level. Super relaxing atmosphere. Everything is Buddhist inspiration. All the small details was perfect. Now talk about the food! Menu has a great choices of vegan food. Their dessert and drinks is also amazing. Must try their SUSHI / NIGIRI OPTION! (Its also vegan / no finish) Will definitely coming back with friends and family. And totally recommended restaurant

author: Nurul Nadzifah Abdul Latiff
review_text: Thought this place would be packed when I came—but nope, it was super chill and cozy, which was a lovely surprise! The vibes are on point, perfect for hanging out or just taking a breather. Food was spot on—exactly like the menu promised. I had the chicken chop with black pepper sauce and WOW, sooo good! Bonus points: the whole place is crazy Instagrammable. Cute corners everywhere. Will definitely be back!

author: Brittney M
review_text: The inside of this place is definitely aesthetically pleasing and nice to look at. I went here with my family for lunch and the experience was pleasant. Our server was super friendly and attentive. The cornbread and Croquettes were very good. However I got the chicken parm and it was just ok, very Mid. If I am ever in Miami I’d give this place another try, just a different dish. Haha.

author: Doron Bracha
review_text: I'm sorry to write that our experience was mediocre and disappointing. We went there with another couple of friends for dinner on a Friday evening in mid August. The place was full of people, apparently having a good time. The staff was busy and diligent, kind and friendly. The location is not so nice and the exteriors are somewhat rough, between a central bus station on a busy street with traffic and honking cars, and a parking lot of a funeral home, with big trash dumpsters. We sat in the back yard tent, four people around a small table with small plates. We liked the concept of sharing various plates and dishes, but the portions were small and the food was very salty and greasy (gave me heartburn). The black cod was unpleasantly smelly (fishy), and the green salad was very bitter and salty. The only way to fill my tummy was to order some bread, which was served with way too much butter, really wasteful. I saw a picture of fries in a review online and asked the waitress why it wasn't on the menu, she smiled and said it's a secret... she also suggested the special of the day, but did not tell us the price, and that was not on the menu either. As a matter of principle and practicality, all items should be on the menu, and customers should know the prices before placing orders. The prices are pretty high and they charge around 23% fee to cover gratuity for the waiters, kitchen and bar staff. We respect and support all those good people, but do not like to be charged such high fees. Either raise the prices and show them clearly on the menu, or take whatever tips people leave and split the money between all the employees. Customers should have the freedom to decide how much they want to tip, considering the quality of food and service they received. We enjoyed spending a couple hours with our friends, but did not enjoy the food or sitting on the asphalt in the undecorated tent, with loud background noise. For us, it was not worth $40 per person (with no meat or seafood, with no dessert or coffee); there are much nicer places at that price level.

author: Wong Jennifer
review_text: Freshly made and no preservatives breads. Personally , I Like the English breakfast muffin and graham cheese bread the most.

author: Ed Hsiung
review_text: Bread baked fresh....Best of all Banh Mi. Street side seating so subject to fumes from motorbikes and the staff are what you expect....crude and to the point. Worth to visit at least once...maybe twice. Haha!

author: Wilson Foo
review_text: I had this before in my younger days but it’s hard to find them in Singapore these days. This stall does theirs on the spot and they are soft and chewy with strong pandan flavour. Not too sweet though. 50 baht for nine in a box.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Adolfo Cañamar
review_text: My first time in Miami FL, Came across this Food truck so I gave it a try & I didn't regret it! Came back the next day for more, the food was delicious! I got the lamb chops with corn on the cob & even a simple mashed potatoes was so amazing with a unique flavor . My wife had the lomo sándwiches & really enjoyed them. Great service, very friendly and the prices were very fair for the quality of the meats .. No tables but we walked to the front to the pier & u can enjoy it there or have a picnic on the grass anywhere .. Highly recommended it ..

author: Ivan Michael Pung
review_text: This restaurant is rather out 🏘️ of the way but since we were travelling from Airport ✈️ to Tulemben 🏝️, it was a perfect 👌 stop ✋over. It is a beautiful Indonesia 🇮🇩 Restaurant surrounded by Padi Fields 🌾. Staff – Amazing service from the team 💁🏼‍♀️💁‍♂️💁🏾. They spoke 🗣️ good English 🏴󠁧󠁢󠁥󠁮󠁧󠁿, always wearing a smile 😄 and polite. They received us at the entrance ⛩️ and guided us to our table. Once seated, the menu 📖was distributed. They gave us some suggestions while we are ordering 📝 as it was our first time there. 💥 Pro Tip : Just order the signature pork special 😋 Restaurant – Very beautiful 🥰traditional Indonesian design ✍️ and build 🪚🔨🪛🔩. Spacious, tall ceiling, very airy 💨, windy and surrounded by Padi 🌾🌾🌾 Fields. Where it should be, there are tiles and when it shouldn’t, it will have natural stones 🪨. #lovely Tables and chairs 🪑are wooden 🪵and gave a nice homely setting. Food – Very well prepared and cooked 🧑🏽‍🍳👩🏽‍🍳👨🏾‍🍳 Babi Guling. Tried the Babi 🐷 Porsi Special and Nasi Ayam 🐓 and they are just so well marinated, soft and juicy! It just fell off the bones 🦴and went so well with the rice 🍚. It was a very, very satisfying meal 😋 and tick off all the check boxes ✅✅✅✅✅. What is more amazing is the low 📉cost to have a meal there. You can see from my pics. 📸, the menu dish is at about Rp$42,000 (before 10% tax) and that’s USD$2.60. So insane, I wish 💭 I had added on a takeaway. 🥡 There are a few Babi 🐷 Guling restaurants in Bali 🇮🇩 and this particular restaurant, I will highly recommend 😎 to all of you! So don’t miss it, get your driver to drive 🚙🚘🚖 you over, trust me, you will thank me! 🫶

author: Ma Ro
review_text: It's so good here. The FOOD is so amazing. I haven't had the time to take photos of other food we ordered😅 we order prawns, veggies, and satay. THE downside is not so accessible for tourist since the MRT and Bus is too far. You may get grab or have a local drive you here 🤗

author: ZS Lee
review_text: The best cream puff, banana pie & chicken curry puff I have ever had 🥹😭 Penang’s pride !!!! Highly recommended !!!

author: Samuel Oghogho
review_text: Food is really great.Well made African and Nigerian dishes.I tried Ofada rice and the sauce and it was fantastic.Also got a takeout the jollof rice which is always amazing.Food can be pricey but its worth every penny.

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: S. M.
review_text: Slow service. Greasy plates and spoon. Taste was so-so, not the best Moo Kata that I've had. I was seated at a table located on the second floor; and my seat was right under the the air conditioner which was dripping with aircon water almost the entire time I was eating.

author: Dennis Cheong
review_text: Have not visited since COVID. Market was renovated and feels better. It is main5a breakfast/lunch market/hawker centre

author: Gail U
review_text: Visited the lounge this evening for the first time. This lounge is amazing, the team treated me as a special guest as if it were a top rated hotel. The shower was fantastic, spotless and great towels and toiletries. The food is a la carte and restaurant quality. The staff were by far the best bit, offering wine pairings, making sure the experience was exceptional. Honestly, I have been to a lot of airport lounges and this is unlike any other. A big thank you to Hazel, Dian, Alvin, CS, Azfar and Ben - you are amazing hosts and you could not have been more attentive! Thank you.

author: Anupong Wongkulluck
review_text: Big and famous Pho restaurant with mostly visited by locals. Soup in chicken and beef Pho are different but both are tasty. The chicken meat is quite dried and chewy. Beef and meat ball are delicious. If you have to pick chicken or beef, just go for beef. For the price it is not expensive but you have to pay a little bit higher than small local restaurants.

author: Natasha Reyes
review_text: This restaurant and it’s staff has been the best by far I’ve ever been to and that’s including Disney! Our waiter Jose Gonzalez was absolutely attentive and did it all with warmth and welcoming hospitality. The food is all delicious! Can’t wait to come back

author: Jaimy De C
review_text: Sphere and food was okay. Missed a bit of the “ Forrest Gump “ vibe. We both took the salmon with broccoli and rice dish.

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Danny Carratala
review_text: I had a wonderful dining experience at De Tham Restaurant! The food was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented — a great mix of authentic Vietnamese dishes and tasty vegetarian options. The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, making it a perfect spot to enjoy a meal. A special shout-out to Snow, who was absolutely great — friendly, attentive, and made sure everything was perfect from start to finish. Highly recommend this place to anyone looking for delicious food and great service!

author: kk teoh
review_text: I believe the place offers dinners and lunch for the noon and evening/night crowd, but for breakfast, they have dim sum. Plenty of parking along the street and very convenient, and the shop is located near a popular food court (Fresh Food Food Court). The interior of the place is beautifully decorated with chandeliers, large painting, a stage, and even a swing, presumably used for wedding dinners and other events too. We were there for dim sum though and it currently has an offer of 30% off before 11am on weekdays. For tea, we had tieguanyin, which was pretty good, though the typical Chinese tea pots and cups would be a nicer touch compared to the metal teapot and cups used. We ordered a number of dumpling baskets and fried food, which were all steamed on order. So, expect the food to take a while to reach the table. Having said that, taste wise, they were generally quite delicious. Portions are fine and the shrimps used were succulent and firm. We thought the steamed cheong fun, xiao long pau and loh mai kai were average though. The frog porridge was presented in a small claypot but good enough for 3 to share. A note that you can also buy frozen dim sums/dumplings to bring home to steam from a freezer near the counter. Overall, with the discount, it is a worth another visit in the future.

author: James Stewart Jr
review_text: Stopped in during the annual Portuguese Feast, it's a little in off Ferry Street, indoor/outdoor seating, food was excellent, service was perfect, quick, attentive and on point.

author: Noah Farmer
review_text: I ordered the hot honey chicken sandwich and it tasted like one of the best chicken sandwiches I’ve had. Not only that but it was a pretty good size portion you get so it really felt like it was worth the price. My server was fantastic and the views of the bay were fantasticer. My only problem was actually getting to here, with traffic and parking. Some people claim that there’s a woman to blame, but I know this is everybody’s fault (doot doot doo do do🎵)

author: Joey H
review_text: We got the 2 pax lamb spine hot pot. Lamb tasted great, portion was huge for 2 persons, and the soup base was mildly spicy. Service could be more prompt though. Would come back again for the food.

author: Bob C
review_text: Great attention to us making sure we were treated well and fed well too. Loved the Chicken n dumplings. Spaghetti and meatball were as good. Service top of the line. I always say, you don’t need white table cloths to be a five star restaurant. Thank you for a great meal.

author: James W
review_text: We were really keen to try babu guling, and after some research we found out Ibu Oka is one of the well established place for the dish. There are a few Ibu Oka branches and we came to Ibu Oka 1. At around 11.30am the place didn’t have many diners but you could it’s clearly popular with the locals as there were lots waiting for takeaways and Grab food orders. We order a special set with extra skin/ kulit. We had no prior experience with babi guling but we liked what we had. Everything was flavoursome, crisp skin varied a bit in terms of crunchiness and wasn’t heavily seasoned. Overall, we enjoyed the set meal here and would recommend others to try. Just beware it’s cash-only place.

author: Joyce DV
review_text: Food is bland. Staffs would ignore you. Prices does not include tax or service charge. We ordered bun cha but did not give us water for the rice paper until we asked for it. Will charge you for wet tissue. The only thing interesting in this restaurant is the interiors. Do yourself a favor and eat somewhere else. 😭

author: sanny phong
review_text: Nasi Guling special comes with complimentary soup. The meat is tender. However, dishes is not hot, maybe prepared for some times. It has served with spicy sauce and only sauce is hot though. Avocado juice is nice and it is recommended. Overall food is good

author: Nephileen Kattel
review_text: When I walked in I was hit by a very unpleasant smell of feet/sweat. I was thinking maybe it was the bathroom or something, but idk it just smelled bad. Then the food came out, and the chicken sandwiches were nothing like it showed in the images!! They weren’t crispy and it was really below average. The fries were great though….

author: Flicka Zhang
review_text: The food was super nice!!! Highly recommend the shared snack seafood dishes. The service was nice and it’s a great place for gathering with friends.

author: Linda
review_text: Fresh and delicious and great customer service and food is delicious! Hoang Vu is great, atmosphere is great and very good. Highly recommend!

author: Terroll Fields
review_text: Prices are a bit Steep, but The Food was Amazingly Great! This is the True Definition of Soul Food!!! Both of the T's were are Great Employees, not to mention the Bomb Chef!

author: John Van Note
review_text: Traveling solo from Missouri had great experience with staff(Bridgette), Had chicken Parmesan It’s a simple dish, but done very well here. This Midwest boy enjoyed the place. I was not prepared for the strength of drinks, but I loved it.

author: Tung Pham
review_text: The area is extremely large! There are many VIP rooms! Motorbike parking is across the street from the restaurant. Car parking is also available. The staff are very enthusiastic in helping to cross the street and park the vehicle. The food is delicious and tasty. The service is also very attentive and standard. The roast pork has crispy skin.

author: Eric Barron
review_text: I love some good Japanese food, especially sushi, so I was excited to try Koro as the only Japanese spot around me in East Boston. I went my first time and ate in person and was underwhelmed by the maki rolls. The rice was poorly seasoned and fish was okay. I wanted to give it a second try a few weeks later and I got a few rolls for takeout and eating right away at the park nearby. These were worse and the spicy tuna roll had an "off" taste that led me to not finishing it, and I don't like to leave food unfinished. I did not get sick or feel ill, but I've been turned away from giving Koro a third try anytime soon. I really hope they can turn things around because I would love to have a great Japanese spot in Eastie. I'm rooting for you despite my experience.

author: The Laughing Lion
review_text: This location has a big dining area. I've eaten here over 20 times and I've never had a bad experience. They have a drive thru too. Careful with going late in the day, like after 6 pm because they might run out of certain food options. The parking lot is huge too.

author: Jennelle Johnson
review_text: If you are looking for a beautiful, vibrant, ocean front establishment then you have found it! Oceans 13, where you can regularly find the owner Vinny. He is kind, fun and full of life just like the property that he owns!! The charismatic ocean blue interior reminds you that you are on the beach as you enjoy every sip of your cocktail with the amazing staff!!! Don't skip this little gem and their yummy menu while visiting the fun Hollywood Boardwalk!!

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: N Park
review_text: I arrived 20 minutes before the restaurant opened but had to wait another 30 minutes. When you’re near the front of the line, the staff gives you a QR code to place your order. The food comes out quickly once you’re seated. The food was good. The bak kut teh was especially nice, and they offer unlimited refills of the broth. I liked the other dishes as well. I also had lemon tea, which was sweet and pleasant. Even with the long wait, the place is worth trying.

author: Jacqueline L
review_text: The taco truck is the only place I have visited and highly recommend it! Handmade flour tortillas as well. A must try is the baby toxic as well as the chicken chipotle burrito. The quesabirria is 💣. Com.

author: russell ng
review_text: We grabbed this meal and it was very good. I really wanted to get some broken rice on this trip and I was very pleased with this meal. The pork chop is huge. It’s so big and the meal was so good. One of my favourites honestly and I think that I need to get this meal on this trip again because it was so good unfortunately we only had one time and we were crabbing in all these different meals so we’d have time to go to the actual restaurant as you can see me splitting apart this meal in the hotel but I recommend either going to the actual restaurant and getting it fresh or just getting the delivery like we did

author: QueenQyn
review_text: Someone brought their dog inside the restaurant not a service dog either. It was their pet. Immediately gave me the ick. Yuck. Management tried to give me Someone else food. & my food took almost 30 minutes. They tried to fix my food while I waited on my chicken...yuck. 30 minutes wait with the rest of my food just sitting there not being warmed or chilled. Sorry but no thank you. Half the staff didn't speak any English.

author: Nora
review_text: A lot of parking space still quite challenging to find an empty parking 😆 punyala ramai haha You need to order and pay at counter first, and we got our order super duper fast. I honestly think it took about 10 minutes only after ordering mmg gila efficient 👍🏻 However you need to reminded that all orders you need to get yourself from the food/drink pickup point All foods taste delicious and feel really worth it for the whole experience. But ofcourse lagi berbaloi if you come with large groups since can taste a bit of everything. If you're a fan of fruit cocktails and durian crepe, please please please don't hesitate to buy from their vendor, sumpah sedapppp😭 Nak crepe dia lagiiii, i bought a few and made my family and friends tasted it, all of them loved the crepes, tak muak langsung Really recommend the place, worth the hype, keep up the good work 👍🏻👍🏻

author: Michael Chmielewski
review_text: This is a great new coffee shop in JP. Small intimate space which gets pretty busy even during the week. The coffee is very good and I’ve really enjoyed the Turkish style eggs, and breakfast sandwich. Update: went to one of their first nights as a wine bar and it was awesome! Very impressed with their selection of wines. Snacks we had included meatballs and feta dip. We tried a red, orange, white and rose which were all fresh. Will definitely be added to our regular wine spots. Recommend resys as its a very small spot but there is limited walkin counter space.

author: Miss Bella
review_text: Open daily and all options are available from open to close. Parking is available but limited. The atmosphere is Casual. Staff is friendly, knowledgeable, and attentive. The menu is listed on both front and back. Pricing for the food is reasonably priced, the all you can eat Crab Boil option is $45.95 which also includes everything on the menu except the items that are listed within the AYCE Premium Option $35.95. Price for kids (ages 4-9) is $14.95. Please refer to the picture of the menu that I have included. There is a 90 minute limit on dining. Enjoyed the Crab Boil, Boston Roll (Cooked Sushi), Steak and Shrimp teriyaki skewers, and of course the Crab legs with butter. Definitely a restaurant I will be returning to regularly.

author: wallace dos santos
review_text: Easily five stars, maybe even six 👀🤌 seriously delicious food. Like seriously, this is game changing. My friend and I started with Chamoy Pear dish, which was absolutely mouth-watering and zesty. Then we got the Baby Gem salad, which was an interesting New Age twist on a Caesar. THEN, omg, we got the lamb shoulder with some tortillas on the side. DAMN! That went crazy…. And the sauce… omfg. Soo fricking good. No notes, just so delicious. Service was excellent & we sat outside. Would have loved to have gone inside or tried dessert. There were so many other dishes on the menu that seemed really interesting as well, and unique flavor combos. Apparently there’s a real stuffed cheetah in there (allegedly). Can’t wait to go again!

author: Delaney Weiland
review_text: Elephante is that kind of restaurant you can go to with so many kinds of groups and it works for every situation. Between the views, the food, drinks, and service, the experience is a 10/10. I was traveling for work and decided to go based on a colleagues recommendation. I went alone and sat at the bar. It was pretty crowded for 5:30 on a Tuesday but didn't feel too packed in and the service was still super quick. At the bar, I had Daniel and Dorian as my bartenders. They definitely made the solo experience lots more fun. They recommended my dinner and drinks, all of which were delicious and fun! I even got a little taste test of one of their frozen drinks which was a bonus. They definitely knew their menu and bar well.
