I had a dirty martini as well as a margarita and would say the margaritas are the way to go there!! It was so delicious and I am still thinking about it. As for the food, I had whipped eggplant to start and for my main, the Ragu Bianco. Whipped eggplant was incredible, I had never had anything like it and was super obsessed. And the Ragu was perfect, not too heavy and a good portion of food. Overall, it was a great dinner and I ended up chatting with another solo diner for the majority of the evening as well. Would recommend to anyone looking for a good date spot or just a place to grab dinner on a work trip! And if you're at the bar, ask for Daniel or Dorian for a great experience!!!

author: Tedy Wijaya
review_text: First time came here.. It was a Complete dining experience. From the food, hospitality, and the ambience was excellent.. Perfect for family dining moment or business lunch.

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: Onion Yeoh
review_text: Always my favorite! I always bring my friends to this famous and delicious bak kut teh, every of my friends are amaze by the taste of bak kut teh here hope they sell their food forever!

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Lisa Bennett
review_text: Amazing food! Ordered the picahna steak sandwich, it was sooo good! Great flavours and came with 3 different sauces which made it even better if that’s possible! Fabulous service with a great smile from Antonieta, told us about the other locations of the restaurants and trucks. Make sure you try this in Miami, just the best ❤️

author: F
review_text: Day 1 of my vegas trip from New York we decided to get donuts for breakfast. This place was on my list to visit so why not try the famous Carls Donuts on the first morning!....We got a specialty donut which was the creme brulee, a chocolate covered mochi donut and a huge almond cream filled croissant! Everything was fresh and They were all delicious! This place is very clean and the service was 5 stars!

restaurant: De Tham Restaurant - Vietnamese cuisine & vegetarian Food
author: Tyler Bechtold
review_text: Food was phenomenal - and was served exceptionally fast! Kim was our server for the evening and was very attentive to our needs and made sure to make us feel welcome. We got the fresh shrimp rolls, fried spring rolls, beef pho, and the stir fried chicken with chili and lemongrass. This was our first stop upon arriving to Vietnam and we’re happy it was. Thank you so much De Tham! ❤️

author: evon lim
review_text: Good environment, staff are friendly and helpful.Food portions are big. Great choice for Western classics without spending much.

author: Kenn P
review_text: It has a dark moody beach vibe. It's paid street parking. On Fridays they have live music. It feels more like for an older crowd, 40+. It's up close to the water and at sunset its really nice. There's 3 TVs for sports, but not really a sports bar. Large selection of beers close to 40 if I had to guess. Come with your own crowd and make the good times happen.

author: Matthew Heiser
review_text: Placed a catering pickup order and loved how easy it was to tweak the headcount and adjust right up to the last minute. We got 40 breakfast burritos, sausage, chorizo, bacon, and plain egg with cheese, plus a 25-piece variety Danish tray from Bob's East Side Deli. Everything was a hit—everyone raved about the food. Highly recommend!

author: N J
review_text: Awesome location right along the beach. Service was great and they were all nice. I ordered the mariner platter and it was delicious. Breading was falling off of the fish but it was still good. Nice happy hour specials as well. If you are allergic to bees might want to make sure you have your epi as they are all over.

author: NomNom
review_text: Really wanted to like this place— went the first time and it was closed due to new years, okay no problem. Came back on our last day in BKK and was so disappointed. The place is small and atmosphere was gloomy. Found it odd that there was no music at all and could hear every conversation. ok, nevermind. The food was the most disappointing. It looks aesthetic and the beef was… mediocre. The yolk looked good but the whole dish lacked flavour and sauce. it’s literally a steak with a rather dry (overly cured?) yolk and a ton of crispy shallots. Anyone could easily make this at home without their expensive prices. I would not recommend.

author: Chris Lis
review_text: Haven’t been here in several years, but was working on that side of town and stopped. Had a Tolls Creation loaded with meat and crispy hot fries were excellent. Will def try and get by more often in the future.

author: Julieta Williams
review_text: After moving to North Beach on 2022, we are finally checking Petralunga! On a beautiful and perfect sky early evening, we had our lovely table under the stars. Sofia was our server and she was absolutely great! Our salad, pizza and Tiramesu were great. Our cocktails were also on point. We will certainly be returning. Bravo!🙌🏼🇮🇹

author: Chamo Navarro
review_text: Been coming here for the chicken dinner for yrs. But today was my last. Not paying almost $20 for this chicken lol.....why would they even serve someone this! Didnt check till I got home. So dissapointed.

author: Lee Pui Kuan
review_text: Very disappointed with the experience. And a very bad way to start a day. This is what happened. To be fair the food is good. The ground service is also very good and well presented and friendly. ut, a big But, the kitchen is very inflexible and the staff have a bad attitude and was impatient when reponsding to our request to cut the bagel into 4 (instead of the standard 2 piece that they stated in the menu). I can totally understand their 1 slice bagel standard and no-cutlery policy, however what annoyed me is the way the kitchen staff responded to our request. To start, he walked to us with a "wanting to argue and fight" expression and body language. Then what shocked me were the words that come out from his mouth. Not only did he not want to listen to our explanation as to why we need the bagel to be sliced into 4 pieces, he impatiently told us indirectly "if you are not happy, you can leave". SHOCK!!! I can't accept this type of attitude coming from such a highly graded place. Although I like the food, I but will not come back if this is the kind of service I am getting. I won't say "customer is god", but at least show us some basic respect. I can get same food at other places like FOUNDERS, and many more.

author: Alfred Hendric Salim
review_text: Foos taste good, the place is nice.. you eat beside a paddy field.. the servoce is just okay, all done efficiently, but no extra mile.. and it is not a bad thing.. 😃

author: Rachel Jacobs
review_text: What a fun beach place to get some good food and listen to live music/DJ. Great for day time. Went for lunch, family friendly and has beach bar vibe. We didn’t get the whole fried snapper this time but it looked amazing, and can be shared with several people. I also got one of their virgin drinks, a bikini frozen mango was really good and was able to share with my older child. Next time in Sunny Isles will be back again.

author: Otto Lai
review_text: Tried the beef rendang puff, buttery and flaky crust with curry like beef rendang filling, not bad in taste but very fattening, felt very guilty after consumption. Guilty as charged.

author: DEREKWAH
review_text: The curry is fragrance So rich and flavourful I like the rice serve in warm Only the bad thing is the shop lot of fly If can settle this problem will be more nicer Overall price vs quality is definitely wort to come again

author: Thị Thương Nguyễn
review_text: Bringing family from the countryside to eat is also quite delicious, love boiled meat with shrimp paste, delicious and clean, will come back to this claypot rice restaurant in District 1

author: tan SH
review_text: I like the bean spouts than their chicken, ithey tops all with pepper, so all have a peppery taste. I think they have better quality chicken than those normal chicken rice stall, when meat is not soft type, closer to kampong chickens. Locate in tourist streets, i think local seldom eat here.

author: Stephen Hatzis
review_text: This is literally better food than in Germany. 🇩🇪 my go to spot in NYC. Great authentic food and beers. Great atmosphere.

author: Tommy Pak
review_text: 🍳🥞 Breakfast Club – A Brunch Spot Worth Returning To 📍 Located at W San Carlos & Meridian Parking is okay, but it can be a little tricky, especially on weekends when it gets busier. If street parking is full, there’s a garage behind the restaurant with extra spots, so you should still be able to find a place. 🎶☀️ First Impressions Step inside, and you’re immediately hit with a lively crowd and a perfect brunch vibe. The music was on point—it felt like someone had grabbed our personal playlist and queued it up for the restaurant. My girlfriend and I were absolutely loving it! 🍊 A Must-Try: Fresh-Squeezed OJ If you come here, you HAVE to order the fresh-squeezed orange juice. Since it’s January, oranges must be in season because this OJ was next-level good—a perfect balance of sweet and citrusy goodness 🍊🤤. If they had free refills, my girlfriend and I would’ve shut them down! 🍽️ Our Orders 👩‍❤️‍👨 Her Order: Country Fried Steak ✅ Portion: HUGE—and not just all breading! A thick, juicy cut, fried to crispy perfection with just the right amount of crunch. ✅ Gravy: Savory and well-seasoned, tying everything together perfectly. ✅ Sides: Herb potatoes 🥔 (delicious) and wheat toast 🍞 (more on that later). 👨 My Order: Santa Maria Omelette ✅ Steak: Well-seasoned and cooked to medium well, just as I asked 🥩👌. ✅ Flavor Combo: Steak, cheese, salsa, sour cream, and avocado 🥑🧀—each bite packed with flavor, especially when paired with the herb potatoes. 🍞 The Only Miss? The Wheat Toast The only thing that didn’t hit the mark was the wheat toast—it came out late and cold, making it less enjoyable. But honestly, that’s such a minor thing compared to how good everything else was. ⭐ Final Thoughts This spot has quickly become my go-to for brunch, and I get hesitant about trying other places because I always end up comparing them to Breakfast Club 😆. 🔥 Highly recommend for any breakfast/brunch lover! If you’re in the area, this is a must-visit.

author: Chelle T
review_text: Just had a half salad. It was a basic Iceburg lettuce with carrots but it was refreshing. Next time I may try a sandwich. I placed an order and within 5 minutes I was paying and ate on outside tables. Service is nice and efficient.

author: Caleb Rose
review_text: My girlfriend and I loved our experience at Dumpling House. The fact that ordering food from the web app is fantastic - especially since everyone at a table can add food to the order from their own phones with the given QR code. There was only one person working all the tables; but given that orders were placed through the web app, this allowed them to serve all tables while orders were placed. The server went above and beyond in terms of making sure our glasses were always full, that we had time to look at the menu, and check in to see how we enjoyed our food. She was friendly, kind, and didn’t hover when we made our order through the app. When we got our food, it arrived quick, and in a manner that allowed us to try each dish. Each dish we ordered from the pork dumplings to the fried wontons were amazing and straight from the kitchen. The next time we’re back in San Francisco, we’re coming back here. The ambiance was quiet with calm music, perfect for talking in a group setting. We loved the food, we loved the service, this is my favorite lunch place in the Bay Area.

author: Bunga N
review_text: Somehow, its the only halal food I found here. Turns out it tastes good👍🏻 Didn't get to try the puff tho☹️ maybe next time😉

author: Azhar Rashid
review_text: came in earlier for dinner but not allowed to go in though many empty tables (reservation 630pm) two persons ordered appetizer and main course. waiter nor the cashier bother to ask if we were ready for main course once we finished with appetizer. cashier fridgiting for us to leave by 8pm and even told us after that to leave in 10 minutes. cashier didn’t even know what we had ordered and asked waiter to tell him what we had before issuing the bills. time spent 1 hour 30 minutes including waiting time for both appetizer and main course. cashier could have been friendly rather than faking it to be friendly. told us to leave in 10 minutes with reason to accommodate the next guest was so uncalled for as the restaurant published closing time was 8pm. took me a long time to write this review ‘cause i should have understand people in the service industry better. but not for this restaurant. food was good but not great and service has to improve.

author: Addriana Esparza
review_text: “We came for breakfast and loved everything from start to finish. The chilaquiles were flavorful, the beans tasted homemade, and the tortillas were fresh. The staff made us feel like family. Jeanine was our server, she was the sweetest and made our experience memorable. Can’t wait to come back!”

author: Rinku
review_text: Best place for enjoyment. Its open in evening 6pm to 2am. Available dance club bar food restaurant. Also Available shopping market where you can get clothes or other things. Its street market and one of best place for enjoyment in phuket for those who liking drinking etc.

author: MaKenzie Bissler
review_text: We found this place on Tik Tok because of the table made hummus. Christina was so kind and welcoming and helped us decide what to order. We got the sampler, the meat for 2, beet salad and baklava. We loved the sausage and the owner came over and talked to us too! Very family oriented and delicious food. My husband is a picky eater and he said that this place was probably the best food he’s had in a long time - I’d say that’s a win!

author: Anthony Carter
review_text: Help me pick out the best pizza with all the different selections, it was ready very fast, and the place was well clean and quiet.

author: stevenis
review_text: Great to find a good classic burger really. The short end: the food is good and that’s the value. The long end: I just don’t see the value in fast food, McDonald’s is expensive for what you get. I remember eating at a Carl’s Jr and was shocked at the price of a combo. In this way, it’s good to find a classic burger joint. I think the price is a little more than other fast food places, but I’m willing to pay the extra for a decent burger. Also, the fries are my favorite fries in town, hands down. The service is friendly, the atmosphere, is as expected, it’s a burger joint, but, it is really clean inside, that a plus. I’m definitely marking this as my go to burger joint. They also have good snack deals if I want a quick bite when I’m not in the mood for a burger. Looking forward to the other menu items…the pastrami fries look pretty amazing.

author: diesse dasilva
review_text: Great restaurant experience. One of my favorite places to go with the family. For starters they have the best dinner rolls by far, paired with the most delicious cinnamon sugar butter. Their complimentary peanuts are always on point. Their steaks are perfectly cooked whenever I get them, always medium-rare and paired with ribs. Their salads have always been great. If you're getting a margarita go for the extra shot.

author: Tharen Mcgon
review_text: Excellent Indian flavors in a clean and comfortable setting. Absolutely loved it , would return !

author: Seth Hazen
review_text: So the wife and I were touring Bayside for the first time and we decided to have an appetizer and a few cocktails at Margaritaville. We got ourselves a Memorial Cup for Jimmy as well as the Cajun Shrimp Dip and Coconut Shrimp. Gellisa (Lisa) took care of us at the bar and she was so fun, on point and a great bartender. If you see her, sit at her side of the bar and you are good to have a great time.

author: Joshua Dyer
review_text: Peter Luger delivered a great experience. The portions were generous, the service was attentive, and the steak was cooked to perfection. The apple strudel was a nice finish and tasted really good.

author: tim rasicci
review_text: Great service. Very busy. An area that seems to shut down early for some odd reason, the Factory fills the void!

author: Luandri Castillo
review_text: They missed so much of my order and replaced it with a bunch of chicken nuggets and gave me cheese on everything after I asked for no cheese ( bc I am allergic ( awful night staff and will definitely never go here again

author: Porntipa Sae-Kee
review_text: Nice place for quick and yummy breakfast, the food is mainly DimSum: love adding the 'Cik Chow' (Chinese vinegar-black sauce on the table). Apart from Dimsum, We also tried pork congee, it was a pork ball with egg in the congee, easy to eat and test better adding some pepper powder (personal preference) the portion is on the larger size in comparison with usual Dimsum shop that sell congee. The wait time is reasonable and the staff could communicate in several languages. The price is reasonable, the shop is clean and good airflow. The parking is not too challenging to find (Note: we go on weekdays)

author: Mark Rutledge
review_text: Decent food for the price, better than the typical fast food restaurants in my opinion.

author: Thomas Saw
review_text: To me the Best CKT in town, this Outram Park Fried Kway Teow stall at Hong Lim Food center was moved here many years ago from the previous coffee stall below HDB void deck near current Outram Park MRT station. Stall open Mon-Sat (6am-3pm till sold out), close on Sun/Public Holidays. I have eaten this stall CKT many times since Y1998. Be prepared to queue 1 hour or more, like today Saturday from 12 noon that I’ve queued 80min before food served. Few customers behind was told sold out today. CKT is abit moist cooked with egg scramble, many fishcake & bean sprouts semi crunchy. (S$5 small size). You can end the meal with desserts after CKT which is opposite stall, selling 4 types desserts only at S$2.20. This Food Center has many stalls award with good & tasty food at affordable prices.

author: Philipp Vater
review_text: My favourite breakfast spot in HCM. Very authentic place, great taste.

author: Zelilah Perez
review_text: We had such a great time last night! The service was excellent, and the food was even better! My steak was cooked to perfection, and you can never go wrong with a baked potato. The atmosphere was Old School Vegas with a beautiful baby grand piano in the dining area. They even had a band in the bar area. Highly recommend!

author: NICHOLAS WONG
review_text: The restaurant is really beautifully decorated, artistic and creative with local traditional cultural touch on every aspect of vietnamese culture. We were served with the most delicious foods in variety from skewers, shrimp salad, chicken rice and soups.

author: Amanda
review_text: 📍Xi Duo Duo 喜多多, Maxwell Food Centre 🥟 𝑺𝒉𝒂𝒏 𝑫𝒐𝒏𝒈 𝑭𝒓𝒊𝒆𝒅 𝑫𝒖𝒎𝒑𝒍𝒊𝒏𝒈𝒔 [$7] loved the spr light & crispy crust— paired so well with the dumplings & gave it that extra satisfying crunch! 😩✨ each one was generously stuffed w minced meat & chives & the skin had js the right thickness!! 🍜 𝑩𝒆𝒊𝒋𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝒁𝒉𝒂 𝑱𝒊𝒂𝒏𝒈 𝑵𝒐𝒐𝒅𝒍𝒆 [$5] spr generous portion of noodles & minced meat!! noodles were well coated in that rich, savoury sauce once mixed & i rlly enjoyed this bowl till the v last bite 🥺 def cmg back the next time i visit maxwell food centre— but till then ill be thinking abt it 😌

author: Qiru Soh
review_text: I would say definitely the best omakase restaurants in Penang! Food was amazing, especially the uni. Service was excellent as well. Waiters had really nice manners and etiquette.

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: Adrian Wong
review_text: Black chicken was underwhelming for it's price. Tastes as decent as hawker ones, just overpriced. Only special thing is the kidney mee sua, noodles are served thin & very chewable. An uncommon dish in SG, reasonable price.

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: Lenard Sison
review_text: Best meal of my life. The pork jowl, eel sausage, chicken pandan, and baked coconut (drink) were immaculate. Actually had to run back the drink FOUR TIMES. This restaurant was our first meal, and we absolutely had to make it our last as well. The staff, Trung (manager), Dung, and Tien were very accommodating. I cannot emphasize my love for this restaurant, I implore you to try it for yourself.

author: Risse Simpson
review_text: The location was decently busy. Portion sizes are really large, I can make at least three meals out of a two entree plate. Rice and chow mein were pretty standard, like you would find at most Chinese takeaways. Cream cheese wontons were just that, cream cheese only. Named appropriately, lol. Mushroom chicken was juicy with whole mushrooms. Salt and pepper pork was outstanding. Nicely spiced! There were chunks of bone and gristle, letting me know this wasn't a processed pork product. May not be everyone's preference, but I liked it. Service could have been better, the server had to be told a couple of times she had a customer before she came to take my order (she was on her phone). And no receipt given. Overall I would come again because the location is so close.

author: C E
review_text: Yes - Joe's Pizza is great and a must try. But..if you want comparable good Pepporoni and Bbq Chicken New York Style Pizza with half the line up - definitely worth a try! Staff were friendly and service was quick. The pizzas in the photos are heated up and comes out toasty!

author: クリスタルキール
review_text: Very good food and beautiful view. We went gathering for dinner at East Coast Lagoon food Village.

author: Dũng Phan
review_text: The menu wasn't as extensive as advertised, the food was cold (e.g., Thai-style steamed clams,...) the prawns weren't fresh. the space was airy, but the seating arrangement was a bit cramped, making it difficult to move around. Our small family didn't eat much, mainly just wanted to experience the food.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Izzy C
review_text: Don’t tell them the bacon wrapped chicken is dry like a cardboard, there is a blonde manager that will get mad and tell you that the chicken is normally very dry… 😅 we have been at this restaurant like 20 times last two visits not so good

author: Mandy Goh
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ It was my first visit to the Qatar Airways Lounge at Changi Airport Terminal 1, and the entire experience was exceptional from start to finish. The staff were incredibly attentive, and the service was truly impeccable. A special shout-out to Hazel, Elsy, Alvin, and Anu — they went above and beyond to ensure every need was well taken care of and consistently checked in with genuine warmth and professionalism. Not forgetting the amazing food selection on the menu — everything was served hot, delicious, and beautifully presented. The options were quite extensive, though it would be great to see a few more dessert choices added in the future. This is truly what premium service should feel like. It’s no surprise that Qatar Airways continues to uphold its world-class standards and win awards. I’m already looking forward to returning to this lounge and flying with Qatar again as a frequent traveller!

author: Billy Lim
review_text: Worth a visit, and there’s something gratifying about that crunch of the tonkatsu, paired with the side dishes and the simple Japanese-eatery ambiance. For a lunchtime meal (or early dinner) in Penang, especially if you’re around Tanjung Tokong, this is a solid pick.

author: Carito Ingberg
review_text: Nick’s Bar and Grill is a good spot if you’re looking for a casual date or a place to hang out with friends. I wouldn’t call it family-oriented, but it works well for meeting up, especially to watch a game — there are screens everywhere. The location is great, right by the beach with nice views, and the place feels fresh inside with air conditioning. Food was fine — nothing extraordinary but decent. We had the mojo mahi (grilled fish) and fish & chips, both good. Portions were fair and service was friendly. Bathrooms were clean, which is always a plus. The biggest downside for me was the music. It was extremely loud, making it impossible to have a conversation. The playlist itself felt random and didn’t really match the vibe. I understand it’s a bar, but it doesn’t need to feel like a nightclub. Seating is mostly high tables inside, with only a handful of low tables outside (maybe 4). Overall, a fun place if you’re going for drinks, sports, or loud energy. If you’re looking for a quieter dinner with conversation, this might not be the right choice.

author: Patrick Zajac
review_text: First time trying Ethiopian food and I’m glad it was at Bunna Cafe because this place was stellar! Absolutely loved the ambiance, service, and most importantly the food. They start you off with a free plate of popcorn to snack on while you wait for your food which was so fun. Also, I happened to be in during their weekend Bunna Coffee Ceremony so I had a complimentary cup of the Bunna. It was very strong, spiced, and rich, with a prominent ginger undertone. Adding in the brown sugar cubes opened up the flavor so much. Delicious! I tried the Lentil Sambusas which were super crispy. The filling inside was fine but adding on that cilantro lime sauce really tied it all together! There was a subtle spice too that I enjoyed. For my main I went with the Beyaynetu Meal which was the 5 scoop option. I kinda wanted to go for the 7 scoop Feast to try more things but I’m glad I didn’t because the 5 scoop was very sizable for one person! I tried the Enguday Tibs, Shiro, Misis Wot, Yater Kik Alicha, and the seasonal option which was an Eggplant and Walnut Deberjan. WOW!!! Everything was so insanely flavorful and worked well with each other. I think my two favorites were the Shiro and the Yater Kik Alicha. Soooooo so so good I could eat a whole bowl of just those.

author: Lee wei ching
review_text: Bali drink is not cook with Bali, but is make by Bali powder only, not recommended to order this drink, the food portion is small, suitable for kid

author: Alicia Laing
review_text: This restaurant is amazing. I was searching for a place to hold a surprise birthday dinner for my boyfriend. I looked at a few places but decided to try out this restaurant because of the reviews, and when I say they did not disappoint; they absolutely did not disappoint. The food was amazing, the service was amazing, everything was just amazing. When I initially reserved it, it was supposed to be for 10 people, and I was told I couldn't get a private room because the group was too small. To my surprise, they gave us a private room anyway. The room was so beautiful. I've been to many restaurants, and I don't think I've ever gotten this great service. The food was soooo delicious. Their appetizers oh my goodness they have this mushroom in garlic sauce that I don't know who's foot they put in it, but I could have eaten that one dish the whole night and I would have been satisfied. The vegetables I believe they were steamed, but they must have been steamed in love because they were amazing also. Everyone in my group, including the birthday boy, loved the restaurant, food, and service. I can't wait to go back again. When I got to work the next day, I told everyone they needed to go here. Oh, and not to mention it was not expensive at all. I absolutely love this restaurant.

author: Maria Ribeiro
review_text: Lovely place with a view, beautiful sunset, friendly staff and nice food.

author: Jolyn Lim
review_text: The food was enjoyable and well-prepared, with good quality ingredients. The service really stood out — Eka was very friendly, attentive, and made sure we were well taken care of throughout the meal. Overall, it was a pleasant dining experience and I would be happy to return.

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: VHong Tan
review_text: Seng Kee’s pig liver mee sua truly lives up to its reputation — it’s really a case of “better tasted than heard.” We also tried the crispy bee hoon and hor fun, and they were all very delicious. 😋

author: Andrew Tan
review_text: Place was packed with people during dinner time. Service staff was really accommodating n friendly despite being busy. Food fresh, taste good and price is affordable and reasonable.

author: Singh G
review_text: Overall it’s good expressive, i have been to oasis, coffee club and here and it tastes near to same. Good place. Got to visit this place after watching one of YouTube video to taste authentic Thai food and I’m not disappointed . Just a reminder, Pad Thai is noodles and not rice. Shrimp pineapple rice were best of all the menu. They also have bottle beers costing around 100 bhatt. Also the washrooms were super clean.

author: Small Blue Toy
review_text: Really great service from experienced professionals A very well executed meal with impeccable service. Anyone can sell you a 100$ ribeye cooked properly but not many can do it with the level of service Mooo seaport provided Meal timed perfectly, everything cooked perfectly. Upscale setting. One of the best in Boston

author: Good Person (gercog)
review_text: Cozy spot by the Hoa Hien river in Hoi An. Pineapple fried rice with juicy prawns, a bright citrus–seafood salad, and crackling bánh xèo wrapped in herbs. The green sauce sings. Kind staff, fair prices, calming water views. We left full, smiling—and a little in love with this place. Truly loved it!!

author: Patricia
review_text: One of the mus to go place for pork ribs in bali. Love this location quiet comfy and cozy. Portion is nice, the ribs and crispy pork is very good 🫶🏼🙏🏻

author: Cher Ong
review_text: It's definitely not the best, but it's quite food. My regular supper spot as i love maggi goreng & theirs is 1 of the most consistent tasting one. It's hard to get a delicious maggi goreng at nasi kandar place because they seem to have multiple chef frying. I love their fried chicken as well, well seasoned & crispy skin. Of course, there are other better ones, but their's is good enough if u don't compare. They have an air cond zone, so if you're afraid of stuffy air flow, then u can opt to sit in. Their nasi kandar is good as well. The kuah campur 😋. Ingredients are not too fancy, basics only.

author: Riyadul Hoque
review_text: During my trip to Boston, I visited a Pakistani and Middle Eastern restaurant that instantly felt like home. The owner, who I believe was also running the place, was incredibly friendly and served us with genuine warmth and hospitality. We ordered classic Pakistani dishes, and the chef also Pakistani prepared them right in front of us, which made the experience even more special. The flavors were just like back home, and after five days of traveling, I finally got to enjoy a sip of proper desi-style chai and I absolutely loved it! This place is a gem for anyone craving authentic taste and heartfelt service.

author: Nancy Ta
review_text: My go-to spot when I'm in the mood for a good burger or steak. Wonderful atmosphere and service.

author: Joe and Mindy
review_text: From Bánh Mì to Bliss: Bếp Mẹ Ỉn, the Sister Restaurant You Can't Miss If you loved Bánh Mì Mẹ Ỉn (and you should!), then Bếp Mẹ Ỉn, its sister restaurant just steps away, is an absolute must-try. Nestled in an alley (picture we attached )near Ben Thanh Market, this hidden gem is well worth seeking out. I had the Nem Nuong Me In, minced pork wrapped in rice paper with fresh veggies and Thai basil, and it was an explosion of flavor! It quickly became one of my favorite dishes in Saigon, a perfect harmony of amazing tastes. Today was the day I fell head over heels for Vietnamese cuisine. The restaurant's location adds to its charm, creating an intimate and authentic atmosphere. The staff is friendly and attentive, making the dining experience even more enjoyable. Overall, Bếp Mẹ Ỉn is a culinary adventure that will leave you craving more. Don't miss out on this hidden gem when you're in Saigon!

author: Jim Morris
review_text: Walked in with seven friends and had a great reception. Quick service premade pizzas are delicious and hot. You can custom order pizzas and they do take about 20 minutes to 40 minutes. Depends on how busy they are but it’s well worth it. The gluten-free option is absolutely amazing. One of my friends is gluten-free one of the best pizzas he’s ever eaten! The traditional buffalo wings are non-breaded and great sauce. Step off the strip and have an affordable meal with all of the excellent service and awesome ambience!

author: Raditya
review_text: A Hidden Foodie Paradise in the Middle of the City! Orchis Food Court is an absolute gem — if you know, you know! It’s the kind of place that looks unassuming from the outside but completely overdelivers once you step in. Tons of local vendors, amazing variety, and everything feels super fresh and made with care. I tried the Thai basil chicken, boat noodles, and mango sticky rice — all delicious, affordable, and served fast. Whether you’re a traveler or a local looking for quick, tasty eats, this spot hits the mark every time. Clean seating, good vibes, and zero pretension. Perfect for casual lunches or quick bites after shopping or sightseeing. Don’t sleep on this one!

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: ALTUS WEALTH
review_text: Delicious CKT with duck egg. Compared to many places, this one tastes so good and wok hey. Remember to ask for duck egg. Can get crowded at some hours. Have been here many years, even before they were awarded. Family business from humble beginnings. Try the seafood sides. Surely will come back.

author: Jimmy Zhu
review_text: Perhaps the snowfall toward the end of our meal added to the magic of Tonino, but even on an ordinary night, this place would still be exceptional. On my first visit, I turned to Yelp for guidance and settled on the most popular dish—the Cappelletti. We each ordered it, no hesitation, and it absolutely blew us away. It was rich, comforting, and exactly what we were craving. The ambiance at Tonino was cozy, dim, and lively. Our table by the window felt slightly cramped, but it only added to the charm of the experience, making for a meal that was both intimate and memorable. We also tried the Pizza Bianco, which, despite its name, isn’t actually pizza but rather bread served with dip. Unable to decide, we took our waitress’s suggestion and opted for a sampler of all three. If I went back, I’d go straight for the hot honey or the eggplant caponata—both were standout choices. The clams were tasty but not the highlight of the meal. For dessert, we ordered one of each: the tiramisu, panna cotta, and ricotta cheesecake. If I had to rank them, the cheesecake took the top spot, followed by the panna cotta, with the tiramisu coming in last. If I find myself back in Boston, I’d return to Tonino in a heartbeat.

author: Day dreamer
review_text: Absolutely the best Vietnamese bánh mì in Ho Chi Minh! The menu is super simple—just one type of bánh mì, no customizations, but the portion is huge, easily enough for two to share. The crust is perfectly crispy, slathered with rich pork liver pâté, layered with ham, pork jelly, and fresh veggies 🥬 (served separately to add yourself). So flavorful and satisfying! Highly recommend!

author: Botak
review_text: One of the older hawker centres, that serves reasonably priced food as this is an estate for senior citizens who probably are staying alone or are no longer working. I found it interesting to be able to discover a TUTU kueh stall selling just that and muah chee, which u don't see often since rent these days are high and such food are only found at night markets. There is even a char kway teow stall that serves the dish with a sunny side up egg on top. You can't miss the stall's name : 'dancing char kway teow'. If u enjoy having your meals outside, there are options as seats can also be found outdoors for u to people-watch as well. It is a nice place to reminisce and watch the world go by

author: Larry Upton
review_text: Went for the Husker game on Thursday service was terrible waitress was clueless & walked away from us mid order & went to next table to take their order. Over a hour to get food & drink refills were approx 20 mins. Very dissatisfied. She said she just got hired that day off from Facebook.

author: Jelvis Ferreira
review_text: Hellbender just served me the best pancakes I’ve had in NYC—hands down. The heirloom masa pancakes here aren’t just good, they’re game-changers: perfect texture, flavors that complement each other beautifully, and nothing overpowering. Every bite felt balanced and memorable, to the point where Clinton St. is officially dethroned as my previous pancake champion. I’m already counting the days until we come back. We also shared the skirt steak and the coffee tres leches cake—both phenomenal. The steak was cooked perfectly, paired with flavorful potatoes and a rich butter topping, and the tres leches was indulgent without being too sweet. Between the three dishes, my wife and I left full and completely satisfied. The staff here deserves a special mention. They were knowledgeable, professional, and had excellent communication with the kitchen, even advising on what to avoid for dietary restrictions. That level of attentiveness made the experience even better. Hellbender delivers on flavor, balance, and hospitality—absolutely worth a spot at the top of your NYC dining list.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: John Ramirez
review_text: Beware if you are a family of four. 18% gratuity added on the bill. Been a customer for a while now just recently brought my kids and god damn $140 is crazy. Server came once to ask for drinks and second to ask if we wanted meats as they were closing. Food is good, but service is subpar. Adding gratuity on 2 adults and 2 kids when’s it’s not busy is going to turn away a lot of people. Especially families. For two people this place rocks!

author: Dự Nguyễn Xuân
review_text: The restaurant is crowded during peak hours, so reservations are recommended. The fast food is flavorful, and the ingredients for grilled and hot pot dishes are replenished continuously. The drinks are okay 👌, with ice cream and desserts. The food is decent, with many choices, and the staff are enthusiastic and provide good service ❤

author: BREW
review_text: Good place to stop, just off Fremont St. Lots of nacho options. Did not disappoint. Perfect size to share and very tasty!

author: Rochinee Straughter
review_text: I love Domino’s very affordable pizza, regular price and even better when they have their deals and they always have deals. The food is always fresh and hot when it’s delivered. The desserts are delicious. Salads are fresh. Everything on the menu is bomb.

author: Nur Muhammad
review_text: Seng Heng Braised Duck is the best stall in this quaint and rustic food centre. You can either go for Kway Teow noodles, yellow noodles, or mixed noodles. They have a dry and soup version. Choice for rice is available as well but noodles are superior here. The duck neck is addictive and sinful, and the soup is light with a peppery kick, an amazing palate cleanser. Pro Tip: Come before 9am as they usually sold out by 9am! Early bird gets the worm, they start operating as early as 6am!

author: Zach Brindisi
review_text: Terrible quality food and service, do not waste your money here! I had been a loyal customer for over ten years, spending thousands of dollars and have brought many friends/family members. The past several times I’ve dined there the service has been poor and food quality is horrible. The meat is either extremely undercooked or overcooked. They simply do not come out with good quality food anymore.

author: Laura Ahmad
review_text: 2 soups, 1 sandwich and a pick 2, $41 otd and had a 25% off coupon that the "general manager" would not honor because of "franchise owned or not." Idk what the deal with the GM was but he would not budge. And to tell a loyal guest that it's not for "my store" like he owns Panera. Well, my family, friends and I will not frequent this location and will have to think about dining at Panera moving forward, especially if they have people like Ben Villalvaso(the GM out of all people) ready to turn people away. Like as if it was coming out of his own pocket. Be aware of this location people. One thing to note, absolutely no one was wearing name tags except Ben. The guy with the pink shirt, don't know if it's someone higher than Ben, but no name tag on him either. Our cashier(had to find her name on receipt) had mucus hanging out of her nose while I was ordering. Not her fault but instead of Ben telling her that the coupon is not valid at "his" location, he should be giving her a heads up to clean her nose out. The worst thing to do when ordering food is to look at someone with snot in both their nostrils. If anyone takes the risk visiting this Panera, GOOD LUCK. My family and I had a terrible experience. Food matched the service sadly. Soups were all cold and sandwich bread was so hard it almost chipped my Aunts tooth. Also, how does a French onion soup have minimal to NO cheese in it? What’s funny is on the receipt shows “accuracy matters”, that’s a lie! NOT WORTH IT

author: Dilip
review_text: Definitely worth it if visiting Bali. It’s one of the items on the list you tick off. You would be brave to site by the water as there’s a lot of sea spray. You will get wet so be sure you are ok. Sunset is spectacular. Food is good but a bit overpriced but you are in a 5 star and paying for the venue

author: Angel Kim
review_text: I wanted to order the dry pot but it wasn’t vegetarian. The waiter offered to change the meat into veggies with fried tofu. IT WAS SUPER GOOD and it is big! I’d definitely come back again for the dry pot. Eggplant w/ garlic sauce was good too!

author: Mikki McGehee
review_text: My daughter and I love sushi and have been to several places in Las Vegas but this is by far our favorite. The sushi is always fresh and delicious. Something I also love is that there is so much variety on the menu, so it’s perfect if you have people who don’t like sushi. The service and staff are exceptional and we always feel so welcomed. The prices for take out can’t be beat!

author: AJ
review_text: We ordered the Singapore Curry Laksa, Rendang Curry Beef, Kaya Toast, and White Coffee. Everything was absolutely delicious especially the Rendang Curry Beef, which was insanely good. I’ve been to Singapore about twelve times, and the Laksa here tasted just like what I had there. The interior also really reminded me of cafes in Singapore and Malaysia — cozy, casual, and authentic. Definitely worth visiting if you miss Southeast Asian flavors.

author: Ron E Keyz
review_text: It's some of the best Dominican Food in Boston. Just don't be in a rush. Even if you call ahead it'll still take forever and a day to get your order. The only disappointing thing about the food is they don't make guisados but hey the good is great though

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: Mark D Food
review_text: Delicious food. Chicken is moist and cabbage had wok hey. Rice is fragrant. Could clear the cabbage alone. It is that good.

author: Shem Shem
review_text: A fantastic spot for seafood lovers in Canggu! The food is top-notch — everything is super fresh, delicious, and beautifully presented. I especially enjoyed the grilled shrimp and calamari — you can really taste the quality. The staff is another highlight: polite, attentive, and always happy to help with recommendations. The atmosphere is cozy and welcoming — a great place to spend an evening. Photos on Google don’t do it justice — it’s so much better in person! I’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to others!

author: Zen Yong
review_text: Visited Cook Chai Dim Sum during my trip to Hatyai and it was truly one of the highlights when it comes to local breakfast experiences. This spot is very popular, not only among tourists but also locals, which already tells you a lot about its reputation. If you are visiting Hatyai, this place is often mentioned as a must-try breakfast stop, and after dining here, I can see why. The staff are friendly and attentive, despite the busyness of the restaurant. Even when the place was quite packed, the service still felt smooth and efficient, which is impressive considering the constant flow of customers. The environment is lively and bustling, and while it can feel a little crowded at times, it is still comfortable enough for dining. In fact, the busy atmosphere adds to the charm of the place, giving you a sense of the local dining culture in Hatyai. When it comes to food, there are a lot of varieties to choose from. The selection of dim sum is wide, ranging from steamed buns, dumplings, siu mai, har gao, and many other small plates that are fun to try and share. The food taste is decent—nothing overly fancy, but tasty and satisfying, especially for a casual breakfast. The food portion matches the price, so you get good value for what you pay. The pricing is reasonable, which makes it easy to try a little bit of everything without worrying too much about the bill. What makes this place even more special is that other than dim sum, you can also order bak kut teh. Having a hot clay pot of herbal soup alongside a spread of dim sum gives you a hearty and unique breakfast combination that you don’t often find elsewhere. It’s definitely worth trying if you want to experience something beyond the usual dim sum. Overall, I would say Cook Chai Dim Sum is an essential stop if you’re in Hatyai. It combines good food, fair prices, and an authentic local experience. The mix of locals and tourists dining together makes the atmosphere unique, and it gives you the feeling that you’re eating where everyone in town comes for breakfast. Definitely worth visiting at least once during your stay.

author: Stephanie Cartagena
review_text: Review update/ As you can see by my originally review I was hyped. I got home and saw that zi didn’t get the BBQ sauce I requested many times. I paid $40 and was absolutely SHOCKED at the small portion size. As for flavor I like the Mac and cheese bur everything else had too much salt. The ladies there are amazing but I wouldn’t buy again. I posted pics of the food at the restaurant and then what $40 got me when I finally opened up my bag at home. —————————————- Ok hold up ✋✋✋✋ First time calling and first time coming here and LET 👏 ME 👏 SAY 👏 THIS👏 The service from Nana, Bernice, Shakira was top notch…… I mean I couldn’t stop talking about. They made it clear you arrive at 9:59 and they close at 10pm and they will take care of you. I almost don’t want to rate them so high so it don’t be getting packed in here Lol But highly recommend. Quality service and even at night food looks fresh and the smell will have you ordering way more than you were planning to. 5 ✨✨✨✨✨

author: Andrea Danielle Pinto
review_text: Came here for a late dinner one night as many shops were closed. This place opens till 5am!! Amazing! Burger was good, truffle fries were yum! I would suggest to sit inside as you can see rats outside at night. But we sat outside coz we wanted some fresh air. The staff were really friendly and happy to serve us even though it was pretty late. That’s the kind of service we love! Will be back!

author: Elizabeth Martinez
review_text: This is my fav sushi spot ever. I do live a couple hours away but when around I go grab a sushi. It’s soooo delicious 👍🏻😍!!!

author: Thomas Tam
review_text: Roti tisu was okay - it’s just big. Parts of it were too hard and chewy for my liking but overall alright for the price. Not served with nearly enough condensed milk for the size I think. Curries were tasty but expensive. Watermelon juice was not very sweet - either unripe fruit or watered down. I’d maybe avoid the fresh juices if you come here.

author: kunal gandhi
review_text: The food at Jeh O Chula is absolutely worth the wait—and wait you will. Even if you arrive early, there’s already a line, and it usually takes over an hour to get a table. The service is fast and tables turn quickly, but the queue still moves slowly. Now, the menu is huge, but let’s be honest—you’re here for one thing: the Tom Yum Noodles. Go straight to that section. There are six versions: two with pork, two with seafood, and two with crab. While you wait, order a few starters; there are plenty of great options to warm up your appetite. Be careful with the spice level—it can get seriously hot. If you’re not big on spicy food, choose the mild option. Will I come back to Jeh O Chula? Absolutely. It may feel touristy, and many locals skip the line because they don’t have the patience, but everyone agrees the food is outstanding. Oh one last thing, they only accept cash so do carry enough money with you. Till next time.

author: Key Star
review_text: The service is so bad. I waited in line for so long and ignored them when I asked for orders. They kept saying that they had finished buying.

author: RVSSO
review_text: Phenomenal juicy burguer, medium rare is the way to go. Amazing service by Katie a local who has an amazing energy and overall service qualities. Great music, clean bathroom, amazing spot.

author: Abigail Thompson
review_text: Went in about 20 minutes after open. Got water, bottle was so dirty, and there was floaters. Server never can to take our drink order, so we order food and drinks at one. Chicken tenders was fine, not bad. I got merica burger, medium. It was raw, like mushy raw. Server never came to ask how food was. I had to go up to the bar to ask for our check. Would not recommend and will not go back.

author: Joe Wheeler
review_text: We went to several food centres in Singapore and Maxwell was my favourite. The epicentre of Haikenese chicken rice. There is one place that has long queues but they are all the same - I tested. So don’t queue, support some other dude cooking chicken for almost no money.

author: Ker Sin Wong
review_text: Came back for 2nd visit, love the banh khot. First time trying steam stuffed snail which is exceptionally good. The Nha Tu beef salad was amazing as well. Will definitely come back whenever I’m at HCMC!

author: Derrick L
review_text: Huge variety of hawker food to choose from. From fried noodles to satay to zi char, a great place to chill and enjoy the sea breeze. There’s also semi alfresco seating where you can have a beer and enjoy free music from beer uncles.

author: Kirsten Turrisi
review_text: Lovely brunch spot! Beautiful atmosphere and amazing tapas! Perfect sharing sizes and the drinks were top notch!

author: Robert Morales
review_text: I walked in curious and hungry, craving something hearty like a classic cheeseburger and fries. That’s when I discovered the Oxtail Burger—my first one ever—and wow, it did not disappoint! Absolutely delicious and totally worth the stop. Anaya was awesome, super friendly, attentive, and full of great energy. She even checked in right after my first bite to make sure everything was perfect. Top-notch service and an all-around great experience!

author: Leticia Berrios
review_text: I ordered the tricolor chilaquiles and they were amazing! They come with a very generous portion steak. Their cafe de la olla was delicious and they serve it with a concha bread that is to die for. It was so soft and very tasty. Our server Marvin was very nice and attentive and brought our food out pretty quickly. I highly recommend you try this place out if you are looking for excellent authentic Mexican food with great service.

author: Cat P
review_text: One of the oldest hawker centres in the East offering a plethora of local fares. Opens early in the morning to provide the office dwellers with breakfast and last all the way past midnight with amazing supper choices. Conveniently located next to Mattar mrt and serviced by over 10 different buses from all corners of Singapore.

author: Leidi Chavez
review_text: This beautiful waterfront restaurant is located near the marina offering inside and outside seating. Place is nicely decorated, offering some cool photo opportunities especially if you are a ninja turtle fan. Fun. The fresh roses by the tables were a nice touch. Their menus, especially the drink menu is surprisingly extensive which is cool, although a bit pricey. All the food we ordered came out very tasty and fresh. Now, our server was not as attentive as we wish and we had to be reminding him of things, plus service was slow. Besides that, we had a nice experience, but I will recommend management to be in top of the servers to ensure service is to their standards. We will be back again.

author: Winther Tan
review_text: Very nice dim sum in hatyai. Always full, so need to go early. They r famous for their bak gut teh, but to me it seems too salty. But the dimsum is nice compare to many other places in Thailand n price is very affordable.

author: polly
review_text: The babi guling was so moist and delicious with crunchy skin. Restaurant was spacious and clean. Generous portioned meal. We enjoyed it.

author: Lenore Johnson
review_text: Fantastic. Ronny (manager) was absolutely fantastic. I arrived after a rough day of delayed red-eye travel and he took fantastic care of me. Great food, great service, great prices while looking at the ocean. Who could ask for more?

author: riley
review_text: Very good food. Fun vibe. When we arrived the sign said closed but I’m glad i walked in. She mentioned it sometimes turns from the wind, i would correct this as how many people think it’s closed and just go away.

author: Jason Xie
review_text: Mission Rock Resort is a fantastic spot that combines incredible food with stunning views. The oysters are absolutely amazing – fresh, flavorful, and perfectly prepared. They’re a must-try for any seafood lover. The rest of the menu is just as impressive, with dishes that are well-crafted and delicious. What truly elevates the experience is the view. Overlooking the water, it’s the perfect setting for a relaxing meal or a special occasion. The ambiance is laid-back yet classy, making it ideal for both casual outings and more formal gatherings. If you’re looking for great food and a beautiful waterfront dining experience, Mission Rock Resort is the place to go. Highly recommended!

author: MS B
review_text: I've been wanting to come to this place for a while but was affraid that the kids wouldn't like it. A small spot, cozy and kids friendly. I had the lamb pita which was delicious. They have chicken and pork as well. I will definitely go back to try the plate dinner, the zucchini chips and donut holes. Do not hesitate go, check them out.

author: Duc Lq
review_text: The road is easy to go, motorbikes are parked opposite, remember to cross the road, this part is a bit reckless. The VIP room upstairs is spacious and okay, the hallway is too much smoking and there is no ventilation so the smoke fills the hallway. The food is okay, the service is okay. The investment in seasonal decoration.

author: joe rocca
review_text: What a horrible experience. I called in for an order to be picked up on my way to work. So I have something to eat. The call center sent my order elsewhere. I walk in the manager is staring at his phone Before he took a good solid minute To even acknowledge I was standing there. They had to remake my order didn't even offer a discount. The girls on the inside don't even speak english. And it took up about 25 minutes to make my order I don't see this business open for too much longer the way they run it..

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Aishah Latif
review_text: We came early to Pagi Sore and were actually the first ones in – no queue, no wait, and plenty of tables to choose from. Of course, we picked the best seat by the pool! The staff were so attentive, bringing out the spread of dishes and the drinks menu right away. It’s proper Nasi Padang style – all the small plates arrive covered, and you’re only charged for what you eat. From the variety, we tucked into Gulai Tunjang, Ayam Pop, Udang Tofu, Sambal Terong, Tempe, Sambal Hijo, and the star of the show – Pegedil. The Pegedil was so good I had to pack some to bring back home to Malaysia! And to top it all off, nothing beats a glass of Es Kelapa Jeruk. The whole experience was warm and welcoming – friendly staff, a lovely poolside setting, and food that really hit the spot. Even our Grab driver shared that locals often label Pagi Sore as “Mantol” (mantap betul) – and I couldn’t agree more! Can’t wait to come back for more Pegedil!

author: Nicholas Ng
review_text: Tried the all in one laksa. Abit pricey but it includes a generous serving of chicken, 2 prawns, spoonful of hum and half a egg. Overall, a solid experience. Staff are very friendly as well.

author: Christopher Scott
review_text: I’ve been in Bangkok for 17 days and Roast has slide into my top 3 places to dine… It’s so good I came back twice. I partake in the happy hour ( buy 2 and get 1 free) , the mouth watering fried chicken ( which is indeed a shareable dish ) and the outstanding berry pie…. The staff is so sweet and hospitable….. I sat outside over looking the beautiful greenery and waterfall….. To the team at Roast, thank you so much and you’ll definitely see me again!!! ❤️ 😘

author: Omar Diego
review_text: WOW! What a treat this place is, the food is so good it transported me back home. Compliments to the Chef and Cooks. ¡Gracias estuvo delicioso!

author: Cameron
review_text: Such a cute gem in JP! Jada is a beautiful cafe that feels so light and bright and welcoming. All their food looks so beautiful and is actually unique and flavorful! The savory oats were an excellent start to the day, the jammy eggs melding perfectly with the chili crisp and miso flavors. The staff were also so nice, and I love that they have a few tables kept as laptop-free, making it a nice mix of people working or just chatting/reading. My only slight fault is the Maple Ginger Latte. A good drink, just really no maple or ginger flavor, just a good latte. Still, I would absolutely recommend coming here to hang out for a few hours, and don’t pass on the food!

author: Kira Reed
review_text: Excellent service today from Nick- the skier. I came in for the Vets day lunch special after getting an email from RL. The special was Walts shrimp and chips with cole slaw, and of course the yummy cheddar bay biscuits. A perfect lunch and excellent service. Not too crowded and a pleasant temperature inside. I didn't need my jacket. Great experience and service. Thanks for treating Veterans. We appreciate your dedication to us and how you treat your wonderful staff who are on the front lines providing consistent great service to us.

author: Payman Parseyan
review_text: Food was horrible. Service was horrible, views were incredible. We tried the snapper, the grouper and the seafood platter. We’ve had some good food and bad food from many coastal places in the world. This was among the worst food we’ve ever had and that’s saying something. The server we got was horrible. Stood by us as she handed the menu and asked what we’d like. I thought she was trying to be funny as obviously haven’t even seen the menu yet. We asked her to give us a minute to look it over. She came by 20 minutes later and we ordered. The food came out promptly but that was that. No follow up to refill drinks, i took the plates over to the counter after 60-70 minutes to clear up the table top and then got up and found to server to ask for a menu to order dessert. We sat there for 45 minutes and no one came to ask so I got up again, found the server, and asked for the bill. They brought it promptly and I paid. The views are incredible. The further in you go, the nicer the cliff side seats get. We had “table 17” which was supposed to be best cliff side seat after the honeymoon table. With that said, do with that, what you will.

author: Seth Coldren
review_text: The food, service, hospitality, and ambiance was incredible. We arrived at lunch time with a large party of 11 people. They took our group in and treated us like family! They moved tables around so we could all sit together, and prepared one of the most delicious family style meals we’ve ever had. We will definitely be back and look forward to next time!

author: Nancy LaRue
review_text: This is ridiculous I called to get a taquito plate ridiculous it comes with rice and beans and for Taquitos and then I asked for some nachos with some cheese beans and sour cream no meat with four extra sour cream can the girl that took my order wanted to charge me $72 this is ridiculous I'm going to the city of Los Angeles and I'm going to tell them how they are robbing people blind every time they bring me something they rob me blind out of my money

author: Henry Gunawan
review_text: One of the best babi guling in Bali. If you have spent time to traverse Canggu traffic definitely eat here!!

author: Phung Nguyen
review_text: Today, my family and I went to eat Com Nieu. I chose Com Nieu Chu Chen on Nguyen Trai street because there was a parking lot. My family went in a large group and ordered many dishes, but surprisingly, every dish was delicious. Especially braised snakehead fish with pork belly and sour soup were also delicious. The restaurant is quite crowded at noon, so I think you should reserve a table and order food in advance for quick service. My family ordered the dishes in advance, so we arrived and sat for about 10 minutes before the dishes were served. The tofu pudding for dessert was surprisingly delicious. The total cost for the meal was only 160k per person including drinks. Overall, it was delicious, my family will come back.

author: Brandon Akiaten
review_text: This restaurant was hands down the best place in Bali. My wife and I celebrated our honeymoon with dinner here. Denny was our server and he was the best. He made awesome suggestions, was very attentive, and we never had an empty glass. The drinks, the tapas, and the main dishes were amazing. The atmosphere was incredible. They made the favelas of Brazil cool to experience here in Bali. The music was also amazing. My wife and I don’t even want to leave. If you’re visiting Bali, this is a MUST visit…and ask for Denny.

author: sally
review_text: If you come on weekdays before 7pm, need to pay parking fee rm3. Order service was good, the menu explained well by the cashier guy. After order food, you need to wait until your name being called and go collect at the food counter (trolley provided). The seating is convenient and the view is seaview (not too hot and windy eventhough we came around 12pm). Price is quite reasonable.

author: Eli
review_text: So I arrived here because I was staying in the hotel next door and I just finished a 12-hour Drive to get here. The service is brutally slow and English is not really well spoken in here so it was a little complicated to order. Thankfully I just wanted soup and plantains so that helps keep it simple. With that being said the soup was excellent and the plantains were perfectly roasted so overall I'm very happy with the food but they really needs to up their game when it comes to running the line because they had probably about 12 people in there working the kitchen and it took them almost 15 minutes to give me some soup and plantains. As you can imagine at 9:00 p.m. they were not exactly busy either

author: Loh Ricky
review_text: One of my favourite hawker center, you can find plenty of local delights here and their price are reasonable too You can take MRT to reach here, if im not wrong is Dakota station, short walking distant to the hawker centre. This hawker centre is very packed in the evening but there are many fan around so not very stuffy. There is a newly built Multi storey carpark, so drive to park here is more convenient now compare to last time.

author: Bonnie Harrell
review_text: Within walking distance from our hotel, the Cafe Papillon provided so many options to choose from for Breakfast. I chose the Magda’s combo breakfast with eggs over medium. The eggs were not too oily or buttery or salty. The bacon was also not very salty or greasy. The French toast was the perfect way to end the meal on a sweeter note. Coffee was great, as was the cappuccino.

author: rony soerakoesoemah
review_text: October 2025: under new management- new menues, higher prices- same good service The go to place when you just want to eat without deciding what to order...food is consitently good and service even better...from burger 🍔🍟to pasta 🍝all tasty, the fried chicken 🍗could be a bit more cooked.. the complimentary french bread is oh so warm 🥖 go here when to lazy to cook or just wanna get outta of the house🏣

author: Chantil Sanchez
review_text: The Miam Pancakes were good, menu said it came with maple syrup but it was def not. It was what you’d expect with a high fructose corn syrup kind. The fruit and whipped topping was great and the pancakes themselves were fluffy but at room temperature, so not sure how freshly made they were. The Miam breakfast burrito however was fantastic. Very flavorful and jam packed with fresh ingredients and piping hot. I found it perplexing that we got our food before our coffee order. I had to ask for cream for my brewed coffee after being told when I initially ordered it that it was given on the side. Also be warned that the restaurant automatically adds a 4% “Restaurant Charge” to the bill.

author: Gerry Wijaya
review_text: Been here again and again and again. Remembering this bakery everytime I think of Canggu and Bali. Their pastry is amazing. A must try menu: Pain Au Suisse (Soft in the inside, Crunchy on the Outside) Usually their very pack at 9AM. I’ll recommend to come earlier for the queue. Loving it!✨

author: SUEB Songprasert
review_text: Service was warm and attentive. The staff really know their menu and give great recommendations. The atmosphere is HUNGRY but still cozy — perfect for a casual dinner or celebration with friends.

author: Andrea Sarasin
review_text: This restaurant is a hidden treasure. The staff is always super friendly and treats you like family, the pizza is yummy and has so many good options and the prices are really fair. Our family loves coming here.

author: Leo Jacquez
review_text: We’ve been regulars at Winnie & Ethel for a while and always enjoyed it, but this last visit was rough. From the moment we walked in, the floor was covered in crumbs and it didn’t feel clean at all. The staff seemed robotic and unhappy, with zero warmth or friendliness. Every request felt like a hassle, even just asking for water refills. I tried to swap poached eggs for scrambled and was told they “can’t do substitutions” even though I’ve done it numerous times, including last week. The food, which is usually great, came out overcooked and just off. The place is still nice inside, but between the lack of cleanliness, poor service, and disappointing food experience. Hopefully this was just an off day, but it was enough to make us think twice about coming back.

author: JJ Jen
review_text: Can try if you are around here, need to wait for 5-8 mins. Nothing overly fantastic. They are generous with the fillings.

author: Sook Mei Cheong
review_text: Love their fresh lala and umami broth. Sincere, hardworking folks serving great food. You can take your pick of ingredients to add on. I went with family on Friday evening for dinner. Non air cond and very local environment. There's a western food stall "Hot potato" that serves delicious fare. Gave us some French fries to try for free. Nice boss!

author: PY L
review_text: Everything is great here. Arrive at 11.30am and get a seat straight. There are many tables here suitability for 4-6 people. Waiting time is short. They serve food fast too, in 15 mins. 2 of us manage to try 4 dishes. Pra Ka Bao got a lot of wok hei. Tom yum is thick and slightly sweet not to my favour. Garlic fried pork is crispy, vege with meat taste good too

author: C. Tapia
review_text: I came where with my parents who are VERY picky eaters but they loved the food! The flavors are fantastic. The colorful portions are beautiful. We had a handful of the lentil sambusas, the feast for two, their Ethiopian version of a Bellini (YUM) and the baklava for dessert. A delicious meal with hearty portions. We left feeling satisfied but not overly stuffed. And everything is so healthy and simple ingredients

author: MARKROBERT WRONGWAY MURPHY SR
review_text: 1st off. Onions are the cheepest..of all overhead...portions controlled. When I ask for Xtra Onions I measured 1/4 sliced in 1//2 inch slivers..& ure jr bacon was thinner then ah white castle...DO YOU KNOW 15$

author: Christian Jones Lucas
review_text: This place was very crowded and hot. The seating is outdoor fans but not all of the fans were on. Be prepared for workers from each hawker stall to approach you as you walk around to offer you the menu. Even if you aren't even close to their stall.

author: Azyan Azami
review_text: I had such a lovely experience at Livingstone. The ambience immediately puts you in a good mood with its cosy, welcoming space and the kind of atmosphere that makes you want to sit a little longer. I was totally in love with their coffee blends. We tried both the Petitenget and Canggu blend and each one had its own character. Smooth, aromatic and genuinely satisfying. Food wise, we tasted quite a variety. The different nasi goreng options were all enjoyable. The salmon version had a nice balance of flavour, the chicken was comforting and familiar, and the oxtail nasi goreng was rich and deeply savoury. We also tried the fish and chips which came with a crisp coating and tender fish inside. The fluffy pancakes were a pleasant surprise, light and soft with just the right amount of sweetness. I would definitely return for the coffee alone, and the food just makes the whole visit even better.

author: Isaac Fuente
review_text: We went here on our first day in Penang, the food was amazing, a queue (which is always a good sign), but goes quickly… no more than 10 minutes. If you’re in Penang, and want to try Nasi Kandar, this is a must

author: Lydia Liem
review_text: This bakery has my heart! Their croissants are flaky, yummy, and absolutely worth the splurge. You can taste the love in every layer. And the coffee was just as delightful. Not the cheapest spot, but definitely the one that leaves you smiling.

author: Joshua Einhorn
review_text: We have been waiting for this grand opening for a while... To say the least it was worth the wait! Noting we went on a Sunday evening with the family so it was a bit busier, but that did not affect service whatsoever. For a place that's been open for only two weeks now they seem to be running smoothly. I had the Walker Burger Royale. It was pretty amazing! Hit the spot. Great portion sizes all around the table. Loved the idea of the "cocktail for a cause" libations. The Late Check-out is something I would definitely get again! Usually go for a beer but this was a pretty solid choice. Great options for kids too. Have a feeling this spot is going to fit right in to the Vinnin Square scene... and fills a void of a gathering spot for locals that the area has needed for some time as an alternative to the growing options on Humphrey St and Downtown Marblehead. Would come back again... and again! Still cannot believe the transformation this place did as you would've never expected this with the way it was set up before.

author: Luvenia Lindsey
review_text: I made an online order at 12am and received a BEAUTIFULLY MADE AND GREAT TASTING 2 topping PIZZA! I will be back!

author: Lie Gracecia
review_text: Very good service. Food is very flavourful, and one of a kind.

author: Sky Jay
review_text: This Panera is in a good location, plenty of parking and not a mad house like the Hughes Dr. Location. However, my thoughts about the quality of the food and the customer service fluctuate between a 3 and 4 star rating. The employees here are either very friendly or they are not very. Also the food and drinks are quite pricey for what they are, as most menu items are rather plain tasting - but do seem healthy. With that said, I would probably visit more only if it were more affordable.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Sabinus Brutus
review_text: We got each a taco combo with 3 good size tacos with rice, beans and Parmesan cheese corn 🌽. Since we stayed at the hotel neighboring the restaurant, we got a free margarita and 20% off between 5 and 6 pm.

author: Nicole Romkes
review_text: We had a wonderful breakfast with our kids here. Kristen helped us amazing with ordering our special wishes for our kids. Food was really good! Unbelievable quick as well! We still have a few days to go here in vegas and definitely will be coming back!

author: Karlyne Neemia
review_text: First time coming here today. I asked the cashier for some recommendations. She did not lie. Everything she suggested was on point. She was sweet and helped us go through the menu to try some stuff out. Food came fast. And they packed my plate. I only tried a few things this time but I will go back to try some more. This time I got the oxtail with Mac and greens with the gravy on the side. And also got the seafood gumbo and the banana pudding. They got a mix of Creole and Jerk so flavors are definitely there. I’d come back again.

author: Adrian Zambrano
review_text: I like it alot they have good deals and prices that you can’t be the food also tastes very authentic and Mexican. The people were very kind and made me feel welcome. I 100% guarantee this amazing restaurant.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Katerina Denisenko
review_text: A stunningly beautiful place with completely clueless management. The food is absolutely tasteless, and the service is unbearably pushy — the waiters, seemingly high, don’t serve you so much as rush you out from the moment you arrive. To top it off, the staff apparently doesn’t know that on a birthday, the candle on the cake is supposed to be lit before it’s brought to the table, not after. Ridiculous.

author: Katie
review_text: Delicious food stalls, very authentic and reasonably priced food all throughout. You can get an assortment of all types of foods, cuisines, deserts and drinks. We ate here and a few other Maxwell's and preferred this, the Lau Pa Sat one is touristy and more uptown blackpool-fake feeling with chains and not locals. But good if you want one million flavours of overpriced satay sticks. The food was delicious here. And very close to the station.

author: TereTere
review_text: I’d honestly recommend this place to anyone who’s in Bali or planning to come. Every single bite is worth the calories. I didn’t find this place through influencers or TikTok hype—just stumbled in as a customer and left completely satisfied. Definitely coming back. *our fave is nasi goreng & coffee. May order more but for now my tummy needs some rest because we keep ordering more than we need.

author: Ernest Baca
review_text: Ok so service was awesome food 3* if the key lime pie was pie not a custard would gain a star. The drinks were 5* but food will stay at 3*. But it is worth a stop inn. We can try again next week will update with new visit. Tony never let our drinks go dry. Thanks Tony!

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: jtango
review_text: Be prepared to queue for 20-30 mins for Heng Heng Coffee. A go to for the caffeine ‘pick-me-up’. The fish ball noodle from Hong Xing handmade fish and meat ball is delicious and must try.

author: Sue M
review_text: First time visiting, a close walk to my accommodation, arrived before 7 am so it was very quiet and quick service. I walked by yesterday and it was very busy, so I decided to go today and check it out. Asked the barista about the menu and he was kind enough to provide some suggestions. Huge variety. Ordered cappuccino and a smoothie bowl. Great atmosphere. My only suggestion would be to provide a serviette with the cutlery 🙏🏼

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: saul mercado
review_text: Made a reservation for New years day party of 10. There was some miscommunication on their end not seeing my reservation the day of. Dispute that tey honored my word and the reservation I had made, and got me through even though it was super busy and a long wait. Seating area is large. We were seated at a large table in a somewhat secluded area which was perfect for our party. We all got the combo B. Meats where good. Large selection of sides, even got tortillas which I thought was cool. Service was excellent never had to wait long periods for food or drinks. I would definitely be coming back!

author: cathe rina
review_text: The ambiance was warm n inviting and the service top notch. It was fantastic dine in here.Food also superb higly recommended good job.

author: Kieun Huh
review_text: Date of Visit: July 29, 2025 I walked into Wingstop around 7:47 PM to pick up my order, which included wings and the free 5 wings promotion they were offering. The store was crowded, with many people waiting or still ordering at the counter. I understand that it was a busy evening, but the experience I had clearly showed poor customer service and a lack of communication from the staff. I approached the pickup area and showed my order details on my phone to two employees at the front. One Hispanic man and one Hispanic woman. I showed them my name and showed my order more than once. They both saw it. But instead of giving a clear update or showing basic courtesy, the Hispanic woman rolled her eyes at me and other customers. That kind of reaction is unprofessional, especially during a high-volume time. A simple response like, “Your order is coming up soon,” or even, “Thank you for your patience,” would have made customers feel seen and respected. But the silence and the attitude only made things worse. I overheard another customer who had ordered at 7:30 PM still waiting at 7:59 PM, visibly frustrated. There was no apology or explanation given to them either. When a business tells customers to go to the pickup counter and confirm their name, it should not lead to eye rolls or dismissive behavior. It felt like staff were annoyed just for having to do their job. That is not acceptable. The entire situation showed a lack of proper training, leadership, and communication. No one was managing the floor. Staff seemed overwhelmed and unprepared, and customers were left confused and ignored. It reflected poorly on the store. This experience was disappointing. I hope the management takes serious steps to improve how their team communicates and treats customers, especially during busy hours. A little respect and basic updates can go a long way in improving customer satisfaction.

author: Jess
review_text: We decided to visit for the first time after seeing their Instagram story, and the restaurant is tucked away on the outer edge of the Vegas Strip. You can tell the building has been well-loved and maintained. The atmosphere is decent, and the food comes out quickly with great presentation.
