We’re big BBQ fans, and while the smoke flavor was fine, it wasn’t anything exceptional. I ordered the tostada plate, which comes with three small tostadas brisket, chicken, and another beef. Those were great, and the chicken was amazing. 2nd order ribs and sides. The ribs, however, needed a bit more time; the meat didn’t come off the bone easily, so they were just okay overall.

author: Shannen Blount
review_text: I was racially profiled by the cashier and the lead staff. If a company has a policy it should be enforced across the board not at the employees discretion. The cashier handed five order to customers without any information, but at my turn she verified that my order was there and insisted on see my order on the app. It is really sad to see other minority practice these same prejudicial practices.

author: Vy Thanh
review_text: The restaurant is spacious, airy, and beautifully decorated. Delicious food. Cheerful and attentive service. Overall, it's great.

author: Noyonika Parulekar
review_text: The gyoza were unimpressive in my opinion — they lacked a strong pork flavor and the sauce didn’t pair very well with them. However, I was here for the ramen. The ramen broth was delicious, very rich, and deep in flavor. The biggest gripe I had was with the thickness of the chashu. Genuinely so disappointing that the tonkotsu featured three thin pieces of pork. There were a few delicious bamboo shoots also in the ramen which added a new textural element which was appreciated. To be honest, I wouldn’t come here again for just the ramen — I believe there are better spots in the city. But if you’re looking for a cure date night spot with decent ramen, this is the perfect place.

author: Chris Peralta
review_text: Great food and great drinks here! The nachos pictured were as good as they look! I ordered the house margarita, and I was prepared for it to be just OK since house margaritas tend to be -- but it was actually very good! I recommend!

author: Suzalinna Sulaiman
review_text: Came around 6pm. No wait. Service was excellent. Plenty of choices. All look good and delicious on the menu. Finally settled with wrapped rice, ketupat tahu & grilled ribs. Tastes delicious and full of flavour. Worth every rupiah. Definitely recommended to those who wanna try Indonesian food.

author: Rox BO
review_text: Update! Stopped by my favorite Argentinean bakery, got parking in front of the store and bought delicious "facturas" pastries and " sandwiches de miga" always the best food and service!!! I have purchased many delicious food items from this place over the 30 years, since Don Carlos was there!!!! This time I bought "Torta Balcarse" omg its decadent!!! Also the signature sandwiches de miga and facturas everything was fresh and delicious!!! Parking is difficult in that area, but after a few turn around you find it, I wouldn't take star off for that. A little far for me but totally worth the trip!!! Service was great!!!

author: Lee
review_text: Exquisite and perfect place for entertaiment. Great unique cuisine and happening place. Pricey but it was worth it.

author: Gabbie Kim
review_text: I enjoyed eating at this food court. There were so many options to choose from—pizza, burgers, sandwiches, Mexican, Indian, Japanese, Mediterranean, and even a café, just to name a few. The food was decent and reasonably priced. We went during lunchtime, so it was quite crowded and hard to find seats. I would visit again.

author: Alain Maalouf
review_text: Great food and a really nice atmosphere. Everything we ordered tasted fresh and well prepared, and the service was friendly and attentive. A few small details could be improved, but overall it was a very enjoyable experience. I’d definitely come back and recommend it.

author: Marcus Hew Mun Kok
review_text: Lovely Christmas Eve dinner at Rosso Vino. The pasta was excellent—especially the pesto and lobster pasta, both flavorful and beautifully prepared. Special thanks to Kirv for the attentive and warm service despite the festive crowd. Highly recommended for a special occasion.

author: indy Del
review_text: Only came here for breakfast twice during my stay. I'm normally not a pancake person but let me tell you..EXCELLENT pancakes, fluffy, fresh and NOT too thick. The eggs were good and home fried potatoes were fresh. Coffee was nice and strong, nice views-oceanfront. Music too loud in the morning. Save that for the night crowd. My service was friendly and prompt both days. Best bang for your buck. Under $10 for fresh breakfast.

author: Cheryl Lee
review_text: Food is on the spicy level here so u need to ask them to reduce the spice level if u can’t take too spicy! Their food is well flavored and cooked with lots of spice! Not a huge variety but worth waiting and eating while you are near this area. Staffs are efficient and food is served quickly despite a queue! Prices are reasonable too! Just that the place is not too big so be prepared to wait for awhile!

author: Hao Tan
review_text: A shorter queue comparing with the other famous chicken ric shop opposite. Chicken was tender and bean spout was crispy and sauce wasn't too salty. We enjoyed

author: Balee Tong
review_text: Best Tonkatsu I've had in Penang and Klang Valley. If you can get a table I waited an hour on a working day afternoon to get a seat in this restaurant. The place is walk in only, no bookings allowed. I probably won't come back due to the uncertainty and time constraints. A place as popular as this can certainly implement a reservation only policy, not the complete opposite which wastes every customers time waiting. The cabbage, rice and soup are refillable, we are off to a good start. Despite being free flow, the soup is rich and packed with vegetables. The pickles were fresh and crispy. We ordered both the sakura pork. sirloin and ribeye, the portions are between (180-200g). Long story short, the pork, hands down was perfectly executed. The fat cap was fragrant and an absolute joy to have. However, I couldn't tell the difference between the ribeye and sirloin. Visually yes, taste and texture felt similar. The rice is perfectly cooked as well. The grains was noticeably separate and chewy.

author: Leo Amador
review_text: The food was just ok. We ordered a soup, carapaus assados, Chicken picadinho, buffalo chicken wings, ate 2 lava cakes. The price for a Macallan12 @ $25 per doze is outrageous considering the surrounding establishments charge between $12 and $16. The service was slow! Spent over $60 (with a bottle of wine) per person with a baby and 2 childen. We will not be coming back!

author: Morit Lahlali
review_text: The food was meh. Pretty sure we got scammed with a lobster. The one we got was way smaller than the one we bought and weighed. Oh well

author: Gene Agawin
review_text: After a night long drive with my Cybertruck (Foundation Series), my brother in law and I decided to stop here in Red Lobster Summerlin Nevada. Red Lobster is one of our favorite sea food restaurants so while cruising along the road, as soon as we saw this Red Lobster, we stopped to check it out. We looked the menu and ordered, as usual the lobster was good and all its sides but to top it all and more importantly - the service - is topnotch - I took a picture of our friendly, courteous server (sorry forgot her name). As a bonus, at that time, I was searching in my Tesla App for a supercharger since my Cybertruck's batt is low and bam! it popped in my phone that a Tesla supercharger is located just behind this Red Lobster - wow, what a pleasant surprise! We dined and charged the Cybertruck at the same time! awesome 👍

author: Savan
review_text: After quite a long time away, we returned for lunch and were pleasantly surprised. The restaurant now feels more spacious, and the interior is noticeably cleaner, brighter, and more inviting than before. We ordered the 2-person lamb set, which included sliced lamb, sliced pork, lamb chops, hand-pulled noodles, lamb tripe, a basket of vegetables, lamb meatballs, and tofu. We also added an extra portion of sliced lamb, garlic pork slices (蒜泥白肉), and two skewers of grilled pork belly. To top it off, we enjoyed their buy-3-get-1-free Harbin beer promotion. Our choice of the lamb herbal soup base was excellent—lighter on the herbs compared to before, but also less salty and refreshingly free of MSG. The broth was clean and naturally sweet. Every item in the lamb set was delicious and of high quality. The lamb chops, sliced lamb, and meatballs were especially outstanding—rich in flavor without being overly gamey. Lamb lovers will definitely appreciate it. A special mention goes to the garlic pork slices, which were tender and packed with flavor. The grilled pork belly skewers were smoky, aromatic with cumin, and satisfyingly savory. The staff were exceptionally polite, professional, and hospitable. All in all, a great dining experience that we highly recommend!

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Jackie Here
review_text: Tried the bún chả here and it was great! The flavor is spot on — tasty, balanced, and not overwhelmingly spicy, just the right kick. Satisfying and definitely worth trying if you’re in the area.

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Andres Yepez
review_text: THE BEST FOOD ON THE AREA!! What’s better than good food? Great service! The food was delicious, the environment was fun, and everyone was super friendly. I will return; thank you to the whole team for the great experience!

author: Kevin Rodriguez
review_text: The white rice is very high quality. You guys should definitely try it. It’s worth every penny lol. Oh, and the staff is very, very nice lol.

author: Vania Mathilda
review_text: They have a good food and good service.. Glad I spent my bday here..

author: Frank Lauda
review_text: The waitress/manager told me she makes the banana cake without sugar, only a bit of honey. Great coffee, service and relaxed atmosphere.

author: Phuong Thuy Le Nguyen
review_text: A café and vegetarian restaurant with a spacious, sunlit ambiance, elegantly decorated and filled with a charming collection of old, quality books. The vegan food is delicious, drinks are decent, and prices are slightly high but reasonable for its prime District 1 location. Perfect for solo visits or groups.

author: Hatice Büşra Kürk
review_text: We ordered nashville and tikkaville burgers. They were delicious, I did want my food to finish actually. The personnel was very kind and helpful as well. We ordered smash burger for the kids without spice, pickles etc. and they ate all of it, even though it was just cheese and meat and we ordered another. Pataka fries has a special sauce with garlic and spices, it was addictive🥹 I will tell my friends about this place and certainly come here again.

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: Mckayller Longsbow
review_text: If you’re looking for authentic herbal soup in Singapore, Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup is a must-try! The black chicken soup is rich, flavorful, and really comforting — perfect if you want something nourishing and tasty. The herbs they use give it a great depth of flavor without being overpowering. The place is simple and no-frills, but that just adds to the charm. It feels very traditional and homey, like a hidden gem. The staff were friendly and attentive, making the whole experience even better. Perfect spot to warm up and recharge, especially if you enjoy traditional Asian herbal cuisine. I’d definitely come back! Friend brought me here, great!

author: Jeremy Guzman
review_text: UPDATE: After many years is been since we have been here, we are not disappointed with the food or service. I had the fish special and wife had the hamburger as pictured. It was very good. Prices are reasonable, but no higher than most places these days. I still recommend and will be back. 👍👍😃 I've been coming to Inchabods for a few times now. And every time I come I love the food. It's fresh daily and the soups are good too. The wait staff is good too. I'm only speaking of the table side. But will keep coming back. :-) It's worth trying.

author: Ong Shu Wen
review_text: Tried the Michelin-recognised yam rice shop in BM — definitely a must-try. I went around 10am on a Friday and it wasn’t crowded yet, but it started filling up soon after. The place is spacious with plenty of seating. The yam rice was fragrant and flavourful, truly worthy of the Michelin mention. The pork mixed with salted vegetable soup was also very tasty. However, the vinegar pork trotter wasn’t really my thing. Portions are generous and prices are very reasonable.

author: Sharath Yarrapothu
review_text: Had a delicious chicken salad and a latte at Crate Café, Bali. The food strikes the perfect balance between healthy and tasty — fresh ingredients, great textures, and really satisfying without feeling heavy. Loved the relaxed, vibrant vibe of the place too. A must-visit if you enjoy clean eating with bold flavours.

author: Garry Lew Your Estate Advisory Realtor
review_text: Visited 4th July 2025 Friday morning. The following sharing are based on our unbiased and personal experience. Wife wanted to give this stall a try and order herself a bowl of Bak Chor mee. Not much queue during this timing so she had her noodle pretty fast compared to the carrot cake stall First bite the noodle wasn’t what I had expected. It’s a bit undercooked but the broth was pretty okay. Ingredients was also generous I would say but didn’t quite catch my taste bud. A lot of missed rather than hit. A 3 ⭐ ⭐ ⭐ for this noodle Follow us for a gastronomic experience and discover the world’s finest in its purest form.

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: C L
review_text: This charcoal duck fried kuau teow very nice and got the "wok hei". Taste good and the duck fried egg is delicious. Price is reasonable. No need long queue and fast serving. Got plenty place to sit. Parking also ok either park inside or opposite just nearby. Just the prawn is abit small of compare those in the island but the taste is definitely good.

author: Maria Goines
review_text: I am a Puerto Rican person. I went here really expecting to find good Puerto Rican food. The food had no flavor. There’s a certain flavor. Puerto Rican foods have all the food basically taste the same. I got what they call little which is not the actually ribs. I don’t know where they come up with these different names. Their beans were watery no flavor. We had a dinner of the steak with onions. You can even taste the onions I’m sorry, but it was the worst Puerto Rican food I’ve ever tasted it.

author: Merve
review_text: Nice atmosphere in the morning and in the evening because inside gets too hot at noon (due to big glass windows). You can enjoy great cocktails (you pay one get two during the happy hour). I ordered grilled fish and salad -the portion was a bit small- but it was really delicious. Prices are a bit above average. Service was very fast.

author: Luis Gzz
review_text: We really enjoyed and recommend the rib eye pho. The grilled tofu spring rolls were also good. The service was also very good. Great addition to the neighborhood and will definitely return!

author: Bill
review_text: Peter Luger delivered an old-school steakhouse experience that felt cozy and down to earth at the same time. We shared the steak for two with creamed spinach and sautéed mushrooms. The steak (medium rare) was incredibly tender with plenty of rare, juicy center cuts, and the signature sauce added a refreshing contrast. The creamed spinach was silky and perfect; the mushrooms were fragrant but a bit salty. Portions were huge, easily more than we could finish. We ended with the cheesecake and its iconic mound of whipped cream. Our server Eric was charming and funny throughout. Also worth noting: they only take debit or cash. A hearty, high-quality, and quintessential NYC steakhouse experience!

author: Cristina Anderson
review_text: Great food! Impeccable service and beautiful decor. I truly enjoyed this place! Make reservations ahead of time. We came here at 8:45am and luckily I made reservations otherwise it would be an hour wait and I understand why! It’s not in the best location but I felt 100% safe at least in the morning, so don’t quote me if you’re going in the evening. I had the French toast (which was fresh and delicious) and a rose and vanilla cold brew, my kids had fried French toast. Definitely go!!

author: Chuck Roast
review_text: The 3 different employees I encountered in my pickup order were all extremely friendly and made me feel welcomed! The food quality was fantastic! I really enjoyed everything we ordered the burnt ends, the brisket, bacon jam brisket, brisket taco, and the hatch chili mac and cheese. I jave been wanting to try this place for awhile and it did not disappoint!

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Mohd Afiq Abdul Ghafar
review_text: The restaurant is very convenient for travelers, offering easy access and a comfortable atmosphere. The food is really good, with an authentic taste that truly represents Indonesian cuisine. The staff are very friendly and helpful, making the overall dining experience even better.

author: Ts. Chin (jcstudio.com)
review_text: **Tangshan Cuisine (唐山美食) in Prai offers authentic Northern Chinese flavors, distinct from Penang’s usual Cantonese or Hokkien fare. Specialties include: - **Tangshan Dumplings (唐山饺子)** – Thick, handmade skins with juicy fillings. - **Lanzhou Hand-Pulled Noodles (兰州拉面)** – Chewy noodles in rich beef broth. - **Savory Pancakes (煎饼)** – Crispy yet fluffy, stuffed with eggs and scallions. **Unique Traits:** - Less sweet, more wheat-based (noodles, buns) compared to Southern Chinese cuisine. - Bold flavors with garlic, vinegar, and cumin, unlike local Malay or Nyonya dishes. Although its viral extremely in sosial media, but if you bring your family, please pay extremely 300% patience, the food you order very slowmo to deliver, some need wait untill more than 20 minutes, only can enjoy food. This my first visit, hoping that not my last visit.

author: Delphica Sibyl
review_text: The Four Horsemen - finally 😊 My husband and I have been devoted LCD Soundsystem fans for years, so the fact that James Murphy co-founded this place has always made it feel like a small dream waiting to happen. We’d been postponing it for weeks, as life has a way of reshuffling plans, but this time my husband said, 'This is your birthday and that’s it. We’re going.' I agreed ;) The restaurant itself is small, understated, and effortlessly elegant. The interior has that kind of simple chic that feels authentic: warm wood, soft light, no pretense. We didn’t have a reservation but decided to take a chance, and after waiting about thirty minutes, we got a table right after 5:20 pm The menu is tiny, almost minimalist, but every dish feels deeply considered. We weren’t too hungry, so we ordered a few small plates and a bottle of wine, saving room for dessert and hoping for a candle later. And the food… oh, the food. I’m not sure words can do it justice. Every bite was a perfect balance of acid, sweetness, and texture. I’m from wine and vinegar country, so I truly appreciate the taste of acidity and here, I finally found a place in New York that speaks to my palate. Their flavors don’t fade the moment you swallow; they linger, evolve, and make you think. I couldn’t help but notice almost everyone around us was ordering their famous warm bread, it looked absolutely divine. But since I bake my own bread at home and had already had a fresh loaf that morning, we decided to skip it this time. Still, it clearly seemed to be the must of the evening, and I’ll definitely try it on our next visit. The wine list is impressive. We chose a French white that was absolutely balanced, bright, and beautifully alive (and no headache after!). And the desserts… I’m still dreaming about the passionfruit cake, so light, tangy, and joyful. I was especially happy that nobody from the staff sang 'Happy Birthday.' ❤️ As for the staff, 'perfect' doesn’t even begin to describe their service. They have that rare ability to make you feel both taken care of and completely at ease. The atmosphere, the music, the people, the vibe: 10 out of 10, or maybe 100 out of 100. To Be Continued :))

author: Adri T
review_text: Great spot for breakfast or brunch! The option to build your own eggs is awesome to cater to your own liking—at reasonable prices, at that. The long black coffee was strong and hit the spot. I would only skip the pancakes—they look better than they taste—we found it quite dry, a bit dense, and lacking in flavor. The “crispy bacon” add-on isn’t crispy at all, either. Just a heads up for those who actually prefer them crispy/crunchy to bite. We arrived around 11,30am for brunch and the place was quite packed. We waited but not too long. The tables are arranged close to one another, FYI—if you’re particular about privacy. Still, would come back here next time to try other menu offerings.

author: Sandra Cash
review_text: This was my first time here. I will definitely be back! We had the waterfall beef, pork belly, the wings and the short rib beef fried rice with an egg on top. Also had the mango margarita. Food was delicious. This was more than enough for 3 people to share with leftovers.

author: Chee Chin Cheng
review_text: Extremely overpriced. Food is just average. Not worth the price. There are better authentic thai food at other places. The restaurant is quite small . 5 of us ordered 2 Appetizer and 2 main dishes and it cost us 1730 baht. Only the Appetizer set is good and the sauce is very nice and special. The white tom yam was a disappointment. Not recommended to eat at this place.

author: Wise seer
review_text: The food was very good and the service was very good too.I'm only giving it a 4 on the atmosphere because it was a lot of people there and I couldn't get my order in enough time but other than that I had a good experience

author: ZJ
review_text: The food at this Cheesecake Factory location was delicious. My family and I came here for lunch, and they truly made it worthwhile. I ordered the steak, and it was incredibly flavorful and cooked perfectly. Highly recommend!

author: Angeli Paray
review_text: Excellent brunch! We had bottomless mimosas and our server truly made sure my glass was never empty. Great location on the inlet so yes there are seats directly next to the water. Lots of umbrellas for shade and more than enough space for large parties. Our server was running around on double time taking care of all of the tables. The food, was excellent. We had the banana bread which came out hot and fresh. The coconut shrimp had this great mango salsa that gave it a fresh acidic flavor. Steak tacos were flavorful and cooked correctly so it was tender and soft. The lobster roll had full on clumps of lobster meat which you can clearly see is fresh and not from a can. The chicken wings were also very well seasoned and nice and crispy. Overall we had an amazing experience and the food did not disappoint. There is only valet parking for $5 unless you want to park across the street and walk.

author: Jesus Caez
review_text: Me and my wife dined here for Christmas Dinner and nothing short of amazing. Me and my wife got the Surf n Turf for two and it blew us away. The steak and lobster were cooked perfectly, the truffle Mac n cheese was also great, I recommend the coconut creme cake to end the night. Me and my wife do not drink so I cannot comment on their alcohol but they had a very extensive wine list!

author: Melissa
review_text: Terrific terrific Chicken. I love a good rotisserie chicken and PioPio does not disappoint! And the green hot sauce is outstanding. The restaurant was clean with a lively atmosphere. All the staff was friendly and kind.

author: Raven Cuddels
review_text: Wow!! Lawrence was super nice and professional - Him and the lady chef were fast and amazing! Give them a raise! amazing food

author: Regi Taylor
review_text: The hotel shuttle driver recommended that we try The Cornbread Soul Food restaurant. He was absolutely correct in his suggestion. Dropped in about 7p on Friday night, the place was fairly busy. The staff was amazing, willing to walk 1st timers through their menu choices. You better bring your best appetite cause you can't eat it all, especially if you select the large meals. The collards are perfect and you'll drink the "pot liquor " (juice), the cabbage was slightly crunchy exactly as I like them and the juice was consumed as well. The yams were sweeten just enough to make your mouth water as they enter your mouth. Of course the Cornbread was the perfect compliment to the meal. The turkey leg meal was overwhelming, much more than I could eat without taking a nap in the restaurant after eating. Had to get the doggie bag to finish later. The catfish was cooked with a highly seasoned batter that took away from enjoying the full flavor of the fish. There were many other items I wanted to try but knew I was allowing my eyes to be larger than my stomach. I appreciate this shuttle drivers recommendation and I too want to suggest this restaurant as a must try!

author: Nelly “Prudential” IG:fininsuranceplanner
review_text: Nice restaurant and bar to chill with family and friends. The seafood dishes are quite tasty/ umami. We ordered: Steamed Garlic Scallop with vermicelli, Rolled Wagyu with Enoki, Abalone Soup, Sea Cucumber Soup, Chong Qing Chicken and Sapo Eggplant. The portion is quite big and can be shared with more than 5 people. Overall I enjoyed the food and the atmosphere. Will come back for the live music on other days.

author: Edmond Khor
review_text: Best banh mi i ever had. There are 3 shops belong to them beside each other(2 kitchen and 1 dining area). You can also bring the banh mi across the road to have it in the other cafe.

author: Karoadtrips
review_text: The entrance was not the easiest to find, but we managed to locate it. A spotless restaurant with extremely friendly staff. The menu has something for everyone, but the prices felt a bit high. The food was fresh, though, so it was worth it. I had chicken and waffles Benedict. Those weren't the best chicken and waffles I've had, but they'll do. Also love the big chunks of fresh fruit as a side. My Bloody Mary was also delicious. Although I requested not to be spicy, it still made my mouth tingle, but not to the point of being too spicy. So that one is forgiven. Every person working that day kept checking on me, to the point it became a bit annoying, honestly. However, when we asked for the check, we were offered the payment machine to be brought to our table. And the waitress already decided we were going to tip 25%... Although we could still change that before actually paying, the move didn't feel right, and it automatically makes me want to tip less. Worth it? If you like over-friendly service that expects big tips and fresh food, go for it. I don't think I'll be visiting again.

author: Soon Lay Teong
review_text: If you want to have a terrible service which they will act like you owned them money, want to have bad mood but you just want to order, this is the correct place to visit. Dear staffs here, if you guys having personal issue, then settle among yourselves, don't throw your negative feeling towards customers.

author: Marilyn Secor
review_text: We made a reservation for Christmas Day for my family of five. What a disappointment. Please check all the current negative reviews before you decide to dine here. The food was mediocre at best. The service was the worse I have ever experienced. The bill was 185.00 and we did not order drinks. Two of the dishes came out coated with sesame seeds which was not listed as one of the ingredients on the menu. I had oral surgery a week before and not able to eat nuts or seeds. When I made the server aware of it she nasily said it was listed on the ingredient list amd asked me if i wanted to order something else. I couldn't believe she didn't offer to bring another without the seeds. I said no and she abruptly left. I took a picture of the menu, sesame seeds were not listed. I wasn't able to eat anything. I asked to speak to the manager and he was unsympathetic. He offered free dessert. We were given 2 desserts to share for a family of five in a brown paper bag to go. What a waste of money. Not a great way to spend Christmas. Avoid this place. There are so many other places to dine that are so much better, especially if you want excellent food and top notch service. They also automatically add 20% to the bill for the tip. I suppose they have to or the servers would never make money. Since they know they are getting a tip regardless they don't work for it.

author: Alexandra
review_text: It was an amazing experience. The beef burgers are better than the chicken burgers. It was a nice atmosphere which clearly matches the concept of the restaurant. Staffs are welcoming and friendly. Would definitely recommend.

author: Pete Klimek
review_text: If you’re looking for the best curry noodles in Singapore, this Bib Gourmand hawker stall is it! (There are two side by side). The wait was about 20 minutes, but let me tell you—it was worth every single second. The curry is rich, aromatic, and perfectly balanced without being overly heavy. You get to choose your preferred chicken cut, and every piece is tender and juicy. The noodles soak up the curry beautifully, and the portion sizes are just right—generous without being overwhelming. This is hawker food at its finest: authentic, full of flavour, and absolutely satisfying. Highly, highly recommended!

author: Eizen Barleta
review_text: Went here on a friend’s recommendation. Everything was fresh, soothing for the throat, and full of flavor. It’s great that they’re open late, making it the perfect spot for satisfying your midnight cravings.

author: S Jackson
review_text: My Grandmother's pigeon peas and rice was the best in the neighborhood. Alex came real close to being as good. My chicken wasn't that fresh. But the Peas n rice is delicious! No dine in options

author: Tyra Montour
review_text: So I have all great things to say about this place! For my first time in Venice Beach it was a great experience. We went for my friends 30th birthday brunch and unbeknownst to us we didn’t know it was a vegetarian restaurant because she thrives off aesthetics but it was a 10 out of 10 on that end and for dining! We had some starters which were the biscuits and mushroom calamari and there were no pictures because we devoured them. The breakfast burritos were delicious and everything pictured matched my sentiments! Other friends ordered pizzas which are not pictured but they enjoyed them as well. I asked for hot sauce which I believe was made in house and it was more on the vinegar end but it’s all preference. The potatoes were well seasoned but to my taste they could’ve been a little more crispy but that didn’t take away from our experience at all. I provided a picture of where we were seated because it was beautiful and perfect for the birthday girl

author: Armen Hovhannisyan
review_text: Something has changed about the food here, the chicken tenders seem different like a cheaper quality and the fries taste bland.

author: Yiling Lai
review_text: Sun 22 Dec 2024 The mootaka lala hotpot is well worth the price of MYR 29.90. They offer a wide variety of food, the cutlery is spotless, and the air-conditioned environment is quite pleasant. I’ll definitely visit again. The total bill for four people came to MYR 132.70.

author: Sharanya Sarkar
review_text: Ah absolutely amazing food! Looked for the highest rated food place around where I was on Newbury street at that point, and this showed up. And the food was so comforting and amazing. We got the lemon rice and chicken, and lamb w/ spicy feta and had an extremely hearty meal!

author: Manuely S
review_text: I was really disappointed. I had ordered from here before and loved it, so I decided to go in person. The restaurant was empty, several menu items weren’t available, and we waited 50 minutes for just two arepas. The grilled beef arepa had a very strong taste, and both arepas fell apart when we tried to pick them up it would have helped if they used the wax paper most places use for arepas. Maybe it was just the time we went, but it was still very disappointing because the place is beautiful and the food looks great. We left hungry and went somewhere else. Sadly, I wouldn’t come back.

author: N Harris
review_text: The restaurant has a large sign at the beginning of the street, very easy to find, the space is spacious and airy, there are also private rooms with karaoke for those who want to have a private party, the food is very good, the price is surprisingly cheap, our group of 6 people ate their fill and only spent 1 million, the restaurant has a very enthusiastic owner, going to each table to greet customers, any problem that is not satisfactory, just give feedback, you can park your car.

author: Buggie
review_text: Delicious food, not too expensive, good many for your buck. They also sell very pretty potted plants and the chairs are painted like flowers

author: Arnesto Hernandez
review_text: Great quality and great portions. Best bang for your buck on the steak sandwich. Will definitely be back to try everything else.

author: Nathália Rizzo
review_text: The best pizza in town! The pie is really big. We’re coming back. Tanvir was really nice and friendly

author: Sasi T
review_text: The crab curry at Oranuch Thai Dining is absolutely delicious—rich, flavorful, and well-prepared. The scallop dish is also fresh and delicious. However, the restaurant is quite pricey, and the service leaves much to be desired. Most of the staff were not attentive, and only the owner seemed to provide good service. If you’re going for the food, especially the crab curry, it’s worth a visit, but don’t expect great service.

author: Ivy
review_text: First time visit for dinner and the cafe is located just right behind the McDonald. We ordered scallop Alfredo pasta and Hawaiian chicken burger. The burger tastes delicious but I think the pasta is a bit creamy and heavy due to its carbonara sauce. We also ordered a Belgium chocolate cake which is also quite nice and not too sweet. We also get two free dessert for leaving a google review! Overall, chilled and nice dining experience!

author: May L
review_text: Decent local eats. Comfort food after all the spicy Thai food. Bitter gourd stuffed with minced meat is so good. We had multiple servings of that dish. All other dishes are acceptable. Service a bit slow.

author: sc Pear
review_text: Definitely will visit again!! Came here quite late and they still willing to take my food order.Tried their crab spagetti and fries. Everything are so delicious. Was joking with the chef that fish roe is my favourite snack, he is so generous and gave me extra fish roe FOC. The two young chefs are friendly,foods are good, reasonable price,atmosphere calm and relaxed. Recommended!!

author: Wissam G. Azar
review_text: If you’re looking for that home made breakfast place in San Francisco, then this would be the place for you. The food looks like it’s coming out of your kitchen, no fancy style, just good food. I went for the big guy’s breakfast, definitely needs a big guy, a two butter pancake short stack, 2 sunny side up eggs, a flat sausage, bacon and some fries, I will give that a 4/5. The cappuccino was really good, very well presented and deserves a photo of its own 😁. Home made coffee and fresh orange juice (pulp included) compliments it all. Enjoy 👍

author: Leonard Lim
review_text: Workshop Coffee in Ho Chi Minh City is one of those places that stands out for its cool, industrial-chic vibe. It’s always lively and full of energy, popular with Chinese tourists and expats alike. Their coffee is excellent, and although the food menu is quite limited, everything I’ve tried has been tasty. The only downsides for me are that the entrance is a bit hidden—you have to go up a flight of stairs to find it—and it can get really crowded and noisy during busy hours. Also, I personally find the chairs quite uncomfortable, which makes it hard to sit for long.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Triet Le
review_text: The restaurant seems to specialize in Nam Vang noodles. My friend ordered dry Nam Vang noodles and it was delicious. I ordered beef noodles, which were tasty but not very rich in the typical beef noodle flavor.

author: Pablo Peralta Palacios
review_text: A local legend in KL (or PJ, whatever) serving traditional Malaysian dish, Nasi Lemak. The place was CROWDED big time. But we still managed to get a seat and set the order for the famous NL straight away. I guess the usual would be to queue like they love here in Malaysia — national sport 🇲🇾. So after 20/30 minutes we have the NL finally in our face (makes sense given the sheer amount of orang2). Altho I’ve had a grand total of one (1) Nasi Lemaks in my life I would say this one is the best. And the reason is because of their fried chicken, which really was excellent. My girlfriend (indonesian) thought the sambal was too sweet; maybe yeah but I still liked it.

author: alzulaikha humaid
review_text: We had dinner here, and the staff were extremely kind, friendly, and quick to respond. The food was delicious, and we found it hard to decide what to order because of the wide variety of options. We eventually chose the peri peri chicken with mashed potatoes, truffle mushroom cacio e pepe, and French fries. All the dishes were absolutely tasty, but for me, the pizza was the standout. This is definitely the kind of restaurant I’d love to return to and explore more dishes from their menu.

author: Sheila Frye
review_text: The food is great. The service is terrible no one ever in the restaurant but takes over a hour to get the food. Ridiculous. Been coming for years this will be the last time!

author: Mrs Persia
review_text: I kept hearing about this place so I tried it out. I have tontry more food there, but I got a simple breakfast. 2 eggs with homemade corned beef hash and potatos. So they charged me 9.00 for the corned beef hash and when it came it was basically potatos with a sprinkle of meat. I was expecting meat with sprinkle of potatos. Boooooo. It's a cute place but music is so loud it's like eating at a night club. I'll have to give them another chance, try a different meal. My friend's burger looked pretty good.

author: Stephen Ng
review_text: $4.80 for the bak Chor mee. Taste was good. Very generous on the minced meat. The meat was made into a wanton which is quite special. No smell on the meat. 👍 Parking is small. Expect long wait time for parking during meal hours.

author: Nathanael Eng
review_text: Great atmosphere, amazing service!! Auntie here very cute very nice hehe, portion is a lor for an affordable price — would recommend because it’s quite underrated, their chicken rice is flavourful and their rostered chicken very tender and juicy!!

author: Rohee Lee
review_text: Tomyam and omelette were tasty! The fried fish is soso only. Overall the service is good the waitress patiently explain the dishes in mandarin. Will come back again for other dishes next time ☺️

author: Scarlett Sum Yee Yeung
review_text: First time in Vietnam! Google recommended a place called Nha Tu, so my boyfriend and I decided to try their hotpot. After eating all the must-try Vietnamese dishes these past few days, we wanted something different. The hotpot with egg, oyster, and sliced beef was surprisingly delicious! They have most of the Vietname must eat food in the menu also.

author: Jos S
review_text: I give all 5 because Edwin made our night while we were waiting for out server that took a little to come take our order! The food is good, the restaurant is pretty and Edwin was the best! Our server was super nice too but I really wish that Edwin would serve us. He had knowledge of what we were asking but he county take the order, since he could not serve us he was very nice and on top of the service while the server came to the table. No complains for the server, I just want to recognize that it was a team that made our experience nice!

author: chee chin hoe
review_text: Food was tasty. Had the fish head HorFun, ikan keli goreng, kerabu chicken feet & fried bitter gourd. All good. Service could be better though

author: Hulk
review_text: Extremely overrated $9.70 to be exact. Rice was not fragrant at all. Look at the soulless fried egg, it basically represents how my plate of nasi lemak tasted. Chili was it self made? … better off getting it from ntuc shelves. The chicken wings were a sure bet though!

author: Luciana Nascimento
review_text: Ordered some food and asked for well done the meat was burnt that’s not well done and the meat seemed like it’s been cut and sat for hours. The only good thing about the food was the fries. The sausage was raw inside. 38 dollars on food that I barely ate…never ordering again.

author: Syazwan Azizi
review_text: Their dish is so tasty. Thai cuisine is on point, and the price is reasonable. The view is the best when you come at sunset. Their service is own served, and orders will be called by your name to get ready for pickup on your own. The place is big enough for group dining and has more tables. There is plenty of parking, you can park near the entrance or behind.

author: Alvin Wong
review_text: We ordered takeout for dinner. It’s was nicely packed and delicious! The soup was excellent 👍🏼

author: Elton Hiew
review_text: One of the best or if not the best Nasi Kandar you can find in Penang. A lot of variety selection and most importantly is that the price is reasonable. They are not stingy with the sauce (kuah) for their Nasi Kandar. Maggie is also best here. Not sure what spices they used but you can’t find anywhere better for Maggie goreng.

author: Mark T
review_text: Good alternative to Huynh Hoa that’s just around the corner. Larger menu so more options than Huynh Hoa - we ordered roast pork which was delicious. There was no pate/sauce so it could’ve done with a bit more flavour. There’s also seating for about 10 people out the front if you’re dining in.

author: Sadat Irtisum
review_text: Tried the pepperoni pizza at Napoli Pizza, and it was absolutely delicious! From the crispy crust to the flavorful toppings, everything was just right. The cheese was perfectly balanced, and it was served hot and fresh with a cold Coke Zero. Highly recommend if you're in the area!

author: Marina Tichonyuk
review_text: We came for the first time and I am sure for the last. Food was good with a lot of options. But the service is terrible. They require paying up-front! Never saw anything like this. Coming in and have to pay right away. AND put tip there!!! Tip before the service! So disrespectful! And then nobody came over a single time. So tip for what??? Terrible service.

author: Sarah L
review_text: We stopped in for dinner the night before we flew home and it was so worth it. We got the crab dip, lobster and shrimp empanadas and the Cash Cay fried seafood platter (all 3 are appetizers) and it was so much food. But worth it because it was *delicious* (the empanadas were my favourite). We had great service while sitting outside and watching the boardwalk/ocean. Highly recommend this stop if you’re in Hollywood Beach!

author: ECA
review_text: Good spot within a row of establishments. Good food and great service too! Food was good, but I have no way to tell if this is better or worse than other Com Tam spots in Saigon. I personally had the Bun Cha which tasted like the other Bun Cha I had eaten on this trip. Perhaps the consistency across all restaurants should tell me that that is how Bun Cha should taste. Worth a visit if you’re in the area!

author: Chee Kng Lim
review_text: I found Baan during my first foray to Hat Yai as a working adult. We went twice but only ate once. This was because I did not do my research properly; on our first try, they were not open for business. Second time, we should have gone earlier. They open at around 10.30 to 11am and before opening, there would have been a queue forming. Not a long one. If you go during the peak hours, be prepared to wait a while. The menu has been consistent, at least since my last visit. The boss is very friendly and fluent in English. He can give you recommendations if you are in two minds. Our favourites are 1. Tom Yum Seafood Clear 2. Stir Fried Liver 3. Pork and Onion Omelette 4. Sour Glass Noodles Salad with Prawns 5. Thai Sausages (mixed flavours) 6. Grilled Pork They have more items which we have not tried so we look forward to more Hat Yai trips. All these food is topped off with a coconut flower nectar drink which is quite hard to find. I have only ever seen it in their shop and another eatery in Hat Yai.

author: Badar Khoirul Imam
review_text: Lau Pa Sat is one of those places in Singapore that you instantly fall in love with. The moment you step in you will feel the lively ambience with delicious aromas floating from every corner. It is the perfect spot to enjoy local flavors especially if you love exploring food like most Indonesian travelers

author: H.Y.M
review_text: Great food and polite staffing and clean service. Great salad 🥗 preparation, flavors for days. French Fries were perfectly seasoned and fried to perfection. I would recommend announcing greetings at the door for guest entry it would definitely improve overall experience.

author: Dustin Kinzinger
review_text: Review of Hoang's Kitchen, Ho Chi Minh City ROSE 🌹 I recently dined at Hoang's Kitchen, where I was thoroughly impressed by the exceptional fried spring rolls – crispy, flavorful, and an absolute delight to eat. The warm and inviting atmosphere of the restaurant complemented the delicious food perfectly. A particular highlight of my visit was the outstanding service provided by our waitress, Rose. Her attentiveness and friendly demeanor really elevated our dining experience, making us feel valued and well-cared-for. The staff at Hoang's Kitchen, especially Rose, truly made our meal special. Her recommendations were spot on, and her genuine kindness added to the restaurant's welcoming vibe. For anyone visiting Ho Chi Minh City, I highly recommend stopping by Hoang's Kitchen for an unforgettable meal marked by delicious food and exceptional hospitality.

author: MRay Chan
review_text: One of the best place to have your caffeine. The Nitro Nanyang Cold Brew was a bold and refreshing pick-me-up, with its smooth, rich flavor that hit all the right notes. It’s a great experience. Food is good, and the menu offers a wide variety of delicious and mouthwatering food. Nicely presented. Staffs were also proactive and friendly. RonChan25/7/2024

author: Geoffrey Holtsclaw
review_text: You know it's legit when it smells like my grandma's basement (in a good way)! Though it's a little out of the way (it took 2 trains and 2 buses to get here from Manhattan), it's well worth the trek. You're far enough away from the city that the prices aren't egregious and the portions are healthy. Just walking in, you're surrounded by authentic German decor and it feels as if you've been transported directly to a restaurant in Germany. In 1880. The staff is so genial and happy to help with menu questions. We were pleased with all the German options, though my date had to order a collection of sides because that was nearly the only vegetarian choice. But the waitress was very willing to let us make the necessary substitutions and alterations to the menu to make it work, which was very sweet. I got the chicken schnitzel a la Holstein (fried egg on top) and got a little anchovy on top of the egg as a happy surprise! Everything came out and we immediately realized our eyes were larger than our stomachs because the portions are huge! I stuffed myself silly because everything was so tasty, but alas I couldn't finish it. And that's high praise. Sadly, we were so full that we couldn't order dessert, but the options looked great! We'll for sure try to make the pilgrimage back if we have a free evening in the future. And you should too! Guten Appetit!

author: Miss Pink
review_text: I ordered the flying dutch man and received just meat and cheese with a sprinkle of lettuce on top. I even relayed that I wanted the double double with everything on it but with onion instead of a bun and received the wrong order anyway. Please train the employees in proper preparation or they need to admit they don't know what something is. Me and my friend were so excited to try them and we were so disappointed.The fries were also stale and hard.

author: 00i
review_text: I had a chance to visit this restaurant while looking for some Western food during our stay in Bali. The interior was really stylish, and the atmosphere was top-notch. The burger itself was absolutely amazing. This place is definitely one of the best choices for tourists in Bali who want a break from the local Balinese diet.

author: Lauren Stevens
review_text: A beautiful restaurant right next the sea with very friendly and welcoming staff, an amazing live singer every night as well. Food and service was amazing every single time. Definitely will be coming back!

author: justine marie
review_text: August 2024 Amazing breakfast spot in Canggu for açaí and smoothie bowls! The portions were huge and everything was so delicious — fresh, flavorful, and super satisfying. The place has such a nice vibe — relaxed, tropical, and totally fitting for the Canggu atmosphere. The staff were friendly, and the service was fast, which made the experience even better. A must-visit if you’re in the area and craving something fresh and healthy to start your day!

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: May P
review_text: Elegant, spacious and inviting Restaurant with ample seating inside and outside. Expansive beautiful bar area with great Happy Hour offerings and prices every day! Nice plantings give it a tropical flair. Some nice vegetarian, but didn’t see much vegan options. Definitely recommend labeling the offerings so patrons can tell which meals are vegan and or vegetarian as so many other finer establishments do.

author: Tammy Pavelich
review_text: Food was great! Chicken n biscuits and a skillet, both were terrific and filling. Drinks were good, being Canadian, I find it somewhat difficult to find a good Ceasar in the U.S, mine was perfect! General manager was chatting with all the tables, giving a welcoming and relaxed atmosphere. They helped with some tourist attractions and recommendations and made a wonderful start to our day!

author: Hui Ting Ho
review_text: Exceptional service, exceptional food, exceptional ambience. The smell of mutton and spices hits you once you enter the restaurant. A great place for mutton lovers. A restaurant with one of the best service ever!!! Better than many high end restaurants. Staff would provide a hot towel to warm your hands once you’re seated. They would give suggestions to the food to order and would promptly replace our plates with new ones. We have a baby with us, and the staff would switch on the lights to the unopened area of the restaurant to let our baby look at the fish to entertain him. This is the restaurant where my baby is willing to sit on the high chair for the longest time! Likely because the chair is comfy. Staff would also try to entertain him and even gave him a stuffed toy as a gift! Would definitely come back again and highly recommended!!

author: Esther Mbiwan
review_text: I love fish! I recently tried swordfish for the first time, and I have to say, I was not disappointed! It was tender, flavorful, and absolutely delicious. It's quickly become my new favorite. The food was amazing! If you enjoy seafood, then Legal Sea Foods is the place to go! I’ll definitely be back for more!! The service was excellent as well.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Dar Tsai
review_text: Fr, the broth is next lvl. It's like, so rich n comforting but also has that perfect peppery kick from the garlic ＆ herbs. Srsly hits the spot. It's super flavorful tho not heavy - u could drink it all day. Best part? They give free refills.

author: Leslie Escobar
review_text: Very cute place decorated. I found this place through tiktok. The salsa that came with the chips was resturant stlye pace sauce not authentic. The michelada was more of a bloody Mary. I came to find a good molcajete and the intention was there but lacked authentic flavor. Prices were on the higher end. I will not be returning and authenticity being the factor.

author: Monique Sanges
review_text: The Figueroa Philly cheesecake was legit. So juicy anx i LOVED the mushrooms. sides are big so we definitely didn't need two sides for two people. Pricey, but you do get pretty big portions. I been coming here since my kid was a toddler and he's 10 this year... my favorite Philly cheesecake place.

author: Anthony McCool
review_text: I do like this place. No chicken sandwich only burgers? Well that will limit my visits as my wife doesn't eat beef. Great service!!! See our YouTube channel Coolest Life.

author: David Dars
review_text: We are so glad we skipped Bubba Gumps and cane to Kuba. Awesome service by all the staff, good food and good prices. The Crispy Boniatos was new to us and so tasty we would go back just for those. The meals were very good but we would have enjoyed a bit more spice but this was our first for Cuban style food. Shredded flank steak with salad and shredded pork with rice/black beans

author: Thị Minh Tâm Trần
review_text: With the price of 165k/ticket, the food is quite good, pig breast, clams, fatty intestines, beef rolls with needles, seafood mango salad, delicious shrimp. The beef is not good, the pieces are big and tough with lots of tendons, the clams are too gritty The tables and chairs are probably dirty because there are too many staff, but the staff is cheerful and friendly Not charging for parking is also a plus, the parking space is spacious The space is quite ok compared to other places that have to climb up and down to get food => With that price, 4*, maybe next time ⭐ Suggestion: the snail dishes are already cooked, so put them on the cooked food counter and not together with the raw food. BUT WHY ARE THERE NO OYSTERS??? I WANT TO EAT OYSTERS WITH CHEESE!!! ⭐⭐⭐

author: Jane Gammad
review_text: I had a wonderful dining experience at PS. Cafe East Coast Brunch (Dinner with Fam) The service was excellent, staff were attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was perfect throughout our meal 🙂 The food was not only beautifully presented but also full of flavor, with every dish tasting fresh and well-prepared. Truly a great place to enjoy good food and warm hospitality. Highly recommended and big shoutout to Ms. Bernie 👏 Filipino hospitality always goes above and beyond, we surely back again!

author: jessihizenberg
review_text: Anh Mâp Restaurant is a straightforward local spot with budget-friendly Vietnamese food. Nothing extraordinary, but everything is decent: portions are filling, flavors are honest, and service is quick. A good choice when you want something simple, tasty, and cheap.

author: kkkami
review_text: This place is really secret! All of the staff is really friendly and helpful. The restaurant is located on the top of the building, so you have to go up stairs but it’s worth! All of dishes are delicious!

author: yc
review_text: Please use the QueQ app to book your place else expect to wait for a very long time. We came on a Wednesday evening and had 89 people ahead of us. Ordered the Tom Yum Mama (everything except the crab meat) and crispy pork. The noodles was very good as it soaked up the Tom yum nicely. Every bite was divine. The ingredients tbh was not anything special. Meatball were slightly dry but if you dip in the Tom yum it’s ok. Squid was slightly tough to chew. The crispy pork was ok not fantastic. I would definitely return for the noodles as it was superb.

author: Giuseppe Digiamma
review_text: Felix is one of the best places I've been in the last few months. Food is amazing, staff extra caring and accommodating. Never felt so much welcomed in a place being there for the first time! From the greetings to the service and the attention received during the meal all was outstanding!!! I'll definitely go back and try more of their dishes!!! AMAZING!!

author: Pete Deserto
review_text: The spicy cauliflower burrito bowl over lettuce is a delicious and refreshing meal on a hot summer day. The crispy cauliflower, combined with flavorful guacamole and mango salsa, creates a delightful explosion of taste. The freshness of the lettuce adds a nice crunch to each bite. Overall, it's a tasty option for those seeking a flavorful and healthy dish.

author: むむー
review_text: I've been in Danang for the past 1 months having 2 coffee everyday, the worst coconut coffee I've ever had. First, I came in and ordered medium coconut coffee and waited 20 mins. There's a 6,7 drinks order before me so I accept to wait but when I went to ask when my coffee is coming they totally forgot about my order. If the coffee tasted good, I wouldn't even complain because anybody can make mistake. But the coffee which came late was just 70 percent ice blended, bery subtle coconut flavour and made me regret coming here. The atmosphere is nice, with some fan located around the chairs.

author: Lois Alton
review_text: Every time I go, I'm never disappointed with the service or food. The only place I go to for breakfast. The amount of food they give you is enough for two. They also offer grits. A staple for my breakfast. Denny's and IHOP doesn't even serve grits.

author: Laurence Mercier-Lafond
review_text: Just WOW! Will definitely be back soon! We were lucky enough to get seated early on a Thursday night without a reservation. My boyfriend said he’d come back here for their bavette steak rather than go to a steakhouse, it was THAT good! He even ate the artichoke which is a miracle! Everything was delicious. We also enjoyed the Arroz Sec, Tomato Bread, and Mahon + Chorizo. The skin contact wine Mission was funky & delicious. Service & ambiance were super pleasant

author: Eric Woodbey
review_text: I've been coming here since I was in elementary school, and it's been a favorite ever since. Over the years, they've introduced new dishes, retired some old ones, and changed up a few recipes—but they've also stayed true to what makes their food so good. Everything is delicious, but the grilled chicken is something special. I don't know how they marinate it, but it's easily one of my all-time favorites—tender, flavorful, and unforgettable.

author: Anton Ego
review_text: I was really disappointed with my visit to Boleh Seafood at Jalan Bukit Bintang. The food was not great at all — definitely not delicious as expected. On top of that, the cleanliness was very poor. I even saw a cockroach while I was there, which made me lose my appetite. With so many better food options in Bukit Bintang, I would not recommend this place. Hopefully the management improves both the hygiene and food quality.

author: Justin Stein
review_text: Great outdoor but covered spot, delicious food and cool vibe. Our Arepitas and shrimp cocktail were a great start, and the Mahi Tacos were incredible, coupled with my wife’s Smash Burger that was perfect. Only knock was long wait to see our server, but she was great afterwards.

author: Moses P
review_text: Perfect place for big group who like to enjoy typical Indonesian foods! The place is classic modern and plenty of spaces. Staffs are friendly and polite. I like this place, i will be back!

author: Jennifer
review_text: Went to this location earlier during the week and had a great experience! The moment I walked in, Jillian not only greeted me with a bright smile but took my order really fast! She was very professional, friendly and gave me a great drink recommendation! I decided to eat in-house and was impressed by Noah's diligence in keeping the dining room spotless and making sure everyone was good. He even took the time to check in on me, offering extra napkins and sauces - great service! Will definitely come back 😊

author: Đức Trần
review_text: Nice spot to hang out with friends. Will visit again next time!

author: G Lachhayya
review_text: Absolutely delightful dessert! The crème brûlée was perfectly caramelized, with a rich, smooth custard underneath. The fresh fruit topping added a lovely balance of sweetness and freshness. Every bite was enjoyable. The presentation was beautiful, and the quality was excellent. It was a perfect way to end the meal. Highly recommended!

author: Average Guy
review_text: Good, will come again if I’m in the area. But I don’t think I will make a special trip just to have this. One thing is for sure, the beef tendons were very very soft. Loved them. But I thought the beef balls were just normal.

author: Gobert
review_text: Mee goreng is nice, the staff used to be very friendly, but now just normal. Still one of our fav place to chill during supper time.

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: Cindy Aurellia
review_text: i loveeeeee these. look how sexy is this. i mean all of it just taste okay but the chicken taste so damn good. we got fishball soup for free thanks!! i also always like vegetables with these sauces. i juat hope the sambal can be better, its kinda bitter and no flavor. my mom even came back to take food away to the hotel 😂😂 ate other dishes and it didnt dissapoint me. out of topic but this restaurant has a good music taste 😃 love yall

author: Destry Sagita
review_text: On my mom's phone like usual to make a review since she's not the kind of person who makes reviews. But anyways, we went to BM Yam Rice Kopitiam on our last day (which was the day we were going to go home) in Penang, 7 October which was yesterday for lunch. Ordered the signature yam rice with pork soup (there were two bowls of pork soup, one with what i think is what usually is, pork belly, a type of pork cut i don't know and meatballs.)The other bowl had some weirder cuts (that i don't like but my parents love) think there was pork intestine but i forgot the pork cuts/parts of the rest in that soup. The bowl of pork soup i had (that i ate most of it on my own too) was the one without pork intestine (my parents shared that bowl of soup) and IMO of my taste buds, it tasted pretty good. The pork soup had some chopped pickled mustard greens (i think that's the English name) too but they didn't taste very sour (which i liked since i often find the pickled vegetable too sour) and they made (at least, i think they were the cause) the soup a little sour-ish, which tasted good in the soup, not too sour but just sour enough to be refreshing in a way. The pork itself in the soup tasted great too. And the pork soup was a great combo with the yam rice. The yam rice was a little salty but it was really good, i don't quite know how to describe the taste but i really liked it, especially paired with the pork soup. Oh yeah, we also ordered the braised tofu and egg which were good too. I had specially drank some of the soup and ate some of the pork and a little of my yam rice before picking some pork (and a meatball) and a half braised egg and placed them in my yam rice before chopping the egg with my spoon and mixing the yam rice with it and with the pork and meatball too (it tasted great!) I don't know how much it costed since my parents were the one that paid and they forgot how much it was. But anyways, i'd say this place was a pretty solid 4/5 out of 5 stars, though i put it four stars since i only went there once (oh and that time was also my first time eating yam rice, so yam rice had a pretty good first impression on me from this place) Anyways, i would recommend this place to people going to Penang and haven't decided what to eat yet (and especially if they haven't eaten yam rice before or like yam rice) And yep, that's all, it's a little long but oh well, overall, it was a great experience (and as usual, i was the last one to finish my bowl, since i like doing everything and maybe especially eating at my own pace)

author: Coriandermixxx
review_text: The place is super hype and people will queue for hours! There are two options for queuing: Use the QueQ app (recommended for faster process) Or come directly to the restaurant. We used the app and only waited about 10 minutes in front of the restaurant. What we ordered: 1. Roasted Pork 🐖 – 4/5 Good, but tastes similar to what you find at the night market. 2. Mama Noodle 🍜 (Roasted Pork & Seafood) – 4/5 This is the specialty here. Toppings are generous (prawn, squid). Noodles are too thin for my taste. If you can eat spicy, go for it! Otherwise, the sourness dominates. 3. Salmon Salad 🐟🥗– 4/5 Good, but again similar to night market quality. 💡 Tip: For roasted pork and salmon, the night market is better value – same quality, cheaper price, and bigger portion.

author: Skye Cai
review_text: Great yellow curry crab meat. Not too oily. the crab meat is jumbo and fresh. The meat is sweet doesn’t have strong taste. Goes very well with the curry. The red chilli cloves on top is a little spicy. Friendly staff that will great everyone. Queue is massy but once get the queue number it’s quite fast. CASH ONLY!

author: Eda A.
review_text: Quality, cleanliness, speed and aesthetics all in one place, a place you can come every meal of the day.👏✨️✌️✅️

author: Estrella Sagarzazu
review_text: Beautiful waterfront Italian restaurant with exceptional service from Regina. Delicious food, creative drinks, and a perfect atmosphere for a great time. We enjoyed the weekend lunch special — 50% off made it even better! Highly recommend.

author: Marie-Eve Racine
review_text: Tucked away in a small alley, but well worth the detour. Quality food at very affordable prices, often with a special to introduce a typical dish. Sometimes they offer a combo with a drink with the plate, and that's worth it too.🤓 There is also a water station if you don't want a special drink. The decor, ambiance, and space are all very pleasant, whether you want to eat or have a drink while you work. We went there almost every day after we tried it, so much did we enjoy it. The staff is super friendly and helpful, making it a must-visit restaurant in our eyes.🤗

author: Rachel Cheung
review_text: I’m very picky in a way that I know enough about ingredients and cooking techniques so believe me when I give them a rare 5 stars from me. Top quality ingredients, hummus was silky smooth you can taste every subtle flavors because they use good chickpeas, spice, and olive oil. Then the mixed grilled platter with lamb chop/ kebab were outstanding. Juice clean fat and well cooked. Desserts are pretty but too sweet in my opinion. Wonderful service our Ecuadorian waiter was excellent!

author: Daniel Herrera
review_text: Delicious and affordable pizza-by-the slice! Very hard to find these days, perfect for a quick lunch stop. Restaurant was clean, spacious and has multiple TVs for viewing. Erika was very friendly and accommodating. Hooked me up with a slice and side salad. Salad was big and very tasty with lots of veggies in it. Pepperoni pizza was crispy and hot and not too greasy. Slice was not huge, but on the bigger side. There were lots of options for slices when I went in. So far a Hidden gem!

author: Q w
review_text: We came with 6 pax and ordered 3sets of pork and beef , was extremely enough . The food was super delicious. Mr Ben and other staff who serviced us during the dinner were very nice . Food, people , entertainment all made us a happy one. Would definitely come again and highly recommend!

author: Camila García Varas
review_text: Best brunch in town! Delicious & Good pricing. Definitely coming back!

author: Supakij Khomvilai
review_text: Good Singaporean restaurant. Found it from review in YouTube and other recommendations somewhere. Our group of 13 people are really enjoyed our lunch there. We made a reservation through WhatsApp of the restaurant which is the easiest way to do and I recommend you to do it to secure your seating. Seating area are air conditioned. Every dish are really good, fresh ingredients and well cooked. Price are reasonable. Credit card accepted. Staffs are helpful. Enjoy!

author: Jennifer Stewart
review_text: Great location! We sat outside to enjoy the view, people watch, and listen to music from nearby restaurants. Ernest was very attentive and had excellent suggestions for menu items to try out. Portions for the mains are generous- so bring a healthy appetite or get a to go box. Everything we tried was flavorful and fresh. It was helpful to have photos of the menu items and drinks.

author: Alvi Rahman
review_text: Excellent food, amazing service. The latte art stuff is incredible, we printed a photo of our son on a caramel macchiato put a huge smile on our faces and was delicious. Very accommodating with high chairs and friendly service.

author: F'burg Foodie
review_text: While working in the area a co-worker suggested we try this tapas joint. Went in on a weeknight and they were pretty busy, so be sure to make reservations. Service was really good during our entire stay. The menu is loaded with some really nice, appetizing Spanish dishes. But what impressed me most was that the food was very nicely prepared! After going to another local “Spanish” joint nearby I was very unimpressed with the way they prepared their food and felt that most all places with that outdated exterior and interior were going to be this way… It was refreshing to find this place that has a very updated and beautifully decorated interior and food to match. Bottom line – Definitely worth visiting, but make reservations! Oh, and get the paella!

author: PA Muller
review_text: Really nice place! The service was good and the food was delicious! We sat by the window with a nice view of the water and yachts. I will say it was very expensive. We got two plates of food and two drinks for a total of almost $100. It was definitely an experience. Thank you, Land Shark!

author: Lavender Star
review_text: Awesome customer service. Top notch food. Will definitely be back, often.

author: Evon Ong
review_text: Order for nasi goreng no bawang but still have. The staff here so terrible, can't even understand the order. We order Milo ais but he still wrote limau ais. We double check the order because the staff look so confuse. Then he only let us see what he wrote. The end it wrote wrongly then he only start correct the order. No more next visit. Alert!

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Victor Caindec
review_text: As tourists in Singapore, this is our favorite go-to place for bah ku teh. Food is consistently great (see photo), and the service is always pleasant. Deanna and her team deserve 5 stars. Will be back again soon.

author: Miki T.
review_text: It’s classic Thai Pendant pancake I ate it since I was young. Always go to take a few if I go to Siam, same taste and same price.

author: Anthony Maxwell
review_text: It was a wonderful experience. Actually, I was told to go here by my side and just a lap and a friend of mine. When is some nachos so we went here? The service was great. The food was fresh i had the enchilada nachos.I left a picture, the music was cool, and the atmosphere was cool. Great spot to sit down and have something to eat or to drink. I definitely will go back..

author: sarah bender
review_text: came here on a whim, the first time since the remodel.. and WOW! Martin was our server, he was super accommodating and kind. We ordered the tomahawk steak and 2 salads and everything was prepared perfectly. We will definitely be back.

author: Shanru
review_text: Beautiful restaurant with great views of the ocean from the windows. We were able to be seated before sunset — highly recommend getting a reservation. The whipped eggplant was unique and delicious as well, and the service was friendly. It felt a bit crowded inside the restaurant, with the seats and tables crammed next to each other, and it was harder to talk as it was very loud inside. The food also took longer than expected to come out, but it was nice to sit and enjoy the views.

author: Alison Pouw
review_text: same owners as radio bakery. went for brunch and got the egg tostada. i would love to go back and try the pancake. the egg tostada was good but needed a bit more flavor/salt - a bit oily. it was good but not incredible. the grapefruit juice was incredible if you’re into that. cute decor inside too.

author: Maizura Shahril
review_text: We visited this place during our short trip to Jakarta, and with all the buzz around it, it became our very first stop for a meal after landing. We managed to beat the crowd by arriving around 3pm and only had to wait about 5 minutes before getting in. The atmosphere, the staff, and especially the food were all amazing. The food was seriously delicious, the portions were generous, and the prices were very affordable. Definitely a place I’d come back to if I ever visit Jakarta again!

author: Robert Fang
review_text: Always a great experience here. Portions are big and the service is great. The quality of food is awesome and I'm never disappointed. They have a great menu with unique items and flavors. We always come back to try new things. A great brunch place though it does get very busy. Arrive early or after the rush and you'll be seated pretty quickly.

author: Bethany Ely
review_text: The Food is good and tastes authentic. They provide large portions. The environment is fun, vibrant, and loud. FYI, they add 18% to your ticket no matter what you order.

author: Portia Freeman
review_text: Positives: Service was fairly good, they were attentive, they let us switch our table to the lounge seats when we asked at a quiet time. The ambiance is very nice, and the view is to die for! It’s perfect to go at sunset so you can watch it over the ocean on this rooftop restaurant. I got the Oaxacan old fashioned, it was strong and delicious. Negatives: I heard so much about this whipped eggplant dip. It’s just a very small plate of velvety spread, and it mildly tastes of eggplant. It came with a huge plate of puffed up pita, which looked cool and was nice to rip into as a table. The spread and the pita as a whole just didn’t seem worth the hype? It wasn’t bad, but it was kind of nothing. My main gripe is that you realistically go through the entire spread before you get even halfway through the pita. We also ordered the ragu, pesto, polenta and mushrooms, and a vodka pasta. All of it, ESPECIALLY the ragu, was unbelievably salty. I am not shy about salt, and unfortunately, I am known to oversalt when I cook at home because I know how much the right amount of salt can elevate a dish, but it was so salty, it made my mouth hurt slightly. It was a bummer that the over salting showed up in every single pasta dish. I also didn’t appreciate the undercooked egg white in the polenta. It was pretty gooey… Lastly, this is more of a pet peeve of mine, but they took one of the plates of pasta away when approx a quarter of the dish was left. The server didn’t ask if we wanted it boxed. Usually, I’d say something or stop them before they whisked it away, but it was so mediocre and salty that I didn’t really care to not have it again. Go for the ambiance and a nice cocktail, not the food. It may be disappointing, at least given how much hype this restaurant has received in LA.

author: Michele Hallahan
review_text: The place is very spacious, so the wait is never too long. If at all. The food is always good. I've never been dissatisfied with anything. And they are very accommodating if you want to change something. Our server was extremely nice and efficient. Quick, friendly service done right. I hate that I forgot her name, but she was great.

author: Kartiyayini Sinathurai
review_text: Good quality Food , especially roti and fried chicken . Only problem with the take away service , once you ordered you have to stand beside them and stare non stop then only they will start to make your food . If you went to sit waiting for the order to get prepared it will take forever and they will ignore , happens few times , probably because it’s just take away and they are prioritising dine in customers or my order was too small

author: Katy Huang
review_text: The go-to tapa place in Miami. Quality ingredients paired with authentic flavors of Spanish cuisine makes dining at NIU kitchen an outstanding experience.

author: Thomas
review_text: An extremely popular place, rightfully so - Delicious Banh Mi’s, good choice of drinks and well priced. Only one small point is when you do takeaway, you don’t get access to the dips and sauces which usually help make the bread less dry, however if you dine in you get access to plenty of different dips kept on your table. A couple of chilly sauce packs for takeaway would be nice (many places do that already).

author: Ivan Beh
review_text: The yam rice, pork ball and soup is nice, can’t find it in KL, worth to wait (almost 30 to 45 minutes)

author: Cindy Ronald
review_text: What a great find! Our group of four walked in without a reservation to this intimate Jamaican restaurant, and were accommodated. Our server, Jimmy was great explaining the dishes and offering advice. Food was delicious! This is definitely a repeat spot when we return.

author: Miss Billionaire
review_text: Just a nice first try at this shop OK chicken rice. The food was fresh and high quality. Like it so much !

author: Xueting Alford
review_text: Had this meal last Thursday. Everything was great! Especially the service! The waitor was very considerate and sweet!

author: Elatse
review_text: Tampines Round Market is a fantastic spot for fresh food at unbeatable prices. The market is always clean and well-maintained, making it a pleasant experience for shoppers. I love the variety of stalls offering everything from fresh produce to delicious cooked meals. The atmosphere is lively, with friendly vendors ready to help you find what you need. It’s a great place to explore local flavors without breaking the bank. Parking can be a bit tricky during peak hours, but it’s worth the visit for quality and affordability. Highly recommend for anyone looking to enjoy authentic local cuisine!

author: daezjn
review_text: Visited on a Wednesday at 6 PM- quiet at the time, but highly recommended by family and friends. The food is reasonably priced and delicious! Their signature Ipoh-style short and thick bean sprouts are fresh, crunchy, and lightly stir-fried. The pork balls are bouncy, and the white chicken is well-seasoned with pepper and served with a tasty sauce. But for me, the real highlight was the noodles- delicate, smooth, handmade, and light. Skip the rice and go for the noodles! Drink options include leong sui, iced Chinese tea, etc., though unfortunately, they serve drinks in disposable plastic cups instead of glass- would love to see less plastic waste. Service is brisk and efficient, and the restaurant has that classic old-school Chinese eatery vibe- no frills, no air conditioning, but well-ventilated with strong fans. The decor is effortlessly nostalgic, with eclectic pictures, paintings, a Chinese calendar, and a traditional praying altar. The bright green walls, uniforms, and colorful tableware add to the charm.
