It’s also impressively clean for this style of restaurant- no slippery floors or greasy kitchen surfaces. Plus, the back kitchen even has a view of some back alley wall art! Definitely coming back.

author: Dil ki bt
review_text: Loaded Nachos - These nachos are the perfect snack when you’re craving something cheesy and indulgent.

author: Ilah Rusli
review_text: Went there few times.. so far all good. I love the sandwich and poke bowl.

author: Veamas Wahyu Saputra
review_text: Great atmosphere and service, thou the fnb is pricey, it's worth it

author: Anthony W
review_text: Review of Raising Cane’s – 828th Location Rating: 8.5/10 This location offered the most generous portion sizes I’ve ever received at any Raising Cane’s, making the price point feel especially reasonable for Boston. As someone who has visited over 25 Cane’s locations across the United States, I can confidently say this was the least clean among them. That said, the all-gold aesthetic and the unique sentimental value tied to it being the 828th restaurant add a distinct charm that sets it apart. Despite the cleanliness concerns, the visual experience and symbolic significance make this one of the most memorable Cane’s locations I’ve visited.

author: Irwin Wainwright
review_text: Such a wholesome fun bar perfect place for a good meal if you’re hungry or a good drink at the end of a work day! Karaoke is a blast every Friday and the bartenders Renea, Marissa , and Zoe are the best

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: The WAT31
review_text: The food was amazing. The chicken was tender, even the breast was tender surprisingly. Rice balls packs a lot of chicken flavour compared to the plate of rice. Additional star since owner gave us a free bowl of soup with fishball. Would recommend and the taste is on par or slightly lacking compared to Singapore chicken rice.

author: Sam Root
review_text: Good country breakfast with a massive portion.. If you looking for a quick bite to eat in the morning it is a great option right off the main road. Service was good with a nice ambiance. Place was clean and the staff was very friendly.

author: christopher varner
review_text: Was there for dinner very early, with my inlaws, so only saw the early bird crowd. I had the haddock which was surprisingly good. It has an old Vegas vibe, complete with a large chandelier over the baby grand. The restaurant side is non-smoking. Would definitely go back.

author: Mario Reyna
review_text: The food and service was excellent! There was a good balance of checking in and letting us enjoy the food, atmosphere, and overall vibe of the place. It was not busy at 5pm on a Saturday, which I really enjoyed. Definitely worth the drive.

author: Kenson Luk
review_text: Best shaved ice I have ever had. I got the Thai milk tea bingsu. It had 3 kinds of bubbles and croutons inside, whip cream and sliced almonds, the ice was very soft and light.

author: Zackery Goh
review_text: I recently visited Pison Cafe, and I can confidently say it was an exceptional dining experience! From the moment I walked in, the cozy atmosphere and friendly staff made me feel right at home. The menu offers a delightful variety of dishes, and I was particularly impressed by the freshness and quality of the ingredients. I tried their signature avocado toast, and it was simply divine! The bread was perfectly toasted, topped with ripe avocados, a sprinkle of feta, and a drizzle of balsamic glaze. For my main course, I indulged in their savory quinoa bowl, which was a harmonious blend of flavors and textures. Each bite was bursting with freshness, and the presentation was top-notch! The coffee is another highlight; it’s evident that they take great care in sourcing their beans. I had a cappuccino that was both rich and creamy, making it the perfect companion to my meal. Overall, Pison Cafe is a must-visit for anyone looking for delicious, wholesome food in a welcoming setting. I can’t wait to return and explore more of their menu! Highly recommended!

author: J Seng
review_text: Small hawker center on second floor. Notable stalls are fried carrot cake, nasi lemak, bak chor mee, kopi etc. Look for stalls with long queue for popular food items.

author: Al Martinez
review_text: This is now one of my favorite places. Went here on a perfect night with cool weather and clear skys. This place is absolutely amazing for an evening eating oysters and steak 🥩 and smoking cigar by the water. Glorious views of the marina. Amazing service and food. Will definitely return for brunch and weekends to check out the live music.

author: Chutikarn Sukchote
review_text: Love everything about hoi an, especially this cafe. Good coffee, good vibe, good spot to take pic and talking chilling. The coconut coffee is a bit sweet for me but overall would be 9/10!

author: Kayla Lujan
review_text: Quick spot for a sweet treat. We got Nutella and PN&J both were good! Messy but they have a small AC area next door (most people dont see it) so there was seating to snack on these!

author: Joyce Lau
review_text: Crispy, flavourful Thai-style dishes! The fried fish was perfectly crunchy with lots of garlic, and the salads were fresh and well-balanced. Great comfort food 👍 Definitely coming back for their food!!

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: Frog Green
review_text: The food was delicious, sushi was perfect and tasted like the real deal! Drinks were beautiful and tasted refreshing and sweet. The pizza was filled with toppings, it was yummy only thing is that the crust n dough is a bit stiff..not the ones like pizzahut/domino but overall it was amazing for a vegetarian dish. The service was great, they were very kind and sweet. The sushi is overall worth the price, I'd definitely come back again and try more sushi and other dishes.

author: Erin
review_text: This place was really sad. Management and workers aren’t very friendly, always in a rush to get people out of the seats. Not even accommodating to families either. They chased a kid and his family out because the kid only eats French fries, even though the rest of the family was going to be buying a meal. Wow. Guess the 10 dollars from a kids meal was such a loss that they didn’t want the money from the rest of the family. Rest of the food was super fatty, no real good cuts of meat.

author: Howcan Eats
review_text: A pretty standard nasi lemak - not outstanding but also nothing that we would complain about. Offers a good variety of ingredients, most of which tasted freshly cooked. The sambal had a good heat and paired well with the coconut rice. Do note that ikan bilis and peanuts are offered as separate ala carte ingredients and do not come with the rice by default. The standout ingredient though is the chicken wing - freshly fried, crispy and wonderfully aromatic.

author: Mohit Rohilla
review_text: One should definitely visit this restaurant. New vibrant looks. Nice atmosphere. Team is super fast. Food is really delicious.

author: Hashlye Gonzalez
review_text: Horrible place! Took an hour for my order to come out wrong . I ordered a 20 boneless original hot but instead got a 10 LEMON PEPPER . Outrageous. Every time I come here they don’t serve wings instead they serve chicken nuggets . What is that . I need a refund and a Time Machine for my time wasted . Don’t come here .

author: Gege Miami
review_text: We ordered a burger cooked medium rare, but the experience was extremely disappointing. First, they brought us a patty that was completely burnt and dry — clearly overcooked. After we complained, they brought a replacement, but this time the burger was completely raw inside — cold, red, and visibly uncooked. We refused to pay for it, but the staff insisted that this was their standard for medium rare. That is simply not true. People at the next table agreed with us — they were also surprised that the restaurant considered this to be medium rare. Only thanks to a gentleman at the neighboring table who supported us and spoke up, the restaurant finally agreed to remove the burger from our bill. We were very disappointed with both the food and the staff’s attitude. We won’t be coming back.

author: Foodtastic Critic
review_text: Went around 7pm with friends for a bite to eat. Our waiter was funny and on point. Appetizers came out, and the portion of the salads was huge and beautiful with fresh lettuce. Entrées came out right after the skirt steak was mouth-watering as it cut like butter. Chicken parm had way ti much sauce n cheese as you couldn't find the cutlet under all that cheese as for the baked ziti was dry not enough sauce or meat way to much cheese that overwhelmed the sauce to a lite pale orange sauce which was not appealing n very lil mozzarella cheese on top. I would not order the baked ziti again. Bathrooms were cleaned n plenty of free parking

author: Jayne Collins
review_text: Decided to go for one of their signature coffees, and opted for the coconut green rice ice coffee, it was like drinking rice pudding and totally delicious. The other drink we ordered was the iced coconut coffee, again delicious. Really nice peaceful part of Hoi An right on the riverside, so pleased the pilot on our flight recommended it to us. Excellent spot to escape the busy streets

author: Gita Primasari
review_text: I have team lunch with my colleagues in here. Their place is quite pretty and the serving time is fast. Most of the fish menus price tag is “market price”. So it’s quite surprise for us when we found out in bill that the grouper fish is cost 500k. I think you need strategy when you visit here. pick your dish well, then you will be happy when you are eating your food. Food 4/5 Ambience 5/5 Service 4/5

author: LY Jun
review_text: My 3rd time here! Love the spicy pork & seafood hotpot + mama noodle! It’s a must to order here! & the grill pork jowl is tasty, soft & nice thickness!

author: Fany
review_text: Great food but I called to let them know about lemonade drink tasted like water , answer but hanged up on me. Just wanted to let them know so it can be fixed.

author: Roberto G
review_text: August 10, 2025 – My First and Last Visit I finally went to this sushi place my fiancé had been bragging about. I was excited… until I experienced the service. This is my personal opinion based on my personal experience. The food is good — but when customer service is this bad, the quality doesn’t matter. My order number was 141, and I waited 55 minutes before my food came out. Yes, they were busy, but here’s the problem: there should be a system in place — at least one dedicated cook or staff member for dine-in customers so they’re not stuck waiting while take-out orders flood the kitchen. By the time my food arrived, my hunger and patience were gone. For me, this was the first and last time I’ll be here. Advice for anyone thinking of visiting: Call ahead, place your order by phone, and give yourself at least an hour before you expect to eat. Owner/manager, if you read this — take it as constructive criticism. Good food might get people in the door, but bad service will keep them from coming back.

author: Farhan Eram
review_text: We came with a party of nearly 32 people and even despite the immense traffic - service and quality of food was nothing short of terrific. We all left the establishment on the cold winter night feeling full, warm and most importantly, SATISFIED. Thats the Namkeen way!

author: Wolf Hester
review_text: All prices on Menu exclude: - Service Charges 10% 😬 - GST 9% Hope the food is worth it. Food extremely tasty. Amend your prices on the menu.. to include the above charges..

author: Leonard Wan
review_text: This cafe (kopitiam) is located in a residential flat area that is slightly remote from the main traffic. I came here for an afternoon tea, had a hot milk coffee and toast with butter and egg. The coffee is normal, not too sweet. I love the toast however. What I appreciate is the pricing, they are so much affordable. The environment is pretty decent too. Not too hot, not crowded, you can enjoy your afternoon tea quietly and peacefully there.

author: Xiang Liu
review_text: Exceptional service & unforgettable experience at La Brisa La Brisa never disappoints, but this visit truly stood out because of the incredible service from Gilang. From the moment we arrived, he went above and beyond to make sure our experience was special. He was attentive without being intrusive, warm, professional, and genuinely cared that we were having a great time. The food and drinks were excellent — beautifully presented, full of flavor, and perfectly timed. We enjoyed a bottle of wine, and Gilang’s recommendations and attention throughout the evening made it even better. He checked in on us thoughtfully and handled everything with such ease and kindness. It’s rare to come across service that feels this sincere. Gilang is a real asset to La Brisa and absolutely deserves recognition. Because of him, this wasn’t just a meal — it was an experience we’ll remember and happily return for. Highly recommend La Brisa, and if you’re lucky enough to be looked after by Gilang, you’re in great hands. 🌿🍷

author: Franco Scardino
review_text: Great food and drinks! The mushroom tacos and hamachi appetizers were a real standout. The cheese empanada was reminiscent of a calzone, but more delicate and refined. The crispy lamb is a must and bursting with flavor.

author: B E V V Y J I L L
review_text: The Best Babi Guling in Ubud! 🐷 One of the reasons I love Bali is because of its amazing food, and for me, Babi Guling Oka 3 serves the best babi guling in town! When I first visited Bali in February 2024, my driver highly recommended it and I’m so glad he did! The flavors were unforgettable, making it a must-visit for me every time I return.When I returned to Bali in October, I knew I had to come back. However, due to a feast, they were closed for three days, and I had to patiently wait before I could satisfy my cravings. But when they finally reopened OMG, it was so worth it! I ended up buying a lot because I just couldn’t resist. 🔹 The Babi Guling – The crispy skin, tender and juicy meat, and perfectly blended spices make this dish absolutely irresistible! 🔹 Authenticity – This is the best and most authentic babi guling I’ve ever had in Bali, especially in Ubud. 🔹 Consistency – Even after months, the quality and taste remain top-notch, making it a must-visit every time I’m in Bali. If you’re ever in Ubud, you CANNOT miss Babi Guling Oka 3. It’s hands-down the best place for babi guling, and a place that keeps me coming back to Bali

author: END ADVENTURES
review_text: We were recommended by our Air BnB host. And they were right in the mark. The menu is large, has so much available, something for everyone! We started with a Bellini and a mimosas flight. Amber was attentive and friendly. The food was great, especially the sour dough toast. Clean, airy, music playing. Definitely recommend. Erin EnD Adventures

author: Anja A.
review_text: This place is amazing! We went two times in a short period of time since we were thinking about their food and other dishes we haven't tried. Some of the must tries are: Barbari Bread, Yellow French Bean Borani, Citrus Date & Cabbage Salad, Lamb Ribs, Grilled Scallops, Eggplant.

author: Ong
review_text: Ordered the Crispy Pork stir fried with Basil and it's the bomb! Highly recommended! I was already full but I still ate the entire plate. My friend order the spicy crab rice and it was also saap and delicious. Will definitely be back again for more!

author: Rochelle Flores
review_text: I gave 3 stars on atmosphere, because we had a drive through order. Food was better this time, the last time we ordered, our bean burrito was a sad paste of a bean something. It didn’t taste like beans, it look like it was just a layer of bean paste, and called it a burrito.

author: Kimberly Schmaus
review_text: Olay (sorry if I spelled it wrong) was an amazingly attentive, kind, funny, and surprisingly intuitive server (he had a feeling I wanted a green Thai tea which is exactly what I wanted, and I didn’t verbalize it to anyone at all)! The food was so delicious along with green Thai tea and Thai iced coffee that we got, not pictured since they were devoured quickly. Where I live on the east coast, I’ve tried pretty much all the hot spot Thai places and none of them are as good as this place. We also tried the mango sticky rice, and it was so good that we decided to order another one as well as the fried banana with ice cream, which did not disappoint. We will be back here the next time we’re in Vegas! :) (also, I took the entree picture after we had already eaten)

author: Dolly
review_text: To start off, our waitress Karla was amazing! This was our first time here and I came with my fur baby. We were in the area and decided to give this place a shot. As New Yorkers, we were beyond impressed! The food was amazing! The seafood was fresh, that’s all that matters. To top it off, the peach cobbler was to die for. I’m just thinking about it and drooling. I would definitely go back, your $$ will be well spent. Take my word for it! Ooo the valet personnel was very nice and friendly. She was on a roll!

author: J
review_text: Chicken tikkah Mac and cheese was amazing. It consists of 2 well marinated tenders on top of Mac and loaded with the minty sauce. The spicy smash burger was good, but next time I would request no mayo sauce (or only on the side). Definitely trying the Nashville sandwich and the chicken & waffles combo next. Definitely a top pick for Nashville style halal on Bedford Av.

author: Jonathan Villeda
review_text: The service was friendly and attentive, but unfortunately the food didn’t live up to expectations. The ceviche wasn’t fresh, and overall the dishes were disappointing and overpriced. Not likely to return.

author: Raymond Green
review_text: This place is the " real deal " trust me, the food is amazing.. the workers Sophie, and Arielle. OMG they will take good care of you. They both are so nice get the orders right 👍 and take good care of the customers. They make u feel like your part of the " real deal " family thank you ladies... Please order from here.. the food is good I didn't get a chance to upload a photo...this business and staff are truly....... The Real Deal.....

author: Rob Gonzalez
review_text: The Food was great and or server Jacqueline was very friendly and sweetheart offered substitution on some of the sushi cause I was allergic to salmon and avocado. Thank you for such great service. The food tasted great and came to the table quick I'll definitely be back

author: Diane Garcia
review_text: Night crew manager she yells at employee to hurry and she goes outside to smoke I sat there in my car for about45 min she smoked a cigarette every 10 min on her phone literally every 10-15 min she went outside to smoke. She was rude to employee . I’m suprised he didn’t slap the old lady. Or walked out of his job leaving her by herself. She should be fired for her rudeness and laziness. He should either get a raise or be promoted . He did a great job and stayed calm. Especially on a truck load night she just watched him while smoking outside while he maintained truck load AND the store. Which I don’t think it’s his position to be unloading. My props to him keep up the good work n patience. Old lady needs to retire n SMOKE her life away. Other than that food was great great service. I go eat almost every night . I stayed ands ate there at the parking lot n this dude took it all like a champ worked extremely hard while old lady out for a smoke every 10 min sad but true. He needs to be recognized. Not being yelled at. She is mean, grumpy, and rude, to employee .

author: CMB
review_text: Absolutely amazing! I don’t understand how there is not a line out of the door here. The lemon drop martinis by our bartender were great. We ordered the ceaser salad, lobster ravioli, filet and asparagus. The ceaser salad is a must. The croutons were incredible. The lobster ravioli was the perfect portion and the sauce was creamy and flavorful. The filet was cooked perfectly as ordered, medium rare (the peppercorn sauce is a must) and the side of asparagus was the perfect vegetable for the meal. Also order the crème brûlée if you have room! The shell of sugar was crisp and came with a beautiful sliced strawberry. Presentation was phenomenal and the taste was even better. Our bartender was amazing very attentive and was so sweet. I will be back soon!

author: Shandreka Hall
review_text: Brunch at this upscale gem was everything I didn’t know I needed! From the moment we walked in, the vibes were immaculate — the decor is stunning and absolutely perfect for photo ops. Every corner feels curated for both comfort and aesthetics. The food? Delicious with impressively large portions that left us full and happy. Every dish was seasoned perfectly and beautifully presented. What really made the experience unforgettable was the service. Carolina was our waitress and she was phenomenal — attentive, kind, and incredibly professional. The entire staff worked like a well-oiled machine. If we had a dirty dish or napkin on the table, it was gone within seconds. Our table was kept spotless the entire time, which really elevated the dining experience.

author: Maita Rosieann G.K
review_text: Its near to the palace few minutes walk. Good enough serving food was ok was good and sauce was not spicy which is really good for foreign people dont like really spicy food. Roasted pig skin was not available anymore unfortunately we ate around 3pm probably was already sold out so they substitute fried pig skin on the babi guling meal.

author: Ingrid Schultze
review_text: Argentine Bakery has been my favorite since they opened abt 35 yrs. ago. I had the honor to order my son°s engagement cake yesterday, and they did a SUPERB JOB…Love them all….as if family. Gracias Natalia for making Justin and Kelly°s day so special…the whole cake was fully consumed by attendees and are today still raving about it. Los quiero!

author: Megan Gomez-Reyes
review_text: There is hardly any Potato Corner locations in LA Metropolitan area, so when we saw this location, we came out here for a nice quick bite. We had Spicy BBQ Loopy fries with the chicken tenders, and Garlic and Parmesan Loopy fries with tenders as well. The chicken is amazing, and the fries weren't bad but maybe we will try different flavors next time. It would be nice if they had a Cajun flavor or regular seasoned salt, though. But no complaints, but for a place called Potato Corner, the star of the show was definitely the chicken. Nice and hot, and REALLY crunchy!

author: weda
review_text: We came around 4pm and it was raining hard we had to move table due to the wind. They have spacious seating with many tables and chairs. Perfect for big groups. The babi guling itself wasn't among my favorites, I still can smell the pork from the meat. But the babi guling goreng was so good tho! Be careful, the bumbu was quite spicy compared to other babi guling. Beware if you're not a fan of spicy food.

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: Mohammed Isa Sidek
review_text: Ayam Penyet was really delicious and tasty after i ordered the food I ask the staff to bring the food to the table where I was sitting and she bring the food to the table after that I paid for the $6.50

author: Abby Y
review_text: Difficult to find this shop in the mall as a tourist, so we were glad when we spotted the unmistakable orange sign. Well decorated restaurant to Uncle Roger's theme. QR code to look at menu and make order. Spicy fried rice was nice- especially the sambal! Kimchi fried rice- kimchi taste wasn't strong. Mala popcorn chicken wasn't as spicy as expected. The drinks came in a nice cup too. Overall wholesome and pleasant experience, but we didn't think we have a reason to visit a second time.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: เอียด มะนาวหวาน
review_text: The atmosphere is chill, the food is affordable, and the music is great.

author: Pei Leng Tho
review_text: Nice dishes. We are in a group of 10 and we ordered 2 set meals. Dishes are yummy not salty or oily.

author: R. Fletcher
review_text: Great beachfront restaurant, the service was great, and the food was good and the atmosphere was electric. .. Beautiful views, near all the ships and shops. I highly recommend this place if you wants sights, sounds and a cool vibe.

author: Nur Humaira
review_text: We went here during weekday, so the queue was quick. The portion was quite huge and what we ordered can be easily shared between three people. Highly recommended!

author: Vivian N
review_text: We shared one steak and also got their sundae which was huge! We got our steak medium and it was pretty good. We made sure to drizzle the meat juices on the meat as well. The server served us each a slice of the steak in the beginning which I thought was pretty cool. It also explained why most of the google review photos didn’t have a fully intact steak lol. The sundae was a must-try for us- they’re known for their whipped cream. However, the ice cream itself didn’t taste like anything special. There was just a LOT of hot fudge and whipped cream. It was good but also got sweet/heavy fast. It could definitely feed four. The server showed us how to eat it which is to stick the entire long spoon into the sundae and pull up lol but it was so big. Surprisingly the milk chocolate coins were really good imo. Oh and I don’t think they take credit card (it’s written on the menu) so make sure you bring a debit card or cash. If you are celebrating a birthday or something, we did see them sing happy birthday to a couple tables.

author: James Bischof
review_text: Wendy's always provides fresh and flavorful food, ensuring satisfaction every time. Whether you choose to dine in or order delivery, the quality is consistently top-notch. Make sure to try their invigorating lemonade drinks. Additionally, the Biggie Bag offers a substantial and satisfying meal. With a variety of options including burgers, nuggets, and fries, there's something to delight everyone's taste buds.

author: Mark
review_text: The food was amazing. As you see from my shrimp salad. The only issue was service. That could be attributed to low staff and the tempo of the crowd. I still highly recommend this place.

author: Br3
review_text: I was in the area and just had to stop by. It had been too long. I ordered 6 tacos and a large drink and paid $20 flat. They take cash and card. Hand-made tortillas (always a good sign) and freshly cooked meat and spicy salsa plus agua frescas. They have a few tables set up to eat your food. If you're looking for good tacos, give them a try. FYI, parking is tricky. Sometimes, you have to drive around to find somewhere to park.

author: cys edi
review_text: Food is so so and not the truly authentic Hong Kong style and standard. Probably the local interpretation of tim sum. The tim sum are pre prepared or frozen and steam on the spot. Nevertheless, it is a place to enjoy tim sum with the festivity mood as it is crowded and lots of people moving around enjoying the eats. Price is reasonable. Service is friendly and cordial. Overall quite enjoyable social eating.

author: aindrila karmakar
review_text: A wonderful spot for Italian food in Robertson Quay! Had such a lovely experience at Rosso Vino. The location by the river is beautiful and the ambience is warm, cosy and perfect whether you dine indoors or choose the al-fresco seating outside. We tried their Christmas festive menu and really enjoyed the dishes — everything felt thoughtfully curated and authentically Italian. Their regular à la carte options also look great, so definitely planning to return for that too. Most importantly, the hospitality here is amazing. The staff are friendly, attentive, and make you feel genuinely welcomed from the moment you enter. Overall, a great place to enjoy good food, a nice atmosphere, and wonderful service. Highly recommended!

author: claudia p
review_text: Best Argentian Bakery around, all the staff is Amazing and very friendly. I have been coming to them for 25 yrs +. Highly recomend them.

author: Ethan Taylor
review_text: Got sushi in May and all flavor was just hidden by above average-spicy mayo Got Ramen in June and the chicken was as hard as a hockey puck Got Ramen in August and the Pork was as hard as a hockey puck Ramen broth is salty and I don’t want any spoonful of it I like that someone monitors the reviews and hopefully adjusts. Best of luck

author: Daniel Khor
review_text: The pho is good and service is amazing too. Do come and try. The beef ball is awesome.

author: Cole Kehn
review_text: delicious local spot, I am obsessed with their pastinis!!!!!

author: T O
review_text: was there this past Saturday for brunch. very popular place, and I understand why. Delicious food. I had the nova benedict. It was very good. I think it would be better with kippered salmon, but of course that's a matter of taste. the pistachio cream stuffed french toast was the star just delicious. will definitely be back.

author: Roberts Lifestyle
review_text: Old school country kitchen. Great food at a decent price. We’ve been here a few times in the past for breakfast. The portions are always fulfilling. They offer a delicious southern breakfast that hits the spot. The grits were a great consistency and buttery. My eggs were scrambled well and the corned beef hash was excellent. The overall breakfast experience was satisfactory and the service was great.

author: Milana Bulo4ka
review_text: I just love this place!! The server was so nice, and I just loved the lasagna 🤤😀

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: chefquak
review_text: excellent dinner @ เอกฉันท์ - Ekachan Ethnic Thai Cuisine superb meal for the price. tomyam (traditional without coconut milk) with river prawns was superb. river prawns very fresh and nicely done not overcooked. the tomyam flavour was excellent. Ceylon chicken with Royal Thai curry was very good and goes very well with complimentary ruby black rice. the deepfried fish with tumeric sauce also superb. really sweet and very fresh fish 👍👍👍 excellent meal for 1338b=S$55nett inc drinks 2.1.2026

author: Linda Pham
review_text: Delicious food! Seems like there's a long line during the day but we ate around 8pm with little to no line. The Hainan chicken is our favorite! Meat is super tender and soft and the sauces provided are delicious. We also loved the Kaya toast and butter. Can't beat the classics! Parking is available underground behind the building.

author: W. V. F.
review_text: Nice breakfast place, great food and a lot of it. Coffee is good too, and the orange juice is fresh pressed. Prices are not much more than a fast food breakfast at Denny’s, so for the location I can highly recommend it.

author: Andrew Yeoh
review_text: This SBK outlet is located in a rather quiet part of Taman Perda. They serve Malaysian morning breakfast favourites like nasi lemak, curry noodles, and toast. There is a wide range of beverages to choose from whether hot or cold. The food is tasty. The coffee is also very good.

author: Su Jane
review_text: I'm missing their mochi egg tart! Overall, the brunch here is ok. I ordered the oxtail soup, which was comforting on a rainy day. The food was delicious that I returned for a second straight day (conveniently located next to the yoga barn), proving how good it is

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: The Chopsticks
review_text: When to have dinner here on Friday night around 7pm and there’s no queue.. so we ordered first and pay before getting seated. Came here from looking at tiktok.. i must say the star is really the herbal chicken soup.. it was really good and the soup is flavourful authentic.. i had the ginseng chicken. The steam fish and spicy sauce in my opinion second best but the fish that i had chosen was an old big fish i think not so great the texture.. despite that i still like the soup gravy. The crab bee hoon not too bad can be more crispy. The squid portion is alot for 2 person we didnt finish it.. overall is good, the place is pack with patron and constant queue. I would be back just to drink the herban chicken 😂👍.

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: Shahrul IM
review_text: Great food here. I love the taste of Nasi Ayam and Rice Ball. Worth it coming from KL to taste the food. Plus, the owner and staffs are very friendly and serve food very fast. Definitely will come here again anytime visiting Malacca.

author: Khairur Azhan
review_text: - Variety of food but environment not so clean. - Rosy & Nora's Popiah goreng & popiah basah and its dipping sauce were good.

author: Jennifer Quintana
review_text: The customer service in this location is absolute trash and downright disrespectful. The employees stand around talking instead of helping the customers (even when they have a line). They give you attitude just because they have to work. Several times I’ve gone in for a pickup order and they’ve LIED to my face telling me it’s not ready when it’s very visibly right behind them waiting on the counter with my name on it and everything. I ordered online for pickup and they gave me the items in a regular bag (which is hard to carry all the way to my job) and when I asked the worker if they could give me the other bag with handles, she says they don’t have any (which again A CLEAR LIE) since I could see the bags right by the counter and several other pickup orders were given in those bags. I had to explain to the cashier how to do her job because she did not know how to scan the subway app for points and she proceeds to give me attitude for it. They’re always rolling their eyes at people and acting annoyed when a customer doesn’t speak Spanish. I myself happen to know Spanish and have heard them trash talk other customers for not understanding them. Fire these horrible people who clearly don’t want to work there and give the opportunity to others who will at the very least, TRY to be nice instead of being rude and disrespectful. This is not the first time I’ve had a bad experience at this location and it’s a shame because it’s the nearest one to my college.

author: Tiffini Tasby
review_text: What a great Christmas dinner. Linda and her team was fantastic! I loved the service and my food was phenomenal! I need a wheel barrel to get out of here. Lost my parents last year. It felt like home in this atmosphere. Great music great times with my loved one. Thank you Linda for being a wonderful person to meet with a great heart plus funny!

author: Keith Lim
review_text: Decent selection of food. The nasi lemak store is serves good nasi lemak and their carrot cake is really nice

author: Y
review_text: Probably the most fresh sushi I’ve had in a very very long time!! I had the salmon with avocado and sesame seeds and it was divine!!! My friend had the jalapeño sushi roll; also delicious. Wish I had taken a picture but I ate it so quickly that there was no time haha Also the service was spectacular and the food came out quickly. The restaurant is also very nice and decorated beautifully. 10 out of 10!

restaurant: Mặn Mòi, Tao Đàn - 34 Võ Văn Tần
author: Ghazal Lotfi
review_text: Man Moi is a cute restaurant in Ho Chi Minh City. The building is beautiful and has a great design. The food was good, though a bit on the expensive side. We tried the anchovy salad, sticky rice with chicken and mushroom, and the sturgeon fish. Everything tasted great and we enjoyed all the dishes. The general manager, Phuong, came by our table to check on us as well which was great. The only downside was that there were no napkins on the table. Other than that, it was a good experience and we would recommend the restaurant.

author: Ana Sanakina
review_text: Amazing authentic Peruvian cuisine with friendly and caring service. We got Papa Rellena and Lomo Saltado and both were excellent. Can’t wait to go back!

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Takahiro Koyama
review_text: If you're looking for an authentic taste of Singaporean local food, you've got to try Bak Kut Teh, and Song Fa is definitely the place to do it. This popular dish is a peppery, savory pork rib soup, and it's commonly enjoyed with a bowl of white rice or alongside "油条 / Dough Fritters" for dipping. Song Fa is a renowned establishment with a impressive track record, boasting 14 outlets across Singapore and earning the Michelin Bib Gourmand award for eight consecutive years (2016-2024). Their menu features their signature Bak Kut Teh Soup Dishes, along with Braised Dishes, various vegetable sides, and small plates. They also have a good selection of Chinese teas to complement your meal. Now, let's talk about the Bak Kut Teh itself. The pork ribs are incredibly tender and fall-off-the-bone, yet still have a satisfying texture. The quality of the meat is excellent—you can really taste the rich pork flavor, and there's absolutely no smell. The soup is a clear, flavorful broth, bursting with the essence of pork and pork bones. It's a delightful blend of salty notes with a strong kick of white pepper, plus a wonderful aroma and taste of garlic. A fantastic bonus at Song Fa is that soup refills are free! For those who want to savor the pure meatiness, I highly recommend the "特级龙骨汤 / Premium Loin Rib Soup." If you prefer to enjoy the sweet, melt-in-your-mouth fattiness, then the "排骨肉骨茶 / Pork Ribs Soup" is the way to go!

author: josh li
review_text: Roast chicken both meat n rice were dry, soup heavily laced with msg n still tasted terrible. Chicken cutlet laska soup not hot enough with noodles undercooked. Only cash or paynow accepted although multiple modes of payment stated. Really regretted even trying out esp when Eng's hainanese chicken rice in e hawker centrenever disappoints. Must be fake google reviews!

author: Milena
review_text: We had such a wonderful experience at Sun Sun Warung! The food was incredibly delicious — every dish was full of flavor and clearly made with love and fresh ingredients. The staff were so friendly and welcoming, always smiling and making sure we had everything we needed. The atmosphere is really lovely too – cozy, relaxed, and with a beautiful Balinese touch that makes you feel right at home. We had to wait around 15 minutes for a table because the restaurant was quite busy, but it was absolutely worth it. If you don’t like waiting, I’d recommend making a reservation in advance. The prices are unbelievably good for the quality you get – honestly, the food could easily cost much more. Overall, we couldn’t have been happier. Great food, wonderful people, and a beautiful place – a must-visit in Bali!

author: Bert Grobben
review_text: Chill beach front place. Simple outfit, but that’s all you need for a drink and some food. Friendly and attentive staff. Kinda feels like eating at someone’s home. The menus looks broad. Portion sizes are big, and the items we have very tasty! Will come back for an afternoon at East Coast

author: Pablo Pinto
review_text: Great food great workers but bathroom never works and it's packed with USC students

author: Russ Lacuata
review_text: Located in the Old Town Hoi An. The restaurant is very popular and long queues, but it is worth it! The queues is endless, but the staff does an excellent job managing the orders. The baguette is fresh with the right balance of crunch and chewy. The sauce is delicious and well seasoned, family secret and the filling of meats and pork are amazing. The price is reasonable. The best Banh Mi.

author: Nicolás Tolnay
review_text: FLAKES EVERYWHERE I remember when I found an article that stated the best Pain au Chocolat of Los Angeles, and It is true. Also, it said that the owner spent 2 years perfecting his croissant recipe. Ever since I been obsessed with this place. They use french butter, and you can see them laminating their doughs through the day. They make their own chocolate, and sell bars and baking chips as well. Excellent drinks are made here, consistently good. The earlier I go the better it gets, that warm turkey and cheese croissant, right out of the oven, is pure gold. Different shapes and flavors, always innovating. WOW!!!

author: Andrew Tan atomi Singapore
review_text: There's something truly special about this hawker centre that evokes nostalgia and sets it apart from others in Singapore. Tucked away in cozy HDB enclaves, it feels like a hidden gem that deserves to be cherished and preserved. It's a comforting reminder of the simpler joys in life. It’s inspiring to witness these hawker stalls thriving after the pandemic's challenges, even amidst the quieter atmosphere following the election rallies. As we await the election results tonight, let's take a moment to pause and reflect. Regardless of the outcome, we trust that the ruling party will assemble a new cabinet to guide Singapore toward a brighter future. Now is the time to close the widening gaps, unite, and move forward into this new era under PM Wong’s leadership.

author: Jimmy Su
review_text: Came here with a friend for lunch on Friday and this place totally deserves its Michelin star. We got there about 15 minutes before opening, so parking was easy and we were part of the first group in line. Holbox serves Yucatán-style seafood tacos, and every single one we tried was incredible. We ordered the scallop taco, octopus taco, smoked kanpachi taco, Baja fish taco, and the aguachile with spot prawn and scallops. The scallop was buttery and sweet, the octopus was super tender with that perfect char, and the smoked kanpachi had this deep, smoky flavor that was just insane. The aguachile was bright, spicy, and refreshing—perfect for a warm day. The service was exceptional. You order at the counter, and they somehow manage to bring everything out quickly and perfectly timed, even with so many tables scattered around the market. It’s impressive how smoothly everything runs. We finished with the churros and chocolate sauce, which were the perfect ending—crispy, light, and the chocolate was rich but not overly sweet. The small lot is paid (about $4 an hour), but there’s some free street parking if you get lucky. Definitely worth coming a little early for a spot. Can’t wait to come back and try more of the menu, especially anything with uni. This place is a gem.

author: Donna Robinson
review_text: Came for the experience and succeeded. The food that I ordered I did not like at all. Others did enjoy their croissant sandwiches and said the potatoes were very good. I had the sourdough avocado toast it did not even come to average, but I will say the experience was great to be in. Customer service was attentive . I definitely recommend making reservations it is extremely busy place to go. You will have to pay for parking . The picture on the coffee have easy instructions to follow and that was my favorite part. The coffee taste was just subpar not really good at all, but I’m glad I was able to go and I would go again just order something different.

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: David Popperfield
review_text: My favourite dish from Hanoi. Glad to be able to try it here, although I wish for the soup to be slightly more tangy. Overall, the grill pork and pork cake were delicious. Perfectly charred and marinated. They have both outdoor and indoor areas. Staffs were friendly and hospitable! Will definitely recommend and come back again

author: The Soto Standard
review_text: I got the 3 tender combo with toast and fries, my wife got the same thing. We throughly enjoyed every bite and the ice in the drink is a nice touch. I also love the ketchup packets. The guy at the door welcomed us and even gave us a suggestion to use the self service to get our food faster (great host) anyways to be short. Great Food, Excellent Customer Service , Very Clean and Spacious Environment. Got my food in 5 mins regardless of the huge line out of the door. I entered and the guy welcomed me immediately. For a fast food spot this specific Raising Canes Is And Should be the Standard for Fast Food Done Right!!!

author: Edwin Rios
review_text: Asked for a glass of water while looking at the menu and this has to be the worst tap water I've ever had in a restaurant. Enough to take your appetite away. Food was average and if they use the same water for cooking, this is likely affecting their food quality. Had to order a bottle of sparkling water to get by. For the price of their menu, the least they can do is give you a decent glass of water. Music was high enough where I had problems listening to the servers or the person a cross the table. This takes away from enjoying the environment with your party.

author: Sam L
review_text: Being from PA, this was a must-visit. And I am happy to say, Lucino’s is ALWAYS the best! Whether it be the pizza, the wings, pasta, everything is delicious. And the Cheesesteak are a MUST!

author: Flo Yeow
review_text: This is a very good Korean BBQ restaurant. The impeccable service, food quality, and overall vibes set it apart from other, more casual KBBQ spots in the area, making it an option you should try at least once. While the extensive menu can be a little confusing compared to a traditional KBBQ place, it allows them to offer a wide range of premium ingredients like lobster and expensive meat cuts. We opted for a simple KBBQ set meal, which saved us the hassle of navigating the many pages. I particularly appreciate that the team cooks everything for you and is quite patient throughout the process. We were able to relax and enjoy a wonderful evening of good conversations and delicious food.

author: Ashley Farias
review_text: The service was excellent. Staff was friendly, attentive and informative. I ordered the fried rice from their brunch menu and my sister ordered the melted butter pancakes. She loved the pancakes. While I enjoyed their unique touch to the fried rice and perfectly runny egg, I didn't love how much oil it was all swimming in. We also waited 45 min for our food. Edit: I made I a typo and wrote "informal" but really I meant "informative"🤦‍♀️ Learning that they just expanded and were adjusting to the new space is great context for helping me understand the delay!

author: Jason McAfee
review_text: Food was great service was great. I had never been in a restaurant like this before. One of my first times in Boston. A lot of things with closed so I didn't choose this place initially but it was clutch. Empanadas were great The door they were made with flaky soft. Ingredients were good. Beef was a little dry the yuca balls were great. To see myself going back for some of their fried chicken as well. It was delicious. Not bad guys, thanks.

author: louise
review_text: First — the bread they put on your table is not free. So if you think you won’t finish it, don’t open it lol it was also very crispy and it was nice to dip in the soup. We got seated right away, we came at 8AM. We ordered and got our food within 5-10 minutes and it was flavourful. Honest opinion– the broth is really good as well as the freshly made noodles, however, I think there are better pho restaurants than this one. I wouldn’t come back but it was good to try the Michelin ⭐️⭐️⭐️ pho. People generally stay around 30 minutes and would leave right away. PS, they don’t have any high chairs for the babies, so prepare to have them on your lap if they can’t sit by themselves yet.

author: Zokrath Tan
review_text: This place has a wide and good selection of local foods if you want to be spoilt for choice. By local foods, I mean the Singaporean foods that singaporeans love to eat. There may be multiple stalls selling the same kind of dishes, but they all have their own taste and regular customers. Definitely go try the different stalls for satay, carrot cake, bbq chicken wings, and hokkien mee.

author: Gina Guedesse
review_text: The food was really good. It looks dated inside and there were a lot of people so I can't fault the servers but in this particular instance, it just took a little while to get drink refills (and our first drink, because the Coke and sweet tea was out when we went through the line to pay). I would definitely go here again.

author: sahand sb
review_text: What you get for the price is great! Clam Chowder was tasty! Cozy neighborhood type bar and food!

author: Anita Tang
review_text: I had lunch at The Shady Shack in Canggu, Bali, a beautiful vegetarian café and bar, and it was a fantastic experience. The Breakfast Burger was fresh, flavorful, and generously portioned, paired with a delicious homemade tomato sauce. The Jamu Jamu was honestly the best I had in Bali — perfectly balanced with a mild, pleasant taste and none of the usual bitterness. The staff were warm and welcoming, and the atmosphere was incredibly cozy, surrounded by lush greenery. I especially loved the relaxed couch seating, which made the whole vibe feel peaceful and chill. Highly recommended if you’re looking for a vegan-friendly restaurant in Canggu or just a relaxing spot for healthy, plant-based food in Bali.

author: Shazrul Idhlan
review_text: Lovely place with very nice decor. They have a huge number of great Indonesian food and the taste is awesome. Highly recommended for your Indonesian food cravings. Do come before 1pm because when we left the line was very long and wait times could be hours.

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Thuỷ Tiên Lê
review_text: I visited this grilled meat buffet restaurant because the reviews were okay (maybe because the staff asked for reviews :)))), but the actual experience was quite disappointing. The meat was okay, not too special. The appetizer line was cold and not delicious. There were a few staff so sometimes I had to call once or twice to be served, but they were still very enthusiastic, especially the staff who changed the grill and helped with table reservations - I still appreciate this 👍 However, after finishing the meal, I had a stomachache and quite severe diarrhea. I don't know if it was because of the food or how it was preserved, especially the kimchi that showed signs of being expired (sour and very smelly) which really made me uncomfortable. Plus, when I changed the grill, there was a lot of detergent left on the grill. Although it was only 139k, I can't ask for much. I hope the restaurant will review the hygiene and food quality, because this experience makes me not dare to come back.

author: swalrond
review_text: Food is hit or miss but the attitude especially with the female staff is uncalled for. Not sure why so many Jamaican resturants tend to hire these disgruntled women. I've had decent experiences with the men there but a good majority of the female staff will make you go elsewhere and not spend a dime in there. To the owner please explain why I can't be sold a small plate with just meat and no rice or cabbage? If I'm paying the same price and not asking for more meat than they would normally put on a plate that includes the sides, whats the problem? I'm asking for the same portion they would give if it was meat with sides but I don't want sides for dietary reasons but your female staff says they cannot sell it that way. Are you losing money on the rice not sold if its not included in the plate? Make it make sense please. You can only buy a medium oxtail but not a large or small. Makes no sense. Food is not consistent but I've always supported this place and gave it many chances but like many others I don't think I will continue to do so.

author: xawrax
review_text: Best bagels in town, hands down! You can taste the quality in every bite. I love that they offer so many options. The store has a cozy vibe and the service is quick even during busy hours. Highly recommend!!! Five stars all the way! <3

author: hste- lee
review_text: The Tai Lok Mee aka Hokkien Mee (KL style) is nowhere near the KL standard. Far from it to be precise! Lacked wok-hei and the tai lok mee used here is flat instead of the fat round ones, hence the moniker! Wat tan hor is and sang mee is just passable. Maybe the northerners preferred it this way. Surely not for me!

author: Dom
review_text: Cool golden interior. Food was pretty good. If there are any sweet tea enjoyers in Boston it is sold here.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Eric Batson
review_text: Great tacos. Very big portions on both the tacos and chips and guac. Good prices. Wonderful service, Yela was on top of it all night. 10/10 would recommend. Especially the Carnitas. Great live music on a Tuesday night as well.

author: Jovell Gan
review_text: I found a nice and affordable vegetarian stall inside the Staff Canteen at Terminal 1. Despite the name, it is open to everyone, not just airport staff, which is a pleasant surprise. Do note that it is located before immigration (non-transit area), not after security, so it’s suitable if you’re sending someone off, picking someone up, or haven’t cleared immigration yet. Operating hours: 0730-1830

author: Peewara Chaichart
review_text: Nice place to enjoyed Breakfast. Not very crowded from Tourists tour like other Dimsum place in Hatyai but I can say the quality is great, clean and fast service. Various choices of food from Dimsum, Congee, Fried stuff and Ba-Kut-Teh(Pork stew).

author: Arman Barbuco
review_text: The place has good food. The service is good and they have a lot of good wines you can choose from. We ended up buying a couple of bottles after dinner. Their foods are good. The downside of this place is parking in case the area gets busy. But it is worth a visit and a must-try.

author: Orlando Martinez
review_text: Nice place next to the water. Very friendly nice bartender. Came in for lunch n sat by outside bar. Had fresh Landshark on draft n lunch special. Priced was reasonable for the area. 20% grad automatic on bill. Looking forward to going back

author: Thanh Vu
review_text: We just walked in and were so lucky to be seated after about 10 mins. I love the Buns and the ramen broth is good, rich with full of flavor. This is a great spot in Midtown to enjoy ramen and other food in the menu.

author: BK DUCHEZZ
review_text: My girlfriends and I came across this place by accident. We just wanted to grab a bite to eat before hitting the road after attending the Burna Boy concert in Newark the night before. We googled a few spots close to our Airbnb and decided on this one. I’m so glad we did. Food was good. A variety of vegan options and the server even made some suggestions. The service was courteous, friendly and warm. The atmosphere was adorable . They even had a Dj that started playing some tunes we could groove to. I loved everything about this place. I will make sure I visit again if I’m in the Newark area.

author: Kate Rosita
review_text: A very popular restaurant. Although it serves instant noodles, the ingredients are great. It deserves the Michelin name and tastes great. Be sure to use the app to queue in advance to avoid meal times. They sell whole coconuts, so you can ask the staff.

author: Mika'ele Keni'
review_text: Ono Sushi is a solid AYCE spot; Southeast of the Strip, about a fifteen minute drive. I came here for a quick solo lunch, was the first one to arrive and get seated when it opened. A few other patrons started trickling in. All of them looked like local professionals on their respective lunch breaks. I don't think there were any tourists. Medium size venue with a decent amount of seating with plenty of parking available in the plaza. I didn't realize I've actually been here before...forgot to write a review. The menu has changed a bit. I don't see s few item I got the last time I was here. Looks like they were minimally staffed. There was a lady running the front, taking orders a cleaning tables...superstar efficiency kind of stuff. I only saw one chef making all the sushi and I heard there were another one or two people in the back. Everything came out in a timely manor, good presentation and food was good. No issues! I was impressed... #AYCE: ~ Idako Karaage (Baby Octopus) - 3.5/5 ~ Geso Karaage (Squid Legs) - 3.5/5 ~ Pork Belly - 5/5 ~ Sashimi Appetizer (Chef Choice) - 4/5 ~ Oyster - 4/5 ~ Poke Tacos - 4/5 ~ Kaki Fry (Fried Oyster) - 4/5 ~ Shrimp Skewer - 4/5 ~ Salmon Belly - 4/5 ~ Ocean Trout - 4/5 ~ Amaebi - 4/5 ~ Uni - 4/5 ~ Unagi - 4/5 ~ Nigiri - 4/5 - Ikura - 4/5 - Ono - 4/5 - Red Snapper - 4/5 ~ Lychee sorbet - 4/5 I noticed some this that are no longer on the menu: Previous visit: (2019) ~ Seasoned Brussle Sprouts - 4/5 ~ Green Tea Pannacotta - 4/5 ~ Red Bean Ice Cream - 4/5 This place definitely has a more local vibe to it. No issues coming back...

author: Jessen george
review_text: The location is perfect for tourists who's visiting ubud. Which is near to the ubud palace and ubud art Market.vehicles will not reach to the property so you have to walk nearly 250 m. But it is good. The property ambiance is perfect for tourists. One side of the restaurant is facing toward the nature that's great and other side is with a fish pond and birds wich gives a cool atmosphere. We ate food after 3pm so the food was not hot at all. Better the want to heat the dish especially the pork meat, so overall food experience was not so great.

author: Edwin Sim
review_text: I was hoping to find some authentic traditional hawker food here but was a disappointment. I ordered and waited for over 30 mins for white carrot cake, fried kuay teow, satay and chicken wings and no way they were even close to what I wanted with old school common hawker food. All were below average and the better one is the chicken wings but from my taste bud it's not fresh.

author: Lee KH
review_text: Heard the lamb was good so I decided to give it a try during lunch. The place was empty but was warmly greeted by Rajiv who served me throughout lunch. Ordered the lamb. There was a hiccup in terms of how the meat was cooked. While the dish pleasantly displayed, it was cooked 2 notch higher then intended. However, the service recovery by Rajiv was excellent even though I showed no displeasure - the food was indeed delicious even though it was medium well instead of medium rare. He raised the bar for customer experience. Had the tiramisu for dessert which was a little heavy for me. Decent taste, not too sweet. It was a great lunch overall. There is live band during the night, will visit again for dinner one day.

author: Willie Ruiz
review_text: Great food. Very tasty. The service was excellent. Clean and spacious dinning area. They let you have the spices on the side to adjust your spice level which I enjoyed.

author: Cher Ong
review_text: A place that specialises in egg noodles 🍜 & various types of meat. The roast duck & roast pork are delicious. The roast pork has a very crispy & fragrant skin. The ratio of the meat is just nice, not too oily. The crab meat roll is quite nice, but a bit greasy. Ordered the 5 piece set for 2 pax, a bit too much. The egg noodle tastes average. Service is very bad. They have plenty of staff, but none of them are attentive. No smile on their faces & rude attitude.

author: maryori guadalupe
review_text: Nice presentation and friendly staff. Mahi tacos were amazing but the chicken was a little over cooked and I could taste shrimp cross contamination flavor in the cilantro rice which felt like it was just reheated and not fresh at all. Not a lot flavor in the rice and beans .Nice view in front of the beach. Little too expensive for tacos 🌮. Meh nothing to write home about in my opinion. Sorry 😐

author: zhen qin lee
review_text: Excellent food and uncle is so nice! Best braised pig trotter ever!

author: Mathurin Lohvithee
review_text: This restaurant was recommended by my Indonesian friend. I came with high expectations and was not disappointed. Everything here tastes so good, delicious and flavorful. I will definitely go back to dine here if I have a chance.

author: Filthy Vegan
review_text: Finally made it to this vegetarian restaurant. Very nice Vietnamese vegan food. Lovely decor inside. Wide open cool looking interior. One of the nicest places I've visited anywhere. Friendly staff. Well done.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: 秋野雅人
review_text: 2019/1/20 I really love Hu Tieu. I went there in the afternoon when there weren't many customers, and I felt relaxed and at ease.

author: Kevin Kwok
review_text: Ok this place is outside so it's going to be a little hot and chaotic. We came when there was no line and only a few tables. Lucky us! The service isn't good but the food is! The menu seems huge so I would look at photos here on Google maps and just tell the staff this is what you want. Cash only. The seafood fried rice was our favorite.

author: Nereida Crespo
review_text: My favorite restaurant on the Hollywood beach boardwalk. Always my first stop for food when I visit. Great food, service & music with beautiful views of the beach. Highly recommend this place!

author: Elijah Chell
review_text: We were thoroughly impressed with the food; it was much better than we anticipated. The staff deserves major praise. They were incredibly helpful in coordinating a small, instant surprise for our friend and even assisted us with a last-minute cake order. Thank you for the wonderful service!

author: Jena Hong
review_text: This place is great!!! The baked goods are on the pricier side, but they’ve been made with a lot of care. Definitely a go to place if you enjoy croissants with A LOT of layers. I like their chai latte and chocolate bars as well. There tends to be a long line in the afternoon and there are only a few tables available so you may have to wait.

author: Ella Amoroso
review_text: We loved Milk and Madu at the new branch in Seminyak! All the staff, particularly Windi and Vera were so attentive, smiley and kind to us. We loved our breakfast on day 1 so much that we came back 3 times! The food was all so fresh and came out quickly. The aperol and elderflower spritz were also perfect! Breakfast was particularly brilliant with the live musicians, which created a wonderful atmosphere. I would come back here everyday if i could!

author: Prabina Bhattrai
review_text: Momo Nepali Authentic Food delivers an unforgettable taste of Nepal with its expertly crafted momos and traditional dishes. The flavors are rich, with a perfect balance of spices that bring comfort and authenticity in every bite. The cozy atmosphere and attentive service make it feel like a home away from home. A must-visit for anyone craving genuine Nepali cuisine.

author: Lin Rudy
review_text: The best Indonesian local casual dining chain. Wide variety selection of dishes from various Indonesia’s region specialties. Highly recommended if you are a tourist or expats wanting wide options of Indonesia’s dishes. As locals we approved the authenticity of these dishes. Food are usually consistent throughout all chains across Indonesia.

author: Mauro Davalos D
review_text: Door signs and google information shows they close at 10pm but the guy or guys that work here always close 1h early! It’s always the same insane problem!!! They do whatever the hell they want. Hope their manager or owner see this and solve it!

author: Chriz Shop
review_text: If you ever come to Ho Chi Minh City, I really hope you give this beef noodle shop a chance. It’s located in District 1, so it’s very convenient to visit. The pricing is reasonable and the portions are generous. The soup base is clear yet flavorful, with a light sweetness and a very comforting aroma. The noodles are smooth with a slightly rough texture, which gives them a nice chewy bite. One great bonus is that the side vegetables are free-flow, so you can add as much as you like. I highly recommend the fat beef brisket. Don’t worry about the word “fat” — it’s definitely worth trying. The meat is soft and chewy, and surprisingly not oily or greasy at all. Overall, it’s a satisfying and hearty bowl of beef noodles. If you’re in District 1, why not give it a try? 👍

author: Angeline Lee
review_text: First time here easy to park and I love the vibe. The girl even offered a chair for my dad who wasn’t feeling well. Their turmeric rice is flavorful and the coffee is really good I like their royal coffee. Maybe they can provide handle in the toilet for disabled people the toilet quite small so I can't get inside it to help my dad. Other than that everything was superb

author: Mahesh choppa
review_text: Such a delightful experience! The shakshuka was rich and flavorful, and the pistachio affogato was exceptional. The complimentary pistachio tart was a lovely touch. Warm service, lovely staff, relaxing atmosphere — I left feeling genuinely happy. Highly recommend! 🌿

author: Gragor Joseph
review_text: I've always dined in at this location (Jamaica Plain), or ordered my food to-go while inside. Always great service, and so far, everything I've tried from them tastes amazing (mainly, the paninis and pizzas). I do plan to eventually make my way through most of their menu, eventually.

author: Simone
review_text: Absolutely unacceptable! I was served a drink with two bottle caps sitting at the bottom of the glass. This isn’t just careless; it’s a serious hygiene and safety issue. Completely ruined my experience, and I would never recommend this place to anyone until they seriously rethink their quality control.

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: Pho Big Bowl
review_text: On my trip to Thailand I walked by this restaurant that seemed busy with many people inside eating. I decided to go in and give it a try and it was delicious. The dipping sauce was the highlight. I really enjoyed all the bbq here as well as the generous portions. The staff was very attentive and helpful. I would highly recommend to any one looking for a yummy spot to eat!

author: Millie Stonerook
review_text: Went here for breakfast while on vacation. Great portion size and great price. Would highly recommend!

author: Diamond Taylor
review_text: Visited JRK! with colleagues from county government and had a fantastic experience. The staff kindly let us in early so we didn’t have to wait in the hot sun—super hospitable. They plated each order with care, accommodating everyone’s dietary needs. I had the jerk shrimp with jasmine rice—absolutely delicious. The sweet virgin margaritas were a hit too. We’ll definitely be back!

author: Mikee
review_text: Food was good and the portions were huge. The 1kg pork ribs were meaty and juicy, and are enough to share with around 4 people. And some of the drinks come in large 650ml sizes, also easy to share. The rib sauce leans sweet, so it’s great if you’re into that kind of flavor. French fries came with some sort of truffle sauce that was good, but it was spicy and wasn't to our liking. Service was great and the atmosphere was fun, saw the staff do a fun dance when someone ordered a cocktail. Our waitress, Mbok Wiwin, did great. The place has gitten less crowded as of around this time (December 2025), since the government has been doing experimental one way road changes.

author: Danice M
review_text: The best ever coffee.... We all loved our coffee and hush puppies. The vibe, staff are amazing. We felt right at home and are excited to stop in the have breakfast on our next family outing. Brother Cran and sister Claudia are the best, they know all the amazing places - Photos to follow... Thank yuou!

author: Jaime Mendez
review_text: Every time I come here, the food is amazing! The place is always clean, the music sets a great vibe, and the staff is super friendly. You can really taste the authentic flavor in every bite. Definitely one of my favorite spots highly recommend!

author: Thanh NGO
review_text: The food was delicious, seasoned perfectly to our group's taste. The fried rice was amazing. The staff were all enthusiastic and quick. We will definitely come back! It's recommended to make a reservation in advance as the restaurant gets quite crowded.

author: Jorge T
review_text: Great food matched by great atmosphere. The place was packed. They could space out the tables a little better. They really cram everyone in there. Nice professional staff. Will definitely be back

author: Janet Depaz
review_text: May 2025, The joint has a new menu. See pictures attached. This place is a local gem! I enjoy eating there both during the week after work and on weekends with the family. The staff is always friendly and attentive, the food is really good (love the tacos, pizza, and wings), the cocktails are very tasty, they have specials every day, and at breakfast time the place is always packed. Parking off the street, music always playing!

author: Yau Xue Yen
review_text: Saw the recommendation on social media so we decided to visit after eating so much normal banh mi. Surprisingly there wasn't a lot of customer, only locals. We ordered the special version (number 2) and it was soooo great 😭💕 too good that we visited twice hahaha The owner doesn't know much English but we managed to communicate. The serving was fast and they are quite nice overall. We only tried the banh mi, but they do sell other dishes as well! Five star from Malaysian ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐👍

author: Cheng Mun Mun
review_text: Food is pretty great. Finally, some good western food in Butterworth! I tried the otak otak seafood spaghetti. The otak otak is in the sauce. The flavour is really powerful, with a dash of spiciness to it. Makes the whole spaghetti really nice to eat. The chicken is also nicely fried. Portion is huge. Ordered an alcoholic beverage with rum in it. Really nice cocktail combo. Overall I love the food. Will be back for more.

author: Kayden Kong
review_text: The service was very bad...cannot ask question at all...they will keep on rushing you to order...all worker attitude was very bad👎🏻...the chinese worker here most terrible...seems like we come here to eat no need to pay...the food is ok only🤮...very bad experience👎🏻...will not come again！！！

author: Taksaorn Sirikantaramas
review_text: I came alone so had only few menus. Grilled chicken with lemongrass was so good, the sauce is like satay sauce which is flavorful and goes well with the grilled chicken. Dessert was also nice with tropical fruits. Restaurant decoration is great.

author: Dharmendra Bhudia
review_text: Really tasty food and lots to choose from. Price are good also. A must id your in the area

author: Din Neo
review_text: One of the best local coffee shop where you can find many authentic food. Highly recommended!!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Brittany Redding
review_text: This place is great. The decor is so bright, colorful, and fun! The taco platter was amazing. You can't mix and match but my group just all got a different taco platter so we could try a few. The brisket taco and the Korean short rib with kimchi taco were amazing. Our server, Majo, was amazing. So friendly and made sure we had everything we needed. Will definitely be back next time I in town.

author: Robert M
review_text: Food is great no doubt. Visited on not busy day it was empty so the atmosphere was pretty relaxing. I'm not sure how this place is when it's busy, but food arrived on time. Waiter was moody but not rude. Mole enchiladas 🤌🏽.

author: Kim Cano
review_text: I tried Bobe yesterday with some girlfriends as I found in on TikTok and unfortunately I would have to say it was an ok place to eat. My server was super sweet and friendly and very accommodating to any allergies i had. The decor on the inside is super cute but unfortunately we are here for the food but why I’m giving 3 stars is because the food does lack in flavor unfortunately and so do the drinks. I wouldn’t be back but I will say the vibe is cute but as far as for the food and drinks * I had a strawberry matcha latte * you’re not missing out on anything and they’re are better places nearby that are so much more flavorful in their food.

author: Logan Pagan
review_text: So me and my family which were a party of 10 went to this restaurant for my grandma 91 year birthday. We weren't welcomed, the waiter rush us to order EVERYTHING AT ONCE because they had so many parties that were coming. The food was HORRIBLE! The grilled rib eye steak which was 43 dollars came to the table not the way I asked them to make it. It still looked frozen in the inside while the outside was cooked crispy. Service overall sucked and was very disappointed at this place. But, the atmosphere was tradition and old style which I liked at least. If the food is going to be pricy, it should be cooked and served better! On another note, this place charged me a 20 percent gratuity that the waiter did not deserved. I would of tipped more of the service was better. The portion of the food was very small for the price and everyone left out of this place hungry.

author: Jody Chang
review_text: This is my second time visiting, and the food and atmosphere are excellent. Strongly recommended for Thai-style beef dishes.

author: Chris Kasel
review_text: We had an 80th birthday party for my aunt here. The entire staff was so accommodating, very helpful, and took pride in their work. The food was absolutely incredible. We will be coming back and recommending this place to others.

author: Stephany Hwang
review_text: The Cheesecake Factory has the best angel hair meatballs pasta. I'm in love with it. The Mexican style salad is also great. Service was a bit slow considering how many tables were still empty, but they were overall nice and attentive. Great value for price!

author: Tiffany Leung
review_text: Food was delicious, and the menu has several bakery, breakfast, and lunch options. The staff are very friendly, and the space is lovely with big windows for lots of sunlight. Dani was helpful and kind!

author: Hammerhead
review_text: One of the best hawker food in Penang serving authentic delicacy by local people unlike many hawker where foreigner start to over. Highly recommend their yam rice pairing with soy source pork leg/intestine. Plz do come early to avoid over crowded peak hours.

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: XY L
review_text: Amazing food - very fragrant, nutty tea and rice mixed with fresh ingredients. The bonus was the pork belly! It’s a meal I love so much that I’d love to move my house closer to it. I had them taken out and delivered before. Equally good!!!!

author: Janelle
review_text: Tried this yummy pandan snack at Siam Square 💚 Chewy, tasty, and honestly so addictive—could keep eating it and never get bored 😝

author: Rosa Munoz
review_text: This place is amazing! We been coming here for the last 7 years. The food,service and the atmosphere never disappoints. I highly recommend this place🔥

author: Saira Rab
review_text: Delicious donuts made fresh! I tried their specialty donuts and liked their pastries! Recommend their croissants as they are soft not hard like some other places. The price range is similar to pink box donuts, but they offer more variety of drinks and have no drive-thru.

author: Dr. Frances Ince
review_text: Red Lobster continues to impress! The food was exceptionally good, and the seafood boil was as delicious as ever. This has always been one of our favorite places to eat, and over the last couple of months, both the service and the food have been outstanding. Many years ago, this location was always busy with a line out the door. Lately, it’s been surprisingly empty, with only the bar and one back section in use. I’m not sure if it’s due to staffing, the economy, or something else—but the quality hasn’t changed. The food is consistently delicious, the greeters at the front are always friendly and welcoming, and our server was top-notch. Highly recommend this location!

author: Terence Ho
review_text: Was there for lunch with a customer and many of the stalls were not open. Tried the fried prawn noodle. Its ok just that the prawn and ingredients were only added onto the noodles after the noodles are cooked. So the ingredients are actually cold. Would be better if they cook the ingredients together with the noodles

author: Diana Anghelus
review_text: I had this restaurant on my list and without even knowing we got there after visiting the Uluwatu Temple. It's literally around the corner, however , it's a good kilometer going up, so better take a taxi. It was dark outside when we got there and we could not see much . We didn't have a reservation , however, they were so nice and able to get us in, as the place it's pretty big. We got sat by the cliff, luckily, as least we could hear the waves and see if at nigh . Food was a lot and it came pretty quick . Price was decent for the location, not very expensive. You can take pics by the famous heart but make a reservation for a premium table.

author: Jayesh Nema
review_text: After You Dessert Café at CentralWorld is an absolute paradise for anyone with a sweet tooth. The moment you step in, the aroma of freshly baked treats and the sight of their iconic desserts instantly tempts you into ordering more than you planned. Their Shibuya Honey Toast, Kakigori, and seasonal specials are nothing short of awesome and delicious—beautifully presented, consistently rich in flavour, and worth every calorie. This is the kind of place where every bite feels like a warm hug, and it’s easy to see why it’s a favourite among locals and tourists alike. That said, be prepared for a bit of patience. Service tends to be slow, especially during peak hours, and the café often struggles with managing the heavy footfall it attracts. The staff can come across as rude or indifferent, which can feel a bit disappointing considering the high expectations the brand sets. Long queues and slightly chaotic crowd handling are fairly common. Still, despite these drawbacks, the desserts remain the hero—so good that they almost make up for everything else. If you’re willing to overlook the service and the rush, the taste and quality of the treats make a visit totally worthwhile. After You at CentralWorld is definitely a must-stop for dessert lovers—just go in with patience, and you’ll walk out smiling (and full). 🍰✨

author: Swee Ping Lim
review_text: This hawker centre houses about 20 food stalls, covering some of the most popular foods in Penang. Overall the food quality is good and the price is reasonable. Sometimes it can be difficult to find a car park, especially during peak hours.

author: Taneisha Tomlinson
review_text: I went here with my husband in November for brunch while we were in Miami, and we had a good time. We were seated outside, which was great. The day was cool and breezy, and we enjoyed the ambiance and the view. The food and the drinks were delicious. We would definitely go back for sure.

author: Chung Cheong Wong
review_text: Very nice Nasi Lemak! Fried chicken drumstick is juicy and tender. The best is the sambal chilli. Not too spicy and have a fragrant aroma of spices. Service is very fast despite the crowd.

author: Yanick Suriyati
review_text: Finally got a chance to try this hype place! Food is good, service is good too, could be improved more and should get more brief or training for them to be able to identify their own menu 😂 the daily worker has been missed placed the drinks, however it’s a minor things for me. The ambience is great, although it was crowded and makes us waiting a bit for the menu to be taken and the receiving our food.

author: aye phoo
