review_text: This food center is much cleaner and more organized than other places. We got chili crab 🦀 and it was nice. But my highlight would be the sambal stingray from Homg Kong live seafood stall. So many food options! Wish i could try all. The sugarcane juice with lemon is not tasty though. The shop watered it down. I can’t taste any sugarcane flavor.

author: Ben D
review_text: I came here to meet up with a friend, and it turned out to be a great spot. The place is cozy and everything feels well thought out. We asked the staff for a recommendation and tried the charcoal coffee. It was rich, not too sweet, and really smooth. The flavor was unique and easy to enjoy. The staff were super friendly and helpful, which made the experience even better. I also tried matcha granola for the first time in my life. I had it hot, and it was surprisingly good. Warm, earthy, and just the right texture. They also have a lot of beautifully presented pastries, and I asked for something not too sweet just the right balance. There are other light breakfast options too, like wakota toast and some vegan dishes, which all tasted great and felt healthy. The only downside is that it gets really crowded on weekends. We had to wait quite a while for a seat, and after we sat down, others were already waiting for our table. There’s a good amount of seating quiet corners for working, a central area, and a little outdoor patio but still, weekends are busy. It was also a bit noisy outside because of a bunch of motorcyclists riding through the usually quiet town. Definitely not the café’s fault, just one of those “welcome to America” moments. It’s a such cool and chill place for coffee, conversation, working, or just having some time alone.

author: Ashley C
review_text: Looking for a cool 50’s diner off the strip? Check out the Omelette House 50’s Diner on Desert Inn. Known as “the friendliest diner around.“ They have an awesome menu, the portions are huge, and they have some of the lowest prices we’ve seen in Vegas. Make sure to try their signature pumpkin nut bread and delicious spuds. Got 10 bucks to spare? You can splurge to eat in style in their classic 1957 Chevrolet Bel Air.

author: J M
review_text: Every time I come here and order ahead. To pick up they make me wait 20-30 min extra It’s always the same, I’m done coming here is not even good & the prices aren’t that great. I would give 0 stars Honestly worst customer service in LA

author: Yvonne Chou
review_text: I recently had lunch at Kok Sen Restaurant and it truly lived up to its reputation as one of Singapore’s classic zi char gems. I ordered the Claypot Yong Tau Foo, Bittergourd Black Bean Sauce Pork Ribs, Black Bean Beef Hor Fun, and a pot of Pu-Er Tea. The standout dish for me was definitely the Bittergourd Black Bean Sauce Pork Ribs. The pork ribs were tender, juicy, and beautifully coated with a rich black bean sauce that was both savory and slightly smoky, pairing perfectly with the gentle bitterness of the gourd. It was comforting, homely, and full of wok hei. The Claypot Yong Tau Foo was hearty and generous, with each piece absorbing the flavorful broth. The Black Bean Beef Hor Fun also impressed, the noodles had that irresistible charred aroma, and the beef was well-marinated and tender. Service was brisk and efficient despite the busy lunch crowd, and dishes came out piping hot. Prices are on the higher side for zi char, but the quality, portion size, and authentic taste justify it. If you’re looking for a taste of traditional Singapore zi char with bold flavors and wok hei, Kok Sen is a must visit.

author: Kyle Montoya
review_text: Breakfast burrito was bland and mediocre. I’m suspicious the tortillas were bought at target. If you put ketchup on eggs, you’ll like this place. If you like flavor, I recommend eating elsewhere.

author: Trinity Dickinson
review_text: Delicious Thai dishes, and a Cantonese special. Tamjai is a very attentive, friendly and polite hostess, and John the owner is an incredibly gracious guy who gave me an umbrella and told me about Bangkok. Everyone should try this place!

author: Wayne C. Robinson
review_text: By far, the best restaurant in Penang. Great everything. Will return soon. 2nd time was a disappointment, and we brought friends. We made a reservation with Vincent. We got there and the guy said there was no Vincent and that this was not The Palm Restaurant. He sent us to the back to another place. Very confusing. Hamburger was shit. Cheap bun. Very sweet sauce and way too much. Price unjustified. Unsure if we will return.

author: Jose Cora
review_text: My parents are Puerto Ricans and their culinary skills are 😘👌 My dad's hobby is roasting pork on the weekends. My mom chefs up arroz con guandules, yuca, guineitos and morsillas. When I go to Spanish Restaurants, I always check to see how they compare to that old school style way of cooking my parents have. The lechonera 👍👍 The food is excellent!!! I definitely recommend this restaurant!!!

author: Noc L.
review_text: Checking out the hype that everyone was raging about. I have to say its overrated. Can't believe everything you see on social media. The chowmein was salty, the mushroom chicken was salty, the orange chicken was more batter than chicken. The flavor is there, just too salty for my palate. My favorite would have to be the honey walnut shrimp, but they're stingy on that bc I had to pay extra for that side. Because they just open, I might give them another chance to settle in and improve their routine and recipe.

author: Eddie Marti
review_text: Dino's hand's down is one of my favorite spot to eat chicken when i visit back home in the L.A.area. I found this place back in my senior year in high school early 2000's, and you know what, the taste, the juiciness, the quantity, the quality, and the deliciousness, is all the same. Love how i can come back and visit and the flavor hasnt changed and its as good as my first time visiting. Keep up the great work. Highly recommend the chicken plate. Which ever way you like. Chicken is life!!!!😋

author: Jonathan Setiawan
review_text: Men Lari bigul hits different, came back 3x in 3 days. Overall great food, quite pricey, but worth the money. Will definitely come back!

author: Kelias Quek
review_text: I love Thai food and visiting Bangkok is a yearly affair for me and my partner. We have never tried this place before but decided to give it a go after seeing some review on RED. Here’s my thought, crab meat rice was good, Tom yum too! But the other two dishes was a big no no. Firstly the ‘fresh’ river prawn tasted flakely and with no seasoning, which is a hi he disappointed. And the seafood vermicelli was just so-so. This really gave the place a huge mark down in my pov. So if you do visit there, do try the crab meat with rice and egg or Tom yum. Other than that don’t waste your stomach space.

author: Chian
review_text: Still my favourite shaved ice spot in hatyai!!! Good food, good environment and great service. In love with their salted eye shaved ice!! Tried their croffle for the first time and turned out a BOOMMM!!!! regret to try it too late!!! We ordered the kaya croffle , it’s so nicee mannnn!! Buttery and crunchy yummy! End ii we ordered the second one : salted egg croffle, it’s still good but i would recommend the kaya one more ❤️

author: Rob
review_text: I haven’t given this place the credit it deserves since I usually order here off Uber Eats. I been buying from here occasionally for the past 6-7 years or so. Their cakes has to be one of the best cakes I’ve ever had. I’ve tried their empanadas and they’re great too but their cakes is something to die for. It’s so tasty and fulfilling. The perfect mix of sweet and flavor where some bakeries can’t get that perfect combination. I live local but never been here in person lol. I will make sure I stop by here one day to see the wonderful people who have sending me delicious treats all the years in person.

author: KayyLynn
review_text: 2 HUGE specialty slices and a fountain drink for $10! Can't beat the price! Pizza was fresh and hot!

author: Selina Tan
review_text: Had a great time at Boleh Seafood Pot! The seafood was super fresh, especially the crab we got for free with our RM250 order 🦀🔥 Love the variety 8 kinds of seafood in one pot! The place is spacious, has karaoke rooms, and even free snacks. Perfect for group gatherings. Will definitely come back!

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Lova Lova
review_text: I am speechless! The food is absolutely delicious, always fresh and tasty! This is my favorite restaurant in Saigon. Hands down, the best bun cha Ha Noi I have ever eaten. I always end up eating here whenever Im visiting. Staff’s attitude is always great as well😊

author: Siena WD
review_text: Unfortunate that I finally found a go-to/favorite Ethiopian place in the city a few weeks before going home for the summer. It took some time to get here but I was very committed to procrastinating my homework, and if you're an ethiopian restaurant offering me a vegetarian combo there's really no limit to how far I'll travel for that. I got the feast for two (though I am only one. Next night dinner. It's called being smart) and apparently they offer this to go in a pizza box which is very smart and fun however I worried it would be clunky for the subway so instead I got a million containers of greatness. My photographs as always are of dubious quality, but rest assured the food was not. The injera, thank god again, was sour, I hate when it's bland but this was far from it, the perfect vessel for all of everything. I don't know all the names of the dishes but I loved everything I ate. The mushrooms stood out, I love gomen, the split peas and red lentils were doing their thing, something was spicy and idk what it was but it was ASTOUNDING I say really the whole meal I was just thrilled with so I had it again that weekend and loved it just as much. When I picked up my orders both times! The person working was friendly and warm and unbelievably kind, I'll have to dine in next time because I imagine the service is top notch. I'm going to enjoy my summer away from the easy coast but I will say, this spot will be on my mind and I'm looking forward to being reunited with the greatness that is Bunna Cafe.

author: c man
review_text: Out of all the ONLY ONES RESTURANT LOCATIONS … this one has a more fresher and cleaner feeling and look. I also find the food better especially the chicken soup. BUT THE COCO BREAD & CHEESE LEAVES A LOT TO BE DESIRED AND THERES NEVER NOT MUCH CHEESE. THE CHEESE ISNT MELTED AND IT JUST VERY VERY LITTLE AMOUNT OF CHEESE. IF THAT GETS FIXED theyre absolutely for me THE JAMAICAN RESTURANT IN BOSTON.

author: Marcus CHUA
review_text: Good taste roti canai, staff friendly and service good. Overall cleanliness can be improve.

author: Davis Lin
review_text: Nothing special about the pizzas here except for the good service by the friendly waiters. Ordered a few pizzas and spaghetti. The spaghetti had little taste maybe due to it being too creamy. The pizza was good and you can request for the pizza to be sliced into how many pizzas. Atmosphere was peaceful and fantastic and you can get a good view of the bridge on the 2nd level.

author: Joyce
review_text: Had the pork ribs at Wahaha — the portion was huge.The meat was super tender and not dry at all. Came with fries or rice and some veggies, so I was really full. The sauce was sweet and savory, really good😋

author: Lexia Cicone
review_text: We got a vegan wedding cake from Fiore's Bakery. Pros: The cake was very affordable, looked beautiful, and tasted amazing. Even our non-vegan guests commented on how good it was! We also loved that they offered gluten-free cupcakes for our guests with dietary restrictions. Cons: The ordering process was unfortunately quite disorganized. We received a call on the day of pickup asking what design we wanted, even though we had confirmed the details with an employee several months earlier. When we re-sent the design that had already been approved, the employee responded in a rude manner, and we felt the response was unnecessarily defensive. More particularly, the employee dismissed our concerns on the phone, continued to cut us off, and attempted to gaslight us into thinking that we caused the miscommunication (despite showing screenshots of our continual communication with our point of contact at the bakery about our design for over a year). While the end result was wonderful, the experience leading up to it was stressful. I’d recommend Fiore’s for their delicious vegan cakes, but would be cautious about using them for weddings, and suggest confirming design details multiple times to avoid any last-minute confusion.

author: Imigrou
review_text: We had a wonderful experience at this restaurant! The food was delicious and generously served, with every dish full of flavor and beautifully presented. The service was outstanding — very personalized, with a staff that was clearly well-trained and attentive. The atmosphere is warm and family-friendly, making it the perfect spot for our Sunday lunch. A special mention goes to the maître d’, Fabiano, who was especially kind and attentive throughout our entire meal. His attention to detail truly made the experience even better. Highly recommended!

author: Richard Soon Chai Lim
review_text: It's located in an old estate, and now that the downtown line Mattar MRT station is situated behind the Hawker Centre, which brings convenience for hawker food connoisseurs. There is a mix of stalls that caters to the breakfast and lunch crowds and those who cater for the dinner and supper crowd. It's a must for an experience to those who love Hawker Centre foods.

author: Azis Muslim
review_text: a comfortable place to use as a place to gather, talk, or meetings and taste quality Indonesian cuisine

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: D G S
review_text: The most fabulous hot pot experience we’ve ever had! We enjoyed both the soup and the grill — everything was just amazing. We couldn’t even finish all the food we ordered, there was so much! The value for money was incredible. Totally worth it. Just wow!

author: Yap Han Lin
review_text: We had a wonderful dining experience at this Vietnamese restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious. Each dish was well-prepared, flavorful, and truly showcased authentic Vietnamese cuisine. A special mention goes to the staff, especially Sam, who was attentive and friendly throughout our visit. Sam patiently shared insights about Vietnamese cuisine and helped us understand the dishes better, which made the experience even more enjoyable. Highly recommended for anyone looking for great food and genuine hospitality.

author: constantly penat
review_text: combination of their flavourful broth and the tender wagyu is top-notch, worth the hype and the slightly higher price service was great, no queue at all as we went 4pm on a weekday

author: Marcus Goh
review_text: passes by without much queue at odd hours, decided to try out due to good review. good tasting food, nice open space to dine. hands washing point available for those who prefer to touch their food.

author: Kevin Cai
review_text: I flew a red-eye and was already exhausted from my previous leg, but the exceptional service made all the difference. The bathrooms and showers were spotless, the food was freshly prepared, and the drinks came out quickly and perfectly made. Most importantly, the staff were incredibly accommodating and friendly - a big shout-out to Hazel, Elsy, Jessy, Pinky, Alvin, Divan, and Marissa for truly enhancing my overall flying experience.

author: Berry Yeap
review_text: Authentic Thai cuisine in a charming setting! Loved the decor—you enter through a narrow path before reaching the restaurant. 😍✨ 🛎️ Without a reservation, you might miss out! We walked in around 5:30 PM and were lucky to get a table. One note: the high chairs for kids here don’t have safety straps. 😅 Thankfully, my little one managed fine. With just two of us, we couldn't order too much. We tried the recommended appetizers: crab meat spring rolls (180/270 THB), braised pork leg with radish (today's special), stir-fried mani leaves (150 THB), and the spicy seafood soup (300 THB). Plus one rice and two drinks, the total came to 1,095 THB. Overall, a great experience! 😌👌

author: Josue Castillo
review_text: I’ve been waiting for koro to open definitely a great addition to east Boston! I had the koro roll, wings, B.L.T roll, miso ramen and the shrimp tempura, they were all delicious I highly recommend! Can’t wait to come back and try the rest of the menu

author: Victoria
review_text: The lala soup is super nice and affordable. The lala clay pot is selling at $13.80. Then you can choose all the fresh ingredients inside the fridge. Come on weekdays not so crowded. Weekend will be packed and sold out fast. I can just come here for the soup. Super hearty for a rainy day or any day. Haha

author: Giang Hà
review_text: Great restaurant. Delicious, nutritious, cheap, cool, clean, beautiful, enthusiastic staff, funny owner, everyone should come and experience it. 10 points without any buts.

author: B L
review_text: My go-to spot for authentic Hainan chicken rice and white coffee! This restaurant never fails to deliver - the chicken is always tender, flavorful, and perfectly poached. The rice is fragrant and infused with just the right amount of chicken stock. And the white coffee? Divine! Smooth, creamy, and not too sweet. It's the perfect complement to their delicious Hainan chicken. The service is always friendly, and the atmosphere is cozy and welcoming. If you're a fan of Hainan chicken or great coffee, this spot is a must-visit!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Leve Leverett
review_text: Loved the outdoor vibe, sunny and warm!! Come hungry! Serving sizes are super large! Food was hot and amazing! We ordered grilled chicken nachos and the mahi mahi tacos!!

author: Nik K
review_text: Best yam rice eaten so far. The sourness of the soup was just nice and also they are very generous in the portion of meat given. Offals and pork cooked to perfection. ordered for 2 pax, and it was so good that we ordered an extra again. Great amount of yam can be seen with the rice. Situated in an old kopitiam, though not very well maintained, but the place is clean. Highly recommended

author: Fan
review_text: We came here because this place had such good reviews, but many other people thought that too. In the evening the queue is big and expect to wait a few minutes before you can enter. The food is good, but not really great in my opinion. What I loved was the original Thai bowl that they served the drinks in!

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Louwil Cadorna
review_text: First time I ate Bak Ku Teh! And it didnt disappoint, so yummy! Deana, thanks for your great service!

author: Evonne Ching
review_text: Good place to find Chinese style pasembur with crispy fried bits, chee cheong fun, char kuey teow, and fragrant egg & coconut tarts! Hidden gem in bukit mertajam area if you’re looking for a good coffee shop with everything local.

author: Tiffany Love
review_text: I ordered food from here via Uber Eats. I got an order of fried Oreos, Small waffle fries and 10piece honey bbq wings (5flats & 5 drum). The fried Oreos 10/10. The fries 10/10, the wings 7.5/10. The drums tasted amazing but the flats tasted a bit old. Their ranch is also 10/10, it tasted like wing stop ranch. I will definitely order again though but maybe earlier in the day. (Forgot to take a pic of the fried Oreos)

author: Gabriela Mascaró
review_text: One of my favorite spots for a casual or business lunch during the week. The ambiance is upbeat with good music, but still quiet enough for easy conversation. Service is relaxed, no one rushes you. The lunch menu delivers great quality, and if you go on a Friday, they offer the best wine deal in town: a bottle of Whispering Angel for $25. Food is solid (4/5), and the chicken truffle dim sum appetizer is a standout. Don’t leave without trying the Peking duck: rich, crispy, and perfectly paired with delicate sides. Valet is available, but Uber is usually easier. Totally worth it.

author: Ridwan Mustafa
review_text: Delicious affordable halal char kway teow from a chinese convert islam muslim owned. Has 3 pricing! Small:$4.50 Middle $5.50 Large $6.50. Ordered the small one and it look pretty decent. Service wise can be improve. Just don’t come during peak lunchtime period between 12 to 2.30pm as he’s busy and will give sour face (whoever order when he’s making the order as he’s only 1 person no assistant)

author: Rick Cobb
review_text: Fun place, great service, but the food wasn’t great at all. The pizza was super salty. Then again we ordered one with several kinds of processed meats. The garlic knots were terrible though. They were hockey pucks with flavor added on the top. I hate to be so negative, but after reading other reviews I really expected better.

author: Jacob Barbato
review_text: Busy and lively atmosphere, kitschy decor, and fresh cut steaks. Appetizers and entrees round out offerings, full bar available. Service is quick and friendly. Affordable prices for families.

author: Thu Hương Phạm
review_text: The restaurant has a spacious, airy space, many seats, fully equipped with fans so it is quite cool. The menu is diverse with many different dishes. There are grilled dishes, hot pot dishes and pre-cooked dishes. The price is reasonable, affordable. The taste is suitable for me and my group of friends. The car will be parked right on the sidewalk in front of the restaurant, there is a parking attendant. The downside of the restaurant is that we ordered fried squid eggs with fish sauce, our group mentioned it twice but still did not see this dish so in the end we paid. When asked, both times the staff responded that it was being prepared. The bill was also a bit slow to pay. The last point is that the restaurant gives away guava for dessert.

author: Yee Sheng Kwan
review_text: FANTASTIC!! The best Bingsu I had tried ever. Really impressive 🔥 Good photo and good desserts! Jackson Wang must try thiss!

author: Sarah
review_text: Really awesome selection of food. Lots to chose from which makes it fun. The downside is that it can get very busy and feels like a small space.

author: Justin Marrero
review_text: This was hands down the worst Chinese buffet I’ve ever been to — and I’m not exaggerating. Every single thing I tried tasted bland, stale, or just plain wrong. The chicken? Rubbery. The noodles? Oily and flavorless. The sushi? I wouldn’t trust it to feed a stray cat. Even the fried rice somehow managed to be dry and soggy at the same time. How is that even possible? Nothing — and I mean nothing — was enjoyable. Not one bite. I actually left hungrier and more frustrated than when I walked in. If this is what they consider “fresh” or “authentic,” they need to seriously reevaluate everything. The only thing worse than the food was the regret that hit me halfway through chewing the first bite. Save your money, your time, and your stomach — go literally anywhere else.

author: Nirmal Bhai
review_text: La Favela is truly one of the most vibrant and exciting places to visit! The seamless booking process already sets the tone for a great experience. From the moment you step inside, you’re transported into a lively and unique atmosphere filled with stunning décor, captivating photospots, and a fun, upbeat vibe. The environment is perfect for both casual nights out with friends and special celebrations. The food and drinks are consistently amazing : tasty, well-presented, and definitely worth coming back for. The staff are friendly, helpful, and attentive, making the entire experience feel welcoming and enjoyable. It’s my second time here, and I’m already looking forward to many more visits! A special shout-out to the DJ who always does a fantastic job! The music selection keeps the energy high all night and really brings the whole place together. Whether you’re dancing the night away or just soaking in the ambiance, the soundtrack of the night never disappoints. Overall, La Favela is a must-visit spot for anyone looking for great food, delicious drinks, and a fun night out filled with great music and photo-worthy moments. Love this place, highly recommended!

author: MsOmNom
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 — Authentic pho, Michelin-recognised for a reason Visited Phở Hùng near Ben Thanh Market in Ho Chi Minh City, and it absolutely lived up to its Michelin Guide recognition (2024–2025). This is a no-frills, very local spot serving excellent, authentic pho at very reasonable prices. The atmosphere feels genuinely Vietnamese — simple, bustling, and focused on the food. I tried the house special pho, and it was outstanding. The broth was deep, aromatic, and clean, with generous portions of beef and well-balanced flavours. Add in the fresh herbs, bean sprouts, and chilli to taste, and it’s comfort food at its best. To top it off, they also serve traditional Vietnamese iced coffee, which was strong, smooth, and the perfect finish to the meal. If you’re looking for a true local pho experience in Ho Chi Minh City — especially one backed by Michelin — Phở Hùng is absolutely worth a visit.

author: Tomas Piaggio
review_text: Awesome place in Boston, with great food options, nice beer and cocktails, plenty of space to go with a big group. The music is not loud so you can chat without any problems. Will definitely come back!

author: corina vozniak
review_text: For Venice this was 5* for me. Attentive staff, good cocktail/wine list, and most marvelous sausage/rabe orecchiette pasta. Loved the meatballs, okay pizza (mostly because all LA pizzas taste the same, soggy in the middle, yeasty fluffy crust and whatever else on the middle), but the pasta...it was a little chewy, a little doughy (all in the best way possible), perfectly saucy, spiced to perfection. The Nebbiolo they source washes down splendidly after all the protein/carb intake. Servers are attentive, knowledgeable, non-intrusive but always around and quick.

author: Jason Quek
review_text: No need to go to the main stall. The branch at Siam Paragon is equally good. And don’t have to queue long hours like Raan Jay Fai under the hot weather. Save time and effort and fulfill your crab meat hunger. 😂

author: Steven Chiu
review_text: Really a hidden gem with seniors getting up at early as 330am to be there. It was already crowded at 5am!

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Butch Recibe
review_text: The price is very affordable. The place is cozy, the food is really really great. The free soup is very delicious. The Banh Mi was my favorite. They use pure meat.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Bernadette Guanine Barte
review_text: I came in thinking it was a rice meal, I was disappointed it was noodle (I am a rice girl). But oh my goodness, the noodles delivered. I never expected it to be THAT delicious! Really really delicious. Can’t stress that enough. Such a small place but SO GOOD!

author: Serge Boudreault
review_text: Very simple, cheap good food. Eaten here many times. Good tofu dishes.

author: Moon Kum Weng
review_text: Am regular customer who frequently buy breads from Continental. They have a wide range of loaf breads, muffins, sourdough, corn bread, banana bread, egg tart, cinnamon rolls, white bread, raisin breads, etc. Enough variety for the young and old. Both healthy and not so healthy. Owing to the huge sales daily the prices are very competitive. Thus, this bakery is very popular with people who consume breads regularly. Parking is an issue around the shop. Most customers will just stop outside, quickly run in & pick the breads, pay and drive off.

author: Kee Kelven
review_text: It was my first time visiting this bakery, and it quickly became one of my favorites. The bakery has an old-school look and is filled with the amazing smell of fresh bread and pastries. They serve all kinds of baked goods, including sourdough, muffins, cinnamon rolls, tarts, and croissants. My personal favorite is the cinnamon rolls, which are really soft and rich in cinnamon flavor and sweetness. The bakery is always crowded, and everyone has to pick their bread quickly before it sells out after the staff puts it on the racks.

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Christopher Tann
review_text: Absolutely incredible eating experience. I had a warm bowl and every individual ingredient was fresh and prepared so deliciously. One of my favorite meals that I didn’t cook myself. And the people here are super cool; Angel is super kind and answered all my questions and help me with all my modifiers!

author: roxanne charles
review_text: This is my 2nd review with the same issue different staff. I went there this past weekend after running errands. Out of all the many many Jamaican spots I enjoy them overall for the food. I come from Dorchester (in traffic) to receive the rudeness. The server was a man (again) very rude and lack hearing. He looked as if he was high. I asked for a large jerk chicken rice and peas. He proceeds to put white rice. I was trying to get his attention and clearly he is not hearing me. At that point I asked the female server to take my order. I still had to watch the customer behind deal with his ignorance. He had the nerve to go back and forth with her about her order. To the owner: Customer service its the key to a successful business. If you choose to keep ignoring these complaints regarding the rude staff, your business will eventually suffer in the long run. This is insulting to our people who want to support black business. We have to do better and hold staff accountable for their unprofessional behaviors.

author: Hai Phan (Francis)
review_text: This is where I often go to eat the famous Singapore frog porridge. I just came back and felt the taste of the dish is still great. The service is very fast, professional, reasonable price. The restaurant is clean and the staff is quite enthusiastic.

author: Liz Selles
review_text: I'll be honest, I wasn't expecting much from a beachside restaurant. But boy was I wrong. We went on a Friday around 2:30 pm. It was a beautiful day so this was the perfect spot. The food was so good. And so were the drinks. And very reasonably priced. But my favorite part was Amanda our bartender. She was awesome and my Sea Breeze was perfection. Took great care of us. Can't wait to come back. And a shout out to manager Shane. Great job. Thank you.

author: Jacqueline Lee
review_text: We ordered the collagen soup based with lamb chops incl grilled ones. We had divided preference for both and dessert come free w every hotpot ordered. The bamboo shoots will hv to cook slightly longer otherwise it'll be too hard. Overall, the experience is good.

author: Gia Thanh Viên
review_text: Good packaging Good service Fast delivery Nice shipping method Good product quality

author: Elizabeth M
review_text: We had a fantastic dining experience at Crazy About You! The atmosphere was warm and welcoming, and the food was absolutely delicious; every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. A special shoutout to our waitress, LAURA, who went above and beyond to make sure we had everything we needed. She was friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable about the menu. Her service truly made our visit even more enjoyable. Highly recommend this place for both the amazing food and top-notch service. Can’t wait to come back!

author: Novi Beerens
review_text: I ordered black pepper crab, and Kangkung Belacan. Both were ok. The ambiance was noisy but we can still talking. Good place to eat seafood while shop at Plaza Indonesia.

author: PJ
review_text: 7am staff is fabulous and friendly 🤩 "In Store" experience is peaceful; the playlist is calming. The Coffee Cream is a little weird but I left there a happy camper.

author: Sarah Lee
review_text: Most affordable and valuable mookata buffet in Northern area- Khao Kun offers unlimited buffet with a wide range of choices for food at the price of RM29.90. They have cooked food stations, ice stations, popcorn, drinks, ice-cream and plenty of ingredients for you to cook with. With the time limit of 120 minutes, it’s more than enough to enjoy the buffet. For cooked food, their signature fried chicken is a must try. During our visit, they were running a promo of free lala pot which was packed with flavours and fresh. For the mookata, you can opt for tomyam soup or clear soup. The ingredients here were fresh and of all the meat, the lemongrass and tomyam chicken & pork tasted the best.

author: Bridget Ohms
review_text: Stopped here for a quick breakfast and we were not disappointed!! Delicious food, great service & amazing atmosphere!! I have to add that their banana bread muffins are the BEST!!

author: Dior Ella
review_text: Located in a paid parking lot. I was skeptically but it smelled phenomenal so I tried since people were raving how spicy it is. Welcome to the taqueria where the tacos are as authentic as the street they're named after. The atmosphere? About as casual as a siesta under a palm tree. Now, let's taco 'bout the food. These tortillas are so fresh, they practically introduce themselves. The carne asada? Tender enough to make a vegetarian reconsider. And don't even get me started on the salsa—spicy enough to make your taste buds do the cha-cha. Service? It's like they've mastered the art of efficiency with a side of más salsa, señor?You'll have your tacos faster than you can say guac! So, if you're craving a taste of Mexico without the airfare, this taqueria is your ticket to flavor town. Just bring your appetite and leave your expectations on the side street. It’s street food after all not a five-star fiesta.

author: Debbie Z
review_text: Had breakfast at At Peru this morning. I come to Hollywood Beach every year. Absolutely the best breakfast on the beach. Classic American - crispy bacon is actually crispy and tastes great. Potatoes have just the right amount of seasoning. Pancake is cooked perfectly. Not too mushy. Not too dry. Ronny is a fantastic server. Prices are reasonable - well actually cheap per HB standards. Price is cheap but food is not. Did I mention we eat here at least 4 times during our one week visit! You can’t go wrong if you eat breakfast at At Peru but you sure can go right!

author: Elizabeth Luna
review_text: This spot has some amazing rolls. From deep fried rolls to baked rolls and, of course, classic rolls, everything is different and delicious. We've been exploring their menu for years now, and it is definitely a fusion that calls to continue to be discovered. This is Sinaloa style sushi made with lots of love. The rolls are creative and culturally distinctive, and all come with classic regional sides that include a secret signature sauce. This food takes time. It's usually a 25-minute wait for your order. If there are people ahead, it usually takes a minute to get your order. Calling in your order is highly recommended. It is also cash only and the parking is very limited and there are only a few benches for outdoor seating and no restrooms. Despite a few unappealing elements, this place is always packed. It's definitely a must try.

author: Jacqueline Tew
review_text: The food was served very quick and looks good! However, I would like to add that the honey mustard chicken we ordered (which was a recommended menu item) was underwhelming and not what was expected. The chicken was cold and slightly overcooked. I believe it would taste better if the chicken was crispy and hot from the pan/airfryer. The staff here are friendly and helpful (ie. explaining the menu ingredients, checking on availability, during payments). They are doing their best to give the customers a good service. Of course, the ambiance of the cafe is comfortable as well. As this is their soft-launching era, I trust that the team is continuously improving and perfecting their menu. Worth to give them a chance 🫶🏻

author: B.
review_text: Food was great but the service was horrible. The waitress was nice but after bringing us our drinks and food, she disappeared. We finally ordered drinks with her and another server and didn’t receive those drinks until over a half hour later. The workers/servers were taking shots with the locals at the bar. There was only one guy for the entire restaurant going around serving all the different meat for the ridizio. That is UNACCEPTABLE, especially on a busy day like Father’s Day. There were also a bunch of solicitors coming in trying to sell stuff to everyone. Not sure what type of management they have, but they definitely need to make some adjustments to their service.

author: Dan
review_text: Food was average. There is a lot more delicious food in Bangkok. Prawn though was a huge disappointment. Under-seasoned and a bit over-cooked with no umami.

author: Andrea Kylle
review_text: The grilled corn is fantastic, balancing smoky grill marks with a savory cream sauce, and served on skewers for easy eating.

author: Darren Cantwell
review_text: The food is quite nice and it’s affordable. I did find a small hair amongst the chicken which is why I took off one star. The flavor was good.

author: Kenoa Askerneese
review_text: Visited shortly after brunch so food options were limited but good nonetheless. Chicken quesadilla came with a side of rice and beans. Had a Sunset in Tijuana. Everything was so so good. You can tell isa vibe at night too. Staff was friendly and helpful when explaining menu options. Lots of photo ops too! 😊 I'll definitely visit again.

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: Yeoh Yuxian
review_text: This is a must come for foodies! There’s the famous Geylang Briyani Stall, Iqbal Soup Kambing, the old school Hainan Kaya Toast (where you can get your kopi in a tin), and Oli Thosai! Place is super packed and the queue is long too. But super worth it!

author: Lauren Tinha
review_text: Our team had reservations earlier today, Joseph our server was amazing, he saved the day! The food was okay , but I was disappointed to learn that house items such as the calamari, the chicken parmigiana, and the surf and turf were unavailable during our visit. For that reason, I’m leaving a four-star review. However, Joseph’s excellent service and thoughtful plate recommendations truly elevated the experience to what felt like five-star hospitality. I will return, and I hope the restaurant will be better stocked on my next visit.

author: Abe R
review_text: It was a Sunday outing and we did expect the crowd. The Nasi Lemak: 1. Love the fragrance rice 2. Sambal was my kind of sambal. Well balance between sweet spicy. 3. Chicken - mama'mia lovely. The table setting : It's a mess. All the tables are squash to max the capacity which made it stuffy. I said that because if your next neighbour fart, you will be blessed with whatever aroma definitely. 🤣🤣🤣 So as much as I ❤️ the taste of your Nasi Lemak, if i suddenly crave for it, I will only grab food them to unsure the survival of my Nose

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: Ryan
review_text: Standard bowl of pig organ soup, Ordered taukee on the side and wasnt given much. Chilli sauce that they give is not spicy. Overall just an average pig organ soup nothing special.

author: Maitri Bhandari
review_text: From the moment I stepped into Bunna Cafe, I was completely charmed. Tucked away in Brooklyn, this all-vegan Ethiopian spot radiates warmth and culture, and an inviting, communal vibe. They even host an authentic Ethiopian coffee ceremony in the evenings, which adds to the immersive feel. The staff was wonderful, warm, welcoming, and happy to answer questions about the menu and traditions. We kicked off our meal with Kategna, a crispy, toasty injera snack paired with Daata, a spicy side sauce that delivered just the right amount of heat. Simple, but incredibly satisfying. Next came the highlight: the Feast. It’s a platter of injera topped with vibrant scoops of various stews and vegetables. Each one was distinct, bursting with flavors. The crimini mushrooms were earthy and umami-rich, the lentils hearty and beautifully spiced, and the collard greens brought a fresh, slightly tangy contrast. The Shiro, a spiced chickpea stew, was deeply comforting and packed with flavors. Honestly, it was impossible to pick a favorite. Every bite felt thoughtful, nourishing, and made to be shared. I sipped on refreshing Hibiscus tea throughout the meal, which was the perfect complement to the bold, warming flavors. Bunna Cafe is a celebration of Ethiopian cuisine and culture. Fun, flavorful, communal, and deeply satisfying. I’ll definitely be coming back.

author: Lim SC
review_text: Finally visited the talk of the city when coming to nasi lemak. Anticipated the queue and crowd even at 11am Friday working day. However queue moved fast. Service was prompt. The nasi lemak was good, sambal too. Fried chicken was crispy outside tender inside. The only little weak was the atmosphere - tight sitting places to cater for the crowd. Be prepared to seat with strangers on the same table. Well what to compliant as sharing table with stranger is an norm in Malaysia street food culture.

author: Kaustubh M
review_text: One of our all time favorite spots. Everything j the menu is perfect and well seasoned. Good cocktails and very hospitable staff. We always get the raw oysters and the loaded seafood roll. Can’t ask for much more than this.

author: Mich Bartolo
review_text: Sep 2024: For bar food, it was great. The fried ravioli was delicious and perfectly crispy. The fries were evenly cut and fresh, and the burgers were decent for a bar. The local drinks were a nice touch as well.

author: Fateema Akter
review_text: Namkeen is such a pretty restaurant and the staff are so sweet, especially Angie in the front :) We got the chicken and waffles, “hot” is not for the weak.. and the waffles were so tasty!! Everything comes out fresh. Definitely a great place to go with friends.

author: Niles Cong
review_text: Best Cơm Tấm in-town. If you are looking for an extremely full and delicious dinner to fill up an empty stomach, this is the place you want to give it a try. The seats are okay, but the main dish was absolutely without a doubt. The toppings are many, and you may have to order additional portion of rice to finish the remaining. The serving was quite fast and waiters were energetic. The only downside is thr price is a bit high for the dish with full topping.

author: yan H
review_text: This cosy café sits quietly next to the beach giving a peaceful and relaxing feel. The bright and airy space inside makes it a nice spot to enjoy a slow meal. A slice of chocolate cake and a hearty sandwich on the table add the perfect finishing touch to a peaceful afternoon.

author: Jeffrey Osborne
review_text: Such a great low key place to get work done on a busy weekday, most people won’t travel that far from the downtown area so the foot traffic isn’t terrible, no distractions, great environment and even better food options ( vegan )

author: juanita1 “Juanita” Pitt
review_text: Froze my tush off. (AC was cranking) Food was decent. Was not excited that they were holding a political rally. I go out to eat to 'escape' the computer and TV.

author: Huntyr Escobar
review_text: Janae was the dopest server ever. Food came out hot, fresh and delicious. She refilled drinks without even having to ask her and she checked on us several times throughout the meal. Great service awesome food. We will be back.

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: Christopher Wong
review_text: The food was exceptional and the atmosphere is incredible whether seated inside or outside. The spacing between tables promotes a casual relaxed vibe. On taste alone I can understand why this restaurant was recognized with the Michelin bib Gourmand award. FOOD (1) Rawaeng (Beef Turmeric Curry) My favorite dish that pairs perfectly with Thai Jasmine rice. (2) Deep Fried Chicken Wings w/ Lemongrass & Sweet Fish Sauce My second favorite dish. The bed of fried lemongrass under the chicken wings isn't just for presentation. It goes well with each bite of the wing and sweet sauce. I liked this more than Korean fried chicken. Don't hate me. (3) Grilled Pork Neck & Dipping Sauce Has a flavor profile similar to Vietnamese grilled pork even though the dish looks more similar to Chinese BBQ pork. The garlic and herb garnishes pairs perfectly with the pork. (4) Spicy Shrimp Salad Taste was agreeable. But not what I was expecting for a salad in terms of texture and cohesion of vegetables and meat like if you were to order larb. It would have been more appropriately classified as a stir-fry with a sweet chili sauce. In retrospect, there were no vegetables or fruit like the squid or beef salad. Maybe they forgot or messed up my order? SERVICE While the waitresses were friendly, I was pretty disappointed with service. For customers waiting in the lobby, they offered other customers right before us a small cup of cold tea in the lobby. But not my party. My table was never shown the specials of the day blackboard menu unlike other tables around me. I ordered mixed rice but was only served white rice. I ordered bottled water with ice but only got a bottle of room temperature water. The water didn't even arrive though two dishes showed up on our table. It probably wouldn't have arrived if I didn't ask about it. I know the difference between Michelin Bib and Star establishments, but these waitresses are just standing around until you stare or wave them down for every little thing rather than being proactive and attentive. This left a bad impression on the overall experience. They need to train and figure out their service workflow because it was pretty bad. I just wanted to get the check and leave as soon as possible. Well, I got the check and saw a mandatory service charge for 10%. Hopefully my service experience at another Chiang Mai Bib Gourmand will be better tomorrow.

author: J.W. Werner
review_text: Even though this place was busy I was still able to get a table for one fairly quickly. It is beautifully decorated with the South Florida vibe. You may have to wait a little extra, but you might consider asking for a waterside table. Just be prepared that you may be in the sun. But it’s worth it. This sweet tea is pretty good and I ordered the Smoked Fish Dip, Key West Pasta, a side of coleslaw, and the Sticky Toffee Cake for dessert. The smoked fish dip was good. I do think it had a little too much jalapeño that was overpowering the smoked fish. Maybe less jalapeño and add a hint of lemon or lime. I squeezed some lime for my tea and it was great. The coleslaw had a really good flavor and texture, but a little dry. I like my slaw a little wetter. The Key West Pasta was fabulous! The linguine was perfectly cooked and so were the shrimp. The sauce was extremely flavorful, almost like an Italian tomato-vodka sauce. The crispy, crunchy toasted bread was a perfect match. The Sticky Toffee Cake was really buttery rich and flavorful but mine was a tad on the dry side. Still a great finish to the meal. The waterside tables and atmosphere was inviting and super relaxing. At least 6-7 boats honked their horns as their passengers waved at the dock side guests. One boat even docked at the restaurant and those aboard came into the restaurant to dine. The staff was very friendly and attentive too.

author: Kaliah Gopher-Moore
review_text: Terrible service wouldn’t even give me a refund, don’t buy shit from here if you want your money stolen

author: Jiayi (Summer) He
review_text: The food was amazing, the beef is so tender and in my opinion the sauce really brings everything together in the rice bowl. The raw egg yolk is also really good

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: Paul Ciprian
review_text: One of the oldest markets in Singapore. Now, very nicely renovated. It has two sections: one is the agri-food market, the other is a hawker center where you can eat cheaply and well.

author: killian aperce
review_text: The food was good, but the staff were very unpleasant, condescending, and barely spoke English. I recommend walking an extra 5 minutes to eat somewhere else.

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: 보디사트바
review_text: I went because I was in front of the hotel. It was the best banh mi I had in Vietnam. and I was walking by and they greeted me, but I didn't know you were doing this to me. smile is so beautiful.

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: Adrian Ng (Realtor Consultant)
review_text: Came with family for a late dinner. Ordered the usual mee sua, fried pork belly, steamed squid and fish hor fun. Food taste good except for the hor fun which is totally bland. Price is reasonable, serving sizes are good. However staff attitudes are bad and quite rude. So suggest just come, eat, go. Don't expect friendly service.

author: Chris Eng
review_text: Incredibly good in all respects. We've loved every dish across multiple visits. If for some crazy reason you're only ordering one pasta, pick the bucatini with chili anchovy butter and bottarga. Save room for the tiramisu, which is made using amaro (Meletti I believe), dark chocolate, and sea salt -- this combo balances out what in most other restaurants would be a cloyingly sweet dessert.

author: jay melo
review_text: Best Shawarma in Boston! Literally in their name also great verity of food and desserts to choose from. GOAT Combo is definitely my go to order. Amazing!

author: Eric Creighton
review_text: I went to the Carl's jr on sunset and it was closed as in forever and I should have followed my first mind and went somewhere other than Carl's Jr but I went to Carl's Jr on eastern they had an old lady behind the window couldn't hear so reluctantly ordered the food anyway when I got home this is how many fries I had didn't matter because the fries where like a day old she had a bad attitude but that's okay because if I was in my mind to late 70s I would probably be the same but anyway this will be my last time ever going to any Carl's Jr in the state of Nevada again

author: Monifa
review_text: Let me start by saying… I love Jamaican food!! Every time I come to Miami from Trinidad, I make sure to get some. ( this was my first time trying here - JRK) Today, the food was great no complaints there. HOWEVER… the customer service experience was horrible. The lady working at the front was screaming at the staff the entire time. OMG!!! The workers were actually moving fast and doing their best packing Uber Eats, handling in-store customers, everything! But her attitude? Terrible. She absolutely needs an attitude check ASAP. I don’t know what was happening behind the scenes, but there is NO REASON to speak to employees like that, especially in front of customers. It was uncomfortable and unprofessional. Honestly, because of her, I may never return. The food was great, but customer service matters too.

author: James Richardson
review_text: From the moment we walked into Nachlo, we knew we were in for a special experience. This is, without a doubt, one of the best Middle Eastern restaurants I have ever had the pleasure of visiting. It's truly a hidden gem! Every dish we tried was bursting with fresh, authentic flavors. The hummus was velvety smooth and perfectly seasoned, the falafel was crispy on the outside and tender on the inside, and the kabobs were incredibly succulent—clearly marinated and grilled to perfection. I highly recommend trying their signature dish (whatever that may be, maybe a specific slow-cooked lamb or specialty rice dish), it was a culinary revelation. Portions are generous, and the quality of ingredients shines through in every aspect. The atmosphere at Nachlo is wonderfully warm and inviting. The decor strikes a beautiful balance between traditional and elegant, making it perfect for a date night or a family gathering. The subtle background music and the comfortable seating added to the overall pleasant dining experience. Our server was an absolute delight—attentive, knowledgeable about the menu, and genuinely friendly. They offered great suggestions and made us feel welcome and well-cared for throughout the entire meal. The service was prompt without ever feeling rushed. If you are looking for an authentic taste of the Middle East, look no further than Nachlo. It's more than just a meal; it's a delightful experience. We can't wait to come back! Go, you won't be disappointed!

author: Ngô Tô
review_text: The restaurant has a spacious, airy, and cozy atmosphere, like having a drink on your own porch. The food is delicious and very reasonably priced. The bald-headed owner looks funny and cheerful; for some reason, he reminds me of Dien Ba Quang from The Smiling Proud Wanderer, haha.

author: Sofia Varela
review_text: Such a nice spot. Im traveling for work and staying nearby and the food was fresh! amazing branzino papillote. The service was friendly and made me feel at home. The manager came by to check on me, which I thought was a really nice touch! the place was empty but Valentina and the manager really took care of me.

author: Astrid Chavez
review_text: Why did I pay 400$ when I went? I got the fried fish and it was so deep fried you couldn’t even taste the fish. Also left the skin on which was definitely a weird choice. Got the “special drink” and it was straight up vintage dressing for a salad. but waitress was really sweet! Wouldn’t really recommend unless you wanna spend a lot of money for fast food quality food fr.

author: Lin Flores
review_text: I literally cannot believe the ratings for this joint aren’t higher! The food was flawless and the best meal I ate while visiting San Fran! We ordered hush puppies to share and they were divine, so thickly breaded and delicious. I had a latte with oat milk and it was actually the best latte I had while there.

author: Charlie Te
review_text: This pace has been on my radar for awhile and I am glad that I got a chance to check it out veggie heading back home. We ordered a variety of items on the menu just because it all sounded good. The barbacoa tacos, burnt ends, ribs, brisket, and hot link were all tasty. I did really enjoy their Hatch Chile Mac & Cheese and street corn as well. I really don't think you can go wrong with anything here.

author: Jenifer Jolley-JJ-
review_text: Live this jack in the box- great work to the swing shift & mainly graveyard crew!

author: Jacqueline Khoury
review_text: This is a really cool bar. It has 2 pool tables, large TVs, full food menu, and WIFI. I like to come here to get work done from my computer while eating lunch or dinner. Coffee in the morning is also really good. The bartenders treat you like a friend would and they are very helpful overall. I recommend trying the burgers here. Thanks Zo for making me feel welcomed and introducing me to the bar. That was a nice feeling.

author: Kitty Fong
review_text: Stumbled this place as we pass by while looking for lunch. Shocked by the crazy long queue I checked the rating of this place crazily high so we decided to go along. Total wait time : 1 hr with 70% of it waiting on the chair they provided so it’s not that miserable. We were seated by the counter so we can watch the making while waiting. The vegetables, Japanese rice and miso soup are free flow. No sharing allowed. The server pre-grilled the patties first then bring over to my mini grill plate. Here’s what we’ve tried: 1. Chicken Hamburg Original ⭐️⭐️⭐️ - The patties texture a bit firm, peppery and slight garlicky taste. 2. Chicken Hamburg Truffle Sauce ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ - It’s the same as original the hamburg while cooking on the grill however they put a sauce separately on your table so it’s for dipping it not for grilling it together. The truffle sauce tasted good. 3. Chicken Hamburg Black sauce ⭐️⭐️⭐️ - Not as interesting a truffle one, it’s a bit sweet and peppery. 4. Chicken Karaage ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ - Crispy and juicy inside, well marinated too. Overall I feel they’re rather overhyped but again maybe it’s not their signature meat which is beef and we done eat beef. With the queue? No.

author: Mr Vee
review_text: Excellent family style restaurant, generous appetizer and pasta portions. Plenty to share so bring your appetite! Our hostess seated us promptly, Christian and Marco are both awesome and attentive despite the busy hour. They deserve the kudos. We love the calamari and seafood pasta dishes. Freshly prepared and perfect with a dash of parmesan and fresh ground pepper. Highly recommended!

author: Ricardo A.
review_text: Great authentic portuguese food. Amazing squid (grilled) and calamari, the food is always spectacular. Especially the cod fish items. Always pleasing to chat it up with the locals and the hostess. Parking can be a hassle if the lot is packed but never have a problem finding one nearby.

author: βigcat 6öhömё
review_text: This stall is quite famous, featuring several delicious stir-fries. It's a truly delicious place, and there's also a tea stall nearby, which is also quite popular, with crowds on weekdays and holidays. 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM is peak dinner time, so parking is a bit of a gamble, as you'll end up parking farther away. The same goes for tables; you might have to wait a bit. The prices are pretty standard, a bit higher than they used to be, but still reasonable. This is just one of the stalls in the entire food stall complex. The overall environment is quite simple and unpretentious, but the food is a perfect blend of local lifestyle, making it a highly recommended place to eat. 23/07/2023🐱

author: Ian O Toole
review_text: The pineapple chicken was delicious. The empal2rasa was not great. Es durian should state its durian icecream not actual durian.

author: Emily Chng
review_text: We visited on a Sunday, about 11. 20am. Was lucky cos we got a table without waiting. Everything we ordered came promptly, the operations of this coffee shop is efficient. BM Yam Rice (RM 10) is good. There are 2 lanes, one for take away, one for dine in. Generous amount of pork. They even top up the soup without me asking. Good job! Passembur is okay, better if the gravy is sweeter. Chee Cheong Fun is a winner. Must order. Lobak is alright, the dipping sauce can be improved. Ask for more chili as the lor gravy is quite bland. Char Mee is so so, nothing extraordinary. Drinks can be ordered from the counter. Next time I will try something else.

author: Sam Napolitano
review_text: Ok, wow… what an amazing place. We stayed at “The D” on Freemont Street. Ameribrunch was a short 5 minute walk away. I saw previous reviews on Google Maps and thought we need to give this place a try… while we weren’t money winners in Vegas this time, we won the best picked breakfast place in town! Every dish was meticulously prepared, hot, fast and fresh. The Americanos we had were smooth and tasty along with an amazing spicy Bloody Mary. The restaurant is super cute and very eclectic. It just had a happy vibe to it! Topping off our experience was our waiter Alex. What an incredible guy and he really made our day. Not once, but twice. We had such a great experience with him that we brought more people from our party over the next morning. I hope the management sees this post and keeps him happy because he is a true asset to your organization! Thanks Alex! Give Ameribrunch a shot! You owe your belly a happy experience and this is the place to make it happen!!!

author: Amy W
review_text: We were so thoroughly impressed by our meal here on Saturday night that we ended up coming back two other times during a quick weekend trip to NYC. We even rode the PATH train into Newark FROM Manhattan on Sunday evening because we had enjoyed our first experience so much and knew we wouldn’t find a better meal. My boyfriend is Portuguese and has extremely high standards for the cuisine. We have been to Portugal multiple times and we agreed that the meals we had at Coimbra equaled the best meals we had across the Atlantic. Just like a true Portuguese place, olives and delicious rustic breads were served right away. (But unlike Portugal, there was no charge!) My boyfriend got squid for one meal (pictured) and octopus for another. Both were so tender and flavorful, and the potatoes and vegetable sides fresh and perfectly cooked. I ordered the barbecue chicken special (pictured) for two meals, it was so delicious. The stuffed rock crab appetizer is also pictured, another A+. The caldo verde was better than some versions I had in Portugal. The flaming chourico and aletria and bolo de bolacha desserts were perfection as well. The prices are extremely reasonable for the portions and quality delivered. The service is incredible. Pedro was so pleasant and welcoming and helped us out with his thoughtful recommendations. He remembered us when we came back and treated us so well each time. Nelson was also very kind and friendly and we really appreciated his attentiveness. We felt like we had made new friends. We will definitely be back. This place is worth the drive from Maryland. I can’t wait to visit Coimbra again!

author: Ryan Dickinson
review_text: My wife and I came here a bunch of times during our stay. The coffee has a wonderful rounded flavour to it, our favourite Vietnamese coffee so far! Also def worth trying the sugar free banana bread, super tasty.

author: Choo
review_text: A cozy cafe to have the breakfast. You can opt for wheal meal bread for the sandwich, come with add-on option. Overall it’s slightly pricy.

author: Giovani V
review_text: Food and service good enough. I’m giving five stars because the time when I was there a man came in with different capabilities and they serve him as they should fhe other time a lady not in her best, she were dirty and maybe drunk but they still treat and serve here as they supposed to. Maybe if she were bothering the customers maybe they will do something .

author: Steve Facer
review_text: Not sure what happened to the location, but back in the day a super burrito would make you feel over full and would walk out feeling super satisfied. Today, we went in for what was expected to be a great sit down lunch. I ordered a super burrito and was presented with something that was just a little bigger than a microwave burrito and was actually smaller than their chimichanga. A total rip off for just under 25 bucks.

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: Jay Chong
review_text: I was really impressed by his boat noodles. They suited my taste perfectly. The flavor was incredibly rich and delicious! Recommend.

author: Kenny Tang
review_text: Famous bánh mì spot in HCM — and the sandwiches are huge! The shop runs almost like a mini factory, with staff constantly assembling bánh mì. A loaded pork-and-ham one costs 75,000 VND. The pickles and garnishes are given separately for you to add yourself. From what I could tell, it’s takeaway only. The baguette was nicely crunchy, though the size made it a bit hard to eat — it would probably be even better if it were about a third smaller. The meats blended well and the pâté was tasty. I added all the garnishes, including the chillies, and it came together nicely. It’s clearly a well-known spot in HCM, with queues outside and a steady stream of Grab drivers picking up orders. Worth trying if you’re in the area, but I’m not sure I’d make a special trip for it. There are so many bánh mì options in the city, and plenty of them are also very good.

author: Mr Jun
review_text: Forget all the famous hawker centres that you got from YouTube. Come here 😁 Love the food, not too crowded, love the people, and there is a free water fountain at the back.

author: Hagz
review_text: One of the best Thai restaurant in Vegas it's a must every time I visit. The staff was pleasant and extremely attentive. The remodel has changed this from a hole in the wall to a stylish spot for lunch and dinner. You can't go wrong with anything on the menu it's all amazing and the heat scale is very reasonable. Worth a trip to Fremont Street! 100% recommend!

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: HL
review_text: First time eating mookata. Got the $729 set just enough for 2 pax. Wish there were more type of sauces

author: Jacelyn Phang
review_text: There was a snaking queue during dinner time (Friday 7plus) but I was seated inside the eatery very quickly. Managed to get the last order for the chicken (will recommend to go before 8pm cos the chicken was sold out at that time). Service was good and prompt !! Had a $15 chicken, 2 plates of rice, a sambal French beans and a salted veg tofu soup for 2 pax. Food came in adequate portion and was tasty. I did feel that my white chicken was a bit too cold thou. 🥶 the soup has a comforting homely style with a lot of ingredients!! 👍🏻

author: Wei Leng
review_text: Place is clean, pleasant and tidy. Food is tasty and price is reasonable. Will come again next time. Thank you for the good food.

author: Ron Roche
review_text: Enjoyed a quiet lunch with my wife. The style and ambiance of The Joint is just what you'd expect in the new JP. Very warm and inviting yet high tech with QR code menus and payments. We both ordered the crispy chicken sandwich, mine with the chipotle sauce and hers without. I highly recommend the sauce. It added just a bit of a bite without overpowering the perfectly prepared chicken. The seasoned fries rounded out the plate perfectly. Service was quick and friendly while not being intrusive.

author: Maria Felina
review_text: First time at this restaurant with my family. Plenty of parking but they are busy! Originally they told us one hour wait but ended up being 15 mins. Food was delicious and it came out quick. The kids menu had plenty to pick from but is pricy at $15. Comes with drink and ice cream. My salad was okay. Nothing fancy but the chowder was delicious. NOTICE: There is a admin fee when dining here. Our waitress said it is due to inflation and it’s per item. Receipt included.

author: Alex Andino
review_text: Food was terrible. A surprise for a Portuguese restaurant in Ironbound. They served me days old chicken that was reheated. it smelled like a chicken out of the fridge that was put back in the oven. Fries were cold. Not coming back.

author: Ilene Dcosta
review_text: Delicious Banh mi!! Was so different to have it in this small table by the road but the taste was excellent. Very friendly owner, had a good variety of options Also had the cold coffee. Would recommend for a hearty breakfast

author: jme sheppard
review_text: The Food was so good, I got the number 13 omelet Large and the Large is a Large, delicious and the service was very good....we got to see the king of kings lowriders there aswell......thanks again for the great start to our day.......

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Dayton Blanco
review_text: Aury is an absolute star behind the bar! Super attentive, friendly, and always makes you feel welcome. The drinks were perfect, but what really stood out was her energy and the way she takes care of everyone with such ease. She truly made the night memorable. Highly recommend Aury if you want amazing service and a great vibe!

author: Lara
review_text: this place was pretty dang solid! the decor for both inside and outside was very cool, loved the atmosphere. the outside has a direct view of the water and was nicely shaded at night. for our appetizers, i got the asian spring rolls and my boyfriend got some type of cheese dip and both were very good! i always love a spring roll. for our entrees, i got the truffle pasta and my boyfriend got the waygu burger. my bf absolutely loved his burger and my pasta was pretty okay, it was just a bit much with it being all the same flavor. i liked the kale pieces in it, but i wish there was a side to break up the flavor or some type of protein in the pasta itself. i got very full lol. our server was nice, just a bit odd.. a lady took our picture and then later came back trying to sell us over priced glass photo frames?! i thought it was for social media or something but i guess not 😊but yeah, besides that, very solid experience!

author: Jack Lee
review_text: Definitely one of the best ribs I ever had! The servers Ayu and Satya were very friendly and helpful. It was my first time here, so I didn't know what to order. They recommended me what to eat and what portion should I have since there only one person eating. Will come another time when I'm back in Bali

author: Joanne Kong
review_text: Ther service: friendly and attentive. Our server did a grest job in putting in our order wo our food came out appropiately knowing that the Paella took 35-40 min. The food: We ordered 4 tapas dished. Cod Croquttes were great. The Tortilla Slice Espanola was delicious. Patatas a la Brava also very good. The Chorizo al Vino, i usually love. But I found that that the chorizo in this tapas dish (in red wine) to be mealy and the casing tough. The alcohol itself in this dish was not burned off enough giving the entire dish a sour taste. Will not order again. The paella was delicious but the pricing is deceiving. The price on their menu is a per person price with 2 people being the minimum. The pricing doesn't make any sense cause you can't order a single serving. So, the cheapest paella dish is priced at $25, but its actually $50, whether u go there by yourself or with five people. Additionally, you can only order 2, 4, 6, etc. The paella comes in servings of 2. Which makes the pricing deceiving. On a side note, the chorizo in the paella is very tasty, and different from the tapas. Although its the same chorizo, the cook is better. Wine: Their selection of wine is resonably priced for a restaurant. There are two prices with each bottle. One for take home and one to drink at the restaurant. Still very reasonably priced and a very nice selction. Overall, it was a very nice experience. Overall, the food was very good. The atmosphere: once you step into the back restaurant area you forget thats its the bck side of a gas station. The wall of wine and murals make it a plesent dining experience. Its noting fancy with wooden tables and metal chairs, but the food is good. What more do you need. We will definately go back.

author: Eunice 유니스 Chong
review_text: Huge, clean and well ventilated place. You order from a menu instead of having someone pushing the cart like old school method. The price of the dim sum is the same as how the building looks- extravagant! Siew Mai is RM7.60 (above average) but the siew mai has very small bites of scallops, mushrooms, and prawns.. Fishball (RM6.90) is huge and soft. I guess the locals are right about this place- it caters mainly to tourist. Chille sauce has sour (lime?) taste with some garlic aftertaste.. One option for sauce only.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Veronika Ulmanová
review_text: We had such a good time at this vietnamese typical diner. Mainly, their pho is a must try! Delicious experience Very friendly staff who offered an extra plate of sprouts when they only saw wee were enjoying it (without us even thinking of asking for more). They brought it to us with a kind smile. Hope their diner grows and goes well!

author: Nana Setiawan
review_text: Food taste is good, price is reasonable. They have private rooms and a big room and area to rent if you want to have a small party like engagement or birthday party like more than 20 people.

author: Rory York
review_text: We ate here a few times and definitely recommend it. Satay street is worth doing too, atmosphere a lot nicer outside than inside. Not that the inside is bad, just noisy at times. Check captions for names of food recommendations.

author: Rick Kok
review_text: It was a great weather to sit outdoor at PS cafe East Coast. Coffee and breakfast was good. Not to mention, the service was excellent, especially with Nicholas and YY. They took great care to serve us from drinks to food, making sure my wife and I are comfortable. Nicholas even shared about PS cafe history. Both of us will surely come back to visit the staff and cafe again ❤️ The experience is wonderful. Well done 👏🏻

author: Sofia K
review_text: We had lunch here and it turned out to be such a lovely experience from start to finish. The location is absolutely breathtaking, sitting right on the edge of the cliff with a wide open ocean view that feels peaceful, dramatic, and incredibly beautiful. It’s the kind of scenery that immediately puts you in a relaxed mood and makes the meal feel extra special. We didn’t have a booking, but it wasn’t busy at the time, so we were able to walk straight in, choose a table with a nice view, and order right away without any waiting at all. We decided to have the grilled fish, and it was honestly delicious. The fish was grilled perfectly crispy and slightly smoky on the outside, yet soft, juicy, and tender inside. You can really taste the freshness. The Balinese sauces that came with it were full of flavor, aromatic, and added that authentic local touch that made the dish even more enjoyable. It was served with steamed rice and vegetables, creating a simple but very satisfying and balanced meal. The atmosphere was calm, breezy, and very open, making it a perfect spot to enjoy seafood while taking in the stunning coastal scenery. If you love beautiful views and tasty, freshly grilled food, this place is worth a visit.

author: Koda Knight (Marty's Disney Adventures)
review_text: I ordered a carne Asada quesadilla and a carne Asad burrito. The only modification j asked for is no pico and add extra sour cream and they charged me for the modification but still put Pico in my burrito. After I brought it back with my receipt to have it fixed they proceeded to make fun of me in Spanish regarding the whole situation thinking I did not speak Spanish. Worst experience of my life they really need to do proper training or grt new staff. This place is a go to for the wife and I while we are at work but we will be finding somewhere els to go from now on

author: Kisse
review_text: Lovely cafe and nice food.Nice but bit slow service. French toast with fruit was huge portion ( big enough for 2 people)

author: Thian Boon Seng
review_text: One of the best place to have a breakfast in hatyai. Clean, air conditions and good services

author: Paul Oliveira
review_text: Had a birthday celebration there with 11 people and everything was fabulous. Olivia and the entire staff did a great job accommodating us with a private table on the patio. Rob, our waiter, was very attentive, and did a fantastic job. Food and drinks were great! The view is wonderful and very serene. We all took pictures on the lower dock area. Thank you for everything 🥂

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: Cheong Loong
review_text: For malay food lovers, this is the place where one can find the halal ingredients to prepare that muslim meal you have in mind. If lazy just adjorn upstairs to the food court where most of halal muslim stalls have the dish you want to eat. Only thing is which stall is good. It is just a preference of taste but will not go wrong if one sees a long queue infront of the stall. For the adventurous new to muslim food , just try . The rich spicy coconut cooked food will give you that kick and leave a good impression in one's mouth.

author: Marisol Medina
review_text: So disappointed. We paid almost $40 for two tropichops, one soda and a large portion of fries with not even 15 fries. When we ordered the Tropichops, the employee didn’t even ask us if we wanted any toppings so we literally paid $15 for rice, a few beans and 10 mini strips of steak with nothing else and $10 for the other chicken tropichop again with nothing toppings. We weren’t even given a receipt! I am so dissatisfied.

author: Steve Gonyaw
review_text: Loved the experience. The atmosphere, the food, the service…. All tops! Even on a packed Saturday night, my date and I never felt the pressure or stress of a busy night. Staff was warm and welcoming. Bartenders were fun and very fast with orders, they seem to love their jobs and that goes a long way for guests.

author: Rene Munoz
review_text: This review is written after speaking with a person who frequents Argentina as his father is born and raised in Argentina. The main focus was the meat, as that's what Argentina is known for. I was excited about it since my family has been butchers for generations. I asked the mixed grilled meats, medium well. A week later, I still tasted the charred exterior, the lack of flavors, and the meat was over-cooked. The decor is full of Argentina soccer glories and televisions displaying the baseball world classic. The fried Calamari was not memorable and bland. The only thing worth the price was the mashed potato. Overall, it was overpriced and not worth a second visit. Over $200!! The service took too long to take our orders, and rarely did they ask us if we needed anything.

author: Isaiah Vang
review_text: What an AWESOME find! We love Thai food and this place was absolutely delicious. The atmosphere was fun with live music and karaoke. Everything felt comforting with a family style environment. Huge shout out to our server! He was very friendly and personable and made the experience enjoyable. Definitely will come again!

author: Dante Gell
review_text: Flaming Grill Buffet has a good variety of food, but the best part is the service, especially from the manager. She's super attentive and makes sure everyone's having a good experience. The food is what you'd expect from a buffet – lots of options and a good value. Definitely worth a try if you're looking for a casual meal with friendly service!

author: Shelow Ann Regacho
review_text: As a Filipino, i have to try this. I was curious with how different it is from the lechon we have in Ph and I would say it didn't disappoint.

author: Leville
review_text: Clean place with consistent food. Eggs are all done properly. Overall a very good experience here.

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: MaiAek agri
review_text: Great and chill atmosphere, delicious food, friendly staff and prices.

author: Renato Miranda
review_text: I visited Casanova during a special event and had a great time. They served many Brazilian pastries such as coxinha, pastel, chicken pie and churrasco steak and they were all delicious. The staff members I interacted with were friendly and helpful. Parking around this area is challenging since it's near the Ferry st area but if you check Spot Hero, Park Whiz or any other parking apps you'll find many parking lots on Raymond Ave (10 minute walk) for $10.

author: May Wong
review_text: This eatery has a wide variety of local good food for everyone Upper flr ji ji noodle house - 45min-1hr wait Their soya chicken is well seasoned. Of course if u must try try the chef recommendation - char siew has nice smoked taste. For coffee my fav - generation coffee roasters at ground flr. To tapao, get the curry puffs. Both shops along same row (upper floor near the mezannine seating area nearer to chinese pancakes) are michelin recommended. If you are to eat there, take the corner shop crispy puffs. Crumbs can b quite messy. The centre stall curry puff staff is good too. I am not keen on the michelin curry chicken noodle stall. The curry is more for westerners? Light milk+coconut+ curry.
