No curry dominant taste. Only saving grace is their salted chillie. Pairs well with the curry noodle. Go on weekend breakfast timings 9-1030 if you don't want much q.

author: Anas Aqilah Abdul Salam
review_text: It’s my second time eating. And I tried different menu today, their set lunch. For the portion and price, it’s very reasonable, taking into account their appetiser + main course + sides/ dessert + drinks for only RM32++. Very reasonable and of course, quality food. It’s pork free, their poultry sources are halal, but the reason they can’t obtain halal is because they sell alcohol beverages. Overall, good food good quality good portioning and reasonable price.

author: Hanh Hoang
review_text: I visited the restaurant a bit after 10 PM. It was still quite busy but luckily no wait for a table. The crowd was a mix of tourists and locals. The interior is decorated with numerous photos of the owner/head chef posing with customers, giving the place a personal touch. I tried two of their bestsellers – the white pepper crab and the meehoon. The crab was flavorful, though the seasoning was too strong for my taste. The meehoon, on the other hand, was delicious. In terms of price, it’s on the higher side – around $10 per 100 grams, comparable to Jumbo Seafood, though the ambience here isn’t quite as upscale.

author: Kerrie Fraser
review_text: We made an impromptu stop at Bay Pointe on our way through Boston and we are so glad we did! We were able to be seated right away with a view of the water. Our waitress was so attentive and gracious. The food was delicious but the star of the night was the sweet chili shrimp appetizer. We just loved our stop in Quincy. Thank you!!!

author: Jades Vazquez
review_text: I had a great experience at IHOP in Las Vegas! The food came out hot, fresh, and exactly what we ordered. Everything tasted delicious, and the portions were generous. Our waitress, Ester, was amazing—she was friendly, attentive, and made sure we had everything we needed without us having to ask. She really made us feel welcome and taken care of. The manager, Miguel, was also wonderful. He was professional, kind, and clearly cares about both the customers and the staff. It’s easy to tell this location is well-managed. Overall, the service and atmosphere made this visit stand out. I would definitely come back and recommend this IHOP to anyone visiting Las Vegas! 🥞😊

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: NinaBelle Travels
review_text: Dining at Ekachan: The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine feels less like a meal and more like a carefully composed travel essay, one written in spice, smoke, and story. With a focus on unique authentic ingredients, sourced with reverence and prepared with quiet confidence, each dish unfolds as a chapter, guiding us on a journey through the four corners of Thailand through the cuisine. And journey we did, from the herbal depth of the north to the fiery brightness of the south, all balanced with thoughtful restraint. We selected a luxurious Yunnan beef dish in honour of my maternal heritage; and a bold charcoal grilled catfish, along with a spicy squid egg number in honour of my paternal heritage. There is an elegance to Ekachan that doesn’t announce itself loudly. Instead, it lingers, much like the flavours; inviting reflection, conversation, and an appreciation for the cultural wisdom embedded in every plate. We loved it so much, we decided to return for a birthday dinner, a rare compliment in a city rich with extraordinary dining. The second visit felt even more special: familiar yet revelatory, celebratory yet grounded in tradition. Thank you to the wonderful Ekachan crew who looked after us! 🇹🇭🥢🍚

author: David Herrera
review_text: Awesome place, great coffee and great food. A relaxing atmosphere and the A/C is 💯.

author: Lee Martin
review_text: I’ve yet to have a bad meal here or one I wouldn’t order again. Bobby flay steak NY strip was cooked and seared perfect. Tejas BBQ brisket a thing of beauty. Limesalt like an elevated chipotle, wish there was more guacamole in the side but all in all, the food is always ready for pickup very fast and food is fresh. Have been able to take advantage of the promo codes w friends and take food to the park it’s a life hack.

author: noeshk com
review_text: Very good food. Plentiful portions. Waitresses are very attentive. Food is well priced and worth it. Better than most pricier restaurants on the Strip or Fremont areas. Ho eat here.

author: Anthony M
review_text: Great donuts that taste just as good as they look. Keep in mind that they will be overly sweet if you get a flavor heavy on sugary tastes but donuts with a tart filling are well balanced. It's a very busy place but the line moves quickly.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Djeus Wong
review_text: Recommended by our spa owner, we managed to get a quick dinner here at 9.20pm and it turned out a very satisfying one. The staff are attentive, the food very tasty and burst with flavour, the place spacious and clean. Definitely will return.

author: diana pierre
review_text: They gave me the wrong order and when I called them, they told me that I would have to come and pick up the right order when I explained I could not they hung up the phone. This place is incredibly unprofessional and they do not care about their customers.

author: Tedd Lookatch
review_text: Right at the end of Fremont's experience, just a little outside the crazy zone, you'll find a nice little authentic taste of Thai. Big beer selection, including Chang Singha and slew of good selection and locals. The person next to me highly enjoyed theirLechee martini. The vibe with live feed footage of the streets of Bangkok lived up the hype. They had a huge menu with of of options including many specials. I tackled the dungeness crab fried rice perfect for late night bite. Light, fresh, and layered flavors made a simple dish a lot more complex. The red curry and its 18 ingredients made fresh had a nice snap to it to it. The yellow was more mild and balanced. Patron next to me took on a ribeye plate and raved about the flavorful cook on the meat.

author: Misti Pierce
review_text: I had been wanting to eat at this restaurant for over a year, & it did not disappoint! We went for Brunch. The Staff was fantastic from the moment we walked in the door. They were busy, so we put our name on the list & got seated within 30min. We tried some of the new Drink Menu items & loved them both. We shared a Breakfast Plate, which was more than enough for 2 people. We also added 1 of their famous Pancakes, at the suggestion of our Waiter. Highly recommend. The prices were extremely fair & we enjoyed everything about this restaurant. Next time we are in Vegas, we will definitely eat at Winnie & Ethel's again.

author: Massimo
review_text: We went to Eyval for dinner and found parking without much trouble. The place had a nice energy with a modern look and a comfortable crowd. The kitchen was fast and the food was excellent. The ghorme sabzi had deep flavor and tender meat. The tahdig was golden and crisp, and the kabob was juicy and well seasoned with saffron rice and grilled tomatoes. The servers, however, weren’t very attentive. Drinks sat empty for a while, and it took some effort to get their attention. For two people, the total was about $120, which felt fair for the quality. Overall, Eyval delivers top Persian food and a great vibe, but the service could be more engaged to match the kitchen’s pace.

author: En Alvarez
review_text: I had an amazing experience here it was my first time and I felt right at home they are very catering to the lunch crowd that has to be done by a certain time to get back to work. The food was very reasonably priced especially for the area and I was treated with the utmost love and respect. There is a reason why they have been around for over 15 years I will be coming back it was an amazing experience

author: Ming Wei Lee
review_text: Seen them from the pre-renovation cash only days until the current setup. Food is great albeit being slightly pricey even by Singapore standards. Place is packed and one way around the queue is to make a booking in advance but do arrive on time to respect the reservation. Also they can get quite chaotic at the counter and entrance area. Not sure why they design it that way as it's a huge bottleneck.

author: CINTYA ENCISO
review_text: Ill be honest. I thought I had placed my order at another restaurant but I made a mistake and placed my order here. I had never been here before. I had driven by and it never appealed to me. I thought it was just another restaurant that served ceviche and cocketeles. So I had to pick up my food and thought OMG I WILL regret this mistake. Well I couldn't just leave the food. When I got there it was 9pm and they close at 10 and they still had people eating there, picking up orders I mean they were busy. Oh before I forget. The girl that took my phone order was very very nice. She explained the different types of rolls and their ingredients. She was super cool. If you read this review tell your boss to give you a raise, you deserve it. So when I was paying I still had my doubts and I asked her what the hell did I order so she gave me a menu and pointed to what I ordered. I was like this looks yummy. It was very delicious. I honestly don't remember everything I ordered. I know I ordered the Grenudo roll. It wasn't what I expected. It was great. Loved it. The sauce or dressing that they give is really good. Not spicy or bland at all. It has good flavor. I know i ate something that had crab meat on the bottom or the side. That was really good too. Like I said I don't remember the names but I do recommend it. You will not regret it. Oh and the portions are good size. Not exaggerated big but enough to fill u up and still have left over or one order is enough for two people.

author: Paul Ciprian
review_text: Lots of small stands with cooked Asian food. Some have long queues, some don't. Stands with natural juices (more or less...). Spartan conditions, with tables and chairs fixed to the floor, self-service, cheap cutlery. Minimal hygiene conditions, crowded, but worth a try.

author: Shu Ou
review_text: Fantastic burgers. Mango shake is very thick: might need a spoon!

author: Daniela Duenas
review_text: BEST BREAKFAST EVER!!! Alfonso was our server, he is from colombia like us and was soo nice!!!! He made accurate and diet specific recommendations. He recommended the french toast as one of the most popular items, and it was SOOO GOOD! Overall a great experience, the food is amazing and the atmosphere is gorgeous. But our waiter Alfonso truly tied it all together to a perfect experience

author: vegas tonite
review_text: The best burgers,pastrami and milk shakes..don't order the grill chicken salad..they don't cut up the vegetables

author: PS “PSOng” Ong
review_text: One of my best meal in Da Nang! Service staff was very accommodating and professional even though it was crowded. They were fully booked through out. Reservations is required. Please DO NOT do walk in. The pizzas were wonderful, I just love the crust. The servers were very knowledgeable and professional. Wonderful experience in my first Da Nang trip!

author: Sledge Williams
review_text: I've always been curious about trying out Chili's but never had an opportunity or much interest to head to one until I've seen a commercial for their 3 for me special and that was enough motivation for me to go out of my way to head to the spot. Outside the area may look small because it's part of a mini mall but it is vast inside, even with a couple of people in there, the area still looks spacious. It didn't take long for one of the waiters (Freddie) to sense my presence and take my order. Props to Fred, he was very attentive and on point so no issues with service whatsoever. Back to the review, I ordered the 3 for me which was the Quarter Pounder Cheeseburger w/ Fries as the entree, chips and salsa as the appetizer and Coke Zero as my beverage. As my starter arrived I was overwhelmed by the size of it. It was damn near as big as the entree, I didn't wanna fill up on the chips and salsa, no matter how good they were and focused my attention on my burger and fries after taking in half of the appetizer. That commercial wasn't lying when it threw shade at McD's quarter pounder because what I got from Chili's, THAT WAS A QUARTER POUNDER! Not that half-baked garbage that McD's doles out as an excuse of a premium burger. Fries were precise in texture and good in taste. I would say that I could got more in Fries but I've really no need for it since the larger than usual starter definitely made up for it. All that for $11.97 plus a well deserved tip bringing it close to $15, it was absolutely solid. I enjoyed that trip here.

author: chloe Keast
review_text: Such friendly service, amazing view, and delicious food and drinks :)

author: Jenn Salazar
review_text: You cannot walk by this place. You have to go in. The atmosphere is as beautiful and flavorful as the food. Everything we had was beyond fantastic. You have to 🏃‍♂️ and try this place!

author: Alex Grossomanides
review_text: Absolute trash restaurant, should be shut down. Waited 30 minutes for a raw burger that cost $18. My wife's salad was bagged romaine lettuce on a plate.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: Grekys Ferrer
review_text: I had an amazing experience at this restaurant. The food was absolutely delicious, full of flavor, and beautifully presented. On top of that, the service was outstanding. Jessica was extremely attentive, friendly, and professional, making sure we felt welcome and well taken care of at all times. Thanks to her excellent service and the incredible food, our visit was truly memorable. I highly recommend this place and especially Jessica!

author: Vaughn Rondon
review_text: "If you’re looking for a perfect broadwalk spot, Nick’s Bar & Grill is it! I stopped in and was blown away by the food. The clam chowder was rich and loaded with flavor—definitely a highlight. I followed it up with the fish and chips, which were perfectly crispy and fresh. To top it all off, the Don Julio margaritas were expertly made and hit the spot while people watching. Great vibes, football game on multiple screens, and topped off by Karaoke after the game. Excellent service right on the boardwalk. I’ll definitely be back!"

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Yongkwan Song
review_text: I ordered delivery through Uber Eats to my hotel, and tried the USDA Prime Beef Picada. The portion was reasonable, and overall the flavor was good. The best item was the Churrasco — the meat was tender, aromatic, and not tough at all. The only disappointing part was the Lomo (Prime Pork Loin). It was quite salty, so I couldn’t eat much of it. If you don’t feel like going out but want to enjoy some meat in your room, I would recommend it. And if a full set feels too heavy, choosing individual cuts might be a better option. The mashed potatoes and corn that I ordered on the side were also delicious — especially the mashed potatoes, which were extremely smooth with just the right seasoning. One downside: I ordered twice from the hotel and asked for utensils both times, but none were ever included. Luckily, my hotel had utensils available, but if you’re staying somewhere without them, it could be quite inconvenient.

author: Nurul Afifah
review_text: Ordered the medium size Char Kway Teow at $5.50 (as pictured). Very flavourful with lots of cockles included. There's also the option to add extra cockles for $2. The owner is Chinese-Muslim so the food is halal~

author: Dangst 55
review_text: They have a varieties of sauces for the wings, which actually taste pretty great but the fries weren’t good at all they were hard. I recommend strictly for the wings only.

author: Joycelyn Pangilinan
review_text: EXCELLENT: customer service, food, ambiance. Only $24.99 lunch. Definitely recommend and will visit again. One and only thing that made us sad, ONLY ONE PIECE OF DESSERT IS ALLOWED.

author: Christina Spuling
review_text: I had the best experience at Bubba Gump Shrimp, walking by on our way to Brickell and stopped by this Amazing Bartender Juan (JP), me and my fiancée we had the best food & cocktail experience in Miami so far. The costumer service and the food was so so amazing!!! We had such a great time and the best cocktails I ever had.

author: Kevin Simpson
review_text: We ate here twice while in Hollywood, Florida. Highly recommend the breakfast meal. Roberto and the team were amazing!

author: chiauwon chen
review_text: Self service order. U need to order your foods when u enter the shop. Yam rice is delicious. Pork soup is tasted a bit sour, yummy. Pork soup u can choose pork liver, tongue, stomach, blood, heart, kidney. No worry to choose kidney it's no any smelly taste. The chili must put some having with yam rice. It's taste best. Soup is free add on.

author: Desiree Joseph
review_text: I haven't been to this restaurant, since the pandemic. I must say I was pleasantly surprised. From the hostess,to my waiter Joseph, the bartender that made my drinks, and the chef that prepared my food. Everything and everyone was on point, beautiful personalities, atmosphere was chill, and the price was worth every bite. I highly recommend you drop by for a delicious meal and memorable dinning experience.

author: Baggage Claim Philosopher
review_text: WHO GAVE THESE PEOPLE THE RIGHT TO BE THIS GOOD? I’ve been to Pison Ubud twice now, and let me tell you, it’s so consistently excellent it’s starting to annoy me. Nobody should be this good at feeding people unless they’re trying to overthrow a government. You walk in and the place is vibing, all style, energy, and good-looking people pretending they’re not checking their reflections in every shiny surface. The staff? Exceptional. Too exceptional. Smiling, attentive, helpful like they’re auditioning to be adopted into your family. I’m suspicious of that level of kindness; it usually means someone’s stealing your watch. But no, they’re just… good. It’s unsettling. Now let’s talk food. I had the Seafood Spaghetti, and dear God, it was so scrumptious I nearly applauded. That’s embarrassing. No grown adult should clap for pasta unless they’re at an intervention. Perfectly cooked, flavours bursting, the kind of dish that makes you rethink your life choices, like, ‘Why don’t I live here? Why do I bother cooking at home like a fool?’ Then the Truffle Tenderloin Steak; juicy, gorgeous, covered in truffle like it’s trying to seduce you. I've eaten steak in a lot of places, sweetheart, and half of them should be in prison compared to this. This thing melted in my mouth so gracefully I filed a police report for emotional manipulation. Pison is the kind of place that’s so good, so polished, so utterly on point that you leave feeling slightly inferior. You want to improve yourself just so you deserve their dessert. So here’s the truth: Food: Outrageous. Stop showing off. Service: Kind enough to make you suspicious. Atmosphere: Cool people pretending not to stare at your shirt. Overall: If you go to Ubud and miss this place, you’re the kind of person who goes to Paris and eats at the airport. Pison Ubud, I love you. I hate how much I love you. I’ll be back. And I’ll insult you again. That’s how affection works, sweetheart.

author: Eric Tan
review_text: Comforting local favourites in the heart of Circuit Road. Wantan mee was delicious.

author: Mrgrc
review_text: I travelled through Vietnam for three weeks. And this was the worst Bahn Mi I've eaten! Since it was described as 'the best', I gave it a chance. I have eaten better and cheaper than here while travelling. + Everything is thrown on a pile? Vegetables are wrapped in plastic... Not a good experience for me.

author: Gleryca Perea
review_text: They closed 20 minutes early and we literally wanted cookies they were going to throw them out anyways. If I could give them a 0 I would bad Service she ignored us and Started mopping in front of the door saying she is not going to open they closed AT 10 but we go there at 9:40 and they didn't let us in.

author: Muhammad Nur Ikhwan Ismail
review_text: my friend told me “theres only so much you can do with fried rice” and while i agree with him, i would expect a restaurant that highlights fried rice as it’s main dish would execute a perfect fried rice but alas, the wok hey was weak and the fried rice itself was pretty mild-tasting without the sambal. we also got the mee goreng and surprisingly, the mee goreng got a better taste profile than the fried rice (in my opinion lah). 3/5 stars (generous rating) the sides: satay was disappointing, what was served to me is not a satay in my definition 😭 looks fried instead of bakar over charcoal and the sambal kacang was tastelesss. (2/5 star) and omg the cabbage??? raw cabbage with drizzle of sweet sauce and they call it “King of Flavour Cabbage” 😃…. the most disappointing dish lol… 0.5/5 star final words, i think uncle roger should r&d the side dishes better. i would summarise my experience as “decor kedai lagi best dari makanan dia biasa je nyah”. best regards :)

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: Jason Chin
review_text: 🍜✨ Hidden Thai Gem Alert! ✨🌿 Discovered a secret food haven tucked behind a quiet shop lot! Everything here is a winner—crispy Pork Crackling, juicy Grilled Pork Balls, silky-smooth Kanom Tuay, and the incredibly flavorful Boat Noodles. Each bite feels authentically Thai and undeniably delicious. Trust me, your taste buds will thank you! 🤤👌 📍 Choo Jaroen Boat Noodles

author: Tony Rosca
review_text: Le Tub Saloon – Hollywood, FL This place screams old-school Florida! Rustic, funky, and right on the water. The burgers are huge — juicy, perfectly grilled, and totally live up to the hype. Don’t come here if you’re in a rush though; service can be slow, but that’s part of the vibe. Grab a cold beer, chill by the Intracoastal, and enjoy the view. It’s got that laid-back beach shack energy that’s hard to find anymore. Must-try: The famous sirloin burger 🍔 Vibe: Quirky, chill, and unapologetically Florida 🌴

author: Stephant S (stephant_s)
review_text: These is a huge hawker centre with Many delicious and famous food here! These hawkers have been running their stalls here for years! This is one of the best place that you can get almost all the best tastes of Singapore food at the affordable price! Look for those with long queues and let the patrons guide you to find the best! My Recommendation: Bedok Chwee Kueh Nasi Lemak Tiong Bahru Pau Mee Goreng Nasi Briyani Mutton Mee Rebus Stewed soup Vegetarian Satay Bee Hoon Steamed Chicken Rice Fish Soup Porridge Fried Carrot Cake Prawn Noodle Fried Hokkien Mee Desserts Herbal Mutton Soup Mala Hotpot Spinach Soup Satay Sugarcane Kway Chap Fishball Noodle Beancurd Desserts Food variety ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Wallet friendly ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Cleanliness ⭐️⭐️⭐️ Few things to improve for this place that I can see are the hygiene issue and the birds…

author: Mariam A
review_text: What a hidden gem! Was looking for a waterfront restaurant to celebrate my 30th birthday at and found Mykonos kitchen and bar last minute. Decided to give it a try and I am so happy we did. Our server Valentina was the absolute sweetest server. She was so accommodating to everything our family of 4 needed, which included an infant and a toddler. The food was good. The atmosphere was perfect. There was live music on a Friday night. Thank you to the singer and the crew for singing the happy birthday song for me. We really enjoyed our dinner here!!!

author: Gerald Prado
review_text: This is the best Mexican restaurant in all of Las Vegas. Tortillas were fresh, the beef enchiladas had some of the best shredded beef. Was basicallly Barbacoa. Sabroso! 10/10 would enchilada again.

author: Y T
review_text: Love the aesthetics and plants! Support my IG @ytbossbae 🤍 The avocado toast (1st option) | The Valley girl with cream cheese was amazing! The balsamic gave the kick but also made me visit restroom. I got the Palm latte (coco & vanilla). Maybe not a good combo with the balsamic 🤣 this latte is 7/10. Enjoyed and love the rest of the coffee shop! Also mini store in the back if you love shopping with their styles!

author: Denise
review_text: Nearby dim sum to our hotel, place is busy with locals and tourists. Good value and dishes were fresh. Thai coffee was also good. We like the ordering process, you pick the dim sum and they steam it on a tower with your table number.

author: Pang Yong Song
review_text: We were looking for a chill place for Father's day dinner and a pet friendly one so that we could bring our fur kid along. Glad to have found High Tide Bistro & Bar. Vibes were chill and the owners were very prompt & friendly in their service. We found out they were owners of a Goldie too. Our pet was provided with a bowl of ice water and he had doggie biscuits too! Coming to the food, owners gave their recommendations. And they were definitely up to mark. Kids enjoyed the starters of Jalapeno Corn Fritters and Calamari. That was followed by the mezza platter. Humus with Pita and the Falefel was great. We shared 2 mains of Kathi Roll and Butter Chicken with an extra side of naan. Kids totally mopped up the butter chicken sauce with the Naan and the rice goes so well with the dish. Chill vibes with good food. Will come back again.

author: Guillaume Bourcy
review_text: As a vegetarian this is a landmark place for me. Imagine this is where plants and veggies come to party to create the perfect dishes. Even the smoothies look ready for a magazine cover. It’s that perfect mix of “I’m being healthy” and “I might still order fries.” The space is pure Venice — sun-drenched, leafy, and filled with people who look like they just came from yoga or a photoshoot (or both). Food’s fresh, colorful, and guilt-optional. The avocado toast is practically a local landmark, and the juices taste like they were mixed by someone with a PhD in vibes. We also love their Pad Thai as well as the Surfer burrito, available all day. Pro tip: if you have the option, sit outside — it’s the best people-watching spot on Abbot Kinney, and the sunshine somehow makes your latte taste 20% better (scientifically unproven, spiritually accurate)

author: Beyzaa Osmani
review_text: I have tried many different Persian and Mediterranean cuisines, but this one stands out at the top. The food is absolutely delicious and enjoyable. The staff members are friendly and attentive. I loved everything about the experience and will definitely return. I highly recommend it 😃

author: tue ngocgia
review_text: This was my first time eating at the restaurant, and the staff were very attentive and enthusiastic. The food was delicious and the atmosphere was lively.

author: Keith Chan
review_text: Tucked away on the second level of a small building, we even walked past it. You go in a small hallway then up 2 flights. The beef bowl was a soft spot but bit dry, the yolk was interesting but i preferred the yolk to ooze out. The corn was okay. You could order something else. The wagyu rice bowl is the star here. Tender and flavorful! Would recommend! Chill vibes at night with the dj!

author: Robin Luff
review_text: I went to the buffet with my neighbor an we truly enjoyed the buffet! It was all hot an very much enjoyed it! The service is amazing too! It's very busy but the food is hot everytime we went back for more! The drink shouldn't be a separate charge? With the drink its over $20 so folks know. We will definitely be back! Bringing my bff in a week! Yummy meal! Steak is great too! See ya soon!

author: Pongpon Phanthaphuek
review_text: I’ve dined here twice already, both times while visiting Bali from Thailand, and it has become a must-visit spot for me. The food is absolutely delicious, the drinks are excellent, and the staff provide warm and attentive service. The atmosphere is also wonderful, making the whole experience even more enjoyable. Most importantly, everything is great value for money. The prices are very reasonable and not at all out of reach. Highly recommended if you’re in Bali. Definitely worth a visit!

author: Pris Tan
review_text: Average at best. Si fang tofu fish promfret har giau kai four heavenly king vege. Reasonably priced. Prompt and efficient service . Staffs frequently asked whether news to top.up soup.

restaurant: Kub Kao' Kub Pla Central World
author: xuan li
review_text: Tom Yum Kung soup is really too ordinary. There are only shrimp and the two foods in the first picture that in the Tom Yum Kung soup .Then the taste is very clear and watery. It is not the same as in the picture. The seafood fried noodles have no taste. It is pitiful that there are few seafood in it. There are only three shrimps and two small squids. There are also shrimp heads in it. There are more than half of themushrooms and the white potato-like thing in the seafood fried noodles. There is not much seafood. It is not cheap in terms of price, but the dishes are really ordinary. Two dishes and one drink is more than 800 baht. It is very expensive. And the waiter's attitude is relatively good, with a sense of service.

author: Chan Sheng
review_text: It's noisy, it's messy, service level is a bare minimum and it's hot during lunchtime. But the food is pretty fantastic overall to overcome these issues. The speciality Ipoh beansprouts are plump, sweet and juicy. Never had this kind of beansprouts anywhere else and it's certainly unforgettable. The chicken is also very well made.

author: mackfrack
review_text: One of my absolute favorite places to spend an evening in Las Vegas. There’s live music every night, and our favorite group to watch is always The Ambassadors. They took a few special music requests and made our evening. We’ve had the same waiter several times, and the service is phenomenal. Definitely a budget friendly option for dinner and a show off the strip!

author: Liz
review_text: Bánh Mì Huỳnh Hoa is hands down one of the best bánh mì spots in Saigon. From the moment you take your first bite, you can taste the quality in every layer. The baguette is perfectly crispy on the outside and soft inside, packed generously with a rich variety of cold cuts, pate, fresh herbs, and house-made sauces. Each component is well-balanced, flavorful, and incredibly satisfying. Despite being famous and often busy, the service is quick and efficient. One bánh mì is filling enough for a full meal. If you’re looking for an unforgettable, authentic Vietnamese bánh mì experience, Huỳnh Hoa is an absolute must-try.

author: Kevin Murphy
review_text: Mooo... Restaurant in Boston is as exceptional as any high-end spot we've experienced worldwide. From ascending the stairs to departure, the staff makes you feel truly special—there's no greater satisfaction when spending hard-earned money at restaurants, retailers, or hotels. Our server was excellent, but Stefan, the Sommelier/Beverage Manager, stood out, easing our overwhelm with the vast wine list. After describing our preferences, he confidently assured us, "I have you covered." The first bottle was superb; the second even better. Food: 10/10. Staff: 12/10. Highly recommended.

author: Jessie Teng
review_text: Roti is good but the staff were rude! The place was very dirty. Most of the tables were uncleared. My brother raised hand asked for waiter for few times and got no responses!

author: Kezia Vania
review_text: Had lunch at Remboelan and it was such a pleasant experience 🌤️✨ We ordered the Cumi Saos Padang, Cumi Goreng Sambal Matah Kecombrang, Iga, and Bistik Selat Solo. Everything was super flavorful! the Padang sauce had that perfect spicy kick, the sambal matah was fresh and fragrant, and the iga was fall-off-the-bone tender. The Bistik Selat Solo felt homey and comforting. For drinks, we got Es Leci and Es Teh Tarik — both were light, refreshing, and hit the spot. The place is really cozy and beautifully set up, perfect for a relaxed family lunch. It feels homey, clean, and peaceful. Service was fast and friendly, everyone was super warm and helpful 🫶 Totally recommend this spot for a chill lunch with family. Great food, lovely ambiance, and good service all around.

author: Mariel Wilk
review_text: This place is one of the best. It was recommended multiple times to us coming to Bali and does not disappoint. Been back multiple times. I LOVE the vibe, look, feel, staff is BE-YOND lovely. All around no brainer to enjoy this nourshing place ALL AROUND! TOP notch energy! Thank you. Grateful costumer! Pictured: Friend I was with had the cauliflower dish, I have had the harvest bowl (special - with some modifications) , protein and nori (with modifications, probably the protein bowl fav so far) , extra falafel (ALL very good!) I would say the sweet potato wedges and all the different veggies etc they offer in dishes are delightful and fresh!

author: Yew Chong Poh
review_text: Food big portion and good taste, love it. The staff provide good service and environment also good and nice for family, friends gathering functions. strong recommend it, price reasonable and worth to eat. Nice

author: Carl Everett
review_text: Carl’s deserves all 5 stars, and maybe even a Michelin Star. The entire experience was fantastic, and we will be back. The doughnuts were made with care, and the freshness of the items at Carl’s shined through. Every member of the staff was super nice, and treated everyone in the store with care and a genuine smile. There are many things I am looking to try in the future, like their cold brew coffee on tap. They have done good enough, I don’t mind them using my name on the building! I’ll for sure be back!

author: Giang Tran
review_text: I tried the crab omelette rice and was impressed by how plentiful and fresh the crab was. But the real star was the pork Pad Kaprao—it was super spicy, but the flavors were so incredible it essentially took me to heaven. The place is usually quite crowded, but I got lucky and got a table within 10 minutes. It’s not the most convenient location to get to, but for food this good, I’d come back anytime. A must-visit if you're a fan of authentic, bold flavors!

author: Maggie Ramirez
review_text: Food was good. Exactly what you expect from fast food, simple. And in all honesty killing the game in affordability. Get a better deal with Jack options and actually full compared to other fast food, even if all you have is 20 bucks. Jack wins 🏆

author: Okema Brooks
review_text: Purchased a classic double cheeseburger combo, fries were under cooked the patties were slider sized patties on a regular bun Smashed together very Disappointing because I was Hungry food presentation was terrible gave it to my Dog even he was looking crazy at me like you bought this smh

author: Sasha M
review_text: A Michelin-recognized, upscale taco spot that became famous thanks to social media buzz. I went fairly early in the evening, so the line wasn’t too long, and I was able to get a seat at the bar right away. It’s not a fully open kitchen, but you can still see part of the action — the staff all looked incredibly busy and dedicated. The server was quick, attentive, and provided great service. The food came out fast, and everything tasted exceptionally fresh. Every bite was full of flavor and satisfaction. I’d definitely love to come back to try more of their dishes.

author: Supat Limsakul
review_text: The crab fried rice was delicious, with large pieces of crab. The sukiyaki was also delicious; the broth was tasty. The fried pork was very tender.

author: Protective Dad Pranks
review_text: BEST CUBAN PANINI I’ve ever had! If you love Cuban sandwiches, you have to try the Cuban Panini here. The pork is slow-roasted overnight. And the flavors that comes from this sandwich is AMAZING! I love everything about this place from the decor to the location of the restaurant. With a phenomenal beach view and a laid-back setting. You can’t go wrong eating at Oceans 13. On the day of this review, I had a eight hour layover in Fort Lauderdale. So I rented a car and came here because of the Google reviews. Let me tell you this place does not disappoint. Phenomenal FOOD, LOCATION and STELLAR SERVICE! Easy 5-Star Review!

author: Abbott Hsu
review_text: Well decorated and designated surroundings inside restaurant. You can enjoy the traditional Indonesian cuisines with friends or families on weekends and holidays. Foods are yummy and tasty with authentic flavor. Good place for you to enjoy your time here. Enjoy.

author: Tosin E.
review_text: I was in the area to make my hair and was really hungry. Saw high reviews on google and decided to try. I got the ofada & ayamase... the taste was average. The ofada was just a lot of oil and ponmo, and the quantity was small...quite unsatisfying.

author: Laura Powell
review_text: This is our new favorite sit-down donuts shop! Lots of creative, unique donuts. We picked blueberry cobbler, coconut cake, and apple pie donuts, just to name a few. Scrumptious ham and cheese croissant hot from the oven with fresh-squeezed orange juice. Nicely laid out dining room. We will be back to try the quiche and other specialty donuts!

author: puspita sari
review_text: Had a great lunch here! tried the double smash burger, juicy and flavorful. The apple crumble was a nice surprise, and the pineapple juice tasted super fresh. Cozy place with a relaxed Ubud vibe. Would definitely come back.

author: Jo
review_text: Recently dined at Segar and tried several dishes including the Hong Kong noodles, hor fun, cockles fried kway teow, three eggs royal spinach, fu rong egg, lemon chicken, and Thai-style chicken. The food doesn’t taste as good as before. Flavours were lacking, and the overall experience felt disappointing. Staff didn’t come across as very friendly either. The place was surprisingly quiet for a weekend, which felt a bit unusual.

author: Air Tree Water
review_text: They offer traditional Thai-style noodles, including beef, pork, and chicken. I highly recommend the beef version. Although a bowl of noodles costs over 200 THB, which seems a bit expensive—about twice the price of regular affordable noodles—you’ll find that the ingredients are truly excellent. Both the noodles and the meat have a smooth texture, and the noodles have just the right level of chewiness. In terms of portion size, an average adult might need 1.5 to 2 bowls to feel full, even when paired with side dishes and condiments. For dessert, I highly recommend the green noodle-like dessert in the photo—it’s incredibly delicious. Because their on-site queue and ordering process isn’t very smooth and has significant room for improvement, I didn’t give full marks for staff service. However, the food and location are absolutely impeccable.

author: طارق بن عزيز
review_text: I liked the atmosphere of this café and its location is nice. However, the presentation lacked attention to detail. The espresso was served without a spoon, and the sparkling water came in a paper cup. I also came specifically for the affogato and was surprised to find out they no longer offer it. That said, the staff were wonderful. I especially appreciated the barista who prepared my second drink — she took care with the latte art after noticing I pay attention to details, even though she mentioned it would be more difficult with oat milk instead of regular milk. Despite the presentation issue, I will definitely come back. It’s still worth revisiting.

author: Durley Carrasco
review_text: This terrace is a hidden gem! With breathtaking views of the city bay skyline, it’s the perfect spot to unwind. The ambiance is cozy and inviting, making it ideal for family gatherings. The service is exceptional, with friendly staff that make you feel right at home. Overall, the combination of great food, stunning views, and warm hospitality makes this terrace a must-visit. Highly recommended!

author: Sabrina A.
review_text: Host and service staff are great. Good place to go for meal on a budget where you get to pick and chose. Salad bar could have been better in my opinion.Nonetheless, I provided a 3 star as a lot of dishes on the line seemed to be unattended to ie: not stirred appropriately while on a steam table or warmer. The womens restroom was disgusting and needed attention.

author: neo l c
review_text: Authentic Laksa and New Char kua too stall are available.. Reasonably cheap Worth trying only available morning till noon

author: Eric Cervantes
review_text: Dino's is a chicken spot in the downtown/USC area of Los Angeles. They are open late for hungry college kids and night owls alike. The chicken appears char broiled with a blend of vinegar, garlic, and various spices to give it a lively flavor. There are also options to order burgers, burritos, grilled cheeses, and more. Yet, the chicken is what gave Dino's its notoriety. Order the half chicken, with fries, and extra sauce. You'll get the whole platter swimming in the juices. Fries and all to give it that signature zing. It's a small area, with no bathroom to use. Be sure to bring some wet naps to clean your hands, but overall, a historical nice sit down for unique flavors.

author: Leia H
review_text: The JB San Lou Bee Hoon is a disappointment, soggy and not nicely pan fried at all. It was not authentic, (if you tried it in JB you would know)The sambal that accompanied was extremely salty. Other than that their sweet sour pork, stir fried vegetables, boiled prawns are delicious.

author: Simple Simon
review_text: So so compare to Chok Dee Dim Sum in Hatyai. No Air con room. Large size Buk Ku Tay is B380. Abit of high price.

author: Trúc Nguyễn
review_text: The beef hotpot restaurant has no faults, everyone! It meets the criteria, delicious and cheap. My family ordered a beef hotpot and received a plate of boneless chicken feet and mixed tendons. Braised beef intestines with green pepper. Grilled beef with salted egg sauce.

author: Dalesca castro
review_text: Amazing personal, Lucas our server the manager and the other caleño guy 🫂🫂🫂 excellent 🙏🏼🙏🏼great fresh food you feel the quality really tasty😋, perfect place if you like feel at home and at the same time being cared for by the staff it’s wow. It’s classic 🙌🏽🙏🏼👍

author: Stuart Wilkinson
review_text: Wendy and the team made us feel super comfortable and looked after, even going so far to put the football on the big screen so we could watch the finals, also the beer was cold and as tasty as an Aussie needed. Love this pub xxx

author: Lazy Human
review_text: Well, don't expect service or the environment to be good. But just come here because their chicken hor fan is the best I have ever eaten. The broth, the fragrance is exceptional and please drink it all. The dry curry noodle is a must try.

author: Raquel L
review_text: If I could give this place 0 stars I would. HORRIBLE customer service. Their workers are so rude and get annoyed when you ask them questions and they are super condescending. No type of professionalism or customer service. Food is nasty and tables are filthy when you order inside. Will not be coming back.

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Justin Phillips
review_text: Amazing atmosphere. The staff are delightful. Joe was awesome and recommended the GRILLED CHURRASCO STEAK. They are amazing and I recommend everyone try it. I will definitely bring my friends here in the future! Thank you Joe!

author: Jakob
review_text: Attended dinner after making a same day reservation. Food choices are plentiful and are complementary to all palates. These are more of shared portion types of servings. Order a bunch and share amongst your party. The Mac and Cheese is unmatched. The best I’ve had in quite some time. The only dish we tried that I didn’t have a second portion of was the shrimp scampi. Just didn’t hit hard for me. Everything else was fantastic. Service was friendly and prompt. I really enjoyed the ambiance, though near the end of our visit it did get quite crowded and loud. Still, this is nothing that would prevent me from returning. If you’re in the area and looking for high quality food and service, all at a fair price, look no further.

author: Andreas Darmawan
review_text: We ordered the Mclovin and Smashin. It was pretty good! The meat was okay, but the bun was the bomb! Recommended if you’re craving for some good burgers

author: Jennieanne Steinman
review_text: I visited this place with my husband and 17 year old son a few days ago for brunch. We were quickly sat and really liked the comfortable vibe. The menu had plenty to choose from. When the food came, my husband and son's were fine but they brought me the wrong food. The waitress took it away and said she'd have the correct food brought over. Unfortunately, when my meal finally arrived, my son and husband were done eating so that was kind of a bummer but they didnt mind waiting for me to eat. The chicken in my sandwich was so dry and tough that it was inedible. I ate some of the bread because I was honestly so hungry at that point. The waitress asked if I wanted a box and I let her know that I didnt eat it because it was tough and dry. She just quickly said "sorry about that" and quickly brought us our bill. I was honestly bummed to pay $17 for an inedible sandwich that I got at the end of our visit with barely an acknowledgement at all about it. That being said, my son's pancakes were awesome and the portion was huge. My husband's chicken and waffles was great.

author: taeyeon
review_text: Food is usually good however today was terrible, stingray smelled so bad we couldn't even eat it. I hope you guys do a thorough check on the food that you serve as this was a really huge disappointment for me today.

author: hua
review_text: Nestled in the industrial area, this hidden gem offers a delicious experience for local zhi char food. Many tasty food here. Their nyonya fish and heavenly four kings veggies are a must to try. While their pork satay is equally good too. Outdoor seatings are the best. Price is reasonable and there’s ample parking available. We have visited this place many times. Most of the times they are very crowded after 7pm.

author: Roxsan Solis
review_text: Went to eat here right before the holidays. It was around 7pm on a Sunday. The place was dead. Our server was the worst, the manager seemed nice, but he only greeted us. The food was bland. The only thing we enjoyed were the hashbrowns. Never again. Waste of $80.

author: Amanda Isberg
review_text: We visited on a rainy Sunday afternoon around 12:30. We were immediately seated and able to order. I got the special including soup and the waitress thoughtfully suggested a child special for my 7 year old. We both loved it! I only wish it were served hot as the only thing slightly warm was the soup. Everything was pretty good overall!

author: Red Wind Lee
review_text: Is a "rumah pangsa" kind of coffee store. Is like traditional Singapore store below the flat. Taste was OK and quite special for the salted coffee. Bread was quite mangali...quite a traditional national breakfast in Malaysia. Parking was quite limited as it was original for household.

author: Endea McKnight
review_text: First, I would like to say Kathryn is one of the best waitresses I’ve ever had ! I visit a Las Vegas restaurant 1-3 times a week and I have had some great service but Kathryn is now number one . She made several recommendations and gave me a background on the coffee, house potatoes and malt syrup. She seemed very excited about their menu items which made me even more excited. She was also very attentive . I just loved her energy and fun sweater. Next, the house potatoes were incredibly crispy on the outside and fluffy in the inside. The gravy on the chicken fried steak had something special in it. The gravy was sweet and savory. Lastly , I never want to eat a waffle without malt syrup again !

author: L C
review_text: I ordered the Jalapeno Angus Burger Combo which was very good. The ingredients all came together perfectly: pepper jack cheese, jalapeno, lettuce, tomatos, red onions and santa fe sauce. Fries are served hot & crispy lightly salted. 4 1/2 Stars.

author: Kee Diamond
review_text: I went to a Palestinian restaurant in New York for the first time. As expected from its popularity, everything was delicious. I was very satisfied with both the atmosphere and the service. I definitely want to go again

author: Shem
review_text: The frog dish cooked in ginger and spring onion was indeed very flavorful, stingray just as good. The gong gong (shellfish) was a disappointment. They are not fresh, overcooked and when you are able to pull any flesh out of the shell, they are slimy which means they are probably rotten.

author: mystic delusional
review_text: Beautiful settings, good service and good food. Drinks are not crazy sweet. Almost didn't make it there, glad we did. Should try.

author: Anthony Boyle
review_text: A very ordinary restaurant, I’d never go back. I was alone so found a table easily. Server came over and threw a menu on the table. Then came back and asked what I wanted to drink. I said Beer, but they don’t sell beer, so I oped for a hot Chinese tea. The tea came out, lukewarm, in a plastic cup, with a plastic straw! Horrible. The menu wasn’t big (despite the size of the restaurant) so I just ordered the Single Chicken and rice. He wanted to sell me beansprouts but I didn’t want any. Food came out quickly and the chicken was cold….not just warm, but cold. Thankfully the rice was hot which made the meal edible. The chicken tasted ok but half of it was just fat and bones. Lots of people there, obviously tourists like me. A local would never go there, certainly not twice. I won’t go back either.

author: Maria B
review_text: Worst $8 I've ever spent. I purchased the marcha with the coconut syrup, it was watered down, the coconut taste was not good and maybe 5 sips is all I got. Place was clean, the girl that took my order was really unfriendly.

author: Marina N.
review_text: Little gem near our hotel and decided to visit from the reviews. Chill, relaxing and casual dining style. There’s fans around you can use for your table. We got coconut and salt coffee - different takes on them from other cafes but are delish and refreshing. Got to say hi to the kittens who wonders around but they’re mellow and leave you alone. Decent pricing too!

author: Gerardo Buenaventura
review_text: Service was a little fast. The food here is good would recommend. And the atmosphere is pretty good too.

author: Lakeisha G.
review_text: The tables in the middle are a little too close together. You cant even squeeze through to get out of your seat. The food was good, we had about a 20 minute wait, but it was packed and Sunday.

author: Zaida M.
review_text: I love the breakfasts, the French toast and waffles in this place, there are many delicious options, the place. It is spacious and clean but there are no sugar free options

author: Anna
review_text: This was my third visit to Novikov and, unfortunately, the first truly disappointing one. My friend was celebrating her birthday, and I insisted we go to Novikov because it had always been a top-tier experience. When we arrived, no one acknowledged the birthday, even though we mentioned it when making the reservation. Our waiter seemed distracted and rushed, barely looked at us, kept asking us to repeat our orders, and didn’t offer any recommendations on what dishes were best. The food this time was quite mediocre. My truffle rice was extremely salty, I could barely eat it. No one offered to refill our wine glasses when they were empty; we had to flag down the waiter each time. When we ordered dessert, we asked for a candle to be placed in one of them. The response was a dry “okay” (still no friendliness or birthday greeting, unlike in other restaurants where they make an effort). I don’t know what happened to Novikov, but I have no desire to return. The service was poor, the food was average, and it left a bitter aftertaste on what was supposed to be a special celebration.

author: Ardi Tjitra
review_text: I ordered a few dishes for a family of 7. I can't give 5 ⭐ because I found the food is a bit oily especially the fried rice. Taste is okay, nothing stand out to be honest. Price is at a higher level. Spent about THB6K for the food shown.

author: Wee Loon Chia
review_text: Followed the Michelin guide to this place. Ordered the recommended shrimp and pork pancake and it did not disappoint. The mixture of everything including the fresh vege wrapped with the rice papers, with the special sauce, it worked perfectly. And that’s the only thing we ordered, other than a can of special Saigon beer, as we were not hungry, and we were glad we did as the pancake serving was a big portion enough for two. The service was ok. There was one guy at the entrance attending to the new arrivals, and will inform if there is no table available. Table service was great too. The restaurant is located in the alley opposite to the Benh Thanh Market, and has a good vibe!

author: J. Yeh
review_text: This is a wonderful hidden area for a lot of great food choices. Great area for lunch. My brother got oysters from a raw bar, and I got a fried chicken sandwich and sweet potato fries from Hailey Jane's. There are many other foods like, pizza, sushi, Mediterranean, Indian, drink bar, etc. The area is spacious with many seating tables, and has a very nice atmosphere with natural lighting. It's also very close to the red line South Station T station.

author: SK
review_text: Came here for late lunch after out from Hatyai. Food was served kinda slow probably not much chefs are on duty during off peak hour.

author: Kylie Mahaney
review_text: Stopped here for a beachside lunch and it was perfect. We started with the Old Bay peel-and-eat shrimp, simple and delicious. Our server recommended the sweet Thai chili wings and the flounder sandwich, and both were great. The wings were crispy, meaty, and flavorful, and the sandwich was huge and tasty. Service was super friendly, and sitting on the boardwalk made for great people-watching. Definitely a solid spot if you’re in the area.

author: Ezzy Chan
review_text: Great food, good ambience. The tze char stall, sambal Kang Kong , steam fish, sweet and sour pork and rice x 04 cost 52 SGD The oyster egg costs 8 SGD The prawns and sotong cost 12 and 15 SGD respectively. Even with the drinks, still less than 100 SGD for a family of 4. Awesome. 🙃

author: Miguel
review_text: A famous Michelin guide spot. The crab fried rice did not impress me. It was ok but probably not worth that price. Their sauce tied it up all together beautifully.

author: Elizabeth Wang
review_text: Tonchin Midtown delivers the same modern, Tokyo-inspired atmosphere the brand is known for — stylish, lively, and full of energy. Compared to the Brooklyn location, this one definitely feels more polished. The unagi roll and ramen were both delicious and beautifully presented — rich flavors, well-balanced broth, and great texture on the noodles. You can tell the kitchen takes pride in its craft. That said, the service felt distant and a bit mechanical, which was disappointing, especially when you expect the warmth and attentiveness of Japanese hospitality. Overall, it’s a solid spot for quality ramen in Midtown, but I hope the service one day matches the heart that’s clearly in the food.

author: Christa Dunn
review_text: Very nice place for brunch and coffee! The portions were very generous and the prices were reasonable. We enjoyed the breakfast pizza as well as the chicken and waffles.

author: shafik karim
review_text: Overall good restaurant, most comfortable queue-time i spend throughout my holiday in Penang. Closeby to Outlet, so after shopping can eat nasi kandar here

author: Casper
review_text: Tried the Takumi omakase set and it was definitely worth it. The highlight of the experience was the 6 piece special sushi prelude before the warm main dish. It was amazing. Each sushi presented was absolutely a treat with each tasting getting increasingly better. For the warm dish, topped up additional for the A5 miyazaki wagyu beef with tofu in a milky miso broth. The service was exceptional too, with the staff explaining the ingredients for each presented dish, as well as a few performative presentation from the chef for some special dishes. Overall a great experience with the freshest ingredient for the price point and would return to try other dishes. 😋

author: Andrew Chan (www.roadtrippers.asia)
review_text: One of the best place to have this sang mee and tailok mee (KL Hokkien Mee) in Penang. The flavoring is good, organized and service is rather fast even though there is usually a lot of people. The tailok mee is nicely cooked with good smokey frangrance and price wise is also quite affordable at RM6 per plate if not mistaken. Parking can be an hassle though.

author: suveena nair
review_text: We had breakfast here and it was amazing! Reasonable pricing and great service from our waiter Merta. The atmosphere was lovely, with great live music playing (not too loud, you can still talk). I wish I could visit over and over again.

author: Arihant Paruchuru
review_text: We ordered cheese arepas, fries, and a guava marmalade waffle, and every item was disappointing. The waffle had no noticeable cream at all—only the bland taste of the waffle itself. None of the food stood out in a good way, and honestly, the only thing worth consuming was the water. Overall, a very underwhelming experience.

author: Jordan Cooper
review_text: I love Pizza Classica, but the dish I’ve been having there for like two decades was baked ziti, and it’s suddenly been taken off the menu. They have ziti, they have sauce and cheese, why is this off the menu? It’s an Italian restaurant staple. I’m just confused and disappointed. It was my favorite baked ziti in the area.

author: Sin Yee Lee
review_text: The decoration is indeed good, but the quality of the service and food needs to be strengthened. For dimsum, the time to wait for the food to be served is also very long. I have to wait about 30 minutes to come. During eating, there are flies flying around, quite annoying. After eat, make me lost appetizer. Not recommend for dim sum.

author: Vikram Makol
review_text: Amazing sandwiches at this location. I drive 10 miles to get sandwiches from here.

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: Manong Josh
review_text: Mediocre non-pepperish and less taste BKT. Ambience is nice but more noisier now due to new road. Food is normal not like before but still acceptable.

author: R
review_text: Dropped by around 3+ in the afternoon after seeing all the great reviews. The place was empty (well, duh look at the time sir), but the food definitely didn’t disappoint. The beef rolled in wild betel leaves was the star of the meal for me. Rose was amazing too, recommending her favourite dishes and even showing us the proper way to enjoy the beef. We ended the meal with two Saigon Specials, and honestly… that sealed the deal. One of the best meals we’ve had.

author: MP
review_text: Food is really good, portions abundant but service could be better. We had a few dishes which were really tasty and more than enough.

author: martymar77b Butler
review_text: This place was awesome!!! Those potatoes were great too, so try them. I got the pancakes and they were big as my head!

author: Camilla Seeland
review_text: This place is amazing. Especially this location in kuta (it is a lot tastier than the other one in kuta). we ate here 4 times and will definitely return. Since it is so tasty it get busy so please be patient with the staff they are working hard and doing their best.

author: John Nott
review_text: Excellent latin fare in downtown miami, near the courts. Affordable good quality and prompt service. Been eating there for 20 years. No complaints. I recommend the rabo encendido.

author: Siti Nurzahidah Ishak
review_text: Worst nasi kandar ever I have been. Bad service, rude waiter, we ask for order 3 times. We even go to them and ask properly, but they just ignore and said wait at the table. Been observe them how long they will take time to get our order and come to serve us, Unfortunately they just go serve the existing customer who ady have food in their table. Worst worst worst, bad service

author: Katie Maus (KAT)
review_text: A truly wonderful place where you can order the same types of meals that your Mother or Grandmother's house used to make. There are 2 sections, smoking & non smoking. The Live 🎷 music is sensational. Sometimes jazz, sometimes country, 🎹and they have a crowd that comes for it, too. And did I mention, FINALLY priced low and fair, as it should to be. Drinks are righteous 🥃🍸Vintage Vegas at it's absolute BEST✨️

author: KC
review_text: I was looking for a place where we could try all the different street and common food in one location. We have been having the same old restaurants that serve the usual restaurant dish and I finally stumbled upon this gem. First up, the service was excellent. I could see our server (in cool black glasses) always looking over at us and dropped everything so she could attend to us immediately. English was also very fluent. The food was the real stand out here. Though portions are average, the quality of the dishes really shone. We ordered about 8 different dishes and most of them were well prepared. Their menu was not too extensive and we could try a little bit of everything. Even the coconut water was amazingly cold and tasty. My favourite was the black rice cake, loco moco (yeah it's not Vietnamese) and the meat on a sugar cane thing. Excellent and a definite choice for me to return to bring my future guests. Price was extremely value for money too.

author: hottyson hottyson
review_text: Seven year celebration for this location today. I have enjoyed all seven years to the hilt! BEST DONUTS IN VEGAS! We absolutely LOVE Carl's donuts. We always chose Carl's over any other donuts. They are delicious and worth every cent. All employees (except for one female) are always smiles and friendly. If you run into one of the owners, you will be presented with a bright smiles and welcomes. Thank you Carl's for always making it possible for my family to enjoy such delicious donuts. Update: Jade M did not help my wife with her order and so it was too late as we had been rung up. If we had purchased a dozen items we would have gotten a discount. Jade M instead chose not to help my wife by suggesting a twelfth item. We spent over $50 and this is the service she chose to provide us. Thanks for nothing. Also no greeting and no smiles from her. Jade M is ruining what was the best donut shop in town. Orange juice was still delicious. The quiche is yummy. And of course the donuts are perfect. Too bad about the service. We are going to go to another donut shop next weekend.

author: Qifan Zhou
review_text: Had a fantastic lunch at GRECO today! I ordered the lamb plate with fries and yogurt sauce, and everything was delicious. The lamb was perfectly cooked—tender, juicy, and packed with flavor. The fries were crispy and seasoned just right, while the yogurt sauce added a creamy, refreshing balance to the dish. The portion is just right for a weekday lunch. Highly recommend if you’re looking for authentic Greek food in Boston!

author: Sean Sean
review_text: Deducted points from them as they aunty forgot my order. We came at 730am and she asked for my order and we were the first customer.. She mention that the soup will only start at 8am so we waited patiently. By 8qm, the place is already quite full ( like 20tables). When at 8 am, I noticed the aunty started serving 2 other tables that came after us. I firmly complained about it, and she released she has mixed up the order. Eventually, we became the fourth customer to be served, even though we were first on the order. Soup bass for ipoh hor fun is ok n curry noodle is also ok for me. No wow. It's above average I guess, since so many people come here

author: Romano Pravdič
review_text: 1. It’s GIANT. Definitely for 2 people 2. It’s filled with a TON of ham and meat Beware! It’s good, but just too much filling for my taste, had to throw the other half away as I could not eat it 😬 Also not enough vegetables to balance the flavors. Service is fast. But it you want to get as full as possible, 73k VND is an unbeatable price. There is no “dine-in”, just takeout.

author: Gw Ng
review_text: Came here first time as a tourist. Bought 3 drinks at sgd $60 consider cheap for a sgporean. Staff were friendly. Overall experience was fun.

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: aindrila karmakar
review_text: Tried the new Jumbo Menu at Michelin Bib-Gourmand Zhup Zhup and it was amazing! The Five Fortune Jumbo Prawn Noodles came loaded with tiger prawns, lala, pork ribs, shabu pork, and their signature prawn ball in rich broth – super flavourful and satisfying. The Jumbo Prawn Paofan was comforting with clams, egg floss, and plump prawns. We also had the Har Cheong Gai wings which were crispy and juicy. Drinks like Calamansi Sourplum and Yuzu Soda were refreshing and paired well with the food. Great portions, quality ingredients, and a must-try for seafood lovers in Singapore.

author: Las Vegas Hair and Makeup
review_text: This place taste so good. They are burgers are authentic and amazing. I don’t like burgers and these ones were my favorite. I was gonna tell Alexx can you get One of my sons got pancakes. We got zucchinis. The only thing that I could say is, it’s kind of pricey. But I would come back for a caving.

author: AZ Dad2day
review_text: Wonderful Jamaican. restaurant in Miami. Great location Very clean establishment with plenty of seating in back! The interior is fun and has an exciting Jamaican vibe! The service from Willie was outstanding and he is an example of hard work for the whole staff! The food was excellent. Everything is made fresh! The Jerk Mac n Cheese was absolutely delicious! Definitely a must try for all!

restaurant: El Toro Loco Steakhouse Bayfront Park Food Truck
author: Albert Martirosyan
review_text: the meat they put on the menu does not correspond to reality and the same weight dishes. the wait is very long. file mignon is the cheapest beef..

author: Jenny P
review_text: We visited this place because it was recommended by multiple people. We did not have to wait much to get a table and our server was the savior of the review ?and the bread). He was amazing!!!! We ordered fried calamari, it was good. We also had the clam chowder and it was very good too but I was honestly expecting something with more punch. Reasons why the low rating: - The sodas we ordered were flat - Restrooms were not clean at all and very unorganized. There was no soap; all there was, was an empty liquid soap bottle with the top out. No drying towels.

author: Meredith Oliver
review_text: I enjoyed Four Horsemen, but it didn't blow my mind for the price. If I went again, I'd stick to the small plates so I could try more things. The chicken was good, but not great and it was huge. Their menu changes on a regular basis, so you can't be sure what you're going to get. Nothing I had was bad. Wagyu crostini and harimasa (not pictured) were my favorites. I arrived at 10:45am, and waited for them to open at 11. A line formed quickly, and it's a slow process for them to seat everyone in their tiny space. If you can't get a reservation, show up as early as you can.

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: Manop Pithukpakorn (mprandy)
review_text: This local restaurant takes traditional Thai dishes to the new level. I went to this restaurant knowing nothing about this place. Upon arrival, I was amazed on how attentive the staffs were. Service is outstanding. Every dish was delicious and flawless. This meal also ended in high note with Honey Yuzu sorbet, perfect combination of smooth sorbet, fragrance, right degree of sweetness and citrus. No wonder it’s very popular esp. among tourists. This is the place with Michelin-star quality. 👍

author: Verren Yaputri
review_text: Loved the food! everything was well-presented and tasted amazing. The ambience is beautiful and relaxing, perfect for a nice Christmas dinner. The staff, especially kak Kahfi, were polite, helpful, and quick to assist. Highly recommended.

author: Joe Murphy
review_text: I took my Father to the Freemont Street Experience tonight for his birthday and after enjoying the scenery and street concerts Vegas has to offer, we stumbled into Bangkok Street Thai Restaurant. The staff was great and the food was amazing. My Father and I had the Drunken Noodles. It was absolutely delicious. You gotta check this place out and Bird thank you for the great service.

author: Diandra Leigh Dente
review_text: Koro is the new spot. From the moment you walk in, it's got that vibe – effortlessly chic, but still welcoming. You can tell there was thought and attention to detail about the whole experience. The sushi is so fresh, it's insane. You can really taste the quality, and tell that everything's made with so much care. Eastie has been needing a place like this, and Koro Ramen & Sushi is it. I'm so excited to have this restaurant in the neighborhood. It's not just a spot for food, it's a whole mood and so is Chef Harold.

author: Fix Mobile Central
review_text: The environment was cozy and relaxing. Food overall was great. All the menu that we ordered was rich of taste which synchronize with the restaurant name “Seribu Rasa”. Highly recommended.

author: Wong Jennifer
review_text: Few different type of food choices. Somehow hard to find parking at the roadside especially peak hours. Paid mbpp parking lots from 8-6pm. After 6pm, free mbpp parking lots at roadside. First time Tried 珍记 fried rice 排骨王炒饭 RM10. Taste normal and a bit salty. Rice and Meat portion is ok , but the pork taste normal, no surprise. Environment is clean. Near to USM.

author: prakhar deep
review_text: This restaurant has firmly established itself as a popular go-to spot for brunch and breakfast, and it’s not hard to understand why. Whether you’re catching up with friends or starting your day with a hearty meal, the experience here consistently hits the mark. One of the standout features is the portion size. The servings are generous without feeling overwhelming, offering great value for the price. The drink selection is also worth noting—whether you prefer a classic mimosa, a refreshing iced coffee, or something more creative, the bar delivers quality beverages that perfectly complement the food. Speaking of food, the pancakes are an absolute must-try. Fluffy, golden, and served with a variety of toppings, they manage to be indulgent without being too heavy. It’s no surprise they’re a favorite among regulars. However, the menu does have its limitations—particularly for vegan and vegetarian diners. While there are a few meat-free options, the selection is quite minimal and could benefit from more thoughtful variety. This might be a drawback for those with dietary restrictions or preferences. Despite that, the restaurant remains a beloved choice for many. The cozy, lively atmosphere and consistent food quality make it a reliable option for those in search of a satisfying morning meal. If you’re not following a plant-based diet and enjoy classic brunch fare, this place is definitely worth a visit. For pancakes and good vibes, it’s hard to beat.

author: avni sinsinwar
review_text: Really nice café! Loved the cocktails. I had Aperol Spritz, and it was perfect. The food was amazing, and I liked that the menu had the option to turn non-veg dishes into veg one, such a thoughtful idea. Joy and Maggie were super pleasant and friendly, they really made the experience enjoyable. Would definitely come back again!

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: wai yin Sit
review_text: Bak Kut Teh here promises a comforting and aromatic experience. So gather your ingredients, let the flavors meld, and enjoy this hearty dish! 🍲🌿

author: Mark Altreuter
review_text: All-you-can-eat is amazing. So much variety and no time or plate limits. I highly recommend the Hibachi station. If you want to get your money's worth, just throw a bunch of steak on the grill. I had hibachi steak with some teriyaki sauce and it was delicious. Desserts were ample and the cheesecake to die for. Sushi was okay. The rice seemed thick/dense. *Note: I went on a Sunday afternoon and had the Sunday all-day buffet.

author: Aru Karuna
review_text: Hor Fun @ koay teow thing is really good. Love the balance and the prawn based soup with won ton. Amazing flavours. I will surely be back wt friends. One setback, the owner got to improve the roti bakar. Plz dont use standard gardenia like bread loaf. Was expecting a nice crispy hainan bread for roti bakar. The 3 in 1 teh tarik is not my liking as well.

author: Bungy Coaster
review_text: Took awhile to be seated, and then they took us the wrong order (people who had been there longer didn’t get asked about their party, even though they were closer to the front). Waiter got an order wrong because he stopped listening. They had to remake food. Overall food was about as expected once we had it.

author: David Crow
review_text: The line was already building just as they opened. We were in there fourth. Everything croissant wise was stellar. Cookies were also delicious. The coffee drinks were not as dialed in but still decent. I was so excited to dig in to our baked goods that I skipped the photos. Bottom line is you won’t be disappointed with anything made here.

author: Robert Rael
review_text: Food was good and came out quick. There was no cilantro/onions on the burrito. They offer little packets, but who wants to open up the burrito again to put it on? Restrooms could use some work but otherwise nice place.

author: Qamarul Fadhli
review_text: Went here for lunch during weekdays. Had few dishes such as Nasi Bakul Daun Jeruk Ayam Pandan (non-spicy), Nasi goreng seafood (chose normal spicy option), Cumi lada garam (spicy default), Bakwan sayur udang, Perkedel jagung, Ayam goreng sambal bajak. They were awesome and delicious. Portion was good. Service crew was friendly and attentive. Food served hot and promptly too. Restaurant was clean and packed throughout our time there. Good place to have good meal for any occasions. Will not hesitate to return here or any other branches.

author: VILLAS CHANNEL
review_text: Absolutely delicious! We had an incredible breakfast at Restaurant Farmers Market. The omelets were amazing—perfectly cooked, flavorful, and packed with fresh ingredients. The French toast was next level—crispy on the outside, soft and fluffy inside, with just the right amount of sweetness. Highly recommend going for the full breakfast experience—you won’t be disappointed. Great service and a cozy atmosphere made it even better. Definitely coming back!

author: Ame
review_text: Ordered the value set: - Oyster with egg was good - Sambal kang kong was good - Cereal prawn was ok, cereal was good - Extra ordered hotplate tofu which was not bad too. - Finally curry fish head, abit disappointed as the taste wasn't as good as our last few visits. The curry gravy was more bland than before. Overall, it was still good for us. Value for money too.

author: Bryson Ritz
review_text: Such a great experience! The Tiki Toast was a must get. Dee was a great server. Mike the General Manager came by and filled up our water bottles for us. Will definitely come back both for the great food but also the great service!

author: Huseyin Ertac
review_text: I've eaten here multiple times, and I have to say their shawarma tasted pretty good. They also give a free bottle of water when you buy a menu, which was great. However, it raised a huge suspicion in terms of hygiene when I saw rats walking around the last time I was there. I do not think I will be going back. They also give a free baklava for a 5-star review on Google Maps, therefore I don't believe they deserve this rating they have.

author: Simple Things
review_text: Nacho Daddy has a large, open space that’s perfect for big groups, with plenty of seating options to fit everyone’s vibe. Our waiter was super helpful, kind, and knowledgeable, which made the experience even better. The food was good and the drinks were refreshing. If you’re in Vegas looking for a spot with a fun bar vibe and great atmosphere, this is definitely the place to be!

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Michel
review_text: After visiting the Thai Binh market, I stopped at this restaurant for a meal. The "Hu Tieu Nam Vang" noodle soup is very good with its broth.

author: Dwayne Sturdivant
review_text: And ask for extra everything I paid for it and it looks like this I want my order re made or my money money back this this nasty

author: Gede Cahya
review_text: This coffee shop has such a chill vibe, perfect for a cozy afternoon! ☕️ The coffee itself isn't too intense, which I actually kinda like. However, I have to admit, it felt a little pricey for what it was. Maybe it’s the atmosphere that comes with the cost! 🌳 Still, it's a nice spot.

author: Kate O'Connor
review_text: We’ve tried this place three times and were disappointed every time. We’re honestly confused by the positive ratings. The sushi misses the mark across the board. The spicy tuna seriously lacked flavor and was just tuna with a side of spicy mayo and oversized cucumber, and the rice was oddly sweet. Overall, it almost tasted like what you’d expect sushi to taste like if you tried to make it at home. The shrimp tempura had similar issues. The house ramen also wasn’t good. The noodles were rubbery even after following the heating instructions, and the meat was strangely seasoned. Nothing tasted terrible, but everything tasted off. Overall, this is a 1–2 out of 10 for sushi and ramen. If you seriously like sushi or ramen, this is not your spot. It’s unfortunate because it’s close by, but there are much better options elsewhere.

author: Lingual Tan
review_text: Seafood is not fresh. Worst bamboo clams I’ve ever had in my life - they were tasteless! I thought you could never go wrong with bamboo clams? I regretted ordering 6 pieces. When I gave feedback to the wait staff, she merely responded no refunds can be given and walked away. Clams in soup was nothing extraordinary and was overly peppery. Wouldn’t come back again and would NOT recommend. Plus, drinks only accept cash, and if you pay with Paynow, they charge you GST.

author: Randy
review_text: My favorite Tijuana style tacos out of all of LA! Savory and smoked coal-grilled meat wrapped in fresh hand-made tortillas. The line can get long sometimes but these authentic tacos are worth the wait!

author: Duangsamorn Songmuang
review_text: Delicious fried rice with crab.good and quick service.great value.clean restaurant.

author: Christian Chiu
review_text: it’s a very pretty place, and it seems like a super popular spot for photo taking the food itself I found was just okay, and relatively pricey depending how much you eat

author: Matt M
review_text: Nice restaurant. Cocktails were great. Food wasn't. But they were polite and removed it from our bill.

restaurant: Ming Qin Charchol Duck Egg Char Koay Teow
author: Ong Shu Wen
