review_text: Tried a Michelin-listed restaurant in BM, and I must say the Char Kuey Teow was impressive — the charcoal frying gave it a strong wok hei that even beats some I've had in Penang. The lala was flavourful at first but became a bit too sweet and overwhelming after a few bites. On the plus side, the restaurant has a spacious parking area, and food was served quickly. Overall, it’s a must-try spot if you’re in BM.

author: Alexandra Honor Arrivillaga
review_text: My husband and I have been coming here for years . The food is delicious. Authentic Hispanic cuisine. No tables inside , it’s a takeout place only . Parking is difficult but manageable. The service is welcoming and friendly.

author: Lim CY
review_text: A good place for chicken rice, it offers a wide selection of side dishes to choose from, which adds variety to the meal. The food is decent and consistently prepared. The shop is clean, service is fast and efficient, and prices are reasonable, making it a convenient option for a satisfying meal.

author: Shako Liu
review_text: I’m a visual person and I love how colorful the foods are. But more than just visuals, the taste is supreme! I come here a lot when I crave for something delicious and healthy. The staff is always kind and friendly. This restaurant is a neighborhood gem!

author: Yuridiana N
review_text: Food is delicious! Great prices and Excellent Customer Service. I highly recommend this location at Nellis. Aldo the gentleman who assisted me through the drive up window made my day. He offered me excellent customer service, he welcome me with a Smile and a happy attitude. I loved this encounter and I LOVE the food!! Will definitely be back! Thank you.

author: Cynthia Francis
review_text: Don’t go to a buffet when you haven’t eaten all day! I planned to take the food to go but when I realized how much food I had, it made sense to just pay the buffet price and sit down and eat! The worst decision! I had three employees come to my table asking for my receipt! The last person was a rude teenager- braces wearing kid! Just as I was about to tell him to go get your father. My waitress came to the rescue and set him straight. She gets a tip!! Ruined my appetite!!! My plastic glass was broken! The food is not good and my tongue is coated with MSG! 🤮

author: Sylvia
review_text: This dining experience was absolutely unforgettable! Every single dish was incredibly delicious. I couldn’t go wrong with any choice, and the Parihuela Amelcochada was so amazing that I’m even considering going back to Miami just for it LOL. The service was top level too. The server was so nice, he even helped peel our lobster and packed up the leftovers for us. Every little detail made the meal feel extra special and welcoming. I really hope this restaurant opens a location in San Diego someday so more people can enjoy such amazing food and thoughtful service! Truly worth every bite.

author: Stanic Teoh
review_text: A little bit hot, however it is BBQ mookata, so already set expectations for hot environment. With the price RM29. 90 it is worth, prawn, sotong, crabs, and many choices Free flow drinks, should give a try.

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: Jowe Chu
review_text: Yummy food and quick service. Crowded but we got seated quickly on a Saturday. Ordered fried garlic pork, prawn paste chicken and oyster omelette. The fried dishes are v crispy and nice. The omelette has a nice chili crab like sauce.

author: HooiChew Tan
review_text: Year 2018: Many good choices of Hawker food with reasonable price. Crowded and hard to get a parking during weekend. Unfortunately, A bit dirty at the tray return area as birds flying around there search for leftover food as the return trays was not collected promptly and send to wash immediately. Wish this can be improved for better hygiene for the eaters. 3 stars 🌟 rating for year 2018. Year 2022: Good Sarawak Kolo Mee, long queue. The birds 🐦 eating leftover food around tray return area shelves not found during this visit. Wish this will not happen anymore. With this upgraded it to 4 stars 🌟 rating for the improved hygiene ambience at tray returns area. Year 2023: Table never clean after other eaters left. Terrible table cleanliness and clean response time. Zero 🌟 for the table cleaning response time. After years still no significant and game-changing improvements. Bad table cleaning frequency. You want everyone come bring their own tissue paper to clean by themselves????

author: Tan Ellie
review_text: Haven't had such a good tze char in a long while. Flavour: great! Enjoyed all dishes Price: friendly if you avoid seafood - medium prawn (amazing salted egg flavour that comes with some curry mixed in so it is not gelat) was $33, though there were probably 12 prawns. For comparison, small garlic pork rib was $12 Freebie: free snacks and dessert (ice cream)

author: Andrew Eills
review_text: Great pizzas, Cesar Salad and Satay Chicken. Really good prices. Orange juice was freshly squeezed and very good value. It was nice to step into the friendly atmosphere of Harry's and have a good meal before out flight. Highly recommended.

author: Life’s a journey
review_text: We were walk in customer, we didn’t reserve a table but luckily there was a table available. If you wish you have a nice table with good view, we recommend you to reserve in advance. After we finish our food we asked staff to move to nicer table for drink which they agree to move us. Food was simple and fresh seafood. We ordered mixed seafood and fish steak. They both tasted good. One thing wasn’t restaurant fault is lot of people nowadays just love to take photos and selfies which disturb other customer sometimes. But the view is stunning.

author: Tze Keong Choo
review_text: Had dinner here on Thursday evening before 6pm, assigned seats on Level 2. Service from Top was top-notch, helped us with carrying our bags up and attentive to our needs. Food was great and highlights were the beef in fish sauce and satay!

author: Kanika Khatri Daing
review_text: Had an amazing time here .. the staff was so so nice and welcoming.. Had some great breakfast.. Avo toast was a HIT !! The coffee was good .. Will visit this next time for sure .. And recommend it to everyone who ever is travelling to Ubud .. 👌🏼

author: Jack Bekos
review_text: One of my favorite meals in NYC this year. Every dish was a dream. We ordered the oeuf, green tomatoes, fennel salad, tartare, mushroom toast and rainbow trout. Latter two were our favorites. The passion fruit tart dessert was magical. The best part? The wildly inventive wine list that paired perfectly with every bite. Service was great and homey, intimate setting was wonderful. Expensive but worth it for a special occasion.

author: Candy Ramirez
review_text: First time going with my husband and it did not disappoint! I would always see the place but we finally made it today and it was worth every penny! Service was great everyone there working together in checking in and asking us if we needed anything. The food was done so quick and it was DELICIOUS!! 😋 The spuds were a 10/10!! Definitely will be recommending this place! I love the whole vibe of the place and music!

author: Judy Ong
review_text: Full of authentic Italian flavours and well prepared dishes. The waiting staff were friendly and attentive, making the whole dining experience enjoyable. Will definitely be back again.

author: A
review_text: i would actually give it a 3.5/5 because the nuggets are always fresh but the past few times the fries haven’t been. My cat wouldn’t even eat them refried fries just horrible fries and the staff tends to get aggressive in drive-thru , but overall a pretty decent experience and if i had to suggest a meal it would be the Asiago Ranch Club meal ❤️

author: Kiana Braun
review_text: Honestly the only thing that saves this place is the location. The French fries tasted like they had sat in a porta potty so I’m not sure if they just use way too strong of cleaner in the kitchen or if they were using a cleaner while cooking the food but I couldn’t eat them. The smash burger also had no flavor, it is a seafood place so hopefully the seafood is better. My other issue with this place was the outfits the waitresses and hostess were wearing, they were terrible and not flattering at all. This place would be great if the food was 10x better and they allowed these ladies to wear proper clothing that actually fit them because the views and the vibes were great!

author: Jennifer Dever
review_text: I have not been here since the Chase Center has been completed- but I am happy to say it’s as good as ever! I had the dungeness crab sandwich for lunch and although it is pricey it’s worth it! The amount of crab on the toasted brioche was good, and the sauce is on the side. Perfect. It also came with a generous sized salad and fries. Worth it. Of course you can’t beat the location sitting bay-side. Good stuff!

author: 孤獨的美食家
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ La Brisa Bali is one of the most beautiful beach clubs in Canggu — effortlessly combining bohemian charm with a laid-back seaside vibe. The decor is stunning, built mostly from reclaimed wood and fishing boats, giving it an authentic, rustic character that perfectly fits the Bali spirit. The entire place glows warmly under the sunset, with fairy lights and ocean breeze setting the perfect tropical mood. The atmosphere is easily the highlight. Whether you’re chilling by the pool, watching surfers ride the waves, or sipping cocktails while the sky turns golden, it’s impossible not to feel relaxed. The music is mellow and fits the mood — upbeat enough to energize, yet calm enough for good conversation. The food is generally good. The grilled octopus was tender and flavorful, the truffle pasta rich and creamy, and the pizza surprisingly well-baked with a crispy crust. While the quality is solid, the prices are quite high for Bali standards — you’re clearly paying for the view and the setting. The service was polite and attentive, though the staff seemed quite busy at peak hours. Still, they managed to keep things running smoothly with a smile. Overall, La Brisa is not just a restaurant but an experience — a place to unwind, enjoy the ocean, and soak in Bali’s relaxed elegance. Perfect for sunset drinks or a romantic dinner by the sea.

author: Paul Craven Craven
review_text: What a fabulous brunch experience and the staff was absolutely amazing especially Caitlyn as she had so much going on and was so friendly and sense of urgency was absolutely 💯 above and beyond and the food was great and so that means we will def be coming back and thank you for a great breakfast brunch experience as it was my daughters birthday !!!

author: josselyn chirinos
review_text: I had order lunch from this restaurant through Uber eats and aside from them giving me the work sizes of fries I got a long white hair on my sandwich which completely ruined my lunch.

author: Małgorzata Pindych
review_text: We absolutely love this place! Being deeply in love with Vietnam, we especially appreciate being able to come back here whenever we’re in Bali and Vietnam isn’t accessible. It’s like a little slice of our favorite country—right here on the island. The service is always excellent. We’ve never had a single issue with the staff. They’re clearly well-trained, know exactly what they’re doing, and always make us feel welcomed and taken care of. The food comes out super quickly, and even the drinks are outstanding. Special shoutout to the pandan iced tea—it completely blew my mind. One of the very few places where I can order it without sugar and it’s not treated like a weird request. And the food? Just amazing. We always leave feeling light, happy, and full—but not heavy. It’s magic. And let’s talk about the prices: absolutely fantastic. Every time we visit, we walk out beyond satisfied. Can’t wait to come back again (and again).

author: John D'Cruz (Kajangfood)
review_text: A bakery that I have been patronising for over 20 years. I used to make it a point to pick up bread and buns when I’m in Penang to take back to KL. It’s certainly good quality and value for money compared to KL prices. Recommended to visit if you’re in the area.

author: Ayesha Connolly
review_text: We’ve been to just about every diner in Las Vegas, and saying we’ve tried them all is barely scratching the surface. As true diner fans, we know a good one when we find it. This place is it. Sure, it’s in a rougher part of town, but honestly, who cares when the food is this good? Everything they make here hits the spot. The omelettes are always cooked perfectly and packed with flavor. Their chicken-fried steak is comfort food at its finest. The cheeseburger is classic and satisfying. Don’t miss the chili either. It’s hearty and full of flavor. And for a sweet finish, you have to try the blueberry-filled French toast. It’s unreal. Always check the board for their specials! We keep coming back because it never disappoints. Friendly staff, great portions, and real-deal diner food. Highly recommend to anyone who loves diners as much as we do.

author: Lukasz Mamcarczyk
review_text: Cheap, authentic and friendly, what else would you want? Highly recommend. I've been here maybe 5 times already and not once I didn't like something. The dishes are fresh and tasty, I recommend the chicken with cashew nuts, spring rolls and fried rice. You will not regret coming here. Chicken leg was so crispy and literally mouth watering. To get here you just need to walk down the alleyway, not that hard to find.

author: Kevin Khor
review_text: The glass noodles crab is so good, a must try. The prawn is well grill and juicy, and the curry crab meat is good too. The service is good with a lot of smile on face, love it. Seating is a bit packed but manageable.

author: Deon Jong
review_text: Queued more than 30 minutes for the best braised duck. Queue is not very fast moving but it is worth the queue. Had it with rice alone and it was divine. Sauce was not overly salty and herbal tasted 👍🏻

author: Rebecca
review_text: Jamaica plain has needed a bigger coffee shop that isn’t a chain! I’m thrilled that we now have somewhere to work and lounge. It’s a great addition to the neighborhood. It’s also a unique concept, with Indian inspired snacks and beverages. The Cardamom Clove latte is perfect and a large quantity. It’s truly some of the best coffee I’ve had in Boston in a long time and is perfectly balanced. I also tried their breakfast sandwich with Calabrian chili oil butter, which was tasty, but a bit small. I can’t wait to try their other offerings.

author: chris carvo
review_text: I kept getting adds saying it was so much better than panda without the panda price. The rice was ok but the chow mein was disgusting. The noodles were overdone mush. The orange chicken was super thick breaded and all sugar no flavor. The real star was the bbq pork. I spit out the first bit due to the overwhelming sugar and taste of red dye. It didn't take like any bbq pork I've ever had. I ate almost all of everything simply to not waste food but I couldn't eat more than one piece of the pork. Good marketing but the food doesn't hold up.

author: Jun
review_text: I personally think this restaurant has it's own unique style and taste The price in my opinion is abit expensive but it's totally worth it on what your ordering 🤤. I ordered the Nasi Lemak and the chicken piece is huge 😱 The Restaurant is Halal certified so for the Muslims who are interested, can try out this place. The service is super fast, I just ordered a few minutes and then the food is already prepared. Overall the environment is clean and comfortable. Hope some of you guys can try out this amazing place 😁 👍

author: MOSES NOLASCO
review_text: The place is clean and the cooks are ready to prepare your food as soon as you place your order. The lady at the cash register is polite and beautiful. The coffee is a little bit pricey in opinion because is just regular coffee, anyway; the French toast I ordered were soft, warm and delicious... enjoy it my dear friends.

author: Neiko Alexander
review_text: The food was amazing! Catfish was so hot, fresh, and crunchy! I don’t play about mac and cheese and it certainly met my expectations. Cornbread was moist and not crumbling apart! Nice comfortable aesthetic too!

author: Lyon Hu
review_text: The food had good taste, but the portions were small. The service was average.

author: Haimanti Gupta
review_text: La Favela is one of a kind..! It’s a must visit if you are in seminyak. Everything is breathtaking - food, drinks, vibe, and ambience. Denny was just awesome and made us feel so nice. His hospitality is something to experience for sure.

author: Oksana Maister
review_text: My new favorite spot in SF! 🍜 Cozy vibes, super friendly staff who make you feel instantly welcome, and some of the tastiest dumplings and noodles around. Great prices, flavorful drinks, and they also offer takeaway—perfect when you want their delicious food at home. A true neighborhood treasure!

author: Colt Murgio
review_text: Mykonos is a unique Greek fusion restaurant featuring high-end Greek dishes. We booked a reservation for 11 people and were very flexible on the timing, as we ended up being an hour late. Once we arrived, we got seated immediately at the table. Also, we noticed the beautiful decor and atmosphere. We ordered a variety of appetizers and entrees. I will say I was a little disappointed with the lack of service, considering only a handful of tables were occupied. The food tasted amazing, with my favorite being the lamb chops. Overall, I would come back here and have a great meal.

author: Mr. Toilet
review_text: Food was fine, you have to grill the meat yourself. But food preparation was very slow, we waited for a very long time even when it was just plates of raw meat. Great atmosphere for hanging out, a bit loud because there was a birthday party. Clean restaurant.

author: Jpezze
review_text: So I placed an order in store gave my name and used my app to collect points every time I come to this location on it’s an issue my order was ready and the guy working a white man could not say my name he was about to put my food up on the stand to wait I’m literally sitting in front of the counter not only that the name is in the bag and it also say the color of my shirt on the bag but I guess because I’m black native descent he didn’t not care ever other store I visit says my name even if it’s not correct but this store it always an issue that why I try my hardest not to come here

author: Maribel Hernandez
review_text: What is there not to love but the closest taste of fine Portuguese dining while not having to catch a flight to Coimbra, Portugal. My favorite was their pork cube clams, well marinated that the pork cubes and clams taste like they were one. The octopus salad was also well seasoned, maybe a little too heavy with the onions but the octopus wasn't chewy or overcooked, it was seasoned and settled well with all the flavors when served. I did not like the soup, I can get fresher soup from Seabra's on 83 Wilson Ave. The not-so-pleasant-going-towards-the-fermented soup I couldn't palate the soup after the second try. Other than that everything else was well made, locally bought and I did love their mixed salads, the salads tasted fresh which is difficult during a time of climate justice. Maybe the waiter should of asked was there something wrong with the soup. I would have shared my opinion. The pastel de nata sweet and not too heavy but just heavenly crisp and a thick pudding like cream of heaven. There's a parking lot available on Fillmore, the atmosphere was laid-back, patrons sitting down either at the bar or on the serving tables. There's a larger dining area on the left side of the restaurant and a private room downstairs for a more private party. Waiters were attentive and courteous, they wanted to know how they can be of service as they checked in on the customers. There bartenders can be a little snarky but I understand it's challenging to be behind the counter. Next time Coimbra, overall well done.

author: Jaycee Rodriguez
review_text: My husband always somehow suckers me into trying this place again after awful food & customer service experiences. This most recent one was no different. There is a lack of quality Dominican food in J.P. The chicken from here is WAYYYYY too salty and the rice was crunchy. Batatas were dry and had been clearly sitting for hours. Their prices are also OUTRAGEOUS! $2.75 + tax for a papa relleno smaller than my fist with almost no meat filling. I'd recommend traveling to Lawrence for decent Dominican cuisine.

author: Sumit Saudagar
review_text: Rating: ★★★★★ (5/5) Cong Cafe in Hoi An is a must-visit for coffee lovers! The cafe has a cozy, vintage atmosphere with a unique retro charm that makes it stand out. I tried their signature Vietnamese iced coffee, and it was rich, strong, and absolutely delicious. The ambiance is relaxed and welcoming, perfect for a casual hangout or enjoying a quiet moment. The staff was friendly and provided excellent service. The prices were very reasonable for the quality and experience. If you’re in Hoi An, don’t miss out on Cong Cafe for a true taste of Vietnamese coffee and a lovely environment!

author: S C
review_text: A restaurant with many workers, so even though it's often crowded, food service is pretty fast. We ordered a number of dishes which are all very satisfying. Price is very affordable as well.

author: Sasa Swift
review_text: Food quality dropped so much. Rice was not the high quality jasmine rice and no fragrance of authentic Hainanese Rice. Chillies and ginger was good. Chicken was tender and juicy but lack of the depth of taste. Worse is the fried bitter gourd with egg, it served as mixed veggies, watery veggies with weird combinations, onions, butter gourd, egg and lettuce ! Who eat like that? the soup is free but .. not worth to mention of it: Old school restaurant that has lost its charm

author: Blane Hartleb
review_text: One of our must go to places every time we come to Vegas. Chicken skins with honey dipping sauce. The chicken thighs in a white sauce and the bread with bacon jam....omg. words can't describe these dishes. Then we finish with the bread pudding. I ask for extra glaze. Wow.

author: XSP
review_text: Randomly came across the cafe. It turned out to be such a great experience that we stayed for a long while. The ambience in the evening was cozy and relaxing. There was a live singer with a really great voice. We also liked the coffees and the ox bone soup.

author: helios realm
review_text: Very very crowded even more crowded than the mall's food courts. People queue up patiently for their turns..either for cafe seating places or for purchase of famous pineapple cake 🍍,instant coffee. So after waiting we were allocated to our seat. Service is fast and prompt. Oriental signature nasi lemak is quite a disappointment ,only a little hint of coconut milk,,the chicken meat part is gargantuan large,,,broiler chicken?but sambal is 👍. Oriental curry laksa (meehoon) is heavenly good,, 👍😊 love it,,,all the herbs,spice,curry swimming around your tongue. Egg tarts is only average,,before we ate it,the crust already falling aparts.🫢😑. Teh tarik is good,,must try it.and they are not stingy with their drinks. (Just look at the picture how it overflows.👍

author: Molly Pratt
review_text: My friends of color call this "the racist place". On multiple occasions we have experienced microagressions directed towards us by multiple employees. If you are not white, be prepared to be treated rudely. Even though the food was good, we will but be going back.

author: Cathy Dang
review_text: Such a cute establishment with so much seating! Both indoor and outdoor. Great assortment of food and drinks. Service was excellent. Only thing I didn’t appreciate was that the photos of the grandmas on the wall Were so clearly AI generated. Would have loved to see real family photos or real grandmas. But that’s not enough to Derail my review from being a five star regardless.

author: Esther Khoo
review_text: The clay pot la la is very fresh, very delicious. the soup base was also really nice. soup refill and sauces and cooking wine all self service and provided. there's a variety of other ingredients to choose from ranging from different kinds of meats, dumplings, meat balls to vegetables. it is also possible to add more lala was $5.80 for 250g. the clay pot is over charcoal which cooks lala perfectly. only downside that we experienced was that the food too quite awhile to come. other than that, went around 5.30pm so no queue really and food was really good.

author: Nicole Smith
review_text: Come here for brunch!!! The food was absolutely bonkers! Portions were also great for the price, two of us split three dishes and both had leftovers to take. Both of us really enjoyed our teas as well. The service was quick and kind and the vibes were wonderful with the music in the background. Highly recommend!

author: Alice Woo
review_text: This small restaurant serves some delicious Duck Noodles. You can have your noodles dry or with soup and with mixed meats. The noodles were very chewy and the broth tasted delicious and very flavourful. As for the duck meat.. it’s soft, tender and very tasty. They were very generous with the spring onions and crispy fried onions. You can add extra sauces if you like your noodle a bit spicier or more flavourful. We enjoyed eating the noodles very much… so yummy!

author: Emma Lopez-Ponnada
review_text: Enjoyed my lunch here. Belen was a very nice server. They have a $19 lunch special. 1 protein, 2 sides, soup, & a coffee. I chose lamb kofta (juicy), humus, and salad. We also tried two delicious pastries: orange pound cake & spicy beef sfiha (also juicy). They do charge an automatic 18% service charge when you eat in & ask if you want to leave tip on top of that when you check out.

author: Saoud FS
review_text: The people who run this place are wonderful and very courteous, the food's great and they've got a pretty wide variety of different cuisines on their menu. Great place to drop by if you're a student!

author: Aden Teklu
review_text: Got the chance to try a variety of things here and we were really pleased. The STAR OF THE SHOW is their baked mac and cheese. That was the dish that our group collectively kept saying they wanted more of. The bacon burger and spicy notes were so great, and the tots definitely were delicious. Grape and burrito was super refreshing next to all of the hot meals, and the black rice and oxtail risotto was perfection. For dessert we tried the glazed donut bread pudding, and while yummy it was a bit underwhelming. Should’ve added their bacon ice cream on top, would’ve added a great flavor to it. Staff was really friendly and accommodating. Also, they gave a rooftop but you need to make a reservation

author: Terri Martin
review_text: Was seated quickly and had my food quickly. My server was a lovely lady. She made fresh coffee for me.

author: Yi Wen Chan
review_text: Delicious nasi kandar with very fragrant curry 😍 dhal with roti canai also very nice, Maggie goreng seasoning perfectly nice with “wok hei” 😍😍😍

author: Armi Castro
review_text: Great food! If you go there as for Joao Neto. He is excellent and will help you have a great time eating authentic Brazilian food. The Pichana is great and the music was on point! I will definitely come back again with my family

author: Cami Tussie
review_text: Great vibe, casual outdoor atmosphere with music playing by the boats. Lots of delicious seafood at a good price. Fried fish isn’t oily at all. Recommend the grouper. Coconut shrimp good but not amazing, same with seafood salad, probably wouldn’t get again. Great service, don’t forget to get your parking validated in lot 72 across the street!

author: Carlos Vivas
review_text: A Must-Visit for Breakfast Lovers in Coconut Grove! 🌴☕🍳 Greenstreet Café is a true gem located in the heart of Coconut Grove, Florida. I came here for breakfast with my family and we were all thoroughly impressed. The atmosphere is vibrant and welcoming, with both indoor and outdoor seating that lets you soak in the Grove's charm. The food was absolutely delicious — fresh ingredients, generous portions, and beautifully presented. We tried a mix of dishes: fluffy omelets packed with flavor, perfectly toasted breakfast sandwiches, and one of their signature plates that left us wanting more. They also offer crisp, fresh salads, and a variety of healthy options that make it easy to start your day right. One of the highlights for me was the fresh-squeezed juices — vibrant, refreshing, and clearly made with care. Their coffee was rich and satisfying, a perfect pairing with our meal. Service was friendly and attentive, and the overall vibe was laid-back yet classy — ideal for a relaxing morning out. If you're in the Coconut Grove area and looking for a delicious breakfast spot with great service and a cozy atmosphere, I highly recommend Greenstreet Café. It’s the kind of place you’ll want to return to again and again.

author: Jaime See
review_text: a different style of dim sum - miniature size. not of d same variety 1 wld find in a typical dim sum restaurant. taste has more of a fish sauce base, but subtle enough to taste d meat. tried d bak kut teh which was a bit flat, not of d herbal flavor of klang, malaysia. haadyai's bkt more on d salty side, more like a meat soup. however, d char kuew teow was not bad at all. has 'wok hei' n tastes good. the milk tea n coffee were not up to par at all, but they use a squarish cup for their chinese tea. a pleasing visual indeed...

author: Cheryl Lee
review_text: This looks really good, almost full house in fact, hop over to get the authentic thai food here!! Come with friends and be satisfied!! Love the vibes here!!

author: Julie F
review_text: This place is very popular on social media, so I came with high expectations. I waited around 10 minutes in line, and once I finally tried the food, I have to say it was very good and definitely worth eating. Unfortunately, the service significantly lowered the overall experience. Apart from the lady at the entrance who was managing the queue, most of the staff appeared cold and unwelcoming, with little to no smile — especially the cashier. The attitude felt tense and unfriendly, which was quite disappointing. This felt very un-Thai. If you’ve dined at other restaurants in Thailand, the contrast in hospitality is noticeable. Considering the price, I believe customers should receive not only good food but also friendly and respectful service. We traveled from overseas genuinely excited to enjoy local cuisine, but the cold reception made the experience less enjoyable. I hope the owner takes this feedback seriously, as the food has great potential, but the service needs improvement.

author: Christopher Vargas
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 4/5 “Golden Vibes at the Golden Cane” The Raising Cane’s in downtown Boston—known as the Gold Cane—definitely lives up to its name. The gold theme makes the place stand out from the typical fast-food spots; it feels a little more special and modern, like a celebration of Cane’s itself. The decor is flashy but clean, and the bright gold accents give it a fun, upbeat atmosphere. As for the food, it’s classic Cane’s—simple, crispy, and satisfying. The chicken fingers were fresh and hot, the Cane’s sauce hit just right, and the Texas toast was buttery perfection. The crinkle fries were solid, though they could’ve been a bit crispier. Service was friendly and quick even though the place was pretty packed. The “gold” theme isn’t just for looks—it’s meant to mark this location as one of the flagship or showcase restaurants for Raising Cane’s, highlighting the brand’s best design and energy. It’s got that downtown buzz and a good mix of students, tourists, and locals grabbing quick bites. Overall, the Gold Cane is worth checking out for the experience alone. Great for a quick meal, late-night stop, or just to see what a “gold standard” Cane’s feels like.

author: Stefanie Nicolosi
review_text: Their Chicken fingers and fries do not disappoint. Karaoke is a fun time. The drinks were lackluster but we didn't even arrive until after midnight. Staff was likely just trying to control overdrinking. Reasonable prices and fun history. All around good time.

author: Brian Bounds
review_text: Hello Bob’s East Side Deli, I want to start out by saying this place Rocks. If anyone is looking for a great Breakfast, or Lunch you must stop here at Bob’s. Bob’s crew that work there are such awesome people they take care of their customers whether it’s the first time or not. So I put on RC Boat races at Sunset park in Las Vegas. The Boating organization is Called NAMBA we have been around for over 50 years. We came to Bob’s with a large request, we asked them if they would be willing to serve lunches for our National event we put on in September of last year 2024. Stacy said sure we came up with a menu. They knocked it out of the park. They had every lunch ready on time, they didn’t miss a lunch they even had name tags on every box. Wow it was amazing what they did. We couldn’t thank them enough. So Now it’s the first weekend in May, we went back to Bob’s East side Deli and asked them if they would be willing to help us out again on Lunches as I put on another RC Boat races at Sunset Park they said for sure. So we came up with another menu and every thing was Great. But this time they went above & Beyond they are not open on Sundays, but she had a crew come in & make are lunches on a day they are not open on. Stacy, her Daughter, & staff NAMBA & I can’t thank you enough for the wonderful lunches you provided us with. Thank you so much. So if you live here or if you’re just visiting from out of town please Stop here you will not be disappointed. Brian

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: Jennifyr Y
review_text: Well we enjoyed this thoroughly. Small bowls with handmade noodles. Pork was crispy and duck was tender. Food is 5 stars. Great tasting and excellent value. Hit the spot! Soup was subtle and flavourful. V clean toilet. No air con but plenty of fans downstairs. Aircon in upstairs part. So good we came again in the evening!

author: Nidhi Verma
review_text: This entrée is special the moment I first see it. Beautifully presented in a sleek, heated buffet server, this vibrant entrée pops with color and flavor in each perfectly cooked, tender piece tossed with crisp, fresh bell peppers and a mouthwatering sauce that’s rich yet satisfying in every bite. Careful attention to detail-from sizzling aroma to stunning plating-really elevates dining experience. What a standout dish this was, combining bold taste with elegance!

author: Vic C
review_text: Food was ok. Fish dip was more like canned tuna. Rockefeller oysters were ok, but were just above room temp. I thought they would be nice and toasty from baking. Mahi Mahi was nice and warm and still juicy.

author: Micheal Yerigian
review_text: The food was decent. Thought the potatoes might be instant mash potatoes.

author: Ninven Koh
review_text: Crab 🦀blackpepper not recommend & kemsom soup a little bit salted🐟,vegetable pakliang kai 🥬is taste so yummy

author: Bunny
review_text: Berniece, Zamiyah and especially Mike are awesome and they are courteous! I came in feeling very sad and they lifted my spirits. Thank you die the good souls food and also making my soul feel better too with their kindness ❤️ I dined in and Mike bright me my food and was very professional and courteous and he is handsome too. Gos bless this establishment!

author: Ashley T (Shark and Eagle)
review_text: We are from Melbourne and solid fan of Doo Dee Melbourne, I was surprised Doo Dee was originally from Thailand I thought it was just some random name. The food is good and price is fair, I had curry crab for 350b, which would be cost 5 or more times for in Melbourne. Very happy and would def come back again.

author: Sierra Harken
review_text: The shakes are insanely good! The burgers and fries are also great. This is truly a staple so make sure to come hungry. We found there’s good availability for seating if you go in person, but typically get this as takeaway.

author: Milton Mejía
review_text: Very bad service, the cashiers are always in a bad mood, and they don't pack things properly. Ranch dressing spilled all over my order, I paid extra, and the soda cups are broken; all the soda spilled in my car's cup holder.

author: Peini Chong
review_text: The restaurant had a great atmosphere.. Service was friendly. Meat quality was good and fried chicken was juicy. We left feeling full and extremely satisfied.

author: Hai Yan Yu
review_text: we reached(12:10pm) before the shop open to skip the queue. we have already decided what to order while waiting for the store to open. so we are the first table to be served. Many dishes have different size to choose from. curry crab is the best. unfortunately that day live crab has not available yet when we place order. so we changed to river Prawn Vermicelli Casserole, not bad also.

author: Mayank Dayal
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Food and service here are excellent. The red onion tart was absolutely amazing—full of flavor and beautifully presented. The spicy watermelon margaritas were another standout—refreshing with just the right kick, and the bartender is top notch. What’s also great is their bakery: after 8 PM, all remaining baked goods are just $1! The coffee cake and muffins are fluffy, fresh, and really tasty. I’ve also vouch wonderful things about their pizzas—crispy, light, and loaded with fresh toppings. Overall, this place is a real gem in Venice for a laid-back vibe, delicious food, and great drinks. Highly recommended!

author: Kim Thủy Bùi
review_text: Airy, clean tables and chairs, very fresh meat, reasonable price and a lot of food.

author: Maximilian
review_text: Le Tub gives funky Florida dive bar energy with huge burgers, rustic wood, a waterfront breeze…This place isn’t trying to be fine dining, it’s all about the character, the chaos, and that very specific “old Florida” charm. We ordered mahi mahi sandwich, a chicken club, burger, fries, etc. Portions are generous. Tastes solid. Is it going to blow your foodie mind? Nah. But does it hit the spot with a cold drink in hand while you’re sitting by the water? Absolutely. Service is on point, our server was chill, friendly, and way more attentive than I expected for a spot that feels like you should be barefoot.😅 Come here for the experience, not just the food. If you like quirky, tropical dives with character, this place is 100% a vibe.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Chris C
review_text: We tried the bun bo hue for breakfast at 11am and it was amazing. The lady is very friendly and we loved the steak and flank beef spicy noodle soup for 70k. Great way to start the day.

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: Mun Chong
review_text: Cabbage chicken - weekend only dish - chicken probably double boiled wrapped in cabbage leaves. Cabbage leaves were close to melting (highlight #1 of dinner) Garlic steamed sotong - a bit sweet Onion omelette - nicely cooked Chinese spinach cooked with 3 types egg - highlight#2 of dinner Fried noodles Fried rice Recommended condiments were sambal chilli, fresh red chilli and freshly minced garlic - highlight #3

author: Tan Wei Sheng
review_text: The foods are below par on the price paid. Limited selections and most of the items in store are pretty dull. Service wise was a-okay. Atmosphere is another down point as it's just too crowded. Bus loads of tourists tend to come in which seems to hype up the place but definitely not worth a 4* review.

author: Dwayne Yong
review_text: Mookata, a Thai-style steamboat and grill, offers a wide variety of ingredients, both cooked and raw. The selection is great, from fresh vegetables to marinated meats. The pork belly is tasty but has too much fat. A better balance would be 2/3 meat and 1/3 fat, which would make it perfect. Overall, Mookata is a good choice for those who enjoy grilling and boiling their own food, but the pork belly could use a slight improvement. Definitely a good place for family and friends' gathering

author: Stefano Gentile
review_text: Found this small restaurant - not really a hidden gem - on Google Maps, apparently quite popular, since I’m staying in a nearby Airbnb, and definitely it deserves all its praise. I did not have to wait in line (went Friday around 9h45), the restaurant was practically empty. I ordered the mix (N.8?) curry scrambled eggs and normal scrambled eggs with rice, as well as Thai milk tea. Prices are very reasonable too! In short, it was delicious, very recommended if you stay in the area.

author: Stephanie Rivas
review_text: We visited this establishment for the first time on a Friday morning and were pleased to find there was no wait time. Our server was exceptionally kind and efficient. The food was average; I ordered the carne asada burrito with a side of French fries. However, I was disappointed to find French fries already included in the burrito, which defeated the purpose of ordering them as a side. The carne asada had an unusual flavor, and I only managed to eat half of the burrito. We also tried the mini trio pancakes, expecting a variety of flavors, but were surprised that the Oreo pancakes only had Oreo toppings and as well as the dulce de leche pancakes hint of dulce de leche. The strawberry pancakes lacked banana flavor despite being labeled as strawberry and banana. The concha served with café de la olla was only half a concha. Given the food's somewhat lacking flavor profile, I personally do not think I will be returning.

author: Truth Fairy
review_text: Good vibes with funny standee. Claypot rice is the best here. Typical hawker vibes with relatively better and cheaper food. Duck rice is just 3 stars. Fried yong Tau foo not bad, smells very aromatic when it was cooked. May be jelat if you are eating one plate alone so suggest you share. Come around 1230pm but still have seats. Shops here open and close when ever they feel like it. But whether the food here is worth traveling for I don’t think so. But good to go if you are nearby.

author: Ernesto Soto
review_text: Great variety of cachapas! Very easy to get if you drop off from Jackson Square station (T). The meat it's cooked to perfection and flavorful. Their portions are generous. Paellas seems to be very popular there was well. Staff is great, I will definitely come back again to keep trying other stuff on their menu!!!

author: Jani Valkonen (JayValkyr)
review_text: This Michelin-selected restaurant comes with high expectations. We had lunch here and it was good. Nothing exceptional, especially compared to the dinner we had last night almost by chance. Still recommended and absolutely worth a visit.

author: Lynn Friedman
review_text: I really love this family run business. The dumplings are made to order, and the staff is friendly & helpful, will take the time to help you order if you can't deal with the QR code system. Love love love the Crystal Shrimp Dumplings. Other favs are the chili oil wontons and the cucumber salad. Actually, anything with chili oil is delicious. There's sriracha & soy sauce on the table. Beware, they close for a stretch between lunch and dinner, except for the weekend, so mind their hours. On a nice day I do takeout & eat in nearby Dolores Park. 100% recommend

author: Mikeyy Lunarezz
review_text: I found this place by accident on Google maps while looking at jersey mills mall. I decided to check this place out after shopping at the mall which is a few miles away. Restaurants is located in a trip mall which has free parking which is always a plus. From the outside place doesn't seem very big but that is deceiving because it's pretty big inside. There's plenty of seating very large selection of food, including fruits, vegetables and more. Staff is welcoming and your really get you money's worth. Food was great, they keep place clean and food always stocked. They even have a party room for special events. They also have a restrooms which is also clean and well maintained. I enjoyed my experience overall. If you're looking for a cool buffet and you're out with friends or family and you happen to be in the area this place will not disappoint.

author: Soly Portillo
review_text: When driving up to the place you think two things. One, where will I park and two, this place must be very good. I didn't actually have to wait for parking that long. Under 3 minutes. Also it was on a Saturday morning. They have bench seating even outside of where you check in your party which is a nice gesture especially for those who need/want to sit while waiting in line. The servers were on the go at all times. So we waited under 20 minutes which showed just how quickly the service was. The placed was a little crammed up it seemed like but, walked through the aisles with no problems. The agua fresa drinks are made from concentrated. Unfortunately. The liquados were made well. All there dishes seemed like they had a little of that spicy . It tasted really great except, not everyone such as a person in my group can handle and amount of it. There fresh coffee from their pot was delicious. Lorenzo was the server. He was quick. He was knowledgeable about what they had. His suggestions were tried with appreciation. With one of the plates having a piece of shell from the egg still, I let them know so they could mention to the chefs. I know you guys are busy and all but dont rush to where it becomes a growing mistake. The noise level was perfect unlike those other places that have music so loud you can't even hear yourself think. I heard it was like a Spanish Dennys. I reminds me more of Eli's on the eastside. As if they was its sister. Maybe they are? It was priced well compared to other places. I think I went in there with higher expectations. Overall decent place.

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Thanh Lê Nguyễn Duy
review_text: The staffs were friendly, helpful and always looked out for their customers' experiences. Besides the great customer service, the food was great, various and the seasoning was delicious. 8/10 will come back.

author: danbi byun
review_text: I absolutely loved my visit to Sue’s Cafe! I ordered the charcoal latte and strawberry shortcake! Both were amazing. The latte had the perfect balance of nutty and sweet flavors without being overpowering, and the cake was incredibly soft and delicious. The staff were so kind and welcoming, and the peaceful, calming atmosphere made the experience even more enjoyable. Can’t wait to come back!🌱☕️

author: Totally Becks
review_text: The restaurant is a traditional Thai Chinese place that focuses on hot pot porridge. The boiled rice black crab with roe soup is excellent. The restaurant is very comfortable with interesting deco. They also play nice music in the background that somehow isn’t noisy. We can still have a lovely conversation while enjoying the meal.

author: Komang Lestari
review_text: Had a pleasant dining experience at Here Duan. I ordered the spicy deep fried pork neck salad and stir fried-rice seafood, the taste was well-seasoned and flavorful. The portion size was worth the price. The place is comfortable, making it a nice spot for family meals. Overall, a enjoyable experience, and I’d definitely consider coming back to try other dishes.

author: Ira Simmons
review_text: I tried a new bowl (Sad Papi) It was delicious. (Albacore and forbidden rice) Try it. You’ll love it!

author: Terry Yee
review_text: This is no 4 star restaurant but I would give 4 star for their duck noodle soup! The broth is flavourful, the duck meat is just tender nice and adding on the fish sauce and chilli just make my first meal here after reaching so beautiful. ☺️

author: Andre Ouimet
review_text: Stopped in for a double rye during the week. A real comfortable place to stop. I tried them on Friday, but left after I was told that double was going to cost me 6 dollars more, coming in over 20 dollars.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Roger Alarcon
review_text: Great service by both the human and the robot lol.. food was great as well.

author: Yeoh Yuxian
review_text: Had dinner at PS Café East Coast Park; ordered the PS Burger and Crispy Chicken. Loved the setting by the sea and the relaxed vibe. The burger was juicy, the chicken had a nice crunch. Big shoutout to Eileen and Joel ! They were attentive, friendly, and made the meal even better.

author: Teoh Soo Chong
review_text: Truly enjoy these delicious Chipotle chicken sandwiches with crunchy nachos from SANDWISH Borelis, Batu Kawan, Penang 👍🙏😍😃 Thank you Teoh Soo Chong 22 Oct 2025

author: Marianne Brabant
review_text: Great breakfast family restaurant in HCMC. Simple menu, not many options but they have mastered their dishes. The deconstructed banh mi is a must. All the fillings you’d usually have served in a flavourful broth with a side of fresh bread. Very filling, generous portion and fair priced the service is extremely fast.

author: Glynis Brown
review_text: Love the excitement of Bangla specially the street food. Many thanks to Ceylon and staff. Done a wonderful job cooking our food

author: Olena Hozhulian
review_text: Amazing place for having a Korean bbq. The price is reasonable. Highly recommend to visit it with a big company of friends.

author: Rina Suryanah
review_text: Food is amazing… the ambience really nice.. warmfull staff.. 😘 got birthday suprise song from the staff haha didnt expect! Keep going ya …

restaurant: Cheng Mun Kee Pig's Organ Soup
author: Goh Kheng Leng
review_text: The soup base is nice except the lean meat a bit tough to chew. The braised pork is nice not too salty.

author: Matthew Gall
review_text: Went for The Ride for 2...very enjoyable experience for a first visit. 9 courses (which included dessert) of shared plates. Really enjoyed some unique flavor pairings. Our server and rest of staff were great too.

author: Rose
review_text: potato corner is for sure the best place to get fries. their sour cream flavor is simply addicting. i would come back to it over and over again if i could!

author: Nien Hwei
review_text: Had a lovely dining experience on a Sunday night. I ordered the Thai-style kerabu chicken chop and it did not disappoint — generous portion, packed with flavor, and definitely value for money. The staff were friendly and welcoming. Will definitely be back to try other dishes

author: Ames Gonzalez
review_text: I cannot even begin to tell you how amazing this place is. First off the food is awesome! Perfect food after a day on the beach or after fishing etc. exactly the vibe! And the drinks are SOLID too! I had called last minute for a party of around 25 people for Saturday during their busy lunch hour. It was supposed to be a small lunch for my 9 year old son’s birthday. We originally had a different restaurant in mind but found out later on that several family members wanted to join us and the party got too large for the previous location. He was going deep sea fishing nearby with his friends earlier in the day and we needed a chill beach vibe that could accommodate a large party, this was perfect. They were so accommodating for my entire party! And even when his fishing trip was cut short because of bad weather and many guests had become sea sick, I called frantic and worried they wouldn't be able to accommodate us earlier than scheduled and they were already set up and prepared and told us to come on by whenever we were ready! We all showed up at different times because some family were coming from far away. All of the staff we met were very attentive, kind, calm, and everything was so smooth and took away all of my stress (as a mom, when your sons birthday gets ruined by weather/sea sickness and the restaurant staff are so welcoming and reassuring it helps SO much!) we all had a great time! We were able to bring a cake for him and then the staff EVEN did their own special birthday surprise for him! It was just SO sweet and special! I am really truly thankful to Oceans 13 for how well they handled everything, all the food they had to prepare… so many people in the same party ordering at different times. And they even gave the adults an extra Birthday “happy hour” form the bar to lighten the mood! Everyone was so impressed with this place. Just the absolute best! I don’t live super close but I will ABSOLUTELY travel to come back here and support them! So so thankful! Thank you guys so much for everything! You single handedly SAVED my sons birthday!

author: Mel C
review_text: Default size of drink is Large. Staff will serve and charge you for a Large even though there's a Regular size available. They did not ask and take the opportunity to upsell. Both staff at the counter were so quick to respond(when questioned) as though it was already a planned tactic.

author: K
review_text: I discovered this spot by accident. I was in the elevator at my hotel and saw a couple holding takeout bags from the restaurant. The food smelled so good that I Googled the name on the bag right there. It ended up being just a block or two away, so I walked over. I’m so glad I did. The food was fresh, well-seasoned, and full of flavor. Hospitality was A1. There isn’t a lot of seating, but I was still able to sit and enjoy my meal. The playlist was on point too — good tunes, good vibes. It’s a small but cozy comfort spot with real Jamaican soul-food energy ( vegetarian options as well) I ordered jerk fried rice ( bussin!) with oxtail (so tender fell right off the bone) , shrimp, cabbage, sweet plantains, jerk mac and cheese, a beef patty, and a drink. My total was around $60, and it was worth it. The portions were big, and I even had leftovers the next day, which still tasted amazing. Definitely a spot I’d recommend — flavor and vibes A1. I usually dint write reviews but I had to give this place its flowers - I’ll def visit again !

author: Matthew Coronato
review_text: 10/10. Very accommodating with no rush. Came in from out of town with loads of bags and they had no issues. Quickly fed with very tasty food! All the meats were outstanding and tender.

author: 주영우
review_text: It was not very special, but it is delicious enought to try beef brisket noodle. They have quite much of quantity inside the bowl. It was good enough to win the hangover. Try the noodle with the fried bread. If I have chance to visit here again, I will do it. And I can introduce here to my friends too.

author: Jessica
review_text: Absolutely awful. Ordered the chicken cordon bleu, and it came out half raw. RAW CHICKEN. One side of it looked like they hadn't even tried to cook it (and the cheese was still solid), and it was drowning in sauce. Told a waiter that it was raw, and he gave us a weird look, looked confused, and said they'd make a "new one in 5-6 minutes". First of all, a brand new one of that thickness would take far longer than 5 minutes to cook, and second of all, they just reheated amd replated the same food (with the slice I cut off placed back on top). Even cooked properly, it wasn't good. The frozen chicken cordon bleu from Barber Foods is better. Whatever, we just wanted to hurry up and leave. They also served what looked like house-made potato chips as an appetizer, which might've been a unique feature if the chips hadn't been soggy. But things got worse when we got the bill. After being charged, we noticed that an extra $4 had been added, as well as a "suggested tip" of 20%, with another line for "additional tip". The total charged amount included the "suggested tip", making it a mandatory tip instead of a recommendation. This is for two people by the way, not a party of six. Called the manager over, he explained that the $4 was their credit card fee - this wasn't stated anywhere beforehand. Then, he tried to claim the suggested tip amount hadn't *really* been charged to the card yet: a flat out lie, considering we could see in the bank app that it HAD been charged. Next, he tried to claim that they charged the suggested tip but would refund the total afterward to be whatever we wrote on tip line... we pointed out that the receipt line said ADDITIONAL tip, not total tip. He stared blankly at the additional tip line and said "I've never seen that before". Brother, you're a manager and have no idea what your receipts look like?? Huh?? No, if we wrote something on the additional tip line, I am 100% certain that it would've been added on top of what we'd already paid. Then, he got frustrated with us and said "You know what, I'll just refund this and do it myself, I pay my employees". Uh, if you *actually* paid your employees, you would give them a liveable wage instead of relying on tips to do it for you. To be clear, we weren't arguing that the staff didn't deserve tips, but arguing that it's scammy and dishonest to charge a "suggested" tip and then ask for more on top of that, when the customer is going to assume that the bill didn't automatically include a tip (y'know, like how every other restaurant operates). Dishonest business practices abound. Wonder how many people they've scammed into double-tipping using this method.

author: Andrew Chan (www.roadtrippers.asia)
review_text: It is one of the top dimsum spots in Hatyai, but for us Malaysians, please do not compare Thai dimsum to Malaysian dimsum as well as their bak kut teh. Comparable to other dimsum spot in Hatyai, this one is pretty good, food is fresh, and choices are plenty. You can select what you want in the bak kut teh right on the spot too. Service is good and fast and prices are competitive all over town.

restaurant: 71 mookata - สาขาบรรทัดทอง
author: Rhonda S
review_text: 🔥 Mookata Heaven at 71 Mookata (Banthat Thong Branch)! 🔥 ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Hands down one of the best Mookata experiences in Bangkok! 🥩 Quality Ingredients: The meat was incredibly fresh, especially the marbled pork and chicken slices. The seafood platter was packed with scallops, prawns, squid, and more—all super fresh and clean. 🍲 Flavorful Broth & Grill: Their golden grill pan heats up quickly and evenly. The broth was rich and comforting, perfect for boiling veggies and noodles. Grilling meat on the dome gave it that authentic smokey-charred edge. 🥗 Sides & Highlights: We loved the generous veggie platter and their signature raw shrimp salad with spicy lime chili sauce—zesty, refreshing, and packed a punch! 🌶️🦐 🪑 Comfortable Setting: Spacious, clean interior with modern decor and good ventilation. Tables were arranged neatly and staff was attentive and polite. 💰 Value for Money: Portions were generous, and the quality surpassed the price. A great spot for group dinners or satisfying mookata cravings.

author: Retty Chheang
review_text: I had the all kinds of beef phô and it was great. The service is good and staffs are friendly and helpful. They don't speak English but speak enough just to take the order. I didn't realize their Michelin stars until I left.

author: J B MacDonald
review_text: The Chinese food part was fine, but the seafood and desserts weren’t eatable. A little Overpriced and they make you pay before so for the people that only have card, you can’t leave a tip for the server. Also I can find better food and prices at another buffet only 10 minutes from my house. This was almost an hour drive. Don’t come here, MID!

author: Brad Loncar
review_text: The service was super friendly, fast, and helpful. Really appreciate that. The tacos are very thin and look (at least mine) nothing like the photo. The potato olés have a good flavor.

author: Adam
review_text: Had the Fish Fillayyyy with cut-fries, very very tasty. The fish filet sandwich was great and also, that Walla Sauce I was dunking the cut-fries into was SUPER tasty. The staff service was excellent. Very attentive and friendly. Ended up ordering "The Breast" to go and had every intention of having it for dinner but... it's just too damn tasty. Eating it now. 5/5 stars. nom nom nom Keep up the good work, thank you for existing and also for being open on xmas eve. :)

author: TAO D
review_text: Driving through the bustling downtown LA area under the scorching sun, a craving for some fiery Mexican cuisine suddenly struck me. We stumbled upon a low-key local chain eatery that specializes in quick-serve Mexican cooking, offering everything from mouthwatering tacos to scrumptious mulitas, along with a salsa bar. I must say, this hidden gem exceeded my expectations. From the moment we entered, the register welcomed us warmly and displayed incredible patience as they guided us through the menu. As someone who isn't well-versed in Mexican cuisine, their thorough explanations and recommendations were greatly appreciated. Their willingness to ensure that every customer feels comfortable and informed added an extra touch of hospitality to our visit. The restaurant itself was immaculate, with a steady flow of customers and a glimpse of the kitchen where fresh food was being prepared behind the counter. We opted for the taco combo, which allowed us to savor three tantalizing tacos with different meat fillings alongside a serving of steamed rice and flavorful bean paste (with a splash of cheese on top). The presentation of the food was exceptional and convenient. I particularly enjoyed the individually packed condiments and the generous serving of onions and cilantro, allowing us to customize each bite to our liking on the go. Another aspect that truly stood out was the reasonable price of the meal. For this combo (please see the attached pictures), it cost us less than $10 in total. Overall, our experience here was short (less than 15 mins) but nothing short of delightful. The combination of friendly and patient staff, spotless surroundings, and delectable food made for an exceptional dining experience. Whether you're craving a quick bite or a full Mexican feast, this low-key local chain eatery is definitely worth a visit.

author: Carmine Santiago
review_text: The absolute best deal and quality in the Fast Food arena is this ($10 Burger Pack ) You Must try it nothing compares to this excerpt paying more than double at a sit down restaurant. You get a restaurant quality burger with everything on it too humongous homestyle Chicken strips that taste like my mother made, but couldn’t cook them as good as these a bunch of fries and a big cup of Good ranch! It doesn’t taste like anybody else’s it taste like a restaurant and for $10. It is amazing to go through a drive-through and get this. To get the best quality, eat it ASAP You know how those delivery apps take almost an hour and your food taste like an hour old but hands down best bang for your buck!

author: Toni García
review_text: First time here and it was so good! Don’t let the outside fool you! Service was great! The staff was super nice! Can’t wait to come back!

author: Sarah Soong
review_text: Nice setup, good place to try local food, though probably not the best in taste but good enough given its location and comfortable environment. Efficient and polite service.

author: Benjamin Chen
review_text: Tastes great — definitely one of the best breakfast bagel options in George Town. I really love their bagels! The restaurant was quite busy, so we waited a short while for seats, but it wasn’t too long. I did find a hair in one of the bagels, but the staff handled it well and remade it for us. I appreciate their good attitude, so it’s fine for me — I’d still be happy to come back next time I’m in Penang!

author: L Frederick
review_text: I ordered a medium jerk chicken. The portion of the rice and cabbage was suitable , however i was given 3 pieces of the chicken thigh back bone which is unacceptable. The taste of the food lack that Jamaican flavor. I called to give constructive criticism but they said they are to busy to speak with me why am leaving this feedback. Boston have a big Caribbean community step your game up only one! Don't be the only one!

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: ms __
review_text: Easily one of my favourite restaurants in Chiang Mai! The flavours of every dish were incredible, and the warm, friendly team made the experience even more special. I was pleasantly surprised with a birthday dessert at the end of the meal — such a thoughtful touch that made the evening unforgettable. Highly recommend making a reservation before visiting, as it’s a popular spot among the locals.

author: Todd Reed
review_text: Holiday party at Spanish Tavern was outstanding. Food excellent portions and everything was delicious from the appetizers to the main dishes and dessert. Sangria was big hit as well.

author: Hardy Wi
review_text: Excellent Indonesian seafood restaurant. Almost all dishes were done well. Not overly salty like most restaurants in Jakarta. Service was great too. 4* for atmosphere since the AC couldn't catch up with the heat - note that this is quite common in Jakarta. It's not too hot but cooling can be improved.

author: Marvin Sims
review_text: I absolutely love coming here. Their food is so good. They have a variety of stuff to choose from. The fries are so good.. crispy, soft, and well seasoned. They have a variety of milk shakes.. very berry, pineapple, strawberry, vanilla, and chocolate. The wait time was not long at all. U can either drive through or walk up to order. Staff is very friendly.

author: Rachel Green
review_text: A great place to try or go for Viennese food. We found this place hidden away and pleased we took the chance. Mai was a wonderful server from welcoming us and looking after us during our time. The food was beautiful, tasty and a good variety. I’d be happy to return here again.

author: Sandra
review_text: Affordable vegetarian food at staff canteen. The quality is good too! Ordered horfun and it was cooked freshly upon order. Wok hei is nice, totally enjoyed my meal before my flight!

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Khắc Tiệp Trương Công
review_text: Delicious food, enthusiastic and friendly staff, reasonable prices

author: Thomas Lo
review_text: The gulf prawns were delicious, perfectly cooked and seasoned. A gem of a restaurant in Queens.

author: Florian Kowarsch
review_text: Hidden gem with authentic Vietnamese food & cozy scenery. Helpful service. Just be prepared to receive all dishes at once & there is a lot to eat & choose from.

author: Just Me
review_text: Between the taste of the food, the hospitable service, the atmosphere. I was thrilled to have learn about this place for the first time! My husband being Venezuelan now I know he’s not alone. It’s not easy finding great Venezuelan places like these. The pork chops from the parrillada extravaganza were INCREDIBLE soooo tender. The tequenos were unbelievable with their dipping sauces! Please if you’re in town, or want to have a birthday party or you just want to go for drinks and appetizers come try this place! It’s incredible 🙌🏼❤️‍🔥❤️‍🔥

author: Hanson Tjung
review_text: One of my fav fine dining place. The ambience is very nice! Can enjoy the city from above. Great hospitality, all the staffs are helpful and informative. Two thumbs up for the food, esp the spaghetti and the steak. Love the cheese cake and chocolate for the dessert. From Wed to Sat, there is live dj performance at the bar. Party will be fun.

author: Courtney Abbott
review_text: Treated me like family and a dope chill spot. Always have cake and always a good time. You best get my bud mr jon a budlight, wings are fire, any special that have is delish ❤️ shane is also a charm.

author: Wiz Yeo
review_text: We finally got to try the famous Kok Sen Restaurant, a spot that's always packed and comes with a Michelin Bib Gourmand reputation. Overall, we had a very good and satisfying meal, with every dish being well-executed. It's definitely a top-tier zi char experience, though perhaps the Michelin hype set our expectations a little too high. We ordered a wide spread, including their famous signature dishes. The Big Prawns Hor Fun was a clear standout, with a generous, silky, and flavourful egg gravy that was full of wok hei. The prawns were large and fresh. The Claypot Yong Tau Foo was also excellent; the stuffed items (eggplant, tofu, peppers) were delicious, and the rich, savoury claypot sauce was perfect over rice. The other dishes were all classic and cooked to a high standard. The Crispy Roasted Chicken had paper-thin, crispy skin, and the Stir-fried Beef Hor Fun was loaded with tender beef. We also enjoyed the Prawn Rolls (Hei Zho) and a fluffy Fu Yong Omelette. The service was exactly what you'd expect from a place that is perpetually this busy. It was highly efficient and fast-paced. While you can't really call it "friendly" in a warm or chatty sense, they were absolutely not unfriendly. They were professional, attentive enough, and got the job done. Here's why it's a 4-star and not a 5-star for us: all the food was genuinely good and definitely above average, but we just couldn't pinpoint that special "Michelin" x-factor. It's fantastic, classic Cantonese zi char, but we weren't blown away in the way the reputation might suggest. That said, it's a solid, reliable, and delicious meal that I would still recommend.

author: SHERLY RAHAYU
review_text: Chinese dinning with chinese live music n crowd . Tasty food and good service

author: Broderick Tolbert
review_text: Maaaaaaaan!!!!! This place is amazing! The food is second to none but, the drinks are to GOOD-to-be-true! The owner puts his own swing on the cocktails. I recommend The Mule, Apple Sake(comes in a nice bottle) and the Berry Citrus Sangria. This place does not disappoint!

author: Syed Ahmad Alkaff (Armodeco)
review_text: As a person looking for halal, there are not much options. But the options you have are not bad. Can't go wrong with nasi lemak or nasi padang etc. Prices on average for a cheap meal is $4 which is the best part. All in all 7.5/10 !

author: Eric K
review_text: Decent size restaurant. Food (10/10) - Best pork chop broken rice tasted so far. Large piece of pork provided. Price (9/10) - Good value for the serving size provided. Service (9/10) - Staffs were friendly with very limited English. Ambience (7/10) - It was quite clean and spacious inside. Floor was slippery and not air conditioned. Will definitely be back again.

author: Игорь Мыза
review_text: The restaurant makes a great first impression with its cozy outdoor terrace, stylish seating, and warm lighting. The palm trees and sunset view add to the relaxed vibe. Hubble Bubble is a stylish spot for dinner or a night out with friends. Delicious food, great hookah, and a cozy atmosphere make it an excellent place to relax and enjoy your evening.

author: nadiah abmajit
review_text: The Palm Café & Bistro, Penang is a cozy, tropical-themed cafe in Tanjung Tokong. It’s known for its Bali-inspired decor, chill vibes, and lots of Instagram-worthy spots. The menu mixes local and Western dishes from nasi lemak to pancakes and pasta. People love the friendly staff, relaxing ambiance. A great place to unwind, take nice photos, and enjoy tasty food.

author: Gustavo Rodriguez
review_text: Decent enough place to eat at. Some homeless characters are around the way but not inside. Nice staff and affordable food.

author: Merryheart
review_text: Tucked away in two modest shop houses along the ever-buzzing Geylang stretch, JB Ah Meng doesn't look like much from the outside-but come evening, it's packed to the brim with hungry diners who know exactly what they're here for. This zi char joint has built a loyal following, thanks to its menu of over 30 classic Johor Bahru-style dishes. If you're familiar with Malaysian style zi char, you'll likely spot your favourites right away. And while some dishes hit the mark more than others, there are a few standouts worth mentioning. The famed JB San Lou Beehoon came out as expected-pressed flat and crisped up on both sides, delivering that signature wok hei. Though satisfying, it didn't quite match up to the authentic JB version. The sambal kang kong, however, was a solid hit-spicy, crunchy, and perfectly balanced. Prawn rolls were decent but unmemorable. A surprising highlight was the fried spicy lala, which packed a punch and had us reaching for more. In short, JB Ah Meng makes a strong case for those craving a zi char fix without making the trip across the Causeway. It's not quite a JB clone, but for a night out in Singapore with friends over comforting, wok-kissed dishes-it's a worthy contender.

author: Dr. Madeline Tejada
review_text: I'm so glad they opened this location in JP. It's very spacious and the decor is nice. I've been going to their location near dedham for a while now. I love their Arepas!!! I usually order the pabellon. They taste amazing and you can't beat the price!

author: A Eng
review_text: Our party of 16 arrived for a 10:30 dinner. We were seated quickly with tables prepared for our big party. The interior of the place was nice and renovated. It's probably the nicest diner I've been to. The staff was great and the food came out hot. I was impressed with the food and service. Parking was available too which helped with family who drove in from out of town. This diner wasn't my top choice for a late celebration, but I'm glad we gave this place a chance because we will be back for breakfast and future celebrations.

author: O K
review_text: Terrible customer service from the cashier taking the order on the headset last night, November 22. I could hardly order since the cashier was so in my mouth, cutting me off and not letting me finish my order. I had to repeat the order 5 times !! And he still got my order wrong !! He obviously doesn’t enjoy his job and should find a new one. I’ve never had an experience like that here. Very disappointing when people let their bad mood run their shifts. Please find a new night time cashier because he is not the one! That young man needs to be put on the food line or something because customer service is not for him !!

author: Jack Sanchez
review_text: Problems ordering cause the people here didnt speak English. You have to speak Spanish too eat here.

author: Franz Jeunesse
review_text: Cong Caphe in Hoi An is really a vibe! The atmosphere really lives up for Ancient Town type of chill. Minimal lighting inside the cafe. Less people compare to the other branch in Da Nang City. Most of the staff can speak english

author: Wee Loon Chia
review_text: Followed the Michelin guide to this restaurant for some “home cooked” Vietnamese food. It has three floors each tastefully decorated with excellent vibes. Service was attentive. Claypot snakehead fish was succulent, mango chicken feet salad was good as well but the chicken feet was a little rough to bite, little pancakes with shrimps were delicious. Spring rolls with beef were ok. The sauces that come with the dishes were excellent and elevated the taste. Overall I would recommend this restaurant.

author: Lim Jin Jhu
review_text: Had an amazing omakase experience here! Great fresh food and good service👍

author: Rina Mirez
review_text: I was craving something to eat after I finished studying at the library and found this place by happenstance. I walked in and the staff immediately acknowledged me and were incredibly friendly. I ordered a few slices to eat and it was honestly some of the best pizza by the slice I ever had!! It was so good!!! You could tell their ingredients were super high quality. Everything was so delicious I ordered a few more slices to-go for my roommate. The location being conveniently close to the trains, park, and library was an even greater plus. The staff was charming too! This will 100% be my new pizza spot whenever I'm in the Bryant Park/NY public library location. Such a surprisingly great experience.

author: Adekemi Alabi
review_text: Delicious and tasty food.Very classy and d owner’s customer service is outta dis world.All d way from Indianapolis she made me feel at home.

author: Jack Choo
review_text: Unassuming look from the outside and very local like. Many tourists visit this place as well as the food is fantastic at a decent price as well. Authentic Thai fair with them asking before hand foreigners the spice level….so beware! Come early of you want a spot.

author: Lydia Halliwell
review_text: Amazing tasty food! We came here as a recommendation from our hotel staff - it did not disappoint. We had the grilled pork vermicelli noodles and bone marrow broth and beef noodles. Both dishes were excellent, freshly made and full of flavour! Highly recommend visiting!

author: Angelica Peñas
review_text: Food was great! We ordered bun cha & the seafood pancake, which is a good breakfast if you want something that still feels fresh but heavy enough. Thank you to Rose who served us well & even shared some Vietnam knowledge with us. The egg coffee is a bit too salty for my taste, but still good.

author: Scott Richardson
review_text: Great sandwiches and wraps. Appetizer sampler was very mid. Want to watch football games on a Saturday because they have lots of screens and games on which is great, but no TVs were turned up and all you heard was worn out music. It was ok, but there are too many other places to spend our time than going back here.

author: Duj Štokić
review_text: Too expensive for the quality and the taste, for the starter we took spring rolls and they were OK, but for the main course we took their sausages and a vietnamese pancake with beef. Sausages were sweet ( not our thing) so we cant judge but the pancake was filled with like a kilo of cabbage and 3 small pieces of beef. Overall too expensive and we went home hungry.

author: Kevin Stevano
review_text: Amazing service and experience at Cafe Gigi Susu! The service truly deserves 5 stars, especially thanks to Valen, who served our drinks and food. Everything was delicious, well-presented, and exceeded our expectations. He was very informative, friendly, and attentive. He explained the menu clearly, gave great recommendations, and made us feel very welcome throughout our visit. His warm attitude really enhanced the overall experience. Highly recommended cafe with outstanding service. Definitely coming back again!

author: Jenelly Edith
review_text: This is my go-to for a healthy lunch! Absolutely amazing everytime! So healthy, delicious and amazing vibes! I always feel so good after eating since they use raw ingredients and no seed oils! They also have GF options! I recommend getting the salon, sweet potatoes, carrots and beet sauce. So delish! One of my favorite lunches in Miami!

author: Mrs Chew
review_text: I had the wanton noodle soup with roast pork. The noodle is nice and the soup is good. I personally recommend the deep fried crab meat roll, it very flavourful coupled with the Thai chilli sauce.

author: Suhaila Kasim
review_text: This restaurant is one of our favorite Japanese restaurants in penang . Our favorite is tongue stew ( is a must have ) . The sushi and sashimi are made from fresh ingredients.

author: Ren Moslares
review_text: Best place in Changi Airport Terminal 1! I am quite amazed by the interior of this place, it is very spacious and comfy! You can even play golf while killing time with cold drinks and the best choices of food. They have enough space for luggage, too!
