There is also a nearby toilet, you can always ask the friendly-homey team member to look after your stuff and run to the loo. Always a must-stop when I am flying at Terminal 1! Kudos to the team at Changi Airport Terminal 1.

author: Trevol Chapman
review_text: First time here and the food was amazing! Patrica was so nice and welcoming making my experience phenomenal. I ordered the 2–2-2 for breakfast and the scrambled eggs was amazing while my GF ordered the B.E.L.T looked amazing! Thank you Fiore Caffe Miami!

author: Zarii Parra
review_text: Amazing local place. Guinness on tap ! Service on point and the clam chower is really good. Real people work here so don't be surprise if they act like humans an not just like service robots

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: Loo Poh Keng
review_text: Alot of good hawker food.But q is long for the better ones and most good food finish selling by noon.

author: Hands Off
review_text: When I walked in, there was no visible menu, and the woman at the counter was on the phone talking extremely loud. I stood there confused until I grabbed a paper menu—only for her to tell me it was a catering menu and then direct me to the food area. She said it was “like Chipotle,” where you choose your items as you go, but the problem is you can’t even see the prices until you’re at the end of the line. I picked my rice, protein, and veggies. I asked for plantains first and then broccoli—all in one bowl. After the server put the broccoli on (only two small pieces, by the way), he told me afterward that it was extra. When I said something, he suggested taking it off — after it was already on my food. At that point, I was just over it and said, “No worries,” but he started acting annoyed, as if it was my fault. Then we moved on to the sauces — no utensils, no napkins, nothing offered. I just grabbed my food and left laughing in disbelief. I was honestly so upset. I paid $12 for parking just to eat here was $18, and after a long overnight shift, this was supposed to be my one good meal of the day. Instead, I left frustrated, hungry, and disappointed. The food wasn’t even good — mostly bones, barely any meat, and the rice had no flavor, just oxtail sauce poured over it. This didn’t feel like a real Jamaican restaurant at all it’s just for simps who leave the corporate world and Go down for lunch - you’re better off packing your own. Even the woman up front said, “It’s like Chipotle.” Honestly, that says it all because I thought I was at JRK! =/ P.S Sloppy work putting my food in the bag btw smh There was another woman who experiencing the same as me and we talked in the parking lot it’s ridiculous.

author: Balee Tong
review_text: Service is good for a typical dimsum place. Bright and enthusiastic. But so so if the price is considered. The venue can get a bit warm during busy times. Xiao long Pau had thick skin and bland soup. Siumai & hakau was good but not worth the price. Lomaikai, lopakkau & wu kok was good. Ribs was good but more bones than meat. Overall the food was so so, and overrated considering the price. For the same price bracket I prefer dimsum station (not in ipoh).

author: Antonionia “Marie”
review_text: $4 champagne $6 bellinis cant beat that. Nice big breakfast portions cant beat the price for the amount of food. Nice ambiance. Super soft baguettes. Tasty french toast. I enjoyed my meal. The food compared to the price, location and ambiance is unbeatable.

restaurant: Serafina Downtown Miami | Italian Restaurant & Wine Bar
author: neshat shahabi
review_text: Absolutely the best. My boyfriend and I loved it so much we went there twice during our three day vacation. Cute and bougie, close to everything. The space has a lush green vibe and the food was incredible. We left smiling and our hearts are still with them.

author: Casey Chong
review_text: Nice atmosphere, food you can get anywhere nothing special but the service level is for local Vietnamese. Plenty empty free table and yet asked us to squeeze with other 2 seater tables

restaurant: Mộc Viên - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Darren Meredith
review_text: It’s a really quiet hidden gem … staff are really friendly and attentive prices are good and location is quiet although a little messy. Can get away from the beeping and enjoy beer with your food. Living in Thailand I do miss a good baguette and they didn’t disappoint.

author: Jordan Liu
review_text: 1. Chicken Tikka Masala - Good, interesting flavour 2. Chicken Lollypop - Very interesting flavour -> Leans more towards sour then spicy with a nice lingering aftertaste 3. Jalapeno Cheddar Corn Fritter - Best dish amongst the order!!! Love it! 4. The Satay Club (3 chicken, 3 beef) - Chicken was super tender! Beef was chewy, grilled just nice! Sauce was great and compatible with the satay! Will recommend to go and will want to go again just for the Jalapeno Cheddar Corn Fritters! Hidden at the end of East Coast Park!

author: Melissa Cortez
review_text: So let me put all yall mamasitas and mamsitos on game tho! This right herrrrrrrr this righhttt herrrr is the prize have you not tasted this delightfulness chicken yet get the chicken with the fries extra juice extra tortillas and dip my boy 😋 workers there are amazing and work hard for this delishness get you a plate ASAP rocky let me know the deal 🥰

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: N S
review_text: I'm a tourist, but after visiting AEON, I wanted to eat Bun Thit Nung, so I went there, knowing it wasn't a tourist spot. I ordered using the menu, got in line, and got my takeout right away. It's cheap, fast, delicious, and has a local food vibe, so I recommend it. It was a bit of a challenge walking from AEON, with some difficult crosswalks, but if you try, you can get there.

author: lillian meza
review_text: This is my favorite chicken burger place, always look for original flavors and this place has it, especially the sauce and the crispy chicken, like to order the deluxe with cheese combo, the staff has always been friendly, the service is usually very fast and coordinated it seems like, the only thing I would suggest is if they could also open on Sundays as I often forget and have had to go to other places when I have a sunday crave, overall great place.

author: Ed Seet
review_text: Local meals with broken rice. The food and service is good. Go early or there'll be a long queue. Grilled chicken Thigh and Pork Chop were very nice. Tried the pumpkin flower with garlic... Not my kind of vegetable dish though... Broken rice, a must try.

author: Sabrina A.
review_text: VISITED DRIVE THRU AROUND 1230PM. NO ONE IN DRIVE THRU. WAS ASKED TO PULL AROUND FRONT TO WAIT. ORDERED CHICKEN SUPREME MUNCHIE MEAL. PRESENTATION OF SANDWHICH WAS BEAUTIFUL BUT MY BREAD WAS HARD AND FRIES WERE NOT HOT. HAVING TO PARK, I WOULD EXPECT HOT AND FRESH. THE ICE WAS MELTED IN MY FRESH BREWED ICE TEA WHEN I RECEIVED. GOOD NEWs, I RECEIVED MY JIBBI!❤️

author: Nguyen Tuyet Trinh
review_text: Excelent services, delicous foods and spacious room. I will comeback more often. 💕

author: reshy daswani
review_text: January 31 around 7:30-8:30pm - Bad star for the woman with curly hair here. I ordered my childhood favorite bbq giga fries. The fries barely had seasoning so I asked her to give me a bit of bbq powder and she rudely said that it costs 50 cents. At that point, I did not have my card with me because my friend was sitting far away watching my stuff and it was very cold but she did not cared when I told her that. The Asian woman with fair skin ended up helping and she was friendly. She was pleasant and offered a good service.

author: T4ko
review_text: The food wasn't served in order. Two other tables that arrived 15 minutes later than us had their food served faster than us. They hadn't made reservations; it was obvious they had just arrived and then went to order.

author: Jose Hernandez
review_text: Basically, like a lot of other fast food type restaurants like this one lately, the quality of the food just wasn't there. Got the trio, which looked a lot smasher than i remember. The Cuban sandwich was excellent though.

author: M Sabr
review_text: Amazing local flavors at Remboelan! The food is authentic and delightfully spicy—absolutely worth it. Huge shoutout to the staff for their hospitality; we did a walk-in at 9:15 PM (close to their 10 PM closing time) and they treated us perfectly. Great food, great vibes, and even better service. 10/10!

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: WM
review_text: I was seated immediately during lunch time, and ordered a THB120 dry noodle (all ingredients combo). Every item was well seasoned - from the braised mushrooms, to the fragrant Chinese sausage, to the flavourful chicken, and tasty wantons. Noodles were springy. Servings are small so men might want to add noodles for THB30.

author: Lay Ying Yeoh
review_text: Ordered their kerabu chicken chop and otak otak spaghetti, both taste good and delicious. Like otak otak spaghetti very much, it tastes unique and yummy. The food was in big portion and price is reasonable. We order root beer float as our beverage, it taste okay. Service was fast and friendly. Easy to find parking around this area. Highly Recommended to try a new style western food.

author: danny velez
review_text: Of all the things to say about this place, I'll start by saying that the food is great, the atmosphere is great, and the portion sizes are great. This place is all about getting that perfect picture for Instagram but without compromising on taste. All their drinks come in special glass. The food is delicious. The wait times aren't too bad, though sometimes it appears like they're completely packed (cause that parking situation is bad). Speaking of parking, they have valet as well. Pass by and enjoy great food with a great staff at great prices, especially if you've never had typical Venezuelan food.

author: Pui Ka Chan
review_text: We came here for my birthday celebration. The restaurant was decorated in style with a joyful and cozy ambience. All staff were friendly and welcoming with big smiles on their faces. We ordered the Yellow Fin Tuna and Salmon Roe Tartelette, Mixto Ceviche, Woodfire Chicken, Char-grilled Octopus and Potato Mille Feuille. Everything was delicious. We especially loved the chicken which was tender, juicy and well seasoned. The portion of the dishes were pretty generous. We were both very full and decided not to order any desserts. However, knowing that it was my birthday, the Santenera Team insisted to celebrate with me. It was really heartwarming. Thank you very much for your hospitality and all the tasty dishes! Will definitely come back if we visit Canggu again.

author: Fotoxer WU
review_text: Here’s a lot of Chinese people here eating the Indian food here I guess because of the long pancake there. Well, you can take a special photo here with the long pancake , and your owner is very ambitious and very kind to show you how to eat. They taste like normal Indian food I like it but the rice could be much better

author: Renee Richter
review_text: Interesting coffee shop. The drinks are unusual, most are mixed with tea. We enjoyed it.

author: M
review_text: Food was good. Had the beansprouts, tofu, fishball soup, rice. All around good food. Atmosphere is great as well - felt grounded and authentic. Service is good - fast and efficient. Really enjoyed the meal here before a stroll at the nearby nightmarket

author: Blake Aiton
review_text: Came from Maine for a conference and wanted some sushi. Googled near me and found this restaurant. Great little joint. Immediately greeted with a friendly hello, and service was great. Had a dynamite roll, salmon and tuna nigiri and sushi. The place was clean and welcoming, and the sushi was awesome.

author: M *
review_text: This hawker center is conveniently located on top of the MRT, offering a variety of delicious food options. The famous chicken rice is highly recommended, but it’s worth noting that other chicken rice dishes are equally tasty. There are also many refreshing drinks, such as sugarcane with lemon. One recent addition to the menu is chilli ban mian stall, which is a delightful dish featuring eggs, anchovies, fish balls, and prawn paste balls. While it may not be overly spicy, it’s well-made and worth trying. There are similar stall that also sell equally nice noodle and some dumpling. Overall, this hawker center is a great place to explore local cuisine, with a wide range of dishes from Western to Eastern influences. It’s definitely worth visiting a few times to sample some of the delicious food. Non aircon and can be warm during day time. Need to chop the table for sure as many tourist and local will visit.

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Harwati Hashim
review_text: The food is delicious and reasonably priced. However, the service could be improved. When we visited, it wasn’t crowded, but we still weren’t served efficiently. I asked for a menu from one of the staff, but she never returned. Fortunately, a male staff member later attended to us and fulfilled our request. With better service, the dining experience here would be much more enjoyable.

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: Dhara H
review_text: Ordered 5 dishes and all 5 taste fantastic! Didn't take a photo of the prawn spring roll, but it's absolutely scrumptious that we'll come back just for this! The white rice and Riceberry combo is highly recommended, brings a different layer of joy to accompany the curry or the beef menu we ordered. Special mention to the young coconut drink that comes pre-peeled off its husks, not just novelty but great way to enjoy your beverage and the coconut flesh (I'm a self proclaimed coconut connoisseur!). Cannot wait to return to this restaurant and try other items in their menu. PS. Must book in advance or you won't get a seat.

author: Shawn “SinCity” Burke
review_text: Great crew, excellent service and always friendly! The burgers and fries are just what you’d expect from In N Out.

author: Miguel Sanchez (Mich)
review_text: Élephante in Santa Monica is an absolute gem! Perched on the rooftop with breathtaking ocean views, this Italian restaurant is the perfect spot to watch the sunset. As the sky transforms into hues of orange and pink, the atmosphere becomes truly magical. Élephante's rooftop setting offers an unobstructed view of the Pacific Ocean, making it an ideal spot to witness the sunset. From wood-fired pizzas to handmade pastas, the menu features a range of traditional Italian dishes crafted with fresh, locally sourced ingredients. The staff at Élephante are knowledgeable and attentive, ensuring a seamless dining experience. The combination of chic decor, lush greenery, and stunning views creates a lively yet intimate ambiance, perfect for special occasions or casual gatherings. Reservations are highly recommended, especially if you want to secure a table with sunset views. The restaurant's rooftop setting is particularly stunning during sunset, making it a perfect spot for romantic dinners or special occasions. Overall, Élephante is a must-visit destination in Santa Monica, offering an unforgettable dining experience with its stunning sunset views, delicious Italian cuisine, and vibrant atmosphere

author: SUNSHYNE315
review_text: First time here and I was so impressed...The food was excellent. My server Dayanara was amazing. Very friendly and accommodating. Thank you!

author: C
review_text: After shopping we worked up an appetite and stopped in to sample the jerk and curried chicken offerings. It's like the other Jamaican spots. Food displayed cafeteria style. The servers were more than generous with the portions. My shopping buddy likes the fluffy rice and beans. The curried chicken had good heat to it. The jerk chicken succulent and flavorful. I will try lunch next time.

author: Dalit Rosenfeld
review_text: Taverna Opa in Hollywood is always such a FUN experience! The atmosphere is always alive especially if you come for dinner. Belly dancers, music, and napkins flying in the air! The food is delicious and very authentic Greek cuisine. The service is always good. I have been here many times with friends and for special occasions and it never disappoints. Perfect spot for great food, entertainment, and unforgettable memories right by the Hollywood boardwalk. Totally recommended!

author: Sang Chau
review_text: Nice place with local food for a gathering or birthday party. The food is fresh and the taste is really good and really Vietnamese. It is really crowded during weekends, the staff in the parking lot is really supportive to help guests to park their car/bike but since in weekend, it's really crowded so take time to park so prepare extra time for this.

author: Ellen Levitt
review_text: I have gone here occasionally over the past several years and the food is always wonderful. I went today for lunch because it's Sigd and I wanted vegan food. The kale was amazing. The others really tasty too.

author: WOOCHEOL LEE
review_text: They say it's local, but we visited with our coworkers who were on a business trip. The food was clean and we had a great time.

author: Mercedes Reid
review_text: So... I ordered a cake for a birthday dinner. I was rushed off of the phone by the person taking my order. I guess the store was busy??? Anyway, I asked for fresh fruit on my cake to which she told me it would be an extra charge, I said that it'd be fine and asked for strawberries. The cake had NO STRAWBERRIES AT ALL. So why did she charge me extra? Also, the cake was kind of dry. I felt so bad because it was a special birthday and the cake was the worst part of the experience. I normally order from here every year and this is my first complaint. I'm so disappointed. 😔

author: Will Sama
review_text: This is the grossest food I have ever had. Cluck sandwich they can't make it without it being dark brown from overused grease. They have homeless people sleep in the lobby. It's plexy glassed in like you are visiting a jail. Very grimy the staff are lazy and very much suck at running a kitchen.

author: Leah Johnston
review_text: Lots of greenery & vintage decor. They have a ground floor, rooftop, and inside working area. I had the peanut butter coffee and croissant. The peanut butter coffee was divine, and the croissant was so flaky and airy. Staff are super kind and welcoming. Thanks so much!

author: meffieyv
review_text: I recently visited Gigi Susu Bali and had an absolutely wonderful experience! From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was welcoming and the service was top-notch. A huge shout-out to the crew member, kak Eric, who was incredibly helpful throughout my visit. He was attentive, always ready to assist, and really made the experience stand out. Thank you, kak Eric! 🙏 I ordered the Big Breakfast and the Frittata, both of which were delicious and perfectly prepared. For drinks, the Iced Palm Sugar Latte was wonderfully balanced, and the Nelayan Energy (a fresh mix of carrot, pineapple, and orange) was soooo refreshing. Everything tasted amazing. This place is a must-visit for anyone looking for delicious food, great ambiance, and outstanding service. Highly, highly recommend!

author: Noesha
review_text: Would give this place zero stars if I could my first impression was a huge cockroach when I was going into the restroom. Rude waitresses and the “owner” scolded me and my fiancé when I told him I did not enjoy the food. Update: This was my second time of me giving the restaurant another try and still horrible quality food and horrible customer service. At least have some new cutlery that hadn’t been used the whole “40 years” you’ve been in business.

author: Rai Akash Santosh
review_text: No wonder this is such a highly sought destination for tourists. Perched on the cliffside, this stunning restaurant offers breathtaking panoramic views that create the perfect romantic setting for couples, families and friends. The spacious outdoor seating allows you to enjoy the spectacular sunset while indulging in delicious seafood dishes. The friendly and attentive staff make the experience even more memorable, ensuring every detail is taken care of. Whether you're here for the view, the atmosphere, or the fresh seafood, Malini Uluwatu is an absolute must-visit for a truly unforgettable dining experience in Bali.

author: Anja A.
review_text: I did enjoy the food at Hellbender, but the service could have been better. We were among the first guests seated, yet it still took about 5–8 minutes for our server to notice us and bring water. The portion size of aguachile is quite small, considering the price. The Brussels sprouts lacked flavor. On the positive side, the empanada was amazing, as were the mushroom tacos and fried cheese.

author: Calvin
review_text: I came here about 10 years ago several times. And it is still here. The dishes are still delicious and in good portions. Wish you the best and stay another 10 years.

author: Gabriela Caballero
review_text: The menu does not have western friendly food. Service is great!

author: Chick Doctor
review_text: Awesome place! Very generous portions, delicious (healthy) food, and nice vibes! Must come ❤️ New fav in this area!

author: Queen Nok
review_text: Toasted Italian sandwich. Toasted on the outside which made it very hard/crispy. Like trying to eat a sandwich made of croutons. Ordered whole, could only eat 1/2 because of it being overly salty. If you want your entire week's worth of sodium allowance in one sandwich, then this is the one to eat. I love Panera Bread and am a frequent customer, but this sandwich should be taken off the menu. This sandwich left me with such a bad taste/experience, that I'll probably not have another craving for an Italian sub until next year.

author: Katherine Melo
review_text: Amazing experience at Maracaibo! The food was absolutely delicious, full of flavor and beautifully prepared. The service was outstanding, especially Frandery )Frank), who was incredibly attentive and kind. Even though we arrived close to closing time, we were made to feel truly welcome. Exceptional food and service. Highly recommended!

author: Sapphira Bella
review_text: We came here for a friend’s birthday dinner a few weeks ago and got the downstairs seating section. The place was jam packed and very busy. It’s BYOB so we brought our own wine, tequila, etc. The vibe was cute and homey. We had the appetizers to start with of za’atar, labneh, hummus, etc. The bread was not great quality and the dips were OK. We tried the vegetable platter, a lamb kebab and a chicken kebab. Everything came with pilaf and salad. Overall the food was very OK. It was decent, lacked seasoning and some of it was not cooked well. The service was very good and they accommodated our large party but the food was underwhelming.

author: Skye
review_text: Had from 1 western food stall chicken chop at $7 and 1 fried hokkien prawn noodles at $5 by myself. Gravy of the chicken chop so diluted and tasteless and small in size but the chicken quite tender. Comes with some unsalted fries that I didn't like it and a slice of japanese cucumber that I like. The fried hokkien prawn noodles pretty wet and taste like corn flour. Not impressed at all. Won't order from these 2 stalls again. I remember many years back bedok interchange that hawker center have nice food but totally disappointed. If happened to be at bedok interchange this hawker center, will try other stalls food.

author: Kate
review_text: We had a group experience in a private dining room for events. The appetizers with champagne were delightful before dinner. The service was impeccable and timely. The Caesar salad fresh, the filet mignon and whipped potatoes, creme brulee and cappuccino paired with their chocolate truffles were all outstanding. I will be back, even if only for the service. Aside, if you're a water snob, you won't be disappointed here.

author: D J
review_text: Unfortunately I went to Panera which I normally enjoy. Not this time. I went through the drive through to get a drink and a cup of soup. How difficult should this be? It took 15 minutes. I ordered, paid and waited. Nobody updated me and the cars behind me piled up and started beeping at me. I couldn't move because I didn't get my food. It took forever, I had to ask for a spoon and napkin when I did get the order. The girl at the window was somewhat rude. I won't be coming back to this Panera. Hopefully the manager reads these reviews and gets the crews act together. I enjoy the food but don't want to deal with the poor service and lack of attention.

author: Emiliano Lucer0
review_text: Food was overall decent, but workers look very stressed service was decent not what you would look for though, big disappointment they had no forks or spoons but yet handed out foods that require utensils to eat with. They didn’t say a word about not having utensils until we asked for them, PLUS place is full of mosquitos.

author: Amit Singh
review_text: Had a really great time here. Came to celebrate birthday and we enjoyed every bit of it. The staff here are very helpful and friendly as well. Especially staff name Seth , Tina & Lisa served us very good. Will definitely come again next time !

author: Catalina Altomonte
review_text: Such a delicious Vietnamese pancake! Also had the yummiest goi cuon here. Broken rice was also a winner and loved how tasty the pork was. Everything felt really light and fresh, and especially loved all the dipping sauce. Came a peak lunch hour and the waiting time moved much faster than expected.

author: Maria E
review_text: This was my childhood spot and would still come regularly even though I do not live in the area anymore. The food now is terrible I don't know what administrative/staff changes they have made over the years but it's all gone downhill. I'm done with this place.

author: Paul Duncan
review_text: Amazing GF Deep Dish! Using this app to locate a gluten free pizza option in Las Vegas was daunting with so many choices, however, due to the many positive reviews we decided to try Evel Pie. The business was busy, a great sign of good food. Ordering is done at the counter and if you are eating in, they give you a number for your table. The gluten free is a little bit of a wait, but, 100% worth it. I had the ‘Olivia Gluten Free John” with mushrooms, olives and pepperoni. My wife had the same crust with the Maui Wowie version. Be aware it is a little spicy, but great flavor. After a 50 minute wait, we had our delicious dinner delivered to the table. Great flavor from the pizza, and an amazing gluten free treat. I have never had a deep-dish pizza in a gluten free version. Ordering tip, grab a menu while you are waiting to be helped, then have your decision before to arrive at the cashier, and be prepared for taking some home as the deep dish is a lot of great food (that warms up very well). Love it, would absolutely recommend.

author: barby terzian
review_text: Food was great! Sara was nice and very professional. She suggested good plates!

author: Carolina Sanchez
review_text: My waiter Héctor was very friendly and so was Luis ..and the food really good, good portion and the coffee delicious I totally recommend it !

author: Kathleen Foxx
review_text: WOW. We were impressed the moment we walked in. Our server was wonderful, staff was super attentive, food was magnificent. Couldn’t have picked a better place for a surf n turf birthday dinner! Menu is a La carte, so you order your main entree and sides separately. We ordered half portions of the sides and it was still too much food! Absolutely wonderful.

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: Djoko Purwanto
review_text: Yummies ... with a few HALAL stalls 01.01 al-syafiq 01.02 yusoff mee

author: Jonathan Foo
review_text: Upside : Reasonable pricing for Rm29.90 (not including tax) Buffett style has reasonable choices of food spoiled for choices. Fresh prawn, clams and even crab was observe. Unlimited flow of coke, Thai Milk tea and even lemongrass for you to pick. Downside : Limited parking space , the environment is too humid especially if you come on midday! All so so hot like oven despite the fan used! Not your romantic place ya guys.

author: A Jewell
review_text: Traveled for a weekend trip to Miami with a friend and stopped in for brunch on a Sunday morning. Staff super friendly, service great. Tiramisu french toast was amazing! Applewood bacon also incredible. Coffee surved with warmed froth for a gourmet touch. Parking ticket for the garage next door was punched as an unexpected but very appreciated surprise. We definitely recommend. Definitely will include on the itinerary for the next trip to Miami!

author: Jeniffer Reyes
review_text: Matias was a great server but food was mediocre at best.. they offer free desert for the review… I guess now you know why they’re so highly rated! Come here for drinks skip the rest.

author: Mareesa Ahmad
review_text: Holy cow this place was insane. THE BREAD AND BUTTER ARE YOU KIDDING. I dream of it. The steak was divine and we did the side flight which was much larger than we expected, but all was delicious. Honestly thought the prices were high at first but they give large portions so it’s all worth it!

author: Feri S
review_text: This was my second visit, driven by curiosity to try the crispy fried duck and the squid ink fried rice—and wow, they were absolutely delicious. The duck was tender and tasty, but the real highlight was the squid ink fried rice, easily one of the best I’ve ever had. Both dishes are a must-try if you come here.

author: Hardiwanto Yongkong
review_text: Fine dining with Indonesian flavor taste. Food 4/5 Fresh seafood and high quality ingredients from veg to meat. Using a lot of indonesian spice combination. Pricey but you can get high quality dishes in here. Recommend menu : Ayam Goreng Serundeng and Sapo Tahu. Ambience 5/5 Good ambience, a lot of seats for groups. They even have vip room for your special events. Service 5/5 Excellent table service, waitress can explain their menu even when their dishes will be served.

author: JacobBiscuitsAreBest
review_text: It was out first time trying out at this place and it apparently had good some good pasta. We were awfully eager to try out their pasta and was greeted by an adorable cat streching outside the dior. The interior design is cosy and rather spacious with air-conditioning, making it a comfortable place for dining. The food came quite fast and the Crab Meat Aglio Olio. The plate was filled with many little pieces of roe and it was overflowing with crab meat. The flavoring was spot on, not too creamy, just a light and fun flavour. I was a little disappointed at the fact that the crab meat was frozen crab meat, not the fresh one , so it kind of made the whole dish feel cheap. The truffle mushroom gnocchi however, was a different story. Everybite was glorious, the rich and thick truffle cream coating everybite of the gnocchi, simply perfection. Since parmesan cheese was mixed into the sayce, there was a lot of strechy heavenly chessy goodness. This is highly recommended. Overall a pretty good experience. Would definitely come back to try the lunch set and the pizzas.

author: Cher Ong
review_text: I've always loved their food, but this is the 1st time trying their dim sum. Quite a lot of choices & they only steam it when u order. So u have to be patient while waiting. It takes quite some time for your food to be served. Their price range is very reasonable & the best part is they have 30% discount on your total bill before 11 am. That makes it really cheap. Quality & tastes are quite good. The atmosphere is beautiful & comfortable. A relaxing breakfast spot.

author: Lidia Barboza
review_text: It’s so sad to see how this place has gone downhill. It’s like the owner does not even care anymore. I remember when I used to live in Vegas back in 2008 this place was awesome. The prices, food portions, and food quality was fantastic. Now, the food was expensive for 3 small tacos some beans and rice for $15.99, it’s a bit much. But I figured it was fine if the food would be good. Nope! Tacos were cold and unseasoned. The rice was cold and hard. The only thing that was decent were the beans but they were also cold. The agua the horchata had the water but only a little bit of the horchata. Overall, it makes me sad, not mad. Just sad that they’ve allowed this place to go downhill. News flash to the owner, your place isn’t dead “just because” it’s dead because you no longer have pride in what you do and what you serve. If you don’t want to even care for this business, then just shut the place down and be done with it.

author: Zoey Gocking
review_text: Chili’s on Cooper Ave is always a great experience! The food is consistently fresh, hot, and full of flavor — especially the fajitas and burgers. The staff is friendly, attentive, and makes you feel welcome from the moment you walk in. Service is quick without feeling rushed, and the restaurant is always clean and comfortable. Whether you’re stopping by for lunch, dinner, or just drinks, this location never disappoints. Definitely one of the best Chili’s spots around!

author: Bamin Razali
review_text: Came in the evening. Unfortunately, food was cold. Wud taste better if theyre hot or at least warm. The fried bitter gourd and fried onions were marvelous, tho ! Teh Ais was fine, not bad. Comfortable joint with AC.

author: Anna Burgess
review_text: What a fantastic night at Medallion Steak House & Seafood. The food was beyond incredible — honestly, out of this world. But the standout for us was our waiter, Carlos. He was thoughtful, kind, and so considerate, and he truly went above and beyond to make sure we had a great experience. Carlos is the reason this felt like more than just dinner. Highly recommend.

author: Enrique Wee
review_text: I only come here for their tandoori chicken and garlic nan of which I love. Prices are very reasonable. Clean and attentive waiters.

author: Poppy Anna
review_text: La Favela is definitely a place to visit when in Seminyak! It’s a restaurant that turns into a club later in the night! The cocktails and the food were superb! I had the Rosalina cocktail (defo recommend) and for food we had the chicken tenders (crispy & moist), the patatas bravas (nice & fluffy) and the chicken pasta from the specials menu (creamy and flavoursome)! Also to mention our waiter Eka was so friendly and super attentive, he took time to chat with us and never hesitated to ask if we needed anything! I would definitely recommend coming here if you want a great night!!

author: Lashandra Dorado
review_text: Beautiful dinner at Taverna Opa I had such a wonderful evening at Taverna Opa in Hollywood. The food was absolutely delicious — fresh, perfectly seasoned, and full of authentic Mediterranean flavor. The grilled octopus was tender and flavorful, the tzatziki bright and refreshing, and the lamb was cooked to perfection and the atmosphere was relaxed and inviting, with that subtle coastal charm that makes you want to stay a little longer. The staff was attentive, friendly, and made sure everything was just right. Even without loud music or dancing, it still felt warm and full of life — just the right balance between lively and peaceful.It’s one of those places where the flavors, service, and setting come together beautifully. I’d definitely come back again — next time maybe on a weekend to experience the more festive side too.

author: Jessica Tirza
review_text: My partner and I were very well taken care of at Seribu Rasa. The team was wonderful and made us feel truly welcomed especially Kak Dea who gave us a very good impression. Many Thanks and will definitely come back!

restaurant: Kieu Bao Rice Noddles with Grilled Meat
author: Minh Anh Phạm
review_text: The food is incredibly delicious, and the prices are cheaper than many other places I've eaten at. Highly recommend! 👍👍👍

author: Amber Zhang
review_text: Absolutely phenomenal seafood! It’s located in a busy food hall and the lines get crazy (expect a 1-hour wait on weekends), but the flavors are unbeatable. This has become my go-to spot whenever I visit LA. Everything is so fresh and perfectly prepared. If you have the time, you HAVE to eat here!

author: Jinxiang Shi
review_text: A restaurant in Las Vegas with a lot of flavor. I've been to Thailand and the food here is very authentic, so the fact that so many people have given it good reviews is well deserved encouragement! I will definitely come back next time I'm in Las Vegas!

author: Jared Weggeland
review_text: My wife and I were staying for just one night before an activity tomorrow nearby. We enjoyed some time on the beach, then looked for somewhere to have a tasty dinner. As we were walking along the boardwalk I smelled the burgers cooking and had to try. The atmosphere was upbeat and exciting. The staff were friendly. Our server forgot something and remedied it immediately. He was very attentive and our drinks never saw an empty bottom. The onion rings appetizers was very fresh, crispy and came with a zesty chipotle dipping sauce. I had the jalapeño Swiss burger and added bacon. It came with all the fixings and the fries were uber crispy. There was plenty of sauce to go around. I am glad we stopped by. This was a good choice. Thanks for the good food and service. I would recommend the place.

author: Lauren Yoon
review_text: The food comes out quickly. I think my health will get better after eating hot “bak kut teh”. My mom said it was her first time eating bakute and it was so delicious. It was a very good meal for the price because many dim sum came out at a low price👍🏼👍🏼

author: deRykcihC
review_text: The mixed curry and fried chicken is probably the star of this nasi kandar restaurant. Especially the chicken, spices are just enough to make it crispy and juicy.

author: Diana Arday
review_text: The pizza here was 10/10. Really nice and freshly made. Only issue was they had 1 working restroom so the queue was long but other than that, a really nice place to eat and catch up with friends.

author: Hello Indo
review_text: i have no comment with the food and environment but the service is among the worse I've encountered when taking order keep insisting on giving me food that i dont want and when i want the chicken breast part,keep insisting on the part with wing,bro just take my order la.honestly disappointed 2 times the charm third NEVER!

author: jen k
review_text: This was my first Ethiopian cuisine experience and I loved that they don't give you utensils for the full effect! The food isnt really a looker if you're not into pureed food, but the taste was delightful! Highly recommend and for any vegans or vegetarians craving some hearty food. I have gone 2 times now and they are just as good! The interaction (bread) they have is tangy and slightly sour.

author: Ryan Ochsner
review_text: The pho here is phenomenal — easily some of the best in SF. Which is exactly why this review is so frustrating. The operations are a mess. Their Google hours are wrong, their own website hours are wrong, and delivery apps constantly show them as “open” when they’re fully closed. I’ve now had multiple orders accepted, waited 45–60 minutes, and then had them canceled because… surprise! They weren’t actually open. At that point, every other restaurant is closed too. It’s maddening. I’ve also gotten calls about out-of-stock items where the person on the phone didn’t speak English, so we literally couldn’t communicate. Not judging anyone for language, but when your hours are already unreliable, that extra layer of chaos does not help. This place has incredible food, but the basic operations are so unreliable it’s almost impossible to be a returning customer. People want to give you money — you’re making it needlessly hard. Please fix your hours and your order process. You’re going to lose loyal customers over issues that are 100% preventable.

author: Lydia Chin
review_text: Amazingly delicious authentic Thai cuisine. Need to make reservations in advanced as they only have 7 tables. We walked-in and were lucky to get a table. Ordered 4 dishes + 1 soup and came to about 1100Baht. Wanted Omelette Crab but out of stock. So we ordered Stinky Beans + Prawns, Fried pork with brown sauce, Young Coconut shoots + prawns, Glass Noodles with eggs and prawns, and Signature White Tom Yum Seafood. Everything was so good. Highly recommended. Will definitely come back again.

author: Sun Lee
review_text: This place I got recommended by my co-worker and my friend celebrate with me for my birthday. Good atmosphere as soon as I walked in. Surprisingly during the lunch there are two other tables having a birthday lunch too. The food are so comforting and the waitress are so nice, we’re having difficulty ordering and she’s nice enough to let us have the sampling the sauce so we know what to get. They got a good selection of beers. There’s a shop next to them and sell sausage, beer, snacks. Will come back another day

author: Kezia
review_text: I've actually been to this cafe for years and i have to say, the quality of the food remained the same! Had the brunch menu with their smoked salmon egg bennys and their scrambled egg croissants with their fruit bowls and some cake and coffee. Loved every option, i would definitely recommend this restaurant to those who are keen for brunch style like cafes. However i would say that the food would be more appropriate for australian rates (150k+) but if you are willing to spend anyway, i'd say it's worth the price. Good ambience for working, coffee is good and cakes are affordable too. All in all, i will continue to visit this place and recommend it to my friends!

author: JungJim 1776
review_text: L’Industrie Pizza — Burrata Slice Review Busy for a Thursday, but for good reason. I ordered the burrata slice and the presentation was excellent. Overall, it was a very good slice — 7.9/10. The crust had a nice crisp, though it could’ve used a bit more time in the oven. Slightly greasy, but not enough to detract from the experience. Still well-balanced and enjoyable. The atmosphere was my main downside: standing-room only and very crowded. Elbow-to-elbow dining made it feel a bit chaotic and had me feeling antsy. That said, I appreciated the small details — like the canned water branded with L’Industrie, which was a nice touch. If I return, I’d skip the single slice and go straight for one of their artisan pies with more toppings. While it wasn’t the best slice I had that day, it absolutely held its own on a full Brooklyn pizza walking tour. I’d definitely recommend it. Scorecard 🍕 Slice: 7.9/10 🔥 Crust: Crisp, could be more done 🧀 Toppings: High quality, well-presented 🏙 Atmosphere: Crowded, standing only 💧 Details: Branded canned water = nice touch

author: Brittany Furlan
review_text: Literally such a fun spot. Feels like you’re in Tulum but it’s Santa Monica. If you can get there before sunset, you will have the best view of the sun setting above the ocean. Pure beauty. The food is delicious. The whipped eggplant appetizer is insane. Everything is so good actually you can’t go wrong. Make reservations.

author: Olivia Oostmeijer
review_text: Hands down my favorite restaurant in Canggu. The outdoor seating is set between the trees and is so tranquil, and their menu is fantastic, there were so many options we didn’t know what to choose. We went for the cauliflower steak, crumbed mushrooms, lasagne and fresh spring rolls - everything was 100/10. And all fully vegan. They also have a wide selection of guilt free desserts. I couldn’t recommend this spot enough 🤩🤩

author: Alexander Wong
review_text: Modern chinese restaurant serving their signature wanton noodles, crab meat balls and roast pork. The roast pork has a crispy outer layer with melting fats in the middle. Doesn't have that porky smell and taste very delightful. The crab meat ball for me was alright but has a strong crab smell that I'm unaccustomed to. Otherwise the fish ball and wanton noodle clean flavours and bright ambiance is acceptable.

author: D. Sanders
review_text: This was my go-to breakfast spot during my month in District 1, Ho Chi Minh City. They serve made-to-order American breakfast, so don’t worry if you don’t see a standard option listed on the menu—they’re happy to accommodate. The Vietnamese coffee is excellent, and the cozy, mom-and-pop atmosphere makes it especially welcoming. The service is outstanding, with Jasmine and Hannah going above and beyond—they even memorized my usual order after just two visits. A warm, friendly place and a perfect way to start the day. I’ll definitely be back on my next trip to HCMC!

author: Tanja Zoellner
review_text: Top value for money! I especially love the ambience and Polynesian style. The fish was very tasty and the coconuts are large. The staff are very friendly and attentive. Would definitely come again!

author: Jhenu
review_text: Went with no expectation. Was pleasantly surprised by high quality and delicious Thai food. Highly recommend this hotel for anyone travelling to Vegas. Must Try !

author: Jamie X.M Lee
review_text: Great atmosphere. Food was good. And they have set lunch with very reasonable price. With RM28 you can get one appetiser, one main, one sides and a cup of fruit punch which consider quite a great deal. Their pizza taste good too. The cafe is just along the alley next to Sri Weld Foodcourt which is very easy to find. Not to forget to mention their mushroom soup taste real good. Overall great experience.

author: adrien nicholas
review_text: First time visitor, the service was welcoming. As I came towards the end of the day there wasn't any pounded yams or fried plantains. But the jollof rice was tasty, but turkey was a bit on the oily side.

author: Mendel Davis
review_text: Absolutely worth the trip from Baltimore! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I came all the way from Baltimore specifically to try this spot, and it did not disappoint. The burrata pizza was phenomenal—creamy, fresh, and perfectly balanced—and the Margherita pizza was classic, simple, and executed flawlessly. Every bite reminded me why great pizza doesn’t need to be complicated. On top of the amazing food, the service truly stood out. Wendy, one of their incredible team members, went above and beyond and even let us try the Neapolitan dessert—which was the perfect ending to an already fantastic meal. She was warm, knowledgeable, and genuinely made the experience memorable. Wendy absolutely deserves a raise and a promotion. Between the quality of the food and the outstanding service, this place is a must-visit. I’d gladly make the drive again without hesitation. @Wendy hmu on Ig @godsworkinprogress234

author: David Murphy
review_text: After visiting your restaurants in NewYork , Miami and Chicago we said while in Boston we would try this Location our reservation was for 7.15pm Sunday 14th December 2025 , The Food and Restaurant was as always amazing However The Service was absolutley appalling, after being seated we were left 25mins waiting to order drinks this i could understand if it was busy however it was very very quiet with most wait staff just standing around the bar area chatting and watching the tvs, i decided id go to bar myslef and order drinks (not acceptable) when we did get our drinks the waiter whom seemed so uninterested in having to work, we asked to order wine with dinner however after waiting a further 20mins for our chosen wine our meal had already arrived to our table . We are so disapointed in our visit in Boston as we have always had such amazing service in your other Locations , not good at all i will definetley not be back and will not recommend this Boston location, Not worth the money that it costs.

author: Fernshares
review_text: The servers are welcoming and friendly, asked for feedback if food is nice at random tables. The portion of BBQ ribs is quite generous, and ribs is cooked just nice. Like that they also provide generous amount of sauce. The walnut salad is refreshing and crunchy. The kid love the cheese pull of the Cheeseburger and fries from kid's menu. Seared Barramundi is good as well. Red velvet cake is soft and not too rich. Would love to come back again.

author: Alisha
review_text: The flavors are fresh and vibrant, and the staff is super friendly

restaurant: RM Pagi Sore PIK (Resto & PS Coffee)
author: Tan TM
review_text: Pagi Sore Fabulous food. Would return without doubt as the price is reasonable while the food is tasty. Fantastic variety. My favourites are - beef rendang - Green sambal - Fish Head Curry - Scar daun keladi - Fried chicken. My only gripe is the Q mgmt or rather the lack of it. The place is crazy packed and there is a lady who takes down your request for a table and completely ignores you afterwards. No smile, no reassurance that the table is coming, and tptal poker face. But despite the chaos at the front desk, our name is called and we got our table. Best to sit in an air conditioned area.

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: Sing Wee Choo
review_text: Passed by, and thought to try try. Had the seafood hor fun as a taste test. (for me, any good Tzi char place must first serve a good seafood hor fun. Generous servings of sotong, fish slices, 2 medium prawns... (none of the fish cake slices nor tiny prawn nonsense you find in those other franchise-type Tzi char...) Wok hey gao gao.... Yummy. Will be back with family to try more of the menu. Will review ratings... Crowded on weekends. Call to reserve seats. Charges GST. Another visit, tried lala bee hoon, ee mee and potato leaves... Yummy!

author: Stella
review_text: I went there by myself and still had a great time :) There are two stages - one on each floors (i think? maybe one more) and the songs on the first floor were quite random but still nice. Fyi you get one free drink with your entrance fee. One important note is that the entrance and the exit are different! The exit is on the first floor. I didn't know that so I had to climb up and go down again to leave 🤦🏻‍♀️

author: 조현진 (jhonny)
review_text: I took a bite and it was so good that I got back in the long line to buy another one. But soon you came over and said, “Are you guys buying again? You don’t need to wait in line twice,” and helped us out. And that’s when I met the best fig jam ever. (I won’t say too much in case it causes any trouble for your shop—but I’m sure you know what I mean 😉) We felt like we received such a big gift that day. Your warm kindness made us fall even more in love with New York. Thank you so much. You’re truly the best pizza—and it was one of the best moments ever. 💛 A hundred stars!

author: yth _
review_text: I love Andres! Excellent service. He explained the menu items clearly to us and even gave recommendations. He was very attentive to our needs, constantly checking in on us. The food was delicious and priced reasonably (They have free appetisers for each entree). The atmosphere of the restaurant was excellent too. I love the warm lighting. It was very comfortable to the eyes and provide a great candlelight experience :) Would definitely come back again

author: Sup_Lick
review_text: After a long day/ night of drinking in key west,when awaking the next morning I started to head back up to Philly. Along the way I was getting that craving u get after a night of drinking, for me it’s bacon, or something salty in that range. Threw up maps and looked for a place close, I read farmers market I think good food. Walked in the waitress was nice sat down, she said the specials are behind on the screen, a full list of stuff there was. I grabbed a ham steak, salt cured. Eggs bacon home fries and toast. Eggs and bacon great, the ham steak was huge was salty, which well it’s in the name, the toast had so much butter had to get napkins to take it off. The service was great, the waitress soft spoken, Attractive with freckles and grey eyes. When I head back to Florida, would stop again, No ham tho.

author: AmyJune Hineline
review_text: This place is huge. We walked in and they told us there was no seating downstairs. OK. We wait a minute. I ask "Can we sit upstairs." Wow, we had to ask. We got upstairs and sat at the bar. Server is nice and chatty. We order drinks. Menu is big and plates are very overpriced, maybe due to proximity of Chase Center. We decide on an app of Mac and Cheese. it was served hot and on a skillet. Cool. Tasted medicochre at best... food we could have gotten at any restaurant that orders from sysco foods.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Stephanie Eudave
review_text: One of my fav Korean BBQ spots! There are little to no wait times & the food quality is amazing 😻

author: A K
review_text: This is a very popular place, and we had to wait a bit to get in. They have an outdoor seating area at the front of the restaurant, and because the space is quite large, the turnover is fairly quick. The pork ribs and shrimp were really tasty, while the whole chicken was just okay. We liked the vibrant atmosphere, and the serving staff were friendly and welcoming. The customers are a mix of tourists and locals, which adds to the lively atmosphere.

author: Merryheart
review_text: Chuan Kee Seafood is a very lively Malaysian/ Singaporean Chinese eatery that embodies the best of zi char dining - a huge menu, bustling atmosphere, and dishes meant for sharing. Service was excellent throughout our meal; the staff were warm, attentive, and genuinely friendly, which added to the overall experience. Everything we ordered was cooked well and satisfying, and the pricing struck a nice balance - moderate, yet very good value for the quality and portion sizes. Highlights of our dinner included the Bi Feng Tang Wok-Fried Prawns (crispy, fragrant, and addictive), Duck Wrapped in Lotus Leaf (aromatic and tender), and the Signature Homemade Beancurd, which had a lovely silky texture. The Curry Fish Head was on the pricier side at $50, but worth it given that it was prepared with fresh Red Grouper - rich curry, generous portion, and great with rice. Another standout was the Four Heavenly King vegetables with sambal; the spice level was spot on and the sambal had just the right depth of flavour. A sweet treat at the end - complimentary ice cream and soybean custard added a nice touch. Overall, this is a fantastic spot for a casual but delicious zi char meal with family or friends. I'll definitely be back to explore more of their extensive menu.

author: Lay Ying Yeoh
review_text: Their Dai Lok Mee and Sang Mian very very delicious, cooked with wok hei. The sang mian very crispy and soaked with the soup. The sambal sauce a bit spicy but taste good. Please come early if you don't want to wait but they served really faster. The price is reasonable and the portion is okay. The atmosphere not so good but can try. I will come again.

author: Frisca Aprillia
review_text: The food was sooo bursting with flavor, i've had a spicy slowly kicking my mouth with nasi bakar cabe ijo sei sapi & ayam taliwang asap mandalika. Don't forget to order mie rebus pesisiran because they have the broth sooo delish umami🤌🤌Service was excellent, they willing to replace our es cendol because we tell them that was too sweet for the normal palm sugar, but we are so full. Keep up the best service and food!🤟

author: Daniella Louise Santiago
review_text: Had a pretty good cheese paratha, and an even better mango aloe dessert while I waited for a bus back to my hotel. It’s conveniently on a busy bus stop.

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: Shan Leong
review_text: Overall the taste was good 👍, have the authentic taste. The 南乳肉 and the 酿豆腐 was nice. Recommend to add on . 🤣 Service was fast and friendly. Location was easy to find, many parking lots around there. As for environment is non aircon and consider clean.

author: N. Gan
review_text: We dined at Segar Restaurant today, a Halal-certified eatery we frequently visit. This restaurant offers great value with its $33.80 set meals for 2. We selected cereal prawns as our main dish, accompanied by minced chicken tofu, chye sim with garlics, two glasses of refreshing lemon juice, and two plates of white rice. Their assam fish is a must-have for us, so we added it to our meal as always. What stood out once again was the exceptional service provided by an elderly server, Guek Hua who greets everyone with a warm, familiar smile. Her passion for serving diners is evident in the way she attentively observes their needs and spontaneously offers assistance. I was particularly impressed by her agility and skill in carrying 4 to 5 plates at a time, effortlessly serving each table with grace. Her dedication truly enhances the dining experience, making every visit enjoyable.

author: Beatriz Villalobos
review_text: With all due respect, the food was unsatisfactory and the prices were steep. The food took a long while to make/come out. And, it also took a long while to get a receipt. There were only us and another couple at the restaurant so I am unsure of why the wait times were so long. Overall, I was underwhelmed with the quality and quantity of the food. Also, the pricing was absurd.

author: Mursal Guliyev
review_text: I had a great experience at La Industria. The atmosphere was vibrant and stylish, with great music and decor. The food was fresh and flavorful.The staff was friendly and attentive, and everything came out quickly. Definitely a great spot for a casual lunch or a fun dinner with friends. I’ll be coming back soon!

author: Karla
review_text: The manager was very rude and completely unhelpful. They messed up the order and she didn’t even try to fix it. The service is awful in general and the place is not clean at all. Not worth it

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: Fong Zhi Yen
review_text: Broth was thick with aroma and overall portion size is huge, worth what you’re paying for! The pork rib meat is soft and tender and the seafood was sweet and well-cooked! Other than just the food, will recommend you to try their home made drinks. Was refreshing and didn’t taste too sweet at all!

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: Sheen Cher
review_text: Tried Zhup Zhup and totally get why it’s a Michelin Bib Gourmand favourite. The flavours are rich and comforting, and the GAOGAO broth is seriously addictive. We had the Jumbo Prawn Hokkien Mee and Jumbo Prawn Paofan — the tiger prawns were huge, sweet, and super satisfying. Also loved the har cheong gai and their refreshing drinks like the yuzu soda and ice lemon tea. Definitely worth a visit if you’re a prawn noodle fan!

author: Binder Family
review_text: We live an hour north in Delray, and this is still our go to dinner date spot. Dishes are light, and flavors are intentional. We really appreciate the consistency here.

author: Jeneen Hinkle
review_text: Oh my!! It was my first time on the North-east coast and I wanted lobster and fish and chips and Bay Pointe did not disappoint! The fish and chips were so light and flaky they were the best I have ever tasted. The lobster roll was flavorful, stuffed with sweet succulent lobster with a hint of mayonnaise! The clam chowder was rich and flavorful with large chunks of clam! The service was great also! What a wonderful dining experience 👌

author: Yulia Shekeladze
review_text: everything was delicious (although deep fried mackerel wasn’t out favourite, it had a very fishy taste) and this place absolutely deserves the hype. also we went without reservation, i got in line at 4:45 (saturday night) to put my name down for a group of 3 and we were seated at 7:30, so it is definitely possible.

author: Grace Charmenita
review_text: First of all, food not taste so good,but have a lot of option. Second , sushi rice taste weird and I found a Little Rocks inside from couple of sushi. Third, the Salmon they’re cut so thin and small,doesn’t have a couple option for sushi and doesn’t have sashimi(even the price $15/person) I’m from New York,I know the price is reasonable for buffet here,but I know you still can upgrade it,that’s why you guys have 2 location now. Fourd,all the server speak so loudly to each other and laughing so loud ,it’s not polite when you’re working like that, it’s not beside each other but the gap so far and they’re talking to each other like have no customers,that’s not good SOP. Fifth,server was rude! I’m coming with my husband for my birthday, they put me in small booth seat for 2 people, I mean we’re big person even not so fat but we can’t sit there because our winter coat also so big,we need space to put it so we can sit more comfortable and enjoy the food. First time eating we want to ask the server but they didn’t ask us how’s everything, until we move by ourself and one of server from far away ask like why you want move to other tables(which is that time not busy and not full table around us ,maybe 1 section side just have us and 1 family of 3 , that’s it) and then my husband just said because we need to put our winter coat we don’t have space. And then she ask,how many of you, we said just 2 people. And then I think either the manager or the lady owner said it’s okay, so just it’s okay,why need ask so many times? I mean even we just 2 people’s why we can’t move to the other tables? Next time you need to see if even just 2 people if they’re bringing a lot of stuff or have a big winter coat,just give them booth seat with 4 people not just for 2 peoples. I know maybe there have server who got section side for them to paid their salary but it’s not how to service the guest especially when you’re in buffet which is need more higher service not just let the customers pick and eat and go home,it’s not to go shop. I hope you guys upgrade it everything, but for now I will not recommended this place for buffet, I will see you guys later and I will try to edit this review if you guys done upgrading this.

author: Peter Farejowicz
review_text: Felix Trattoria on Abbot Kinney delivered a fantastic dining experience. The atmosphere was sophisticated yet warm, making it perfect for a night out with friends or a special occasion. We ordered everything family style, and every dish was fresh, flavorful, and beautifully prepared. The pastas, in particular, were standout. One note: I wouldn’t recommend the white sauce pizzas—those fell a little flat—so I’d suggest sticking with the traditional ones. Service was attentive without being overbearing, and the whole evening felt well-paced and enjoyable.

author: Ellen Turner
review_text: Big portions, fresh ingredients, great value. I liked that they had impossible meat and friends liked their jerk chicken. I do wish I had read the review that said to get a bowl before our visit, the burrito is a two hander and will burst with the amount of food they put in it.

restaurant: Hùng Mập - Hủ Tiếu Nam Vang - Bún Mọc - Bún Bò Huế
author: Alex Thuan
review_text: Hung Map's Phnom Penh-style noodle soup restaurant in District 1 is the ideal destination for those who love Phnom Penh-style noodle soup. The restaurant stands out with its rich flavor, delicious broth combined with shrimp, meat, and quail eggs, creating a fantastic bowl of noodle soup. The restaurant has a comfortable and clean atmosphere, and the service is quick and enthusiastic. What's special is that the prices here are very reasonable, suitable for many customers. If you are looking for a delicious and affordable restaurant in District 1, Hung Map's Phnom Penh-style noodle soup restaurant is a choice you shouldn't miss.

author: Becky
review_text: From loud Freemont Street to Broken Yolk Cafe. It was a nice change of scenery. Let's jump right into this review. I'm not from Las Vegas so I have no logistical advice on how to get to the cafe or parking recommendations. But, it's worth you finding out or Google mapping yourself there. We visited on Saturday around noon. It was a 20 minute wait for a booth. What did we have - Mom Omelet - Spinach, mushroom, onion, red and green bell pepper. Topped with avocado, salsa fresca, and sour cream - (530 cal) - vegetarian -$17.95 -10/10 Californian Omelet -Bacon, homefries, American cheese. Topped with avocado and sour cream - (1050 cal) - $17.95 -10/10 ** Omelets are served with a side and toast. ** Food arrived quickly within 15 minutes. The inside of the cafe is asethically pleasing - bright colors, tables, booths, and bar seating available - indoor and outdoor. The menu had options/variety. Our server was friendly and personable. All the employees we encountered were friendly and welcoming. Great customer service overall. When I'm back in Las Vegas I'll definitely be dropping in for brunch.

author: Chong Lip
review_text: Great backyard Duck Noodle…amazingly nice…😋👏🏻👍🏻👍🏻 No doubt…must try if come Hatyai

author: Corey Collins
review_text: Wow, Cacique Restaurant is such a gem! The vibe is super chill, perfect for grabbing a quick bite. The staff is friendly and always up for a chat. I loved their fresh juices—totally refreshing! Can’t wait to go back! 112 W Flagler St, Miami, FL 33130. 🌟

author: Melissa Boyd
review_text: Went here because I had heard all these raving reviews on instagram/tiktok. Customer service… horrible. Doesn’t make you feel welcomed. I tried to hold a little conversation about how I heard all about their food, and wanted to try it. I was so excited. The young lady scrunched her face, and didn’t respond. She took away the excitement. I had to go get my id to be matched with card. When I came back in, the young lady was sitting talking to another employee, and didn’t see me (I guess). The other lady cashier saw me and just stood there, then looks down at at the cashier that was doing my order and started laughing talkin’ about girl you so ignorant, lol. Now I’m getting upset. Paid for my order and left. As I was walking out they were laughing about the incident. Absolutely no tip from me, and no more business. And people wonder why a lot of us don’t like supporting black owned businesses!!! DO BETTER…!!! Oh, I ordered the lobster Mac n cheese, and the banana pudding ( more like cookies and instant pudding). The lobster and Mac is tasty. Haven’t touched the cookie pudding, yet.

author: Larry Berg
review_text: New: The lobster is always perfect! Their new shrimp scampi is huge and delicious! We always get good service here. It's always nice and clean. We love going to this restaurant; we are regulars. Old: On our most recent visit, everything was perfect. We heard the ownership had recently changed hands. From what I've researched, a seafood conglomerate has purchased it. The food and service were unsurpassed on this visit. Every steak was perfect and great cuts. Every lobster tail was big, and perfectly cooked. Our server, Linda, was courteous, attentive and very helpful. Their Wednesday night steak and lobster special is amazing! So is the Tuesday night crab special. Every weekday has a special! Every time we come here, it seems to get a little bit better. Now under new management, we hope that trend continues. OLD REVIEW: Usually good food and service. Both can be a tad spotty during and after COVID. Always good portions. Good management.

author: Laura Amador
review_text: Richard was awesome. It was my first time in and he answered all of my questions. It helped me make a fantastic choice. I had the steak with Thai fried rice I take a picture of my food, but I already devoured it I also had a lychee martini which was really good

restaurant: The Hive - Healthy Eats & Organic Cafe - MDR
author: Emil Cohen
review_text: The Hive coffee shop at AMLI Marina Del Rey may look like a nice café, but behind the scenes, their operations create a serious nuisance for the residents who live here. Every single night at around 1:30 AM, delivery trucks arrive for The Hive — seven nights a week. These are large trucks with lift gates, engines running, loud reversing alarms, and flashing lights that wake people up in the middle of the night. The deliveries last 30–60 minutes, and the noise carries directly into apartments above. What makes this worse is that The Hive doesn’t even open until 7:00 AM. There is no valid reason why deliveries must happen at 1:30 AM when they could easily occur after opening or before closing. Instead, the business chooses a schedule that disrupts hundreds of residents’ sleep for their convenience. A café should be part of the community, not a source of nightly disturbance. Until The Hive changes its delivery practices and respects the residents who live above them, I cannot recommend supporting this business. If they fix this, I will update my review.

author: David A.
review_text: This was a fun experience and our group really enjoyed it. We visited during a tropical storm which was unfortunate but the inside is lively and the service was great. We enjoyed the food we tried and the drinks hit the spot. I'm sure when the weather is gorgeous and you're visiting the beach, there couldn't really be a better choice.

author: Fion Tan
review_text: Crab fried rice 👍🏻 Tomyam is nice! Thai omelette is the best! Vermicelli noodles are also delicious.

restaurant: Geylang Serai Market and Food Centre
author: Azfar Maswan
review_text: best place in the world! the variety of southeast asian ingredients here is amazing. and the meats from the butchers are the cheapest on the island. Siti Flower Power has a complete Jamu (Nusantara traditional medicine) store where you can get ingredients to cure different ailments. best place for fresh coconut milk is Mr Khaled's shop. after buying your groceries, head up to the hawker and enjoy classic Singaporean fares such as Laksa Siglap, Kacang Phool or even freshly made chapati. everything here is heaven!

author: Daniel Tee
review_text: I love Banh Mi and this Banh Mi Chao taste just absolutely phenomenal. Very authentic, very hearty, you really can't go wrong with this place.

author: Places Noted.
review_text: Tonchin delivered a fantastic ramen experience. The dipping noodles were generous in portion and the broth was rich, authentic, and full of flavor. Service was excellent — friendly, accommodating, and unlike many other NYC spots, we never felt rushed. It made for a really comfortable dining experience. Definitely worth booking in advance if you want to secure a spot. Highly recommend dining here when in New York.

author: Brian
review_text: I’ve been here on several occasions but I will mention my most recent experience. We went on Thanksgiving day. Surprisingly, the place was not crowded so the staff weren’t crazy busy. As usual I he food was well seasoned and the portions were more than generous. I give it a 10 out of 10.

author: Gabriella Enrico
review_text: Our favourite breakfast spot in Chiang Mai! So good we went twice fresh fruit was amazing loved the mango

author: Yan Ren Emmanuel Tan
review_text: Nice ambience. Great pics. Wide variety on menu. Portion slightly small but reasonable.

author: CHIN HOWE Tang (Howe)
review_text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️ Tried TG’s Bistro and ordered the **roti tisu**. The presentation looked nice and crispy, but the taste was just average — not so sweet . Service was okay and the place was quite casual, but nothing particularly stood out. Overall, a decent spot if you’re nearby, but not something I’d go out of my way for.

author: Adeshola Andre
review_text: Delicious yummy food, clean environment and deliver food on time,no disappointment

author: Shelly Shi
review_text: Updated: second time here with groups of friends. The dishes are authentic and big portions! Highly recommend. Fast take out- the Szechuan cold noodles came out fast, and was delicious with tasty sauce, just wished there were some protein options can be added.

author: viona sumartio
review_text: The food is delicious overall, the staff and their service is great so far the vibes were rlly good as we can karaoke while eating

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: Palanthorn Loomcharoen
review_text: Delicious food, relaxed atmosphere, and live music at night.

author: j s
review_text: Very good quality for the price . You walk over to the counter to select your dimsum n hand it over to be steamed. The noodle is also very good. Be sure to get the table outside if you can as the tables indoor are very cramped and the air inside a little stuffy

author: Yi Ling Lai
review_text: Whenever I visit Bangkok, Nara Thai is a must have. The yellow curry soft shell crab and creamy tom yummy goong are my go to. Great service, great food, always happy to be back

author: Kim Reale Artist
review_text: Ichabod’s is wonderful old school Las Vegas. The food is terrific. The service is superior and it’s got a very cozy atmosphere that you don’t find and a lot of the newer restaurants these days. Five stars all the way! I recommend it very highly.

author: Dolma Yankey
review_text: Quick (not rushed) service, delicious food, chill atmosphere! The fried Oaxaca cheese was scrumptious, the lamb taco was so good (didn’t even realize I was eating lamb- nice and crispy, and not gamey at all), scrambled egg tostada delish- seemed like Chinese dish inspired due to the chili-oil, and the masa pancakes 😋 - top notch. The pancakes were super moist, hot, with a good amount of butter and maple syrup, just the perfect dish to end our brunch! The portions are on the smaller side. But super happy with our first-time experience. Will definitely come back ;)

author: Narumi M
review_text: The atmosphere was warm and friendly. The owners personally gave us recommendations , especially the salted coffee which was the bomb!! Everything we had was delicious. They even gave us local eateries and places to see in HCM. I highly recommend folks (local and tourist) to come check them out.

author: Rajeev Rajan
review_text: Great place to have some nice seafood & other non-vegetarian delicacies - like chicken & other meat! Be ready to bargain to get the best deal. Too crowded on weekends & rightly so with all the party options around.

author: Dana McEvers
review_text: The food was bland, I hate it when cooks do not cook with salt. That tells me they know nothing about salt enhancing all the flavors together. Other than that...Mark was an awesome server and th view was perfect!

author: Nick Miner
review_text: The brisket is really brisket unlike a lot of bbq places in Vegas. However, it is boiled with no flavor. The burnt ends were pretty good. I'll come back for those. But save your money on the brisket. Both dishes came covered in pickles. I don't want pickle flavored meat, guys. Please put that on the side. I was seated promtly. My order was taken and brought quickly. No complaints there. The music was far too loud. Prices are in line with everywhere else. Just to be clear, PLEASE PUT THE PICKLES ON A SEPARATE PLATE.

author: Angela Killian
review_text: Service was fast…food was ok, but not great vegetarian options. I got the vegetarian banh mi thinking it would be all veggies and it was all noodles and tofu with no sauce. I ordered again the omelette banh mi and it was really tasty. They want to get you in and out due to limited seating. Beer was ICE cold! I think this place has a lot of hype from foreigners leaving reviews. It was good but not the best and they didn’t add any mayo which is a deal breaker for me personally.

author: Charlotte Cabezas
review_text: Always hits the spot. I love that they serve such generous servings and the service is always kind.

author: Sherilyn Tran
review_text: We stumbled upon the restaurant by chance, and it turned out to be the best decision. The food was sensational—we ordered two bánh xèo, one spring roll, and one rice soup, and everything was served without a long wait. The staff were very attentive, and the wonderful employee, Hera, showed us how to eat bánh xèo the right way! Truly the best bánh xèo I’ve ever had! Thank you for the great experience—we will definitely be back

author: Gloria Ordonez
review_text: UPDATE: to respond to the “owner “ that responds to everybody with the same link which is to complain directly to Mc Donald’s they DON’T CARE OK. I already did that. I’ll just avoid this place. They had me waiting for my orders for over 40 MINUTES!!! Every single person that got there after me got their orders!!! I had to get really angry after 40 to finally get their attention. After which they gave me an incomplete order (I did not receive my coffee) and on top of that they gave me the WRONG burger. I had paid for a Quarter pounder DELUXE and i received a regular one. Very insulting. Of course, after 45 min I was not going to wait any longer for them to fix it. The worst experience ever!!!

author: Jacob Ekegren
review_text: Price is great. Went out for a good time. Ordered a bunch of food and the server was great. She was by herself, but did an amazing job.

author: 王迪雅
review_text: The food was okay — for my taste, it wasn’t bad but not particularly delicious either. My boyfriend actually quite liked it. Two of the dishes came out a bit cold, and I personally prefer my food to be hot. The crispy duck with rice was served hot though.

author: Rashi
review_text: Service may be a little slow but the atmosphere, the picturesque location, and the quality of food was just amazing. Have a good quality of unique oysters. There fresh, warm sourdough bread that they provide to have inside also is great. Yes you have to pay for it. All the quality of crab and seafood and caviar just spectacular. The best part is that it is walking distance to the Chase center, so if you plan ahead you'll have a wonderful night!!

author: Dumnoi
review_text: Following our breakfast in Pasadena, we noticed a long queue at a nearby spot, prompting us to stop and explore. It ended up being the highlight of our day! Every pastry and baked treat we sampled was absolutely delightful, particularly the chocolate and almond croissant. It was wonderfully flaky, with just the right amount of butter, and the filling was scrumptious, featuring high-quality chocolate and almond paste. The lemon berry danish was equally impressive, boasting a perfectly balanced sweet and tangy lemon curd. I can’t help but wish I lived closer so I could visit and taste everything on the menu!

author: Jessica S
review_text: Overall our experience here was good, we only had s short wait to be seated unlike other reviews, and we were seated along the water. Double bonus! This place is super quirky and cute, the vibe is definitely beach shack, and the menu as well as how the food is served (paper plates etc) reflects that. Don't come here expecting a ton of food options, of fancy by any means, and if you have anyone picky in your group be sure to make sure theres something they will eat ahead of time. We did the BLT lobster sandwich and fries for $27 and the letub burger, our friends got the chicken sandwich and a salad. Overall the food was good. I would not say the burger is the best burger but it definitely was not bad. The lobster BLT was tasty, and it was the only entree that came with fries without the extra $6 charge. We would absolutely come back, and the vibe and location were lovely.

author: Victor Pierce Jr
review_text: We actually go to MC BARBER SHOP in this plaza. Reasonable prices & Martha is Excellent!!

author: Yelloboi Jaysen TJ
