review_text: Assorted dim sum in hatyai. At least, no need long queue like cheok dee dim sum. Beautifully craft design mini dimsum. Taste average. Only steamed after ordering.

author: Sweet Home
review_text: The food is very good, the reason I put one star because the table have a post said if you give 5 stars you will have one free drink. I really don’t like that. It is not fair to the restaurant around it. It should earn its star by offering good food. It earns 7000+ good reviews, I don’t know how many of them is because of the free drink.

author: Zach Oschin
review_text: Best restaurant we’ve been to in Boston. Food was excellent. Restaurant is small and romantic and service is great. Highly recommend if you can get a reservation.

author: HFZ
review_text: Wide range of food options, usually more popular stalls include Muslim food and drinks (nasi padang, mee bakso, teh halia teh pandan, etc.) and Chinese food (duck porridge, chicken rice). Western and Japanese food options also available although not really recommended, pretty average nothing special. Drinks are pretty affordable as compared to the nearby coffeeshops, wider range of beverages sold too.

author: Raymond Bowman
review_text: Such a great experience! Will likely eat here everyday while in Vegas. The food was delicious and our server, D' Essence was very helpful and overall just so pleasant. This place is definitely newer and you can tell that all the staff clearly cares about everyones experience. You can not beat the pricing!!! Must try.

author: Yaniv Gheber
review_text: Very friendly and quick, great food! Great if you're hungry and need a perfect quick meal!

author: Kristine
review_text: Tasty zone is a yummy spicy Chinese restaurant. Newly renovated dive covid it has a fun vibe. It's not a big restaurant so if you are coming at lunch or dinner hours there may be a wait. There is plenty of parking and well located in the shopping center at the corner. The service is good. Nothing over the top but friendly and efficient. The food is yummy and spicy. It is served hot and fresh. The menu is large with a huge variety to choose from spicy, ma la and not spicy. I recommend getting the yogurt if getting spicy if you are not used to it.

author: Muhammad Syahazmil Mohd Zaki (Syamil)
review_text: I had an amazing experience at Sarastro KL by Millennium, all thanks to the outstanding service by Coline and Tina. Both were exceptionally warm, attentive, and professional throughout my visit. Coline made sure every detail was perfect, while Tina’s friendly attitude made me feel truly welcomed. Their hospitality added a personal touch that made the whole experience memorable. Highly recommend this place — especially if you’re lucky enough to be served by Coline and Tina!

author: Johnny Tan
review_text: Ordered the nasi chicken ayam goreng. The curries were decent. But the chicken was bone dry. Pass. Also tried the Two Veg + garlic Naan. The naan was fresh and hot but everything else was lukewarm. Cabbage was decent. Potatoes were decent. But then, the naan turned hard after just a few minutes. Naan should stay soft for more than 5 minutes. Overall, very average food. But good price. Would not come back.

author: Dominic Ho
review_text: Authentic Thai food - kengsom fish (excellent), deep fried catfish (a bit dry) & kerabu chicken feed (excellent). The sambal belacan is fantastic (available for sale). Service is quite fast. The ambience can be improved upon.

author: Doug Ainsworth
review_text: Excellent experience. One of the best steaks I've ever had. We did feel a little rushed but service was still great. We got the steak for 2 and was amazing. Really need to order it rare or medium rare its still going to cook in the butter once it's on your table. I know it seems over the top but spooning the butter over the meat takes it to another level. Can't go wrong with the German potatoes and finished it off with some cheesecake. Had several cocktails and a beer all were very good as well. For how well known and rated the place is prices weren't super crazy but you will spend 200 to 300 for 2 people. I would definitely come back again or at least try the one in Vegas.

author: Tan Junyu
review_text: It just reopen after 3 mths renovation and it packed with people. Alot of people queuing for the pig organ soup, wanton mee and fishball noodles. Apity that bittergroud beef is overcooked, tough and too salty.

author: CoMeToPaPa
review_text: In Thailand if its dim sum.. Its not that big of a deal.. But for a try sure give it a shot... Malaysia dim sum is better

author: Farmer John
review_text: This was the BEST food I've had. Double-sized portions with low pricing. I was at the restaurant on Sunset for my birthday. Shrimp burrito, fajitas and a tostada bowl. Service and atmosphere are perfect. Some Pinkbox for dessert.

author: Christina Estrada
review_text: What an incredible and authentic Mexican restaurant! I visited with my boss and a coworker, and we loved the experience. The service was fantastic our waiter was friendly, funny, and let us taste-test all the mimosa flavors (which were seriously yummy!). Great food and a wonderful time.

author: Alexsis Deleon
review_text: Food was horrible and the waiter refused to give us a refund on it. They never checked on our table and took over an hour for our food. The next day the food made me sick!

author: C
review_text: This spot is a cherished favorite. Whenever I have the time it's a top choice for breakfast. Service is unparalleled. Very clean and welcoming environment. Its Saturday morning so theres about a 20 minute wait. Reasonable. I started off with a giant grilled blueberry muffin and medium coffee. Deliciousness. Ordered one egg full breakfast which included toast and hashbrowns with choice of meat. Expertly prepared to order. All I've got to say this is a solid choice with all the basic amenities available. I hope y'all never change.

author: ed crisostomo
review_text: fast quick service, food came out less than 5 minutes. menu has something about everybody from burgers, chicken fingers, tacos, burritos,shakes, and breakfast. don't forget they have happy hour too.

author: Nanananana Dada
review_text: Cozy and glamorous environment. Clean and tidy. Currently there is a promotion whereby customer can get free wantan and dessert by review in Google. We ordered salted egg pumpkin, pork, peanut butter noodle and lemon fish. The ingredient is fresh and portion is generous. Honest review but not doing this for free food lol Price is high side but justifiable.

author: Joanne Sugiyama
review_text: This is a no frills, small place but the food is LEGIT. My husband likes very spicy food and I like mine mild. We ended up sharing 3 plates and he added the dried chili peppers on the table to every single bite. We had panang curry with chicken (spice level 1), pad see ew with beef and pad thai with beef. The food came out fast and the flavor was on point! We did have to wait a little bit at 8om on Friday night but the list went fast and we were seated, ate and walked over for gelato within 2 hours. Highly recommend - we will be back!!!

author: MrsKwon P
review_text: Tonchin NYC One of the best spots for authentic ramen in the city. The broth is rich and flavorful, and the noodle texture is perfectly chewy and delicious. Highly recommend making a reservation—walk-ins usually wait 30 minutes to an hour, and during peak hours it can take even longer

author: Brett Austin
review_text: What an amazing place with an amazing view and amazing staff! Have visited multiple times and each time the food and service have been perfect. We enjoyed early dinner before shows at Chase Center and there was plenty of seating. On one visit I had the Mission Rock Cioppino and my partner had the Jumbo Prawn Mac & Cheese, both had amazing flavor w/nice portions. On our last visit we had the burrata, grilled fish tacos and crab salad…perfect as well. The wine was outstanding w/nice pours, as was the Mai Tai. Lastly, the Espresso Martini…was crazy good! A must try! Parking can be horrendous and expensive…depending on when you visit, so definitely look for local events at Chase Center (the restaurant is pretty very close)…so that you enjoy the area and your visit to Mission Rock Resort. One more note, there’s almost a grab and go section on the first floor of the restaurant, so check that out if you’re pressed for time. I can’t review that section…since we didn’t utilize the service, but it looked like it was nicely organized.

author: Mafrey S
review_text: I went there for dinner, and the service was amazing. However, I was very disappointed with the papaya salad. It lacked flavor, and the sauce didn’t taste right—it seemed like it might have been pre-made. I mentioned it to the server, but they said it was American style. My husband tried the papaya salad as well and agreed that the taste was off. On a positive note, the baked mussels were delicious and ended up being our favorite dish of the night.

author: antonius
review_text: The food, the staffs, and the place are all amazing! Various options of thai food are also available, especially if you’re not into spicy food. They were also giving crackers as a complimentary while waiting for the food to come. Very recommended. 👍🏻

author: hladyt me
review_text: The food was delicious. Well seasoned and hot. I ordered the western skillet with scrambled egg and American cheese.

restaurant: Zhup Zhup | Prawn noodle | Hokkien Mee | Pao Fan
author: Another Big Bite
review_text: 5 Fortune Jumbo Prawn with lovely seasoned yellow noodle mixed Kway Teow in dry version. The 5 fortune comprises jumbo prawns, seafood ball, sliced thick & collar bone pork slices & clams in rich broth is delicious. More Jumbo Prawn in our Paofan (Rice)- very flavorful with the umami seafood rich broth all soaked up by the rice. Crispy batter yet rich marinated juicy tender Har Cheong Gai - prawn paste chicken wings is finger licking good! Kinda expensive refreshing drinks we ordered but it’s a must to quench our heat - CALAMANSI Sour Plum & Sour Plum Prune Soda. A must to experience this popular many hours prep prawn rich broth. Dress lightly!

restaurant: Taco Beach Shack - Mexican Restaurant in Hollywood Beach
author: Cesar Davila
review_text: The food and service at taco beach shack was great, we had the churasco taco combo plate which comes with 3 tacos, grilled corn on the cob with Parmesan cheese, rice & black beans and a chicken salad with honey vinaigrette, monster-Rita and a shot of tequila. Our server Yela was very attentive, friendly and patient as we switched tables 3 times for a better view of the live performer they had there, she’s a great singer and it enhanced the great atmosphere of this outdoor and festive restaurant.

author: Jorge Narvaez
review_text: If you’re looking for a no-nonsense, hearty breakfast that doesn’t skimp on quality or portions, Egg Works is the place. This spot delivers every time—whether you’re craving a classic eggs-and-bacon plate, a loaded skillet, or one of their signature omelets that can put you out for the rest of the day (in the best way). Service is friendly and efficient. The staff knows the menu and keeps your coffee full without asking—exactly how a breakfast joint should run. They’re pros, and you can tell they’ve been doing this a while. The vibe inside is comfortable, casual, and clean—kind of that old-school breakfast diner feel but with a touch of personality. Everything just works, and there’s never a long wait unless you’re rolling in mid-morning on a weekend (but even then, it moves fast). Bonus points for their homemade banana nut muffins and house hot sauce—both are worth taking home. Overall, Egg Works doesn’t try to be flashy. It’s just good food, done right. A dependable spot that respects your time, your appetite, and your

author: Gabrielle Marie Yap
review_text: Walked-in at around 10 AM on a Sunday and was seated immediately. We secured a table near the ledge for 800k+ minimum spend. Take note that this spot can have direct sunshine. Our food was: • brunch - bagel, french toast, fruit platter, 2 hot drinks • snacks - french fries & frozen strawberry margarita • early dinner - tuna poke bowl, hummus dip & chips, white sangria Food was good and service was nice. We stayed until 7:30 PM since the place is nicer at night. Wasn’t able to catch the sunset because of the rain and wind but it’s all good, we also switched tables because of the rain & wind. Once the rain stopped, we were watching the surfers ride the waves. It was nice. We recommend this beach club if you’re looking for a place to chill and relax.

author: Jeanne Herawati
review_text: Very good food indonesian fusion, fast service, very kind staff, homie environment 👍🏻

restaurant: The Chill Buffet (Chi Nhánh 2) - Buffet nướng 139k
author: Bảo Diệp
review_text: The prices are very reasonable, drinks are refillable, and there's plenty of breast meat. However, the seating is a bit cramped and the food selection is limited. It's great if you only want to eat breast meat. The gas grill produces minimal smoke and a pleasant aroma. The music is loud and irritating, making conversation feel like a wedding reception.

author: Bryan (SMAD)
review_text: Trying out the reopening of The Coffee Edition! Good food, good drinks.

author: Scott Wolff
review_text: Great breakfast menu as well as other meal times. This is my go to spot for breakfast on the go

author: Daniel Ravelo Mejia
review_text: You have to come and try it! Without a doubt, the best Vietnamese bánh mì in Ho Chi Minh City! The menu is super simple: just one type of bánh mì, no customization options, but the portion is huge, ideal for sharing between two. The dough is perfectly crispy, covered with a rich pork liver pâté, layered with ham, pork aspic, and fresh vegetables 🥬 (served separately to add). Super tasty and satisfying! I highly recommend it. Just one costs 73,000 VND, approximately $2.77. It's worth it. It's close to the center, very easy to get to. One is enough, but with two breads, it's a delight.

author: K
review_text: Food, service, and staff are all great. They have delicious daily specials and a great selection of food to choose from on the menu. Prices are fair in regards to its location. Every person who works here is extremely attentive and makes sure that they satisfy any of your meal needs. I would say price wise, it's ok for being pretty deep in downtown Miami. You can't expect the lowest prices for the area, but for what you get with your meal it's pretty good. The only con, I'd say, is the overuse of fans and AC indoors. On some seats, your food will get a bit colder quicker than others.

author: Alson Asehan
review_text: Started the month of October trying Red Lobster for the first time. I can definitely say that it won't be the last! Service was great, thanks to Alex and Whitney! Food was delicious and the lobster pizza was my favorite out of all our orders. Overall, it's a perfect Red Lobster experience. Until my next visit!

author: Richard Ho
review_text: Khao Khun Mookata is a super value for money mookata outlet. Setup is simple, food ingredients are fresh with a free flow of beverages and even ice cream for dessert. This outlet at Raja Uda Butterworth is worth visiting as the dining space is airy and open. Perfect environment to eat mookata, with an option of spicy tomyum or clear broth soups. As usual, there was a section of pre-cooked finger foods, with very tasty chilli crab and yummy fried wonton and nicely grilled satay. Staff were kind and attentive, and even helped us shift to a shady and cooler spot as our table was in a warm location. Excellent mookata place for everyone to try in the Butterworth area.

author: Riadh Said
review_text: I was really impressed by the reviews before trying this brunch place, so my expectations were high. I ordered the avocado toast with extra salmon and, given the price (around $30), I was expecting something more refined. The sourdough bread was excellent & crunchy on the outside and fluffy inside. However, the avocado was overly mashed and tasted very similar to the small pre-made guacamole cups from Costco. The egg was also disappointing, it felt like a standard machine-boiled egg, similar to what you’d get at McDonald’s or Tim Hortons, rather than something house-made or authentic. The side salad was another letdown as the dressing was very watery, as you can see in the picture, which took away from the overall freshness. On a positive note, the salmon was good, and the service and atmosphere were both great. Overall, a pleasant experience, but the food didn’t quite live up to the price or the hype.

author: Irene Smith
review_text: The food was delicious, the portions plenty. The server Roberto was super nice and friendly.

author: Ali ÇİÇEK
review_text: We stopped by Milk & Madu for a light snack and really loved it! The fruit bowl was fresh, colorful, and full of tropical flavors like dragon fruit, mango, and berries. It was the perfect healthy and refreshing mid-day treat. The atmosphere was cozy and lively, with great live music in English playing in the background. A wonderful spot to relax, enjoy good vibes, and have something delicious and natural in Bali!

author: rachel
review_text: Ayat, can only be described as a euphoric dining experience. This restaurant has quickly become a favorite among friends in the city. The atmosphere is incomparable, cozy enough for conversation but busy enough to hear the laughter and joy around you. The food is indescribable, beautifully seasoned with unforgettable flavor. The staff is also incredibly kind, and very thoughtful in their service. Some menu highlights were the halloumi watermelon salad (truly life changing), the Pistachio Paradise Pizza, and the Chicken Shawarma. All dishes were amazing, but these were each unforgettable. Ayat is the spot to go if you want a unique and outstanding experience in a homey environment with beautiful ambiance. This is a must-try restaurant, I’ll be taking every visitor I have!

author: JungoXL
review_text: Great Caribbean food and even Chinese-American style fried rice (Cho- Fan) with a Latino twist. Good people, good service, long lines most of the time but definitely worth the wait. No dining in, take out & delivery only.

author: Rangsan Ruamyoo
review_text: CookChai Dimsum is a lively and authentic dim sum restaurant that captures both the heart and flavor of Southern Thailand’s food culture. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere feels warm and bustling, with families, friends, and locals enjoying their meals together in a casual setting. The interior is simple yet full of character, decorated with traditional photos, bright signs, and the unmistakable aroma of freshly steamed dim sum. The highlight here is, of course, the dim sum itself. Steaming bamboo baskets filled with classic selections such as siu mai and har gow arrive hot and flavorful, with generous fillings and a satisfying texture. Beyond dim sum, the restaurant offers impressive hot dishes. The herbal pork soup served in a clay pot is rich, aromatic, and deeply comforting, blending Chinese herbs with tender meat and mushrooms. Another standout is the sizzling hot plate dish packed with minced pork, mushrooms, and chilies, which delivers both spice and bold flavor. Pairing this with the crispy golden egg omelet creates a balance of textures that complements the meal perfectly. Service is friendly and efficient, even with the busy crowd, and prices are very reasonable for the generous portions. Overall, CookChai Dimsum is not just a place to eat but an experience that celebrates traditional Chinese-Thai flavors. It’s highly recommended for anyone looking for a hearty breakfast or brunch in the area.

author: Art Dopplis
review_text: The decor and atmosphere were both amazing. The staff were friendly and attentive. The food was great. There wasn't a party going on this night but it still has a nice upbeat vibe. I would definitely recommend and we intend on returning next time in the area.

author: Pradeep Mudaliar
review_text: Food was Amazing. Thanks to the chef. Service was immpecable. Anna was amazing. Her attention to detail has been great the whole time i was there. If i every come back to vietnam i will definately visit this place. Thank you for your service Anna :)

author: Benito Camesta
review_text: Such a cool vibe, it's a bar with amazing pizza. I got the bee sting based on all the reviews and it doesn't disappoint. The dough is so light, there is a spicy to it but all the flavors compliment each other so well.

author: Diana Luft
review_text: The place has really gone down the drain. The quality of the dishes was terrible. The service before was this place’s redeemable quality - not anymore! They continued sitting people outside in areas they know flooded as it rained. We watched as a couple was basically rained on since the canopy had small tears and water pooled around them. It stopped raining for a few minutes, the couple paid and left, they cleaned the table. One of the waiters warned the hostess “it’s going to rain again.” And was shrugged off and a new party was seated again…..

author: Yvngumar
review_text: Couple things to say about this place. 1 its a pretty small place to dine in not much tables around as you can see in the video but plenty of space to move around. The menu is pretty wide as in there are a diverse amount of options to choose from which is good. It’s Mexican grill so the 2 main course are tacos and or burritos. There is also the option of the bowl which is plenty if you ask me but not as much as it would be in its counterpart hot peppers. Hot peppers and Guac time are kind of like the apple and Samsung companies in this situation. Both are competing within the same industry of Mexican grill restaurants and both have relatively the same options when it comes to choosing the ingredients. There are only a few slight differences like the portion sizes, sauces available, pricing, locations etc. I will not get into every one as I would be here forever but all you need to know is that compared to hot peppers this place is somewhat lacking. I paid $17 for a burrito bowl for half and half portions when the guy clearly charged me for double. I also told him to tell me when I was ordering something that would cost extra and he neglected to do that so communication is not a strong point in this place. Overall the atmosphere is clean and oriented and it does smell nice so I will give them that.

author: alex cheong
review_text: Tonkatsu Akinai in Tanjung Tokong is a Japanese restaurant that has built quite a reputation, and it shows from the moment you arrive. On my first visit, I had to wait close to an hour for a table as the place was completely packed. This alone made me curious to see what the hype was all about. Once seated, I noticed that the menu was not very detailed. Many of the items were written in Japanese, which can be confusing for customers who are not familiar with the cuisine. Because of this, the waitstaff had to go through lengthy explanations at almost every table, which felt inefficient. The dining environment also left some room for improvement. Despite having several air conditioners, the restaurant was not cool, and the heat from the open cooking near the dining area made it feel rather stuffy. When my order arrived, I had the katsu pork set, which came with rice, salad, and soup. The soup unfortunately was lukewarm on the first try and properly hot only when I requested a replacement. The rice also felt slightly undercooked, which was a letdown. That said, the highlight was definitely the fried pork. The breading was crispy, the meat juicy, and it paired perfectly with the tangy tonkatsu sauce. The salad was fresh and added a nice balance to the meal. Overall, Tonkatsu Akinai shows potential but suffers from inconsistency. While not a bad experience, I feel some improvements are needed to match its popularity.

author: MELISSA CHIA
review_text: First time here with 4 friends to celebrate birthday for a friend. Heard through TikTok. Michelin?? Kinda disappointed. Overrated. The Signature hor fun too salty though the 4 prawns are fresh. The yam basket, birthday girl complain saltfish. Curry fish head so so. I eaten better ones in heartland coffeeshop. The 沙皮雞, chicken meat is fake one. Use flour n meat mixed paste taste like fishcake, a letdown. Overall service is ok. Enbience too noisy, toilet stinks. Told not to be late but we are early still gotta wait till exactly 7.30pm appointment time then get seated. Well unlikely to come back. Not worth the queue n waiting time. Too pricey for this type of food.

author: ana
review_text: I had such a wonderful experience at Ayat! The food was absolutely delicious — full of flavor, fresh, and beautifully presented. The atmosphere was cozy and welcoming, perfect for both a casual night out or a special dinner. Our server, Yulisa, made the experience even better. She was so attentive, kind, and knowledgeable about the menu. She made great recommendations and checked in at just the right moments without ever feeling rushed. You can tell she really cares about her guests having a great time. I’ll definitely be coming back soon — everything from the service to the food was amazing!

author: Mark Coletta
review_text: This is a hidden gem the food is always good and our family enjoys the different steaks great Argentina Restaurant and the staff is always very attentive.

author: Abhilash M. Prasad
review_text: This place is the perfect example of why you should never judge a book by its cover. I walked in casually, not expecting anything special, and the inside completely surprised me. The vibe was great, the cafe was much better than it looked from outside, and their latte was genuinely amazing. I was extremely satisfied and would definitely recommend this spot.

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: Hafizun Mushtafa
review_text: Perhaps one of the best chicken rice I have ever tasted. Ever. Sadly we went here when our tummy is a bit full so we cannot fully feel the taste of this nasi ayam. Even so, the taste when our stomach is full is still damn delicious. The nasi ayam perfect 10 out of 10, got choices between steam and roasted. Both are great. One thing that caught my attention was the rice ball. I thought it was just a plain ball with rice taste but it was good. Feel like a soup in the form of rice. The portion is fair and the price is a bit high lah but deserve with the quality. The service is good, the worker is nice and the waiting time is not that long too. The restaurant is clean and comfortable. We went during weekend afternoon and there are less customers during our visit. Fast forward to 10 minutes, there are already a long queue waiting for turn. limited seating available for sure. I guess we are the lucky customers. We look through the hall and saw a lot of prominent figures and famous artists already went here.

author: Sai Kaushik Duvvur
review_text: Dorian was an amazing host and took real great care of us, we really loved the food and the ambience is great! My wife loved the custom print on her and hot chocolate which they do. Would definitely come back!

author: Sweetprincess Honey
review_text: We visited this well-known restaurant two days ago, popular among both Malaysians and Indonesians. We arrived around 11 a.m., just before the lunch crowd, and there were only one or two groups ahead of us on the waiting list. The staff took our name and asked us to wait nearby. After about 5–6 minutes, we were called in. Before entering, we were informed of a 2-hour dining time limit, which was understandable due to the restaurant’s popularity. A staff member guided us to our table, and we were provided with menu books (quite thick with many choices) and the option to scan a QR code for digital ordering. We took about 10 minutes to decide and ended up ordering: • Nasi Bakar Ayam Asap – wrapped in banana leaf, tasted good with generous filling, though the flavor was more subtle. • Nasi Goreng Sapi (forgot the exact name)– delicious, slightly spicy, and served in a generous portion. We only ordered small mineral water, as we weren’t too hungry and had already had a lot of sweet food and drinks earlier. As for the environment, the place felt crowded and a bit cramped. The tables were quite close to each other, and it was noisy, especially with a nearby family talking loudly. The walking space between aisles was narrow, and on our way out, it was a bit confusing to navigate due to partitions separating sections. I even ended up in the wrong aisle before finding the right way out.

author: Raymond Chua
review_text: Great food. Nice atmosphere. But all self service. And the self-service system is a bit messy. Suitable for patient person. The food taste sooooo good and the price is reasonable.

author: Hoover E Londono
review_text: I lived in Brazil 7 years eating here is like being in Brazil . The beer the food the beef

author: Andrew Levenson
review_text: Tonino was a gem! Delicious food and wonderful service. I enjoyed the pasta, Pizza Bianca and tiramisu. I will say, though, try Via Cannuci nearby. Less hype, but IMO it’s equally delicious and much easier to get into. Leave extra time to find parking!

author: Sara Kazemi
review_text: I was visiting New York, and my friends had secured a reservation here weeks in advance — and I can see why! The vibes were immaculate — a perfect blend of modern and Persian aesthetics. The music, the staff, the atmosphere — everything was spot on. We ordered the Barbare bread with masto moosir, the octopus kebab, the kashkeh bademjoon, and the kebab — every single dish was incredible. The flavors were authentic yet elevated, enhancing traditional Persian spices beautifully. This was hands down one of the best Persian meals I’ve ever had outside of someone’s home. 10/10 — if you haven’t tried it yet, you need to. Absolutely amazing! I will deff be going back here when I come to New York again

author: C Perry
review_text: We had such a great time here, again! We tried it last December and were pleasantly surprised. We love the Mahi tacos and the Wahoo Fish Dip was fantastic. The service was super friendly and made the whole experience easy and enjoyable. Alex, our server, was very accommodating which makes the experience so much better. The tables were comfy, and we love the view. Definitely one of the highlights that brings us back. The food was delicious, and the atmosphere made it even better. Everything just came together for a really fun afternoon out. We’ll definitely be coming back!

author: Kelly Bradbury
review_text: Perfect views, breezy, tropical; you can’t get anymore South Florida fun than Le Tub! Situated on the water of the intracoastal in beautiful Hollywood, Le Tub offers delicious appetizers and main dishes. Our family enjoyed the Caesar salad, Mahi sandwich, and every bite of Le Tub’s renowned hamburger. Our server, Jay, was friendly and professional. Our drinks were always refreshed when needed and our meals beautifully served. I highly recommend Le Tub for its delicious, fresh menu choices, excellent service, and delightful location. Pro tip: if needed, there is plenty of metered parking across the street (and a short walk) from the restaurant.

author: Muge Selcuk
review_text: We had lunch at Holbox around noon, and even with the line, we were seated in less than 30 minutes. The service was warm, friendly, and quick. The food was excellent — we tried the sea urchin, grilled branzino, octopus, smoked fish and scallop tacos, and churros. Every bite was fresh, flavorful, and well-balanced. Despite being a Michelin-starred restaurant, the prices were quite reasonable. Watching the chef chat with guests added a personal touch. Overall, everything — food, service, and value — came together perfectly. We’re definitely planning to return and try the tasting menu.

author: Daisy Linares
review_text: The place is very beautiful and unique. The food was amazing. Love the mojarra frita. It was amazing 😋🥰🥰😍 The restrooms are very clean and very beautifully decorated.

author: mimi
review_text: Loved this place! The food was fantastic, and the service was top-notch. Our server (DICKY) was awesome—friendly, quick, and very helpful. Can’t wait to come back!q

author: The MY World
review_text: It's Phở restaurant, which was selected as "Selected" by Michelin. Actually I visited here long time ago but I cannot remember how they were, so I tried again. When I visited this time, it was rainning so not so many customers were coming. Then I had Pho Tap Cam (all in), then it came within a minute!! The fastest serving in Michelin Pho Lol. Anyway, The pho was quite standard and tastes good. Perfect as standard but not special. The price is a bit pricy due to Michelin. If you are looking for the The Standard Phở, then it's nice place to visit.

author: RG K
review_text: Great team & service. Everyone is sharp, attentive & Pleasent. Clean place. Burgers are nicely assembled beautifully.

author: NiMan Liu
review_text: It was pretty busy, but once someone came over to help us an excellent dinner took place. Steak medium rare was cooked perfect. Red snapper had a fantastic crisp. Candied yam was to die for. Edit: Red velvet cake and banana bread pudding was amazing. Too bad they ran out of peach cobbler, definitely coming back to try that.

author: Gildwen LE FERREC
review_text: A known place for the coffee drinkers. Great busy-coffee « bar » where one can meet friends, do some coworking in dedicated spots, enjoy the taste of coffee and learn new grain type and tastes. They have great food as well and really offer a precise coffee making. Highly recommend!

author: CM Teo
review_text: First visit after so many years, Nicely Renovated, Clean bright and Neat set up. Food portion was good and tasty. Friendly staff and good service. Happy with the "New Feel" Will definitely come back for the Food again! Recommended....

author: Donnie Biederman
review_text: Our group did the Lip Smacking Foodie tour. This was one of our stops. They have a great selection of beer and mixed drinks. My favorite was the deviled eggs. Awesome atmosphere here. I plan on returning.

author: Ciara T
review_text: We had to go to the Japanese Consulate and were so happy to find this food hall right next door. The food was really good and it seemed very clean and new. There weren’t a lot of people in the middle of the day. I’d love to try all the restaurants.

author: Super Fragrance
review_text: Ordered small ckt for $4.50 Pros Taste. Sweet but I guess more important spicy which brought out the savoriness. Many fresh hum. At least relatively speaking. It is not a big plate but quite a few hum. Bloodiness adds to the taste. Eggs is also very distinctive cooked. Cons Well it is meant to be halal. Not halal certified but owner is Muslim. So no lup cheong or pork lard to go with it. Sadly. Still a delicious plate

author: Jen Legere
review_text: Lots of great flavor in every dish. No salt on the table, which was fine for most dishes except the Caesar salad, which was surprisingly bland and unremarkable given the very high quality of the other dishes. The beef Wellington was incredible. Let’s talk about gluten allergies: yes there are menu options. The lobster risotto can be made GF without the crispy onions, salad with no croutons, etc. I was disappointed that there was not a GF dessert option. There are so many incredible GF dessert options to include on a menu, I was really shocked that Gordon Ramsey lacked the innovation and forethought to approach dessert with intention. The coco old fashioned was delicious and became dessert instead. Expensive for the size of the drink, but the ice cube was fancy.

restaurant: Song Fa Bak Kut Teh 11 New Bridge Road
author: Alex Wong
review_text: This is my first time trying Singapore bak kut teh. I'm impressed with the Michelin Bib Gourmand achievement, and they have their own uniqueness tastes as compared to Malaysia bak kut teh. To be honest, I loved both of them. There is nothing to compare about who is having the best bak kut teh between the 2 countries. However, 1 thing I learned from Song Fa is the proper way to drink Chinese tea, and it shouldn't be soaked in the teapot for more than 20 seconds. Otherwise, it will taste bitter. This is one thing which is not "educated" in the famous Malaysia Klang bak kut teh. Therefore, an additional point for Song Fa. I even went to have my dinner on the second night at The Centrepoint outlet. I will definitely be back again in the future.

author: WDG Dingguo
review_text: Classic hawker centre that was renovated. Better ventilation, seating and lighting

author: Food lover
review_text: The noodles is pretty good not too soggy, but I do find the price high in terms of ingredients. A bowl almost $5 comes with 3 wantan and some minced pork and noodles. I ordered the dry noodles but cook gave me soup noodles. Didn't want to disrupt the queue behind so accepted sadly... A bowl of fish ball soup for $5 only came with 9 fish balls..

author: Ankit Kapoor
review_text: Friendly staff, best view., the chicken grill balinese meal and vegetarian pasta options were also excellent. Our server made sure to add and amend non veg pasta to veg pasta. We were at Malini to celebrate my husband's birthday and thank you 'Wan' for making the moment special by arranging pastry.. Whether you visit for a romantic sunset dinner or a leisurely weekend lunch, the view is always mesmerizing. A must-visit coastal gem — come for the view, stay for the food. Perfect for special occasions, date nights, or simply to unwind with the ocean as your backdrop. for us.

author: Igha Ayemi
review_text: Pho Vietnam was one of the highlights of my trip. The food was so good that I came back a second time. Impeccable hygiene, fast and organised staff, and outstanding flavours. Truly deserving of its Michelin recognition. A must visit!

author: Marika de Nie
review_text: The Jamaican Jerk wrap aka Roti. Was absolutely delicious! I’m a big foodie and I love West Indian/Caribbean food. The flavors were amazing. I had it with the cabbage mango salsa. And the plantain that had cinnamon spice. The flavors were absolute magic in my mouth . The only downfall, but I didn’t give it a lower rating. Because everything was so good everything was so clean and great service. Was I wished it was a real authentic roti wrap versus a tortilla wrap. With the flavors made up for it. I will order from there again.

author: Sharlene Marie
review_text: Some of the best flavors. It was definitely a flavorful culinary experience!

author: Lim EV
review_text: Greeted by whiffs of freshly baked bread and pastries… delightful as we were lost for choices what to buy. Obviously forgot to take photos of all the goodies we bought but I will list them down. 6 cream puff - delightful light cream and decadently sinful 4 egg tarts - bigger than my palm 1 butter raisin bun - thick gluten sins 1 butter purple potato bun - a bit healthier but that is just me justifying my purchase 1 sourdough cranberry loaf - oh so good 1 English muffins - received nod of approval from wife and everyone that was in the bakery 1 cheese corn bread - daughter ate it quietly no sharing Total damage 80.10. Well worth it as it accompanied us from Penang back home, and we had them for breakfast till 2 days after.

author: Dee D'Cruz
review_text: Great little restaurant with very reasonable prices and huge variety of food, fresh seafood and even specialties like frogs legs which we tried! We sat in the air conditioned restaurant and had probably the best Pad Thai of our trip! The fried rice and pork omelette were also delicious and we loved the Morning Glory (love adding some greens)! Bonus points for the Iced Thai Tea being served ice cold and delicious!

author: An Le
review_text: I had one of the best meals in Bali here. To start with, the restaurant was really responsive and nice to accommodate our change of plan. Overall, the dinner was amazing with the salmon roe and tuna, beef tartare, potato mille being the highlight. And you cannot miss their amazing dessert. We ordered a frozen cheesecake and it was so creamy, refreshing, and not too sweet. My partner and I went here for a birthday dinner and we got a complimentary guava tart. The tart was delicious, soft, fruity. We will definitely come back to this place for celebration!

author: A J
review_text: This place has been on my list for years. Food was absolutely excellent! A bit pricey for the portions but we will be coming back here again. Everything was tapas size including the larger dishes. We ordered the charbroiled oysters, steak tartare, tomato bread, seared foie, bavette steak and arroz bec. Charbroiled Oysters - wonderful flavor of smokey with the mild oyster taste. A bit pricey at $8 per piece but would absolutely order again Steak tartare - My only critique would be that the steak tartare had a bit too much brine that overpowered the steak flavor but it was still quite good Tomato bread - can’t go wrong with this to complement the meal Seared Foie - loved the combination of flavors. Definitely combine each bite with the sweet and salty sauces on the dish Bavette Steak - made perfectly rare as we ordered despite the thinner cut of meat. Both he steak and roasted vegetable relish was had an amazing Smokey flavor! Only comment would be to have the relish warm instead of cold Arroz Bec - added this last minute to give one of the rice dishes a try. The combination of mushrooms, sausage and aioli with the rice was delicious. We couldn’t finish to wrapped up to go home and my husband ate it before the end of the night lol The establishment also only does wine so unfortunately no beers and cocktails. We didn’t ask but would be interested to know if they allowed customers to also BYOB. Looking forward to going back!

author: Hamilton
review_text: Great pizza and pasta, not a fan of the pork chop with apricot jam, too dry. Be aware, the pasta is quite “al dente”. Obviously over-priced for what is basically a good pasta ($26 to $50 pastas)

author: Ardelia Jane Suhardi
review_text: Seven Kingdom is a great spot if you’re looking for a restaurant with a strong concept and a comfortable atmosphere. The interior feels well-designed and inviting, making it suitable for both casual dining and special occasions.

author: Valorie Chadwick
review_text: This is by far my favorite small-business coffee shop. They always bring my order to my table, and they’ve always been so friendly. Conversational, but respectful when I’m trying to work. They make their own homemade syrups and the coffee comes from a good source, so the flavor is always great. Aesthetic atmosphere, clean tables, chill music, comfortable temperature (they don’t complain if you adjust the window shades). I especially love the adorable book and plant shop in the back. Also, as someone with a service dog, I super appreciate that the owner seems educated on ADA laws, so I feel comfortable coming into Savor without expecting to run into people’s untrained pets. They also have coffee-with-a-cop days so I love how they actively take steps to make the community feel more safe. Hands down the most comfortable coffee shop in Vegas.

author: Jeremy C
review_text: A bit of a hidden gem in the area. Good food at reasonable price. Friendly service. The mee goreng is really good. My personal go-to for Mee Goreng Mamak when I'm in the area. If that guy is frying as you walk by, you will smell the lovely mouthwatering aroma. The nasi kandar has a few highlights but I wouldn't say it's groundbreaking.

author: Ryan LaFebre
review_text: It breaks my heart to have to change my rating from 5 to 3. I've been coming here since 2016 but unfortunately they've changed for the worse. The tacos are just different and not as good. This change started at some point during Covid and I was hoping it was temporary. It's not. Tacos are maybe more oily and a different type of corn tortilla? And they got rid of the amazing roasted jalapeños that used to go so well with the original tacos. I really wish they'd raise prices instead of making the food less tasty and offering only the cold, canned, pickled jalapenos that aren't worth eating. I miss the amazing, original Tacos El Gavilon 😔

author: 龔振勝
review_text: Let me say: I LOVE the fact that they make the shells fresh on-the-spot (got that extra corn flavor) and it's pressed right in front of you. Plus you can see them grill everything right there. Pretty self-explanatory: You start at the end of the line where the menu is. You let the lady making the shells know what you want, and she'll start the shells for those items, then you confirm with the next guy cutting up the stuff what kind of meat, so he'll cut it up and throw them on the shells once they're grilled correctly. Any more from the grill is the next guy over, but if you're good, you can skip straight to paying where you can get a drink. Horchata tasted good too! One thing to note: When the guy asked "Que carne?" (What meat?) My cousin said something in the most gringo accent there was. Homeboy's face got contorted as he tried to guess what she meant. Yo, give her a break, she's from Chicago, she's about as white as they come, but she tried. 🤣

author: Shelley Goh
review_text: Food quality is good but not exceptional. It’s standard Nasi Lemak fare. Rice portion is abit too small. Also, there is no itemized breakdown of ordered items in the receipt. Hard to know if I’m being charged correctly. Just got to have faith in the cashier and pray they don’t make a mistake. It will be great if the business can work to improve on transparency in this area.

author: Jehna Liddle
review_text: Amazing Pork Ribs for amazing price! Could never find something like this in Australia, so we went twice! Beautiful food in a lovely complex! Pork is very special in Bali so they do it incredibly well. Ice cream next door was fantastic too!

restaurant: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup Pte Ltd
author: Marcuz Pae
review_text: walking distance from kembangan MRT, excellent place to have tzechar if you are willing to wait since there’s lots of people on the weekend. their signature is the black chicken herbal soup, the flavour of the soup is quite clear with a mild umani taste. the must order carbs will be the crispy bee hoon, with the mee sua. in addition, meat dishes you can order the pork belly, prawn paste chicken and the steamed pork, perfect for a family dinner near the MRT.

author: Christopher Kong
review_text: I had some business in the area and want something to eat and thought about Bunna! I had no reservations and had about a 20-30 minute wait on a Saturday night. I am now convinced this is the BEST Ethiopian place for great vegetarian food! The place was packed even as late as I arrived. Very warm and accommodating staff. The food was so on point! We ordered drinks as well and just as amazing as the food! It is a little out of my normal area but I will surely go out of my way to get back here again.

restaurant: Bamee Kon Sae Lee Thong Lo
author: Thep Tan
review_text: Easy peasy. Good selection, friendly staff. The broth was ok, a little bland but you can season it to your taste. Overall the food was good enough that I will come back for a quick meal. We had 3 noodle dishes with wontons and fried pork, crab fried rice and 1 watermelon drink. The total was 360THB

author: Sibyl Tate
review_text: I booked my set meal thru pelago, and the manager acknowledged it at the reception. They served our meal quite fast. But the drinks selection is very limited. When we wanted to add a platter, the waitress advised us about the size of the platter and suggested us some other choices. I really appreciate that she wasn’t hard selling and think we wouldn’t able to finish our food. Thanks a lot 🫶🏻

restaurant: Thunderbolt Tea by Boon Lay Traditional Hakka Lui Cha
author: Lee Poco
review_text: Small corner shop selling the best lei cha in Singapore! Recommend the brown rice and add the extra fried pork belly if you like.

author: PhilYouIn
review_text: Small restaurant with nice decor, seating inside and on the sidewalk. Service is professional but not particularly friendly. Prices are steep, and the food is good, but you do not get what you pay for. Zucchini flower is served in a drab plate, all alone. We had to ask for a side of marinara sauce. And although my chicken and mashed potatoes were also delicious, would it have really hurt their bottom line to throw in a vegetable? One broccoli floret? A single asparagus stalk, perhaps? (Check out my photos) What really irked me was the cocktails. If you’re gonna charge $17 for a drink, you had better make it right. Taste and presentation. They failed horribly. Moscow Mule did not taste like a Mule, and was served in a gin & tonic glass. Old Fashioned was served with half a dozen ice cubes and the incorrect garnish. One visit was enough.

author: Kiều Nguyễn Thị
review_text: The space is quite nice and the drinks are excellent, especially the coconut coffee, which I really liked. However, the staff’s attitude was truly disappointing. They didn’t seem cheerful or friendly, and appeared irritated with customers. I noticed one staff member (K. Linh), whose attitude was particularly bad — definitely not suitable for the service industry. Good drinks won’t make customers come back if the service is poor. On the bright side, the manager was friendly, calm, and had a good attitude.

author: Nindita L
review_text: A memorable evening at Phoenix Gastrobar by Holywings ✨ Crispy bites, sizzling skewers, comforting pasta and hearty mains paired with creative cocktails, all enjoyed in a breathtaking interior with stunning design details. The live band and grand bar ambience made the night truly special. 🎶🍸

author: 68_10_Lê Hồng Hảo
review_text: Tasty food, kinda hot but it doesn't matter since the service overall wasn't bad

author: Kent Rasmussen
review_text: If you’re looking for authentic, energetic, and rich Latin culture, Mamacitas is the spot on the Broadwalk. You’re met with vibrant energy from the moment you arrive—live music or a DJ spinning Latin beats, strong margaritas that hit just right, and a menu full of bold, flavorful dishes. The food is fantastic—fresh, in generous portions, and delicious. Whether you’re there for a casual afternoon lunch or a lively night out, Mamacitas delivers the whole experience. Highly recommend if you want to soak in the sights, sounds, and tastes of Latin culture right on the beach.

author: Ryan Tammaro
review_text: Super light slice with a nice blend of cheese and sauce but a crisp slice. It’s excellent! Loved the chocolate chip cookie but probably not worth $4 You’ll have to contend with a line and likely limited to no seating but worth it for this slice!

author: Yoandra R
review_text: Amazing view and music 🎶 We had a great time and enjoyed the food. Had the biggest drinks I’ve ever had in my life. Hopefully I will get to visit it again.

author: Ashley Chance
review_text: My picky daughter even loved it. Fast, friendly, and absolutely delicious.

author: Sharmaine T
review_text: Great service and lovely ambience. The food was served well and on time. However, overall the dishes were a tad salty. The sticky rice with the fried chicken wing was dry and slightly undercooked, and the whole crab in the vermicelli dish wasn’t very fresh. The yellow curry crab also had noticeably less meat compared to our previous visit. We’d still like to give the CentralWorld outlet a try next time.

author: P R
review_text: Reasonable price for beef dishes. Ordered beef rice bowl and beef truffles fried dumplings. They are delicious. The atmosphere is good and photogenic. Staffs are having well mannered.

author: Nguyen Van
review_text: The ambiance is beautiful, the food is delicious, and the prices are reasonable. The staff are enthusiastic and take good care of the customers.

author: Kora Blair
review_text: What can I say? The food is delectable and the service: exceptional! It taste like a bit of my childhood. I just love being in La Lechonera and enjoying the cuisine! I wish they offered seating. I’d love to sit down and have a proper Puerto Rican meal!

author: Ashley T (Shark and Eagle)
review_text: It’s honestly pretty good, compare to other pho place, I wish they have special beef( combination of all type of meat like we do back in Melbourne). The price is reasonable with choices of sizes!! That’s really good because I just want small dishes.

author: Ab Raham
review_text: Had best experience ever for a store. They were closing and and we ordered food and they had pretty much every option and served food happily

author: Darlene Laplante
review_text: I’ve been driving past this place for a while as it’s on a “trucker’s road”. TikTok led me here and I’m glad it did cause the food , the live DJ on weekends and the calm atmosphere was. 10/10!

author: CLAUDIA
review_text: I read many different comments here but for my taste it's already perfect. Although i can't give it a 5 because the chicharron kerupuk isn't really tasty. But the other meatier taste so good! :) And don't forget to ask for more of the sambal cause they will only give you a little. The rice portion here is also not so big, so if you need more just ask for rice cause they already give you lots of food on the menu. It's a big place but after lunch time it get pretty crowded. Parking lot is big but mainly for motorcycle only. The toilet is just okay, but it's a wet toilet.

author: Cheryl Valentina
review_text: Who doesn’t love The Cheescake Factory! The prices are great and the quantity is humungous and its too hard for two people to even have a single dish! Go as a 3 people and you can still try maybe 3 dishes and top off with a dessert! We had the Nachos and damn they tasted amazing! Have to go back here!

author: Nizzam
review_text: ✅ Ayam bawang relatively delicious ✅ Flavours are beautifully balanced ✅ Place is relatively clean and ample seating ✅ Shorter waiting time ✅ Above average price tag 💢 Its a long queue all the time even weekdays 💢 Limited and paid parking

author: brandi brady
review_text: I really enjoyed every bite and the service was great! the server had lots of great suggestions on food & pairings. we were a party of 4, walk in. for me, it makes it extra special when you stand in line for a seat & secure it in the first seatings. the hiramasa & green tomatoes are my fav, the glazed beetroot & mushroom toast were great. the mackerel was good, it didn’t knock my socks off the way everything else did. looking forward to when I can get over there for lunch!

author: Lizzie Maltby
review_text: Reasonable price for what we got. We got the piglet combo, which was nice but needed sauce adding to it. We also got the Notorious P.I.G, which was good but also could do with some sort of sauce as it was a bit dry. Overall it was a good brunch place.

author: Anaïs I.
review_text: Photos by @anais.ia My favorite place. The food is ALWAYS clean and amazing. The staff is sweet and place amazing for breakfast lunch dinner or chill. Can you tell I am into avocado toast too much =)

author: darren peng
review_text: Located not far from Bui Vien Walking Street, this charming family-run restaurant may not catch your eye from the outside, but don't let appearances deceive you. The owners' warmth and hospitality instantly make you feel at home, while the food is nothing short of amazing. After enjoying a delightful dinner on our first day in Ho Chi Minh, we're already planning to return for another culinary adventure. Their menu boasts a diverse selection of dishes, but it's their delectable fried chow fun and bitter melon egg that truly steal the show.

author: Sung Long
review_text: The newly renovated MacPherson Market & Food Centre is very much cleaner with new floorings, fittings and seatings. The price and quality of foods are reasonable and good. All these give patrons and a more pleasant and delightful experience.

author: trinity connor
review_text: Beautiful atmosphere, amazing service, all the staff here are very lovely and attentive!! So kind, all are very good at speaking english. We got the seafood basket, it was succulent amazing asian seasoning on the seafood, the crab and lobster were very soft and yummy. Drinks were good also

author: Talia Yohai
review_text: Very good poke and even better thanks to the student discount!

author: Albert Foodie
review_text: The chicken texture is smooth and tasty The laksa soup has rich coconut flavors. Not too impressed with their fried items. Overall very good chicken rice and laksa

author: Mark Czako
review_text: It’s always a pleasure to come here! I always get seated and served within a couple of minutes the waiters/waitresses are very kind (important to note that I sit down at the bar most of the time). The only thing this specific Texas Roadhouse could improve on is the Steak Fries… Sometimes come out cold, but overall they could have a little more crunch. The sirloins are top quality, I never had to chew on some raw portion. Clean meat, properly grilled! Highly recommend this restaurant!

author: jayne lee
review_text: Came to 4P pizza twice during my trip to Danang. People told me it's overrated but i beg to differ. The quality of the ingredients were so good, price point is decent, the service staffs attention to details were immaculate! Best part was they allowed half & half pizza flavours and have options of Small or Large Burrata! Tried the bolognese pasta, crab pasta, tiramisu, panna cotta. Pizza flavours we had Large burrata parma ham on both days, another flavour was salmon miso and the other was scallop gratin. totally recommended to drizzle the honey and chilli oil on their burrata pizza! It will make a huge difference Staffs were very well train as upon ordering the panna cotta they will mention that the fruits will be sour and they let you decide :) they also provided wait time of pasta/pizzas. Counter seats are totally recommended if you like to watch how they do their operations.

author: Noam Kaniel
review_text: Excellent Asian Restaurant in Brickell. Very good food. Trendy and noisy atmosphere with DJ but the music is not too loud. Big menu, so I’ll come back to try some other things. I recommend!!

author: Alicia Johnson
review_text: Food was Nice and delicious, service was okay just Nice But not worth the price. Was way too expensive and the quantity of Food is very less. Can eat for once on ur own tidak as its too expensive for a chicken rice . The amount of rice and chicken we received for two people is so so less But the price is was too much . I literally paid RM 41 for two people.. once again not worth the price. And yes definitely i am not coming back.

author: Santos Gil
review_text: I really enjoy eating here. The food is consistently good, the restaurant is neat and tidy, and the staff are always cheerful and professional.

author: Glara Y.
review_text: I honestly don’t understand why this place is getting bashed. We almost skipped it because of the reviews, but tried it in the end at my son’s insistence - and we’re so glad we did! The fried rice came out in about 10 minutes and was so tasty that we finished every grain on the plate. It goes perfectly with their chili sauce. The satay was great too. My suggestion: don’t read too much into the reviews - just give this place a try!

restaurant: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือชูเจริญChoo Ja Roean Boat Noodles
author: buck low
review_text: Simply Heaven! The soup is thick and full of umami. Bigger in portion and price is even more reasonable than those already famous.

author: Janet
review_text: Yum chicken cesar salad. The staff worked quickly and friendly and they were busy. Definitely coming back. 🤠😁 🥗🍴 Update Had a tropi chop so good! Oh the ropa vieja is so 🤤 delicious 🔥🫶 The fried chicken cilantro tropi chop with avocado is delicious 🤤

author: Choon T
review_text: Yam rice in BM is very similar to 猪杂汤 in Singapore. Flavours were authentic and the braised pork trotters were very good too. The chilli paste with the dark soya sauce was perfect to go with the ingredients and rice.

author: I'm Done
review_text: A wide variety of dim sum options at very affordable prices, a table full of food for four cost us only 700 THB. Service was great and the space itself was roomy and comfortable. However, one downside I would say was the staff's overwhelming presence. We were the only customers at the time, and over 10 staff members gathered closely around our table, watching us intently. I understand they wanted to provide prompt service, but it felt a bit excessive, a little more personal space for us would be so much better 😂

author: FINESS917
review_text: I had chicken with rice and beans. The portion was a lot. But the flavor was ok. It was seasoned but tasted like all the season was on the skin of the chicken. Whatever the season is , it gives off a bit too salty taste. The chicken itself was grilled fine.

author: Thuong Thuong
review_text: Today I stopped by a small restaurant in the center of District 1, and as soon as I entered, I felt the familiar feeling of "Mother's cooking", reminding me of my hometown's dinner every afternoon. The wooden tables and chairs were simple, not fancy, but cozy in a very Vietnamese style. I ordered a small tray: stir-fried squash with garlic, sour soup with snakehead fish, and sweet and salty braised ribs. In the heart of bustling Saigon, sitting down to eat these rustic dishes naturally made me feel light, like temporarily escaping the noise to return to the kitchen of my childhood. It was just a normal meal, but it was delicious in a way that I would remember for a long time.

author: Shella Yuridasari
review_text: Hype of the town. Came in the morning to get a Pain au Suisse and a cup of medium hot cappuccino. The pastry tasted good, coffee was ok. Would like to try other menu. They serve various pastry, desserts main courses, coffee and non coffee drinks. They have spacious downstairs and upstairs seating area. Bike is the best transport if you want to visit.

author: francis montgomery
review_text: It was cold and we found soup. Won ton soup with delicious won tons and baby bok choy that was vibrant while tender...so tender. The broth was light, not salty. We also enjoyed soup dumplings that were so fresh, hot, and tasty, the black vinegar with slivers of ginger. As well as the won tons in chili sauce (yes, please...to embarrassed to order second serving) Salt and Pepper chicken wangs with light coating that remained crispy. Oh, the marinaded cucumbers were a fresh, delicious and seasoned with a nice Chile. The price of some dishes were only $12.50, while others were $9.95 cucumbers were $6.50. We are willing to take MUNI in order to avoid looking for parking. F-LINE here we come.

author: Yaz F A
review_text: Good food and friendly staff. Chicken porridge was delicious

author: Aulia Rahman Putra (Aulia Putra)
review_text: A restaurant serving Tahitian-inspired cuisine. A pleasant place with friendly and welcoming service. The food is quite interesting, with a wide variety of dishes. A pleasant place to enjoy the evening with seafood specialties and warm drinks.

author: Joseph Siraki
review_text: This place was the best hookah lounge we have been in Miami! Amazing service by Zlata and her tea recommendation was absolutely great! Will be coming back for sure! And will let my friends who are visiting Miami to come here!

author: Calbee Cracker
review_text: Fresh seafood, delicious zhi char dishes and freebies to munch on. Their satay is a must try! Price is fair and no service charge even though they are so friendly and helpful. I will gladly bring family and tourist here.

author: abdul AM
review_text: One of the most important and beautiful activities in Thailand is visiting the night markets and experiencing the food and the wonderful atmosphere.

author: Harry Kek
review_text: Plenty of food choices and the prices generally are cheaper than most other hawker centers. NEA should look into the cleanliness of the place. The regulatory supervision and compliance are bad because some of the stores put their things outside the stalls. The floors are generally not that clean and a lot of common areas are not clean. Just compare to the present Beach Rd hawker centre and you can see the vast difference.

author: Kim Tannu
review_text: I needed a restaurant for a repast, I had less than 3 days to book a place and the amount of people went from 30-50 to 75-80. Diana was amazing, she worked with me on the menu to accommodate the few vegetarians we had and was able to work out final details and get me all the paperwork via email and texts so I didn't have to drive there. She was professional, responsive and easy to work with. I had dined at the old Coach House Diner many times but never at CH Steakhouse and was nervous about the quality but the food was delicious! Everything was well seasoned and all th entrees came with mashed potatoes and vegetables. It was such a large crowd yet the filet mignon was cooked perfectly. Those that ordered the Dill Salmon and Chicken Marsala also enjoyed their meals. The onion soup I had to begin the meal and cheesecake that ended the meal were also wonderful. Even the cabernet that was included in our package was so much better than I expected. Our section's server, Albert was amazing and did everything in his power to make sure everyone was taken care of. I could not ask for a better experience especially on such short notice. It was well worth the price. Next time I'm in that area, I will definitely book a table!

author: James Wong
review_text: A restaurant that could be plucked right out of Philly, Lucino’s serves good pizza and even better authentic Philly cheesesteaks and other fares in an environment that celebrates the reigning NFL Super Bowl champion Eagles. Serving sizes are generous and in today’s environment can be considered decent value. Add a trivia night that is hosted one night every other week and you have a restaurant that deserves regular visits.

author: Kahani Patel
review_text: Elephante is such a vibe. The cocktails were excellent — super balanced and really well made. The standout dish for me was the whipped eggplant; honestly one of the best things on the menu. Fresh, flavorful, and addictive. Great atmosphere, great service. Perfect spot for a night out.

author: Wholesome CBD & Supplements
review_text: The food was fast, the server staff is friendly and helpful with their menu, and the restaurant is clean. We were able to eat in their 50's Diner Car which adding a nice ambiance to our meal. The music was family friendly and the price for their pancake special was affordable. The food was delicious and we will be back!!!

author: Padma Janki
review_text: Lovely place to eat and drink, the cocktails are amazing. Delicious jerk salmon, yum. Take a walk around here, there are lovely little restaurants and shops along the river.

author: Shikhar
review_text: Their daily chicken Thalis were just delicious. The chicken was just cooked perfectly and their vegetarian dish and daal went so well with the rice. The naans were soft and slightly puffy just like the way I like it. Overall the atmosphere was very good too. I watched yje chelsea vs psg Club World Cup match while eating. I really enjoyed my meal and overall experience a lot.

author: Joshua Young
review_text: Fun local deli right next to a fire station, so you know the food is legit. Staffs were friendly. Portions were large. Grown-up Grilled Cheese was delicious. The BBQ brisket were tender and melts in my mouth. Steaktip sub was huge, my friend couldn't even finish. Can't go wrong with steak tips plus peppers and onions.

author: Puti Adissa
review_text: This place is a must visit! All the food is absolutely delicious and definitely worth the wait😍😍 My biggest tip is to come early, even before they open, so you don't have to wait in a long line. The egg tarts are the star🥰 they are incredibly fresh and superrr flakyy🫶🏻The drinks are great too! Don't forget to grab their sachet coffee as a souvenir. The only downside is that the nastar cookies are really hard to find; they seem to be sold out at every location.

author: Bryan (SMAD)
review_text: We had a fantastic dining experience at Geylang Lor 9 Fresh Frog Porridge (芽笼九巷活田鸡)! The frog porridge here is absolutely delicious and lived up to all the great reviews we've heard. The frog meat was tender and flavorful, cooked to perfection. The white porridge was very well done, smooth and comforting with just the right consistency. We also recommend the homemade fried prawns—the chilli sauce had a perfect balance of spicy and sour. The stingray was also very well done, adding to the variety of tasty dishes. It's a pity the cockles were not available during our visit, but we still had an amazing meal. However, the staff could improve their professionalism. They announced the overall bill amount out front, which felt a bit rude. It would be better if they asked how we would like to make payment and guided us downstairs to settle the bill before eating. Despite this, the restaurant has a lively atmosphere, and the food quality makes it a true gem for food lovers. If you're in the Geylang area and looking for a unique and tasty meal, we highly recommend trying this place!

author: Ms Flo
review_text: My husband and I visited the Miam Cafe located in Miami about a week ago while we were in town. We were greeted promptly upon arrival. We then proceeded to the register to place our order. Once our order was ready, it was brought out to our table. They looked to be a little short staffed on this particular day, although I'm unsure if this is the typical set up regarding the number of staff daily. However, it didn't hinder them from getting the orders out in a timely fashion. The food was fresh, hot and delicious when it arrived. The cashier/waitress checked on us quite frequently despite her being the only one working both the register and waiting tables. Would definitely return to this location.

author: Joanne PeaceMind
review_text: Giving 3 stars because no aircon quite hot to eat. Overall price is the cheapest of all. Just located beside Bedok Mall so it is very convenient location. Can use PayLah n PayNow. CDC vouchers too. Sheltered from Bedok mall to here. Nice. Please keep food this affordable, thank you.

author: Monica Tudor
review_text: Sun Sun exceeded my expectations! The grilled duck was juicy with perfectly crisp skin, and the coconut pancakes were heavenly. Friendly service and a relaxed vibe. Highly recommend!

author: Duyên Kỳ (My)
review_text: Quality food, lots of it, reasonable price, fruit dessert ok, thank you Thu Ha for serving my table, taking care of customers ❤️ Hot pot adds +20k per person, quite ok

author: Fairy
review_text: The flaky curry chicken puff was delicious, with a generous portion of filling. However, the teh C was mediocre—the tea lacked flavour and wasn’t particularly enjoyable. Service was good and fast.

author: Ryan
review_text: They messed up on my friends order, but did give him a voucher for free burrito.. I guess that makes up for it. My order was fine. And taco bell always delivers..

author: L Chan
review_text: Lots of well-loved & famous hawker stalls in one big place. Atmosphere is lively & welcoming. Nearest MSCP with linked sheltered walkway is block 88A

author: Paul Y
review_text: The owner of this restaurant was cocky and rude. A guy selling Hainanese chicken rice who couldn’t even say a word in Hainanese. When I courteously and gently asked where we could get the chicken soup like last time, after we had been waiting for more than 10 mins when all dishes were served, thinking it could’ve been a self service; instead of addressing our need, he turned around, out of nowhere accused us to his team that we were impatient. If this owner runs a business of this size with reasonable quality of food, he should have known how to treat his clients well. Shame on this owner !

author: Dhanush Sirohi
review_text: Love this place! It’s a hidden gem Chowmein and momos are so tasty. True Nepalese taste. It’s must visit if you are around. The owner is also very friendly and lovely. Would definitely visit again.

author: Ni
review_text: This rooftop restaurant is worth checking out if you can find it's discreet entrance. Once we found it, we walked up several flights of stairs. There was friendly service and some delicious food, despite a mix up on one of the orders. There is not much of a view though. There is no gluten free menu available.

author: Emeline Koh
review_text: Considering an interesting place for dim sum but a bit far from the town. The food here is not really fantastic as what social media have video. Not as nice as Malaysia dim sum because the taste is quite bland. The BKT is nothing fantasy and not strong. Might be good for those who like more bland food

author: Zainal Mubarak
review_text: Rembolan Restaurant offers a delightful dining experience with a strong focus on authentic flavors and warm hospitality. The menu presents a variety of traditional dishes that are both flavorful and satisfying, with portions generous enough to share. The standout for me was the grilled seafood—fresh, perfectly cooked, and seasoned just right. The ambience is cozy and inviting, with tasteful décor that makes you feel at home. Service is generally attentive and friendly, though during peak hours it can be a little slower. Prices are abit high for the top few malls in indonesia but; for the quality of food, making it value for money. While there’s still a bit of room for improvement in speed of service and drink variety, overall, Rembolan is a great choice for a casual yet memorable meal. I’ll definitely be coming back.

author: Joanna Osborne
review_text: Sooooooooooo after COVID, they started opening later on Sundays, but we're early birds, so we started going to another restaurant on the beach. Today while walking to the other place, we realized they were back open early on Sundays, and we got extremely excited. So we are back eating at our Oceans 13 spot. Today, I had the lobster frittata, and it was delicious. I also had a mimosa, which was Amazing!! So glad they are back open early!!! The best on the Beach!!

author: Bruce (Bruce Ning)
review_text: I came here to celebrate my girlfriend’s birthday. The waitress, Asmi, was incredibly friendly and even gave us a complimentary cake. The food was excellent—especially the Wagyu Picanha MB7 cooked medium rare—and the char-grilled octopus was a close second. A perfect place for celebrations.

author: R D (IEATFOOD&GOLF)
review_text: Meh, Food 2.5/5: Got shrimp tacos (again). Very under seasoned. Found the shrimp a little bit dry as well. Needs more mexican flavours. The queso dip was just ok and nothing special. Food could definitely use more flavour. Service 4/5: Great servers, drinks were refilled without being asked. Atmosphere 5/5: Great Mexican feel. Decor was def authentic from the table to the kitchen. Overall 2.5/5: wouldn’t be my first choice of mexican in the area.

author: summer rogue
review_text: Service by the staffs were excellent. Food tasted superb. Everything was beyond expectation. The best kopitiam.

author: david we
review_text: I ordered the Merica smash burger with the better than ketchup. The smash burger itself was very tasty but for me the bun kinda brought it down a bit. It would be nice to have a brioche bun or something softer than these harder sesame seed rolls. Cheese fries tasted good too thanks to the cheese but the French fry itself was nothing special.

author: Jake Flynn
review_text: Ahhhhh Sam Walker’s…not to tout myself but we go to Bowery and Chubbs more often than I’d like to admit. And trust me I get a chub for Chubbs. Both are sister restaurants and in the same restaurant group as Sam Walker’s, evident by the identical menu font…FINE. Sam walkers offers similar fare but more of a combination of all the offerings at Lucy’s, Chubbs and Bowery. Great beer selection friendly staff and good food. However…….. It’s almost like you get the selection of all three restaurants, the nachos from Chubbs, the Italian egg rolls from Lucy’s and the pasta from Bowery but somehow it just doesn’t hit the same level, just being honest. Maybe because they are trying to do all three. Overall it is good though and is a great value. Espresso martini didn’t skip a beat from the sister restaurants, identical, delicious and large like Jack G’s peepeee. Overall I think they could try to do less with the menu and offer some more uniqueness/originality for the benefit of quality over quantity. This is my constructive criticism though if they ever ready this. I would come back.

author: Carin Rudich
review_text: Eyval is a must especially if you love Persian food. The restaurant is open and airy and is much bigger than you realize. There are three separate dining areas to it. There were 3 of us and we definitely over ordered but wanted to try different dishes. See the photos. We had some serious leftovers. The cocktails are unique in flavor and easy to drink. Our waiter was very sweet and thoroughly explained the dishes and guided us on what to order. The entire staff was very personable every time they came to the table, either to bring food or clear the table. Unbelievable flavors in these well curated dishes! Reservations required!!!

author: Jay Chong
review_text: A local breakfast coffee shop. ordered few dishes. Fried chicken cutlet was good, the fried chicken drumsticks flavor could be stronger for me. Both tom yam rice and ginger rice was just nice. Portion is big enough for one. For the drinks, cold drinks are not allowed to adjust the sweetness which is too sweet for me. The services were excellent. Overall it’s a nice place to having breakfast or lunch with family and friends.

author: Shawn Hackler
review_text: We waited a while for someone to come around to seating us. Employees kept passing by, giving us a glance while we waited at the host stand, then moved on. Once seated, our waiter failed to bring us half our drink order. Then, when we told him we needed a minute with the menu, never returned. The coffee was good and the manager comped it when we walked out having never had the chance to order food.

author: Jayden Han
review_text: This restaurant’s food is pretty good, but the atmosphere is a bit loud and unclean

author: Frederick Sun (Freddie)
review_text: You will download the App to get a number and wait for the table. It took me about 90 mins to get the table. I started joining the App while leaving the hotel. Still waited 40 mins at the restaurant. The mama noddle mixed was delicious as their signature. The crispy pork was also super good. Especially dipping in mama noddle’s soup. The squid with yellow curry was so so, not recommended. Did not order the raw salmon which is also their signature.

author: sophie jacqueline
review_text: The vibes here are unmatched ☀️☀️ super beautiful and beachy space. The food was incredible - we got the ‘best egg sandwhich’ but veganized with tofu scramble & impossible sausage and it changed my life. We also got the butcher’s breakfast veganized & oyster mushroom calamari. The tofu scramble is soo flavourful & delicious! Also had really fun drinks like mimosa flights. Perfect sunny brunch spot. 5 stars!

author: Rudy Gerard Chong
