review_text: Finally tried this well-known local coffee shop after a late lunch at the delicious nasi campur 2 stalls down, and it is worth the hype. Good thick creamy iced coffee for RM2.70. Was taken aback at the cost of their roti kahwin at RM5, but it was a good size compared to regular coffee shops, with 2 stacks toast generously spread with kaya and butter. The bread is either thinner than usually or pressed thin, which makes the serving look small, but is in fact hearty. The low roofed open dining area of the astaka is surprisingly cool despite the hot day, so its a good choice to bring friends for a lazy afternoon tea time if you don't feel like splurging at an air-conditioned cafe at premium prices, though they do close by 4pm.

author: Daniel V
review_text: The Food does not taste fresh, me and my wife got 4 rolls and of the 4, only one had a distinct flavor. Upon ordering food my wife had observed a piece of salmon just sitting on a shelf and as we waited 25 mins for food and also ate for 20 mins that same piece of salmon was sitting in the same spot. This place is not worth it to us. The food is edible but the handling of the food is questionable. Go at your own risk but for us this was not worth it. I definitely think it is over hyped. The rolls I purchased are Hot Cheeto roll Ali roll El pecado roll Bobby roll The distinct flavor was in the hot Cheeto roll.

author: Bryan Garcia-Aguilar
review_text: Everything about this place screams authentic old-school burgers. The taste screams, "Amazing!". I'll be coming back to try out the gyros nexts.

author: adrian_97s
review_text: Recommended by the hotel owner, this dim sum joint is better than those touristy dim sum place. The bkt is good, not as good as those Klang ones but good enough. The dim sum were different than malaysian dim sum but nonetheless good.

author: Shawnette Fields
review_text: My Sister referred Kings Family & my daughter brought me. I was impressed. All of the staff that I interacted with were genuinely friendly, the atmosphere was pleasant, the restaurant was clean & everything I ordered was good.

author: Kenny Yap
review_text: Somewhat unnecessarily oily but it’s definitely a very delicious bowl. I added $1.20 for extra minced pork so total $6. No queue at around 930 on a weekday morning.

author: Steve Bintley
review_text: Popped in here for a Saturday evening snack and left impressed. It’s fairly small and it was rather chaotic but the pizza was great. Decent sized slices and a delicious crispy base, with both thin and deep pan options available. Spicy chilli flakes are available and there’s a small amount of seating available against the wall. For a good value pizza fix I’d certainly recommend!

author: sonya pase
review_text: I came across this burger spot while exploring Seminyak. The location is super convenient—close to everything and easily reachable on foot. The interior immediately caught my attention: bright and inviting from the outside, yet warm and cozy once you step in. My hubby and I chose our burgers with the help of the friendly staff. I loved it! I’d give it a solid 8.5/10. The burger is perfect if you’re looking for something tasty and easy to grab on the go. Can’t wait to come back on my next visit! 🤗

author: Rene Dhariswari
review_text: Lovely place with a cozy atmosphere and delicious bakery items. Everything was fresh and well presented. Special thanks to the staff, especially Dekwi, who was very friendly and welcoming. Great service and a pleasant experience overall. Will definitely come back! 😍🫶🏼

author: I’ll be the Judge of that
review_text: I ordered a McDouble combo it comes with nuggets I requested bbq as I pulled away from the window noticed it was not there I stopped got out my car and walked to the window to tell the girl it was missing she argued that it was in my bag I showed her my bag and she still insisted it was there even asking her coworker if he saw in the bag and then said if you want another one I can give you one I said I want the one that comes with my meal. So unprofessional the nerve to call me a lie about a sauce is not good customer service at all I’m very disappointed in the training system they must have.

author: XZ Xu
review_text: It’s a hidden gem in Brickell. As a Bostonian, I have been to this place for five years. Our waiter Francisco is very friendly, cute and nice! Love the view, food and everything!

author: Yianni Dimitriou
review_text: It was my first time getting authentic Puerto Rican food. My girlfriend and I got the fried chicken, with yellow rice, and fried plantains. The crust and seasoning on the chicken was oooooouuuuuweeeeee goooooood!!! They did not have flan today so I got the tres leches dessert instead and it was really good! The hot sauce was almost like a spicy vinaigrette — really enjoyed it with my rice. The service was excellent and food delectable. Thank you!

author: Will See
review_text: On a lively Sunday evening, my friends and I, a group of six, visited Carson Kitchen in historic Downtown Las Vegas, a vibrant spot known for its creative American comfort food. Arriving without a reservation, we were fortunate to snag seats early, as the restaurant was packed and buzzing with energy. Reservations are highly recommended, as the intimate space fills up quickly. The menu, though concise, offered plenty of tempting small plates perfect for sharing. We ordered several dishes, with the cocoa espresso New York strip, tempura green beans with pepper jelly cream cheese, and spicy killer shrimp stealing the show—each bursting with bold, well-executed flavors. Other dishes were tasty but leaned slightly too salty for our liking. The drink menu was similarly compact but thoughtfully curated, ensuring we found satisfying cocktails to complement the meal. The portions were generous for the price, offering solid value for an off-Strip gem. Service was friendly and attentive despite the bustling crowd, though it felt a touch stretched at times, earning a 3.5-star rating. Carson Kitchen’s modern, urban vibe and inventive dishes made for a memorable night, and we’d return if back in the Downtown area. Deliciousness Rating: ★★★☆☆ (3.5/5) Service Attitude: ★★★☆☆ (3.5/5) Value for Money: ★★★★☆ (4/5) Likelihood of Returning: ★★★☆☆ (3.5/5)

author: Choon Chang Lee
review_text: Good food, good service, Nice environment.. 1 bad thing is the parking .. And for wheelchair and elderly, please book earlier for ground floor ..

author: Thảo Nguyễn Phương
review_text: The rice in the clay pot was delicious, the dishes were flavorful, the portion of braised fish was a bit small, but the braised pork belly was very tasty – everyone seemed to be ordering it :>>

author: Ron Wayne
review_text: The cook was great. But it's really smokey. Nothing worse than eating your prime rib in a cloud of cigarette smoke. Ruins the taste of everything. The farthest table from the actual bar was about 20 feet

author: Hyung “Logy” J
review_text: I regret that I only visit here recently! It was always in my want to go bucket list and many of my friends recommend to stop by for their food especially pizza ! Margarita pizza was superb with extra cheese on top and the crust is not so thick! The fish & chip portion is damn big because normally it’s only either one piece or two piece but it’s three piece here !! The resto is spacious and well maintain. And !! It is just beside of cdc! Would revisit in future!

author: Ikhwan Isnawan
review_text: My family and my relatives bring us to war called East Coast Lagoon Food Village during NDP Eve for early dinner. Food was nice better than Lau Pat Sat. Those friendly staff are here.

author: Aaron Walker
review_text: Yesterday was my first time visiting Hubble Bubble Lounge, and unfortunately, the level of service we received was extremely disappointing. From the moment we ordered, the waitstaff was inattentive and unresponsive. No one checked on our table at any point during our visit. We asked for water when placing our food order, but it never arrived I had to physically get up and track down a waiter just to receive it. The same issue occurred when it was time to receive our check; I had to ask multiple staff members before anyone assisted us. As they would always just walk past or table consistently. Additionally, I clearly informed the staff that I am allergic to watermelon and requested a simple substitution for extra strawberries. Despite this being a reasonable request, they were unable or unwilling to accommodate it. Overall, this experience fell far below even the most basic expectations of service. I was genuinely shocked by how poor it was, especially for a first visit. At the very least, I believe a refund of the mandatory 20% service charge/tip is warranted, as the level of service provided did not justify it in any way. Hopefully some one can reach out to me to resolve this matter. I hope management takes this feedback seriously, as this experience has significantly impacted my impression of your establishment.

author: Mary Grace Cruz
review_text: We reserved atleast 3 days in advance & we were informed that only 2nd row seats were available. Me & my husband decided to stay longer to enjoy the place & when there’s available seats at the 1st row they gladly transferred us to nice seats with ocean view. Remember to place a reservation few weeks before so u can get best seats. We had good experience all in all at Malini Uluwatu, though the seafood platter are just average in terms of taste. Staff are very friendly & accommodating. Shoutout to Ella & to other staff who patiently took our photos.

author: Gloria F
review_text: Been here couple times, and always live how they treat us! The new place quite homey and aesthetic since they added wine chamber in dining area. The lounge had DJ and the city view was amazing 🤩 🌃

author: Qiuyi
review_text: We really enjoyed the food. We ordered grilled chicken wings, fried Hokkien prawn mee, and some Thai dishes, including papaya salad. The taste was nice and not too spicy — maybe you can ask them to adjust the spiciness level if you prefer. The most popular drink there is sugarcane juice. You can also enjoy satay, as many stalls sell it. That night, there weren’t too many people, maybe because it was a weekday.

author: Hagz
review_text: I love Le Tub. It's a hidden gem! We come here every year when we visit Hollywood beach. The decor is made from a collection of old crab traps, driftwood, toilets (yes toilets) and other treasures found on the beach over the years super unique. There known for their amazing cheeseburgers very basic but huge and has that homemade backyard grill vibe I love it! Be careful how you order your cheeseburger if you say medium rare..it's going to be rare like blue...if you say medium it's going to be medium rare kind of confusing but that's how they get down at le tub lol...there greek salad is massive definitely feeds two maybe three...Good prices for the amount of food and quick service. Also awesome drinks! Amazing view of the inter coastal. You can see all the boats coming through and sometimes see fish jumping in and out of the water pretty awesome. 100% recommend!!

author: Annie. Travel and Food
review_text: The restaurant has a charming ambiance with tasteful décor, creating a pleasant dining atmosphere. The staff were attentive and genuinely friendly, which made the experience welcoming. As for the food, the flavors were decent, though not outstanding. Unfortunately, the seafood did not meet expectations — the squid lacked freshness and was slightly mushy, while the shrimp had a noticeable odor. The bánh xèo was flavorful but overly greasy, which made it feel heavy. The dipping sauce had a rather unusual taste that may not suit everyone’s palate. I would still consider returning to try other dishes, hoping for a more balanced flavor and fresher ingredients next time.

author: Karen Young
review_text: What a gem! We need GF, no dairy/no egg. Found what we wanted with several options here. And the GF baguette was perfection! We had the roasted artichokes and mushroom paella. So satisfying to eat such good food!!! Photo of our empty paella pan because I dove in so fast.

author: Michael Bowen
review_text: Friendly staff, fast service and the food is great. I recommend the wet burrito. It's a place for the family.

author: Elijah Brooks
review_text: Very welcoming. Food is amazing!! I always get this for lunch but the workers deserve so much credit for creating this amazing atmosphere.

author: Lim Yong Siang
review_text: Each bite delivers a burst of that signature Wagyu richness—a creamy, decadent flavor that coats the palate. It is savory, slightly sweet, and immensely satisfying without ever feeling greasy or heavy. The accompanying sides—fresh, bright green broccoli florets and chunks of caramelized sweet potato or squash—are the ideal counterpoint. A special thanks must also go to our waiter, Ziyu, whose superb service and attentive care made the dining experience truly exceptional from start to finish. This is a must-try for any true beef enthusiast.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Gemma Gilbert
review_text: This is the best Bun Cha in the world! Possibly my favourite meal I had all throughout Vietnam. Super fresh noodles with the most perfectly balanced broth and incredible meat balls. So good we came back twice.

author: Đại Dương Nguyễn
review_text: Pinkpong Buffet is a dining destination well worth experiencing, especially for those who love a youthful atmosphere and diverse cuisine. From the moment I entered, I was impressed by the modern decor, the cute color scheme, the cleanliness, and the comfortable feeling it created for diners. The tables and chairs were neatly arranged, suitable for groups of friends, families, or celebratory meals. The most outstanding feature of Pinkpong Buffet is the quality of the food. The dishes are attractively presented and diverse, ranging from grilled meats, seafood, fried dishes, side dishes, to desserts. The food is fresh, seasoned perfectly, and the grilled dishes are particularly flavorful, aromatic, and not greasy. The dessert counter is also very appealing with many types of cakes, fruits, and sweets – you can eat them endlessly without getting bored. In addition, the staff at Pinkpong are very quick, friendly, and enthusiastic in assisting customers when needed. The buffet price is reasonable compared to the quality and quantity of food, making it well worth the experience. Overall, Pinkpong buffet is an ideal choice for gathering, enjoying a fun meal, and savoring delicious food with family and friends.

author: Ethan Gaudioso Travels
review_text: I came here on a Saturday night, and the pizza was delicious! They had so many different choices to choose from. All of the pizzas weren’t too expensive and you can buy them by the slice. For a Saturday, we only waited five to ten minutes, and there was room to sit down and wait. I loved the vibes and atmosphere with all of the neon signs and pictures everywhere. I definitely will be coming back next time I am downtown!

author: Jennifer
review_text: I stopped by for the first time today and tried one of their chia bowls, felt like a queen breakfast 👸🏼 Beautifully balanced, fresh, not overly sweet, and surprisingly filling. The cafe itself is bright, open and welcoming. You can feel that people enjoy being here, it's easy to settle in and easy to strike up a conversation if you're in the mood. Staff was attentive and kind, even during the busy hours. A couple of small things to note: the overall noise level can get a bit intense when it's crowded, and I personally would love to see a water station or some served water added in the future. Little touch, big impact. Other than that, great experience, fair value, and it seems like they're preparing to open a new spot in Pererenan, which is exciting. Would definitely come back for the bowl alone.

author: Alfie Hood-Nguyen
review_text: Amazing, comforting bowl of chicken and prawn kway teow soup (hor fun), friendly staff and very reasonably priced! If you don’t want the hor fun there are other yummy looking meals to choose from other vendors there. Highly recommend!

author: SJ Hosin
review_text: The description of "straightforward menu" is very accurate. Cuban bread was crispy and fresh with lots of butter. Guarapo is my go-to drink here (yes I know). I was seated quickly, everyone was friendly and I ate well.

author: shirley DAVIS
review_text: SuPerB!! Lobster and crab cakes for appetizers. Filet and Chilean Sea Bass was to die for. The choCoLate cake was simply put "Oh My"!!. The drinks were well made - The service ♤♤♤ couldn't be beat.

author: C
review_text: Had lunch at Chuan Kee Seafood and the food was great — we ordered the Seafood Claypot, Tofu, and Sweet & Sour Pork, all delicious and very good value at about $15 per person. It was also surprisingly uncrowded for a weekend. Rating: 5/5. Chuan Kee is a long-standing Teochew-style zi char spot known for clean, seafood-forward flavors and wok techniques passed down through generations. Its cooking stays true to old-school hawker traditions, focusing on freshness, balanced seasoning, and consistent execution. A dependable classic that continues to serve honest, heritage-style zi char done right.

author: Ritika
review_text: Loud music and brings lights all over, good to visit when in Phuket. V similar to Pattaya walking street. Thai street food is good, coconut icecream is a must try.

author: B Y
review_text: Very disappointing experience. The decorations and atmosphere is good. but after we sat at the bar and were constantly pestered to order cocktails. In about 10 minutes, the barista asked at least five times if I was going to order one. It felt pushy and annoying.. when I decide, I’ll order. I dont know if they get cut from if i order one. Didnt understand why rushing me? I came there to relax not annoy like this. The cocktails are extremely overpriced and low quality for what you get. Overall, this place is charging European prices for a very mediocre experience. I left feeling like I wasted my money. Would not recommend at all.

author: Penny Gaffney
review_text: We were looking for place for a light meal before going to water puppet show and had this restaurant on the way from our hotel on the list. The restaurant located on the 6th floor of sort of a residential looking apartment building. There is a restaurant name sign in front of the building. But first you have to walk into sort of an apartment courtyard with many motorcycles packed walkway. The view on the top was very nice. It's mostly open outdoor restaurant with a moveable roof for sun and rain. Lovely bit of garden in the middle of the place. We had 3 dishes to share between the 3 of us, squid herbs salad, grilled fish with garden salad, and steam lemongrass clams. We also had 2 desserts to finish off the meal, some coconut mix beans with green chewie and a longan mix dried fruits sweet. The food was okay and the place is very relaxing. However there were not really anything I can called service, as it was hard to even find the staff to order food with.

restaurant: Quán Ngon - Bún Chả Hà Nội
author: Dr. The-Hiep Nguyen
review_text: Quan Ngon - Bun Cha Ha Noi serves the best bun cha in Saigon! The ground beef is incredibly tender, and the light yet flavorful fish sauce is so good you'll want to drink it straight! You also need to try their Vietnamese egg rolls (cha gio or nem ran) too. From the street, the restaurant may look small with just three tables on the first floor, but there’s more seating on the upper levels. Despite being located on De Tham, in the heart of the bustling Bui Vien Walking District, the place remains clean and surprisingly quiet. The staff are courteous and friendly, making for a great dining experience. Highly recommended!

author: Belkys Diaz
review_text: Downtown spot across from courthouse as food is limited in this area if u her for jury duty. Place is cool has seating in back I ate here 2 days in row and picked up to go home so it was pretty good. My only issue is the rice was not hot or warm just room temperature. Taste was good and service n all was great.

author: Beyase Warton
review_text: My friend and I wanted to stop by a place to get something to eat before we went back home to the city and this was recommended to us! They make really good daiquiris and their pizza is delicious! The staff was nice and the whole vibe of the place "outside" was so cool!

author: A J
review_text: Absolutely amazing experience at Miam Cafe Biscayne! The food was delicious and beautifully presented, the pancakes were unreal and the matcha drink was perfect. The atmosphere is bright, clean, and so inviting. But what really made my visit exceptional was our server, Dani. He was incredibly attentive, pleasant, and professional from start to finish.

author: Bebe William
review_text: This place is amazing. I love food. The portions are pretty big. They definitely give you your money's worth. Our server Noah was great. He was patient, attentive, and helpful. I gave 4 stars ⭐ because the hostess said we'd receive a text when they had a table available. We never received any contact nor did they call our name for a table. I went into the restaurant and she said she'd called us already. Which was false. I told her we had been sitting in the waiting area the entire time.

author: Robert Chin
review_text: Modern steakhouse with a twist! Celebrated my mom's birthday with a delicious dinner here at Moo. We wanted something different than the typical steakhouse (Smith & Wolensky, Capital Grille, etc.) and we've heard great things about Moo. The lobster bisque with souffle topping is one of the best I've ever had - sweet from the lobster and not overly buttery. The porterhouse was cooked perfectly. We definitely recommend the cream spinach and mushroom sides. We topped it all off with an apple tart a la mode...yum! Thank you to our waiter, Daniel for providing the best service and making my mom's birthday super special.

author: Janez Y
review_text: Nice, rich broth for Thai boat noodle soup. The beef is fresh and tender, and the chili adds a perfect spicy kick. Only downside is the constant queue and slightly pricey noodles. Still worth trying if you’re craving bold flavors.

author: Sushmita Jadhav
review_text: Went here on a Friday night. It was nice and peaceful, not too loud. Food was really really good. Imo it’s a must visit place in NJ

author: Kenny Choo
review_text: The roaster pork fried rice and crab meat rice are really nice. If you can take spicy, you may eat with the chili it brings up the flavour in your mouth.

author: Carlos Gonzalez M.
review_text: Greenstreet Café is one of those places you don’t just visit once; you adopt it as a ritual. 🌿✨ From the first coffee to the last cocktail, the vibe carries that European charm seamlessly blended with Miami’s tropical spirit. The menu is generous, designed to cover every craving: from breakfasts that feel like a weekend indulgence even on a Tuesday, to main dishes that strike the right balance between comfort food and subtle sophistication. The coffee is solid, the brunch is a classic, and the mimosas… well, let’s just say they’ve rescued more than a few Sundays. 🥂 Service is usually quick, always with a genuine smile, which makes a difference in a spot that’s popular and buzzing yet never loses its personal touch. The terrace is the crown jewel: dining under the trees with the hum of Coconut Grove around you is almost therapeutic. In short, Greenstreet Café is the kind of place where time slows down, food tastes better than expected, and you end up promising yourself you’ll come back…. and you do.

author: Aleksandra Dacko
review_text: Dining at Peter Luger Steak House in Brooklyn was truly exceptional. The steak was a masterclass in preparation, perfectly seared on the outside and tender within, showcasing the deep, rich flavor that only comes from expertly aged beef. The accompanying salad, though simple in concept, was executed with remarkable precision and freshness, proving that even the most straightforward dishes can be elevated to excellence. The atmosphere carried the weight of tradition, with a timeless New York charm that made the experience feel both iconic and intimate. Service was attentive yet understated, allowing the quality of the food to remain the centerpiece. This was not just a meal but a reminder of why Peter Luger continues to set the standard for steakhouses.

author: Chew LìYǎ
review_text: Too bad 02-10 Minced pork noodle 🍜 is Off today, Tue, 02 January 2024. So try besides Niang Tofu. Average on scale. Majority operate in the morning and Close by around noon

author: lee chaiyin
review_text: The porridge frog was very tasty I ben eat almost more than 10 years the taste still same and the sauce very delicious , price oso cheap n environment was very clean

author: Alphonse Eelric
review_text: Dishes are good, fast, price are very reasonable. But its always crowded with Malaysians hence some time waiting time would be long. But overall is a good place to catch a nice meal. Try not to drive here as there is no parking! take a grab or ride a small motorcycle is better. Note: not Halal! not Halal! not Halal!

author: Louisa Banuelos
review_text: The food was pretty good! The service was a bit non existent, but in their defense, it was super busy from the event going on, so I don't blame the server at all. Next time I'm getting cheesecake!

author: Joshua Chua
review_text: The Qatar lounge experience at Changi T1 is super luxurious. The lounge can comfortably accommodate the premium passengers on their flights. The food is also exceptional from their Ala carte menu. Special mention to Hazel, Divan, Ben, Cs and Ann for their hospitality, great food and drink! Will definitely come back again if I ever get the opportunity to!

author: Yolanda Alvarez
review_text: Food was great! And our server Nancy was even better! We love to come to this place all the time, definitely recommended 👍

author: Eric Tang
review_text: Remboelan @ Plaza Senayan, Jakarta Atmosphere: Located inside Plaza Senayan. Premium Indonesian cuisine . The decor is captivating and opulent. The interior is rainforest themed . This location has no waiting list as compared to other branches located in more popular shopping districts. Service: Staff were friendly and able to provide tailored recommendations . Food: Ordered their tumid bunga pepaya kecombrang & ikan asap (Stir fried papaya flower and papaya leaf with Kecombrang flower, shredded smoked fish, and stink bean), sapi sambal mbe nusa dua (Marinated beef topped with sambal Mbe), cumi betutu Tabanan ( fried squid and cassava caves in house special betutu sauce). The local salad was complex, textured and flavorful with local ingredients. The beef was tender with a touch of spiciness. The fried squid was tender. Finishing with Es Teler Abang a local iced dessert which was refreshing. Price: IDR 230k or MYR 60 per person Google: 4.8

author: Alvin B. Kristian
review_text: The waitress or bartender was very friendly. The drink i chose was berry long island tea. It’s very refreshing. Unfortunately, this place is not busy because I think its location is a bit out of the way.

author: Henry Yap
review_text: The outlet is inside Pavilion and is quite big and has a lot of seats but there are just too many people at a time regardless of the time that visit, especially during lunch and dinner hours. Despite the crowds, queueing time was about 20 minutes which considers not too long… The menu serves local delights mainly, and I ordered different type of food and all tasted good… Do not expect to have high level of service due to the crowds, but any requests responded quickly. Overall value for money- Food is not that expansive especially with quite a big portions each, I have been there 3 times in 3 days… Recommends to all that want to try local delights with a not too bad environment👍

author: Kevin de Guzman
review_text: Banh Mi Chao Dì Nu isn’t trying to be the best food in Vietnam and that’s exactly why it works. What it does offer is arguably the best bánh mì chảo you’ll find in the heart of District 1 (IMO) especially if you’re looking for something local, comforting, and honest. The dish arrives sizzling in a small pan, packed with familiar favorites: eggs, sausage, pate, meat, and sauce bubbling together, meant to be scooped up with crusty bread. While it may not blow you away compared to legendary spots across Vietnam, within central D1, it stands out as a go to for a solid Banh mi chao fix. The vibe is very much local eatery. You can sit outside on the street or head next door to the connected indoor space if you want shade.

author: Vinh Ly
review_text: The location and ambience was great but the food is subpar. Nigiri tastes old and the rice on the rolls were falling apart as we picked them up. We also ordered a seafood fried rice that was decent, packed with meats but was very very oily. The most disappointing was the fried/tempura ice cream, which was 90% dough. Overall, food looks better in pictures… I came with ONE other person and yet they automatically charged a 20% gratuity despite not refilling our water at all.

author: Lisa Xiaremba
review_text: I’ve wanted to try this place for a while since it’s in the plaza with 99 Asian Supermarket - I have to say I was pleasantly surprised! The seafood and dinner buffet are the way to go here, surprisingly fresh and tender black pepper crab, and they have a more Cajun-y seafood tray for the dinner buffet as well with some really juicy shrimp. Lunch buffet I’m not sure is worth it compared to other Chinese buffets. Also don’t get the sashimi on the sushi station, it tastes a little like death. But the sushi is okay. Also, can we talk about the stir fried cabbage. That was surprisingly flavorful…

author: claire wiedmann
review_text: This local restaurant at Sunset and Sandhill serves delicious barbeque meats with a Mexican twist. We got the Tostada Flight which I loved but my boyfriend would have perfered a bowl because it had salad on too of the meats. We shared the half of the burnt ends which had a most flavored sauce where we didn't have to add a barbeque sauce. They had 3 tasty sauces on the table which I added to my tostadas. We chose the 16 oz hatch chili Mac. & Cheese which was one of the best I ever had. Our server was great because he was attentive, took the time to explain the menu, and timely with the meal delivery. The restaurant lost a star because it was so cold in there (90 degrees outside) that I needed a sweater. Thus, I was too cold to enjoy the delicious meal fully. The other downside for me was they didn't serve plain churros there which I like simple deserts.

author: Cameo Litz
review_text: The quality of food is excellent. The service is phenomenal. The app is easy to use to order online and pick up. It’s my favorite place for poke.

author: Jason Mont
review_text: Last night, I had the pleasure of dining at this wonderful Mediterranean restaurant with a group of friends and family. We were looking for three things: exceptional Mediterranean cuisine, a fun dining experience, and a great atmosphere – and this place exceeded our expectations on every level. From the moment we walked in, the ambiance struck the perfect balance between lively and intimate. The warm lighting and thoughtfully designed space created an inviting environment that was perfect for our group gathering. The energy was vibrant without being overwhelming, making it easy to enjoy great conversation throughout the evening The menu impressed us from start to finish. Every single dish we ordered was expertly prepared and bursting with authentic Mediterranean flavors. The appetizers set a high bar – each one showcased fresh ingredients and bold seasoning that immediately transported us to the Mediterranean coast. The standout of the evening was undoubtedly the bronzino. Cooked to absolute perfection, the fish was flaky and tender with a beautiful crispy skin, seasoned with herbs that complemented rather than masked the delicate flavor of the fish. It's clear the kitchen knows how to handle seafood with the respect it deserves. Our main dishes were equally impressive, with generous portions and presentation that showed real care and attention to detail. The flavors were complex and well-balanced, showcasing the best of Mediterranean cooking traditions. The service throughout the evening was attentive without being intrusive, and our server was knowledgeable about the menu and happy to make recommendations. This restaurant has definitely earned a spot on our regular rotation. I'm already planning my next visit and looking forward to exploring more of their menu. If you're seeking an authentic Mediterranean dining experience with great food, wonderful atmosphere, and a fun night out, this place should be at the top of your list. Highly recommended!

author: IP P
review_text: Very dirty tables. Cleaners are getting lazier nowadays despite almost no need to clear plates and trays from tables already. Town concil and NEA dont bother about cleaniness and smokers smoking in the food centre Sat, Sun and PH 10am-12noon.

author: Foodieextreme Foodieextreme
review_text: Bali was our third port stop on a 28 day Asia cruise and we were lucky to have an overnight stay here. On our first day we hired a private tour guide through a tour company but sadly he wasn’t willing to take us where we wanted to go. I had hoped to bring my little daughters to the beach but after over four hours of driving he brought us to a beach restaurant in the dark. Disappointed we canceled our second day with that company and decided to take a chance with a driver from the port. That’s how we met Kadek Agus, an older gentleman who was incredibly kind, patient and sincere. I told him how much I had wanted to try Bali’s famous suckling pig, something I’d seen on Mark Wiens’ food videos. I had mentioned this to our guide the day before while we were in Ubud but perhaps because he was Muslim he steered us away and said it was too far or not available. I had tucked that food wish away thinking it just wasn’t going to happen. When I told Kadek Agus about it he said with such honesty that yes the suckling pig was indeed in Ubud, where we had just been yesterday, and now it was too far since the ship was leaving later that day. I was disappointed but I really appreciated his transparency and effort. He took us to another place that served pork but unfortunately the satay was too spicy for my little girls and they weren’t able to adjust it. As we were driving again I spotted Wahaha Pork Ribs in Jimbaran and asked if we could stop. It ended up being the perfect decision. While I had hoped for more traditional Balinese food sometimes moms have to adjust and this was just what our family needed. The staff were incredibly welcoming. When they saw my daughters getting bitten by mosquitoes the hostess kindly offered us bug spray to keep them comfortable. Service was fast helpful and kind throughout. We ordered the pork ribs for the kids and the pork knuckle for ourselves. The knuckle was huge and carved tableside, crispy juicy and hands down the best pork knuckle I’ve ever had. My husband was happy to discover they were offering a buy one get one free caipirinha special which was a fun bonus. Wahaha really delivered on flavor service and comfort. It turned out to be a highlight of our Bali stop and we’re so grateful to Kadek Agus for his thoughtfulness and care. Highly recommend both the restaurant and this wonderful driver if you ever find yourself arriving by cruise in Bali.

author: buyushay
review_text: San Pedro Square Market in San Jose is the kind of place that grabs you by the senses the moment you step in and refuses to let go until you leave pleasantly overfed and a little dazzled. It’s a lively crossroads of aromas, colors, and clinking glasses—a pocket-sized festival happening every day of the week. The variety of food alone feels like someone spun a globe, pointed blindly, and said, “Yeah, let’s serve all of that.” Want tacos? You’ll find tortillas puffing on the griddle and salsas bright enough to wake the sleepiest taste buds. Craving pizza? There’s dough spinning through the air like a mini–Cirque du Soleil performance. Fish and chips? Crispy, golden, and steaming like it came straight out of an English seaside fryer. Indian food? Spices bloom from those stalls—cumin, cardamom, chili—each one whispering promises of comfort and fire. And when you need to cool down, reset, or just enjoy the energy of the place, there’s always a bar waiting with something cold, smooth, or sparkling. Despite the crowds, seating never feels like a battlefield. There’s ample room to settle in—inside, outside, tucked into corners, or right out in the open where you can people-watch to your heart’s content. Families, couples, tech workers, the pre-show crowd, the post-work crowd—they all blend into one big, cheerful urban hum. Everything was excellent. San Pedro Square Market isn’t just a place to eat—it’s a place to graze, wander, sip, and soak in the good life for an hour or an afternoon. A colorful little oasis in downtown San Jose that delivers every time.

author: Alson Ong
review_text: First time visit here, non-local Came here for early dinner around sunset time. This place gives a good vibe and ambience with the Balinese style renovation. I ordered the new menu: Crispy Softshell Crab Burger, which is good but somehow feels that it would be better if another sauce such as creamy buttermilk or salted egg sauce is used instead of tartar sauce for the burger. The fries are fried to perfection - Crispy and Filling! The staff served well as well. And, staying at The Palm Suite entitled me a 10% discount off from the bill ☺️

author: Ling Sg
review_text: If you’ve read the reviews beforehand and still decide to go, don’t expect a clean environment or good service. This was my second visit, and whether it's here or at Lou Wang, the experience remains the same. It seems to be part of their style, or maybe their business is thriving enough that service isn't a priority. While the restaurant (it's a coffeeshop) may not offer the best ambience, the chicken and beansprouts are iconic dishes in Ipoh that are still worth trying. I’d bring friends here, especially since it's convenient for us as we stayed nearby. The steamed rice and hor fun are good to go with chicken and bean sprouts. To avoid the crowds and chaos (including staff shouting), try to visit early. It could be challenging, especially on a rainy day, as space is limited and ground is wet. Travel light—there’s not much room for shopping bags, and you wouldn't want to leave them on the floor given the condition of it.

author: Kenia Mendez
review_text: The service from Lissette was excellent – very kind and attentive the whole time. The food was delicious and different, full of flavor and beautifully served. I loved the pita bread, so soft and fresh. I tried the Hibiscus Margarita (the purple drink with mint) and it was amazing, super refreshing and unique. My dish was the Mixed Platter, a perfect combination of chicken, lamb, yellow rice, and veggies – everything was spectacular! Definitely an experience worth repeating. 💚

author: Sheren
review_text: Thumbs up for their crab and chicken chili! Definitely wanna go back here if i go to KL

author: Carys Barton
review_text: Just went here to buy some a snack before my flight to find lobster skewers piled ontop of the vegetarian food - Staff didn't seem to understand the issue with this. Dread to think what other cross-contamination goes on

author: Rick Takeshita
review_text: More balanced than the other famous one around the corner 😜 plus they have thin, lighter, crisper bread. Outside seated Vietnam vibes n no wait.

author: Jolene Zhou
review_text: My 3rd visit to Ajoomma. Always a good time! Love the beef soup and seafood pancake. Don’t have to bbq on our own and service is always great. Looking forward to my next visit already!

author: Emilie Veyland
review_text: My first time here and I will for sure come back! Amazing and peaceful atmosphere, food is top notch, the menu is quite elaborated with different meal types, I did not know what to choose, so many great options! And cherry on the cake, the staff is wonderful, kind and caring 🫶🏻 thanks for such a nice lunch experience!

author: Benny Poh
review_text: The environment isn't great; it can get very hot. I believe this is due to the low buffet price of RM29.90, which attracts a large number of customers. The service is acceptable, and the food tastes average, although I often feel very thirsty after dinner. It's worth a try.

author: christine solomon
review_text: We had such a great experience at Mangrove while celebrating a birthday! From the moment we walked in, Wesley and Aaliyah were phenomenal—welcoming, attentive, and super helpful with menu recommendations. I tried the lobster mac (10/10!) and the citrus champagne salmon, which was absolutely amazing. The drinks were delicious too, giving off that perfect Caribbean, island vibe. To top it all off, we had the butter rum cake for dessert—it was to die for! Great food, great people, and such a vibe overall. I’ll definitely be back!

author: Karma Fashion
review_text: I love forest hill diner breakfast and services I order every Saturday morning routine for pickup and the guy who takes the orders is always so friendly and patient with my difficult orders. And the food is good! Fresh and not greasy like some breakfast sandwiches at other places.

author: Charm
review_text: I was very disappointed by my oxtail lunch 11/7/23 the oxtail was full of fat more fat that meat. We all should know oxtail cannot be cooked that way, because you will have more grease than gravy. Everyone talks about how great the food is at Only One well lets be more consistent and on point or get a better cook. Very Disappointed...........

author: Constanza Blondet
review_text: I love Sweetfin Poke!!! I’m a fan! My go-to is the Signature Spicy Tuna Bowl with bamboo rice, extra salmon, and so many goodies I get to pick, to make my bowl exquisite, fun, and sensational! Everyone who works at my local Sweetfin in Venice, is a star! Super kind each and every time I go in person to enjoy Abbott Kinney. Grateful for Sweetfin Poke! 🙏🩵🍣🥗

author: Khalida
review_text: Had a family dinner here. It was okay. Food options were plentiful but nothing was that good. I will not be returning. I felt a way about being asked to pay before we even sat down. It was a bit janky. Nice people.

restaurant: Ekachan The Wisdom of Ethnic Thai Cuisine
author: Jarad Yeow
review_text: Food wise one of the best restaurants out there in Chiang Mai so far. The food was flavorful and you would appreciate the flavours especially the tomyam in every bite you take. However, the only concern was that each time we had to wait for some time to get refills for our rice which took about 15 minutes each round. Ordered some fish, tomyam, morning glory and beef. The food I’ll give it a 9/10 for sure. Amazing. Atmosphere was great as well. Would definitely recommend here but just make sure you made reservations earlier as we were unable to get a seat the first time we went there.

author: Eliz Tiew
review_text: This restaurant is an absolute gem! The environment is wonderfully cozy and incredibly relaxing, creating an atmosphere where you can truly unwind and enjoy your meal. It's the perfect setting for a leisurely and comfortable dining experience. And the food? Oh, the food is simply mouth-wateringly delicious! Every dish we tried was bursting with flavor and perfectly prepared, leaving us craving more. Highly recommended!

author: Kenzi
review_text: Dined in today. Truly was the best experience I’ve had at a restaurant! Staff is so kind especially our server Suzy. Food was amazing! Highly recommend the Caesar Salad Fries, Buffalo Chicken pizza, and the Apple Walnut dessert pizza. All in all amazing experience food is beyond delicious! I will be back! 😋

author: Cassandra Strozier
review_text: The subway downtown it's sad they never have 2 things to match 😕 they wait to prepare the sub then say we don't have onions no tomatoes 1 kind of bread I never go there again

author: William Tun
review_text: For the price this is a best buffet in the state of mass. Even better than other flaming grills. The staff there is wonderful. Amy is a great server like always. Thanks again guys will definitely come often!

author: Lingyu Liu
review_text: Finally made it to Ipoh Kappitiam, and it absolutely hit the spot. Everything tasted warm, familiar, and full of that cozy Southeast Asian comfort. i ordered Hainan Chicken Rice The chicken was tender and silky, just the way it should be. The rice was fragrant and perfectly oily, and the trio of sauces—ginger, chili, and dark soy—tied everything together. Simple but so satisfying.

author: YAP FLY
review_text: This is a three-generation duck leg noodle shop! It's located next to the Grand Hyatt Hotel (a short walk down the street)! With decades of service and its reputation, it quickly fills up after 8:00 PM, mostly with tourists. The clear duck leg noodle soup has a subtle ginger flavor (Malaysians might find it a bit bland, but compared to other clear broths, it's quite good). The duck leg is perfectly tender and delicious. 👍 The food was a little slow to arrive, though. We waited 20 minutes for our food, even though there were still two or three bowls ahead of us.

author: Ashley Nessl
review_text: Came on a Sunday some what randomly, they asked if we had reservations I didn’t really know was need from just stumbling upon this place but they were very accommodating and luckily able to get us in plus a table outside which was amazing, but I would recommend going the route of a reservation. Also was pleasantly surprised to find out everything was 50% off, and they do this every Saturday and Sunday. From here on out the food and service was amazing Sofia took very well care of us and ordered a few of her recommended items. And naza was very kind I will definitely be returning and loved my experience

restaurant: จำเนียร Jamnien ( Coffee & Dine )
author: PRU SE
review_text: Restaurant and cafe Delicious food, a variety of drinks to choose from, coffee, tea, fruit juice, soda Mid-range to high prices, but the food and ingredients used with the taste are worth the price The atmosphere of the shop is loft + vintage, sit and eat, sip coffee, chill out. You have to find parking on the side of the road, but it's not difficult because there aren't many cars on this road.

author: Denise A.
review_text: Another fabulous meal and wonderful dining experience at Zum Stamtisch! We arrived on a Saturday afternoon and the place was filled, but within a half hour we were seated. Cold Hofbrau beers to start, followed by my 2 favorites, the Deutscher Salat and the kaiserspatzle. You can not go wrong with either. The special on this day was bone in goose with homemade stuffing and we had to try it! Amazing!! As this was our first time having goose, we do did not know what to expect. It tasted similar to turkey but not exactly. We did not find it gamey at all, it was moist and flavorful. The stuffing was the perfect pairing and it tasted phenomenal. The red cabbage was sooo darned good. Apple strudel for dessert. Service was quick, friendly and on point. Really such a lovely place to gather, relax and enjoy some German cuisine. Very clean restrooms downstairs. On street parking.

author: Fermin Coto
review_text: Fantastic place!!! The music on a Wednesday afternoon before Thanksgiving was a little loud, but I think that is the vibe, and likely I'm just old now. The food was fantastic, one of the best Cubanos I've ever had. The Kubiche was phenomenal, the right blend of citrus and savory.

author: DS Gno
review_text: Came here cause of the reviews..Ordered lala hotpot here… 10min become like BCM and taste bad. The shabu shabu taste 50% like chewing gum, 50% like rotten meat.

author: Brayan Ramirez San Juan
review_text: Simply an amazing place, beautiful with excellent customer service, and very good food. Nothing bad to say, from the mac and cheese, to the truffle fries, to the pasta. Everything was delicious. The place was clean and quiet. Average parking.

author: Snowing June
review_text: Can't comment for the rice and dishes because I did ordered before their roti popular, roti Hong Kong, roti john and mee goreng only. The taste of foods are not consistent and depend on which chef make it when you order. Staffs are very nice and friendly. Place a little bit small but lots of table serve at night without the roof. Normally easy to get the parking too.

author: Jay Terry
review_text: My first Caramel Crunch Frosty definitely not my last. Warning: It's really sweet.

author: Jasmin
review_text: Best Ethiopian food in the city (that I know of). Flavorful and fully vegan!, value for money, and service is friendly and quick. Ambience is casual and cozy. Good playlist, on weekends they sometimes even have live music. Fri, Sat, and Sun they have the coffee ceremony at 5pm and serve free Ethiopian coffee, which is also delicious! Have been here for dinner multiple times and weekend brunch (different menu).

author: Lee
review_text: Got a rojak, tian tian chicken rice set (medium) and a hokkien noodles. Seats and tables are not very clean. Tian tian chicken rice stall had a queue. Service was prompt but the chicken rice was so-so only. The hokkien noodles did not appear like what was on the signboards of the store. Rojak was alright. Overall food was average.

author: Sherry
review_text: These are THE best croissants I've had in LA by a LANDSLIDE and it's 100% worth the wait. They're only open from 8:30 to 3 and they always sell out. We got there at 10:30 and there was already a line, but don't worry, the line moves fast. But oh my god, the layers on the lemon berry danish, SO good, but the infamous chocolate croissant was even better, a beautiful texture and the FLAKIEST crunch. Pro tip, you HAVE to try their savory options like the spinach feta croissant. These were sooo worth the hype! Thanks for reading! ^-^

author: Alanta
review_text: La Brisa is one of those places that just captures you the moment you walk in. The whole venue has this dreamy jungle-ocean vibe — lush greenery, rustic timber, and the sound of waves right in front of you. It feels like a tropical escape inside the heart of Canggu. The sunsets here are absolutely breathtaking. Watching the sky turn gold and pink while overlooking the ocean is pure magic — easily one of the best sunset spots in Bali. The food is consistently delicious, fresh, and beautifully presented, and the whole place has an effortless, laid-back vibe that makes you want to stay for hours. Great music, great atmosphere, and a perfect blend of nature and beach luxury. Highly recommend La Brisa if you’re looking for an unforgettable Bali experience.

author: Mary Carmona
review_text: I'm late finding this place. Order a soup, bacalaito, stuffed sweet plantain, and cooked banana with pernil. All was good, employees were sweet and the place itself is so cute. Parking is a plus.

author: Shernny
review_text: Local Favourite and It’s my favourite too. Like their fried noodle and fish , the crunchiness of the noodle..yum. I can just eat the Bak Kut Teh without rice as it is not to salty and just perfect. Hatyai You Zha Kuih is a must eat. Plain without dipping sauce is my favourite. Highly Recommend to visit.

author: Khánh Bank
review_text: Enthusiastic staff, fast and cheerful service. I think the food is okay for the price, cheap too, overall 8/10

author: Nur Aniesha
review_text: Good food , happy tummy❤️ my fav tandoori and nasi ayam bawang so goooood. spacious & comfortable☺️

author: Teh Siew Hoon
review_text: Purposely come here to try their salted coffee. A bit disappointed, doesn’t taste like coffee instead it actually tastes more like Milo. But it still good to drink.

author: Munchanaks On Tiktok
review_text: These were goood! The pricing is a bit on the higher end especially in BKK but I’d say if you want to have a good ambiance dinner with a mix of good conversations with your colleagues - this is a place you can go to! Must get 🌟 Tom Yum 🌟 Crab Omellete

author: Greg Michaels
review_text: From out of town and I expected better service. My second time at a margaritaville. My first experience was great! This was horrible! Waiter was impatient. The chef had a say in the menu. We ordered the new chicken and biscuit. Was told no biscuit, no big deal. Asked if we could substitute the biscuit for something else. Waiter had to go ask the chef, was told no. Again, no big deal. I said I will just take the meal without the biscuit. Waiter said the chef blocked it on the computer, seriously? Blocked it because he didn't want alternatives lol. Treat your tourists better, they make your money! I am returning to Florida in a few months and I definitely won't be back here. Chillis is here, will try them.

author: aR Jay
review_text: Came in late after spa session at ame spa next building, arrived at 9.05pm. Wait for about 15min to get a seat just enough time for last order at 9.30pm. Service was excellent. The food are marvelous! The price is awesome! Glad got to dine here at Remboelan!

author: Mary Naughton
review_text: I was back in the neighborhood and able to stop into Zum Stammtisch. My father used to take us and other family members here as frequently as we could. We often would see Aurora. Tonight, in memory of Dad, Mom and I came in for dinner. The waitress was lovely. I ordered rieslingschnitzel, which is veal schnitzel in a light riesling and mushroom gravy, I had the creamed spinach with it and the schnitzel was served over deliciously crisp home fries. Mom got the jägerschnitzel with the traditional darker mushroom gravy and also the creamed spinach. I wanted something a little different for a beverage so I got the coffee that has brandy in it. In the past, I’ve also had their goulash soup, which is a favorite for all and their potato pancakes. I’m so sorry the pork store has closed next door, I enjoyed going there as well. A few helpful hints for those who have yet to try this neighborhood icon, they take cash and card, they’re closed on Mondays, parking is hard to come by so get here earlier and prepare accordingly. Also, they close at 10pm however, their kitchen closes at 9pm, so to get a meal, you’ll need to be in before then.

author: Hayden Leung
review_text: Your typical Chinese-American buffet. The typical price for lunch is around $13, but I visited on Indigineous People’s Day where the all day price was $18. Interiors & Atmosphere: - I was seated away from the food area. This section had a slight antique, musty odor. The inside is rather old and could benefit from some modernization. Food: - Selection is pretty typical with a variety of meats, fried foods, seafood, and stir-fry’s. Sushi did not seem very fresh. Overall, I’d say this place is worth it for the price and when you just need to get your fix of Chinese-American buffet food.

author: Jo Shuttleworth
review_text: We ate here in 2018 on our first trip to Vietnam and were so glad to return in 2023! Delicious food and plenty of choice, friendly welcoming family. We tried many of the noodle dishes and the chicken with cashew nuts and rice. Highly recommended!

author: Edi Anguiano
review_text: Tire Shop Taqueria is a great place to enjoy flavorful food in a fun and relaxed setting. The restaurant has a cool, casual feel, and it really does feel like a neighborhood spot where people come to enjoy good food without any stress. From the moment you walk up, the smell of grilled meat lets you know you are in for something special. One of the best items on the menu is the carne asada tacos. The meat is very tender and juicy, and it has a rich, smoky flavor that tastes amazing in every bite. The carne asada is cooked just right and pairs perfectly with the warm tortillas and fresh toppings. These tacos are simple but incredibly delicious. The grilled al pastor tacos are also a must-try. They are well-seasoned and full of bold flavor without being too heavy. You can really taste the spices, and the grilled edges add a nice texture that makes them even better. Each taco feels carefully made and very satisfying. The cheesy gringas cooked on the griddle are another highlight. They are crispy on the outside, warm and melty on the inside, and packed with flavor. The cheese stretches with every bite, making them comforting and hard to resist. They are perfect if you want something rich and filling. The campechanas are very tasty and bring together different meats in one delicious dish. The flavors blend well, creating a hearty and satisfying option. Overall, Tire Shop Taqueria offers amazing food, friendly service, and a relaxed vibe that makes every visit enjoyable and memorable.

author: Yashita Vashishth
review_text: We had a wonderful experience trying out authentic Balinese cuisine at Sun Sun Warung. The flavours were impeccable! And Febri helped us understand the dishes and provided seamless assistance throughout! Will definitely come back 😊

author: Mark Estochin - Realtor Henderson, NV
review_text: This is what I call a "hole in the wall" an east side deli. They have some great food at great prices. It does have new owners since the owner Bob, unfortunately passed unexpectedly. R.I.P. Bob. But the food is always great, service is always great, great location, and they also do deliver. They have great sandwiches as well. I mean how can you pass up the breakfast wrap/burrito for $7.03 with tax?!

author: jim teo
review_text: This mee chiang kueh (stall #01-18) is good. Not too small, not too thin till it becomes flimsy, generous filling of peanuts and not too sweet compared other sellers from many other stalls at other places. Fans of mee chiang kueh should not want to miss trying out this traditional food.

author: Luna Reed
review_text: Went here recently with my father who lives out of state, this restaurant was a great introduction to the city of Newark. The atmosphere was very warm and inclusive and you could tell that people are regulars here, it was nice to see our server call their regulars by name. The presentation of the food is absolutely beautiful (See pictures), and the taste was amazing, our server brought us several sauces all of which were great. The only thing that could be improved is the seats were a little bit uncomfortable. P.S. the cream soda is S++++++ tier

author: Jufie
review_text: Whenever I visit Bangkok I always make it a point to eat at one of the Nara locations. I’ve been to this location a few times and I’ve always been impressed with the food. My personal favourite is the yellow curry with crab. Overall would highly recommend to anyone who wants to try upscaled, elevated Thai cuisine.

author: Carmen Tun
review_text: I really liked this place! We went on a wednesday night so not busy at all. Food came out quick and extra delicious. We ordered an assortment of foods and everything was a hit! Especially loved the Ous, the artichoke, and the gamba al ajillo. Super fresh, lovely tasting food and a very charming atmosphere. Staff were so nice and attentive as well. One thing I will say, is that you might want to order a few side orders of bread since a lot of the dishes really benefit from having it, but do not come with it (like sopping up all the delicious sauce from the gamba al ajillo). I don’t think you can really go wrong with anything you order on the menu. There was only one thing I did not particularly like, which was the foie gras, but I think that’s only because the pairings on this dish overpower the foie. I’m chalking it up to personal preference taste though. Overall great spot, very happy I stopped in.

author: Lee Mun chew
review_text: Hey there! I think this is the famous Ipoh tourist dim sum shop. It’s always packed with people, especially on weekends and public holidays. But I managed to come in on a weekday, so I didn’t have to wait for ages. The food was really good, overall. And the environment and design are so traditional, it’s like stepping back in time.

author: Sunny Day
review_text: Visiting from another state. Came here with some friends who told me this was the best place for fried clams which I was craving for. They said order the seafood platter which comes with the best clam chowder. The place was packed. We were squished waiting at the front door which was the only place to wait until your name was called. My opinion, it was like a hole in the wall where locals gather. (Nothing wrong with that. ) The waitress was pleasant but extremely busy. We all ordered the fried seafood platter plate. It wasn't long before our food arrived. As soon as the plate was sat before I was immediately disappointed. I really wanted fried clams and they gave me 4 clams with the bellies, 4 shrimp, 3 scallops and 2 half pieces of fish. I was looking for a plate overflowing with these items since it's called a platter. Tasting every item including the clam chowder left me disappointed as there was no good seasonings that I liked on any of the food. The only thing I enjoyed was the fries. I'm leaving this spot to the locals who seemed to really enjoy the food while my search continues for great fried clams in Boston.

author: Elaine L
review_text: Everything is superb here. I was traveling here in Hat Yai and this is the best meal I’ve had throughout my trip. It’s just a simple stall at the corner but everything is so good and flavorful. The crab fried rice is so generous with the crab. It’s such a simple dish but it’s so flavorful. Plus point is that it’s not oily at oil. The Tom yum is also amazing. Full with flavor, not too salty or too sour. Everything is perfectly balanced. I ordered 2 omelette. 1 with pork and 1 with crab. I definitely love the pork better as it has a better texture than the crab one. The glass noodles is the least of my fave but it’s still a great dish. What a hidden gem and will definitely return for a meal here. Price is also so reasonable with such generous ingredients. The place has a very simple layout. Hence, it does not have the best atmosphere but you can tell everyone is enjoying their meal very very much. ☺️

author: Food & Footprints
review_text: Wide variety of dominican food. They had everything from rotisserie chicken, beef, and meatballs to oxtail and goat. We ordered mangú with salami, and white rice, green pigeons (guandules) and goat. On both plates we asked for a side of avocado. Food was very well seasoned and cooked, we will be coming back. Prices were fair ($12-13 for the mangú and $23 for the goat) side of avocado was $2.5 and juice was $5.

author: Liying Wu
review_text: Great authentic Thai food, Pork Leg over Rice is a must-try. Definitely will come again soon :)!

author: Jaime Smith
review_text: I just tried this place for the first time not long ago. It was pretty good. The buffet is a pretty decent size which means the variety of food they have is good. I enjoyed it & the price is great!

author: Janice Gorence
review_text: BBQ Chicken Pizza was yummy! Love the crust , Lots of cheese. Sausage and mushroom pizza they skimped on the toppings and didn’t care for the taste of the sauce.

author: Riki Yamashita
review_text: Wah lao weh! It definitely is like home, Ipoh mali. Delicious just like from my childhood. Authentic Malaysian Hainanese Chicken Rice. The closest I recall tastes as good as in PJ's Japan Gasing (near SFX Church) or Subang Jaya's SS15. My friend flew it from LA to Pittsburgh. It was an amazing treat. When I visit LA, this place would be my destination.

author: Jim Tarwater
review_text: Welcoming environment and extremely friendly staff! Makes me wish I lived nearby. I had the Margherita pizza and my wife had the cheeseburger with fries. All delicious! We will definitely come back here when in town!!

author: oscar w
review_text: noticed this brand for quite sometime as I'm a laksa and hum lover. today is the first time I had the chance to try. not sure if quality of food is different if I had chosen to dine in at the coffeeshop. takeaway laksa tastes quite bad. beehoon is not thoroughly cooked, still tough. cockles not fresh seem frozen or kept in the fridge for quite some time and overcooked. lacks laksa leaves. for $6.50 I would have expected better quality.

author: Harm Rai
review_text: Bit of a touristy place - hyped up by hotels etc - I would say a really good banh mi, especially if you like the crispy bread. I had the chicken and cheese - the cheese had a ton of flavour and complimented the chicken quite well. The chicken itself was slight lly warm, could have been hotter. We also had the veggie (w/o avacado die to allergy). Again, very crispy bread and I think it would have been very good with the avacado. We also had the mango lassi/smoothy which was very good, to s of mango flavour... First banh mi in Hoi An - maybe there's better out there.

author: Joanna Vasquez
review_text: My friends suggested this place for a happy hour on a Friday evening. I got there a little earlier than they did and sat at the bar and was handed the menu for the Miami Spice month. It looked good, but I really wanted to try the happy hour menu my friends spoke of. So I had to ask for it. My friend arrived shortly after and we ordered drinks from it. The drinks not only were delicious, but also very appealing to the eye. The bartender was a little inattentive. She was on her phone for a long time, and genuinely I really don’t care, but I clocked it because we were one of the only group sitting there, and there was two of us, and then there was another person sitting by themselves, and we constantly were trying to have to get her attention. However, a second bartender arrived within 15-20 minutes and really turned the night around. We ordered a lot of sushi off the happy hour menu and all of it was amazing. So overall, this is a solid place for sushi and an adequate place for happy hour.

restaurant: Ten-Raku All You Can Eat Korean BBQ
author: Pedro Najera
review_text: The Food Is Great!! A lot of Options!! Service Was 6 Out of 10, Just Cus The Server Never Came Bak To Our Table After The 2nd Time We Ordered, We Waited about 30 Mins And She Never Came Not Even For Refills But Again The Food is Delicious.

author: youcef ould
review_text: No Language , very rude , uneducated staff , I wish i could select below 0 star!

author: Yessi Bleu
review_text: I have been going here since I found it in 2013 and have been going wvwr since even when I have live 90min away of make ny way there its a plus my family lives in jamaica plain haha...I always get thr monster wrap Joe Spa with curly fries. This last time I went i got a wrap and a kids meal mozzarella sticks and fries and its a reasonable price

author: Erika Lopez
review_text: We frequent this restaurant when we are in town. I love going there, the service is amazing. Anything you ask for the server will bring it to the table. Atmosphere is always happy vibes. The food.... 💯❤️ ALWAYS GOOD.

author: Alisa Fellah
review_text: I’ve been visiting Segar since I was a child, long before they moved from Bedok, even before the construction of Bedok Mall. It’s always been a family favourite, with their claypot golden chicken being a standout dish we’ve loved for years. Recently, we visited their Chinatown Point location. After the original Bedok spot closed, this became our go-to for awhile before the West Coz Cafe was built, but I’m sad to say the quality of the Chinatown outlet has noticeably declined. While the food is still decent and better than many other halal options, it doesn’t quite match the high standard it once did. For instance, the beef fried rice, which used to have a wonderful char and tender beef with crispy rice bits, now lacks that signature char. It’s still flavourful but missing that crispy edge that made it so special. The claypot golden chicken, once a highlight, was also disappointing this time. The golden sauce, usually thick and sticky, was more runny, and the chicken pieces were tough and mostly boney. The sizzling effect and caramelised onions that used to be a treat were missing, and the dish wasn’t served hot enough. On a positive note, the Nonya lady’s finger dish was excellent and maintained its quality. However, the pandan chicken was bland, lacking the aromatic pandan flavour, and the oat prawns, though buttery and sweet, were overcooked and dry. If you’re near HarbourFront, I’d recommend trying the West Coz Cafe location, which offers a taste closer to the original Segar experience. Overall, despite my critique, the food is still bloody good—just not quite up to the exceptional standard I remember from the old days. If you’re near HarbourFront, I’d recommend trying the West Coz Cafe location, which offers a taste closer to the original Segar experience. Unfortunately, the Chinatown Point branch didn’t quite meet expectations, so you might want to consider other options for an authentic Segar meal.

author: Soraya Teffaha
review_text: Couldn’t resist stopping by for a bite. Cozy atmosphere, delicious food, and great drinks. Even though I’m not vegan or vegetarian, I was pleasantly surprised by how delicious everything was. A place worth returning to!

author: Bernie H
review_text: Very nice traditional thai restaurant. The service is very good and thoughtfull. Good decoration, and they have plenty seating, so basically no wait even so we have reservation for our lunchtime. They also have many other location, so its easily accessible for people wanting to taste the good thai cuisine.

author: Rachel Low
review_text: Hawker owner was busybody and walked towards my group of friends when we were just checking out our friend’s crutches. He scolded us and said 你的老师没有教你这个东西不可以玩吗？ In a very rude voice. We didn’t even bother him and were minding our business then he came up to us and scolded us. After that all he did was glare at us from his stall non - stop, while we were minding our own business. This made us felt very very uncomfortable and felt that he invaded our privacy. Wasn’t a pleasant experience.

author: Javier Otero
review_text: Great food and atmosphere and awesome service. Definitely I will come back soon. 100% Recommended.

author: Alphonse Eelric
review_text: This place offers variety of Chinese style dim sum & Bak Kut Teh (Chinese clay pot sup with pork). Pricing wise is reasonable, but some time it might crowded with tourists from other province & Malaysia. Parking are plenty, park free at roadside, but beware! do not park at red white line or against the traffic as your car will be locked by traffic police & unlocking fee is whooping 1000baht!! They have another hall opposite their outlet, customer can take seat at either side & order food they want.

author: Moshi J.
review_text: “Sweet Treats Worth the Hype” The After You café at CentralWorld’s 2nd floor (across from the Apple Store) may be smaller, but it has a major advantage—no queue! Meanwhile, the larger 7th-floor branch often has a wait, but both locations serve the same iconic desserts. I tried the baby-sized mix-flavor Kagikori and their famous Honey Toast, and both were excellent. The Honey Toast, while served with a honey-syrup blend, still nailed the perfect balance of sweetness. They even provide complimentary cold tea, a nice touch to cleanse the palate. The decor is cozy, and the staff is attentive. Note: it’s cashless, so have your card or app ready. Although prices lean on the higher side, the quality justifies it. Expect a short wait for your order even if there’s no line. Great spot for dessert without the usual hassle.

author: Curtis S
review_text: The young woman working the counter made this visit extremely uncomfortable. She was rude and dismissive from the beginning, and her attitude made it feel like I was an inconvenience for simply ordering food. There was no greeting, no patience, and no basic customer service. On top of that, communication was a problem. It was genuinely hard to tell if she understood English, because she barely responded, didn’t acknowledge questions clearly, and seemed irritated when I tried to clarify my order. If you’re working directly with customers, clear communication and professionalism are the bare minimum—and neither was present here. This employee single-handedly ruined the experience. I won’t be returning unless management addresses how customers are treated.

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: Elaine Quek
review_text: Read good reviews. Decided to give it a try. Rice balls are quite small. One person probably needs 4 to 5. Steamed kampung chicken was disappointing but roast chicken was better. Chinchalok omelet was very salty. Kai Lan was well prepared. Service staff are a bit indifferent. There is chilli sauce but no ginger sauce. Parking is a hassle. Hard to find lots. Overall, was okay but nothing to rave about.

author: Mark Kunie
review_text: Great staff. Everything was fresh and perfect quality. Monkeys dream is a must. PaDak chicken also.

author: Arem Assuan
review_text: El Carajo is a truly unique and exceptional spot in Miami that seamlessly blends the charm of a top tier wine store with the delights of a bakery and a fantastic Spanish restaurant. From the moment you step in, you're greeted by an impressive selection of wines from around the world . The knowledgeable staff are always on hand to offer recommendations, making it easy to find the perfect bottle, my favorite muga prado enea. But El Carajo isn't just about the wine. Their pastry counter is a delightful temptation. El Carajo is a must visit for anyone seeking a true taste of Spain and a truly unique Miami experience.

author: Melissa Ocaranza
review_text: Very clean service is great prices are reasonable and let me tell ya this food is delicious 😋 highly recommend

author: Angelina Kurniawan
review_text: Pondok Kemangi in Pluit offers a cozy and welcoming ambiance, perfect for family gatherings or dining with friends. The food, while not particularly extraordinary, is still enjoyable and satisfying. The service is commendable, with friendly staff ensuring a smooth dining experience. Even when dining in a group, the food arrived promptly without much waiting time. Parking is also convenient, which adds to the overall ease of visiting the restaurant. In summary, it’s a great spot for a casual meal with loved ones, and I would definitely recommend it for its pleasant atmosphere and reliable service

author: Ling L
review_text: Authentic Korean BBQ experience! The meats and dishes are genuinely Korean, well-prepared, and full of flavour. Prices are very reasonable for the quality, and the ambience is great—comfortable and lively without being too noisy. Service was attentive and friendly, making the whole dining experience enjoyable. Definitely a place I’d return to & will try their fresh lobster next time!

author: Marcus Goh
review_text: This restaurant is highly rated, so I took a taxi there to try it when I had some time. Their Nasi Lemak is very famous, it is their signature dish. Rice is fragrant and rich, yet fluffy and not too greasy. The rice has a subtle coconut milk aroma. The chicken is fried to a perfect crisp, with a crispy bits sprinkled with spices. The meat inside is still juicy and tender. The chicken is rich in spice flavor and pairs perfectly with the Nasi Lemak. The portions are generous and the prices are reasonable. The menu doesn't just include Nasi Lemak. There are other options such as noodles and bread to suit different tastes. Service is relatively fast, especially when taking orders and serving food. The restaurant is clean and bright. Because it's very popular, there's often a queue. There are many tables, but it can get crowded. You likely have to share a table with strangers. The location isn't very convenient and not near city; need to take a taxi to get there.

restaurant: Bukit Merah View Market & Hawker Centre
author: Xinren Zhang
review_text: Not all stalls are available, which is normal. The tables are spaced nicely to avoid crowding. Special stalls to note:1 chai chuan tou mutton soup(michelin award) opens only 11am-1.30pm or until sold out. Closed on mon. 2 na na curry(michelin award) for extra spicy curry. 3 hakka thunder tea and yong tau foo.

author: Claudia Pedraza
review_text: Our waiter Jude was really rude, he was fine at the beginning. Then he asked us what are we gonna order and he was 'surprised' we didn't order one thing of each part of the menu, when he told us that everything was to share....Then he got mad and threw the bottle of water. He got a really bad attitude. We order a beer he never brought it. They already charge you 20% of service and he asked us if we need change 🤣 when he already reacted like a loco. Of course we didn't leave more money because of him and he went to our table and throw us the 5 dollars 🤣🤣 vete a tratar la ira hermano but the food was good!

author: Dolly Harriet
review_text: It is known as one of the best rooftop restaurant/bar in Jakarta. We went there for a nice meal and I think the food are okay. We had to sent back our steak cause it was rare and we asked for medium rare. The pasta we ordered was delicious! Drinks were nice too. Desserts was quite sweet for my taste. Overall, it's an experience to have. The service and ambiance were good!

author: Derek
review_text: The food here was surprising good compared to what I paid. The service was great as well. They have a large election of food. I would be back.

author: Mike G
review_text: I had murtabah daging and it was AMAZING. Nasi kandar also top notch. These guys know what they're doing, the flavours are extraordinary. A meal here will be a high point in any trip to Penang 😋

author: Michael Härte
review_text: We spent a fantastic evening at Cuca, where everything was perfect from start to finish. From the very first moment, we were welcomed warmly and guided professionally through the evening. The dishes are more than just food; they are small works of art – creative, exclusive, and a true culinary delight. The concept is excellent: you choose about 3 to 4 dishes per person, which are served one after another. It was also a lovely touch that each course came with a brief explanation of the special ingredients and the preparation. You can feel the team’s passion in every detail. The drink selection leaves nothing to be desired either. They offer excellent Balinese wines and an impressive range of unique cocktails. A big plus: all cocktails are also available as non-alcoholic mocktails without losing any of their sophistication. The service was flawless: attentive, professional, and very warm. The atmosphere, especially the stunningly beautiful garden, perfectly rounded off the experience and created a very special vibe. While the price level is a bit higher than the usual average in Bali, it is absolutely worth every cent for the excellent quality and the unique overall experience. It couldn’t be any better – highly recommended for any gourmet visiting Bali!

author: Tatiana Santos
review_text: I visited Petralunga in North Miami because they had a 50% off promotion on everything — and honestly, that was too good to miss! The place itself is very nice, the atmosphere feels welcoming, and the service was absolutely outstanding — everyone was attentive and friendly from start to finish.
