The pizzas were really good, and the tiramisu was one of the best I’ve had in Miami — truly a must-try dessert. However, I also ordered the tuna tartare and the tableside cacio e pepe, and those didn’t impress me as much. I’d definitely come back for dessert and a glass of wine, maybe even a pizza night, but probably not for a full dinner. The only downside is parking — it took me almost 25 minutes to find a spot, so be prepared for that if you visit during busy hours.

author: Sara
review_text: Yusnavy was PHENOMENAL with providing us superb service. The food was FANTASTIC my burger was good perfectly. The atmosphere is very romantic with the low lighting and candle lights.

author: Aphirak Bamrungruan
review_text: Tonchin absolutely delivers one of the best ramen experiences in the city! From the moment the bowls arrive, you can tell each one is crafted with care -- rich, flavorful broth, perfectly cooked noodles, and fresh, vibrant toppings that bring everything together beautifully. Every bite is balanced, comforting, and deeply satisfying without feeling heavy.

author: beldim2010
review_text: Beautifully decorated spot with good food but impersonal service. My wife and I visited Little Tijuana for an early dinner in May 2025. The moment we walked in, we were struck by the restaurant’s beautiful, artistic decor, which instantly set the tone for a pleasant dining experience. The overall experience was mixed though. Most of the food ordered was excellent with a couple of exceptions. The drinks were flavorful, but noticeably diluted. Service was efficient but impersonal. Everything arrived correctly and politely, yet we never felt truly cared for - no one stopped by to ask if we liked the food or drinks, no smile, no friendly chat. We can recommend Little Tijuana for its ambiance, décor, and solid food — just don’t expect much beyond what's served at your table. Food ordered Guacamole Trio - three types of guacamole to try and all three were absolutely tasteless :( Mexican Fajita - excellent. Flavorful and sizzling. Lamb Barbacoa (lamb shank) - excellent. Melting in the mouth.

author: Nancy Sears
review_text: Anytime I’m near the airport. I make a point to stop at this place. Their paella is not to be missed. The bartender Benjamin is so nice, informative and attentive.

author: Holly Hayes
review_text: Hardly a wait to be seated. Ariel is a very good waiter. He took good care of my family. He was especially transparent about our food allergy requests and the risk of cross contamination. My son is allergic to milk and rice flour. We were able to make an informed decision and get him something suitable to play it safe. He handled his section very well!

restaurant: Ee Ji Ban Chicken Rice Ball
author: CAROL ANG
review_text: Tried the chicken rice here and it was quite disappointing. The rice balls were very small, and the roasted chicken had no taste at all. The chilli sauce wasn’t nice either. I also ordered the sambal prawns — the portion was small and the prawns were tiny. Overall, not worth it. There are definitely better options elsewhere.

author: Bob G
review_text: Sadly, no longer a place that I would go out of my for. DECOR: Once upon a time, Il Poeta had unique decor... Santa Fe meets New Orleans is the way I would describe it. The walls were Southwest in Color and decorated with unique artifacts. It was very "artsy" and very Forest Hills. Now, with a recent re-do of the decor, I can best describe it as "Generic Long Island Restaurant". Gone is the uniqueness and in its place are generic white tablecloths and a conservative color scheme. SERVICE; i recognize that finding servers is difficult these days, but the service here didn't even reach diner standards. First, the wrong mixed drink was brought to the table. Then, the mixed drink that was brought as a replacement, which at least looked correct, didn't taste correct. Other reviewers have noted this issue as well, and for $17.00 it should have been exemplary! The server seemed to be limited to a dialogue of "cheese or pepper?". DISHES: We had the tuna tartar and Tagliatelli specials as well as the Apple Salad and the Penne with Asparagus "a la vodka". The tuna tartar had an "off taste". The Tagliatelli was OK. The two pasta dishes were served in round plates that looked unique but weren't appropriate for the pasta. The Apple Salad was way overly dressed and the dressing overpowered any flavor that the ingredients may have had. There were very few Apple Slices as well. Dessert was the Cream Brulee which was OK but, again served in a plate that was more appropriate for Flan. Overall, Il Poeta is worth visiting if you plan to be in area but I would no longer go out of my way to dine there.

author: Lily
review_text: Nice and spacious place. We had a family dinner with 25 people here. Didn't manage to get a private room upstairs due to holiday season. We ate downstairs in the main dining hall. Food was delicious, especially enjoyed the seafood. A minus point for the environment is because of the mosquitoes. A minus point for the service. The staff is friendly but very slow on collecting used plates, even though we have asked them to do so. They just seemed busy and wonder around the dining hall. But overall it's a nice restaurant with good food. I'll come back when I come to Jakarta again.

restaurant: Ẩm Thực Chay Tuệ - Trần Hưng Đạo
author: My Tran
review_text: A must-visit for anyone who loves great food — vegan or not. The dishes here are fresh, flavorful, and made with real care. Everything tastes as good as it looks, and you leave feeling nourished and satisfied. The staff are warm, the vibe is calm, and the whole experience feels thoughtful and welcoming. I’ll definitely be coming back!

author: Brad Marvine
review_text: A busy food court that has a wide range of scrumptious food. The area is very crowded, especially during peak hours (lunch and dinner). Service is pretty good!

restaurant: LAO XIANG CLAYPOT BAK KUT TEH
author: Joshua Yap
review_text: Came around 5:40pm. Tried the dry bkt with some 油条. The soup is very herbalicious. The dry BKT was flavourful. Worth a try. One person dry BKT was around RM16.50, Garlic rice RM1.50, 油条(RM1.5) and a cup of Chinese tea (RM0.70)

author: Andy Mai
review_text: This restaurant is Michelin Guide 2024 and it definitely deserves it. The food doesn't have plenty of selection but everything is very tasty. You can try everything and it will taste good. The toast is what you should try as dessert instead of appetizers since it's pretty sweet and perfect after a meal. Plenty of parking in the parking structure behind the plaza. Seats can be limited so expect a wait line. Once you are in, the food comes out pretty fast. It's a handicap friendly facility.

restaurant: GoodYear Seafood Village Tampines (Zi Char and Bak Kut Teh)
author: JH
review_text: Big seating area, some are air-conditioned and some are alfresco. Food was really good, especially the golden garlic fried pork. Wanted to try the cabbage chicken but portion was too big for 4 of us, definitely will come back to try.

author: Metehan Beyazbirlik
review_text: There were homeless people inside, and they asked me for spare change. The person who asked was polite, but someone else might not be as polite in the future. It seems like security is necessary here. I mean, come on, you're a fast-food restaurant in the heart of Miami, you have to provide security.

author: Robert Rodriguez
review_text: Went specifically for the stone crabs. Ordered Lg platter. Received 4 medium claws for $64.95. But that's Lg to them. Terrible. Terrible. Terrible. Tasted old. Quality was not anywhere where it should have been. See the picture I took of one of the claws. Speaks for itself. The lobster bisque was delicious as was the chicken, bacon, avocado sandwich with fries. The fries were phenomenal. Service was good. It's the last 3 that saved it from a 1 star review. Told the mgr. He replaced the 1 claw for a much better one but still not worth the money. At any price because yes it was that bad.

author: Cocuti Roxana
review_text: I had a really good experience!! Amazing good food and great service! Dennis was our server and he did an outstanding job. Definitely coming back! Great greek atmosphere and music as well!!

author: patricia schneider
review_text: Always a nice place for lunch or dinner. Located inside Bayside in downtown Miami. The menu is heavy on shrimps 🍤. Delicious shrimp cocktail with 8 large shrimp for 14,99. Very friendly service and great atmosphere. Went again in Nov 2025. Ramona was a great waitress. Consistently good food. Same good vibe. Thumbs up

author: Agnes “ManKiller” Sem
review_text: My friend recommended me this fishhead steamboat here. The soup tastes good with the charcoal fired soup. Think they called it chilli prawn, cooked with tofu is nice as well. I love fish so i am open to try all places for good soup n fish. I had red grouper here. I always love song fish.

author: Zac
review_text: Food was above average for this type of restaurant, and service was good. The main downside was we were seated under a leak in the roof so water was dripping on us, and it was very busy so we didn't bother requesting to change seats. Overall I would go again, but at $46 for two, I don't know if the value is really there.

author: myvi
review_text: Vivi( Vivian) was the best ever. We were at the bar and barntender wasn’t the best but Vivi was best ever . Im coming back because of her

author: Little L (and the family)
review_text: I was surprised by how good and tasty it was (sorry Uncle Roger🤣)I have to admit. All of our food was delicious though my simple egg fried rice came a little cold compared to the rest of the food and it was a bit pricey, but it was still really tasty. Would go again.
